alt_text: A vertical scroll painting features black ink bamboo on a tan ground, with calligraphic text at the top.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll, primarily featuring an ink painting of bamboo on a light brown ground. At the top, a horizontal band of deep blue-green contains large, gold-colored calligraphic characters. Below this, a lighter green horizontal band displays multiple columns of smaller, black calligraphic text. The main body of the scroll is a light tan or beige color, serving as the background for the bamboo. Several bamboo stalks, rendered in varying shades of black ink, rise from the lower right and extend upwards and across the central portion of the painting. Some stalks and leaves are depicted with dark, solid ink, while others are lighter and more translucent, creating a sense of depth. The bamboo branches extend both to the left and right, with clusters of pointed leaves. Towards the bottom right, dark, amorphous shapes suggest rocks or ground from which the bamboo emerges. A small red seal is visible below the calligraphic text on the lighter green band.

metadata.title: 탄은 이정	 대나무   조선|灘隱 李霆	墨竹圖	朝鮮|Bamboo in the Wind
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink on silk with gold on colophon

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a dense cluster of bamboo stalks and leaves against a light background
long_description: This horizontal ink wash painting features a dense cluster of bamboo rendered in varying shades of black and gray ink on a light, tan-colored background. On the left, several thick bamboo stalks rise vertically, some appearing lighter and more in the background, while others are darker and more prominent. These stalks show distinct nodes and segments. Interspersed among the stalks are numerous thin, delicate branches and smaller leaves, also in lighter ink washes. In the center and extending to the right, a large, prominent branch arches downwards, covered with numerous broad, dark ink leaves. These leaves are painted with strong, sweeping brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. Further to the right, more bamboo leaves and thinner branches are visible, some overlapping and creating depth. The background is largely empty, providing a stark contrast to the detailed bamboo. In the upper right corner, a vertical column of dark calligraphic text is present, reading from top to bottom: "宋蘇東坡墨竹真蹟神品". Below and to the left of this text, several red square seals are stamped onto the painting, with additional seals appearing in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: 清　佚名　蘇軾(僞款)　墨竹圖　卷|Bamboo

alt_text: A person riding a large turtle, holding a fishing rod, with a distant city in the clouds above
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a person riding a large turtle, with a distant city in the upper background. The background is a light, muted yellow-beige. In the upper third of the painting, faint, misty mountains rise above a city. The city features multiple tiered structures, possibly pagodas or temples, and a bridge, all rendered in soft greens and grays, appearing partially obscured by clouds or mist. In the middle section, a person is seated on the back of a large, dark green and brown turtle. The person wears a blue robe with brown accents and light-colored, flowing lower garments. They have dark hair styled in a topknot and a mustache. A long, thin fishing rod extends from their hands towards the upper left. Behind the person's head, a dark, swirling mass, possibly hair or a cloud, extends upwards and to the left. The turtle is depicted with a textured shell, its head and four legs visible as it moves through faint blue-green washes that suggest water or clouds. In the lower left quadrant, below the main figures, there is vertical black script followed by a red square seal. The artwork is framed by a muted gray-green border with a subtle pattern, and narrow gold patterned fabric strips at the very top and bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A traditional painting shows numerous women in colorful robes on a multi-level building and in a garden beside a pond.
long_description: The painting features a scene with numerous women, a multi-level building, a pond, and a garden, all set against a gold-flecked background. The composition is divided, with a large, blue pond on the upper left, its surface marked with wavy lines. Below the pond and extending to the lower left is a sandy-colored ground area. In this area, several women are depicted, some kneeling or walking, dressed in long, patterned robes of white, green, and red. A small garden with white and red flowers and green foliage is visible in the lower left. To the right and center, a multi-tiered wooden building dominates, featuring open platforms, staircases, and sections with green railings and black lattice screens. The building's structure is light brown with green accents. Many women are positioned throughout the building, sitting or kneeling on the various levels. Their long black hair is visible, and they wear elaborate, flowing robes in shades of gold, green, red, blue, and white, often adorned with intricate patterns. Some women appear to be interacting, while others are engaged in individual activities, such as holding a red flower or a fan. A small, dark green bush is situated at the base of the building on the lower right. The entire scene is framed by a textured, gold-flecked border, particularly prominent at the top and bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Album of twelve paintings; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A gray and black cat with a patterned collar crouches, intently watching a small spider on a light floor next to a screen
long_description: The artwork depicts a cat intently focused on a spider on a light-colored floor. The cat, positioned in the upper right and center, is mostly gray with a dark gray head and ears, and white markings on its face, including around its eyes and muzzle. Its body is a lighter gray, rendered with fine brushstrokes suggesting fur texture. The cat wears a decorative collar or bib around its neck, featuring a vibrant pattern of orange, blue, and green shapes. Its eyes are light-colored, and its whiskers are visible, extending outwards. The cat is in a low, crouching posture, with its front paws visible and its head lowered, looking directly at the spider. In the lower left corner of the image, a small, brown spider with eight legs is depicted on the light, plain floor. The spider is significantly smaller than the cat, appearing as a tiny detail in comparison. To the left of the cat and extending from the top to the bottom of the image is a vertical structure, possibly a screen or door frame. This structure has a dark, thick vertical border on the right, a thin white vertical line next to it, and a wider, light beige panel to its left. The background behind the cat and the floor is a uniform, light gray-beige color, providing a simple setting for the interaction between the cat and the spider. There is some visible text in the lower right corner, consisting of black characters and a red seal.

metadata.title: 猫に蜘蛛図|Cat Watching a Spider
metadata.medium: Album leaf; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two cats in a muted landscape with a bird and various plants and flowers.
long_description: A horizontal painting depicts two cats and a bird in a muted, earthy landscape with various plants. The background is a light, warm brown with subtle undulations suggesting ground. On the left, a white cat with a dark brown patch on its left cheek lies on its stomach, looking upwards and slightly to the right. Its eyes are yellow. It is partially obscured by a cluster of green foliage with several bright red, open flowers and some smaller purple flowers. Above and to the far left, a section of a tree trunk with green leaves extends into the frame. In the center, more green leaves and sparse grasses emerge from the ground. On the right side of the painting, a second white cat stands on all fours, facing left. This cat has several brown and black patches on its back and a bushy, striped tail that curves upwards. It holds a small, brown and white bird gently in its mouth. Its yellow eyes are focused on the bird. Behind this cat, more green foliage, including some bamboo-like leaves, rises from the ground. The overall composition places the cats as central figures amidst the natural elements.

metadata.title: 清　佚名　明宣宗(僞款)　唐苑嬉春圖　卷|Spring Play in a Tang Garden
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink drawing of children running from a snake, while another figure chases it with a long stick.
long_description: An ink wash drawing on a light, uncolored background depicts a dynamic scene with multiple figures and a snake. On the far left, a single small figure, possibly a child, runs to the left with arms outstretched and head turned back, its dark hair appearing spiky. To its right, a dense cluster of approximately eight to ten similar small figures runs to the right, their bodies overlapping, some looking forward, others glancing back. All figures are rendered with dark ink lines, showing movement and expression. A thin, dark snake slithers horizontally across the central empty space, positioned between the two groups of figures. On the far right, a larger figure, possibly an adult, runs to the right with a long, thin stick raised high above its head. This figure has long, dark, flowing hair and wears a robe with some light green and dark gray ink washes. Behind and around this figure are sparse, vertical ink strokes suggesting tall grass or reeds. In the bottom right corner, there is a vertical column of black text and a red square seal.

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicting two birds, a flowering tree, rocks, and plants on a light brown background
long_description: This is a multi-panel screen painting featuring a natural landscape on a light brown, textured background. The screen is composed of six vertical panels. On the far left, the panels are largely empty, showing only faint, wispy vertical lines of light brown. Moving right, a cluster of white flowers with long, dark green leaves emerges from the bottom edge of the second panel. In the center, two birds are depicted. One bird, with a dark head, white chest, and dark wings with white markings, is perched on a small, rounded brown rock formation, looking downwards. Below this rock are small green plants and a few white flowers. Above and to the right of the perched bird, a second bird with similar markings is shown in mid-air or perched on a thin branch, facing right. To the right of the birds, a large, gnarled tree trunk with several branches extends upwards and to the left. These branches are adorned with numerous small, delicate white flowers. The tree is rooted amidst a complex arrangement of large, angular brown and gray rocks. Green foliage grows around the base of the tree and within the crevices of the rocks. The far right panels continue the rock formations and show a lighter brown, slightly undulating background suggesting distant terrain. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, grays, and greens, with accents of white from the flowers and the birds' plumage.

metadata.title: 狩野山卜筆四季花鳥図屏風|Birds and Flowers of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Two vertical scroll paintings depict misty, mountainous landscapes in muted tones of brown, gray, and black.
long_description: Two vertical scroll paintings are presented side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a central rectangular painting framed by a light, unpatterned border, which is then surrounded by a wider border of light green fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern. The top and bottom sections of the scrolls are also made of this patterned light green fabric, with wooden rollers visible at the very bottom. The paintings themselves are ink wash landscapes, predominantly in shades of dark brown, gray, and black, with lighter, faded areas suggesting mist or distance. The left scroll depicts a towering, craggy mountain range on the left, with peaks fading into a hazy background. Below, a body of water or river is visible, with faint indications of land or structures along its banks. The right scroll presents a similar scene, with a large, irregular mountain mass dominating the upper right, also partially obscured by mist. The lower section of this painting shows a flatter landscape with water and indistinct details. Both paintings convey a sense of depth and atmosphere through the use of varying ink washes, creating a monochromatic, ethereal quality.

metadata.title: 해질녘 산사의 종소리 조선|煙寺暮鍾圖 朝鮮|Evening bell from mist-shrouded temple (left); Autumn moon over Lake Dongting (right)
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on silk

alt_text: Monochrome artwork showing an armored warrior, a bell-shaped object with text, and smaller figures in a turbulent, wavy environment.
long_description: A monochrome artwork, likely an ink drawing or print, is centered within a decorative blue border with gold patterns, which is then framed by a speckled gold outer border. The central image depicts a dynamic scene with two prominent elements. On the right, a large, muscular figure in elaborate patterned armor, including a helmet with a feather-like plume, is shown in a crouched or lunging pose. This figure has a fierce expression with a beard and open mouth, and appears to be emerging from or interacting with stylized waves that rise around its lower body. On the left, a large, bell-shaped or dome-shaped object, covered in rows of small, dense text, rests on a rocky or wavy base. Below this object, several smaller figures are depicted, some appearing to be prostrate or in supplication, also surrounded by waves. One of these smaller figures is a seated deity with a halo. Stylized waves fill the background behind all the figures. Vertical lines of text are visible in the upper right and left portions of the central image area. The blue border features a repeating pattern of stylized golden birds and cloud-like scrolls.

metadata.title: 『画本葛飾振』|Picture Book in the Katsushika Style (Ehon Katsushika-buri)
metadata.medium: Folding album of twenty-eight block-ready drawings (hanshita-e) for book illustrations; ink on paper with woodblock-printed borders and titles

alt_text: A horizontal scroll painting depicting a walled garden with traditional buildings, various trees, and distant hazy hills
long_description: This horizontal scroll painting features a landscape rendered in muted tones of gray, green, and light brown, with subtle red accents. The composition is divided horizontally by a long, light gray wall that traverses the middle ground. In the upper left corner, several columns of black ink calligraphy are visible, accompanied by two red square seals. Below and to the right of the calligraphy, a tall, winding gray wall with a textured top edge extends from the left, partially obscured by a large, dark green pine tree with a gnarled trunk and a lighter green weeping willow tree. Behind this wall, hazy gray forms suggest distant mountains or clouds, interspersed with patches of dark green foliage. Above the central horizontal wall, a cluster of traditional-style buildings with dark, tiled roofs are nestled among dense green trees. Two slender poles, each topped with a small red flag, rise behind these structures. Below the central wall, a verdant garden space unfolds, populated by various trees with both dark and lighter green leaves. Towards the far right, a prominent open-sided building with a dark roof, light brown wooden supports, and red vertical elements stands within this garden. A low, light-colored fence delineates a section of the garden in front of this building. The sky across the upper portion of the painting is a uniform, hazy light gray, suggesting an overcast atmosphere.

metadata.title: 清　楊天壁　敬芝軒第貳圖　卷|Second View of the Studio for Respecting the Fungus of Longevity
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling town with many people, buildings, and a large arched bridge
long_description: The painting is a wide, horizontal composition depicting a bustling urban landscape rendered in a muted palette of browns, grays, and dull greens, accented by reds and blacks. The scene is densely populated with numerous figures, buildings, and trees, suggesting a lively town or city. Starting from the left, several dark-roofed buildings with red walls are visible, interspersed among trees with sparse foliage. Groups of small figures are scattered across the ground, some walking along paths, others gathered in small clusters. Further right, a prominent, large arched bridge dominates the central area, spanning what appears to be a waterway, though the water itself is not distinctly rendered. Many people are depicted ascending and descending the bridge, while others are in small boats beneath its arch. On both sides of the bridge, more buildings with dark, tiled roofs and red-painted sections are visible, some appearing to be multi-story structures. The areas around these buildings and the bridge are teeming with crowds of people, engaged in various activities such as walking, conversing, and carrying items. Trees with bare branches or sparse leaves are distributed throughout the landscape, adding to the natural elements within the urban setting. The overall impression is one of a vibrant, densely inhabited area with continuous activity across the entire frame.

metadata.title: 清 佚名 清明上河圖|Going Upriver on the Qingming Festival
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash landscape scroll with misty mountains, traditional buildings, water, and a small boat
long_description: A vertical hanging scroll features a grayscale ink wash landscape painting. The scroll's top and bottom borders are made of a patterned fabric with repeating floral or cloud motifs, while a textured, possibly brocade, fabric forms the middle border around the painting itself. The painting depicts a vast, misty landscape. In the foreground and mid-ground on the right, a complex of traditional buildings with multiple tiered roofs is nestled into a hillside, appearing to extend down towards the water. Jagged, rocky mountains rise behind these structures, partially obscured by a pervasive mist that fills the middle ground. On the left side, a wide body of water stretches across the scene, with a small sailboat visible near the left edge. Distant, low-lying hills are faintly visible across the water. Closer to the water's edge on the right, more smaller buildings, including a pagoda-like structure, are visible, and several small figures appear to be gathered on the land near the water. In the upper left corner of the painting, a block of vertical text is inscribed.

metadata.title: 明　佚名　傳仇英　唐宫圖　軸|A Tang Palace
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A detailed painting shows numerous figures in a lush garden, with a central group under a canopy and others scattered around
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a large gathering of figures in an outdoor garden setting. The ground is primarily green, with various trees, shrubs, and rock formations scattered throughout. On the far left, a large blue-green rock or water feature is visible. In the upper center, a large, light-colored canopy with a blue patterned border shelters a central group of approximately ten figures. Most of these figures are seated around a low, light-colored table, some holding small objects or gesturing. Others stand around the perimeter of the canopy, observing or interacting. Their clothing features various colors including blues, pinks, whites, and browns. To the left of the canopy, a group of four figures, dressed in long robes of pink, white, and light blue, walk towards the right, some holding fans or other small items. Below them, in the lower left-center, is a prominent, multi-tiered rock formation adorned with flowering plants in shades of pink and white. In the lower center, a group of four figures in long robes stands, facing towards the right. On the far right, outside the canopy, two figures are visible. One stands holding a tray with small red objects, while another kneels on the ground next to a low table with items on it. A third figure is seated on the ground further right. The overall scene is filled with numerous figures engaged in various activities within a lush, detailed landscape.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   蘇蕙璇璣圖  卷|Lady Su Hui and Her Verse Puzzle
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two figures in traditional attire, one standing and one seated, in an outdoor setting
long_description: A monochromatic artwork depicts two figures in an outdoor or courtyard setting. The image is rendered in black, white, and various shades of gray, with a textured, aged appearance. On the left, a standing figure faces right, wearing a light-toned, long-sleeved robe with a dark, V-shaped collar. Her hands are clasped in front of her, and her hair is styled in a dark, elaborate coiffure on top of her head. The lower part of her robe features distinct vertical pleats. To her left, a large, dark, ornate vase stands on the ground, and below it, a lighter, barrel-shaped object with two oval cutouts is visible. On the right, a second figure is seated on a low, dark bench or platform, facing left. This figure wears a dark-toned, long-sleeved robe with a lighter, possibly patterned, collar or trim. Her hair is also styled in a dark, elaborate coiffure. She appears to be holding a rectangular object, possibly a book or tablet, in her hands. The lower part of her robe also shows vertical pleats. In the background, behind and between the figures, faint outlines of a tree or foliage are visible, particularly above the standing figure. A low wall or structure with irregular dark markings, possibly indicating stones, extends across the middle ground.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Unmounted hanging scroll; ink and color on paper (?)

alt_text: A black and white image shows a person riding a horse, depicted in mid-stride.
long_description: The black and white image features a single figure on horseback, positioned slightly below the vertical center and extending across the horizontal center. The background is a uniform dark gray, providing a stark contrast to the lighter tones of the horse and rider. The horse, depicted in a dark gray with lighter highlights on its legs and face, is shown in mid-stride, with its front legs lifted and its back legs extended. A bridle and reins are visible, with the reins held by the rider. A saddle is on the horse's back. The rider, facing right, wears light-toned clothing, including a tunic or jacket and trousers. A headpiece or hat with a decorative element is on the rider's head. The figure's posture suggests movement, leaning slightly forward. In the upper left corner, a square-shaped block of illegible characters or a seal is visible, rendered in dark marks against a lighter background, with additional faint vertical marks to its right. The overall composition emphasizes the dynamic movement of the horse and rider.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A grayscale ink wash painting shows a spotted horse grazing near a robed figure under weeping trees and cliffs.
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting depicts a serene landscape in varying shades of gray. The upper half of the composition is dominated by towering, rugged cliffs or mountains on the left, rendered with textured brushstrokes that suggest rock formations and crevices. From the cliffs and a large, gnarled tree on the right, numerous long, drooping branches with dense, small leaves or blossoms hang downwards, creating a weeping effect that extends across much of the upper and middle ground. A faint body of water or stream is visible at the base of the cliffs on the far left. In the middle ground, a spotted horse with a light-colored body and dark, irregular spots grazes on the grassy terrain, its head lowered towards the ground. Its mane and tail are dark. To the right of the horse and slightly behind it, a robed figure stands near the base of the large, gnarled tree. The figure wears a light-colored, long robe and dark shoes, and appears to be holding a small, round object, possibly a fan, in their hands. The lower portion of the painting features undulating grassy ground with a few scattered, darker rocks. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette, utilizing a range of grays from light washes to darker, more defined lines for outlines and details.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A standing, robed figure with a beard and long hair looks down, holding an object under a dark branch.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a standing figure against a light brown, aged background. The central figure, an older-looking person with long, dark, wispy hair and a beard, is oriented slightly to the right, with their head tilted downwards. They wear loose, dark grey and black robes that drape around their body, with lighter skin tones visible on their face and chest. Their hands are positioned near their chest, holding a light-colored, rectangular object, possibly a scroll or book. The figure's feet, appearing reddish-brown, are visible at the bottom, suggesting simple footwear. Above the figure, in the upper left quadrant, a dark, gnarled branch with abstract, dark foliage extends downwards and to the right. On the far right side, a dark, vertical, abstract shape is visible, possibly another branch or rock formation. In the upper left corner, dark vertical text is present, followed by a red square seal. Another red square seal is located on the left side, roughly at the figure's mid-torso level.

metadata.title: 明   佚名  倣吳偉   漢鍾離像   軸|The Immortal, Zhong li
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A monochrome landscape painting featuring towering, textured mountains, dense pine trees, and scattered traditional buildings
long_description: The artwork is a monochrome landscape painting rendered in shades of brown, sepia, and dark grey, depicting a vast mountainous scene. The upper two-thirds of the composition are dominated by a series of imposing, rugged mountains with undulating peaks and steep, vertically striated slopes, suggesting deep valleys and cliffs. Some mountain surfaces show subtle textures resembling foliage or rock formations. In the upper right, a small, multi-tiered building with a dark roof is nestled on a mountain ledge. On the left side, at the base of a large mountain, a cluster of traditional-style buildings with dark, gabled roofs is visible, connected by what appears to be a bridge or pathway. The foreground and midground feature numerous tall, dark evergreen trees, likely pines, with distinct clusters of needles, rooted on rocky, uneven terrain. A winding, lighter-toned area, possibly a river or path, meanders through the lower part of the scene, separating the foreground trees from the larger mountain masses. The sky above the mountains is a lighter, muted brown, creating a sense of atmospheric depth.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   舊傳顧愷之   會稽山圖   卷|The Hills of Kuaiji
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Monochromatic landscape painting with mountains, tall trees, a river, a multi-tiered building, and figures with horses
long_description: The wide, horizontal landscape painting is rendered in a monochromatic palette of dark browns, greys, and lighter sepia tones, creating a hazy, atmospheric scene. In the left foreground, dark, craggy rocks rise, from which several tall, slender trees, resembling pines, extend upwards with their branches. Behind these, rounded, hazy mountains recede into the distance. Towards the center, a winding river or stream with light, textured strokes, suggesting flowing water or rapids, cuts through the midground. It flows between dark, undulating hills and rocky formations. Sparse, bare-branched trees are scattered across these hillsides. On the right side, a prominent multi-tiered building, resembling a pagoda with multiple roofs, is nestled on a mountain slope, its dark silhouette standing out. Below this building, near the river, a group of small figures and several horses are visible, appearing to traverse a path or bridge. The background on the right also features layered, hazy mountains, contributing to the sense of depth and vastness. The overall composition uses varying tonal values to define forms and create a sense of distance.

metadata.title: 明/清  佚名   舊傳郭煕   關山行旅圖    卷|Traveling amid Mountains
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Monochrome landscape painting with mountains, water, trees, a hut, and a bridge
long_description: This monochrome landscape painting, rendered in shades of dark gray and black ink on a light brown ground, depicts a vast natural scene. In the background, multiple layers of mountains rise, their peaks and slopes detailed with varying densities of trees, suggesting forests. The mountains recede into the distance, creating a sense of depth. The middle ground is dominated by an expansive body of water, possibly a lake or wide river, dotted with several small, tree-covered islands. In the foreground, a cluster of tall, leafy trees stands prominently on the left, with their branches extending upwards. To the right of these trees, a small, thatched-roof hut with a fenced enclosure is nestled on a gentle slope near the water's edge. Further to the left, a small, arched bridge spans a narrow stream or inlet. The brushwork varies from fine lines for tree details to broader washes for mountain forms. On the far right edge of the painting, a vertical column of characters is visible, accompanied by a small red seal.

metadata.title: 明/清   佚名   舊傳董源   山水圖   卷|Landscape

alt_text: Two robed figures with a pole stand near two elaborate birds on a plain background
long_description: The monochrome artwork depicts two human figures on the right and two large birds on the left, set against a light, textured background. On the right, a tall, bearded man with a wide-brimmed, pointed hat wears long, flowing robes. He holds a dark, vertical pole-like object that extends upwards, culminating in a flame-shaped top. His gaze is directed towards the left. Behind him, a smaller figure, also wearing a hat, stands partially obscured, appearing to hold onto the larger man or the pole. Both figures are rendered with dark outlines and shading, creating depth in their clothing. On the lower left, two elegant, bird-like creatures stand on long, slender legs. Each bird has a long, curved neck, a small head adorned with a crest, and an elaborate, fanned tail composed of numerous delicate feathers. The birds are positioned facing towards the right, with one slightly behind the other. Their bodies and tails are detailed with dark lines and shading, contrasting with the lighter background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink painting of bamboo stalks and leaves on a light brown background with vertical calligraphy on the right
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal rectangular painting featuring bamboo rendered in dark ink on a light brown, aged paper-like background. The composition is dominated by several bamboo stalks and numerous leaves, primarily occupying the left and central portions of the image. From the lower left, thicker bamboo stalks rise upwards, branching out into thinner stems. The leaves are depicted in various shades of dark gray and black ink, with some appearing almost solid black and others lighter, suggesting different ink washes. The leaves are clustered in groups, fanning out from the branches, and many are angled, overlapping, and appear to be in motion. Some leaves are long and slender, while others are broader. The bamboo branches extend horizontally across the middle of the painting, with some reaching towards the upper right. The background is a uniform, light brown color, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink of the bamboo. On the far right side of the painting, a column of vertical calligraphy is present, written in dark ink. The characters are arranged neatly in a single column, extending from the top to near the bottom edge of the painting. The overall impression is one of natural movement and calligraphic elegance.

alt_text: Figures and horses rest under trees in a muted landscape with rocks and foliage
long_description: The painting depicts a landscape scene with multiple figures and horses under trees, rendered in a muted palette of browns, greens, and subtle reds. The composition is horizontal, with the ground occupying most of the lower half and extending upwards. On the far left, a partial red structure, possibly a gate or building element, is visible. Below it, a large, dark, irregularly shaped rock formation with textured surfaces dominates the lower left quadrant, surrounded by green bushes. In the upper left-center, a figure dressed in light-colored robes stands next to a saddled, dark-colored horse, both positioned beneath a tall tree with green foliage. The horse faces right. Towards the lower center and extending to the right, a cluster of several trees with varying trunk widths and green canopies provides shade for a group of figures and horses. At least three horses are visible here: one light-colored horse with a red saddle cloth, another darker horse, and a third partially obscured. Several figures are interspersed among the horses and trees. One figure, possibly mounted, wears a prominent red garment. Other figures are standing, dressed in lighter robes. The ground beneath the trees is covered with sparse green patches. The overall impression is one of a resting or traveling party in a natural setting.

metadata.title: 舊傳錢選   錦堂圖   卷|Brocade Hall
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two birds with blue crests and long tails perch on a gnarled branch with white and pink blossoms against a light brown background.
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts two birds perched on a gnarled, dark brown branch that extends from the right side of the frame towards the center. The background is a plain, light brown, suggesting an empty sky. The bird on the left is larger, facing right, with a prominent blue crest on its head, a red beak, and a white patch under its chin. Its body is primarily olive green, transitioning to blue on its wings and a long, flowing blue tail. Its feet are red, gripping the branch. Behind and slightly to the right of the first bird, a second, smaller bird faces left. It also has a blue crest and a reddish beak, with a lighter, pale brown body and blue wing feathers. Delicate branches with numerous white and pale pink blossoms extend across the upper half of the painting, particularly dense on the left side and above the birds. Some blossoms are fully open, while others appear as buds. The main branch supporting the birds is thick and textured, with smaller offshoots bearing a few more blossoms and buds. The overall composition is balanced, with the birds and the main branch anchoring the right and center, and the flowering branches filling the left and upper areas.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   舊傳易元吉   八禽圖   卷|Birds on Branches
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A horizontal painting shows various white and dark birds in a serene landscape with trees, green hills, and water
long_description: The painting is a horizontal landscape rendered in a muted palette of browns, greens, and reddish-pink. The background is a warm, light brown, suggesting an expansive sky or distant atmosphere. On the far left, a large tree with a thick, dark brown trunk and branches extends upwards and towards the center. Its branches are adorned with small, reddish-pink blossoms or leaves, and several dark-colored birds perch among them. Below this tree, a series of undulating green hills and banks slope downwards, defining the terrain. Further to the right, a smaller, bare tree with dark, gnarled branches stands on a green bank, with two small, light blue birds perched on its branches. A calm body of water, depicted in a slightly darker brown-green hue, stretches across the lower half of the painting, separating the foreground banks from the mid-ground. Along the green banks bordering the water, several large white birds, resembling cranes or egrets, are positioned. Some stand upright, one appears to be preening with its head tucked, and another is bending its neck towards the water. In the upper right portion of the painting, several smaller white birds are shown in various stages of flight, with their wings spread. Additional small, dark birds are visible near the water's edge and on the branches of the trees. The overall composition creates a serene natural scene with a sense of depth and movement.

alt_text: An ink wash landscape painting on a fan, featuring mountains, trees, and a river.

In the background, several prominent mountains rise, their peaks depicted with dark, textured ink strokes that suggest ruggedness. Lighter washes of ink create a sense of atmospheric depth and mist around their bases and between the peaks. The midground is dominated by rolling hills covered with dense clusters of trees. The trees on the right side are particularly dark and full, with individual leaves or branches suggested by varied brushwork. A lighter, more open area of trees and vegetation extends towards the left. A horizontal band of lighter ink across the middle suggests a misty valley or distant water. In the foreground, a river or stream flows from the center towards the lower left edge of the fan. Its banks are dotted with small rocks and patches of land. In the lower left corner, near the river, there are a few indistinct shapes rendered in a faint yellowish-brown hue. In the upper left quadrant, several columns of vertical text are inscribed in black calligraphic script. Below and slightly to the left of the text, a small red square seal is visible. The radial lines of the fan structure are visible throughout the entire painted surface.

In the mid-ground, a cluster of trees, some with sparse branches and others with denser foliage, grows on a rocky embankment that slopes down towards a body of water. A small, simple structure, possibly a hut, is visible among the trees on the left. A calm expanse of water stretches across the middle of the fan, reflecting the distant, softer mountains in the background. A small, narrow boat with a single figure is positioned on the water, moving towards the right. On the far right side of the fan, a large block of vertical calligraphic text is inscribed in black ink, occupying about one-third of the fan's surface. To the immediate right of the pavilion, a tall, gnarled pine tree with dense foliage rises, its branches extending over the building. The rocky hill beneath the pavilion is rendered with textured brushstrokes, showing various smaller trees and dense foliage. To the left of the main structure, a stone arch bridge spans a body of water, connecting the rocky foreground to a smaller, tree-covered landmass in the mid-ground. On this distant landmass, another smaller, simpler pavilion is partially visible amidst the trees. The water surface is calm, reflecting the light. In the background, hazy, ink-washed mountains rise, their peaks sparsely dotted with trees, creating a sense of depth and distance. The sky above is a uniform, light tone, blending into the distant mountains. The entire scene is depicted using varying shades of dark ink, creating a rich tonal range against the light brown paper.

The middle ground and foreground are densely populated with dark green trees, some forming clusters, others appearing as individual, gnarled forms. Throughout the lower half of the landscape, many small figures are seated on the light brown ground. These figures, dressed in light-colored robes, are arranged in various small groups, appearing to converse or interact. On the right side of the mid-ground, a prominent building with a dark roof and light-colored walls stands amidst the trees, with figures visible inside and around it. The branch is dark brown, gnarled, and appears to be bare of leaves, but is adorned with numerous white blossoms and smaller, reddish-pink buds. The bird on the right, positioned slightly lower and to the right of the first, also has a brownish body with hints of blue-grey on its wings and head, and is facing right with its beak slightly open. Its back and wings are a muted olive-green, contrasting with its white belly. Its reddish feet grasp a thin, gnarled branch that extends horizontally across the mid-section of the painting. Below the bird and extending across the lower half of the image are several large leaves. The most prominent leaf, directly beneath the bird, is broad and palmate, rendered in muted green with significant brown discoloration and numerous irregular holes, suggesting decay or insect damage. Its central veins are clearly visible. To the right and slightly above this large leaf, another branch extends with smaller, more intact leaves that are mostly brown and olive green, some bearing small dark, round objects that resemble berries. This bird appears to be facing downwards, with its reddish-brown head and part of its back visible, suggesting similar plumage to the first bird. long_description: The artwork features a botanical painting on a light tan, rounded rectangular background. A single branch of a camellia plant extends diagonally across the composition, originating from the lower left and reaching towards the upper right. The focal point is a large, fully bloomed red camellia flower situated in the upper central portion of the image. This flower displays numerous layered petals, creating a full, rounded form. Below and to the left of the large flower, the branch is adorned with several dark green leaves. These leaves are oval with pointed tips and show subtle variations in shading, suggesting depth. Further along the branch, towards the lower left, a smaller, partially opened red camellia bud is visible, encased by green sepals and surrounded by additional green leaves. Another smaller, tightly closed bud appears further to the right on the branch. The branch itself is brown, with a slightly textured appearance, and small, sharp thorns are visible along its length, particularly towards the lower right. In the bottom left corner of the tan background, a small, square red seal with dark characters is present. The painting depicts the plant with a clear, detailed style against a plain, unadorned background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan mounted as an album leaf; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Insects fly among green leafy branches with yellow and pink flowers on a light brown background
long_description: This artwork depicts a vibrant natural scene on a light brown, rounded background. A dense cluster of green leafy branches dominates the right and lower portions of the composition, extending towards the left. The foliage features numerous small, dark green leaves. Among these leaves, various flowers bloom: many small, light yellow or off-white daisy-like blossoms are concentrated in the upper right and center, while several larger, fringed pink flowers are scattered, with one prominent bloom in the lower left-center and another in the mid-right. Several insects are distributed throughout the scene. In the upper left, two dark, beetle-like insects appear to be in flight. A slender, light-colored insect, possibly a dragonfly or damselfly, is positioned in the upper right, near the top of the leafy branches. In the lower left-center, a yellow and black striped insect, resembling a wasp or bee, rests on one of the pink fringed flowers. A small red insect is visible on a leaf in the lower right. A red seal, containing illegible characters, is present in the lower left corner of the artwork.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   蜂舞花叢   册頁|Flowers and Bees

alt_text: A small bird perches on a branch with dark green leaves and bright red berries on a light brown background
long_description: The artwork is a circular painting featuring a bird on a fruiting branch against a plain background. The background is a uniform light brown or tan color, filling most of the circular frame. A single branch extends diagonally from the lower left quadrant towards the upper right. This branch is adorned with numerous dark green leaves, some appearing slightly lighter on their undersides, and clusters of bright red berries. The leaves are ovate with serrated edges. The berries are small, round to heart-shaped, and appear in groups of two or three along the branch. A small bird is perched on the central part of the branch, facing towards the right. The bird has a light brown body with a darker, grayish-brown head and a distinct white patch on its throat or chest. Its tail feathers are a muted brown, and its wings show subtle variations in brown and gray tones. The bird's beak is dark and pointed. It is partially obscured by the surrounding leaves and berries, positioned among them as if feeding or resting. The composition places the natural elements centrally, with ample open space around them.

alt_text: A brown bird with spread wings perches on a branch with green leaves and light green fruits
long_description: The artwork features a bird perched on a fruiting branch against a plain, light brown background. The overall shape of the painting is a rounded square. A slender, dark brown branch extends horizontally across the middle of the frame, with smaller twigs branching off. Numerous green leaves, varying in shade from dark to lighter green, are attached to the branches. Many of these leaves show signs of insect damage, with small, irregular holes scattered across their surfaces. Several round, light green fruits with a subtle reddish-pink blush are visible among the leaves, hanging from the branches. On the right side of the composition, a small bird is perched on one of the branches. The bird has a light brown back and wings, with a lighter, almost white, underside. Its head is dark brown with a lighter patch around its eye and a small, pointed beak. Its wings are slightly spread, suggesting it has just landed or is about to take flight. The bird faces towards the right, its gaze directed slightly downward. The background is a uniform, light tan or beige color, providing a stark contrast to the detailed natural elements in the foreground.

metadata.title: Untitled

alt_text: A painting depicts three light-colored, textured fruits on a thorny branch with dark green leaves against a plain background
long_description: The artwork features a branch laden with three fruits and numerous leaves, set against a plain, light brown background. The branch originates from the lower left and extends diagonally towards the upper right, displaying several smaller, thorny twigs. The fruits are roughly pear-shaped or round, characterized by a light yellow-brown hue and a textured, slightly bumpy surface. The largest fruit is prominently positioned in the upper right quadrant, with a small dark insect visible on its surface. Another fruit is situated below and slightly to the left of the largest one, partially obscured by surrounding leaves. A third, smaller fruit is visible in the lower left, also partially hidden by foliage. The leaves are predominantly dark green, with some exhibiting lighter green or brown edges, suggesting varying stages of growth or decay. They are clustered around the fruits and along the length of the branch. The background is a uniform, unadorned light brown, providing a stark contrast to the detailed botanical elements. The overall composition is balanced, with the plant elements occupying the central and right portions of the square frame.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   秋梨圖   冊頁|Branch of Tree with Fruit
metadata.medium: Album leaf; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A crested bird perches on a branch with white flowers and green leaves on a circular brown background
long_description: A circular painting features a bird perched on a flowering branch against a plain light brown background. The bird, positioned slightly right of center, faces left with its head turned slightly forward. It has a prominent crest on its head, a dark pointed beak, and dark markings around its eyes. Its chest and belly are light, transitioning to darker, possibly blue-grey, feathers on its back and wings. Hints of red are visible on its tail feathers. The branch, dark brown and gnarled, extends from the lower left, curving upwards and to the right, supporting several clusters of green leaves. Among the leaves are multiple white flowers with distinct yellow centers, resembling camellias, some fully open and others appearing as buds. A large, rectangular red seal with two columns of characters is visible at the top center of the circular composition. A smaller, square red seal with characters is located in the lower left quadrant.

alt_text: A painting depicts people playing a board game on a balcony above a garden with a large tree and lotus flowers
long_description: A horizontal painting depicts a multi-level scene with a building and a garden, rendered in earthy tones of brown and green with accents of brighter colors. On the right side of the upper half, a wooden balcony or elevated platform is visible. Six individuals are gathered on this platform. Two low, rectangular tables are positioned in the center of the group, and the individuals appear to be engaged in a board game, with small pieces visible on the table surfaces. Their attire includes robes in shades of green, blue, and light brown. One person on the far left of the balcony holds a white fan. The balcony features a dark brown railing with intricate, geometric patterns. Below the balcony, a garden scene unfolds. A large, ancient-looking tree with a thick, gnarled brown trunk and abundant green, weeping foliage occupies the left side, extending from the bottom edge of the painting upwards, partially obscuring the balcony. Three figures are present in the garden area. Near the base of the tree, a person in a brown robe stands, holding a long, thin object, and looks down at a small child in a light-colored garment who is crawling or sitting on the ground. To the right of the tree, a set of dark brown stairs with patterned railings ascends towards the balcony. A person in a green robe stands on the lower steps, facing right. Further right, another person in a light brown robe stands on the ground, also facing right. In the lower right corner, a cluster of green foliage with several light pink lotus flowers is depicted. The ground throughout the garden is a uniform light brown.

metadata.title: 明   佚名   舊傳周昉   閑庭仕女圖   卷|Women and children in a garden
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A horizontal landscape painting depicting mountains, trees with red foliage, a body of water, and small structures
long_description: A horizontal landscape painting features a muted, earthy color palette dominated by browns, dark greens, and reddish-browns. The left side is anchored by a large, dark brown mountain or cliff face, densely covered in dark green and reddish-brown foliage. At its base, a body of water extends towards the center. A small, light brown wooden bridge crosses a narrow gap in the lower left, connecting to a smaller landmass. Further right along the water's edge, a small, simple structure with a thatched roof and light brown walls is nestled among the trees and rocks. The central and right portions of the painting are filled with an undulating mountain range, also dark brown and covered in a variety of trees. Many trees display distinct reddish-brown leaves, suggesting autumn, while others are dark green. The mountains are rendered with numerous small, dark strokes, creating a rugged texture. The upper portion of the painting is a lighter, uniform brown, suggesting a sky or distant haze, with faint, darker outlines of distant peaks. The far right edge shows a white patterned border, indicating the edge of the scroll or mounting.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   舊傳范寬   煙嵐秋曉圖   卷|Autumn Landscape
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Four figures and a brown horse on a plain background, with one figure seated at a low table.
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts four human figures and a brown horse against a plain, light brown background. The surface shows signs of age with visible cracks and discoloration. On the left side, a brown horse stands facing right. Below its head, a man with a dark beard kneels on the ground, holding a dark line or rope. To the right of the horse, another man with a dark beard stands, wearing a light-colored tunic with red and blue accents and dark boots. He appears to be holding the horse's bridle. Further to the right, a man with a dark beard sits on a low, rectangular wooden table, facing left. He wears a long, light-colored robe. Behind the table, a woman stands, also facing left, holding a green fan with a red handle. She wears a long, light-colored dress with red accents at the chest. A red square seal with dark characters is visible in the upper right corner of the painting.

metadata.title: 明/清   佚名   舊傳趙孟頫   相馬圖   卷|Judging a Horse
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A horizontal landscape painting depicting mountains, trees, a winding path, and traditional buildings.
long_description: The image is a horizontal landscape painting rendered in muted tones of brown, grey, and dark green on a light, aged background. The composition unfolds from left to right, depicting a vast natural scene with subtle signs of human presence. On the far left, a winding path or river, indicated by lighter brushstrokes, meanders through a relatively flat expanse. This area is populated by numerous trees with dark, dense canopies and slender trunks, scattered across the foreground and mid-ground. As the eye moves right, the landscape transitions into a series of undulating hills and towering mountains. These mountains are depicted with textured, layered brushwork, creating a sense of ruggedness and depth, primarily in shades of grey and brown. In the central-right portion of the painting, nestled within a valley formed by the mountains and surrounded by more dark green trees, is a complex of traditional buildings. These structures feature distinct reddish-brown roofs and lighter-colored walls, suggesting a temple or a large dwelling. The mountains continue to recede into the background on the far right, maintaining the overall sense of an expansive, serene natural environment. The painting's palette and style evoke a classical landscape aesthetic.

metadata.title: 明　佚名　郭忠恕　僞款　輞川圖　卷|Wangchuan Villa
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Four horses on a plain tan background, some with red bags hanging from their bridles.
long_description: The image depicts four horses against a plain, light brown background. On the far left, a partial view of a dark brown horse is visible, facing right. Next to it, a larger, light-colored horse, possibly white or pale tan, stands facing right with its mouth slightly open. This horse has a dark mane and tail. Both the partial brown horse and the light-colored horse wear light blue or green bridles, from which a conical, bright red bag hangs below their chins. To the right of these two, another light brown horse stands, facing right with its head lowered as if grazing or drinking. Behind it, partially obscured, is a fourth horse of a similar light brown color, also with its head lowered. Both of these rightmost horses also wear light blue or green bridles, and each has a bright red, conical bag hanging from its bridle. The horses are rendered with subtle shading, giving them a three-dimensional quality against the flat background.

metadata.title: 明   佚名   八駿圖   卷|Eight Horses
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A white and a dark dove rest beneath a flowering branch on a muted brown ground
long_description: The image is a horizontal painting on a muted, yellowish-brown ground. In the lower left, two doves are depicted. The dove on the left is white, standing with its head turned slightly to the right. Its feathers are rendered with fine, scale-like details, and it has pinkish-red feet and a small red eye. To its right, a dark-feathered dove crouches low to the ground, facing left towards the white dove. This dark dove also has a small red eye. Above and to the left of the doves, a branch with light-colored flowers and green leaves extends horizontally across the upper left portion of the painting. The flowers are mostly white or very pale yellow, with some showing a darker center. The ground beneath the doves and extending to the right features sparse, delicate green and brown vegetation, suggesting grass and small plants. The overall impression is one of quiet natural observation. A vertical column of dark characters is visible on the far right edge of the painting.

metadata.title: 明/清   佚名   舊傳艾宣    鵪鶉   卷|Quail
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A black and white ink painting depicts a vast snowy mountain landscape with trees, buildings, and a lake
long_description: The image is a vertical, black and white ink painting depicting a vast, snow-covered mountain landscape. The upper portion features a dark, textured sky above a wide body of water, possibly a lake or river, with distant, undulating hills or mountains on the far bank. The middle ground is dominated by towering, craggy mountains, heavily textured with ink washes and lines, their peaks and upper slopes covered in white snow. Bare, dark trees with intricate branches are scattered across the mountainsides and valleys, contrasting sharply with the white snow. Several multi-story buildings with curved, tiered roofs are nestled among the mountains, some appearing on ledges overlooking the water. A small boat with a sail is visible on the water to the right. In the lower portion, more snow-covered rocks and trees frame a winding path that ascends from the bottom left, where small figures can be seen walking. The overall impression is one of a serene, wintry scene rendered with detailed brushwork and varying shades of ink.

metadata.title: Untitled

alt_text: A painting depicts a central seated figure in red, flanked by other figures and two small children below, amidst clouds
long_description: This vertical painting features multiple figures against a muted brown background with lighter, swirling cloud-like patterns. At the top center, a large figure sits with legs crossed, wearing a long, flowing red robe with a white undergarment. This figure has dark hair pulled back, with a small dark ornament on the forehead, and hands clasped in front. To the left and slightly below, a standing figure with a shaved head wears a long, multi-layered robe in shades of brown, red, and blue, holding a long, thin object in their right hand. To the right of the central figure and slightly lower, another figure sits, adorned in an elaborate, patterned robe with a headdress. This figure's hands are positioned near a tall, leafy plant with several red flowers in a pot, which is centrally located in the lower half of the composition. Below the plant, two smaller, child-like figures stand facing each other. The figure on the left wears a green garment with flowing blue ribbons, while the figure on the right wears a blue garment with similar ribbons. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy browns, muted reds, and subtle greens and blues. The figures are arranged in a roughly triangular composition, with the largest figure at the apex.

alt_text: A grayscale portrait of a bearded man in a hat, with calligraphic text above and patterned borders.
long_description: This grayscale image depicts a vertical scroll-like artwork. At the very top, a horizontal decorative border features a repeating pattern of stylized floral or cloud-like motifs against a darker background. Below this border, the upper half of the main field is filled with multiple columns of calligraphic text, rendered in dark characters on a lighter gray background. The text is arranged vertically, reading from right to left. Below the text, a half-length portrait of a man is depicted. He faces slightly towards the right, with a dark, multi-tiered hat covering his head. He has a prominent beard and mustache, and his facial features are rendered with subtle shading. He wears a robe, indicated by broad strokes, and appears to be holding or resting his hands on an object that extends diagonally across his chest. The lower portion of the artwork concludes with another horizontal decorative border, identical in pattern and tone to the one at the top.

alt_text: A bearded man in a hat and robe stands among tall, dark trees in a muted, vertical painting
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a lone figure standing amidst a dense forest, rendered in muted tones of brown, grey, and dark green. The central figure, an older man with a visible beard, wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat and a long, flowing robe, holding a staff in his right hand. He faces forward, positioned in the lower-middle section of the composition. Tall, dark trees, some with bare, gnarled branches and others with sparse, needle-like foliage, frame the man on both sides and extend upwards, creating a sense of depth. The trees in the foreground are darker and more defined, while those in the background appear lighter and more indistinct, blending into a hazy, atmospheric setting. Faint suggestions of distant mountains or hills are visible in the upper background. The ground in the foreground is uneven, with a few dark, angular rock formations. In the upper central portion of the painting, a faint red seal or inscription is visible. The entire painted area is bordered by a decorative fabric with patterns in light green, blue, and orange hues.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical ink painting shows a mountainous landscape with dense, gnarled trees and a winding path
long_description: The artwork is a vertical ink painting, primarily in shades of gray and brown, on a light, aged paper-like surface. The composition is divided into three main sections from top to bottom. The upper third features faint, distant mountains with soft, undulating peaks, rendered with light washes of ink, suggesting a hazy atmosphere. In the upper right corner, vertical lines of dark script are visible, accompanied by several square and rectangular red seals. The middle section is dominated by a dense cluster of trees. These trees have numerous gnarled, intertwining branches, some appearing bare or sparsely covered with small, dark marks suggesting foliage. The branches extend across the width of the painting, creating a thick, textured canopy. The trunks of these trees are less distinct, blending into the overall mass of branches. The lower third of the painting shows more substantial tree trunks on either side, framing a central area. A winding path or stream, indicated by lighter tones and subtle outlines, meanders through the foreground. The ground is depicted with textured strokes, suggesting rocky or uneven terrain, with darker lines defining contours and shadows. The overall impression is a deep, forested landscape with a sense of depth created by the layering of elements.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   倣文徵明   深林調茗   軸|Scholar Seated in Grove

alt_text: Three robed figures stand on aged paper below a column of vertical Chinese text and red seals
long_description: This vertical artwork is rendered on light brown, aged paper. In the upper left quadrant, a block of vertical text in dark ink, composed of multiple columns of Chinese characters, is visible. Below and to the left of this text block are two small, square red seals. The lower half of the artwork features three figures, likely men, drawn with thin, dark lines, arranged in a horizontal line across the bottom third of the image. The figure on the far left has a beard and wears a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves. He appears to be holding or supporting a long, light-colored scroll or piece of fabric that extends towards the center figure. The middle figure also has a beard and wears a similar long robe. He is positioned slightly behind the left figure and also seems to be interacting with the scroll, holding it with both hands. The figure on the right is slightly shorter and wears a dark, tall hat and a long robe. He has a beard and is looking towards the other two figures and the scroll. His hands are positioned as if he is about to receive or examine the scroll. The background is plain and unadorned, matching the color of the paper. Another small red seal is visible in the bottom right corner. The drawing style is simple, focusing on outlines and drapery folds, with minimal shading.

metadata.title: 明/清   佚名   舊傳方從義   三學士圖   軸|The Three Scholars

alt_text: A painting of a seated, bearded man in red robes with a green halo, on a patterned cushion.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a seated, bearded man against a plain, light brown background. The man is positioned in the lower center of the composition. He has dark skin, a full dark beard and mustache, and short dark hair. A circular, light green halo surrounds his head. He wears a red robe draped over his left shoulder, leaving his right shoulder and chest bare. A light green sash is visible around his waist. His hands are not clearly visible, but his posture suggests he is seated cross-legged. He sits on a large, green, leaf-shaped cushion, which is covered by a red cloth with a subtle patterned design. Below this cushion, to the right, is a smaller, similarly shaped green cushion, on which a pair of light brown sandals rests. The background is a uniform light brown. The central image is bordered by a decorative frame featuring a repeating pattern of dark blue and red motifs. On the right side of the painting, vertically aligned, are three Chinese characters in dark ink: "大阿羅漢像". On the left side, a longer vertical inscription in dark ink is present, followed by two square red seals stacked vertically.

alt_text: A horizontal painting depicts horses and riders in a green landscape, with a large section of text on the right.
long_description: This horizontal artwork is divided into two main sections: a painted landscape on the left and a section of calligraphic text on the right. The painted portion depicts a hilly, green landscape with areas of brown ground. In the upper left, two dark horses appear to be running across a lighter brown patch. Below them, towards the lower left, a reddish-brown horse with a lighter belly stands facing right, while another lighter-colored horse stands to its right, facing left. On a prominent green hill in the middle-right, a large, dark-leafed tree with some reddish foliage stands, accompanied by several other dark trees. Below this tree, a figure dressed in a red garment rides a dark horse, facing right. To the right of this rider, another lighter-colored horse stands. The entire painted scene has a muted, earthy color palette. The right section of the artwork features multiple columns of black calligraphic text, arranged vertically on a light, aged paper background. Several red seals or stamps are visible within and around the text.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A wide, horizontal landscape painting featuring towering, textured mountains, dense trees, and small structures.
long_description: This wide, horizontal landscape painting is rendered in muted tones of brown, beige, and dark gray, giving it an aged appearance. The composition is dominated by a continuous range of large, undulating mountains that extend across the entire width of the image. The mountains are depicted with a distinctive texture, characterized by numerous parallel, wavy lines that create a sense of ruggedness and depth. In the left portion, a massive, rounded mountain peak rises prominently, its surface heavily textured. Below it, smaller peaks and valleys are visible, with a few small, dark structures nestled into the terrain. A body of water or a river appears at the bottom left. Moving towards the center, the mountains continue, forming a complex network of ridges and valleys. Small, dark green trees are sparsely scattered among the lower slopes and in the valleys. The right half of the painting features a less dense mountainous area, with more open space in the upper right. A cluster of tall, slender trees with dark foliage stands prominently on the far right, their trunks visible. More small structures are visible among these trees and at the base of the mountains. The sky above the mountains is a uniform, dark gray-brown, blending with the mountain tops. In the upper right corner, there is a faint red seal and some illegible text.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Handscroll; Ink and color on silk

alt_text: A standing figure in elaborate robes holds a tall vase, looking gently downward.
long_description: A full-length painting depicts a standing figure with light skin, positioned slightly to the left of center against a plain, warm brown background. The figure's head is tilted slightly, and their gaze is directed gently downward. Dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun at the top of the head, adorned with small green elements. Around the neck, a gold-colored necklace is visible over a red inner garment. The figure wears a dark brown outer robe with lighter brown trim, and light blue sleeves. A tall, light yellow vase with a dark blue-green top and a red ribbon wrapped around it is held in the crook of the figure's left arm and supported by the right hand. The lower body is covered by a long, flowing white skirt or robe, from which multiple thin red and blue ribbons hang. A wide, dark green sash with blue vertical stripes extends down the front of the figure. A light pink slipper or shoe is visible at the bottom edge of the white garment.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   持瓶仕女   軸|Girl Bringing Jar of Wine
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink painting of a tall, vertical landscape with towering mountains, dense trees, and two traditional buildings.
long_description: This vertical ink painting on light brown paper depicts a vast, mountainous landscape. The upper left corner features several columns of dark, vertical calligraphy. The top half of the composition is dominated by towering, rugged mountains, rendered with dark, textured brushstrokes that suggest rocky surfaces and dense foliage. Some peaks appear to be partially obscured by mist or clouds. Below these highest peaks, a series of smaller, rounded mountains are visible, also covered in trees. A narrow waterfall or stream descends from one of these mountains on the left side, flowing into the middle ground. The middle section of the painting is filled with numerous trees, primarily tall, slender pines with dark, feathery needles, forming a dense forest that extends into the foreground. In the lower section, a cluster of large, gnarled trees with thick trunks and extensive canopies stands prominently. To the left and right of these trees are two traditional-style buildings with dark, sloped roofs and open fronts, nestled among the foliage and rocky ground. The ground is uneven and textured with ink washes and strokes. Small red seals are visible in the upper right and lower left corners of the artwork.

metadata.title: 明   佚名   倣王紱   秋窗讀書圖   軸|Landscape

alt_text: Vertical lines of black calligraphy on a light brown, aged paper scroll with faint red seals
long_description: The image displays a vertical scroll of aged, light brown paper with black ink calligraphy. The paper has a mottled, uneven texture, suggesting age and wear, with darker brown areas and lighter, almost beige tones. The calligraphy is arranged in several vertical columns, primarily from right to left, with characters of varying sizes and brushstroke thickness. The ink is a deep, matte black. The main body of text consists of three full columns on the right, followed by two shorter columns to the left, and a final, very short column further left. The characters are written in a fluid, expressive style. Towards the bottom left, there are faint red seal impressions, partially obscured and faded, appearing as irregular reddish-brown smudges. The overall impression is one of traditional script on an antique surface.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A black and white ink painting depicts a mountainous landscape with trees, buildings, water, and figures
long_description: This vertical black and white ink wash painting portrays a vast, serene mountainous landscape. In the upper section, towering, rugged mountains dominate the background, their peaks partially obscured by a soft, misty haze. Several thin waterfalls cascade down the steep rock faces. The mid-ground opens into a valley where a winding river or stream flows, its banks lined with numerous dark, dense trees, primarily appearing as pines with their characteristic needle-like foliage. Scattered throughout this forested valley are several small, traditional-style buildings with dark roofs, nestled discreetly among the trees on both sides of the water. In the lower section of the painting, more prominent trees frame the scene, with their dark trunks and full canopies. A small, arched bridge crosses a narrow section of the water on the lower left. On the lower right, a larger, open-fronted building reveals two small, seated figures within, engaged in an activity. The foreground features rocky terrain and smaller trees, leading the eye towards the central valley. Small, vertical calligraphy is visible in the upper right corner of the artwork.

alt_text: An ink painting of a mountainous landscape with a river, traditional buildings, and bamboo trees
long_description: This monochrome ink painting depicts a vast landscape scene, rendered in shades of black, grey, and the natural light beige of the paper. The composition is horizontally oriented, with a decorative border featuring green and light blue geometric patterns along the top edge. In the background, faint, misty mountains with jagged peaks rise, their forms softened by atmospheric perspective. The middle ground is dominated by a river that flows from the left, curving towards the right. On the left bank, a large, dark rock formation is covered with bamboo. Adjacent to this, a complex of traditional buildings with tiled roofs is nestled by the river. A small, low bridge with railings crosses the river in front of these structures, leading to a smaller, open-sided pavilion with a thatched roof on the opposite bank. To the right of the buildings, a prominent, gnarled tree with sparse foliage stands tall, surrounded by dense groves of bamboo. Further to the right, two small figures, appearing to be people, walk along a winding path that meanders through rocky terrain and more bamboo. The river continues to flow towards the right, showing ripples and darker areas indicating movement. In the upper left quadrant, several columns of black calligraphic text are visible: "竹話仙館", "信鮮尤九仙令", "李時高九仙利", "畫竹寫竹寫竹", "紅茶: 堂六仙", "雨山學佛寺如", "為以戊午月雨", "秀閣西山仙度", "李時此", "海東王華". Below the text, two red square seals are present. The overall impression is one of a serene, natural environment with human presence.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Monochromatic landscape painting depicting distant mountains, a body of water, dense trees, and a building with two figures.
long_description: A vertical monochromatic landscape painting, rendered in various shades of black and grey ink on a light brown or tan background. The upper half of the painting features a vast expanse of water or mist, with a range of distant mountains rising from it. The mountains are depicted with soft, rounded peaks and valleys, some with more defined ridges, all rendered with subtle ink washes. The sky above is a lighter, hazy tone. In the upper left corner, a block of vertical text in black ink is visible, followed by a red seal. The text reads: "急雨初收山色淨 晚風微動水光涼 幽人獨坐茅亭下 一任閒雲過石梁 丁丑秋日寫此 為子昭先生清玩 王翬". The lower half of the painting is dominated by a dense cluster of trees with gnarled trunks and rich foliage, rendered with darker ink washes and fine brushstrokes, suggesting pines and other deciduous trees. To the left of the trees, rocky terrain is depicted with textured ink strokes. To the right, a traditional building with a tiled roof, open sides, and a raised platform is nestled among the trees. Two small figures are visible inside the building, one seated and one standing. A simple bridge or walkway extends from the building to the right, crossing over a narrow stretch of water to a small landmass. A second red seal is partially visible in the lower left corner.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   倣王翬   倣李公麟草堂圖   軸|Landscape in the Style of Li Gonglin
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A traditional ink painting depicts a mountainous landscape with a pagoda, waterfall, and small figures on a path.
long_description: This square-format painting, rendered in ink and wash, presents a serene mountainous landscape with a muted color palette of grays, light blues, and greens, accented by touches of red. The composition is dominated by rolling mountains that fill most of the frame. In the upper left, a large, light-colored mountain slopes upwards, its textured surface suggesting rocky terrain with sparse vegetation. A winding path ascends this mountain, and two small, dark figures are visible on it, one higher than the other. Perched atop a prominent peak in the upper center-left is a multi-tiered pagoda with a distinctive curved roof. Red foliage and other trees surround the pagoda, adding color to the scene. To the right of the central peak, a steep, dark-green forested mountain rises, creating a deep valley. A waterfall cascades down this valley, flowing into a body of water or river at the bottom of the painting. The foreground features more textured landforms and sparse vegetation. The upper portion of the painting is a light gray, suggesting a cloudy sky or mist. In the upper left corner, vertical black ink calligraphy is present, reading: "溪山積雪", "桂玉生香書畫", "壬午冬日", and "王石谷". Below this text are two square red seals with indistinct characters.

metadata.title: 清   曹澗   倣名家山水   冊|Landscapes in the Styles of Various Artists
metadata.medium: Album of twelve leaves; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A long, multi-panel painting depicts a vast mountainous landscape filled with numerous small figures, trees, and traditional buildings
long_description: This horizontal painting, composed of twelve vertical panels, presents a panoramic landscape rendered in a muted palette of light brown, various greens, and subtle blues.
