alt_text: A black and white line drawing of a kneeling figure in traditional robes observing several rats.
long_description:
The image is a black and white line drawing on a light, untextured background. A large, robust figure in traditional attire dominates the left and center of the composition, depicted in a kneeling or crouching posture, facing towards the right. The figure wears loose, layered robes with wide sleeves, and a sword with a visible hilt and scabbard is tucked into a belt at the waist. The figure's hair is pulled back, possibly into a topknot, and the face has a stern expression with thick eyebrows, small eyes, a broad nose, and a closed mouth. Both hands are clasped together in front of the chest, suggesting a moment of focus or tension.

Scattered across the right and bottom-left areas of the drawing are six smaller figures of rats. On the far right, one rat stands upright on its hind legs, appearing to hold a small object. Below it, two rats are depicted in close proximity, one seemingly on top of the other. Further to the bottom right, another rat is curled up. On the bottom-left side, two more rats are visible: one stands on its hind legs holding a thin, stick-like object, while the other crouches nearby. All rats are rendered with simple, expressive lines, clearly showing their tails. The overall scene suggests an interaction or observation between the large figure and the group of rats.

alt_text: A black and white ink wash painting shows two thatched-roof houses in front of misty mountains with a rising smoke plume.
long_description: This black and white ink wash painting depicts a landscape featuring two buildings with thatched roofs in the foreground, set against a backdrop of mountains and a rising plume of smoke. The larger building is positioned in the lower-left, characterized by a dark, rectangular body and a prominent window with a white grid of nine panes. Its steeply angled thatched roof is rendered with visible, dark brushstrokes suggesting straw. To the right and slightly behind this, a second, smaller building also features a dark body and a thatched roof. To the right of the second building, a tall, dark fence made of numerous vertical stakes extends upwards. In the background, two large, softly rendered mountains or hills rise, with the left mountain appearing behind the left building and the right mountain behind the right building. Both mountains are depicted with light, diffused tones, suggesting distance or mist. In the upper-right quadrant, a dark, vertical plume of smoke or mist rises from behind the right building, curving gently to the left as it ascends into the light-toned sky. A vertical inscription of several dark characters is visible on the upper-left side, aligned with the left building's roof.

alt_text: A painting of dark, textured mountains towering over a row of small, thatched-roof houses by water.
long_description: A vertical landscape painting depicts a scene dominated by large, dark brown and orange mountains with heavily textured surfaces. The largest mountain rises on the left, extending almost to the top edge, with smaller, similarly textured peaks to its right and in the lower center. These mountains are covered in numerous small, dark dots, giving them a rough appearance. Faint, light green lines resembling vines hang from the upper left mountain. In the lower left and center, a row of approximately six small, white houses with light brown, thatched roofs are situated along a wavy, gray path or body of water. In the background, lighter, muted gray and green mountains are visible behind the prominent dark peaks. The sky or background is a light, uniform beige-gray. On the lower right mountain, a small red square seal and some vertical black script are visible.

alt_text: A tall, narrow ink painting shows a waterfall flowing between dark, craggy mountains.
long_description: The artwork is a tall, narrow scroll painting, primarily executed in shades of black and gray ink on a light beige paper, and framed by a dark blue border with a subtle patterned design. A wide waterfall dominates the central vertical axis, depicted as a light gray, almost white, band flowing from the top of the composition downwards. On the right side, a dark, textured mountain face, rendered with heavy ink washes and jagged brushstrokes, descends alongside the waterfall. Its surface shows variations in ink density, suggesting rock formations. On the left, a narrower, dark cliff edge also frames the waterfall, appearing more abrupt and less detailed than the right side. At the bottom of the waterfall, several rounded, dark ink forms are visible, resembling rocks or water churning, with lighter, curved lines above them suggesting spray or smaller waves. A series of lighter, arcing lines further indicate the movement of water at the base. In the lower right quadrant, a small red square seal and some black calligraphic characters are visible.

alt_text: A dark fish swims upward on a light brown scroll, with faint ink washes suggesting water and mist.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a dark, fish-like creature rendered in ink on a light brown paper background. The fish is positioned in the lower right quadrant, oriented to swim upwards and slightly to the left. Its body is depicted with varying shades of dark gray and black ink, showing distinct scales and fins. Below the fish, faint, swirling lines of light gray ink suggest water movement. Above the fish, extending vertically towards the top of the scroll, is a very subtle, almost transparent streak of lighter ink, possibly representing mist or a waterfall. In the lower right corner, beneath the fish, there is a small, dark inscription and a circular red seal. The central artwork is bordered by a narrow, light brown frame, which is then enclosed by wider, dark brown bands at the very top and bottom of the scroll.

alt_text: Two figures in elaborate robes, one holding a branch, stand before a flowering tree on a brown background.
long_description:
The artwork is a vertical painting on a light brown background, depicting two figures in traditional attire, positioned slightly right of center. The taller figure stands in front, facing left, with her head turned slightly to the left. She wears a long, flowing outer robe in a muted brown or tan color, trimmed with a vibrant red border along the bottom and down the front opening. A wide, patterned sash or sleeve in shades of green and blue with red tassels hangs from her left side. Beneath the outer robe, a lighter-colored garment is visible. Her dark hair is styled upwards, adorned with prominent red and gold ornaments that resemble a fan or leaves. She holds a long, slender, dark object, possibly a branch, extending upwards from her right hand.

Behind and to the right of the taller figure, a second, shorter figure is partially visible, facing right with her head slightly bowed. She wears a rich red robe with a white collar, decorated with subtle patterns. Her dark hair is also styled upwards, adorned with intricate silver or white ornaments. In the upper right quadrant of the painting, a branch with delicate white blossoms extends downwards, suggesting a flowering tree. Faint, lighter patterns are scattered across the brown background, particularly around the figures' lower robes. Small, vertical script is visible in the lower right corner of the painting.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A monochrome ink painting shows a boy riding a dark bull, holding a stick.
long_description: This monochrome ink painting on a light beige paper depicts a boy riding a bull. The composition is centered, with the figures occupying the lower right half of the frame. The boy, rendered with simple, fluid black ink lines, sits astride the bull's back, facing towards the left. He has short, dark hair and wears a simple, light-colored garment with visible folds. His right hand holds a thin, dark stick that extends forward. The bull is depicted in dark, almost solid black ink, with visible brushstrokes giving texture to its body. It has two short, curved horns, and a rope or bridle is visible around its snout. The bull's legs are in motion, suggesting it is walking or trotting, with its front right leg lifted. The ground beneath the bull is indicated by faint, light gray washes. In the upper right corner of the painting, there are two vertical lines of black calligraphic characters, and below them, a square red seal impression.

alt_text: Two smiling robed figures in ink wash, one pointing skyward, the other holding a broom.
long_description: The image is a vertical ink wash painting on a light tan paper scroll, framed by a gold patterned border at the top and bottom, and a dark green patterned border on the sides. Two figures are depicted in the lower half of the scroll, rendered with expressive black and grey ink strokes. The figure on the left is a standing person with a wide, smiling face, long dark hair, and a visible beard. This figure wears loose, flowing robes, cinched at the waist with a dark sash and ties. The right arm is raised, with the index finger pointing directly upwards. The figure's gaze is directed towards the second figure. The figure on the right is seated or kneeling, facing the first figure and looking upwards. This figure has a rounder face, a slight smile, and dark hair tied up. Loose robes drape around this figure, and a broom or whisk with a dark handle and bristles rests on the ground beside the right foot. Both figures wear simple footwear resembling sandals. The background is a plain, light tan color, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink figures. A small, square red seal is visible in the bottom right corner of the painted area.

metadata.title: 寒山拾得図 (Kanzan Jittoku zu)|Hanshan and Shide

alt_text: A gray kettle hangs over embers beneath a red-leafed maple tree next to a large brown rock
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a natural scene with a prominent tree, a hanging kettle, and a large rock. A thick, dark brown tree trunk with a few small dark growths on its right side extends from the upper right, curving leftward across the top third of the image. Numerous clusters of bright red, star-shaped leaves, characteristic of maple, densely cover the branches on the left side. From a branch near the center, a thin dark rope hangs down, suspending a light gray, rounded kettle with a small lid and a light brown, U-shaped handle. Below the kettle, a small cluster of red and orange embers glows, surrounded by a dark gray, smoky or shadowed area that extends upward behind the kettle. To the right of the kettle, another thin dark string hangs from the same branch, adorned with a vertical series of small, irregularly shaped, roundish objects in shades of brown and white. On the far right, a large, rounded, textured brown rock formation rises from the bottom edge, extending upward to about two-thirds of the image height. Patches of thin green grass or moss grow on the rock's surface. The background is a plain, light beige color. A small, faint red seal is visible on the lower right side of the rock.

alt_text: A monochrome drawing of a turtle with a patterned shell, its head raised, moving through swirling water.
long_description: The artwork is a monochrome drawing depicting a turtle in profile, facing left, against a plain, light background. The turtle occupies the central and lower-left portion of the composition. Its head is raised and turned slightly upwards, revealing a pointed snout and a small, faint reddish mark on its forehead. The turtle's skin on its head and legs is textured with small bumps and folds. Its four legs are visible, with clawed feet, and appear to be in motion. The large, domed shell of the turtle is intricately patterned with hexagonal and pentagonal shapes, outlined in dark ink. From beneath and around the turtle's body, particularly from its rear and sides, emanate numerous swirling, wavy lines, suggesting movement through water or clouds. These lines are drawn with varying thickness, creating a sense of depth and flow. The overall impression is of a powerful creature in dynamic motion. The drawing is executed with dark ink on a light, possibly aged, paper.

alt_text: An armored figure with a sword battles a large hairy beast, with a coiled snake and scattered text.
long_description: This black and white ink drawing depicts a dynamic scene centered on an armored human-like figure engaged with a large, hairy, four-legged beast. The beast, resembling a lion or mythical creature, is heavily furred with a prominent mane around its head, sharp claws, and a long, striped tail that curls upwards. It wears segmented armor on its back and legs, and its head is turned to the left with an open mouth revealing teeth. Perched on or intertwined with the beast is an armored figure, wearing a helmet with a decorative plume and segmented body armor. This figure holds a sword with a decorative hilt, pointing downwards. The figures are positioned in the lower-left and center of the composition, suggesting a struggle or a ride. In the upper right quadrant, a coiled snake with patterned scales is depicted. Various calligraphic characters and abstract shapes are scattered across the background, including cloud-like swirls, a rectangular banner with small marks, a diamond-shaped grid pattern, and several lines of text.

alt_text: A dynamic ink drawing of a scowling, bearded man in a robe with two swords, lunging forward with splayed fingers.
long_description: The image is a monochromatic ink drawing depicting a single male figure in a dynamic, aggressive pose. The figure is positioned centrally, lunging towards the right with his body angled. He has a scowling expression with furrowed brows, a bald pate, and a full beard and mustache rendered with dark, thick lines. Long, dark hair flows from the sides of his head, extending behind his shoulders. He wears a loose-fitting robe, depicted with broad, dark brushstrokes and lighter gray washes, suggesting folds and volume. A wide sash or belt is visible around his waist, from which two short swords or daggers are tucked, one on each side. His left arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand clenched into a fist near his chest. His right arm is extended outwards to the right, with fingers widely splayed. His legs are bent, indicating a crouching or lunging movement, with the right leg extended further back. The background is a plain, light gray, emphasizing the figure.

alt_text: A stout man with a topknot and beard holds a large red bowl of yellow liquid, looking intently into it.
long_description: A full-body, front-facing depiction of a stout, older man seated and hunched over a large, shallow red bowl. He holds the bowl with both hands, positioned directly in front of his face, and looks down into the pale yellow liquid it contains. Concentric rings are visible on the surface of the liquid. The man has a dark mustache and a short, dark beard. His dark hair is pulled into a topknot, with a light blue patch visible on his scalp. His skin is light-toned, with reddish accents on his face and hands. He wears a dark gray or black outer garment with a lighter gray grid pattern, over a light blue undergarment visible on his arms and chest. Dark gray or black clothing covers his lower body. A sword hilt with gold and blue details protrudes from behind his left shoulder. Another sword, with a gold and purple hilt and scabbard, lies on the ground near his right leg. The background is a plain, light gray wash.

alt_text: Black and white print of a bearded man in elaborate robes seated on a fur-covered throne, holding a scroll
long_description: A vertical black and white print depicts a man seated centrally, facing slightly towards the left. He has a long, dark, flowing beard that extends to his waist and a prominent mustache. His eyes are narrow, and his eyebrows are thick. He wears an elaborate headdress with decorative elements and voluminous, layered robes with wide sleeves. The man is seated on a large, ornate chair or throne, which features prominent, shaggy fur-like armrests that drape over the sides. His right hand holds a rolled scroll, which has some visible script on its surface. Various lines of script are also visible in the upper left, upper right, and center of the print, as well as on the man's chest. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure.

alt_text: Ink drawing of a smiling child pointing at a long scroll with large characters and vertical script.
long_description: A monochromatic ink drawing depicts a smiling child holding a long, vertical scroll. The child, positioned slightly to the right of center, has a round face, short dark hair, and closed eyes, indicating a joyful expression. They wear a loose-fitting garment with a prominent ruffled or fur-like collar and trim around the cuffs and hem. The child's right hand points to the upper section of the scroll, which is filled with several large, dark, abstract shapes or characters. Below these, lines of smaller, vertical script are visible. The scroll extends from above the child's head to below their waist, where their feet, clad in what appear to be sandals, are visible. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

alt_text: A drawing of a shaggy-haired figure with a drum and barrel, alongside three insects and a nest
long_description: The artwork is an ink drawing on a light-colored, rectangular paper, featuring black lines with selective red accents. The composition is divided, with smaller elements in the upper left and a larger figure dominating the lower right. In the upper left quadrant, three winged insects, resembling wasps or bees, are depicted in black ink. Each insect has a distinct body and two pairs of wings. To their right and slightly above, a detailed, textured beehive or wasp nest is rendered with numerous small, circular cells. In the upper right corner, a few faint, short, curved black lines are visible. The lower right portion of the drawing features a figure, primarily outlined in black ink with red lines highlighting its hair and clothing details. The figure has shaggy, red-lined hair and appears to be seated or reclining. It holds a large, round, drum-like object in front of it, from which a thin pipe extends to the left. To the right of the figure, a barrel-like object stands upright, adorned with a circular, multi-petaled flower design on its side, also accented with red lines. The figure's body is partially obscured by these objects, with flowing black lines suggesting its form. The background is otherwise plain.

alt_text: A hunched, bearded man in a loose robe leans heavily on a bamboo-like staff, with one bare foot visible.
long_description: A drawing depicts a single, elderly-looking man, hunched over and leaning on a tall staff, against a plain, light-colored background. The man is positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing towards the left side of the frame with his head bowed. He has a long, white beard and mustache, and his face shows subtle red coloring on the cheeks and around the eyes. He wears a loose, flowing robe, rendered with broad black outlines, which drapes around his body. Around his waist, a sash or belt is visible, from which several small objects hang, including a rounded, gourd-like shape and a rectangular pouch with a patterned design. His right hand grips the top of a slender, segmented staff, which extends downwards to the ground. His left foot is visible at the bottom left, bare and appearing to step forward. The artwork primarily uses black ink outlines, with minimal red color accents on the man's face and possibly the staff's handle. Faint handwritten text at the bottom right corner reads: "a Hermit. with cane".

alt_text: Two smiling figures, one serving food to the other, under an umbrella with bottles and a woven basket.
long_description: The artwork is a black ink drawing on light-toned paper, depicting two figures engaged in a meal under an umbrella. The figure on the left is seated, facing right, with a large, rounded bundle strapped to his back. He has a smiling face with large ears and holds a small, shallow dish in his hands. The figure on the right is kneeling, facing left, also with a large, rounded bundle on his back. He has a similar smiling face with large ears and holds a ladle, appearing to scoop food from a large, shallow bowl placed on the ground between the two figures. The bowl rests on a stack of two flat, rectangular objects. Above and behind the figures, a large, dark umbrella or canopy is partially open, supported by two visible poles extending upwards and to the left. In the upper right background, faint outlines of rectangular structures are visible. In the foreground, on the ground, several objects are arranged. To the left, a small, cylindrical object with a tassel lies horizontally. Next to it, a large, round, woven basket or jar with a distinct chevron pattern stands upright. To the right of the basket, three empty bottles of varying heights and shapes are positioned. The drawing uses bold, calligraphic lines and washes of black ink. Faint handwritten text in the bottom right corner reads "Ebisu and Daikoku" and "obtaining new year's fortune". The number "15" is visible in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: Ink drawing of a seated figure in a dark robe and hat, holding a large round fan and a bamboo staff.
long_description: The artwork is an ink drawing on a light, off-white paper, depicting a single, seated figure facing forward. The figure wears a dark, loose-fitting robe with wide sleeves, and a dark, square-shaped hat. The face is rendered with simple, dark lines, showing closed eyes, a small nose, and a thin mouth, with a short beard and mustache. A lighter-colored garment is visible around the neck and chest, beneath the dark robe. A long, slender, light-colored staff, possibly bamboo, leans against the figure's right shoulder, extending upwards past the head. The figure holds a large, round fan in front of their body, covering the lower torso and lap. The fan has a light-colored surface with a dark, patterned border composed of short, angled strokes resembling chevrons. In the central area of the fan, four small, dark, irregular shapes are visible, resembling written characters or symbols. The figure's hands are visible at the bottom of the fan, holding a short, light-colored handle. The background is a plain, light tone, with some faint, lighter gray washes around the figure, suggesting depth or shadow. The drawing uses varying ink tones, from solid dark areas to lighter washes and fine lines. In the bottom left corner, handwritten text reads "NA 3332" and "10-". In the bottom right corner, handwritten text reads "Rikyu" and "Zen Master".

alt_text: Three turtles, two large and one small on a larger one's back, with leafy plants, in an ink drawing.
long_description: The image is an ink drawing on light-colored paper, depicting three turtles and various plant forms. Two large turtles are positioned diagonally across the composition, with a smaller turtle riding on the back of the lower large turtle. The upper large turtle faces towards the upper right, its shell detailed with a hexagonal pattern. Its head, four legs, and tail are visible, rendered with black ink outlines and some internal shading. Below it, the second large turtle faces towards the lower right, also featuring a hexagonal shell pattern, visible head, legs, and tail. A small turtle rests on the center of this lower turtle's back, mirroring its direction and also displaying a hexagonal shell pattern. Faint red lines are visible on the shells of both the lower large turtle and the small turtle. Surrounding the turtles are several clusters of dark, leafy plant forms, rendered with loose brushstrokes, suggesting foliage or aquatic plants. The background is a plain, light tone, with the drawing area having a slightly irregular, rounded shape against the rectangular paper.

alt_text: Two muscular, long-haired figures in a dynamic, wrestling-like struggle, drawn with bold black ink lines
long_description: A black ink drawing on light, off-white paper depicts two intertwined, muscular figures in a dynamic struggle. The figures fill most of the frame, arranged diagonally from the upper right to the lower left. The lower figure, positioned on its back or side, has its head turned to the left and slightly downwards. It features long, flowing, dark hair and a beard, with an open mouth revealing teeth and wide eyes. Its body is heavily muscled and contorted, with visible limbs and hands. Drapery or stylized clothing flows around its form, emphasizing movement. The upper figure leans over the first, appearing in a dominant position. This figure has shorter, wavy hair and a more defined, human-like face with a furrowed brow. Its body is also muscular, with bent limbs and clenched hands, suggesting intense exertion. Similar drapery or stylized clothing flows around its form, mirroring the dynamic lines of the lower figure. The drawing is characterized by strong, fluid black ink lines that define the contours, musculature, and flowing elements of both figures. The background is blank.

alt_text: A watercolor and ink drawing of a turtle with two pencil sketches of turtle heads on light paper
long_description: The image displays a watercolor and ink drawing of a turtle on the right side, accompanied by two pencil sketches of turtle heads on the left, all rendered on a light-colored sheet of paper. The main turtle drawing is oriented diagonally, with its head pointing towards the lower left corner and its tail extending towards the upper right. Its shell is a blend of gray-green and reddish-brown hues, segmented into distinct hexagonal and irregular plates. The turtle's head is light gray with a prominent reddish eye, and its mouth is slightly agape, revealing a beak-like structure. All four legs are visible, featuring webbed feet and claws, and a long, segmented tail tapers behind it. To the upper left of the main drawing, a larger pencil sketch depicts a turtle's head in profile, showing its outline with two circular markings on top and fine lines suggesting texture on the neck. Below this, a smaller, less detailed pencil sketch of a turtle's head, also in profile, features similar circular markings. Both sketches are rendered in light gray pencil lines. The background paper has an aged, cream-colored appearance.

alt_text: A plump child with wild hair rides on the back of a large bear, climbing a rocky, sparse mountain.
long_description: This vertical ink and wash painting depicts a child-like figure riding on the back of a large bear, ascending a rocky landscape. The central figures are positioned slightly to the left of the vertical center, moving upwards and towards the right. The child, with plump, reddish-toned skin and a full head of dark, wild hair, wears a white robe adorned with a dark, geometric pattern. The child's expression is neutral, and its hands appear to be gripping the bear's fur or a strap. The bear, rendered in dark gray and black ink with visible fur texture, walks on all fours, its head turned slightly to the left. Its claws are visible as it grips the uneven terrain. The landscape beneath the bear consists of jagged, dark rock formations and sparse, small, dark green or black plant clusters. The background is a plain, light cream color, with the landscape elements concentrated in the lower and right portions of the image, suggesting a mountain path. The overall impression is one of movement and ascent.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and red color on paper

alt_text: Ink drawing of a muscular, grimacing figure with flowing drapery, holding a long, thin object overhead
long_description: A full-length, black ink drawing on light-colored paper depicts a dynamic, muscular male figure. The figure stands facing forward, with its body angled slightly. Its head is bald, featuring a furrowed brow, wide eyes, a broad nose, and a grimacing mouth revealing teeth. A short beard and mustache frame its face. The upper torso is bare, showing a muscular build and a prominent belly. The figure's right arm (viewer's left) is raised high and bent at the elbow, with a clenched fist holding a long, thin object that extends upwards and curves. The left arm (viewer's right) is bent at the elbow, with the hand open, fingers splayed, and a bracelet visible on the wrist. Loose, flowing drapery or sashes wrap around the figure's lower body and legs, creating a sense of movement. Both ankles are adorned with anklets. The drawing uses bold, expressive ink lines against a plain background. In the top left corner, the text "17EP11" is visible. In the bottom left corner, the text "NA 3332 7.E" appears. In the bottom right corner, the text "NIO - THE GUARDIAN" is present.

alt_text: A still life drawing of two round, fruit-like objects containing figures, resting in a woven basket with leaves.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal composition rendered in dark brown ink on a lighter brown paper. In the lower center, a long, shallow, rectangular basket with a woven pattern on its sides extends horizontally across the image. The basket's interior is dark. Resting within the basket are two large, round, fruit-like objects. The object on the left is slightly larger and more prominent. Both objects have a lighter, almost translucent circular outline, and within these circles, intricate dark brown line drawings depict multiple figures. The left object clearly shows a central figure wearing a tall, dark, fan-shaped hat, surrounded by other smaller figures and decorative elements. The right object also contains figures, though they are less distinct. Surrounding these two central objects, both to the left and right, are several dark, stylized leaves or foliage elements, some appearing to emerge from behind the fruit-like forms. On the far right side of the image, vertical dark brown text is visible, followed by a circular red seal impression below it. The background is a plain, unadorned light brown.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and color on brown prepared paper

alt_text: An old man with a long white beard and a tall hat rides a deer, holding a gnarled staff.
long_description: This monochrome ink drawing on light beige paper features an old man with a long white beard and a tall, rectangular hat, riding a deer. The man is positioned centrally, facing slightly left, with his body angled towards the viewer. His face is wrinkled, and his long, flowing beard extends down to his waist. He wears loose robes, depicted with broad, flowing brushstrokes in varying shades of black ink. His right hand holds a gnarled staff that extends downwards towards the left. The deer, mostly obscured by the man's body, is shown with its head facing left, its mouth slightly open, and two small antlers visible above its head. Its body is rendered with lighter ink washes, contrasting with the darker lines of the man's attire. The background is plain. On the right side, vertical black text is visible, with a circular red seal below it.

alt_text: A small, muscular, bald figure crouches on the head of a larger, robed, open-mouthed figure with a beard
long_description: This black ink drawing on light-toned paper depicts two figures in a dynamic, vertical composition. A smaller, bald, and muscular figure is positioned at the top, crouching with bent knees and elbows, with its hands placed on the head of the larger figure below. This upper figure has a scowling or intense expression, with visible facial features and a stout build. The lower, larger figure is depicted with an exaggerated, open-mouthed expression, showing teeth and a wide tongue. This figure has a beard and is adorned in voluminous, flowing robes with many folds and some decorative elements, possibly tassels, on the left side. Its left leg is bent and raised, with the foot pointing upwards, while its right arm extends to the right, holding a small, key-like object with a pointed end. The overall drawing is characterized by strong, fluid ink lines that define the forms and drapery, with minimal shading.

alt_text: A standing figure with long hair and a beard, wearing flowing robes, holding a decorated staff, against a plain background
long_description: The image is a monochrome ink drawing on light-colored paper, depicting a full-length standing figure. The figure is positioned centrally, facing forward, with a slight tilt to the head. A faint circular halo is drawn behind the figure's head. The figure has long, flowing hair that extends down past the shoulders, and a full beard and mustache. A small, ornate crown or headdress sits on top of the head. The face features narrow, elongated eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. Large, elongated earlobes are visible. The figure wears loose, flowing robes with wide sleeves that obscure the body shape. The left hand, with visible fingers, grasps a long, slender staff or sword hilt vertically in front of the body. The staff is decorated with intricate patterns and what appear to be small, round elements along its length. The right arm is mostly covered by the voluminous sleeve, with only a hint of a hand near the staff. The robes fall in soft folds, revealing two bare feet at the bottom, with distinct toes. The background is plain and unadorned, with some faint discoloration on the paper. The lines are drawn with varying thickness, creating a sense of depth and movement in the drapery.

alt_text: Black ink drawing of a crouching figure in traditional attire holding a long sword.
long_description: A black ink drawing on a light, untextured background depicts a single figure in a dynamic, crouching pose. The figure is positioned slightly to the right of center, facing towards the right with their head turned slightly to the left. They wear loose-fitting, wide-sleeved traditional clothing, rendered with bold black outlines and some areas of solid black ink for shading. The lower part of their garment features a geometric pattern of interlocking lines. Their hair is styled upwards and appears to be tied, with short, dark strokes. The figure holds a long, unsheathed sword with both hands, extending it towards the right side of the frame. The sword has a textured hilt and a long, straight blade. A second, shorter, sheathed sword is visible at the figure's left hip, tucked into their sash. The figure's right arm is bent, with the hand near their chest, while their left arm is extended to grip the sword. The overall impression is one of readiness or action.

alt_text: Three light-colored birds fly low over large, stylized blue and gray waves under a hazy sky
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal composition depicting three birds flying over a vast expanse of stylized waves. The upper portion of the image features a muted, hazy gray sky, with lighter areas suggesting clouds or mist. Below the sky, a faint, darker gray line indicates a distant horizon or landmass, with a few indistinct, darker shapes suggesting trees or hills. The majority of the image is dominated by large, undulating waves rendered in shades of light blue, gray, and off-white. The waves are depicted with smooth, curving lines, creating a sense of rhythmic movement. Darker blue lines define the troughs and crests of the waves, adding depth and form. On the far left, smaller, more turbulent waves with white caps are visible. Three birds, predominantly white with gray markings on their wings and backs, are shown flying low over the waves. The bird on the far left is slightly lower than the other two, with its wings spread wide and its head pointing downwards, as if diving or skimming the water. Its beak is open. The two birds on the right are positioned closer together on a large wave crest. Both have their wings raised and their heads pointing downwards, also with open beaks. Their bodies are mostly white, with distinct gray feathers on their wings and tails, and dark talons visible. The overall impression is one of dynamic movement across a vast, watery landscape.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a dark, segmented object with a tail, hanging from a string
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on light-colored paper depicts a dark, segmented object suspended by a thin line. The object, rendered in shades of black and dark gray ink, is positioned in the upper center of the composition. It has a rounded, somewhat flattened form, appearing wider than it is tall, with overlapping, scale-like segments visible across its upper surface. From the lower left side of the object, a thin, pointed, dark appendage extends downwards and slightly to the left, resembling a tail. Beneath the main body, several small, indistinct dark forms suggest legs or other lower appendages. A thin, dark line extends vertically upwards from the top center of the object, where it appears to be attached by a small knot or loop. This line continues upwards, exiting the frame at the top edge. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white, with no other elements or details visible. The artwork is contained within a rectangular area, which is mounted on a slightly larger, similarly colored sheet of paper.

alt_text: A warrior-like figure with a sword battles a large, colorful bird with prominent wings against a grey background.
long_description: The artwork presents a dynamic scene featuring a human-like figure in combat with a large bird. The figure, positioned centrally and leaning towards the right, is depicted with a sword raised in a striking motion. This figure wears an elaborate costume consisting of a dark grey robe, red and blue patterned arm and leg coverings, and blue footwear. A golden scabbard with black markings is visible horizontally behind the figure's back. The figure has dark hair, a beard, and an intense facial expression, with eyes focused on the bird. The bird is large, occupying the lower and left portions of the composition. It has a light pink body, a dark green head, and a prominent beak that is open. Its large wings, featuring dark green feathers and pink undersides, are spread wide, creating a sense of motion. The bird's head is tilted upwards, appearing to be in a struggle. The figure's left leg is bent, with the foot pointing right, while the right leg is extended downwards. The background is a muted, light grey, providing a neutral setting for the action. Japanese characters are visible in the lower right corner of the image. The overall composition emphasizes the diagonal movement and intense interaction between the two subjects.

alt_text: A black and white line drawing of a fierce, wide-eyed face with curly hair and a lotus crown
long_description: A black and white line drawing depicts a close-up, head-and-shoulders view of a figure with a fierce expression. The face is broad with wide, round eyes that have small, dark pupils. The eyebrows are thick and heavily furrowed, creating deep lines on the forehead. The nose is broad and rounded, and the mouth is downturned with two small fangs protruding from the lower lip. The cheeks are full, and there are lines indicating a double chin or neck folds. The hair is rendered as a mass of tight, concentric spirals that frame the face. On top of the head, a stylized lotus flower with multiple petals serves as a crown. On the right side of the head, a long braid of hair, intricately woven and adorned with two lotus-like ornaments, hangs down past the ear. A similar, though less detailed, ornament is visible on the left shoulder. The drawing uses strong, consistent black lines against a light, uncolored background, with no shading or color variation.

alt_text: A drawing of a man with a wide-open mouth and closed eyes, inserting a thin stick into his nostril.
long_description: The artwork depicts a single figure, likely a man, from the chest up, positioned slightly left of center against a plain, light beige background. The figure's head is tilted back and turned towards the right, with his mouth wide open, revealing a reddish tongue. His eyes are closed or heavily lidded, and his eyebrows are thick and furrowed, suggesting an intense sensation. A thin, light-colored stick is held between the thumb and forefinger of his left hand, which is visible on the lower left. The stick extends upwards and is inserted into his left nostril. The man has a prominent nose, a dark, short beard or stubble around his chin and jawline, and a visible ear with a simple ring earring on the right side of his head. His hair or a draped garment is rendered in broad, vertical stripes of reddish-brown and black, flowing down his back and shoulders. The overall color palette is limited to these reddish-browns, black, and the light beige of the background and skin tones.

alt_text: A dark bird with a red face stands as a green snake coils around its body and long striped tail.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal watercolor painting depicting a large bird and a snake on a plain, light background. The bird, positioned centrally and facing left, has a dark body with blue-black and brown feathers. Its head is dark with a prominent red patch around its eye and a small red crest on top. A white beak extends from its face. Its long neck is dark, leading to a robust body with layered wings showing shades of brown, blue, and grey. The bird stands on two light blue-green, scaly legs with visible claws. Its tail is exceptionally long, extending horizontally to the right, composed of numerous brown feathers with distinct black stripes. A greenish-grey snake is coiled around the bird's lower body and the base of its tail. The snake's head, with a visible red eye, is positioned near the bird's left leg, facing downwards. The snake's body wraps around the bird's torso, passing under one of its wings, and then tightly around the long, striped tail. The background is a simple, light beige color with subtle, soft grey washes beneath the bird, suggesting a ground plane.

alt_text: A line drawing shows an adult carrying a child on their back, while another child holds their hand
long_description: The image is a vertical, monochromatic line drawing on a light, aged paper background. It depicts two figures, one large and one small, moving from left to right across the frame. The larger figure, positioned on the left, is seen from the back, facing towards the right. This figure wears voluminous, flowing robes with distinct folds and a wide sash. A smaller figure, a child, is carried on the larger figure's back, also facing right. This child has a bald head with a small tuft of hair on top and extends their arms forward, holding a long, thin object towards a decorative element on the larger figure's head, which resembles a cluster of rounded shapes and a small lantern-like object. To the right of the larger figure, a second small figure, another child, walks towards the left, holding the larger figure's right hand. This child also has a bald head with a small tuft of hair and wears a simple robe tied with a sash. They carry a small, rectangular, lidded box in their left hand, held up near their head. Both children wear simple sandals. The drawing uses strong, fluid lines to define the forms and drapery, with minimal internal detail, creating a sense of movement. The background is plain.

alt_text: Line drawing of a woman carrying one child on her back and holding the hand of another child looking at a cage
long_description: A vertical, black and white line drawing depicts a woman with two children against a plain background. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, faces right with her head tilted down, looking towards the child beside her. Her hair is styled in an elaborate bun adorned with several small, round ornaments. She wears a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves. A baby is carried on her back, secured by a sash, with its head visible over her right shoulder. To her left, she holds the hand of a toddler who also faces right. This toddler, wearing a simple robe and sandals, holds a small, rectangular, open-work cage in their raised left hand, looking up at it. The lines are fluid and vary in thickness, defining the figures and their garments. A small, faint red seal is visible in the lower right corner of the image.

alt_text: A line drawing of a multi-tailed canine-like creature with sharp claws, on light paper.
long_description: The artwork is a black ink line drawing on a light, off-white paper, depicting a mythical creature. The creature, resembling a fox or canine, is positioned centrally, lying on its back or side with its head turned to the left. Its body is robust, and its four limbs end in sharp, prominent claws. The creature's head features pointed ears, a long snout, and an open mouth revealing sharp teeth. Its eyes are narrow and intense. From its rear, nine distinct, bushy tails fan out upwards and to the right, each rendered with individual lines suggesting fur. The creature's body is outlined with strong, continuous lines, while the fur on its tails is depicted with finer, parallel strokes. In the upper right corner of the paper, vertical lines of Japanese text are visible. The overall composition is simple, with the creature as the sole subject against a plain background.

alt_text: A person in elaborate robes playing a stringed instrument with a bow
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a person standing upright against a plain, light beige background. The person has dark hair styled in an elaborate updo, adorned with small red ribbons and delicate floral ornaments. Their face is pale with closed eyes and a small, red mouth. They wear an elaborate, multi-layered robe. The main garment is a light blue-green color, patterned with subtle dark blue floral motifs. A prominent red sash, tied in a large bow with long trailing ends, cinches the waist. Underneath, layers of brown, light yellow, and white fabric are visible, with a ruffled, lace-like white trim appearing at the collar and along the edges of the sleeves and lower hem. The bottom edge of the robe is a vibrant red, also featuring a white ruffled trim. The person holds a light brown, elongated stringed instrument in their left hand, resting it against their body. Their right hand holds a thin, dark bow with a red string, positioned across the instrument's strings. The instrument has a small, decorative, dark-colored element near its lower end. The overall impression is one of elegance and musical performance.

alt_text: A stout, smiling figure with a beard holds a fishing rod and a large fish, seated on textured ground.
long_description: The image is a vertical woodblock print featuring a stout, smiling figure rendered with bold black outlines and minimal red coloring on a light, off-white background. The figure occupies most of the frame, seated and facing slightly right with a full-frontal gaze. The figure has a round face with closed, smiling eyes, a broad nose, a wide smiling mouth, and a full beard and mustache. A simple band-like head covering is visible. The figure wears loose robes; the sleeves are patterned with geometric shapes, and a circular, stylized floral emblem is centered on the chest. In the figure's left hand, a long, thin fishing rod extends upwards. The right hand cradles a large, scaly fish with a prominent eye and fins, held against the figure's side. The figure is seated on a dark, textured mass composed of abstract, brushstroke-like shapes, suggesting rocks or turbulent water. Red accents are visible on the figure's clothing and the fish.

alt_text: Monochrome ink drawing of a dark bundled object with a cinched middle, accompanied by three spiral forms
long_description: The artwork is a monochrome ink drawing on a light, off-white paper, featuring a central bundled object and three smaller spiral forms. The central object, positioned slightly above the vertical center, is rendered in shades of dark gray and black ink. Its top section is rounded, with distinct vertical brushstrokes creating a textured appearance. Below this, a solid, dark horizontal band encircles the object, cinching it. The bottom section flares outwards, composed of lighter, more fluid horizontal and diagonal brushstrokes, suggesting a soft, fibrous texture. To the right of the central object, two smaller, dark gray spiral shapes are stacked vertically. Each spiral has a small, curved line extending from its top. To the left and slightly below the central object, a single, similar dark gray spiral form is depicted. This spiral also has a curved line extending upwards from its top. The background is a plain, light off-white, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink forms. The overall composition is simple, with the elements arranged in the lower half of the paper.

alt_text: A person in traditional clothing carries a large rectangular object on their back, leaning backward in a dynamic pose
long_description: This vertical artwork depicts a single person in a dynamic, off-balance pose, leaning significantly backward and to the left. The figure is rendered primarily with black ink outlines on a light-colored, possibly off-white, paper background. The person's head is turned sharply to the left, looking upwards. Their face and visible right arm show a light reddish-brown skin tone. They have short, dark hair and a visible ear adorned with a circular, coiled ornament or earring. A large, light-colored rectangular object is strapped to their back, angled diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. This object is outlined in black and features a small circular detail on its lower right side. The figure's right arm is raised high above their head, bent at the elbow, with the hand clenched into a fist. The left arm is mostly obscured by the body and the object. They are dressed in loose, flowing garments, including a robe and trousers, depicted with energetic black ink lines that suggest movement and fabric folds. The main garment appears light-colored, contrasting with the dark outlines. The legs are bent at the knees, and the lower legs are visible, leading to feet wearing simple sandals. The feet are angled, contributing to the sense of an unstable or active stance. The background is plain, with faint grid lines visible on the light paper.

alt_text: A person with long black hair and elaborate patterned robes reclines on a plain background
long_description: A single figure is depicted against a plain, light background. The figure occupies the central and lower right portion of the image, angled diagonally. The person has long, straight black hair that cascades down their back and over their shoulders, extending onto their robes. Their face is pale with delicate features, including thin, dark eyebrows, downcast eyes, a small nose, and a small red mouth. They wear multiple layers of richly patterned robes. The outermost robe is predominantly red, adorned with intricate patterns of gold, blue, and white floral and geometric motifs. Beneath this, layers of lighter-colored fabric are visible, including a light blue robe with small, repeating patterns, and sections of white fabric with subtle designs. Further layers feature bold black and white geometric patterns, resembling checks or waves. The sleeves and folds of the robes are voluminous, creating a sense of depth and texture. The long black hair is intertwined with the folds of the light blue and patterned robes. The background is a uniform, light beige or tan color, providing a neutral setting for the figure.

alt_text: Two black ink drawings of stylized, curved, snake-like forms with heads, on light paper with script.
long_description: The artwork features two black ink drawings of stylized, curved forms on a light-colored, irregularly shaped piece of paper. The paper has a subtle grid pattern and appears aged, with some faint discoloration. The two main drawings are arranged vertically, side-by-side, with the left drawing being a simpler, thinner outline. This left form curves upward and then down, resembling a snake with a distinct head at its lower end, featuring an eye and a pointed snout. To the right, a second, more detailed drawing depicts a similar curved form, rendered with thicker, bolder lines. This form also curves upward and then down, with a head-like element at its lower end, similar in style to the left figure but more elaborate. The interior of this right form shows a series of short, curved lines and dots, suggesting texture or scales along its upper curve. A solid black circular spot is positioned near the top of this right form. The base of this right figure is wider and more defined, suggesting a solid, ear-like structure. Between and below the two drawings, vertical lines of black Japanese script are visible. Below the script, a red, rectangular seal with intricate characters is present. The entire irregularly cut paper is mounted on a plain, lighter background.

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a bearded man in flowing robes standing on stylized waves with a sword.
long_description: The vertical ink wash painting features a single figure, a man with a long beard and mustache, rendered in black and gray tones on a light, aged paper background. The man is positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing left with his head turned to look forward. His hair is pulled back and tied into a bun on top of his head. He wears long, flowing robes, depicted with broad, dark brushstrokes for the outlines and lighter gray washes for the folds and volume. His right arm is bent, with his hand appearing to be tucked into his sleeve or holding something unseen. His left arm is mostly obscured by the voluminous sleeve. The lower part of his body and robes are shown standing on a series of stylized, dark gray wavy lines, suggesting water. Beneath his feet, a long, slender object, possibly a sword or staff, lies horizontally across the waves. On the right side of the artwork, near the bottom, two vertical characters, '友我', are written in black ink, followed by a square red seal. The overall composition is dynamic, with the flowing lines of the robes and waves.

alt_text: A black and white ink drawing of a standing figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and flowing robe
long_description: The artwork is a vertical, black and white ink drawing on a light background, depicting a full-length standing figure. The figure, positioned slightly to the left of the center, faces towards the right side of the frame, with her head turned slightly forward. She wears a large, flat, circular hat that casts a shadow over her upper face. The hat has a dark, domed center. Her hair is styled with multiple decorative elements that hang down around her ears. She is dressed in a flowing, layered garment, possibly a robe, with wide sleeves. The fabric drapes loosely around her body, creating folds and shadows rendered with varying ink washes and lines. Her left arm is visible, bent at the elbow, with the hand obscured by the fabric. Her right arm is mostly covered by the voluminous sleeve. The lower part of her garment extends to the bottom of the frame, showing the hemline and folds around her feet. In the upper right corner, a branch with several clusters of leaves or flowers extends downwards, partially overlapping the top of the hat. The background is a plain, light tone, with some faint smudges or marks visible. The drawing uses strong black lines and lighter washes to define form and texture.

alt_text: Fierce bald figure with a blue sword battles a disembodied head amidst flying debris.
long_description:
The artwork depicts a dynamic scene with two figures, one mostly complete and one a disembodied head, against a light, unadorned background. The dominant figure, positioned centrally and extending across much of the frame, is a muscular, bald man with a fierce expression. His eyes are blue, and he has a short, dark beard and eyebrows. He wears dark, flowing robes, primarily black and grey, with red and purple tassels or cords wrapped around his arms and waist. His skin is a light, pale tone, showing prominent musculature. He holds a long, thin blue sword with a red hilt, angled diagonally from the upper right towards the lower left. His body is contorted in a powerful, active pose, with his bare feet visible, one stepping forward.

Below and to the left of the main figure, a large, disembodied head lies on its side. This head shares similar features with the main figure: bald, fierce expression, blue eyes, and a short dark beard. Green, leafy or spiky elements are visible around the base of this head and also near the main figure's left arm. The entire scene is filled with small, irregular brown fragments, suggesting an explosion or destruction, particularly around the sword and the figures' limbs. In the upper left corner, vertical Japanese characters are visible: "深知魯尚和花".

alt_text: A two-panel monochrome drawing featuring a disembodied head peeking from a wall and a horned, bearded figure with a serpentine body on rocks.
long_description: This monochrome drawing on light-colored paper is divided vertically into two distinct scenes. The left panel features a disembodied head with long, dark, flowing hair emerging from behind a light-colored wall. The head faces right, displaying a long nose, narrow eyes, and a wide, smiling mouth that reveals teeth and a tongue. The dark hair extends horizontally to the left, appearing to float. The wall is depicted with horizontal lines suggesting brickwork or panels. The right panel shows a grotesque, bearded figure with horns and a serpentine body amidst rocky terrain. The figure's head is at the top, facing left, characterized by a furrowed brow, prominent nose, and a long, flowing beard. Its body is a thick, scaled, serpent-like form that coils around and behind several jagged, mountainous rock formations. Small, stylized trees or bushes are drawn on the rocks and along the serpent's body. The background of both panels is plain, with faint smudges visible on the paper.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Two paintings mounted together; ink on paper

alt_text: Five bird studies and a stylized mask on a light background
long_description: The artwork features five individual studies of birds and one central drawing of a stylized mask, all arranged on a light, off-white background. The central element is a black outline drawing of a mask-like face, positioned vertically. It has prominent, furrowed brows, wide eyes, a broad nose, and a wide mouth with visible teeth. A vertical line bisects the face, and a horizontal line crosses the eyes, indicating a guide. The top of the head features a spiky or flame-like pattern. To the upper left of the mask, a small bird stands on two thin legs, facing left with its beak open. It has a white body, black markings on its back and wings, and a pinkish-red breast. To the upper right, a slender bird stands upright, facing right, with its head tilted back and beak open. This bird is primarily black and white with a patterned back and wings. In the lower left, another bird is depicted in a dynamic pose, appearing to be on its side or in motion, with its head lowered. It has black and white feathers with pinkish-red on its underside, and its wings are spread. To the lower right, two small birds stand side-by-side, both facing right with their beaks open. They are similar in appearance to the bird in the upper left, with white bodies, black markings, and pinkish-red breasts. Each bird study is presented on an irregularly shaped, lighter cutout, which is then affixed to the main background sheet.

alt_text: A drawing of a seated, bearded figure with ornate headwear, a standing robed figure, and various decorative objects
long_description: The artwork is a drawing rendered primarily in black ink with some red accents on light brown paper. The composition is divided into two main sections. On the right, a figure is seated full-frontal, depicted with a beard and a wide, smiling expression, revealing teeth. This figure wears an elaborate, multi-tiered headpiece and robes, holding a rectangular object in both hands at chest level. The figure is positioned behind a low, rectangular table, and is framed by red lines that suggest a canopy or screen with swirling decorative elements at the top corners. To the left of the seated figure, a tall, slender standing figure is depicted in robes, facing towards the right. Its head is featureless, covered by the hood of its robe. To the right of the standing figure, a tall, pear-shaped object rests on a slender, decorative stand with a bow-like element. Below this, an oval object contains the handwritten character "裏". Further to the left, a tree branch with dark foliage and hanging, vine-like leaves extends downwards. Below the standing figure, small, dark bushes are visible. In the bottom center, a small, lidded pot with a rounded body and small feet is drawn with red outlines.

alt_text: A vertical painting on tan paper depicts a large, elongated, dark and light grey fan with a bamboo handle.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting on a light tan or beige background. Centered within the frame is a large, elongated object resembling a fan or a stylized leaf, rendered in shades of grey and white. The object is widest in the middle and tapers slightly towards the top and bottom. Its left side is painted in a darker, almost black, grey, while the right side is a much lighter grey, almost white, creating a sense of depth and curvature. The very top edge of the object has a slightly textured or jagged appearance. Below the main body, the object narrows into a handle, which is depicted as a series of vertical, light brown segments, resembling bamboo, with two horizontal bands suggesting bindings. The handle extends downwards, ending before the bottom edge of the paper. To the lower left of the handle, there is black calligraphic text arranged vertically, and below it, a square red seal impression. The overall composition is simple and focused on the central object.

alt_text: A vertical painting features a long brush, an abstract blue-green shape, and black calligraphy with a red seal
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular panel with a plain, light brown background. In the upper left quadrant, a soft, abstract shape appears, blending shades of light blue, green, and white, resembling a cloud or a distant, misty landscape element. Below this, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center, is a long, slender object resembling a writing brush. Its body is a light tan color, outlined in a darker shade, and it tapers to a sharp, dark point at the top, with a lighter, possibly white, brush head just below the tip. The brush extends downwards, almost reaching the bottom third of the panel. To the right and slightly behind the lower part of the brush, a shorter, thicker, light brown cylindrical object lies horizontally, angled slightly upwards to the right. In the lower left quadrant, black calligraphic characters are visible, arranged vertically. Below these characters, a small, rectangular red seal or stamp is present. The overall composition is sparse, with elements placed against the uniform background.

alt_text: A tall robed figure with a staff stands above two kneeling figures on a light brown scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting on a uniform light brown background. A tall, robed figure stands prominently in the upper half, facing slightly to the viewer's left. This figure wears a large, light gray hood that obscures their head and most of their face, with a small dark opening visible. Over a light gray undergarment, they wear a dark brown, flowing outer robe. In their right hand, they hold a tall staff topped with a decorative element resembling a stack of red and white segmented objects. A small, light-colored gourd or bottle hangs from their left hand. Their feet are visible, clad in light-colored footwear. Below and to the right of the tall figure, two smaller figures are depicted kneeling or sitting on the ground. The figure on the left wears a simple red garment. The figure on the right wears a dark red robe adorned with a pattern of white flowers, and their dark hair is visible. In the lower right corner, vertical black script is present, accompanied by a small red seal below it.

alt_text: A vertical painting of a dark, hairy creature above a large, red, hat-like object with black script.
long_description: A vertical painting on a light brown scroll features a dark, shell-backed creature above a large, red, rounded object. The creature, positioned in the upper half, has a dark, textured shell and a head pointing downwards. From its back, numerous long, thin, dark brushstrokes extend upwards and slightly to the left, resembling flowing hair or flames. Below the creature, a prominent, rounded, red object with black outlines dominates the lower half. It has a smaller, similarly shaped protrusion on its upper right side. On the surface of this red object, a few small, black, calligraphic marks are visible. In the bottom right corner, a small, square, red seal impression is present.

alt_text: Two figures, one taller in red and yellow, one shorter in red and white, against a dark, textured background
long_description: A tall, narrow, vertical artwork depicts two figures against a dark, mottled background with areas of silver and white resembling mist or clouds. The taller figure stands on the left, facing right with their head tilted slightly upwards. They wear a vibrant red outer garment with wide sleeves, adorned with green and white stylized patterns. Beneath, a lighter, possibly gold-colored garment is visible. A tall, pointed, yellow headpiece sits atop their head, and their face is pale. To the right and slightly in front of the taller figure is a shorter figure, also facing right. This figure wears a red and white garment, with their head bowed or looking downwards. Their hands appear clasped in front of them. The overall color palette features strong reds, yellows, and greens against the dark and silvery background. A small, rectangular red seal is visible in the bottom right corner of the artwork.

metadata.medium: Painting; ink and color on paper (tanzaku)

alt_text: A black and white ink drawing of a grotesque, spiky-haired figure with a wide grin, seated next to vertical text.
long_description: This black and white ink drawing depicts a grotesque, seated figure on the right, balanced by vertical script on the left. The figure's head is large and round, framed by a dense, spiky halo of hair or fur that radiates outwards. Its face is highly detailed with a wide, toothy grin, prominent eyes, and a wrinkled brow and nose. The figure's body is draped in voluminous robes, rendered with bold, fluid brushstrokes that create deep folds and a sense of movement. The robes extend downwards and to the left, partially covering a rectangular object that resembles a book or tablet, which also bears some smaller, indistinct characters on its surface. To the left of the figure, a prominent column of large, vertical characters is visible, followed by several smaller columns of script. The characters are rendered in a calligraphic style, with varying line thickness and brushwork. The overall composition is dynamic, with the dark, expressive figure contrasting against the lighter background and the structured text.

alt_text: A black and white ink drawing of a roaring tiger with striped fur, crouching low and facing left
long_description: A monochrome ink drawing depicts a large feline, likely a tiger, in a dynamic, crouching pose against a plain, light background. The animal faces left, with its head turned slightly upwards and its mouth wide open, revealing sharp teeth and a visible tongue. Its eyes are narrow, and whiskers extend from its snout. The body is heavily patterned with dark, thick stripes and some scattered spots, rendered with varying brushstrokes that suggest fur texture. Many stripes are curved or spiral-like, particularly on the shoulders and hindquarters, creating a sense of movement and volume. The tiger's front legs are bent, with large, clawed paws visible. Its back is arched, and its hind legs are also bent, positioned as if preparing to spring or having just landed. The tail is thick and striped, curving downwards and then upwards behind its body. The drawing fills a significant portion of the rectangular frame, with ample empty space around the animal. The lines are bold and expressive, characteristic of ink brushwork.

alt_text: Black and white ink wash painting depicting three bell-shaped flowers with stems and delicate leaves
long_description: This black and white ink wash painting features a cluster of three bell-shaped flowers with their stems and leaves, positioned on the right side of a light, unadorned background. The flowers are rendered in a dark, solid black ink, appearing as distinct, five-pointed bell shapes. One flower is at the top right, another slightly below and to its left, and a third below that, partially obscured by leaves. From these flowers, slender stems extend downwards, depicted with lighter shades of gray ink. Numerous elongated, pointed leaves branch off the stems, created with varying tones of gray wash, giving them a soft, translucent appearance. Below the main cluster, the leaves become denser and lighter, fading into the background. Two long, thin, curved lines, possibly representing grass blades or tendrils, arc from the upper right towards the upper left of the composition, adding a sense of movement. The rest of the background is a uniform, very light gray, almost white. Faint, illegible marks are visible in the bottom left and bottom right corners of the image.

alt_text: An ink painting depicts dark, broad leaves and clusters of small berries on a light background
long_description: This black and white ink painting features botanical elements positioned in the lower right portion of the frame, set against a plain, light gray background. The upper and left areas of the image are largely empty, creating significant negative space. Two prominent, broad leaves are depicted with varying shades of dark gray and black ink washes. The leaf on the left is partially visible, showing a dark, irregular form. The leaf to its right is more fully rendered, displaying a distinct, multi-lobed shape with dark lines suggesting veins radiating from its center. Above and slightly to the right of this central leaf, a cluster of small, round berries or fruits is shown. These berries are rendered in lighter gray tones, forming several small groupings on delicate stems, contrasting with the darker foliage. A smaller, darker leaf is also visible beneath the main berry cluster. The brushwork is fluid, creating soft gradations between the dark and light areas of the plant forms. The overall composition emphasizes the organic shapes and textures of the plant against a minimalist backdrop.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of two long-necked birds, one looking up, standing in sparse grass
long_description: The image is a black and white ink wash painting featuring two long-necked birds, likely cranes or herons, standing in a sparse grassy area. The birds are rendered with varying shades of black and gray ink, creating a sense of depth and texture against a light, almost white background. The bird on the right is more prominent, positioned slightly forward and to the right of the center. It stands upright with its long, slender neck extended upwards and its pointed beak angled towards the upper left. Its body is a mix of light gray and dark, almost black, patterned feathers, particularly on its back and wings, which appear slightly fanned. Its long, thin legs and webbed feet are dark and clearly defined, resting on the ground. The second bird is positioned behind and slightly to the left of the first, its body partially obscured. Its neck is curved downwards and to the left, with its head and beak pointing towards the lower left. Its plumage also shows dark patterns, though less distinct than the front bird. Both birds have small, round eyes. Below the birds, sparse, short strokes of ink suggest grass or reeds on the ground. The background is largely empty, a light gray wash that fades towards the edges, emphasizing the birds as the central subject. Faint, handwritten text "742411" is visible in the upper left corner.

alt_text: A black and white ink drawing of a large, textured toad next to a cluster of plants
long_description: The image is a black and white ink drawing on a light, possibly aged, paper background. A large, warty toad dominates the right side of the composition, facing left. Its skin is heavily textured with numerous small, dark, raised bumps, giving it a rough appearance. The underside of its body, particularly its throat and belly, is smoother and lighter. Its large, prominent eyes are dark and round, positioned on top of its head. Its wide mouth is slightly open, showing a hint of an upper lip. Two front legs are visible, each ending in clawed, webbed feet, also covered in bumps. The toad appears to be resting or moving slowly. To the left of the toad, a cluster of plants rises from the bottom edge. There are several tall, slender stems, each topped with a flat, umbrella-like cluster of small flowers or seeds. Below these clusters, smaller leaves are visible along the stems and at the base of the plant. The plants are rendered with fine lines, showing delicate structures. The toad is significantly larger than the plants, creating a sense of scale. The background is plain, emphasizing the two main subjects. The drawing style is detailed, particularly in the rendering of the toad's skin and the plant structures.
