alt_text: A black and white artwork depicts several large chrysanthemum blossoms with dark leaves and smaller buds arranged diagonally.
long_description: This black and white artwork features a dynamic arrangement of chrysanthemum blossoms and foliage against a light, plain background. The composition is dominated by five large, round chrysanthemum flowers, varying in their depiction and tone. In the upper right, a large, dark chrysanthemum is shown with fine, radiating lines emanating from its center, surrounded by clusters of dark, irregular leaves and small, textured buds. Below and slightly to the left of this, a large, light-toned chrysanthemum displays distinct, overlapping petals, creating a textured, almost scale-like appearance. Further down and to the right, another large, light chrysanthemum mirrors the detailed petal structure of the one above it. In the lower left quadrant, a large, dark chrysanthemum, similar in style to the one in the upper right, is depicted with radiating lines and is accompanied by a dense cluster of dark leaves and buds extending towards the left edge. A smaller, light chrysanthemum with radiating lines is positioned below the dark one in the lower left. Throughout the image, dark, irregularly shaped leaves and small, textured buds are interspersed among the larger blossoms, connecting the floral elements. The overall impression is one of organic growth and movement across the light background.

alt_text: An ink drawing of a monkey sitting, looking right, holding a small object in its right hand
long_description: A black and white ink drawing depicts a monkey seated and facing towards the right side of the frame, with its body angled slightly towards the viewer. The monkey occupies the central-left area of the composition against a plain white background. Its head is roundish with a prominent snout, small eyes that gaze to the right, and visible ears. Shaggy fur is rendered with dark, textured brushstrokes on its head, around its face, and on its limbs. The monkey's right arm is bent, and its hand holds a small, indistinct object. Its left arm is also bent, with the hand positioned near its chest or mouth. The torso appears to be covered by a lighter, flowing garment or is rendered with smoother, less hairy texture, indicated by lighter ink washes and fewer brushstrokes. Its legs are bent, with the left leg extending forward. The overall style is characterized by loose, expressive brushwork, with varying shades of ink creating depth and texture.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Unmounted painting; ink and watercolor on paper

alt_text: Fluffy, monkey-like creature with a leaf in its mouth, sitting on a branch with flowers.
long_description: The image is a monochromatic ink drawing depicting a fluffy, monkey-like creature seated on a slender branch. The creature, positioned slightly right of center, faces left with its head turned towards the viewer. It has a large, round head with a dense, curly mane framing its face, and a small, dark nose and mouth. A dark, elongated object, possibly a leaf or scroll, is held in its mouth. Its body is covered in long, flowing fur, rendered with fine, delicate brushstrokes, giving it a soft texture. One paw is raised near its chest, while the other rests on the branch. Its long, bushy tail curls behind it, extending towards the lower left. The creature is perched on a dark, thin branch that extends horizontally across the lower third of the composition. To the left of the creature, two small, light-colored flowers with multiple petals and dark centers bloom on a stem with dark leaves. To the right, the branch continues with a few more dark leaves and a thin, delicate stem extending further right. The background is a plain, light gray, providing a stark contrast to the darker lines and washes of the central subject and foliage. The overall impression is one of delicate detail and fluid lines.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Unmounted painting; ink and watercolor on paper

alt_text: A black and white drawing of a muscular man with a large fan-like headdress, holding a sword.
long_description: A black and white drawing depicts a muscular male figure standing and leaning forward. The man is bare-chested, wearing a dark, short garment around his waist and hips, with bare legs and feet. His face shows an intense expression with furrowed brows, and he has short, dark hair. A large, radial, fan-like structure extends from behind his head, fanning upwards and outwards, composed of alternating dark and light sections. His right arm is bent, holding a short, dark sword horizontally in front of him. His left arm is also bent, with the hand positioned near his chest. A long, thin object, possibly a scabbard, is visible behind his left leg, angled downwards. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the stark, black and white lines of the drawing.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Unmounted painting; ink and watercolor on paper

alt_text: Black and white ink painting of a large rooster with a fanned tail and a small chick
long_description: This black and white ink wash painting depicts a large rooster and a small chick on a light, unadorned background. The rooster dominates the right and upper-center portion of the composition. Its body is rendered with broad, dark ink strokes, forming a dense mass of feathers. A prominent, fanned tail, composed of several long, curved, and pointed feathers, extends upwards and to the left, reaching towards the top edge of the frame. The feathers vary in darkness, with some appearing solid black and others showing lighter gray washes, suggesting texture. The rooster's head, though less detailed, is visible as a darker mass above its body, facing left. To the lower left of the rooster, a much smaller chick is depicted. It is rendered with darker, more solid ink, appearing to be in a pecking or foraging posture, with its head down and small legs visible. The chick is positioned closer to the bottom and left edges of the artwork, creating a significant size contrast with the rooster. The background is a uniform light gray, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink figures and emphasizing the brushwork.

alt_text: A fan-shaped, black and white artwork shows multiple figures and a monkey in a sparse landscape
long_description: This black and white artwork is presented on a fan-shaped surface, depicting a scene with several human figures and a monkey in a landscape. The background features a gently sloping terrain with sparse, brush-like vegetation indicated by short, dark strokes. In the upper left, two figures are positioned near a large, dark, textured mass resembling a haystack or a dense bush, next to a tree with bare branches. One figure stands tall, draped in a long robe, while another kneels beside them. Below these, towards the bottom left, a single figure sits on the ground, facing right. In the center, a monkey stands upright on two legs, holding a stick horizontally with both hands. To the right of the monkey, a standing figure with a conical hat and dark clothing holds a long, thin object, possibly a stick or rope, extending towards the monkey. Further to the right, near the bottom edge, another figure kneels or crouches, carrying a large, round object on their back, secured by a strap over their shoulder. The figures are rendered with simple, dark ink lines, creating a sense of movement and interaction within the open landscape.

alt_text: A bearded man sits on a rock, fishing in water, surrounded by reeds on a fan-shaped artwork
long_description: This black and white artwork, presented on a fan-shaped surface, depicts a solitary figure fishing amidst a natural setting. The fan is wider at the top and curves inward towards the bottom, with the artwork filling most of its surface. In the center, a bearded man is seated on a dark, irregularly shaped rock, facing towards the right. He has a long, light-colored beard and dark hair, and wears a simple, dark-lined robe. He holds a thin fishing rod that extends into the water below the rock, where faint ripples are indicated by curved lines. Behind the man, to his right, is a large, conical, woven basket. The background is filled with numerous dark, thin, vertical strokes representing reeds or tall grasses, which are particularly dense on the right side of the composition and sparser on the left. The overall style is characterized by bold ink lines and washes, creating a serene, contemplative scene.

alt_text: A fan-shaped artwork depicts a mountainous landscape with a waterfall, several buildings, and dense trees.
long_description: A black and white image displays a landscape scene rendered on a fan-shaped surface. The upper portion of the artwork is dominated by mountains, with softer, rounded peaks on the left transitioning to steeper, more jagged formations towards the center-right. A waterfall cascades down the central mountain face. In the midground, a large, gnarled tree with sparse branches stands to the left of center. To the right of center, a multi-tiered pagoda-like structure with multiple roofs is situated on a raised platform. Below and to the left of this prominent building are smaller, roofed structures. The right side of the midground and foreground is filled with dense, tall evergreen trees, while smaller trees and bushes are visible in the left foreground. The composition creates a sense of depth, leading the eye from the distant mountains through the architectural elements and trees to the immediate foreground. The entire scene is rendered in varying shades of gray, black, and white, providing texture and contrast.

alt_text: A fan-shaped ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape with a multi-tiered building, water, and small figures.
long_description: This fan-shaped, black and white ink wash painting depicts a detailed landscape. In the foreground, a body of water stretches across the lower left and center, with dark, jagged rock formations and tall, thin reeds along its banks. A small boat with a single figure is visible on the water towards the left. On a prominent rocky outcrop in the lower right, a figure is seated or standing. A winding path ascends from the lower right towards a large, multi-tiered building situated on a hill in the mid-right. This building features a distinctive, multi-layered roof and is surrounded by trees. Numerous small figures are scattered along the path and throughout the landscape. In the midground and background, rolling hills and mountains rise, densely covered with trees and foliage, rendered in varying shades of gray. The overall impression is a serene, expansive natural scene with human activity.

alt_text: Grayscale painting of a large, conical mountain with a light peak, emerging from dense clouds
long_description: The image is a grayscale painting depicting a large, conical mountain rising from a dense layer of clouds. The mountain, positioned centrally, has a broad base that is entirely obscured by the clouds, and its peak extends towards the top edge of the frame. The upper slopes and peak of the mountain are rendered in lighter tones, suggesting snow or ice, with visible ridges and contours. Darker, textured areas appear on the lower visible slopes, indicating rock or shadowed sections. The clouds are depicted as a thick, undulating mass of varying gray tones, with softer, lighter areas blending into the background and darker, more defined shapes forming the lower edges of the cloud layer around the mountain's base. The background above the clouds is a lighter, uniform gray, suggesting sky. In the lower right corner, there is a vertical column of characters, likely a signature or inscription, followed by a square seal. The entire painting is framed by a decorative border with a repeating pattern, visible at the top and sides.

alt_text: A small bird perches on a dark rock, looking up at a vine with red and orange leaves
long_description: The artwork is a vertical composition on a light, muted beige background. In the upper left, a vine with numerous red and orange leaves hangs downwards. The leaves are mostly heart-shaped, varying in size, with some smaller, lighter red leaves further down the stem. Small clusters of dark, round berries are visible along the vine. To the right, a large, dark, irregular mass, rendered with broad ink washes, dominates the upper right quadrant. This mass appears to be a rock formation or a tree trunk, with some lighter, feathery brushstrokes suggesting texture or foliage at its top edge. A small bird is perched on the right side of this dark mass, positioned slightly below its highest point. The bird faces left and upwards, with its beak slightly open. It has a dark body, a lighter, possibly reddish-brown belly, and a distinct blue-grey head. Its eye is a small dark dot. Below the main elements, in the lower half of the composition, faint, wavy lines are visible on the light background, suggesting a body of water or mist. In the lower right corner, there is vertical calligraphy in dark ink, accompanied by a small, square red seal.

alt_text: A vertical painting shows a stack of turtles tied with a red ribbon, with two crabs and flowing brushstrokes
long_description: The artwork features a vertical composition on a light beige background. In the center-left, a stack of approximately seven turtles is arranged vertically. Each turtle has a dark green or brown shell with lighter undersides and heads. A vibrant red ribbon is tied around the upper portion of the turtle stack, forming a prominent knot. The ribbon extends downwards and to the right, curving gracefully, and terminates in two red tassels. One tassel is positioned to the left of the turtle stack, and the other is at the far right end of the ribbon. A crab with light-colored claws is positioned at the top of the composition, near the knot of the red ribbon. Another crab, with darker claws and a brownish body, is situated at the bottom right, near the end of the ribbon. Light green and white brushstrokes emanate from behind the turtle stack, flowing towards the right, suggesting movement or water. In the bottom right corner, there is black calligraphy and two red square seals.

alt_text: Three birds in flight, rendered in ink wash, against a light beige background with a faint curved shape
long_description: A tall, vertical scroll painting features three birds in flight against a light beige background. The background is mostly empty, with a faint, light-colored, curved shape running along the left edge, suggesting a distant cloud or mountain. The birds are rendered in varying shades of gray and black ink wash. The smallest bird is positioned in the upper right quadrant, flying towards the right with its wings spread. Below and to the left of this bird are two larger birds, both flying towards the left. The upper of these two larger birds has its wings fully extended, while the lower bird, slightly in front, also has its wings spread and its legs visible. The ink wash technique creates a sense of depth and texture in their feathers. In the lower right corner, there is black ink calligraphy, followed by a square red seal. The scroll is framed by decorative borders: a light brown, speckled pattern at the top and bottom, and a muted green-blue border with a subtle floral or leafy motif along the left and right sides.

metadata.title: 三羽黒鳥図|Three Crows in Flight

alt_text: An old man with a long white beard sits by dark rocks and a building in a misty landscape.
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a serene landscape with a central figure. The left two-thirds of the image are dominated by a light, misty background in shades of beige and light gray, with subtle horizontal brushstrokes suggesting a hazy atmosphere or water. On the right side, a prominent old man with a very long, flowing white beard and hair is seated on the ground. He wears a light yellow-ochre robe with dark outlines and holds a thin, light brown staff in his right hand, which rests on his shoulder. His body is angled slightly to the left, and he appears to be leaning against a dark, jagged rock formation that rises behind him. These dark brown and gray rocks are textured and irregular, with small patches of green foliage visible on their surfaces. Around the base of the rocks and the seated man, clusters of small, round, yellow-orange flowers and sparse green grass are depicted. To the far right, partially obscured by the rocks, is a structure with a light pink roof and intricate green and light blue architectural details, including columns and patterned walls. The overall color palette is muted, with earthy tones, dark grays, and subtle hints of color in the man's robe, flowers, and the building. In the bottom right corner, a small red square seal with black characters is visible.

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting shows a vast landscape with mountains, water, boats, buildings, and people.
long_description: This horizontal, multi-panel screen painting depicts a panoramic landscape scene across its upper section, with a decorative border along the bottom. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by golden-browns, grays, and dark greens, suggesting an aged appearance. The upper landscape section features a wide expanse of water in the midground, with distant, hazy mountains fading into a light golden-brown sky in the background. On the far left, a steep, rocky hill with tall pine trees rises, and small figures are seen climbing a path. Below this hill, a complex of buildings, possibly an estate or temple, is nestled among trees, with numerous figures gathered around. In the center, several large, dark-hulled boats with tall masts are moored near the shore, while smaller boats are scattered across the water. Further right, dramatic, steep mountains rise from the water, featuring a prominent waterfall cascading down one face. At the base of these mountains, a cluster of buildings, including a pagoda-like structure, is visible. More distant, layered mountains extend to the far right. The bottom section of the screen consists of a continuous decorative border, divided into rectangular panels. Each panel displays a repeating pattern of dark, stylized floral or geometric motifs on a golden-brown background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; color on silk

alt_text: A vertical painting depicts a misty landscape with red-leafed trees on rocky shores, mountains, and boats on water
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a misty, muted landscape dominated by trees with red foliage. The upper third of the image is a light, hazy gray-brown, suggesting an expansive sky or dense mist. Below this, a large tree with reddish-brown leaves emerges from the left, its branches spreading across the upper-middle section. Further down, several trees with vibrant red leaves grow from dark, rocky shores that frame a body of water. The water, rendered in lighter gray tones, occupies the middle ground, with two small sailboats visible, their sails indistinct against the misty background. In the distance, faint, hazy mountains rise on the right horizon. More red-leafed trees are positioned on the lower right, their trunks leaning towards the water. The left side of the lower half features more rugged, dark rock formations, with subtle indications of small structures or figures nestled within the landscape. A small, dark inscription with a red seal is visible in the lower left quadrant. The overall impression is one of a serene, atmospheric scene with a strong vertical emphasis.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A seated figure with a halo, wearing robes and elaborate jewelry, next to a vase with a plant
long_description: A vertical painting on aged paper or silk depicts a seated figure in light colors against a plain background. The central figure is positioned cross-legged on a dark, textured base resembling foliage or a rocky outcrop. A large, pale circular halo emanates from behind the figure's head and upper body. The figure has a pale complexion, with dark hair partially covered by a flowing, light-colored hood or veil that drapes over the head and shoulders. The figure wears a light-colored, flowing robe that leaves parts of the chest and arms visible. Elaborate jewelry includes a long, multi-strand necklace with dark beads and bell-like pendants, and smaller bell-shaped ornaments near the figure's left ear. A dark band is visible on the upper left arm. The face is round, with downcast eyes, a small mouth, and faint dark lines suggesting a mustache and goatee. To the right of the figure, a dark, slender vase holds a delicate plant with thin branches and small leaves. The background is a uniform, light brown or beige. In the lower right corner, vertical black text is visible, followed by a red seal.

alt_text: An ink wash painting shows a bearded man in a hat walking left, holding a stick and dragging a brush bundle.
long_description: An ink wash painting on a light, horizontal background features a single male figure walking towards the left, occupying the right side of the composition. The man is depicted with a long, narrow face, a pointed beard, and a mustache. He wears a dark, rounded hat that sits high on his head. His body is turned slightly, showing his back and right side, and he is dressed in a light-colored, loose-fitting robe with wide sleeves. His lower body is clad in darker, baggy trousers that reach his calves, and his feet appear to be bare or in simple sandals. He holds a thin, dark stick in his right hand at waist height. Attached to his left leg, or dragging behind it, is a bundle of dark, spiky brushwood or a broom-like object. The background is largely empty, a uniform light color, with faint, dark ink strokes in the lower left and center suggesting uneven ground or sparse vegetation. A small, square red seal is visible in the lower right quadrant.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Album of seventeen sketches; watercolor on paper; mounted on natural silk

alt_text: A black and white ink wash scroll painting shows a monkey seated on a dark, jagged rock formation.
long_description: This vertical, black and white ink wash scroll painting depicts a monkey perched on a prominent rock formation, rendered with varying shades of gray. The monkey, positioned slightly above the lower center, faces towards the left side of the composition. Its body is depicted with soft, graduated washes, appearing lighter on its torso and darker on its head and limbs, suggesting fur. The monkey's face is detailed with darker lines, showing a round head, distinct eyes, and a slightly downturned mouth, giving it a contemplative or watchful expression. Its right arm is bent, resting on its lap or the rock, while its left arm is less distinct, blending into its body. Below and to the right of the monkey, a rugged, dark rock formation dominates the lower portion of the painting. This rock is rendered with bolder, darker ink strokes and washes, creating a textured, jagged appearance with sharp edges and some spiky protrusions, possibly sparse vegetation. The rock extends from the lower right corner, providing a solid base for the monkey. The upper and left areas of the scroll are largely empty, filled with very light, almost imperceptible washes, creating a sense of open space or mist around the central figures. The artwork is framed by decorative borders on its vertical sides, featuring a repeating pattern of dark, stylized shapes on a lighter background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A black and white scroll painting depicts a bird perched on a thin branch above a large leaf.
long_description: A vertical, grayscale scroll painting features a bird perched on a thin branch above a large leaf, set against a light, plain background. The central painted area is framed by a dark, patterned border on all four sides, adorned with repeating floral or cloud-like motifs. The bird, positioned slightly below the vertical center, is dark-feathered with a long tail extending downwards to the right. It faces left, with its head tilted slightly upwards. The thin branch extends diagonally from the upper left towards the lower right, passing beneath the bird. Below the bird and branch, towards the lower right, is a prominent, dark, rounded shape resembling a large leaf or pod, detailed with lighter lines suggesting veins or creases. To the left of this large shape, a few smaller, lighter leaf-like forms are visible. In the lower right corner, just above the large leaf, there is a vertical block of dark, stylized text or calligraphy.

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a large, distant mountain overlooking a body of water with several boats and a forested landmass.
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting features a serene landscape rendered in shades of light beige, grey, and black. The upper half of the composition is dominated by a large, conical mountain, its peak slightly darker, appearing in the distant background. To its left, a smaller, less defined mountain is visible. Both mountains are depicted with soft, diffused lines, suggesting mist or clouds around their bases. Below the mountains, a horizontal band of lighter grey indicates a body of water or a misty valley. In the lower half of the painting, a dark, rounded landmass with several small, stylized trees on its crest occupies the right side. To its left, a flatter, lighter landmass extends. The foreground features a body of water with several boats. The most prominent boat, in the lower left, has two tall, rectangular sails with vertical lines, and a dark, simple hull with a small figure on board. Further to the right and slightly behind, another boat with similar sails is visible. Additional, less detailed boats are scattered across the water near the landmass. In the lower right corner, vertical calligraphic text in black ink is present, accompanied by a red, square seal mark below it.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; black paint on silk

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a bird with ruffled head feathers perched on a gnarled branch, framed by gold borders
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features an ink wash depiction of a bird on a branch, framed by decorative gold borders. The central artwork, rendered on a light beige paper, shows a bird perched on a dark, gnarled branch in the lower half. The bird, facing slightly left and looking downwards, has dark feathers and a prominent crest of ruffled feathers on its head. Its body is rendered with varying shades of gray and black ink, creating texture and depth. The thick, dark branches extend from the lower left, with thinner, bare twigs reaching upwards and to the right. The upper portion of the paper is largely empty, a plain light gray background. The central painting is bordered by a thin, plain gold strip, which is then surrounded by a wider, patterned gold fabric. This outer border features repeating motifs, possibly floral or cloud-like, in a slightly darker gold against a lighter gold background.

alt_text: A vertical scroll with calligraphic text above two potted plants on a table and a teapot on a stand.
long_description: A vertical, monochrome artwork features calligraphic text in the upper section, followed by two potted plants on a table, and a teapot on a stand in the lower section. The background is a light, aged tone, and all elements are rendered with thin black lines. The upper third of the scroll contains several vertical lines of text, with larger characters on the right and smaller, more numerous characters to their left. Below the text, two potted plants are depicted on a simple, rectangular table with four thin legs. The plant on the left is in a wider, fluted pot and has a dense, bushy top. The plant on the right is in a narrower, simpler pot and features a more sparse, upright stem with a few leaves or flowers at its apex. In the bottom third of the scroll, a teapot with a spout, handle, and lid is shown resting on a tall, cylindrical stand. The stand has a small, circular protrusion on its side.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink wash and color on paper

alt_text: Stylized painting of bamboo stalks, butterflies, and flowers around a patterned box on a light background.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting on a light yellow-tan background, framed by patterned fabric borders. The main scene depicts a natural setting with a central focus on a decorative box. On the right side, several slender, dark brown bamboo stalks rise vertically, some bending gently towards the left. In the upper left quadrant, three stylized dark brown butterflies or moths with delicate antennae are shown in various flight positions. A fourth similar butterfly is positioned near the bottom left, closer to the ground. At the bottom right, a rectangular box with a slightly open lid rests on the ground. The box is light-colored with a repeating pattern of blue and white stylized floral or geometric shapes. The interior of the open lid is dark. Surrounding the box and bamboo are various plants and flowers. Several pink and white flowers with green stems are visible behind and to the right of the box, while smaller green leafy plants grow in the foreground and to the left. The ground is indicated by sparse green and brown brushstrokes. In the upper right corner, there is a small section of black calligraphic text and a red square seal. The top and bottom borders of the scroll are a gold-colored fabric with a subtle textured pattern, while the side borders are a dark fabric with a repeating pattern of lighter grey floral or leaf motifs.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Six-panel screen with white flowers and green leaves on a gold background
long_description: This artwork is a six-panel screen featuring botanical motifs on a gold background. The entire surface of the screen is covered in a shimmering gold, which appears to have a subtle, horizontal brushstroke texture. Against this luminous backdrop, several clusters of flowering plants are depicted, seemingly growing upwards from an unseen ground line at the bottom of the panels. There are three distinct groupings of these plants, spaced across the six panels. The leftmost grouping, spanning the first two panels, consists of two plants: a taller one with two white flowers and a shorter one with a single white flower. The central grouping, occupying the middle two panels, is the most dense, featuring multiple stems and several white flowers in various stages of bloom. The rightmost grouping, on the last two panels, mirrors the left with two plants, one taller with two flowers and one shorter with a single flower. The flowers are rendered in a soft, opaque white, with delicate, slightly ruffled petals. Their centers are a very pale yellow or light green. The leaves are a vibrant, deep green, with some lighter green highlights, and exhibit a distinct lobed or serrated shape. The stems are slender and green. The plants are arranged with ample space between them, allowing the gold background to dominate much of the composition. A small, circular red seal is visible on the far right panel, positioned to the lower right of the rightmost plant.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; color on paper

alt_text: Two-panel screen with painted fans and flowering vines on a gold background
long_description: The image displays a two-panel screen, hinged in the center, featuring a painting on a gold-colored background. The screen is bordered by a dark, possibly black, frame, with an inner border of brighter gold. The main painted area of each panel is a muted, slightly textured gold.On the left panel, a large, open folding fan is depicted in the lower-left quadrant. The fan's surface is divided into two sections: a vibrant blue on the left and a light gray or off-white on the right, separated by a diagonal line. The fan's ribs are dark, fanning out from a central pivot point at the bottom. To the right and above the fan, a vine with green leaves and two purple, bell-shaped flowers, resembling morning glories, extends upwards and to the right. Small white flowers are also visible among the leaves.The right panel features three open folding fans. In the lower-left of this panel, a prominent red fan is depicted, similar in size and orientation to the blue fan on the left panel. Its surface is a solid, deep red, with dark ribs fanning out from its base. Behind and slightly to the right of the red fan, a larger, light-colored fan is shown. This fan is predominantly off-white or very pale gray, with a subtle depiction of blue-tinged mountains or clouds along its upper edge. Further to the right and slightly behind these two fans, a smaller, dark-ribbed fan is partially visible, its surface mostly obscured but appearing light-colored. Various green leaves and small white flowers are scattered around the bases of the fans on this panel, forming a delicate floral arrangement.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; color on silk

alt_text: Two horizontal panels with silver-leaf backgrounds displaying multiple small botanical paintings of plants and flowers
long_description:
Two horizontal panels, framed in a dark reddish-brown wood, are presented against a plain dark gray background. Each panel features a light, textured silver-leaf background, divided into a grid of squares by subtle lines. On these silver backgrounds, several smaller, distinct paintings of botanical subjects are affixed.

The left panel contains three such paintings. On the far left, an oval-shaped piece of paper shows green leaves and small red elements. In the center, a rectangular piece depicts dark, gnarled branches with green leaves and clusters of blue and red flowers or berries. To the right of this, another oval-shaped piece features dark branches with small red dots.

The right panel also displays three paintings. On the far left, a rectangular piece shows light-colored, possibly golden, foliage or flowers. To its right, a small square piece presents delicate dark branches with sparse white or light-colored blossoms. On the far right, a tall, narrow rectangular piece features a vertical branch adorned with numerous light-colored, delicate flowers, possibly plum blossoms.

metadata.title: 花鳥図風炉先屏風|Folding Screen for Tea Ceremony with Six Bird-and-Flower Paintings
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; lacquer, color, and silver on paper

alt_text: Ink painting on a two-panel screen depicting a gnarled grapevine with leaves, tendrils, and clusters of grapes
long_description: A two-panel screen, angled slightly, displays an ink painting on a light tan background. The screen is framed by a light brown border, with a thin gold line separating the frame from the artwork. The painting depicts a grapevine rendered in various shades of dark gray and black ink. The right panel features the main, thick, gnarled vine, which originates from the lower right corner and sweeps upwards and to the left, dominating the upper half of this panel. The vine is painted with broad, expressive brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement and texture. Attached to this main vine are several large, dark gray grape leaves, concentrated in the upper right quadrant. Below these leaves, two clusters of small, dark gray grapes hang from delicate stems. A thinner, lighter tendril extends from the main vine, curving downwards and to the left across the lower half of the right panel. In the lower right corner of the right panel, a vertical inscription in black ink is visible, followed by a small, square red seal. The inscription consists of two characters, with the top character appearing to be "春". The left panel features a single, slender tendril that originates from the lower center of the panel and curves gracefully upwards and to the left, ending near the upper left corner. This tendril is painted with fine lines and has a few small, faint leaf-like forms along its length. The light tan background of both panels is largely unadorned, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink work. The composition is asymmetrical, with the bulk of the botanical elements concentrated on the right panel, balanced by the delicate tendril on the left.

alt_text: An ink wash painting of a smiling, bald, bearded man with a large belly, holding a staff.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll, primarily rendered in ink wash on a light gray-brown paper. A golden border with a repeating pattern of stylized fruit and foliage frames the main image on the left, right, and bottom edges. The central figure, a large, bald, and bearded man, dominates the lower two-thirds of the scroll. He is depicted with a wide, open-mouthed smile, revealing teeth, and has small, dark eyes. His face is round, and he has a short, dark beard and mustache. His torso is bare, revealing a prominent, round belly. He wears loose, flowing robes, rendered with broad, dark ink strokes, draped over his shoulders and arms. His left hand, with visible fingers, holds a thin, dark staff that extends diagonally upwards behind his head and shoulder. His right arm is also bent, with the hand partially visible. The lower part of his body and feet are suggested by minimal, dark brushstrokes. The upper third of the scroll is an empty, light gray-brown space.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a bird perched on a tree stump, looking up, with a golden patterned border
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a bird perched on a tree stump, rendered in ink wash on a light gray background. The bird, positioned slightly left of center, faces left and looks upward. Its plumage is depicted with varying shades of gray and black, showing distinct feathers on its wings and tail. The bird's long tail extends downwards, and its head is tilted back, revealing a light-colored throat and chest. It stands on a thick, gnarled tree stump, also rendered in dark grays and blacks, with visible texture suggesting bark. To the right of the stump, a slender, bare branch extends vertically upwards, with small nubs indicating where smaller branches or leaves might have been. The background is a plain, light gray, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink work. The central painting is framed by a wide, golden fabric border on the left and right sides, adorned with a repeating pattern of stylized floral or cloud motifs. Thin golden lines also frame the top and bottom of the central image. The entire scroll is mounted on a lighter, possibly off-white, fabric.

alt_text: A black and white image of a seated, adorned figure with a halo and flame-like aura, on a lotus pedestal
long_description: A black and white, vertically oriented image depicts a seated figure against a dark background, framed by a simple border. The central figure is shown from the waist up, seated in a cross-legged posture on a multi-layered lotus pedestal. The figure wears a crown with three prominent points and a central jewel, and has long, dark hair visible on either side of the face. The face is round with downcast eyes, a small nose, and a slight smile. A circular halo surrounds the head, and a larger, almond-shaped mandorla with flame-like edges frames the entire upper body. The figure's right hand is raised to shoulder height, palm facing outward, with the thumb and index finger touching in a gesture. The left hand rests in the lap, holding a small, dark object. The figure is dressed in flowing robes, with visible armbands and necklaces. The fabric appears to be draped over the shoulders and around the lower body. The entire image has a textured, cracked appearance, suggesting age or a specific artistic technique.

alt_text: A manuscript page features text above a scene of five figures dancing and playing music outside a building with three figures.
long_description: A vertical manuscript page features a block of text at the top, occupying approximately the upper third, above a painted illustration. The text is written in multiple lines of black script with some words highlighted in red, and the numbers "386 go" are written in blue ink near the top center.Below the text, the illustration depicts a scene divided vertically into an outdoor area on the left and a building on the right. The outdoor area has a greenish-yellow ground and a sky with dark blue and gray clouds. Five male figures are shown in various poses. From left to right, one man in a red tunic and white turban plays a drum. Next to him, a man in a blue tunic and orange turban holds small cymbals. In the center, a dark-skinned man with yellow pants, a green sash, and an elaborate blue and gold headpiece dances with arms raised. To his right, another man in orange pants, a white tunic, and a white turban also dances with raised arms. A fifth man, partially obscured on the far right of this group, wears a red tunic and white turban and holds a stick.On the right, a multi-story building with a purple upper section and a brown lower section features a decorative patterned border between the two levels. On the upper floor, two women are visible in separate window frames; the woman on the left wears a white garment, and the woman on the right wears an orange garment. On the lower floor, a man with a white turban, yellow dhoti, and green shawl stands in a doorway, looking towards the left. The overall color palette includes vibrant reds, blues, yellows, oranges, and greens against earth tones.

alt_text: An Indian miniature painting depicting a blue-skinned figure and a woman in a palace courtyard with attendants and a hilly landscape
long_description: The rectangular painting is framed by a dark brown border. The scene is divided horizontally into a foreground courtyard and a background landscape with buildings. In the foreground, a dark reddish-brown floor extends across the bottom. On the left, a woman with dark hair is seated on a pink cushion, facing right. She wears a yellow skirt, a red top, and green sleeves, adorned with jewelry, and holds a small white object in her right hand. Behind her is a white building with arched doorways and decorative patterns. To her right, a blue-skinned male figure stands facing her, wearing a yellow dhoti, a crown, and a sash. His hands are clasped in front of him. Further to the right, two women stand, facing left. The woman on the left wears a brown top and an orange skirt, holding a small pot over a square basin from which water appears to flow. The woman on the right wears a pink top and a green and orange skirt, with a long white garland. Behind the courtyard, a low, decorated wall separates the space from a light brown hilly landscape. Flowering plants with small red blossoms are visible along the wall. In the mid-ground, two male figures are seated on the hill. The figure on the left wears purple robes and is seated cross-legged. The figure on the right wears white robes and a red turban, stirring a pot with a stick. In the far background, a white domed building sits atop a distant hill. The sky above is pale green with horizontal blue cloud-like formations. On the left, white palace structures with small domes rise above the courtyard wall.

alt_text: A bearded man in traditional attire sits on a cushion, smoking a hookah in a garden setting.
long_description: The painting is a vertical rectangle framed by a thick red border. It depicts a man seated in a garden setting. The lower half of the image features a vibrant yellow rug with an intricate pattern of red and green floral motifs. On the right side of the rug, a hookah with a red base and a long, curved dark hose is placed. The hose extends towards the man's mouth. The man is seated on a large, ribbed, pink cushion on the left side of the rug. He is shown in profile, facing right, with his right leg bent and his left leg tucked under him. He has a dark beard and mustache and wears a white turban with a red and white striped band and a black feather. His upper body is bare except for multiple strands of white pearls and a white sash across his chest. A dagger with a white hilt is tucked into his waistband. He wears light orange or pink trousers. His right hand holds the mouthpiece of the hookah hose to his lips. Behind the man and the rug, a low, dark blue wall or fence separates the foreground from the background. To the left, a dark green tree with a visible trunk stands. To the right, a large green bush with numerous small red flowers is depicted. The sky above is a light mint green, with a band of dark blue and white clouds at the very top. Two small, dark birds are shown in flight in the upper right portion of the sky.

alt_text: Black ink Japanese calligraphy on aged, light-colored paper, arranged in three vertical lines with a small signature.
long_description: The image displays a piece of light-colored, aged paper with black ink calligraphy. The paper has a slightly textured appearance with visible creases and subtle discoloration, suggesting age. The calligraphy is arranged in three main vertical columns, written from right to left, with a very small, short column of characters positioned at the bottom right. The ink is dark black, and the strokes vary in thickness, exhibiting a fluid, expressive style. The rightmost main column is the longest, starting near the top edge and extending downwards, featuring several characters with sweeping curves and sharp angles. To its left, the second main column is slightly shorter, also composed of multiple characters with similar calligraphic qualities. The third main column, further to the left, is the shortest and appears to consist of fewer, more elongated characters. The small column at the bottom right consists of two compact characters. The overall impression is of a handwritten text with a dynamic and artistic quality against a subtly aged background.

alt_text: An ink wash painting of a hut with a large thatched roof, a mountain, and small trees in a minimalist landscape
long_description: This black and white ink wash painting depicts a simple landscape featuring a central hut, a large hill, and a cluster of trees. The artwork is rendered with varying shades of gray and black ink on a light background. In the center, a prominent hut stands with a wide, conical or bell-shaped thatched roof. The roof is depicted with numerous vertical brushstrokes of medium gray, suggesting texture, and is darker at its base, gradually lightening towards the top. A small, dark, triangular shape is visible on the upper right side of the roof. The hut is supported by a few dark, vertical lines, indicating posts or walls, which are mostly obscured by the roof's overhang. To the upper left, a large, curved form, resembling a mountain or steep hill, dominates the background. It is rendered with broad, sweeping strokes of dark to medium gray ink, extending from the top left corner downwards towards the center of the composition. On the right side of the painting, a cluster of small, dark, mushroom-shaped forms, likely representing trees or bushes, are grouped together. These are depicted with solid dark gray or black ink, creating a dense mass. The ground beneath the hut and trees is a lighter wash of gray, with subtle horizontal brushstrokes suggesting a flat or slightly undulating surface. The overall background is a very light, almost white, wash, providing a sense of open space and depth.

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape with trees, a small building, and calligraphic text.
long_description: The image is a vertical ink wash painting on light-colored paper, mounted on a pale blue-green border. The artwork depicts a serene mountainous landscape rendered with varying shades of black ink. The upper third of the painting features a prominent, craggy mountain peak in the center, its slopes dotted with small, sparse trees indicated by fine brushstrokes. To the left of this peak, a lighter, more distant mountain range is suggested. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of calligraphic text are inscribed, accompanied by two red square seals below them. The middle and lower sections of the painting are dominated by a cluster of trees and large rocks. On the left, a tall, slender tree with a distinctive, gnarled trunk and sparse foliage stands out. To its right, several other trees, mostly bare-branched, rise from a rocky ground. A small, simple building with a peaked roof is nestled among the trees and rocks in the lower-middle section. The foreground features scattered rocks and faint indications of ground cover. Two red square seals are visible in the lower right corner, and one in the lower left. The overall style uses delicate lines and washes to create depth and texture.

alt_text: A bald figure in elaborate, patterned robes sits facing right, with sandals on a low stand.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a seated, bald figure against a plain, dark brown background. The figure, with light skin and a smooth, rounded head, faces slightly to the right, with a calm expression. They are dressed in multiple layers of robes. The innermost visible layer is a light grey-green with a subtle, repeating circular pattern. Over this, a more elaborate outer robe or shawl drapes, featuring broad sections of dark blue, red-orange, and green, all adorned with intricate floral or brocade patterns in gold and lighter hues. The figure's hands are mostly obscured by the voluminous sleeves. In front of the figure, on the lower right, a pair of light-colored sandals or clogs rests on a small, low, red-orange stand with carved legs. Faint, vertical text is visible in the upper right portion of the dark background. The entire composition is framed by a decorative border with a repeating floral or vine pattern in muted gold and green on a lighter, textured background.

alt_text: A line drawing of a seated man in traditional robes and cap, holding a flute, surrounded by Japanese calligraphy
long_description: The artwork features a line drawing of a seated man on a light-colored, textured paper, surrounded by black script. The man is positioned in the lower center of the composition, facing towards the right. He is depicted with a rounded, dark cap on his head and wears light-colored, flowing robes with wide sleeves that obscure his hands. He holds a thin, light-colored, horizontal object, possibly a flute or a scroll, in front of his chest. His face is rendered with light skin tones, small eyes, and faint red lines indicating a mustache and a small goatee. The entire figure is outlined with thin black lines.Several columns of black Japanese calligraphy are arranged around the figure. In the upper right corner, two vertical columns of script are visible; the rightmost column reads "ぬの時氏". Below this, on the middle right side, a single vertical column of script reads "清永えもん". In the upper left corner, two vertical columns of script are present, with the rightmost column reading "うつろの". A shorter vertical column of script is also visible in the lower left area. The paper itself has a subtle, horizontal fibrous texture visible throughout.

alt_text: A seated figure in traditional robes and a dark cap, with Japanese script, framed by decorative borders
long_description: The artwork depicts a seated figure, likely a man, rendered in a simple, almost monochromatic style on a light gray or off-white background. The figure occupies the lower central portion of the main panel. He is shown facing forward, with a round face, small eyes, and a small mouth. He wears a dark, flat-topped cap on his head. His body is clad in voluminous, layered robes, primarily outlined in dark lines with minimal shading, suggesting a light color. His legs are folded beneath him, and his hands are not visible. In the upper left quadrant of the main panel, there is vertical Japanese script written in black ink. The script reads: "清画" followed by a longer passage of smaller characters. The central panel is bordered by decorative elements. Immediately above and below the main panel are narrow, dark brown bands adorned with repeating gold floral or abstract patterns. Beyond these brown bands, the artwork is further framed by wider, green borders on all four sides, featuring a repeating pattern of gold floral motifs.

alt_text: A fragmented ancient painting of a haloed figure in striped blue and brown attire, holding a staff
long_description: A heavily damaged, rectangular painting on a light brown, textured surface. The painted area is roughly central and irregular, with significant portions missing. A haloed figure, likely male, is depicted from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. The face is light-skinned with dark outlines for the eyes, nose, and mouth. A light brown halo encircles the head. The figure wears a garment with alternating horizontal stripes of blue and light brown on the arms. The torso features vertical stripes of blue and light brown, with some green sections. The figure's right hand is raised to chest level, palm facing outwards, with fingers slightly curled. The left hand holds a long, slender object, possibly a staff or spear, which extends diagonally upwards and to the right. The top of this object has a dark, irregular shape, possibly a flag or a spearhead. The background behind the figure is a faded light green. To the left of the figure, a large, curved blue shape is visible, possibly part of a wing or another element. The painting is severely deteriorated, with numerous cracks, chips, and areas where the paint has flaked off, revealing the underlying light brown material. The edges of the painted area are uneven and ragged.

alt_text: A partially preserved fresco fragment depicts a standing figure with reddish hair and green sashes against a blue background
long_description: A vertical fresco fragment displays a standing figure against a heavily damaged light blue background, which reveals the rough, light brown plaster beneath. The figure, rendered with light tan skin, is positioned centrally and faces left in profile, though the torso is turned slightly to the right. The figure has reddish-brown hair styled upwards, a prominent nose, a small mouth, and a large ear adorned with an earring. The right arm is bent, holding a white, fan-like object upwards. The left arm is also bent, with the hand near the waist, holding an indistinct object. Green sashes or ribbons are draped over the figure's shoulders and around the waist and legs. A light-colored, possibly white, loincloth-like garment covers the lower torso. The legs are bare, and the figure stands on bare feet. Significant portions of the painted surface are missing, particularly on the right side and around the edges, contributing to the fragmented appearance of the artwork.

alt_text: A multi-armed deity with two smaller figures seated on a lotus throne, flanked by text panels
long_description: A rectangular painting features a central illuminated panel depicting a multi-armed figure, flanked by two vertical panels of black text on a light tan background. The central figure is seated cross-legged on a red and blue lotus throne, facing forward. This figure has light skin, an elaborate gold crown, and a gold halo. Two of its four visible arms are raised with hands pressed together in a prayer gesture at the chest. One upper right hand holds a white lotus flower, while the upper left hand is raised with an open palm. Two smaller, light-skinned figures are seated on the lotus throne, one on each side of the central figure, facing inward with hands in a prayer gesture. The central panel is framed by a red archway with green foliage and gold patterns above, and a red and yellow patterned border. The left text panel contains eight lines of black script: "ऊँ नमो भगवते अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय". The right text panel also contains eight lines of black script: "नमो भगवते अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय अष्टमहाभयत्राणाय". Both text panels are bordered by a red and yellow patterned strip.

alt_text: A small bird flies towards a gnarled branch adorned with red-orange blossoms and green leaves.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a small bird in flight near a flowering branch, set against a plain, light brown background. The central image is framed by a narrow dark blue border with a geometric pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider gold-brown border featuring a repeating floral motif. Small gold circular designs are visible at the corners of the inner blue border. A gnarled, dark brown branch extends from the lower left, diagonally upwards, then curves downwards towards the lower right. Along this branch are clusters of red-orange blossoms and numerous oval-shaped, light green leaves. The blossoms vary in size, with some fully open showing multiple petals, and others appearing as buds. The leaves have visible darker veins. In the upper right-center, a small bird is captured mid-flight, facing towards the left. Its wings are spread wide, revealing light gray and white feathers with dark tips. The bird's body is white on its underside and darker on its back, with a distinct black head and a prominent white patch on its cheek. Two small, square red seals are visible in the lower left corner of the central painting, stacked vertically.

alt_text: Blue-skinned figure in a tree above six light-skinned figures partially submerged in wavy blue water.
long_description: The painting depicts a scene with a central blue-skinned figure seated in a tree, surrounded by six light-skinned figures partially submerged in water. The blue-skinned figure, positioned in the middle of the upper half, wears a yellow garment, a crown, and various ornaments, and is encircled by a prominent red halo. This figure sits on a branch of a brown-trunked tree with green leaves, extending across the upper middle section. Below the tree, a wide expanse of blue water with white wavy lines fills the lower half of the composition. Six light-skinned figures, adorned with necklaces and armbands, are shown from the waist up in the water. Two figures are on the left, looking towards the tree, and four figures are on the right, also looking up with their hands raised. The background features a yellow ground with scattered green plants and a light blue sky with white clouds at the top. A thin brown border frames the entire scene.

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting of a small hut on a cliff, with flowing calligraphy above.
long_description: A vertical hanging scroll features a light beige main panel framed by a light green border at the top and bottom. The top border has a subtle, lighter patterned design. The upper two-thirds of the light beige panel are filled with multiple vertical lines of flowing, light brown script, arranged from right to left. The script is composed of delicate, thin strokes. The lower third of the panel depicts a landscape scene rendered in ink wash. A small, simple hut with a sloped roof is perched on the edge of a steep, dark cliff, positioned towards the right side of the composition. Bare branches of trees or shrubs extend upwards and outwards from behind and below the hut. The cliff face is rendered with varying shades of dark ink washes, creating texture and depth. Below the main cliff, more sparse, dark branches extend downwards and to the left, suggesting vegetation clinging to the rock face.

alt_text: A large gathering of figures, a central seated figure with a halo, and a horse under a red canopy in a garden
long_description: The painting depicts a large outdoor gathering under a red and gold patterned canopy, set within a lush green landscape, all framed by a dark blue border with intricate gold floral motifs. In the center, a prominent figure with a green halo around their head is seated on a raised, light purple platform, facing towards the right. This central figure is dressed in light purple robes with gold details. They are positioned on a large, white rug adorned with small pink and green floral patterns, which covers the ground beneath the canopy. Numerous other figures, mostly dressed in light purple robes and turbans, are arranged around the central figure. To the right, many figures are seated on the rug, some holding fans or musical instruments. To the left of the central figure, a line of figures in light purple robes are seated, facing the center. Further to the left, outside the rug area, a group of figures in white robes and turbans stand, holding poles that support the canopy. Below them, on the green ground, a brown horse with a red and white patterned blanket stands facing left. In the lower left corner, a dark-colored dog lies on the green ground. The upper portion of the painting features dense green foliage and brown tree trunks, suggesting a garden or forest setting. The red canopy is supported by golden poles and features a repeating gold floral pattern.
