alt_text: A traditional Indian miniature painting depicting Krishna and Radha with gopis in a lush forest setting.
long_description: The rectangular miniature painting depicts a vibrant scene with multiple figures set within a stylized landscape. In the upper left, a dark-skinned male figure, likely Krishna, is seated on a light, dotted platform. He wears a tall, ornate crown, jewelry, and patterned garments, with a halo behind his head. To his left, a lighter-skinned female figure stands, looking towards him. In the upper right, a lighter-skinned female figure, likely Radha, is seated on a similar dotted platform, facing left, with a halo behind her head. She wears patterned garments and jewelry, with one hand near her face. A dense, dark green forest with rounded trees and lighter foliage forms the background, separating the two elevated figures with a prominent central tree. Below these elevated figures, five lighter-skinned female figures, or gopis, are arranged in a line across the lower foreground. They are adorned in patterned skirts and blouses, with veils, and appear to be dancing or moving in a circular formation with outstretched arms. The ground in the immediate foreground is a darker, plain surface, while the middle ground features light, dotted terrain and smaller bushes. The entire scene is framed by a thin, dark border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Color, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: Two central figures sit in a pavilion, flanked by attendants and garden foliage, with a block of text above
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting features a central scene of figures within an elaborate pavilion, topped by a section of script. The upper portion of the artwork contains a light gray, cloud-shaped cartouche filled with multiple lines of dark, dense script, set against a dark background. Below this, the main scene unfolds within a multi-tiered architectural structure. A prominent, striped, pyramidal roof crowns the central pavilion. The main platform is elevated, with patterned steps leading up to it on both the left and right sides. A small, tiered fountain structure is visible in the lower center of this platform. Within the pavilion, two main figures are seated on a patterned cushion or throne, facing slightly towards each other. Both figures wear distinct headwear and patterned garments. On the lower level of the platform, two female figures stand on either side, facing inwards towards the central figures. On the upper platform, closer to the central figures, two additional female figures are visible, one on each side, also facing inwards. All attendants wear patterned garments. Behind the pavilion, on both the left and right sides, are dense areas of foliage, suggesting a garden. The background of the main scene is a plain, light tone. The bottom edge of the painting shows a patterned border and some indistinct shapes, with visible signs of wear.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Color, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: A man on a decorated horse leads a procession of attendants through a hilly landscape
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a procession of figures moving from left to right across a light-toned background. In the upper left, a dark, undulating hilly landscape with small, dense trees rises diagonally. The rest of the upper background is a plain, light color. The central figure is a man seated on a large, elaborately decorated horse. The man, positioned slightly right of center, has a prominent mustache and beard, and wears a turban and ornate, layered clothing. He holds a slender object, possibly a staff or weapon, in his right hand. The horse is adorned with a decorative headpiece, a fringed blanket covering its back, and other intricate trappings. Its mane is long and appears to be styled. Surrounding the horse and rider are numerous male attendants. To the left of the horse, two men walk forward, one holding a tall pole with a triangular flag, and the other a staff. Both wear turbans and simple, flowing garments. To the right and behind the horse, several more attendants walk. One carries a large, leaf-shaped fan on a pole. Another holds a long, dark, club-like object. Further right, two men carry a large, round drum. All visible attendants wear turbans and simple, light-colored clothing, and many have mustaches and beards. The figures are rendered with considerable detail, contrasting with the simpler background elements. The image is presented in grayscale, showing a range of dark and light tones.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Color, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: Two figures in a landscape with hills and dense trees, one seated above, one reclining below
long_description:
The image is a black and white artwork, likely a miniature painting, depicting two figures in a stylized landscape. At the top, a band of text in an Indian script spans the width of the image. Below the text, the scene is divided into two main levels by a rolling hill.

On the upper level, a figure is seated on the crest of a hill, facing towards the right. This figure wears a crown or elaborate headdress, a simple garment, and jewelry around the neck and arms. The figure's left arm is raised, and the right arm rests on the lap. Behind and around this figure are dense, stylized trees with many small, dark leaves.

On the lower level, a second figure is depicted in a reclining or seated posture on the ground, looking upwards towards the figure on the hill. This figure wears an elaborate patterned garment, jewelry, and has hair styled with a bun or braid. The figure's left hand holds a small, fan-like object, while the right arm is extended outwards. This figure is positioned between two large, stylized trees, one on the left and one on the right, with distinct, layered foliage. The ground features rolling contours and sparse tufts of grass. The entire scene is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray, with strong outlines and detailed patterns.

alt_text: A man and two women in traditional attire perform a ritual with plants and offerings in an architectural setting.
long_description:
The black and white illustration depicts three figures engaged in an activity within an architectural setting. At the top, several lines of text in an unknown script are visible. The background features a building with a decorative railing on the left and arched openings on the right. A large, ornate canopy with a patterned underside hangs above the central figures.

In the center, a tall, multi-tiered pedestal holds numerous leafy plants. A male figure stands to the right of the pedestal, facing left. He has dark skin and wears a crown or elaborate turban, a necklace, armbands, and a long, pleated robe. His right hand is extended towards the plants on the pedestal.

To the left of the pedestal, a female figure stands facing the male figure. She has lighter skin and wears a sari-like garment and jewelry. She holds a tray with a small, ornate lamp or vessel. To the right of the male figure, another female figure stands, also with lighter skin, wearing a sari-like garment and jewelry. She holds a small cup or bowl in her left hand. All three figures are barefoot.

alt_text: A woman in traditional attire stands between a building and a tree, looking up at a chain.
long_description: This black and white painting depicts a woman standing outdoors, positioned slightly to the right of the center. She faces left, with her head tilted upwards and to the left, her gaze directed towards the upper left portion of the frame. Her right arm is raised, holding a thin, rope-like object or chain that extends upwards into the dark foliage of a tree. Her left arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand near her waist. She wears a long, flowing skirt, a fitted top, and a veil draped over her head and shoulder. Visible jewelry includes earrings, a necklace, and bracelets on her wrists. To the woman's left is a white building with a flat roof and an open, dark doorway revealing a patterned floor inside. To her right, a large, dark tree with dense, textured foliage extends from the bottom to the top of the frame. The background behind the woman and the tree is dark, with lighter, wavy lines suggesting clouds or a stormy sky. The ground in the foreground is light-colored and plain. At the top of the painting, a block of text in Devanagari script is visible: "॥सूय ममाल जी ही डोल की रानी॥जो वनशरि य नभू दिरही है॥अंबर नीन मे हार सिंगारनि कुंकु सांभ भी नपनी तम नोहरही है॥चंचलाको चमकी सविभी भी नर्गई चोक्तिही है॥ यामप माषदी राग हिडोलकी रागनी चित केचोपल ही है॥"

alt_text: A man and woman embrace, surrounded by several women, under a sky with stylized clouds
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a scene with multiple figures under a band of text at the top. The top section features a dark rectangular band containing lines of text in an unfamiliar script. Below this, the main scene unfolds. The background is a light gray, with several dark, wavy, cloud-like forms arching across the upper portion of the scene. In the center, a man and a woman embrace. The man, positioned slightly to the left, has dark hair and wears a long, light-colored garment. His right arm is around the woman's waist. The woman, to his right, also has dark hair and wears a patterned garment. Her left arm is around the man's neck, and her right hand holds a dark, elongated, club-like object vertically. Surrounding the central couple are seven other women, all with dark hair and wearing long, patterned garments. On the left, one woman stands behind the couple, holding a small, dark object. Further left, another woman stands with her right arm raised. Below her, a smaller woman sits or kneels, holding a dark, cylindrical object. On the right, one woman stands behind the couple, looking towards them. Further right, another woman stands, holding a small, dark object. Below her, a smaller woman stands, holding a dark, cylindrical object. In the foreground, a dark, elongated, cylindrical object lies horizontally on the light gray ground.

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire, one seated and one standing, in a garden setting with a building and text above.
long_description:
The painting depicts two women in a garden setting with a building on the right and text at the top. The upper portion of the image features a band of dark text in an Indian script against a lighter background. Below the text, a dark, tall palm tree with fanned leaves rises on the left, extending towards the top edge. To its right, a row of lighter, rounded trees or bushes is visible behind a low, dark horizontal line, possibly a wall or fence. On the far right, a light-colored building with a multi-tiered, sloped roof is partially visible, showing an arched entrance and a dark interior.

In the foreground, two women are positioned on a light-colored ground. On the left, a woman stands facing right, towards the seated woman. She wears a long, light-colored skirt and a darker top, with her hair pulled back. She holds small, dark, leaf-like objects in both hands, extended forward. On the right, a second woman is seated on a patterned, possibly striped, chair or cushion. She faces left, towards the standing woman, and wears a long, light-colored skirt and a darker top. Her hair is also pulled back. She holds similar small, dark, leaf-like objects in her hands, positioned near her lap. The overall impression is a scene of interaction between the two figures in an outdoor, semi-architectural environment.

alt_text: Three figures, one dancing, two playing instruments, under a tree with text above
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting framed by a thick black border. At the top, a rectangular block of text in an unknown script occupies the upper portion of the painting. Below this text, a scene unfolds featuring three figures in a landscape. On the left, a large tree with a visible trunk and dense, dark, stylized foliage dominates the upper left quadrant. Its branches extend towards the center. Under the tree, on the left side of the composition, a figure stands facing right, holding a drum-like instrument horizontally across their waist. This figure wears a light-colored top and a patterned skirt with dark, teardrop-shaped motifs. In the center, a dark-skinned figure with a headdress is depicted in a dynamic, mid-air dancing pose. Their arms are raised, holding two stick-like objects, and their legs are bent, suggesting movement. This central figure wears a light-colored dhoti and flowing sashes. To the right of the central dancer, another figure stands, facing left, holding a stringed instrument that resembles a veena or sitar, held diagonally across their body. This figure also wears a light-colored top and a patterned skirt similar to the figure on the left. The background behind the figures is a light, unadorned area, possibly representing a sky or open space, with a subtle, lighter horizon line near the bottom. The ground beneath the figures is a lighter, uniform shade. The overall scene is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray, indicating a monochrome or grayscale image.

alt_text: A bearded man in a white robe rides a rearing dark horse, accompanied by three other men.
long_description: The painting depicts a dynamic scene with a central figure on horseback and several accompanying men against a plain background. A man with a dark beard and mustache, wearing a turban and a long white robe, sits atop a dark, rearing horse. He holds reins in his hands. The turban features a plume-like ornament, and he wears a necklace. The horse, dark in color, is shown with its front legs lifted, suggesting movement. It is adorned with an elaborate bridle and saddle, featuring decorative patterns. Behind the rider, partially obscured by the horse's body, is another man with a beard and turban, looking forward. Below the horse, walking forward, are two more men. Both have beards and turbans and wear white robes. The man closer to the viewer holds a long staff diagonally across his body. The background is a solid, dark color, possibly dark gray or blue, with a thin lighter border at the top edge.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Colors, silver and gold on paper

alt_text: A painting depicts a man and woman on a balcony observing women swinging and dancing below a tree.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting with a decorative border depicts a scene with multiple figures and a large tree. In the upper left, a man and a woman are positioned on a balcony. The man, on the right, faces left with a mustache and a turban-like head covering. The woman, on the left, faces right with a head covering. Both appear to be looking down and to the right. The background features a dark, cloudy sky with faint wavy lines. A distant horizon line with small trees is visible. On the right side, a large, full tree with dense foliage and numerous white flowers dominates the mid-ground. Below the tree, two women are on a swing, suspended from its branches. One woman is seated, facing left, holding the ropes, while another woman stands on the swing, facing right, also holding the ropes. Below the swing, four women are depicted in various dancing or walking poses, arranged in a semi-circle. Each woman holds a long, curved object, possibly a garland or a stick with a flower. They wear long dresses and head coverings. On the left, a building structure with an arched doorway is visible, forming the base for the balcony. In the foreground, a low wall or platform extends across the bottom, with small dark shapes, possibly ducks, in a pool of water.

alt_text: A black and white painting of a man and woman conversing in a garden, with a tree and a bird
long_description: This black and white painting depicts two figures, a man and a woman, standing in an outdoor setting with a dark background, enclosed by an ornate border. On the left, a woman stands facing right, towards the man. She wears a long, light-colored, patterned dress with a full skirt and long sleeves, cinched at the waist by a sash. A long veil covers her head and drapes over her shoulders and back. Her arms are raised, with her hands open and palms facing upwards. She has visible earrings and a necklace. On the right, a man stands facing left, towards the woman. He wears a long, light-colored, patterned tunic (jama) over trousers, and pointed shoes. A sash is draped over his left shoulder and across his body. He wears a tall, elaborate turban adorned with a plume, a long necklace with a large circular pendant, and earrings. His right arm is raised, with his index finger pointing towards the woman. Behind the woman on the left is a tree with a slender trunk and a dense canopy of small, detailed leaves. In the upper right corner, a small bird is shown in flight. The ground beneath the figures is covered with grass and scattered small plants and flowers. The entire scene is framed by a dark, decorative border featuring intricate scrollwork and floral motifs.

alt_text: A long, horizontal painting shows many people on a sandy shore, a bridge, and in market stalls beside water
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a bustling scene along a body of water, rendered in a muted palette of light blues, greens, browns, and reds against a pale yellow-brown background. The composition is divided into a sandy shore, a wooden bridge, and a section of water.On the left, a large crowd of figures, dressed in various colored kimonos and robes, gathers on the sandy bank. Some individuals are partially submerged in the light blue water on the far left. Moving right, several open-sided stalls with striped roofs are visible on the shore. People are depicted interacting within these stalls, some appearing to sell goods, others observing. One stall features a large, white, round umbrella, and another has a vertical sign with black characters.A wooden bridge with railings extends from the mid-left towards the mid-right, spanning a narrow channel of water. Numerous figures walk across this bridge, some carrying bundles or fans. On the right side of the image, the sandy shore continues, where several individuals are seated on raised wooden platforms directly over the water. These figures appear to be bathing or washing, with some partially undressed. The water is depicted with wavy lines, suggesting gentle movement. The overall scene portrays a lively public gathering place with various activities taking place simultaneously.

metadata.title: 源琦筆 　華洛四季遊楽図巻|Scenes of the Four Seasons in Kyoto
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A large green-skinned figure lies on the ground, surrounded by three smaller figures, one blue-skinned, in a room
long_description: The painting depicts a scene with five figures against a vibrant red background, partially enclosed by a building structure on the left. A large, light green-skinned figure lies horizontally across the lower half of the frame, facing upwards with its head to the left. This figure has dark, wild hair, wide eyes, and a patterned white and orange garment around its waist, with white and red markings on its skin. A smaller, blue-skinned figure sits astride the large figure's stomach, looking towards the left. To the left of the large figure's head, a standing figure with light brown skin, wearing a purple top and yellow skirt, pulls at the large figure's hair with both hands. Below this standing figure, a very small, light-skinned figure, wearing a white garment and jewelry, stands with arms outstretched towards the large figure. To the right of the large figure, another standing figure with light brown skin, dressed in a yellow top and purple skirt, leans forward with both hands extended towards the large figure. This figure also has dark hair and jewelry. The building structure on the far left features blue walls, a red roof with purple trim, and a patterned orange and red bed-like structure. The background behind the figures is a solid, bright red, with a thin strip of light blue at the very top.

alt_text: A man on a blue horse, accompanied by attendants, in a landscape with distant buildings
long_description:
The painting depicts a central figure on a rearing blue horse, surrounded by four attendants, set against a hilly landscape. The artwork is framed by a thick red border. In the immediate foreground, a narrow strip of green ground is visible, dotted with small, sparse plants.

The central figure, a man with a dark beard and mustache, wears a white turban, a white tunic, and multiple necklaces. He sits astride a blue horse that rears on its hind legs, its front hooves lifted. The horse has a decorated bridle and saddle. The man holds the reins with his left hand and raises his right hand.

Four male attendants accompany the horse and rider. To the left of the horse, a man with a beard and turban, dressed in a white tunic, holds a bow in his left hand and an arrow in his right, looking towards the horse. Directly in front of the horse, another bearded man in a white tunic holds the horse's bridle. Behind the horse, a third bearded man in a white tunic holds the horse's tail. To the far right, a fourth bearded man in a white tunic holds a tall pole topped with a large, ornate, golden fan-like object.

The background features a light-colored, undulating landscape. On the left, a complex of white buildings with domes and walls is nestled among green trees. On the right, another white building with a red flag on its roof is visible, surrounded by trees, with a winding dark path leading towards it. The sky above is a pale blue and white.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor and ink on paper

alt_text: A woman with a grey bird on her gloved hand sits on an ornate platform in a green landscape.
long_description: The painting is a square composition framed by a wide, plain orange border. Within this border, a central green landscape is depicted under a narrow strip of blue sky at the top. Black script is visible at the very top of the green area, reading "मैलवराग रागिनी की टंक". In the center, a woman with light skin and dark hair is seated on an ornate, elevated platform. She faces towards the right side of the image. Her attire includes a pink top, a patterned reddish-brown shawl draped over her shoulders and chest, and a blue and white striped skirt. She wears various pieces of jewelry, including earrings, necklaces, and bracelets. Her left hand, adorned with rings, holds a small, light-colored object. Her right hand is covered by a long, yellow glove and supports a small, grey bird with a dark beak, which is perched facing her. The platform she sits on features a bright yellow cushion. The base of the platform is silver-colored with intricate geometric patterns and rests on four bell-shaped legs. To the left of the platform stands a tall, dark green, conical tree with a light pink trunk. To the right, another tall, conical tree with dense, orange foliage and a light pink trunk is visible. A branch with light green leaves extends from the upper right corner, curving downwards behind the woman. The ground is a uniform dark green, with some lighter green accents.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and silver on paper

alt_text: A purple-skinned, horned figure sits under an umbrella, facing a running green reptilian creature.
long_description: The rectangular painting features a red border and is divided into two distinct scenes by an architectural structure. The left scene, set against a white background, depicts a purple-skinned, male figure seated on a green cushion atop a yellow and blue striped mat with white floral patterns. This figure has a dark mustache and beard, large ears, and two dark, upward-curving horns. He wears a white and blue striped dhoti, multiple necklaces, armbands, and a white sacred thread. His right hand is raised with an open palm, while his left hand rests on his lap. A golden, decorated umbrella is suspended above his head. The figure is framed by an archway with orange and white decorative pillars. The right scene, set against a dark blue background with a yellow ground line, shows a green, reptilian-like creature in a dynamic running or leaping pose. This creature possesses a long snout, an open mouth revealing a tongue and teeth, and a long tail. It is adorned with a red dhoti, necklaces, and armbands. Its hands are raised, and its feet display visible claws. The two figures are positioned facing each other, with the stationary purple figure on the left and the active green creature on the right, separated by the central architectural element.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor, ink and gold on paper

alt_text: Several small birds perch among bamboo stalks in an ink wash painting on a light background
long_description: The artwork is a vertical composition featuring bamboo and small birds rendered in ink on a light, aged background. The background is a muted, yellowish-beige color, showing some subtle variations in tone. Dark ink bamboo stalks and leaves dominate the lower two-thirds of the image, extending from the bottom edge upwards and slightly to the left. The bamboo leaves are depicted with varying shades of dark gray and black ink, creating a sense of depth and movement as they overlap and cluster. Interspersed among the bamboo and on thinner, more delicate branches are several small birds. In the upper right quadrant, a bird with a light body and darker wings is perched on a slender branch, facing left. Below and slightly to its left, another bird, also light-bodied, faces right on a similar branch that bears small clusters of dots, possibly berries or tiny flowers. Further down and to the left, two more small birds are partially visible, nestled within or behind the bamboo foliage, also rendered in lighter ink with darker details. The birds are depicted with fine lines, suggesting feathers and small beaks. In the upper right corner, above the bamboo and birds, there is a vertical inscription of black calligraphic text, followed by a small, square red seal. The overall impression is one of a natural scene, with the dark, strong lines of the bamboo contrasting with the lighter, more delicate forms of the birds and their perches.

metadata.title: 明　佚名　仿林良　喜上梅梢圖　軸|Birds Amidst Blossoming Plum and Bamboo
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A man on a white horse holding a spear, accompanied by a walking attendant with a bow and arrow.
long_description: The painting is a vertical rectangular composition framed by a thick, solid red border. It depicts two male figures, one riding a horse and the other walking, against a simple landscape background. The ground is a dark green, transitioning to a lighter green in the middle ground, and topped by a light blue sky with a thin, horizontal white cloud line. On the left, a man with light skin and a dark beard sits astride a white horse, facing right in profile. He wears a long, white tunic adorned with small, dark, repeating patterns, a red sash, and a striped turban with a plume. He holds a long, dark spear vertically in his right hand and reins in his left. A quiver filled with arrows and a bow are strapped to his back. The white horse has a detailed bridle, a red saddle blanket, and its legs are depicted in motion, with orange hooves. To the right of the horse, a second man walks forward, also facing right in profile. He has light skin and a dark beard, and wears a long, yellow tunic with small, dark, repeating patterns, a white sash, and a dark turban with a plume. He carries a bow in his left hand. Both figures and the horse are rendered with fine details, standing out against the plain background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A man with a mustache and turban rides a dark brown horse, holding a spear and a round shield
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a man on horseback against a simple landscape. The man, positioned centrally and facing right, has a dark mustache and a small dark beard. He wears a light-colored turban, a long white tunic, and red sashes or wraps. A dark earring is visible on his right ear. He holds a long, dark spear vertically in his right hand and a round, black shield with six gold studs in his left. The dark brown horse is also facing right, with its front left leg raised as if in motion. It has a bridle with light blue and orange accents, and a saddle adorned with white, pink, and blue fabrics. Its hooves are dark gray with orange bands above them. The background consists of a flat, light green field in the lower two-thirds and a light blue sky with faint white cloud-like marks in the upper third. A decorative border, light brown with dark brown stylized patterns, runs along the left side and across the top of the painting.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A colorful painting depicts a large procession of figures, some on horseback, carrying banners and playing instruments.
long_description: A horizontal painting shows a lively procession of numerous figures, some on horseback, against an off-white background. The artwork is framed by a dark blue border with a repeating pattern of lighter blue shapes. The procession moves from left to right, arranged in multiple rows. In the upper left, a figure in a blue robe and red hat stands on a brown horse, playing a long, light-colored flute. Behind and around this figure are several other individuals in blue or yellow vests over light-colored tunics, all wearing red hats. In the upper middle and right, more figures walk, some carrying large, ornate banners with red and yellow designs, possibly depicting dragons. Two more figures are mounted on horses, one brown and one white, both with green saddles. The figures' clothing primarily consists of blue, yellow, and black garments, often with red hats. In the lower section, a long row of figures walks, each carrying a smaller, rectangular banner with a red and yellow design. These figures are dressed similarly to those above, in blue or yellow vests and red hats. On the far right, a vertical yellow rectangle contains black text, which reads: "正黃旗德印". Below the figure on the horse playing the flute, a smaller vertical rectangle with black text reads: "跑馬吹笛". The overall impression is of a vibrant, detailed parade.

metadata.title: 清  那爾敦布  順治皇帝進京之隊伍賽馬全圖  卷|Horsemanship Competition for the Shunzhi Emperor
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A traditional painting depicts figures, a horse, and boats along a winding river with houses and hills.
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a landscape scene with figures, animals, and structures rendered in muted tones of brown, green, and light blue. The composition is divided by a winding waterway that snakes from the left foreground towards the right background. On the far left, an open-sided structure with a dark, possibly thatched roof and light-colored walls shelters three figures. One figure, dressed in light robes, sits on a raised platform. Another figure, in green and red garments, sits beside them. A third figure, dressed in light clothing, stands next to a brown horse, holding its reins. The horse is saddled, and a large, ornate umbrella is held above the standing figure. A gnarled, dark-trunked tree with sparse foliage grows beside the structure. The winding waterway, rendered in light blue-gray, occupies the central and lower portions of the image, with irregular brown banks. On the right side of the waterway, a series of rocky hills rise, dotted with dark green pine trees and other foliage. A lone figure, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and carrying a staff or bundle, stands on a rocky outcrop overlooking the water. Further along the bank, a cluster of small houses with light brown thatched roofs are visible. Two larger boats with masts are moored near these houses, and a smaller boat is visible further down the waterway. The background features more distant hills and trees.

alt_text: Ink wash painting depicting layered mountains, an expansive body of water with villages, trees, and extensive calligraphic text.
long_description: This ink wash painting features a landscape rendered in shades of black and gray on a light-colored paper. The upper portion of the image is dominated by a series of rolling, layered mountains, depicted with textured brushstrokes that suggest contours and foliage. Below the mountains, an expansive body of water stretches across the middle ground, with a few small, dark boats visible on its surface. Scattered throughout the water and along its edges are numerous clusters of trees, many with drooping branches, resembling willows. Interspersed among these trees are small villages, each composed of several simple, rectangular houses with dark roofs. The houses are arranged in groups, some appearing to be on small islands or peninsulas within the water, connected by what might be a small bridge on the far right. The lower foreground shows areas of lighter wash, suggesting land or shallow water. Extensive vertical columns of calligraphic text are present on the upper left and upper right sides of the composition, with additional, smaller columns of text and several red seals located in the lower left corner of the artwork.

metadata.title: 王翬、楊晉、顧昉、王雲、徐玫 仿古山水圖 冊 紙本|Landscapes after old masters

alt_text: Multiple armored warriors engage in a dynamic battle with swords, bows, and shields.
long_description: The image depicts a dynamic battle scene featuring multiple armored figures engaged in combat, rendered in a style reminiscent of historical scroll paintings. The background is a muted, light beige or off-white, showing subtle vertical lines and faint discoloration consistent with an aged artwork. The composition is horizontal, with the figures spread across the lower two-thirds of the frame, creating a strong sense of movement from left to right. On the far left, two armored figures are partially visible, one holding a long pole weapon. Immediately to their right, a large, light-colored rectangular shield stands upright, adorned with four black diamond shapes arranged in two rows. Behind this shield, two figures are positioned; one, wearing a dark helmet, holds a bow, aiming towards the right. In the center-left, another armored figure, wearing a red and black helmet and armor, holds a sword and appears to be lunging forward. Above and slightly to the right of the shield, a prominent figure in white, red, and black armor, with a red head covering, runs vigorously to the right, holding a curved sword. This figure has a distinct facial expression with wide eyes and an open mouth. A long, dark object, possibly a scabbard, is strapped to their back. Below this running figure, another armored warrior is in a crouched position, holding a bow. Further to the right, a second prominent armored figure, also running to the right, wears a large red cape or banner over their shoulders and a horned helmet, carrying a long sword. In the bottom right, a figure in dark armor points forward with one hand and holds a bow with the other, looking towards the right. Behind this figure, a stylized, bare tree branch extends upwards from the bottom edge. The armor is detailed with various patterns and colors, predominantly red, black, white, and dark blue. Weapons include curved swords, bows, and polearms, conveying an impression of intense action.

alt_text: A horizontal painting depicts figures on a shore and in water, with a hilly landscape behind them.
long_description: This horizontal painting features a scene divided between a light-colored shore and a body of water, with a hilly landscape in the upper left. The background on the left shows rolling hills in shades of green and brown, dotted with dark green pine trees. The shore, which occupies the lower left and center, is a light tan color. On this shore, two figures are positioned. One figure, wearing a red garment and with long dark hair, is seated or reclining. Another figure, dressed in a light-colored robe, is hunched over the first. A dark, wavy line separates the shore from the blue-grey water that extends across the right half of the painting. Within this water, several figures are visible. Some appear to be partially submerged, with only their heads or upper bodies showing. Towards the far right, one figure with light skin and dark hair is being held or supported by another figure, who wears a light robe and has a bald head with some facial hair. The overall color palette is muted, with blues, greens, browns, and a prominent red garment.

alt_text: An open, aged book showing handwritten text on the left page and a few characters on the right
long_description: The image shows an open, aged book, presented from a slightly elevated, direct overhead perspective. The book is bound vertically, with two pages visible. The left page is almost entirely covered with dense, vertical handwritten text in dark ink. The characters are small and appear to be in a script style. There are some small, dark smudges and faint discolorations on this page, particularly near the top. The right page is largely blank, appearing lighter in color than the left page. In the lower right quadrant, there are three vertical handwritten characters in dark ink, larger and more spaced out than the text on the left page. The top and right edges of this page show more significant signs of age, with several dark brown stains and small tears or worn spots. Both pages are made of a light, off-white or cream-colored paper that shows a visible texture, possibly from fibers. The paper has a generally aged appearance, with subtle yellowing and various small, irregular dark spots and smudges scattered across both pages, indicating wear and tear over time. The binding edge between the two pages is visible as a dark, slightly recessed line. The outer edges of the book are also visible, showing a slightly darker, worn texture.

alt_text: A fan painting depicts a mountainous landscape with traditional buildings, a body of water, and calligraphic text.
long_description: The image displays a fan-shaped painting featuring a vibrant mountainous landscape with traditional architecture. The painting is set against a light, patterned background. The central and left portions of the fan are dominated by numerous mountains, rendered in shades of green and deep blue. Some peaks are steep and jagged, while others appear more rounded and forested. Nestled within the mountains, particularly in the central area, are several multi-tiered buildings with distinctive red-orange roofs and light-colored walls. A prominent complex of structures, possibly a temple or palace, is situated in the mid-ground, featuring multiple levels and intricate details. Bridges and pathways, some with railings, connect different parts of the architectural complex and ascend the mountain slopes. A body of water, appearing as a lake or wide river, is visible in the upper-middle distance, reflecting the lighter tones of the sky or distant, hazy mountains. Smaller structures and bridges are also visible on the right side, integrated into the landscape. In the upper right section of the fan, there is a block of vertical calligraphic text written in black ink, accompanied by two square red seals. The overall composition creates a sense of depth and grandeur within the natural setting.

metadata.title: 清	徐揚 	仙山樓閣圖     扇面|Palaces of the Immortals
metadata.medium: Folding fan mounted as an album leaf; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Two vertical scroll paintings depict mountainous landscapes with water, trees, small boats, and distant structures.
long_description:
The image displays two vertical scroll paintings, presented side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a landscape rendered primarily in black ink wash on a light brown ground, with subtle variations in tone.

The left scroll depicts a towering, jagged mountain range dominating the upper half, with a lighter sky above, containing a faint circular form in the upper right. Below the mountains, a wide body of water stretches across the mid-ground, dotted with several small, dark boats. The foreground consists of rocky terrain and various trees, including dense clusters of pines and some deciduous trees, extending from the left and bottom edges. Small, indistinct figures are visible near the water's edge in the lower left. A narrow, patterned border in gold and black separates the painting from the light brown paper mounting, which is further framed by a wider light green fabric with a repeating diamond pattern at the top and bottom. Faint red seals and black text are visible in the upper left corner of the painting.

The right scroll mirrors the composition of the left, also featuring a prominent, craggy mountain range in the upper half, with a lighter sky. A body of water occupies the mid-ground, with small boats. The foreground is characterized by tall, dark pine trees that rise from rocky outcrops on the right. Nestled among these rocks and trees are several small, dark structures, including a pavilion with a pointed roof near the water's edge on the lower right. Small figures are also discernible in the lower right. This scroll shares the same patterned borders and fabric mounting as the left scroll. Faint red seals and black text are visible in the upper right corner of the painting.

metadata.title: 啓孫筆　四季山水図|Landscapes of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A bald, robed figure sits on rocks, holding a staff, surrounded by mist in a vertical scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a solitary figure in a misty landscape. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by shades of beige, brown, and grey. In the lower-middle section of the scroll, a bald figure is seated on a light-colored, irregular rock formation. The figure is seen from the back, turned slightly to the right, and wears a loose, brown robe that drapes over their body. Their left arm is visible, and they hold a slender, dark staff that extends upwards behind them. Sparse, dark foliage or branches are visible around the rock formation where the figure sits, and a small, dark bowl-like object rests near their right side. Below and to the right of the seated figure, two dark, angular rock formations rise from the bottom edge of the painting. The lower half of the painting features a light, hazy ground. Above the figure, a large expanse of the scroll is filled with swirling, greyish mist or clouds, which gradually fades into the pale, unadorned background at the top. The top and bottom edges of the main painting area are bordered by narrow strips of light green fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern.

metadata.title: 霊彩筆　豊干寒山拾得図|Fenggan, Hanshan, and Shide
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicting numerous figures in traditional buildings and landscapes with gold clouds.
long_description: The artwork is a multi-panel screen painting, likely a six-panel screen, with a dark background punctuated by large, irregular gold leaf clouds or mist. The composition is divided into several distinct scenes, each featuring multiple figures and architectural elements. In the upper left, a group of figures, some on horseback, are gathered under dark green trees. Below them, a building with a light-colored porch extends over a dark area, possibly water, with two boats docked nearby. Inside the building, figures are engaged in various activities, including writing. Moving right, more figures are seen outdoors, some walking in groups, others interacting near buildings. The buildings feature brown roofs, light-colored walls, and red accents. Many figures wear long robes in shades of red, brown, white, and blue. Gold clouds separate different narrative sections and create a sense of depth. In the upper right, several figures are depicted on rooftops and inside buildings, some appearing to be monks or religious figures in dark robes. Below them, more buildings are shown, with figures inside and on elevated walkways. The lower right section features a group of figures gathered outdoors, with a single figure seated inside a building with a patterned screen. Throughout the painting, small white animals, possibly dogs, are visible in the landscape. The overall impression is a bustling, narrative scene set in a traditional environment.

metadata.title: 南蛮屏風|Arrival of the Europeans
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, gold, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A traditional ink and wash landscape painting featuring towering mountains, a winding river, dense trees, and small human structures.
long_description: This vertical landscape painting, rendered in a muted palette of greys, light browns, and greens, depicts a vast natural scene. The upper portion of the image is dominated by a light, almost white sky. On the right, a series of towering, rugged mountains rise dramatically, their peaks rendered with dark grey ink washes and fine, textured lines. Numerous small, dark green coniferous trees dot the slopes of these mountains, particularly on the lower ridges. A small, light-roofed hut is visible on a high ridge towards the upper right. Below these large mountains, the landscape transitions into rolling hills that descend towards a wide body of water on the left. These hills are also covered with a mix of dark green coniferous trees and some lighter, reddish-brown deciduous trees. A narrow stream or gorge cuts through the lower hills on the right, spanned by a small, arched bridge. The left side of the painting features a wide river or lake that recedes into the background, where distant, hazy mountains are faintly visible. Along the near bank of this water body, more undulating hills and rocky outcrops are covered with trees. A solitary, small figure, depicted in light grey, stands on a path or bank near the water's edge in the middle-left. The overall impression is one of a serene and expansive natural environment.

metadata.title: 清　蕭雲從　山水圖　冊|Landscapes
metadata.medium: Album of eight paintings; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman in an elaborate kimono and headdress, holding a red object, under a moon with two birds.
long_description: A tall, vertical scroll painting features a central light beige panel framed by olive green borders with decorative elements. The top and bottom borders are adorned with delicate white and gold leafy branches, some with small white flowers and a single green leaf. A patterned band of small, reddish-brown rectangular bricks separates the central panel from the top and bottom decorative borders. In the upper center of the light beige panel, a pale, circular moon shape is visible. To its right, two small, dark bird silhouettes fly upwards. The main figure, a woman, is depicted in the lower half of the central panel. She faces slightly left, with her body angled towards the viewer. Her hair is styled in a large, dark, intricate headdress with gold or light-colored elements extending outwards. Her face is pale with delicate features. She wears a multi-layered garment, including a blue-grey upper garment with textured patterns around the shoulders and sleeves, and a red collar. Her lower garment is a voluminous, patterned kimono in shades of purple, blue, and orange, with intricate designs. A large, dark, almost black, outer garment or cloak with a circular gold motif on the back is draped over her left shoulder and arm. Her right hand holds a small, red, flower-like object. Red shoes or socks are visible at the bottom of her feet. A red square seal with illegible characters is located near her lower right foot.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A blue-skinned man embraces a woman, flanked by two other women, beneath trees with monkeys and birds, with text above
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular painting with distinct horizontal bands. At the top, a bright yellow rectangular panel contains black text in Devanagari script: "कापि कपोल तले मिलिता लपितुं किमपि श्रुतं मूले। वाचुचुंब वनिते वदती स्थिते पुले करनैक ले।।४।।।" Below this, a dark blue band features a white wavy line, followed by a thin red horizontal line. The central scene unfolds against a deep red background. In the upper half, four stylized trees with dark brown trunks rise from the bottom edge of the blue band. From left to right, the trees alternate between green foliage with circular patterns and pink foliage with star-like patterns. A light-skinned monkey is perched in the leftmost green tree, and another in the rightmost green tree. Two dark birds are visible in the left pink tree, while a blue and black peacock-like bird with a long tail is in the right pink tree. In the lower half of the central scene, four figures stand on a dark brown ground line. In the center, a blue-skinned man with a white turban, white dhoti, and yellow sash embraces a light-skinned woman wearing a green patterned skirt and an orange top. His right arm is around her shoulder, and his left hand rests on her waist. Her left arm is around his shoulder, and her right hand is on his waist. To the far left, a light-skinned woman with a grey and white striped skirt and a yellow top holds a dark, slender object. To the far right, another light-skinned woman with a yellow and white striped skirt and an orange top also holds a dark, slender object. The painting concludes with a decorative border at the bottom, featuring a red and white chevron pattern above a dark grey panel with faint white circular motifs.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor and silver on paper

alt_text: A painting depicting an interior scene with two figures, green floors, and decorative gold and black patterns
long_description:
The rectangular painting depicts an interior scene, viewed from an elevated perspective, framed by a patterned border. The central area features a room with a predominantly green floor, marked with faint horizontal lines. In the upper left, a section of the floor is reddish-brown, separated from the green by a dark diagonal line. Along the top and bottom edges of the central scene, a black band with gold decorative motifs, resembling stylized pinecones and swirling vines, is visible. This black band is bordered by a wavy gold line, which also forms cloud-like shapes that partially obscure parts of the scene, particularly on the right and left sides.

Two figures are visible within the green-floored room. On the left, a figure is seated or reclining on a red patterned mat or cushion, wearing white and blue garments. Their head is not clearly visible, but their posture suggests a relaxed position. To the right of this figure, another figure is partially visible, lying on a patterned mat with a white pillow, wearing an orange garment. This figure's head is also not clearly depicted. The room features architectural elements, including a section on the far right with dark vertical and horizontal lines forming a grid pattern, possibly a screen or wall. The overall composition uses strong diagonal lines to create depth. The colors are rich, with prominent greens, reds, golds, and blacks. The outer border of the entire artwork is a lighter green with a subtle woven or striped pattern.

metadata.title: 伝俵屋宗達筆　源氏物語図「宿木」 |“Trees Encoiled in Vines of Ivy” (Yadorigi)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A regal figure sits on a cushion with attendants, while two small elephants stand in a garden below
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular painting framed by a thick, solid red border. The scene is divided horizontally into two main sections. The upper section depicts an indoor setting with a central figure seated on a large, pink-cushioned white platform. This figure wears elaborate white and gold robes, a dark green turban, and has a halo of light around their head. They have a dark mustache and hold a small object in their hands. To the left of the central figure, two male attendants sit on the floor, dressed in patterned robes and turbans, looking towards the central figure. To the right, a third male attendant stands, holding a long, green, feather-like fan over the central figure. The background features light-colored walls with arched doorways, decorative pillars, and small, ornate windows with colorful patterns. A golden railing runs along the bottom of this upper section. The lower section of the painting depicts an outdoor garden. It features a grid-like pattern of light brown pathways interspersed with square patches of bright green, leafy plants. In the center of this garden, a dark, rectangular pool or fountain is visible, containing dark, wavy shapes. Two small, dark gray elephants stand facing each other on the pathway, positioned just below the central seated figure. The overall color palette includes light creams and browns for the architecture, vibrant greens for the plants and fan, rich reds and pinks for cushions and clothing, and accents of gold.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, silver, and gold on paper

alt_text: A blue-skinned figure and a woman embrace in a vibrant garden with peacocks under a sunset sky
long_description: This vertical painting depicts two figures embracing in a vibrant, lush garden, framed by a decorative border. In the center, a blue-skinned figure with a golden crown and light green and orange garments holds a white garland. They embrace a lighter-skinned figure wearing an orange and red patterned skirt and a golden top, who also holds a white garland. Both figures stand on a green, grassy area dotted with small plants. The surrounding landscape features large, undulating green hills densely covered with various flowering trees and shrubs. On the left, a prominent tree with pink and red blossoms extends upwards. On the right, another tree with pink flowers hosts a peacock on one of its branches. Numerous other peacocks and smaller birds are scattered throughout the foreground and background, some on the ground, others perched among the foliage. In the upper background, a dramatic sunset sky with bands of orange, red, and light blue is visible between two prominent green hills. The entire central scene is enclosed by a wide, dark red border adorned with intricate gold floral and leaf patterns.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A painting shows a river flowing through a lush landscape with people, animals, and a sage in a cave
long_description: The painting depicts a wide river flowing diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, separating two lush, dark green landmasses. On the left bank, a figure dressed in a red and gold patterned garment sits on a patterned rug, facing right. Next to them, a white horse with red and gold adornments stands. Behind them, a dense forest of trees with large green leaves and some with purple blossoms extends upwards. The river itself is a light blue-grey, with two small, green islands. Each island is populated by several white birds. In the river, several figures are visible: a person in a red garment sits in the water, another figure with a white turban is partially submerged, and a person rides a white animal, possibly a horse or bull, also in the water. Further down, a small boat carries multiple figures. On the right bank, a dense forest of dark green trees with some purple blossoms covers the landscape. In the upper right, a multi-tiered white palace-like structure is partially visible behind the trees. In the lower right, a bearded man with light skin and a bare torso sits cross-legged on a yellow mat within a cave-like opening. He wears a simple orange cloth around his waist. Below him, several white birds stand near the water's edge. Numerous small black and white birds are perched throughout the trees on the right bank.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, silver, and gold on paper

alt_text: A large, gnarled pine tree with dark needles painted in ink on a golden six-panel screen
long_description: The artwork is a six-panel screen featuring a large, dark pine tree against a uniform golden background. The tree's thick, gnarled trunk originates from the lower right corner, extending diagonally upwards and to the left before curving to run horizontally across the upper half of the screen. The trunk is rendered with varying shades of black and dark grey ink, creating a textured appearance. Numerous branches, also painted in dark ink, extend from the main trunk, reaching towards the edges of the panels. These branches are densely covered with clusters of short, black pine needles, depicted with fine, concentrated brushstrokes. The dark ink of the tree contrasts sharply with the bright, reflective golden surface of the background, which appears to be composed of individual panels. In the lower right corner, a small red seal is visible beneath a short vertical line of black calligraphic text. The tree dominates the composition, filling most of the visual space with its sprawling form.

metadata.title: 鈴木松年筆 老松図屏風|Aged Pines
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink on gold-leaf

alt_text: A monochrome ink landscape painting depicts mountains, a village with thatched-roof houses, trees, and a bridge.
long_description: A monochrome ink painting on a light background depicts a mountainous landscape with a village. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of dark calligraphy are present, with a red square seal below them. The left foreground features rocky terrain with sparse vegetation. A small, simple bridge with two posts on each side spans a narrow body of water, leading towards the center. To the left of the center, a tall, slender tree with a dense canopy of small, dark leaves stands prominently. A cluster of several houses with distinct thatched roofs, varying in size, are nestled among rolling hills and dense foliage in the mid-ground. The houses are rendered in lighter ink tones, contrasting with the darker ink of the surrounding landscape. In the background, towering mountains rise, rendered with lighter ink washes, suggesting mist or distance. The right side of the painting shows dense vertical lines of trees, some with pointed tops, extending up the slopes of the mountains. The artwork utilizes a range of ink tones, from deep black for details like tree leaves and calligraphy to lighter washes for distant mountains and atmospheric effects, creating depth.

metadata.title: 清　龔賢　山水圖　冊|Landscapes
metadata.medium: Album of six paintings; ink on paper

alt_text: Monochrome ink painting of snow-covered mountains, bare trees, and a waterfall in a winter landscape
long_description: The image is a monochrome ink painting, primarily in shades of gray and black, depicting a winter mountain landscape. Large, rounded mountains dominate the upper half, appearing snow-covered with lighter gray washes. Darker ink defines their contours and rocky textures. Small, dark figures or structures are visible on the mountain slopes, suggesting paths or distant dwellings. A dense forest of bare, deciduous trees with intricate branches fills the central and right portions of the mid-ground. Their dark, skeletal forms contrast with the lighter background. Scattered among them are a few evergreen trees with distinct needle clusters. To the far right, partially obscured by trees, are the roofs and walls of a small cluster of buildings, rendered in light gray. The lower left features a cascading waterfall flowing over large, rounded rocks, also appearing snow-dusted. A small, dark bridge or path crosses the stream at the base of the waterfall. The foreground is filled with numerous large, rounded boulders and rocks, some covered in snow, others showing darker, exposed surfaces. There are several blocks of vertical text in black ink, accompanied by red seals, in the upper left and upper right corners. Upper left text: "空山古木歲寒心書日無人茆屋深惆悵晚來天欲雪此回好景待誰吟" followed by two red seals. Upper right text: "枯有雪圖日積雪處處雪霜此香山向" followed by two red seals.

metadata.title: 明/清　惲向　欲雪圖　冊頁|Snowscape, from Album for Zhou Lianggong
metadata.medium: Double album leaf from a collective album of twelve paintings and facing pages of calligraphy; ink on paper

alt_text: A snowy landscape with mountains, a body of water, a village, and a person on a bridge.
long_description: This monochromatic artwork depicts a winter landscape, primarily rendered in shades of gray, white, and light brown. The upper portion of the image is a light gray sky. In the distance, a series of snow-covered hills or mountains stretch across the horizon. A wide, light gray body of water occupies the lower left and central areas. On this water, in the mid-left, a small, light-colored boat with a dark, indistinct figure is visible. Further back on the water, a narrow strip of land with faint, small structures can be seen. The right side of the composition is dominated by a large, prominent snow-covered mountain or rock formation, extending from the top edge almost to the bottom. At its base, on the right, several pine trees with dark green needles and dark trunks are visible, also dusted with snow. Nestled at the base of this mountain, towards the center-right, is a small village or collection of buildings featuring light brown roofs and walls, partially obscured by the trees and snow. A curved, light brown bridge spans a narrow channel of water in the lower center. Under the arch of this bridge, a figure in a light brown garment is seated. Bare, gnarled trees with dark branches and white snow cling to the land near the bridge and the water's edge in the foreground. In the upper left corner, several columns of dark vertical text are present. The largest block reads: "富春人雨 寒江獨釣雪 和夫又何 不信見 夫復何求 東坡居士". To the left of this main text, smaller characters are visible. Below the text, in the upper left, and in the lower left and lower right corners, are square red seals.

metadata.title: 清   葉欣   聼雪圖   冊頁|Snowscape, leaf from Album for Zhou Lianggong
metadata.medium: Double album leaf from a collective album of twelve paintings and facing pages of calligraphy; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An open book page with a column of text on the left and an ink landscape painting on the right
long_description: The image shows an open book or album page with two rectangular panels, each featuring a different composition, set against a light off-white background. Both panels are on light brown paper.The left panel is filled with columns of black calligraphic text, written vertically from right to left. The text is dense and covers most of the panel. Towards the bottom left, two square red seals are stamped over the text, one positioned above the other. A smaller, rectangular red seal is visible near the top right of the text block.The right panel contains an ink wash landscape painting. In the upper right, a prominent, craggy mountain or cliff face rises, adorned with numerous small, dark trees and a small, simple building with a peaked roof nestled into its side. Below this, a body of water, possibly a lake or bay, stretches across the middle ground, with several smaller, rounded rocks or islands dotting the water near the shore. In the lower left, a cluster of tall, slender trees with sparse, dark foliage stands on a lower landmass. Another small, simple building is partially visible behind these trees. The foreground depicts a rocky shoreline. The painting is rendered in various shades of black ink, creating a sense of depth and texture. In the upper left corner of this panel, several lines of black calligraphic text are present, reading "雨小舟" and "百年中秋". Below this text, a square red seal is stamped.

metadata.title: 清   諸家   名家書畫   冊|Album of painting and calligraphy for Maoshu
metadata.medium: Album of fourteen paintings and facing pages of calligraphy; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a vast, snow-covered mountain landscape with villages, a river, and figures
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a vast, snow-covered mountain landscape in muted tones of gray, black, and sepia. Towering, jagged mountains dominate the upper half, their peaks and slopes heavily blanketed in white snow, with darker rock faces visible in crevices and along edges. Two small, multi-tiered buildings with curved roofs are nestled on ledges: one high on the central mountain, and another on a lower peak to the left. Below the mountains, rolling hills also covered in snow descend into a valley. A winding river or stream, partially obscured by snow and ice, flows from the mid-right towards the bottom-center, spanned by a small, multi-arched bridge. Dark, slender trees, possibly pines, with snow-laden branches, line the riverbanks and dot the landscape. In the lower-left quadrant, a cluster of traditional-style houses with sloped roofs is deeply buried in snow. A narrow path winds through this village, where two small figures, one appearing to be on horseback, are visible. The upper right corner contains vertical script in dark ink, followed by a red square seal. The sky is a light, hazy tone, suggesting a cloudy atmosphere.

metadata.title: 清  袁耀  雪棧行旅圖  軸|Inn and Travelers in Snowy Mountains
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A six-panel screen painting depicts flowering trees against a shimmering gold background.
long_description: This six-panel screen painting features a landscape dominated by flowering trees against a rich gold background. The panels are arranged horizontally, with a decorative border along the top and bottom edges. A large, dark-trunked tree with gnarled branches covered in white and silver blossoms occupies the center and right side of the screen. Its branches extend across multiple panels, with dense clusters of flowers. To the left, a smaller, more delicate tree or branch with dark, slender limbs bears sparse, light pink blossoms. The gold background, which appears to be gold leaf, has a textured, shimmering quality. Darker, muted brown and green shapes, resembling clouds or landforms, are interspersed throughout the gold, particularly around the bases and branches of the trees, adding depth to the composition. The overall impression is one of a vibrant, yet serene, natural scene.

metadata.title: 桜梅柳図屏風|Cherry, Plum and Willow Trees
metadata.medium: Single six-panel folding screen; ink, color, gold, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A landscape painting with bare trees, distant mountains, and two figures in a boat on a body of water
long_description: This square-format artwork depicts a serene landscape rendered in muted tones of brown, gray, and subtle green, suggesting an ink wash on aged paper or silk. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of dark calligraphic text are visible, followed by a square red seal. The text reads: "高嶽峻嶺遠宮 嘉樹清流更多 戊辰冬日 畫於華亭". A smaller red seal is positioned below this text. The background features a range of soft, rounded mountains stretching across the upper half of the composition, their forms gradually fading into a lighter, hazy sky. The peaks are gently contoured, with faint suggestions of small structures or sparse vegetation on their slopes. A wide expanse of calm, light-toned water occupies the central horizontal band, reflecting the soft hues of the distant landscape. In the foreground, to the left, a dense cluster of deciduous trees with bare, intricate branches stands on a low-lying island or bank. Their dark, gnarled trunks and fine networks of branches are rendered in varying shades of dark gray and brown ink. The ground beneath these trees is depicted with muted green and brown washes, interspersed with several rounded, rock-like forms at their bases. To the right, on the water, a small, flat-bottomed boat moves towards the right. It carries two figures. The figure in the front is seated, facing right, dressed in a light-colored garment. The figure in the back is also seated, facing right, and appears to be holding a long pole or fishing rod extending into the water. A large, square red seal is present in the upper right corner, and a smaller, rectangular red seal is in the lower right.

metadata.title: 明  盛茂曄  唐詩意山水圖  冊|Landscapes after Tang Poems
metadata.medium: Album of six paintings; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A muted landscape painting shows a small building next to a large porous rock and a leafy tree.
long_description: A muted landscape painting features a small, single-story building positioned slightly right of the center. The building has a dark, possibly thatched roof and light-colored walls with two visible window-like openings revealing a dark interior. To the left of the building, a large, irregular rock formation rises, characterized by its light brown and gray tones and numerous circular and oval perforations, giving it a porous appearance. To the right of the building, a tree with a light brown trunk and branches extends upwards and to the right. Its sparse canopy is depicted with light green leaves. The ground in the foreground is rendered with subtle washes of light gray and brown, suggesting uneven terrain or shallow water. The upper portion of the painting is a very light, almost uniform pale blue-gray, creating an expansive, misty background. In the bottom right corner, two small red square seals with dark characters are visible.

metadata.title: 清 樊圻 山水圖 冊 紙本|Landscapes
metadata.medium: Album of eight leaves; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Hand-drawn map showing winding rivers, landmasses, and numerous walled structures with text on an aged background
long_description: An antique-style, hand-drawn map on a light, aged background, possibly parchment or silk. The map is oriented horizontally and features a decorative border along its top and bottom edges. The central elements are two prominent, winding rivers. The upper river is depicted in a reddish-brown color, flowing from left to right across the top half of the image. The lower river, colored a muted green-blue, flows from the lower-left, curves significantly, and exits towards the right. Several smaller, thinner tributaries branch off from both main rivers. Numerous small, rectangular, walled structures, colored light brown with dark outlines, are scattered across the land areas. Many of these structures appear to be fortified compounds or buildings. Some are situated on small, rounded hills, which are depicted in shades of green and brown. A particularly large, prominent hill with a green, textured top is located in the lower-center, surrounded by the green-blue river. Another smaller, green-topped hill is visible in the upper-right quadrant. Small, dark lines indicate bridges or crossings over the rivers in several places. Various sections of the map contain vertical lines of text in an unfamiliar script, written in black ink. The decorative borders at the top and bottom feature a repeating pattern of small, colorful geometric shapes, including red, blue, green, and yellow.

metadata.title: 清  佚名  大運河地圖 (從北京至長江)  卷|Map of the Grand Canal from Beijing to the Yangzi River
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash landscape painting on a two-panel screen depicting mountains, water, a boat, and figures.
long_description: An ink wash landscape painting on a two-panel screen, rendered in shades of black, gray, and sepia on a light, aged background. The screen is framed by a decorative green border with gold floral patterns. The left panel features a tall, dark, jagged cliff face on the left, extending from top to bottom. A gnarled tree with dark, sparse foliage grows from the cliff, its branches reaching towards the center. At the base of the cliff, two small figures are visible on a path, one appearing to ride an animal. Below them, more dark rocks and sparse vegetation are depicted along the water's edge. The central area of the composition is a wide expanse of water, rendered with lighter washes, suggesting a lake or bay. In the distance, across the water, a series of rolling hills or mountains are visible, fading into a lighter, misty background. On the right panel, a single boat with a tall, rectangular sail is depicted on the water, moving towards the right. Along the bottom edge, particularly on the right panel, faint outlines of structures, possibly houses or a village, are nestled among trees and rocks near the water. A small red seal and some faint vertical text are visible in the lower left corner of the left panel.

metadata.title: 山水図屏風|Landscape
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink on paper

alt_text: A detailed painting of a Buddha seated under a large tree, surrounded by numerous figures in a landscape
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a complex, multi-scene composition centered around a seated Buddha figure. In the upper-middle, a Buddha with a green halo and orange robes sits in a meditative pose on a lotus throne, positioned beneath a large, ornate tree. The tree features numerous white flowers and intricate golden branches from which various decorative elements and strands of beads hang. Above the tree, a dark blue sky is filled with white clouds, each containing rows of small, robed figures. Below the central Buddha, the landscape transitions to green hills and tiered platforms. On either side, vast crowds of smaller figures, predominantly dressed in red and white robes, extend outwards and downwards, creating a sense of immense gathering. These crowds appear to be seated or kneeling on the green terrain. Further down, the painting unfolds into multiple distinct scenes. On the lower left, a large circular motif encloses many small figures, while other areas show buildings, rivers, and smaller groups of people engaged in various activities within a green and brown landscape. The very bottom edge of the painting features a narrow, dark horizontal band containing lines of small white script. The overall color palette is rich, with dominant greens, reds, oranges, and blues.

alt_text: A seated figure with long black hair and elaborate robes beneath a golden moon and stylized clouds.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a seated figure against a dark background. The figure, positioned in the lower half of the composition, faces slightly to the right with eyes closed and a serene expression. Their skin is pale, and long, straight black hair cascades over their shoulders and down their back. They wear voluminous, layered robes, primarily in shades of brown and gold, with prominent accents of dark red, white, and dark blue. The sleeves and lower edges of the robes are wide and flowing, creating a broad, rounded silhouette. Above the figure, the background is a deep, dark brown or black. In the upper center, a large, circular golden disc, resembling a moon, is depicted with subtle texture. Below the moon, a dark vertical structure, possibly a pillar or fence post, rises from a horizontal band that spans the width of the painting. Stylized white, cloud-like or wave-like forms are visible on either side of this structure, against the dark background. The horizontal band below these forms features small, square, patterned motifs. The painting is framed by a decorative border at the top, featuring gold patterns on a dark red ground, and plain gold-colored borders on the sides. The very bottom edge has a striped pattern.

metadata.title: 丹生明神像|Niu Myōjin
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A vibrant painting depicts a landscape with hills, caves, and a river, where human and monkey-like figures gather around a large fire
long_description: The painting presents a panoramic landscape filled with activity, framed by a dark blue border with gold floral patterns. The upper portion features a light blue sky with wispy white clouds and a plume of dark smoke rising from the far right horizon. Rolling hills, rendered in shades of light brown and tan, dominate the middle ground, interspersed with dark green trees and shrubs. On the far left, a cave entrance reveals a green-skinned figure seated on a patterned platform, holding a staff. Two figures, one human-like in green and one monkey-like in white and orange, stand before the seated figure. Further into the middle ground, two dome-shaped structures are visible in a grassy clearing, surrounded by smaller figures. To the right, another cave houses a building-like structure with figures inside and outside. The foreground is bisected by a dark blue-green river or stream. In the center, a large, oval-shaped fire pit, constructed from white stones, contains a pile of brown logs. Several figures are engaged around this central feature. On the left, a white monkey-like figure bends over the water. To the right of the fire pit, a white monkey-like figure carries a dark, branch-like object towards the logs, while another white monkey-like figure stands nearby. A group of approximately ten human-like figures, dressed in various light-colored garments, stands on the right bank of the river, observing the scene. Another white monkey-like figure is partially submerged in the water on the far right.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, silver, and gold on paper

alt_text: A seated man with a beard and topknot, wearing a brown and light blue robe, holding a sword
long_description: The image is a vertical portrait of a man seated cross-legged, presented as a hanging scroll. The man occupies the lower two-thirds of the central panel, which is a muted, warm brown color. He faces towards the right side of the frame, with his head turned slightly upwards. His skin is light-toned. He has a shaved forehead and a small, dark bun of hair at the back of his head. A dark beard and mustache frame his mouth. He wears a dark brown robe with a subtle, repeating pattern, and a visible red collar. Over this, he wears a light blue-grey sleeveless garment with wide, stiff shoulders. This outer garment features two dark, stylized floral or geometric motifs on each shoulder. A white sash with horizontal black stripes is visible around his waist. His lower body is covered by light grey or white pants, which show distinct folds from his seated posture. His right hand is raised, with fingers touching his beard near his chin. His left hand rests on the hilt of a sword, which has a black scabbard, a gold-colored hilt, and red cords wrapped around it. The sword lies across his lap. He is seated on a green mat, which has a white border patterned with small black circles and crosses. The central brown panel is framed at the top by a dark green fabric with a gold floral pattern, and the entire artwork is bordered by a dark reddish-brown fabric with a subtle woven texture.

metadata.title: 武将肖像画|Portrait of a Warrior
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A blue-skinned figure and a white figure ride a striped tiger-like creature, followed by an elephant-headed figure.
long_description: The artwork depicts a procession of figures on a reddish-brown background. On the right, a large, striped, tiger-like creature walks to the left.
