It has a long, striped tail that curves upwards and ends in a trident-like shape. Its body is white with black stripes, and it has a prominent snout and large eyes. Riding on the back of this creature are two figures. The larger figure, positioned towards the rear, has blue skin, dark hair, and a small crescent shape on its head. It wears a light green sash across its chest and holds two white, circular objects in its right hand, while its left hand is raised. The smaller figure, seated in front of the blue-skinned one, has white skin and a mustache. It wears a green garment and holds a small, dark object to its mouth, appearing to play a wind instrument. To the left of the tiger-like creature, an elephant-headed figure walks. This figure has white skin, four arms, and wears a green sash. Its trunk is raised, and it holds a small object in one of its hands. Behind this figure, a large, white and green banner or flag extends upwards and to the left. The background is a solid reddish-brown color, with some areas showing wear and tear. The figures are outlined in black, with details rendered in black lines.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: A colorful Indian miniature painting depicting a royal procession with an elaborately decorated elephant carrying two figures, surrounded by many attendants
long_description: A rectangular painting with a red border depicts a vibrant procession. A large, dark gray elephant, adorned with a gold and orange saddlecloth and golden chains, moves prominently towards the right. On its back, a golden howdah carries two seated figures dressed in white with turbans; one holds a golden staff. An elephant driver, also in white, sits on the elephant's neck, holding an ankus. Numerous attendants surround the elephant. To the left, a group of figures walks, one holding a large black umbrella. Others carry staffs or musical instruments, dressed in various colored garments including orange, pink, and white, with turbans. A small group of white dogs with red markings accompanies them. To the right, a larger crowd of figures proceeds, many carrying tall spears topped with red flags. Their attire includes turbans and garments in shades of orange, white, and brown. The background is a plain, light green, with a band of dark gray and white clouds across the top. A narrow strip of light green represents the ground.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A six-panel screen painting depicts various plants and flowers, butterflies, and green landforms on a gold background
long_description: The artwork is a six-panel screen presented horizontally, featuring a vibrant gold background. Across the bottom, dark green, irregular shapes suggest land or water, from which a variety of plants and flowers emerge. Tall, slender green grasses with delicate blades rise from these green forms, extending upwards across the gold surface. Interspersed among the grasses are numerous flowering plants. On the left, clusters of pale purple and white multi-petaled flowers are visible, alongside smaller orange-red blossoms. In the center, larger red and pink multi-petaled flowers bloom from the green ground, accompanied by more white and pale purple flowers. Towards the right, additional green plants with smaller white and light purple flowers, as well as some orange-red blooms, grow from the green shapes. Several small, light-colored butterflies are depicted in flight across the gold background, particularly in the upper left and central sections. Two large, dark green, amorphous shapes, resembling stylized clouds or distant landmasses, float in the upper left and upper right portions of the gold background. A narrow, dark border with a repeating floral or geometric pattern frames the entire screen and delineates the individual panels.

metadata.title: 四季花草図屏風|Flowers and Grasses of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, gold paint, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A regal man on a rearing black horse, accompanied by a walking attendant, in a sparse landscape.
long_description: The image depicts two male figures and a horse against a light background and a green foreground. A regal man with a dark beard and mustache sits astride a rearing black horse, positioned slightly right of center. He wears a golden-yellow tunic with intricate patterns, green pants, and a turban adorned with a black plume and jewels. A golden halo radiates behind his head. In his right hand, he holds a white fly whisk, and in his left, a long green spear. The black horse rears on its hind legs, facing right, with its front legs lifted. Its mane is decorated with white and red tassels, and it wears a red bridle and a green and gold saddle cloth. Walking alongside and slightly in front of the horse, to the left, is a dark-skinned man with a dark beard and mustache. He wears a light-colored tunic, a red turban, and a green and pink striped sash around his waist. He holds a white object over his left shoulder. Both figures and the horse are depicted in profile, facing right. The background is a plain, light beige color, while the foreground is a strip of green ground with sparse, small green plants. In the lower right quadrant, there is black text written in an Indian script. The text reads: "मालराजधीराजमालरागणो श्रीसंग्रामसी.म.जी.योतेबजुरा".

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, gold, and Basra pearls on paper

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting shows numerous people in a landscape with buildings, boats on water, and gold clouds.
long_description: The artwork is a six-panel screen painting, primarily featuring a landscape with numerous small figures, buildings, and bodies of water, all set against a shimmering gold background that also forms cloud-like or land-like formations. The composition is divided into several interconnected scenes.On the far left, dark green mountains rise, topped with brown peaks. A tall, dark green pine tree stands prominently in the foreground. Below, a small, dark-roofed building is nestled into the landscape. Moving right, a red-railed bridge spans a blue stream, with several figures walking across it and others gathered on the gold ground nearby. Further right, a larger building with a red roof and white walls houses figures both inside and on its surrounding porch.The central area features a wide expanse of blue water, upon which two boats, each carrying multiple figures, are depicted. Around the water's edge and on the gold ground, many small figures are scattered, engaged in various activities such as sitting, standing, and interacting in groups. A small tree with delicate white blossoms is visible near the water.To the upper right, a large, multi-story building with red railings and a patterned roof extends over the water, with numerous figures visible on its balconies and within its open rooms. Below this, another building with a green roof and red railings also hosts groups of people on its porch and inside. The gold background continues throughout, creating a sense of continuity and light across the entire scene. The figures wear clothing in muted reds, blues, whites, and browns.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; ink, color, and gold on gilded paper

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape with thatched-roof buildings, trees, and small figures.
long_description: A tall, narrow ink wash painting on a light beige ground depicts a mountainous landscape in muted tones of grey, black, and subtle light blue-green washes. The composition is vertical, with elements arranged from top to bottom. At the top, towering, craggy mountains rise, their peaks rendered with textured brushstrokes. Sparse trees dot the upper slopes, appearing as small clusters of dark dots. In the upper right quadrant, vertical lines of text are visible, accompanied by a square red seal below them. Below the highest peaks, a cluster of buildings with distinct thatched roofs is nestled on a mountain slope, connected by winding paths. Further down, the landscape becomes denser with more prominent trees, their branches gnarled and textured, particularly a large tree on the left side. The mountains continue to descend, forming valleys and ridges. Towards the bottom, a body of water or mist is suggested, with small, indistinct figures visible, some appearing to be in boats or on the shore, and others walking on land. The overall impression is one of a vast, serene natural environment.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A full-length portrait of a man in a dark robe and tall black hat, holding a white object.
long_description: The artwork is a full-length portrait of a standing man, positioned centrally against a plain, light brown background. The man faces slightly to the viewer's left. He wears a tall, black, rectangular hat that sits high on his head. His face is light-skinned with dark eyes, a dark mustache, and a dark beard. He is dressed in a long, dark, flowing robe that covers his entire body down to his feet, obscuring them. Underneath the dark robe, a lighter, possibly cream-colored garment is visible at the neck and chest, forming a V-shape. His hands are clasped together in front of his chest, holding a rectangular white object. The background is a uniform light brown or tan color, showing signs of age. A vertical column of dark characters is present on the upper left side of the background. Two small, square red seals are visible: one in the upper right corner and another in the lower left corner.

metadata.title: 北宋 佚名 睢陽五老，畢世長像 冊頁|Portrait of Bi Shichang, from the set Five Old Men of Suiyang
metadata.medium: Album leaf; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ancient painting on fabric depicts three groups of ornate figures, including deities, with visible text below.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal painting on a light-colored, aged fabric, with significant damage, especially on the right side and top edge. The painting features three main groups of figures, rendered with black outlines and limited color, primarily red-orange and some light blue. On the far left, a male figure with a light complexion and a large, ornate headdress sits with a smaller female figure on his lap. He holds a leaf-like object in his right hand. Both figures wear elaborate jewelry and garments with red-orange accents. Below them, a stylized animal, possibly a lion or horse, is depicted. To the right of this pair, a standing female figure with a light complexion and an ornate headdress faces forward, holding a small object in her raised right hand. She wears a long, flowing garment with red-orange details. Below her, a stylized bird-like creature is visible. Further to the right, a multi-armed figure with a light complexion and an elaborate headdress sits on a decorative throne. This figure has multiple arms, holding various objects, and wears intricate jewelry and garments with red-orange accents. The throne is highly detailed with architectural elements. Scattered between the main figures are smaller, less detailed motifs, including what appear to be miniature stupas or shrines, and floral elements. Above the central standing figure, some faint, dark text is visible. Along the bottom edge of the fabric, below all the figures, a line of dark script is present. The rightmost portion of the fabric is heavily torn and fragmented, with only faint traces of figures remaining.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Double-sided scroll; ink and color on cloth

alt_text: A panoramic painting on a gold screen depicts numerous figures, buildings, and landscapes, separated by stylized clouds.
long_description: A wide, multi-panel painting on a gold background depicts a bustling scene of people, buildings, and natural elements. Stylized white and grey clouds or mist separate different areas of activity across the composition. In the top center, a large, ornate building with a dark roof and red-orange accents on its eaves and railings stands prominently. Many small figures are gathered around it, some seated, others standing. Green trees and shrubs are visible near the building. On the upper left, a blue body of water is visible, bordered by green hills. Several figures are near the water's edge and on the hills. In the mid-left, below the water, groups of figures are gathered, some near white, flowering trees. Buildings with dark roofs and white walls are scattered throughout the scene. Across the bottom center and right, numerous figures are engaged in various activities, walking in groups, standing, or sitting. Some appear to be in processions. Several buildings with dark roofs and white walls are depicted, some with open courtyards. Figures wear a variety of colored garments, including white, blue, black, and red, and many wear hats. The gold background serves as the ground and sky, with landscape features emerging from it.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; ink, color, and gold on gilded paper

alt_text: A central golden figure sits cross-legged, flanked by two bearded attendants, two white bulls, and text.
long_description: The image is a horizontal painting on a light brown ground, featuring a central red panel. In the center of this red panel, a golden-skinned figure sits cross-legged in a meditative pose, adorned with a multi-tiered crown, large circular earrings, and multiple necklaces. This figure has four arms; the lower two hands rest in the lap, holding a smaller, similarly posed figure. The central figure wears a patterned lower garment and sits on a prominent yellow, cloud-like or flame-like base that extends across the bottom of the red panel.To the left and right of the central figure, two bearded male figures kneel, facing inward towards the central figure. They have darker skin, wear conical hats, and are dressed in patterned lower garments and sashes. Each attendant holds an ornate, lidded vessel with both hands, extending it towards the central figure. Above each kneeling figure, a white bull stands, depicted in profile and facing away from the center. The background of the central panel is a solid red, with faint, stylized floral motifs visible behind the figures. On the light brown ground to the far left of the red panel, black text is visible, which reads: वामीते हिहिति. Below this text is a solid red circle. Further below, more black text reads: वामवाद चारणा. Additional black text is visible on the light brown ground on the far right edge of the painting.

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a person standing by a river with mountains and trees, and text at the top left
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting, presented on a light beige background, depicts a mountainous landscape with a lone figure by a body of water. The artwork is primarily rendered in shades of gray and black ink, with subtle blue accents. At the top left, a vertical column of black calligraphic text is visible. The text reads: "泊舟月夜看如畫", "何處是吾鄉", "戊子冬月寫於吳門", "石谷". Below this text, two small, square red seals are stacked vertically. The upper portion of the painting features towering mountains, rendered with light gray washes that fade into the background, suggesting mist or distance. Darker ink lines define the contours and textures of the mountain slopes, with small, dark dots indicating sparse foliage or trees. In the middle section, a solitary figure stands on a rocky bank, facing towards the right. The figure is dressed in a long, light-colored robe and appears to be looking out over the water. The scale of the figure is small in comparison to the expansive landscape. To the right of the figure, the terrain continues with more rocky formations and scattered vegetation. The lower third of the painting is dominated by a body of water, likely a river or stream, flowing horizontally across the scene. The water is depicted with horizontal gray washes and accented with small, blue, wavy lines that suggest ripples or movement. Several dark, rounded rocks are visible both within the water and along its banks. At the very bottom of the painted area, two more square red seals are placed, one in the bottom left corner and another in the bottom right. The overall composition emphasizes the vastness of nature surrounding the human presence.

alt_text: Two horizontal panels depicting multiple figures amidst a vibrant floral landscape with red flowers and green foliage
long_description: The image displays two horizontally oriented, rectangular painted panels, stacked one above the other. Both panels feature a dark blue-green background densely covered with stylized red flowers and green foliage, creating a lush, garden-like setting. The overall style is decorative with a flat perspective, and the figures' clothing features intricate gold and red patterns. The top panel shows three figures, each seated on a red cushion or platform. From left to right: The first figure has dark skin, wears a red patterned skirt, and holds a golden orb in one hand. The central figure has light skin, wears a similar red skirt, and holds a small object to their chest. The third figure has reddish skin, also wears a red patterned skirt, and holds a small, dark object. All three figures are depicted with elaborate headwear and jewelry, and are surrounded by red flowers and green leaves. The bottom panel also features three figures, similarly seated amidst the floral landscape. From left to right: The first figure has light skin, wears a red patterned skirt, and holds their hands in a gesture. The central figure has reddish skin, multiple arms, and wears a red patterned skirt, holding various small objects in their hands. The third figure has light skin, wears a red patterned skirt, and holds a small, white object in one hand.

alt_text: Two rectangular wooden book covers, one side painted with seated figures, the other dark and unadorned.
long_description: The image displays two long, rectangular wooden book covers, each shown with both its painted and unpainted side. The top book cover is presented first with its painted side facing up, followed immediately below by its unpainted side. The second book cover follows the same arrangement. Each painted side is a narrow, horizontal panel divided into six distinct, rectangular compartments. Each compartment features a stylized, seated figure against a background of alternating red and black. The figures are depicted with various skin tones, often gold or light green, and wear elaborate headdresses and garments. Many figures have multiple arms, holding various objects, and some are seated on thrones or animals. Small, dark script is visible along the top edge of some compartments. The unpainted sides are dark, almost black, with a textured, slightly uneven surface. They show areas of reddish-brown discoloration and appear to be the reverse of the painted panels. The overall impression is of two similar, ornate wooden objects, each with a richly decorated face and a plain, dark reverse.

alt_text: Two horizontal panels, the top with five painted multi-armed figures in red circles, the bottom with carved floral patterns
long_description:
The image displays two elongated, horizontal rectangular panels, stacked vertically against a white background. The top panel is slightly shorter and thinner than the bottom panel. Both panels appear to be made of a dark, possibly wooden, material.
The top panel features five distinct painted sections, each depicting a multi-armed figure within a red circular frame. These red circles are separated by narrower, dark blue or black rectangular sections. From left to right, the figures are: a dark blue figure with multiple arms, seated; a golden figure with multiple arms, seated; a golden figure with multiple arms, seated; a reddish figure with multiple arms, seated; and a greenish figure with multiple arms, seated. Each figure is depicted against the red circular background. The panel itself is dark brown or black, showing some wear and small holes.
The bottom panel is a single, continuous piece, entirely covered in intricate, raised, carved or embossed patterns. The patterns consist of swirling, organic motifs, resembling vines, leaves, and abstract floral designs, repeating along the length of the panel. The material is a dark, reddish-brown, with variations in tone that highlight the three-dimensional texture of the carving. The edges of this panel also show some wear.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Distemper on wood; repoussé gilt-copper cover

alt_text: Four multi-armed deities with elaborate attire and crowns, seated on various animals, against a vibrant red background.
long_description: A horizontal rectangular painting depicts four multi-armed figures, each seated on an animal, against a vibrant red background with a green border. From left to right, the first figure has light skin, numerous arms holding various weapons like swords and bows, and wears an elaborate gold crown, jewelry, and a patterned dark blue and gold skirt. This figure is seated on a white swan or goose, which faces right. The second figure, also light-skinned, has multiple arms holding weapons, a similar crown, jewelry, and patterned skirt, and sits on a brown, four-legged animal resembling a lion or deer, also facing right. The third figure has red skin, multiple arms with weapons, and similar ornate attire, seated on a dark peacock with its tail fanned out behind it, facing right. The fourth and final figure on the right has green skin, multiple arms holding weapons, and similar elaborate adornments, seated on a dark, four-legged animal, possibly a lion or tiger, facing right. Each of the four main figures has a golden, flame-like aura behind their head. The red background is adorned with decorative elements in the upper section between the deities, and the lower portion features smaller figures and animals around the bases of the main mounts. The entire composition is framed by a green border.

alt_text: A tall, narrow ink painting depicts a towering mountainous landscape with dense trees, a winding river, and a small building.
long_description: This tall, narrow ink painting on a light brown ground depicts a towering mountainous landscape. In the upper right, a block of vertical black text is visible, followed by two red seal impressions. The upper portion of the painting features several rounded, misty mountain peaks receding into the distance. Below these, a large, craggy mountain dominates the upper half, its steep, textured slopes rendered with dark ink washes and fine brushstrokes. Dense clusters of trees with dark foliage cling to the ridges and crevices of the mountains. A prominent, tall, slender tree with a gnarled trunk stands vertically in the lower-middle, its branches extending outwards. Further down, a winding path or stream is suggested in the lower right, leading towards a small, open-sided pavilion with a tiled roof, situated near the water's edge. More trees and scattered rocks populate the middle and lower sections. The foreground on the left features a large, rounded rock formation, with smaller rocks and sparse vegetation in the lower right. The artwork uses varying shades of black ink to create depth and texture.

metadata.title: 明/清  僧滐  山水  軸|Landscape

alt_text: A light brown artwork features a dark ink branch with delicate flowers and buds, with a red seal.
long_description: The artwork is a square-format image on a light brown, speckled background. A branch, rendered in dark gray and black ink with lighter gray washes, extends from the lower left corner upwards and towards the right. The main trunk of the branch is thicker at the bottom, gradually thinning as it ascends. It has several smaller offshoots. Along the branches, numerous small, circular flowers are depicted, each with distinct petals and a darker center. Some smaller, unopened buds are also visible. The flowers are concentrated in clusters, particularly in the upper right and central areas of the branch. The ink work shows varying degrees of saturation, creating a sense of depth and texture in the branches and petals. In the lower left corner, a square red seal with dark, stylized characters is present. The background has a mottled appearance with small, irregular dark specks scattered across the entire surface.

metadata.title: 清  湯貽汾  墨梅  四冊頁|Blossoming Plum
metadata.medium: Four album leaves; ink on gold-flecked paper

alt_text: Ink wash painting of towering mountains, misty valleys, dense trees, a river, and a small boat
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting presents a monochromatic landscape of mountains, mist, and trees. The upper third features towering, craggy mountains rendered in varying shades of gray ink, from light washes to darker, textured strokes defining peaks and ridges. Wisps of lighter ink suggest mist or clouds partially obscuring the mid-sections of the mountains. In the upper right, a vertical column of black calligraphic text reads: "山中無曆日 寒盡不知年" followed by "庚子冬日寫於滬上" and "石廬". Below this are two red square seals. Below the highest peaks, the landscape transitions into a valley where more mountains recede into the distance, softened by lighter ink washes. The middle ground is characterized by a dense cluster of trees on the right, some with full, dark foliage, others with bare, intricate branches. To the left of these trees, a wide body of water, possibly a river or lake, stretches horizontally. On the far side of the water, distant hills and a few small, simple structures with peaked roofs are visible. The lower third of the painting brings the viewer closer to the water's edge. More trees, some with thick, gnarled trunks and sparse branches, stand prominently on the right and left banks. Patches of grass or reeds are depicted along the gently sloping ground near the water. In the lower left, a small, flat-bottomed boat with a single figure is visible on the water, moving towards the right.

metadata.title: 清    胡遠    四季山水圖    四條屏|Landscapes of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Set of four hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A dark-skinned deity figure, richly adorned in gold and yellow, stands against a blue background within a decorative border.
long_description: The artwork depicts a standing, dark-skinned deity figure, centrally positioned against a solid dark blue background. The figure wears a bright yellow dhoti-like garment that flares out to the sides and yellow sleeves. Its skin is a deep blue-black. The deity is heavily adorned with multiple strands of gold and white beaded necklaces and garlands that extend from the neck down to the knees, forming a long, shield-like shape. A prominent gold crown with a large, fan-shaped green plume sits atop its head. The figure's right hand is raised, holding a small pink flower, while the left hand holds a slender, dark staff. The face features large, dark, almond-shaped eyes, a small nose, and a small mouth. A small white dot is visible on the chin. The figure stands on a maroon-purple platform. The entire composition is framed by an inner border of gold squares with white dots, followed by a thin green line, and an outer, wider red border. In the bottom right corner, a small, red, turban-like object rests on the maroon platform. On the bottom left of the platform, two small green triangular symbols are visible. At the top, above the inner border, there is text in Devanagari script: "श्री गोसांई जी को उदधै है" on the left and "श्री नाथ जी ने" on the right.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor and gold on paper

alt_text: A ruler on an elaborately decorated elephant leads a procession of horsemen and foot soldiers across a green landscape.
long_description: The painting depicts a grand procession moving from left to right across a green landscape under a light blue sky. In the center-right, a large grey elephant carries a richly adorned howdah, within which sits a prominent figure. This figure, likely a ruler, wears a yellow tunic, a red and gold turban with a plume, and holds a small pink flower. An attendant sits in front of the ruler on the elephant's neck, guiding it with a goad. The elephant is decorated with a yellow and purple blanket, and its tusks are visible. To the left of the elephant, a group of horsemen rides in formation. There are at least eight visible horsemen, dressed in white, green, or yellow tunics and turbans, some with beards. Their horses are various shades of brown, grey, and white, some with decorated saddles and bridles. One horseman in the foreground rides a brown horse, while others are behind him. In the far background, on a rising green hill to the right, several more horses and red tents are visible, suggesting a larger encampment or procession. Along the bottom edge of the painting, beneath the elephant, a line of small foot soldiers in white and red attire marches. The sky above is a pale blue, with a single small white dot, possibly a star or moon, in the upper left. The overall scene conveys a sense of movement and grandeur.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A colorful procession of people, elephants, and horses surrounds a multi-tiered white palace with figures inside.
long_description: The painting depicts a large, multi-tiered white palace or pavilion at its center, surrounded by a landscape with numerous figures and trees. The central structure is octagonal, with a prominent arched entrance at its base. Its lower level features several open alcoves where groups of figures are seated or standing, dressed in colorful garments. The middle level also has open sections with figures, and the top level shows two figures seated under a canopy. Above and behind the palace, a procession moves from left to right across a light green ground dotted with dark green trees. This upper procession includes figures riding elephants and horses, and several chariots pulled by horses, all adorned with colorful fabrics. Flags are visible on some vehicles and elephants. Below the palace, a similar, larger procession moves from right to left towards the palace's entrance. This lower procession also features many figures on foot, riding elephants, and on horseback, as well as several elaborate chariots. The figures wear a variety of brightly colored clothing in shades of pink, orange, blue, yellow, and green. The ground in the foreground is a light brown, transitioning to light green around the palace, with more dark green trees forming a backdrop. The entire scene is framed by a light brown border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts tall bamboo stalks and leaves beside a large, textured rock.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a composition of bamboo and a large rock, rendered in black ink on a light, off-white background. In the upper and middle sections, multiple clusters of bamboo stalks rise vertically. The slender stalks are defined by dark, crisp lines, while the abundant leaves are created with energetic, overlapping brushstrokes, giving them a feathery appearance and suggesting movement. Some of the bamboo foliage extends towards the top and right edges of the painting. At the bottom right, a prominent, irregularly shaped rock is depicted. It is rendered with a range of gray washes and darker black accents, creating a textured and solid form. Short, dark brushstrokes suggest sparse ground cover around the base of the rock and the bamboo stalks. In the upper right quadrant, vertical calligraphic text in black ink is visible, accompanied by a small, square red seal directly below it. The artwork relies entirely on the interplay of black ink tones and the light background to create depth and form.

metadata.title: 高橋草坪筆　墨竹図|Bamboo in Summer

alt_text: A six-panel screen painting featuring various flowering plants and grasses against a shimmering gold background.
long_description: The artwork is a six-panel screen, presented horizontally, with a luminous gold background that appears to be gold leaf, showing subtle variations in texture and reflectivity. The entire surface is covered with a detailed depiction of various plants, grasses, and flowering vines, primarily concentrated in the lower and middle sections of the panels, with some elements extending higher. From left to right, the first panel features tall, slender grasses with long, arching blades rising from the bottom edge, accompanied by smaller, leafy plants. The second and third panels show denser clusters of flora, including broad-leafed plants and delicate, fern-like foliage. Among these are numerous flowers, rendered with muted colors such as soft pinks, purples, and light blues, alongside white blossoms. In the upper portion of the third and fourth panels, dark, trailing vines with small, clustered leaves hang downwards, suggesting an overhead canopy. The lower half of the screen across all panels is filled with a diverse array of botanical life. Some plants have large, rounded leaves close to the ground, while others stand upright with slender stems and small, delicate flowers. The rightmost panels continue this botanical theme, showcasing more leafy bushes and flowering plants. Here, some flowers are depicted with brighter accents of orange and red, providing a subtle contrast to the overall subdued palette. The plants are rendered with fine ink outlines and washes, with color applied sparingly to highlight the blossoms and leaves. The gold background creates a sense of depth and luminosity, emphasizing the organic forms of the vegetation. No figures, animals, or man-made structures are present.

metadata.title: 四季花野菜図屏風|Flowering Plants and Vegetables of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, light color, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: Profile portrait of a woman with dark hair, elaborate jewelry, and a sheer veil, against a dark background.
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a woman in profile, facing left, against a dark, unadorned background. The painting is framed by a green border with gold flecks. The woman occupies the central and right portion of the canvas. Her skin is light-toned. She has long, dark hair that falls down her back, with a few dark curls visible near her ear and temple. Her eye is dark and almond-shaped, with a prominent brow and a long, dark line extending from the outer corner. Her nose is long and straight, and her lips are small and reddish. She wears multiple pieces of jewelry. Her right ear features a large, light-colored pearl earring with a green teardrop-shaped pendant. Her left ear, partially obscured by her hair, also has a similar pearl earring. Her nose is adorned with a small red stud and a larger white pearl ring. A small red dot is visible on her forehead. Around her neck are several strands of white pearls, and beneath them, a wide, intricate gold-colored necklace with a rectangular pendant. She wears a light-colored garment, possibly a tunic, and a sheer, reddish-brown veil or dupatta draped over her head and shoulders, edged with a thin gold band. Her right hand is raised to chest level, with fingers slightly curled, and she wears a ring on her ring finger. Her fingernails are painted red. The background is a solid, dark blue-grey color, providing a stark contrast to the figure.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: Several figures operate a water-lifting device on a hillside, with one person in a basket, surrounded by calligraphic text.
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a scene of labor on a hillside, rendered in muted earth tones, greens, and browns. The composition is divided between a landscape scene on the right and columns of calligraphic text on the left and far right.In the central-left portion, four figures are actively engaged in operating a water-lifting device. They stand on a wooden platform or bridge that extends over a dark, unseen area, possibly a water source. Three figures, dressed in simple white or light-colored tunics and dark trousers, are positioned in a line, pulling on ropes or levers connected to the mechanism. The figure furthest left wears a white cloth around their head. They are under a simple, open-sided shelter with a dark, sloped roof supported by poles.To the right of this group, a fifth figure, wearing a light-colored garment, is seated or crouched inside a large, open-weave basket suspended from a tall wooden pole. This pole is part of a larger structure that includes a horizontal beam and a counterweight, suggesting a well or water-lifting system. The figure appears to be pulling on a rope or chain. The background behind these figures is a steep, grassy hillside, with some rocky outcrops visible below the water-lifting structure.On the far left, several columns of vertical text are written in black ink. On the far right, more columns of vertical text are present, also in black ink, followed by a small red square seal at the bottom right corner. The overall impression is one of human activity integrated into a natural, somewhat rugged landscape.

metadata.title: 元  忽哥赤  和  佚名  耕稼圖  卷	|Rice Culture, or Sowing and Reaping
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a small bird perched on a thin vertical element, with faint lines on a light background.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a minimalist ink wash depiction of a small bird on a light, aged paper background. The central artwork is framed by a gold-colored mounting with subtle patterned details. The bird, positioned in the lower-middle section, is rendered with varying shades of black and grey ink. It has a dark head, a lighter body, and dark wings and tail feathers, and is oriented facing downwards and slightly to the left. It appears to be perched on a thin, vertical element, possibly a reed or a slender branch, which extends from below the bird. To the left of the bird, several faint, vertical lines suggest additional reeds or bamboo stalks. In the lower-left quadrant of the painting, there is a small inscription of black characters, accompanied by a square red seal.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: One of a triptych of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A person reads in a building overlooking a landscape with mountains, pine trees, and a flowering cherry tree
long_description: The image is a horizontal painting framed by decorative borders at the top and bottom. The main artwork depicts a landscape scene with a figure. The top border features a band of gold with a repeating floral or cloud-like pattern, above a narrower band of brown with a repeating geometric motif. The bottom border mirrors this design. The central artwork is rendered on a light, aged beige or off-white background. In the upper left, a large, rounded mountain or rock formation with green and brown accents rises. Below it, several dark green pine trees are visible. To the right of the mountain, a person with a shaved head, wearing a light brown robe, sits inside an open-sided building. The person is seated on the floor, leaning over a book or scroll placed on a low, dark brown table. The building has a light-colored wooden frame and a dark roof, extending over a cliff edge. To the right of the building, a gnarled, dark brown tree with white and light pink blossoms stands on a separate cliff. The tree's branches extend towards the right. Below the main elevated landscape, the scene continues with a lower expanse of light beige ground, dotted with numerous dark green pine trees of varying sizes. Faint, undulating lines suggest distant hills or water in the background. The overall color palette is muted, featuring greens, browns, grays, and the soft white and pink of the blossoms.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Section of scroll 1 from a set of 3; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Ten vertical panels depicting stacks of books, vases, and various decorative objects on shelves
long_description: The artwork is a ten-panel screen, with each panel featuring a vertical composition of stacked objects. The upper two-thirds of each panel show a light, unadorned background, while the lower third has a patterned, light brown background. Each panel presents a unique arrangement of items, primarily books, vases, and decorative objects, often placed on small tables or shelves. From left to right, the panels display a variety of items. The first panel shows a tall stack of colorful books, a vase with flowers, and a dark vase on a small table. Subsequent panels continue this theme, featuring more stacks of books in various colors like red, blue, green, and white. Interspersed among the books are ceramic vessels, some holding flowering branches or leafy plants. Other objects include a circular clock face, a fan, scrolls, and small, intricately designed wooden tables or stands. The objects are rendered with a mix of soft and bright colors, creating a sense of depth and detail. The overall impression is one of abundance and varied collections, with each panel offering a distinct yet harmonious collection of items.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ten-panel folding screen; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman reclines on a bed while two other women stand and kneel nearby, under a stormy sky and next to a building
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting with a thick red border. The scene is divided horizontally into two main sections. The upper left portion depicts a stormy sky with swirling dark gray and blue clouds, interspersed with thin, wavy brown lines. In the upper right, two white domed structures with red and gold accents rise above a building. The building features a white facade with small, decorative red and white patterns, and a green-walled interior visible on the right. Inside the green-walled room, a woman reclines on a white bed with decorative tassels. She wears a red garment and a red head covering, and her eyes are closed. Her left arm is bent, resting on a pillow, and her right arm is extended towards her lower body. To the left of the building, on a patch of green grass, two other women are depicted. One woman stands, looking towards the reclining figure, wearing a pink top and a green skirt, with a white veil over her head. The second woman kneels in front of the standing woman, also looking towards the reclining figure, dressed in a green top and a red skirt, with a green veil. Both women have dark hair and visible jewelry. The overall color palette includes vibrant reds, greens, blues, and whites, with dark grays for the sky.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire picking flowers in a vibrant, yellow-hued garden with trees
long_description:
The artwork depicts two women in a lush, flowering landscape, framed by a thick red border. The background is dominated by a vibrant yellow field densely filled with green foliage and small white and red flowers. Two large trees with rounded, green canopies are prominent, one on the left and another on the right, extending towards the top of the frame. A narrow strip of light blue sky with faint white clouds is visible at the very top edge.

In the foreground, a strip of green ground with small white flowers separates the figures from the bottom border. The woman on the left wears a red skirt with white patterns, a green top, and a green veil covering her head and shoulders. She is adorned with multiple necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. Her head is slightly bowed as she reaches down with her right hand to pick a flower from the dense foliage. In her left hand, she holds a dark gray, pot-shaped vessel with a handle.

The woman on the right wears a white skirt with red patterns, a light purple top, and a white veil. She also wears several necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. She extends her left hand towards the foliage, seemingly picking a flower, while holding a reddish-purple, pot-shaped vessel with a handle in her right hand. Her gaze is directed towards the flowers. Both women have dark hair and facial features typical of Indian miniature paintings. The overall scene is rich in detail and color.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll with a central circular painting of a person with a fan, a flowering tree, and surrounding calligraphy
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a central painted section surrounded by extensive calligraphy. The central painting is enclosed within a circular frame, depicting a person seated indoors. The person, positioned slightly to the left of center, wears a long, flowing robe in shades of red and pink with blue trim. Their dark hair is styled, and they hold a light-colored, round fan in their left hand. To their right, on a surface, an open book or scroll is visible. Behind the person, a patterned screen with white dots on a blue background is seen, alongside a dark, vertical structure. Below the circular painting, a flowering tree or bush with numerous small white blossoms and dark, gnarled branches extends across the lower portion of the central painted area. The background of the painted section is a muted brownish-gold. Surrounding this central image, the scroll is filled with columns of dark script. A large block of dense, smaller script occupies the top section. Vertical columns of script run along the left and right margins, interspersed with several red square seals. Additional lines of script are present at the bottom of the scroll.

metadata.title: 清   崔鶴   李香君小影   軸|Portrait of Li Xiangjun
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An ink painting on a vertical scroll depicts a flowering branch, a faint moon, and calligraphy.
long_description: This vertical ink painting features a dark, gnarled branch with numerous white blossoms against a light gray background. The branch originates from the bottom right, curving upwards and slightly to the left, with several smaller offshoots. The blossoms are small, round, and white, each with a dark center, clustered along the branches. A faint, light gray circular form, representing a moon, is positioned in the upper-middle left section of the scroll, partially obscured by a thin branch. In the upper left, two large, dark characters are visible: "漫月". Below these, several vertical lines of smaller, dark calligraphy extend downwards along the left side of the artwork. Two square red seals are stamped below the main body of text on the left. A single square red seal is also present in the bottom right corner of the scroll.

metadata.title: 清　童鈺　浸月圖　軸|Drenched in Moonlight

alt_text: A procession of figures in traditional attire on a shimmering gold background with mountains and trees.
long_description:
The artwork is a horizontal panel, likely a screen, featuring a group of figures against a shimmering gold background. The composition is divided into six vertical sections by faint lines, suggesting a multi-panel screen.

On the far left, a figure dressed in green and brown robes with a dark hat kneels or sits on a dark blue-black ground, facing towards the right. Above and behind this figure, a light brown mountain peak with subtle shading rises into the gold background.

Moving right, a central procession of figures dominates the middle ground. A tall figure in flowing white robes with black trim and a dark hat walks towards the right. Behind this figure, another individual holds a large, light brown parasol over them. Several other figures follow, dressed in various robes of white, green, and patterned brown. Some carry objects; one holds a tall pole with a light-colored lantern, and another carries a large, brown, saddle-like bundle on their back.

Further to the right, the gold background gives way to more landscape elements. A large, gnarled pine tree with dark green needles and a brown trunk extends across the upper right portion of the panel. Below the tree, a small, light-colored building with a dark roof is visible. Several figures are positioned in this area, some standing, some kneeling. One figure in a brown robe appears to be interacting with another figure in white robes. The ground throughout the scene is primarily gold, with areas of light brown and sparse green foliage.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on gilded paper

alt_text: A multi-armed figure on a lion battles a large buffalo and smaller figures in an ancient-style painting.
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular painting framed by a light brown border, depicting a dynamic battle scene. On the left, a multi-armed figure, possibly a deity, is seated atop a large, light-colored lion. The figure wears a headdress and holds various weapons in its many hands, including swords, a disc, and a mace, with arms extending in an arc around its upper body. The lion is shown in a powerful, lunging stance, facing right. To the right, a large, dark grey buffalo with prominent horns dominates the right half of the composition. Its body is marked with an inscription: "शकीसो". The buffalo is depicted in motion, with its front legs raised, appearing to charge or stomp. Below the buffalo and between the lion and buffalo, several smaller human-like figures are engaged in combat. Some figures are on the ground, appearing to be fallen or trampled, while others stand, holding shields and weapons. One figure in the lower center, wearing orange lower garments, holds a round shield and a weapon, facing the buffalo. The background is largely unadorned, with faint, wispy cloud-like forms in the upper right. Inscriptions in an unknown script are visible in the upper left corner, reading "किशानी", and in the upper center, reading "PE". The color palette is subdued, primarily featuring black outlines, washes of light brown, grey, and subtle touches of red and yellow on the figures and their attire.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: An ink wash landscape painting shows towering mountains, dense forests, small buildings, and two figures on a path.
long_description: An ink wash painting depicts a vast, monochrome landscape dominated by mountains and forests. The upper left features a large, rounded mountain rendered with varying shades of dark gray and lighter washes, creating a sense of depth. Below it, two small figures, wearing conical hats and carrying staffs, walk along a winding path that extends from the lower left towards the center. To the right, a dense forest of tall, slender trees, painted with dark, vertical strokes, covers the slopes of another mountain range. Nestled within these trees on the upper right are several small, simple buildings with peaked roofs, appearing as clusters of light shapes against the darker foliage. The overall palette is a range of grays, from deep charcoal to light, misty washes, suggesting an atmospheric or hazy quality. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of black calligraphy are visible, reading "雨餘千山 峽裏晴嵐 故築茅簷釣" followed by a smaller signature and a square red seal below it.

metadata.title: 활호자  김수규  산수도  조선|活毫子  金壽奎  山水圖  朝鮮|Rainy Landscape
metadata.medium: Album leaf mounted as a hanging scroll; ink and color on bast fiber

alt_text: A portly, bald man with a beard, carrying a large sack and staff, looks upward, with calligraphy above.
long_description: A vertical scroll features a single, portly figure in the lower half, slightly right of center, against a plain, light-colored background. The man is bald with a round face, a small beard, and a smiling expression as he looks upward. His bare chest and belly are visible beneath loose, flowing robes, rendered in light tones with dark ink outlines. A large, light-colored sack is slung over his left shoulder, and he holds a dark staff diagonally across his body with both hands. In the upper left portion of the scroll, multiple lines of dark, vertical calligraphy are present. Below the calligraphy, a red circular seal is visible. Another smaller, rectangular red seal is located in the lower left corner. The central artwork is framed by a decorative border of greenish-blue fabric with a subtle patterned design and thin gold accents.

metadata.title: 狩野孝信筆   布袋図「拄杖擊破三千界。彌勒撫掌笑呵呵，明月清風無。」|Hotei

alt_text: A vertical scroll with black calligraphy at the top and an ink painting of bamboo and a rock at the bottom.
long_description: A tall, vertical scroll features a light brown paper ground with decorative gold-patterned borders at the very top and bottom. The upper third of the scroll contains several columns of black calligraphic text, written vertically from right to left. Below the text, on the right side, are two prominent red square seals, one stacked above the other, with illegible characters. Further to the left, below the text, is another smaller red seal. The middle section of the scroll is largely blank. The lower third of the scroll displays an ink painting. On the right, a cluster of slender bamboo stalks rises, with several dark green or black leaves extending from them. To the left of the bamboo, a large, dark, irregularly shaped mass, possibly a rock or mound, is depicted with varying shades of black and gray ink washes. A small, circular red seal with illegible characters is located in the bottom right corner of the painted section.

metadata.title: Untitled
