alt_text: A wrathful deity with multiple eyes and fangs sits amidst flames, surrounded by smaller figures
long_description: The artwork is a vertical textile painting, predominantly dark blue, depicting a central wrathful deity surrounded by flames and numerous smaller figures. The large, dark-skinned central deity sits cross-legged on a low, dark platform. Its face is wide with three prominent eyes, a gaping mouth revealing fangs, and a red tongue. Its reddish-brown hair is spiky, and it wears a crown adorned with skulls. Its hands are positioned near its chest, holding indistinct objects. A large, circular halo or aura, outlined in gold, frames its head and upper body. Numerous red and orange flame-like shapes emanate from behind and around the central figure, extending upwards and outwards across the dark blue background. In the upper left and right corners, two smaller, seated figures are visible, each with a halo. Along the left and right sides, and below the central deity, several other smaller figures or creatures are depicted, some appearing to be in dynamic poses amidst swirling dark patterns and additional flame elements. The very bottom edge of the painting features a row of stylized, smaller faces or figures, seemingly emerging from a dark, wavy base. Gold outlines define many of the figures and details against the deep indigo background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Distemper and gold on blue silk

alt_text: A painted wooden panel features four circular medallions depicting a lion, a monkey, a winged creature, and two snakes.
long_description: A long, rectangular wooden panel, horizontally oriented, displays a series of painted motifs. The panel appears aged and worn, with visible cracks and some missing fragments, particularly along its lower edge and in the central area. The primary decoration consists of four circular medallions, evenly spaced across the panel, set against a reddish-brown background. Each medallion is encircled by a border of small, dark brown or black dots. Inside each, a central golden-yellow circle contains a depicted creature, rendered in a brownish-gold color with dark outlines. From left to right, the first medallion shows a four-legged animal, possibly a lion or a similar feline, in profile, facing right, with a visible mane and tail. The second medallion features a creature resembling a monkey or primate, also in profile, facing right, with a curled tail. The third medallion contains a winged, four-legged creature, possibly a dragon or griffin, facing left, with a long neck and prominent wings. The fourth medallion displays two intertwined snake-like creatures, with their heads visible on opposite sides of the circle. Between and above the medallions, the reddish-brown background is adorned with stylized, swirling floral or foliate motifs in shades of brown, gold, and hints of light green. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy reds, golds, and browns, contributing to the panel's rustic and aged appearance.

alt_text: Painted panel with central red rectangle of white text, flanked by seated figures and deities
long_description: The artwork is a horizontally oriented rectangular panel, painted with a central red text block surrounded by numerous figures. The central feature is a large red rectangle containing white, stylized script, which appears to be Tibetan, reading "ཨོཾ་མ་ཎི་པདྨེ་ཧཱུྃ". This text block is framed by narrow green and red borders. To the left of the central text, a vertical panel features a prominent seated figure in red robes, positioned centrally on a multi-layered lotus throne. This figure has a golden complexion and is surrounded by a green and red halo with intricate floral and cloud-like motifs. Below this central figure, three smaller figures in orange and red robes are seated on a green ground. Above, two more figures are depicted, one seated and one standing. The right side mirrors the left, with another vertical panel featuring a similar prominent seated figure in red robes on a lotus throne, surrounded by a halo. Below this figure, three smaller seated figures in orange and red robes are arranged, and above, two more figures are visible. Above the central text and the two flanking panels, a horizontal band depicts a series of smaller seated and standing figures in various colored robes (orange, red, blue, white) against a light green landscape background. Vertical red and blue striped columns mark the top corners. Below the central text and flanking panels, another horizontal band shows a row of seated figures. Some of these figures appear to be deities or protectors, with more elaborate headdresses and postures, while others resemble monks, all against a green ground. The overall color palette is vibrant, dominated by reds, greens, oranges, blues, and whites, with distinct outlines and a traditional style.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Distemper on board with silk cover

alt_text: A colorful miniature painting depicts a royal procession with a king on a decorated horse, surrounded by attendants.
long_description:
The image is a vertical rectangular painting depicting a procession of figures on a green landscape under a blue sky. In the upper portion, the sky is a deep blue with light blue and white clouds along the horizon line. A small white crescent moon is visible in the upper right quadrant. The lower portion of the painting features a vibrant green ground with subtle variations in shade, suggesting grass.

The central figure, likely a king or noble, is positioned slightly to the left of the center, riding a large, dark gray horse. This figure is depicted with a golden halo around his head, wearing a white and gold patterned robe, a red sash, and an elaborate turban adorned with jewels. He holds a small white object in his left hand. The horse is richly decorated with a patterned saddle cloth, a gold bridle, and a decorative headpiece.

Surrounding the central figure and horse are numerous male attendants, all dressed in similar white robes with sashes of various colors (red, pink, green) and turbans (red, pink, orange, white). Many carry objects: one holds a large red umbrella over the central figure, another holds a white pennant, and several others carry staffs or maces. The procession moves from left to right across the frame, with figures both in front of and behind the central horse. The figures are arranged in multiple rows, creating a sense of depth. Their faces are depicted in profile, with dark hair and beards.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor and gold on paper

alt_text: A person climbs a rope from a multi-story building towards a horse, with figures and a landscape
long_description: This oval-shaped painting depicts a complex scene with a large building on the left and a landscape on the right, under a dark sky. The multi-story building, rendered in shades of gray and white, features multiple windows and balconies. On the second floor, a figure reclines on a bed, attended by two standing figures. Below, on the ground level, four figures are seated or reclining on a platform, with one playing a stringed instrument. A person in green attire is shown climbing down a red rope that extends from the top of the building towards the lower right. Below the rope, a richly adorned red horse stands, facing left, with a figure in a white garment standing beside it. The right side of the painting features a dark green landscape with several large trees with broad leaves. In the background, a cluster of gray animals, possibly cattle, are visible. Further in the distance, a white walled city with multiple structures is depicted on a hill. The sky above is dark gray with hints of lighter clouds.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor, ink and gold on paper

alt_text: A vibrant painting depicting several figures, an elephant, and a mermaid-like creature on a red background with a dark water feature.
long_description:
The artwork is a rectangular painting with a dark red border. At the top, a horizontal band of white text in a non-Latin script is visible, followed by a thin blue band and a thin white band. The main field of the painting is a vibrant red, dotted with small white specks.

In the upper left, a light-skinned man with dark hair and a mustache sits cross-legged on a green throne with red legs. He wears a yellow garment, a white sash, and multiple necklaces and armbands. His right hand is raised, and his left hand rests on his lap. To his right, a light-skinned woman with dark hair is depicted in a dynamic pose, appearing to dance or gesture. She wears a green and gold patterned skirt, a gold top, and jewelry. Further to the right, a blue-skinned figure kneels on the red ground, facing left. This figure wears a white loincloth and holds a light-colored, cylindrical object with both hands.

In the lower left, a light-skinned man with dark hair and a white turban sits cross-legged on the ground. He wears a white garment and holds a small, light-skinned figure in his arms. To his right, a large, dark gray elephant with prominent white tusks walks towards the right. It wears a gold chain around its neck and a decorative pink and white band on its head. Below the elephant and the sitting man, a dark, wavy body of water extends across the bottom of the painting, with a green grassy bank adorned with small pink flowers. Partially submerged in the water on the far left, a light-skinned figure with a human torso and a white, scaly, serpentine lower body is depicted. This figure has dark hair and holds a small, light-colored object in its raised right hand. A small number "96" is visible in the bottom right corner of the red border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor, ink, and gold on paper

alt_text: A composite creature with a blue bird head, human arm holding a red flower, and various animal legs and tail.
long_description: A watercolor painting on a light, off-white background depicts a composite mythical creature, known as a Navagunjara, standing in profile, facing left. The creature's head is that of a blue bird, resembling a peacock or rooster, with a red crest, a white eye with a black pupil, and a red beak. Its long, curved neck is also blue and adorned with a gold necklace featuring dangling leaf-shaped pendants. The front-most leg is a light brown human arm, bent at the elbow, with a gold bracelet on the wrist. The hand holds a detailed red flower with green leaves. The second front leg is a greyish-brown elephant leg. The creature's main body is light grey, with a prominent red hump on its back, from which a string of black beads hangs. The rear-most leg is a pinkish-brown horse or deer leg with a dark hoof. The leg in front of it is a tiger's leg, featuring black stripes on a tan background. A long, curved, red snake-like tail with white markings extends upwards and then curls down behind the creature. Below the creature's body, in the lower left, is text in a non-Latin script that reads 'नवकुंजर'.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor, ink, and gold on paper

alt_text: A long, horizontal painting depicts a winding river, a large lake, and scattered green hills with small settlements.
long_description: A wide, horizontal painting in muted tones depicts an expansive landscape from an elevated perspective. A broad, light brown, serpentine river dominates the upper portion, winding from the left edge towards the right. Its banks are lined with light green land and small clusters of dark green trees or low hills. Several small settlements, depicted as groups of tiny buildings, are visible along the river's curves. Below the river, the landscape is a mix of light green and tan ground. In the lower right, a large, irregular body of water, similar in color to the river but wider, occupies a significant area, resembling a lake or bay. Its shores are also dotted with small settlements and dark green vegetation. Numerous rounded, dark green hills or mountains are scattered across the entire landscape, particularly in the upper left, lower left, and along the edges of the large body of water in the lower right. Faint, light-colored lines suggest paths or roads connecting some of the settlements. The overall impression is a detailed, panoramic view of a populated river valley and coastal area.

metadata.title: 清  佚名  黃河萬里圖  卷|Ten Thousand Miles along the Yellow River
metadata.medium: Two handscrolls; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A central figure in red robes surrounded by smaller figures and a mountainous landscape with flowers
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a central, large figure seated cross-legged on an elaborate, multi-tiered throne. The figure wears red robes and a red hat, with hands in a gesture, holding a small object. A light blue halo encircles the head, and a larger red aura surrounds the body. The throne is adorned with flowers and foliage. Above the central figure, at the top center, a smaller red-skinned deity with multiple arms is depicted amidst clouds and flowers. To the upper left and right, two smaller robed figures, each with a light blue halo, are seated on clouds. Flanking the central figure, at mid-left and mid-right, are two more smaller robed figures, each with a green halo, seated on the ground. In the lower section, at the bottom center, a blue-skinned wrathful deity with multiple arms is seated on a pedestal, surrounded by red flames. To the bottom left and right, two additional smaller robed figures, each with a light blue halo, are seated on the ground. The background features a blue sky with clouds and a small moon or star at the top, transitioning to green and blue mountains, trees, and numerous flowering plants throughout the middle and lower sections. The entire composition is framed by a dark blue border.

alt_text: A bald, bearded man in a boat with a deer, reaching for a turtle in water, under a pine tree with a flying crane
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a scene with a large, bald, and bearded man in a boat, a deer, a turtle, a pine tree, and a flying crane, rendered in muted tones of brown, green, and gray against a light beige background. In the upper left, a white crane with black wingtips and red markings on its head flies downwards, its wings spread. To the right, a large, gnarled pine tree trunk extends from the top edge, with dark green needles on its branches reaching towards the left. Below the pine tree, a smaller, bare tree with delicate branches is visible. In the lower half of the painting, the man, with a prominent bald head, long white beard, and large earlobes, is seated in a dark brown boat. He wears a green robe with white undergarments. His body is turned slightly to the right, and he leans forward, extending his right arm towards the water. His left hand rests on the edge of the boat. Inside the boat, behind the man, a white deer with small antlers is visible, its head facing left. The man's right hand is positioned just above a small, dark-shelled turtle in the water. The water below the boat is depicted with light gray wavy lines, suggesting gentle movement. To the lower right, dark, jagged rocks and green bamboo-like plants emerge from the water. A red seal and black calligraphic text are visible on the lower right rock formation. The text reads '萬石' (Manseki).

metadata.title: 曽我蕭白筆    寿老人図|The God of Good Fortune Jurōjin
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A six-panel screen painting depicting a golden landscape with red-leafed trees, mountains, a waterfall, and small figures
long_description: This six-panel screen painting features a vibrant autumn landscape set against a shimmering gold background. The gold, which covers the upper two-thirds of the panels, suggests a luminous sky or dense mist, with visible vertical lines indicating the screen's structure. On the left side, a gentle, undulating brown hill rises from the bottom edge, topped by several small trees with striking red-orange foliage. The ground below this hill is a lighter, sandy brown. Moving towards the center, the golden mist continues, interspersed with more subtle, lighter brown hills in the mid-ground. The right side of the painting is dominated by a prominent, darker brown mountain or cliff face. A white waterfall cascades down its side, appearing as a narrow, vertical stream. Several trees with vibrant red-orange leaves are scattered on and around this mountain, some clinging to its slopes, others at its base. Below the waterfall, the landscape flattens into a lighter brown area. In the bottom-center section, a winding path or riverbed is visible, along which several small, dark figures, possibly people or animals, are depicted moving. Adjacent to this path are a few small, dark, vertical structures resembling fences or posts. The rightmost panels continue the golden background, with additional subtle brown hills and a few more scattered red-leafed trees, completing the expansive autumn scene.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on gilded paper

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono kneels on a woven mat beside a body of water, holding a fan
long_description: This artwork features a woman kneeling on a raised mat beside a body of water, all set against a plain, light brown background. The woman is positioned on the left side of the composition, facing slightly right with her head bowed, looking down at the mat. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun, adorned with a small, golden ornament. She wears a long-sleeved kimono. The upper portion of her kimono is dark purple with a pattern of white and light blue geometric shapes and lines, and her left shoulder is exposed. A green sash is tied around her waist. The lower part of her kimono is white with large, flowing patterns in blue, red, and green, resembling waves and floral motifs. Her right hand rests on the mat, while her left hand holds a dark green fan with a lighter green rim. Her bare feet are visible beneath the hem of her kimono. The rectangular mat is made of light brown wood and is elevated on short legs. Its surface is covered with a woven pattern of alternating dark brown and light brown squares, creating a checkerboard effect, interspersed with red and white zigzag lines. The mat extends from the lower left towards the center of the image. To the right of the mat, a body of water is depicted with light gray, wavy lines suggesting movement, receding into the background. The background is a uniform light brown. In the upper right corner, vertical black script reads: "真利川八きとて 袂ふた左保の那". In the lower left corner, vertical black script reads: "光頭翁", beneath which is a red rectangular seal.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape with trees, buildings, and figures along a winding path and river.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on a scroll depicts a serene mountainous landscape. The color palette is primarily grayscale, with subtle hints of light brown or ochre on the building roofs and the scroll's inner borders. In the upper section, two prominent, pointed mountains rise, with the larger one on the right and a smaller one to its left. Wisps of lighter gray suggest mist or clouds around their bases, blending into the pale background. The middle ground features a valley filled with numerous trees, some with dense, dark foliage, while others appear bare or sparsely leaved, rendered with delicate brushstrokes. Several small, traditional-style buildings with light brown roofs are nestled among the trees and along a winding path that descends through the landscape. On the right side, a steep cliff face is visible, with some buildings appearing on terraced sections. In the lower section, a winding river or path, rendered in lighter gray tones, traverses the foreground. Two small figures are depicted on a bridge or narrow walkway crossing this feature. The ground throughout the lower and mid-sections is a light, muted gray, suggesting snow or mist. Vertical black text, likely calligraphy, is present in the upper left corner, accompanied by a few small red seals. The painting is framed by a dark brown border adorned with a repeating pattern of light gold cloud-like motifs. A lighter, patterned strip in a similar color scheme separates the painting from this outer border at the top and bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A group of robed figures gathered under a large gnarled tree next to a building, one holding a scroll
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a gathering of figures beneath a large tree next to a building. The upper half of the image is dominated by a gnarled tree with a thick, light-colored trunk and branches, and dark green, sparse foliage. Behind the tree, to the right, is a building with red architectural elements and yellow walls, featuring a patterned window or screen. Below the tree, a group of approximately twelve figures, mostly men, are arranged in a loose cluster. They wear long robes in various colors, including shades of green, brown, red, and blue, with some featuring patterned designs. Their skin tones vary, and some have beards or shaved heads. In the center of the group, one figure holds a horizontal scroll or painting, which displays a landscape scene with a small, light-colored figure. To the far left, a younger figure, possibly a boy, stands holding a staff. The figures are engaged in various postures, some looking towards the scroll, others conversing. The background is a plain, light beige color. Red seals and some faint vertical text are visible on the left side of the painting, near the top and middle. The entire scene is framed by a dark blue border with a repeating gold pattern.

metadata.title: 加藤信清筆　羅漢図|Ten Rakan Examining a Painting of White-Robed Kannon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicting numerous Buddhist and guardian figures in three distinct sections
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a complex composition of numerous figures against a dark brown background, framed by a patterned gold and green border. The artwork is divided into three main horizontal sections by decorative red and gold bands. The top section depicts a dark, mountainous landscape with swirling clouds. Various figures are scattered across this scene. In the center, a large red circular mandorla frames a multi-armed, fierce-looking deity. Surrounding this central figure are several other figures, some standing, some in dynamic poses, rendered in red, brown, and pale skin tones. Many figures are accompanied by white rectangular cartouches containing vertical black text, such as "不動明王", "降三世明王", "軍荼利明王", "大威徳明王", and "金剛夜叉明王". The middle section is a grid of fifteen seated figures arranged in three rows of five. Most of these figures are depicted in golden robes, seated cross-legged on lotus pedestals, with halos behind their heads. Some wear elaborate crowns and jewelry, while others are simpler in attire. Notable exceptions include a red, multi-armed figure in the top row, second from the right, and another more dynamic, colorful figure at the far right of the top row. The bottom section mirrors the top in its landscape style, featuring a dark, mountainous terrain. A variety of figures, including guardians and human-like forms, are positioned throughout this lower scene. These figures are rendered in a palette of red, blue, brown, and pale skin tones. Similar to the top section, white rectangular cartouches with vertical black text are placed near many figures, including "梵天", "帝釈天", "持国天", "増長天", "広目天", and "多聞天".

metadata.title: 熊野曼茶羅図|Mandala of Kumano Shrine
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: Two women and a child walk on a path overlooking a village, temple, and forested hills
long_description: This black and white print, likely intended for a fan, depicts a panoramic landscape with figures. In the foreground, on the right, two women and a small child are shown on a winding path. The woman on the left wears a light-colored kimono with dark trim and has her hair styled up. She holds a long piece of fabric. The woman on the right carries a child on her back, who is also dressed in a light-colored garment. This woman wears a similar kimono and has her hair styled up. Both women wear tall, platform-like sandals. A vertical cartouche with Japanese characters is visible near their feet. To the left of the women, a small child is seen kneeling or crawling on a low, rounded structure, looking down towards the village. The background presents an expansive view of a village with numerous houses, characterized by their dark, tiled roofs, nestled among fields and trees. In the mid-ground, on a distant hill, a temple complex with a prominent building and a tall, rectangular banner displaying the characters "高山寺" (Kōzan-ji) is visible, surrounded by dense forest. A large, gnarled pine tree with long, textured branches dominates the far left side of the composition, framing the view of the village. Other trees with varying foliage are scattered throughout the landscape, contributing to the depth of the scene. The overall composition is detailed, showing a blend of human activity and natural scenery.

alt_text: An ink wash painting of a bald, bearded man in a flowing robe, with calligraphic text and red seals above.
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting depicts a bald, bearded man in a simple robe, rendered in shades of black and gray on light beige paper. The man is positioned slightly right of center, facing upwards and to the right with a serene expression. His head is bald, and he has a full, dark beard and mustache. His body is draped in a flowing robe, indicated by broad, sweeping brushstrokes that suggest folds and movement. The lines of the robe extend downwards, with some faint, abstract brushstrokes in the lower right corner that might suggest a ground or a simple setting. In the upper left portion of the scroll, there is a block of black calligraphic text arranged in vertical columns. Below this text, two red seals are visible. The background is otherwise unadorned, a plain, light-colored surface that highlights the figure and text. The overall impression is one of simplicity and contemplation.

metadata.title: 芦葉達磨図 (Royō Daruma zu)|Bodhidharma Crossing the Yangzi River on a Reed
metadata.artist: Kano Genshun 狩野元俊|Gyokushitsu Sōhaku

alt_text: Two robed figures sit under gnarled pine trees on a cliff overlooking a misty mountain landscape.
long_description: An ink painting depicts a mountainous landscape with two figures. Several large pine trees with dark, gnarled trunks and dense, dark green needle clusters dominate the left and center of the composition. Their branches extend across much of the upper and middle sections of the image. On the left, beneath the canopy of the pine trees, two robed figures are seated on a gentle, light brown slope. They face each other, appearing to be in conversation or contemplation. Their robes are light-colored, and their forms are simple. Below the figures and trees, a steep, dark brown cliff face drops sharply. To the right of the cliff, a misty valley is visible, with faint, dark vertical lines suggesting distant trees. In the upper right, a large, rounded mountain peak rises, partially obscured by a reddish-brown mist or sky. The overall color palette is muted, consisting primarily of shades of brown, beige, and dark grey ink, with a subtle reddish wash in the upper right sky.

metadata.title: 清 高岑 擬古山水圖 冊 絹本|Landscapes in the styles of old masters
metadata.medium: Album of ten leaves; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling village, green mountains, a river with boats, and misty peaks
long_description: The painting is a long, horizontal scroll depicting a detailed landscape with a village, mountains, and water, rendered in a muted color palette of greens, browns, and grays against a pale background. On the far left, a wide body of water features a large, multi-masted boat with sails furled, and several smaller boats. Figures are visible on the shore and in nearby fields, which are delineated by faint lines. A few simple buildings with dark roofs are scattered near the water. Moving towards the center, the landscape transitions into a densely populated village. Numerous buildings with dark, tiled roofs and light-colored walls are clustered together, some appearing to be multi-story. Paths wind through the village, populated by many small figures engaged in various activities, such as walking, carrying items, and interacting near doorways. Lush green mountains rise behind and around the village, covered with a variety of trees, including tall, dark green pine-like trees and smaller, lighter green deciduous trees. To the right, the village continues, gradually becoming more enveloped in soft, white, cloud-like mist that obscures parts of the landscape. More green mountains emerge from the mist. In the upper right distance, a tall, slender, multi-tiered pagoda-like structure with a pointed top is visible, partially shrouded by the clouds. Other smaller structures also appear within the misty, mountainous terrain.

metadata.title: 明/清   張宏  桃源勝概圖   卷|Peach Blossom Spring
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A horizontal landscape painting depicting misty mountains, a wide body of water with boats, and scattered trees.
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a vast, misty landscape with mountains, water, and boats, rendered in ink and light washes of color. A wide body of water, rendered in light gray and blue washes, stretches horizontally across the middle ground, separating landmasses on either side. On the left, a rugged, dark gray mountain range rises from the water's edge, with a small, light-colored structure visible on its lower slope. Further back, a single boat with a mast and sail, rendered in light brown, floats on the calm water. Beyond this, a series of softer, blue-tinged mountains recede into a thick, light gray mist that fills the upper left quadrant. The right side of the painting features a more densely packed and jagged mountain range, rendered in darker grays and greens, with numerous small, dark green trees clustered along its lower slopes and extending into the valleys. Several small boats are moored along the shoreline at the base of these mountains. The peaks of these mountains are sharp and irregular, some appearing to pierce through the pervasive mist that weaves through the valleys and obscures the distant background. The upper central portion of the painting contains several columns of black calligraphic text. In the lower left corner, two red square seals are visible.

metadata.title: 明/清   黃向堅  萬里尋親圖 卷|Searching for My Parents
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A large, bearded man in red robes sits centrally, surrounded by many smaller figures and scenes of people and creatures below
long_description: This vertical painting depicts a complex narrative across multiple registers, dominated by a large central figure. The upper half features a light-skinned, bearded man with a dark mustache, wearing a golden crown and a red robe with green trim. Flame-like elements emanate from behind his head and shoulders. He is seated, with his hands resting on a surface, and is flanked by numerous smaller figures. These figures, mostly men, wear various colored robes in shades of red, green, blue, and brown, and some have distinct facial features like green skin or pointed ears. Some hold scrolls or writing tools. The background of the upper section includes red patterned fabric, architectural screens, and colorful banners on the right. A vertical column of black text is visible on the upper right: "常丁丑年五月日奉安于山靈閣佛前功德主 丁丑年 甲". The lower half of the painting is divided into several scenes. On the lower left, a cloud-like frame encloses three figures, two adults and a child. Below them, a procession of figures, some on white horses and others walking, moves across a green landscape. They are dressed in red, green, and blue garments, accompanied by a small white animal. In the lower right, a large, red-skinned, multi-headed figure, possibly with three stacked heads, sits prominently, adorned in green and red robes. He is surrounded by a crowd of smaller figures, many in red or green robes, some with bare chests. To the left of this seated figure, a red-skinned, horned creature with a white face and a large mouth stands amidst a group of smaller, seemingly distressed figures. Architectural elements like walls and steps are visible in the mid-ground.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A dark dragon emerges from clouds and waves on a vertical scroll with decorative borders
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a large, dark dragon against a muted brown background. The dragon's body is depicted in shades of dark gray and black, with lighter outlines highlighting its scales and features. Its head, with prominent eyes, horns, and whiskers, is positioned towards the upper left, facing right. Its powerful claws are extended, and its long, serpentine body twists downwards. Below the upper dragon, another section of a dragon or a second dragon's head emerges from a swirling mass of clouds and waves. This lower section also shows scales and a clawed limb. The clouds are rendered in lighter gray tones, creating a sense of movement and depth, while the waves at the bottom are depicted with cresting foam. The entire scene is framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark brown with a subtle gold floral pattern. The side borders are a lighter green-brown with a repeating square pattern containing small floral motifs.

metadata.title: 明  佚名  雲龍圖  軸|Dragon Amid Clouds and Waves

alt_text: A standing crowned figure with a serene expression holds a bowl, surrounded by floral motifs on a light background.
long_description: A vertical artwork depicts a standing figure against a light-colored background adorned with floral motifs. At the top, a decorative border features blue, red, and gold geometric and floral patterns. The central figure has light skin and a serene expression, with eyes gently closed and a small mouth. A golden crown with dark elements sits on the head, framed by a red and gold arch. Long earlobes are visible. The figure's bare chest is adorned with a prominent gold necklace, and red sashes drape over the shoulders and arms. The right hand is raised with fingers extended in a gesture, while the left hand holds a golden bowl. The lower body is covered by an orange skirt patterned with repeating blue and red floral designs. A dark sash is tied around the waist. The figure's feet rest upon two pink lotus blossoms. On either side of the figure, the light background is decorated with scattered pink, blue, and orange flowers and green leaves.

metadata.title: 唐/五代 菩薩圖|Banner with Bodhisattva, possibly Mahamayuri

alt_text: Two gold-leaf panels with large black calligraphic script on light rectangular paper, set against a dark background
long_description: The artwork consists of two vertical panels, each featuring a rectangular sheet of light-colored paper with black calligraphic script, set against a shimmering gold background. The gold background, likely gold leaf, displays a textured, reflective surface with visible seams or patterns. Each paper rectangle is centrally placed within its panel, leaving a wide border of gold on all sides. The calligraphy on both panels is executed in black ink with a brush, creating expressive and fluid strokes. On the left panel, multiple columns of script are visible, with characters varying in size and density. Some characters are large and bold, while others are smaller and more delicate, forming vertical lines of text. Similarly, the right panel presents several columns of black script, also exhibiting a range of character sizes and brushwork. The overall impression is one of dynamic and rhythmic writing, with the dark ink contrasting sharply against the light paper and the luminous gold surround.

metadata.title: 池大雅書   「楓橋夜泊」屏風|"Maple Bridge Night Mooring"
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a mountainous landscape with a large waterfall, a winding river, and figures gathered among trees.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting, rendered primarily in shades of brown, grey, and black ink on a light brown ground, presents a detailed landscape. In the upper left corner, multiple columns of black Chinese characters are visible, overlaid with several red seals. The upper half of the painting is dominated by a dramatic mountainous landscape, with jagged peaks rising into a lighter, misty atmosphere. A prominent waterfall cascades down from a high point on the right side of the upper-middle section, flowing into a winding river that snakes through the middle ground. The river is depicted with lighter areas for the water and darker, textured areas for rocks and banks. As the river moves towards the bottom of the painting, it widens and becomes less defined, suggesting a broader body of water or mist. In the lower right corner, a cluster of trees with slender trunks and sparse foliage is rendered in darker ink. Beneath these trees and extending to the left, several groups of small figures are seated or standing on undulating ground, appearing to be gathered. Two additional, smaller figures are visible further to the left, near the bottom edge of the painting. The artwork is framed on its left and right sides by decorative borders featuring repeating patterns of stylized floral or cloud motifs in a lighter color against a darker background.

metadata.title: 같은 해에 태어난 관리들의 친목 모임 조선|同庚契會圖 朝鮮|Gathering of government officials
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A green and yellow bird perches on a gnarled branch with pink blossoms and green leaves, with an inscription on the left
long_description: The image is a painting depicting a bird perched on a flowering branch against a light, muted yellow background. The central subject, a bird, is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing right. Its back and upper wings are olive green, while its chest and belly are pale yellow. The bird's head is a light blue-grey, and its upper wing feathers show subtle reddish-brown markings. It grips a gnarled, dark brown branch that originates from the lower left and extends horizontally across the middle of the composition. The branch is adorned with several clusters of small, light pink blossoms, each with a yellow center, and a few slender green leaves. Additional larger, broader green leaves are visible below the main branch. In the upper left corner, there is a vertical inscription in black characters, arranged in multiple columns. The visible characters read: 故園 依舊 桃李 春風 畫意 詩情 丁卯 仲春 寫於 湖上 漁莊. Below this text, a small red square seal is present. The entire painted area is bordered by a gold frame with a speckled, textured pattern.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Album leaf; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash painting depicting two goats near a gnarled tree and water, with vertical text and a red seal.
long_description: A horizontal ink wash painting on a light-colored ground is framed by a gold-colored border with a subtle patterned texture. The central focus is two goats rendered in shades of gray and black. The larger goat, positioned slightly to the right of center, faces left with its head lowered, appearing to interact with a smaller goat. The smaller goat, to the left, also has its head lowered, and their horns seem to be intertwined or touching. Both goats have shaggy fur and prominent curved horns. To the far left, a dark, gnarled tree trunk rises, its branches extending horizontally over the goats. Sparse leaves and some hanging elements are visible on the branches. Below the branches, on the left side of the trunk, vertical lines of text are present, with a small red square seal beneath them. In the background, to the right of the goats, a body of water extends across the width of the painting, indicated by faint horizontal lines. Along the water's edge, several dark, irregular shapes suggest rocks or small land formations, with sparse vegetation depicted as small clusters of dark marks. The foreground beneath the goats and tree is a lighter wash, suggesting ground, with a few small dark plant forms.

metadata.title: Untitled

metadata.medium: Album of thirty paintings; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A multi-armed, boar-headed deity sits enthroned, surrounded by worshipers, with a reclining figure below.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical drawing on light beige paper, rendered primarily in black ink with subtle washes of yellow and orange. The composition is divided into two horizontal registers. The upper register features a central, four-armed figure with a boar's head, seated cross-legged on a stylized mound. This central figure wears a crown of pointed elements and holds a small bowl in its lower two hands. Its upper right hand holds a circular object, and its upper left hand holds a conch shell. To the left of the boar-headed figure, a smaller, bird-headed figure kneels. To the far left, a standing figure with a headdress holds a large, flat, circular object. To the right of the central figure, three smaller standing figures, adorned with headdresses and draped garments, stand with hands clasped or raised in reverence. Above the boar-headed figure, a small, bushy tree-like form is depicted, with a crescent moon and a small circle above it. The background of the upper register includes stylized rolling hills, clouds, and rows of trees on both the left and right sides. At the very top center, text in an Indian script reads "श्री वराह". The lower register depicts a single, nude or lightly clothed figure reclining horizontally, facing left, with its head resting on its left arm. Its right arm extends towards the left. To the right of the reclining figure, a circular object with a grid pattern is drawn.

alt_text: A multi-armed figure riding a winged creature, attacking a prostrate figure in a monochrome line drawing.
long_description: The image is a monochrome line drawing on light-toned paper, depicting a dynamic scene within a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there are two sets of characters: "चंडामहा" and "nn३". The central composition features a multi-armed figure riding a large, winged creature that is positioned over a prostrate figure on the ground. The rider, seated on the winged creature's back, faces towards the left. This figure has at least four arms, with two raised above its head. One upper hand holds a circular shield or disc, and another holds a long, thin object resembling a sword. The figure wears a tall, ornate crown and what appears to be jewelry or adornments on its body. Its lower body is draped in flowing fabric. The winged creature, likely a mythical bird-like being, has a prominent beak, a human-like torso, and large, feathered wings extending behind its back. Its powerful, clawed feet are positioned on top of the prostrate figure below. The prostrate figure lies horizontally on the ground, mostly obscured by the winged creature, with only parts of its body visible. The drawing is executed with fine, consistent lines, and there are some faint smudges and marks on the paper, indicating its age.

alt_text: A pencil drawing depicts a large horned creature attacking smaller figures on a platform, with several onlookers to the right
long_description:
This is a monochrome pencil drawing on light-toned paper, depicting a dynamic scene with multiple figures. On the left, a large, powerful horned creature, resembling a lion or bull with a long tail, is positioned on a circular platform. It stands on its hind legs, leaning forward, with its front paws extended towards smaller figures. This creature has prominent horns, a mane, and wears a sash around its waist. Below its front paws, on the platform, are several smaller, grotesque figures with horned heads and expressive faces, some appearing to be in distress or being held by the larger creature. One figure's head is clearly visible, with large eyes and a grimacing mouth.

To the right of the platform, a group of five standing figures observes the scene. These figures also have distinct, often grotesque, facial features, including horns, beards, and wide eyes. They are depicted in various postures, some with hands clasped or raised, suggesting observation or reaction. Their bodies are slender, and they wear simple garments. The background is largely unadorned, with faint, cloud-like shapes sketched above the main figures. In the upper left corner, there is a line of text written in an unfamiliar script: "मञ्जुश्रीवज्रभैरवः ॐ ह्रीः ठः". The drawing is executed with fine lines, showing details in the figures' anatomy, clothing, and facial expressions.

alt_text: A monochrome sketch depicts numerous monkeys and human-like figures in a dense, active composition
long_description: A detailed monochrome sketch, rendered in fine lines on light-toned, aged paper, depicts a crowded and dynamic scene within a faint rectangular border. The paper shows signs of wear, particularly along its edges. In the upper left corner, outside the main border, faint text is visible, reading "नहुष नेरवा". The composition is densely populated with numerous figures, primarily monkeys and several human-like individuals. Along the top edge, a row of monkeys is depicted, some seated, others in various poses. The central area of the drawing is highly active, featuring a cluster of figures, including monkeys and human-like forms, appearing to be in motion or falling amidst swirling lines that radiate outwards, suggesting energy or a powerful force. One prominent human-like figure in the upper right appears to be reaching or gesturing towards the central activity. Other human-like figures are visible on the right side, some standing or seated. Monkeys are scattered throughout the scene, often overlapping, climbing, or interacting with each other and the human-like figures. The lower portion of the drawing is less dense, with a few monkeys positioned near the bottom border. The overall impression is one of a complex narrative or event unfolding with many participants.

alt_text: Monochrome drawing of monkey-like figures carrying large objects, with human-like figures conversing in a rocky landscape.
long_description: The monochrome drawing depicts a bustling scene filled with numerous figures, rendered in fine lines on a light brown, aged paper. In the upper right quadrant, two human-like figures are seated on the ground, one with a faint halo around their head, facing two standing figures. Behind them, a sparse forest with small structures is visible. The central and lower portions of the image are dominated by a large group of monkey-like figures. Many of these figures are actively engaged in carrying substantial, irregular objects, possibly rocks or boulders, over their heads or shoulders. They are depicted in various dynamic poses, walking, bending, and interacting with each other. Some smaller monkey-like figures are shown on all fours in the foreground. The background features large, organic rock formations and scattered trees, suggesting a rugged, natural environment. The overall composition is dense, with figures filling most of the space, conveying a sense of collective effort and movement.

alt_text: A multi-armed deity riding a tiger battles a buffalo-headed demon, surrounded by smaller figures and a mountain.
long_description: A vertical ink drawing with sparse red and green washes depicts a dynamic battle scene. In the center, a multi-armed figure, likely a deity, with a crown and multiple weapons, rides a tiger. The deity holds a bow and arrow, a sword, a trident, a shield, a mace, a discus, a conch shell, and a bell in her many hands. She is shown stabbing a large, buffalo-headed demon with a trident, causing red blood to spray from the demon's neck. The demon has a human-like body and is collapsing. Below the central figures, several smaller human-like figures and animal-like creatures (possibly lions or dogs) are engaged in the battle, some appearing wounded with red marks. One small human-like figure aims a bow and arrow, while another holds a weapon. In the upper left, two figures are seated on cloud-like forms, one on a bird and the other on a swan, appearing to shower red dots downwards. To the right, a rocky, mountainous landscape rises, topped by a structure featuring a discus and a conch shell. The entire scene is outlined in black ink, with red washes highlighting blood, clothing, and some details, and green washes indicating ground or water at the bottom.

alt_text: Pencil sketches on aged paper depicting horsemen, seated figures, and animal heads
long_description: A collection of faint pencil sketches on a light brown, aged piece of paper. The paper shows signs of discoloration, smudges, and some faint reddish-orange and yellow marks. In the upper left quadrant, a scene depicts several figures seated on a raised platform, possibly within an architectural structure. One figure is prominently seated, while others are arranged around a low, table-like object. Above this scene, faint lines suggest further architectural elements or abstract forms. In the upper right, multiple sketches of animal heads, resembling boars or pigs, are visible. One large, detailed head with tusks is prominent, with another, less defined head above it. Below the upper left scene, in the mid-left, a man on horseback is drawn, facing right. He has his left arm raised and extended forward, and the horse is depicted in a dynamic, leaping or rearing pose. Further right and slightly below, another man on horseback is shown, facing left. This rider appears more detailed, holding what might be a sword or staff, and his horse is standing. Throughout the paper, various faint lines, partial figures, and abstract marks overlap the main sketches, indicating a working or study sheet.

alt_text: A crowded, faded drawing depicts a battle scene with many figures, some riding animals, and deities
long_description: A rectangular, faded drawing on aged, light brown paper depicts a crowded battle or procession scene, outlined by a thin black border. The composition is densely packed with numerous figures, both human-like and animal-like, across the entire frame. On the far left, a multi-armed, multi-headed figure, possibly a deity, rides a large lion. Below the lion, an emaciated, standing figure with a staff is positioned next to a smaller, bare-chested figure. Faint red text, "कलिहार", is visible near the smaller figure's legs. Below them, a reddish-brown, recumbent animal, possibly a bull, lies on the ground. Moving right, another multi-armed figure rides an elephant, positioned above the recumbent animal. To the right of the elephant, a figure rides a deer-like creature. Above these mounted figures, several smaller, winged or flying figures are depicted in the upper portion of the scene. The right half of the drawing is dominated by a chaotic melee of combatants. Many figures are on foot, wielding weapons such as swords and bows. Others are mounted on horses or various animals. Some figures have blue skin, while others are depicted with pale or light skin tones. Several figures exhibit multiple heads or arms. The ground is indicated by a faint green wash along the bottom edge. Faint script, "श्री", is visible in the upper right corner. Outside the main border, in the bottom left, additional faint script, "नाम साहिब", is present.

alt_text: Crowded drawing of mythical figures, humans, and animals in a chaotic battle scene with light color washes
long_description: A horizontal drawing depicts a densely crowded and chaotic scene with numerous figures, some human-like, some animal-like, and some monstrous. The artwork is primarily rendered with thin black outlines, with sparse, light washes of yellow, blue, and reddish-brown color. On the far left, a standing figure in a yellow robe faces right, next to a seated figure wearing a crown and a candelabra-like object on its head. Behind them, a large, dark, winged or large-eared creature is visible. The central and right portions of the drawing are filled with a multitude of figures engaged in what appears to be a battle or conflict. Many figures are on horseback, some wield swords, bows, and shields. Animal figures, including horses and possibly elephants or other creatures, are interspersed throughout the crowd. Some figures have multiple arms or animal heads. The upper background on the right side features faint blue coloring, suggesting a sky or distant landscape. The overall composition is dynamic and packed with detailed, though lightly colored, forms.

alt_text: A multi-armed figure on a lion confronts a large army of human and animal-headed warriors in a line drawing.
long_description: The image is a monochrome line drawing on a light brown, rectangular sheet of paper, depicting a confrontation between a multi-armed figure and a large army. The drawing is primarily in black outline, with some figures on the left also outlined in a reddish-brown hue. On the right side of the composition, a standing, multi-armed figure is depicted atop a recumbent lion. The figure has a human-like head and torso, with at least ten arms extending from its shoulders. Each hand holds a distinct object or weapon, including an axe, a hammer, a sword, a bell, a pot, an arrow, and a bow. The figure wears a headdress and a long garment. The lion beneath it is shown in profile, facing left, with its mouth open. On the left side, a dense army of warriors advances towards the right. The army is composed of numerous figures, some appearing human and others with animal heads, such as dogs or boars. They are arranged in multiple rows, extending from the bottom left to the upper left. Many warriors carry clubs or spears. In the lower-middle left, several figures are shown riding horses and chariots, also moving towards the right. The figures in the foreground are larger and more detailed, while those in the background are smaller and less distinct. At the top center of the paper, the number "१०" is written. The paper has slightly ragged edges, particularly on the left side.

alt_text: A pencil sketch depicts a large buffalo-like creature battling a multi-armed figure on a lion and several warriors
long_description: This monochrome pencil sketch on light-colored paper depicts a dynamic scene of conflict. On the left, a large, horned, buffalo-like animal with a thick body and a curled tail faces right. Above its back, several rounded, cloud-like or rock-like shapes are drawn. Below the buffalo's front legs, several small human-like figures are shown, some appearing to be fallen or trampled on the ground. On the right, a multi-armed figure, possibly female, is seated astride a lion that faces left. The figure holds various objects, including a curved sword, a spear, and what appear to be clusters of flowers or foliage. The lion has a distinct mane and a long tail that extends to the right. In the lower center, between the large animal and the lion, several smaller human-like figures are engaged in combat. One figure, standing with a shield and a spear, aims towards the buffalo. Another figure, lower and to the right, is depicted with a bow and arrow, aiming left. Other figures are on the ground, some appearing to be in distress. Faint markings, including "१६३", are visible in the upper center of the drawing. The entire artwork is rendered in pencil lines on a light, uncolored background.

alt_text: A pencil sketch of an elephant with a rider charging towards a running man holding a spear on light brown paper.
long_description: A pencil sketch on light brown paper depicts an elephant with a rider and a running human figure. The large elephant dominates the left and center of the composition, shown in profile facing right, with its legs extended as if in a powerful stride or charge. A small figure sits atop the elephant's back, holding a stick or goad. The elephant wears a simple saddle or blanket with geometric outlines. To the right of the elephant, a smaller human figure runs in the same direction, also in profile. This figure wears minimal clothing, possibly a loincloth, and holds a long, thin object resembling a spear with a multi-pronged or star-shaped tip, pointed forward. The drawing is rendered with simple, clear pencil lines, showing no background elements.

alt_text: Two decorated elephants with riders face each other, their trunks intertwined, in a pencil sketch.
long_description: The image is a horizontal pencil sketch on light brown paper, depicting two large elephants facing each other in the center. Both elephants are adorned with elaborate harnesses and what appear to be seating structures or howdahs on their backs. Each elephant has a small rider seated on its back, holding a staff or ankus. The elephants' trunks are intertwined or touching in the central vertical axis of the drawing. Their bodies are robust and rounded, with visible details of their legs bent as if in motion or preparing for an encounter. The elephant on the left faces right, its tail curled upwards. The elephant on the right faces left, its tail also curled. The drawing is rendered with visible pencil lines, indicating a sketch or study, and the paper shows a prominent vertical crease running down the middle, separating the two elephants. The background is largely unadorned, with faint, indistinct lines suggesting a minimal setting.

alt_text: Monochrome line drawing of a seated figure adorned with snakes, a kneeling figure, a tiger, and a bull under trees
long_description: A monochrome line drawing on aged, light brown paper depicts two human figures and several animals under trees. The central and largest figure is seated on the left, facing slightly right. This figure has long, flowing hair, a serene expression, and is adorned with multiple snakes wrapped around the neck and arms, and a long beaded necklace. The figure's lower body is covered by what appears to be a tiger skin, with the tiger's head visible beneath the figure's left leg. To the right, a smaller figure kneels, facing the larger figure with hands clasped in front of the chest. This figure has long hair, a simple garment, and wears earrings and a necklace. To the far left, a small bull or cow-like animal is depicted standing. To the right of the kneeling figure, a tiger lies on the ground, facing left. The background is filled with several trees featuring dense, rounded foliage. The drawing is executed with fine black lines, and the paper shows signs of age and some discoloration, particularly in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A monochrome drawing of a bearded man on a decorated horse, holding a sword, with a striped tiger below.
long_description: The artwork is a monochrome ink drawing on light brown paper, depicting a dynamic scene with a man on horseback and a tiger. The central figure is a man, shown in profile facing left, with a dark beard and a turban. He wears a long-sleeved garment and layered, skirt-like attire. His right hand holds a curved sword, raised slightly, while his left hand holds the reins of the horse. The horse, also facing left, is depicted in motion, with its front legs raised. It is adorned with an elaborate bridle, decorative elements on its neck, and a saddle. Below the horse, a striped tiger is shown in a crouching or pouncing posture, facing left. The tiger has visible stripes, an open mouth with teeth, and its front paws are extended. The drawing uses black lines to define all figures and details, with no color fill.

alt_text: A black ink drawing of a crouching mythical creature with a lion-like body and a human-like face
long_description: The drawing, rendered in black lines on light brown paper, depicts a crouching, mythical creature in a horizontal orientation. The creature occupies the central space of the composition. Its body is robust and feline, resembling a lion, with muscular limbs. The front right paw is extended forward, while the left front paw is bent beneath its chest. The hind legs are partially visible, one tucked under the body and the other extending towards the left edge. A tail curves upwards from the creature's back, disappearing off the left side of the frame. The creature's head is positioned centrally, featuring a distinct human-like or monkey-like face. It has large, dark, almond-shaped eyes, a small, rounded nose, and a wide, smiling mouth revealing small, uniform teeth. The face is framed by a large, circular mane or collar composed of overlapping, scale-like patterns. Each scale is outlined, and many contain a small dot. Two small, ear-like protrusions are visible on either side of the head, integrated into the scaled mane. Faint, uncolored outlines of foliage or ground elements are visible beneath and around the creature, suggesting a natural setting.

alt_text: A drawing on aged paper depicts two animal heads forming a circle, a running deer, and faint text

At the top center, two animal heads, possibly lions or tigers, face each other with open mouths, forming the upper part of a large, thin-lined circle. The heads have visible eyes, noses, and textured manes or scales. Inside this circle, faint black script is visible, reading "सवा स क बी" on the top line and "सु ५" on the bottom line. To the upper left of the circle, a faint outline of a striped animal's hindquarters and tail is partially visible. To the upper right, a faint outline of a plant with leaves and a flower is drawn. In the lower half of the paper, a black deer with white markings on its belly and legs is depicted in a running pose, facing right. It has long, curved horns. The ground beneath the deer is indicated by a faint, irregular line. The paper itself shows signs of age, with a torn edge on the lower left and various smudges and discolorations throughout.

alt_text: A central bell-shaped object with leaf patterns, surrounded by various floral designs and a decorative border
long_description: The artwork is a black ink drawing on a light brown, textured paper, depicting a central decorative object surrounded by floral motifs and a border. The central element is a large, bell-shaped form, wider at the base and tapering towards a narrow, fluted neck at the top. The neck features a band of vertical lines and a chevron pattern. The main body of the bell is adorned with numerous vertical lines, each containing a small, elongated leaf shape pointing downwards. Below the bell, a horizontal band displays a repeating pattern of small, pointed arches. Around this central form, several individual floral designs are arranged. In the upper left, a stylized flower with multiple petals is framed by swirling leaf-like tendrils. Directly below it, a tall stem with serrated leaves supports a large, multi-petaled flower. On the upper right, two smaller, simpler flowers with short stems are depicted. Below these, a taller stem with three flowers and multiple pairs of leaves extends downwards. A faint, handwritten number "43" is visible in the upper right corner, next to one of the floral motifs. Across the entire bottom of the composition, a wide horizontal border features a continuous vine-like pattern with stylized flowers and leaves.

alt_text: A figure in a palace setting with architectural details and a bed, rendered in outline with color washes
long_description: This vertical rectangular artwork on light brown paper features a scene rendered primarily in outline with sparse watercolor washes. A thin, dark border frames the composition. The upper half depicts an elaborate architectural setting under a pale sky. In the top left, a yellow, sun-like shape with radiating lines is visible. Below it, a structure with a domed roof and an open archway is outlined. To the right, a multi-story building with several balconies, arches, and a domed roof dominates the upper right. This building shows faint washes of pink and grey. The lower half of the image features a central figure and a large, ornate bed. The figure, positioned in the lower left, faces right and wears a crown or turban and a long robe. The robe has distinct patches of green, orange, and white. The figure's face shows a light blue wash. The figure appears to be gesturing towards or interacting with a large, multi-tiered bed or platform that occupies the right side of the lower section. This bed structure is adorned with washes of pink, orange, yellow, and green. A smaller, faint figure is visible on the far right, near the bed. The ground is indicated by faint horizontal and vertical lines. The overall impression is that of a detailed architectural drawing with figures, partially colored with translucent watercolors.

alt_text: A monochrome line drawing depicts a crowded battle scene with multi-armed figures, animals, and fallen combatants.
long_description: A monochrome line drawing on light brown, aged paper depicts a dynamic and crowded battle scene. The composition is filled with numerous figures, both human-like and animal-like, engaged in conflict. In the upper center, a multi-armed figure with a headdress holds a sword, bow, shield, and other weapons, appearing to strike towards the right. Directly opposite, a large, elephant-headed figure with multiple arms, also holding a weapon, recoils or fights back. Below these central figures, an emaciated, long-haired figure is positioned horizontally, seemingly involved in the struggle, while another figure lies fallen on the ground in the lower right. To the left, a group of figures is depicted, some seated on various animals including a bull, dog-like creatures, and a large bird. One figure on the left has multiple heads, and another has multiple heads and arms, seated on a bird. Other human-like figures stand or ride alongside. The entire scene is framed by a simple double-line border. Faint, unidentifiable markings are visible in the upper right corner of the drawing.

alt_text: A monochrome drawing depicts a man on horseback, two seated figures conversing, trees, and a distant crowd.
long_description: This monochrome drawing, rendered in red-brown lines on a light-colored paper, depicts a scene set in a natural landscape. The composition is framed by a thin border. In the far background on the left, a dense crowd of figures, some holding spears or flags, appears on a rolling hill, with a small structure visible at the hill's peak. To their right, several trees with rounded canopies and distinct trunks are scattered across the midground, interspersed with more hills. On the far right background, a large, dark, cave-like opening or rock formation is visible. In the foreground, from left to right, a man on horseback is positioned on the left, facing towards the right. He wears a turban and robes. The horse is depicted with a bridle and saddle. Below the horse, a small, four-legged animal, possibly a dog, is visible. To the right of the horseman, two figures are seated on the ground under a tree. The figure on the left, appearing younger, wears a turban and has hands open as if in conversation. Opposite him, the figure on the right, appearing older with a beard, is seated cross-legged in simple robes, with a small bowl placed on the ground in front of him. Further to the right, near the large rock formation, two smaller figures are seated on the ground, facing towards the central seated pair. They also wear simple attire. The ground throughout the scene is uneven, with subtle indications of rocks and mounds.

alt_text: A drawing of a procession of figures above a scene with a large sea serpent and a person in water.
long_description: The drawing, rendered in brown ink on light brown, aged paper, presents two distinct horizontal scenes. In the upper register, a procession of approximately eight to ten figures moves from left to right. These figures are depicted in profile or three-quarter view, wearing long, flowing garments. The leftmost figure appears to be kneeling or bending over a large, round object, possibly a drum. Following this, several figures walk in a line, one carrying a stringed instrument resembling a lute or guitar on their back. The leading figure on the right extends their right arm forward, holding a small, indistinct object. The figures are drawn with simple outlines, showing minimal facial features or details. The lower register depicts a scene in water with two large serpentine creatures and a human figure. On the left, a large, coiled serpent-like creature emerges from the water. Its head is adorned with numerous wavy, tentacle-like or frilly appendages. A human figure, appearing to struggle, is partially submerged in the water next to the serpent's body, with arms outstretched. To the right, another large, coiled serpentine form is partially visible, rising from the water, with a textured or scaled pattern on its body. The water is indicated by horizontal lines. The overall drawing has a sketch-like quality with some visible pencil underdrawings and smudges on the paper.

alt_text: A monochrome line drawing depicts a walled palace with figures, horses, and a person looking up in the foreground.
long_description: This monochrome line drawing, rendered in dark lines on light brown paper, depicts a bustling scene outside a large walled structure. At the top, a grand palace or fort wall stretches across the image, featuring multiple domes, turrets, and an ornate arched gateway at its center. Figures are visible on a balcony above the gateway and within the archway itself. In the mid-ground, directly in front of the gateway, a raised platform is occupied by several small figures. To the left of the platform, a group of figures stands, some mounted on horses. Further to the left, a tall, robed figure stands beside a small animal. To the right of the central platform, another cluster of figures is depicted. On the far right, a series of five arched shapes are drawn, possibly representing clouds or distant hills. The foreground is largely open, with a single draped figure positioned in the bottom right corner, looking upwards and to the left. Faint, low arched outlines are visible along the very bottom edge of the drawing. The number "११" is inscribed at the top center of the image.

alt_text: Monochrome profile portrait of a person wearing a turban, elaborate jewelry, and patterned clothing, facing right
long_description: A monochrome drawing depicts a person in profile, facing towards the right side of the frame. The subject's head and upper torso are visible, rendered in fine lines and shading on a light, aged paper background. The person wears a tall, turban-like head covering adorned with decorative elements, including a central floral motif and a patterned band. Long, wavy hair cascades from beneath the turban, extending down the back of the neck. The face features a prominent eye with a defined brow, a long nose with a small ring, and full lips. An elaborate earring, composed of multiple small shapes, hangs from the ear. Around the neck are several strands of necklaces, some appearing as strings of beads, others as flat, linked elements. A large pendant, shaped like a cluster of teardrops, hangs from one of the necklaces. The visible garment is patterned with small dots and larger paisley-like shapes. The person's right hand is raised to chest level, with fingers slightly curled and adorned with rings. A bracelet is visible on the wrist. The bottom of the image features a horizontal band, resembling a plinth or a decorative base, with vertical lines at its ends.

alt_text: Profile portrait of a person in a turban, holding a small rectangular object, rendered in monochrome.
long_description: A monochrome drawing on light brown paper depicts a person in profile, facing left, from the chest up. The figure has a prominent, almond-shaped eye with a dark pupil, a straight nose, and full lips. A large, intricately patterned turban covers their head, adorned with a jewel featuring three oval shapes at the front. A single, stylized curl of hair extends from behind the ear. The person wears multiple strands of beaded necklaces and a patterned garment with diamond shapes. The right hand, with a ring on the index finger, holds a small, light-colored rectangular object near the chin. A bracelet is visible on the wrist. The figure rests on a low, rectangular base with decorative, spherical elements at each end. The drawing uses fine lines and subtle shading to define forms and textures.

alt_text: A cow, a kneeling woman, and a seated man under a tree and stylized mountains, drawn in black ink.
long_description: The image is a black ink drawing on light brown, aged paper, depicting three figures and natural elements. In the lower left, a cow lies on the ground, facing right, with its head slightly raised and two small horns visible. To its right, a woman kneels on her left knee, with her right leg bent, facing right. She wears an earring, a necklace, and bangles on her arms. Her hands are extended forward, holding a small, flat, circular object towards the man. To the woman's right, a man sits cross-legged, facing left, with his head bowed and eyes looking down. He appears bare-chested, wearing a simple garment around his waist and possibly a necklace. Both human figures have their hair pulled back. Above and behind the figures, a large, stylized tree with rounded foliage and branches extends from the upper left. To the right of the tree and behind the figures are several tall, rounded, stylized forms resembling mountains or rocks. In the upper right corner, black text reads "राग भैरव ॥१". The ground is indicated by simple horizontal lines.

alt_text: Reddish-brown ink sketch of a central standing figure surrounded by other figures within an oval frame
long_description: A reddish-brown ink sketch on light-colored paper depicts multiple figures enclosed within an oval frame. In the lower-center, a standing figure, likely a woman, faces right, draped in long, flowing garments. To her left, two figures are partially visible, also facing right towards the central figure. On the lower-right, three figures, possibly women, are grouped together, looking towards the central figure. In the upper-right, within a rectangular opening resembling a window, two figures are visible, one with a prominent, ornate headdress. The background features faint, lightly sketched outlines of what appear to be hills or distant structures in the upper-left. The entire composition is rendered with thin, reddish-brown lines, suggesting an underdrawing or preliminary sketch. The paper shows some light discoloration and faint smudges. In the top-left corner, the numbers "२२" are written, and in the top-right, "१४८" is visible.

alt_text: Three figures in draped garments, one reclining, one kneeling, one standing, on an aged paper drawing
long_description: The image is a drawing on a light brown, aged paper, depicting three figures within a rectangular frame. The figures are rendered with black outlines and minimal, faded color washes. On the left, a figure reclines or sits on a raised platform, covered in a blue-grey drapery that conceals most of their form, with their head bowed. In the center, another figure kneels or bends forward, facing the reclining figure, dressed in a brown-gold draped garment. To the right, a third figure stands upright, also facing the other two, wearing a light red-orange draped garment. Faint, uncolored outlines of what appear to be two small vessels are visible on the ground in front of the raised platform. The background is largely unadorned, with a faint vertical line on the right suggesting a wall. At the top of the paper, above the main scene, there is a horizontal band of faded brown-green wash and several lines of faint, handwritten script. The overall impression is that of an unfinished sketch or study.
