alt_text: A drawing of a multi-armed deity, an elephant, and a group of people with a hookah
long_description:
This is a black ink drawing on light brown, textured paper, featuring two horizontal scenes. A prominent horizontal crease runs across the middle of the paper.

The upper scene depicts two figures. On the left, a multi-armed, elephant-headed figure sits cross-legged, facing forward. This figure has four arms: the upper left hand holds a bowl of small round objects, the lower left hand holds a bow, the upper right hand holds a string of beads, and the lower right hand rests on its lap. It wears a crown adorned with leafy elements, necklaces, armbands, and a patterned garment. To the right, a large elephant walks towards the left, its trunk curled upwards. It is decorated with a necklace and a saddle-like covering on its back.

The lower scene shows a group of three human figures and a hookah. From left to right, a woman stands facing right, wearing a long dress and jewelry, with her right hand extended. Next to her, a man stands facing right, wearing a dhoti and a shawl, with both hands extended forward, palms up. In the center, a tall, slender hookah with a conical base and a cup-like top stands between the standing man and a seated man. The seated man, with a mustache and beard, sits on a patterned cushion or platform, facing left. He holds a long pipe from the hookah to his mouth. To his right, a smaller figure stands, holding a leafy branch or flower over the seated man's head. All figures are rendered with thin black lines.

alt_text: A man in profile stands before a pedestal with footprints, with hills and text in the background.
long_description: The monochrome drawing depicts a male figure standing in profile, facing left, within a rectangular border. The figure is positioned slightly to the right of the center. He wears a turban, a long robe, and a sash around his waist. His hands are pressed together in front of his chest in a gesture of reverence. He has a beard and a mustache. To the left of the figure is a rectangular pedestal, on top of which are two distinct footprints. In the upper background, undulating lines suggest a landscape of hills or mountains. Above the figure's head and to the right of the pedestal, some text is visible, reading "भगतसेना". The overall drawing is done in fine lines on a light-colored, aged paper.

alt_text: Line drawing of a saddled horse standing in profile on a light brown paper
long_description: The image presents a line drawing of a horse, rendered in profile and facing left, centered on a rectangular piece of light brown paper. The horse's body is outlined with thin, dark lines, depicting a slender and well-proportioned form. Its head is held high, featuring a detailed bridle with straps around its muzzle and behind its ears. A long, flowing mane extends from its neck, and a full tail hangs down, both delineated with multiple parallel lines. A saddle is positioned on the horse's back, characterized by a raised pommel and cantle. The saddle is elaborately decorated with a circular motif on its side and multiple tassels hanging from its lower edge. Additional decorative elements, possibly part of a saddle blanket or harness, drape over the horse's hindquarters, also ending in tassels. The horse stands on all four slender legs, with clearly defined hooves. The background is the plain, textured light brown paper, which shows some faint smudges and discoloration, particularly around the horse's neck and upper back. A small, faint blue mark is visible in the upper right corner of the paper.

alt_text: A nude male and a robed female stand in a landscape with trees and a wavy ground line.
long_description: The image is an unfinished drawing on light brown paper, depicting two figures in a natural setting. A faint rectangular border frames the central scene. On the left, a male figure stands facing right, with his body angled slightly towards the viewer. He is mostly nude, with a cloth or sash around his waist, and wears a necklace. His left arm is bent, holding an object that resembles a snake or vine, while his right arm is extended towards the female figure. He has a gentle expression with a slight smile. On the right, a female figure stands facing left, looking towards the male. She wears a long, flowing garment, possibly a sari, with a light pink hue visible on the skirt. A long braid or sash extends from her head down to the ground, where it intertwines with a wavy, snake-like form. She wears a garland around her neck. Behind and between the figures, several trees with outlined leafy canopies fill the background. In the upper left corner, a few grey, cloud-like shapes are visible. The ground beneath the figures is marked by several wavy lines, suggesting water or uneven terrain, with a snake-like form near the female's feet. The drawing is primarily in outline, with minimal color applied.

alt_text: Pencil sketch of a multi-level palace scene with a woman praying and two seated figures
long_description:
The image is a monochrome drawing, rendered in fine lines on light-toned paper, depicting a complex architectural scene with multiple figures. The composition is contained within an oval outline, though the paper itself is rectangular. In the background, a sprawling city or palace complex is visible, characterized by numerous domes, arched structures, and tall, slender spires, all drawn in outline.

In the midground on the left, a female figure stands on a balcony or terrace, facing towards the right. She is depicted in a long, flowing garment and a head covering, with her hands clasped together in front of her chest. Below her, the architecture features multiple arched openings and a railing. To the right, within what appears to be an interior room, two figures are seated. The figure on the far right is seated on a raised platform or bed, wearing an elaborate headpiece resembling a crown and a draped garment. To their left, a second figure is also seated, facing the crowned figure. The room has a large, open archway or window on its right side, looking out. The entire drawing is executed with delicate, precise lines, showing preliminary details and outlines without color.

alt_text: A horizontal frieze drawing depicts a dense arrangement of human figures, animals, and elaborate foliage in a continuous pattern.
long_description: The image displays a long, horizontal rectangular drawing rendered in monochrome, likely ink on light brown paper. The central panel is filled with a dense and intricate composition of intertwined human-like figures, various animals, and elaborate botanical motifs. The drawing exhibits a horror vacui effect, with almost every space filled by detailed elements. On the far left, a winged, human-torsoed figure with a head emerges from a large, stylized flower, its arms outstretched. Moving right, the composition unfolds into a complex tangle of forms. Several human-like figures, some appearing cherubic and others more adult, are depicted in dynamic poses, often interacting with the surrounding elements. Some figures possess animalistic features or are presented in hybrid forms. Interspersed throughout the dense foliage are various animals, including what appear to be lions, deer, and other fantastical creatures. The botanical elements consist of large, curling leaves, numerous stylized flowers, and swirling tendrils that form a continuous, organic pattern across the entire length of the panel. The drawing is characterized by fine lines and subtle shading, which contribute to the texture and depth of the intricate design. The central decorated panel is enclosed by a thin border line, and the surrounding paper is a lighter, plain tone, showing minor signs of age and slight damage along its edges.

alt_text: Three women in traditional attire, one fanning, one applying oil, and one reclining on a plain background
long_description: This artwork depicts three women on a plain, light-colored background. The composition is arranged diagonally, with one woman reclining in the center, attended by two others. On the left, a woman is positioned facing right, holding a yellow and red fan with a dark handle in her right hand, pointing it towards the reclining figure. She wears a white garment with red outlines and gold trim, along with earrings, a nose ring, and bangles. Her dark hair is pulled back, and her eyes are open. In the center, a woman reclines on her back, her head tilted to the left, looking upwards. Her long, dark hair flows downwards and to the left. She is dressed in a similar white garment with red and gold accents, adorned with a necklace, earrings, and bangles. Her arms are bent, and her hands are visible. To the right, a third woman stands, facing left, positioned behind the reclining figure's head. She holds a small, dark object in her left hand, while her right hand is near the reclining woman's hair, appearing to apply something. She also wears a white garment with red and gold trim, earrings, and bangles. Her dark hair is visible beneath a head covering. The background is an unadorned off-white, showing some faint creases.

alt_text: Grid of small pencil sketches depicting multiple scenes with figures, buildings, and chariots on light paper
long_description: This artwork is a grid of twelve small, detailed line drawings rendered in pencil or ink on a light-colored sheet of paper. The grid is arranged in four rows and three columns, with some slight irregularities in the top and bottom edges of the paper. Each rectangular panel depicts a distinct scene, populated by numerous human figures. The figures are shown in various activities and settings, including indoor scenes with seated groups, and outdoor scenes featuring figures on horseback or riding in chariots pulled by horses. Architectural elements such as buildings, walls, and doorways are visible in many of the panels, providing context for the scenes. The style is illustrative, with clear outlines and minimal shading, focusing on narrative detail. Small numbers and short lines of text, in an unfamiliar script, are present within several of the individual panels, often near the top or center of the scene. The overall composition suggests a sequential narrative or a series of related events.

alt_text: Two men in light garments stand facing each other, one gesturing, the other holding a small hammer
long_description: Two men stand facing each other on a light brown paper. The man on the left wears a light-colored, long-sleeved tunic and a matching long skirt-like garment that reaches his ankles. He has a green turban on his head and a mustache. His right hand is raised, palm open, as if in conversation, while his left hand hangs at his side. He is barefoot. The man on the right also wears a light-colored, long-sleeved tunic and a matching long skirt-like garment. His tunic appears to be open or tied at the back, revealing a portion of his back. He wears a dark cap on his head and has a mustache. He holds a small hammer with a dark head and a light handle in his right hand, pointing it slightly upwards. His left hand hangs at his side. He is barefoot. Both figures have light skin tones. The background is a plain, light tan color. Black script is visible across the top edge of the paper, above the figures. The script reads: "नरावाः श्रीमनमोहनजीकैफराका भोगवाल".

alt_text: A pencil sketch depicts two figures standing on a large lotus blossom, surrounded by trees and plants.
long_description: A monochrome pencil sketch on light brown paper depicts two figures standing on a large lotus blossom, surrounded by natural elements. The central composition features a taller figure on the left and a slightly shorter figure on the right, both facing each other. The figure on the left wears an elaborate headdress and a long, flowing garment, with their right arm extended towards the other figure. The figure on the right has hair pulled back and a halo-like circle behind their head, wearing a long skirt or dress. Their left arm is raised, reaching towards a branch of a tree, while their right arm is bent near their chest. Both figures stand barefoot on a large, multi-layered lotus blossom, drawn with distinct petals forming an oval base. Behind and around the figures, various plants and trees are sketched, including a prominent tree with numerous leaves directly above and between them. Additional foliage, possibly indicating smaller plants or bushes, fills the foreground and background, suggesting a lush outdoor setting. The drawing is rendered entirely in line work and light shading, without color.

alt_text: Detailed architectural drawing of a domed interior with multiple arched windows and a central octagonal enclosure.
long_description: This detailed architectural drawing depicts the interior of a grand, domed structure, rendered primarily in light brown, beige, and white tones with subtle red accents. The view is from a slightly elevated perspective, looking down into the central space. A large, hemispherical dome dominates the upper portion, covered in a repeating pattern of small, interlocking geometric shapes outlined in light gray. At the dome's apex, a circular motif features radiating lines and small red teardrop-like elements. Below the dome, a continuous band of large arched openings encircles the upper wall. These arches are framed by light-colored architectural elements and each contains a rectangular window with horizontal slats, suggesting a screen. Further down, a second tier of smaller arched openings is visible, also featuring screened windows or decorative panels. These lower arches are separated by panels adorned with delicate floral motifs in red and green. The floor and lower walls are covered in a repeating geometric pattern of interlocking stars and polygons. In the center of the space, an octagonal enclosure with a low, intricately patterned railing is depicted. Inside this enclosure, two rectangular, pillar-like structures, possibly cenotaphs, stand prominently, also decorated with geometric designs and architectural details. The drawing employs fine lines and subtle washes to convey depth and intricate ornamentation.

alt_text: A horizontal sheet of light brown paper featuring multiple ink sketches of human heads in profile, some with facial hair
long_description: A horizontal rectangular sheet of light brown, textured paper features numerous ink sketches of human heads in profile, varying in detail and completeness. The paper itself shows visible fibers and scattered splotches of red, yellow, and purple pigment, particularly on the right side. The heads are arranged primarily in two rows, with additional smaller, fainter sketches interspersed. In the top row, from left to right, are several heads in profile facing right. The first has a small topknot and a mustache. The second has a prominent black mustache and beard with a dark, receding hairline. The third is a bald head with a small ear. The fourth has a small topknot and a small earring. The fifth has a mustache and a topknot. Following these, a small, framed sketch depicts a figure with raised arms. Next is another head in profile with a prominent chin and a small topknot, followed by a very small, faint sketch of a head at the far right. The bottom row, from left to right, begins with a head in profile facing right, featuring a mustache, a small topknot, and a visible shoulder line. Next is a smaller, fainter sketch of two heads facing each other. This is followed by a head in profile facing right, with a dark mustache and beard and a receding hairline. A small, faint sketch of a seated figure appears next, followed by a head in profile facing right with a small earring and a topknot. The right side of the bottom row is mostly blank, showing only the paper texture and color splotches.

alt_text: Architectural drawing of a domed structure with an arched opening and a detailed, multi-tiered base.
long_description: A monochrome architectural drawing depicts a symmetrical, ornate structure on aged, light brown paper. The structure features a large central dome topped with a finial, flanked by smaller decorative elements. Below the dome, a wide, flat roofline extends outwards, supported by an elaborate arched opening. The arch is adorned with intricate floral or geometric patterns and is supported by two slender, fluted columns. The base of the structure is substantial and multi-tiered, composed of rectangular panels, decorative moldings, and a low, central platform. The drawing is rendered with thin, precise black lines, indicating a technical or design drawing. The paper itself shows signs of age, with visible creases, smudges, and small dark spots, particularly in the central area, and its edges are uneven and torn.

alt_text: A man on a rearing horse holds a spear, surrounded by figures and an animal in a dynamic scene
long_description: A monochrome drawing on light-colored paper depicts a dynamic scene centered around a man on horseback. The man, with a beard and wearing a helmet and armor, sits upright on a rearing horse. He holds a long, slender spear vertically in his right hand, with his left hand raised. The horse is highly decorated with intricate patterns on its bridle, saddle, and a large, ornate blanket covering its back. Below the horse's raised front legs, a smaller figure is shown in a crouched or fallen position, holding a small, curved weapon. To the left of this figure, a large animal, possibly a bull or buffalo, is depicted with its head lowered, appearing to be in motion or struggle. Another figure lies prone on the ground in the lower right corner of the composition. In the upper right, faint, unfinished sketches of two additional figures are visible: one lying horizontally and another showing a head and torso. The drawing is rendered in fine lines, with some areas showing minimal shading.

alt_text: A partially colored drawing of a seated man with a dark beard and pink turban, gesturing with his right hand.
long_description:
The artwork depicts a seated man, rendered in a combination of pencil sketch and color, on a light brown, aged paper. The man is positioned facing towards the left side of the frame, with his torso angled slightly forward. His head is fully colored, featuring a dark, pointed beard and a dark mustache. His face is depicted with a light green skin tone. He wears a vibrant pink turban, wrapped around his head, with a thin yellow band visible at the front and a black, plume-like ornament rising from the top. A small, gold-colored earring hangs from his right ear.

His upper body is clad in a long-sleeved white garment, possibly a jama, with some faint red or pink lines indicating folds or decorative elements around the chest and waist. His right arm is raised, bent at the elbow, with his hand open and fingers slightly spread, as if in a gesture of speaking or greeting. His left arm is bent, resting on his lap or the seat. The lower half of his body, including his legs and the seat he occupies, is rendered primarily in pencil outline, showing the form of loose-fitting trousers and a simple, four-legged stool or chair. The background is a plain, unadorned light brown, consistent with the paper's color, with some minor smudges and discoloration visible.

alt_text: Monochrome drawing of a large battle or procession with numerous figures on horseback, a village, and a temple.
long_description: This monochrome drawing, rendered in ink on light-toned paper, depicts a sprawling, complex scene filled with numerous figures. The composition is horizontally oriented. In the upper left quadrant, a small village is visible, consisting of several simple, rectangular buildings with peaked roofs. Above and to the right of the village, a larger, multi-tiered structure with a prominent spire, resembling a temple, stands on a raised area. Stylized cloud formations frame the top edge of the drawing. The central and right portions of the image are dominated by large groups of figures, many of whom are mounted on horses. These groups appear to be in motion, forming a procession or engaging in a battle. Figures on horseback are depicted with varying postures, some holding spears or banners. Interspersed among the mounted figures are smaller groups of figures on foot, some appearing to be fallen or lying on the ground. A horizontal band, possibly representing a river or a path, traverses the middle of the drawing, separating some of the groups. The drawing is executed with fine, unshaded lines, creating a detailed yet flat representation. Visible creases run vertically and horizontally across the paper.

alt_text: A red chalk sketch depicts a horse-drawn carriage with multiple horses and riders, moving right.
long_description: The artwork is a red chalk drawing on a light brown, rectangular piece of paper, depicting a horse-drawn carriage in profile, moving from left to right. On the left, three horses are shown in a dynamic pose, with their legs lifted as if galloping. Each horse is ridden by a figure, who appears to be wearing a turban or cap. The horses are harnessed together, pulling a large, ornate carriage on the right. The carriage has two large, spoked wheels and a prominent domed roof topped with a finial. The sides of the carriage appear open or have large windows, revealing several figures seated inside. Additional figures are visible on the exterior of the carriage, one near the front and another at the back. The drawing is rendered with clear, continuous red lines, showing the outlines of the figures, horses, and carriage, with minimal internal detail or shading. The background is plain.

alt_text: A monochrome drawing depicts a bustling town with numerous buildings, crowds of people, horses, and elephants.
long_description: This monochrome drawing, rendered in fine lines on light-toned paper, presents a complex, multi-layered scene of a bustling town or city. The composition is divided into several sections, filled with architectural structures, human figures, and animals. In the upper left quadrant, a circular enclosure contains several small figures and a building with a domed roof. Surrounding this enclosure are numerous horses, some with riders, and several elephants. More small figures are scattered throughout this area. The upper right quadrant features a large, dense crowd of small, circular-headed figures forming a semi-circle around a central, multi-tiered structure, possibly a float or a temple, which also has figures on it. Below this main crowd, more figures and animals, including horses and an elephant, are visible. The number "43" is written in the top right corner. The middle section of the drawing is dominated by rows of simple, rectangular buildings with flat roofs, resembling houses. In the center, a larger, more elaborate building with multiple domed roofs and an arched entrance stands out, suggesting a palace or a significant public structure. Figures are depicted near and within the entrance of this central building. To the left of this central building, near a smaller house, the text "गगगदेव" is visible. The bottom section mirrors some elements from the top, featuring more scattered figures, horses, and elephants. Two additional circular enclosures, each containing a small structure and figures, are positioned in the lower left and lower right corners, respectively. The entire drawing is filled with intricate details, creating a sense of lively activity across the depicted landscape.

alt_text: A black and white drawing of a large procession with elephants, horses, and many people
long_description: A detailed black and white ink drawing depicts a grand procession moving from left to right across the lower two-thirds of the horizontal composition. The upper third of the paper is blank. On the far left, a large elephant with a decorated saddle carries a rider, followed by several horses with riders and numerous foot soldiers. The central area is densely packed with rows of marching foot soldiers, all wearing turbans and carrying staffs or spears. Above them, more horses with riders are visible. On the right side, two large elephants face left, each bearing an elaborate howdah on its back. These howdahs contain multiple figures, some with turbans and beards, holding banners or weapons. One elephant's howdah is topped with a large, ornate canopy. Below and around these central elephants, more horses with riders and foot soldiers fill the space, creating a sense of a vast, organized movement. The figures are rendered with fine lines, showing details in their clothing, facial features, and the animals' decorations.

alt_text: A long, horizontal drawing shows tigers hunting deer in a landscape of dense grass and rolling hills.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal, monochromatic drawing depicting a dynamic hunting scene. The composition is filled with dense, tall vegetation, resembling grass or reeds, which covers most of the ground. Several animals are distributed across the length of the drawing. On the far left, a large tiger is positioned low, seemingly stalking, with its head turned towards the right. Above it, another tiger is partially obscured by vegetation. To the right of these, a deer with prominent antlers is depicted running through the tall grass. Further right, a large, recumbent animal, possibly a boar or another deer, is partially visible amidst the foliage. In the central section, the terrain rises into gentle mounds. A small, agile animal, possibly a young deer or a hare, runs over one of these mounds. Above it, another tiger is shown in mid-leap or running through the upper part of the vegetation. Towards the right side of the drawing, more tigers are visible. One tiger is depicted leaping downwards from a higher point, its body stretched. Below it, another tiger is low to the ground, possibly pursuing prey. Scattered throughout the scene are various types of vegetation, including some with distinct, feathery leaves, and others represented by simple vertical strokes. The overall impression is one of movement and pursuit within a wild, natural landscape. The drawing is executed with fine lines, suggesting pencil or ink on paper.

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire, one supporting the other, in a detailed monochrome line drawing
long_description: The image is a monochrome line drawing on light-colored, aged paper. It depicts two women, rendered with fine, delicate lines, standing in close proximity. The woman on the left is slightly taller and appears to be supporting the woman on the right. She wears a long, flowing skirt (ghagra) and a veil (dupatta) draped over her head and shoulders, extending down her back. Her left arm is gently wrapped around the waist of the other woman, while her right hand delicately touches the other woman's neck or upper chest. Her face is in profile, looking towards the other woman, with a serene expression. She is adorned with earrings, a nose ring, multiple necklaces, bangles on her wrists, and armlets. Her hair is pulled back. The woman on the right leans into the first woman, her head tilted back and eyes downcast or closed. She also wears a long skirt and a veil, which is draped over her head and shoulders. Her left arm is bent, with her hand holding a small, indistinct object near her waist. Her right arm is extended outwards, with her hand open, holding another small, indistinct object. She is heavily adorned with multiple necklaces, earrings, a nose ring, and bangles. Her bare feet are visible at the bottom, showing anklets. Both figures are drawn with intricate details, highlighting the folds of their clothing and their elaborate jewelry. The background is plain, light-colored paper, showing some minor smudges and discoloration, particularly in the upper right and lower right corners. The overall composition is vertical, with the figures occupying the central space of the artwork.

alt_text: A detailed map-like drawing of a temple complex with deities, worshippers, a large cow, and a river
long_description: The artwork is a hand-drawn, map-like illustration on a light-colored, possibly aged, paper. The primary colors used are black ink for outlines and details, with washes of light blue and green for landscape elements. The central and largest feature is a rectangular temple complex, depicted from an aerial perspective. Within the main temple enclosure, a prominent black, cylindrical object, likely a lingam, stands on a base at the center. To its left, a large, white, recumbent cow, outlined in black, faces right. Numerous human figures, also outlined in black, are positioned around the lingam and the cow, some standing with hands clasped, others kneeling or seated. Above the lingam, within the temple structure, are several smaller shrines. One on the left contains a multi-armed deity figure, with the text "पद्मावती देवी" written above it. To the right of the lingam, another shrine has the text "श्रीकाशीविश्वेश्वर मेरु". The temple complex features a large, multi-storied arched gateway at its bottom, with small figures walking near it. Outside the main temple walls, to the left and right, are areas colored in green, suggesting land or vegetation. Above the temple complex, a light blue area represents water or sky, with small figures and trees, and the text "चन्द्रकीश्वर" visible. Below the temple, a larger light blue area depicts a body of water, with a cluster of small, simple houses on its left bank. To the far right, a vertical column of twenty-four circular shapes is drawn, with the text "यक्षराक्षस" appearing above and below this column. The entire scene is enclosed by an irregular, wavy border.

alt_text: Pencil drawing of an elephant interacting with two scaled, dragon-like creatures under a flowering tree
long_description: A pencil drawing on light-toned paper depicts a large elephant under a flowering tree, interacting with multiple scaled, dragon-like creatures. The elephant, positioned centrally, faces right with its body in a recumbent or kneeling posture. Its trunk is raised and curled upwards, and it has large ears and a decorative line around its neck. Above and to the left of the elephant, a tree with a slender trunk branches out, displaying several large, simple five-petaled flowers and leaves. A prominent scaled creature, resembling a fish or dragon, rests on the elephant's back, its head near the elephant's raised trunk. This creature has a long, textured body with visible scales and small limbs. Another smaller, similar creature is situated near the elephant's front left leg. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, a third dragon-like head with an open mouth and horns is visible, seemingly detached from a body. The drawing is composed of clear, dark lines against the lighter paper.

alt_text: Faded diagram on paper showing a grid of figures, animals, and structures with sparse color dots.
long_description: A faded, light brown paper diagram is divided into a grid-like composition with a large central area and smaller rectangular compartments along the left, top, and right edges. The paper shows visible creases and discoloration, particularly in the center. The central area contains faint line drawings of multiple human-like figures in various poses, some appearing to be seated or reclining, with swirling lines suggesting movement or drapery. Small, irregularly placed dots of red, yellow, and blue pigment are scattered across this central section. Along the left, top, and right borders, a series of small, vertically stacked rectangular compartments are visible. Each compartment typically frames a single seated figure, often with a halo or elaborate headwear, rendered in faint outline. These border compartments also contain small, sparse dots of red, yellow, and blue. Faint, unreadable text appears above or below some of these figures. The bottom section of the diagram features horizontal rows. The uppermost of these rows depicts several structures resembling temples or buildings with domed roofs, also with scattered small color dots. Below this, a row shows multiple four-legged animals, possibly cows or bulls, standing in profile, facing both left and right. The very bottom edge of the paper has a decorative border composed of small, stylized, petal-like shapes.

alt_text: A seated man with a beard and turban holds a sword, wearing traditional attire, on a chair with animal carvings.
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting on light-colored paper, depicting a single figure. The figure is a man, shown from the waist up, seated in profile facing left. He has dark hair and a dark, pointed beard. He wears a light green turban adorned with a jeweled ornament and a black plume. His skin is light-toned. He wears a long, light-colored garment, possibly white or very pale green, with long sleeves. Around his neck are multiple necklaces, one appearing to be a string of pearls, and another a gold-colored pendant. A yellow sash crosses his chest from his right shoulder to his left hip. He holds a sword with a pink-purple blade and a gold-colored hilt, resting it across his lap with his right hand. His left arm is bent, with his hand resting on his left thigh. He is seated on a yellow-gold chair with a high back. The chair's back and armrest are decorated with carved animal figures, possibly lions or tigers, in the same yellow-gold color. One animal is visible on the backrest, and another on the armrest. The background is a plain, light, off-white or beige color. In the upper left corner, there is text written in a dark script: "श्रीमहाराज जमु." The man's bare feet are visible at the bottom, pointing left. The overall style is a line drawing with light watercolor washes.

alt_text: Two figures on an elephant fight a tiger while deer flee in a dynamic, uncolored drawing
long_description: This horizontal drawing on light-colored paper depicts a chaotic scene involving an elephant, two human figures, a tiger, and two deer. The central element is a large elephant, facing left, with its trunk raised and tusks visible. It is adorned with a patterned blanket on its back, secured by straps, and has golden bells and decorative elements on its side and legs. Two male figures ride the elephant. The figure in front, closer to the elephant's head, leans forward, holding a long staff or spear with both hands, aiming downwards. He wears a crown or elaborate headpiece and patterned clothing. The second figure, positioned further back on the elephant's rump, is seated and holds a bow, aiming an arrow towards the upper right. He also wears a crown and patterned attire. Below and to the left of the elephant's head, a tiger is depicted in mid-action, its body striped in black and yellow-orange. Its mouth is open, showing teeth, and its claws are extended, seemingly engaging with the elephant's trunk or front leg. In the upper right portion of the image, two deer are shown leaping or running away. They are depicted in light grey tones, with one larger and one smaller, both in mid-air. The drawing uses black ink for outlines and details, with washes of grey for shading on the elephant and deer, and yellow-orange for the tiger's stripes and golden elements on the elephant. The background is plain, light-colored paper.

alt_text: An interior scene depicts a large gathering of people below ornate windows and doors in a two-story building.
long_description: This watercolor and ink artwork depicts a two-story interior scene. The upper section features a row of three large, dark brown wooden doors or windows with crisscross patterns, set against a light gray wall. The central door is slightly wider and taller than the two flanking it. Below these, an ornate white and gray decorative railing or balcony extends across. To the left and right, the upper walls display recessed window structures with similar dark brown elements and intricate white and gray patterns. The ceiling is light gray. The lower section of the image portrays a large room filled with numerous figures, mostly rendered in outline with minimal color. The walls are a warm yellow-orange, adorned with faint decorative outlines. On the far left, a dark-stepped staircase ascends, partially hidden by a draped yellow-orange curtain. Several large, yellow-orange draped canopies hang from the ceiling, forming arched openings that frame the central gathering. In the middle, a prominent figure, possibly standing or seated on a raised platform, wears a more detailed garment and a turban, surrounded by other seated figures. Many additional figures, primarily sketched in outline, are seated or kneeling on the light, uncolored floor, filling the foreground and extending into the background. The scene suggests a crowded indoor assembly or event.

alt_text: A large gathering of people in an ornate hall with a central ceremony and lush green plants.
long_description: The image depicts a grand, multi-level architectural setting with a large group of people. In the foreground, a wide staircase with white railings descends towards the viewer, filled with numerous figures. These figures, mostly men, are seated or kneeling, wearing white or light-colored robes and turbans, with some having orange or yellow sashes or head coverings. They face a central area at the top of the stairs. At the top of the stairs, a central platform or stage is visible. On this platform, a group of figures is engaged in a ceremony. Several figures are kneeling or sitting on the ground, some in green or yellow garments. One prominent figure, possibly a deity or important person, is seated under a richly decorated canopy with yellow and red drapes. This canopy is supported by ornate pillars. To the left and right of the central platform, white statues of lion-like creatures are visible. The architectural structure extends upwards and outwards from the central platform. On both sides, tall, dark, arched trellises are filled with lush green foliage, including palm-like leaves and smaller plants. Numerous blue pots containing plants are hung from these trellises. Beyond the trellises, on the upper levels, more architectural details and distant figures can be seen, suggesting a larger complex. The ceiling above the central canopy is a light brown or beige color, possibly a wooden or painted surface. The overall impression is one of a grand, ceremonial event taking place in a richly decorated, semi-open-air setting with abundant greenery.

alt_text: Two figures sit in a multi-story building with domes, balconies, a staircase, and a palm tree.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting on light brown paper depicts a multi-story building with two figures on the ground floor. The artwork is outlined in black ink with minimal color washes. At the top left, two domed structures with finials are visible, alongside a balcony with a patterned railing. To the right, a palm tree with coconuts stands against the sky, above which two crescent moon shapes are faintly drawn. Below the upper balcony, another balcony with a similar railing extends across the building. A smaller domed structure is on the far left of this level. A long, narrow staircase with numerous steps ascends along the right side of the building, leading to the upper levels. On the ground floor, two figures are seated on a low, decorated platform or bed. The figure on the left is a woman, shown in profile facing right, with dark hair, wearing a light-colored garment and jewelry. Her left hand is raised near her face. The figure on the right is a man, also in profile facing left, wearing a turban and a light-colored lower garment, with a bare torso. His right hand is raised in a gesture, and a sword in a red scabbard hangs vertically behind him. The background behind the figures is simple, with a window-like opening. Black script is visible at the top, reading "मेघराम रागिनी" on the left and "देसीजडी रागना" on the right, with reddish-brown stains nearby. Light washes of red, green, and blue are used for clothing, architectural details, and the sword scabbard.

alt_text: A man on a horse with a bow and quiver, and another man standing to the left
long_description: The artwork is a vertical drawing on a light brown, aged paper. The central focus is a man riding a horse, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center and facing towards the right. The horse is depicted in outline with some red coloring on its hooves and a red beaded bridle. Black tassels hang from the saddle area. The rider, who has a mustache, wears a crown with a dark, possibly feathered, plume. He holds the reins in his left hand and a red bow in his right. A quiver filled with arrows is visible on his back, behind the saddle. To the left of the horse, a smaller, standing male figure faces the rider. This figure has a beard and wears a turban and simple garments. His right hand is raised towards the rider. The background is largely plain, with two small, stylized architectural elements at the top of the composition, one in the upper left and another in the upper right, both with red accents. The drawing uses black outlines with sparse red and dark gray/black color fills.

alt_text: A central seated figure with a halo, flanked by two standing figures, on a dark scroll painting
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features three figures against a dark background, framed by decorative borders. A large, light-skinned figure is seated centrally at the top, positioned on a dark, ornate throne. This figure wears a red robe draped over the left shoulder, leaving the right arm and chest exposed. The face is serene, with closed eyes. A golden halo encircles the head, and a larger golden mandorla surrounds the upper body. The figure holds a small, light-colored object in the left hand, resting on the lap, while the right arm extends downwards with an open hand. Below the central figure, two smaller, light-skinned figures stand symmetrically on either side of a dark, ornate structure resembling an altar. Both standing figures wear long, flowing robes in red, green, and gold, adorned with intricate patterns. Each has a smaller halo behind their head. The figure on the left holds a dark, possibly floral, object in both hands at chest level. The figure on the right holds a similar dark object. The background is a dark, textured field. To the right of the central figure, a column of light-colored vertical text is visible. The painting is bordered by a narrow, patterned reddish-brown strip, then a wider light brown border with a subtle pattern, and finally by plain light-colored fabric on the far left and right.

alt_text: A monochrome landscape drawing depicting a pavilion nestled among numerous trees and rolling hills
long_description: This horizontal, monochrome ink drawing on light-colored paper depicts an expansive landscape scene. On the far left, a traditional pavilion with a dark, gabled roof and open sides is situated on a raised platform, surrounded by a low railing. Several tall, gnarled trees with dense, textured foliage, resembling pines, frame the pavilion and extend across the left and central-left areas of the composition. The ground beneath these trees and around the pavilion is rendered with numerous small dots and lines, indicating rocky terrain and vegetation. Moving towards the center, the landscape continues with a cluster of various trees, some appearing full with leaves, while others have more sparse or bare branches. Behind these central trees, the terrain gently recedes, suggesting a valley or a body of water in the middle distance, depicted with lighter, less defined strokes. Large, rounded rock formations are visible among the trees in the central foreground. The right side of the drawing features a more open landscape with fewer, more widely spaced trees, some with bare branches, fading into a lighter background. A subtle, decorative vertical border with a repeating pattern, possibly of clouds or waves, is visible along the far right edge of the paper. The entire scene is rendered with fine lines and varying shades of grey ink, creating a sense of depth and atmosphere.

alt_text: A couple embraces under trees in a lush landscape with a block of text at the top
long_description: A rectangular painting depicts a couple embracing amidst a verdant landscape, topped by a band of text. The upper portion features a light tan background with multiple lines of script in black, interspersed with some red characters. Below this, the main scene unfolds with a man and a woman in an embrace. The man, on the left, has dark skin and wears a light-colored, possibly off-white or pale pink, lower garment with a patterned sash and a turban. His left arm is around the woman's back, and his right hand is near her face. The woman, on the right, has lighter skin and wears a brown skirt, an orange top, and a sheer fabric draped over her head and shoulders. Her left arm is around the man's neck, and her right hand rests on his chest. Their faces are close together. They stand on a light green ground with scattered darker green foliage and small plants. Surrounding them are several trees with dark green, dense foliage and reddish-brown trunks. One tree in the background, centrally located, has lighter green, palm-like leaves, with two small, dark figures visible in its branches. Another tree on the right has small red dots, possibly fruit or flowers, among its leaves. The painted scene is framed by a thin red line, and the entire piece has a rough, light brown border. In the bottom right corner, the numbers "18.85.58" and "Cooma 13" are visible. The transcribed text reads: "सो प्रछन्न संजोग कवि कहै वियोगगमाना जानै पीय प्रिया किसखि सद्दृतिसमान ॥ कवि ॥ वनमे हयलो न कुमारिसु रगिरमे रु विसोसरु रुपियो कलकृ डितशजित कामकलो विपरीत रति कियै । मनिसाहति स्यामजगडजरा चितिचेले चलचारु हियै मय दलके फुलो कुलाकृतु के सवंतु मनौ निचयै कलि".

alt_text: A long, narrow, light brown manuscript leaf with three sections of black text and two circular holes
long_description: A long, narrow, light brown manuscript leaf is centered horizontally against a plain gray background. The leaf is rectangular with slightly rounded ends and measures approximately five times longer than it is tall. It is divided into three main sections of densely packed black text, each section containing multiple lines of script. The text appears to be in an ancient script, possibly Sanskrit or a similar Indic language, with characters arranged in horizontal lines. Two small, circular holes are punched through the leaf, one between the first and second text sections from the left, and another between the second and third sections. These holes are positioned vertically in the middle of the leaf's height. The surface of the leaf shows some minor discoloration and a few small tears or irregularities along its top edge, particularly above the middle and right text sections. The overall impression is that of an aged, well-preserved document.

alt_text: A long, narrow, light-colored manuscript with dense dark text in three sections, punctuated by two circular holes.
long_description: The black and white image displays a single, elongated, rectangular object, likely a manuscript, positioned horizontally against a subtly textured, lighter background. The object itself is a light, uniform tone, with slightly rounded ends and a smooth appearance. It is densely covered with dark, intricate text, arranged in horizontal lines across its surface. The text is divided into three distinct sections. Each section contains approximately six to seven lines of script, which appears to be composed of many small, complex characters. These text blocks are separated by two small, dark, circular holes, which are centrally aligned along the object's vertical axis. The first hole is located about one-third of the way from the left end, and the second is about two-thirds of the way from the left end. A narrow, unwritten margin frames the text on all sides. On the far left edge, below the first line of text, two small, dark, vertical characters are visible, resembling 'W.L.' or similar markings. On the far right end, a few small, dark, vertical characters, possibly '11-12', are present.

alt_text: A multi-armed deity with two smaller figures, set against a dark arch and golden frame
long_description: The painting depicts a central, standing figure with multiple arms, flanked by two smaller figures, all within a golden-yellow border. The central figure faces forward, with a light-colored upper body and a red lower garment. A red, circular halo or aureole is behind its head, which is adorned with a crown-like headdress. At least four arms are visible, extending outwards from the torso; the upper right hand appears to hold a white, lotus-like object. The figure stands on a dark ground. To the left of the central figure, a smaller, light-skinned figure stands, facing towards the center. This figure has bent arms and appears to wear a light-colored garment. To the right, another smaller figure stands, facing towards the center. This figure has a reddish skin tone and wears a yellow lower garment. Its arms are also bent. Behind the three figures is a dark, almost black, arched background that contrasts with the lighter figures. This dark arch is set within a broader golden-yellow frame that surrounds the entire composition. Red elements are visible in the upper corners of this outer frame, suggesting decorative motifs. The overall artwork has a worn appearance, with visible lines and texture across the surface.

alt_text: A dynamic figure with dotted skin and a crown, holding objects, against a red aura and green border.
long_description: The painting depicts a single figure in a dynamic, wide-legged stance, centered against a large, red, oval-shaped aura. The figure's skin is light-toned, covered in numerous small red dots across the torso, arms, and legs. The figure wears a dark headdress or crown with gold elements, and has dark hair. The face features wide, dark eyes, dark eyebrows, and a small mouth. A small red mark is visible on the forehead. The upper body is bare, revealing prominent breasts, and adorned with multiple gold necklaces. The right arm is raised high, bent at the elbow, holding a yellow, curved object. The left arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand near the chest, holding a small red object. The lower body is clad in blue shorts with a gold border. The legs are spread wide, with the left leg extended to the side and the right leg bent. Both feet are covered in red, curved footwear. The red aura behind the figure is bordered by a dark green rectangular frame, which in turn is flanked by narrow yellow vertical strips on the far left and right edges of the painting. The overall color palette is dominated by red, blue, gold, and the light skin tone.

alt_text: A crowned figure in yellow and white, seated within a shrine-like structure with a red and white halo
long_description: The painting depicts a single figure seated centrally within a rectangular, shrine-like structure. The outermost border of the artwork is a solid yellow band, framing a dark grey or black inner border. The central figure has light skin and wears a white upper garment and a yellow skirt or dhoti. An elaborate golden crown or headdress adorns their head, with dark hair visible beneath. The figure wears a necklace and armbands. Their right leg is bent with the foot tucked in, while the left leg extends forward and slightly to the left, with a red line suggesting a foot or garment detail. The left hand appears to hold a small, light-colored object, possibly a lotus bud, near their shoulder, while the right hand rests on their lap. Behind the figure's head is a large, circular or oval halo, primarily white with a red inner border. Small, indistinct dark markings are scattered within this red border. The background immediately behind the figure and within the shrine structure is dark grey or black. The shrine structure itself is light-colored, with a decorative top and base, resembling architectural elements.

alt_text: A painted scene on a scroll featuring a large, spotted-body figure and a smaller figure, flanked by black text
long_description: This horizontal image displays a painted scene on a light brown scroll, flanked by columns of black script. The central painted panel is rectangular, framed by a thin gold line and a wider white border, set against a solid red background. The panel features two figures. The larger figure, positioned on the left, has light yellow skin covered in numerous small red spots. This figure is seated on a red cushion, leaning against an ornate white headrest with a small gold finial. The figure has long black hair styled upwards, dark eyes, thin eyebrows, and small red lips. The upper body is bare, while a blue garment with a white sash covers the lower body. The right arm is bent with the hand held near the chest in a gesture, and the left hand rests on the left thigh. The legs are bent, with the feet visible. To the upper right of the main figure, a smaller figure is seated on a red cushion, facing the larger figure. This figure also has light yellow skin and long black hair, with a white, halo-like shape behind the head. It wears a white top and a red lower garment. The right hand is raised near the face, and the left hand rests on the lap. On either side of the central painted panel, columns of dense black script are visible on the light brown scroll material. The script is arranged in multiple lines, filling the space to the left and right edges of the image.

alt_text: A seated figure in red robes with a halo, flanked by columns of black text on a light brown scroll.
long_description: A horizontal section of a scroll features a central painted image flanked by columns of black text. The central image depicts a figure seated cross-legged, facing forward, with light yellow skin and dark hair. The figure wears a red robe that covers the body and arms, with hands held in a gesture at chest level. A light blue backrest is visible behind the figure. A pale, almost white, oval halo with small red marks surrounds the figure's head and upper body. This central image is set within a red rectangular panel, which is further framed by a thin dark blue border. Above and below the central image, within the blue frame, are white horizontal bands. The entire central panel is bordered by thin yellow lines at the top and bottom. To the left and right of the central image, black script is arranged in multiple vertical lines on a light brown, textured background. The script on the left appears to be in a different hand or style than the script on the right, with the left script being more densely packed. A small, faint, handwritten mark is visible below the text on the bottom left.

alt_text: Seated central figure in red robes flanked by two smaller figures, with text on a scroll.
long_description: A rectangular painted panel is centered on a light brown, fibrous scroll material. The panel features a large central figure seated in a meditative pose, wearing a long red robe. This figure has a dark green halo around their head and a red background behind them, which is bordered by a thin white line. Their hands are clasped in front of their chest. On either side of the central figure, two smaller figures are seated, also wearing red robes and facing inward towards the central figure. Their hands are clasped in a similar gesture. The painted panel itself is framed by a thin gold line. To the left and right of this central painted scene, columns of dense black script are visible on the light brown scroll material. The scroll material shows visible texture and some signs of age.

alt_text: A crowned figure with a halo, holding a bow and arrow, seated within a red architectural frame
long_description: The image depicts a rectangular painting on a light-colored manuscript page, flanked by columns of black text in an Indic script. The central painting features a seated figure with a light yellowish skin tone, facing forward with the head slightly tilted to the right. A prominent red halo encircles the figure's head, which is adorned with an elaborate gold crown, large circular earrings, a necklace, armbands, and bracelets. The upper body is bare, while the lower body is covered by a red dhoti-like garment. The figure's right leg is bent with the foot resting on the seat, and the left leg is bent with the foot tucked underneath. In the left hand, a long, thin red object, possibly a bow, rests on the left shoulder. The right hand holds a smaller, pointed red object, likely an arrow, near the chest. Three vertical lines are visible on the figure's chest. The figure is seated on a white, ornate cushion or throne. The background behind the figure is a deep blue. This central scene is enclosed within a red architectural frame, characterized by multiple arches and pillars. The top of the frame is predominantly red with lighter, stylized shapes that suggest smaller figures or decorative motifs. Two light blue pillars are visible on either side of the central figure within the red frame.

alt_text: Multi-armed figure with yellow skin and blue clothing stands amidst red flames, flanked by black text
long_description: A rectangular painting on a light brown background features a central multi-armed figure flanked by columns of black script. The central figure has yellow-gold skin and wears a short-sleeved blue top and blue shorts. It possesses eight arms, four on each side, with hands in various gestures. The figure's face is yellow-gold with three eyes, and it wears an elaborate gold crown. A green and blue bird-like element is visible near its upper right shoulder. The figure stands with legs spread, feet flat, on a small, light brown animal resembling a boar or pig. Behind the figure is a vibrant red, flame-like aura, set against a dark blue rectangular panel. This panel is bordered by a thin yellow line. On the left and right sides of the central panel, columns of black script are arranged vertically on the light brown background, each column separated from the central image by a thin yellow border. The script is dense and fills the columns.

alt_text: A long, horizontal, light brown manuscript with dense dark text and three central holes.
long_description: The image displays a long, horizontal manuscript, likely a palm leaf, against a plain, light background. The manuscript itself is a light, warm brown or tan color, with slightly irregular and worn edges, particularly at the far left and right. It is oriented horizontally, extending across the majority of the frame. Dark, dense script is written in multiple lines across the entire visible surface of the manuscript. The text is arranged in horizontal rows, with individual characters appearing small and closely spaced. Three distinct, roughly circular or oval holes are punched through the manuscript, spaced relatively evenly along its horizontal axis. These holes are light in color, matching the background, and interrupt the flow of the text. The first hole is located approximately one-quarter of the way from the left edge, the second at the center, and the third about three-quarters of the way from the left edge. The script is consistent in appearance throughout the document, covering the surface from near the top edge to near the bottom edge, leaving narrow margins. The overall impression is of an ancient, well-preserved document.

alt_text: A long, horizontal manuscript leaf with three columns of dark text and two central holes.
long_description: A long, horizontal manuscript leaf, light brown in color, is presented against a lighter, off-white background. The leaf is rectangular with rounded corners on the left and a slightly irregular, torn edge on the right. It features three distinct columns of densely packed, dark script, likely in an Indic language, running horizontally across its length. Each column of text is separated by a vertical blank space. Two small, circular holes are punched through the leaf, one between the first and second columns of text, and another between the second and third columns. The text appears to be handwritten, with consistent line spacing and character size. On the far left edge, vertically oriented, are the numbers "27". On the far right edge, also vertically oriented, are the numbers "270". The surface of the leaf shows some minor creasing and discoloration consistent with age, particularly along the bottom edge of the rightmost section.

alt_text: A long, light brown manuscript leaf with three blocks of dark text and two central holes.
long_description: The image presents a single, elongated, horizontal manuscript leaf, appearing light brown with an aged texture. The leaf's edges are somewhat irregular, particularly on the right side where it shows signs of wear. Dark, dense script, likely in an Indic language, covers the surface, organized into three distinct rectangular blocks. The first block of text is positioned on the left. To its right, a thin vertical line marks a division, followed by a circular hole. The second, central block of text is situated between the two circular holes. Another thin vertical line and a second circular hole separate this central block from the third block of text on the right. This third block extends towards the right edge of the leaf. Each block contains multiple lines of small, consistent characters, creating a uniform pattern across the surface. The overall visual suggests an ancient, handwritten document.

alt_text: A long, horizontal ancient manuscript with three columns of dark script and two circular holes
long_description: A rectangular, horizontally oriented piece of aged material, possibly palm leaf or paper, is centered against a plain, light, off-white background. The material itself is a light brown or tan color, with slightly irregular and worn edges. The surface is divided into three distinct vertical sections, each filled with dense, dark script. The script appears to be in a non-Latin alphabet, characterized by small, intricate characters arranged in approximately five to six horizontal lines within each section. The text is uniformly dark against the lighter background. Between the first and second sections, and again between the second and third sections, there is a small, circular, light-colored hole. These holes are positioned centrally within the vertical space between the text columns, suggesting a historical binding or organizational feature. The overall impression is of an ancient, well-preserved document.

alt_text: A long, light brown manuscript leaf with three columns of dark script and two central holes
long_description: The image displays a single, elongated, light brown manuscript leaf, presented horizontally against a plain, off-white background. The leaf has a slightly irregular, worn edge, suggesting its age. It is divided into three distinct rectangular sections of text, separated by narrow, unwritten vertical bands. Each of these three sections is filled with multiple lines of dense, dark script, likely an ancient Indian script, written horizontally from left to right. The script appears uniform in size and style across all sections. Two small, circular holes are punched through the leaf. The first hole is located centrally in the unwritten band between the first and second text sections, and the second hole is similarly placed between the second and third text sections. These holes are aligned horizontally along the central axis of the leaf. The overall impression is of an ancient document, possibly a palm-leaf manuscript, with its surface covered in meticulous handwritten text. The texture of the leaf appears fibrous, and its color is a muted, earthy brown.

alt_text: A long, horizontal manuscript leaf with three columns of dark text and two central circular holes.
long_description: The image displays a long, horizontal strip of light brown, aged material, possibly paper or a palm leaf, with slightly irregular edges. The surface shows some subtle discoloration and texture, suggesting age. The strip is divided into three distinct rectangular blocks of dense, dark script, likely an ancient language, written in horizontal lines. Each block of text is separated by a circular hole punched through the material. The first text block is on the left, followed by a hole, then the second text block, another hole, and finally the third text block on the right. The text fills almost the entire height of each block, with narrow margins at the top and bottom. The script consists of many small, intricate characters, uniformly dark against the lighter background. The two circular holes are positioned centrally between the text blocks, appearing as light, unwritten areas.

alt_text: A long, light brown palm leaf manuscript with three sections of dense black text and two central holes.
long_description: The image presents a single, elongated, light brown palm leaf manuscript, oriented horizontally against a lighter background. The leaf has a slightly irregular, organic shape with rounded corners and edges that appear somewhat worn. The surface is a uniform light brown or tan color, showing some subtle variations in tone. Black text, written in a dense, horizontal script, covers the majority of the leaf's surface. The text is divided into three distinct columns or sections. The leftmost section of text begins with a vertical stack of two characters, "१" and "१", positioned to the left of the main text block. The main body of text in this section consists of six lines of script. Moving right, a circular hole, approximately 0.5 cm in diameter, is centered vertically within the leaf, acting as a divider. alt_text: A painted depiction of a golden and white stupa with a tiered spire, framed by red and gold borders
long_description: The artwork presents a centrally positioned, stylized stupa against a light, off-white background. The stupa is predominantly colored in shades of gold, white, and red. At the base, a broad, reddish-brown band supports a multi-tiered golden structure. This lower golden section consists of two rectangular platforms, each decorated with faint geometric patterns, including interlocking shapes and diagonal lines. Above these platforms, a smooth, white, dome-shaped element rises, outlined in a thin red line. Resting on the white dome is another golden, rectangular section, also subtly patterned. The stupa is crowned by a golden spire composed of several stacked, progressively smaller, disc-like or umbrella-like tiers. From the upper part of the spire, two wavy, red ribbon-like elements extend outwards, one on each side, against the pale background. The entire central image is flanked by vertical borders. Each border features a wider red band on the interior, adjacent to the central image, and a narrower golden-yellow band on the exterior. The overall impression is of an aged painting, with colors that appear somewhat muted. The edges of the artwork are slightly uneven, particularly at the top and bottom.

alt_text: A faded illustration of a golden, tiered structure resembling a stupa, flanked by red script on a light background
long_description: The image displays an ancient-looking illustration on a light, textured background, possibly aged fabric or paper. Centered in the frame is a stylized, multi-tiered structure, predominantly colored in faded gold or yellow. This structure has a broad, rectangular base with multiple horizontal layers. Above the base, there is a bulbous, rounded section, which is adorned with a horizontal band of small red triangular or dot-like patterns. Topping this rounded section is a conical, stacked spire composed of several diminishing horizontal rings, also in faded gold. Red lines outline various sections of the structure. On either side of the central golden structure, red script or symbols curve upwards, following the contour of the central object. Vertical red bands are visible along the far left and right edges of the composition, suggesting a border or part of a larger design. The overall color palette is muted, featuring faded gold, red, and the light brown/beige of the background. The edges of the artwork appear irregular and worn.

alt_text: A reddish-orange, multi-armed figure with a green headdress stands within an aura, framed by blue and gold borders
long_description: The artwork depicts a reddish-orange, multi-armed figure standing centrally on a light-colored background. The figure has a human-like form, facing forward with a slight turn to the left. Its skin is a uniform reddish-orange hue. It possesses eight arms, four on each side of its torso, extending outwards. The hands are open, with some holding thin, dark objects that resemble arrows or sticks. The figure wears a green, elaborate headdress that covers the top of its head and extends slightly behind it. Its face is also reddish-orange, with simple features. A dark line defines the waist, and a loincloth-like garment covers the lower body, also in reddish-orange. The figure stands within a large, light cream-colored oval or almond-shaped aura that frames its entire body. This aura is outlined with thin, dark lines. On either side of the central aura, vertical dark blue panels frame the composition. Beyond these blue panels, narrower vertical gold-colored borders with faint patterns complete the framing of the artwork. The top edge of the artwork is slightly irregular, suggesting an older textile or paper.

alt_text: A golden stupa with a white dome and tiered base, set against a light blue background with red borders.
long_description: The image depicts a stylized stupa rendered in a flat, illustrative style. The stupa occupies the central portion of the frame, set against a rectangular light blue background. It is predominantly golden yellow, with a white, rounded dome-like section in its middle. The stupa features a multi-tiered base, each tier outlined in a darker reddish-brown and adorned with small, reddish-brown dots. Above the base, the white dome is also outlined in reddish-brown and has a band of small, rounded shapes along its lower edge. Surmounting the dome is a golden yellow spire, composed of several stacked, decreasingly sized rings, topped with a small, rounded finial. The entire blue background panel is bordered on the left and right by vertical strips of reddish-orange, creating a framed appearance for the central stupa.

alt_text: A standing figure in a red robe with a yellow-orange face and a green halo, raising one hand.
long_description: The image displays a full-length standing figure, centrally positioned against a dark blue-green background. The artwork appears to be a painting on a panel or textile, with narrow, light brown borders on the left and right edges. The figure's skin is a light yellow-orange, and the face is round with small, dark eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. A small red dot is visible on the forehead, and the hair or head covering is dark. A light green, circular halo encircles the head. The figure is clad in a long, flowing robe of a deep red color, which covers the body from the neck to the feet, showing visible folds and drapes. The figure's right hand (viewer's left) is raised to chest level, with the palm facing outwards and fingers slightly curled upwards. The left hand (viewer's right) hangs down by the side, with the palm facing inwards and fingers slightly curled. The feet are obscured by the robe, which meets a dark, narrow horizontal band at the very bottom of the image. The overall impression is of an aged artwork with muted colors.

alt_text: A blue-skinned, red-eyed figure with a yellow headdress and leopard-print skirt stands against a red, flame-like background.
long_description: A vibrant painting depicts a muscular, blue-skinned figure with striking red eyes and a red mouth, set against a fiery red background. The figure wears a yellow, textured headdress and a yellow skirt with dark, irregular spots resembling a leopard print. Various necklaces and armbands adorn its body, with a prominent red element around its neck. Its right arm is raised, hand open, while its left arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand held near its chest. From the left arm, several small, pale, head-like objects hang. The figure stands in a dynamic, slightly crouched pose on an irregular, brown base. The red background features wavy, flame-like patterns. Vertical borders, yellow with intricate red or brown decorative motifs, frame the central image on both the left and right sides.

alt_text: A multi-armed figure with reddish skin and yellow clothing in a dynamic pose, framed by red decorative borders
long_description: The artwork depicts a multi-armed figure with reddish-orange skin, dressed in yellow clothing, against a light, off-white background. The figure is positioned centrally, appearing to crouch or kneel with one leg bent and the other extended. It wears a yellow top, yellow pants, and a yellow head covering. The face has simple features, with eyes that appear closed or downcast. Four arms are visible: two upper arms extend upwards, with one hand near the head and the other holding a curved, bow-like object. The two lower arms are bent, with hands holding small, elongated objects, possibly arrows. Faint red outlines of foliage or decorative elements are visible in the background behind the figure. The entire composition is framed by thick, reddish-orange vertical borders on the left and right sides. These borders feature intricate, repeating scroll-like patterns in a lighter color, possibly yellow or off-white. The top and bottom edges of the artwork are irregular, suggesting an aged material. The dominant colors are reddish-orange, yellow, and the light background hue.

alt_text: A golden, tiered stupa-like structure with red hanging symbols on a light background, framed by red.
long_description: The artwork depicts a central, golden, tiered structure resembling a stupa, set against a light, rectangular background. The structure occupies most of the vertical space within the central panel. Its base is a multi-tiered platform, rendered in gold with subtle horizontal lines and decorative patterns along its edges. Above this, a large, rounded, light-colored dome-like section rises, encircled by a thin red band at its base. From the top of this rounded section, a conical, golden spire ascends, composed of several stacked, diminishing rings. Two chains of red, stylized characters or symbols hang from the upper part of the conical spire, curving downwards on either side of the rounded middle section. These chains appear to be connected near the top of the spire and extend to just below the widest part of the rounded dome. The central light-colored panel is bordered on its left and right sides by solid red vertical bands, creating a frame for the central image. The overall impression is of a painted or drawn image on a textured surface.

alt_text: A golden-yellow tiered monument, resembling a stupa, stands centrally against a blue background with red borders
long_description: The image displays a tall, golden-yellow, multi-tiered structure centered on a blue background. The structure rises from a broad, rectangular base with horizontal lines, tapering upwards. Above the base, a slightly narrower, light-colored, rounded section features a row of small, red, triangular shapes along its lower edge. The next section is golden-yellow and consists of several stacked, horizontally-lined tiers, forming a bell-like or conical shape. This is topped by a smaller, more ornate golden-yellow finial with multiple rings and a pointed apex. Small, dark red, stylized leaf-like motifs are scattered across the blue background on both sides of the central structure. The entire composition is framed by a vertical red band on the far left and another on the far right. The blue background extends to the top and bottom edges of the central image area.

alt_text: A stylized painting of a standing figure with yellow skin and a red garment, framed by an arch and colored borders
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a single standing figure with light yellow skin and dark outlines. The figure has a slender torso, broad shoulders, and long limbs. The head is slightly tilted to the left, featuring dark hair styled upwards, possibly adorned with a small crown or elaborate headpiece. Large, dark eyes look forward, complemented by prominent dark eyebrows, a long nose, and a small mouth. The figure wears large circular earrings, a necklace, armbands, and anklets. A red lower garment, resembling a dhoti, is wrapped around the waist and extends to the knees, with a flowing sash. The figure's posture suggests movement, with the body leaning to the left. The right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand held near the chest. The left arm extends downwards, with the hand holding an indistinct object or part of the garment. The figure stands within a light cream-colored, arched frame or halo. To the left of this arch is a vertical red band, and to the right is a vertical dark blue-green band. The top and bottom edges of the artwork are frayed, revealing a woven texture.
