alt_text: A green-skinned figure sits centrally on a lotus, flanked by two smaller figures, with text panels on both sides.
long_description: This horizontal painting is divided into three vertical panels. The central panel features a large, green-skinned figure seated in a meditative pose on a multi-petaled lotus throne. The figure wears a golden crown, a green top, a red and gold patterned skirt, and numerous gold and pearl necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. Their face has a serene expression with dark hair. The right hand holds a small, light-colored object, while the left hand rests on the lap. Behind the central figure is a large, ornate golden archway with a red inner border, decorated with green foliage at the top. Two smaller figures flank the central deity, each seated on a smaller lotus cushion. The figure on the left has yellow skin, wears blue and gold attire, and has dark hair. The figure on the right has blue skin, wears red and gold attire, and has a prominent nose ring. The background of the central panel is a dark, patterned gold. The left and right panels contain black text on a light brown background, framed by yellow and red borders. The text on the left reads: "अथवा यद्यवधि अधनायवद्या धनानावयवद्या वधियायवद्यय अवद्यवदवद्या यावनावद्याया मद्यवदद्याय". The text on the right reads: "योगधियवद्यये विद्यवद्ययया यारनिगधवा वायायवद्यय बोधिनगवद्यय नर्मलवद्यायवधि आद्ययवद्ययवना".

alt_text: A multi-armed red deity with a crown stands on a reclining figure, surrounded by flames and an arch, flanked by text
long_description: This rectangular artwork features a central painted panel flanked by columns of black text on a light brown background. The central panel is framed by a yellow border adorned with small red dots. Within this frame, a large, multi-armed figure with red skin dominates the composition. This figure stands upright, positioned on top of a smaller, horizontally reclining figure with golden skin and dark hair. The main figure wears a golden crown, multiple white beaded necklaces, armbands, and a golden skirt-like garment. Its face has a smiling expression, and its hair is depicted as golden. Red flames emanate from around the figure, filling much of the background. Two of its many hands are visible holding white, patterned, lantern-like objects. Above the figure, an ornate golden arch rises, decorated with small, seated figures and green foliage against a dark blue-green background. The background immediately behind the main figure is a deep red, blending into the flames. The text on the left and right panels is written in black script, arranged in vertical columns.

alt_text: A central figure with light skin and an elaborate crown sits in a shrine, flanked by two smaller figures and panels of black script.
long_description: This horizontal painting features a central, vertically oriented panel depicting a seated figure, flanked by two narrower vertical panels filled with black script. The central figure has light skin, dark hair, and a serene expression, wearing an elaborate gold crown, necklaces, armbands, and bracelets. The figure is seated in a cross-legged position on a multi-colored cushion with red, blue, and green sections. Their hands are held at chest level in a gesture. The figure is dressed in a white upper garment and a red and white patterned lower garment. Behind the figure is a golden, intricately patterned archway, framed by a red border. Above the figure, a multi-tiered, pagoda-like structure rises, with green foliage and small animal figures on either side. Two smaller figures flank the main figure: a yellow-skinned figure with dark hair sits to the left, and a red-skinned, more fierce-looking figure with white hair and fangs stands to the right. Both smaller figures are adorned with jewelry. The two side panels are light brown and contain multiple lines of black script. The left panel reads: "घाधीनानाययः", "फगवववववववव", "समाधिनानायय", "यायानानावेधय", "घेनानानानाना", "बोधियवववववव", "झायायायायाया". The right panel reads: "नवेधययययययय", "लीनानाययययय", "यययययययययय", "गवववववववव", "मा०८०८०८०८०", "मूलाधका", "छडीधयययययय". A small red '8' and '1' are visible next to the fifth line of text in the right panel. The entire central panel is bordered by a thin yellow frame with small red dots.

alt_text: A green-skinned deity with a crown sits on an ornate throne, flanked by two smaller figures and text panels.
long_description: This horizontal rectangular painting features a central, ornate scene flanked by two panels of text, all set against a light brown background. The central scene is framed by a red and yellow border with small dots. At its center, a large, green-skinned figure sits on an elaborate throne. The figure wears a crown, large circular earrings, and various pieces of jewelry, with a red lower garment. Its right hand holds a white, string-like object. Behind the figure's head is a red archway, surrounded by a golden, patterned halo. Above the arch, green foliage and golden architectural elements are visible. To the left of the central figure, a smaller, yellow-skinned figure sits on the ground, facing inward. To the right, a similar smaller, blue-skinned figure also sits on the ground, facing inward. Both smaller figures appear to be in a posture of reverence. On the far left of the artwork, a vertical panel contains eight lines of thick black text. On the far right, another vertical panel contains eight lines of thick black text, mirroring the left panel. The entire artwork is bordered by a thin yellow and red line. The dominant colors are green, red, gold, blue, and black against the light brown ground.

alt_text: A deity on an ornate throne with a smaller figure, flanked by two panels of black script on a light background
long_description: This horizontal artwork depicts a central scene flanked by two panels of text. The central image features a large, light-skinned figure seated on an ornate, golden throne with a blue patterned cushion. The figure has dark hair, a serene expression, and wears a red lower garment and various pieces of jewelry, including necklaces and armbands. Their hands are held in a specific gesture, palms facing each other with fingers slightly curled. To the right of the main figure, a smaller, yellow-skinned figure sits on the ground, looking up. This figure wears a patterned yellow garment and jewelry. Behind the main figure is a red archway with intricate golden patterns, topped by green foliage. To the right of the main figure, a golden tiered structure, resembling a stupa, stands. The central image is framed by a red border with a golden inner line. On both the left and right sides of the central image are vertical panels of dense black script on a light, aged background. Each text panel is bordered by a thin red line and a wider golden line with small red dots. The entire artwork is enclosed within a red and golden border. The overall color palette includes reds, blues, yellows, greens, and the natural tone of the paper.

alt_text: A central golden figure with two smaller attendants, seated on a lotus, flanked by two panels of black text.
long_description: A horizontal rectangular painting on a light brown background is divided into three vertical sections. The central section features a colorful depiction of a main figure flanked by two smaller figures, all seated. The main figure, with golden skin, sits cross-legged on a red and blue lotus cushion. This figure wears a red lower garment, gold jewelry, and a tall, dark headdress, and has a white halo behind the head, framed by a red archway. The right hand is raised with the palm facing forward and fingers extended, while the left hand rests on the lap. The face has a gentle smile. Behind the central figure is a golden, tiered architectural structure with green foliage and small flowers. To the left of the main figure, a smaller golden-skinned figure sits on a cushion, looking towards the center. To the right, a smaller green-skinned figure also sits on a cushion, looking towards the center. Both smaller figures wear patterned lower garments and jewelry. The left and right sections of the painting each contain multiple lines of black text, framed by thin red and yellow borders. The text on the left panel reads: "मङ्गलकल्याणविंश" "नववाद्यकल्याणः" "गुह्यसुखमावाप्तः" "कल्याणमित्रमाप्तः" "मङ्गलमायनाय" "वावस्थानमायति". The text on the right panel reads: "विवर्धयित्वा" "वामदक्षिणाय" "ज्ञानवज्राय" "सिद्धवज्राय" "वज्रसत्त्वाय" "नमोस्तुते".

alt_text: A central light-skinned figure sits cross-legged, flanked by two attendants and two panels of black script.
long_description: A horizontal rectangular painting on a light brown background depicts a central seated figure flanked by two smaller figures and two vertical panels of text. The central pictorial section is framed by a yellow border with red dots. The main figure, with light skin, sits cross-legged on a multi-colored cushion, wearing a red and white dhoti and various gold and red ornaments. Their hands are raised in specific gestures. A large white halo encircles their head, and a flaming red and white aureole surrounds their body. Behind them is an elaborate golden throne-like structure with green foliage and small red flowers at the top. To the left of the central figure, a smaller, light-skinned attendant sits, dressed in blue and red, with gold jewelry. To the right, a smaller, blue-skinned attendant sits, dressed in yellow and red, also with gold jewelry. Both attendants face the central figure. On the far left, a vertical panel contains eight lines of black script. On the far right, another vertical panel contains eight lines of black script. The script is in an Indic language.

alt_text: A green-skinned figure dances among smaller figures, flanked by text panels.
long_description: This horizontal rectangular painting is divided into three vertical sections: two outer text panels and a central illustrated panel. The central panel features a large, green-skinned figure in a dynamic, dancing pose on a vibrant red background. This prominent figure has multiple arms, with one raised holding a patterned object resembling a sword or club above its head. It wears patterned green and yellow clothing, elaborate jewelry, and a large, ornate golden halo or headdress. Its body is adorned with white dots. Surrounding the central figure are numerous smaller figures. To the left, several figures with varying skin tones, including one with a white beard, look towards the central green figure. Below the central figure, several smaller, mostly nude figures, some with light skin and some with darker skin, are in active poses, some appearing to be children. To the right, a blue-skinned figure supports the central green figure. The background of the central panel is a vibrant red, with green foliage and vines at the top. A decorative border of yellow dots on a red line frames the central illustration. The two side panels are light beige with black text in an Indic script. Each text panel has a red border with yellow dots, matching the central panel's frame. The text on the left panel reads: "यावनायक्षमा यवनामिथाव अधवा हठसग कामावररासय यावबुधवा नगवा हसगुवि मदेववगाधवा". The text on the right panel reads: "वलोहनिजिहि सतमहायागिह ययवावयायय वरराधिथयवध प्रधविदिधयधा सविरासयभागन मेवधयसुलेवधा".

alt_text: Multi-armed deity seated on an ornate throne, flanked by two panels of black text on a light background
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal rectangular painting featuring a central, multi-armed figure flanked by two vertical panels of text. The central figure, depicted with light skin, sits cross-legged on a blue and red cushion. Two of the figure's primary hands are clasped together in front of the chest, while at least four other arms extend outwards, holding various small, indistinct objects. The figure wears a tall, ornate crown, necklaces, armbands, and draped garments in red, white, and blue. Behind the figure's head is a red halo, and the figure is seated against an elaborate, golden, arch-shaped throne with intricate patterns. Green foliage is visible at the top of the throne, suggesting a natural setting. The central image is framed by a thin red border with small gold dots. To the left and right of the central image are two vertical panels of light tan paper, each filled with multiple lines of black text. The text on the left panel reads: "नांसवानामाजे", "काङ्गववव", "यायामामाड", "यायारामा", "यासववव", "वावाविसलेन", "वानाययाव". The text on the right panel reads: "वनारणीडगव", "मायायकाया", "ववाववमलान", "नछछगायक", "सवववधजना", "महामलेनय", "वधवनमेय". Each text panel is also bordered by a similar red and gold dotted frame.

alt_text: A green-skinned deity sits centrally on a throne, flanked by two smaller figures, with text panels on a manuscript page.
long_description: This rectangular manuscript page features a central painted illustration flanked by columns of black script. The central painting depicts a large, green-skinned figure seated on a multi-colored cushion. This figure has dark hair, a white crown, and a white halo behind their head. Their hands are held together in a gesture, possibly holding a small, flame-like object. They wear necklaces, armbands, and a red and gold lower garment. Behind the figure is a red archway with gold dots, topped by green foliage and a tiered golden structure. Two smaller figures sit on either side of the central deity. The figure on the left has light brown skin and wears a blue garment, while the figure on the right has blue skin and wears a red and gold garment. Both smaller figures look towards the central deity. On the left and right sides of the central painting are vertical panels of black script in a South Asian language, arranged in multiple lines. The entire composition is bordered by a yellow band with red dots.

alt_text: A central deity figure dances among smaller figures, flanked by two panels of black text on a scroll.
long_description: This horizontal scroll painting features a central, vibrant illustration bordered by two panels of black text on a light brown background. The central rectangular illustration has a bright red background and is framed by a yellow border with red dots. At the top, dark green foliage with small, light-skinned figures in various poses fills the upper portion. A large, light-skinned central figure with multiple arms dominates the middle, depicted in a dynamic dancing pose. This figure wears elaborate gold and red jewelry, a patterned red and white lower garment, and has a large, ornate gold halo behind its head. One of its raised hands holds a small red object. Surrounding the central figure are numerous smaller figures, some light-skinned and some darker, with varying hair and facial features, including some with beards. They are depicted in various poses, some reaching up towards the central figure, some kneeling, and others appearing to react with awe or distress. They wear simple yellow and orange garments. The left panel, on a light brown background, displays multiple lines of black text. A small orange '25' is visible at the top left. The text reads: 'यारविनाकासः नाययागश्रीवाकः गयाययववमथा वानामिधयकाः गावडउककाय मघबलायया तववमाकाम'. The right panel, also on a light brown background, contains multiple lines of black text with two small black circles at the top. The text reads: 'गययववगसमथय नाययगयाववयाड माववगयाववया माववराघयववा ववगववसमववया श्रववगवव मथययमावव'.

alt_text: A multi-armed deity on an ornate throne, surrounded by three smaller figures, against a blue background with a red border.
long_description: A rectangular painting features a central, multi-armed deity seated on an ornate throne against a blue background, framed by a red border. The main figure has light brown skin, four arms, and wears a tall, red and gold crown, multiple necklaces, armbands, and bracelets. A red and white halo encircles the head. The upper left hand holds a golden trident, while the lower right hand holds a small, dark, flute-like object. The other two hands are in gestures. The deity is dressed in a patterned gold and red skirt and a white and red patterned garment over the torso. The throne is gold and red with intricate patterns, resting on a base with animal-like feet. Above the central figure is an ornate, red and gold canopy. To the right, three smaller figures are arranged vertically. The uppermost figure is seated, has light brown skin, wears a crown and jewelry, and holds a stringed instrument. Below this, a second seated figure, also with light brown skin, a crown, and jewelry, holds a small, dark object. The lowest and smallest figure is seated, with light brown skin, a crown, and jewelry, holding a circular object. All three smaller figures have red and white halos behind their heads and wear striped lower garments.

alt_text: Two figures, one human-like and one animal-headed, sit on an ornate bed within a decorative border.
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting features two figures on an ornate, elevated structure against a blue background, framed by a red border. The figure on the left has dark skin and a human-like face, adorned with a pink top, gold and white necklaces, earrings, and a crown. A red and gold halo-like circle frames their head. This figure reclines, looking upwards and to the right, with their left arm bent and their right arm extended towards the other figure. The figure on the right has dark skin and an animal-like head, wearing a light brown garment with red and gold patterns and similar jewelry. They are seated, holding a small, round, reddish object in their hands, seemingly offering it to the left figure. A red and gold halo also frames their head. Both figures are positioned on a richly decorated bed or throne, featuring intricate geometric and floral patterns in gold, red, black, and white. The structure has ornate legs and a base. Above the figures, a decorative canopy or upper border displays more patterns, including a central arch with a bird-like creature. The artwork uses a vibrant palette of blues, reds, golds, and dark skin tones.

alt_text: A large reclining figure and a smaller seated figure in an ornate, colorful architectural setting
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts two figures within an elaborate architectural setting, framed by a red border. The background is predominantly deep blue. On the left, a larger figure reclines on an ornate bed or couch, facing right. This figure has dark skin, a prominent headdress, and is adorned with multiple necklaces, armbands, and patterned clothing in gold, red, and white stripes. A red, oval-shaped halo or aura surrounds their head. The bed itself is richly decorated with red, gold, and blue patterns. To the right, a smaller figure is seated, facing the reclining figure. This figure also has dark skin, a headdress, and is dressed in pink and gold patterned garments, holding a small, dark vessel. Above the figures, the architectural structure features multiple tiers of decorative elements in red, gold, and blue, including a central archway with an indistinct motif. long_description: The artwork presents a fan-shaped piece of paper, painted with natural elements, set against a speckled gold background. The fan occupies the central and left portions of the rectangular frame, with its curved edges revealing the gold background on the top, right, and bottom. The fan's paper is a light, aged cream color. On the fan, in the upper left quadrant, are several light brown, rectangular shapes with dark outlines, resembling segments of bamboo or a small fence. They are arranged in a slightly diagonal cluster. Below and to the right of these elements, long, thin blades of grass or reeds are painted in varying shades of green and light brown. These blades curve gracefully downwards and to the right, some overlapping. Faint, diffuse pinkish-white smudges, possibly blossoms, are visible in the upper right and central areas of the fan. In the lower left, on one of the brown grass blades, a small, circular red seal or stamp is visible. The gold background is uniformly speckled with darker gold flecks, creating a textured appearance.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting on a gold background depicts various green plants and white flowers in a field
long_description: The artwork features a fan-shaped painting centrally placed on a rectangular background of gold-flecked paper. The fan itself is a light, creamy beige, with subtle washes of pale green suggesting a gentle landscape or field. Various plants and grasses are depicted across the fan's surface. In the lower center, a prominent plant with large, dark green, lobed leaves grows upwards. To its left and right, smaller plants with lighter green leaves and clusters of white flowers are visible. Further to the right, a plant with small, dark brown or black clusters of flowers or berries emerges from the ground. In the upper left, more green foliage, including some fern-like leaves, is depicted. Thin, vertical strokes of green and brown suggest blades of grass throughout the scene. In the lower left quadrant of the fan, there is a vertical inscription of black characters, with a smaller red seal or characters beneath it. The overall composition is naturalistic, with the plants arranged organically within the fan's curved boundaries.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A small black and white bird is painted on a light fan-shaped paper, set against a gold-flecked background.
long_description: A rectangular artwork features a fan-shaped painting centered on a gold-flecked background. The fan-shaped paper is a light, off-white color, with its wider, curved edge at the top and narrower, curved edge at the bottom. A small bird, predominantly black and white, is depicted in the upper right quadrant of the fan. The bird faces right, with a black cap on its head, a white face, and a white belly. Its back and wings are black, and its long tail feathers are also black. Its legs are thin and dark. Faint, thin, diagonal lines are visible in the upper left portion of the fan, extending downwards and to the right. In the lower right corner of the fan, there are a few black calligraphic characters and a square red seal. The fan-shaped painting is mounted on a rectangular background that is covered in small, irregular gold flecks, creating a shimmering texture. A thin, plain, light brown border frames the entire rectangular composition.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A painting on a fan-shaped ground depicts a horizontal gourd with a flowering plant and calligraphy against a gold-flecked background
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular image featuring a fan-shaped painting set against a gold-flecked background. The central fan-shaped area, with its curved top and bottom edges, is a light, creamy beige. The surrounding background, above and below the fan, is covered in a dense pattern of small, irregular gold flecks on a light beige ground, creating a shimmering effect. Within the fan shape, a large, light brown gourd lies horizontally, extending from the left-center towards the right. It has a rounded, wider body on the left and tapers into a narrower, elongated neck that curves slightly upwards to the right. From an opening on the upper side of the gourd's wider body, a small plant with delicate white flowers and dark stems emerges, standing upright. To the right of the gourd's neck, a vertical line of dark, stylized calligraphy is visible, accompanied by a small, square red seal below it. The gourd exhibits subtle shading, suggesting volume, and the fan-shaped ground appears to be made of a slightly textured paper.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting on a gold-flecked background shows long green leaves and light pink and white blossoms with a red seal
long_description: A rectangular artwork features a fan-shaped painting set against a gold-flecked background. The background is a light golden-brown, densely speckled with small, irregular gold flakes, creating a shimmering texture. A thin, plain brown border frames the entire rectangular piece. The fan-shaped painting occupies the central area, its curved edges defining its form. The fan's surface is a light, creamy beige or off-white, with subtle variations in tone. On the left side of the fan, a cluster of long, slender leaves extends diagonally upwards and to the right. These leaves are painted in shades of muted green and brown, with visible brushstrokes suggesting their texture and movement. Towards the upper right portion of the fan, several soft, cloud-like forms are depicted. These forms are primarily white, with hints of very pale pink and a touch of light blue-grey in the upper left of this cluster. Near the bottom left of the fan, nestled among the lower parts of the leaves, is a small, rectangular red seal. Above and slightly to the left of the seal, there are a few faint, dark brushstrokes that resemble stylized characters or writing. The overall composition places the natural elements within the distinct shape of the fan, which is then presented on the textured gold ground.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting depicts a figure near a thatched hut and trees, set against a gold-flecked background.
long_description: A rectangular artwork features a fan-shaped painting centered on a gold-flecked background. The fan-shaped area, light beige in color, depicts a tranquil landscape scene. On the right side of the painting, a thatched hut with a dark roof is nestled beneath a large, gnarled tree with a thick, dark trunk and some green foliage. A figure, dressed in light and dark garments, is visible near the hut, appearing to be seated or tending to something. To the left of the hut, another slender tree with sparse green leaves stands. In the foreground on the left, a low, rectangular structure or platform is depicted, with faint brushstrokes suggesting water or a path in front of it. Sparse, tall grasses or reeds are visible behind this structure. Small clusters of red blossoms or berries appear near the base of the large tree on the right. The brushstrokes are loose and painterly, with muted tones of gray, black, green, and light brown dominating the scene within the fan. The gold-flecked background has a textured appearance, with small, irregular gold specks scattered across a lighter tan base. A thin, plain brown border frames the entire rectangular piece.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A white bird perches on a dark, gnarled branch within a fan-shaped painting on a gold-speckled background
long_description: The artwork features a fan-shaped painting centered on a rectangular, gold-speckled background, all enclosed by a thin, light brown border. The fan-shaped paper is a light beige or cream color. On the left side of the fan, a thick, gnarled branch, painted in dark black ink, extends horizontally towards the center. Perched on this branch, slightly to the left of center, is a small, white bird with a slender beak, facing towards the right. Above the main branch, to its left, are a few faint, thin lines that suggest smaller branches or reeds. Scattered across the light beige background of the fan, particularly around the bird, are small, subtle white speckles. Near the base of the dark branch, a small, square-shaped red seal or mark is visible. The gold-speckled background surrounding the fan has a textured appearance, with numerous small, light-colored flecks.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan painting mounted as album leaf; tempera on paper

alt_text: A large golden fish swims in a river, with people and buildings on the banks, within an ornate border.
long_description: A rectangular painting features an oval-shaped central image, framed by a black border with gold floral motifs, and an outer textured light pink border. The central image depicts a scene divided horizontally by a winding, light gray river with white wavy lines. In the lower half of the oval, a very large, golden-scaled fish with prominent red fins swims horizontally, its head facing left. Below this large fish, several smaller, stylized aquatic creatures are visible: one with a pink head and green tail, another with a green head and tail, and a few small pink, oval shapes. The upper half of the oval shows green grassy banks on either side of the river. On the left bank, a small boat carries several figures dressed in colorful garments. On the right bank, a light-skinned figure wearing a white cloth sits on a white cushion by the water, holding a small, round object. Further back on the right, another figure in white sits on a cushion, and to the far right, a standing figure with raised arms, also in white, is depicted. Behind these figures, a village extends with numerous white and light-colored buildings, some featuring domed roofs or spires. Green trees are scattered among the structures, all set against a light blue sky.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: Monochrome landscape painting of mountains, water, trees, and small structures on a vertical scroll.
long_description: A tall, vertical monochrome ink painting on light-colored paper depicts a vast landscape. The artwork is presented as a hanging scroll with a gold-patterned border at the top and bottom. The upper third features distant, hazy mountains with soft, rounded peaks, partially obscured by mist or clouds. To the upper left, there is visible text arranged in vertical columns. Below the mountains, a wide body of water or a river flows downwards, bordered by landmasses on both sides. On the left bank, a large, dense cluster of trees with textured foliage extends from the mid-ground to the foreground. On the right, a winding path or riverbank is lined with bare, skeletal trees and some small, indistinct structures. In the middle of the water, a small boat with two figures is visible, and several small, dark shapes, possibly birds, are scattered above it. On the right bank, a multi-tiered pavilion with a pointed roof stands near the water's edge. The lower third shows more landmasses covered with various trees, including several tall, prominent pine-like trees with textured trunks and dense foliage on the right. Rocky outcrops and textured ground are depicted with dark ink strokes. Small figures are visible on the land, one near the base of the large trees on the right, and another further left. The overall impression is a serene, expansive natural scene rendered with varying shades of black and gray ink.

metadata.title: 明      謝時臣      四時佳興圖      軸 四幅|Landscapes of the Four Seasons
metadata.medium: Set of four hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman in a teal kimono kneels on a patterned cushion against a plain background, framed by decorative borders.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single figure. A woman kneels on a patterned cushion in the lower section of the scroll, facing slightly to the left with her head turned towards the viewer. She wears a teal-blue kimono adorned with white circular floral motifs, and a red and white striped collar is visible at her neck. Her dark hair is styled upwards, secured with a gold ornament. Her hands are clasped together near her chest, holding a dark, flat object. The cushion she kneels on is dark green with a subtle patterned border and a darker, possibly purple or brown, inner pattern. The background behind the woman is a plain, light beige. To the right of the woman, on the beige background, there is vertical black text and two square red seals stacked vertically. The entire central image area is framed by two decorative borders. The inner border is a narrow strip of light beige with a delicate gold leaf pattern. The outer border is wider, teal-blue, featuring a repeating geometric pattern in a darker blue and gold floral motifs.

metadata.title: 二代目岩井粂三郎の肖像|Portrait of Iwai Kumesaburō II
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll: ink and color on silk

alt_text: A central seated figure in red robes holding a bowl, flanked by two standing figures, surrounded by many smaller figures
long_description: The artwork depicts a central, large figure seated in a meditative posture on a multi-tiered lotus throne. This figure has golden skin, a serene expression, and is dressed in flowing red robes with gold accents. The right arm extends downwards, while the left hand holds a dark bowl in the lap. A golden halo encircles the figure's head, set against a vibrant red background adorned with swirling patterns. Flanking the central figure are two smaller, standing figures, one on each side. These figures have lighter skin tones, wear elaborate garments with gold details, and hold small objects in their hands. They stand on smaller lotus pedestals. The entire composition is framed by a dark border. Along the top and sides of the central scene, numerous small, identical figures are depicted in individual, oval-shaped red frames, arranged in multiple rows. These figures are seated in similar meditative postures. Below the main lotus throne, a complex base extends across the bottom of the image. This base features multiple horizontal registers, each containing more small, seated figures and decorative motifs in red, gold, and dark blue. The overall color scheme is dominated by deep reds, gold, and dark blue-black accents.

alt_text: A dark, vertical painting of a central seated figure with a halo, surrounded by many smaller figures and creatures
long_description: The image is a vertical painting, predominantly dark with faded colors, suggesting age. At the center, a large, light-skinned figure sits cross-legged on a lotus-like base. This figure has a prominent blue halo behind its head and a larger blue aura behind its body. Its right hand is raised in a gesture, and its left hand rests in its lap. The figure wears dark robes. To the left and right of the central figure, and slightly below, are groups of smaller, standing figures. These figures appear to be human-like, some with shaved heads, wearing robes. Their skin tones are lighter against the dark background. Below the central figure, on a platform, are several small, light-colored, ornate objects, possibly ritual implements or offerings. Further down, in the lower third of the painting, are more figures. On the left, a red-skinned, horned, demonic-looking figure stands, holding a weapon. To its right, another dark, monstrous figure with a wide, red mouth and fangs is visible. On the right side of the lower section, a large, white, animal-like creature, possibly an elephant or lion, is depicted, adorned with decorations, and carrying figures on its back. Other smaller, less distinct figures are also present in this lower area, some appearing to be attendants or additional demonic entities. The overall composition is hierarchical, with the large central figure dominating the upper half, and a more crowded, dynamic scene in the lower half. The colors are muted, with gold accents on some figures and objects, and a dark, almost black background. The painting is framed by a reddish-brown border with a thin green and gold patterned strip on the inner edge.

metadata.title: 釈迦三尊十大弟子像|Shaka (Shakyamuni), the Historical Buddha, with Two Attendant Bodhisattvas and the Ten Great Disciples
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll features black calligraphy above an ink painting of jagged rocks and sparse trees.
long_description: This is a tall, narrow vertical scroll with a light tan fabric border on its left and right sides. At the very top, a decorative band features a repeating pattern of small red and black floral or geometric motifs. Below this band, the upper two-thirds of the scroll are filled with vertical lines of black calligraphic text, written in a traditional script on light-colored paper. The text is arranged in columns, reading from right to left. Below the calligraphy, the lower third of the scroll contains a monochrome ink painting. This painting depicts several tall, jagged rock formations or mountains, rendered with varying shades of black ink wash and sharp, angular lines. Sparse, small trees and dots of foliage are scattered across the rocks, particularly in the lower left and central areas. The painting uses a limited palette of black ink on the light paper, creating a sense of depth and texture. In the bottom left corner of the painted section, two small red square seals are visible. The scroll concludes at the very bottom with another decorative band, identical to the one at the top, featuring the same repeating red and black pattern.

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicts numerous figures, mostly children, playing in a garden with a gold background
long_description: This six-panel screen painting features a vibrant garden scene populated by numerous figures, predominantly children, set against a shimmering gold background. The composition is divided by a dark blue body of water that winds through the lower and middle sections, with stylized green and gray cloud-like forms appearing in the upper left and upper right. On the far left, a figure swings over the blue water, while below, several small figures interact with a large white crane. Moving right, a bustling scene unfolds with many small figures engaged in various activities. Some are playing with drums, sticks, or fans, while others ride a green, dragon-like creature. A few taller figures, likely adults, are interspersed among the children, observing or participating. In the central panels, a raised platform or veranda is visible, where several figures are seated or reclining, including one prominently dressed individual. Below this platform, more children are actively playing, some chasing a small brown dog. The right side of the screen is dominated by a large, gnarled pine tree with dark green needles and a thick, twisted brown trunk. Behind the tree, a building with a green tiled roof and patterned walls is partially visible. Green and gray rock formations rise behind the building. The figures are depicted with light skin and wear colorful robes in shades of red, green, blue, white, and yellow.

metadata.title: 狩野永納筆　唐子遊図屏風|One Hundred Boys
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Two red horizontal panels with golden seated figures and smaller attendants, connected by a string
long_description: Two long, narrow, horizontal panels are displayed one above the other against a plain gray background. Both panels feature a series of painted figures on a red ground. The top panel presents a row of eleven golden-skinned figures seated in a meditative pose, facing forward. Each seated figure has dark hair and is depicted with hands in their lap, framed by a dark outline and a golden halo. Between these larger seated figures are smaller, lighter-skinned attendant figures, some standing, some kneeling, and some in dynamic poses. These smaller figures wear garments in shades of green, red, and light brown, and often appear to be gesturing towards the seated figures. A thin, reddish-brown string extends from the right side of this top panel, curving downwards. The bottom panel mirrors the composition of the top panel. It also displays a row of eleven golden-skinned seated figures, identical in appearance and pose to those above. They are similarly interspersed with smaller, lighter-skinned attendant figures, dressed in green, red, and light brown garments, engaged in various actions. The reddish-brown string from the top panel connects to the right side of this bottom panel, linking the two sections. The figures are rendered with clear outlines and flat areas of color, creating a repetitive yet detailed visual narrative across both strips.

alt_text: A multi-panel artwork depicting children playing by and in a river, with a boat, against a gold-flecked background
long_description: This multi-panel artwork features a serene landscape scene with children by a river, set against a light, cream-colored background heavily flecked with shimmering gold. The composition spans horizontally, depicting a wide, calm body of water with gently sloping banks. On the far left, two children are positioned near the water's edge. One child, dressed in a blue and green patterned garment, stands in the shallow water. Beside them, another child, wearing a green patterned garment, kneels and appears to be reaching into the water. In the central part of the scene, a small, light-colored boat floats close to the riverbank. Inside the boat, two more children are visible. One child, in a green patterned garment, holds a long, slender pole, extending it into the water. Another child, wearing a red and white patterned garment, is seated in the boat. To the right, a fifth child stands on the riverbank, facing towards the left. This child, dressed in a light blue patterned garment, carries a smaller child on their back. Behind them, a few sparse green bushes with delicate leaves are depicted. The water is rendered in soft washes of light blue and grey, while the land is a muted beige. The figures are small in scale compared to the expansive, luminous background, which is densely covered with gold flecks, creating a shimmering effect across the entire surface. A small, rectangular red seal is visible in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: 円山応震筆　子供遊び図屏風|Children Playing in Summer and Winter
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Ink wash landscape painting showing misty mountains, trees, and a reflective body of water on a vertical scroll
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting depicts a misty landscape rendered in shades of dark gray and black on a light brown background. The composition is structured in layers, moving from top to bottom. The upper third of the painting features indistinct, rounded mountain peaks largely obscured by a thick, light mist, with only faint outlines visible. The middle section reveals more defined, craggy mountains on both sides, framing a wide, calm body of water in the center. This water reflects the faint outlines of trees and distant landforms, and wisps of mist rise from its surface, clinging to the mountain slopes. The lower third of the painting is dominated by a large, gnarled tree with dark, dense foliage on the left, its roots extending over a cluster of rounded rocks. To the right of this tree, a smaller, bare tree stands near the water's edge. The water in the foreground is still, reflecting the sky and surrounding elements. A small, faint inscription in vertical characters is visible in the lower right corner, near the edge of the water. The painting is framed by a light blue border with a repeating pattern of small, dark floral or cloud-like motifs, and an inner thin, light beige border with a subtle pattern.

metadata.title: 清 法若真 雲山圖軸|Cloudy Mountains
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll, ink and color on silk

alt_text: A multi-panel screen depicting a battle and landscape with figures, buildings, and water, against a gold cloud background.
long_description:
This six-panel screen is predominantly gold, featuring large, stylized gold clouds with dark outlines that weave across the entire composition, separating different scenes and creating a sense of depth. The background behind the clouds is rendered in muted browns and tans, representing land and water.

The leftmost panels depict a wide expanse of water with undulating waves, rendered in shades of brown, gray, and white. Several small boats, each carrying a few figures, are visible on the water. A large white bird, possibly a crane, stands in the water near the center-left. Other small figures are scattered on small landmasses or in the water.

The central panels transition to more land-based scenes. Buildings with dark roofs and light-colored walls are nestled among green pine trees. Figures in various garments walk along paths or stand near the structures. The gold clouds continue to flow through this section, partially obscuring parts of the landscape and figures.

The rightmost panels depict a more active scene, possibly a battle. Numerous figures, many dressed in armor and carrying weapons like bows, arrows, and swords, are engaged in combat. Some figures are on horseback, while others are on foot, running up a brown, hilly terrain. More buildings and pine trees are present, with distant, dark mountains visible above the gold clouds in the upper right. The overall impression is one of dynamic movement across a rich, gold-infused landscape.

metadata.title: 新曲図屏風|“Takebun,” from the Musical Drama “The New Piece” (“Shinkyoku”)
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, gold and silver leaf on paper

alt_text: People on a building watch a woman in turbulent water, connected by ropes to a fierce dragon near mountains
long_description: The horizontal artwork depicts a dramatic scene with a building on the left, a body of water in the center, and a dragon and mountains on the right. The top and bottom edges are framed by a gold border. On the left, a light brown wooden building with a dark brown roof houses several figures. On the veranda, a group of men in various robes, some with hats, are actively pulling red ropes that extend into the water. One man in an orange robe and black hat is seated, while another in a white robe holds a sword. In the turbulent blue-grey water, a female figure in white robes with long dark hair is surrounded by swirling white foam, appearing to be pulled by the ropes. To the right, a large, green-scaled dragon with red accents on its body and a red tongue emerges from dark, swirling clouds or smoke, its mouth open. Behind the dragon, a steep, rocky mountain with green pine trees rises into a light brown sky.

metadata.title: 『大織冠』|The Great Woven Cap (Taishokkan)
metadata.medium: Three handscrolls; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A horizontal manuscript page with black text and a miniature painting of six figures on a blue background
long_description:
A horizontal manuscript page features a light beige background with dense black text in an Indic script. The text covers the left two-thirds of the page and extends to the top and bottom edges. A rectangular miniature painting is embedded on the right side, occupying about one-third of the page's width. The painting has a solid light blue background.

Within the painting, six figures are depicted. Five figures stand in a horizontal line towards the center-right. From left to right, the first figure has dark skin, wears a white dhoti and blue sash, and a white turban, embracing the second figure. The second figure has light skin, wears a yellow dhoti and red sash, and a white turban. The third figure has dark skin, wears a yellow dhoti and red sash, and a white turban, looking right. The fourth figure has light skin, wears a white dhoti and red sash, and a white turban, gesturing right. The fifth figure has light skin, wears a red dhoti and white sash, and a white turban, standing at the far right.

A sixth, smaller figure is positioned in the lower-left of the painted area. This figure has light skin, wears a white dhoti, a red sash, and a red turban, and is kneeling or crouching with both hands extended forward, palms up. Some lines of text at the very bottom of the manuscript page are written in red.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: A multi-panel screen features overlapping landscape scenes with mountains, water, trees, and decorative patterns on a gold background
long_description: This wide, horizontal multi-panel screen is predominantly gold, serving as a shimmering background for a complex, collage-like composition. Various irregularly shaped panels and sections overlap and interlock, creating a dynamic visual arrangement. On the far left, a section with a brown geometric pattern is visible at the top, partially covering a light-colored panel. This panel depicts a bird perched on a branch adorned with white blossoms. Below this, a larger, horizontal panel showcases a misty landscape with distant mountains, a prominent island-like landmass in the middle ground, and water with small boats. The colors in this landscape are muted grays, greens, and browns. To the right, a section with a gray patterned design, resembling fabric, extends diagonally. This gray pattern also forms the background for several smaller, irregularly shaped panels arranged in a zig-zag fashion across the central and right portions of the screen. These smaller panels contain diverse scenes: one features a vibrant green mountainous landscape with red-roofed buildings; another depicts a more open landscape with a large tree, a small building, and clouds; and a lower panel displays green grasses and white flowering plants against a light background. The gold background itself has a subtle grid pattern, suggesting gold leaf application. A thin black frame borders the entire screen at the top and bottom edges.

metadata.title: 屏風尽図屏風|Screens within Screens
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on gilt paper

alt_text: A detailed, multi-panel painting depicts numerous scenes of daily life within a sprawling complex of traditional buildings and gardens.
long_description: The artwork is a wide, horizontal painting composed of multiple vertical panels, likely a screen. It presents a bird's-eye view of a large, interconnected complex of buildings and gardens, rendered in a detailed, narrative style. The background is predominantly a light gold or tan, with architectural elements in shades of brown, red, and blue. The composition is divided into numerous horizontal bands by stylized blue cloud-like forms, which separate different scenes and perspectives. Within these bands, various buildings with red-tiled roofs and light-colored walls are depicted, some with open interiors revealing figures engaged in activities. Gardens with green trees, shrubs, and occasional flowering plants are interspersed between structures. Ponds and streams with blue water are also visible. Numerous small figures, dressed in traditional attire, populate the scenes. They are shown walking, conversing, riding horses, and participating in various gatherings, both indoors and outdoors. Some figures appear to be performing or observing events in courtyards. The scale of the figures is small relative to the expansive architectural and landscape elements. The overall impression is one of a bustling, active environment within a grand estate.

metadata.title: 親鸞上人絵伝|The Illustrated Life of Shinran (Shinran shōnin eden)
metadata.medium: Set of four hanging scrolls; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A multi-panel screen depicts a landscape with buildings, trees, and figures on a gold background, partially obscured by clouds
long_description: This horizontal, multi-panel screen features a detailed landscape with architectural elements and numerous figures, set against a shimmering gold background. The composition is structured by large, stylized gold cloud formations that obscure and reveal different scenes. Dark green hills and numerous pine trees with dark green needles and brown trunks are scattered throughout the landscape.On the far left, a light-colored mountain peak rises above a dark blue body of water. Below, a building with a dark roof and light walls is depicted. Inside, several figures in robes, some red and some white, are seated on green mats. Outside this building, more figures are visible near trees. Moving right, another building shows a figure in a red robe seated on a green mat. Further right, a group of figures, some in red and some in white robes, are positioned on a green slope, with architectural structures like fences and pathways nearby.The central panels continue this pattern, with various buildings, some revealing interior scenes with figures. One section shows a figure in a white robe seated alone in a building. Below, two deer are depicted near a dark pond. Towards the far right, more figures in robes are seen walking or seated near trees and buildings. A crescent moon is visible in the upper right corner of the sky. The figures are small and stylized, dressed in traditional robes of red, white, and green, engaged in various activities like sitting, walking, and conversing. The overall color palette is dominated by gold, complemented by dark greens, dark blues, whites, and reds.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Six figures in traditional robes sit outdoors among hills and a stream, beneath a cherry blossom tree
long_description: This horizontal scroll painting depicts six figures seated in an outdoor landscape. The scene is set against a pale yellow-beige background, with rolling hills in shades of light green and brown. A light blue stream flows from the left, curving through the middle ground. On the far right, a tree with delicate pink and white blossoms stands. From left to right, the figures are arranged across the middle ground. The leftmost figure wears white robes and a tall black hat, sitting facing right near the stream. Next to them, a figure in light orange-brown robes sits facing right, appearing to play a stringed instrument. Slightly behind this pair, another figure in white robes and a tall black hat also faces right. Further to the right, a figure in blue robes and a tall black hat sits facing left, positioned near a small green hill. Adjacent to this figure, another individual in orange-red robes and a tall black hat sits facing left, closer to the flowering tree. The sixth figure, also in white robes and a tall black hat, sits facing left near the base of the blossom tree. All figures are seated on the ground. On the far left of the scroll, black calligraphy is present, reading "きはしとた" and "えもとと" below it. On the far right, another section of black calligraphy reads "ちのちの" and "うつろい" below it.

metadata.title: 伝海北友雪筆　『源氏物語』　絵巻|The Tale of Genji
metadata.medium: Set of two handscrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Monochrome drawing of a central seated figure surrounded by numerous celestial beings and attendants on a lotus throne
long_description: A monochrome drawing, rendered in sepia tones, depicts a complex scene centered around a prominent seated figure. This central figure, positioned in the upper middle, has a halo behind its head and is seated on a multi-tiered lotus throne. Its hands are held in a gesture, and it wears flowing robes. Flanking the central figure are two standing figures, each with a halo and elaborate headwear, dressed in detailed garments. Below these standing figures, two more figures are depicted in dynamic poses, also with intricate clothing and possibly holding objects. The entire composition is filled with numerous smaller figures, some with halos, appearing to float amidst swirling clouds or celestial patterns. These figures are arranged in layers, extending from the sides and top of the central group. The artwork is characterized by fine line work and subtle shading, giving it an aged, detailed appearance. The overall impression is of a divine assembly or a celestial gathering.

metadata.title: 극락에서 설법하는 아미타불	조선|阿彌陀極樂會圖  朝鮮|Amitabha Buddha’s assembly in the Western Paradise
metadata.medium: Ink and traces of color on paper

alt_text: A person in a patterned kimono sits on a mat, holding a fan, with a sword nearby, against a plain background with calligraphy
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single figure seated on a mat against a plain, light brown background. The figure, positioned slightly to the left of center and occupying the lower half of the scroll, is shown in a three-quarter view, facing towards the right. They have long, dark hair pulled back, and a pale complexion. The person wears a multi-layered kimono; the outermost layer is a light brown or gold color with a subtle pattern of small, scattered floral or geometric motifs in darker tones. Beneath this, a white garment is visible at the neck and chest. The figure's left hand holds an open, white fan with dark ribs, while their right hand rests on their lap. They are seated on a rectangular mat with a red center, bordered by green and a darker blue-gray. To the right of the figure, a long, thin object resembling a sword or dagger with a light-colored blade and dark handle is visible, resting horizontally. Behind this, a red, somewhat abstract object with a curved form and a dark base is present. A fluffy, light brown fur-like object is also visible near the figure's right side. In the upper left portion of the scroll, dark vertical calligraphy reads: "枝 ちりぬるを わがみよに ふるながめせしまに 瑞光". Below this text, a red rectangular seal is visible. In the lower right corner, near the edge of the mat, the character "瑞光" is written, accompanied by a red square seal. The entire painting is framed by a dark blue border with a repeating gold geometric pattern.

metadata.title: 初代嵐橘三郎　（二代目嵐吉三郎）　の惟高親王|The Actor Arashi Kitsusaburō I (Kichisaburō II) as Prince Koretaka
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash landscape painting featuring mountains, pine trees, a bridge, and flowing water
long_description: The image is a horizontal ink wash painting on a light, aged-looking background, depicting a panoramic landscape. The composition flows from left to right, with varying densities of black and gray ink creating depth and atmosphere. On the far left, a rounded mountain peak rises, partially obscured by mist, with a circular, unpainted area resembling a moon or sun. Sparse, dark foliage is visible on a lower ridge. Moving right, a prominent, gnarled pine tree with dense, dark branches dominates the central foreground, rooted on a rugged, dark rock formation. Below this formation, dark ink suggests flowing water or a waterfall. To the right of the large pine, a narrow bridge with small, dark figures crosses a gap, connecting to another rocky outcrop. Further right, the landscape continues with more distant, misty mountains and scattered trees, rendered with lighter washes of ink. The far right shows another mountain peak, also partially enveloped in mist, with a few slender trees on its slopes. The overall impression is one of a serene, expansive natural scene.

alt_text: A gray bird perches on a branch with leaves and an orange fruit, with calligraphic text and red seals.
long_description: A painting on a light tan, rectangular sheet of paper depicts a gray bird perched on a branch. The bird, positioned slightly right of center, faces left with its head turned towards the viewer. It has a dark gray head, a prominent yellow eye with a black pupil, and a light gray-brown body with darker feathers on its back and tail. Its dark feet grip a dark brown branch that extends from the upper right towards the lower left. Above and to the left of the bird, several other dark brown branches extend, bearing leaves. Some leaves are a muted gray-brown, while others have a reddish-brown center. Below the bird, another branch extends downwards and to the left, where a single round, orange fruit, resembling a persimmon, hangs among gray-brown leaves. The background is a plain, light tan. In the upper left corner, there is vertical black calligraphic text. In the upper right corner, there are two red square seals, one above the other, and below them, another red square seal.

alt_text: A painting of two robed figures, one adult and one child, standing near a blossoming tree
long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting on light-colored, aged paper, featuring two figures and a tree rendered with ink lines and subtle washes of color. The main figure, positioned slightly left of center, stands facing towards the right. This figure wears a dark, rounded hat and long, flowing robes outlined in black ink. The robes are primarily light-colored, with faint hints of red and yellow visible in some areas. Behind and slightly to the left of the main figure is a smaller, child-like figure, partially obscured by the larger one. This smaller figure also wears robes with dark outlines and appears to be looking in the same direction. To the right of the figures, a tree with a slender, dark trunk and delicate branches extends upwards and towards the right. The branches are adorned with numerous small, light-colored blossoms or leaves, depicted with fine dots and light washes. The ground beneath the figures and the tree is suggested by soft, irregular washes of light brown and grey, creating a gentle slope or uneven terrain. The upper portion of the background is left largely unadorned, maintaining the light, neutral tone of the paper. In the bottom left corner, a small, square red seal is visible.

alt_text: A painting depicts an elderly person with a long white beard and hair, holding green leaves
long_description: A vertical painting on light, aged paper depicts an elderly person from the chest up, facing slightly to the right. The figure has light-toned skin with a reddish tint on the cheeks and hands. Long, flowing white hair extends from the head down past the shoulders, and a very long, full white beard covers the chin and chest, blending with the hair. The eyes are narrow, and the nose is broad. The figure wears a loose-fitting, light beige or off-white robe with darker outlines and faint gray vertical markings. The right hand, positioned centrally, holds several long, slender green leaves or blades of grass. The background is a plain, light cream color, showing some discoloration consistent with age. On the right side of the painting, there are vertical lines of dark script and two square red seals, stacked one above the other. The entire artwork is mounted between two horizontal black bars at the top and bottom.

alt_text: Two smiling figures stand beneath a gnarled pine tree in an ink wash painting on a scroll
long_description: The image is a vertical ink wash painting on a light brown scroll, depicting two figures beneath a pine tree. The background is a plain, light tan color. In the lower right quadrant, a gnarled pine tree trunk rises, its branches extending upwards and to the left, covered in clusters of short, needle-like leaves. The tree's bark is rendered with textured ink strokes, suggesting age and ruggedness. Below the tree, in the lower center, two figures stand on a patch of ground indicated by light ink washes. Both figures are depicted with smiling, round faces and wear loose, flowing garments. The figure on the left is slightly behind and to the left of the figure on the right, with their heads close together. The figure on the right holds a thin, dark object, possibly a staff or a closed fan, in their right hand. The ink work uses varying shades of black, from fine lines defining facial features and clothing folds to broader washes for the tree trunk and shadows, creating a sense of depth and form against the light background. The overall composition is balanced, with the tree dominating the upper and right portions and the figures anchoring the lower center.

alt_text: A line drawing on aged paper depicts a person in traditional attire riding a horse
long_description: A monochrome line drawing on a light-colored, aged sheet of paper depicts a person riding a horse. The paper is rectangular with slightly curled edges and is held by two dark, rectangular clips at the top and bottom. The drawing occupies the central area, featuring a person on horseback, facing towards the left. The horse is shown in profile with its front legs raised, suggesting movement. Its mane and tail are long and flowing, rendered with multiple lines. The horse's head is adorned with a decorative bridle that resembles a dragon's head, complete with prominent eyes and a snout. The rider is seated upright, wearing a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves. A sword is visible at their left hip. Their hair is styled in an elaborate bun on top of their head, and they have a round face. They hold reins connected to the horse's bridle. Behind the person's head, a fan-like or spiky element extends outwards. The drawing uses black lines with light gray wash for shading on the robe and horse. The paper is a yellowish-beige with some brown stains.

alt_text: Full-frontal portrait of a seated figure in elaborate traditional attire, holding a scepter.
long_description: A full-frontal portrait of a seated figure, likely a man, is depicted on a light-colored paper, possibly a scroll, which is held down by four black rectangular weights at its corners. The figure has a light complexion, a thin black beard, and a mustache, with visible red lips. They wear an elaborate hat with a dark, possibly green or black, main body, topped with a red, rectangular structure. Small red and green dots are visible along the hat's edges, connected by thin red lines. The figure is dressed in a light-colored, possibly cream or pale yellow, robe with wide sleeves. Red and green trim is visible on the collar and cuffs. The figure's hands are clasped in front, holding a long, slender, light green scepter or tablet vertically. The figure is seated on a chair with armrests that feature decorative elements resembling golden dragons with green and red accents. The background is plain, light-colored paper, showing faint grid lines and some discoloration. There are faint red markings on the right side of the paper. On the left sleeve, faint black characters are visible, one of which appears to be '个'.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a small bird perched on a bamboo branch, on a vertical scroll with calligraphy
long_description: The image displays a vertical ink wash painting on a light beige paper. A tall, segmented bamboo stalk dominates the central axis of the composition, rendered in various shades of grey and brown ink, with darker bands indicating the nodes. To the left of the upper half of the bamboo, a small, fluffy bird is perched on a slender branch that extends horizontally from the left. The bird faces slightly right, with visible details on its head and body, and a short tail. Several bamboo leaves, painted in darker, more opaque ink, are clustered around the upper part of the bamboo stalk and near the bird. In the lower right quadrant, vertical calligraphic characters are visible, rendered in dark ink, with a faint circular red seal beneath them. The overall impression is a minimalist composition with a focus on natural elements.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of birds on branches and a rock, with a signature seal
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on aged, light cream-colored paper depicts several birds and natural elements in shades of dark brown, black, and sepia. The paper shows several horizontal creases across its surface. At the top left, a small bird with a light belly and dark back perches on a thin, dark branch that extends upwards and to the right. Other thin, dark branches with small, dark buds or leaves extend from the left. Below this, in the middle of the composition, a larger bird stands on a dark, textured mass that resembles a rock or tree stump. This bird has a patterned body with lighter underparts, a dark back, and a slightly ruffled crest. Its beak is open, facing upwards and to the right. Further down, towards the bottom left, two smaller birds are perched on a gnarled, dark branch or root structure. One bird faces left, the other faces right, both with open beaks. In the bottom left corner, a vertical line of dark text is visible, ending in a circular dark seal.

alt_text: A large, detailed dragon with scales and claws, surrounded by swirling clouds and waves in a monochrome drawing
long_description: The image displays a monochrome drawing, likely ink on aged paper, featuring a large, serpentine dragon. The dragon's body coils dynamically across the central and upper sections of the composition. Its head, positioned towards the upper right, has prominent eyes, horns, and a long snout, with visible sharp teeth in its open mouth. The dragon's body is intricately detailed with scales and spiky protrusions running along its back. Four powerful limbs, each ending in sharp claws, extend from its body. The dragon is enveloped by swirling patterns that represent clouds and waves. Darker shading creates depth and texture, particularly around the dragon's form and within the cloud formations. Lighter, more abstract wave-like patterns are visible in the background, especially in the upper right and lower left corners. The overall color palette consists of various shades of gray, black, and muted browns, suggesting an aged artwork. The paper itself appears somewhat discolored and textured, contributing to the antique aesthetic. The composition is dynamic, conveying movement through the dragon's coiled posture and the surrounding atmospheric elements.

alt_text: Ink wash drawing of a horse on light paper, rendered with dynamic brushstrokes, facing right
long_description: An ink wash drawing depicts a horse in a dynamic pose on a light beige, rectangular sheet of paper. The paper appears to be creased or folded, creating a faint grid pattern across its surface. The horse, rendered in shades of dark brown and black ink, is positioned centrally, facing towards the right with its head slightly turned towards the viewer. Its front legs are lifted, suggesting a rearing or prancing motion, while its hind legs are more grounded. The artist uses expressive, varied brushstrokes; broad, sweeping strokes define the horse's body, particularly its chest and hindquarters, while finer lines delineate its legs and facial features. The mane is a dense, textured area of darker ink, contrasting with the lighter, more open strokes of the body. The background is plain, allowing the horse to be the sole focus of the composition. A vertical inscription, consisting of several characters, is visible in the lower right corner of the artwork.

alt_text: Ink painting of a dragon in swirling clouds above a leaping tiger on a vertical scroll
long_description: A vertical ink painting on light-colored paper depicts a dragon in the upper section and a tiger in the lower section. The dragon, rendered in dark and medium grey ink washes, dominates the top third of the scroll. It has a serpentine body, a detailed head with prominent eyes and a flowing mane, and sharp claws. It is surrounded by swirling, dark grey clouds and lighter mist, suggesting movement and power. Below the dragon, a transitional area features vertical, wavy lines in lighter grey, creating a sense of atmospheric flow or water. The lower half of the scroll is occupied by a tiger, also depicted in black and grey ink. The tiger is shown in a dynamic, leaping or rearing pose, with its head turned upwards towards the dragon. Its body is covered in distinct dark grey stripes against a lighter grey base, and its long, spotted tail extends to the left. The background throughout the scroll is a uniform light beige or tan, with some subtle variations in tone from the ink washes.

alt_text: A detailed ink drawing of a large, scaled dragon emerging from swirling clouds on aged paper
long_description: A vertical drawing on light brown, aged paper depicts a large, serpentine dragon rendered in shades of gray and black ink. The paper shows visible creases and a slightly mottled texture. The dragon's head is positioned towards the top of the composition, facing left, with a long snout, prominent eyes, and a flowing mane or whiskers. Its body extends downwards, covered in distinct scales and featuring a spiky ridge along its back. Four powerful, clawed limbs are visible, two near the upper body and two further down, each with sharp talons. The dragon is depicted amidst swirling clouds, which are rendered with softer, lighter gray washes, creating a contrast with the darker, more defined lines of the dragon. The clouds fill the background around the creature, with some areas of the paper left lighter. Towards the bottom of the drawing, sections of the dragon's lower body or tail are visible, also surrounded by the cloudy environment. The overall composition suggests a dynamic, powerful creature in motion.

alt_text: A horizontal scroll painting depicts a landscape with rolling hills, blossoming trees, a building, and two figures.
long_description: This horizontal scroll painting features a muted landscape scene with two figures on a light beige paper background. The paper shows faint vertical and horizontal fold lines. The left two-thirds of the composition are dominated by a landscape. Rolling hills, rendered in soft gray and green washes, recede into the background. Scattered across these hills and in the mid-ground are numerous trees, some depicted with delicate light pink or reddish blossoms, and others with white blossoms. Nestled among the trees on a gentle slope is a small, simple building with a thatched roof. The foreground in this section contains sparse green foliage, indicated by light brushstrokes. The right third of the painting features two figures walking towards the left. The taller figure wears a long, flowing robe and a distinct tall, dark hat. Beside them, a smaller figure in a simple robe walks. Both figures are rendered with minimal detail, primarily outlines in dark ink. The foreground in this section also includes sparse green foliage. The overall color palette is subtle, with soft greens, grays, and hints of light pink and red against the dominant beige of the paper. The painting is framed on the far left and right by dark, rectangular wooden scroll rollers.

alt_text: Three men in traditional robes sit on the ground, one bearded, surrounded by long, thin objects.
long_description: The artwork is a watercolor painting on a light, off-white paper, depicting three men seated on the ground. The figures are rendered with black outlines and washes of color. In the center, a man with a dark beard and mustache sits facing forward, wearing a dark gray outer robe over a lighter, possibly white, inner garment. He holds a long, thin, light-colored object, possibly a sword or scabbard, horizontally across his lap. Above him, vertical lines of black text are visible. To the left, a man with a dark topknot sits in a green robe, turned slightly to his right, looking towards the central figure. His hands are resting on his lap. To his left, more vertical lines of black text are present. To the right, another man with a dark topknot sits in a blue robe, also turned slightly to his left, looking towards the central figure. He holds a small, dark, rectangular object in his hands. Above him, additional vertical lines of black text are visible. On the ground in front of the men, several long, thin, light brown objects, resembling sword blades or scabbards, are laid out. The background is plain and unadorned. The overall impression is of a gathering or discussion.

alt_text: Ink painting of several birds perched on branches amidst leafy plants, with calligraphic text and a red seal.
long_description: This horizontal ink painting on a light, aged paper depicts a scene with multiple birds and plants. On the far left, two small, brown-and-white birds with striped backs are perched on a thin, dark branch. Above and to their left, dense clusters of light gray-brown leaves, resembling wisteria, hang down. At the bottom left, a few slender, segmented horsetail-like plants emerge from the ground line. In the center, a larger, mostly white bird with black wing tips and a faint pinkish-red beak is perched on a thick, gnarled brown branch. Its beak is open, and its feet are also a faint pinkish-red. Above and slightly behind this bird, a smaller, light brown bird with a pale belly is perched on a thinner branch, appearing to hold a small, light object in its beak. The thick, gnarled branch extends towards the right side of the composition. On the far right, several vertical lines of black calligraphic text are visible, below which is a square red seal impression. The background is a uniform light cream color, showing some faint brown discoloration and creases consistent with an aged scroll.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a bearded man in a hat leading a monkey on a leash.
long_description: An ink wash painting on a light, cream-colored paper depicts two figures within a faint, irregular oval outline. The artwork is rendered in varying shades of grey and brown ink. On the left side, a bearded man stands, facing right. He wears a tall, pointed hat and loose-fitting robes. His face shows a long beard and mustache, and his eyes are small. He holds a thin, dark line, resembling a leash or rope, in his right hand. This line extends towards the right, connecting to the second figure. The second figure, a monkey, is positioned to the right of the man, facing right and slightly forward. The monkey is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose, with its arms extended forward, holding a thin stick horizontally. Its tail is not clearly visible. The background of the painting is entirely blank, providing no contextual elements beyond the two figures. A small, dark inscription, "M 39631", is visible in the bottom right corner of the paper, outside the oval outline.

alt_text: A horizontal painting depicts seven horses of various colors and poses on a light background with Japanese text.
long_description: A long, horizontal painting on aged, light-colored paper features a procession of seven horses from left to right. The background is a plain, light beige with some faint vertical lines and discoloration, suggesting a scroll or screen. Starting from the left, a partial view of a light-colored horse is visible. Next, a black horse rears on its hind legs, its head turned towards the viewer. Behind it, a light brown horse stands facing right. Above these horses, vertical Japanese text is visible, including "馬足" (Umaashi), "黒" (Kuro), and "栗毛" (Kurige), some within red rectangular outlines. Moving right, a white or light grey horse walks forward, its head slightly lowered. Above it, text reads "五明" (Gomei). Following this, another light grey horse stands, with text "白毛" (Shiroge) above it. A light brown horse with a darker mane and tail stands next, lifting one front leg, with text "鹿毛" (Kage) above. The final horse on the far right is a light tan color, standing still and facing right. Above this horse, text includes "ハロック" (Harokku) and "ツキミツ" (Tsukimitsu). All horses are rendered with subtle shading, giving them a three-dimensional quality against the flat background.

alt_text: A horizontal painting depicts nine water buffalo in various shades of brown and gray, standing on a light ground with text
long_description: The horizontal painting features nine water buffalo arranged across a light, unadorned background. The ground beneath them is a pale tan, with sparse dark specks suggesting patches of grass or dirt. The buffalo vary in color, including shades of light tan, gray, dark brown, reddish-brown, and black. Starting from the left, a light tan buffalo with curved horns faces right.
