To its right, a gray buffalo and a lighter tan buffalo stand, both facing right. Behind them, a dark brown buffalo with its back to the viewer and a lighter brown buffalo with its head down are positioned. Further right, a reddish-brown buffalo faces right, while a dark black buffalo with prominent horns stands behind it, facing right. To the far right, two dark gray and black buffalo stand, one facing right and the other facing left. All buffalo have large, curved horns. Vertical lines, possibly folds in the scroll, are visible across the light background. Several columns of dark, vertical text, likely Japanese characters, are interspersed among the buffalo, appearing above and between them.

alt_text: A detailed narrative painting showing numerous figures on and around a red bridge, with buildings and landscape elements
long_description:
This horizontal painting depicts a complex narrative scene with multiple figures, architectural elements, and natural landscapes, all partially obscured by stylized clouds. The overall color palette is muted, featuring light blues, greens, and browns, accented by vibrant reds and some darker details. The scene is horizontally divided by several wavy, light-colored cloud bands that create a sense of depth and separate different narrative sections.

A prominent red arched bridge with railings spans the middle of the composition, connecting two landmasses. On and around the bridge, numerous figures are depicted. Many figures wear robes; some have halos around their heads. On the left side of the bridge, a group of figures, some carrying objects or riding animals, appears to be approaching or crossing. Several figures with halos are walking on the bridge itself.

Below the bridge on the left, more figures are gathered near a building with a distinctive roofline. Some figures appear to be kneeling or standing in groups. Further left and slightly above, more figures are visible, some with elaborate headwear. To the right of the bridge, a few figures are seen near a small structure. Further right and below, another building with a multi-tiered roof is visible, and more figures are scattered in the landscape, some engaged in activities like running or carrying items. The landscape includes pine trees, rolling hills, and a few flowering trees. The top and bottom edges of the painting feature decorative borders, and the main scene is framed by a dark blue border with a subtle pattern.

metadata.title: 秋夜長物語絵巻断簡|The Final Scene from A Long Tale for an Autumn Night (Aki no yonaga monogatari)
metadata.medium: Fragment of a handscroll mounted as a hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A large, pale, seated figure with a halo, flanked by two smaller seated figures, surrounded by many other figures within a floral border
long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting depicting a central, large, pale-skinned figure seated in a meditative posture, facing forward. This figure has dark hair, closed eyes, and a serene expression. A large, circular, golden halo surrounds its head, and a fainter, larger golden aura encircles its body. The figure wears pale, flowing robes that gather in soft folds and sits upon a multi-tiered, ornate pedestal in shades of dark red and gold. Directly below the central figure, on either side of the pedestal, are two smaller, similarly pale-skinned figures, also seated in meditative poses and facing forward, each with a halo and pale robes. The figure on the left is partially obscured by a staff-like object with a red banner. The lower half of the painting is densely populated with numerous smaller figures, varying in size, color, and posture. These figures include human-like forms and more stylized or monstrous beings with red skin, multiple arms, or elaborate headdresses. They are arranged in a dynamic, swirling composition, with some appearing to float or fly, and others standing or kneeling. The background is a muted green-brown, and the figures are rendered in reds, blues, greens, and browns, with gold accents. The entire composition is framed by a wide, vertical border on the left and right, featuring a repeating pattern of golden floral motifs against a dark background, with narrower horizontal gold borders at the top and bottom. At the very top, a small, stylized, winged motif in red and gold is visible, with several faint circular elements below it.

metadata.title: 釈迦三尊十六善神像|Shaka (Shakyamuni), the Historical Buddha, with Two Attendant Bodhisattvas and Sixteen Benevolent Deities
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gold, and cut gold on silk

alt_text: Ink drawing of an elephant attacking a horse and rider during a battle
long_description: This uncolored ink drawing on light-toned paper depicts a dynamic battle scene. The composition is horizontally oriented, with a large elephant dominating the right side, facing left. A rider sits atop the elephant, holding a goad. The elephant's trunk is wrapped around a fallen human figure on the ground, while its front left foot is raised over another figure. To the left of the elephant, a horse rears, facing right, appearing to recoil from the elephant's attack. Below the horse, another human figure is on the ground. Further to the left, a line of soldiers on horseback, armed with spears and rifles, advances towards the right. Behind them, a second line of soldiers on foot also carries weapons. In the far background, a smaller, less detailed line of figures suggests more troops. The background also features rolling hills and a few sparse trees on the right. The drawing uses fine, consistent lines to render detailed figures, clothing, and weaponry.

alt_text: A tall, white crane with a black neck and red head stands centrally on a light background, depicted in ink wash
long_description: The artwork is a vertical hanging scroll featuring a single crane rendered in an ink wash style. The crane stands centrally, facing directly forward, its long, slender body occupying most of the vertical space. Its head, positioned at the top, is small with a prominent red patch on its crown and a dark, pointed beak. The neck is long and thin, rendered in dark grey or black ink, gradually widening into the bird's body. The main body of the crane is depicted in white, with subtle outlines defining its form. The tips of its wings, visible on either side of its lower back, are rendered in dark grey or black, creating a contrast with the white body. Two very long, thin legs, also in dark grey or black, extend downwards, ending in splayed, three-toed feet with small claws. The background is a soft, light grey wash, with subtle horizontal brushstrokes suggesting an atmospheric effect. The central image is framed by a series of borders. The top and bottom borders are a textured brownish-gold. The side borders are a muted grey with a repeating, subtle pattern resembling stylized clouds or waves.

metadata.title: 鶴図|Cranes
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Three black birds fly left, two light birds perch right on a branch, against a gold background
long_description: This two-panel artwork features a gold background with birds. The left panel shows three black birds in various flight poses. Two are in the upper left, one slightly above and behind the other, both with wings spread, facing generally right. The third black bird is in the lower left, flying upwards and to the right, also with wings spread. The birds are rendered in solid black ink with some visible feather details. A small, dark calligraphic mark is present in the lower left corner of this panel. The right panel depicts two light-colored birds, appearing white or pale gray, perched on a thick, dark, gnarled branch. The branch extends from the lower right towards the center of the panel. The bird in the foreground faces left, its head slightly lowered, with long, slender legs gripping the branch. The bird behind it faces right, its head held higher. Both birds have long, pointed beaks. Above the branch, several thin, dark stems with small, elongated, leaf-like or seed pod structures hang down. A small, dark calligraphic mark is in the lower right corner of this panel. The background throughout both panels is a uniform gold, showing a subtle grid pattern. The entire artwork is enclosed by a dark border featuring a repeating pattern of light-colored floral or geometric motifs.

metadata.title: 柴田是真筆　烏鷺図屏風|Egrets and Crows
metadata.medium: Individual panels remounted as a two-panel folding screen; colored lacquer, white pigment, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: Monochrome ink painting of a seated figure with raised arm and flowing robes, alongside vertical calligraphy.
long_description: The artwork is a monochrome ink painting on a light-colored surface, framed by a brown border with a decorative inner band. The central element is a figure, rendered with fluid black ink strokes, occupying the lower left and central portion of the composition. The figure is depicted in profile, facing left, appearing to be seated or kneeling. Their body forms a large, rounded shape, suggested by broad, sweeping lines that define voluminous robes. The head is small and positioned at the top of the body, with minimal detail. The figure's right arm is raised upwards, with the hand appearing to gesture or hold a small, indistinct object. The left arm is less defined, blending into the drapery. A faint, thin horizontal line extends from beneath the figure's base towards the right side of the painting. In the upper right quadrant, there is a block of vertical calligraphy in black ink, arranged in several columns. Below and slightly to the left of the calligraphy, a square red seal impression is visible. The background is a plain, light gray or off-white, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink lines.

metadata.title: 風外慧薫筆　指月布袋図|Hotei Pointing at the Moon

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows a woman in a patterned kimono beneath calligraphic text.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting, primarily light beige, framed by a patterned border. The upper half of the scroll features multiple columns of black calligraphic text, arranged vertically from right to left. Below the text, a woman is depicted standing, facing slightly to the left, with her head turned towards the viewer. She wears an elaborate, long-sleeved kimono with a train that extends to the bottom edge of the painting. Her kimono is predominantly dark green and black, adorned with vibrant patterns in red, blue, and gold. A prominent circular green motif is visible on her right sleeve. Her left hand is raised to her head, touching her dark, styled hair, which includes red accents. Her face is pale with delicate features, and her lips are red. A small red rectangular seal is visible to the right of her lower body. The background behind the woman is a plain, light beige. The scroll is bordered by a repeating light blue and white geometric pattern.

metadata.title: 花魁図|Parading Courtesan
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A white egret stands in shallow water beneath white hibiscus flowers, bamboo, and a gnarled tree trunk.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting on a light, muted gold background. In the upper right quadrant, a cluster of white hibiscus-like flowers with yellow centers blooms from a dark, gnarled tree trunk that extends vertically down the right side. The flowers have large, dark green, lobed leaves. Thin, dark green bamboo stalks with slender leaves emerge from behind the flowers and extend upwards and to the left. The tree trunk is textured with dark brown and black markings, suggesting bark or moss. In the lower left quadrant, a large white egret stands in shallow water, facing right. Its long, slender neck is curved, and its head is tilted upwards with its beak open. A small, pointed crest extends from the back of its head. Its feathers are depicted with soft, flowing brushstrokes, particularly on its body and tail. Its long, thin legs are visible in the water, which is indicated by subtle horizontal lines and small, dark brown and gray rocks or clumps of earth. A second egret's head and neck are faintly visible behind the main egret, facing downwards. A vertical column of dark characters is visible on the right side, near the bottom of the tree trunk, followed by a red square seal. The entire painting is framed by a decorative border: a narrow, patterned green band at the top and bottom, and a wider, mottled gold border along the left and right edges.

metadata.title: 土佐光起筆　芙蓉白鷺図|Egrets and Cotton Roses
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A speckled bird with an open beak perches on a flowering plum branch above bamboo and water
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a bird and flowering branches. The central image is on a light brown or tan paper, framed by decorative green fabric borders. In the lower half of the central panel, a bird with speckled brown and white plumage is perched on a thick, gnarled branch. Its beak is open, suggesting it is singing or calling, and its head feathers appear slightly ruffled. The branch extends from the right, curving downwards and to the left, with smaller twigs branching off. Several clusters of light pink or white plum blossoms with red centers are visible on these branches, particularly in the upper right and lower left of the bird. Below the main branch, a few green bamboo leaves are depicted, extending upwards from the lower right. Towards the bottom of the painting, a faint horizontal line suggests a body of water, with a few blades of dark green grass emerging from the water's edge on the left. A small, irregular red seal impression is visible in the lower left corner of the central panel. The upper half of the painting is largely empty, with only a few sparse plum branches extending from the right side. The overall impression is one of a natural scene with a focus on the bird and its immediate surroundings.

metadata.title: 狩野松栄筆 梅鵯図|Brown-Eared Bulbul (Hiyodori) on a Branch of Plum
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A figure in a red and white patterned garment looks over their shoulder against a golden background with white flecks
long_description: A vertical artwork depicts a standing figure, seen from the back, slightly turned to the left, looking over their left shoulder. The figure wears a long, flowing garment, predominantly red, with wide white sleeves and a white collar. The white sections and the lower part of the red garment are adorned with a repeating pattern of dark, possibly black, floral or leaf motifs. A wide, white sash (obi) is tied around the waist. The figure's dark hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The background is a plain, light golden-brown color, possibly gold leaf, with numerous small, scattered white flecks across its surface. To the right of the figure, a vertical element resembling a bamboo blind or screen is partially visible. The figure stands on a light-colored surface with faint horizontal lines, suggesting floorboards. On the right side of the golden background, near the figure's lower body, there is a column of vertical text followed by a small red seal. The central painting is framed by a wide, dark blue border featuring a repeating pattern of gold floral motifs and swirling cloud-like shapes.

metadata.title: 雪中縁先美人図|Beauty on a Veranda in Snow
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono stands beside a koto, with calligraphy on a scroll.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a full-length image of a woman in traditional attire, standing slightly right of center against a plain, light tan background. Her head is tilted downwards and to the left. She has dark hair styled in an elaborate bun, adorned with gold hairpins. Her face is pale with delicate features, including red lips and dark eyebrows. She wears a multi-layered kimono. The outermost layer is dark, possibly black or deep blue, and features a prominent pattern of peacock feathers with iridescent blue and green 'eyes' and gold accents. Beneath this, visible at the collar and sleeves, are layers of white fabric trimmed with red, and another layer with a green and light blue floral or geometric design. A wide, brown sash (obi) is wrapped around her waist. The kimono flares out at the bottom, revealing a red and white floral pattern, possibly cherry blossoms, on the lining. To the right of the woman, on the floor, rests a koto, a long, dark brown stringed instrument with a curved, lighter-colored bridge at one end and several small, white, movable bridges along its length. A small, dark, round object lies near the far end of the koto. On the left side of the scroll, several vertical lines of black Japanese calligraphy are visible. Below the calligraphy, near the woman's right shoulder, are two red square seals. The scroll is framed by decorative borders: a repeating pattern of gold and dark shapes at the top and bottom, and a lighter, patterned border along the sides.

metadata.title: 歌川豊春筆　蜀山人（大田 南畝）賛　 琴に立美人図|Female Entertainer with a Koto
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical painting depicts numerous white egrets standing and flying amidst green lotus leaves and pink blossoms.
long_description:
This tall, vertical painting features a serene natural scene dominated by white egrets and green lotus plants against a pale, yellowish-beige background. The background suggests a misty or watery environment, with subtle variations in tone.

In the lower and middle sections, numerous large, round lotus leaves in various shades of green are densely clustered, appearing to float on water. Interspersed among these leaves are several delicate pink lotus blossoms, some fully open and others still budding. Thin, reedy grasses in muted greens and browns also emerge from the water in places.

A significant number of white egrets populate the scene. In the lower foreground, a cluster of approximately ten egrets stands close together among the lotus leaves, some with their heads lowered, others standing tall. Their bright white plumage stands out against the darker greens. Further up, more egrets are scattered individually or in small groups among the foliage, some appearing to walk or wade. In the upper right portion of the painting, a diagonal line of six smaller white birds, likely egrets, are depicted in various stages of flight, ascending towards the top right corner.

In the upper left corner, a column of dark, calligraphic text is visible, accompanied by two square red seals below it.

metadata.title: 山本梅逸筆　蓮池白鷺図|Egrets in a Lotus Pond
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts an owl perched on a gnarled pine branch against a large full moon.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts an owl perched on a pine branch against a large, pale full moon. The artwork is framed by a teal border with a subtle gold patterned design at the top and bottom. The central image features a light-colored background, with a prominent circular moon dominating the upper right half of the composition. The moon is rendered as a large, light gray circle with faint, darker gray brushstrokes radiating slightly from its edges, suggesting a soft glow. In the upper left, a gnarled pine branch extends diagonally downwards and to the right. Its trunk is depicted with dark, textured lines, and clusters of sharp, dark pine needles are visible. An owl, rendered in shades of black and gray, is perched on a lower section of this branch, slightly to the right of the center. The owl faces forward, its body covered in intricate feather patterns. It has large, round eyes with dark pupils and light irises, and a small, dark beak. Its talons grip the branch. Below the owl and to the left, a small red square seal and faint, vertical script are visible on the light background.

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts red, white, and light blue poppies with green leaves and buds.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a central image of a cluster of poppies and their foliage against a plain, light beige background. The central panel is bordered on the sides by a gray fabric with a subtle geometric pattern, and at the top and bottom by a narrower strip of light beige fabric adorned with a swirling gold vine motif. The poppies are concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the central panel. There are several large, open blossoms in varying shades of red, white, and a pale purplish-blue. Two prominent red poppies are visible, one positioned towards the upper left of the floral cluster, and another slightly lower and to the right, displaying ruffled petals. Three white poppies are also present: a large, fully open one to the left, and two smaller, partially open ones below it. A single pale purplish-blue poppy, with its petals slightly curled, is situated on the lower right side of the arrangement. Slender green stems support the blossoms and leaves, some exhibiting gentle curves. The leaves are broad, lobed, and dark green, with visible veins, forming a dense cluster around the base of the flowers. Several closed poppy buds, oval-shaped and green, are depicted on thin stems; one is prominently placed at the very top of the floral arrangement, and another is visible further to the right. Subtle, lighter green, feathery foliage is rendered in the background behind the main poppy cluster, particularly noticeable on the lower left side. In the lower right corner of the central panel, there is a vertical inscription in black characters, accompanied by a red square seal.

metadata.title: 鈴木其一筆　芥子図|Poppies
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Three light-colored birds among white blossoming branches, a gnarled tree, and ground with rocks
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts three light-colored birds in a natural setting against a light brown background. In the upper middle, a light grey bird with a white belly is perched on a dark, gnarled branch adorned with numerous small white blossoms. The branch extends from the upper right, curving downwards and to the left. Below and to the right of the perched bird, another light grey bird is shown in mid-flight, descending towards the lower right. In the lower left, a third light grey bird stands on a small cluster of dark rocks, bending its head downwards. To the right of this bird, a large, dark brown tree trunk with a textured surface rises, with several green bamboo leaves emerging from behind it. The ground in the lower section is a light brown wash, featuring small green mounds and additional dark rocks. A faint, lighter area in the lower middle suggests a body of water. A small red seal and some dark script are visible in the lower right corner. The central painting is framed by a dark green border with a repeating gold pattern, and narrower, lighter patterned borders are at the very top and bottom.

metadata.title: 清原雪信筆　緋連雀桜竹図|Waxwings, Cherry Blossoms, and Bamboo
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two robed figures, one with a tall hat and one with a conical hat, walk through a green, hilly landscape.
long_description: The artwork features a fan-shaped painting set against a light tan background, framed by a green border with gold patterns. The fan painting depicts a landscape scene with two figures. On the left, a standing figure wears a tall black hat and a white robe with light blue patterns. This figure holds a thin white object vertically in their right hand. To the right, a second figure walks along a path, wearing a large, light-colored conical hat and a light grey robe. This figure carries a tall, rectangular, ladder-like object on their back and holds a staff in their left hand. The landscape consists of rolling green hills with scattered small trees, some resembling pines, and a winding path. The background features a muted, cloudy sky in shades of brown and grey. The ground is a light tan color, contrasting with the darker green of the hills.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fan mounted as a hanging scroll

alt_text: A horizontal scroll painting depicting a procession of people, oxen, and carts, with a seated figure and text.
long_description: This horizontal scroll features a central painted and inscribed panel, bordered by decorative fabric. The central panel depicts a narrative scene with multiple figures, oxen, and carts, moving generally from left to right, culminating in a gathering around a seated figure on the far right. On the left, two figures, one in a dark robe and another in a light blue robe, carry a red, open palanquin-like structure over a stylized blue and white wavy landscape element, possibly a river or path. To their right, a reddish-brown ox with white horns pulls a two-wheeled cart with a green canopy. A figure in a red robe sits atop this ox. Following this, another reddish-brown ox pulls a similar two-wheeled cart with a green canopy, with a figure in a blue robe walking alongside it. Further to the right, a group of figures is assembled. A central figure, dressed in a light brown robe, sits cross-legged on a square, patterned platform. Several other figures, dressed in robes of red, blue, green, and brown, stand around the seated figure, some appearing to gesture or converse. The background of the scene is a light, off-white color, with sparse, stylized trees. Below and to the right of the figures, a substantial block of vertical calligraphic text in black ink occupies the lower right portion of the central panel. The entire central panel is framed by a green border adorned with a gold floral pattern. This is further framed by wider brown fabric borders, also featuring a subtle gold floral pattern, at the top and bottom of the scroll.

metadata.title: 『過去現在絵因果経』　断簡　(松永本)|The Illustrated Sutra of Past and Present Karma (Kako genzai inga kyō emaki)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A two-panel artwork with Chinese calligraphy on the left and an ink landscape painting of mountains and a bridge on the right
long_description: The artwork is presented on a light, off-white background, divided into two vertical panels. The left panel is filled with vertical lines of black Chinese calligraphy, written from top to bottom and right to left. The characters are dense and uniform in size. Towards the bottom left, a square red seal is visible, partially overlapping the calligraphy. The right panel features a monochromatic ink painting of a mountainous landscape. The composition is dominated by tall, jagged mountains rendered with dark ink washes and fine lines, creating a sense of depth and texture. The mountains rise steeply, with a prominent, narrow bridge connecting two peaks in the upper-middle section. Below the bridge, the mountains continue downwards, revealing small, simple structures nestled at their bases and on various ledges. A few sparse trees or bushes are depicted on the mountain slopes. In the lower right quadrant of this panel, a vertical inscription in smaller black characters is present, accompanied by two square red seals, one above the other. The overall impression is of a dramatic, rugged natural scene.

metadata.title: 鄭旼  黃山八景  水墨紙本  九開冊|Eight views of the Yellow Mountains
metadata.medium: Album of nine leaves of painting and calligraphy; ink on paper

alt_text: Minimalist ink painting of a stout, robed figure with a hat, staff, and calligraphic text.
long_description: This vertical scroll features a minimalist ink painting of a single figure on a light, unadorned background. The central figure is rendered with broad, expressive black ink strokes, creating a stout, rounded form. The figure wears a dark, stacked hat on its head, with lighter, vertical strokes suggesting a face or beard beneath. A wide, dark, circular collar or neck opening defines the upper body, which is a large, rounded shape. From behind the figure's head, a thin, dark vertical line extends upwards, suggesting a staff or bundle. On the left side of the figure, several vertical lines of black calligraphic text are visible, with a small, square red seal positioned below them. The artwork is framed by a narrow, brown decorative border at the top and bottom, featuring repeating gold floral or abstract patterns and thin blue curved lines. These inner borders are further framed by wider, plain light-yellow borders on all four sides.

metadata.title: 「天満宮」　渡唐天神図|“Tenmangū,” Sugawara no Michizane as Tenjin Traveling to China

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a small bird perched on a bamboo stalk with accompanying calligraphy.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on light beige paper features a small bird perched on a bamboo stalk with accompanying calligraphy. The slender bamboo stalk runs vertically along the left side of the composition, rendered with varying shades of black ink, suggesting depth and texture. A small, light-colored bird with dark markings on its head and wings is perched on a thin branch extending from the bamboo in the upper left quadrant. Its beak is open, facing slightly upwards, as if singing. To the right and slightly above the bird, two broad, dark ink strokes represent bamboo leaves, rendered with a fluid, expressive style. A column of black ink calligraphy occupies the central right portion of the paper, flowing downwards in a series of elegant, connected characters. Below this main text, a smaller block of calligraphy is visible, followed by two distinct red seals, one square and one rectangular, stacked vertically. The background is a uniform, light beige, providing a stark contrast to the black ink elements.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆亀田鵬斎賛 竹雀図|Sparrow and Bamboo

alt_text: Three vertical scrolls: a seated robed figure in the center, landscapes on the left and right, with calligraphic text
long_description:
The image displays three vertical hanging scrolls, each featuring a light brown paper section for the artwork and text, framed by a dark green border and a patterned light green fabric at the top and bottom. Each scroll has two vertical gold-colored fabric strips at the top, attached to a horizontal bar. The overall color palette is muted, primarily light brown, dark green, and black ink, with small accents of gold and red.

The left scroll features black calligraphic text arranged in vertical lines at the top, with a red circular seal below it. Below the text, a landscape scene is depicted in black ink washes. In the foreground, a small structure with a pointed roof sits on a rocky outcrop, surrounded by trees. To the right, a bridge-like structure extends over water, with a small figure on it. In the background, mountains rise, rendered with lighter ink washes, and a faint circular shape is visible in the sky.

The central scroll also contains black calligraphic text in vertical lines at the top, with a red circular seal below it. Below the text, a single figure is depicted in black ink washes. The figure is an elderly person with a bald head and a beard, seated cross-legged, wearing loose robes. They hold a long, thin staff horizontally across their lap with both hands. The figure's face is turned slightly to the right, with a gentle expression.

The right scroll features black calligraphic text in vertical lines at the top, with a red circular seal below it. Below the text, a landscape scene is depicted in black ink washes. In the foreground, a rocky shoreline with trees and small structures is visible, bordering a body of water. In the background, tall, steep mountains rise, rendered with varying ink washes, suggesting depth and mist.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Set of three hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A woman in an elaborate kimono stands beside a cherry tree with falling white blossoms on a yellow background.
long_description: The image is a vertical painting depicting a woman standing next to a flowering tree, set against a plain background and framed by a patterned border. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, faces left and looks over her left shoulder towards the upper left. Her skin is pale, and her hair is styled elaborately with black elements and gold, stick-like ornaments. She wears a multi-layered kimono. The outermost layer is dark blue or black with scattered gold and light blue floral patterns. Beneath this, a red garment with a gold pattern is visible at her chest and sleeves. Her wide obi, tied at the front, is a dark gray or black fabric patterned with large, colorful hexagonal motifs in red, green, and blue, interspersed with smaller floral designs. Below the obi, a white, pleated undergarment is visible, extending to her feet, which are clad in red-soled footwear. To the left of the woman, a tree trunk rises vertically, its bark rendered in shades of gray and brown. White blossoms with small green leaves cluster on its branches, particularly in the lower left and extending upwards. Numerous small white petals appear to be falling from the tree, scattered across the light yellow-ochre background. The painting is bordered on the top, bottom, and sides by a blue fabric with a repeating geometric pattern of interlocking circles. In the lower left, near the base of the tree, there is a vertical inscription in black characters, followed by a red seal. The inscription reads: "Katsukawa Shunsho ga".

alt_text: A group of five figures, including a woman, a man, and three children, walking, with the man holding an umbrella
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a central tan-colored panel framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark blue with a repeating pattern of gold floral motifs, while the side borders are a lighter gold with a subtle geometric pattern. The central panel depicts five figures walking from left to right, positioned in the lower half of the composition. The background is a plain, light tan color, with a faint, lighter circular mark near the top center. From left to right, the figures are: a man, bald on top with dark hair on the sides, wearing a dark blue robe over a lighter garment. He holds a large, dark brown umbrella with a black rim over the head of the woman next to him. His face is turned towards the woman, with a slightly open mouth. Next to him is a young child, positioned slightly in front, wearing a light green robe with dark patterns, their head turned towards the man. Centrally located is a tall woman, wearing an elaborate black robe with red and gold floral patterns, and a red undergarment visible at the collar and hem. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo, and she holds a dark, fan-like object in her left hand. In front of the woman is a smaller child, wearing a red robe with white and gold patterns, their head turned towards the woman. On the far right is another small child, wearing a green robe with red and gold patterns, also with their head turned towards the woman. All figures are depicted with clear outlines and flat areas of color. A small, faint inscription of a few vertical lines of characters is visible in the lower left corner.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on silk

alt_text: A light-skinned person in a red coat and tricorn hat holds a red parasol, accompanied by a smaller dark-skinned person.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting featuring two figures against a plain, light tan background, framed by decorative borders. The dominant figure, positioned slightly to the left and in front, is a light-skinned person with light-colored hair, possibly a wig, visible beneath a black tricorn hat. They wear a long, bright red coat adorned with blue cuffs and white decorative elements down the front. Beneath the coat, white breeches and white stockings are visible, ending in brown, flat shoes. In their left hand, they hold a long, slender white pipe, and in their right hand, they hold an open, bright red parasol with a blue and white patterned underside, positioned above their head. To the right and slightly behind the first figure stands a smaller, dark-skinned person. They wear a pink tunic patterned with small white dots, light blue breeches, and a red head covering. This figure is barefoot and holds a thin, dark stick or cane in their right hand, pointing downwards. Both figures are depicted in full length, facing generally forward but with their heads turned slightly to the left. The background is unadorned. A decorative border with red and gold floral or scroll motifs runs along the top and bottom edges of the central image, flanked by a wider, light brown frame with vertical stripes.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk, negoro lacquer roller knobs

alt_text: A tall scroll painting of a woman in a patterned kimono carrying a small figure on her back
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single standing woman carrying a small figure on her back, set against a plain, light yellow-brown background. The scroll is framed by decorative borders: the side borders are dark blue-green with a repeating pattern of lighter blue cloud-like shapes, while the top and bottom borders are a rich brown with a subtle, intricate gold pattern. The woman, positioned in the lower half of the scroll, faces slightly to her right, with her head turned to look towards the viewer. She has pale skin, dark hair styled in a tall, elaborate bun, and delicate facial features with red lips. She wears a vibrant, long-sleeved kimono. The upper half of the kimono is primarily red with white and blue floral patterns. The lower half transitions into a patchwork of dark blue, green, and red sections, adorned with various patterns including white birds and floral motifs. Her left hand is visible, holding a small, green, leaf-like object. On her back, a small, elderly male figure is visible, positioned behind her left shoulder. He faces away from the viewer but his head is turned to his left, revealing a wrinkled face and a white beard. He wears a dark, patterned robe with gold accents and a tall, black hat. He appears to be holding a small, red object in his right hand. In the lower left corner of the scroll, there is vertical black text and two red square seals.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and colors on silk

alt_text: Monochrome ink painting of a flowering branch with large blossoms, smaller flowers, and developing fruits.
long_description: This monochrome ink painting on a light, off-white paper depicts a flowering branch with various botanical elements. A prominent, large blossom with several broad, light-toned petals forms the central focus, its inner structure rendered with darker ink washes. Above and to the left of this central flower, a cluster of smaller, open flowers with numerous delicate petals and dark centers emerges from a branch, accompanied by several dark leaves. To the right, two pear-shaped forms, possibly fruits or large buds, hang from a branch, each with a textured surface and small leaves. Further down and to the left, several smaller, rounded buds are visible along the gnarled branches. The branches themselves are rendered with varying shades of dark ink, extending across the composition from the lower left towards the upper right. The artwork utilizes a range of ink washes, from light gray to deep black, to create depth and detail. A small, square red seal with illegible characters is present in the lower left corner of the image.

metadata.title: 「四時清雅」|"Refined Elegance in the Four Seasons" (Shiji seiga), Album of Flower Paintings
metadata.medium: Album of twelve leaves; ink on paper

alt_text: A traditional ink painting shows a small boat near a large cliff, a pine tree, and water with reeds.
long_description: A vertical ink and wash painting depicts a serene landscape scene. A large, light-colored cliff face dominates the right side, extending from the top to the bottom edge. Its surface is rendered with subtle grey washes and faint, darker lines suggesting contours, with some darker, almost black brushstrokes indicating vegetation or shadows along its upper right and near its base. On the left, a prominent pine tree extends its branches across the upper left and central areas. Its needles are depicted with short, light blue-green strokes, and several thin, dark lines represent hanging vines or roots from its branches. The bottom third of the painting features a body of water, rendered with horizontal washes of light grey. Along the water's edge in the foreground, numerous thin, dark grey and black strokes depict reeds or tall grasses. A small, light-colored boat with a single figure seated within it is positioned in the water, slightly right of center, near the base of the cliff and below the pine tree's branches. The figure is depicted with simple, dark strokes. Several vertical lines of dark script are visible on the right side of the cliff face, reading: "巖下有此人製 鬆圖程嘉燧". Numerous red square and rectangular seals are stamped throughout the composition: two in the upper right corner, one below the script, one in the lower right corner, two in the lower left corner, and one in the upper left corner.

metadata.title: 明   程嘉燧   山水二幅   冊頁|Two Landscapes
metadata.medium: Two leaves from an album; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A traditional painting depicts people in a courtyard with buildings and a horse against a gold background.
long_description: The image displays a section of a traditional painting, likely a screen panel, set within a gold border. The background is a rich, speckled gold, suggesting an expansive, perhaps ethereal, space. The scene depicts a gathering of multiple figures and a horse within a courtyard setting, framed by architectural elements and sparse greenery. In the upper portion, several buildings with dark gray, tiled roofs and green-paneled walls are visible, extending horizontally across the background. Below these structures, a white-walled courtyard unfolds. On the left, a figure in an orange, patterned robe sits on the ground, facing right. To their right, a prominent figure in a black robe and tall black hat stands, facing right with arms slightly extended. Further right, two figures in dark robes and hats are seated at a low, white table. Towards the right side of the courtyard, a brown horse with a black mane and tail rears up on its hind legs, facing left. A figure in a white robe and dark hat is mounted on its back, while another figure in a white robe stands beside the horse. A small, green pine tree with a gnarled trunk is positioned to the far right. In the foreground, several figures are seated on the ground: one in a blue robe on the left, two in green and orange patterned robes in the center, and two in white robes on the right. The figures wear traditional attire, and the painting employs a clear, illustrative style with distinct outlines and a vibrant color palette.

metadata.title: Untitled

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a tall bamboo stalk with several branches and numerous leaves against a light background.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on a light, off-white paper depicts a bamboo plant. A thick, dark bamboo stalk rises from the lower left quadrant, extending upwards and slightly right, with visible nodes indicated by horizontal breaks in the dark ink. Several thinner branches emerge from the main stalk, curving upwards and outwards. Numerous bamboo leaves, rendered with swift, varying brushstrokes of black ink, are clustered around these branches and also appear to drift downwards across the composition. The leaves range from solid, dark shapes to lighter, more translucent strokes, suggesting movement. Towards the upper right, more branches and leaves extend diagonally across the frame. In the middle right section, a vertical column of black calligraphic text is visible, followed by a small, square red seal impression below it. The background is a plain, unpainted light surface, providing a stark contrast to the dark ink of the bamboo.

alt_text: An ink painting on light paper depicts two bamboo branches with leaves, accompanied by calligraphic text and red seals.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal ink painting on a light, off-white paper, with a slightly textured appearance. The central and right portions of the composition are dominated by two clusters of bamboo branches and leaves, rendered in black ink with varying brushstrokes. The upper cluster, positioned towards the top right, shows several thin branches extending diagonally downwards and to the left, adorned with numerous pointed leaves. The leaves are depicted with quick, sharp brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. Below this, a second, slightly smaller cluster of bamboo branches and leaves emerges from the lower left, extending upwards and to the right. This cluster also features thin branches and pointed leaves, similar in style to the upper one, but with a slightly different orientation. The ink ranges from deep black to lighter grey tones, suggesting different pressures and amounts of ink. On the far left side of the paper, a vertical column of black calligraphic text is present, starting near the top and extending downwards. Below this text, a red seal in the shape of a double gourd is visible, containing more characters. Further down the left edge, several smaller, rectangular red seals are stamped vertically. On the far right side, another vertical column of black calligraphic text is visible near the top, followed by two square red seals stacked vertically below it. The overall impression is one of minimalist elegance, with the dark ink contrasting against the light background.

metadata.title: 明   詹景鳳   草書千字文   卷|Thousand Character Classic

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a tall woven basket filled with leafy plants, gourds, and vines.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical ink wash painting on a light, off-white paper, mounted within a light brown border. The central composition features a tall, narrow, woven basket at the bottom, rendered in black ink with detailed cross-hatching and vertical lines, creating a textured appearance. The basket has a flared base and two small handles at its upper rim, from which a thin, arched handle extends upwards, curving over the central plant arrangement. Inside the basket, a dense cluster of dark grey and black leaves and thin stems is visible. Above the basket, a vine with several large, rounded leaves, depicted in varying shades of grey ink, extends upwards. Some leaves are darker, almost black, while others are lighter grey, showing the brushstrokes. Small, rounded gourds, also in grey, are interspersed among the leaves and along the thin black vine, which curves and intertwines. In the upper right portion of the paper, vertical black calligraphy is present, followed by a small, square red seal. The overall impression is of a natural arrangement of plants and a basket, rendered with expressive ink strokes.

metadata.title: 与謝蕪村筆秋草花竹籃図	|Autumn Flowers in a Bamboo Basket
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Two white egrets stand in shallow water, framed by tall, arching reeds in a monochrome ink painting.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts two white egrets standing in shallow water, framed by tall reeds. The taller egret is positioned on the right, its long neck extended upwards and its beak pointing towards the upper right corner. Its body is mostly visible, rendered in bright white. To its left and slightly in front, a second, shorter egret stands with its head lowered, its beak pointing downwards. This bird's body is partially obscured by the taller one, but its white plumage is also prominent. Both birds have slender legs, which are dark, and stand in water indicated by faint, wavy lines at the bottom of the frame. To the left of the egrets, a dense cluster of dark, slender reeds or grasses rises vertically, with several long leaves arching gracefully towards the top and right, creating a natural canopy. The background is a soft, light grey wash, suggesting a misty or atmospheric environment. The entire scene is rendered in a monochrome palette of black, grey, and white. A small, rectangular red seal is visible in the bottom left corner of the painted area. The artwork is bordered by a light brown material, with a narrow, patterned strip at the top and bottom edges of the central image.

alt_text: A woman in a red kimono, a kneeling woman, and a child in a patterned kimono on a scroll.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts three figures in elaborate attire against a plain, light beige background. On the left, a tall woman stands, facing slightly right, with her head turned forward. She wears a vibrant red kimono adorned with gold, green, and brown floral and geometric patterns. Her hair is styled in a high, dark bun with a white ornament, and her skin is pale. She holds a green, patterned object in her left hand. To her right and slightly lower, a second woman kneels, facing left, with her head turned forward. She wears a dark blue or black kimono with intricate blue, white, and gold patterns. Her dark hair is also styled in a bun. Behind and slightly above the kneeling woman, a small child stands, facing left, with their head turned forward. The child wears a black and white patterned kimono and has two small dark buns in their hair, holding a green stick-like object. In the lower right corner, there is vertical text in a dark script and a red rectangular seal. The painting is bordered by a narrow gold patterned strip at the top and bottom, and wider side panels. The side panels feature a light blue-green fabric with large dark blue circular motifs containing gold script, transitioning to a dark blue and white checkered pattern below.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A tall, narrow artwork depicts a woman in a green kimono holding a large black and tan umbrella.
long_description: A tall, narrow, vertical artwork depicts a full-length figure of a woman against a plain, light tan background. The artwork is framed by decorative borders at the top and bottom, featuring blue and gold patterns resembling clouds or waves. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing towards the right, with her head turned slightly to look towards the viewer. She has a pale complexion, small red lips, and dark hair styled in an elaborate updo adorned with red and gold hairpins. She wears a long, flowing green kimono that appears to have a subtle, faint pattern. Beneath the green kimono, layers of fabric are visible, including a white layer, a vibrant red layer, and a light tan layer. Her obi, or sash, is patterned with blue floral or cloud motifs on a white background, tied with a red bow at her waist. She holds a large, open umbrella over her left shoulder. The umbrella has a black canopy with small white speckles, and tan ribs with red accents. Her hands are visible, holding the umbrella handle. Her feet are clad in white, and she wears black, geta-like sandals. Black calligraphic text with a red square seal is visible in the lower left portion of the tan background.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a bearded figure in a conical hat and layered cloak, holding a bowl and chopsticks
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on a light cream-colored paper, mounted on a brown scroll with decorative black and gold borders at the top and bottom. The central panel features a full-body figure standing slightly right of center, facing left. The figure has a prominent nose, a dark beard and mustache, and dark eyes. They wear a wide, conical hat that casts a shadow over their eyes. Their body is covered by a layered, textured cloak, rendered in varying shades of gray, resembling woven material. The cloak extends from their shoulders to just above their bare feet. In their left hand, they hold a small, dark bowl. Their right hand holds two thin, dark sticks, resembling chopsticks, positioned over the bowl. A thin, dark staff or stick is visible behind their right shoulder, extending vertically down to the ground near their right foot. In the upper right quadrant of the painting, there is vertical calligraphy in black ink, accompanied by two red square seals and one red oval seal.

alt_text: A gnarled tree branch with white blossoms and a small bird on a light brown scroll.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a gnarled tree branch with white blossoms and a small bird, set against a plain light brown background. The thick, dark brown branch dominates the central panel, extending diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right. Its surface shows textured details and patches of a greenish-blue hue. Numerous small, white, five-petaled blossoms with tiny dark centers are clustered along the main branch and its thinner offshoots, some fully open and others appearing as buds. A small, light-colored bird, possibly grey or light brown, is perched on a lower, thinner branch on the right side of the main trunk, facing towards the right. In the lower right corner, there is a vertical line of dark calligraphic text next to a square red seal. The central image is framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark with a subtle, intricate pattern. The side borders are lighter, featuring a repeating geometric pattern resembling a key or fret design.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆   鶯白梅図|Bush Warbler (Uguisu) in a Plum Tree
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on silk

alt_text: Numerous sparrows perch and fly around a blossoming tree, with a peony at the base of the trunk.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a multitude of sparrows amidst a flowering tree, rendered in ink and light colors on a light-colored ground. The composition is dominated by a central tree trunk and branches that extend from the bottom to the top of the scroll. Numerous sparrows, depicted with brown, black, and white plumage, are scattered throughout the branches. Several birds are shown in various stages of flight near the top, while others perch on thin, gnarled branches adorned with small, light-colored blossoms. A dense cluster of sparrows occupies a thick, curved branch in the mid-section, some facing left, some right, and some looking downwards. Towards the lower left, a large, light pink peony flower with green leaves blooms near the base of the tree trunk. The branches are rendered with dark grey and black ink, suggesting texture and age. Calligraphy in black ink and a red seal are visible in the upper left portion of the painting.

metadata.title: 梅雀図|Sparrows in a Plum Tree
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman in a grey kimono holds a patterned umbrella while walking through falling snow
long_description: The vertical scroll painting depicts a woman walking through a snowy landscape. She is positioned slightly to the right of center, facing left with her head tilted down. Her skin is pale, and her dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun. She wears a grey kimono with a subtle checkered pattern, its wide sleeves and hem revealing a vibrant red lining patterned with white geometric stars and a black lining with a grey interlocking pattern. Her left hand gently holds the front of her kimono, while her right hand holds a large, open umbrella over her head. The umbrella is dark blue with broad gold stripes, both surfaces speckled with white dots representing falling snow. She wears black wooden sandals (geta) on her feet, which are partially obscured by the snow on the ground. The background is a muted grey, filled with numerous small white dots indicating a heavy snowfall. To the right and behind the woman, several trees or bushes are visible, their branches heavily laden with white snow. A low, dark fence or railing runs horizontally across the mid-ground behind her. The ground beneath her feet is a light, snow-covered surface. In the lower right corner, vertical lines of black calligraphy are present, reading "一陽斎豊国画", followed by a red square seal. The entire painting is framed by a dark border with gold floral patterns, and narrower decorative strips with geometric patterns appear at the very top and bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A standing woman with an elaborate hairstyle and patterned robes on a vertical scroll painting.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a single standing woman against a plain, light brown background. The woman is positioned slightly to the left of center, facing left with her head turned to look in the same direction. Her skin is pale, and her facial features are delicately rendered. Her black hair is styled in an elaborate, high coiffure with multiple loops and several thin, light-colored sticks or pins protruding from it. She wears layered robes; the innermost layer is a vibrant red with a repeating white geometric pattern of hexagons and stars. Over this, an olive-green layer with subtle dark patterns is visible, and the outermost robe is a flowing, light beige or cream color, draped loosely around her body and arms. Her right hand is raised near her head, holding a thin, light-colored object. Her left hand holds a folded scroll or piece of fabric against her chest. The robes pool around her feet, creating soft, undulating lines. On the lower left side of the painting, vertical script in black ink is visible, accompanied by a red square seal below it. The top and bottom edges of the scroll feature narrow, light gray decorative borders with subtle patterns.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink wash portrait on a scroll depicts an old man with a bald head and a full beard, with calligraphy above.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man, rendered in black ink wash on a light beige paper. The man's bald head occupies the upper-middle portion of the scroll. His face is depicted with broad, expressive brushstrokes, showing a prominent nose, heavy eyelids, and a full, dark beard and mustache that extend down to his chest. His eyes are small and dark, looking slightly to his left. The contours of his face are defined by varying shades of black ink, from light gray washes to darker, more solid lines. Above his head, to the left, is a vertical line of black calligraphic text. To the right of the calligraphy, two small, square red seals are visible. The central painted area is bordered by a light brown fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern on the left and right sides. A darker brown fabric with a more intricate pattern forms the top and bottom borders of the scroll.

metadata.title: 白隠慧鶴筆　達磨像|Portrait of Bodhidharma

alt_text: A smiling old man with a long beard sits by a large woven basket under bamboo stalks and a moon
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light, off-white background, depicts an elderly man seated outdoors under a moonlit sky. The composition is framed by a light brown border. In the upper left, a large, pale, circular moon is partially visible, with thin, dark bamboo stalks and leaves extending from the upper right corner downwards and across the top. Interspersed among the bamboo are lighter, delicate plant elements with small dots. In the upper right, vertical lines of black text are visible next to a red square seal. The central figure is an old man, seated in the lower-middle portion of the painting. He has a long, flowing white beard and a bald head with some dark hair on the sides. His face is characterized by a wide, toothy smile and narrow eyes, conveying a joyful expression. He wears loose, flowing robes, depicted with broad, fluid brushstrokes. In his left hand, he holds a small, woven basket that appears to contain light-colored objects. His right hand rests near the basket. To the man's right, a tall, large, woven structure, possibly a fish trap or a shelter, stands upright. It has a rounded top and a textured surface, with a small, dark, round object hanging from it by a thin line. The man and the large woven structure are positioned on a dark, textured ground, rendered with bold, dark brushstrokes that suggest rocks or earth. To the left of the man, faint horizontal lines indicate water. In the bottom left foreground, a few dark, irregular shapes are visible, possibly representing rocks or debris. Sparse, dark, grass-like strokes appear at the very bottom right.

metadata.title: 曽我蕭白筆　太公望図|Tōkaibō with a Fishing Basket

alt_text: Ink wash painting of an old man with a long beard and hair, with black calligraphy above.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features an ink wash portrait of an old man in the lower section and black calligraphy in the upper section, set against a light beige background. The scroll is framed by decorative borders. The upper portion of the painting contains several vertical lines of black calligraphic text, with a small red seal mark visible within the text block. Below this, the lower half of the painting depicts the head and shoulders of an old man, rendered in varying shades of gray and black ink. He has a bald head, a long, flowing dark beard, and long dark hair tied back, extending to the right. His face is characterized by heavy eyelids, a slightly downturned mouth, and visible wrinkles, giving him a somber or contemplative expression as he gazes towards the left. The brushstrokes are fluid and expressive, particularly in the beard and hair. The main painting area is bordered by a narrow gold-colored strip with a subtle pattern, which in turn is surrounded by a wider blue-gray outer border adorned with a repeating pattern of gold floral or leaf motifs.

metadata.title: 風外慧薫筆 達磨図|Portrait of Daruma

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a flowering tree with white blossoms and tall bamboo stalks on a light background.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a flowering tree and bamboo stalks on a light background. A prominent tree trunk, rendered in dark gray and black ink washes, rises from the bottom center, branching out extensively. Its branches, also in dark ink, are covered with numerous small, white blossoms, some fully open with visible petals, others appearing as tight buds. The tree's form is dense with branches in the lower and middle sections, becoming sparser towards the top. To the left of the main tree, several slender, vertical stalks of bamboo, depicted with thin black lines, extend upwards, reaching varying heights. The background is a uniform, light beige or tan color, providing a neutral setting for the botanical elements. In the lower left area, a column of black calligraphic text is visible, followed by two square-shaped red seals stacked vertically. The central painted area is bordered by a narrow, light-colored strip with a subtle, delicate pattern. This inner border is then framed by a wider, muted gray-green fabric with a repeating pattern of stylized flowers or leaves.

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a potted fungus-like plant with calligraphy and numerous red seals.
long_description: A tall, vertical scroll painting features a central artwork on a light beige background, framed by a gold-colored border with a subtle patterned design at the top and bottom. The main subject is a potted plant, positioned in the lower half of the central beige panel. The plant consists of several mushroom-like forms with broad, undulating caps in shades of light brown and beige, supported by dark, gnarled stems. These stems emerge from a light gray or off-white rectangular pot. The pot has a slightly wider rim and four small, rounded feet. Its visible sides are densely covered with numerous small, square red seals, arranged in an irregular grid pattern. Above the plant, in the upper right quadrant of the beige panel, there is a column of vertical black ink calligraphy. Below this text, two distinct red square seals are visible. The upper portion of the beige panel above the calligraphy and the lower portion below the pot are left blank.

alt_text: Two vertical scrolls: one with an ink landscape of mountains and trees, the other with black calligraphy.
long_description: Two vertical scroll paintings are displayed side-by-side against a dark background. Both scrolls share a similar structure: a wide, light brown border with a subtle, repeating pattern, framing a narrower, lighter central panel. The left scroll features an ink wash painting of a mountainous landscape. Tall, craggy peaks dominate the composition, rendered with varying shades of black ink on a light, uncolored background. The mountains rise steeply, with sharp, angular forms and textured surfaces created by brushstrokes. In the lower half of the painting, a cluster of dark, leafy trees, possibly pines, grows on a rocky outcrop. A small, light-colored structure with a dark roof is nestled among the peaks on the left side. The upper left corner of the painted area contains a small block of dark text and two red square seals. The right scroll displays vertical lines of black calligraphic text. The characters are written in a fluid, cursive style, filling most of the central panel from top to bottom. The ink varies in density, creating lighter and darker strokes. A single red square seal is visible near the top of the text, and another larger red rectangular seal is positioned near the bottom of the text.

metadata.title: 池大雅筆　「独座敬亭山」図|Landscape and Couplet of Chinese Verse
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A scroll painting shows a dark bird on a light bank with a log, a basket, and a green hill with flowers.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a light brown background with a patterned border. The upper half of the scroll is largely blank, a plain light brown. In the middle section, a dark grey bird with its head tilted upwards stands on a light beige surface, which has subtle horizontal lines suggesting water or ripples. To the bird's left, a thick, dark grey, curved log or branch extends horizontally. To its right, a small, dark, woven basket-like object rests on the same light beige surface, with a thin, curved green line extending upwards and to the left from it, and a wisp of grey smoke rising from behind it. The lower section of the painting features a large, curved, light green hill or bank occupying the lower left. Along the upper edge of this green area, a cluster of small white and red flowers with green leaves is depicted. To the left of the flowers, on the green surface, there is black calligraphic text and a red circular seal. The entire painting is framed by a brown border with repeating light-colored floral patterns.

metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A bald figure in grey and red robes sits on a chair, holding a staff, with black calligraphy above.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a seated bald figure in the lower half, with black calligraphy and red seals in the upper half. The figure, facing forward, has a light skin tone and a calm expression. They are dressed in layered robes: an inner grey robe with long sleeves and blue cuffs, and an outer red robe draped over the left shoulder and lap. The figure holds a long, slender brown staff vertically in their right hand, resting it on the ground. In their left hand, they hold a small, dark object, possibly a brush, and a white, fan-like object. The figure is seated on a simple, dark brown wooden chair with a high back and armrests. The background behind the figure and calligraphy is a plain, light cream color. The entire composition is framed by an inner dark blue border with a subtle patterned design, and an outer wider border of gold with a repeating geometric pattern.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows a bearded man in profile, facing left, with an earring and closed eyes
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a man's head and upper torso in profile, facing left, against a plain, light-colored background. The man occupies the lower half of the central panel. He has a prominent nose, a full beard, and long hair that extends down his back. His eyes are depicted as narrow slits, suggesting they are closed or nearly closed. A large, circular earring hangs from his elongated earlobe. He wears a simple, light-colored robe, indicated by broad, dark brushstrokes for the folds and edges. His hands are visible in the lower left, holding a long, dark, staff-like object that extends diagonally upwards from the bottom left towards his chest. The background is a uniform, light beige or off-white color, with some subtle variations in tone. In the upper right quadrant, there is a vertical column of dark, calligraphic text, followed by a red seal. The central painted area is bordered at the top and bottom by narrow strips of patterned fabric in red and gold, and on the sides by a wider, textured dark green or brown fabric.

alt_text: A seated bald figure in ornate robes holds a fan, with calligraphic text above
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a seated figure against a plain, muted brown-gray background. The upper portion of the painting features several columns of dark calligraphic text. Below the text, a bald figure with light skin, dark eyes, and a small mouth is shown seated. The figure wears layered robes; an inner robe of dark brown-gray is visible beneath an outer robe of dark green. The outer robe is adorned with wide, horizontal bands of gold, intricately patterned with geometric designs. The figure's right hand holds a slender, dark, stick-like object, possibly a closed fan. The figure is seated on a chair with a dark green backrest and armrests covered in a red fabric with a gold pattern. The figure's feet rest on a low, dark green footrest, which also has a patterned base. The entire artwork is bordered by a light brown frame with subtle gold patterns at the top and bottom edges.

metadata.title: 景南英文像|Portrait of Keinan Eibun
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: Two horizontal panels, each with five painted figures in red archways, depicting various deities and a Buddha.
long_description:
Two horizontal, rectangular panels are stacked vertically, each containing five distinct painted figures. The panels appear aged with some wear, and each figure is set within a red, arch-shaped niche. Dark vertical bands with geometric patterns separate the niches. The overall color palette includes reds, greens, blues, golds, and light skin tones.

The top panel features five seated figures. From left to right: The first figure has light skin, two arms, and hands near the lap, wearing a simple garment and jewelry. The second figure has light skin, two arms, with one raised holding a sword-like object and the other hand near the lap, wearing a simple garment and jewelry. The central figure has golden skin, two arms, with the right arm extended downwards and the left hand in the lap, wearing a red robe. The fourth figure has light skin, four arms, with two hands pressed together at the chest and two outer hands raised, wearing a simple garment and jewelry. The fifth figure has light green skin, two arms, with one arm resting on a raised knee and the other arm behind the back, wearing a simple garment and jewelry.

The bottom panel features five figures, mostly in dynamic standing or dancing poses. From left to right: The first figure has dark blue skin, two arms, one raised and one lowered, wearing a loincloth. The second figure has golden skin, six arms, holding various objects including a sword and a skull cup, wearing a loincloth and jewelry. The central figure is seated, with golden skin, four arms, two hands near the chest, and two outer hands raised, wearing a simple garment and jewelry. The fourth figure has light skin, six arms, holding various objects, wearing a loincloth and jewelry. The fifth figure has dark blue skin, six arms, holding various objects, wearing a loincloth and jewelry. All figures in both panels are depicted with a red halo or aura behind their heads.

alt_text: A detailed red painting features a central stupa surrounded by numerous smaller figures and stupas in a grid
long_description: This vertically oriented, rectangular painting is dominated by shades of red, black, and gold. At the center, a large, ornate stupa-like structure rises. It has a domed base and a tiered conical spire, decorated with gold and black patterns. Within the dome of this central structure, a multi-armed figure with a light complexion sits on a throne, flanked by two smaller figures. Above the central stupa, a triangular arrangement of smaller stupas and figures leads towards the top edge. The entire composition is structured as a grid of rectangular compartments, with a deep red background. Around the central stupa, and extending to the edges of the painting, are numerous smaller compartments. Many of these contain miniature stupas, depicted in white, gold, and black, arranged in rows and columns. Other compartments contain individual figures, often seated or standing, with varying complexions (red, white, green, black) and sometimes multiple arms or heads. These figures are typically framed by arched niches. Along the top edge, a row of larger compartments features seated figures. Along the bottom edge, a horizontal band contains many small, seated figures, possibly a congregation, with some faint, illegible text beneath them. The overall impression is one of intricate detail and repetition, with a strong central focus.

alt_text: A multi-armed blue deity with three heads and a sword stands dynamically on a red background, surrounded by smaller figures
long_description: A vibrant painting depicts a large, dark blue, multi-limbed deity centrally positioned against a rich red background. The deity has three heads, with the main head facing forward and two smaller heads visible on either side, all featuring three eyes. It holds a long, dark sword with a golden hilt raised above its head with its primary right hand. Its primary left hand holds a small, dark object near its chest, while other hands are visible, some making gestures. The deity wears elaborate golden crowns, necklaces, armbands, and a decorative belt with dangling ornaments. Its muscular body is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose with one leg raised and the other bent, resting on a decorative base. The red background behind the central figure features flame-like or radiating patterns. Numerous smaller figures are depicted within this red field, some seated, some standing, often enclosed within small, arched frames or circular outlines. These smaller figures vary in color and posture. Above the central figure, a horizontal band contains several more small figures, each within its own arched compartment. Below the central figure, a decorative platform forms the base, with a row of even smaller figures along its bottom edge, also within compartments. The primary colors are dark blue, gold, and red, with accents of white, black, and other muted tones for the surrounding figures.

alt_text: A multi-limbed, multi-headed blue and red deity embracing another figure, surrounded by a fiery red aura and smaller figures
long_description: This painting features a large, multi-limbed, multi-headed central figure standing dynamically against a vibrant red background. The central figure's body is split vertically, with the right side appearing blue and the left side red. The main head is blue, adorned with an elaborate gold crown, and a smaller red head is pressed against its left side. Numerous arms extend from the central figure, holding various objects such as a staff, a skull cup, a sword, a noose, a trident, a bow, and an arrow. The figure's legs, one blue and one red, are positioned over smaller, prostrate figures on a decorative base. The central figure is surrounded by a large, flame-like red aura, outlined in gold, which fills most of the central panel. Above this main scene, a horizontal row of five smaller, seated figures is depicted, each within an arched niche against a dark green background. These figures vary in color, including red, gold, white, blue, and green, and are shown in meditative poses. On either side of the central red aura, two additional smaller figures are placed within red oval frames, totaling four such figures. These side figures are also multi-limbed and appear in active or seated postures. The entire composition is framed by a dark green border, with a decorative band at the very bottom featuring small, indistinct patterns.

alt_text: A colorful Buddhist thangka featuring a central mandala with a deity, surrounded by numerous smaller figures.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular scroll painting, or thangka, dominated by a central, intricate mandala design. At the top, a dark blue fabric panel is partially covered by a folded, lighter beige and green fabric flap. Below this, the painted section begins with a horizontal row of small, seated figures, each within an individual compartment, against a red background. The central mandala is a complex arrangement of squares and circles. At its core is a large red square, within which a central, multi-limbed, red-skinned deity is depicted in a dynamic pose. This central figure is surrounded by four smaller figures, one in each cardinal direction, also within the red square. This inner square is bordered by a series of concentric bands: a gold band, a green band with small figures, a blue band with more figures and decorative patterns, and an outermost red band containing a row of small, seated figures. Beyond the main mandala structure, the painting extends with additional rows of small figures. These include seated figures in various poses and dynamic, standing figures, some appearing to ride animals, all against a dark background. The bottom of the painted section features a horizontal row of these dynamic figures. The scroll concludes with a plain dark blue fabric panel at the bottom, which is attached to a red-painted wooden dowel. The overall color palette is rich, featuring prominent reds, blues, greens, golds, and whites.

alt_text: A colorful painting depicts two large seated figures, one light-skinned and one green, surrounded by smaller figures and floral designs
long_description: This rectangular painting features a dark blue background framed by a narrow red border. The composition is dominated by two large, ornate seated figures in the center, flanked by smaller figures above and intricate floral patterns below. In the upper section, a row of eight smaller figures is depicted. Each figure is seated, some with halos, and dressed in various colored robes, primarily red and gold. The left central figure has light skin and is seated cross-legged on a golden lotus pedestal. This figure wears a red robe with gold patterns, a gold necklace, and a crown. The hands are held in front of the chest in a gesture, with fingers touching. A red halo encircles the head, set against the dark blue background.
