The right central figure has green skin and is seated with the right leg extended and the left leg bent, resting on a golden lotus pedestal. This figure wears a green and red robe with gold patterns, a gold necklace, and a crown. The figure has multiple arms, with the primary hands held in front of the chest in a gesture. Other hands extend outwards, holding various objects that resemble flowers or symbols. A red halo encircles the head. Below the two main lotus pedestals, the lower section of the painting is filled with a dense, symmetrical floral design. This pattern features red and green flowers with swirling green vines on a dark blue ground. In the bottom center, a small, light-skinned figure is seated within a circular motif, surrounded by the floral elements. Another very small seated figure is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A large, dark, wrathful deity with multiple eyes and a skull crown sits amidst flames, surrounded by numerous smaller figures.
long_description: The artwork depicts a large, dark-skinned wrathful deity centrally positioned, surrounded by a vibrant red and orange flaming aura. The central figure has a wide, open mouth revealing fangs and a red tongue, with three prominent eyes on its face. It wears an elaborate gold crown adorned with skulls and intricate gold jewelry, including a long garland of white skull-like beads. Its hands hold a horizontal staff or weapon across its chest. The deity is seated on a multi-layered lotus throne with green, blue, and red petals. Around the central deity, within the fiery aura, are numerous smaller figures. To the left and right, several dark-skinned, wrathful figures appear, some with multiple limbs or animal heads. Interspersed are serene figures and various animals like deer. The upper border features multiple rows of smaller, seated figures, predominantly serene individuals in orange and red robes, with some darker, wrathful figures appearing in between. The lower section of the artwork shows a landscape base with a procession of smaller, active figures, including dancing deities, warriors, and offerings, against a backdrop of green and brown earth tones. The overall color palette is rich, dominated by deep blues, reds, oranges, and gold accents.

alt_text: A central standing figure, possibly a Buddha, surrounded by numerous narrative scenes in a complex landscape.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular painting, framed by a plain brown border. The central and largest element is a standing figure, depicted within a dark blue, almond-shaped aura. This figure has light skin, a serene expression, and wears flowing robes in shades of red, gold, and green. The right hand is raised with the palm facing outwards, and the left hand points downwards. The figure stands on a large, ornate lotus pedestal, which is predominantly red and gold with intricate swirling patterns. Around the central figure, the painting is filled with numerous smaller narrative scenes, arranged in a complex, multi-tiered landscape. These scenes are set against a backdrop of green hills, blue skies, and white clouds. Many small human figures are depicted in various activities, some seated, some standing, some interacting. Some figures are inside small, ornate buildings with red roofs and blue walls, while others are outdoors. Animals, such as white elephants and horses, also appear in some scenes. The scenes extend from the top to the bottom and left to right edges of the central aura, creating a dense visual narrative around the main figure. The overall color scheme is rich, with dominant blues, greens, reds, and gold accents.

alt_text: A detailed, multi-panel painting featuring a central red deity surrounded by numerous smaller figures and narrative scenes.
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting features a complex, multi-layered composition dominated by a central circular design. The overall color palette is rich, with deep reds, gold, greens, and dark blues. At the center of the artwork is a large, red-skinned figure seated on a lotus throne, with multiple arms and hands held in a gesture of prayer or meditation. This central figure wears a golden crown and a halo. Surrounding this figure within the innermost red circle are several smaller, lighter-skinned figures, some standing and some seated, adorned with gold. An outer ring of the central circular design contains numerous small figures, some in dynamic poses, within individual compartments, alternating with decorative patterns. This central mandala structure is bordered by concentric bands of green, blue, and red. Above and to the sides of the central mandala are multiple horizontal and vertical rows of smaller, individual figures. Each figure is seated within an arched niche, often against a red background. These figures display various skin tones, including gold, green, and white, and exhibit different hand gestures. The top section of the painting contains several such horizontal rows. Vertical columns of similar niches with seated figures extend down both sides of the central circular design. The bottom section of the painting features several horizontal panels depicting narrative scenes. These scenes show groups of people in various activities, some seated on the ground, some standing, against a red background. These figures are smaller and appear to be engaged in more earthly interactions compared to the figures in the upper sections.

alt_text: A multi-panel artwork depicts numerous dark birds, some flying in scattered groups, others gathered on the ground.
long_description: This horizontal, multi-panel artwork, likely a screen, is divided into six vertical sections. The background is a muted, light golden-beige, with subtle horizontal streaks of lighter and darker tones that suggest an open sky or expansive space. Numerous birds, rendered in dark gray and black ink washes, populate the scene. The birds are depicted in two main states: flying and standing on the ground. In the upper half of the panels, groups of birds are shown in various flight postures, with wings spread or partially folded. They are scattered across the upper sections, moving in different directions, some appearing to ascend, others to descend. In the lower half of the panels, larger groups of birds are gathered on the ground. These birds are mostly standing or huddled together, some facing left, some right, and some looking forward. Their forms are more rounded and compact compared to the flying birds. The composition creates a dynamic contrast between the active flying birds and the more static ground-dwelling birds. The panels are framed by a thin, dark blue border adorned with a repeating pattern of small, light-colored dots.

metadata.title: 叭々鳥図屏風|Mynah Birds
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A painting depicts seven white and black chickens with blue combs on a plain golden background, framed by a patterned border
long_description: The painting features seven chickens, predominantly white and black, against a plain golden-yellow background. The composition is horizontally oriented, with the chickens arranged in two main groups.On the left side, a large white chicken stands upright, facing right, with its wings slightly spread, giving it a fluffy appearance. Its comb and wattles are a dark blue-black. To its lower left, a smaller, dark black chicken with a similar fluffy texture and dark comb sits or stands low to the ground, facing right.In the center, a few small green plants with tiny white flowers are depicted on the ground.On the right side, a group of five chickens is clustered. A large black chicken stands prominently in the upper center-right, facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Its comb and wattles are also dark blue-black. Below and to its left, a white chicken with a dark comb pecks at the ground. To the far right, a smaller white chicken stands, facing left, with its head slightly lowered. Behind the large black chicken, another white chicken is partially visible, and a fifth white chicken is visible further back, its head and upper body obscured by the black chicken. All the chickens have feathery, soft-looking plumage. Their legs are dark, and their feet have visible claws.In the lower right corner, there is a small red square seal with illegible dark characters, and above it, two vertical dark characters.The entire painting is enclosed within a decorative border. The border is dark brown with a repeating pattern of golden floral or leaf motifs.

metadata.title: 森狙仙筆　烏骨鶏図|Silkies
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A central seated figure surrounded by concentric circles of numerous smaller figures on a brown background
long_description: The artwork is a square-format painting featuring a complex circular composition of numerous figures on a muted, aged background. At the center, a light-colored, possibly golden, figure sits in a meditative pose on a lotus-like base, enclosed within a red circular halo. This central figure is surrounded by several concentric bands, alternating between dark blue and brown. Within these bands, numerous smaller circular medallions are arranged in rows. Each medallion contains a single, often seated, figure, depicted with varying postures, hand gestures, and headwear. These figures are rendered in faded colors, primarily light yellows, reds, and blues against a darker background within their respective circles. Beyond the outermost concentric band, the brown background extends to the edges of the painting. In this outer area, additional small figures are scattered, not contained within medallions. These figures also vary in appearance, some appearing to ride animals or be in dynamic poses. The top and bottom edges of the painting feature a narrow decorative border with a green and gold patterned design. The left and right edges have a plain, light blue-green border. The overall impression is one of intricate detail and a hierarchical arrangement of many figures.

metadata.title: 星曼荼羅図 (Hoshi mandara zu)|Star Mandala
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gold, and cut gold on silk

alt_text: Two spotted deer stand beneath large pine trees in a mountainous landscape with a waterfall.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a natural scene with deer, trees, and mountains. The upper portion features a light brown sky with subtle, wavy patterns suggesting clouds or mist. Below this, dark green pine trees with gnarled, reddish-brown trunks and branches dominate the upper and middle sections of the composition. On the right side, a waterfall cascades down a green mountain, indicated by vertical white and light green stripes. In the central foreground, two spotted deer are visible. The larger deer, positioned slightly to the left, has antlers and a light brown body with white spots, facing towards the left. A smaller, similarly spotted deer stands to its right, facing towards the right. Both deer are situated beneath the dense canopy of the pine trees. On the ground near the deer, several clusters of red and pink mushroom-like forms are depicted. The lower section of the painting shows green and brown hills with sparse, reddish-brown vegetation. The entire artwork is framed by a patterned brown border.

metadata.title: 작자미상 소나무 아래 사슴   조선|作者未詳 松下雙鹿圖   朝鮮|Deer amid Pine Trees
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman in a green kimono kneels on a cushion, holding a cup, with musical instruments and figures behind her
long_description: The artwork depicts a woman kneeling on a pink cushion in a room, surrounded by various objects. The central figure, a woman with pale skin and dark hair styled in an elaborate bun, wears a vibrant green kimono adorned with blue and red circular and floral patterns. A red undergarment is visible at her neck and sleeves. She holds a small white cup with red designs in her right hand, her gaze directed forward. To the left, two standing figures are visible, possibly as part of a screen or painting. The figure on the left wears an orange kimono with detailed patterns, while the figure on the right is dressed in a purple kimono. Below these figures, a light-colored structure with a blue and white braided rope hanging from it is present. On the right side of the composition, a long-necked stringed instrument, possibly a shamisen, leans against the light-colored wall. Above the instrument, dark calligraphic writing is visible on the wall. In the lower left foreground, an open green box containing several small, dark objects in compartments rests on the floor, with a gold ring beside it. To the lower right, next to the pink cushion, a stack of open books or papers with black text is arranged on the floor. The floor is a muted green, and the background wall is a light gray. The entire scene is framed by a light beige border with a subtle patterned top and bottom.

metadata.title: 娘義太夫|Female Chanter for Jōruri Puppet Theater
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A sepia-toned painting depicts a woman with her head resting on her hand, holding a child
long_description: This sepia-toned painting, rendered in a portrait orientation, depicts a woman holding a child against a dark, indistinct background. The figures occupy the central and lower portions of the composition. The woman, positioned on the left, is shown from the waist up, facing towards the right with her head gently tilted downwards. Her eyes appear closed or cast down, and her right hand supports her chin or cheek. She has voluminous, curly hair styled high on her head. She wears a dark garment, possibly a dress, with a lighter, ruffled collar or shawl draped over her left shoulder and chest. Her left arm is wrapped around the child, holding them close. The child is seated on the woman's lap or held in her arms, positioned slightly to the right of the woman. The child faces towards the left, looking upwards with a slightly open mouth. They have light, curly hair and plump limbs. The child wears a light-colored, loose-fitting garment that exposes their arms and legs. Their right arm is raised, with the hand slightly open. The background is a deep, muted brown and dark gray, providing a stark contrast to the lighter tones of the figures' skin and clothing. The overall impression is one of a tender, intimate moment captured in a limited color palette.

alt_text: A multi-panel altarpiece depicting a robed saint, heavenly figures, demons, and earthly scenes
long_description: A vertical, rectangular altarpiece is composed of four panels framed in gold. The right panel is a single, tall vertical panel featuring a standing male figure, likely a saint, dressed in a dark brown or black monastic habit. He has a short beard and a halo. He holds a red book in his left hand and a tall staff with an ornate top in his right hand. At his feet, a small, dark brown, four-legged animal lies on its back. The background is gold, and the top of this panel has an elaborate gold archway with gothic tracery. The left side of the altarpiece is divided into two square-ish panels, one above the other. Both are also framed in gold with gothic arches at the top. The upper left panel depicts a crowded scene with many figures. In the upper part, numerous figures with halos and wings, dressed in various colored robes (pink, brown, white), are arranged on clouds against a dark blue sky. Some hold objects like a cross or a banner with a red cross on a white field. Below them, several dark, horned, winged, and animalistic figures, resembling demons, are depicted on a dark, rocky landscape. The lower left panel shows a group of figures on a rocky landscape with dark, pointed hills in the background. On the left, a figure with a halo, wearing a dark robe and a pink garment, stands with an outstretched hand, facing a group of five other figures. These figures also have halos and are dressed in various robes (pink, brown, blue). Some hold staffs or books. Small white, round objects are scattered on the ground in the foreground. The background is a dark, rocky landscape with a few dark green trees.

metadata.title: Saint Giles with Christ Triumphant over Satan and the Mission of the Apostles

alt_text: Two figures embrace in a lush landscape with cherubs, an urn, and distant hills
long_description: A classical painting depicts a scene with multiple figures in a natural setting. In the center, a light-skinned woman, mostly nude, sits on a white cloth draped over a dark rock. She has light hair adorned with a white flower and green leaves, and holds a small pink flower in her left hand. She leans towards a light-skinned man with reddish-brown hair, who is partially draped in a flowing yellow cloth. The man embraces the woman, their faces close together as if kissing. His left arm is around her waist, and his right arm rests on her shoulder. Behind the embracing couple, to the upper left, a large, dark brown urn rests on a light-colored pedestal, partially hidden by dark green foliage. To the upper right, three winged cherubs are visible. Two cherubs with light hair are clustered on a cloud-like formation, looking down at the couple. One of them holds a small white flower. A third cherub, also with light hair, flies higher and further right, reaching towards a tree branch. In the lower right foreground, a fourth nude cherub with light hair kneels on a small rock, holding a bouquet of small colorful flowers. A yellow cloth is draped on the ground near this cherub's feet. The background features a dark green, leafy tree on the right, and a distant landscape with rolling hills under a blue sky on the far right. The foreground ground is a mix of dark green foliage and brown earth.

alt_text: A crowded painting of three crucifixions on a golden background with many figures and soldiers on horseback
long_description: This horizontal rectangular painting depicts a crowded scene of three crucifixions against a textured golden background. Three figures are nailed to wooden crosses, positioned across the upper third of the composition. The central figure, on a slightly taller cross, has a pale green body and wears a white loincloth. Two angels with blue and pink wings float near his head. The figure on the left cross also has a pale green body and a white loincloth. The figure on the right cross has a lighter skin tone and a white loincloth. Dark green rocky mounds are visible beneath the side crosses, contrasting with the golden sky. The lower two-thirds of the painting are densely populated with a large crowd of people and soldiers on horseback. On the far left, a group of figures, predominantly women, are gathered, some appearing to support a woman in a blue robe and red cloak. Several figures in this group have halos. In the center, directly beneath the central cross, are numerous standing figures and some on horseback. One figure in a long golden robe stands prominently. To the right, a group of soldiers on horseback, clad in armor and holding spears, are depicted. Some shields are visible, one bearing the red letters "S.P.Q.R." A red banner with the same inscription, "S.P.Q.R.", is visible on the far right. The figures wear garments in a variety of colors including reds, blues, greens, browns, and whites. Many figures, particularly on the left, are depicted with halos. The ground beneath the crowd is a dark, earthy tone.

alt_text: A bearded man in a bishop's miter and red and gold robes, holding a staff, within a circular frame.
long_description: The artwork is a square panel depicting a half-length figure of a man within a circular frame. The central figure, a man with a light-colored beard and mustache, faces forward with a neutral expression. He wears a tall, ornate miter on his head, which is decorated with gold patterns and green and red jewels. A golden halo encircles his head against a dark blue background. His right hand is raised with two fingers extended in a gesture, while his left hand holds a tall, golden staff topped with a curved cross. He is dressed in elaborate robes: a white undergarment, a red outer cloak with wide gold-patterned borders, and a gold-patterned stole around his neck. The gold patterns on his garments feature intricate scrolling designs. The circular central image is set against a wider gold background, which is decorated with a repeating pattern of small, overlapping circles and a swirling vine motif along the inner edge of the circle. The entire panel has a visible wooden frame at its edges. The background behind the figure is a deep, dark blue.

alt_text: Crucified Christ on a cross, surrounded by ten haloed figures against a gold background.
long_description: A religious painting depicts the crucifixion of Christ against a gold background. In the center, a nude male figure, Christ, is nailed to a simple wooden cross, wearing a white loincloth. Blood is visible on his hands, feet, and from a wound on his right side. A golden halo encircles his head. The background is entirely gold leaf, textured with visible wear and scratches. Below the cross, ten haloed figures are arranged on a dark, uneven ground. From left to right: A woman in a black habit stands with hands clasped in prayer. Next to her, a man in a bishop's miter and ornate green, blue, and white robes holds an open red book. Beside him, a woman in a dark blue robe stands, looking up at Christ. In front of her, a figure in a dark brown habit kneels, also looking upwards. Directly below Christ, a woman in a red dress kneels with arms raised, gazing up. To her right, a man in a dark purple robe stands with his left hand to his head, looking up. Next, a man in a dark brown habit kneels, writing in a blue book. Beside him, a man in a dark brown habit stands with hands clasped in prayer. On the far right, a woman in a light grey dress and pinkish-purple cloak holds a small bowl.

metadata.title: The Crucifixion
metadata.medium: Tempera transferred to canvas, laid down on wood, gold ground

alt_text: A Nativity scene with Mary and Joseph kneeling before the radiant baby Jesus, surrounded by angels above.
long_description: This horizontal panel painting depicts a Nativity scene. In the center foreground, the baby Jesus lies on a golden cloth, radiating golden light outwards. To the left, Mary kneels, facing right, with her hands clasped in prayer. She wears a deep blue cloak over a red dress, and a golden halo encircles her head. To the right, Joseph kneels, facing left, with his hands clasped to his chest. He wears a red cloak over a blue garment, also with a golden halo. Behind the figures, a dark, simple stable structure is visible. A gray donkey stands behind Mary, and a light brown ox behind Joseph, both looking towards the baby. Above the stable, a row of twelve angels, each with a golden halo and wings, kneel on a blue, cloud-like band. They are dressed in robes of various colors, including blue, red, black, gold, pink, and purple, and have their hands clasped in prayer. The background on the left features a green tree with dark foliage and a red-walled building. On the right, a rocky, barren landscape with a few small structures rises. The ground is a greenish-brown, and the sky transitions from dark blue at the top to a lighter blue-green.

alt_text: A Nativity scene with Mary and Joseph kneeling before baby Jesus, with angels above
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting, set within a golden frame, depicts a Nativity scene. The upper portion of the artwork features a light blue sky with a horizontal band of light brown below it. Six small, robed figures, likely angels, are arranged in two groups of three, floating above the brown band and appearing to look downwards. Faint, light-colored text in a non-Latin script is visible in the blue sky above the figures. Below this, a thatched roof structure, composed of horizontal brown and yellow lines, extends across the width of the painting. The main scene unfolds beneath the roof, within a simple, dark brown stable interior with a lighter brown floor. At the center bottom, a naked baby, adorned with a golden halo, lies horizontally on a white cloth, facing slightly to the left. To the left of the baby, a woman, dressed in a dark blue robe and a white head covering, kneels on the ground, her hands clasped in prayer. She also has a golden halo. To the right of the baby, a man, wearing a dark blue tunic with a red-brown cloak, kneels with his hands raised, palms open. He, too, is depicted with a golden halo. In the dark background of the stable, the head of a brown cow with horns is visible on the left, looking towards the baby. To its right, a white animal, possibly a donkey, is partially visible. The overall color palette is muted, with dominant browns, blues, and reds, accented by gold halos.

alt_text: A painting of a bare-chested man with a crown of thorns, long hair, and a beard against a dark background
long_description: This vertical painting depicts the bust of a man against a dark, almost black background. The man's head is slightly tilted, and his gaze is directed forward and slightly upward. He has long, dark brown hair that falls over his shoulders and a full, reddish-brown beard and mustache. A crown of green and brown thorns rests on his head, with some thorns visibly piercing his forehead. His face is pale, with prominent cheekbones and a slightly open mouth. His eyes are wide and appear to be looking out of the frame. The man's bare chest and shoulders are visible, rendered in light skin tones with subtle shadows defining the collarbones and musculature. The skin shows fine cracks, suggesting age in the paint. At the very bottom of the painting, a light beige horizontal bar extends across the width of the frame. On this bar, slightly to the right of the center, is a small, square emblem composed of four smaller squares, alternating in light grey and white, creating a checkered pattern.

metadata.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
metadata.artist: Antonello da Messina (Antonello di Giovanni d'Antonio)
metadata.medium: Oil, possibly over tempera, on wood

alt_text: Portrait of a young man with reddish-blonde hair and a dark cap against a dark background
long_description: A head and shoulders portrait depicts a young man with fair skin, turned slightly to the left, looking forward. His reddish-blonde, wavy hair falls to his shoulders, framing his face. He has light blue eyes, a small nose, and closed lips forming a subtle, gentle smile. He wears a dark, soft cap that covers the top of his head and a dark tunic or shirt with a high neckline. A narrow white collar is visible at his neck, secured by a small white tie or clasp. The background is a solid, dark, almost black color, providing a stark contrast to his illuminated face. The lighting appears to come from the left, highlighting his features.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Young Man
metadata.artist: Antonello da Messina (Antonello di Giovanni d'Antonio)

alt_text: Black and white painting of a woman breastfeeding a baby, both with halos and a visibly cracked surface
long_description: The image is a vertical, black and white painting depicting a woman breastfeeding a baby, rendered with a visible network of fine cracks across its surface. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, faces left with her head tilted down, looking towards the baby. She wears a dark, draped garment that covers her head and shoulders, revealing her right breast. Her face is smooth, with downcast eyes and a small mouth. A circular halo, decorated with small floral or star-like patterns, surrounds her head. The baby is held in the woman's left arm, positioned horizontally across her lap, facing right and looking up at her breast. The baby's left arm is bent, with its hand near its chest, while its right arm is extended towards the woman's breast. The baby's legs are bent, and its feet are visible. A smaller, simpler halo encircles the baby's head. The background is a light, textured surface, appearing to be a plain wall or sky, with the same cracking pattern as the figures. The overall impression is one of intimacy and tenderness, captured in a monochromatic palette.

alt_text: A Nativity scene with Mary, Joseph, and baby Jesus, surrounded by angels, shepherds, and a landscape
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a Nativity scene set in a rocky landscape with a distant town. In the center, Mary and Joseph kneel in adoration before the infant Jesus, who lies on a white cloth on the ground. Mary, on the right, wears a dark blue robe over a red garment, with her hands clasped in prayer. Joseph, on the left, wears a purple robe with a white sash, also with hands clasped. Behind them, a brown cow and a dark donkey are visible within a simple, thatched-roof shelter formed by rocks. Above the shelter, two angels kneel on a cloud, one in an orange robe and the other in a pink robe, both with wings, holding a scroll. To the far left, a winged angel in a red robe flies in the light blue sky. Below, two shepherds stand, one holding a staff, looking upwards, with several white sheep grazing nearby. The background on the left features green hills, trees, and distant blue mountains under a pale sky. On the far right, a shepherd sits on a rock, playing a pipe, with a few sheep near him. Behind him, a fortified town with red-roofed buildings and tall towers is visible on a green hill, receding into the background. The overall color palette is earthy, with greens, browns, blues, and touches of red and purple.

alt_text: A man and woman in period clothing sit before a landscape painting with mountains, a castle, and a church.
long_description: A horizontal painting depicts a man and a woman seated side-by-side, facing slightly right, with a detailed landscape visible behind them through what appears to be a window. The man, on the left, has a round face, light skin, and short reddish-brown hair visible under a large, brown fur hat. He wears a dark coat with a wide, light brown fur collar. His hands are clasped in front of him. The woman, on the right, has a pale complexion and wears a white, rounded head covering that completely conceals her hair. Her face is somewhat angular, and she looks straight ahead. She is dressed in a teal-green gown with a wide, dark collar and cuffs, and a white undergarment is visible at her neckline. Her hands are clasped, holding a small, light-colored object. Between the two figures, and extending behind them, is a vibrant landscape scene. On the left, behind the man, are blue mountains and a light-colored castle by a body of water. To the right, behind both figures, a winding river flows through a green and brown landscape with scattered trees. A white church with a tall spire stands on a hill, and a small bridge crosses the river. Tiny figures are visible on paths in the landscape.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Married Couple (Lorenz Kraffter and Honesta Merz?)

alt_text: A family of six, with a man pointing, stands in a lush landscape with a distant town.
long_description: The painting depicts a family of six positioned in a verdant landscape under a partly cloudy sky. On the left, a man stands, dressed in a dark coat, breeches, and a wide-brimmed black hat, with a white collar. He points his right arm towards the distant horizon, where a town with spires is visible amidst rolling green hills. To his left, a young boy in a light gray suit, a hat, and holding a stick, stands looking forward. To the right of the man, a woman sits on a low bank, wearing a long, flowing red gown with white sleeves and a white collar, and a white cap. She holds the hand of a small infant dressed in white, who stands beside her. To her right, another infant in a light blue dress stands, holding a stick. Further right, an older boy in a brown suit and hat stands, holding a stick, with a small brown deer at his feet. The background features a dense forest of dark green trees on the right, with lighter green trees on the left. White flowers are visible on some of the trees. In the upper right corner, partially obscured by foliage, two small figures are visible, one appearing to climb. The foreground consists of dark green foliage and a light brown path where the family stands. The sky above is a mix of light blue and white clouds.

alt_text: A partially nude woman with two children in a landscape, one on her shoulder, one by her leg
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a woman and two children in a natural landscape under a cloudy sky. The central figure is a woman, facing slightly right, with light skin and dark, wavy hair. She is mostly nude, with a blue drapery wrapped around her left shoulder and waist, covering her lower body. Her right hand rests on her hip, while her left arm supports a child on her left shoulder. This child, with light skin and curly blonde hair, looks towards the viewer with a slight smile, partially covered by a reddish-brown cloth. A second child, also with light skin and curly blonde hair, stands to the woman's lower left, holding onto the blue drapery at her waist and looking towards the viewer with a smile. To the left of the woman, two tall, slender trees with dark foliage stand, with a dark bird perched on a branch of the left tree. In the distant background, a light-colored building with an arched entrance is visible, accompanied by several small, dark deer-like animals. The sky is a dark blue with lighter blue and white clouds, and distant, dark blue mountains rise on the horizon. The ground is a mix of dark brown and green, with some lighter patches, suggesting an outdoor setting.

alt_text: Nude woman with a large bird and cherubic figures emerging from broken eggs in a landscape
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a nude woman with a large bird and several small figures in a natural landscape. The light-skinned woman, with braided light brown hair, stands or sits centrally, looking down towards the bird's head. Her left hand is near the bird's beak, which is close to her chest. The bird is large, with greyish-brown feathers, a long neck, and webbed feet, positioned to her right. Around the woman's feet are five small, nude, cherubic figures. On the left, two figures are partially encased in broken eggshells; one sits with an eggshell around its lower body, looking down, while another sits with an eggshell on its head, covering its face. On the right, two figures interact, one standing over another lying on its back, partially in a broken eggshell. Another broken eggshell is visible to the far right. The background features dark green trees with thick trunks behind the main figures. To the left, a dirt path leads towards a light-colored, multi-story building with an arched entrance, where two small figures are visible. The ground is a mix of brown and green, with some darker foliage in the foreground. The sky above is light blue with scattered white clouds.

alt_text: A woman with red hair holds a nude baby, both with halos, against a dark, rocky background with flowers
long_description: A painting depicts a woman holding a baby, positioned centrally and slightly to the left. The woman has reddish-brown, curly hair adorned with what appear to be dark red roses. She wears a red gown with a gold-trimmed neckline and a green mantle draped over her left shoulder and lap. A faint golden halo encircles her head. Her gaze is directed downwards towards the baby, her face in profile. The baby, nude, is held in her arms, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. The baby has light reddish-brown curly hair and a faint halo. Its right arm is raised, resting on the woman's chest, while its left arm is around her neck. Its legs are bent, with the feet resting on the green drapery. The background is dark and appears to be a rocky grotto or cave. On the right side, behind the woman's shoulder, several dark red roses with green stems and leaves emerge from the rock. On the lower left, near the woman's lap, lighter-colored flowers with green stems and leaves are visible against the dark background. The lighting is focused on the figures, creating a strong contrast with the dark surroundings.

alt_text: A seated portrait of an elderly woman wearing a black dress, a large white ruff, and a white cap.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts an elderly woman seated, facing forward with her head slightly turned towards the viewer's right. Her face, illuminated from the left, shows numerous wrinkles around her eyes and mouth, with a pale complexion. She has small, dark eyes, a straight nose, and thin, closed lips. Her short, light grey hair is mostly covered by a white, close-fitting cap that frames her face. She wears a large, stiff, white pleated ruff around her neck, which stands out against her dark attire. Her long-sleeved dress is black, appearing to be made of a heavy fabric, possibly velvet, with subtle patterns visible on the sleeves and bodice. White cuffs are visible at her wrists. Her left hand, adorned with a simple gold ring on her ring finger, rests on her lap or the arm of the chair. Her right hand is partially obscured by her body and the chair arm. The background is a plain, dark brown, with a hint of a wooden chair back visible behind her on the right side. The overall lighting emphasizes her face and the white elements of her clothing.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of an elderly woman with a wrinkled face, wearing a white ruff and dark clothing
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts an elderly woman seated and facing towards the left side of the frame, against a plain, dark brown background. Her light-skinned face is heavily wrinkled, with a soft gaze directed to her left. She has light-colored eyes and her grey hair is partially visible beneath a dark cap and a prominent white, winged bonnet that frames her face. A large, multi-layered white ruff with numerous pleats encircles her neck, casting subtle shadows. She wears a dark, possibly black, gown with wide sleeves, which appears to be made of a heavy fabric like velvet. The gown features a brown, possibly fur, trim or lining visible on her chest and shoulders. Her hands are clasped together at her waist, resting on what appears to be the dark, carved wooden armrest of a chair, though only a small portion of the chair is visible on the lower left. The overall color palette is dominated by dark browns and blacks, contrasted by the bright white of her ruff and bonnet.

alt_text: A seated older man with a white beard and black cap holds an open book and spectacles.
long_description: A portrait depicts an older man with light skin, a long white beard, and a black cap, seated and looking slightly to the viewer's right. He wears a dark, possibly black, robe or coat with a white ruffled collar. His face is illuminated from the upper left, highlighting his features and the texture of his beard. His left arm rests on a reddish-brown wooden chair armrest, which features carved details. In his hands, he holds a small, open book with golden edges. His right hand, holding a pair of wire-rimmed spectacles, rests on the open pages of the book. The book displays black-and-white illustrations, appearing to be botanical in nature, possibly depicting plants or flowers. The background is a plain, dark brown or grey, providing a stark contrast to the illuminated figure. On the right side of the dark background, light-colored text is visible, reading 'A. DE. VOS. Fecit. 1635.'

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man, Possibly a Botanist

alt_text: Three men in a small wooden boat on calm water, conversing, with large ships in the hazy background
long_description: An oil painting depicts three men in a small wooden boat on calm, light-colored water under a hazy, bright sky. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, dark grays, and soft yellows. In the foreground, the three men are seated within the boat, facing each other. The man on the left wears a dark, patterned jacket, a dark cap, and a light sash around his waist, gesturing with his hands as he speaks to the man in the middle. The middle man wears a dark sweater and a dark cap, with his hands clasped in front of him, looking towards the left. The man on the right, seen in profile, wears a dark coat and a dark cap, holding something to his mouth. The boat itself is a simple rowboat with light-colored interior planks and a dark trim. On the right side of the boat's stern, the signature "D. M. RAE" and the year "1885" are visible. In the background, the water extends to a hazy horizon. On the left, several large ships with masts and smokestacks are silhouetted against the bright sky. Further to the right, smaller, indistinct boats are visible in the distance, blending into the atmospheric haze.

alt_text: Mary and Jesus in clouds appear to a woman writing in a landscape with a raven
long_description: The painting depicts two distinct scenes, one celestial and one earthly, separated by a vertical column of white clouds. On the left, in the upper half, a woman in a long blue robe holds a baby. Both figures have golden halos. The woman, with long brown hair, stands on a golden crescent moon, surrounded by a radiant golden light and white clouds. The baby, mostly unclothed, is held in her left arm, looking towards the viewer. On the right, a woman with curly blonde hair and a golden halo sits on a rock, dressed in a flowing red gown. She holds an open book in her left hand and a quill in her right, appearing to write. Her gaze is directed upwards and slightly left, towards the celestial vision. Behind her, a dark tree with green foliage hangs over a body of water. In the distance, across the water, are green hills or mountains and a small town with buildings and boats. The sky above is light blue with white clouds. In the lower left foreground, a large black bird, possibly a raven, stands on a closed blue book adorned with golden clasps and corner protectors. The bird has a small golden halo above its head and golden talons. The ground beneath the woman and the bird is a dark, rocky terrain. The overall palette includes rich blues, reds, greens, and golds against a muted landscape.

metadata.title: Saint John on Patmos
metadata.medium: Oil, gold, and white metal on spruce

alt_text: A black and white painting of a woman in dark robes holding a nude infant against a landscape and dark drapery
long_description: A black and white vertical painting depicts a woman holding a nude infant. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, has her head tilted down and to the left, looking at the child. She wears a dark, flowing robe that covers her head and shoulders, with a lighter band visible around her forehead. A decorative brooch with a central dark stone is on her chest. A faint halo is visible around her head. Her left arm supports the child's back, and her right hand holds the child's leg. The infant, nude and plump, sits upright on the woman's lap, facing slightly left and looking upwards. His right hand holds a small, dark, stick-like object. His left arm rests on the woman's arm. His legs are bent, with his feet visible. The background is divided: to the left of the figures, a landscape with distant mountains, a body of water, and trees under a cloudy sky is visible. To the right, dark, heavily folded drapery fills the space behind the woman's head and right shoulder. The overall tone is dark, with lighter tones for the skin of the figures and parts of the landscape.

alt_text: A triptych painting depicting the Madonna and Child in the center, flanked by two standing saints
long_description: This triptych painting features three vertical panels, each depicting a figure or figures against a gold background. The central panel shows a seated woman holding a child. The woman, positioned slightly to the right, wears a dark blue cloak over a red garment, with her head gently tilted towards the child. The child, mostly nude, is held in her left arm and looks up at her, holding a small, dark object in their hands. Both figures have faint halos around their heads. To the left, a standing male figure faces right, towards the central panel. He has a long white beard and hair, and wears a green cloak over a red undergarment. He holds a slender staff in his right hand and a closed, dark book in his left. His bare feet are visible at the bottom of the panel. A faint halo encircles his head. The right panel features a standing female figure, facing left, also towards the central panel. She has light brown hair and wears a pink cloak draped over a blue garment. In her left hand, she holds a long, green palm frond, and in her right, a small, flaming heart. Her bare feet are visible, and a faint halo is above her head. The gold background behind all figures shows some texture and wear.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Philip and Agnes

alt_text: A man in an ornate bullfighter's suit sits slumped on a carved wooden bench, surrounded by his gear
long_description: An oil painting depicts a man in an elaborate bullfighter's suit, slumped on a dark, ornately carved wooden bench. The man, with reddish-brown hair, has his head bowed, looking downwards. His right arm rests on his leg, while his left arm is bent, with his hand resting on the bench. He wears a dark blue jacket with extensive gold and red embroidery, a white ruffled shirt, bright yellow breeches tied with red bows at the knees, white stockings, and black loafers. To the left of the man, on the bench, is a silver-colored hat, and on the floor, a pair of white gloves. To the right of the man, a large, dark, studded leather chair is visible. Next to the chair, a dark, folded cape or fabric, a sword, and a brass brazier-like object are arranged on the floor. The background above the bench features a dark wall with subtle floral patterns. Above this, a painting shows the lower half of two figures in flowing robes. The overall color palette is dark and rich, with deep browns, blues, and reds contrasting with the man's yellow breeches and white shirt. In the bottom right corner, the signature "C. BARGUE. 71" is visible.

alt_text: A man in a striped turban and gold tunic sits on a stone bench, holding a stringed instrument
long_description: The painting depicts a man seated on a rough, light gray stone bench, positioned slightly to the right of the canvas's center. He faces the viewer's right but turns his head to look towards the left. He wears a multi-colored turban with red, yellow, and green stripes, and has a dark mustache and small earrings. His attire includes a gold-colored tunic with blue trim over a white shirt, white trousers, and a dark, flowing garment covering his lower body. His right foot is bare, while his left foot wears a dark, pointed slipper. He holds a stringed musical instrument in his lap, featuring a long, dark neck and a bulbous, ribbed body in shades of light blue and green. To his left, on the stone bench, rests a small, ornate cup with red and gold accents, and a long pipe with a dark stem and a light-colored bowl. The background is predominantly dark brown and black, with a faint, lighter architectural detail visible in the upper left corner. A dark, metallic pot or vessel is partially visible on the right side of the background. On the dark ground in the lower right, several yellow and orange peels are scattered. The lighting is dramatic, illuminating the man and the objects immediately around him, while the rest of the scene recedes into shadow.

alt_text: Eight-panel religious painting depicting various biblical scenes and figures on a gold background
long_description: The painting is a vertical rectangular panel divided into eight smaller rectangular scenes, arranged in two columns and four rows. Each scene features multiple figures with halos against a textured gold background. The top left panel depicts two crowned figures seated on a throne, flanked by two standing figures. The figure on the right places a crown on the head of the figure on the left. The top right panel shows five standing figures in various robes, holding staffs or with hands raised. The second row, left panel, illustrates a body being lowered, supported by several figures in pink, green, and light brown robes. A kneeling figure in yellow attends to the feet. The second row, right panel, shows a group of figures mourning over a recumbent body, with one figure in blue supporting the head. The third row, left panel, features figures gathered around a dark opening, possibly a tomb, with a kneeling figure in pink at the entrance. A red, flowing object is in the upper part of the scene. The third row, right panel, displays a crowd of figures looking upwards, some with arms raised, beneath several small, light blue, bird-like forms in the gold sky. The bottom left panel presents an architectural structure with multiple arched openings, within which approximately ten haloed figures are visible, depicted from the chest up. The bottom right panel features a central, partially nude figure with a red drape and visible wounds, standing on a raised platform, surrounded by a blue aura. Several figures are seated or standing on either side, and small, dark figures lie prostrate below the platform.

metadata.title: Scenes from the Life of Christ
metadata.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood, gold ground

alt_text: A woman in red and blue holds a baby, with another child looking up, framed by two landscape windows.
long_description: A painting depicts a woman, likely the Madonna, seated centrally, facing slightly right, and looking down at the baby she holds. She wears a deep red gown with long sleeves and a blue mantle draped over her lap and legs. A sheer, light-colored veil covers her brown hair, and a faint golden halo encircles her head. The baby, likely the Christ Child, sits on her lap, facing left and looking down. He is nude, with plump limbs, and raises his right hand with fingers splayed. His left hand holds a dark, small object, possibly a rosary or chain, which the woman also holds with her right hand. A faint golden halo is visible above his head. To the lower right, a third child, likely John the Baptist, is partially visible, looking up and to the left. He has curly brown hair and wears a light-colored garment, with his hands clasped at his chest. A faint golden cross is visible near his left shoulder. Behind the woman, two rectangular windows open to landscapes. The left window shows a green, tree-filled landscape with a distant building and a small figure on horseback. The right window shows a more open landscape with rolling hills, a building with a red roof, and a faint, curved rainbow-like arc in the sky. The overall palette includes rich reds, blues, and greens for the drapery, warm skin tones, and muted greens and blues for the landscapes.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist
metadata.artist: Fra Bartolomeo (Bartolomeo di Paolo del Fattorino)

alt_text: A portrait of a man in a red cap and black tunic against a landscape with trees and distant buildings.
long_description:
The painting depicts a man in a head-and-shoulders portrait, positioned slightly to the left and looking towards the right. He has a pale complexion, dark brown hair that reaches his shoulders, and a short, dark fringe across his forehead. His eyes are light, and his nose is long and straight. He wears a red, soft cap that covers the top of his head and ears. Around his neck and draped over his shoulders is a light pink scarf, tied loosely. His garment is a dark, almost black, tunic with a high neckline.

The background features a light blue sky that transitions to a lighter hue near the horizon. On the left, a small, leafy tree stands on a gentle hill, with faint white buildings visible in the distance behind it. On the right, a taller, more slender tree with distinct green leaves rises from a golden-brown ground. The landscape behind the man consists of rolling hills in muted greens and browns.

Across the top of the painting, in gold lettering, is the inscription: "MATTHAEVS. SASS. TVE. NVS. OBIIT. 1506". The overall composition places the man prominently in the foreground against a receding landscape.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man
metadata.artist: Fra Bartolomeo (Bartolomeo di Paolo del Fattorino)

alt_text: A street scene with a woman tending to a fallen man, a white horse, and groups of people near pink buildings.
long_description: The painting depicts an outdoor scene with numerous figures and pink-hued buildings. In the right foreground, a woman dressed in a dark brown or black habit with a white wimple kneels, supporting the upper body of a man lying on the ground. The man wears a red tunic and blue trousers. His head is slightly raised, and his eyes are closed. To the right of this pair stands a white horse, saddled with a dark teal blanket and bridle, facing left. Its head is slightly lowered. In the center of the composition, a group of approximately eight men stands, conversing. They wear various colored robes and hats, including red, purple, and dark blue. One man in a prominent red robe and hat stands slightly forward, looking towards the kneeling woman. A brown dog lies on the ground in front of this group, facing right. To the far left, two men stand facing each other, engaged in conversation. One wears a light pink robe and a red hood, while the other wears a dark teal robe. The background is dominated by buildings rendered in shades of pink and light red. These structures feature arched doorways, rectangular windows, and some architectural details like pilasters and cornices. A darker, more ornate building with a tall, narrow archway and a small religious image above it is visible on the far right, next to the horse. Green foliage is visible behind some of the buildings. The ground is a light, sandy color.

metadata.title: Saint Dominic Resuscitating Napoleone Orsini
metadata.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: Monastic figures and bearded men in a multi-level pink architectural structure filled with open books.
long_description: The painting depicts a multi-level architectural interior rendered in shades of pink and brown. The composition is divided vertically by a prominent white column on the left and horizontally by floor levels. In the upper left section, a figure in a dark hooded robe is visible from the chest up, reading an open red book while leaning on a dark railing. This figure is positioned within an arched opening, suggesting a balcony or upper window. Below this, on the mid-left side, another figure in a dark hooded robe stands, facing right. This figure has a golden halo around their head and appears to be reaching towards a shelf of open books behind them. This area is also framed by a large archway. The right side of the painting features a lower level with a wooden counter, behind which three figures are positioned. The central figure wears a dark hooded robe and is actively reading an open book placed on the counter. To the left of this central figure, an older man with a white beard and a red garment looks towards the center. To the right, another older man with a white beard and a striped garment also looks towards the center. Above these three figures, a long shelf holds numerous open books, some with prominent red covers, arranged in a row. The overall lighting is soft, and the colors are muted, emphasizing the architectural forms and the figures within.

metadata.title: Saint Thomas Aquinas Aided by Saints Peter and Paul

alt_text: A crowded, dramatic painting depicts multiple figures in a hilly landscape, some engaged in conflict.
long_description: The painting depicts a crowded, dramatic scene set against a dark background with a hilly landscape. On the far left, two figures in long, flowing robes, one pink and one white, stand facing right, observing the unfolding events. Next to them, a figure in elaborate golden armor with a red shield and a spear stands prominently. Behind these figures, a small town with white buildings is visible on a reddish-brown hill. Moving towards the center, a dense group of figures is engaged in a struggle. Several figures wear blue or light-colored armor and carry shields. One figure is on the ground, dressed in red and yellow garments. Small, dark green trees and bushes are scattered across the middle ground. On the right side of the composition, the conflict continues. A nearly nude figure with a halo is being pulled by several other figures up a dark, rocky hill. Another figure in red pants and golden armor, holding a spear, stands in the foreground. Further back, another small town with white buildings crowns a distant hill. The overall scene is filled with movement and tension, with figures in various states of action and distress. The color palette includes rich reds, blues, golds, and earthy tones against a dark sky.

alt_text: A painting depicting multiple figures mourning over a body and lowering another into a tomb
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a crowded scene of multiple figures against a golden-brown, textured background with rolling hills. On the left, a group of figures surrounds a body lying horizontally on the ground. A figure in a red robe kneels, cradling the head of the body, which is wrapped in white cloth. Behind them, a figure in a blue robe kneels, bending over the body's legs. Two figures with golden halos stand behind, raising their hands in gestures of distress; one wears blue and red, the other blue. A figure in a dark robe kneels at the center, embracing the midsection of the body on the ground. To the right, a light pink sarcophagus is positioned diagonally, with its open side facing the viewer. Several figures are actively lowering a second body, also wrapped in white cloth, into the sarcophagus. One figure in a dark robe supports the upper torso, while another in a blue robe supports the legs. A figure in a light blue robe stands centrally, facing away, observing the scene. Another figure in a pink robe kneels in front of the sarcophagus, looking into it. A simple wooden cross-like structure leans against the front of the sarcophagus. Most of the figures in the scene are depicted with golden halos around their heads. The ground beneath the figures is a speckled golden-brown.

alt_text: A young woman in a garden looks up at two ethereal figures near a stone house, surrounded by trees.
long_description: A painting depicts a young woman standing in an overgrown garden, looking upwards and to her right. She is positioned in the right foreground, wearing a grey-blue blouse with white sleeves and a long brown skirt. Her hair is pulled back with a dark band, and her left arm is slightly extended to the right, palm open. To her left, partially obscured by dark green foliage, are two translucent, pale figures. One appears to be a winged woman holding a basket or vessel, while the other is a male figure, seemingly in armor, standing upright. In the mid-ground, a light-colored stone house with dark windows is visible, surrounded by more garden plants, including what resembles cabbage. A wooden structure, possibly a cage or trellis, stands near the ethereal figures. Dark green trees with dense foliage frame the left side and top of the composition. The ground is covered in various green and brown plants, suggesting a wild or untended garden. The overall lighting is subdued, creating a somewhat mystical atmosphere.

alt_text: A woman with a bow and a winged child in a landscape with two dogs
long_description: A classical painting depicts a woman and a winged child in a natural landscape with two dogs. The woman, positioned slightly left of center, sits on a red drapery that cascades over her legs. She wears a light-colored, off-the-shoulder garment that exposes her right breast and arm. Her dark hair is pulled back, and she looks down towards the child. Her left arm is raised, holding a brown bow, while her right arm extends forward. The nude, winged child kneels on the ground to her right, reaching up towards her right arm with both hands. The child has curly hair and a quiver of arrows strapped to their back. To the left, a lean, brown dog sits upright, looking towards the woman and child. Behind it, a darker dog lies on the ground. The background features a lush green landscape with trees on both sides, a distant structure on the horizon, and a blue sky with light clouds above. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the figures in the foreground.

alt_text: A young man in a red suit stands beside a table with classical sculptures, a dog at his feet
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young man in an elaborate red suit standing in an interior setting. He is positioned slightly to the right of center, facing forward with his head turned slightly to the left. His left arm is bent at the elbow, with his hand resting on his hip, while his right arm is extended forward, palm open, gesturing towards a large, ornate wooden table to his left. He wears a powdered white wig, a white ruffled shirt, a white waistcoat with gold embroidery, red breeches, white stockings, and black shoes with buckles. On the table are several objects: a stack of books, a quill and inkwell, a classical bust of a woman, and a celestial globe. Behind the table, a larger classical statue of a standing figure is visible. The background features a dark wall on the left, a draped brown curtain on the right, and a glimpse of a blue sky and a green, hilly landscape with a distant building through an opening. A dark green upholstered chair with a dark hat on it is visible to the right of the young man. A small brown and white dog lies on the checkered green and white floor in the lower left corner, looking up at the young man.

alt_text: A large stone gate and wall with two round towers, a grassy foreground, and several figures and animals.
long_description: A landscape painting depicts a large, ancient-looking stone wall and gate under a light blue sky with some clouds. The wall stretches across the middle ground, featuring a prominent arched gateway in the center. Two large, round towers, constructed from rough-hewn, light brown and gray stones, flank the central archway. The wall extends to the right, showing smaller rectangular openings, while to the left, it appears partially ruined. In the foreground, a wide expanse of green grass with patches of lighter brown dirt covers the lower half of the painting. On the left, near the gate, a person wearing a blue top and a hat sits atop a light-colored donkey or small horse, facing right. Another person, wearing a reddish hat and dark clothing, stands beside the donkey, looking towards the rider. Through the archway, a narrow street lined with light-colored buildings is visible, receding into the distance. To the right of the foreground, a white horse or donkey grazes on the grass, facing left. Further to the right and slightly closer to the viewer, a person with dark hair, wearing a light-colored shirt and dark pants, sits on the ground, leaning against a brown object. This seated figure appears to be engaged in an activity with their hands. Near this person, two small, dark-colored animals, possibly dogs, lie on the grass. The sky above is a pale blue with wispy white clouds, suggesting a bright, possibly sunny, day, with some shadows cast on the ground. A signature "P. Bazille 1867" is visible in the bottom right corner.

metadata.title: Porte de la Reine at Aigues-Mortes

alt_text: A couple rests in a grassy field near a stone monument with hooded figures and a recumbent effigy, with trees and ruins beyond.
long_description: The painting depicts a verdant landscape dominated by a large stone monument and two figures in the foreground. The monument, positioned slightly left of center, features a horizontal slab on which a recumbent effigy of a robed figure lies, head propped on a pillow. Below this, five standing, hooded figures, resembling monks or mourners, are carved into the monument's base, facing forward. Their faces are obscured by deep hoods, and their hands are clasped or hidden within their robes. To the left of the monument, a woman in a light-colored, possibly pink or peach, ruffled dress lies on her side on the grass, her head resting on her arm. Her dark hair is visible. Next to her, a man in a dark suit and white shirt sits upright, leaning back against the woman, with his arms crossed. A light blue umbrella is open and resting on the grass between them and the monument. Scattered flowers, primarily yellow and red, are visible on the grass around the couple. The foreground is a lush green lawn with small red and white wildflowers. In the mid-ground, behind the monument, a dense forest of dark green trees stretches across the upper half of the canvas. To the right, a faint, light-colored structure with arched openings, possibly ruins, is visible through the trees. A small, light brown animal, possibly a donkey or horse, grazes in the grass in the far right mid-ground. The sky above the trees is a pale blue with some white clouds. The overall lighting suggests a soft, diffused daylight.

alt_text: A man with powdered hair writes in an open book, seated beside a classical female bust.
long_description: A three-quarter length portrait depicts a man with powdered white hair, seated and looking directly at the viewer. He has a light complexion and is dressed in a dark brown coat with large buttons, a white ruffled cravat, and white cuffs. His right hand holds a dark pen, poised over an open book resting on his lap or a table. The book has white pages, some of which are fanned open. To the man's left, a light-colored classical bust of a bare-chested woman is visible, facing left in profile. The bust is positioned on a surface, with a glimpse of a cloudy sky and a distant landscape visible behind it through an opening. The background on the right is dark, with hints of reddish-brown tones, suggesting a draped fabric or wall. The overall lighting highlights the man's face and hands, as well as the bust and the open book.

alt_text: Portrait of a man in a dark military uniform with silver braiding, holding a sword, against a cloudy background
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man in a military uniform, positioned slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned to look towards the left. He has light brown, curly hair, fair skin with rosy cheeks, and light-colored eyes. His expression is neutral. The background is a muted, cloudy blend of warm brown tones on the left and cooler blue-grey tones on the right, suggesting an open sky. The man wears a dark blue or black military jacket, heavily adorned with horizontal rows of silver braiding across the chest, characteristic of a hussar uniform. A high white collar is visible beneath a black cravat, topped by a yellow or gold-trimmed collar. A light-colored sash or strap crosses his chest from his right shoulder to his left hip. On his left chest, a star-shaped medal with a red cross at its center is prominently displayed. His long sleeves are dark, matching the jacket, and feature intricate silver braided designs at the cuffs. A wide, deep red sash is wrapped around his waist, cinching the jacket. Below the jacket, he wears light brown or tan trousers. His right hand, positioned at the lower left of the canvas, rests on the hilt of a sword, which points downwards. The sword has a dark blade and a decorative tassel near the hilt. His left hand is mostly obscured by his body and the red sash.

metadata.title: George IV (1762–1830), When Prince of Wales

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in a white dress and red shawl, holding a fan, against a dark and landscape background
long_description: The painting is a three-quarter length portrait of a woman seated outdoors, facing slightly right with her gaze directed to the right. She has light brown, curly hair styled upwards, adorned with a dark band across her forehead. Her fair skin shows rosy cheeks and lips, and her eyes are light-colored. She wears a white, high-waisted dress with short, puffed sleeves, accented with gold clasps at the shoulders and gold bands on the upper arms. A long, reddish-pink shawl is draped over her left arm, across her lap, and down her right side. Her left arm rests on a dark, indistinct surface to her left, while her right arm extends downwards, holding a closed, golden-yellow fan with a dark handle. The background on the left is dark and shadowy, suggesting dense foliage. To the right, a landscape unfolds with dark trees, a body of water, and distant mountains under a cloudy sky, rendered in muted greens, browns, blues, and grays. The light source appears to come from the upper left, illuminating the woman's face and dress.

alt_text: A winter landscape painting with a church surrounded by people skating on a frozen river under a dark, cloudy sky
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a bustling winter scene under a dramatic, dark sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by heavy, dark grey clouds, with hints of lighter grey and blue peeking through in places. In the center, a prominent church with a tall steeple stands on a snow-covered bank, its light brown walls and snow-dusted roof contrasting with the somber sky. Bare, dark trees surround the church, their branches reaching upwards. The lower half of the painting shows a wide expanse of frozen ice, populated by numerous small figures engaged in various activities. On the left, a dark boat is partially visible at the edge of the ice, with several figures standing nearby. Across the ice, people are skating, walking, and playing. Some figures appear to be falling, while others pull a sled with a person on it. The figures are dressed in dark, heavy clothing, with some wearing hats. To the right, a cluster of houses with snow-covered roofs and bare trees lines the bank, and a small arched bridge is visible. The overall color palette is cool, with dominant greys, browns, and whites, punctuated by the warmer tones of the church and some of the figures' clothing.

alt_text: A portrait of a light-skinned man in a red cap and light tunic, looking right with crossed arms.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a light-skinned man, positioned slightly to the right, against a plain, dark background. He wears a close-fitting, bright red cap that covers his ears and the back of his head, with two small red ties hanging down on either side. His face is illuminated from the left, highlighting his prominent nose, thin lips, and dark eyes, which gaze towards the right. He has a serious expression. Around his neck, a white, ruffled collar or ruff is visible, extending slightly over the neckline of his tunic. He wears a light grey or off-white tunic with long, wide sleeves that show vertical folds. His arms are crossed at the waist, with his right hand's fingers visible resting on his left arm, mostly covered by the sleeve. The background is a solid, dark, almost black color, providing a stark contrast to the illuminated figure.

alt_text: A man in religious vestments with a staff and book, praying in a landscape setting
long_description: The image is a vertical, arched-top panel painting depicting a man in religious attire. A man with light skin, short light brown hair, and a tonsure stands slightly to the right of center, facing slightly left. He wears a dark robe, a white collar, and a large, ornate golden cope draped over his shoulders and extending down to his feet. The cope has a wide, embroidered border with small, dark figures in niches. His hands are clasped in prayer at chest level. A tall, golden, spiky staff or crozier rests against his left shoulder, extending upwards beyond the top of the panel. A large, circular, jeweled brooch is visible on his chest where the cope closes. To the man's right, a dark green draped table or lectern holds an open book. The book has visible lines of text or musical notation on both pages. Below the book, on the floor, rests a white and gold mitre, adorned with a small, colorful crest or emblem hanging from it. Behind the man and the table is a dark brown architectural column. The background features a landscape visible through an opening. On the left, several bare-branched trees stand near a building with a red roof. On the right, a river or body of water flows under a stone bridge with two arches. Distant hills or mountains are visible under a light sky. The overall color palette is rich, with deep golds, greens, and browns, contrasted with the lighter skin tones and sky.

alt_text: A triptych with Mary and Child enthroned, surrounded by saints and kneeling supplicants in a landscape
long_description: This triptych features three panels framed in ornate gold, each with a pointed arch at the top. The central panel depicts the Virgin Mary, dressed in a red gown and dark blue mantle, holding the Christ Child. They are seated on a tall, white marble throne with intricate architectural details, set within a grand structure. Above Mary, a golden, flaming object is surrounded by small angels and clouds. Below the throne, four figures kneel in prayer: two men in dark robes and two women in red and black habits. In a niche beneath them, two small, nude figures are visible. The background shows a distant landscape with hills, trees, and buildings under a blue sky.The left panel shows a standing male saint in a light brown habit, holding a staff. Below him, two male figures in similar habits kneel in prayer, facing the central panel. An angel is visible in the upper left corner of the frame. The background is a landscape with trees and buildings.The right panel features a standing male saint, possibly a bishop, wearing a white alb, a red and gold cope, and a miter, holding a crozier. Below him, two male figures in light brown habits kneel in prayer, also facing the central panel. An angel is visible in the upper right corner of the frame. This panel also has a landscape background. The figures throughout the triptych are rendered with detailed drapery.

alt_text: A trompe l'oeil painting of a blue vase overflowing with colorful flowers in a marble-patterned architectural niche.
long_description: The painting depicts a large, ornate floral arrangement in a vase, set within a painted architectural niche, creating a trompe l'oeil effect. Centered, a large, bulbous teal-blue vase with elaborate gold ornamentation. Gold handles curve from the rim to the widest part of the body. The base is also gold with intricate scrollwork. The rim has a gold scalloped pattern. The vase is filled with a dense, colorful bouquet. Flowers include large red and orange blossoms, yellow and pink blooms, white clusters, and purple spikes. Green leaves and stems are interspersed throughout. Some flowers, like a pink peony and red blossoms, spill over the vase's edge and onto the plinth below. The vase rests on a painted white plinth with gray veining, mimicking marble. Behind the vase, the background is a light cream color with subtle gray marble-like veining. The niche is framed by painted pilasters on the left and right, also in a marble pattern, creating the illusion of depth. Shadows are painted to enhance this three-dimensional effect. Additional painted floral sprigs with small red and green elements are visible on the background wall to the left and right of the vase. The entire painted scene is enclosed within a decorative, ornate gold frame.

metadata.title: Vase of Flowers in a Niche

alt_text: A woman in a blue cloak and red dress looks down at a sleeping baby in a landscape
long_description:
A vertically oriented painting depicts a woman and a baby in the foreground against a landscape background. The woman, positioned in the upper half of the composition, wears a light blue cloak draped over her head and shoulders, and a reddish-pink dress underneath. Her head is tilted downwards, and her eyes are cast towards the baby. Her hands are clasped together in front of her chest, fingers intertwined. She has fair skin and soft facial features.

Below her, in the lower half of the painting, a nude baby lies horizontally on a white cloth, with a dark, possibly black, pillow supporting its head. The baby is sleeping, with its eyes closed. Its right arm is bent with the hand near its chest, while its left arm is extended, resting on its stomach. Its legs are bent, showing plump, fair skin and light brown hair.

The background features a muted landscape under a light blue sky. A faint, lighter blue arc is visible behind the woman's head. On both the left and right sides, distant hills are visible, dotted with sparse trees and architectural structures, including arches and buildings, receding into the horizon. The overall color palette is soft, with blues, reds, and earthy tones.

alt_text: A painting of the Madonna holding the Christ Child, with a landscape on the left and a red curtain on the right.
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts the Madonna and Child positioned centrally. The Madonna, shown from the waist up, faces slightly to the viewer's right, her head gently tilted, and her gaze directed forward. She wears a deep blue cloak with a gold-colored trim over a white veil and a red garment. A faint golden halo encircles her head. She cradles the nude Christ Child on her lap, who faces slightly left and looks upwards. The Child has light brown, curly hair, and a faint golden halo. His left hand rests on his chest, while his right hand holds a small, yellowish-green fruit. The background is divided vertically. To the left of the Madonna, a light blue sky with soft white clouds transitions into a green and brown hilly landscape. Several white buildings, including a prominent tower, are visible on the hills, along with a few bare-branched trees. To the right, a rich red curtain hangs, gathered in vertical folds, featuring a subtle pattern of gold circles. A dark horizontal band forms the base of the painting, with a lighter rectangular panel in its center. Inscribed on this panel in capital letters are the words "IOANNES BELLINVS".

alt_text: Madonna and Child flanked by four saints, two men and two women, against a landscape background
long_description: A horizontal oil painting depicts six figures arranged in a row, with a central Madonna and Child flanked by two saints on each side. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the right of the center, wears a deep blue mantle over a pink gown and holds a nude infant in her arms. The infant looks towards the viewer, while the Madonna gazes down at the child. To the far left stands an older man with a white beard, dressed in a brown cloak over a blue tunic, holding a large red book in his left hand and a set of keys in his right. Next to him, a young woman with light brown hair holds a long, golden palm frond. To the far right, another older man with a dark beard wears a green cloak over a dark tunic, holding a slender staff topped with a small cross in his left hand and a white scroll with faint writing that appears to read 'ECCE AGNUS DEI' in his right. Next to him, a young woman with dark hair, adorned with a green laurel wreath, holds a small, ornate golden jar. All figures are positioned in front of a landscape background featuring blue skies with white clouds and distant, light blue-grey mountains.
