The paper has faint, dark markings on its visible surface, including what appears to be "1653" and other illegible text. The background is a uniform dark brown, providing a stark contrast to the man's face and the lighter elements of his attire. The lighting illuminates his face and the hand holding the paper, creating a sense of depth.

alt_text: A still life painting featuring a dead hare, a dead bird, a silver tureen, various fruits, and a cat.
long_description: The painting depicts a still life scene set against a dark, indistinct background, likely a stone wall. A stone ledge or table runs across the lower half of the composition, on which various objects are arranged. In the lower left corner, a white and brown tabby cat crouches, looking upwards and to the right with wide eyes. Its fur is mottled white, brown, and black. Dominating the center of the scene is a dead hare, its light brown fur visible, lying on its back with its head turned towards the right. Its front paws are extended, and a small red mark is visible near its mouth. Behind the hare, partially obscured, lies a dead bird, possibly a partridge, with blue-grey and brown feathers, and a distinct red area on its chest. To the right of the hare, a large, ornate silver tureen with a lid and two handles stands prominently. The tureen has a reflective surface, showing highlights and shadows. On top of its lid rests a single orange, slightly shriveled, with a small stem visible. On the stone ledge in front of the hare and tureen, several pieces of fruit and nuts are scattered. Directly below the hare's head is a bright red apple. Further to the right, a small cluster of brown nuts and a few white shells are visible. In the lower right corner, a green apple and two reddish-brown pears are arranged. The overall lighting is dim, creating a somber atmosphere and emphasizing the textures and forms of the objects.

alt_text: A young person blows a large soap bubble over a stone ledge, observed by another child peeking.
long_description: The painting features a young person, likely a boy, leaning forward over a stone ledge, intently blowing a large, translucent soap bubble. The figure, positioned slightly left of center, wears a brown tunic with white ruffled cuffs visible at the wrists. Their dark brown, curly hair frames a pale face with a focused expression. A thin, light-colored straw extends from their mouth to the bubble, which hangs just below the ledge, reflecting light and displaying subtle iridescent colors. To the left, on the stone ledge, a clear glass holds a pale, frothy liquid. In the upper left background, dark green foliage with lighter blue-green leaves is visible against a deep, dark green backdrop. To the right of the main figure, a second child's head, wearing a dark green cap, peeks out from behind the ledge, their eyes wide and looking towards the bubble. The composition is dominated by the figures and the bubble, set against a dark, shallow background, with the stone ledge forming a strong horizontal line across the lower half of the image.

alt_text: A formal portrait of a man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark coat and white shirt.
long_description: This is a formal, waist-up portrait of a man with dark hair and a neatly trimmed beard, set against a plain, dark background. The man faces directly forward, his gaze level with the viewer. His skin is light, and his dark hair is parted on his left, with sideburns extending to his jawline. He wears a dark, possibly velvet, coat with wide lapels over a white collared shirt. A dark cravat or necktie is visible at his throat. His left hand is tucked into the front opening of his coat, with a ring visible on his ring finger. The coat appears to be a deep brown or black, with subtle highlights suggesting texture. The background is a uniform, dark grey-brown, providing a stark contrast to the man's face and white shirt. In the bottom right corner, a signature reads "Th. Chasseriau" followed by "1840".

alt_text: A partially nude woman bathes, attended by two women, in a classical outdoor setting with a mirror.
long_description: This vertical oil painting depicts three women in a classical outdoor setting. In the left foreground, a light-skinned woman, partially nude, sits on a blue and gold cushioned chair. Her blonde hair is adorned with blue ribbons, and she holds more blue ribbons in her left hand, looking down and to her right. A white drapery covers her lap and lower body, and her right leg is submerged in a large, ornate silver basin with shell-like handles. To her right, a second woman stands, dressed in a brown and pink draped gown, holding a framed mirror. She looks down towards the seated woman. In the right foreground, a third woman kneels, facing the seated figure, and gently touches her left foot. This kneeling woman wears a blue top and an orange skirt, with a white cloth in her hand. Behind the figures, a dark column rises on the left, and a lush green landscape with trees is visible. In the upper right, a classical white building with columns and a light pink draped figure on its upper level stands against a blue sky with scattered white clouds. The ground beneath the figures is a tiled floor.

alt_text: Oil painting of a man with light hair and round glasses, wearing a dark coat and white collar
long_description: A painted portrait depicts a man from the chest up, angled slightly to his left against a dark, textured background. He has a light complexion with rosy cheeks and lips, and wears round, wire-rimmed glasses. His eyes, visible through the lenses, look directly forward. His light-colored hair, possibly gray or blond, is styled upwards on top of his head. He wears a dark, possibly brown or deep red, coat or cloak with a prominent white collar or cravat that stands high around his neck. A small vertical strip of bright red fabric is visible on the lower left edge of the painting, suggesting a chair or garment detail. The light source appears to be from the upper left, illuminating the left side of his face and the white collar, casting the right side of his face and body into softer shadow. The background is a plain, dark, brownish-gray, with visible brushstrokes that suggest a textured surface.

alt_text: A portrait of a man with a beard and short hair, wearing a white hooded robe against a red background
long_description: A vertical portrait depicts a man from the chest up, framed by a dark, textured border. The man, with light skin, is positioned slightly to the right of the canvas's vertical center, his head turned slightly to his right, and his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has short, dark brown hair with a visible tonsure and a long, full, reddish-brown beard that extends down to his chest. His eyes are light blue, and his nose is prominent. He wears a white hooded robe with a wide collar, the hood resting on his shoulders. The fabric of the robe shows soft folds and shadows, particularly around his neck and chest. The background is a solid, deep red, with subtle variations in color and texture, creating a sense of depth behind the figure. The lighting illuminates his face and the upper part of his robe, casting soft shadows. Along the bottom edge of the dark frame, light-colored text is visible, reading 'PETRUS X DIL ME FECIT A 1509'. A small, dark, irregular shape rests on the white robe near the bottom center.

alt_text: Close-up portrait of a bearded man with long hair, wearing a crown of thorns with blood on his forehead.
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with a beard and long, dark hair, set against a dark blue background. The man's face is centered, looking directly forward with a somber expression. He has a prominent brow, dark eyes, a straight nose, and a full, dark brown beard that extends down to his chest. His long, dark brown hair falls over his shoulders. Around his head, just above his forehead, is a crown of dark, thorny branches. Drops of red blood trickle down his forehead from beneath the crown, and there are also small red marks on his neck and chest. The dark blue background features delicate, swirling gold leaf patterns on either side of his head and above the crown. The painting is enclosed by a light gray border, which is itself framed by a darker brown edge. Along the bottom edge of the light gray border, faint gold lettering is visible, including what appears to be "The Thpth" and other indistinct characters.

metadata.title: Head of Christ
metadata.medium: Oil on parchment, laid down on wood

alt_text: Six figures mourn over the body of Christ, laid on a white shroud in a hilly landscape.
long_description: A painting depicts six figures gathered around the body of a deceased man, laid on a white shroud in a landscape. The man, presumably Christ, lies horizontally in the lower center, his pale, bare torso showing wounds on his side, hands, and feet. He wears a crown of thorns and a white loincloth. To the left, a bearded man in a dark hat and dark clothing supports Christ's head. Above him, a woman in a white head covering, red dress, and green cloak holds a small, dark jar. In the center-back, a woman in a black veil and blue dress appears to be fainting, supported by a man in a reddish-brown cloak. To the right, a man in a red cloak and red hat holds the white shroud near Christ's feet. On the ground in the lower right, several dark tools, including nails and pincers, are visible. The background features a green, hilly landscape with scattered trees and distant buildings on the left. On the right, a mound of earth shows a dark, upright post and several skulls and bones.

alt_text: An angel kneels before a woman standing in an arched doorway, with a garden and brick building in the background.
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in an outdoor setting with architectural elements. On the left, a winged figure, dressed in a long red robe with a white undergarment, kneels on one knee. This figure has large, dark wings with gold details and holds a tall, slender staff topped with a gold finial. Behind this figure, a lush green landscape features a low, crumbling brick wall and dark green trees against a lighter green background. To the right, a woman stands within an arched stone doorway, which is part of a larger brick building visible behind it. She wears a long, flowing blue robe over a red garment and holds an open book in her left hand, with her right hand raised. Above her head, a small white dove with radiating light hovers. To her left, within the doorway, are three white lilies. The floor of the doorway is tiled with a geometric pattern of red and white squares, and a wooden plank lies on the ground in front of the steps. Visible text on the steps reads "REGINA CELI".

alt_text: A painting depicts the Nativity, with Mary, Joseph, and shepherds adoring the infant Jesus, while angels hover above.
long_description: The painting depicts a Nativity scene with numerous figures gathered around the infant Jesus, illuminated by a radiant light from above. In the upper center, a bright golden star shines within a luminous cloud, flanked by two winged putti holding a white banner inscribed with "GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO." Below them, additional putti heads emerge from the clouds. The central focus is the nude infant Jesus, lying on a bed of straw, bathed in the divine light. To his left, Mary, dressed in a blue mantle and green head covering, gently holds a white cloth over him, gazing down. Beside her, an elderly man with a white beard, likely Joseph, sits on a stone block, leaning on a staff and looking towards the child. Behind Mary, a woman with a golden crown observes the scene. A donkey's head is visible behind the infant. To the right, several figures, primarily men, are gathered. In the foreground, a man in a green tunic and red sash kneels, holding a white lamb and looking intently at the infant. Behind him, another man in a red and yellow tunic leans forward. Further back and to the right, more figures, some with beards and turbans, are partially obscured by shadows, with a few holding lit candles. A small crescent moon is visible in the dark upper right. On a stone platform near the infant are a yellow jug and three white eggs, while a woven basket containing fish rests on the ground below.

metadata.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds with Saint Catherine of Alexandria

alt_text: Madonna and Child flanked by a male saint and a female saint, set against a landscape and green panel
long_description: A rectangular painting depicts four figures arranged in a shallow space, with a landscape visible on the left and right, and a solid green panel behind the central figures. In the center, the Madonna is seated, facing slightly right with her head tilted down. She has light skin, brown hair covered by a white veil, and wears a red dress with a blue cloak draped over her shoulders and lap. She holds the nude Christ Child on her lap, who has light skin, a faint halo, and holds a small brown cross in his right hand, looking towards the left. To the left of the Madonna, a male saint stands, dressed in a brown hooded monastic robe. He has short brown hair, light skin, and his hands are clasped at his chest as he looks towards the Christ Child. Behind him, a blue sky with white clouds transitions to green hills. To the right of the Madonna, a female saint stands, wearing a black veil over a white wimple, and a grey-green robe with dark horizontal stripes. She has light skin and her hands are crossed over her chest, as she looks towards the central figures. Behind her, a blue sky with scattered clouds extends over green hills, with a small town featuring a church visible in the distance. A brown ledge or parapet runs across the bottom of the painting, bearing the inscription "IOANNES BELLINUS FACIEBAT" in white capital letters.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Francis and Clare

alt_text: Three haloed figures, two men and one woman, stand in a vertical panel painting
long_description: The painting features three full-length figures, two men and one woman, standing against a dark, paneled background. Each figure has a golden halo above their head. On the left, a man with dark, curly hair and a short beard looks towards the center. He wears a golden-yellow tunic, a reddish-purple cloak draped over his shoulders, and bright blue hose with dark boots. He holds a tall, light brown staff vertically in his left hand, from which a dark, wide-brimmed hat hangs. His right hand rests on his hip. In the center, an older man with a long, flowing white beard and a bald head stands on a white, rectangular pedestal. He wears a long, brown cloak over a blue collar and dark sandals. He holds a staff in his left hand, which has a small bell and a red cloth tied to it. A small, dark-colored dog stands on the reddish-brown floor at the base of his pedestal, looking towards the left. On the right, a woman with long, light brown hair and a serene expression looks slightly downwards and to the left. She wears a long, dark green dress with a white undershirt and a voluminous red cloak draped over her left arm and lower body. She holds a long, green palm frond in her left hand and a small, ornate silver object, possibly a censer, in her right hand. Her bare feet are visible at the bottom right. The background behind the figures is dark, with a vertical seam behind the central figure, separating a darker green-brown area on the left from a lighter gray-brown area on the right. The floor is a uniform reddish-brown.

metadata.title: Three Saints: Roch, Anthony Abbot, and Lucy
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A still life painting featuring a human skull, an oil lamp, books, a quill, and a glass on a dark background.
long_description: A dark still life painting depicts a collection of objects arranged on a light gray-brown surface against a deep, dark background. Dominating the center is a large, light brown human skull, positioned in profile facing left, resting on a stack of two books. The top book has a dark brown cover, and beneath the skull, a light blue-green sheet of paper is visible, slightly crumpled. A white feather quill pen lies diagonally across the paper and the top book, its tip pointing towards the lower left. To the left of the skull, a terracotta-colored oil lamp with a handle stands on a pedestal, emitting a faint wisp of smoke upwards. Below the lamp, on the table surface, are a black inkwell and a dark pen holder. To the right of the skull, a dark, ornate glass or goblet lies on its side, its rim facing the viewer, reflecting light from an unseen source. Faint white text is visible on the dark background to the right of the skull, reading "P. H. / 1622".

metadata.title: Still Life with a Skull and a Writing Quill

alt_text: A landscape painting depicting people gathered by a river with boats, a multi-arched bridge, and dense trees.
long_description: This landscape painting features a wide river flowing through a verdant scene under a light blue sky. In the foreground, on the left, a group of five figures is gathered on a grassy bank beneath large, dark green and brown trees. Two women are seated or kneeling on the ground; one wears a reddish-brown dress, and the other a lighter-colored dress, with a basket nearby. Three standing figures are positioned behind them, one in a blue tunic and another in a brown cloak. The river, which occupies the middle ground, is covered in a soft, light mist or haze, reflecting the pale sky. Two small boats are visible on the water; the closer boat, positioned towards the left, contains three indistinct figures. In the background, a multi-arched stone bridge spans the river, connecting the banks. Beyond the bridge, rolling hills or mountains fade into the hazy distance, blending with the light blue sky that features scattered white clouds and a few small, dark birds. The overall color palette is dominated by greens and browns for the foliage and ground, with muted blues and grays for the water and distant landscape.

alt_text: A serene landscape painting depicting a river, distant hills, a stone tower, and grazing livestock.
long_description: The painting presents a wide, serene landscape under a soft, light blue sky with scattered white clouds, brightening towards the horizon. In the left foreground, dense, dark green trees frame a tall, round stone tower with a conical roof, adjacent to an arched gateway. A path leads from the gateway down a gentle slope. Below the gateway, a small figure dressed in blue sits on the ground. Several brown and white cows and sheep graze on the grassy terrain in the lower left and center foreground. The midground is dominated by a wide body of water, possibly a river or lake, which reflects the sky and appears slightly hazy. Two small boats, each containing a few indistinct figures, are visible on the water. The far bank of the water features more trees and gentle slopes. In the background, rolling hills and mountains recede into the distance, appearing in muted blue-grey tones, with a small, light-colored structure visible on one of the distant hills. On the right side, a large tree with lighter green foliage stands prominently, with a path winding down towards the water. The overall color palette consists of deep greens, earthy browns, soft blues, and hazy whites.

alt_text: A classical landscape painting with figures, animals, and trees, under a dramatic sky with a distant town
long_description: This expansive landscape painting depicts a scene at what appears to be dusk or dawn, with a wide vista under a dramatic sky. The upper third of the canvas is filled with a sky transitioning from light blue at the top to warmer orange and pink hues near the horizon, populated by large, fluffy white and grey clouds. In the distant background, a range of soft, blue-grey hills stretches across the horizon, with a small, light-colored town visible atop a prominent hill to the right of the center. The middle ground features a broad, flat valley rendered in muted greens and browns, partially obscured by a light mist or haze. On the far left, a tall, light-colored rock formation rises, partially covered by sparse green and reddish-brown foliage. In the lower left quadrant, a standing figure in a reddish-brown tunic gestures with both arms towards a small flock of white sheep or goats gathered in the misty area. A dark, reflective stream or river flows horizontally across the lower center of the painting. Two figures are depicted wading through the water, moving from right to left. The figure on the left wears a blue tunic, while the figure on the right, leading a brown cow or ox, wears a yellow-orange tunic. The right side of the painting is dominated by a dense cluster of tall, dark green trees with slender trunks, extending from the midground to the top edge. More scattered trees are visible throughout the landscape, contributing to the overall verdant and somewhat shadowed atmosphere. The foreground ground is a mix of dark greens and browns.

alt_text: A fleet of large sailing ships anchored near a lush, mountainous coastline with people on the sandy beach
long_description: The painting depicts a bustling coastal scene with a fleet of large sailing ships and numerous figures on a sandy beach. The sky above is a mix of light blue at the horizon, transitioning to a cloudy, greyish-blue overhead. The sea is choppy, rendered in dark blue-green tones with visible whitecaps, and extends from the foreground to the distant horizon.On the far left, a large, multi-masted sailing ship, possibly a galleon, is partially visible, its dark wooden hull and intricate stern decorations prominent. Red and green pennants fly from its tall masts, which hold furled sails. In the middle distance, several other similar ships are anchored in the water, displaying various red, yellow, and green flags.The right side of the painting features a lush, green coastline. A light brown sandy beach occupies the lower foreground, curving gently towards the right. Beyond the beach, dense green foliage covers rolling hills, which recede into hazy blue-green mountains in the far distance. Small red and white tents are scattered among the trees on the right side of the coast.On the sandy beach, a group of approximately twelve figures is gathered. Many are dressed in flowing, colorful garments, including shades of blue, green, red, and white, and are depicted in dynamic poses, some with arms raised as if dancing or gesturing. In the lower left foreground, a small, dark wooden boat rests on the sand, containing three figures, one of whom appears to be disembarking towards the larger group. Further to the right on the beach, a few additional figures are visible, some standing, others in motion. A dark tree trunk is partially visible along the far right edge of the canvas.

metadata.title: The Trojan Women Setting Fire to Their Fleet

alt_text: A landscape painting shows a castle on a distant hill, framed by tall trees and rolling green terrain.
long_description: The painting depicts a broad landscape under a light blue sky with subtle white clouds. The foreground is dark, featuring patches of brown and green ground with sparse, lighter vegetation. On the left, a dense mass of dark green and brown trees creates a shadowed area, extending upwards. In the center, several tall, slender trees with lighter, yellowish-brown foliage stand out, their dark trunks reaching towards the sky. Between these central trees, a brighter, open area suggests a path or clearing leading into the midground. In the middle distance, a light-colored castle with multiple towers and crenellated battlements is situated on a gently rising hill. The castle has visible openings, possibly windows or archways. To the right of the castle, the landscape continues with undulating green hills, sparsely covered with smaller, dark green trees. A large, full tree with dense, dark green foliage occupies the right side of the midground, partially obscuring the view. Small, indistinct figures or animals are visible in the grassy areas of the midground, particularly on the right. The overall scene is a verdant, natural setting with a prominent architectural structure in the background.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a young person in a black feathered hat, white ruffled collar, and fur-trimmed coat.
long_description: The painting is a half-length portrait of a young person, likely a male, positioned slightly to the right and looking forward with a neutral expression. The subject has light skin, dark eyes, and light brown hair visible beneath a dark, flat cap. The cap is adorned with a prominent white feather on the left side. A white, ruffled collar, or ruff, encircles the neck, sitting atop a dark, fur-trimmed garment. The fur, which appears to be light brown or grey, lines the collar and the front opening of the coat. The coat itself is dark, possibly black or deep brown, and features an intricate gold pattern of interlocking diamonds or squares across the visible chest area. A long, thin gold chain with a small, ornate pendant hangs around the neck, draped over the fur and patterned fabric. The background is a plain, dark, muted color, providing a stark contrast to the subject's light skin and the details of the clothing. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting the face and the textures of the clothing.

alt_text: A man in dark robes and a cap writes in an open book against a vibrant blue background.
long_description: A waist-up portrait depicts a man with light skin, a long face, and a prominent nose, looking directly forward. He wears a dark, flat-topped cap that covers most of his hair, and a dark, wide-sleeved robe with a thin white band visible at his neck, tied with a dark string. His left hand holds a piece of light-colored paper, while his right hand, adorned with a gold-colored ring on the fourth finger, holds a slender, dark writing instrument, poised over an open book. The book has a reddish-brown cover and light-colored pages filled with dark text. It rests on a narrow, dark green surface at the bottom of the frame. The background is a solid, vibrant blue. In the upper left corner of the blue background, the word "ORONCIO" is visible in light-colored letters.

alt_text: A man in elaborate clothing rides a dark horse, against a stone wall and classical columns
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man on horseback, positioned slightly left of center and facing right. The man has a short dark beard and mustache, wearing a dark cap with a small feather. He is dressed in an ornate dark doublet with white sleeves and intricate silver-colored embroidery, a dark cape, and brown boots. He holds a thin, light-colored stick or whip in his right hand. A sword hangs from his left hip. The dark brown horse is adorned with an elaborate white and dark saddle cloth featuring intricate patterns and tassels, and a bridle with a large white feathered plume on its head. The horse's front left leg is raised, suggesting movement. The background consists of a light brown stone wall on the left, with two large classical columns visible on the right. The ground beneath the horse is a muted brown with sparse green foliage in the lower left and right corners.

metadata.title: Henry II (1519–1559), King of France
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A Nativity scene showing the infant Jesus in a manger, surrounded by Mary, Joseph, angels, shepherds, and animals
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting depicts a Nativity scene with multiple figures gathered around the infant Jesus. In the lower center, a naked infant lies on a white cloth within a simple wooden manger. To the left, Mary kneels, dressed in a dark blue robe, with her hands clasped in prayer and her gaze directed downwards towards the infant. Behind her, Joseph stands, wearing a red robe, with a beard and his right hand raised. A donkey and an ox are positioned behind Mary and Joseph, looking towards the manger. Two smaller angels, dressed in light-colored robes, kneel on either side of the manger, also with hands clasped in prayer. To the right of the manger, a man in an orange tunic kneels, his hands clasped. Behind him, another man in a green tunic and a straw hat stands, holding a staff. Other figures are partially visible behind these two. In the lower right foreground, a white lamb rests on the ground. The scene is set within a rustic stable structure on the left, with a thatched roof and wooden beams. Above the stable, three larger angels float in the dark blue sky, holding an open scroll displaying musical notation. The left angel wears an orange robe, the middle a green robe, and the right a pink robe. In the upper right background, a distant landscape features rolling green hills, a town, and two small figures with sheep. A white bird-like shape is visible in the dark sky above the landscape. The overall color palette includes rich blues, reds, oranges, greens, and earthy browns.

alt_text: A dark still life painting featuring a globe, open books, musical instruments, a skull, and a portrait on a draped table.
long_description: The painting depicts a dark, rectangular still life composition arranged on a draped table. The table is covered with a rich, reddish-brown fabric, gathered and folded, against a dark, muted background. In the upper right, a heavy, dark brown curtain is draped, partially revealing a faint architectural structure with an open doorway behind it. Dominating the upper center is a large, light-colored terrestrial globe with detailed dark markings, resting on a dark, ornate stand. To its right, a large, thick book lies open, displaying two pages of text. The right page features a decorative initial and the visible phrases "DIE DERDE DEELENDE DAT TWEEEDE DEEL" and "JESUS HEEFT HAVE SOME". Partially visible beneath this book, on the far right, is a human skull. In the mid-ground, a violin with its bow rests diagonally across the table, its light brown wood contrasting with the darker elements. To the left of the violin, a quill pen lies next to an open document with a map-like drawing. Nearby are a small, dark chalice, a bundle of light-colored fabric tied with a ribbon, and a string of white beads with a red tassel and a small cross. Scattered among these items are a small compass and several coins. To the right of the violin, a dark, ornate metal object and a small, closed book are visible. A wind instrument with a flared end extends towards the lower right corner. In the foreground, a framed portrait of a man with a beard and a white collar, looking slightly left, is prominently displayed. Below the portrait, the inscription reads: "JACOB CATS RAADTPENSIONARIS VAN HOLLANDT EN WESTVRIESLANDT". An open sheet of musical notation lies to the right of the portrait. The overall palette is dominated by dark browns, reds, and grays, with lighter accents from the books, globe, and portrait.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a woman in a dark dress and an elaborate hat with feathers, looking left
long_description: A bust-length oil portrait depicts a woman facing slightly left, her gaze directed to the left side of the frame. Her fair skin is highlighted by rosy cheeks, and her dark eyes are set beneath light brown eyebrows. Her brown hair is visible beneath an elaborate dark blue or black hat. The hat features a checkered band around its crown, a large, dark feathery plume on the right side, and a lighter blue fabric element on the left. A small, dark earring hangs from her visible left ear, and a dark ribbon is tied around her neck, visible on the left. She wears a dark blue or black dress with puffy sleeves and a wide, light blue collar or shawl that sits over a white chemise or blouse. The bodice of the dress has a gathered or ruched detail running down its center. The background is a muted, dark brown, with a slightly lighter tone around her head, offering no distinct features. The painting exhibits visible brushstrokes, characteristic of an oil medium.

metadata.title: Mrs. James Pulham Sr. (Frances Amys, ca. 1766–1856)

alt_text: A large, light-colored Gothic cathedral with a tall spire stands in a green field, framed by dark trees.
long_description: This landscape painting features a large, light-colored Gothic cathedral with a tall, slender spire dominating the central background. The cathedral is rendered in shades of cream and grey, with numerous windows, buttresses, and intricate architectural details visible along its long facade. It stands on a flat, expansive green lawn. In the foreground, a narrow, winding stream flows horizontally across the lower portion of the canvas. Several cows are depicted in and around the stream; some are drinking from the water, while others graze on the adjacent green grass. To the far left, a dirt path curves into the scene, leading to a wooden fence or gate. Two figures stand near this fence: a man in dark clothing, holding a stick and pointing towards the cathedral, and a woman in a light-colored dress beside him. The entire scene is framed by dense, dark green trees with thick, textured trunks and branches that extend from the sides and top of the canvas, creating a natural archway. The foliage is rich and varied in tone. Above the cathedral and through the gaps in the trees, a bright blue sky with scattered white, fluffy clouds is visible. The lighting suggests a clear day.

metadata.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Bishop's Grounds

alt_text: An oil painting depicts a landscape with a large tree, a distant church, and figures on a path under a cloudy sky
long_description: An oil painting presents a landscape scene with a prominent tree on the right and a village in the distance on the left, under a dynamic sky. The upper left quadrant features a sky filled with heavy, textured clouds in shades of white, grey, and dark blue, with visible brushstrokes suggesting movement. Patches of lighter blue sky are visible between the clouds. The right side of the painting is dominated by a large, dense tree with dark green foliage, extending from the top edge almost to the bottom. Lighter green and hints of blue peek through the leaves. A dark, indistinct figure walks on a brown path that curves from the bottom right corner towards the center of the painting, disappearing into the shadows beneath the tree. In the mid-ground on the left, a light brown church tower with a pointed roof stands tall, surrounded by a few small, light-colored buildings. Below the church, a green field slopes downwards, where two light-colored animals, possibly cows or horses, are visible grazing. The foreground consists of dark, earthy tones with hints of green and brown, leading into the path and field. The entire painting exhibits visible brushwork, giving it a textured appearance.

alt_text: A woman in a red dress breastfeeds a baby against a dark, rocky landscape with distant buildings
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a woman breastfeeding a baby, set against a dark, rocky background with a distant landscape. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, has long, wavy dark hair and fair skin. She wears a deep red gown with a lighter, sheer undergarment visible at her chest. Her head is tilted down, and her eyes are directed towards the baby. A faint golden halo encircles her head. Her left arm supports the baby, who lies across her lap. The baby, nude with fair skin and light brown curly hair, faces left and is actively breastfeeding. His right arm is raised, with his hand near the woman's chest, while his left hand rests on her arm. The baby is propped on a red cushion or cloth. Behind the figures, a large, dark, irregular rock formation or tree trunk creates a strong vertical element. To the left of this dark formation, a green landscape with slender trees, a body of water, and light-colored buildings is visible under a light sky. To the right, a similar landscape features more rugged terrain, a body of water, and a tall, pointed building under a yellowish sky. In the foreground, a patterned rug or cloth in shades of brown, green, and red is visible beneath the baby and extends to the bottom edge of the painting.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a man with a reddish-brown beard, dark hat, and black coat, holding gloves
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man facing forward, positioned centrally against a dark, textured green background. He has light skin, a short reddish-brown beard and mustache, and dark brown eyes that look directly ahead. His nose is straight, and his lips are full. He wears a dark, flat cap on his head, covering his hair, and a dark, possibly black, coat with a prominent reddish-brown fur collar that frames his neck and shoulders. His shoulders are broad, and the coat extends downwards, filling the lower half of the canvas. His hands are clasped together at the bottom center of the image, just above the lower edge. The left hand, seen from the side, holds a pair of light brown gloves. The right hand, seen from the front, rests on top of the gloves, with a gold ring visible on the ring finger. Both wrists are adorned with white, ruffled cuffs that emerge from the sleeves of his coat. The overall lighting highlights his face and hands, creating a contrast with the darker clothing and background.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with Gloves

alt_text: A portrait of a woman with reddish hair, wearing an elaborate dark dress and headpiece, against a green background
long_description: The painting depicts a half-length portrait of a woman with fair skin, positioned slightly to the left, against a plain green background. Her head is turned slightly to her left, and her light blue eyes gaze in the same direction. Her reddish-blonde hair is visible around her forehead and temples, styled in soft waves. She wears a white and gold headpiece that covers the back of her head, with a dark veil extending downwards. Her lips are closed in a neutral expression. She is dressed in an elaborate dark brown gown with wide sleeves and a square neckline. The bodice of the dress is adorned with intricate gold and white patterns, including geometric shapes and what appears to be a stylized "A" with a small, tear-shaped pearl pendant hanging from it. The neckline is edged with a band of gold and light blue embellishments. Around her neck, she wears a necklace composed of gold links interspersed with small, round, light blue and reddish-orange jewels. The sleeves of her dress feature similar gold and white patterns. A white undergarment is visible at her wrists and possibly beneath the bodice. The background is a uniform, muted green, providing a stark contrast to the dark tones of her attire.

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a bearded man in a feathered hat and dark clothing, looking right
long_description: A black and white, head-and-shoulders portrait depicts a man facing slightly right, his gaze directed towards the right edge of the frame. He has an oval-shaped face with a prominent nose, light-toned skin, and dark, bushy eyebrows. A full, dark beard covers his chin and cheeks, connecting to a mustache above his lips. He wears a dark, round, flat-topped hat, tilted slightly, with a large, light-colored feather plume extending from its right side. His attire consists of a dark, high-collared garment, possibly a doublet or vest, with a row of small, dark buttons running down the center front. Beneath this dark outer layer, lighter-toned, puffy sleeves with horizontal folds are visible on both arms. The background is a plain, light gray tone, slightly darker at the top and edges, creating a subtle border around the figure. The overall image has a high contrast between the dark elements of his clothing and hat, and the lighter tones of his skin, feather, and sleeves.

metadata.title: Charles de Cossé (1506–1563), Comte de Brissac

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a man in a dark hat and a fur-lined coat, looking forward
long_description: This black and white, waist-up portrait depicts a man looking directly forward. He has a round face with light-colored hair visible around his ears and a short, light beard or stubble. His eyes are light, and his nose is broad. He wears a dark, flat cap that covers the top of his head, and a dark garment underneath a voluminous, light-colored fur-lined coat. The fur is thick and shaggy, covering his shoulders and extending down the front of his body, creating a strong contrast with the dark fabric of his inner clothing and hat. A small, ruffled white collar is visible at his neck. The background is a plain, light-colored wall with a subtle vertical texture, framed by a darker border at the top and sides. The man's shoulders fill most of the lower half of the frame.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a man with a beard and black hat, wearing dark clothing against a green background
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned centrally and facing forward, against a plain green background. The man has light-to-medium skin tone, with a short, dark brown beard and mustache. His eyes are dark brown and look directly at the viewer. He has a straight nose and his lips are closed. He wears a flat, dark, possibly black, cap or beret tilted slightly to his right, covering most of his hair. Beneath the cap, a small amount of reddish-brown hair is visible near his right ear. His attire consists of a dark, likely black, garment with broad shoulders and long sleeves. A white, ruffled collar is visible at his neck, peeking out from the dark clothing. The front of his garment features a small, silver-colored clasp or decorative element just below the collar. The green background is a muted, somewhat olive-green hue, appearing slightly darker at the edges and lighter around the man's head, suggesting a subtle light source from the front. The brushstrokes are visible, giving the surface a textured appearance.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Bearded Man in Black

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a bearded man in a patterned, high-collared shirt with a pendant
long_description: A black and white, head and shoulders portrait depicts a man with dark, curly hair and a full, dark beard and mustache. His light-colored eyes gaze directly forward, and he has a straight nose. Around his neck, a small, ruffled collar is visible, sitting above a high-collared shirt. The light-colored garment features a vertical row of small, round buttons down its center front. The fabric of the shirt displays distinct patterns: the sleeves are adorned with horizontal wavy lines, while the front panel exhibits vertical lines interspersed with short, curved, leaf-like or slashed motifs. A thin, dark cord or chain, from which a small, dark pendant hangs, rests on the front of his shirt. The man is positioned slightly off-center to the left, filling most of the frame against a uniformly dark and plain background.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Bearded Man in White

alt_text: A circular portrait painting shows a bearded man in a dark cap against a green background
long_description: The artwork is a circular portrait painting depicting a man from the chest up, set against a plain, mottled green background. The man's head and shoulders fill the central portion of the circular frame. He faces directly forward, looking out with light-colored eyes. His skin tone is fair, with subtle pink and yellow undertones. He has a full, dark brown beard that extends from his cheeks down to his chest, and a mustache that connects to the beard. His hair is not visible beneath a dark, flat cap that covers the top of his head and ears. He wears a dark, high-collared garment, likely black, which blends into the shadows at the bottom of the portrait. The green background is somewhat uneven in color, with lighter and darker patches, and shows visible signs of age, including fine cracks across its surface. The overall impression is of a somber, direct gaze from the subject.

alt_text: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a bearded man in a black cap and coat against a dark green background
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned slightly to the left of the frame and facing towards the right. His gaze is directed to the right, beyond the canvas. He has a full, reddish-brown beard that covers his cheeks and chin, and short, dark hair is visible beneath his cap. He wears a dark, flat, round cap that covers the top of his head. His skin tone is light, with subtle pinkish tones on his cheeks and nose. His eyes are dark brown, and his lips are a muted pink. He is dressed in a dark, possibly black, garment that covers his shoulders and chest. A crisp white collar stands high around his neck, contrasting sharply with the dark fabric of his clothing and beard. The garment appears simple, with no visible embellishments. The background is a dark, muted green, with subtle variations in tone that suggest a textured surface or a wall. The lighting is soft, illuminating his face and the white collar, creating a gentle contrast with the darker areas of his clothing and the background. The overall impression is one of a somber yet detailed depiction.

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a bearded man wearing a dark hat and ruffled collar
long_description: This is a black and white, head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned centrally and facing slightly to the viewer's right, while his gaze is directed straight forward. The man has a light skin tone and a full, dark beard and mustache that covers his chin and upper lip. His hair, visible beneath his hat, appears short. He wears a dark, soft-brimmed hat, possibly a beret, tilted slightly to his right. Around his neck, a white, ruffled collar is visible, contrasting with his dark, high-collared garment. A thin, dark chain or cord with a small, dark pendant hangs from his neck, resting on his chest. The background is a plain, light gray tone, providing a subtle contrast to the dark clothing. The overall texture suggests an aged painting, with some visible surface imperfections and cracks. The man's expression is neutral.

alt_text: A head and shoulders portrait of a man with reddish-brown curly hair, a white ruff, and a gold chain
long_description: A head and shoulders portrait depicts a man with light skin, facing slightly to the viewer's right, with his gaze directed forward. His hair is a mass of reddish-brown curls, framing his face and extending to just above his shoulders. He has light-colored eyes, a straight nose, and a small, light-colored mustache and beard stubble on his upper lip and chin. His lips are closed in a neutral expression. He wears a black garment, likely a doublet, with a high, ruffled white ruff around his neck. Over the black garment, a heavy, multi-strand gold chain is draped, forming a V-shape across his chest. The background is a dark, muted olive green, providing a stark contrast to the man's light skin and the gold chain. The man's head and upper torso fill the majority of the square-format canvas, positioned centrally.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with a Gold Chain

alt_text: A portrait painting of a man with a reddish-brown beard and dark clothing against a dark background.
long_description: This is a head-and-shoulders portrait painting of a man, positioned slightly to the right of the viewer's center, against a dark, muted background. The man has fair skin and a full, reddish-brown beard and mustache that extends down to his chest. His hair, also reddish-brown, is short and curly, framing his face. He has dark eyes that gaze slightly to the viewer's right, a straight nose, and a small, closed mouth. He wears a dark, possibly black, garment that covers his shoulders and chest. A white, intricately patterned lace collar with a pointed shape is visible at his neck, contrasting sharply with the dark fabric of his clothing. The collar has a delicate, almost scalloped edge. The background is a dark, olive-green or brownish hue, providing a somber backdrop that highlights the man's face and collar. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, illuminating his face and the white collar, while the rest of the painting remains in deeper shadow. The brushstrokes are visible, particularly in the texture of the beard and the lace collar.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with a Pointed Collar

alt_text: Bust-length portrait of a man with a reddish-brown beard and black cap against a dark green background.
long_description: A bust-length portrait depicts a man facing slightly right, his gaze directed forward. He has light-toned skin, a reddish-brown beard and mustache, and light-colored eyes. A black, soft cap covers the top of his head. He wears a dark, high-collared garment, likely black, with subtle texture visible on the front. A white, ruffled collar peeks out from beneath the dark garment's collar. His right hand, visible in the lower right, holds a crumpled piece of light-colored fabric, possibly a handkerchief or glove. The background is a plain, dark green, providing a stark contrast to the figure. The painting is framed by a thin, dark border.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with Gloves

alt_text: A portrait of a man with a reddish-brown beard, wearing a black hat and dark clothing against a green background
long_description: A waist-up portrait depicts a man with a prominent reddish-brown beard and mustache, set against a plain, dark olive green background. The man's head is turned to face the viewer directly, with light-colored eyes and a neutral expression. He wears a soft, black beret-style hat adorned with a dark, fluffy feather plume positioned on the right side of his head. His attire consists of a dark, high-collared garment, possibly a tunic or doublet, which covers his shoulders and chest. A vertical row of small, dark, round buttons extends down the center front of this garment. Beneath the dark outer layer, white, slightly rumpled sleeves are visible at his forearms, extending to the lower edges of the painting. The man's torso is angled slightly to the viewer's left. A simple, dark brown border frames the entire painted scene, with a lighter, horizontal band at the very bottom, resembling a ledge or sill.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with a Black-Plumed Hat

alt_text: Black and white oval portrait of a woman with a light complexion wearing an ornate headpiece and a dark dress
long_description: This black and white oval portrait depicts a woman from the chest up, facing slightly to the left with her gaze directed forward. Her skin appears light, contrasting with the dark background and her dark attire. She wears a decorative headpiece consisting of a light-colored band adorned with what appear to be small, round elements, possibly pearls or jewels, across her forehead. A dark veil extends from the back of the headpiece, draping over her right shoulder. Her dark dress features a light-colored, possibly lace, collar or chemise visible at the neckline. A string of small, dark beads or pearls outlines the neckline of her dress, and another string of similar beads forms a decorative pattern across the front of her bodice. Her hair is mostly covered by the headpiece and veil. The overall composition is centered within the oval frame, with the woman's head slightly above the vertical center.

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a man in a dark hat and jacket, with a beard, holding a stick
long_description: The black and white portrait depicts a man from the chest up, positioned slightly to the right of the frame's center, with his gaze directed forward. He wears a dark, flat-crowned hat that covers most of his hair, and a dark, high-collared jacket with visible buttons down the front. A small, light-colored collar is visible at his neck. The man has a narrow face with a high forehead, dark eyes, and a small nose. A dark, short beard and mustache frame his mouth. His right arm is bent, with his hand resting on his hip, while his left hand holds a thin, dark stick vertically at his side. The background is a light, uniform tone, showing subtle vertical lines that suggest a wooden panel or textured wall, with some visible cracks and imperfections across the surface. The lighting emphasizes the man's face, hands, and collar, creating a contrast with his dark attire.

alt_text: Black and white portrait of a man with a pointed beard and mustache, wearing a dark hat with a feather
long_description: This is a black and white, head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned slightly to the left of the frame, facing towards the viewer's right, with his gaze directed forward. His skin appears light against the dark background and clothing. He has a prominent, straight nose, small eyes, and thin lips. A pointed beard extends from his chin, and a mustache covers his upper lip, both appearing dark. His hair, also dark, is short and mostly covered by his hat. He wears a dark, flat cap on his head, which is adorned with a large, light-colored, feathery plume positioned on the right side of his head, extending upwards and outwards. His attire consists of a dark, high-collared jacket or doublet, buttoned down the front with several small, round buttons. The fabric of his garment shows subtle texture. The background is a plain, dark tone, appearing slightly lighter around his head and shoulders, with some visible signs of age or texture on the surface. The overall composition is centered on the man, filling most of the frame.

alt_text: Half-length portrait of a woman in a dark dress and hat, adorned with pearls, looking forward
long_description: A black and white, half-length portrait depicts a woman facing slightly to the viewer's right, with her head turned to look directly forward. Her skin appears light against her dark clothing and the plain, dark background. She wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat that covers her hair, with a lighter, possibly ruffled, trim visible beneath the brim. A white, ruffled collar encircles her neck, above which a pearl necklace with a single drop pearl is visible. A long, dark chain drapes from her neck, crossing over her chest and extending down the front of her dark dress. The dress features prominent puffed sleeves at the shoulders that taper down to her wrists. Her hands are partially visible at the bottom of the frame, appearing light-colored with what seem to be white cuffs. Her face is oval-shaped with dark eyes, a small nose, and a small mouth with a faint smile. The background is a simple, textured dark gray, providing a stark contrast to the figure.

alt_text: Portrait of a man with dark curly hair in a black coat, seated against a dark background
long_description: A painted portrait depicts a man seated, angled slightly to the left, with his head turned to face forward, looking directly at the viewer. He has light skin, dark, curly hair, and a faint beard or stubble around his jawline. His eyes are dark, and his lips are closed. He wears a dark, high-collared coat or jacket with several dark buttons visible down the front. A white shirt collar is visible at his neck. His right arm rests on the light brown wooden armrest of a chair, and his left hand is visible, resting on his lap or the chair. The background is a plain, dark brown, with subtle variations in tone, appearing slightly lighter behind his head. In the upper right corner, the text "C. COROT" is written above "1839."

alt_text: A woman and child in a rocky, sparse landscape, with an angel flying in the sky above them.
long_description: The painting shows a vast, open landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the upper center, a winged figure, an angel, flies with outstretched wings. In the lower right foreground, a woman kneels on the ground, dressed in dark robes. Her head is thrown back, and her arms are raised towards the sky. Beside her, a small child lies on the ground, wearing a light-colored garment. The immediate foreground is rocky and uneven, with patches of sparse green and brown vegetation. To the left, several trees with dense green foliage grow among large rocks. In the midground, a prominent light brown rocky cliff face rises. The landscape extends into the distance, becoming a hazy, flat plain with faint hills on the horizon under a lighter, yellowish sky. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy tones, greens, and blues.

alt_text: A nude woman reclines on a patterned blanket on green grass by a calm sea under a cloudy sky
long_description: A horizontal oil painting depicts a nude woman reclining on her side in an outdoor landscape. The woman, with light skin, lies facing right, her head slightly raised and turned to the right. Her dark hair is pulled back, secured with a blue ribbon or band. Her left arm is bent, with her hand resting behind her head, while her right arm lies across her stomach. She rests on a light-colored, patterned blanket or cloth, which is spread over green grass. Small, scattered white and red specks, possibly flowers, are visible in the grass in the foreground. To the left, behind the woman, is a dark, dense mass of foliage from a tree, with hints of a darker landmass or cliff behind it. The right side of the background features a calm, grey-blue sea with subtle whitecaps. Above the sea, the sky is overcast with light grey clouds. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by greens, blues, greys, and the woman's skin tones. The signature "Corot 1868" is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A landscape painting features large, dark trees, a group of figures, and a distant body of water under a cloudy sky.
long_description: A landscape painting depicts a scene dominated by a large, dark green tree on the left and center, its dense foliage filling much of the upper left quadrant. To the right, a slender tree with lighter, possibly birch-like bark, leans inward, its branches extending towards the center. The sky above is a mix of light blue, grey, and soft orange and pink hues, suggesting either dawn or dusk, with visible clouds. In the foreground, a grassy, uneven path or field stretches across the bottom of the canvas, rendered in muted greens and browns. On the right side of the foreground, a group of three figures stands together. One figure, wearing a hat, points an arm towards the right horizon. The figures are dressed in dark, indistinct clothing. Further back, to the left of the standing group, a smaller cluster of two or three figures is seated on the ground, partially obscured by the shadows and foliage of the large tree. Beyond them, a body of water, possibly a lake or river, extends across the middle ground, reflecting the soft light of the sky. On the far right horizon, faint, blocky structures, possibly buildings, are visible. The overall palette is characterized by deep greens, earthy browns, and muted blues, with the sky providing the lightest tones. The signature "COROT. 1872" is visible in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: A light-skinned nude woman reclines on a spotted cloth in a landscape with distant figures
long_description: A horizontal oil painting depicts a light-skinned nude woman reclining in a natural landscape. She lies on her back, facing slightly towards the right, with her head resting on her bent left arm. Her right arm is also bent, with her hand near her head. Her legs are bent at the knees, with the right leg positioned slightly over the left. She rests partially on dark, textured ground and partially on a light-colored cloth with dark, irregular spots, resembling an animal print, beneath her lower body and legs. The background features a muted green and brown landscape with a body of water visible in the distance under a cloudy, light gray and white sky. To the upper right, nestled among dark green trees, are several smaller, indistinct nude figures, appearing to be interacting or bathing. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy greens, browns, and muted blues, with the woman's skin tone being a pale, warm hue. The artist's signature, 'COROT', is visible in dark letters in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: A landscape painting depicts trees on a bank overlooking a wide body of water under a cloudy sky
long_description:
The painting is a landscape scene dominated by a wide body of water and a cloudy sky. The foreground on the left features a dark, earthy bank rising slightly, covered with sparse vegetation and small, dark trees. Several taller trees with slender trunks and dark, leafy canopies stand on this bank, extending upwards into the sky. One tree, slightly left of center, has a lighter, almost white trunk. Beneath these trees, on the bank, two small, indistinct figures are visible, one appearing to sit or crouch.
To the right, the bank slopes down towards the water, which occupies the middle ground and extends across the canvas. The water's surface is a muted gray-blue, reflecting the overcast sky. On the far side of the water, a distant, low-lying landmass with faint structures is visible. In the lower right corner, a small, dark boat is partially obscured by tall, reedy vegetation growing from the water's edge. Another small figure, possibly in the boat or standing near it, is visible amidst the reeds, wearing a light-colored top. The sky above is filled with soft, voluminous gray and white clouds against a pale blue background, suggesting an overcast or approaching storm. The overall color palette is subdued, featuring greens, grays, blues, and browns.

alt_text: Four figures flee across a dark, desolate landscape with a burning city on the distant horizon under a stormy sky
long_description: This horizontal oil painting depicts a somber, dark landscape under a dramatic sky. The upper portion of the canvas is dominated by heavy, dark clouds, with a striking band of orange and yellow light visible on the horizon, suggesting a distant fire or sunset. Silhouetted against this fiery glow in the far background is a city with blocky, indistinct structures. In the midground, a low, light-colored stone structure, possibly a wall or tomb, runs horizontally across the scene, slightly to the right of center. To the far right, a dark, bare tree trunk with sparse branches stands. In the foreground, four figures are prominent. On the far left, a young woman in a light-colored, flowing dress, barefoot, extends her left arm forward as she looks towards the right. Next to her, a bearded man in dark robes holds the hand of a woman beside him; he looks down and to the right. This woman, also in dark robes, has her face obscured and appears to lean into the man, carrying a bundle on her back. To their right, another barefoot woman in a dark dress with a red sash strides quickly towards the right, looking back over her left shoulder. She carries a large, light-colored object, possibly a head or mask, in her arms. On the far right, a solitary, dark-robed figure stands with their back to the viewer, looking towards the distant, burning city. The ground is uneven, dark earth with sparse vegetation and some rocks. The overall palette is dark, dominated by browns, grays, and deep greens, with the orange-yellow glow in the sky providing a stark contrast.

metadata.title: The Burning of Sodom (formerly "The Destruction of Sodom")

alt_text: A landscape painting showing a figure on a dirt path leading through trees to a distant town under a cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a wide landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. A dirt path, light brown with subtle ruts, begins at the bottom center and recedes into the middle distance, curving slightly to the right. A small figure, seen from behind, walks on the path towards the background. The figure wears a long, light-colored dress and a head covering. To the left of the path, a grassy slope rises gently, dotted with small yellow flowers and a few slender trees with sparse, light green foliage. To the right, a dense mass of dark green trees and bushes forms a thick, shadowed border, extending from the right edge and curving inward. In the far distance, a hazy, light-colored town or city is visible on the horizon, featuring indistinct buildings and a prominent central structure. The overall light suggests an overcast day.

alt_text: A dark landscape painting shows a boat with three figures on water, overshadowed by a large tree.
long_description: A vertically oriented landscape painting depicts a dark, muted scene dominated by a large tree and a boat on water. The upper left quadrant features a pale, circular moon partially obscured by wispy, light grey clouds against a light blue sky. Dark, gnarled branches of a large tree extend from the right side, reaching across the upper and central portions of the canvas, with some sparse, dark foliage visible on the right. The tree's trunk is thick and dark, positioned on the right edge. Below the tree and moon, a body of dark water stretches across the middle ground, reflecting some light. In the lower left-center, a dark, flat-bottomed boat contains three figures. One figure stands at the front of the boat, holding a long pole that extends upwards. Two other figures are seated or stooping towards the back of the boat. All figures wear muted clothing, with hints of red and blue on their head coverings or garments. The immediate foreground on the right shows a dark bank with sparse, light-colored vegetation and small white dots that suggest flowers. In the far distance, along the horizon line, a faint, lighter-toned landmass with indistinct structures is visible. The overall color palette is dominated by dark greens, blues, greys, and browns, with lighter accents in the sky and moon.

alt_text: A young girl kneels in a muted, shadowy setting, looking down at a small wreath of blue and yellow flowers
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a young girl kneeling in a muted, natural setting. The girl is positioned slightly right of center, facing left with her head bowed, looking down at her hands. She wears a light-colored head covering that covers her hair, a sleeveless, open-front pinkish-red vest over a lighter, possibly white, undergarment, and a light-colored skirt that pools around her knees. Her skin is fair, and her expression is focused downwards. Her hands are clasped together, holding a small, circular wreath or garland composed of small blue and yellow flowers. The background is dark and indistinct, rendered in shades of muted green, brown, and gray, suggesting dense foliage or a shadowy outdoor environment. A faint, lighter, vertical shape is visible in the upper left background, possibly a distant figure or object, but it is very blurry and merges with the dark tones. The ground beneath her is dark and earthy, with a few faint lighter specks. The overall palette is subdued, with the girl's clothing and the small flowers providing the main points of color against the dark, shadowy backdrop.

alt_text: A painting shows trees on a grassy slope overlooking a lake, with a crucifix and figures.
long_description: A landscape painting depicts a wide body of water under a light blue sky with faint clouds. The foreground features a grassy slope, illuminated by sunlight on the right and shaded by trees on the left. On the left side of the slope, two figures are visible: one lies on their back, and another sits upright, both dressed in dark clothing. A dense line of tall, slender trees with brown trunks and green foliage extends from the left edge towards the center, casting long shadows across the grass. On the right side of the slope, a prominent wooden crucifix with the figure of Christ stands. A group of approximately five figures is gathered around its base; some are kneeling, while others stand. Their attire includes white bonnets and red cloaks. A single tall tree with sparse foliage stands to the left of the crucifix. In the mid-distance, the calm, light blue-grey water shows several small boats. A low, dark landmass stretches across the horizon in the far background.

alt_text: A dark, wooded path with tall trees lining both sides, featuring three figures and a bright opening in the distance
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a dense, dark forest path under a partially visible blue sky. Tall, dark green trees with thick foliage dominate the composition, forming a canopy that shades most of the scene. The tree trunks, particularly on the right side, are visible as dark, vertical forms, with some lighter areas suggesting filtered sunlight. A dirt path, rendered in lighter browns and ochres, winds from the lower foreground towards a bright, hazy opening in the distant background, possibly revealing a body of water or an open field. In the lower left foreground, a woman wearing a light-colored skirt, a dark top, and a red head covering bends down towards a small child dressed in dark blue. Further along the path, in the middle ground, another figure, wearing a light head covering and dark clothing, walks away from the viewer towards the bright opening. The overall color palette is dominated by deep greens and browns, with accents of blue in the sky and the figures' clothing, and lighter tones for the path and distant background.

alt_text: A woman with dark hair and a red ribbon sits in an armchair, looking down at a letter.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a woman seated in a dark, upholstered armchair, positioned slightly to the right of the center. Her head is tilted downwards and to the right, with her gaze directed towards her lap. Her dark hair is pulled back, and a red ribbon is visible near the top of her head. She wears a light-colored, off-the-shoulder dress with a dark green bodice and long, light-brown sleeves. Her left arm rests on the dark, curved armrest of the chair, while her right hand gently holds a white letter or piece of paper in her lap. The background is predominantly dark and indistinct, with a faint, lighter rectangular shape, possibly a framed picture, visible in the upper right quadrant. The lighting illuminates her face, shoulders, and the front of her dress, creating a contrast with the darker surroundings. The overall palette consists of warm browns, deep greens, and creamy whites, with subtle highlights.

alt_text: A mother in dark clothing breastfeeds a baby in white, with a distant figure on a muted, hilly landscape
long_description:
This vertical oil painting depicts a mother breastfeeding her baby, rendered in a palette of dark, earthy tones. The mother, positioned on the right side of the canvas, is shown from the chest up, her head gently tilted downwards as she looks at the infant. She has dark hair pulled back and wears a dark, loose-fitting garment that exposes her right breast. Her skin tone is a soft, light peach.
The baby, cradled in the mother's arms on the left, is dressed in a white, ruffled garment. Its small head is turned towards the mother's breast, and its tiny hands are visible near its body. The baby's skin is also a light peach, contrasting with the darker clothing of the mother.
The background on the left features a muted, hilly landscape with shades of dark green and brown, suggesting an outdoor setting. A small, indistinct figure, possibly a person, is visible on the crest of a distant hill in the upper left corner. The background on the right is darker and more abstract, appearing as a deep brown or black, providing a stark contrast to the figures. The artist's signature, "COROT," is visible in light brown script in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: Painting of a young woman in a light tunic and yellow skirt, wearing a wreath, holding a fan.
long_description: A waist-up oil painting depicts a young woman with fair skin and dark hair, positioned slightly to her left, gazing downwards. She wears a light cream or off-white sleeveless tunic with a V-neckline, layered over a darker garment, and a long, flowing skirt in shades of yellow and ochre. A delicate pearl necklace adorns her neck. Her dark hair is styled with a wreath of dark leaves and small, light-colored flowers. Her right arm is bent, with her hand gently touching the side of her head or hair, and her elbow rests on a dark, rectangular architectural element to her right. Her left arm hangs loosely by her side, holding a closed, white fan. The background is indistinct and muted, featuring lighter grey-brown tones on the left and darker, more shadowed brown-grey areas on the right, creating a shallow sense of depth. The painting exhibits visible brushstrokes, contributing to a soft, somewhat unfinished appearance.

alt_text: A muted landscape painting of a person working in a field beside a river with trees and distant buildings.
long_description: A landscape painting depicts a tranquil scene under a light blue sky with soft, hazy white clouds. The left and lower-middle portions of the canvas are dominated by a calm body of water, likely a river or lake, which reflects the sky and the surrounding trees. Several tall, slender trees with sparse, light green foliage stand in and along the water's edge, their dark, gnarled trunks prominent. These trees extend across the middle and right side of the painting, creating a sense of depth. On the far side of the water, in the middle distance, a few small, reddish-brown buildings are visible, along with a small, dark boat floating near the bank. In the lower right foreground, a figure, possibly a woman, is bent over, appearing to tend to plants in a field of green and light-colored vegetation. The figure wears dark clothing and a head covering. The overall color palette is composed of muted greens, browns, and grays, with soft blues in the sky and water, contributing to a serene and somewhat subdued atmosphere.

alt_text: A painted portrait of a young boy in a dark feathered hat and tunic, leaning on a chair.
long_description: This vertical portrait painting depicts a young boy, positioned slightly to the right of center, looking towards the left. He has light skin, dark hair visible beneath his hat, and dark eyes. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat adorned with a dark feather plume on its right side. A white collar is visible at his neck, contrasting with his dark, long-sleeved tunic or jacket. The tunic features a row of dark buttons down the front and smaller buttons on each shoulder. His right arm is bent, with his hand resting on a light brown, vertical object, likely the back of a chair, positioned along the right edge of the frame. His left arm hangs down, with his hand visible near the bottom left. The background is a plain, muted greyish-brown, with subtle variations in tone. The brushstrokes are visible, contributing to the texture of the painting.

alt_text: A woman in traditional attire sits, looking down, holding a book, against a muted landscape background.
long_description: The painting is a vertical portrait of a woman seated against a muted landscape. The woman occupies the majority of the foreground, positioned slightly to the right of the center. She is shown from the waist up, with her body angled slightly to the left. Her head is tilted downwards, and her gaze is directed towards the lower left. Her right arm is bent, with her hand resting on her head, fingers lightly touching her temple. A ring is visible on her right ring finger. Her left arm is extended downwards, and her hand holds a small, closed book with a teal or green cover. She wears a yellow headband over her dark hair, which falls over her shoulders. Her attire consists of a light-colored, possibly white, blouse with wide sleeves, over which she wears a patterned vest with red trim. A white apron or skirt covers her lap. The colors of her clothing are predominantly muted whites, creams, browns, and grays, with accents of yellow on the headband and red on the vest trim. A dark, possibly black, garment or shawl is draped over her left shoulder and arm. The background is loosely painted with broad strokes, depicting a hazy, grayish-blue sky above indistinct, dark hills or mountains. The overall palette is somber, with strong contrasts between light and shadow, particularly on the woman's face and clothing. The artist's signature, "COROT," is visible in light-colored script in the bottom left corner of the canvas.

alt_text: A landscape painting depicts a river scene with figures on the bank and a person in a boat, under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting is a horizontal landscape depicting a river scene under a cloudy sky. The upper portion of the canvas features a light blue sky filled with soft white and gray clouds. The left side of the composition is dominated by a dense cluster of dark green trees, some with visible, slender trunks, extending from the foreground into the midground. Behind these trees, a light-colored building with a chimney is partially visible on the far left. In the lower left foreground, a grassy bank slopes down towards the river. Three figures, two adults and a small child in a red garment, walk along this bank towards the right. Their clothing is generally dark. Further back and to the right of these figures, another lone, darker figure is visible amidst the foliage. The river occupies the right half of the painting, its surface a mix of dark and lighter blues and grays, reflecting the sky and surrounding landscape. In the midground on the river, a small, dark boat contains a single figure, dressed in a light shirt and dark head covering, appearing to row or pole. Two dark wooden posts rise from the water in the lower right foreground. Along the distant bank, a low-lying landscape is visible, featuring a prominent, reddish-brown, square-shaped structure, possibly a tower or ruin, on the horizon line. The overall palette consists of muted greens and browns for the land and trees, and blues and grays for the water and sky, with darker tones in the foreground gradually lightening towards the background.

alt_text: A woman with dark hair, wearing a white and red dress, holds a small red flower against a dark background
long_description: A three-quarter length portrait depicts a woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a yellow band with green leaves around her head. She faces slightly to the right, with her gaze directed forward. Her complexion is pale, and her features include dark eyes and full lips. She wears a white blouse with a red trim along the neckline and upper arm, which appears loosely draped. Below the white blouse, a darker, possibly reddish-brown garment covers her torso and right arm. Her right hand, with long fingers, holds a small, dark red flower, possibly a rose, at chest level. The background is a muted, dark brown and gray, with visible brushstrokes creating a textured, indistinct surface. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting her face and the white fabric of her blouse. The overall color palette is somber, dominated by browns, grays, and dark reds, with the white of her blouse and the yellow of her headpiece providing contrast.

alt_text: Figures flee a burning city under a dark blue sky with a winged figure flying overhead.
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic landscape under a dark blue sky, suggesting night or twilight. In the upper left, a light-colored, winged figure appears to be flying or descending. Along the horizon line in the background, a city or town is engulfed in flames, casting an orange glow that illuminates the smoke and the silhouettes of buildings.
