A tall, dark structure resembling a tower stands on the left side of the burning area. The midground features rolling, dark green and brown hills with sparse vegetation. A small, light-colored structure or monument is visible in the center midground. In the foreground, several figures are moving towards the left. On the far left, a figure in a light-colored garment with blue stripes holds hands with another figure in a dark robe. Next to them, a third figure in a dark robe carries a smaller, lighter-colored figure. To their right, a fourth figure in dark clothing looks back towards the burning city, with an arm raised. On the far right, several tall, dark trees with sparse foliage frame the scene, their trunks curving upwards. The ground in the foreground is a mix of dark green and brown, with hints of lighter earth tones.

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a hilly landscape with a village and a church on a prominent hill under a light sky
long_description: A wide, horizontal oil painting depicts a panoramic landscape under a light, overcast sky. The composition is dominated by a large, rolling hill that rises from the left and extends across the center of the canvas. Its slopes are a mosaic of various shades of green fields and darker brown, exposed earth, with a light-colored path winding upwards on the left side. At the crest of this central hill, a cluster of buildings with reddish-brown roofs and light-colored walls is visible. The most prominent structure is a church featuring two distinct, pointed spires. To the right of the central hill, a small village or town spreads across the midground and right side of the painting. This area is densely populated with numerous buildings, also characterized by reddish-brown roofs and light-colored facades, nestled amongst scattered green trees. In the immediate foreground on the right, several small trees with dark trunks and rounded green canopies stand in a vibrant green field. The sky above is a uniform pale blue-gray, suggesting an overcast day. In the bottom right corner, dark text reads "VEVE" above "Colmar".

alt_text: An oil painting depicts a narrow village street with several houses, people, and a cat under a cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a narrow, unpaved village street under a bright, cloudy sky. The sky occupies the top third of the canvas, showing patches of light blue interspersed with white and gray clouds. On the left, a tall, dark building with a thatched roof frames the street, leading into a darker, narrower passage. In the center and right, a two-story house with light-colored, possibly stuccoed walls and a prominent thatched roof dominates the scene. An external wooden staircase with a railing ascends from the ground level to a second-story wooden balcony on this main house. On the balcony, a figure in dark clothing is partially visible. Another figure, possibly a child, stands on the stairs below the balcony. At the bottom of the stairs, near the house's entrance, a woman in a light-colored skirt and a dark top with a red head covering stands, holding a small object. To her right, a pile of hay or straw rests against the wall. A small, dark window is visible on the house wall, and above it, the number "48" is painted in black. Further down the street, behind the main house, another smaller, light-colored building with a dark roof is visible. The street itself is a dirt path, with dark shadows cast across its surface, suggesting sunlight from the upper left. A small black cat walks across the street in the lower-left quadrant.

alt_text: A dark, moody landscape painting with trees framing a body of water and a small figure.
long_description: A somber landscape painting depicts a wooded scene, likely at dusk or dawn, with a body of water in the middle ground and distant hills. The foreground is dominated by dark green and brown foliage. A prominent, light-barked tree with sparse branches stands on the left, reaching towards the top of the canvas. To its right, another tree with a darker trunk and denser, dark green foliage is visible. Further right, several more dark trees with fewer leaves frame the right side of the composition. In the lower center, a small figure, possibly a woman, is seen bending over near the water's edge. She wears a dark top, a light-colored skirt or apron, and a yellow head covering. The middle ground features a wide expanse of water, appearing as a lighter, hazy band across the canvas, reflecting the muted light of the sky. Beyond the water, a dark, undulating line of hills or distant land stretches across the horizon. Faint, lighter structures, possibly buildings, are visible on the distant land. The sky above is a muted gray-blue, with hints of lighter tones suggesting a cloudy or misty atmosphere. The overall palette is subdued, consisting primarily of greens, browns, grays, and muted blues. The artist's signature "COROT" is visible in the lower right corner.

alt_text: A dark, lush painting of figures in a wooded area near a brick building, with a bright opening in the distance.
long_description: The painting depicts a densely wooded landscape with several figures and a building under a muted sky. Dark, rich greens and browns dominate the scene, creating a sense of deep shade. In the upper left, a canopy of dark green leaves fills the frame, with hints of lighter foliage or fruit. Two figures are positioned in the lower left, seated or leaning on a low, dark structure. One figure wears a reddish cap and a light-colored shirt, while the other, seen from behind, wears a light shirt and dark trousers. A winding, light-colored path emerges from the lower right foreground, curving towards the center of the composition. This path leads to a bright, hazy opening in the distance, suggesting a body of water or an expanse of sky. Tall, slender tree trunks rise vertically, framing this luminous background. A third, smaller figure is visible in the bright distance, appearing to hold a long pole, possibly fishing. On the right side, a reddish-brown brick building with a visible window and a closed light-colored shutter occupies the upper portion. Below the window, a dark, rectangular opening suggests a doorway. Green foliage and bushes grow against the building and along the edge of the path. A rustic lean-to structure with a light-colored roof is partially obscured by a tree trunk near the building. The overall impression is one of a tranquil, shaded outdoor scene.

metadata.title: The Banks of the Seine at Conflans

alt_text: A painting of a dense forest with a person gathering wood in the foreground and a distant building
long_description: The painting presents a dense forest landscape, dominated by tall, slender trees with dark foliage that frame the composition. In the immediate foreground, a lone figure is crouched on the ground, appearing to gather a pile of branches or wood. The figure wears a dark blue or grey garment over a brown skirt and has a white head covering. The ground around them is a mix of dark greens and browns, with patches of lighter earth. Behind the figure, a body of water, possibly a pond or stream, reflects the muted light of the sky, appearing as a lighter blue-grey area. Several prominent tree trunks, some with light, almost white bark, rise vertically from the lower edge of the canvas, extending upwards and creating a sense of depth. The overall color palette is subdued, featuring deep greens, earthy browns, and dark greys, with touches of lighter blues and whites in the sky and water. In the mid-distance, beyond the water and through the gaps in the trees, a large, light-colored building, possibly a chateau or manor, is visible on a distant, tree-covered hill. The building has multiple windows and a distinct roofline. The sky above is a pale blue with scattered white clouds, providing a contrast to the darker tones of the forest. The artist's signature, "COROT," is visible in the bottom left corner of the painting.

metadata.title: A Woman Gathering Faggots at Ville-d'Avray

alt_text: A young woman in a blue-sleeved dress sits in a grassy field, reading an open book by a lake
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a young woman seated outdoors, engrossed in a book. She is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing left and looking down at the open book resting on her lap. Her head is tilted forward, and her right hand is gently touching her chin. She wears a white blouse with a red trim over her shoulders, and long, fitted blue sleeves. Her skirt is a muted brown or beige color, with visible folds and texture. A dark band or scarf with gold accents is wrapped around her dark hair, which is pulled back. Behind her, a body of water, likely a lake or river, stretches across the middle ground. On the water, a small boat with a figure in it is visible to the left. The background consists of a hazy, light blue and grey sky with soft, indistinct clouds. The foreground is a field of green and brown grass, with small white and yellow specks suggesting wildflowers. The overall color palette is subdued, with the blue of her sleeves and the red trim providing subtle accents against the earthy tones of the landscape and her clothing. The light appears soft and diffused, creating a calm atmosphere.

alt_text: Four figures, two men and two women, stand in a dark forest, holding keys, a book, a chalice, and shackles
long_description: The painting depicts four full-length figures, two men and two women, standing in a dark, wooded landscape. From left to right, the first figure is a bald, bearded man with a blue tunic and a large gold drapery wrapped around his lower body. He holds a set of large, ornate keys in his left hand, which hangs at his side. His head is tilted down, and his gaze is directed towards the ground. Next to him stands a woman with her head covered by a green veil, wearing a dark, long-sleeved dress. She holds a small, dark book in her hands, which are clasped in front of her. Her head is also tilted down, and her eyes are cast downwards. At her feet, a small, dark, winged creature with a long tail lies on the ground, seemingly restrained by a thin cord held by the woman. The third figure is a woman with long, dark hair, wearing a bright yellow dress with a red drapery wrapped around her waist and legs. She holds a gold chalice in her right hand, which is positioned at her chest. Her head is slightly tilted, and she looks directly forward, towards the viewer. The fourth figure on the far right is a bearded man in a brown, hooded robe. He holds a set of dark, metal shackles in his left hand, which hangs at his side. His head is tilted upwards, and his gaze is directed towards the upper right corner of the painting. The background is dominated by dark, dense foliage and tree trunks, with hints of lighter green leaves in places. The ground beneath the figures is dark and uneven, with some small rocks and sparse vegetation.

metadata.title: Saints Peter, Martha, Mary Magdalen, and Leonard

alt_text: A woman in a white dress plays a large wooden harp in an ornate, dimly lit room.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated and playing a large harp in a richly furnished, dimly lit room. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, faces left but turns her head to look directly at the viewer. She has pale skin and her light-colored hair is styled high and powdered, with curls framing her face. She wears a voluminous white gown with ruffles at the sleeves and hem, and a pink sash tied around her waist. Her bare feet are visible beneath the dress. Her hands are positioned on the strings of the harp, as if in mid-play. The harp, made of dark wood with ornate carvings, stands tall to her left. To the far left, a draped table covered with a white lace cloth holds several small bottles and a silver-colored container. Behind it, a dark green curtain hangs. On the wall above, a circular, sunburst-like decorative element is visible. To the woman's right, a red upholstered chair with a gilded frame is partially visible behind her. Next to it, a small, ornate wooden table holds a vase of colorful flowers (pink, white, blue, yellow), an open book, and an inkwell with a quill. Below this table, a lute rests against the wall, and a small black and white cat or dog sleeps curled on a dark cloth on the floor. The room's walls are a deep green, and a dark fireplace mantelpiece with decorative elements is visible in the background.

metadata.title: Marianne Dorothy Harland (1759–1785), Later Mrs. William Dalrymple

alt_text: Two figures run through a stormy landscape, a man shielding a woman with flowing golden fabric.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts two figures in motion, running barefoot through a dramatic, stormy landscape. The man, positioned on the left and slightly behind the woman, is bare-chested with dark, curly hair. He wears a shaggy, dark garment around his lower body. His left arm is raised, holding a large, golden-brown piece of fabric over both their heads, while his right arm is around the woman's waist. He looks towards the viewer with a subtle expression. The woman, in front, wears a sheer, white, flowing gown that reveals her form. Her reddish-brown hair is disheveled, and she looks over her right shoulder with a concerned gaze. Her right arm is also raised, helping to hold the fabric, and her left hand rests on the man's arm. They move along a light, sandy path with sparse green foliage on the left. The background is dominated by dark, silhouetted mountains or hills under a turbulent, dark sky. A faint flash of light or lightning is visible in the upper right corner, hinting at an impending storm.

alt_text: Portrait of a man in a blue and gold military uniform, holding a hat, against a dark background with a sky
long_description: This is a three-quarter length portrait of a man, depicted from the waist up, against a dark and cloudy background. The man stands facing slightly to his right, with his head turned to look directly forward. He has a pale complexion with rosy cheeks, light-colored eyes, and a small mouth. His hair is powdered white and styled in a wig with curls over his ears and a queue tied at the back. He wears a dark blue military-style coat adorned with extensive gold braiding and buttons, over a white ruffled shirt and a white waistcoat also trimmed with gold. His left hand, visible at the bottom center, holds a dark, tricorn-style hat. His right hand rests on a dark, curved object, possibly part of a ship or a large piece of furniture, which extends from the lower right towards the center. The background on the left is dark brown and green, with indistinct shapes that suggest foliage or a rocky outcrop. On the right, behind the man's right arm and the dark object, a lighter sky is visible, showing soft blues, grays, and hints of pink and orange near the horizon, suggesting a sunset or sunrise over a distant landscape or sea.

metadata.title: Admiral Harry Paulet (1719/20–1794), Sixth Duke of Bolton

alt_text: Portrait of a woman in a dark dress seated against a dark, leafy background, hands clasped
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a woman seated, facing slightly to the viewer's left with her gaze directed forward. Her light-skinned face is framed by dark, wavy hair parted in the middle and pulled back, with some curls visible around her ears. She has dark eyes, a straight nose, and a neutral expression. She wears a dark, possibly black, garment that appears to be a dress or a shawl, with long sleeves. The cuffs of her sleeves are adorned with delicate, dark lace. At her throat, a reddish-brown, oval-shaped brooch with a lighter center is visible. Her hands are clasped together in her lap, with her fingers intertwined. The background on the left side features dark green foliage with hints of lighter green and blue, suggesting a natural outdoor setting or a painted backdrop. On the right, a dark reddish-brown element, possibly the back of a chair, is visible against a darker green background. The overall palette is dominated by dark greens and blacks, contrasting with the lighter tones of her skin.

metadata.title: Madame Frederic Breyer (Fanny Hélène Van Bruyssel, 1830–1894)

alt_text: A young woman with abundant red curly hair looks into a hand mirror, her right hand near her hair.
long_description: A painting depicts a young woman with long, voluminous, reddish-brown curly hair, shown from the chest up against a dark, muted background. Her head is turned slightly to her right, and she gazes into a dark-framed oval hand mirror held in her left hand. Her skin is fair, and her eyes are light-colored. Her lips are slightly parted. Her right hand is raised, with fingers spread, positioned near the top of her head, seemingly interacting with her hair. She wears a white lace collar with small buttons over a dark garment, possibly black, with a white cuff visible on her right wrist. The abundant curly hair cascades around her shoulders and down her back, filling much of the frame. The lighting highlights her face and the top of her hair. In the bottom left corner, the signature "Gustave Courbet" is visible in script.

alt_text: A reclining nude woman with long dark hair reaches up to a colorful parrot perched on her hand
long_description: The painting depicts a nude woman reclining on a bed or couch, positioned diagonally across the canvas from the lower left to the upper right. Her body is turned slightly towards the viewer, with her head resting on a dark, possibly green, surface at the lower left. Her long, wavy dark brown hair spreads out behind her head and over the surface. Her left arm is bent, with her hand resting on her upper right thigh, partially covered by a white sheet. Her right arm is raised above her head, with her hand extended upwards. A colorful parrot, predominantly green, yellow, and blue, is perched on her outstretched right hand, appearing to peck at her fingers. The woman's skin is pale, and her body is full-figured. Her eyes are closed, and her expression is serene. A white sheet or drapery covers her lower body from her hips downwards, partially revealing her legs and feet. Below the white sheet, a darker, possibly black, fabric is visible. The background is dark and indistinct, suggesting a shadowy interior or natural setting. To the right of the woman's head, a dark, vertical, ladder-like structure with several horizontal rungs extends upwards. At the very top of this structure, a small, light-colored bowl or object is visible. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the woman's form against the darker surroundings.

alt_text: A nude woman with reddish hair stands in a forest, reaching up, with her feet in a stream.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a nude woman standing in a lush forest beside a stream. The woman, with fair skin and reddish-brown hair, is positioned slightly left of center, facing right with her body angled towards the viewer. Her hair is pulled up and held by her hands on top of her head. Her left arm extends high to the right, grasping a leafy tree branch, while her right arm is bent with her hand also near her head. Her gaze is directed downwards and to the right. She stands on the edge of a body of water, with her bare feet partially submerged in the stream. The water flows from the right side of the painting towards the lower center, creating small ripples and a slight waterfall effect in the middle ground. The background is filled with dense green foliage, indicating a deep forest, with a large tree trunk visible directly behind the woman on the left. The lighting is soft, highlighting the woman's form against the darker greens and browns of the trees and earth. In the lower left corner, the signature "G. Fournier" is visible.

alt_text: A painting of a cloudy sky over a calm sea and sandy beach with two boats on the shore
long_description: The painting depicts a vast sky filled with large, billowy clouds that dominate the upper two-thirds of the canvas. The clouds are rendered in shades of white, light gray, and hints of pale blue, suggesting a bright but overcast day. Below the sky, a calm sea stretches across the middle of the composition, marked by a distinct horizon line. The water is a greenish-blue, with subtle variations in color indicating gentle ripples or shallow areas near the shore. In the distance, on the water, two small sailboats with white sails are faintly visible. The bottom third of the painting shows a sandy beach, rendered in light brown and tan tones, with darker patches suggesting wet sand or shadows. Two small, dark-hulled fishing boats rest on the sand; one is positioned closer to the viewer on the left, and the other is further back on the right. In the bottom left corner, the signature "G. Courbet" and the number "69" are visible.

alt_text: A dramatic oil painting depicts a stormy sea with crashing waves against dark cliffs under a heavy, rain-streaked sky.
long_description: This horizontal oil painting depicts a turbulent seascape under a stormy sky. The upper third of the canvas is dominated by heavy, dark reddish-brown and gray clouds, suggesting an impending or ongoing storm. Below these clouds, vertical streaks of lighter gray and white indicate heavy rainfall, obscuring the distant horizon and creating a dense, atmospheric effect. In the lower left and center, large, frothy waves with white crests crash and churn across the dark, greenish-gray water. These waves appear powerful and dynamic, with visible foam and spray. To the right, a rugged, dark brown and gray cliff face rises steeply from the water, occupying the right third of the composition. The cliff shows distinct rock formations and small patches of dark green vegetation clinging to its surfaces. The waves are seen breaking against the base of these cliffs, adding to the scene's dramatic intensity. The overall color palette is dominated by dark grays, browns, and deep greens, with stark white accents from the wave foam. The artist's signature, "G. Courbet", is visible in the bottom right corner in dark script.

alt_text: A hunter in a red coat holds a fox, surrounded by hunting dogs and dead game in a forest
long_description: The painting depicts a hunting scene set within a dense, dark forest. On the left, a fair-haired hunter, dressed in a bright red coat with a yellow cravat and light-colored breeches tucked into black boots with yellow cuffs, stands leaning slightly forward. He holds a small, reddish-brown fox by its scruff, lifting it upwards. Below him, on the ground, a brass hunting horn and a red cap with a feather are visible. To the right of the hunter, a large, white and brown spotted hunting dog looks up intently at the fox, its mouth open. Further to the right and in the foreground, several dead animals are piled on the forest floor, including two deer, a rabbit, and at least one bird. Another smaller, brown and white dog is visible on the far right, near the pile of game. The background is filled with dark, leafy trees and thick undergrowth, creating a deep, shadowed environment. The overall color palette is dominated by dark greens and browns, with the hunter's vibrant red coat and the white fur of the dogs providing points of contrast. The artist's signature, "G. Courbet," is visible in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: A dark oil painting of a bearded man in a brown robe holding a folded paper and a violin
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a man in a dark, somber palette, positioned slightly to the left of the frame's center. The man is shown from the waist up, facing towards the right and looking downwards. He has dark, wavy hair that reaches his shoulders and a prominent, reddish-brown beard and mustache. His skin appears fair, with shadows defining the contours of his face. He wears a loose-fitting, dark brown robe or coat, under which a sliver of a white collar and a mustard-yellow garment are visible. His right hand, with visible fingers, holds a light blue-gray, folded object, possibly a sheet of paper or a small book, which is illuminated. His left hand rests on the body of a dark wooden violin, which is partially visible in the lower left quadrant of the painting. The background is dark and indistinct, primarily composed of deep browns and blacks, with a subtle vertical reddish-brown stripe on the right side. The lighting emphasizes the man's face and the object in his right hand, leaving much of the rest of the figure and background in shadow. The signature "S. Courbet" is visible in red script in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A dark, lush painting depicts a stream winding through a dense forest with tall trees and green foliage.
long_description: This painting depicts a verdant, shaded forest scene with a stream flowing through its center. The lower half of the canvas is dominated by the dark, reflective surface of the water, which appears deep green and brown, mirroring the surrounding foliage with subtle lighter streaks. Along the banks, lush green grass and smaller plants line the water's edge. On the left side, several tall, thick tree trunks with dark brown bark rise vertically, their dense canopies extending upwards and across the top left of the frame, forming a wall of dark green leaves. To the right, a cluster of more slender trees with lighter brown trunks stands further back, also adorned with abundant green foliage. In the distant center, a lighter patch of green and yellow-green foliage suggests an opening or path, hinting at sunlight beyond the immediate shade. The upper portion of the painting is filled with the dense, dark green canopies of the trees, creating an enclosed, tunnel-like atmosphere over the stream. Visible brushstrokes contribute to the textured appearance of the leaves and the overall impression of a deeply shaded, natural environment.

metadata.title: A Brook in a Clearing (possibly "Brook, Valley of Fontcouverte; Study")

alt_text: A dark, dense forest scene with a winding stream flowing over rocks and lush foliage.
long_description: This oil painting depicts a dense, verdant forest scene with a winding stream. In the foreground, several large, rounded rocks, some with hints of mossy green, are partially submerged in the stream. The water on the far left of the foreground shows some white, frothy movement, suggesting a small cascade or rapids. The stream flows from the lower left towards the center and then recedes into the background, appearing darker and calmer as it moves away. On both sides of the stream, the banks are covered in lush, dark green foliage and undergrowth. On the left, several slender tree trunks rise vertically, partially obscured by the dense leaves. The right side of the composition is dominated by a cluster of thick, dark tree trunks that extend upwards, creating a deep shadow along the right bank. The canopy of the forest forms a dense, dark green mass across the upper half of the painting, with varying shades of green indicating depth and light. A small patch of lighter blue, possibly sky, is visible through the trees at the top center, providing a subtle contrast to the otherwise dark and enclosed environment. The overall palette is dominated by deep greens and earthy browns, with the blue-green of the water providing a central focal point.

alt_text: A snowy forest scene with several deer sheltering under a large snow-covered rock and trees
long_description: This painting depicts a winter forest landscape, dominated by dark, earthy tones and stark white snow. The foreground is covered in a thick layer of snow, with hints of brown and green vegetation peeking through. To the right, a massive, dark rock formation rises, its upper surface heavily laden with white snow. In the center-right, nestled beneath the overhang of this rock and the base of several large tree trunks, are two or three deer. One deer stands, partially obscured, while another lies down, both with brown coats blending into the shadows. The tree trunks, dark brown and gnarled, stand prominently in the midground, with sparse, reddish-brown leaves clinging to their branches. The background recedes into a darker, less defined forest, also covered in snow, suggesting depth. The overall lighting is subdued, creating a somber yet serene atmosphere.

alt_text: A painting of a shipwrecked boat on a rocky beach with a turbulent sea under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic coastal scene with a shipwrecked boat on a rocky beach under a cloudy sky. The upper third of the canvas shows a sky transitioning from a pale orange-peach hue near the horizon to a light blue-gray above, with soft, indistinct clouds. Below the sky, the middle ground is dominated by a turbulent sea, rendered with dark green-gray waves topped with frothy white caps, extending to the distant horizon. The lower half of the image features a rugged beach composed of muted brown and gray sand and numerous rocks. A dark-hulled boat, appearing beached or partially submerged among the rocks, is positioned slightly right of the center. Its single mast leans significantly to the left, and tattered, light-colored sails hang loosely from the rigging. Debris or other elements are visible within the boat's hull. A large, dark, irregular rock occupies the left foreground, while smaller, similarly colored rocks are scattered across the beach around the boat. The signature "Gustave Courbet" is visible in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: A dark landscape painting depicts a narrow river flowing between steep, tree-covered cliffs under a light sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a verdant, rocky landscape with a river flowing through a narrow gorge under a pale sky. The upper portion of the canvas shows a light blue-green sky, with dark green foliage and trees covering the tops of the cliffs. On the left, a steep, rugged cliff face rises, partially covered by dense, dark green vegetation and a prominent tree trunk in the lower left foreground. The exposed rock of this cliff displays earthy tones of brown, gray, and ochre, interspersed with patches of green. The river, a muted brown-green, flows across the lower-middle section of the painting, its surface reflecting the subdued light and showing subtle textures that suggest gentle movement. On the right side, a large, dark cliff wall dominates, rising steeply from the riverbank. This cliff is heavily shadowed, with vertical rock formations and areas of dark green growth. Several slender, dark tree trunks with minimal branches are visible atop this right-hand cliff, silhouetted against the lighter sky. The immediate foreground features a patch of dark green grass and some indistinct, darker shapes near the water's edge. The overall color scheme is characterized by deep greens, browns, and grays, with lighter blue-green in the sky and warmer ochre accents on the rock faces.

alt_text: Two hunting dogs investigate a dead hare in a dark, autumnal forest clearing with dense trees.
long_description: A dark, naturalistic painting depicts a forest scene with two dogs and a hare. In the left foreground, a light brown hare lies on its back in the grass, its belly facing upwards and its legs splayed. Its fur is a mottled mix of brown and tan. To the right of the hare, two large, short-legged dogs with long, floppy ears are positioned, leaning forward with their heads down, appearing to investigate the hare. The dog on the left is predominantly white with large patches of reddish-brown fur on its head, back, and hindquarters. The dog on the right is also mostly white, but with large patches of black fur on similar areas. Both dogs have long, thin tails that curve slightly upwards. The midground and background are filled with a dense forest, featuring tall trees and thick undergrowth. The foliage displays a mix of dark greens, browns, and oranges, suggesting an autumnal setting. The ground is covered in dark grass and deep shadows, with a small patch of lighter blue sky visible through the trees in the upper left portion of the painting. The overall lighting is dim, creating a somber atmosphere.

alt_text: A man in an orange tunic and chainmail raises a cup, surrounded by two other men, one in armor, one in a dark cloak
long_description: This vertical oil painting features three men in historical attire, with a central figure prominently seated and two others in the background. The central man, positioned slightly right of center, has dark hair, a prominent mustache, and a goatee. He wears a bright orange tunic with gold trim at the collar and hem, and a gold chain around his neck. A wide, light brown belt with a silver buckle and studs cinches his waist, from which a sword hangs. His arms and legs are covered in dark chainmail, and he wears chainmail shoes with spurs. His right arm is raised, holding a small, dark brown cup or dice shaker. His left hand rests on the hilt of his sword. He looks directly forward with a steady gaze. To the left and slightly behind the central figure, two men are partially visible. The closer man wears a dark brown tunic and chainmail, with a helmet and a beard, looking towards the central figure. Behind him, another man in a helmet is also visible. On a table in front of these two men, a small wooden box, a dark dice cup, and several white dice are scattered, along with a pair of white gloves. To the right and behind the central figure, a third man stands, partially obscured by a dark, draped fabric. He wears a dark cloak with a fur collar and a gold chain, and has a mustache and goatee. His right hand is placed on his hip. The background is a dark, textured blue-green, suggesting an interior setting. The central figure is brightly lit, contrasting with the dimmer lighting of the background and surrounding figures. The overall palette includes rich oranges, dark browns, and muted blues and greens.

metadata.title: Louis Gueymard (1822–1880) as Robert le Diable

alt_text: A seated woman in a black dress and green shawl, wearing gloves and coral jewelry, looking downwards
long_description: The painting depicts a full-length portrait of a seated woman against a dark, muted background. She is positioned slightly to the right of the center, angled towards the left, with her head tilted downwards and to her left. Her dark hair is parted in the middle and frames her pale face. She wears a long-sleeved black dress with a white ruffled collar and cuffs. A vibrant green shawl, patterned with horizontal bands of gold and orange, is draped over her shoulders and lap. On her left arm, she wears a white glove and several strands of coral-colored beads as a bracelet. Her left hand, gloved, is raised towards her chest, holding a dark, possibly green, pendant or brooch. Her right arm rests on her lap, also adorned with a coral-colored beaded bracelet. Her ungloved right hand holds a crumpled white cloth. The voluminous black skirt of her dress extends downwards, obscuring her legs. Her feet, wearing dark shoes, rest on a rectangular green cushion with a brown base. To the left of the woman, a dark wooden table with ornate gold trim is partially visible, topped with a dark, possibly fur, garment. To the right, a dark red curtain with heavy folds hangs in the background. The overall lighting is dim, with the woman's face and hands being the most illuminated areas. A signature, "F. Bonhol," is visible in the bottom right corner of the canvas.

alt_text: A close-up portrait of an older man with gray hair and glasses, wearing dark clothing, against a dark background
long_description: This is a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man, positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking directly forward. His face is illuminated, revealing a fair complexion with visible wrinkles around his eyes and forehead. He has a prominent nose, thin lips, and light-colored eyes that gaze out from behind round, thin-framed glasses. His hair is thick, gray, and appears somewhat disheveled, swept back from his forehead and temples. He wears dark clothing, likely a jacket or coat, with a sliver of a white collar or shirt visible at his neck. The lighting emphasizes the contours of his face, casting the lower part of his body and the background into deeper shadow. The background is a dark, indistinct brown, almost black, creating a stark contrast with the illuminated face. On the left side of the painting, vertically oriented, is a signature that reads "G. Courbet".

alt_text: A close-up oil portrait of a bearded man with a white collar against a dark background
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned slightly off-center to the right, against a dark, unadorned background. The man's head is turned slightly to his right, and his gaze is directed forward, slightly past the viewer. He has light skin with rosy cheeks and a prominent, dark brown beard that covers his chin and jawline, connecting to his sideburns. His hair, also dark brown, is receding at the temples and appears somewhat thin on top. His eyes are dark, and his nose is straight. His lips are closed, forming a neutral expression. He wears a dark jacket or coat, visible over his shoulders and chest, with a crisp white shirt collar that stands up and folds over, contrasting sharply with the dark fabric. The brushstrokes are visible, particularly in the texture of the beard and the highlights on the collar. The lighting comes from the upper left, casting subtle shadows on the right side of his face and neck. In the bottom left corner, a signature in red script reads "G. Courbet". The overall palette is subdued, dominated by dark browns, blacks, and the lighter tones of the man's skin and collar.

alt_text: A painting depicts a narrow river flowing between towering, tree-covered cliffs under a cloudy sky
long_description: A vertical landscape painting depicts a river flowing through a rocky gorge under a partially visible sky. The upper half of the composition is dominated by towering cliffs on both sides, with a narrow, dark chasm visible between them in the upper center. The cliffs on the left are lighter in tone, revealing exposed grey and white rock faces interspersed with patches of green foliage and trees. The cliffs on the right are significantly darker, densely covered with deep green and dark brown trees and vegetation, creating a shadowed, almost impenetrable wall. The river occupies the lower half of the painting, its surface a murky, dark green with subtle reflections of the sky and surrounding cliffs. Ripples and variations in light are visible across the water. Several dark rocks and what appear to be logs are partially submerged in the river or rest along its banks. The immediate foreground on the right features a small patch of grassy bank with hints of lighter green and a few small yellow flowers. The left bank is also rocky and covered with sparse green growth, with a few individual trees standing near the water's edge. The overall palette is dominated by greens, greys, and dark browns, with a small patch of light blue and white in the sky.

alt_text: A painting depicts a stormy seascape with dark, heavy clouds, rough waves, and a rocky foreground
long_description: A dramatic oil painting depicts a stormy seascape under a heavy sky. The upper two-thirds of the canvas are filled with dense, dark grey and black clouds, textured with visible brushstrokes that suggest movement and depth. A narrow band of lighter, greenish-blue sky is visible along the very top edge, peeking through the oppressive cloud cover. Below the horizon line, the sea stretches across the middle ground, rendered in deep blue-green hues. The water is turbulent, with numerous white-capped waves breaking and churning, indicating rough conditions. Small patches of white foam are visible on the wave crests. In the far distance on the water, a tiny, light-colored sailboat with a single mast is faintly discernible. The foreground features a dark, sandy beach with several clusters of irregular, dark brown and grey rocks. These rocks vary in size and shape, some appearing partially wet from the waves. The overall color palette is dominated by dark, muted tones of grey, blue, and green, with contrasting whites in the wave foam and the lighter sky.

alt_text: Nude woman from behind stands in a stream with a waterfall, surrounded by dark green foliage.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a nude woman from behind, standing in a natural, verdant setting with water. Her light-toned skin contrasts with the dark green background. Her back is turned to the viewer, with her head slightly turned to her right, looking towards a waterfall. Her dark brown hair is pulled up, revealing her neck and upper back. Her arms are bent, and her forearms rest on a dark, mossy surface to her right, near the cascading water. Her body is full-figured, with visible curves of her back, buttocks, and thighs. She stands in shallow, clear water that reaches her calves. The water ripples around her legs and over small, dark rocks on the stream bed. To her right, a narrow waterfall cascades down a dark, rocky wall, creating white foam where it hits the stream. The background is dominated by dense, dark green foliage, suggesting a forest or grotto. A thick, dark brown tree branch extends diagonally from the upper left towards the center, passing behind the woman's upper back. The overall lighting is subdued, with some brighter highlights on the water and the woman's skin. In the bottom right corner, a dark signature reads "G. Courbet".

alt_text: A dark cave opening with a white waterfall flowing past a brown building and rocky cliffs.
long_description: An oil painting depicts a natural landscape featuring a waterfall, a cave, and a building. On the left, a two-story building with light brown walls and dark rectangular windows stands against a dark, mossy rock face. Below the building, a dark wooden structure, possibly a flume or part of a mill, extends into the turbulent water. In the center, a wide, frothy white waterfall cascades over dark rocks, flowing from a deep, dark cave opening that dominates the upper center of the composition. The water appears agitated and bright white, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark tones. The right side and upper background are filled with rugged, dark gray and brown rocky cliffs, textured with visible brushstrokes. Sparse patches of green and yellow foliage cling to the rocks, particularly in the upper left and upper right sections. The overall palette is dominated by dark earth tones, grays, and the bright white of the water.

alt_text: A young woman in a dark dress and hat, with white collar and gloves, stands against a blue and green background
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a young woman, shown from the waist up, positioned slightly to the right of the center. Her head is tilted downwards, and her gaze is directed towards the lower left. Her skin is pale, with a subtle pink flush on her cheeks and light pink lips. Dark hair frames her face, visible beneath a dark, wide-brimmed hat adorned with a dark bow on its left side. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress or coat, featuring a crisp white collar at her neck and white cuffs extending from her sleeves. Both hands are covered with white gloves. Her left hand, on the viewer's right, hangs lower, holding a small, dark, cylindrical object with a reddish-brown tip. Her right hand, on the viewer's left, is bent at the elbow, with the hand resting near her waist. The background consists of a dark, cloudy blue sky in the upper two-thirds, with lighter blue and gray tones suggesting clouds. The lower third features dark green, indistinct foliage or trees, creating a natural setting.

alt_text: A painting of a village with a church steeple by a river, surrounded by green hills and cliffs
long_description: This landscape painting depicts a verdant valley with a river and a village under a cloudy sky. The upper portion of the canvas features a light blue sky with scattered white and gray clouds. Below the sky, a long, light-colored cliff face stretches horizontally across the mid-ground, flanked by green, rolling hills on either side. In the center of the painting, a calm body of water, likely a river or lake, reflects the sky. On the far bank of this water, a small village is visible, characterized by several muted-toned buildings and a prominent, tall church steeple with a pointed roof. The village is nestled against the base of the green hills. The foreground is dominated by lush green foliage and trees, framing the central scene. On the left, a dirt path winds through the grass and trees, leading towards the water. On the right, dense trees obscure part of the view. A small, arched stone bridge crosses a narrow stream in the lower center, which flows from the bottom of the painting into the larger body of water. The overall color palette consists of various shades of green for the vegetation, earthy browns for the paths and bridge, and soft blues and grays for the sky and water, creating a serene natural scene.

alt_text: A grayscale painting shows a dense, textured cluster of light-toned flowers with dark foliage against a muted background
long_description: This grayscale painting features a large, abundant arrangement of flowers, rendered in light tones that appear almost white, dominating the central and lower-right areas of the canvas. The flowers are depicted with visible, impasto-like brushstrokes, creating a sense of texture and volume. Darker tones, likely representing foliage and stems, are interspersed among the light blossoms and extend outwards, particularly on the left and upper right. On the far left, a dark, vertical mass provides a strong contrast and frames the floral arrangement. In the upper right quadrant, a few slender branches with small, dark leaves extend into a lighter, more uniform background. The background itself is a soft, muted gray, offering a subtle contrast to the more detailed and textured foreground. The lower edge of the painting shows darker, more abstract brushwork, suggesting a shadowed surface or base. The overall composition emphasizes the organic form and profusion of the flowers.

alt_text: Black and white still life painting showing five round fruits arranged against a dark, textured background.
long_description: A black and white still life painting depicts five round fruits arranged in the foreground against a dark, heavily textured background. The fruits, possibly apples or similar produce, are rendered with visible, thick brushstrokes, giving them a slightly uneven and organic appearance. Three fruits are positioned prominently in the front row, with two more slightly behind them, creating a sense of depth. The fruit on the far left is round and slightly flattened at the top and bottom. The central fruit is the largest and most prominent, with a small indentation at its top. The fruit on the far right shows a distinct vertical crease or indentation. All fruits exhibit lighter tones on their left sides, suggesting a light source from the upper left, while their right sides and undersides are darker, creating volume. The background is a deep, mottled black, with swirling and uneven textures that suggest a draped fabric or an abstract surface. The overall impression is one of stark contrast between the lighter, solid forms of the fruits and the dark, atmospheric backdrop. A faint signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: Portrait painting of an older woman wearing a pink bonnet and dark clothing against a dark background.
long_description: A head-and-shoulders portrait painting depicts an older woman facing slightly right, looking forward. She wears a light pink bonnet with a ruffled lace trim around her face, covering her dark hair which is parted in the middle. A wide pink ribbon is tied in a bow under her chin, and another pink ribbon forms a bow at her neck. Pinned to the ribbon at her neck is a small, oval-shaped cameo brooch, depicting a light-colored profile against a darker background. She wears a dark, possibly black, garment, with a lighter, possibly green or grey, ruffled collar visible beneath the pink neck ribbon. Her face is aged, with visible wrinkles around her eyes and mouth. Her eyes are dark, and her lips are closed in a subtle, gentle expression. The background is a solid, dark, muted green or black, providing a stark contrast to the lighter tones of her face and bonnet. The lighting illuminates her face from the upper left, casting soft shadows.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman, Called Héloïse Abélard

alt_text: A young person with dark hair sits at a desk, looking upwards, with bubbles floating nearby.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a young person seated at a wooden desk, looking upwards and to the right. The person, positioned in the lower center and right, has light skin and dark, wavy hair. They wear a dark, loose-fitting garment over a white shirt with ruffled cuffs, and a dark belt. Their left hand rests on their lap, holding a thin, light-colored stick or brush. Their right foot, clad in a light-colored slipper, is propped on the patterned armchair they occupy. To the left of the person, a wooden desk holds several objects. A stack of books is on the far left. Next to the books, a framed piece of paper with handwritten text is propped up, partially obscured, but visible words include "prawdziwe jest" and "tylko". In front of the framed paper, a clear glass or goblet contains a dark, frothy liquid, with a thin, dark stick or straw emerging from it. A small, dark, bird-like object is perched on the rim of the glass. Various papers and small items are scattered on the desk surface. In the upper left quadrant, two translucent, iridescent bubbles float in the air. In the upper right corner, a dark green wreath or garland of leaves hangs on the wall. The background is a muted, dark wall, with a subtle light source illuminating the framed paper and the person's face. The overall color palette is dark and earthy, with highlights on the skin, white shirt, and bubbles.

alt_text: A long horizontal painting depicting multiple scenes: a crowd with tents, people near water, and a city with red buildings
long_description: The painting is a horizontal panel, divided into three main sections from left to right. The left section features a large group of approximately twenty figures standing closely together. Many wear elaborate, patterned garments in shades of red, gold, and dark colors, with some wearing hats or turbans. In the center of this group is an older man with a long white beard, dressed in a gold and red patterned robe. Behind the figures are several conical tents, some with golden tops, set against a light blue sky. The middle section depicts a landscape with a body of water, possibly a river or lake, flowing from the background towards the foreground. On the left bank, a woman in a gold dress walks towards the water. In the water, a figure in red lies prone. On the right bank, another figure in a gold and dark patterned dress lies on the ground. In the distance, faint buildings and trees are visible. The right section portrays a city or fortified area with prominent red-orange buildings. The central structure is a multi-story building with arched doorways and crenellated tops. To its left, an ornate archway leads to another building. A figure in a gold and red patterned robe stands in front of the red building, facing right. Inside the red building's archway, a dark-clad figure is visible. Several golden, lumpy objects are placed on the ground near the buildings. The background shows more distant, lighter-colored structures.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a stout, bearded man in a dark robe, red turban, and rings.
long_description: This half-length portrait depicts a stout man with light skin, facing slightly to the right against a plain light blue background. He has a full, reddish-brown beard and mustache, and dark eyes. His head is covered by a reddish-brown turban with a thin gold band. He wears a dark, possibly black, robe with wide, voluminous sleeves. Beneath the robe, a white, gathered shirt is visible at his neck, topped by a collar with a red and gold patterned band. Decorative bands of alternating red and gold stripes adorn the sleeves and the front of the robe. His hands are clasped together at the bottom center of the painting. On his left hand, he wears a prominent ring with a large red stone, and on his right hand, a smaller ring with a dark green or blue stone. The lighting illuminates his face and hands, creating a contrast with the darker tones of his attire.

alt_text: Jesus stands between a woman and a crowd of men, some armed, in a dark, crowded scene
long_description:
The painting depicts a crowded scene against a uniformly dark background. In the center, a man with a beard and long, light brown hair, wearing a grey tunic and a red cloak, stands with his left hand extended towards a woman on his right. His right hand is raised slightly, palm open. The woman, positioned slightly lower and to the right of the central man, wears an orange-red dress with a white bodice and a white headband. She looks down and to her left, her hands hanging loosely. She is being held by her right wrist by the central man.
To the left of the central man, a group of men surrounds him. One man in the foreground, wearing silver armor and a teal tunic, holds a small, dark object in his left hand and looks upwards towards the central man. Behind him, several other men with beards and various head coverings, including turbans and caps, look towards the central figures.
To the right of the woman, another group of men is visible. One man in silver armor and a helmet stands behind her, looking towards the central man. Other men with beards and hats are visible behind him, also observing the scene. The figures are tightly packed, filling most of the frame.
At the top edge of the painting, gold lettering is visible: "WER VNTER EVCH ONS SVNDE IST. DER WERFFE DEN ERSTEN STEIN AVFF SIE. IOH. VIII."

metadata.title: Christ and the Adulteress
metadata.artist: Lucas Cranach the Younger and Workshop

alt_text: A bearded man in blue holds a baby, surrounded by many adults and children, with text above.
long_description: The painting depicts a crowded scene with numerous figures, including adults and children, against a dark background. In the center, a man with light brown hair and a beard, dressed in a flowing blue robe, holds a naked infant in his arms, looking down at the child. To his left, a group of women and children are gathered. A woman in a vibrant orange dress with a white collar holds a baby on her hip. Another woman in a dark green dress, partially obscured, also holds an infant. Further left, a young child in a white garment stands, holding a red string. Below the woman in orange, a child in a white and black striped dress holds a small doll. Several other infants are visible, held by women or peeking from behind adults. To the right of the central figure, more people are present. A woman in a red skirt and white collar holds a baby wrapped in a white cloth. Behind her, a woman in a green dress has her hands clasped together. In the foreground, two young children stand; one in a red dress with a white collar extends her arms towards the central figure, and another in a green and red outfit stands beside her. Behind these women and children, two older men with beards are visible. One man with a long, reddish-brown beard and a red robe gestures with his right hand. The other man has a white beard. The figures are tightly composed, filling the entire frame from edge to edge. At the very top of the dark background, a line of white text is visible: "LASSET DIE KINDLIN ZV MIR KOMEN. VND WERET INEN NICHT. DENN SOLCHER IST DAS REICH GOTTES. M. MARCVS. X." The overall palette includes rich blues, reds, oranges, and greens, contrasting with the dark background.

metadata.title: Christ Blessing the Children
metadata.artist: Lucas Cranach the Younger and Workshop

alt_text: A waist-up portrait of a bearded man in a black hat and garment against a plain red background.
long_description: A waist-up portrait depicts a man turned slightly to his right, looking towards the right edge of the frame, against a plain, deep red background. He has light skin, a full dark brown beard and mustache, and dark eyes. He wears a black beret-style hat adorned with a dark feather plume on its right side. His dark, possibly black, garment features a wide V-neck opening, revealing a white, ruffled, high-necked shirt underneath. A reddish-brown chain or necklace is visible peeking out from the V-neck. In the lower right corner, his right hand is visible, holding a dark, slender object, possibly a staff or cane. A ring with a prominent green stone is worn on the ring finger of his right hand. The background is a uniform, solid red color, providing a stark contrast to the dark attire of the subject.

alt_text: A knight, an old man, and three nude women under a tree, with a landscape and Cupid flying above
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a complex scene set in a wooded landscape with distant features. In the upper left, a small, winged, nude figure, resembling Cupid, flies on a cloud, aiming a bow and arrow downwards. A large, dark-barked tree with green leaves dominates the left side, its trunk extending from the bottom to the top, and branches spreading across the upper half. To the left of the tree, a white horse with a red bridle stands facing right. Below the tree, a knight in shining silver armor with red accents and a large white feathered hat reclines on a rock, looking upwards and to the right. His left arm rests on his chest, and his right arm is extended towards the center. To the right of the knight, an older, bearded man with a stern expression stands, wearing a helmet with horns, a red and brown tunic, and a skirt-like garment adorned with large, round, reddish spheres. He holds a staff in his left hand and points with his right hand towards three nude women standing to his right. The three women are positioned in a line, facing slightly towards the left. They all have light skin and reddish-blonde hair. Each wears a gold necklace with red beads. The woman closest to the bearded man points towards herself with her right hand. The middle woman has a white drapery loosely held around her hips. The woman on the far right stands with her hands at her sides. Behind the figures, a dense green forest transitions into a body of water with a city on its far bank. In the distance, mountains rise, and on the right, a rocky cliff with a small castle or structure on top is visible. The sky is light blue.

alt_text: A woman in elaborate attire holds a silver sword and a severed, bearded head against a dark background.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a woman holding a sword and a severed head against a dark, solid background. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, has pale skin and light hair, with her gaze directed slightly to her left. She wears an elaborate red hat adorned with white feathers and an ornate gold headpiece. Around her neck is a wide, jeweled choker featuring red and gold stones, along with a braided gold necklace. Her bodice is a quilted orange pattern with small white dots, and she wears a white undershirt with horizontal black stripes. Her sleeves are a rich green with gold patterns and puffed white cuffs. Her right hand, adorned with rings, firmly grips the hilt of a long, silver sword. Below her hand, a severed, bearded head with eyes rolled back and an open mouth rests on a brown ledge at the bottom of the frame. The head has dark, curly hair and a reddish, bloody neck. The background is uniformly dark, providing a stark contrast to the figures and their vibrant attire.

metadata.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes

alt_text: A woman kneels, about to be beheaded by a man with a large sword, surrounded by onlookers in a landscape.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures in a landscape under a blue sky. In the foreground, a young woman with light brown, curly hair kneels on her right knee, facing right. She wears a rich red gown with puffed sleeves and a pearl necklace, her hands clasped together near her waist. Her head is bowed slightly, looking towards the ground. To her right, a bearded man, likely the executioner, stands over her, holding a large, curved, silver sword with a gold hilt above her neck. He wears an elaborate red and gold striped tunic with puffed sleeves, striped pants, and a turban-like hat with a spiral ornament. To the left of the kneeling woman, a group of men observe the scene. Two men in the far left are dressed in full silver armor, one holding a long staff. Another man in a dark green tunic with a patterned belt stands behind them, looking towards the woman. In the background, rolling green hills rise, topped with several stone castles or towers under a clear blue sky. Sparse trees and rocks are visible on the hillsides. In the bottom right corner, a coat of arms features two black bulls on a white shield, topped by a single black bull.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a man in a dark hat and fur-lined coat, holding red beads.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man against a dark, muted green background. He is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his head turned slightly to the right, and his gaze directed towards the right side of the frame. The man has pale skin, short dark brown hair that reaches his ears, and light-colored eyes. He wears a dark, flat-brimmed hat that covers his forehead. His nose is straight, and his lips are closed. He is dressed in a dark, possibly black, outer garment with a wide, dark brown fur collar that extends over his shoulders. Beneath this, a white collar with a thin grey trim is visible around his neck, over a dark undershirt. His hands are clasped together at waist level, holding a string of small, round, red beads. A silver-colored ring with a dark stone is visible on the ring finger of his left hand. The lighting appears to come from the left, illuminating his face and hands, creating subtle shadows on the right side of his face and clothing.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with a Rosary

alt_text: A woman cuts a sleeping man's hair under a tree while soldiers emerge from the bushes behind them
long_description: A vertically oriented painting depicts a scene with two figures in the foreground under a leafy tree, while soldiers and a castle appear in the background. In the lower right, a woman with fair skin and light, braided hair sits upright, wearing a rich red dress with gold trim. She looks down at a bearded man whose head rests on her lap. Her right hand is near his head, and her left hand rests on his arm. The man, with dark hair and beard, appears to be sleeping. He wears a teal tunic and red drapery over his lower body, with his bare legs and feet visible. Simple sandals are on his feet, and a white, bone-like object lies on the grass near his left foot. The ground is covered in green grass. Above them, a large tree with dark green leaves and small, light-colored fruits provides shade. In the midground, to the left and behind the main figures, a group of soldiers emerges from dense, dark green foliage. They wear armor and helmets, and some carry long spears or pikes. One soldier on the far left wears a red cap. Rays of light appear to emanate from behind the soldiers. Further in the background, on the left side, a light-colored castle with multiple towers and battlements stands atop a rocky hill. A patch of blue sky is visible above the castle. The overall lighting is subdued, with some areas of highlight on the figures and the castle.

alt_text: A nude woman in a red hat stands beside a winged child holding a bow, within a circular frame.
long_description: The circular painting features a nude woman and a winged child against a dark, almost black background. The woman stands slightly right of center, facing forward with her head turned slightly to her left. She has long, wavy, light brown hair that extends down her back and over her shoulders. On her head, she wears a wide, flat red hat adorned with white, feathery plumes around its rim. Her body is pale, and she holds a sheer, dark fabric in her hands, which drapes around her lower body and trails off to her right. Her left leg is slightly bent, and her feet are bare on the ground. To the left of the woman, a small, nude, winged child stands on a light-colored, rectangular block. The child, with light skin and short, curly hair, looks up towards the woman's face, with its right hand raised near its head. It holds a small, reddish-brown bow in its left hand. The ground beneath them is a light, mottled brown and white, appearing textured. A rough, light-colored border with a patterned edge frames the circular composition.

alt_text: Bust-length portrait of a bearded man in a dark hat and fur-lined coat against a blue background, with German text.
long_description:
A vertical rectangular painting depicts a bust-length portrait of a man in the upper half, set against a light blue-green background. The man has a full, curly white-grey beard and mustache, dark eyes, and a fair complexion. He wears a dark, flat cap with a slight brim, and a dark, fur-lined coat over a white shirt with a ruffled collar. His gaze is directed slightly to the right. In the upper right corner, a small rectangular brown panel contains black German text that reads: "Friederich der Dritt / Churf. / zu Sachßen." To the left of the man's head, the year "1533" is written in black, with a small, stylized symbol below it. The lower half of the painting features a dark, almost black, rectangular area. Centered within this dark area is a larger, rectangular brown panel with black German text, appearing to be a poem. The text reads:
"Friederich bin ich billich genant
Schönen fried ich erzeig im land.
Durch gros verunruhigunge und glück
Wider manchen erzeigten stück.
Das land ich zieret mit gebew
Und Stifft zu hohe Schul auffs new,
Zu Wittenberg im Sachßen land
In der welt die ward bekand
Denn aus der fellt ein Gottes wort
Und thut gros ding an manchem ort.
Das Bäpstlich Reich hörts es nicht
Und bracht rechten glauben wider.
Zum Kaisar ward erförn ich
Des mein alter beschweret sich.
Dafür ich viel erlitten
Von dem mir, weg, trennt zeugt noch gelt."

metadata.title: Friedrich III (1463–1525), the Wise, Elector of Saxony
metadata.artist: Lucas Cranach the Elder and Workshop
metadata.medium: Oil on beech, with letterpress-printed paper labels

alt_text: A bearded man in a black hat and coat holds an orange, with a green curtain and mountains behind him
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man with light skin, blue eyes, and a full brown beard, looking slightly to his right. He wears a black hat that covers his ears and a black coat. Around his neck is a high, ruffled white shirt with black ties at the collar, topped by a wide, flat orange collar. A long necklace of orange beads hangs over his white shirt, extending down to his waist. His hands are clasped in front of him, holding a single round orange fruit. Several rings with dark red stones are visible on the fingers of his left hand. The background on the left features a dark green draped curtain, while the right side reveals a landscape with light blue sky, green mountains, and small white buildings nestled into the hillsides. The man's figure occupies the central and lower portion of the vertical composition.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a bearded man in a black hat and fur-lined coat, with German text panels
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting features a bust portrait of a man in the upper two-thirds, with two panels of German text above and below. The man, positioned slightly right of center, looks directly forward. He has a round face, a dark, full beard and mustache, and heavy-lidded eyes. He wears a black, flat-topped hat with a brim, a white shirt with a ruffled collar, and a dark, fur-lined coat. The background behind him is a plain blue-green. In the top left corner, a small brown rectangular panel contains the text: "Johans der Erß / Churfürst und Hertzog zu Sachssen." The bottom third of the painting is a large brown rectangular panel filled with two columns of faded German text. The left column begins: "Nach meinzo Bleib auff un Wie grosse sorg, Da der Bawr telt Wie gross feind in wald Welches ich helff dempf Der Deudsches land er Der Rotten reißer feind ich war Hielt jm land das wort recht und klar Gros drawen bittern haß vnd neid Vmb Gottes worto willen ich leid. Frembde land scho aus hertzen grund Vnd person so selbs ich da fund. Vor dem Keisar und ganzen Reich Den Fürsten geschach vor nie des gleich Solchs gab mir mein Gott besonder vnd vor der welle was entstunder". The right column begins: "Vmb land vnt leut Hofft beid frei. Ferdnand zu Köni Vnd sein wahl ich all Auff das da. alte Recht Jnn der gülden Bullen gegrund. Wiewol das. grossen zorn errege Mich doch mehr recht kann gunst d eweg Das hertz gab Gott dem Keisar zart Mein guter freund zu leut er ward. Das ich mein end jm frid beschlos Daß sehe den Teuffel das verdros. Erfarn hab ichs vnd zeugen thar Wie vns die Schrifft sagt und ist war. Wer Gott mit ernst vertrawen kan Der bleibt ein vnuerdorben man. So jhne Teuffel odder welt Den steg er doch zu lepe behelt."

metadata.title: Johann I (1468–1532), the Constant, Elector of Saxony
metadata.artist: Lucas Cranach the Elder and Workshop
metadata.medium: Oil on beech, with letterpress-printed paper labels

alt_text: Portrait of a bearded man in a black hat and fur coat, with German text above and below
long_description: The painting is a vertical rectangular portrait of a man, with text panels positioned above and below him. The man is depicted from the chest up, angled slightly to the viewer's right, with his gaze directed forward. He has a full, dark brown beard and mustache, and a prominent nose. He wears a black, wide-brimmed hat that covers his ears, a white ruffled collar, and a dark, fur-lined coat. The background behind him is a solid light blue. In the upper left corner, a small, rectangular, gold-colored plaque is affixed to the blue background. It contains dark, old German script that reads: "Johans der Ehl. / Churf. zu Sach. / und Hertzog zu L. etc." Below the man's portrait, a large rectangular panel fills the bottom third of the painting. This panel has a light brown, parchment-like background and is densely covered with dark, old German script arranged in two columns. The script is small and fills the entire panel, extending from the top edge of the panel to its bottom edge.

metadata.title: Johann I (1468–1532), the Constant, Elector of Saxony
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood, with letterpress-printed paper labels

alt_text: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in a black beret and dark coat against a plain blue background.
long_description: This is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned slightly off-center to the left, against a plain, light blue background. The man's face is round with fair skin, a prominent nose, and full, closed lips. His dark eyes gaze slightly to the right of the viewer. He has short, wavy brown hair visible beneath a flat, black beret that covers the top of his head and ears. His neck is thick, leading to a dark, high-collared garment, possibly a coat or robe, which covers his shoulders and chest. The fabric of his clothing appears dark, almost black, with subtle folds and texture. The lighting illuminates his face from the front, creating soft shadows under his chin and along the contours of his face. The overall impression is a direct and unadorned depiction of the subject. The painting has a matte finish with some visible brushstrokes and fine cracking in the paint, particularly noticeable on the dark clothing.

alt_text: A man in armor stands before a reclining bearded man, surrounded by soldiers, a horse, and a dog
long_description: This black and white painting depicts a dramatic outdoor scene with multiple figures, a horse, and a dog. In the center, a man in elaborate Roman-style armor and a flowing cloak stands, looking down and to his left. His right hand is on his hip, and his left hand gestures towards the ground, lifting his cloak slightly. To his left, an older, bearded man with long hair lies on the ground, propped up slightly, looking upwards. A long staff leans against him, and a small bowl rests on the ground nearby. Several other men, some in armor and holding spears, stand around the reclining man, observing the central figure. To the right of the central figure, a large, light-colored horse rears up on its hind legs, its head turned towards the left. A young man holds the horse's bridle. Near the horse's front legs, a smaller figure, possibly a child, kneels and holds a piece of cloth. A dog is visible near the horse's front hooves. The background on the left is dark with indistinct foliage, while the right side features a lighter, open sky.

metadata.title: The Meeting of Alexander the Great and Diogenes

alt_text: Full-length portrait of a young man in ornate black and gold armor, holding a staff, against a red curtain.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young man standing slightly to the right of center, facing forward with his head turned slightly left. He has light skin, light brown hair, and a small, pointed chin, wearing a stiff white standing collar. He is dressed in an elaborate suit of armor, predominantly black with intricate gold scrolling patterns covering its entire surface, including breastplate, pauldrons, vambraces, gauntlets, cuisses, greaves, and sabatons. A red sash is visible under the armor on his left shoulder and across his chest. His right hand, gloved in light blue, rests on his hip, holding a small, dark object. A sword hilt is visible at his left hip. His left hand, also gloved in light blue, holds a dark brown staff vertically, its end resting on the floor. To the left of the man, on a surface covered by red drapery, sits a matching helmet, also black with gold scrolling patterns, its visor open to reveal a dark interior. The background is dominated by a deep red curtain, draped and folded, filling most of the space behind the figure and the helmet. A darker, possibly brown or black, area is visible in the upper left corner behind the curtain. The floor beneath the man's feet is dark, with a subtle lighter edge along the bottom.

alt_text: A king on a throne conversing with a haloed woman, flanked by soldiers in a medieval scene
long_description: The rectangular panel depicts a multi-figure scene set within an ornate, arched architectural framework. On the left, a long-bearded man with a gold crown sits on a high-backed golden throne, dressed in a long green robe with gold trim. He gestures with his right hand towards the center. To his left, a young soldier in a blue tunic, red hose, and a helmet stands holding a spear and a red shield. In the center, a man in a flowing pink robe with gold trim stands facing the seated figure, his right hand extended. To his right, a woman with a golden halo stands, dressed in a long red cloak over a blue dress, holding a small book in her left hand and gesturing with her right. To the right of the woman, a group of four soldiers stands. The foremost soldier wears a green tunic, red hose, and a helmet, holding a large yellow shield decorated with a black scorpion. Behind him, another soldier holds a red shield with the gold letters "SPQR" visible. The soldiers wear various helmets and cloaks, with spears visible behind them. The background features patterned walls and golden architectural elements, suggesting an interior setting. The overall color palette is rich, dominated by reds, greens, blues, and gold.

metadata.title: Saint Lucy and Her Mother at the Shrine of Saint Agatha; Saint Lucy Giving Alms; Saint Lucy before Paschasius; Saint Lucy Resisting Efforts to Move Her

alt_text: A seated Madonna in an ornate gold and green robe holds the Christ Child against a golden background.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts the Madonna and Child seated against a textured golden background. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the left of center, looks down with a serene expression. She wears a white veil, a dark green undergarment, and a voluminous, richly patterned gold robe with dark green lining. The robe is adorned with intricate black floral and leaf motifs. A golden halo encircles her head. Her left hand supports the Christ Child, who sits on her lap, facing forward and looking slightly to the right. The Child wears a simple gold tunic with a white sash. His right arm is extended, holding a thin, dark object, while his left arm is bent at the elbow. A golden halo also encircles his head. The Madonna's feet rest on a white, cracked marble-like surface. To the lower right, a small green pear and a red berry lie on this surface, with a tiny fly near the pear. At the bottom left, a dark inscription reads: "CAROLVS CRIVELLVS VENETVS PINXIT 1472".

alt_text: A Madonna and Child painting, with a cucumber and peaches hanging above a purple backdrop and a landscape
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts the Madonna and Child against a complex background. In the center, the Madonna, with light skin and downcast eyes, wears a white veil, a gold halo adorned with studs, and an elaborate blue and gold patterned robe with green sleeves. Her hands gently support the Child, who has curly blonde hair and a smaller gold halo. The Child, dressed in a light-colored garment, sits on a lumpy, pinkish-brown cushion with a tassel and holds a small, dark object in one hand, looking downwards. Above the Madonna's head, a purple fabric hangs, from which small red objects, resembling nails or tassels, are suspended. On the left, a large green cucumber hangs from a vine, accompanied by two light-colored peaches with green leaves. On the right, two reddish-pink peaches with green leaves are visible. Below the figures, a yellowish-gold block-like platform extends across the width of the painting. On the left side of this platform, a fly rests. On the right, a cracked white and brown decorative block is depicted. A dark rectangular plate on the platform bears the inscription: "OPVS KAROLI CRIVELLI VENETI". Through openings on either side of the purple fabric, a landscape is visible. The left side shows green trees, hills, and distant buildings under a blue sky, while the right side features tall, slender trees, a path, and distant figures. The entire scene is bordered by a painted wooden frame.

alt_text: Four figures mourn a pale, emaciated man wearing a crown of thorns, set against a golden arched background
long_description: The painting depicts four figures in a somber scene against a rich golden background. In the center, a pale, emaciated man with closed eyes and a crown of thorns on his head is supported in a seated position. He is bare-chested, revealing a lean torso, and wears a white loincloth. His left arm is held by a woman on his left, while his right arm hangs limply, held by a woman on his right. The woman on the left, dressed in a pale blue cloak and white head covering, presses her tear-streaked face against the central man's head, her eyes closed in grief.
