The child holds a small, dark orb in their left hand and has a small cross pendant around their neck.

The woman and child stand on a small, light-colored building with a red-tiled roof. To the right of the building is a small bell tower with a green pointed roof. Above the woman and child, two angels with wings and halos fly on clouds. The angel on the left, dressed in dark green, holds one side of a golden crown, while the angel on the right, in a reddish-brown garment, holds the other side, appearing to crown the woman.

Below the building, two more angels with wings and halos stand on clouds. The angel on the left wears an orange and light blue garment, while the angel on the right wears a red garment. Between these lower angels and beneath the building, a winged cherub head floats above a body of water. The water features several boats, including a larger sailboat with white sails on the left. Distant green hills and a small town are visible on the horizon. The sky is a light blue, with a small dark cross visible to the left of the building.

metadata.title: The Translation of the Holy House of Loreto

alt_text: Two women with greenish skin, one holding a platter of fruit, the other pink flowers, against a dark green background.
long_description: The painting depicts two women standing in a lush, dark green environment. The woman on the left stands facing forward, with long dark hair falling over her shoulders. Her upper body is bare, revealing a yellowish-green skin tone. She wears a dark blue garment that covers her lower body. Her hands hold a dark, shallow platter filled with reddish-orange fruit, possibly mangoes or papayas, at waist level. Her expression is neutral, and she looks directly forward. To her right, slightly behind her, stands a second woman. She has a similar yellowish-green skin tone and dark hair, with a gold earring visible in her right ear. Her gaze is directed downwards and to her left, towards the fruit. Her upper body is also bare, and a light blue draped garment covers her lower body and wraps around her right arm. In her left hand, she holds a small cluster of light pink flowers. The background consists of broad strokes of dark green foliage, with patches of brighter yellow-green suggesting light filtering through. The overall palette features strong contrasts between the vibrant greens and blues, and the distinct skin tones.

alt_text: A painting depicts a village with red-roofed houses, green fields, and various trees under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting shows a rural landscape with a cluster of houses and abundant trees under a light-colored sky. The sky, occupying the top quarter of the canvas, is a mix of pale blues, grays, and yellows, suggesting either dawn or dusk. Below the sky, a distant band of dark green trees marks the horizon, with a field of muted reddish-brown stretching in front of it. In the mid-ground, several tall, slender trees with yellowish-green foliage rise vertically, interspersed with darker green, rounder trees. Below these, a small village comes into view, featuring three prominent stone houses with reddish-brown tiled roofs and white chimneys. Smoke appears to emanate from one chimney on the right. The houses are built with light-colored, possibly stone, walls and have dark, rectangular openings for doors or windows. The foreground is dominated by a vibrant green grassy slope that descends from the right and left towards the center. On the left side of this slope, in front of the houses, lies a large, elongated haystack, reddish-brown at its base and topped with green. To the right, a large, round-canopied tree with yellowish-green leaves stands on the green slope, casting a subtle shadow beneath it. A darker, vertical tree trunk frames the far right edge of the composition. The overall color palette is rich with greens, reds, and earthy tones, creating a serene, pastoral atmosphere.

alt_text: Four women on a wooden porch, one in a hat, one ironing, and two relaxing, with green foliage behind
long_description: The painting depicts four women on a light-colored wooden porch, with a vibrant green and yellow landscape in the background. In the foreground, a woman with dark hair, wearing a light blue patterned blouse and a dark blue patterned skirt, sits with her back to the viewer. She wears a wide-brimmed straw hat with a dark blue polka-dotted band. Her bare right foot extends towards the lower left. To her right, another woman lies on her stomach on a white cloth, facing right, wearing an orange-red dress. Her head is slightly raised, and her forearms are bent, supporting her head. A green basket filled with yellow and orange fruit sits on the porch floor near her. Further back, to the left of the ironing woman, a third woman sits with her back mostly to the viewer, wearing a pink long-sleeved shirt and a dark skirt. Her dark hair is tied back. Behind the woman in the hat, a fourth woman kneels or sits, facing left, wearing a dark reddish-purple long-sleeved top and a dark skirt. She is engaged in ironing a white cloth on a small, dark ironing board. Behind these figures, the background features a bright green and yellow landscape with hints of a tree trunk on the far left and a small, light-colored, possibly sculptural figure with a hat on the far right. The porch floor is made of light brown planks.

alt_text: A still life painting featuring a cluster of fruit, a green bottle, and a red flower on a white cloth.
long_description: The painting depicts a still life arranged on a yellow-orange surface against a dark, muted blue-gray background. A white cloth with prominent folds covers the left and center of the yellow-orange surface, extending towards the right. On the left side of the cloth, a cluster of five or six fruits, mostly pear-shaped, are arranged. Their skins show mottled shades of orange, red, and green, with one fruit on the bottom left being distinctly green. To the right of this fruit cluster, a single red-orange flower, resembling a chrysanthemum with numerous petals, lies on the white cloth, its green stem visible. Further to the right, two more fruits, similar in shape and color to the main cluster, rest on the cloth. Behind the fruit and cloth, a tall, slender green bottle with a wide base and narrow neck stands slightly to the right of the painting's center. The dark blue-gray background wall features two light-colored, stylized, elongated shapes that resemble birds or leaves. One is positioned on the upper left, curving upwards, and the other on the upper right, curving downwards. The bottom right corner of the painting contains a visible signature, "P. Gauguin 91."

alt_text: Two figures stand on a path in a vibrant, mountainous landscape with a grazing horse and tropical trees
long_description: The painting depicts a vibrant, lush tropical landscape under a cloudy sky. In the background, dark green and reddish-brown mountains rise, their slopes textured with brushstrokes. The sky above is a mix of light blue, white, and pale yellow clouds. The midground features rolling hills and fields in various shades of green, with scattered palm trees and dense, dark green foliage. A brown horse with a lighter mane and tail grazes in a bright green field towards the right, its head down. To the left of the horse, two figures stand on a reddish-brown path. The figure on the left wears a light pink or cream-colored long dress and a wide-brimmed hat, facing slightly right. The figure on the right wears a dark gray or black long garment, also facing slightly right, with their back mostly to the viewer. The ground in the foreground is a mix of reddish-brown earth and patches of bright yellow and green. Small, indistinct shapes, possibly chickens, are visible near the horse's feet. The lower left corner of the canvas shows a visible signature: "P. Gauguin 92".

alt_text: A painting of the Madonna and Child seated on a throne, flanked by angels, with monks below.
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts the Madonna and Child seated centrally against a gold background. The Madonna, with light skin and a serene expression, wears a dark blue veil covering her hair and a flowing dark blue robe with red lining visible at the sleeves and lap. She looks slightly to her right. The nude Child, with light skin and curly light hair, sits on her lap, facing forward. His right hand is raised, and his left hand rests on her arm. Both figures have faint dotted halos around their heads. They are seated on a stone throne with a green cushion. The throne features a decorative back and sides with small, arched openings, and is flanked by lush green foliage. Two smaller figures, possibly angels, kneel on the throne's armrests, one on each side, wearing orange-red robes and looking upwards. Below the throne, four figures in dark brown robes, likely monks, kneel in a semi-circle. They support a curved white scroll that displays black text and musical notation. The visible text on the scroll reads: "O quam suavis est domine spiritus tuus" and "qui ut dulcedinem tuam in filios demonstres". The ground beneath the monks and scroll is covered with green foliage and small white flowers.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Angels
metadata.artist: Gentile da Fabriano (Gentile di Niccolò di Giovanni di Massio)
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, traces of gold ground

alt_text: A woman in a gold dress faints, supported by two figures, while a man in elaborate attire sits on the right.
long_description: A large oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with four figures in a dimly lit interior. On the left, a woman in a voluminous, golden-yellow gown with a light blue sash is shown in a state of collapse, her head tilted back and eyes closed. Her left arm hangs loosely, and her right arm is bent at the elbow. She is supported by two other figures; one woman in a dark green dress holds her around the waist from behind, while another figure, mostly obscured, is visible near her head. The fainting woman's dress features white lace trim at the neckline and cuffs, and a patterned border along the hem.To the right, a young man is seated on a low, ornate chair that rests on a circular, raised platform. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat adorned with yellow spikes, a purple jacket over a green tunic, and striped green and white puffed breeches. His legs are crossed, revealing white stockings and light-colored boots. His right arm is draped over the back of his chair, and he gazes towards the left side of the painting with a calm expression. The background is dark, with architectural elements like columns visible, and a rich red drapery hangs behind the seated man on the far right. The floor is composed of large, light and dark reddish-brown tiles.

alt_text: A young person with long brown hair sits on a grassy mound, looking forward, against a cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a young person seated on a dark green, grassy mound in an outdoor landscape. The figure is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing forward with a direct gaze. They have an oval face with light skin, rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and a small mouth. Their long, wavy, dark brown hair is parted in the middle and falls over their shoulders. The person wears light blue trousers, a light-colored shirt with a white ruffled collar, and a loose-fitting, mustard-yellow jacket. The jacket sleeves are long and appear somewhat oversized. Their right hand rests on the dark green mound beside them, while their left hand rests on their left thigh. The legs are extended towards the lower left of the frame, with dark brown shoes visible. The background features a blue sky with large, soft grey and white clouds, particularly dense in the upper left quadrant. Below the sky, the landscape consists of rolling dark green and brown hills or mounds, receding into the distance on both sides of the figure. The overall lighting suggests natural daylight, illuminating the figure against the more subdued background.

alt_text: A dramatic landscape painting featuring ancient ruins, a towering mountain, a bridge, and figures by a river at sunset
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic, expansive landscape under a sky transitioning from stormy darkness to warm light. In the upper left, a large, gnarled tree with dense green foliage grows from a crumbling stone ruin, which features a prominent archway through which bright, warm light emanates. Below this ruin, an arched stone bridge spans a river, connecting the left bank to a rocky, mountainous terrain on the right. The midground is dominated by a series of rugged mountains and hills. On a prominent hill to the right of the bridge, several buildings with light-colored walls and a tall, square tower are visible. Further back and higher, a large, dark mountain rises, topped by a square, fortress-like structure. The sky above the mountains on the right is filled with heavy, dark gray and blue clouds, while the sky on the left, behind the ruins and bridge, glows with soft oranges, yellows, and pinks, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. In the foreground, the river flows towards the viewer, its surface reflecting the dark sky and surrounding land. On the left bank, two figures stand or sit on rocks. One figure, seated, has dark skin and holds a long stick. Another figure, standing, wears a red head covering and a blue garment, also holding a stick. Further to the right, in the river, two smaller figures are partially submerged in the water. The overall palette is rich with deep greens, earthy browns, and grays, contrasted by the vibrant warm light on the left.

alt_text: A bishop in pink and blue robes stands over a kneeling man, with a crucifix and two other figures
long_description:
The painting is an arched panel depicting a religious scene within an interior space. In the center, a man with a halo, wearing a pink robe and blue cloak, stands facing right, with his left hand raised towards a crucifix. He has a short beard and wears a pink miter. Below him, a man in a green tunic and red hose kneels on his right knee, facing left, with his hands clasped in prayer. His head is tilted upwards towards the standing figure. Next to the kneeling man, on the lower right, lies a helmet and a sword.

To the right of the standing figure, a golden crucifix with the figure of Christ is mounted on a dark cross, angled slightly towards the center. Below the crucifix is a white cloth draped over a red patterned altar or table, on which three golden chalices are placed. The background behind these elements features a dark doorway with golden architectural details.

To the left of the central standing figure, two other men are partially visible. The man closer to the center wears a light brown tunic and red hose, looking towards the central figure. Behind him, only the head and neck of a white horse with a red bridle are visible, along with a man in a red cap and brown tunic. The background on the left also shows a dark doorway with golden details.

The upper part of the arched panel features an ornate golden architectural structure with a central circular motif and decorative scrollwork. The overall color palette includes rich reds, blues, greens, and gold.

metadata.title: An Episode from the Life of Saint Giovanni Gualberto

alt_text: Profile portrait of a man in a light gray hat and cloak against a dark background
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a man in profile, facing left, against a solid dark background. The man has light skin, a prominent, long nose, and thin, closed lips. His light-colored eye looks straight ahead, and his dark brown, shoulder-length hair falls from beneath his hat. He wears a wide-brimmed, light gray hat with a small dark decoration and light ribbons on the crown and brim. A white, finely ruffled collar is visible around his neck, above a light gray garment. This garment, possibly a cloak or tunic, drapes over his shoulders and upper chest, showing soft, rounded folds. A slightly darker gray band outlines the upper edge of the garment. The bottom edge of the painting reveals a thin, irregular line of gold or light brown.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man in Profile

alt_text: An angel with large wings kneels before a woman in a blue dress in an ornate room
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in an interior setting with a gold patterned wall on the left and green bed curtains on the right. On the left, an angel kneels, facing right, with pale skin and long brown hair. The angel wears a white tunic, a red cloak, and a gold medallion on its chest. Large white and dark green wings extend from its back. The angel holds a staff with a white scroll wrapped around it, bearing the Latin text "AVE GRACIA PLENA". Its left hand is extended towards the woman. On the right, a woman with pale skin and long brown hair is seated, facing left, wearing a dark blue dress. Her hands are raised with palms open, and she sits on a red cushion. Behind her, a bed with green coverings is visible. In the lower right corner, a small wooden table holds an open book, a red apple, and a white pitcher containing green plants. The floor features a brown and white checkered pattern.

alt_text: Mary, Joseph, and angels adore baby Jesus in a stable, with a cow and figures in the background
long_description: The painting depicts a Nativity scene with several figures against a textured golden background. In the foreground, the Virgin Mary kneels on the left, facing right, with her hands clasped in prayer. She wears a flowing dark blue robe that spreads across the ground and has a golden halo around her head. Her long, wavy brown hair falls over her shoulders. Directly in front of her, on a small blue cloth, lies a naked infant, Jesus, on the ground. Behind the infant, a group of small, white-robed angels with pink cloaks kneel, looking towards the baby. To the right of the infant, Saint Joseph kneels, facing left, with his gaze directed towards the baby. He wears a long, flowing red cloak over a grey tunic and holds a brown staff in his left hand. He has a white beard and a balding head. Behind Joseph, a woman stands, looking downwards, dressed in a green gown with a white head covering. Her hands are slightly raised. On the far left, a brown cow or ox kneels, facing right, next to a rustic wooden stable structure with a thatched roof. The stable is built into a green, mounded landscape. In the distant left background, small figures are visible on a path leading up a hill. The entire upper and right background is a shimmering, textured gold.

alt_text: Portrait of a man in a dark red turban-like head covering holding red beads, with a landscape through a window.
long_description: A vertical portrait depicts a young man from the chest up, facing slightly left but looking directly forward. He has light skin, dark eyes, and long, dark brown hair that falls to his shoulders. He wears a dark red, turban-like head covering that wraps around his head and drapes down his back. His torso is clad in a white garment with several horizontal dark lines across the chest, visible beneath a dark red cloak or robe that covers his shoulders and arms. His hands are clasped at the bottom center of the frame, holding a string of small, red, spherical beads. To the left of the man, a tall, narrow window opens to a landscape scene featuring a body of water, a distant town with reddish-brown buildings, and a green, rocky island. The right side of the background is a dark, plain wooden wall. In the upper right corner, the numbers "1291" are visible, with the letters "H.H" directly below them.

alt_text: A group of people in traditional attire gather in a dimly lit room, some cooking, others dancing.
long_description: This oil painting depicts a gathering of several figures in an interior space, rendered in warm, muted tones. In the left foreground, two men stand near a stone hearth. The man on the far left wears a red tunic, blue trousers, and a blue turban, and is actively stirring a pot on the hearth with a ladle. Next to him, a man with a white turban and a green and white tunic holds a long stick over his shoulder, looking towards the right. To their right, in the mid-ground, a woman in a white skirt and light-colored top is captured in motion, appearing to dance with a stick held above her head. Further to the right, a person with a red turban, white shirt, and green vest sits on a low, rectangular wooden cage-like structure, holding a small, intricate object in their hands. A brass-colored, gourd-shaped object lies on the floor beside the cage. In the darker background, several other figures are seated or standing, observing the scene. The room features a light-colored wall on the left with a hanging basket, and a darker, brown wall on the right. The floor is a light, neutral color.

alt_text: A large, columned hall with people praying, a partially clothed figure, and pigeons on the floor
long_description:
The painting depicts a vast, high-ceilinged interior space, likely a hall or mosque, with numerous columns and arches extending into the distance. The columns are cylindrical, topped with ornate capitals, and support a series of arches that are alternately striped in reddish-brown and off-white. Wooden beams run horizontally between the columns. Many dark, ornate lamps hang from the ceiling and between the arches. Pigeons fly through the upper space and gather on the stone floor.

In the foreground, to the right, three men stand. The leftmost of this group wears a long, flowing red robe with gold trim, a white turban, and holds a sword. He stands on a patterned prayer rug with geometric designs in red, blue, and yellow. To his right, two other men are dressed in lighter-colored robes and turbans, one holding a drum-like object and the other with his hands raised.

Further into the midground, slightly to the left of center, a partially clothed figure stands facing away, wearing only a loincloth. A flock of pigeons gathers on the floor around this figure and to the left. In the background, along the left side of the hall, numerous figures are arranged in rows, facing right, engaged in prayer, many wearing white or light-colored robes and turbans. The floor is made of large, light-colored stone tiles. Light enters from the far end of the hall, illuminating the space.

alt_text: A man embraces a pale, nude woman, possibly a statue, in a dimly lit artist's studio.
long_description: The painting depicts a scene within a dimly lit interior space, likely an artist's studio. In the center, a man with dark hair, wearing a blue tunic and brown boots, embraces a pale, nude woman. The woman's back is mostly to the viewer, her skin appearing smooth and white like marble. She leans into the man, who holds her waist with his right arm and her lower back with his left hand, his face pressed against her shoulder or neck. The man stands on a small wooden block, while the woman's feet rest on a rough, white base atop a wooden workbench. To the left, a large framed painting hangs on a dark wall, showing a landscape with small figures, some in red and white garments. Below the painting, several white classical-style sculptures of figures are arranged on shelves and pedestals. A wooden stand or easel is also visible on the floor. On the right wall, a winged cherub with a bow and arrow floats on a cloud-like form in the upper section. Below the cherub, on a shelf, are three theatrical masks: two with open mouths expressing strong emotion, and one with a more neutral expression. A round, metallic shield leans against the wall beneath the masks. The floor is dark and appears to be a dusty or textured surface. A hammer with a dark handle and metallic head lies on the floor near the workbench. The overall color palette is subdued, dominated by dark greens and browns in the background, contrasting with the pale white of the central figure and other sculptures. The central figures are highlighted by a soft, focused light source.

alt_text: A tiger and three cubs rest in a dark, rocky cave beside a small pool of water
long_description: The painting depicts a tiger and three cubs resting in a dark, rocky environment, possibly a cave or den. A large adult tiger lies prominently in the center-right, facing forward with its head slightly turned towards the viewer. Its fur is a vibrant orange with distinct black stripes and a white underside on its chest and belly. Its eyes are light, and its ears are rounded. Three small cubs are nestled around the adult. One cub lies directly under the adult tiger's chin, its head visible. Another cub is positioned to the adult's left, partially obscured by its body, while a third cub rests to the adult's right, its body fully visible, lying on the rock surface. The cubs have similar striped fur patterns, though their colors appear softer and less defined than the adult's. The animals are situated on a relatively flat, light brown rock. Surrounding them are larger, irregularly shaped rocks in shades of dark brown, olive green, and reddish-brown, suggesting a rugged, natural landscape. The upper half and left side of the painting are dominated by deep, dark shadows, creating a sense of depth and enclosure. In the lower center foreground, a small, dark pool of water reflects a faint, distorted image of the tiger's face and the surrounding rocks. The scene is dramatically lit, with a strong light source illuminating the tiger and cubs, making them stand out against the predominantly dark background.

alt_text: A dark painting features a human skull below a reflective orb, flanked by a tulip, coins, and figures.
long_description: This vertical oil painting depicts a dark, muted scene dominated by browns, grays, and deep reds. At the top, an arched niche frames a large, dark, circular reflective surface, possibly a mirror or orb, which shows a faint, lighter shape within its reflection. Above the arch, the faint inscription "OMNIA VANITAS" is visible. On either side of the arch, two draped, light-brown figures are depicted in relief or as statues. The figure on the left points towards the orb, while the figure on the right leans forward. Centered horizontally below the orb is a realistic human skull, facing forward with dark eye sockets and visible teeth in its slightly open jaw. The skull rests on a dark, textured surface. Below the skull, a scattered pile of gold and silver coins lies on a dark ledge. To the far left, a tall, slender silver vase holds a single red and yellow striped tulip with green leaves and a small white flower at its base. To the far right, a similar silver vase or goblet is visible, appearing empty. In the bottom left corner, a circular gold medallion with two profile busts is depicted, and in the bottom right corner, another circular gold medallion with an emblem is shown.

alt_text: A procession of figures in long robes, some carrying a red-draped bier, others standing by
long_description: This horizontal panel depicts a procession of figures. On the far left, two figures in dark and white robes stand. Next to them, a figure in a white robe and dark green cloak walks forward. Following them are three figures, also in white robes and dark cloaks, who carry a long, dark pole on their shoulders. This pole supports a large, bright red cloth that drapes over a structure, possibly a bier. The cloth covers the central portion of the panel, with its folds visible. At the far right end of the red cloth, a pale head and shoulders are visible, suggesting a figure lying beneath. In front of the red cloth, a thin, dark, bare tree-like object stands vertically. Behind the red cloth, a building with black and white striped patterns and diamond shapes is visible. To the right of the red cloth, a figure in a white robe and dark green cloak walks, holding the edge of their cloak. Behind this figure, a group of several individuals stands. They wear long robes and head coverings in various colors, including pink, blue, and red. The two figures on the far right are dressed entirely in red, including their head coverings. The figures are arranged in a shallow space, with a light-colored ground plane and a light background.

alt_text: A painting depicts a betrothal scene with a central couple, a crowned man, and groups of figures on both sides
long_description: The painting is a horizontal rectangular panel framed by a thin gold border, depicting a scene with ten figures. The figures are arranged in three groups against a light blue-grey background with minimal architectural details.On the far left, four young men stand. The leftmost wears a pink tunic and green hose, holding a staff. Next to him, a man in a red tunic and pink hose, with a bow and arrows, looks downwards. Two crossed sticks lie on the light brown floor near his bare feet. Behind him, another man in a pink tunic and dark hose holds a staff, followed by a man in a grey tunic and pink hose, also with a staff. All four look towards the center.In the central group, a bearded man in a blue tunic and a flowing yellow cloak, with bare feet, extends his right hand towards a crowned, white-bearded man. He holds a staff in his left hand. The crowned man, dressed in a long white tunic and a pink cloak, holds the right hand of a young woman. The young woman, with light brown hair and a faint halo, wears a red dress under a dark blue cloak. She faces the crowned man. Behind the crowned man, a dark rectangular object with a grid pattern is visible on the wall.On the right, three women are positioned. The first two, facing the central couple, wear red dresses, pink cloaks, and white head coverings. They hold hands. The woman on the far right wears a dark green dress and a grey cloak, with a grey head covering, and also faces the central figures. The floor throughout is a light brown.

alt_text: An angel, a man, and a dog in a landscape, with the man kneeling to handle a fish
long_description: This horizontal rectangular painting depicts a landscape with three figures and a dog. On the left, a tall figure with large, reddish-brown wings and a golden halo stands facing right. This figure wears a long, flowing yellow tunic and a draped pink-red cloak. A small, fluffy white dog sits on the ground near the figure's feet, looking towards the right. Behind them, a steep, rocky brown mountain rises under a light blue sky with white clouds. In the center foreground, a piece of draped red fabric lies on the ground. To the right of the center, a man kneels on his right knee, facing left. He wears a blue tunic, red hose, and light brown boots. His hands are on a large, light-colored fish lying on the ground in front of him. Behind the man, a body of water extends into the distance, bordered by a green, conical mountain on the left and several jagged, grey-blue mountains further back on the right. A small cluster of trees is visible in the middle ground, and two taller, slender trees stand on the far right. A distant city with white buildings is visible at the base of the green mountain in the mid-ground. The ground throughout the scene is a mix of earthy browns and greens.

alt_text: A man in a red tunic and a boy in patterned clothing against a landscape with mountains and water
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts two figures, an adult man and a younger boy, positioned in front of a detailed landscape. The man, on the left and larger in scale, faces forward with his head tilted slightly down, his gaze directed downwards. He wears a deep red tunic with a black belt and a dark red cap. His right hand, with light skin, rests at the bottom left of the frame. To his right and slightly in front, a smaller boy stands in profile, looking upwards towards the man. The boy wears a light-colored tunic with a dark, intricate floral or foliate pattern, and a bright red cap. His hands are clasped together at his waist. The background behind the figures is a panoramic landscape divided by a horizon line. On the left, rolling green hills with a winding path lead to a white building, with jagged blue-grey mountains in the distance. On the right, a body of water with small boats extends towards a city featuring multiple towers and a bridge. The sky above is a light blue with scattered white clouds. A dark, thin border frames the central image, and faint white lettering is visible along the top edge of this border, reading: "FRAN. SANETTVS THEOD. FVS. Q. L."

metadata.title: Francesco Sassetti (1421–1490) and His Son Teodoro

alt_text: A portrait of a man with light hair and a dark red cap, wearing a bright red cloak against a green background.
long_description: A vertical portrait depicts a man from the chest up, positioned slightly to the left of center, facing right in profile. His fair-skinned face is round, with a slightly prominent nose and full lips. His light-colored eyes gaze straight ahead. Wavy, light gray hair is visible beneath a close-fitting, dark red cap that covers the top of his head. He wears a dark red garment with a narrow white collar and a thin dark band above it. Over this, a bright red cloak or cape drapes over his shoulders and chest. The cloak features distinct vertical folds, particularly on the right side, adding texture. The background is a solid, dark green color, providing a strong contrast to the man's red attire. The lighting is even, illuminating his features and clothing.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a woman with light curly hair, a red beaded necklace, and a green dress
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a woman from the chest up, positioned against a dark, solid background. Her fair skin is subtly flushed on her cheeks. Her light brown hair is parted in the middle, with tight, light-colored curls framing her face on both sides. The back of her head is covered by a light-colored cap or veil. Her light brown eyes gaze directly forward, and her nose is straight. Her lips are closed in a neutral expression. Around her neck, she wears a red beaded necklace, from which hangs a gold pendant. The pendant is circular with a red central stone, surrounded by several small white pearls. She is dressed in a light green garment, featuring a cream-colored or white bodice and sleeves. The central panel of the bodice has dark lacing crisscrossing over a lighter green fabric. Her sleeves are slightly puffed at the shoulders. A wide, cream-colored collar or shawl covers her shoulders and upper chest, extending over the green dress. The background is a uniform dark, almost black color, providing a strong contrast to her light complexion and attire. The painting is enclosed by a dark reddish-brown border, visible on all four sides.

alt_text: A large man with a child on his shoulders wades through water, holding a staff
long_description: This vertical painting depicts a large, muscular man wading through water, carrying a small child on his left shoulder. The man, positioned centrally in the foreground, faces slightly right with his gaze directed upwards and to the left. He has dark, curly hair and a full beard, and wears a wide-brimmed, light brown hat. His attire consists of a light pinkish-white tunic with long sleeves, and a reddish-brown cloak draped over his left shoulder and around his waist, leaving his lower legs bare. His powerful, bare legs are submerged in light blue-green water, which reaches his mid-thighs and shows ripples around his calves and feet. In his left hand, he holds a tall, dark staff with a leafy, palm-like top, extending from the lower left to the upper left of the frame. The small child sits securely on the man's left shoulder, facing forward. The child has light, short hair and wears a simple, teal-colored tunic. With their left hand, the child holds a pale, spherical object, resembling a globe, raised above their head. The background features a pale blue sky with subtle cloud formations on the left. To the right, distant green hills and trees are visible, suggesting a landscape beyond the water. The overall palette is soft, dominated by muted blues, greens, pinks, and browns.

metadata.title: Saint Christopher and the Infant Christ

alt_text: A circular black and white painting of Madonna, Child, and two angels in a devotional scene
long_description: A circular, black and white painting depicts a central woman with a baby and two angels. The woman, positioned centrally, has her head tilted down and hands pressed together in prayer. She wears a dark hooded cloak over a lighter dress, adorned with a prominent, ornate brooch on her chest. A faint halo encircles her head. To her left, an angel with long, dark, curly hair cradles a baby, who lies on a patterned cushion. The angel looks towards the central woman, while the baby looks upwards and to the left with raised arms. To the woman's right, another angel with similar dark, curly hair stands with arms crossed, also looking towards the central woman. This angel wears a lighter garment with a dark, patterned collar. Both angels have faint halos. Behind the figures, a dark, patterned tapestry hangs, and a distant landscape with hills and structures is visible on the far left.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Angels
metadata.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A three-panel painting depicting the Nativity scene with Mary, baby Jesus, a monk, and other figures, flanked by saints
long_description: This triptych painting is composed of three vertical panels. The central panel depicts a Nativity scene. In the foreground, the Virgin Mary kneels on the right, dressed in a blue cloak over a red garment, with her hands clasped in prayer, gazing down at the infant Jesus. Baby Jesus lies naked on a pink cloth on the ground, looking upwards. To the left, a bald monk in a black robe kneels with clasped hands, also looking towards the infant. In the midground, behind Mary, an arched stone structure frames two standing men, one holding a white lamb, suggesting shepherds. The background features a rocky landscape with a small town visible on the left horizon. Above, three winged angels in light pink and blue robes float in the sky, looking down. The left panel features three figures. In the foreground, a woman kneels on the right, wearing a light blue cloak over a red dress, with hands clasped in prayer, facing towards the central panel. Behind her stand two men with halos. The man on the left has a long dark beard, wears a dark robe, and holds a closed book. The man on the right is bald, dressed in a blue tunic and yellow cloak, and also holds a closed book. The right panel also contains three figures. In the foreground, a woman kneels on the left, dressed in a blue garment and red cloak, holding a basket filled with red and white flowers, facing towards the central panel. Behind her stand two men with halos. The man on the left has a reddish-brown beard, wears a green tunic and yellow cloak, and holds a closed book. The man on the right has light hair, wears a blue tunic and red cloak, and is depicted writing in an open book with a quill.

alt_text: A central figure with a halo gestures towards kneeling and standing figures, some carrying stretchers, against a gold background
long_description: The painting depicts a crowded scene against a gold background with a cracked texture. In the upper center, a figure with a faint halo around his head stands, wearing a dark blue tunic and a pink robe. He extends his right arm and points his index finger towards the right side of the composition. To his left, three women stand, dressed in light pink and cream-colored robes, looking towards the central figure. Below them, a man in a green robe and a light-colored cap bends over, holding one end of a wooden stretcher. In the lower center, a figure in a light blue tunic kneels on one knee, facing right, with hands clasped. To their right, another figure, draped in a long, light-colored, textured robe, kneels with arms raised, looking up. Behind these kneeling figures, a red, rectangular object, possibly a bed or a large cushion, is visible. On the far right, a group of five figures stands closely together. One figure in a dark robe and red cloak raises a hand. Another figure in an orange tunic holds the other end of the wooden stretcher, which has a cross-like structure. Below them, another figure kneels, facing left. The figures wear various colored robes including orange, red, dark blue, green, and cream. The faces are rendered with simple, rounded features.

metadata.title: Saint John the Evangelist Raises Satheus to Life

alt_text: A gold-backed painting shows a haloed figure touching a kneeling man, while other figures stand nearby under an arch
long_description: The painting features a gold background with a heavily cracked texture, framing a scene with multiple figures under a dark blue arch. The arch itself is golden and spans the upper portion of the composition. On the far left, partially visible behind the golden arch, is a figure in a dark brown hooded robe, holding a reddish book. Inside the arch, on the left, a man with light skin, wearing an orange tunic and a red cap, stands facing right. He raises his right index finger upwards and extends his left hand with an open palm. To his right, two women stand close together. The woman in front wears a light yellow tunic and a dark head covering, with her hands raised in front of her. The woman behind her wears a reddish-orange tunic and a dark head covering, with her left hand near her face. Further to the right, a central figure with a light-colored halo stands, facing right. This figure wears a dark blue tunic and a long, flowing reddish-pink cloak. Their right hand is placed on the head of a kneeling man. The kneeling man, positioned on the lower right, wears a light brown hooded robe. He faces left, looking up at the haloed figure, with his hands clasped or reaching out. Behind the kneeling man, a small, sparse green tree emerges from a dark brown mound. The ground beneath the figures is a light brown. On the far right, partially visible behind the golden arch, is another figure in a red and white garment, holding a staff. The top of the arch features a dark blue, almost black, oval shape.

metadata.title: Saint John the Evangelist with Acteus and Eugenius

alt_text: A kneeling man prays before a crumbling idol in a shrine, observed by two other figures and a red angel
long_description:
The painting depicts a scene with four figures and a shrine against a gold background, framed by a golden arch at the top. On the left, a man kneels on his right knee, facing right, with his hands clasped in prayer. He wears a dark tunic and a long red cloak draped over his shoulders and legs. His head is tilted slightly upward, and he has a beard and dark hair. Behind him, partially obscured, stands another man with a light brown cloak and a white head covering, looking towards the center.

In the center, a brown architectural structure resembling a shrine or temple stands with a dark opening. Inside this opening, a small, pale, and emaciated figure, possibly a statue or idol, is perched on a pedestal. Below the pedestal, a broken column lies in pieces on the ground. The shrine itself shows cracks in its structure.

To the right of the shrine, a standing man faces left, pointing his right hand towards the idol. He has a dark beard and hair, and wears a long, dark reddish-brown robe with a red undergarment visible at the bottom. He holds a thin, dark staff or rod in his left hand.

In the upper right corner, a red, winged angelic figure with a halo is visible, appearing to emerge from the golden background. The ground beneath the figures is a light brown, with a raised step in the foreground. The gold background is textured with fine cracks.

metadata.title: Saint John the Evangelist Causes a Pagan Temple to Collapse

alt_text: A bare-chested, bleeding figure of Christ with a crown of thorns, within a gilded architectural frame
long_description: A vertical rectangular panel painting depicts a deceased, bare-chested male figure, likely Christ, set within an ornate, gilded architectural frame. The central figure is positioned frontally, with his head tilted to his right, eyes closed, and mouth slightly open. He wears a crown of thorns, and blood drips from his forehead, hair, and chest. His long, reddish-brown hair falls over his shoulders. His torso is slender, showing ribs, and a wound on his right side (viewer's left) bleeds profusely, with a stream of blood running down his side and across his lower abdomen. His arms hang loosely at his sides, with hands open, palms facing forward, and blood visible on his wrists and palms. He is depicted from the waist up, with a white cloth draped around his lower body, partially obscuring his hips and upper thighs. This cloth is decorated with gold and red patterns at the bottom edge. Behind the figure, a dark blue background with a subtle gold pattern is visible. A golden halo with a cruciform design surrounds his head. To the left of the figure, at mid-chest level, a smaller, brown-robed figure with a halo is visible, looking up at the central figure with hands clasped in prayer. The central figure is positioned against a dark brown horizontal beam, resembling the crossbar of a cross, with two dark nails visible on the beam to the left of his body. The entire scene is enclosed within a richly carved and gilded wooden frame, featuring Gothic architectural elements such as pointed arches and intricate tracery at the top corners. The frame has a reddish-brown base with extensive gold leaf.

alt_text: Nude woman with a quiver and bow stands in a forest next to a deer
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a full-length, light-skinned woman standing nude in a forest. She faces slightly right, her gaze directed to the right. Her body is full-figured, and her reddish-brown hair is pulled back in a braid. A red quiver, filled with arrows, is strapped across her back. Her right hand is raised, holding an arrow, poised as if to nock it. Her left hand holds a red bow, which rests against her left leg. Behind her, a dense forest features dark green foliage and tall, dark tree trunks. To her lower left, a light brown deer with antlers lies on the ground, looking towards the viewer. The ground beneath her feet and around the deer is covered in green grass and various small plants. The color palette is dominated by the woman's pale skin, the reddish-brown of her accessories and the deer, and the deep greens and dark browns of the forest.

alt_text: An angel presents white lilies to a kneeling woman, with two cherubs floating on a cloud above them
long_description: The vertical oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with two main figures and several celestial beings against a dark, architectural background. In the upper left, a large angel with light blue and white wings floats in mid-air, facing right. The angel wears flowing white and gray drapery with a yellow sash around its waist. Its left arm is raised, and its right hand extends a bouquet of white lilies towards the woman on the right. The angel's bare feet are visible, adorned with decorative straps. On the right, a woman kneels on a low, light brown step, looking upwards towards the angel with a slightly open mouth. She wears a long-sleeved red tunic and a voluminous blue cloak draped over her lap and shoulders. Her right hand rests on her chest, while her left hand is extended outwards, palm up. A subtle halo of light surrounds her head. Her bare feet are visible at the bottom right. In the upper right corner, two nude cherubs float on a dark green, cloud-like mass. The more prominent cherub is larger and looks down towards the woman, while a smaller, fainter cherub is partially visible behind it. The background features dark, indistinct architectural elements, including columns and steps. On the lower right, next to the kneeling woman, is a small wooden table or lectern with an open book. On the lower left, a draped white cloth lies on the floor next to a decorative, dark brown pedestal. The overall lighting is dramatic, with light emanating from the upper center, illuminating the figures.

alt_text: A painting shows a woman breastfeeding a baby in a boat with two men, surrounded by cherubs and divine light
long_description: The painting depicts a group of figures in a boat, illuminated by a golden light from the upper left. In the center, a woman with fair skin and light brown hair, dressed in a flowing blue robe and white undergarment, cradles and breastfeeds a baby. The baby, with light skin and hair, is wrapped in white cloth. To the woman's right and slightly behind her, a bearded man with a halo, wearing a brown robe, looks towards the woman and child, gesturing with his right hand. To the far left, a muscular man with dark hair, bare-chested and wearing a yellow cloth around his waist and legs, sits with his back to the viewer, holding a long oar. He is positioned in the front of the boat, which is dark brown and appears to be on a body of water, visible at the bottom of the frame. Above the central figures, several cherubic figures with wings and light hair emerge from dark clouds, looking down. A bright golden light streams from the upper left corner, illuminating the clouds and the figures below. The background consists of dark, stormy clouds and hints of a dark landscape.

alt_text: A crowded Nativity and Adoration scene with Mary, Joseph, baby Jesus, three kings, shepherds, and angels under a stable
long_description: The painting features a crowded Nativity and Adoration scene set against a golden background with a visible crackled texture. In the upper half, four winged angels, two in reddish-orange robes and two in yellow-gold robes, fly with outstretched arms or clasped hands. Below them, a simple wooden stable with a sloped, thatched roof is centrally positioned. Inside the stable, Mary, draped in a dark blue cloak over a red garment, reclines on a red bed, looking down towards the lower center. To the left of the stable, a brown-robed figure, likely a shepherd, stands with a staff, looking towards the scene. A white sheep is visible near his feet. In the lower center, baby Jesus, depicted with a golden halo, lies in a wooden manger. A figure in a rich red robe with gold trim kneels before the manger, holding the baby. To the left of the manger, a bearded man with a golden halo, wearing a blue tunic and yellow cloak, holds a small red object. Below him, two goats and a sheep are clustered. To the right of the kneeling figure, two standing figures, likely kings, wear elaborate robes and crowns. One in a yellow cloak holds a golden chalice, while the other, in a pinkish-purple robe, stands slightly behind him. A donkey and an ox are visible behind the manger, partially obscured.

alt_text: A gold-backed painting depicts the Madonna and Child flanked by two kneeling figures, one holding a lily
long_description:
The artwork is a semicircular panel painting with a rich gold background. In the center, the Madonna is seated, facing slightly right, holding the Christ Child on her lap. She wears a deep blue mantle over a red garment, and her head is adorned with a golden halo. Her light brown hair is visible beneath a blue head covering. The Christ Child, also with a golden halo, wears a light red tunic and stands on the Madonna's lap, facing forward with his right arm extended towards the figure on the right. His left hand rests on his mother's arm.

To the left of the Madonna, a female figure kneels in profile, facing the Madonna and Child. She wears a dark hooded cloak over a long pink dress. Her hands are clasped in prayer, and she holds a tall white lily stem with multiple blossoms. To the right of the Christ Child, another figure kneels in profile, facing the center. This figure wears a long, muted purple or grey robe with a red lining visible at the bottom, and a red hooded cowl. Their hands are also clasped in prayer. Both kneeling figures have pale skin and simple, unadorned faces. The entire scene is set against a textured gold background, framed by a narrow gold border with a dotted pattern.

alt_text: A five-panel altarpiece depicting the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child, flanked by various saints
long_description: This multi-panel painting, likely an altarpiece, features five vertical panels with arched tops, all set against a gold background. The panels are separated by thin gold columns. The central panel depicts the Virgin Mary seated, holding the Christ Child. Mary wears a dark blue robe and a white veil, her head slightly tilted. The Christ Child, mostly nude and wrapped in an orange cloth, sits on her lap, looking forward. Below Mary, two small winged figures, likely angels, kneel on a patterned cloth, looking up. One plays a stringed instrument, the other holds a scroll with illegible text. Two smaller figures are partially visible behind Mary's shoulders. To the immediate left of the central panel, a male saint stands, possibly a bishop. He wears a red miter, a dark robe, and a gold-patterned cope. He has a white beard and holds an open red book in his left hand and a staff in his right. A small figure in blue kneels at his feet. In the far left panel, a female figure stands, draped in a long, muted purple-brown robe and a white head covering. Her hands are clasped. To the immediate right of the central panel, a male figure stands, bare-chested with a brown tunic and a pink drape over his left shoulder and waist. He has short brown hair and a beard. His right hand is raised, and his left hand points down. In the far right panel, a male figure stands, wearing a dark brown monastic habit. He is bald with some grey hair at the sides and holds a red object, possibly a fruit, in his right hand. His left hand is raised. The figures are generally depicted frontally.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A painting of the Adoration of the Magi with Mary, Joseph, and infant Jesus in a stable, and three kings presenting gifts
long_description: The painting depicts a religious scene with multiple figures in the foreground and a landscape in the background. On the left, a wooden stable with a thatched roof houses a brown cow and a gray donkey, visible behind a low fence. To the right of the stable, Mary, dressed in a deep blue robe and veil, sits on a low bench, holding the infant Jesus on her lap. Both Mary and Jesus have golden halos. Jesus, clad in a white cloth, looks towards the right. Behind Mary, Joseph, with a white beard and a golden halo, wears an orange-brown robe and looks down at the scene. In front of Mary and Jesus, an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a red and gold patterned robe, kneels on one knee, his head bowed, presenting a golden object. He also has a golden halo. To the right of Joseph, a younger man with a golden halo, dressed in a dark, patterned tunic, stands and gestures towards the kneeling king. Further to the right, another young man with a golden halo, wearing a brown tunic, kneels and removes his hat, looking towards the infant Jesus. Behind these figures, two horses are visible, one dark and one light gray, with a young attendant holding the reins of the gray horse. The background features a rolling green landscape with several white sheep grazing on hills. Jagged, light-colored mountains rise in the distance under a pale blue sky. A shepherd with a staff is visible on a distant hill.

metadata.title: The Adoration of the Magi
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: Madonna and Child with two angels and a kneeling monk, against a gold and red patterned background
long_description: This vertical panel painting depicts the Madonna and Child flanked by two angels, with a small kneeling figure at the bottom left. The top of the panel is arched, and the background features a repeating gold and red checkered pattern. A large, circular gold halo with faint speckles frames the head of the Madonna, while a smaller, more intricate gold halo surrounds the Christ Child's head. The Madonna is seated centrally, her head tilted slightly towards the child. She wears a dark blue cloak draped over a red dress with a gold patterned design. Her skin is fair, and her gaze is directed downwards. She cradles the Christ Child in her arms, who is partially covered by a light pink cloth. The child, with fair skin and plump features, reaches one hand towards the Madonna's chest and looks up at her. To the left of the Madonna stands an angel with light-colored hair and a pale pink robe, looking towards the central figures. On the right, another angel with light hair, dressed in a similar pale pink robe, holds a slender, dark wind instrument to its lips. At the very bottom left, a much smaller figure kneels on one knee. This figure wears a dark brown monastic robe and appears bald, looking upwards towards the Madonna and Child. The base of the painting features an ornate, geometric patterned border in gold and dark grey.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Two Angels and a Donor
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, gold ground (partly checkered with modern red glazes)

alt_text: A painted panel depicting a nun and a priest in an architectural setting, with celestial figures above
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts two distinct scenes separated by a central white column, all set within an architectural structure. The background features a series of gray arches with dark blue ceilings, suggesting an interior space. On the left, a woman with a light-colored face and hands, wearing a dark habit over a white garment, stands facing right. A golden halo encircles her head. Her hands are clasped at her chest. Behind her, a golden altar-like structure rises. Above and to her left, a light-skinned figure with a beard and long hair, wearing a light blue robe, sits on a cloud, extending a hand towards the woman. Three smaller, winged figures with golden halos are partially visible behind the seated figure, all surrounded by golden rays emanating from a dark blue background. The central white column, topped with a decorative capital, divides the composition. On the right, a man with a light-colored face, wearing an elaborate golden and red patterned robe over a white garment, stands facing left. He holds a golden chalice in his left hand and raises his right hand. A smaller figure, wearing a dark robe over a white garment, kneels behind him, facing left. Behind these figures, a golden altar-like structure with intricate spires is visible. The floor throughout the painting features a repeating pattern of dark brown and light brown diamond shapes with small red and white centers.

metadata.title: The Miraculous Communion of Saint Catherine of Siena
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A painting depicts numerous figures, including clergy, nobles, and angels, interacting in a lush, wooded landscape.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a dense gathering of approximately 25-30 figures in a stylized natural setting. The background features a bright blue sky visible between numerous slender tree trunks with small, round green leaves forming a canopy across the top. The ground is a dark green, covered with various small plants and flowers in shades of red, white, and yellow. The figures are arranged in multiple groups and layers, filling almost the entire frame. Most figures are depicted in profile or three-quarter view, engaged in conversation or holding hands. On the far left, a tall figure in a black monastic habit stands, with a small, light-colored deer visible behind them. Below, a group includes a figure in a black habit holding hands with an angel in a light-colored gown with golden wings. In the center, a prominent group features a figure in a red papal tiara and robe, holding hands with an angel. Nearby, a figure in a dark blue robe and red hat converses with another. On the right, figures in various robes, including red and green, interact. One figure in a long, flowing red gown with a pointed hood is prominent. Further right and slightly elevated, a figure in a golden gown appears to glow. The figures wear a variety of garments: long robes, cloaks, and tunics in colors such as black, white, grey, red, blue, and green. Headwear includes hoods, hats, and a papal tiara. Some figures have visible wings, indicating angels. The overall impression is a vibrant, detailed scene of interaction within a stylized natural environment.

metadata.title: Paradise
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A religious scene in a Gothic-style building, with multiple figures gathered around a baby being presented
long_description: This painting depicts a crowded religious scene set within an elaborate, multi-arched architectural interior. The central space features a vaulted ceiling with blue and red arches, supported by white columns with gold capitals. The floor is a geometric pattern of red, white, and black tiles. In the center, a man in a pink robe with a golden halo holds a baby wrapped in white cloth, presenting it towards a woman in a blue robe, also with a golden halo, who reaches out. Behind them, an older bearded man in a red hat is visible. Several other figures with halos are partially obscured behind the central group. To the far left, a woman in a pink patterned dress with a floral headpiece stands next to a woman in a green dress and white head covering, followed by a man in a golden robe with a halo. To the right of the central group, a man in a blue robe with a halo holds a white scroll. Further right, a man in brown rags kneels on the patterned floor, while an older woman in a brown robe and white head covering stands beside him, holding a staff. The background features buildings with textured, diamond-patterned walls and red roofs, with an open archway on the right leading to a darker interior.

metadata.title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: Four female figures in individual panels, each with a halo and holding a distinct object.
long_description:
Four vertical panels are arranged side-by-side, each featuring a standing female figure against a textured gold background. Each figure is depicted under a golden arched niche and has a golden halo above her head. The ground beneath their feet is a dark, mottled brown.

The leftmost figure stands facing slightly right, her head tilted left. She wears a red undergarment and a dark blue-black cloak. She has a small golden crown on her head. In her left hand, she holds a closed red book resting on her hip, while her raised right hand holds a golden compass or divider.

The second figure from the left stands facing slightly right, her head tilted downwards. She wears a light grey-blue undergarment and a red-orange cloak draped over her lower body and arms. Her right hand holds a small, light brown, multi-storied tower, which rests on her left hand.

The third figure from the left stands facing forward, her head tilted slightly left. She wears a long, flowing light orange-pink gown. In her left hand, she holds a small, dark bowl containing several round objects. Her right hand holds a long, dark, two-pronged fork or tool, pointing downwards.

The rightmost figure stands facing slightly left, her head tilted downwards. She wears a light orange-pink undergarment and a dark brown-black cloak. Her head is covered by a white cloth. She holds a basket or bowl filled with small, round, light-colored objects in both hands. All figures have pale skin tones and soft facial features, with their garments rendered with visible folds.

metadata.title: Saints Catherine of Alexandria, Barbara, Agatha, and Margaret
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: Two standing male figures, one bearded and one tonsured, holding books against a gold background
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting features two full-length male figures standing side-by-side against a gold background. The figures occupy most of the canvas, appearing to stand on a red ground with a subtle, dark red patterned design.The figure on the left is an older man with a bald head and a long, full grey beard. He wears a flowing, bright yellow-gold outer robe over a blue tunic, with the sleeves of the blue tunic visible at his wrists. His bare feet are visible at the bottom of his robe. He holds an open red book in both hands, looking down at its pages. A faint, circular inscription is visible within the gold halo around his head.The figure on the right is a younger man with a tonsured head, showing a shaved crown, and a short, reddish-brown beard. He wears a long, light brown or beige monastic habit, which is cinched at the waist by a white rope with three visible knots. His bare feet are also visible beneath his robe. He holds a closed red book vertically in his left hand, resting it against his chest. His right hand is slightly raised, palm facing forward, revealing a small red mark on the palm. A faint, circular inscription is visible within the gold halo around his head.The gold background behind the figures is richly decorated with raised gesso patterns, forming gothic-style arches and intricate floral or foliate motifs, particularly above and around their heads. The gold surface shows some texture and minor wear.

metadata.title: Saints Matthew and Francis
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A winged figure stands on a fountain, surrounded by armored riders on horseback, with a landscape and animals
long_description: The image is a circular painting, framed in gold. At the center top, a winged figure stands on a large, ornate fountain. The figure is light-skinned, with dark hair, wearing a white garment, and has large, dark wings. It holds a staff in one hand and a small object in the other. The fountain is multi-tiered, with water flowing from it, appearing red in some areas. Below the fountain, a large group of armored figures on horseback fills the middle ground. They wear various styles of armor, mostly grey and dark, with some red and gold accents. Their horses are brown, white, and black. The figures are densely packed, facing towards the fountain. The background features a landscape with rolling hills, some trees, and a body of water or river. The sky is light blue with some white clouds. In the immediate foreground, on a dark brown ground, several animals are depicted. These include a white dog, a black dog, and a brown animal resembling a boar or wolf. Shadows are cast on the ground. The overall color palette includes earthy tones, blues, and the metallic sheen of armor.

metadata.title: The Triumph of Fame; (reverse) Impresa of the Medici Family and Arms of the Medici and Tornabuoni Families
metadata.artist: Giovanni di ser Giovanni Guidi (called Scheggia)
metadata.medium: Tempera, silver, and gold on wood

alt_text: Madonna and Child enthroned with saints and angels in a landscape, beneath a large green tree
long_description:
The painting, with an arched top, depicts the Madonna and Child enthroned, surrounded by saints and angels, set within a lush landscape. In the center, the Madonna sits on a low, ornate throne, holding the Christ Child on her lap. She wears a dark blue mantle over a pink garment, and the Child is nude, reaching towards her. Below the throne, three winged angels are seated on the ground. The angel on the left, in a green tunic, plays a stringed instrument. The central angel, in a dark tunic, holds a small book or tablet. The angel on the right, in a red tunic, looks up towards the Madonna.

To the left of the central group, two standing figures are depicted. The leftmost figure, a woman, wears a dark robe over a pink dress and holds a closed book in her left hand. Next to her, a young man in a golden robe holds a palm frond in his right hand and a set of keys in his left. To the right of the central group, two more standing figures are shown. The figure on the left is an older man with a beard, wearing a bishop's mitre and a golden and red cope, holding a staff. Next to him, a woman in a green dress and a red mantle stands, holding a small object in her hands.

Behind the figures, a large, dense green tree dominates the upper center of the composition. To the left of the tree, a fortified castle with multiple towers sits atop a rocky hill. To the right, a bare tree branch extends, on which a peacock with a long tail is perched. The background features rolling green hills, distant mountains, and a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. The ground in the foreground is rocky and uneven.

alt_text: A woman in a shimmering fur-trimmed gown stands in a richly decorated room, looking towards a tall mirror.
long_description: The painting depicts a full-length portrait of a woman standing in an elaborately decorated interior. She is positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing towards the right side of the canvas. The woman wears a long, flowing gown of a light, shimmering fabric, possibly satin or silk, in a pale gold or silver hue. The gown is trimmed with white fur along the neckline, sleeves, and hem, and a matching fur stole is draped over her left shoulder and arm. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo, and she looks to her right with a neutral expression. Her left hand rests on her hip, while her right hand gently holds the fur trim of her gown. The background features a deep red wall on the left, adorned with a vertical band of intricate floral and geometric patterns in shades of green, blue, and gold. To the right, a tall, ornate standing mirror with a white or light-colored frame is visible, reflecting a faint blue or green hue. Behind the mirror, a dark wooden piece of furniture, possibly a dresser, can be partially seen. On the left side of the painting, behind the woman, a low piece of furniture, perhaps a bed or sofa, is covered with draped fabrics and clothing in dark reds, purples, and browns. The floor is covered by a dark, patterned rug with intricate designs in red, brown, and cream. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting the woman's face and the shimmering fabric of her dress.

alt_text: An oval portrait of a young woman with light hair adorned with flowers, wearing a white dress and pink drapery
long_description: This oval portrait depicts a young woman from the chest up, set against a dark, plain background. Her head is slightly turned to her right, and she gazes directly forward with a faint smile. She has fair skin, light-colored eyes, and rosy cheeks. Her light brown hair is styled upwards with curls, and small pink and blue flowers are nestled into the top of her hair. A strand of hair falls over her left shoulder. She wears a white, off-the-shoulder dress with draped fabric across the bust. A thin pink strap is visible over her right shoulder. On her left upper arm, a gold band with dark, possibly jeweled, accents is visible. A voluminous pink drapery is wrapped around her, flowing over her right shoulder and across her lower body. The portrait is enclosed within a narrow, gold-colored oval frame. Along the top edge of the frame, gold lettering reads "ADELAIDE DE SAVOIE" on the left side and "DUCHESSE DE BOURGOGNE 1710" on the right side.

metadata.title: Marie Adélaïde de Savoie (1685–1712), Duchesse de Bourgogne

alt_text: A man with dark hair and a brown tunic, hands clasped, looks right, with a landscape visible through a window
long_description: An oval-shaped painting depicts a man from the chest up, facing slightly right with his gaze directed to the right. He has fair skin, a prominent nose, and thin lips. His dark, bowl-cut hair frames his face, and he has a faint shadow of a beard. He wears a dark brown tunic with a high, dark collar, under which a sliver of a white shirt collar is visible. His hands are clasped together at the bottom center of the frame, fingers interlocked and resting against his chest. To the man's right, a tall, dark window frame is visible, through which a landscape can be seen. The landscape features a light blue sky, green rolling hills, and a winding river or path. The background to the man's left is a dark, plain brown. The lighting illuminates his face and hands, creating a contrast with the darker clothing and background.

alt_text: Mary holds baby Jesus as three kings and an older man gather around, offering gifts
long_description: This painting depicts a gathering of six figures and a baby within an architectural setting, framed by dark brown columns and a lintel. In the center, a young woman with light skin and dark hair, draped in a dark blue cloak, cradles a baby with light skin, wrapped in white cloth. She gazes down at the infant, who lies on a white cloth, looking towards the viewer. To the left and slightly behind the woman, an older man with a long grey beard and a red cloak stands, looking towards the baby. Behind him, the head of a brown cow is visible in a dark opening. To the right of the central figures, three men are positioned. The closest man kneels in the foreground, with light skin, short grey hair, and a red robe trimmed with dark fur. His hands are clasped in prayer, and he looks towards the baby. Behind him, a man with dark hair and a long, dark beard wears a dark green robe and holds a golden, ornate vessel. He looks downwards. To his right, a man with dark skin and dark, curly hair wears an elaborate gold and fur-trimmed robe, holding a similar golden vessel. He looks directly forward. On a light-colored stone ledge in the immediate foreground, a stack of three golden, ornate cups or vessels is placed. Through openings in the stone wall behind the figures, a distant landscape with rolling hills and faint structures is visible under a light blue sky.

alt_text: Two large, wilting sunflower heads with textured petals and seed centers lie against a vibrant blue background
long_description: The painting depicts two large, wilting sunflower heads lying horizontally against a textured blue background. The sunflower on the left is larger and more prominent, positioned slightly lower than the one on the right. Its central seed head is a dense, dark brown and green, covered in small, textured brushstrokes that suggest seeds. Surrounding the seed head are numerous petals, some still yellow-orange and upright, others drooping and turning a pale, desaturated yellow or light green. These petals show significant texture and individual brushstrokes. To the right, the second sunflower head is partially obscured by the first and appears to be facing away, revealing more of its lighter, almost beige underside and a thick, pale stem extending towards the upper right corner. Its petals are also pale yellow and green, appearing more wilted and less defined than those of the left sunflower. The background is a vibrant, swirling blue, painted with visible, energetic brushstrokes that create a sense of movement and depth. The blue varies in shade, with lighter areas towards the top and right, and darker, more intense blues around the sunflowers. A signature, "Vincent '87", is visible in the lower left corner in yellow script.

alt_text: A vibrant oil painting depicts a large, dense bouquet of white, yellow, and orange flowers in a light vase.
long_description: The painting is a vertically oriented still life depicting a large, overflowing bouquet of flowers in a vase, set against a dark background. The dense arrangement of flowers dominates the central and upper portions of the canvas. Numerous blossoms in shades of white, pale yellow, and light green form the bulk of the bouquet, appearing as rounded, chrysanthemum-like forms with many petals. Scattered among these are brighter yellow and orange flowers, some with more distinct, darker centers. Towards the top left, a few larger, more open orange-brown flowers stand out. In the lower center of the bouquet, nestled within the foliage, are several pink flowers and a prominent, vibrant red flower with ruffled petals, resembling a poppy. Green leaves and stems are interwoven throughout the floral mass, providing a contrast to the lighter blooms. The vase holding the bouquet is light-colored, possibly white or pale grey, with visible vertical brushstrokes, and has a slightly flared rim and base. It is positioned centrally in the lower half of the painting. The background is a deep, dark blue or black, rendered with vertical brushstrokes, creating a somber contrast to the bright flowers. The foreground beneath the vase features patches of green and brown, suggesting a surface or ground. The entire painting exhibits thick, textured brushwork.

metadata.title: Bouquet of Flowers in a Vase

alt_text: A man, woman, and child in a vibrant garden with trees, a fence, and a wheelbarrow under a blue sky.
long_description: This painting depicts an outdoor scene, likely a garden or yard, under a bright blue sky. The overall color palette is dominated by various shades of green, light blues, and sandy yellows. In the foreground, the ground is a mix of light green and sandy yellow, with rows of small green plants. To the left, a wooden wheelbarrow with a single wheel is positioned, filled with a brown, mounded material. In the mid-ground, a man kneels on the left, facing right, with his arms outstretched towards the center. He wears a light blue shirt, dark blue trousers, and a straw hat. His back is mostly to the viewer. On the right side of the mid-ground, a woman in a long, dark blue dress stands, bending slightly forward. She supports a small child, who is taking steps towards the man. The child wears a light-colored dress. Behind the figures, a lush, light green tree with dense foliage fills the upper left and center of the background. To the right of the tree, a light blue wooden fence runs horizontally across the scene, with white clothes hanging on a line behind it. A wooden gate is visible on the far right. The background also features a small building or shed with a dark roof on the left, partially obscured by the tree. The brushstrokes are visible and textured throughout the painting.

alt_text: A vibrant painting of an orchard with gnarled trees, lush green grass, and scattered small flowers under a light sky
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a vibrant orchard scene, dominated by trees and a field of green grass. In the upper right, a large tree with thick, dark brown, gnarled branches extends across the canvas, its sparse foliage rendered in light green and yellow brushstrokes. To its left, another tree with lighter, more delicate branches and white blossoms stands in the mid-ground. Further back, additional trees or bushes with varying shades of green and blue are visible, suggesting depth. The sky above is a pale, light blue or grey, with hints of green and yellow. The foreground and mid-ground are covered in a dense field of green grass, depicted with distinct, short, vertical brushstrokes in various shades of green, yellow, and some blue. Small white and orange-red flowers are scattered throughout the grass, adding pops of color. The overall impression is one of a lively, textured landscape, with visible brushwork creating a sense of movement and light.
