alt_text: A painting depicts a large bouquet of blue irises in a white pitcher against a light background
long_description: The painting features a large bouquet of blue irises in a white pitcher, set against a light, textured background and resting on a green surface. The pitcher, positioned slightly to the right of the center, is a simple, rounded form with a handle on its right side. It is painted in off-white tones with visible, thick brushstrokes, suggesting a ceramic texture. The irises dominate the upper two-thirds of the canvas, overflowing from the pitcher. They are rendered in various shades of blue and purple, with some petals appearing almost black in their deepest folds, while others show lighter blue and white accents, particularly in their centers. The flowers are depicted with broad, expressive brushstrokes, giving them a vibrant, almost sculptural quality. Long, slender green leaves and stems emerge from the pitcher, intertwining with the blossoms and extending outwards. The background behind the flowers is a light, creamy off-white, characterized by thick, swirling brushstrokes that create a sense of movement and texture. Below the pitcher, a flat, horizontal band of light green forms the surface on which the pitcher rests, extending across the bottom of the canvas. The overall composition is dense and full, with the flowers filling much of the frame.

alt_text: A woman with dark hair, wearing a dark dress and light scarf, sits at a table with books, looking left.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated at a dark green table against a vibrant yellow background. She is shown from the waist up, facing left in profile, with her right hand resting near her cheek. Her dark hair is pulled back, adorned with a dark blue ribbon that trails down her back. She wears a dark blue jacket or dress over a light green scarf, which has a small cluster of pink, circular embroidery near her chest. Her skin is fair, and her eyes are light. To her left, on the dark green table, is an open book with light green pages and a yellow-orange spine, stacked on top of several other books. To the right of the open book, a smaller, closed book with a reddish-brown cover and light pages rests on the table. A portion of a light brown or orange wooden chair is visible behind her right shoulder. The background is a solid, textured yellow, with visible brushstrokes throughout the entire composition.

alt_text: A still life painting features a vase of pink and white oleander flowers next to a yellow book on a table
long_description: A still life painting depicts a vibrant bouquet of flowers in a vase, placed on a light-colored table against a solid green background. The large bouquet, centrally positioned, fills much of the upper half of the canvas. It consists of numerous pink and white oleander blossoms, some fully open and others in bud, interspersed with long, dark green, pointed leaves that fan out from the center. The flowers show visible brushstrokes, giving them a textured appearance. The vase holding the flowers is dark blue-green with a lighter blue base and a visible handle on the right side. Below the vase, the table is covered with a light, possibly white or cream-colored, cloth that drapes over the edge, creating soft folds and shadows rendered with varying shades of gray and light yellow. To the left of the vase, a thick, yellow-covered book lies open on the table. The book's spine is visible on the left, and the pages are slightly fanned. Faint handwritten text is visible on the yellow cover, including the words "Les Misérables" and other illegible lines. The background is a uniform, bright lime green, applied with visible vertical brushstrokes.

alt_text: A woman in dark clothing cooks over an open fire in a dimly lit interior, stirring a pan.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated in a dark, rustic interior, illuminated primarily by the glow of a fire. She is positioned on the right side of the canvas, facing left in profile. The woman wears a dark blue dress or tunic, a white collar, and a dark head covering. Her hands hold a long-handled pan directly over a small, brick-like stove structure, from which yellow-orange flames and glowing embers emanate. Above the stove, a dark, round kettle hangs from a chain. The background is a dark, muted green and brown, with indistinct shapes suggesting a wall or corner of a room. On the floor in the lower left foreground, a dark, lidded pot or pitcher is visible next to a small, white bowl. The overall color palette is somber, dominated by deep greens, blues, and browns, with the bright yellow and orange of the fire providing a focal point. The brushstrokes are thick and visible throughout the composition.

metadata.title: Peasant Woman Cooking by a Fireplace

alt_text: A man with a reddish beard and a wide-brimmed yellow straw hat looks directly forward
long_description: The painting is a portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up, against a textured background. He is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his head turned slightly to his left, looking directly forward. He wears a wide-brimmed, bright yellow straw hat that dominates the upper portion of the canvas, casting a slight shadow over his forehead. His face is characterized by a reddish-orange beard and mustache, with visible brushstrokes creating texture. His eyes are a light blue-green, and his nose is prominent. His lips are full and a reddish-brown color. He wears a dark blue or grey jacket with visible lapels, and a white shirt collar is visible beneath. The brushwork throughout the painting is distinct, with short, thick strokes creating a sense of movement and texture, particularly in the hat, clothing, and background. The background is a swirling pattern of light brown, grey, and hints of orange and green, complementing the figure without distracting from it.

metadata.title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat (obverse: The Potato Peeler)

alt_text: A painting depicts a pair of worn, brown, lace-up shoes resting on a light-colored, patterned floor.
long_description: This painting features a pair of well-worn, lace-up shoes positioned centrally on a light-colored, textured surface. The shoes are rendered in thick, visible brushstrokes, primarily in shades of earthy brown, olive green, and muted yellow, with hints of darker tones suggesting shadows and depth. Their surfaces appear scuffed and creased, indicating significant use. Yellowish laces are visible, loosely tied or untied, adding to the sense of disuse. The shoe on the left is slightly angled towards the viewer, while the one on the right is positioned more upright, with its toe pointing slightly right. The background surface, which extends to all edges of the canvas, is composed of broad, textured brushstrokes in light beige, cream, and pale orange, forming a grid-like or tiled pattern. Reddish-brown lines occasionally break through the lighter tones, suggesting grout lines or cracks. The overall impression is one of a humble, everyday object rendered with expressive brushwork.

alt_text: A painting of white roses in a green vase against a light green background
long_description: The painting depicts a large, overflowing bouquet of white roses in a green vase, set against a light green background. The vase, positioned centrally in the lower portion of the canvas, is a bulbous, emerald green vessel with a slightly narrower neck. Its surface shows visible, vertical brushstrokes, giving it a textured appearance. The roses dominate the upper two-thirds of the composition, appearing to burst forth from the vase. They are rendered in various stages of bloom, from tightly closed buds to fully open flowers, with petals primarily in shades of white, cream, and subtle hints of pale yellow and light blue. Darker green leaves and stems are interspersed among the dense cluster of blossoms, providing contrast. The background is a uniform, light lime green, characterized by swirling, visible brushstrokes that create a sense of movement and depth. Below the vase, a horizontal white surface, possibly a tabletop, is depicted, with a thin, dark blue line marking its edge. Scattered on this white surface are several loose white rose petals and small green leaf fragments, suggesting some have fallen from the bouquet. The overall style features thick, impasto brushwork throughout the entire canvas.

alt_text: Swirling blue and white sky over a golden wheat field with an olive tree and a tall cypress.
long_description: The painting presents a landscape under a dramatic, swirling sky. The upper half of the canvas is filled with thick, impasto clouds rendered in shades of light blue, white, and hints of pale yellow and green, creating a sense of dynamic movement. Below the sky, a range of undulating blue and purple mountains or hills stretches across the mid-ground, forming a distant, textured horizon. The lower half of the painting is dominated by a vast golden wheat field, depicted with energetic, textured brushstrokes that suggest rippling movement. In the left foreground, a gnarled tree with dense, windswept green foliage, resembling an olive tree, stands prominently. To the right, a tall, dark green cypress tree rises vertically, its pointed top extending high into the swirling sky. Several smaller green bushes and trees are scattered across the mid-ground, nestled between the wheat field and the distant mountains. A few small red flowers are visible within the golden wheat field towards the lower right. The entire scene is characterized by visible, expressive brushwork and a rich, textured surface.

alt_text: Three women harvest olives in a grove with gnarled trees under a swirling pink and white sky.
long_description: The painting depicts three women harvesting olives in a grove under a textured sky. The sky, occupying the top third of the canvas, is a light pink and off-white, rendered with swirling, short brushstrokes that create a cloud-like effect. Below the sky, a dense olive grove fills the middle ground. The olive trees feature vibrant green and teal foliage, depicted with thick, energetic brushstrokes, and dark, gnarled trunks that twist and curve across the scene. The ground beneath the trees is a mix of dark green, brown, and hints of yellow, also rendered with visible, textured brushstrokes, suggesting uneven terrain. In the center-left, two women are positioned on a tall, light brown wooden ladder. The woman higher on the ladder wears a light blue dress and reaches into the green foliage of an olive tree with her right arm. The woman below her on the ladder wears a light blue garment and holds a large, light brown basket or container, catching olives. To the right of the ladder, a third woman stands on the ground, dressed in a light green or white long garment, with her back mostly to the viewer. She holds a large, light brown basket, appearing to collect olives from the ground or from the lower branches. The overall impression is one of active labor within a vibrant, textured landscape.

alt_text: A gold-backed panel painting depicting the Madonna and Child above three smaller narrative scenes
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular panel painting, vertically oriented, set within a dark, narrow frame. The composition is divided into two main registers: a large upper panel and a smaller lower section. The upper panel features a Madonna and Child against a distressed gold background. The Madonna, positioned slightly left of center, wears a dark, almost black, hooded cloak over a white undergarment. Her pale face, with a long nose and small mouth, is turned slightly right and downward. A faint gold halo encircles her head. She cradles the Christ Child with her left arm, while her right hand gently supports his leg. The Child, with fair skin and reddish-brown curly hair, is mostly nude, covered only by a pink cloth draped over his lower body. He looks forward and slightly left, his right arm raised, and his left hand holding a small white object. A faint gold halo also surrounds his head. A horizontal red band with small gold decorative motifs separates the upper panel from the lower section. The lower section is further divided into three smaller, vertically aligned narrative scenes, each with a gold background. The leftmost scene depicts two figures. A kneeling figure in a pink robe and green cloak, with a halo, faces a standing figure in a dark robe, also with a halo, who is positioned within an arched architectural element. The central scene shows a rocky landscape. At the top, three figures with halos look down from a brown outcrop. Below, a figure in a dark robe lies on a red surface, with a halo, while another figure in a green robe sits nearby, looking towards the reclining figure. The rightmost scene portrays a baby wrapped in white cloth, lying in a green crib-like structure. Below the crib, a group of white sheep are visible, along with a figure holding a staff on the far right.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Annunciation and the Nativity

alt_text: A man in a dark hat and fur-trimmed coat holds a rolled paper, looking left against a dark background
long_description: The painting depicts a man in a three-quarter length portrait, positioned against a dark, plain background. His head is turned slightly to his left, and his gaze is directed towards the left edge of the frame. He has light skin with rosy cheeks, a prominent nose, and full lips. His short, dark brown hair is visible beneath a dark, flat cap adorned with a small, light-colored emblem that resembles an "M" or "W". He wears a white collared shirt with subtle stitching around the neck, visible beneath a dark, possibly brown, undergarment. Over this, he wears a dark blue-grey coat with a wide, dark fur collar and fur trim along the opening. His right hand, positioned in the lower-left corner of the frame, holds a small, tightly rolled piece of paper with faint script visible on it. A simple gold band is on the ring finger of his right hand. The background is a uniform dark green-brown, providing a stark contrast to the man's face and the lighter elements of his attire.

alt_text: A woman with a jeweled headband holds a baby, both looking forward against a deep red background
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a baby, presented in a vertical, chest-up composition against a plain, deep red background. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, has pale skin, dark hair parted in the middle, and wears a dark headband adorned with small red and white jewels. Her large, dark eyes and small mouth are directed forward. She wears a dark blue garment with a square neckline featuring a wide band of gold and white patterned trim. Her left arm supports the baby, while her right hand gently holds the baby's leg. The baby, held to the left of the woman's chest, has light brown, curly hair and pale skin. Like the woman, the baby's large, dark eyes and small mouth face directly forward. The baby wears a loose, light-colored, long-sleeved garment. Its left hand holds a string of small white beads, which drape down. The baby's right hand is raised with fingers slightly curled. Its bare legs are crossed at the ankles, with the feet visible. A simple, dark brown frame surrounds the central image.

alt_text: A man with powdered hair in a blue striped coat and yellow pants sits, holding a light blue paper
long_description: The painting is a vertical portrait of a man seated against a dark, plain green background. The man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left, looking directly at the viewer. He has light skin, dark eyes, and a neutral expression. His hair is powdered white, styled with sideburns that curl forward over his ears. He wears a blue coat with thin, vertical dark stripes, featuring a wide collar and three visible dark buttons down the front. Beneath the coat, a white ruffled shirt or cravat is visible at his neck. His right arm is bent, and his hand holds a light blue piece of paper with handwritten text. The text, written in a dark script, appears to read "Sebastian Martinez" at the top, followed by "y Perez" and "de la Calle" below. His left arm is mostly obscured by his body. He wears bright yellow breeches or pants, with three dark buttons and a silver buckle visible on his left leg, just above the knee. His legs are crossed, with his left leg over his right. He sits on a simple wooden chair with a woven seat, the back of which is visible behind his right shoulder. The lighting comes from the upper left, highlighting his face and the paper.

alt_text: A waist-up portrait of a man in a dark blue uniform with red and white trim, holding a sword
long_description: The painting is a waist-up portrait of a man against a dark, unadorned background. The man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left, and his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has fair skin, a round face, and light-colored, shoulder-length hair that appears to be powdered or styled. His expression is neutral. He wears a dark blue uniform coat with a high, stiff red collar trimmed in white. A white cravat is visible at his neck. On his left lapel, there are two horizontal white stripes. Below these, a gold-colored medallion hangs from a red ribbon. Further down on his chest, a red cross-shaped insignia with a stylized hilt at the bottom is embroidered. The coat has a double row of dark buttons down the front. His right arm is bent, with his hand tucked into the front of his coat. His left arm is bent, and his hand, wearing a white glove, holds the hilt of a sword or dagger. The hilt is silver-colored with a chain-like guard. A white sash or apron-like garment is draped over his left hip and leg, with a red stripe visible along its edge. The cuffs of his uniform sleeves are red with three horizontal white stripes. The background is a solid, dark gray or black, providing a stark contrast to the figure.

metadata.title: Ignacio Garcini y Queralt (1752–1825), Brigadier of Engineers

alt_text: A woman with long blonde hair in a white dress sits on a red cushion holding a fan against a dark background
long_description: The image is a vertical portrait of a woman seated, facing slightly to her left, against a dark, almost black background. Her skin is pale, with rosy cheeks. She has light-colored, long, wavy hair that extends down past her shoulders and over her arms, blending into the background on the right. Her hair appears to be a mix of blonde and light brown tones. She is wearing a white, empire-waist dress with short sleeves and a low neckline. The fabric of the dress drapes loosely over her body, particularly around her midsection and legs. Her hands are clasped together in front of her, resting on her lap, and she holds a small, light brown, folded fan. She is seated on a plush, reddish-orange cushion or draped fabric that occupies the lower portion of the canvas. The cushion has visible folds and texture. The background is uniformly dark, providing a strong contrast to her pale skin and white dress. In the lower right corner, there is some faint, light-colored text, partially obscured, which appears to be a signature or inscription. It reads: "D. Ma. Teresa de Sureda. / Por Goya. 1804."

metadata.title: Josefa de Castilla Portugal y van Asbrock de Garcini (1775–about 1850)

alt_text: A painted portrait of a man with dark curly hair, wearing a dark vest and white ruffled shirt, arms crossed
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a half-length portrait of a man against a dark, muted background. The man, positioned slightly right of center, faces towards the left, with his head turned to look towards the left edge of the frame. He has dark, curly hair that frames his face and extends into sideburns. His skin is light, with a flush of pink on his cheeks, and he has dark eyes and a subtle, closed-mouth smile. He wears a dark, possibly black or very dark brown, vest over a white shirt. The white shirt features a prominent ruffled collar around his neck and voluminous sleeves with ruffled cuffs. His arms are crossed over his chest, with his right hand gently grasping his left wrist. The background is a uniform, dark gray-brown, with a faint, lighter area behind his head on the upper left, suggesting a light source. In the bottom left corner, faint handwritten text reads: "A. Traviño Perez Goya 1820".

metadata.title: Tiburcio Pérez y Cuervo (1785/86–1841), the Architect

alt_text: A young boy in a red suit stands with three cats, a magpie, and a birdcage with small birds.
long_description: A full-length portrait painting depicts a young boy standing in a room, surrounded by animals. The boy, with light skin and shoulder-length brown hair with bangs, wears a bright red suit with a white ruffled collar, a wide white sash around his waist, and white shoes with bows. He holds a thin white string in both hands, which loops down towards the floor. To his left, three cats are gathered on the dark floor. The foremost cat is large, white with black patches, and has wide, light-colored eyes. Behind it are two smaller, dark-furred cats, one appearing black and the other striped gray, both looking towards the boy. On the floor directly in front of the boy, a black and white magpie stands, holding a small white card or paper in its beak. To the boy's right, a green, domed birdcage sits on the floor, containing several small, brown and white birds. The background is a plain, dark greenish-gray wall, and the floor is a light brown. Along the bottom edge of the painting, white text reads: "EL S. D. MANUEL OSORIO MANRRIQUE D ZUÑIGA S D GINES NACIO EN AÑO. 1784".

alt_text: A young boy in a green jacket and white pants stands with a toy horse, holding a hat.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young boy standing in the center of the frame against a dark, muted background. The boy has light brown, short hair and a round face with rosy cheeks and a neutral expression. He wears a dark green velvet jacket with gold trim and tassels, open over a white shirt with a wide, ruffled lace collar. His pants are white and slightly shiny, and he wears light yellow flat shoes. In his left hand, he holds a dark brown hat with a green lining and a red and blue feather plume. His right hand holds the reins of a dark brown toy rocking horse positioned to his right. The horse has a light-colored saddle and bridle. To the boy's left, a light blue and white drum with a yellow top is visible, along with what appears to be a brass trumpet and a yellow, curved object. The floor beneath the boy and objects is a reddish-brown. In the bottom left corner, faint white text reads "Pablo Goya y Lucientes".

metadata.title: José Costa y Bonells (died l870), Called Pepito

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in a dark dress and lace mantilla with blue ribbons, holding a fan
long_description: The painting is a full-length portrait of a woman seated, positioned slightly to the left of the canvas's center, against a muted, dark olive-green background. The woman has fair skin, dark eyes, and a small mouth with a slight, closed-lip smile, looking directly forward. Her dark, curly hair is voluminous and frames her face. She wears a black lace mantilla that covers her head and shoulders, adorned with several loops of bright blue ribbon on top. Her dress is dark, possibly black or deep brown, with a low-cut white bodice visible beneath the mantilla. A light pink flower with green leaves is pinned to her left shoulder. Her long sleeves are white with delicate lace cuffs. Her hands are clasped in her lap, holding a closed fan. A prominent blue ring is visible on the ring finger of her left hand. The skirt of her dress is full and dark, extending to the bottom of the frame. To her right, the back and armrest of a gold-upholstered chair with a wooden frame are visible. The background is otherwise plain, with subtle variations in the dark green tone.

alt_text: Two women in elaborate dresses on a balcony, with two cloaked figures partially visible behind them
long_description: The painting depicts four figures, two prominent women in the foreground on a balcony, and two darker, less defined figures behind them. The overall color palette is dark and muted, with the figures illuminated against a somber background. In the foreground, two light-skinned women are positioned behind a dark, metal balcony railing. The woman on the left has dark, curly hair and wears a light-colored dress with gold and blue embroidery on the sleeves and bodice, and a dark lace shawl over her hair and shoulders. Her arms are crossed, and she looks towards the viewer with a slight smile. The woman on the right has lighter hair, possibly covered by a sheer white veil or mantilla. She wears a similar light-colored dress with gold and blue details. Her right hand rests on the railing, and her left hand is near the other woman's hand. She looks down and slightly to the left, also with a slight smile. The railing consists of vertical dark bars. Below the railing, parts of their dresses are visible, flowing downwards, with the left woman's dress showing a pattern of light blue and gold stripes or bands. Behind the women, two figures are partially visible in the shadows. The figure on the far right is largely obscured by a dark brown cloak and hood, with only a small portion of a face visible in shadow. The figure on the far left is also dark, wearing a dark hat and a dark cloak, with a face partially visible in shadow, looking towards the women. The background wall is a uniform dark gray or brown, providing little detail. The figures fill most of the vertical canvas, and the balcony railing creates a strong horizontal line across the lower middle of the painting. The lighting highlights the faces and upper bodies of the two women, drawing the viewer's eye.

alt_text: Portrait of a man in a brown coat and wig, holding a red book, against a dark background
long_description: A formal, waist-up portrait depicts a man seated, looking directly forward. The background is a dark, almost black color, with a lighter, possibly upholstered chair back visible behind his right shoulder. The man has pale skin and a light gray powdered wig with curls over his ears, tied back. His face is oval with dark eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. He wears a white ruffled cravat, a white waistcoat with a subtle pattern, and a long-sleeved brown coat. A medal with a starburst design hangs from a ribbon on his left lapel. White ruffled cuffs are visible at his wrists. His left arm is bent, resting on his lap, holding a small, rectangular red book. His right arm is bent, with his hand tucked into his coat. At the very bottom of the painting, a light brown band contains handwritten text in dark script, which reads: "D.n Bernardo Iriarte, Vice-prot. de la R.l Academia de las tres nobles Artes, retratado por Goya en testimonio de mu-tua estimac.n y afecto año de 1797".

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in a white dress holding a baby in a bonnet, both looking left
long_description:
A vertical portrait depicts a woman holding a baby, positioned slightly to the right of the center against a dark, plain background. The woman, shown from the waist up, faces left with her head turned slightly, her gaze directed forward. She has dark, curly hair styled elaborately and adorned with small, sparkling elements, possibly jewels or flowers, forming a crown-like arrangement. Her complexion is fair, and she wears long, dangling earrings and a multi-strand pearl necklace that drapes across her chest. Her dress is light-colored, likely white or cream, with sheer, puffed sleeves and a low, rounded neckline. A dark brooch with a gold element is pinned to her chest, and an orange and blue sash crosses diagonally over her torso. A gold bracelet is visible on her right wrist, which supports the baby.

She cradles a baby in her arms, held against her left side. The baby also faces left, looking in the same direction as the woman. It wears a white gown and a white bonnet with a ruffled or lace edge. A light blue and white striped sash is draped across the baby's chest. The baby has fair skin and rosy cheeks. The background is a muted, dark brown or grey, providing a stark contrast to the light-colored clothing of the figures. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting the faces and the front of their attire.

metadata.title: Infanta María Luisa (1782–1824) and Her Son Carlos Luis (1799–1883)

alt_text: A waist-up portrait of a young man in an elaborate light blue coat with a red, white, and blue sash.
long_description: A waist-up portrait depicts a young man with light skin, dark eyes, and light, somewhat disheveled hair, looking directly forward. He wears an elaborate, light blue or silver-blue coat with intricate gold embroidery visible on the lapels and cuffs. Underneath the coat, a white ruffled cravat or shirt collar is visible. A prominent red, white, and blue striped sash crosses his chest from his right shoulder down to his left hip. Several small, gold-colored medals or insignia are attached to the sash. His right hand is partially visible, tucked into the front of his coat. The figure is set against a plain, dark background, possibly dark green or brown, within an oval-shaped frame that is itself contained within a larger rectangular canvas.

metadata.title: Ferdinand VII (1784–1833), When Prince of Asturias

alt_text: A portrait painting of a woman in a yellow dress adorned with jewelry, holding a fan, against a dark background.
long_description:
The painting is a formal, waist-up portrait of a woman against a plain, dark background. The woman stands facing forward, her head slightly tilted. She has a pale complexion, dark, curly hair, and dark eyes, with a faint, closed-mouth smile. Her hair is adorned with a yellow fabric headpiece and a single white feather pointing upwards. She wears multiple strands of pearl necklaces, with the innermost strand featuring smaller pearls and the outer strands larger, irregularly shaped pearls. Large hoop earrings are visible on her ears.
Her dress is primarily yellow, with short, puffed sleeves and a shimmering texture. A white undergarment or skirt is visible beneath the yellow overdress, which is decorated with small, scattered embellishments. A dark sash, possibly black or dark blue with a lighter stripe, crosses her chest from her right shoulder to her left hip, where it is tied with a bow. A dark, ornate medal or brooch is pinned to her chest above the sash. Her forearms are adorned with multiple bracelets and rings on her fingers. Her hands are clasped at her waist, holding a closed, dark-colored fan. The lighting illuminates her face and the front of her body, creating a contrast with the dark background.

metadata.title: María Luisa of Parma (1751–1819), Queen of Spain

alt_text: A large rock formation with buildings on top, fires below, and three winged figures flying in a blue sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic scene dominated by a massive, craggy rock formation that rises from the lower center to the upper left. The rock is rendered with rough, textured brushstrokes in shades of dark brown, gray, and ochre. Perched atop the rock are several light-colored buildings with reddish-brown roofs, forming a complex structure that resembles a monastery or fortress. Along the base of the rock, particularly on the left and extending to the right, are areas of bright orange and red, indicating fires with rising smoke. In the lower right foreground, a crowd of small, indistinct figures, some appearing to wear white robes, gathers near the base of the rock, facing towards the fires. Above the rock, in the upper right quadrant of the dark, muted blue sky, three large, white, winged figures with distinct, broad wings fly towards the left. The overall lighting is dim, suggesting dusk or night, with the fires providing the most intense light. The background on the far right shows faint, dark hills under the blue sky.

alt_text: A crowded bullfight arena with multiple bulls, horses, and figures engaged in the event, surrounded by spectators
long_description:
The painting depicts a bustling bullfight scene within a large, open-air arena under a cloudy sky. The upper portion of the canvas shows a sky transitioning from light blue to muted pink and grey. The arena floor, occupying the central and lower parts of the image, is a sandy, light brown color. Numerous spectators fill the tiered seating that encircles the arena, appearing as dark, indistinct masses of figures in the background and along the sides. Behind the upper tiers, buildings with reddish roofs and dark walls are visible, suggesting an urban setting. A tall, dark tower-like structure rises on the left side, extending above the crowd.

In the foreground, a low wooden barrier separates a small group of seated spectators from the sandy arena floor. Some of these foreground spectators, on both the left and right, wear white clothing. The arena itself is filled with activity. On the left, a brown bull with horns faces two figures in light blue and yellow attire, one holding a red cape. Behind them, a figure on horseback, wearing armor and a plumed helmet, faces right. Further back on the left, other figures interact with another dark bull.

In the center-right, a white horse carries a figure in a wide-brimmed hat, with another figure on foot nearby. To their right, a dark bull with prominent horns charges towards the right side of the frame. Several other figures, dressed in various colored outfits including red, blue, and yellow, are scattered across the arena, some holding capes or lances, engaging with the bulls or moving around the space. The overall composition conveys dynamic movement and a crowded spectacle.

alt_text: A landscape painting with a large tree, thatched-roof buildings, and two figures on a path under a cloudy sky
long_description: A horizontal landscape painting depicts a rural scene under a cloudy sky. The upper half of the canvas is filled with a heavy, dark gray sky, with a lighter, more open patch of pale blue-gray visible towards the upper right. In the left foreground, a large, gnarled tree with dark, dense foliage and several bare, twisted branches rises from a dark, earthy mound. To the right of the tree, the landscape opens into rolling, grassy hills with patches of brown earth. In the midground, towards the right, a cluster of buildings with steep, thatched roofs is visible. The most prominent building has a tall, narrow structure with a chimney on its roof. Adjacent to it, a smaller, more dilapidated building with a partially collapsed roof stands. In the center foreground, two figures are positioned on a dirt path that winds through the landscape. One figure stands, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long coat, facing a second figure who is seated on the ground, also wearing a hat. Further in the distant background, faint figures and trees can be discerned on the horizon line. The overall color palette consists of muted greens, browns, and grays, with dark shadows contrasting with lighter areas of the sky and some illuminated patches of grass.

alt_text: A dark, cloudy landscape painting of a large, old building by a wide river with boats and figures.
long_description: A painting depicts a wide river scene under a heavily clouded, dark gray sky. The sky lightens towards the horizon, revealing a pale strip of light. On the right, a large, multi-story building with a prominent, pointed tower dominates the bank. The building is constructed of dark stone or brick, with a reddish-brown tiled roof and several smaller attached structures. Sparse, dark green trees and bushes grow around its base. A muddy, dark brown bank slopes down to the water, where a figure in a red top stands near the edge. Wooden steps or a small dock extend into the water. In the foreground, two small, dark boats float on the reflective, dark water. The boat closer to the viewer contains several figures, while the other appears to have one. In the distance, a larger sailboat with two masts is visible on the water, with a low, tree-lined landmass on the far horizon. Several small, dark birds fly near the top of the prominent building.

alt_text: A large, old tower stands by a wide river with a boat of figures fishing under a cloudy sky.
long_description: A wide landscape painting depicts a river scene under a cloudy sky. The upper half of the image is filled with a pale blue sky mostly covered by large, soft grey and white clouds. On the far left, a tall, weathered brown stone tower with a pointed roof rises from the river's edge, appearing somewhat ruinous with multiple arched openings and windows. Small, dark birds fly around its upper sections. Behind the tower, on the bank, are a few small, dark buildings with thatched roofs. The river occupies the lower half of the painting, its calm surface reflecting the muted sky. In the lower right foreground, a small, dark boat contains three figures, two of whom are actively pulling a fishing net from the water. Several dark ducks swim near the left bank in the foreground, and scattered wooden posts protrude from the water. A low, green bank with trees and buildings stretches across the middle ground from the center to the right. A church steeple rises above the trees in the center, with more buildings lining the distant bank to the right. Numerous sailboats and other vessels are scattered across the distant river under the hazy sky. The overall color palette is dominated by muted greens, browns, and grays, with pale blues and whites in the sky and water.

alt_text: A wide landscape painting featuring a vast cloudy sky over a river, distant town, and fields with figures.
long_description: A wide, horizontal landscape painting depicts a broad, low-lying vista under a dramatic sky. The upper two-thirds of the canvas are dominated by a vast, cloudy sky, rendered in shades of dark grey, blue-grey, and white. The clouds are heavy and voluminous, with lighter, yellowish-white light breaking through near the horizon, particularly on the left side. Below the expansive sky, a wide body of water, likely a river or estuary, stretches across the midground, reflecting some of the sky's muted light. On the far bank of the water, a low-lying landmass features a distant town or city, characterized by numerous dark spires and buildings silhouetted against the lighter horizon. Several windmills are visible on this distant land, especially on the left, and a plume of white smoke rises from a point on the left bank. Various small boats with sails are scattered across the water. The foreground consists of flat, green and brown fields. On the right side of the foreground, several round haystacks are visible. On the left, a few small, indistinct figures are present, possibly resting or working in the field. Fences or posts are also discernible in the immediate foreground. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by blues, greys, greens, and browns, creating a serene yet atmospheric scene.

metadata.title: View of Haarlem and the Haarlemmer Meer

alt_text: A cloudy landscape with a large fortified building on the right and fishermen in boats on the water
long_description: The painting depicts a wide, somber landscape dominated by a large body of water and a fortified structure under a cloudy sky. The upper half of the canvas is filled with heavy, dark grey and brown clouds, with some lighter, yellowish-grey areas peeking through, suggesting a muted light source. The lower half is a calm, reflective body of water, appearing murky brown-green, mirroring the tones of the sky and the distant land.On the right side, a substantial fortified complex rises from the water's edge. A tall, multi-storied tower with a dark, pointed roof stands prominently in the center-right, its weathered stone or brick facade showing various shades of brown and grey. Below and to its right, a series of robust stone walls and smaller buildings extend along the water, forming a defensive embankment. These walls feature arched openings at water level and smaller turrets with conical roofs. The stone surfaces are textured, with hints of green and brown vegetation.In the far distance on the left, a low, flat landmass with a cluster of trees and a small, dark structure, possibly a windmill, is visible under a slightly brighter patch of sky.Several small boats are scattered across the water. In the foreground, slightly to the left of center, two men in a dark boat are actively pulling in a fishing net, which stretches across the water. One man wears a reddish-brown top, the other a darker garment. Further back on the left, another small boat with one or two figures is visible. Near the base of the fortified wall on the right, several more small boats are present, some with figures, and some appear to be entering or exiting the arched openings in the wall. The overall atmosphere is subdued and somewhat melancholic due to the overcast sky and muted color palette.

alt_text: A wide river scene with boats, a village with a church, and a vast cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a wide river landscape under a heavily clouded sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by a vast expanse of grey and white clouds, suggesting an overcast or stormy day, with lighter patches indicating some light breaking through. The lower half features a broad river, its surface reflecting the muted tones of the sky. On the left bank, a cluster of buildings forms a village, characterized by dark roofs and walls, some appearing to be built close to or over the water on wooden supports. A tall, dark church steeple with a pointed spire rises prominently above the other structures and surrounding trees. Further along the left bank, more trees and indistinct land extend into the distance. Several boats populate the river. In the mid-ground, towards the left, a large, flat-bottomed boat, possibly a ferry, carries multiple figures and at least one brown cow, being propelled by oars. Further to the right, two sailboats with white sails are visible, moving away from the viewer, with the larger one closer to the left bank. On the far right, a low, grassy bank extends into the water, with a small rowboat containing a few figures moored nearby. In the foreground, dark, slender posts or reeds emerge from the water. The overall color palette is subdued, featuring greens, browns, and various shades of grey.

metadata.title: River View with a Village Church

alt_text: Four haloed saints stand with two kneeling donors before a city landscape, with angels in the sky
long_description: The painting depicts four standing male saints and two kneeling donors in the foreground, set against a landscape with a city and mountains, beneath a sky with flying angels. The upper portion features a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the upper left and right corners, groups of winged, robed figures, likely angels, are depicted flying. Some appear to hold thin lines or bows. Below the angels, a detailed cityscape with numerous buildings, towers, and walls extends across the middle ground, suggesting a town nestled in a valley. Rolling hills and mountains rise in the distance behind the city. Two tall, slender dark green cypress trees stand prominently in the center, separating the standing figures. On the far left, Saint Nicholas of Tolentino stands, a balding man with a halo, dressed in a dark brown monastic habit adorned with white flowers on his chest. He holds a closed dark book in his left hand. The inscription "SANTVS NICHOLAVS DETOLENTINO" arcs above his head. Next to him, Saint Roch, a young man with a short beard and halo, wears a purple tunic and a yellow cloak draped over his shoulder. He holds a tall, gnarled staff in his right hand, and his right leg is exposed, revealing a dark mark on his thigh. The inscription "SANCTVS ROCHVS" arcs above his head. To the right of the cypress trees, Saint Sebastian, a youthful figure with curly light brown hair and a halo, stands in a red and dark green tunic with white trim. He holds several arrows in his left hand and a green palm frond in his right. The inscription "SANCTVS SEBASTIANVS" arcs above his head. On the far right, Saint Bernardino of Siena, an older, balding man with a halo, wears a light brown monastic habit. He holds an open book in his left hand, displaying text. His right hand is raised with the index finger pointing upwards. The inscription "SANTVS BERNARDINVS" arcs above his head. The text on his book reads: "PICEA ANVPE SAPIEN TIA VITA VIRTVS VERITAS". At the lower left, a male donor kneels in profile, facing right, with hands clasped in prayer. He wears a dark robe and a red cap. At the lower right, a female donor kneels in profile, facing left, with hands clasped in prayer. She wears a dark dress and a white wimple or head covering. A white inscription on a dark band runs horizontally across the lower center, between the feet of the standing saints: "QVESTA TAVOLA E FACTA FARE PER DEVOZIONE DI SANCTO SEBASTIANO E SANCTO ROCHO PER LA PESTILENTIA DA FRATE BARTOLOMEO DI GIOVANNI DA CASTIGLION FIORENTINO PRIORE DI QVESTO MONASTERO DI SANCTO AGOSTINO DI SAN GIMIGNANO". The ground is a light, tiled surface.

metadata.title: Saints Nicholas of Tolentino, Roch, Sebastian, and Bernardino of Siena, with Kneeling Donors
metadata.artist: Benozzo Gozzoli (Benozzo di Lese di Sandro)
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A man falls from a horse, struck by divine light, surrounded by soldiers and horses in a hilly landscape.
long_description: The painting depicts a dynamic scene set in a hilly, green landscape under a light blue sky. In the upper center, a radiant golden orb, resembling a sun, emits bright yellow light rays downwards. These rays converge on a man lying on his back in the lower center, dressed in blue and pink robes, with his head tilted upwards towards the light source. His arms are outstretched, and his legs are bent. Around the fallen man, several other figures are in motion. To the left, a man in red and yellow runs away, looking back. Behind him, a soldier in red and blue armor rides a grey horse, holding a spear. Further back, another figure on a brown horse appears to be reacting to the light. To the right, a man in blue and red, carrying a round yellow shield, runs forward. Behind him, a group of figures on foot and horseback are visible, some looking towards the central event, others seemingly in disarray. The landscape features rolling green hills, scattered trees including a prominent tall cypress on the left, and distant blue mountains. A small brown rabbit runs in the lower left foreground. The ground is a mix of brown earth and green patches.

metadata.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
metadata.artist: Benozzo Gozzoli (Benozzo di Lese di Sandro)

alt_text: A crowded scene with a man floating above, a man on the ground, and figures gesturing
long_description: The painting depicts a crowded outdoor scene under a light blue sky. In the upper center, a figure in a green robe and red undergarment floats with outstretched arms, surrounded by several small, dark, winged creatures. Below, a large, dark reddish-brown wall with arched openings spans the left background. To the right of the wall, a tall, light-colored column with a gold band stands. Between the wall and the column, a wooden scaffolding structure is visible. In the left foreground, a large group of people, mostly men, are gathered. Many wear tunics in shades of blue, red, and yellow. A bearded man in a yellow cloak over a blue tunic stands with his right arm raised, pointing towards the floating figure. Next to him, a bearded man in a pink robe kneels with hands clasped in prayer. In the center-right foreground, a man lies face down on the ground, dressed in a dark green robe over a red garment. A pool of red liquid is visible around his head. To the right, a group of figures stands near the column. A man in a pink tunic and armor holds a red shield inscribed with "SPQR" in white letters. Behind him, several soldiers with spears are visible. An older bearded man in a dark green cloak stands to the right of the armored man, gesturing with his right hand. Further right, a man in a red and gold tunic and a gold crown sits on a dark green, cylindrical stool, holding a small gold object.

metadata.title: Saint Peter and Simon Magus
metadata.artist: Benozzo Gozzoli (Benozzo di Lese di Sandro)

alt_text: A crowd of people in a town square witnessing a kneeling bishop and a child near a body
long_description: The painting depicts a bustling outdoor scene in what appears to be a town square, with buildings in the background under a light blue sky. A large crowd of figures, dressed in various colored robes and head coverings, fills the space. In the foreground, slightly to the left of center, a figure in a green and red bishop's miter and cope kneels, hands clasped in prayer. To their right, a small child in a dark tunic and white collar stands with arms raised, looking towards a prone figure on a pink mat on the ground. This prone figure, also a child, is dressed in dark clothing and has light hair, with red marks around its head. Further to the right, another figure in a blue robe kneels, facing the prone child with hands raised. Surrounding these central figures are numerous onlookers. On the left, a group of people in blue, red, and pink garments observe, with one figure pointing towards the kneeling bishop. A young man in a light blue tunic holds a staff topped with a cross and a green banner, standing behind the kneeling bishop. On the right side, a dense group of figures in various colored robes—red, green, pink, and white—stand and gesture, some with hands raised. In the mid-ground, a young man in a dark cape and pink hose stands with hands open, looking towards the central event. Behind him, other figures in dark and red robes are visible. The background features light-colored buildings, including a white structure with a classical facade and a red building with multiple windows. The overall scene is brightly lit.

metadata.title: Saint Zenobius Resuscitating a Dead Child
metadata.artist: Benozzo Gozzoli (Benozzo di Lese di Sandro)

alt_text: A king kneels before a seated holy man with a halo, surrounded by monks, soldiers, and buildings.
long_description: A painted scene depicts a gathering of figures in an outdoor setting with architectural elements under a light blue sky. On the left, a group of men stands, some dressed as soldiers in red and gold armor with blue leggings, others in turbans and long robes. One soldier in the foreground points his right hand towards the center. Behind them, a low, green-brown hill rises, topped by a small, dark green tree. A man, likely a king, kneels on his right knee in the center-left, facing right. He wears a gold crown and an elaborate red and gold robe. His hands are raised slightly, palms open. To the right, an elderly, bearded man with a golden halo sits on a dark, low seat. He wears a dark brown monastic robe and extends his right arm, pointing his index finger towards the kneeling figure. Surrounding him are several other men in similar dark monastic robes, some with their hands clasped or raised in front of them. In the background, a light pink building with a pointed roof and arched windows, featuring a star-like symbol on its facade, stands behind the central figures. A light-colored path leads from the foreground towards this building. To the far right, a reddish-brown building with a large, dark archway is visible. The ground in the foreground is a light tan color. The sky above is a pale blue with scattered white clouds.

metadata.title: Totila before Saint Benedict
metadata.artist: Benozzo Gozzoli (Benozzo di Lese di Sandro)

alt_text: Multi-scene Renaissance painting depicting religious narratives with classical architecture and figures in indoor and outdoor settings
long_description: The horizontal painting presents a series of narrative scenes set within a continuous landscape and architectural framework. On the far left, an outdoor scene features a classical, domed pavilion on a raised, stepped platform. A robed figure stands before an altar within the pavilion, while a nude man sits on the ground below. Several robed figures observe from the middle ground, with a hilly landscape, a lake, and distant buildings under a light blue sky. Moving right, under the first archway, two women embrace on a stone step. One wears a blue cloak over a red dress, the other a green cloak over a purple dress. Both have halos. Behind them, a group of women stands under a second arch. The central section, under the second arch, depicts an interior bedroom scene. A woman with a halo lies in a red bed with a white canopy. Another woman, also with a halo, sits beside the bed, holding a swaddled infant. A third woman sits on the floor in front of the bed, holding an open book. A fourth woman stands near the foot of the bed. The rightmost section, under the third arch, shows another interior. A woman in a green dress kneels before an older, bearded man seated in a red chair. Another woman stands in a doorway in the background. The architectural elements, including columns and arches, are rendered in shades of gray and gold, creating a sense of depth and division between the scenes while maintaining a unified composition.

metadata.title: Scenes from the Life of Saint John the Baptist
metadata.artist: Francesco Granacci (Francesco di Andrea di Marco)
metadata.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood

alt_text: A panoramic painting depicts a bearded man in a pink cloth speaking to groups of people in a rocky, treed landscape.
long_description: A panoramic painting shows a wide, outdoor scene with numerous figures gathered in a rocky, hilly landscape under a light blue sky. In the center, a bearded man with a bare chest and a pink cloth draped around his lower body stands on a rock, gesturing with his right arm towards the left. He is the tallest figure in the immediate foreground. To his left, three women are seated on the ground, one in a pink robe, one in a green robe, and one in an orange robe. Further left, two men in dark robes stand conversing, one holding a book. Up a winding path on a green hill in the far left, a small group of figures walks away. To the right of the central figure, a group of men are seated and standing on rocks, facing him. They wear robes in various colors including green, yellow, red, and blue. The landscape features numerous green trees and large brown rock formations throughout. In the distant background, a body of water is visible with mountains beyond it, and several dark birds fly in the sky above the central figure.

metadata.title: Saint John the Baptist Bearing Witness

alt_text: A dark, vaulted room filled with robed figures, some performing a ritual under a window's light.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a solemn interior scene within a large, high-ceilinged room, likely a monastic setting. The color palette is dominated by dark browns, grays, and deep reds, with strong contrasts created by a central light source. The room features a high, vaulted ceiling with arches that recede into the dark upper corners. Along the upper walls, several large, framed paintings are visible, some partially illuminated by light. Below these paintings, the walls are lined with dark wooden wainscoting and long benches where numerous figures are seated. At the far end of the room, a large arched window with small panes is the primary light source, casting a bright glow onto the central floor and the wall directly beneath it. Above this window, a large, dark framed portrait hangs on the back wall. Many figures, dressed in dark, hooded robes, are seated on the benches along both sides of the room, facing inward. In the central foreground, several figures are actively engaged. Two figures in lighter, possibly white, robes stand near a dark, ornate lectern or altar-like structure. One figure in a red robe stands behind this structure, facing the seated figures. Another figure in a dark robe kneels prominently in the lower right foreground, facing the center. The light from the window illuminates the central floor, highlighting these active figures and creating long shadows.

metadata.title: The Choir of the Capuchin Church in Rome

alt_text: A dark painting depicts the Nativity scene with Mary, Joseph, shepherds, a baby, and angels above
long_description: A vertically oriented oil painting depicts a crowded Nativity scene with dramatic lighting and elongated figures. In the upper center, three cherubic angels with small wings float, one holding a white banner with dark text that reads "GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO". To the left, dark green foliage is visible, while an archway frames the upper right. The central focus is a baby, wrapped in white cloth, lying in a manger or on a bed of straw, illuminated by a bright light source. To the baby's right, a woman in a pink and purple robe, likely Mary, looks down with a gentle expression. Beside her, a bearded man in dark robes, likely Joseph, gestures with his hands, also looking towards the baby. To the left of the baby, several figures, presumably shepherds, are gathered. One man, kneeling in the foreground, wears a green cloak and a brown tunic, his hands near the baby. Behind him, other figures lean in, some with their hands raised in awe. A figure in a white garment on the far left raises both arms upwards. A small white lamb lies on the dark brown ground in the lower center, near the kneeling man. The overall palette is dark, with strong contrasts between light and shadow, emphasizing the illuminated central figures.

alt_text: A dark painting shows multiple figures gathered around a baby, with angels and putti hovering above
long_description: A vertically oriented oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures illuminated against a dark background. In the upper third, a cluster of celestial beings emerges from dark, swirling clouds. On the far upper left, a large, muscular angel with a white sash and red drapery holds a bright, glowing object, possibly a staff or sword, pointing downwards. To its right, another large angel in green and yellow drapery looks down, surrounded by several smaller putti. Light emanates from this heavenly group, casting a glow on the figures below.In the central and lower portions of the painting, a group of earthly figures is gathered. At the very center, a baby wrapped in white cloth lies on a bed of straw or fabric. To the left of the baby, a woman with a pale face, wearing a red dress and a white veil, looks down with clasped hands. To her left, a bearded man in a purple tunic and yellow drapery kneels, gesturing towards the baby. Directly in front of the baby, another bearded man, mostly bald, kneels with his back partially to the viewer, looking intently at the infant. Behind him, a man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a light-colored tunic, stands with hands clasped in prayer. To the far right, a tall, muscular man with dark hair stands, his hands crossed over his chest, wearing a yellow cloak over blue-grey trousers. The lower foreground shows dark, rocky ground and the partial form of an animal, possibly a donkey or ox, behind the kneeling figures. The painting uses a strong chiaroscuro effect, with deep shadows contrasting with brightly lit faces and drapery.

alt_text: Jesus heals a blind man, surrounded by a crowd of figures in an architectural setting under a dramatic sky
long_description: The painting depicts a crowded scene with numerous figures engaged in various interactions within an architectural setting. In the left foreground, a central figure, dressed in a pink tunic and a blue cloak, extends his right hand towards the face of a man kneeling before him. This kneeling man, clad in a brown cloth, looks upwards. To the left of the kneeling man, another figure with a bare back and a pink drape around his waist raises his left arm towards the sky, his head tilted back. Several other figures are clustered around these central three, observing the scene. The background on the left features tall, light-colored columns and building facades. The ground beneath the figures is a checkered pattern of light and dark squares. On the right side of the painting, a group of men stands, some with beards, dressed in various colored robes including green, purple, and brown. One man in a purple robe gestures with both hands towards the central figures. Further back on the right, more figures are visible, some appearing to be in conversation or interaction. In the lower right foreground, a man in a green tunic looks upwards, while a woman with bare shoulders and a white garment looks towards the left. The background on the right features more classical architecture, including arches and buildings receding into the distance. The sky above is a dramatic mix of deep blues and white, heavily textured clouds. The overall palette includes rich blues, pinks, browns, and greens, with strong contrasts between light and shadow. The brushwork appears expressive and dynamic.

alt_text: A seated man with a beard and glasses, wearing a red cardinal's robe and hat, against a patterned wall
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a seated man with light skin, a short dark beard, and a mustache, wearing round spectacles. He is dressed in a voluminous, deep crimson-red robe with a matching cap. The robe features a row of buttons down the front and wide sleeves, revealing white lace cuffs at the wrists. Beneath the red robe, a white undergarment with intricate white lace trim is visible, extending to the floor. The man's hands, adorned with rings, rest on his lap. He is seated in a dark, high-backed chair, partially visible behind him on the right, which appears to have red upholstery. The background on the left features dark brown wooden paneling, while the right side displays a gold-patterned tapestry or wallpaper with a repeating floral motif. The floor beneath him has a checkerboard pattern of dark and light squares. In the lower center, directly in front of the man's feet, a small, folded piece of white paper or a letter rests on the floor.

alt_text: A painted portrait of a bald, bearded man with a white ruff and fur-trimmed coat against a dark, muted background
long_description: A head-and-shoulders portrait depicts an older man facing forward, his gaze directed towards the viewer. His head is bald and pale, with a receding hairline. His face is narrow, featuring prominent cheekbones and a long, thin nose. Dark, slightly sunken eyes are set above a full, dark beard that covers his chin and jawline. A white, intricately pleated ruff encircles his neck, standing out against his dark clothing. He wears a dark garment, possibly a coat or robe, which is trimmed with a broad band of light brown fur across the shoulders and upper chest. The fur shows visible brushstrokes, suggesting texture. The background is a uniform dark brown, providing a stark contrast that emphasizes the figure. Lighting appears to originate from the upper left, highlighting the man's forehead and the folds of the ruff. The overall impression is one of a somber and dignified individual.

alt_text: A dark, stormy landscape painting of a city on a hill overlooking a valley with a river.
long_description:
The painting depicts a dramatic, dark landscape under a turbulent sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by heavy, dark blue-grey clouds with streaks of lighter, almost white, clouds suggesting a stormy atmosphere. Below the sky, a sprawling city is situated on a prominent hill on the right side of the canvas. The city buildings are rendered in muted grey tones, with a tall, slender bell tower or spire rising above them, slightly left of center. The structures appear dense and clustered together.

The landscape descends into a valley below the city, characterized by rolling hills covered in varying shades of green and brown. A winding river flows through the valley, appearing dark and reflecting the somber sky. In the mid-ground, a stone bridge or aqueduct spans the river, connecting different parts of the landscape. Scattered throughout the valley and on the hills are various grey structures, possibly ruins or smaller settlements, blending with the natural environment.

The foreground features more detailed vegetation, including bushes and trees in darker green hues, framing the lower part of the scene. The overall color palette is dark and cool, dominated by blues, greys, and deep greens, creating a somber and dramatic mood.

alt_text: A robed figure with raised arms stands beside nude and draped figures, with smaller figures in the sky
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures, rendered in dark, somber tones with some vibrant accents. Figures are elongated and stylized, contributing to the overall intensity.On the left side, a tall, slender figure in a flowing light blue robe stands, facing right and slightly upward. Their arms are raised high above their head, palms open, with the left arm slightly higher than the right. The robe features deep, angular folds, particularly at the bottom where it gathers on the ground. A piece of reddish-brown fabric lies on the ground in front of the robed figure's lower body.The central and right portions of the canvas are occupied by a group of nude and partially draped figures. In the center, five nude female figures stand closely together, mostly facing forward or slightly to the right. Their skin tones are pale, and some are partially obscured by yellow drapery behind them. To the right of these females, several nude male figures are depicted in various dynamic poses. One male figure kneels on the ground, looking upward with arms raised. Another male figure is seen from behind, also with arms raised, partially covered by green drapery. Further to the right, another male figure is seen from the front, with one arm raised.In the upper right corner, several smaller, cherubic figures are depicted amidst swirling clouds, some holding or pulling white drapery. The background consists of dark, turbulent clouds in shades of brown, gray, and hints of blue and yellow, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The ground beneath the figures is a dark, earthy brown.

alt_text: A bearded man in a green robe stands barefoot, holding a large wooden cross against a stormy sky.
long_description: A full-length oil painting depicts a standing, bearded man in a dramatic landscape. The man, positioned centrally, faces slightly to his left with his head tilted upwards. He has a long white beard and hair, and his expression appears somber. He is draped in a flowing, bright green robe that covers most of his body, worn over a dark, possibly black, undergarment. His left arm is bent at the elbow, with his hand open, palm up, and fingers slightly splayed in a gesturing manner. His right arm extends downwards, with his hand resting on a large, rough wooden cross that leans against his right side. The cross, formed by two intersecting beams, extends from near the bottom of the frame to the top, angled diagonally. The man's bare feet are visible on the dark, uneven ground beneath him. The upper half of the painting is dominated by a turbulent, dramatic sky with dark, heavy clouds interspersed with lighter, swirling patches of blue and white. In the mid-ground to the left, lighter, textured terrain with hints of green foliage and distant structures can be seen under a darker sky.

alt_text: A religious icon depicting Christ enthroned in a mandorla, flanked by figures, above multiple rows of saints
long_description: The image is a black and white depiction of a multi-tiered religious icon. The upper section features a central figure, likely Christ, seated on a cloud-like form. He wears flowing robes, has a halo, and holds an open book in his left hand, with his right hand raised in a gesture. He is enclosed within a dark, circular mandorla emanating rays of light, which also contains geometric star-like shapes. To the left of the central figure stands a female figure with a halo, likely Mary, and behind her, an angel with wings. Below them, a winged figure with a human face and a book is visible. To the right of the central figure stands a male figure with a halo, likely John the Baptist, gesturing towards Christ. Above him, a winged eagle-like creature is depicted, and below, a winged lion-like creature holds a book. Greek text is visible on Christ's halo, reading "IC XC", and on the open book. The lower section of the icon is divided into three horizontal rows, each containing multiple groups of figures. The uppermost row of the lower section shows four arched groups of standing figures. From left to right, the first group consists of several women with halos, the second group contains bearded men with halos, the third group shows women with halos, and the fourth group shows bearded men with halos. Above each arch, Greek text is inscribed: "ΧΟΡΟ ΙΕΡΑΡΧΩΝ", "ΧΟΡΟ ΠΡΟΦΗΤΩΝ", "ΧΟΡΟ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΩΝ", and "ΧΟΡΟ ΜΑΡΤΥΡΩΝ". The middle row of the lower section also features arched groups of figures, primarily bearded men with halos. The bottom row shows only the heads and shoulders of several bearded men, emerging from a wavy, textured line that suggests a landscape or a cloud formation. The entire icon has a worn appearance, with some areas of paint loss and visible texture.

alt_text: A young woman sits dejectedly on the floor with broken eggs, while an older woman and a man stand over her in a dim room
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with four figures and various objects, rendered in a muted palette with warm browns and greens dominating the background. On the left, a young woman sits on the floor, leaning slightly forward with her hands clasped in her lap. She wears a white, loose-fitting blouse and a blue skirt, with a light blue cap on her head. Her gaze is directed downwards, and her expression appears somber. Scattered on the floor in front of her are several broken eggs and a straw hat with a blue ribbon, next to an overturned basket lined with white cloth. Behind her, a simple wooden table holds a white teapot and a small white cup. A window with multiple panes is visible in the upper left corner, letting in some light. In the center, a man stands, looking towards the young woman. He wears a dark purple coat over a red waistcoat and light-colored breeches, with a dark hat held in his left hand near his head. His right arm is extended towards the young woman. To his right, an older woman leans forward, her hands clasped in front of her. She wears a white cap, a white apron over a green bodice, and a striped skirt. Her face is wrinkled, and she looks intently at the young woman, with her right hand pointing downwards. In the lower right corner, a small child with light curly hair sits on a wooden barrel, looking down at something in their hands. The child wears a light brown top and reddish-brown pants. The room's walls are a plain, dark beige, with wooden beams visible in the upper right. The overall lighting is dim, with a spotlight effect on the figures.

alt_text: A partially nude woman reclines on a bed as a robed figure leans over her, with an eagle in stormy clouds above.
long_description: The painting depicts an indoor scene with two figures and a dramatic sky element. In the center-right, a light-skinned woman reclines on a bed, her body partially covered by white drapery. She lies on her back, propped up slightly, with her left arm raised and bent, her hand near her head. Her gaze is directed upwards and to the right, her mouth slightly open. Her light brown hair is styled with some braids or adornments. Her torso and legs are visible, with a white sheet covering her lower body and extending over the bed. To the left, a figure dressed in a long blue robe with tan sleeves and a white head covering leans over the reclining woman. This figure has light skin and looks down at the woman with an intense expression, their right hand gently touching the woman's arm. The bed has a golden headboard and footboard, and a small, ornate wooden table stands to the left of the bed, holding a small mirror and a string of beads. The background on the left features dark, draped fabric in shades of brown and purple. On the upper right, a dramatic sky with dark, swirling clouds and bright golden light is visible. A large, dark bird, resembling an eagle, is depicted within these clouds, appearing to descend or hover above the bed. The overall color palette includes rich browns, deep blues, whites, and golden yellows, with strong contrasts between light and shadow.

alt_text: A formal portrait of a man with a powdered wig, pink coat, and ornate waistcoat, looking forward.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man with a pale complexion, rosy cheeks, and light blue eyes, looking directly forward. His lips are closed in a slight, neutral expression. He wears a powdered white wig with tight curls that frame his face, tied at the back with a light blue ribbon. His neck is adorned with a high, ruffled white cravat or shirt collar. He is dressed in an open, mauve-pink outer coat with a soft, possibly velvet texture. This coat features several decorative purple braided tassels or frogging down the front. A brown fur trim is visible along the opening of the pink coat. Beneath the pink coat, a light blue or silver waistcoat is visible, richly embroidered with intricate gold floral patterns and small red roses. A white lace ruffle extends from the waistcoat's opening. On the left side of his pink coat, a red ribbon with a medal or insignia is pinned. The man's body is angled slightly to the right, while his head is turned to face the viewer. The background is a plain, dark, indistinct brown or gray.

metadata.title: Charles Claude de Flahaut (1730–1809), Comte d'Angiviller

alt_text: A painting of a young woman with dark hair and a sheer white veil looking up and right
long_description: A painted portrait depicts a young woman from the chest up, set against a dark, plain background. Her head is turned slightly to her right, and her eyes are cast upwards and to her right, with a soft, somewhat pensive expression. Her fair skin features rosy cheeks and lips. Dark brown, wavy hair frames her face and extends over her shoulders, with some curls visible near her forehead. A sheer, translucent white veil is draped over her head and shoulders, creating soft, flowing folds that partially obscure her hair and upper body. The veil is loosely gathered and tied around her neck. She wears a white, long-sleeved blouse with ruffled fabric around the neckline and cuffs, visible beneath a dark, possibly black, garment that appears to be a vest or bodice. The background is a uniform, muted dark gray-brown, which contrasts with the lighter tones of her skin and clothing. The lighting emphasizes her face and the delicate texture of the veil.

alt_text: A close-up oil painting of a woman in profile, wearing a headscarf and dark draped clothing
long_description: The painting is a close-up, head-and-shoulders portrait of a woman in profile, facing right. Her head is slightly tilted down, and her gaze is directed forward. She has reddish-brown hair, partially covered by a light purple or lavender headscarf tied at the top of her head. The scarf has a subtle patterned texture. Her skin is fair, with rosy cheeks and lips. Her brow is slightly furrowed, and her eyes appear to have dark circles beneath them. Her nose is prominent, and her lips are slightly parted. She wears a white, loose-fitting garment with full sleeves, visible on her left shoulder and arm. Over this, a dark, possibly black or deep blue, draped fabric covers her shoulders and chest, revealing a hint of a light yellow or cream-colored undergarment or skin in the décolletage area. The background is a dark, muted gray-brown, providing a stark contrast to her lighter skin and clothing. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting her face and the folds of her clothing.

alt_text: A woman with curly hair and a white cap sits at a dark table with books
long_description: This waist-up portrait depicts a woman seated at a dark table, looking directly forward with a slight smile. Her face is round with fair skin and rosy cheeks. She has brown, curly hair that falls to her shoulders, partially covered by a sheer, white, ruffled cap. She wears a dark, long-sleeved garment, possibly a jacket or dress, over a white, ruffled cravat or scarf that is tucked into the dark fabric. Her left arm rests on the table, with her hand placed on an open book that has a red cover. Her right hand rests gently on top of her left. To the left of her, a stack of books is visible. The top book is dark red with gold lettering, reading "OEUVRES DE VOLTAIRE" and "TOME VII". Below it, a green book with gold accents is partially visible. The background is a plain, dark, muted color, possibly dark green or brown. On the far right, a vertical gold-colored, fluted architectural detail or furniture element is partially visible.

alt_text: A young woman with brown hair holds a blue and green wreath over a small white dog on a pedestal
long_description: The image is an oval-shaped portrait of a young woman and a small dog, set within a wooden frame. The woman, positioned slightly to the left of center, looks directly forward with a gentle expression. She has light skin, rosy cheeks, and dark brown, curly hair that frames her face and falls over her shoulders. She wears a white dress with a ruffled neckline and sleeves, and a light blue ribbon is tied around her left upper arm. Her hands are raised, holding a small wreath of blue and green foliage over the head of a white, fluffy dog. The dog, with dark eyes and a mix of white and gray fur on its head, stands on a light-colored pedestal or ledge to the right of the woman. Its body is mostly white, and it looks towards the viewer. Below the dog on the pedestal, two pink roses with green leaves are visible. The name "Greuze" is faintly visible on the front of the pedestal. The background features a muted landscape with a dark blue sky on the left and a lighter blue sky with hints of green and brown foliage on the right. The overall color palette is soft, with whites, blues, pinks, and muted greens.

alt_text: An oval portrait of a man with powdered gray hair, a dark coat, and a ruffled cravat, looking right.
long_description: This is an oval, bust-length portrait of a man with light skin, set against a dark, plain background. The man is positioned slightly to the left of center, facing forward but with his head turned to look towards the upper right. He has a light complexion, brown eyes, a small nose, and closed, light red lips. His hair is powdered gray, styled with curls above his ears and tied back, visible as a dark ribbon at the nape of his neck. He wears a white, ruffled cravat around his neck, which is visible above a dark, possibly navy or charcoal, coat. The coat has a wide collar and lapels, and two dark buttons are visible on the front. Beneath the open coat, a gold waistcoat with intricate, colorful embroidery is visible. The embroidery appears to be floral or leafy patterns in shades of red, green, and blue.
