alt_text: A grand arched loggia frames a bustling city view across a wide body of water with boats and people
long_description: The painting depicts a panoramic cityscape viewed through a large, ornate architectural structure. In the foreground, a grand loggia with a high, domed ceiling and a series of arches is supported by thick columns. Two large, dark brown columns stand prominently in the center, framing the distant view. On either side, the loggia extends with more columns and arches, and the walls feature niches containing statues. The ceiling above is a light brown, curved dome with a balustrade visible at the very top. Beyond the loggia, a wide body of light blue-green water stretches across the middle ground, filled with numerous small boats and gondolas. On the far side of the water, a sprawling city skyline rises, characterized by many buildings with red roofs and numerous spires and domes. A large, prominent dome, likely a cathedral, stands out in the center of the city. The sky above the city is a pale blue with scattered white clouds. In the immediate foreground, on the stone terrace of the loggia, several figures are gathered. To the left, a man in dark clothing stands near a small black dog. In the center, a group of elegantly dressed people, including women in wide skirts and men in coats, are conversing. Two small white dogs are also present near this group. To the right, another group of figures, including a man in a red coat and a woman in a light blue dress, are interacting. The terrace is enclosed by a low, light-colored balustrade, over which some figures lean, observing the distant city.

metadata.title: Capriccio with St. Paul's and Old London Bridge

alt_text: A 17th-century painting depicts women, a child, and a dog in a sunlit brick courtyard.
long_description: The painting shows a domestic scene in a sunlit brick courtyard, framed by buildings under a blue sky with white clouds. In the foreground, a woman with dark hair adorned with a white flower stands on the left, wearing a dark bodice, white apron, and a long red skirt. She looks down at a small child in a white dress and dark cap, who stands beside her, looking towards a lean, light brown dog with dark stripes. The dog stands on all fours, facing the child. To the right, another woman in a red bodice and dark skirt kneels, tending to a large dark pot and a white dish on the diamond-patterned tiled ground. She is positioned near an open doorway, through which a dimly lit interior and another figure are visible. On the far left, a man in a dark hat peers out from an open window with red shutters. The courtyard is enclosed by a tall, light brown wall, behind which trees and a distant building with a pointed roof are visible. A tall, dark chimney rises in the background. A climbing vine grows up the brick wall of the building on the right, near a large window.

alt_text: A painting depicts two sailing ships in a harbor, with a town and church steeple on the distant shore.
long_description: This horizontal painting presents a harbor scene under a soft, diffused sky. In the foreground on the left, a large, dark-hulled sailing ship with multiple masts and furled sails is prominently featured, its dark form casting a reflection on the calm water. Small figures are visible near its hull. To the right, a smaller sailing vessel with white, partially unfurled sails floats further out in the water. Two figures in a small rowboat are seen near this smaller ship, one rowing. The lower half of the painting is dominated by the reflective water, showing subtle ripples and mirroring the sky and vessels. Across the midground, a town or city stretches along the distant shore, characterized by numerous buildings and a prominent, light-colored church steeple rising in the center. Green, tree-covered hills ascend behind the town. The upper third of the painting is a light, hazy sky with soft, muted clouds, transitioning from lighter tones near the horizon to a slightly bluer-gray at the top, suggesting an overcast or early morning/late afternoon light.

alt_text: A painting of a city river scene with a stone bridge, boats, people, and buildings under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting presents a wide, horizontal view of a city river scene under a dramatic, cloudy sky. The upper third of the canvas is dominated by a turbulent sky, filled with dark gray and white clouds that suggest an overcast or stormy atmosphere. Below the sky, a long, multi-arched stone bridge spans the river, extending from the left to the right side of the composition. On the far bank, behind the bridge, a cluster of buildings with visible towers, including what appears to be a large cathedral, rises against the skyline. The river flows from the foreground towards the background, reflecting the muted light of the sky. Several boats, including a long, narrow wooden boat, are moored along the left bank. Floating structures, possibly houseboats or barges, are also visible near the bridge, with laundry hanging to dry. Along the muddy, uneven riverbank in the lower right, small groups of figures are gathered, some appearing to be washing clothes. A steep stone staircase ascends the right bank, leading up to a higher level, with a lone figure at the top. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy tones of brown, gray, and muted greens, with touches of white and red from the laundry and figures, creating a somber yet detailed urban landscape.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a man with wavy brown hair and a mustache, wearing a dark coat and white collar.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man with light skin, wavy brown hair, and a light brown mustache, set against a dark, unadorned background. He is positioned slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned to face forward, his gaze directed straight ahead. His face is full, with a prominent nose and small, dark eyes. He wears a dark, long-sleeved garment, possibly a coat, which appears to be made of a heavy fabric. A wide, flat white collar extends over his shoulders, contrasting sharply with the dark fabric. White cuffs are visible at his wrists. His left arm is bent, with his hand resting on a light-colored, horizontal surface that extends from the lower left edge of the frame. His right arm is also bent, and his hand, positioned near the center of the lower edge, holds a crumpled piece of light brown or beige fabric. The lighting comes from the upper left, illuminating his face, collar, and hands, creating a strong contrast with the deep shadows of his clothing and the dark background.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man
metadata.artist: Cornelis Jonson van Ceulen the Elder

alt_text: Half-length portrait of a woman with curly hair, wearing a dark dress, pearls, and holding a white feather.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a woman with light skin and long, dark brown curly hair, which falls over her shoulders. She looks directly forward with a neutral expression. A delicate gold-colored band or net adorns the top of her head. She wears a single strand pearl necklace and long, dangling pearl earrings. Her dark, possibly black or deep green, dress features puffed sleeves and a low neckline, revealing a white lace or embroidered undergarment. A small, ornate brooch is pinned to the center of her chest. Her hands are clasped in front of her, resting at waist level. On her left wrist, a white lace cuff is visible, and she wears multiple strands of pearl bracelets on both wrists. In her clasped hands, she holds a large, white feather and a string of pearls. The background is a plain, dark, reddish-brown color, providing a stark contrast to her light skin and the white elements of her attire.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman
metadata.artist: Cornelis Jonson van Ceulen the Elder

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a man with a mustache and beard, wearing a black coat, white collar, and holding spectacles.
long_description:
The painting is a half-length portrait of a man against a dark, draped background. The man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his body angled towards the left and his head turned to face the viewer directly. He has light skin, dark brown hair that curls around his ears, a dark mustache, and a short, dark beard. He wears a small, dark cap on his head. His eyes are dark, and his expression is neutral.

He is dressed in a dark, possibly black, long-sleeved coat with a wide, stiff white collar that extends over his shoulders. A dark, patterned cravat or tie is visible at his neck, beneath the collar. The coat has a row of small, dark buttons down the front. His right arm is bent, and his hand, with a white ruffled cuff, holds a pair of silver-rimmed spectacles and a light blue ribbon or cloth. The left arm is mostly obscured by the voluminous fabric of his coat.

The background is a deep, muted teal or dark blue, with soft folds of drapery visible on the right side. In the lower left corner, a small section of a light teal or green surface is visible, possibly a table or ledge, with a piece of brown fabric draped over it. The lighting highlights the man's face and hands, creating a contrast with the darker clothing and background.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man with a Watch
metadata.artist: Cornelis Jonson van Ceulen the Younger

alt_text: An angel with wings and a woman kneeling in a richly decorated room, with a dove above
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with two main figures. On the left, a winged figure, an angel, stands facing right. The angel has light brown hair, fair skin, and wears a long white robe with a blue sash. A green cloak with gold trim is draped over its left shoulder and arm, extending behind it. Its right arm is raised, with the index finger pointing upwards. In its left hand, it holds a tall, ornate golden staff. The angel's bare feet are visible. On the right, a woman kneels on a patterned floor, facing left towards the angel. She has light brown hair, fair skin, and wears a light-colored dress with a dark blue cloak draped over her shoulders and lap. Her hands are clasped near her chest. Before her, on a small wooden stool covered with a blue cloth, lies an open book. To her right, a vase with white lilies stands on the floor. The room has a brown wall and a tiled floor with light and dark squares. In the background, a window with open wooden shutters reveals a blue sky and distant landscape. Below the window, a wooden cabinet with a white cloth on top holds a small, ornate shrine with a white figure inside. To the right of the cabinet, a small white dove with a golden halo of light hovers in the air. Further right, a large red four-poster bed with draped fabric is visible. A small framed picture hangs on the wall above the bed. A golden chandelier hangs from the ceiling.

alt_text: A triptych painting depicts the crucifixion of Christ in the center, flanked by saints and monks in landscapes
long_description: A triptych painting features three panels with arched gold frames, set against a dark background. The central panel shows Jesus crucified on a wooden cross, wearing a white loincloth, with a plaque above his head inscribed "INRI". Below the cross, a skull and bones rest on the ground. To the left of the cross, a woman in a blue robe with a white veil bows her head, her hands clasped. To the right, a man in a red and blue robe looks up at Christ, while another man in a dark robe kneels at the base of the cross. A woman in a flowing red-orange robe stands to the far right, gesturing with her hands. The background of the central panel is a vast landscape with rolling green hills, distant buildings, and rocky outcrops under a blue sky. The left panel depicts two standing figures. A man with a beard, wearing a red cloak, holds a white lamb. Next to him, a woman in a green and gold patterned dress holds a staff topped with a cross. A large wooden wheel lies on the ground in front of them. The background is a green, hilly landscape with trees and a blue sky. The right panel shows two standing monks. The monk on the left wears a light grey robe and holds a golden chalice containing a small white figure. The monk on the right wears a dark brown robe and holds a golden paten. This panel also features a green, hilly landscape with distant mountains under a blue sky.

metadata.title: The Crucifixion with Saints and a Donor

alt_text: A woman breastfeeds a baby while an older woman observes, with a still life on a table.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts three figures and a still life on a green tabletop against a dark background. In the center, a fair-skinned woman with reddish-brown hair, covered by a sheer white veil, wears a teal dress and a red cloak lined with fur. She looks down, exposing her right breast to a naked, fair-skinned baby with light blonde hair, who is latched on. The baby holds a small orange fruit in his left hand. The woman's left hand supports the baby, while her right hand is near her breast. To the left, an older woman with a wrinkled face and a dark hooded garment looks towards the breastfeeding pair. She holds a pair of spectacles in her left hand and points with her right hand to a rolled-up scroll. The scroll displays Latin text: "Ecce ancilla domini fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum," and a small red figure. Behind the older woman, a window opens to a blue sky with white clouds. On the dark wall to the right, a small wooden shelf holds a light-colored box and a dark bottle, with a fan-shaped brush hanging below. On the green tabletop in the foreground, a clear glass goblet filled with red liquid sits on the left. In the center, a silver knife with a gold handle lies next to a whole walnut and a cracked walnut. On the right, a dark plate holds a cluster of green grapes, red cherries, a pear, a small apple, and a split pomegranate revealing its red seeds.

alt_text: Christ in a red robe on clouds, surrounded by angels and saints, presides over a multitude of figures on earth
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a multi-figure scene divided into an upper heavenly realm and a lower earthly realm. In the upper center, a bare-chested male figure with long brown hair and a red drapery around his waist and over one shoulder stands on a cloud, arms outstretched, with a bright, glowing halo behind his head. Numerous small, winged cherubs surround him. To his left, a group of robed figures, including a man with a blue garment, are seated on clouds, looking towards the central figure. To his right, another group of robed figures also sits on clouds, observing the central figure. Below the central figure, two larger winged angels are positioned on clouds. The angel on the left, dressed in purple and green, holds a long, golden, curved horn. The angel on the right, in yellow and brown robes, holds an open book. The lower half of the painting shows a green landscape populated by a large multitude of nude figures. In the mid-ground, two long lines of standing nude figures face each other, extending towards the horizon. Between these lines, a few smaller winged angels fly, some holding spears or trumpets. In the foreground, several nude and partially draped figures are scattered across the green ground. Some are kneeling, some are lying down, and others are in various poses of distress or supplication, with some reaching upwards or covering their faces. White drapery is loosely wrapped around the hips or shoulders of some of these foreground figures. The overall color palette includes blues and grays for the sky and clouds, vibrant reds and yellows for the heavenly figures' drapery, and earthy tones for the multitude.

alt_text: A woman in blue and white holds a baby, who holds an apple, against a detailed landscape background.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a baby, seated before a detailed landscape. The woman, positioned slightly left of center, has reddish-blonde hair visible beneath a white head covering that drapes over her shoulders. She wears a dark blue garment with a brown fur-lined sleeve on her right arm. Her gaze is directed downwards and to the right. She cradles a sleeping baby in her left arm. The baby has pale skin, light reddish-blonde curly hair, and wears a red beaded necklace. He holds a small, round, reddish-yellow apple in his right hand and is partially covered by a white cloth. Behind the figures, a vast landscape unfolds under a blue sky with white clouds. On the left, green hills rise, topped by a fortified town or castle, a windmill, and scattered houses around a small pond. On the right, more distant hills frame a large body of water, with a town and a prominent building with a red roof visible on its far shore. In the lower foreground, a dark surface holds several objects. An open book rests on a draped red cloth. The book's pages display black text with some red and blue illuminated letters, and a small framed image is on the left page. The woman's right index finger points to the right page of the book. To the left of the book, a silver-colored, ornate bowl contains a cluster of green grapes, a pear, and a split pomegranate. A tall, stemmed glass filled with red liquid stands to the far left. To the right of the book, a half-peeled lemon, a small knife, and a walnut shell are arranged on the dark surface.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a bearded man in a feathered hat and red doublet, holding a small golden object
long_description: The painting depicts a half-length portrait of a man against a plain, dark green background. The man is positioned slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned to look towards the viewer's left. He has light skin, a dark brown beard and mustache, and short dark hair visible beneath his hat. His eyes are dark, and his nose is prominent. He wears a dark, flat cap adorned with a white feather on the left side and small, colorful jewels or beads around the brim. His attire includes a rich red doublet with vertical white slashes, revealing a white garment underneath. A dark fur collar is visible around his neck and shoulders. His sleeves are dark, possibly black or dark blue, and are decorated with rows of small, round, green or blue jewels. White ruffled cuffs are visible at his wrists. His left hand, positioned on the viewer's right, is open with the palm facing upwards, fingers slightly curled. His right hand, on the viewer's left, holds a small, ornate, spherical golden object, possibly a locket or a watch, from which a dark chain hangs. The overall lighting highlights his face and hands against the darker background and clothing.

metadata.title: Francis I (1494–1547), King of France
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A woman breastfeeds a baby, while a man in glasses reads a book, with fruit on a table.
long_description: The painting depicts three figures and a still life arrangement on a table, set against a plain green background. In the center, a woman with fair skin and light reddish-brown hair, covered by a white headscarf, looks down at a baby she holds. She wears a dark blue dress with a voluminous red cloak draped over her shoulders and lap. The baby, with fair skin and light reddish-brown hair, is nude and actively breastfeeding from her exposed breast. The baby's left arm is raised towards the woman's chest. To the left, partially obscured by the woman and baby, an older man with fair skin, round glasses, and a straw hat is visible. He wears a dark blue tunic and is engrossed in reading an open book resting on a dark wooden stand. In the foreground, a light gray, textured table surface extends across the bottom of the painting. On the left side of the table, a small clear glass vase holds a plant with dark green leaves and small white flowers. To the right of the plant, a silver knife with a dark handle lies next to a half-cut orange and a small, curved piece of orange peel. Further right, two red cherries on a stem are placed on the table, with the woman's right hand gently holding another cherry. Her hand emerges from a dark sleeve with a brown fur cuff. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the figures and objects.

alt_text: A group of five figures, including a mother and baby, gathered in a dark setting, illuminated by a candle
long_description: The painting depicts five figures closely gathered in a dark, intimate setting, illuminated by a single light source. At the center, a fair-skinned baby lies on a white cloth, looking upwards with an open mouth and hands clasped together. Below the baby, a woman with fair skin, dark hair, and a serene expression looks down at the infant. She wears a white garment with a dark teal drape over her head and shoulders, and her chest is exposed. Her left hand supports the baby, while her right hand is near her breast. To the right of the woman and baby, a bearded man with a warm, gentle expression holds a lit candle in his right hand, casting a warm glow on the scene. He also holds a small, light-colored bowl in his left hand. He wears a dark, simple garment and looks towards the baby. To the left, a young man wearing a straw hat and a reddish-brown garment leans in, his face illuminated as he gazes at the baby. Behind him, another young man with dark hair is partially visible in the upper center, looking towards the baby and appearing to hold something that emits small, bright sparks. The figures are tightly composed, with strong contrasts between the illuminated faces and the deep, dark background, emphasizing the central group.

metadata.title: The Holy Family with Shepherds
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A group of seven figures, including two babies and a lamb, gathered around a central woman holding an infant.
long_description: The painting depicts a gathering of seven figures, including two infants, against a dark, indistinct background. In the center, a woman with dark hair, wearing a red cloak over a dark garment and a white head covering, holds a fair-haired baby dressed in a white tunic, exposing his lower body. The baby looks down and slightly to the left. To the left of this central pair, another fair-haired baby, completely nude, sits astride a light brown lamb. This baby extends his right hand towards the first baby's hand. Behind the lamb, a woman in a dark blue cloak and head covering looks towards the babies. To her left, an older man with a white beard and a golden cloak looks towards the babies, his hand near his chin. Behind him, a younger woman with dark hair looks on. To the right of the central woman, an older man with a long white beard and dark clothing rests his chin on his hand, looking down. In the upper right background, a large, light brown woven basket is visible. In the lower foreground, a dark, round vessel with a small, light-colored object inside sits on a dark surface. Below this, a decorative cartouche with two small, pale, cherubic heads on either side displays the inscription: "RADIX SANTA ET RAM. 9. Iohn. 11-12." The overall palette is rich with deep reds, blues, and browns, contrasted by the pale skin tones of the babies and the white garments.

metadata.title: The Holy Family with Saint Anne and the Young Baptist and His Parents

alt_text: A group of people gathered around a table in an interior, with a man pouring water into large jars.
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with several figures gathered around a rectangular table. The room features architectural elements, including a series of golden-brown columns on the left side, opening to a glimpse of a green landscape and a figure partially visible behind a column. In the foreground, on the left, a small potted plant sits in a decorative urn. At the table, a man with dark hair and a beard, dressed in a dark green robe, sits on a wooden stool on the left, raising his right hand with two fingers extended. Beside him, a woman with a white veil covering her head and a dark robe clasps her hands together. To their right, two younger figures, one in a pink robe and another in a light brown garment, sit at the table, looking towards the right. The table is covered with a white cloth, on which a small dark rectangular object and a round, flat, light brown object resembling bread are placed. A small, dark, lidded container sits near the center of the table. On the right side of the table, a man in a red and white garment pours liquid from a light brown pitcher into one of several large, light brown earthenware jars arranged on the tiled floor in the foreground. Behind him, other figures are partially visible. The background wall features a large, dark green tapestry with a gold border, centered with a round, convex mirror reflecting light. Above the tapestry, a wooden ceiling with beams is visible. The floor is tiled in a light, checkered pattern.

alt_text: An angel with a cross-staff and shield stands over a dragon, next to a friar with open, marked hands.
long_description: A vertical rectangular panel features two figures against a gold background. On the left, an angel with light skin, brown curly hair, and large blue-grey wings wears a light blue robe. The angel holds a long staff topped with a cross in their right hand and a red and black shield in their left. They stand over a dark grey dragon with red claws and a long tail, which lies on the ground with its head turned upwards towards the angel's shield. Below the angel, a white scroll with black text reads "SANT MIQUEL". On the right, a male figure, a friar, stands facing forward with both hands raised, palms open. He has short brown hair, a light complexion, and wears a dark brown hooded robe with a rope belt. Small red marks are visible on his hands and feet, and a small red oval shape is on his chest. Behind him, two faint vertical gold columns frame him. Below the friar, a white scroll with black text reads "SANT FRANCISO". The entire background is gold, and a thin dark border frames the panel.

alt_text: A painting depicts the Adoration of the Magi, with Mary and Child receiving gifts from three kings and their attendants.
long_description:
The painting depicts a scene with multiple figures in an interior setting, rendered in muted, earthy tones. On the right side, a woman with light skin, dressed in a blue undergarment and a flowing white cloak, sits on a red-draped bed or bench. She holds a nude infant with light skin in her lap, looking down at him. Behind her, to the far right, an older man with a beard, wearing a brown robe, stands with his hands raised.

In the center foreground, a man with light skin, wearing a long, flowing red robe, kneels on one knee, presenting a small, ornate object to the infant. To his left, another man with light skin stands, dressed in a dark robe with blue and brown sections, holding a clear, spherical object. To the far left, a third man with light skin stands, wearing a green tunic, a red and blue cloak, and dark leggings, holding a red hat in his left hand and a golden chalice in his right. A dark-skinned attendant kneels before him, holding a small golden object. Behind these figures, a group of men with various head coverings are visible. A small white dog stands near the kneeling attendant.

The background features architectural elements like columns and arches, with hints of a distant, rocky landscape on the left. On the floor in the foreground, a blue crown with gold details rests near the kneeling king, and a small, dark wooden stool with a few indistinct objects sits on the far right. The overall lighting is dim, casting soft shadows.

alt_text: Still life painting featuring fruit, a glass, and a bowl on a dark table against a black background
long_description: A vertical still life painting depicts various objects arranged on a dark wooden table against an almost black background. In the lower-left quadrant, a large, pale pink, textured fruit with two green-brown leaves on a stem rests in a shallow, dark metal bowl. Smaller, lighter-colored fruits are partially visible beside it. A segment of a citrus fruit and a long, spiraling peel of a yellow citrus fruit are also in the bowl, with the peel draped over the edge onto the table. Behind this, a smaller, blue and white marbled bowl is tilted, revealing its patterned interior. To the right of the fruit bowl, a tall, slender clear glass stands, and behind it, a wider, ornate gold or brass goblet filled with a dark liquid and small red berries is visible. A smaller, reddish-pink stemmed glass is positioned between the fruit bowl and the goblet. The objects are arranged on a dark, possibly silver, tray with a decorative edge, which sits on the wooden table. To the far left, a richly patterned, dark fabric with shades of brown, red, and gold is draped, partially obscuring the table's edge. The lighting is dim, with highlights on the fruit, glass, and metal objects, creating a dramatic contrast with the dark background.

metadata.title: Still Life with Fruit, Glassware, and a Wanli Bowl

alt_text: A dimly lit interior shows a woman preparing vegetables, with a pumpkin and greens on the floor.
long_description: The painting depicts a dimly lit, rustic interior scene, likely a kitchen or a humble dwelling. In the center-right, a woman is seated, facing slightly left, her head covered with a light-colored cloth. She wears dark clothing and holds a reddish-brown bowl in her lap, appearing to be preparing food. To her immediate left is a wooden bench or table, on which a light-colored bowl filled with what appears to be peeled vegetables or potatoes rests. On the floor in the foreground, a variety of vegetables are arranged. A large, round orange pumpkin sits prominently to the left of the woman's feet. To its right is a large bundle of long, slender green leafy vegetables, possibly leeks or asparagus, tied together. Further to the right, two lighter green, elongated vegetables, resembling cucumbers or gourds, lie on the floor. A broken piece of an orange object is also visible near the pumpkin. In the darker background to the left, a faint, indistinct figure is visible, possibly seated or bent over, near a large, light-colored sack or pile of cloth. The background behind the central woman features a dark, recessed area, possibly a fireplace or hearth, with a round, reflective object hanging on the wall above it. The overall color palette is dominated by deep browns, dark greens, and muted oranges, with highlights on the woman's face, her head covering, and the foreground vegetables. The light source appears to be from the right, casting the scene in a soft, low glow.

alt_text: A family portrait featuring a woman in blue, a man in red, a baby, and two dogs in an ornate room
long_description: A full-length oil painting depicts a family group in an opulent interior. In the center, a baby, mostly nude, sits on a plush, gold-trimmed cushion, reaching its right hand towards the man. To the left, a woman sits on a bed or chaise lounge, wearing a voluminous blue gown with gold trim and white sleeves. Her brown hair is styled high with white feathers, and she looks directly at the viewer, her left hand supporting the baby. To the right, a man sits on the edge of the same furniture, dressed in a red suit with a white ruffled collar and cuffs, white stockings, and dark shoes with buckles. He gazes down at the baby, his right hand extended. On the floor in the lower right, two small dogs are present; one, predominantly white with brown patches, sits upright and looks forward, while a smaller, brown dog lies behind it. The background features a large green draped column behind the man, a light gray wall with decorative molding to the left, and a frieze with classical figures in relief above. A large gold urn is partially visible on the far right.

metadata.title: Edward Smith Stanley (1752–1834), Twelfth Earl of Derby, Elizabeth, Countess of Derby (Lady Elizabeth Hamilton, 1753–1797), and Their Son (Edward Smith Stanley, 1775–1851)

alt_text: A classical painting depicting several figures, mostly women, in a lush landscape, with one woman gesturing.
long_description: The painting depicts a group of eight figures in a classical landscape setting. In the center, a woman dressed in a flowing white gown with a red sash sits on a low bench, extending her right arm with an open palm towards the left. Her gaze is directed slightly to the left. To her right, a bearded older man in a dark robe sits at a small, ornate table laden with golden vessels. Next to him, a younger man in a yellow tunic is seated, leaning his head on his hand, appearing pensive or weary. To the far right, another woman in a light yellow gown with a blue sash stands, holding a basket of colorful fruits and flowers towards the seated young man. In the foreground, near the bottom right, a golden jug and a shallow dish rest on the ground. On the left side of the composition, three women are gathered. One woman, partially nude with a light drape, holds a lyre. Another woman, seated, wears a light brown dress. In the lower left, a woman in a blue and white dress kneels, pouring water from a golden ewer into a shallow basin on the ground. The background features a verdant landscape with trees, distant hills, and a cloudy sky. A large rock formation is visible behind the central figures on the right. The ground is covered in green grass.

alt_text: Seven figures in classical attire interact in a rocky landscape with a distant sea and sunset sky
long_description: The painting presents seven figures in a natural landscape, divided into two main groups. On the left, a woman in a white and pink flowing gown with a sheer veil stands beside an older, bearded man dressed in a brown hooded robe. The woman's right arm is raised, and she looks towards the right. The man, with a long white beard, gestures with his left hand, also looking right. Behind them, a calm blue sea stretches to a horizon under a sky transitioning from light blue to soft pink and orange hues, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The foreground on the left features dark, low-lying hills. The right side of the composition features five figures gathered near a large, light brown rocky outcrop that dominates the upper right quadrant. A woman in a pink dress holds a basket filled with colorful fruits, looking down at a young man seated on the ground. This young man, dressed in a brown tunic, looks up towards a woman in a light yellow dress who holds a long, colorful garland of flowers, extending it towards him. Behind the woman in pink, another woman in a light blue dress holds a golden cup. To the far right, a fifth woman, also in a light yellow dress, stands and holds the other end of the flower garland. The ground beneath the figures is a mix of green and brown earth with scattered small rocks.

metadata.title: Telemachus and the Nymphs of Calypso

alt_text: A black and white painting depicts tall, dark cypress trees framing a path next to a light-colored building.
long_description: A black and white painting shows a sunlit landscape featuring a building, tall trees, and a path. In the center, three very tall, dark, slender trees, likely cypresses, dominate the composition, extending almost to the top edge. Their dense foliage appears nearly black against the lighter sky. A narrow, bright gap separates the two central trees, revealing a lighter background beyond. To the right, a light-colored, two-story building with a dark, overhanging roof occupies the right side of the frame. A small circular opening is visible near the roofline, with two rectangular, dark-shuttered windows stacked vertically below it. A third, smaller rectangular opening is positioned lower down. At the base of the building, a dense, light-toned flowering bush with numerous small blossoms grows, casting a shadow. A path, lighter in tone, begins in the lower right and curves slightly left, leading towards the gap between the central trees. A strong, dark shadow from the trees or building falls across the lower left and central parts of the path. To the left of the central trees, a smaller, bushier tree is visible, and behind it, a structure with a slatted, open roof, possibly a pergola or trellis, is partially obscured by foliage. The ground in the lower left is grassy and shadowed.

alt_text: A large painting depicts a luminous heavenly realm above a chaotic earthly scene with soldiers, a procession, and kneeling figures.
long_description: The painting, presented within an arched frame, depicts a dramatic, multi-figure scene divided into two distinct horizontal realms. The upper realm is dominated by a brilliant, golden-yellow light, from which several ethereal, glowing figures emerge. A central, robed figure with outstretched arms is the brightest, surrounded by other figures, some standing, some kneeling, all appearing translucent against the intense light. Below this celestial vision, the earthly realm unfolds with a complex array of figures and actions. In the center, on a slightly elevated, light-bathed mound, a procession of five figures in long white robes carries a golden, ornate reliquary or casket. To the left of this procession, a chaotic battle scene is depicted, with soldiers on horseback and on foot engaged in combat. One soldier on a white horse raises a sword over a figure on the ground, while another figure in white is being pulled or carried amidst the struggle. To the right, another group of soldiers on horseback, some with banners, appears to be observing or advancing. In the foreground, numerous figures are scattered across the uneven, earthy ground. Many are kneeling with arms outstretched towards the central light and procession, appearing to worship or plead. Others lie fallen, possibly dead or wounded, surrounded by discarded weapons and shields. The background of the earthly scene shows distant hills under a pale sky.

alt_text: A young girl sits on the floor, intently making lace, with a lace pillow on a chair and a cat nearby.
long_description: A painting depicts a young girl seated on the floor, engaged in lacemaking, against a dark, indistinct background. She is positioned towards the left, looking down at her work. The girl wears a mustard yellow long-sleeved garment and a light blue skirt or drapery covering her lap. A white cloth is wrapped around her head, and a small red beaded necklace adorns her neck. Her hands are focused on a small, light-colored object, possibly a bobbin, with white thread extending from it. In front of her, on the floor, is a brown, textured object, and to her left, a ball of white yarn. To the girl's right, a round, white lace pillow, covered with numerous small, dark bobbins, rests on a simple wooden chair with a woven seat. Further to the right, a dark grey cat with a white chest stands on the floor, looking towards the girl. The background is predominantly dark brown, with lighter, cloud-like shapes visible in the upper right corner behind the chair and cat.

alt_text: Dramatic mountain landscape with a cascading waterfall, sun rays breaking through stormy clouds, and birds.
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic, expansive mountain landscape under a dynamic sky. The upper portion of the canvas is dominated by dark, stormy clouds, with a bright burst of light emanating from the upper left-center, casting distinct sun rays diagonally downwards across the scene. Several small, dark birds are silhouetted against the sky. On the far left, tall, light-colored, jagged mountain peaks rise steeply, their surfaces showing variations of grey, brown, and pale blue. A winding, narrow path is visible on a lower, verdant ridge that extends towards the center. The mid-ground reveals a valley or body of water, with distant, hazy mountains beyond. The right side of the composition features a massive, dark, rugged mountain face covered in dense green and brown foliage. A prominent waterfall cascades down this mountain, its white water creating a frothy splash at the bottom, where dark rocks and sparse vegetation are visible. Several fallen tree trunks, stripped of most branches, lie across the mountain slopes, one notably in the mid-ground pointing towards the sun rays. The immediate foreground is dark, composed of shadowed rocks and patches of green and brown undergrowth. The overall palette is earthy, with deep greens, browns, and greys contrasted by the bright sky.

metadata.title: A Mountainous Landscape with a Waterfall

alt_text: A man in black holding a lute stands next to a young girl in a dark dress in an interior room.
long_description: A full-length portrait painting depicts a man and a young girl in a dimly lit interior room. The man, positioned on the left, is dressed in black attire, including a wide-brimmed hat, a ruffled white collar, and a dark cloak draped over his left shoulder. He has a light complexion, a small mustache, and dark hair. He holds a light brown, ribbed lute vertically in his left hand, resting its base on a dark table. His right hand is extended slightly forward. He wears black breeches and stockings, with black shoes. His gaze is directed slightly to the right of the viewer. To the right of the man stands a young girl, appearing much smaller. She wears a dark, patterned dress with green accents, a white ruffled collar, and white cuffs. Her light brown hair is pulled back, and she has a pale complexion. She holds a small, white, fluffy object in her left hand. Her expression is neutral, and she looks directly forward. The background is a muted gray wall with architectural details on the right, including a decorative molding above a doorway. A dark wooden chair is visible behind the man. The floor is a light brown and white patterned tile. Another dark stringed instrument, possibly a viol, lies on the floor in the lower left corner. The lighting comes from the left, casting soft shadows.

alt_text: A full-length portrait painting of a young girl in a white ruffled dress with floral embroidery, against a purple and patterned background.
long_description: The painting depicts a young girl standing centrally, facing forward, against a vibrant, patterned background. She has light skin and long, light brown hair parted in the middle, falling over her shoulders. A light blue, ruffled bow is tied in her hair on the right side of her head. Her eyes are light, and her mouth is small. She wears a white, short-sleeved dress with a high neckline. The bodice of the dress is adorned with a horizontal band of colorful embroidered flowers, including pink, red, yellow, and purple roses. The skirt of the dress is full and features multiple horizontal ruffles, with a few small, colorful floral motifs scattered on its surface. Her arms are bent at the elbows, with her hands placed on her hips, though her left hand is mostly obscured by her body. She wears light-colored shoes. The upper half of the background is a textured, mottled purple, dotted with small, light-colored flowers. The lower half, representing the floor, is a light cream color with an array of abstract shapes and patterns in various colors, including pink, green, blue, and yellow, some resembling flowers or small objects. A wavy blue and white pattern runs along the very bottom edge of the painting. The artist's signature "GUSTAV KLIMT" is visible in the lower right corner.

alt_text: A full-length portrait painting of a woman with dark hair wearing a flowing, pale dress against a light, hazy background.
long_description: This vertical, full-length portrait depicts a woman standing centrally, facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. She has fair skin, dark eyes, dark eyebrows, and rosy cheeks, with a gentle smile on her small, red lips. Her dark, curly hair is styled upwards, and she wears small, dark earrings. She is dressed in a long, floor-length gown that appears white or a very pale blue-grey. The dress features sheer, flowing fabric with subtle vertical, wavy lines, a ruffled or lacy detail around the neckline, and long, slightly puffed sleeves. Her hands are indistinct, resting in front of her. The background is a soft, hazy, light brown or beige, uniform in color, creating a shallow depth behind the figure. A small, dark signature "GUSTAV KLIMT" is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A young girl in a white dress and lace cap sits at a wooden table, holding a playing card.
long_description: The painting depicts a young girl seated at a wooden table, facing directly forward with a slight smile. She has light skin, rosy cheeks, and dark brown hair that curls around her face, partially covered by a white lace cap with a ruffled edge. Her eyes are dark and look straight ahead. She wears a long-sleeved white dress with ruffles at the neckline and cuffs, the fabric appearing soft and flowing, gathered in her lap. Her left arm rests on the table, and she holds a playing card, a "two of hearts," with a red heart symbol visible on its white surface. Her right hand rests gently on the table near a small, light-colored rectangular box. This box has a dark blue or black clover symbol on its visible side. Another playing card, also a "two of hearts," lies flat on the table to the left of the box. The wooden table is a warm brown, and a dark brown wooden chair back is visible behind her right side. The background is a plain, dark gray-brown, providing a stark contrast to the girl's light dress and skin. The lighting appears to come from the front, illuminating her face and the objects on the table.

metadata.title: Girl Building a House of Cards

alt_text: A formal portrait of a young man in a teal coat and red drapery, standing before a landscape
long_description: A formal, full-length portrait depicts a young man with fair skin and dark, curly hair, looking directly forward. He wears a teal-colored, long-sleeved coat with a high, ruffled white collar and matching ruffled cuffs. A dark, thin strap crosses diagonally from his right shoulder to his left hip. A voluminous, bright red drapery is wrapped around his body, flowing over his left shoulder and around his waist, obscuring part of his left arm and his lower body. His left hand rests gently on a dark, rectangular plinth or ledge to his left. His right hand is placed on his hip, partially covered by the red fabric. The background on the left features a light blue sky with a large, light brown tree trunk and some green foliage. To the right of the tree, a dark, vertical architectural element, possibly a column, is visible. The rest of the background on the right is a plain, dark brown or gray.

metadata.title: Charles Beauclerk (1670–1726), Duke of St. Albans

alt_text: A painted portrait of a woman with brown hair, wearing a green dress with a white ruffled neckline, against a brown background
long_description: The image is a painted, bust-length portrait of a woman, presented within an oval format against a rectangular canvas. The woman is positioned slightly off-center, facing forward with a direct gaze. She has fair skin, dark eyes, and small, slightly parted red lips. Her light brown hair is styled in soft, voluminous curls, pulled up and away from her face. She wears a dress that appears to be a muted olive green or yellowish-green, with a low, wide neckline. The neckline is trimmed with a white, ruffled fabric that creates a soft, frothy edge. A piece of reddish-brown drapery is visible over her right shoulder, flowing down her side. The background is a plain, warm brown color, darker towards the edges of the oval and slightly lighter around the woman's head and shoulders, creating a subtle halo effect. The overall impression is of an oil painting, with visible brushstrokes, and the outer edges of the rectangular canvas are dark brown, suggesting a simple frame or border.

alt_text: A painted portrait shows a young man with dark curly hair wearing a dark military uniform.
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a young man, positioned centrally and facing directly forward. He has light skin, blue eyes, a straight nose, and full, reddish lips. His cheeks show a subtle flush of red. His dark brown hair is curly and styled to frame his face, reaching just above his ears. He wears a dark blue military-style jacket with a high, stiff collar trimmed in red. Gold epaulets with horizontal stripes and a small gold button are visible on each shoulder. The jacket features several gold buttons down the front. Underneath, he wears a white collared shirt and a black cravat tied neatly around his neck. The background is a solid, dark reddish-brown color, providing a stark contrast to the figure.

metadata.title: Valdemar Hjartvar Købke (1813–1893), the Artist's Brother

alt_text: A winter landscape painting shows people ice skating on a frozen river and walking on a snowy path near buildings.
long_description: This painting depicts a serene winter landscape under an overcast sky. The upper portion of the canvas is dominated by a cloudy sky, featuring a mix of light blue and various shades of gray, with some darker, heavier clouds suggesting a cold atmosphere. In the foreground on the left, a snow-covered path winds from the lower left corner towards the middle ground. Two figures, dressed in dark winter attire, walk along this path. To their left, a dense cluster of trees, mostly bare with dark branches, stands tall, interspersed with a few evergreen trees that retain their green foliage, all lightly dusted with snow. A large, cut log lies horizontally across the snowy path in the immediate foreground. The path opens up to a wide, frozen body of water, likely a river or pond, which occupies the central and right portions of the midground. Several small figures are engaged in activities on the ice; some appear to be ice skating, while others stand or sit. In the foreground of the ice, a group of three figures, possibly a family, are seen together. On the far bank of the frozen water, a collection of buildings with snow-covered roofs is visible. A prominent structure features a large, square tower, while another smaller building with a conical roof and tower stands further to the right. A stone bridge with multiple arches spans the water, connecting the banks. The buildings and banks are surrounded by more bare trees and some evergreens, all covered in a layer of white snow. The overall scene is rendered with muted colors, emphasizing the cold, quiet beauty of winter.

alt_text: A landscape painting depicts a path with figures leading to a castle town by a river, under a warm, cloudy sky
long_description: The painting presents a wide landscape under a warm, cloudy sky. The upper portion of the canvas is dominated by a sky transitioning from light blue at the top to soft orange and yellow hues near the horizon, with scattered, fluffy clouds. Several small, dark birds are visible against the sky. In the left foreground, a large, dark-leaved tree with a thick trunk and branches fills a significant portion of the left side, casting shadows. A winding dirt path emerges from the lower left corner, moving towards the center. Along this path, several small figures are depicted, some on horseback and others walking, appearing to travel towards the distant town. The midground features a prominent, light brown stone castle or large building with a tall, square tower, situated on a rise and surrounded by dense green foliage. Beyond this central structure, a sprawling town with various buildings and rooftops extends across the middle of the painting, partially obscured by trees and a soft atmospheric haze. In the background, a range of mountains appears in muted blue and gray tones. To the right, another large tree with lighter green foliage stands on a rocky outcrop, framing the view. Below it, a body of water, possibly a river or lake, reflects the sky's light. Several small boats are visible on the water, and the far bank is lined with more trees and distant structures. The overall lighting suggests either sunrise or sunset, with warm light illuminating the clouds and distant landscape, while the foreground remains in deeper shadow.

alt_text: A woman with a child, a man, and a scribe in a richly decorated interior with a dog
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with four human figures and a dog. On the left, a man with dark hair and a dark red tunic leans on a light-colored wooden bench, looking upwards and to the right with his chin resting on his hand. Below him, a woman in a long purple gown with gold trim sits on the same bench, holding a small child dressed in white with red accents. The woman looks forward, while the child points towards the lower right. In the foreground, a dark-colored dog sits on the light-tiled floor, looking up at the child, with a small ball nearby. To the right, a man in a black tunic and a red cap sits on a stool, leaning over a large red wooden desk. He holds a pen in his right hand and appears to be writing or drawing on a large book or scroll. The desk is intricately carved with a gold and red crest featuring a figure on horseback. Behind him, a small wooden table covered with a white cloth holds a silver pitcher, a plate of fruit, and a folded white cloth. The background features richly decorated walls with green and gold patterned tapestries and wooden paneling. An arched doorway is visible in the center background, and to the far right, a small shelf with books and a decorative shrine-like structure are visible. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the figures and the detailed interior. The artist's signature "G. Keller" is visible in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: Hugo van der Goes Making a Portrait of Mary of Burgundy

alt_text: A wide landscape painting with a cloudy sky over a valley, river, and rolling hills
long_description: The painting depicts a vast, expansive landscape under a dramatic sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by large, billowy clouds, rendered in shades of white, grey, and light brown, with patches of bright blue sky visible between them, particularly towards the upper left. Below the sky, a wide, flat valley stretches across the midground, extending towards a hazy horizon. A dark, winding river or body of water flows horizontally through the center of this valley, reflecting some light from the sky. On either side of the river, the landscape is a patchwork of green and brown fields, dotted with numerous dark green trees and clusters of small, light-colored buildings, suggesting distant villages or towns. In the far distance on the left, a range of dark, muted mountains or hills rises faintly against the horizon. The foreground features a rolling, grassy hillside that occupies the bottom third of the painting. A light brown dirt path curves from the lower right corner, winding upwards and to the left, disappearing over a gentle crest. The hillside is rendered with varying shades of green and brown, indicating areas of shadow and sunlight. Several small, light-colored figures, possibly sheep or people, are scattered on the path and the grassy slopes. Darker green trees and bushes are visible on the lower right and left edges of the foreground. The overall palette is natural and subdued, emphasizing the atmospheric quality of the scene.

metadata.title: A Panoramic Landscape with a Country Estate

alt_text: A wide landscape painting shows a river winding through a valley with hills, trees, and a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting depicts a vast, expansive landscape under a dramatic sky filled with large, billowy clouds. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by a light blue sky with numerous white and grey clouds, some appearing dark and heavy, others bright and fluffy. In the foreground, to the left, a cluster of tall, leafy green trees stands beside a winding dirt path that descends a grassy slope. On this path, two small figures in red and blue attire stand near the top of the slope. Further down, a person on a white horse is visible, and another figure sits on the ground nearby. Several white sheep graze on the green and brown slope. To the right of the path, a wide river flows from the middle distance towards the right foreground, its surface reflecting the sky in muted tones. A small boat with a blue flag is visible on the river in the mid-right. The midground features a broad, flat plain stretching across the canvas, characterized by a patchwork of green fields, scattered trees, and distant buildings. Low, undulating hills or mountains form the horizon line in the far background, appearing as a muted brown-green band beneath the cloudy sky.

alt_text: A wide landscape painting under a stormy sky, featuring a river, boats, a distant village, and farms with cows
long_description: A wide landscape painting depicts a flat, expansive scene under a dramatic, overcast sky. The sky, filled with heavy, dark gray and muted brown clouds, occupies the upper two-thirds of the canvas, suggesting impending weather. Below the horizon line, a distant, low-lying city or village with numerous buildings and a few visible spires stretches across the midground. A wide, calm river flows from the left foreground towards the right, reflecting the muted light. On the river, a single sailboat with a prominent white sail moves towards the right, while further to the right, several smaller, darker boats or structures are visible near the riverbank. The foreground features a rural landscape with fields of green and brown. On the right, two rustic farmhouses with thatched, reddish-brown roofs are nestled among trees. Several cows, mostly dark brown, are scattered in the fields near the farmhouses, some grazing and others resting. A small, dark mound of earth or hay is visible near the left edge of the foreground. The overall color palette is subdued, dominated by greens, browns, grays, and dark blues, with subtle variations in light and shadow.

alt_text: A dramatic sunset with a large dark cloud over a reflective body of water and a dark foreground
long_description:
The painting depicts a vast landscape at sunset or sunrise, dominated by warm hues of orange, red, and yellow. The upper two-thirds of the image are filled with the sky. A very large, dark, silhouetted cloud mass, appearing almost black, occupies the upper center, partially obscuring the sun. Smaller, elongated clouds are visible to the left and right of the main cloud, also silhouetted against the bright sky. The sky transitions from a lighter orange at the top to a deep red-orange near the horizon.

A small, intensely bright, yellow-orange circle, representing the sun, is positioned just above the horizon line, slightly to the left of the vertical center. It casts a strong, elongated reflection of bright yellow and orange light across the wide, horizontal band of water that stretches across the middle of the image. The rest of the water surface appears dark, a deep reddish-brown, mirroring the colors of the sky.

The bottom third of the image shows a dark, reddish-brown landmass. It appears mostly flat with subtle undulations. Several indistinct, dark, vertical shapes, resembling posts or small rock formations, are scattered across the land, particularly on the left and right sides of the sun's reflection. Sparse, low-lying, dark vegetation or small mounds are also visible, contributing to the overall impression of a vast, open landscape at dusk or dawn.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a young person with reddish-brown hair and a dark cap, looking left
long_description: A head-and-shoulders portrait painting depicts a young person with fair skin, light eyes, and reddish-brown hair, set against a dark, unadorned background. The subject's head is turned slightly to the viewer's left, and their gaze is directed off-canvas in the same direction. The face is illuminated, highlighting the features, while the rest of the figure and background are in deeper shadow. The person has a neutral expression, with full lips and a small, straight nose. Wavy, shoulder-length reddish-brown hair frames the face. A dark, possibly olive-green or dark brown, rounded cap covers the top of the head. The subject wears a loose, dark brown outer garment, possibly a cloak or coat, which drapes over the shoulders and upper chest. Beneath this, a lighter, possibly white or light grey, fabric is visible, draped diagonally across the chest. The brushstrokes are visible, particularly in the hair and clothing, giving the painting a textured appearance. The overall palette consists of warm earth tones for the figure and a deep, dark tone for the background.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Young Man; (reverse) Girl Making a Garland

alt_text: A group of figures looks up at a pair of bare feet and red drapery disappearing into clouds.
long_description: The painting depicts a group of figures looking upwards at a pair of bare feet and red drapery disappearing into clouds. The vertical panel is dominated by the figures in the lower two-thirds and the sky in the upper third. At the top, two bare feet, seen from below, are positioned centrally, partially obscured by white and light gray clouds. A swathe of red drapery billows around the feet, extending downwards and to the right. The background behind the clouds is a clear, light blue sky. Below, a tightly packed group of approximately twelve figures, mostly men, fills the lower portion of the panel. They are arranged in a semi-circular formation, all looking intently upwards towards the feet. Their faces are turned towards the sky, with mouths slightly open and eyes wide, conveying expressions of awe or wonder. In the foreground, two figures kneel. On the left, a man with a short beard and light brown hair, wearing a red outer robe over a yellow garment, kneels with his back mostly to the viewer, his head turned sharply upwards. To his right, a woman with a white head covering and a dark teal robe kneels, her hands slightly raised and open, also looking directly upwards. Behind these kneeling figures, a crowd of standing men is visible. They have varying hair and beard styles, mostly white or light brown. Their robes are in shades of pink, green, white, and brown. One prominent figure on the far right wears a white robe and has light brown, curly hair, looking up with an open mouth. Another man on the far left, with white hair and a pink robe, also looks upwards. The ground at the very bottom is a small strip of dark green and brown, with a few sparse, light green plants.

alt_text: A woman in classical attire plays a lute, looking right, with other instruments and architectural elements nearby.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated, holding a lute, in a setting that combines classical architecture with musical elements. She is positioned slightly left of center, facing right, with her head turned to look over her right shoulder. Her skin is fair, and her dark hair is styled with a light-colored band. She wears a flowing, draped garment: an orange-brown tunic over her left shoulder and chest, and a voluminous red cloak covering her lower body and right arm. Her left hand is on the strings of the lute, which rests on her lap. The lute is a large, pear-shaped instrument with a long, dark neck extending diagonally upwards to the right. To the left, behind the woman, are two large, fluted classical columns against a light blue-grey sky. A small brown bird perches on a dark, textured surface near the base of the left column. To the right, behind the woman's right arm, is a large wooden organ with vertical pipes visible. A light-barked tree with green leaves is seen through an opening in the architecture. On a wooden surface in the lower right, several other musical instruments are arranged: a violin or viola, a small wooden flute, and an open book of sheet music with visible notes and staves. Another piece of sheet music lies flat beneath the flute. The overall palette is rich with warm reds, browns, and ochres, contrasted with the cooler tones of the sky and architectural elements.

alt_text: A partially draped female figure and a child sit in a desolate, icy landscape under a reddish sun.
long_description: The painting depicts a desolate, wintery scene dominated by cool grays, blues, and browns, with a striking reddish-orange sun. In the center, a large, light-skinned female figure is partially draped in flowing white and gray fabric, her long, light-colored hair cascading over her shoulders. She is seated, looking upwards with her head tilted back, her right arm resting on her knee. To her right, a smaller, light-skinned, cherubic child figure sits beside her, holding a long staff or rod and looking downwards. Both figures rest on an elaborate, dark, ornate structure in the foreground, which features a grotesque, open-mouthed face at its base and is adorned with icicles. Bare, gnarled tree branches extend from the left and right sides of the composition, framing the figures. In the mid-ground to the left, a large, classical urn rests on a pedestal. The background consists of a hazy, cool-toned sky, with the prominent reddish-orange sun positioned slightly above and to the right of the central figures. The overall impression is one of coldness and starkness.

metadata.title: Allegory of Winter
metadata.artist: Jacques de La Joue the Younger

alt_text: Five figures in elaborate clothing, including a young man, a woman in a white head covering, and an older woman, interacting
long_description: The painting depicts five figures arranged in a horizontal composition against a plain, dark brown background. The figures are closely grouped, creating a sense of interaction. The central figure is a young man, seen from the waist up, facing slightly right with his gaze directed forward. He has reddish-brown curly hair and wears a black cap, a white collar over a pink and olive-green doublet, and a red sash tied around his waist. His left hand holds a string of blue and red beads, while his right hand is extended towards the right, palm up. To his immediate right stands a young woman, also seen from the waist up, with fair skin and a serene expression. She wears a white head covering that frames her face, a white lace collar, and a multi-colored garment with gold and blue patterns. Her left hand is open, palm up, near the young man's extended hand. Further to the right is an older woman, shown in profile facing left, with a wrinkled face and a white turban-like head covering. She wears a red robe and a richly patterned sash draped over her shoulder, featuring green, orange, and gold designs. Her right hand is open, palm up, near the young woman's hand. To the left of the central young man, two figures are partially visible. The leftmost figure, a woman, is seen in profile facing right, wearing an orange patterned head covering and a white embroidered sleeve. The figure next to her has long dark hair and is mostly obscured, wearing a patterned garment. The lighting highlights the figures' faces and the rich textures of their clothing. In the upper right corner, faint dark text is visible, which reads: "G. W. K. f. 1640."

alt_text: A woman in profile, holding a skull, illuminated by candlelight reflecting in a mirror
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated in a dimly lit interior, seen in profile facing right. She occupies the left half of the vertical composition. Her head is covered by a dark veil or hair, and she wears a loose-fitting white garment with wide sleeves, cinched at the waist by a red sash or drape that extends over her lap and legs. Her hands are clasped over a human skull resting on her lap or a surface in front of her. To the right of the woman, on a dark surface, stands an ornate, rectangular gold-framed mirror. The mirror reflects two lit candles, their flames appearing as elongated, bright vertical streaks against the dark background within the frame. One candle is visible on a dark, turned wooden candlestick directly in front of the mirror, while the other is only seen as a reflection. The overall lighting is dramatic, with a strong light source, likely the candles, illuminating the woman's face, hands, and the white fabric of her dress, creating deep shadows elsewhere. The background is almost entirely dark, with only faint hints of a wall or corner. In the lower right foreground, a few small, dark objects, possibly pieces of jewelry or chains, are scattered on the dark surface. The dominant colors are deep browns and blacks, contrasted by the bright white of the woman's dress, the red of her drape, and the golden glow of the candle flames and mirror frame.

alt_text: A woman in a blue dress paints at an easel while two women observe her work
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts three women in an interior setting. In the foreground, a woman is seated, facing forward, with her head turned slightly to her left, looking towards the viewer. She wears a voluminous light blue satin dress with a low neckline and ruffled sleeves. Her powdered hair is styled high, topped with a wide-brimmed straw hat adorned with blue ribbons and white feathers. She holds a wooden palette in her left hand and a paintbrush in her right, poised over a canvas on an easel to her left. A long, thin paintbrush rests across her lap. To her right, two women stand closely behind her, looking over her right shoulder towards the easel. The woman closest to the artist wears a light brown dress with a white ruffled collar and a sheer white veil over her hair. Her right arm is around the waist of the woman behind her, who is partially obscured and wears a light-colored, possibly fur-trimmed, garment. The background is dark and indistinct, suggesting an interior space. To the left of the easel, a white bust on a pedestal is visible in shadow. The floor is a light brown parquet pattern. On the floor near the artist's feet, a crumpled piece of white paper is visible. To the right, a small, dark red stool with a cushion holds a piece of white fabric and a pink ribbon. The painting is enclosed in an ornate gold frame with carved leaf patterns.

metadata.title: Self-Portrait with Two Pupils, Marie Gabrielle Capet (1761–1818) and Marie Marguerite Carreaux de Rosemond (died 1788)

alt_text: A woman in a chariot pulled by two horses, with a second woman scattering flowers from a basket
long_description: The painting depicts a dynamic scene with two female figures and two horses against a cloudy sky. In the upper left, a woman with long, dark, wavy hair is shown in profile, looking forward. She wears a golden, armored bodice and a voluminous red cloak that billows behind her, creating a large, bright red shape. Her left arm is extended, holding reins that lead to two horses. She stands in a dark, ornate chariot, partially visible. Two powerful horses, one dark brown and one white, are positioned centrally, rearing upwards. The brown horse is in the foreground, its head turned slightly to the right, with a dark bridle and decorative harness featuring gold medallions. The white horse is behind and to the right of the brown one, also rearing. Both horses have flowing manes and tails. Below the horses and slightly to the right, a second woman floats amidst clouds. She has light skin, light hair, and wears a pale blue or white flowing gown with an off-the-shoulder neckline. A pearl necklace adorns her neck, and a small golden crown or tiara sits on her head. She holds a dark basket filled with pink and white flowers in her left hand, while her right hand is raised, scattering smaller white flowers. Her legs and bare feet are visible, with a faint red mark on her left foot. The background consists of light, hazy clouds at the top, transitioning to darker, more defined clouds at the bottom.

alt_text: A chaotic painting depicts hunters on horseback and foot battling wolves and foxes in a dynamic outdoor scene.
long_description: The painting shows a dramatic and chaotic hunting scene set outdoors under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, a group of hunters, some on horseback and some on foot, are engaged in a fierce struggle with several wild animals. On the left, a man in a red tunic and brown hat, seen from behind, thrusts a spear towards a large brown wolf. Above him, another man with blond hair, dressed in black, rides a brown horse and also aims a spear downwards. In the center, multiple brown wolves are depicted in various stages of attack and defense, with one being speared. Several smaller, reddish-brown foxes are on the ground, some appearing dead or injured. To the right, a man with blond hair, wearing a green tunic and brown boots, rides a powerful white horse. He holds a sword in his right hand and looks towards the right. Behind him, a woman with blond hair, wearing a dark dress with a red skirt and a feathered hat, also rides a horse and looks in the same direction. In the mid-ground, other figures are visible, some wielding clubs. The background features a distant, flat landscape with scattered trees under a light blue and white sky, suggesting an open field. The overall composition is dynamic, with figures and animals intertwined in a violent encounter.

metadata.title: Copy after Rubens's "Wolf and Fox Hunt"

alt_text: A woman in a pink dress sits with a parrot, a dark-skinned figure, and classical elements in a garden setting
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a woman seated in an elaborate pink satin gown, positioned slightly left of center. She has fair skin, dark hair styled high with pink ribbons, and a gentle smile. Her left hand is extended forward, fingers splayed, appearing to release fine white strands or water. Her right hand rests on her lap, gently holding a fold of her voluminous pink skirt, which features gold embroidery along the hem. White lace trim adorns her sleeves, and a blue underskirt is visible beneath the pink.To the woman's left, a blue and yellow macaw parrot is perched on a dark stone ledge, its head turned towards her extended hand. Behind the parrot, a classical stone pedestal or fountain is adorned with green foliage and pink flowers. More pink flowers are visible on the ground in the lower left foreground.To the woman's right, behind her, the head and shoulders of a dark-skinned figure are visible. This figure wears a dark turban and looks towards the woman. Further back on the right, a faint, light-colored classical statue of a draped figure stands on a pedestal. The background on the left features a hazy, light-colored sky or distant landscape, while the right side is darker, with a large pink drapery behind the woman. The overall scene suggests an outdoor or garden setting with classical architectural elements.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman and an Enslaved Servant

alt_text: A formal portrait of a man in a white wig, silver armor, and a red velvet coat, holding a helmet.
long_description: The painting depicts a half-length portrait of a man with light skin, dark eyes, and small red lips, facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He wears a large, white powdered wig with tight curls framing his face and falling over his shoulders. A white ruffled cravat is visible at his neck. He is dressed in a silver breastplate with intricate gold trim and a red velvet coat with gold embroidery on the sleeves and along the front opening. A dark blue cloak, lined with brown fur, is draped over his left shoulder and arm. His right hand, with a white ruffled cuff, holds a gold helmet adorned with a star emblem, resting on a light brown, leopard-print fabric. A black feathered plume is tucked into his armor near his waist. The background on the left features a dark brown, angular structure and some dark green foliage. On the right, the sky transitions from dark brown to orange and light blue, with a distant, light-colored castle emitting smoke or clouds.

metadata.title: André François Alloys de Theys d'Herculais (1692–1779)

alt_text: A village with a prominent church tower sits along a riverbank under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting depicts a wide landscape scene featuring a village situated along a river under a cloudy sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by a vast sky filled with numerous grey and white clouds, with occasional glimpses of pale blue sky peeking through. Below the sky, a line of rolling green hills stretches across the middle ground, dotted with trees and small structures. At the base of these hills, a village extends horizontally. The most prominent building is a church, centrally located, with a light-colored, cylindrical tower topped by a conical, dark-colored roof and a small spire. Surrounding the church are various other buildings, mostly light-toned with reddish-brown roofs, clustered together. On the far left hill, a small, reddish, block-like structure is visible near the crest. The lower third of the painting is occupied by a wide river, its surface reflecting the sky and the village buildings. The water appears dark and calm, with subtle ripples. Along the near bank, tall, dark green reeds and grasses grow densely. On the far bank, between the village and the river, a narrow strip of green land is visible. Here, a few small figures are gathered, and a dark, four-legged animal stands near them. A small, dark boat is also visible close to the river's edge. The overall color palette is muted, with greens, browns, and greys dominating, accented by the lighter tones of the buildings and the sky.

alt_text: Two young children, one with red hair and rosy cheeks, the other with brown hair, in a circular portrait
long_description: This oil painting depicts two young children within a circular frame, set against a dark, indistinct background. The child on the left, appearing younger, has light reddish-blonde curly hair and prominent rosy cheeks. This child wears a loose, flowing white garment that exposes their bare legs and arms. Their left arm is bent, with the hand near their face, while their right hand is not fully visible. The child's gaze is directed slightly forward and to the right, with a soft expression. To the right, a slightly older child with dark brown curly hair looks towards the first child, their mouth slightly open as if speaking or listening. This child wears a white dress with a light blue sash around the waist and ruffled trim along the neckline. A delicate gold chain necklace with a small pendant hangs around their neck. Their right arm is raised, with the hand open and fingers spread, positioned near the top right edge of the frame. Both children are positioned closely together, with their bodies angled towards each other. Below them, folds of red and pink fabric are visible, suggesting they are seated on a cushioned surface. The background behind them is a muted dark blue and brown, with some lighter, cloud-like areas on the left.

metadata.title: The Calmady Children (Emily, 1818–?1906, and Laura Anne, 1820–1894)

alt_text: A full-length portrait painting of a woman in a white fur-trimmed gown, looking back over her shoulder in a landscape.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a full-length portrait of a woman standing in a landscape. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of center, with her body angled to the left, but her head turned to look over her left shoulder directly at the viewer. She has voluminous, light-colored, curly hair and a pale complexion with dark eyes and small red lips. She wears a long, flowing white gown, possibly made of satin or silk, which shimmers with light. A large, light brown fur-trimmed cloak or stole is draped over her shoulders and arms.
