Her right hand, covered by a brown glove, holds a small white object, possibly a flower or a fan, near her chest. A large, fluffy brown fur muff hangs from her left arm, adorned with a bright blue ribbon. The upper two-thirds of the background feature a dramatic blue-gray sky filled with large, white and gray clouds. The lower third shows a green landscape with trees on either side and in the mid-ground. A distant body of water or hazy horizon is visible between the trees on the left. The immediate foreground consists of green grass with scattered small, colorful flowers.

metadata.title: Elizabeth Farren (born about 1759, died 1829), Later Countess of Derby

alt_text: A formal portrait of an older man with white hair, wearing a dark red coat, holding spectacles over a paper.
long_description: The painting is a formal, waist-up portrait of an older man with light skin, seated against a dark, indistinct background. He faces forward, looking directly at the viewer. His face is round with a ruddy complexion, and he has light blue eyes, a straight nose, and thin lips. His sparse white hair is brushed back from his forehead and curls slightly at the sides above his ears. He wears a dark brown buttoned waistcoat over a white ruffled shirt or cravat, visible at his neck. Over the waistcoat, he wears a voluminous, dark red velvet coat with wide lapels and a fur-lined collar that drapes over his shoulders and arms. His left arm rests on a surface, and his left hand, with visible knuckles, holds a pair of small, silver-rimmed spectacles over a sheet of white paper. The paper is placed on a dark, possibly wooden, surface that extends across the bottom of the frame. The background is a deep, dark green or brown, with subtle variations in tone suggesting a draped fabric or a shadowed interior. The lighting illuminates his face and hands, creating a contrast with the darker tones of his clothing and the background.

alt_text: A young woman in a white dress sits with a brown and white dog in a lush, dark landscape
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young woman seated outdoors, accompanied by a dog. The woman occupies the center of the canvas, facing forward with her head slightly turned to her right, gazing directly at the viewer. She has fair skin, dark curly hair styled around her face, blue eyes, and light red lips. She wears a white, empire-waist dress with short, puffed sleeves and a low neckline. A delicate gold chain necklace adorns her neck, and a ring with a dark stone is visible on the ring finger of her left hand. Her hands are clasped together in her lap. To her left, a brown and white dog with floppy ears rests its head on her lap, looking up towards her face. The dog wears a light blue collar. Both figures are seated on a draped, reddish-brown fabric that extends across the lower portion of the painting. The background on the left features dark green foliage and the trunk of a tree. On the right, the background transitions to a dramatic, dark sky with swirling lighter clouds, suggesting a stormy atmosphere. The overall lighting highlights the woman's face and dress against the darker surroundings.

alt_text: A man with a raised dagger confronts a woman holding a cup, while another figure recoils in the background
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic indoor scene with three figures. In the foreground, a muscular man with long, flowing brown hair and a beard lunges forward from the left, his right arm raised high, clutching a dark dagger. He wears a white drapery around his lower body and a blue cloth across his chest, which a woman to his right grasps with her left hand. His face is contorted in an expression of intense anger, with an open mouth and furrowed brow. The woman, seated or kneeling, recoils from the man, her body angled towards the right. She wears a golden-yellow gown and a blue drapery over her lap and left arm. Her light brown hair is styled with a small tiara, and her face shows a look of fear or shock, with wide eyes and an open mouth. In her right hand, she holds a small, ornate golden cup. To the far left, in the mid-ground, another figure, possibly a woman, is seen from behind, leaning away from the central action. This figure wears a blue tunic and white drapery and appears to be falling or recoiling against a dark, fluted column. The background features rich, deep red drapery hanging from above, creating a dramatic canopy over the central figures. To the right, a dark, overturned ornate vessel lies on the tiled floor. To the left, near the recoiling figure, a large, ornate golden jug with a handle sits on a pedestal. The floor is a light-colored tile. The lighting emphasizes the figures, casting shadows on the background elements.

alt_text: A multi-level architectural scene with many people in elaborate costumes, some masked, attending a social event
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a multi-tiered, ornate architectural setting bustling with numerous figures in elaborate costumes. The scene is structured with a central upper balcony, flanked by smaller, recessed boxes on either side, and a lower level with a central double door and more side sections.On the uppermost central balcony, a group of richly dressed figures is gathered. A prominent figure in a red and gold coat stands near the center, surrounded by others in plumed hats, capes, and ruffs. A large, colorful fabric, patterned with green, red, and gold motifs, drapes over the balcony railing. To the left and right of this central balcony, smaller, open boxes contain groups of two or three individuals, mostly women, observing the scene below.The middle section features a large, brown double door at its center. To the left of the doors, a couple in elegant attire, the woman in a flowing pink and white gown, appears to be dancing or interacting. Further left, and in the side boxes, more figures in various costumes are visible. To the right of the central doors, a figure dressed in a harlequin-patterned costume plays a stringed instrument. Other masked and costumed figures are scattered throughout this level, some seated on ledges, others standing in groups.The architecture itself is highly decorative, featuring gilded columns, ornate moldings, and light blue-grey walls. The overall color palette is rich, with dominant reds, golds, blues, and greens in the clothing and decor, set against the more muted tones of the architectural structure. The figures are engaged in various social interactions, creating a lively and crowded atmosphere.

alt_text: A wide landscape painting of a bay with distant mountains, a white building, and a rocky foreground.
long_description: A wide landscape painting depicts a panoramic view of a coastal area under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. The top third of the canvas is filled with this sky. Below the sky, a long, dark blue body of water, likely a bay or sea, stretches horizontally across the middle ground, separating the foreground from distant land. On the far side of the water, a long, low mountain range with some snow-capped peaks is visible, blending into the horizon. In the midground, on the right side, a cluster of buildings sits on a rocky, green hillside. The most prominent structure is a multi-story white building with a dark roof and a flag flying from a pole on its right side. To its left and slightly lower, a smaller, round, light-colored building with a conical roof, resembling a lighthouse or tower, stands. Several other smaller, light-colored buildings are clustered around these two. To the left of these buildings, a vast, dark green plain or valley extends from the water towards the lower left, with faint indications of structures or fields. The immediate foreground, particularly on the right and bottom, is dominated by a rocky, uneven hillside. Large, light brown and grey boulders are scattered among patches of green grass and low, dark green bushes. The ground slopes downwards towards the left. The overall color palette is dominated by blues for the sky and water, various shades of green for the vegetation, and browns and greys for the rocks and distant land.

alt_text: A young woman with dark hair sits on a large rock by the sea, holding a fishing net.
long_description: This vertical oil painting depicts a young woman seated on a large, dark gray and brown rock, positioned towards the right side of the frame. She faces right, with her head slightly tilted downwards, gazing out towards the water. Her long, dark hair flows over her shoulders and back, with a small red flower tucked into it above her right ear. She has fair skin, dark eyebrows, and her lips are closed. She wears a light-colored, off-the-shoulder blouse with a ruffled neckline and red trim around the shoulders, paired with a long, flowing blue dress. Her bare feet dangle off the edge of the rock. Her hands are clasped in her lap, holding a dark brown fishing net that drapes over the rock and a small, dark, pointed tool. A simple, light brown bracelet adorns her right wrist. Behind her, to the left, is a calm body of water, likely a sea or large lake, with distant, hazy purple mountains visible on the horizon. The sky above transitions from a pale orange-yellow at the horizon to a lighter, almost white, pale blue towards the top of the canvas. The overall color palette is muted, with soft light illuminating the scene.

alt_text: A close-up painting of a young person in a white headscarf and dark clothing, looking down.
long_description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a young person, likely a woman, painted in oil. The subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, facing forward but looking downwards and to the right. A white headscarf covers the hair and wraps around the head, with prominent folds visible on the left side. The face is rendered with warm, reddish-brown skin tones, with subtle shadows defining the contours of the nose, cheeks, and chin. The eyes are downcast, and the lips are closed. The subject wears a dark, possibly black or very dark brown, garment with a white collar visible at the neck. A faint signature, "M. Luce 95", is visible on the right shoulder of the dark garment. The background is a muted, dark gray or greenish-gray, with some lighter areas on the left, suggesting a light source from the upper left. The brushstrokes are visible, giving the painting a textured appearance. There is a small, reddish-brown area at the bottom right edge of the dark garment. The overall composition is a close-up, focusing on the upper body and head of the subject.

metadata.title: Peasant Girl with a White Headcloth

alt_text: A painting depicts a woman's head and shoulders in profile, looking left, with dark hair and a purple garment
long_description: The painting presents a head-and-shoulders portrait of a woman in profile, facing towards the left side of the canvas, set against a solid, dark background. Her skin is fair, with a soft pink blush on her cheeks and lips. Her dark brown hair is styled away from her face and pulled back, revealing her ear and a small, decorative gold-toned ornament nestled in a bun or coil at the back of her head. Her visible left eye is dark and appears to gaze slightly upward. She has a straight nose and full, reddish lips. Her neck is long and gracefully extends from her shoulders. She is dressed in a light, cream-colored undergarment, visible at her chest and neck, beneath a loose outer garment. This outer garment is a muted plum or dusty rose color, featuring a wide band of textured gold-colored trim that runs along its opening, down her chest, and over her shoulders. The primary light source originates from the left, illuminating her face and the front of her attire, while casting subtle shadows on the right side of her neck and the folds of her clothing.

alt_text: A woman in dark robes leans on a white pillar in a dimly lit garden with scattered autumn leaves.
long_description: A full-length, vertical oil painting depicts a woman in dark, flowing robes leaning on a tall, white fluted pillar. Her head is bowed, resting on her right arm, which is draped over the top of the pillar. She wears a teal-colored garment beneath her dark outer robes. Her dark hair is visible, falling around her face. Her left hand, with slender fingers, is visible near her waist, holding a small, light-colored object. Around the base of the pillar, a dark purple fabric is draped. The background is dark, featuring dense green foliage and tree trunks. A warm, golden light emanates from behind the trees on the right side, creating a glow. The foreground consists of a light-colored, tiled or paved ground. Scattered brown, orange, and yellow autumn leaves are visible on the ground. To the left of the pillar, an overturned dark amphora-like vessel and a wreath of dried leaves are present on the ground.

alt_text: Two men in historical attire, one a butcher, the other a hunter, in a rustic courtyard with game.
long_description: The painting depicts a scene in a rustic, open-air courtyard, likely a farm or a back alley, with two men and several dead animals. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, grays, and dark reds, with some brighter accents.In the center, two men are engaged in an exchange. The man on the right stands, facing left, dressed in a light-colored, possibly cream or off-white, puffy-sleeved shirt, breeches, and a long apron. He has a stern expression and a short beard. Around his neck is a white ruffled collar. His hands are on his hips, and he appears to be inspecting something held by the other man.The man on the left is seated on a low stool or block, facing the standing man. He wears a prominent, flowing red cloak or cape over darker clothing, and a dark cap. He holds up a dead bird, possibly a pheasant, by its feet, presenting it to the standing man.On the ground between and around the men are several dead animals. To the left of the seated man, a large, light-colored bird, possibly a heron or crane, lies on its back. Closer to the center, a reddish-brown animal, likely a rabbit or hare, is visible, along with another dead bird, possibly a pheasant with iridescent feathers. To the right of the standing man, near a wooden barrel, several smaller, lighter-colored birds are piled on the ground.The background consists of a building with exposed timber framing and a tiled roof. The walls are a mix of light and dark plaster or stone. To the far left, a tall wooden barrel stands upright. To the far right, under a dark overhang, a wooden workbench holds a large grinding wheel. The ground is uneven, dark earth.In the bottom right corner, a signature "Louis Leloir 72" is visible in light script.

alt_text: A painting depicts two women in elegant dresses, one with pearls and flowers, the other holding a framed drawing.
long_description: The painting features two women seated in an interior setting, with a landscape visible on the left and drapery on the right. Both women are depicted from the waist up, with dark, curly hair falling to their shoulders. The woman on the left is positioned facing right, with her head turned to look towards the left. She wears an off-the-shoulder gown with a brown bodice and voluminous, shimmering silver-grey satin sleeves and skirt. A string of pearls adorns her neck. Her left hand holds a small, dark green bouquet of flowers, while her right hand is extended forward, pointing slightly to the right. Behind her, a dark, leafy tree stands against a cloudy blue and white sky, with a distant, hazy landscape visible on the horizon. The woman on the right is seated facing left, looking directly forward. She wears an off-the-shoulder gown of shimmering gold satin. A large piece of bright blue drapery is draped over her lap and left arm. Her left hand rests on a small, dark-framed drawing that she holds upright. The drawing depicts a single pink rose with green leaves. Behind her is a rich, reddish-brown drapery that fills the background. A dark architectural column separates the two women in the center of the composition.

metadata.title: Mary Capel (1630–1715), Later Duchess of Beaufort, and Her Sister Elizabeth (1633–1678), Countess of Carnarvon
metadata.artist: Sir Peter Lely (Pieter van der Faes)

alt_text: A bust-length portrait painting of a young woman with voluminous curly brown hair and a low-cut dress.
long_description: This is a vertical oil painting depicting a bust-length portrait of a young woman against a dark, plain background. The woman's head is turned slightly to her right, and she gazes in the same direction, out of the frame. She has fair skin with rosy cheeks and full, red lips. Her dark, curly hair is voluminous, framing her face and extending to her shoulders. Her dark eyes are open, and her eyebrows are finely arched. She wears a dark brown, low-cut dress with a wide, white, ruffled or lace trim along the neckline, revealing her shoulders and upper chest. The fabric of her dress appears soft and draped. The background is a uniform dark brown, almost black, with a subtle lighter area directly behind her head. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting her face and chest and creating soft shadows on the right side of her face and neck. The overall impression is one of soft illumination on the subject against a deep, muted backdrop.

metadata.title: Study for a Portrait of a Woman
metadata.artist: Sir Peter Lely (Pieter van der Faes)

alt_text: A young man with long reddish-brown hair stands next to a classical female bust, wearing a satin coat.
long_description: A three-quarter length portrait depicts a young man positioned slightly to the right of the center, looking directly at the viewer. He has long, wavy, reddish-brown hair that falls over his shoulders. His face is fair, with rosy cheeks and dark eyes. He wears a light-colored, possibly silver or pale green, satin coat with voluminous sleeves and a white ruffled cuff visible on his right arm. A white collar is visible at his neck. A rich, reddish-brown or rust-colored drapery is wrapped around his left arm and cascades down his body, adding volume to his silhouette. To the left of the man, a white marble bust of a woman is positioned on a dark pedestal. The bust depicts a woman with classical features, her hair styled in waves and adorned with what appears to be a laurel wreath or similar headpiece. Her eyes are blank, typical of classical sculpture. The man's right hand rests gently on the woman's left shoulder/chest area of the bust. The background is dark and muted. On the left, behind the bust, there is a hint of a landscape with a lighter sky and darker forms that suggest trees or distant hills. A dark, fluted column or architectural element rises behind the bust and the man's left side. To the right, behind the man, a dark, patterned curtain or tapestry is visible, adding texture to the background. The overall lighting is dramatic, with the figures illuminated against the darker setting.

metadata.title: Sir Henry Capel (1638–1696)
metadata.artist: Sir Peter Lely (Pieter van der Faes)

alt_text: Full-length portrait of a woman in a blue and grey dress, seated, looking forward
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a woman seated, facing slightly to the viewer's right, with her gaze directed forward. She has an oval face, fair skin, dark eyes, and dark, curly hair styled around her face and shoulders. She wears pearl drop earrings and a pearl necklace. Her dress features a grey, satin-like bodice with a low neckline trimmed with white ruffles, and a vertical row of pearl-like embellishments down the front. White ruffled cuffs are visible at her wrists. A voluminous blue drapery is draped over her shoulders and lap, contrasting with the grey of the bodice and the lighter grey-blue of the skirt. Her hands rest on the blue fabric in her lap. The background is a dark, muted brown, with a reddish-brown drapery visible on the left side. The woman is seated on a raised platform or steps, rendered in a lighter brown tone. At the bottom left, the text "FRANCOISE VILLERS" is visible, and at the bottom right, "DE CREVELANDI" is visible.

alt_text: Two women in a classical interior, one standing with a palette and brush, the other seated and drawing
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with two women engaged in artistic activities. A young woman stands prominently in the center-right, facing slightly left with her head turned towards the viewer. She has light brown, curly hair partially covered by a white, ruffled cap. She wears a flowing white dress with short, puffed sleeves adorned with light blue ribbons, and a wide reddish-orange sash around her waist. Her right arm rests on a dark, draped surface, and she holds a long, thin brush in her right hand, while her left hand holds a wooden artist's palette with various dabs of paint. Her gaze is directed forward. To her left and slightly in front, a second woman is seated on the floor, facing right and looking down intently at a large, light blue-green book or portfolio open on her lap. She has dark hair tied back with a blue ribbon and wears a long, flowing brown dress with white lace trim at the cuffs and neckline. Her left hand holds the book open, and her right hand holds a drawing implement, actively sketching on the page. The background features a dark wall. To the left, a table covered with a dark blue cloth with a patterned border holds a clear glass vase with white and purple flowers, and a basket of colorful flowers. To the right, a tall easel supports a large canvas with an unfinished sketch of a female figure. Behind the easel, a dark green upholstered chair is visible. A tall, narrow window with a light-colored curtain is in the upper right. The floor is covered by a dark rug with a repeating floral pattern in shades of green and pink.

metadata.title: The Interior of an Atelier of a Woman Painter

alt_text: A full-length portrait painting of a young girl with blonde hair in a red dress against a dark background
long_description: A vertical oil painting features a young girl standing centrally, facing slightly right with her head turned to look directly forward. She has a pale complexion and a mass of light blonde, curly hair that frames her face and extends to her shoulders. She is dressed in a long-sleeved, red gown with a full skirt that reaches her ankles. The dress features a high neckline, a white ruffled collar, and a long, sheer white scarf draped over her shoulders and down the front of her bodice. A small cluster of colorful, possibly red and green, floral or berry-like elements is pinned to the scarf at her chest. Her left arm is bent with her hand resting near her hip, while her right arm is extended slightly to her side, her hand gently touching dark green foliage in the lower right. She wears light-colored, flat shoes with small bows on the toes. The background is dark and indistinct, primarily composed of deep greens and browns, suggesting a shadowy outdoor or natural setting. A faint lighter area is visible in the upper left, and textured brushstrokes are present throughout the background. The lighting appears to originate from the upper left, highlighting the girl's face and the front of her dress, creating a strong contrast with the darker surroundings.

alt_text: A portrait painting of an older man with a long white beard, looking left
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a bust-length portrait of an older man against a dark, indistinct background. The man is positioned slightly to the right of center, facing left in profile, with his head turned slightly towards the viewer. His skin appears ruddy and aged, with visible brushstrokes defining the contours of his face. He has a receding hairline with white or light gray hair visible on the sides of his head. A long, full, white or light gray beard extends from his chin and cheeks, reaching down to his chest. His eyes are light-colored and gaze towards the left. He wears dark clothing, possibly a coat or robe, with a hint of a white collar or shirt visible at his neck. Strong light from the upper left illuminates his face and beard, creating highlights and casting the right side of his face and the background into deeper shadow. The background is predominantly dark brown and black, with subtle warmer brown tones on the right and cooler dark tones on the left. In the lower left corner, light-colored script reads "M. J. Schladen 1902".

alt_text: A crowded 19th-century interior scene depicts many people gathered around an auctioneer and various decorative objects.
long_description: The painting depicts a large, bustling interior space, likely a public hall or auction room, filled with numerous figures dressed in late 19th-century attire. The room features a high ceiling with decorative molding and two prominent dark wooden columns dividing the space. On the left, a group of people, predominantly men in dark suits and top hats, are gathered, some looking towards the central activity. An ornate brass chandelier with multiple lights hangs from the ceiling in the upper left. In the center, an auctioneer stands behind a wooden counter, gesturing with his right hand towards a collection of items displayed on tables in front of him. These items include various decorative objects such as colorful vases, busts, and small sculptures. A diverse crowd of men and women, dressed in period clothing including long dresses, suits, and various hats, are seated on chairs or standing, observing the proceedings. Behind the auctioneer, a white sign with a dark border is visible, displaying the word "NOTICE" in large, dark letters at the top, with additional illegible text below. Red curtains are drawn in the background, partially revealing another section of the room where more figures are seated at a raised platform. To the right, a substantial wooden staircase with a dark railing ascends sharply towards the upper right corner. Below the staircase, a man in a dark overcoat stands with his back mostly to the viewer, his hands clasped behind him, looking towards the central crowd. Further to the right, a man in lighter, possibly worn clothing, including a light-colored shirt and trousers, sits on a low wooden bench or step, looking downwards. A tall, multi-paned window on the far right allows natural light into the space. The overall color palette is dominated by warm browns, deep reds, and dark clothing, with lighter accents from the displayed objects and some women's dresses.

metadata.title: Auction Sale in Clinton Hall, New York, 1876

alt_text: A woman in a dark dress stands on a balcony, holding papers, looking into a brightly lit hall with other figures.
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene from an elevated vantage point, likely a balcony or choir loft, overlooking a large, light-filled hall. In the foreground, on the left, a group of figures is gathered. A woman in a dark dress and hat is seated, looking down at a red book. Behind her, several men in dark suits and some with beards stand, looking towards the right. A man with a beard stands at a wooden lectern, also facing right. Below these figures, another woman is seated, facing right, with papers on her lap and more papers and books scattered on the dark floor in front of her. In the center of the composition, a woman in a dark, long-sleeved dress with a bustle and a dark hat adorned with a feather stands facing right. She holds a sheet of paper in her hands and is positioned next to a sturdy wooden balcony railing that extends across the middle ground. The background reveals a vast, brightly illuminated hall characterized by light-colored walls, multiple arches, and columns with decorative capitals. Windows are visible along the upper section of the far wall, contributing to the bright atmosphere of the hall, which contrasts with the darker tones of the figures and the foreground balcony area. The overall color palette features deep browns and blacks for the figures and railing, set against the warm, pale yellows and creams of the distant architecture.

alt_text: Two people play chess at a table, surrounded by a group of onlookers in a room with a window
long_description: The painting depicts an indoor scene with ten figures, primarily focused on two individuals playing a game of chess at a central table. The room has reddish-brown walls and a window in the upper center showing a distant landscape with a hill. Two dark green columns frame the central activity, one on the far right and one partially obscuring the left side of the table. At the center, a young man and a young woman sit opposite each other at a dark green table. Both have light, curly hair. The man, on the left, wears a light-colored tunic with long sleeves and a white draped cloth over his lap. He looks towards the woman. The woman, on the right, wears a light-colored dress and also has a white cloth draped over her shoulder. She looks towards the chessboard. The chessboard is square, with red and white squares, and has black and white chess pieces arranged on it. To the left of the chess players, a group of four men stands. The foremost man wears a black tunic with a pleated light-colored skirt and a red cap, with his arms crossed. Behind him are three other men, one with a red garment. All have light, curly hair. To the right of the chess players, behind the column, a group of four women stands. The woman closest to the table wears a light-colored dress and looks towards the game. Behind her, another woman in a red dress looks down, and two more women are visible further back. All the women have light, curly hair. The floor is a light brown color.

alt_text: A group of figures in a courtyard, one seated, with a woman looking from an upper window of a red building
long_description: The painting depicts a scene with multiple figures set against an architectural background. On the left, in the foreground, a young person with light, curly hair is seated on a stack of rough brown blocks. This figure wears a long, flowing tunic with vertical light brown and gold stripes, and bright red hose on their legs. Their left hand is raised to their head, and their right arm is extended forward with the palm open, as they look upwards and to the right. Behind this seated figure, a group of three other individuals stands. One figure, slightly taller, wears a dark tunic and a dark, rounded hat, with light-colored hair visible. To their left, two other figures with light hair are partially visible, one wearing a red garment. The background on the left features a series of receding arched doorways and walls in muted tones under a dark sky. On the right side of the composition, a tall, reddish-brown building with brick-like texture dominates. An open window on the upper part of this building reveals a woman with light, curly hair, wearing a light-colored dress and a white sash draped over her shoulder. She looks towards the left, with her right hand raised near her ear or face. Below this window, a rectangular panel with a dark frame encloses a lighter, patterned surface.

alt_text: A woman sits with a skeleton behind her, holding money bags, while a violent scene unfolds in the background
long_description: The vertical painting features a seated woman in the foreground, flanked by a skeletal figure and a distant landscape scene. The woman, positioned slightly left of center, has fair skin and dark hair partially covered by a pink and gold headband. She wears a long, flowing golden-yellow robe with a deep V-neck, revealing a pink undergarment. Her right arm is bent, with her hand resting against her cheek and her elbow on a dark, unseen surface. Her left hand holds a large, light brown, sack-like object. Her bare right foot is visible, resting on a dark ground. To her immediate left, a dark, ornate chest overflows with white pearls and a gold chain. Behind the woman, to her right, a large, yellowish-brown skeletal figure with dark, bat-like wings looms. Its head is positioned above the woman's head, looking down. Its left hand rests on the woman's right shoulder. Its right hand holds a small, dark object on a string, which is attached to another light brown sack, similar to the one the woman holds, hanging near her right shoulder. The background on the right side of the painting depicts a blue sky above a green, hilly landscape. In this scene, two male figures are engaged in a struggle. One figure, dressed in a reddish-brown tunic, holds a raised weapon, possibly a sword or club, over another figure in an orange tunic who is on the ground, appearing to recoil. A third, smaller figure in a light brown tunic is visible further back, also in a distressed posture.

alt_text: A lively outdoor scene with numerous people gathered around a building, some dancing, others sitting, and a person on a donkey
long_description: A painting depicts a bustling outdoor gathering in front of a rustic building under a light grey sky. The scene is dominated by a large group of people in the foreground and midground, with a building on the left and a large tree in the center-right. Rolling hills are visible in the background.On the left, a two-story, brown-walled building with a dark, sloped roof stands. Smoke rises from a chimney on its left. A large, gnarled tree trunk with some green foliage grows next to the building, its branches extending over the roof. Below the building, a crowd of people is gathered. Some are seated on the ground or on a low wooden bench. A man in a dark hat and red cloak plays a wind instrument. A couple sits closely, the woman in a white head covering and red skirt, the man in a blue jacket. A small dog is near them.In the center-right, a group of men are actively dancing or gesturing, some with their arms raised. One man in a blue jacket and light-colored breeches appears to be mid-step. Another man in a red jacket sits on a low wooden bench, watching. Several barrels are on the ground. Further to the right, a man on a donkey faces away from the central group, holding a stick. Another man walks beside the donkey. The ground is a muted brown. The overall color palette is earthy, with browns, greens, and muted reds and blues in the clothing.

alt_text: A chaotic battle with numerous soldiers and horses fighting near a large fortress under a stormy sky.
long_description: The painting presents a wide, horizontal view of a tumultuous battle scene under a dramatic, cloudy sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by heavy, dark gray and brown clouds, with lighter, more luminous patches of sky visible towards the right, suggesting a break in the storm or the glow of distant light. In the left foreground, a large, gnarled tree with a thick, dark trunk and sparse green foliage leans diagonally into the scene. Below and around it, a dense mass of soldiers on horseback and on foot are engaged in fierce combat. Many figures are obscured by the sheer number of participants and the swirling dust or smoke. At the center of the composition, a massive, round, light brown fortress or castle rises prominently, partially enveloped in a haze of smoke. A small red flag flies from its highest point. The battle rages intensely around the base of this structure, with figures clashing on a bridge or causeway leading to it. To the right, the foreground continues with more groups of soldiers and horses locked in combat. Several figures are depicted falling or lying on the ground, some with shields and helmets scattered nearby. A soldier on a white horse in the mid-ground appears to be falling. In the far right background, rolling hills and additional fortified structures are visible under the lighter sky, extending into the distance. The overall color palette is somber, featuring deep browns, grays, and muted reds, with occasional brighter accents of white and light blue on clothing and horses, emphasizing the chaotic and intense nature of the conflict.

alt_text: A classical painting depicts multiple figures around a dying man amidst ancient ruins and a distant landscape
long_description: A classical oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures, some appearing distressed or deceased, set against a backdrop of ancient architectural ruins and a distant landscape under a partly cloudy sky. On the far left, a light brown dog stands facing right, looking towards the central figures. Behind it, a large, broken white marble sarcophagus or plinth is visible. Further back, a large, light-colored archway, possibly a triumphal arch, stands amidst green trees, opening to a lighter, hazy landscape in the distance. In the center-left, a man in a long white robe with a hood bends over a pale, partially draped man lying on the ground. The man in white has a grey beard. Next to them, another man with a bare torso and yellow drapery around his waist supports the pale man. To the right of the central group, another man lies prone on the ground, partially covered by blue and brown drapery, with a small shovel and pickaxe nearby. Behind this group, two large, fluted classical columns, one mostly intact and one broken, rise from a stone platform. On this platform, a group of five or six figures observes the scene. One man in a dark green robe and white turban points downwards. Another man in a light green robe points to the right. Other figures in red, blue, and brown garments are also present, some looking down, others looking towards the right. The background features a blue sky with white clouds, and distant mountains or hills on the far right. The ground is a mix of brown and green earth. Dominant colors include earthy browns and greens, blues, whites, and ochres for drapery, with the pale skin tones of the figures contrasting with the darker background elements.

alt_text: A woman in blue and red robes holds a child who reads a book, with a landscape visible through an archway
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a woman holding a child, set against a divided background. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, wears a deep blue cloak draped over a red dress with a light blue veil covering her head. A faint golden halo encircles her head, and she gazes downwards towards the child. Her left hand supports the child's back, while her right hand is mostly obscured by the child's body. The child, with light skin and curly reddish-brown hair, is nude except for a faint halo. He lies on a dark red cushion, propped up on a table-like surface in the lower left. The child holds an open book with visible text in his left hand and a small piece of white paper in his right. To the left of the child, on the same surface, is a white and red pomegranate with some seeds scattered. The background on the left features an open archway with two ornate brown columns, revealing a distant landscape. Through the archway, a light blue sky is visible above green hills and a fortified town with a castle. Small figures are scattered across the landscape. The background on the right is a dark, plain wall. On a shelf against this wall, a brass candelabrum stands next to a small red book. The overall lighting highlights the figures, casting soft shadows.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood

alt_text: Multiple figures carefully lower a pale body from a tall wooden cross against a light blue sky.
long_description:
The painting depicts a vertical composition centered around a dark brown wooden cross against a light blue sky. At the top of the cross, the letters "I.N.R.I." are inscribed in red. A pale, muscular body, clad in a white loincloth and wearing a crown of thorns, is being lowered from the cross.

On the left side of the cross, an older man with a white beard, dressed in a green tunic and orange sleeves, stands on a ladder. He uses pliers to remove a nail from the body's left hand. A long, pink fabric streamer hangs from the crossbar near him. On the right, a younger man with long brown hair, wearing a pink tunic and yellow sleeves, also stands on a ladder, supporting the body's right arm.

Below the body, a figure in a pink and blue tunic supports the body's legs. To the right of this figure, a man in a brown robe and yellow cloak looks upwards with his hands raised. To the left, a group of women is gathered. One woman, dressed in a dark blue robe and white head covering, appears to be fainting and is supported by another woman in a green and yellow dress. Two other women stand behind them. Another woman, wearing a blue dress and an orange cloak, kneels on the ground, looking up towards the body.

The ground is a dark brown earth. A white cloth with dark straps lies in the foreground. To its right, a human skull and a bone are visible. The background features a faint, light blue sky with a subtle hint of a green landscape on the right horizon.

alt_text: A woman with a golden halo, wearing a red dress and dark cloak, clasps her hands in prayer, looking downwards
long_description: This vertical painting depicts a woman from the chest up, positioned slightly to the left of the center against a dark, indistinct background. Her head is tilted downwards and to her right, with her eyes cast low, almost closed. She has fair skin and reddish-brown hair, partially covered by a translucent white veil that drapes over her head and shoulders. A faint golden halo encircles her head. Her hands are clasped together in front of her chest, fingers intertwined, with the knuckles visible. She wears a long-sleeved red garment, visible at her neck and arms, beneath a dark green or blue cloak. The cloak is draped over her shoulders and arms, with a patterned, possibly embroidered, dark fabric visible on the inside of the upper arm area. On the far left, a hint of another figure or object in warm brown and orange tones is visible, including what appears to be a wooden cross held upright. On the far right, a vertical architectural element in muted brown and gold tones is partially visible. The background behind the figure is a dark, solid brown.

alt_text: Madonna and Child seated with two angels holding scrolls, against an architectural background with an arched top
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts the Madonna and Child flanked by two angels, set against a dark background with architectural elements. The Madonna is seated centrally, facing forward with her head tilted slightly to her right, looking downwards. She has pale skin, light brown hair covered by a white veil, and a golden halo. She wears a reddish-pink dress, a green mantle over her shoulders, and a voluminous deep blue cloak that covers her lower body and pools around her feet. Her left hand rests on her lap, while her right arm supports the Child. The Child sits on her lap, facing forward and looking directly out. He has pale skin and light, curly hair, and wears a light pink garment. He holds an open book with black text in his left hand. A golden halo encircles his head. To the left and right, slightly behind and above the Madonna, stand two angels. The angel on the left has light curly hair, wears a green tunic with red straps, and holds a long white scroll with black text. Visible text includes "EXI TE A MEO NEQ SO Q CVM SA LVT E". The angel on the right is similarly dressed and holds a scroll, though its text is less distinct. Behind the figures, an architectural structure features columns, arches, and a golden, shell-like niche at the top center. The Madonna's blue cloak drapes over a patterned base in the foreground.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Angels
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on wood, transferred from wood

alt_text: A woman in profile wearing a red dress and elaborate headdress, with a man in profile in the background.
long_description: A vertical portrait depicts a woman in profile on the right, facing right, with a man's head in profile on the left, facing left. The woman occupies the majority of the right side of the canvas. She has fair skin, a high forehead, and light hair visible at her temple, pulled back under an elaborate red headdress. The headdress is made of a rich, textured red fabric, possibly velvet or brocade, adorned with gold patterns and a trim of small, light beads or pearls along her hairline. It drapes down her back. She wears a single strand pearl necklace and a deep red gown with a fitted bodice and full, dark sleeves that are lined or trimmed with a lighter color. A gold brooch with a circular design is pinned to her right shoulder. Her hands are clasped at her waist, with rings visible on her fingers. To the left, a man's head is visible in profile, facing left, through a narrow, dark opening or doorway. He wears a red cap. Below his head, his hands are visible, holding an object with horizontal black and gold stripes. Between the two figures, a distant landscape with green hills, trees, and small buildings is visible through a rectangular window-like opening. The background behind the man and the landscape appears to be an interior space with architectural framing. The overall color palette is dominated by rich reds, dark tones, and the pale skin of the figures.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Man at a Casement

alt_text: A central figure on a throne flanked by two standing and three kneeling figures against a shimmering gold background.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a central enthroned figure surrounded by other figures, set against a shimmering gold background. The central figure, appearing youthful with light skin and short light hair, sits on a high-backed grey throne with a blue arched niche behind their head. They wear a long, flowing green robe over a grey tunic with gold trim and a decorated chest panel, holding a red book in their left hand. A gold halo encircles their head. Two standing figures flank the throne. The left standing figure, also youthful with light skin, short dark hair, and a halo, wears a blue tunic, a pink cloak, and a red cap, holding a long green palm frond. The right standing figure is similarly dressed and holds an identical palm frond, with red hose visible below their cloak. In the foreground, three figures kneel. On the left, two youthful figures with light skin and short light hair kneel, both wearing long, flowing red robes and facing right towards the central figure. On the right, a bald figure with light skin kneels, wearing a long, flowing pink robe, with hands clasped in front, facing left towards the central figure. The ground beneath the figures is dark with faint geometric patterns, and the background is predominantly textured gold leaf.

metadata.title: Saint Lawrence Enthroned with Saints and Donors

alt_text: An angel with wings kneels opposite a bowing woman in an architectural interior, separated by a column.
long_description: The black and white image presents two kneeling figures within an architectural interior, divided by a central column. On the left, an angel with large, feathered wings and a halo kneels on its right knee, facing towards the right. The angel wears draped clothing, with its right arm raised in a gesture and its left arm resting lower. Its head is slightly tilted, and its gaze is directed towards the figure on the right. Behind the angel, a dark, recessed area with vertical lines suggests a doorway or alcove. In the center, a tall, fluted column with a decorative capital rises from the floor, acting as a strong vertical divider. Behind the column, an arched opening reveals a glimpse of trees or foliage in the background. On the right, a woman with a halo kneels on her left knee, facing towards the left, with her head bowed in a gesture of humility. Her hands are clasped together in front of her chest, and she wears long, draped clothing that pools around her on the floor. Behind the woman, a simpler architectural structure with a small, rectangular window opening is visible. Both figures kneel on low, raised platforms or steps, and the floor features subtle horizontal and vertical lines.

alt_text: A painting of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child, with a dove and hands above them
long_description: The artwork is a tall, rectangular panel with an arched top, depicting two central figures against a dark, patterned background. At the very top, two hands emerge from a dark area, reaching downwards. Between them, a white dove with outstretched wings descends, its head pointing towards the woman's head. Above the woman's head, a large, circular halo is visible, decorated with intricate patterns and text. The text on the left side of the halo reads "AVE MARIA GRATIA PLENA DOMINUS TECUM". The text on the right side reads "BENEDICTA TU IN MULIERIBUS". The woman, positioned on the left, has a pale complexion and a serene expression, looking downwards and slightly to the right. She wears a dark, long-sleeved robe and a veil that covers her hair and drapes over her shoulders. Her right hand is raised to her chest, fingers gently touching. Her left arm supports the child. On her left shoulder, a radiant, star-like emblem is visible. The child is seated on the woman's lap, positioned on the right side of the composition. He has a pale complexion and appears to be looking forward. He is mostly bare-chested, with a dark cloth draped around his lower body and legs. His left hand holds a small, round, dark object, possibly a fruit. A smaller, circular halo, similar in pattern to the woman's, encircles his head. The background is dark, appearing textured with small, light dots or stars.

alt_text: A painting shows a multitude of people in a desert camp with celestial figures and two robed men above
long_description: The painting depicts a vast, multi-figure scene with an arched upper section and a rectangular lower section. The upper, arched area features a golden, cloudy sky filled with numerous dynamic figures, some appearing to fly or float, gesturing and reaching. Outside this arch, in the top left and right corners, are two seated, robed, bearded men rendered in grayscale. The man on the left looks upwards, while the man on the right holds an open scroll. The larger lower section portrays a sprawling desert landscape under a muted sky. In the mid-ground, a large encampment of tents stretches across the scene, with distant mountains visible on the horizon. Numerous figures, some on foot and others with camels, traverse the landscape. The foreground is densely populated with a multitude of people. On the left, a central bearded figure in long robes gestures outwards, addressing a group, some of whom hold large vessels. In the center, many people are kneeling or bending down, some with small children, appearing to gather or receive something from the ground. On the right, another group of figures stands, some looking upwards or gesturing. The overall color palette is dominated by warm browns, ochres, and golden tones, creating a monochromatic effect, with the grayscale figures in the corners providing a contrast.

alt_text: A woman in a pink dress sits centrally in a room with four other figures and a small dog
long_description: The painting depicts five figures and a small white dog in an interior room with dark green patterned wallpaper. A woman in a light pink dress sits centrally in a red-backed chair, facing slightly left with a gentle smile. She holds a closed, light-colored fan in her right hand and looks down towards a small white dog at her feet. Her dress features white lace trim at the neckline and cuffs, and its voluminous skirt spreads around her. To her left, a man kneels on the floor, wearing a long, mustard-yellow robe. He reaches towards the small dog with his right hand, holding a small red object. Behind the seated woman, two men stand. The man on the left has long white hair and wears a grey, long-sleeved coat with a wide collar and decorative vertical fastenings. The man next to him has dark, curly hair and a darker brown garment, leaning slightly forward. To the right of the central woman, an older woman sits in a red-backed chair, dressed in a dark, long-sleeved robe and a dark cap. She holds a white object in her lap and looks towards the central woman. The room's background features dark green wallpaper with a lighter green floral or damask pattern. On the far left wall, a framed portrait of a man in a red robe hangs. On the far right, a bed with green drapery is partially visible, next to a small table covered with a patterned textile and a book. The floor is a plain brown.

alt_text: A domestic scene with five figures: a woman sleeping, another working on a wig, an old woman, a child, and a man
long_description: The painting depicts an indoor domestic scene with five figures against a dark olive-green wall. In the lower left, a woman with light skin is seated, leaning her head on her right hand, appearing to be asleep. She wears a light green dress with a pinkish-yellow shawl draped over her shoulders and a white cap. To her left, a small round table covered with a reddish-brown cloth holds a white wig stand with a white cap on it, and a small open book. In the center, a young woman with light skin and light brown hair is seated, wearing a white bodice and a long pink skirt. She is actively working on a wig, which rests on a white cloth on a small, light-colored table in front of her. Her hands are positioned as if styling or preparing the wig. Behind her, an older woman with wrinkled skin and a light green head covering stands, holding a spindle or similar tool in her hands, looking towards the wig. To the right of the central figures, a small child with light brown hair is seated on a low wooden stool, looking down at a small, open box or book in their hands. The child wears a light brown or beige dress. Further to the right, a man with light skin and a dark wig or hat is partially visible, entering the scene from the right edge. He wears a dark coat and a white cravat, and his right hand is extended forward. Above the figures, a clothesline stretches across the upper left and center of the wall, from which several pieces of white or light-colored laundry are hanging to dry. In the upper right, a wooden shelf is mounted on the wall, holding a white pitcher with a yellow floral design and a clear glass bottle. The floor is a light brown color.

alt_text: A seated woman in a yellow gown surrounded by masked and unmasked figures in an interior setting.
long_description: The painting depicts a group of seven figures, some masked, gathered in an interior space. In the center, a woman is seated, facing slightly to the right. She wears a voluminous yellow satin gown with a grey underskirt, a white lace-trimmed bodice, and a black hat adorned with a white bow. Her dark hair falls over her shoulders, and she holds a white fan in her right hand. To her immediate left, a man with long white hair and a blue robe leans towards her, his face visible. Behind him, a man in a red coat stands, looking towards the seated woman. To the far left, a figure in a black tricorn hat and a black mask stands next to a woman in a dark cloak who holds a yellow mask. On the far right, two figures stand. One wears a pink hooded cloak that covers their face, while the other wears a black hooded cloak and a white mask with a long nose. The background features dark green walls. In the upper center, a window-like opening reveals green drapes and a decorative object on a shelf above. The floor is a light, neutral color.

alt_text: Five people in 18th-century attire gather in a green room, one seated at a tea table
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with five figures in what appears to be an 18th-century setting. The room features green patterned wallpaper and a framed painting of two reclining nude figures, possibly cherubs, hanging on the upper wall. In the center, a person with light hair, dressed in a long white robe with gold trim, is seated at a round table covered with a white tablecloth. This person holds a small white cup and saucer. On the table are a white teapot, several white cups, and some bread rolls. To the left of the table, a man with dark hair, wearing a long olive-green coat and breeches, stands with one hand on his hip. To the right of the seated figure, a man in a blue coat with elaborate gold trim and blue breeches, faces the table, holding a small dark object in his hand. Further to the right, a woman with dark hair, wearing a black veil over her head and shoulders, a pink bodice, and a dark skirt, stands with her hands clasped. Behind her, an older woman with a pale face and a light-colored head covering and shawl looks towards the center. In the lower left foreground, a small, dark green upholstered stool with carved wooden legs is visible.

alt_text: A woman in dark robes holds a child, both with halos, within an arched panel painting in black and white
long_description: A vertical, arched panel painting in black and white depicts a woman holding a child. The woman, positioned on the left, looks gently downward and to the right. She wears a dark, draped garment that covers her head and body, with lighter skin visible on her face and hands. Her face is elongated with a subtle expression. A faint, patterned halo encircles her head. Her left hand supports the child's back, while her right hand gently holds the child's leg. The child, held on the right side of the composition, faces forward with a direct gaze slightly to the left. The child wears a light-colored tunic with decorative patterns on the cuffs and hem. Curly hair frames the child's face, and a faint, patterned halo similar to the woman's surrounds the child's head. The child's arms are slightly extended, and bare feet are visible below the tunic. The background is dark, with subtle, intricate patterns visible, particularly around the halos and along the arched border of the panel. These patterns appear to be decorative motifs and possibly faint, illegible text or symbols.

alt_text: A crowned figure in elaborate robes holds a palm frond and scroll against a gold background
long_description: The vertical painting features a frontal, waist-up depiction of a figure against a solid gold background. The figure has light skin, a round face, and light brown hair visible beneath a large, ornate gold crown. A golden halo encircles the head. The figure wears a richly decorated garment: a blue tunic with a repeating gold pattern resembling fleurs-de-lis and other motifs, and a wide, embellished neckline in gold and dark red. Over the tunic, a bright pink cloak drapes over the shoulders and arms, with a gold border along its edges. The figure's left hand, positioned on the lower left, holds a long, green palm frond vertically. The right hand, on the lower right, holds a white scroll or piece of cloth. The figure's gaze is directed straight forward, with a neutral expression. The top of the painting is framed by a dark, patterned border that curves into a golden arch above the figure's head.

alt_text: A kneeling woman in blue prays over two babies, one held by another figure, in a landscape
long_description: A circular painting depicts a kneeling woman, two babies, and another figure in a landscape setting. On the right, a woman kneels, facing left, with her hands clasped in prayer. She wears a deep blue cloak with a yellow lining over a lighter blue dress. Her head is bowed, covered by a sheer white veil and a dark band, with a faint halo visible above. On the left, another figure, with curly brown hair and wearing a deep red tunic with dark sleeves, kneels or crouches, facing right. This figure holds one of the babies, who is partially wrapped in white cloth and looks down at the second baby. The second baby lies on a light blue cloth on the green ground in the bottom center, looking up and to the left, with one hand near its mouth. Both babies are nude except for minimal coverings. In the background, a green landscape with rolling hills, scattered trees, and a body of water is visible under a light blue sky. Dark, blocky architectural structures frame the scene on the right and partially on the left.

metadata.title: Madonna Adoring the Child with the Infant Saint John the Baptist and an Angel

alt_text: A young woman in a black dress and veil stands in a landscape with trees and a blue sky, holding a ring
long_description: The painting depicts a half-length portrait of a young woman positioned centrally against a landscape background. She has pale skin, a round face, and dark brown hair that is partially covered by a sheer, dark veil draped over her head and shoulders. Her dark eyes gaze slightly to the right, and her lips are closed in a neutral expression. She wears a simple black dress with a visible white collar peeking out at the neckline. Around her neck is a thin black cord necklace from which a small gold ring hangs, along with a blue and gold pendant with a white "K" in its center. Her pale hands are crossed at waist level, with her right hand resting over her left. Her left hand holds a small gold ring between her thumb and forefinger. The background features a landscape with a light blue sky and white clouds on the upper left. Dark green, sparsely branched trees frame the woman's head and body on both sides, extending from the top edge of the canvas. The landscape behind her includes rolling green hills, a few small, light-colored buildings, and a darker green foreground.

alt_text: A bearded man sits on a throne, holding a weapon, with a smaller figure kneeling beside him on a gold background
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts two figures against a gold background. In the center, a large, bearded man sits on a dark grey throne with a light green top. He has dark hair and a full dark beard, wearing a light green tunic, a white mantle, and a voluminous pink drapery covering his lower body. His left hand holds a long, dark, blade-like object with a red, flame-like top. A halo with a floral pattern encircles his head. To his right, a smaller figure kneels on one knee, facing the seated man. This figure has light brown hair and wears a reddish-orange tunic over a light blue garment. Their right hand is raised towards the seated man's head, and their left hand rests on their knee. This figure also has a halo with a floral pattern. The ground beneath the figures is a vibrant green, with a dark green horizontal band at the bottom. The gold background is framed by a reddish-brown arch at the top.

alt_text: A crowned, bearded man in elaborate robes sits on a throne, playing a golden stringed instrument against a gold background
long_description: The artwork depicts a seated, crowned, bearded man playing a stringed instrument, set against a gold background with an arched top. The figure occupies the central portion of the panel, facing directly forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He wears a golden crown adorned with small white and red jewels, and a circular halo of golden dots surrounds his head. His face is dark-skinned with a full, dark beard and mustache, and his eyes gaze forward. He is dressed in elaborate robes. A light green outer robe drapes over his legs and arms, with a darker blue undergarment visible at his sleeves and lower legs. The blue fabric is patterned with small golden fleur-de-lis motifs. A reddish-pink lining is visible at the edges of the green robe. His feet are clad in pointed blue shoes, also decorated with gold. He sits on a simple, light brown bench or throne, only partially visible beneath his voluminous robes. In his hands, he holds a golden, lyre-like stringed instrument. It is shaped like an inverted trapezoid with a curved top, featuring a central circular sound hole and small decorative elements resembling crosses or flowers. His left hand rests on the strings, while his right hand appears to pluck them. The background is entirely gold leaf, heavily cracked and textured, forming an arch above the figure. The lower edge of the panel features a light pink band above a thin green line.

alt_text: A bearded man in blue and pink robes sits on a throne, holding two inscribed tablets, against a gold background.
long_description:
The painting depicts a seated, bearded man, likely a religious figure, against a gold and red background. The man occupies the central portion of the vertical rectangular panel. He has dark, curly hair and a full, dark beard. A circular gold halo with a patterned inner ring surrounds his head. He wears a light blue tunic with long sleeves, cinched at the waist, and a flowing pink or light purple cloak draped over his lap and extending down to his feet. His bare feet are visible beneath the cloak. He is seated on a green and gold throne-like structure with a stepped base.
The man holds two rectangular tablets, one in each hand, resting them on his lap. The tablets are light green with dark, vertical inscriptions. The text on the left tablet appears to be in Hebrew characters, arranged in vertical columns. The text on the right tablet also appears to be in Hebrew characters, similarly arranged.
The background behind the man is primarily gold, with a textured, cracked appearance. Above his head, a dark red arch frames the upper part of the gold background. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the figure centrally placed. The edges of the wooden panel are visible, showing some wear and damage.

alt_text: A bearded man in blue and red robes sits on a throne, holding a small house and a pointer against a gold background
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a seated, dark-skinned, bearded man against a gold background within an arched frame. The man, positioned centrally, wears a long, flowing blue robe and a red cloak draped over his left shoulder and lap. A blue turban covers his head, and a dark, full beard extends to his chest. He gazes forward with a neutral expression. His right hand is raised, holding a slender, dark pointer or stick, with his index finger extended upwards. In his left hand, resting on his lap, he holds a small, light brown, rectangular house-like structure with a dark rectangular opening on its front and a small arched opening on its side. He sits on a simple, light gray throne with a dark gray base. Behind his head is a circular gold halo with a patterned border. The background is predominantly gold leaf, heavily cracked and textured, forming an arch above the figure. The arch is bordered by a dark red band. Below the throne, the ground is a light pinkish-purple band, followed by a green band, and then a light brown, textured band at the very bottom. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the figure dominating the central space.

alt_text: A bearded man in a brown robe holds a book, with a crucifixion scene in the dark background
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a bearded man in a dark brown monastic robe, positioned in the foreground and looking directly forward. He has a somber expression, with a dark beard and receding hairline. His left hand is clenched into a fist, resting near his waist, while his right hand holds an open, dark green book. The man's robe is voluminous, covering most of his body, with a visible white cuff on his right wrist. In the upper left background, a smaller-scale scene shows a crucifixion, with a figure on a cross and several other figures gathered below, some in red and blue garments. The background behind the man and the crucifixion scene is a dark, muted landscape featuring rolling hills, sparse trees, and a dark, cloudy sky that transitions from a lighter teal-blue on the left to a darker blue-green on the right. The overall lighting is dim, with the man's face and hands being the most illuminated elements.

alt_text: A black and white painting of the Madonna holding the Christ Child, who holds a scroll.
long_description: A vertical, black and white painting depicts the Madonna and Child, centrally positioned within an arched frame. The Madonna, shown from the waist up, is seated and gazes slightly to her right with a calm expression. She wears a dark, long-sleeved robe that covers her head and drapes over her body, revealing a lighter-toned trim at her neck and a patterned garment beneath. Her left arm supports the Christ Child, who sits upright on her lap, facing directly forward. The Child has light-colored, short hair and a youthful, round face. He is clad in a simple, light-toned garment that covers his lower body and wears a dark cross pendant on a necklace around his neck. His right hand is raised with an open palm, while his left hand holds a scroll. The scroll, unfurled across his lap, displays the Latin text "EGO SUM VIA VERI" in dark lettering. The background behind the figures features a light-toned, intricate repeating pattern, enclosed by a dark, arched border that frames the top and sides of the composition. The figures occupy the majority of the vertical space within the frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, transferred from wood, gold ground

alt_text: Black and white painting of Christ on the cross, flanked by two grieving figures with halos.
long_description: A black and white, vertically oriented painting depicts a crucifixion scene with three figures. In the center, a male figure with a beard and long hair is affixed to a dark, simple cross. He wears a light loincloth, and his head is tilted to his right. A halo of light lines surrounds his head. His body shows defined musculature and appears emaciated. To the left of the cross, a female figure stands, draped in dark, heavy robes that cover her head and body. Her hands are clasped at her waist, and her head is bowed, looking downwards. A halo of light lines encircles her head. To the right of the cross, another female figure stands, dressed in lighter, flowing robes. Her left hand is raised with an open palm, while her right hand holds a small, dark object near her chest. Her head is slightly tilted, and she looks towards the central figure. A halo of light lines also surrounds her head. The background is a light, textured surface, and a decorative border of dark, wavy lines frames the entire composition.

alt_text: A crowded town square scene with many figures, some on a raised platform, surrounded by buildings under a cloudy sky
long_description: A wide, horizontal painting depicts a bustling urban scene under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground, a large crowd of people fills the lower half of the canvas. Many figures wear long robes and various head coverings, in earthy tones, reds, blues, and yellows. Some are gesturing, looking up towards a raised platform in the middle ground. A small white dog sits near the bottom center, and several children are present among the adults. The middle ground features a large, elevated stone platform or stage. On this platform, a central group of figures is gathered. To the right, a figure in a blue robe and white head covering stands near a railing, facing a group of men. One man, wearing a red tunic, is being held by others. To the left of the platform, a few figures walk away. Behind the platform, a large, multi-story building with a domed roof dominates the center-right. Other buildings, including a tall, square tower with a red dome, are visible further back. On the left, a tall, dark building with arched windows and balconies shows figures looking out. The background reveals more buildings and a distant green landscape with hills under the light blue sky.

metadata.title: Christ Presented to the People
metadata.medium: Oil, gold, and silver on linden

alt_text: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with a reddish-brown beard, wearing a dark suit and blue bow tie against a green background
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man with fair skin, facing forward, against a plain green background. His head is slightly turned to the left, and his gaze is directed straight ahead. He has a high forehead, light reddish-brown hair parted on his left side and combed back, and a full, neatly trimmed reddish-brown beard and mustache. His eyes are light in color, and his nose is prominent. His expression is neutral. He wears a dark, possibly black, suit jacket with wide lapels over a white collared shirt and a white waistcoat. A dark blue bow tie is tied loosely around his neck, resting above the white shirt and waistcoat. On his left lapel, a small red flower with green leaves is pinned. The suit jacket covers his shoulders and upper chest, with the white waistcoat visible beneath, showing two buttons. The background is a solid, muted green, appearing slightly darker towards the edges and lighter around the man's head. In the upper right corner, handwritten text is visible. The top line reads "d. M. S. Avery" in a cursive script. Below that, "S. R. Madrazo" is written, followed by "1876" on the next line. The brushstrokes are visible, giving the surface a subtle texture. The overall lighting illuminates the man's face and upper body, creating a soft contrast with the background.

alt_text: Two women in a dark window, one sitting on the ledge with a red bow, the other behind her.
long_description: An oil painting depicts two women positioned within a dark window opening. On the left, a younger woman with light skin and brown hair, tied up with a prominent red bow, sits on the window ledge. She wears a white ruffled garment with blue ribbon accents over a light pink skirt. Her left arm rests on a horizontal bar across the window, and her gaze is directed downwards and slightly to the right. Behind her, to the right, an older woman with light skin and dark hair, adorned with a dark hat featuring feathers and small flowers, leans forward. She wears a dark dress with white ruffled cuffs and rests her chin on her clasped hands, looking towards the younger woman. The background inside the window is dark, suggesting an interior or deep shadow. A green shutter is visible on the far left. On the right side of the window ledge, a small potted plant with green leaves and tiny red flowers is visible. The artist's signature, "L. R. Hidalgo," is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the painting.

alt_text: A bearded man points, standing with a young woman in a red hat and a boy with a dog.
long_description: The painting is a vertical oil on canvas, predominantly dark with a dramatic contrast between light and shadow. Three figures and a small dog are depicted in the foreground, set against a backdrop of a cloudy sky on the left and a dark architectural structure on the right. In the center, a tall, elderly man with a long white beard and mustache stands, facing slightly right but looking towards the viewer's left. He wears a rich red robe with a fur collar and a dark, turban-like hat. His right arm is extended to the left, palm open, as if pointing or gesturing. His left hand rests on the shoulder of a young woman standing to his right. The young woman, positioned slightly in front of the man, faces forward with her head tilted down, obscuring her eyes. She wears a white blouse, a blue skirt, and a wide-brimmed red hat. A small, furry object is tucked under her left arm, and she holds a woven basket-like container in her right hand. Her bare feet are visible on the dark ground. To the left and slightly behind the man, a young boy kneels or crouches, looking down and to the left. He wears a striped tunic and a head covering. His right arm is bent, holding a stick or bow. A small, dark dog with floppy ears is visible at the bottom left, looking up at the boy. The background on the left features a cloudy sky transitioning from light orange-brown at the horizon to dark blue-gray above. On the right, a dark, imposing building with a doorway and a small, indistinct figure on a balcony is visible. The ground beneath the figures is a dark, earthy tone.

alt_text: A portrait of a woman with curly hair and pearls, draped in fabric, set within an elaborate gold frame.
long_description: The image displays a framed portrait of a woman, presented against a dark background. The portrait itself is oval-shaped, depicting the woman from the chest up, angled slightly to her right but looking directly forward. She has light brown or blonde curly hair that falls to her shoulders. Her complexion is fair, with a hint of pink on her cheeks and lips. She wears a pearl necklace with a single, larger pearl pendant, and a pearl earring is visible on her left ear. Her attire consists of a cream-colored garment with a gold-trimmed neckline, partially covered by a flowing purple or magenta drape. Her right hand is visible, gently holding the purple fabric across her chest. The background behind her is dark, with a subtle reddish-brown hue visible on the right side, suggesting a curtain or drapery. The portrait is encased in a highly ornate, gilded wooden frame. The frame features intricate carvings of foliage, flowers, and fruit clusters along its sides. At the top center, a small, full-bodied figure of a woman with outstretched arms is carved. On the left and right sides, near the middle, are carved figures resembling cherubs or putti, each with wings and holding what appears to be a cluster of grapes or fruit. The bottom of the frame also displays elaborate floral and foliate carvings. The gold of the frame appears aged, with some areas showing wear.

metadata.title: Ingena Rotterdam (died 1704), Betrothed of Admiral Jacob Binkes

alt_text: Portrait of a man in armor holding a pistol, set within an ornate gilded frame with military motifs
long_description: A half-length portrait of a man in dark attire and armor is centered within a highly sculptural, gilded frame. The man has light skin, a serious expression, and long, wavy brown hair that reaches his shoulders. He wears a dark garment, a white ruffled collar, and a shiny metal breastplate and shoulder armor. A heavy gold chain with a circular medallion hangs around his neck. His right hand, adorned with a red cuff, holds a dark pistol. The background behind him is dark, with a faint suggestion of a dark landscape or seascape with a ship visible on the left. The ornate frame surrounding the portrait is gold-colored and features numerous three-dimensional military-themed elements. At the top, a figure on horseback with a flowing cape raises an arm. The sides of the frame are densely decorated with various armaments, including helmets, shields, spears, flags, drums, and small cherubic figures. The bottom of the frame continues this motif with a cannon on wheels, a horse's head, and other weapons and military equipment.

alt_text: A woman in a white cap and red bodice sews a decorative box while a baby sits in a high chair
long_description: An oil painting depicts a domestic interior scene with a woman and a baby. On the left, a woman sits on a dark chair, facing slightly right. She wears a white cap, a white collar over a red bodice, and a long white apron over a dark skirt. Her hands are engaged in sewing or embroidering a rectangular, ornate casket or box, which rests on her lap. The box is dark with gold and colorful patterns. To her right, a baby sits in a tall, light brown wooden high chair with a carved backrest. The baby wears a white gown and a red cap, looking directly forward with a neutral expression, holding a small, light-colored object in its right hand. The room features a dark green wall in the background, with a window on the far left showing dark panes and a hint of a lighter scene outside. On the right, a small wooden table covered with a red cloth holds a white pitcher with a dark lid.
