On the floor in front of the high chair, a dark bowl with a spoon, a dark object, and a silver-colored cylindrical object are visible. The signature "N. MAES" is visible on the floor near the high chair's base. The floor is light brown, and the overall lighting is dim, with light coming from the left.

alt_text: A portrait of a seated woman with a round face, dark clothing, and a light collar, holding a book.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a woman seated, facing directly forward, against a dark background. Her face is round with light skin, dark eyes, and a small mouth. Her dark hair is visible beneath a black cap. She wears a dark, possibly black, dress with wide, light blue-grey collar that extends over her shoulders and a white cuff on each wrist. Her hands are clasped together in her lap, holding a small, dark rectangular object, possibly a book or tablet. The background on the left side features a dark, draped curtain. On the right side, a lighter, more open area reveals a distant landscape with trees and a lighter sky, suggesting hills or mountains in the background.

alt_text: A young woman in a dimly lit room sits peeling vegetables, with a basket of produce nearby.
long_description: The painting depicts a young woman seated in a dimly lit interior, engaged in peeling. She is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing downwards towards her hands. Her skin is fair, and her dark hair is pulled back, covered by a reddish-brown headband. She wears a dark, possibly black, bodice over a red-sleeved garment, and a white apron covers her lap. In her hands, she holds a small knife and a round, light-colored object, from which she is removing a peel. Several other peeled or partially peeled items rest on her apron. To her left, a table is covered with a rich, patterned textile in shades of red, gold, and dark brown, featuring floral or abstract motifs. On this table sits a dark, woven basket filled with more round, reddish-brown items. To the woman's right, on the floor, is a simple wooden bucket with two metal bands. The background is a dark, muted brown wall, with a lighter, vertical strip of wall on the far right, where a small, dark, indistinct object is mounted. A strong light source appears to come from the upper right, illuminating the woman's face, hands, and the objects she is working on, creating a contrast with the surrounding shadows.

alt_text: A painting shows a group of people, including mothers and babies, gathered among ruins and barrels by the sea
long_description: This painting depicts a bustling outdoor scene with numerous figures, architectural ruins, and wooden barrels under a cloudy sky. In the upper left, a large, crumbling stone archway, partially overgrown with vegetation, frames a section of the blue sky. Below it, a group of people is gathered. A woman in a light-colored dress holds a baby, while another woman in a blue and yellow garment also cradles an infant. A man in a light robe kneels nearby, and other figures are seated or lying on the ground, some with their arms raised. At the center of the composition, two large wooden barrels are stacked vertically. A dark bird with a white chest stands atop the smaller, upper barrel. Two smaller figures, possibly children, stand near the base of the larger barrel, reaching towards it. One wears a light pink tunic, and the other, with darker skin, is dressed in brown. To the right, a man in a blue jacket, white shirt, and light-colored pants sits on a low stone wall, looking towards the central activity. Several barrels are scattered around him. In the background on the right, a stone bridge with multiple arches spans over a body of water, revealing a distant blue sea and coastline. The sky above is a mix of light blue, white, and grey clouds. The ground is a textured mix of dirt, wooden planks, and stone, with various small objects and containers. The overall color palette features blues, browns, ochres, and muted tones for the figures' clothing.

alt_text: Several nuns in a dimly lit room engaged in various domestic tasks like sewing and spinning.
long_description: An oil painting depicts seven nuns in a dimly lit, dark brown room, engaged in various domestic activities. The overall color palette is dominated by warm browns, ochres, and dark grays, with accents of white and pale blue. Light enters from a window in the upper left corner, casting a soft, pale blue glow. In the left foreground, a nun in a brown habit and white coif is seated, sewing white fabric. Next to her is a small wooden table with more white fabric and a basket. In the center foreground, another nun is seated, leaning over a low wooden table, working with white fabric. A small wooden stool is positioned near her feet. Further back, slightly to the left of center, a nun is seated, working with a piece of blue fabric. To the right of center, a nun is seated, operating a large wooden spinning wheel. In the right foreground, a nun is seated with her back mostly to the viewer, working with white fabric. In the background, on the left, a standing nun holds a tray with objects. On the right side of the background, another standing nun holds a tray near a wooden shelf unit that displays various pottery and other items. A white ball of yarn rests on the dark floor in the center of the room. The room contains several wooden chairs, tables, and stools.

alt_text: A seated woman in a white gown looks down at two cherubic children playing with hearts and arrows on draped fabric
long_description: The image is a vertical oil painting depicting a seated woman and two children. The woman is positioned in the upper center, facing slightly left with her head bowed, looking downwards. She has long, light brown hair that falls over her shoulders. She wears a loose, off-white or light grey gown that drapes over her body, exposing her right shoulder and arm. Her left leg is visible, wrapped in a white fabric, resting on a patterned step or cushion. To the lower left and right of the woman are two cherubic children. The child on the left has blonde curly hair and wears a light yellow garment, looking towards the child on the right. This child holds a red heart pierced by an arrow. The child on the right is mostly nude, with reddish-brown curly hair, and is seen from behind, reaching towards the green draped fabric. The children are interacting with a dark green, richly textured fabric that is draped over a golden-brown patterned fabric. Several red hearts pierced with arrows are scattered on the green fabric. Behind the woman is a deep red, heavily draped curtain or fabric, filling the upper left and central background. To her right, behind her shoulder, is a basket or container filled with white flowers and green foliage, resting on a patterned cushion. The overall color palette is rich, with deep reds, greens, and golden tones contrasting with the lighter skin tones and white gown.

alt_text: A wide landscape painting featuring a large central tree, a castle, cliffs with a waterfall, and groups of figures
long_description: An expansive landscape painting depicts a verdant scene under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground, to the right, a group of approximately ten figures stands on a rocky path. They wear various colored garments, including reds, blues, and whites, and some carry staffs or banners. Behind them, a tall, rugged cliff face rises, covered with green foliage at its top and featuring a small waterfall cascading down its side into a pool below. Further left, another smaller waterfall is visible. In the center of the composition, a large, prominent tree with a thick, dark trunk and dense green foliage stands tall, dominating the midground. Its branches extend widely. Near the base of this tree, slightly to the left, two smaller figures are visible, one in blue and one in red, appearing to walk along a path. To the far left, in the midground, a fortified castle with multiple square towers and walls is situated on a hill, surrounded by trees. Below the castle, in a grassy area, several small groups of figures are scattered across the landscape. The background opens into a vast valley, stretching into the distance with rolling green hills and fields. A hazy, light blue sky with soft clouds covers the upper portion of the painting. Distant mountains with faint outlines are visible on the horizon. The overall color palette is dominated by greens, browns, and blues, with touches of red and white in the figures' clothing.

metadata.title: David at the Cave of Adullam

alt_text: A bust-length portrait of a bearded man in a dark fur hat against a blue-green background with text below
long_description: This bust-length portrait depicts a man turned slightly to his left, with his gaze directed to the left. He has light skin, light-colored eyes, and a prominent nose. A full, dark brown beard covers his chin and cheeks, connecting to short, dark hair visible under his hat. He wears a large, fluffy, dark brown fur hat with a dark, possibly braided, band visible underneath. His attire consists of a dark, likely black, garment, possibly fur-lined, with a small white collar visible at his neck. The background is a solid, uniform blue-green color. Across the bottom of the painting, a light, off-white band contains two lines of black text in a gothic-style font. The text reads: "DA MAN • 1517 • ZALT • SEBASTIAᴺ WAS ICH • 48 • IAR ALT ANNDORFE ER". The "N" in "SEBASTIAN" is small and raised.

alt_text: A portrait of a fair-skinned, bearded man in a dark cap and coat, looking left against a light blue background
long_description: The painting is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, positioned slightly to the left and looking towards the left edge of the frame. His fair skin contrasts with his reddish-brown, full beard and mustache. He has light blue eyes, a straight nose, and a prominent forehead. His hairline is receding, and he wears a dark, possibly black, cap with a visible woven or textured pattern covering the top of his head. He is dressed in a dark, likely black, coat or robe. A wide, white collar is visible at his neck, extending upwards from beneath the dark outer garment. Beneath the white collar, a dark, subtly patterned garment is visible. The background is a solid, light blue, providing a simple backdrop for the figure. The lighting is even, highlighting the man's face and the details of his attire.

alt_text: A man in a black hat and white headscarf sits playing a guitar and singing against a dark background.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a man seated, playing a guitar and singing, against a plain, dark brown background. The man is positioned slightly off-center to the right, his body angled towards the viewer. He wears a wide-brimmed black hat, a white headscarf, a black jacket with fringed shoulders, a white shirt, and light gray trousers. His head is tilted back, and his mouth is open, suggesting he is singing. His left hand is positioned on the guitar's fretboard, while his right hand strums the strings near the soundhole. The guitar is a light brown acoustic instrument with dark accents. He sits on a simple, dark green wooden bench. A red ribbon hangs from the guitar's neck, extending downwards. On the floor to the right, near his feet, are a reddish-brown ceramic jug with a handle and spout, and a small cluster of light-colored onions or garlic bulbs. To the left, near his left foot, a small, light-colored object, possibly a cigarette butt, rests on the floor. The artist's signature, "ED. MANET", is visible in light script on the right side of the green bench.

alt_text: A young matador in black holds a sword and pink cape, standing in a bullring with a bull and other figures.
long_description: The painting depicts a bullfighting scene, dominated by a young person dressed as a matador in the foreground. The matador stands facing forward, slightly turned to their right, holding a long, thin sword pointed upwards in their right hand and a voluminous pink cape in their left hand. They wear a wide-brimmed black hat, a light-colored scarf tied around their neck, a black jacket with yellow accents on the shoulders and waist, black breeches with tassels at the knees, light-colored stockings, and brown flat shoes with white laces. Their face is pale with light hair. The background shows a bullring arena with a reddish-brown wall. The ground is a light, sandy color in the foreground, transitioning to a darker, shadowed tone further back. To the right, a picador on a light-colored horse faces right, holding a lance. A dark bull is positioned near the horse. Several other figures, some in white, stand near the arena wall in the upper right. A small blue figure is visible near the wall in the upper left.

metadata.title: Mademoiselle V. . . in the Costume of an Espada

alt_text: A still life painting featuring a large loaf of bread, various fruits, a white rose, and a red box on a table.
long_description: A still life painting depicts a collection of objects arranged on a dark wooden table against a dark, almost black background. In the center, a large, round, dark brown loaf of bread rests on a white cloth with fringed edges. To the left of the bread, a round, lidded red box with a blue ribbon draped over its side sits on the table. Behind the red box, a dark basket holds a pile of dark purple plums. To the right of the bread, a single white rose with green leaves stands upright. Below the rose, a cluster of three light orange-pink peaches is arranged. Further to the right, a bunch of green grapes and a knife with a dark handle and a silver blade are visible on the white cloth. The front edge of the dark wooden table features ornate, gold-colored carvings.

alt_text: A man and woman in a small wooden boat on a body of blue water, with a partial sail visible
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in a wooden boat on a body of water, rendered in shades of blue and turquoise. The water fills the upper two-thirds of the canvas, showing subtle ripples and reflections. The boat, a dark brown, occupies the lower portion, angled slightly from the lower left to the upper right. On the right side of the boat, a man sits facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a white short-sleeved shirt and white trousers. A light-colored straw hat with a green band sits on his head. He has a mustache and short, dark hair. His right arm is bent, with his hand resting on the boat's edge, while his left hand is out of view. To the left of the man, a woman sits facing to her right, looking away from the viewer. She wears a blue and white striped dress with vertical lines, and a large, elaborate white hat adorned with dark ribbons or fabric. Her hair is dark and pulled back. Her left arm is visible, resting on the side of the boat. A small, light-colored sail is partially visible on the far right, attached to a mast that extends upwards from the boat. Near the man's feet, a small pile of light-colored objects, possibly fish, rests in the bottom of the boat.

alt_text: A full-length portrait of a blond boy in dark clothing holding a drum-like object and a stick.
long_description: The painting depicts a full-length portrait of a young boy standing against a plain, dark background. The boy has fair skin, light eyes, and short, light blond hair. He looks directly forward with a neutral expression. He wears a white, rounded collar over a dark, long-sleeved jacket or tunic. Below the jacket, he has brown breeches that extend to his knees, and bright blue stockings covering his lower legs. His feet are clad in dark, low-heeled shoes. In his left hand, held close to his chest, is a dark, ornate object that resembles the hilt of a sword or a decorative handle. His right hand grasps a large, light brown, oval-shaped object, possibly a drum or a shield, which rests against his right side. He also holds a long, dark stick or rod vertically in his right hand, extending downwards. The boy's body is slightly turned to his right, with his left foot positioned forward and his right foot slightly back. The background consists of a dark brown wall, and a lighter gray floor extends from the bottom of the painting. The lighting highlights the boy's face and the front of his attire.

alt_text: A dark, dramatic painting shows several figures, some nude, struggling amidst a chaotic, shadowy scene.
long_description: A dark, dramatic oil painting depicts a chaotic scene with multiple figures, some partially obscured, in a turbulent environment. In the upper left, a figure in a dark blue-green cloak and a reddish-orange head covering raises their right arm, holding what appears to be a torch or light source that casts a warm glow. To their right, another figure, also with a reddish-orange head covering, is partially visible, looking towards the right. Below these figures, the scene becomes more entangled. In the lower left, a pale, possibly nude or lightly draped figure lies horizontally, with an arm raised, seemingly amidst swirling white and grey forms that suggest water or turbulent fabric. In the lower right, a large, muscular, reddish-brown figure, possibly nude, is entangled with other forms, its head obscured but a strong torso and limbs visible. The background is predominantly dark, with deep greens and browns, creating a strong contrast with the illuminated figures. The brushstrokes are visible and expressive, contributing to the dynamic and intense atmosphere.

alt_text: A pale, bare-chested man with a halo is supported by two winged angels in a dark setting.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a pale, bare-chested man with a beard and short dark hair, seated and supported by two winged figures against a dark background. The man, positioned centrally, has a faint halo above his head and visible wounds on his hands, feet, and right side. His eyes are open, and his mouth is slightly agape. White drapery covers his lower body, pooling around his legs and feet. To his left, an angel with dark red robes and dark wings bows their head, resting their left hand on their forehead in a gesture of grief. To the man's right, another angel with an orange robe, white sleeves, and blue wings looks towards the man, gently supporting his head with their left hand and his arm with their right. The background is a dark, indistinct cave-like setting. In the lower right foreground, two light brown skulls and a dark snake are visible on the dark ground. The painting features strong contrasts between the illuminated figures and the deep shadows of the background. The artist's signature, 'Manet', is visible in the lower left corner.

alt_text: A wide landscape painting depicts a river with people fishing, a couple, a dog, and a rainbow in the sky
long_description: The painting is a wide, horizontal landscape featuring a river or lake under a dramatic sky. In the upper left, dark clouds give way to lighter blue sky with white clouds on the right. A faint, multi-colored rainbow arches across the upper left quadrant. On a distant green hill in the upper center, a town with a prominent church spire is visible. The middle ground is dominated by a wide body of water, likely a river, with green banks. On the far left bank, a person in light clothing sits, appearing to fish with a long pole. Further right in the water, two men are in a small, dark boat. One man, wearing a white shirt and dark pants, bends over a net. The other man, shirtless with light pants, stands at the back of the boat, holding a long pole. A smaller figure, possibly a child in a straw hat, sits between them. On the right bank, a man and a woman stand together. The man, on the right, wears a red and yellow outfit with a white ruffled collar. The woman, on the left, wears a dark blue dress with a wide black hat and a white collar. A lean, brown dog stands facing right, between the couple and the boat. The right side of the painting is bordered by dense green trees, with more trees visible on the distant hills. The foreground features dark green foliage and some logs partially submerged in the water on the left.

alt_text: A painting of a city on a hill under a cloudy sky, with dark trees and figures around a carriage in the foreground.
long_description: An oil painting depicts a landscape under a cloudy sky. The upper portion of the canvas shows a grey and white sky with hints of light blue. Below the sky, a city or town is situated on a prominent hill, rendered in muted tones of grey, white, and light brown. Several domed buildings and other structures are visible along the skyline of the city. Dark green, slender, tree-like forms are scattered across the hillside. The middle ground features a wide expanse of green, suggesting a field or park, with visible brushstrokes. On the left side of this green area, a cluster of tall, dark green trees with slender trunks rises from the lower edge of the canvas. In the lower right quadrant, a group of dark, indistinct figures stands around a dark, rectangular object, which appears to be a carriage or hearse. One figure stands to the right of the carriage, seemingly attending to it. The overall palette is dominated by greens, greys, and dark browns, with a somber atmosphere.

alt_text: A loosely painted portrait of a bearded man in a hat, seated at a table, looking right
long_description: A loosely painted, horizontal portrait depicts a man seated at a table, rendered in muted colors against a light, warm beige background. The man is positioned in the left and center of the frame, facing right in profile. He wears a dark, rounded hat and a dark blue-grey jacket over a lighter shirt with a green cravat or tie. His left arm rests on the table, with his left hand supporting his head, fingers lightly touching his cheek. He has a reddish-brown beard and hair, and his facial features are softly defined with hints of light pink for skin tone. His eyes are not clearly delineated. A light-colored table extends horizontally across the lower half of the painting, with a dark, indistinct base visible beneath it. On the table to the far right, a faint, vertical, dark-lined object, possibly a glass or stand, is depicted. The painting has an unfinished, sketch-like quality, with visible brushwork and areas where the canvas or ground shows through.

alt_text: A head-and-shoulders oil portrait of a man with a brown beard and light skin, looking forward
long_description: A vertical oil portrait depicts a man from the chest up, set against a dark, indistinct background. The man has light-toned skin, a prominent, full brown beard that covers his chin and cheeks, and short, dark brown hair. His eyes are a light color, and he looks directly out of the frame, slightly to the viewer's left. His nose is straight, and his lips are a muted pink. Hints of pink are visible in his cheeks and around his eyes, suggesting a healthy complexion. He wears a white garment, possibly a shirt or jacket, rendered with broad, visible brushstrokes. A dark, possibly blue or black, collar or lapel is visible on his left side, contrasting with the white fabric. The lower part of the white garment is less defined, blending into the dark background. The background itself is a warm, dark brown, almost black in some areas, with subtle variations in tone, providing a stark contrast to the man's face and white clothing. The overall brushwork throughout the painting is loose and expressive.

alt_text: A painted portrait shows a man with a dark beard and mustache, wearing a light-colored jacket.
long_description: This is a head-and-shoulders oil portrait of a man, positioned slightly to the right but looking directly forward. The background is a dark, muted brown, almost black, with visible brushstrokes, particularly on the right side, suggesting a textured surface. The man's head is slightly tilted to his right. He has a full, dark brown beard and mustache that covers his chin and upper lip. His skin tone is light, with subtle hints of pink on his cheeks and nose. His eyes are dark and appear to be looking straight out of the canvas. His eyebrows are dark and thick, and his dark brown hair recedes slightly at the temples. He wears a light, muted beige or tan jacket with a visible lapel on the left side. Underneath the jacket, a white shirt collar is visible, and a dark tie or cravat is tied at his neck. The brushstrokes on his clothing are broad and visible, contributing to the overall texture of the painting. His shoulders are angled slightly to the right, and his upper body fills the lower half of the canvas.

alt_text: A painted portrait of a woman in a dark hat and light gray coat, looking right.
long_description: A vertical, loosely painted portrait depicts a woman from the chest up, positioned slightly left of center and facing right in profile. Her skin is pale, with subtle pink tones on her cheeks and lips. Her light brown hair is visible beneath a large, dark, wide-brimmed hat that appears black or very dark gray. The hat has an irregular, somewhat crumpled shape with a small, dark decorative element on its crown. She wears a light gray coat or jacket, characterized by broad, visible brushstrokes, and a high, ruffled white collar. Her right arm is bent, and her pale, elongated fingers are visible holding a thin, dark object, possibly a cane or umbrella handle, against her body. The background is a muted, light gray, rendered with broad, visible brushstrokes of dark gray and black, creating an abstract, textured backdrop that lacks specific details. The painting has an unfinished or sketch-like quality, with a limited color palette primarily of grays, blacks, and pale skin tones.

alt_text: A full-length portrait of a bullfighter in ornate costume, holding a hat and a red cape, against a dark background
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man in a bullfighter's costume standing against a plain, dark brown background. The man faces right, with his head turned slightly to his left, looking upwards. He has dark hair, prominent sideburns, a mustache, and a short beard. His left arm is raised, holding a black hat with a bright yellow or gold lining. His right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a folded red cape and a thin, dark stick, possibly a muleta or sword. He wears a light gray or silver jacket with intricate embroidery and tassels on the shoulders. Beneath the jacket, a white shirt and a light blue tie are visible, along with a wide, light pink sash around his waist. His tight-fitting trousers are dark brown or black with light gray or silver stripes running down the sides. He wears white stockings and black, flat shoes. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, casting a subtle shadow to the right of his feet.

alt_text: A large bouquet of white, pink, and purple flowers in a white vase on a brown table, with one fallen flower
long_description: The painting depicts a still life featuring a large bouquet of flowers in a vase, set against a plain gray background. The white vase, centrally positioned, has a bulbous base tapering to a narrower neck, and is subtly adorned with small, light yellow and green decorative motifs near its base and rim. Overflowing from the vase is a dense arrangement of flowers, primarily in shades of white, pale pink, and light purple, interspersed with numerous dark green leaves. The flowers appear full and rounded, with visible brushstrokes defining their petals. Below the vase, a reddish-brown surface, possibly a wooden table or shelf, extends across the lower portion of the canvas. On this surface, to the left of the vase, a single white flower with a stem and several green leaves lies horizontally. The overall composition is vertical, with the bouquet dominating the upper half and the vase and table occupying the lower half. The brushwork throughout the painting is loose and expressive.

alt_text: A still life painting shows a dark woven basket overflowing with red strawberries and green leaves on a light surface.
long_description: This still life painting features a dark, woven basket filled to overflowing with red strawberries and green leaves, set against a muted background. The basket occupies the lower central portion of the canvas, its dark brown and black brushstrokes suggesting a rough, textured weave. A prominent shadow extends from the right side of the basket onto the light, off-white surface it rests upon. The strawberries are piled high, forming a vibrant mound of red and orange-red hues. They appear plump and round, with varying shades indicating light and shadow, and some small, lighter dots suggesting seeds. Interspersed among the berries and peeking from the basket's rim are several small, loosely painted green and blue-green leaves, adding a touch of freshness. The background is a plain, dark gray or greenish-gray, providing a stark contrast that makes the colorful fruit stand out. The artist's signature, "Manet," is visible in dark script in the lower right corner of the painting.

alt_text: A woman in a pale pink dress stands holding a green sprig, with a grey parrot on a wooden stand.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a woman standing centrally against a dark, plain background. She has reddish-brown hair pulled back with a blue ribbon and a pale complexion. Her light-colored eyes look directly forward, and she wears a black choker with a gold medallion. She is dressed in a long, loose-fitting pale pink gown with long sleeves that have white cuffs. A row of light-colored buttons extends down the front of her dress. Her right hand, held near her chest, grasps a small green sprig. Her left hand, positioned lower, holds a lorgnette attached to a long string that hangs from her neck. To her right, a grey parrot with red tail feathers is perched on a dark wooden stand. The stand has several horizontal crossbars and a round, shallow metal tray at its base. Inside the tray, a partially peeled citrus fruit, possibly a grapefruit or orange, lies with its peel scattered nearby. The floor beneath her and the stand is a slightly lighter shade of the dark background.

alt_text: A man, woman, and child in a lush garden with chickens and a watering can.
long_description: An impressionistic oil painting depicts a family scene set in a vibrant green garden. The composition is divided into two main groups. On the left, a man with a dark beard, wearing a blue shirt, dark pants, and a black cap, bends forward, appearing to tend to a patch of red flowers. A grey metal watering can rests on the grass near his feet. In the lower left foreground, a brown hen and a white hen peck at the ground, accompanied by two small yellow chicks. On the right side of the painting, a woman and a child are seated or reclining under the shade of a tree with a dark trunk and green foliage. The woman, with dark hair visible under a white and blue patterned hat, wears a light-colored, possibly white, dress with a full skirt that spreads across the grass. A red fan is visible near her. Beside her, a young child in a light blue outfit and a straw hat reclines on a white cloth or blanket, looking towards the viewer. The background features dense green trees and bushes, with scattered red blossoms adding pops of color. The foreground is dominated by broad strokes of bright green grass. The artist's signature, 'manet', is visible in dark script in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: The Monet Family in Their Garden at Argenteuil

alt_text: A painting of the Nativity with Mary kneeling over the infant Jesus, Joseph sleeping, and figures approaching in a landscape
long_description: This painting depicts a Nativity scene set within a detailed, expansive landscape under a blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the center, a woman with light skin, wearing a blue cloak over a pink dress, kneels with her hands pressed together in prayer, looking down. Before her, an infant with light skin lies on a blue cloth on the ground. Surrounding the infant and the kneeling woman are several small, winged figures, depicted in reddish-orange hues, some appearing to float. To the left, a man with a beard and light skin sits, leaning his head on his right hand, appearing to be asleep. He wears a bright yellow cloak draped over a red garment. Behind him is a rustic structure with a wooden frame and a thatched roof, next to a tree bearing orange fruits. A brown cow's head is visible behind a woven fence in the far left. To the right, two men with dark hair and light skin approach, looking towards the infant. The man in front wears a green tunic and blue trousers, while the man behind him wears a reddish garment. Further back on the right, two more figures walk along a winding path that leads into the distance. The background features rolling green hills, a large, jagged rock formation on the left, and a distinctive, tall, bare tree with a forked top in the middle distance. A body of water is visible in the mid-ground on the left, with a small building nearby.

metadata.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
metadata.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: Madonna and Child with a bearded man and another woman, all with halos, against a dark background with fruit
long_description: The painting features four figures arranged in a vertical composition against a dark background. In the center, a woman with light skin and a solemn expression looks slightly downward and to her right. She wears a yellow head covering that drapes over her shoulders, a dark green cloak, and a reddish-purple dress. She holds a nude infant with light skin, who stands on her lap, facing forward with a slightly worried expression. The infant's right leg is bent, and his left leg is extended, with his foot resting in a white, shell-like object on the woman's lap. Both the woman and the infant have golden halos. To the left of the central woman, a bearded man with a receding hairline and a somber expression looks directly forward. He wears a reddish-orange garment and has a golden halo. To the right of the central woman, another woman with light skin and a serious expression looks towards the center. She wears a reddish-orange head covering that frames her face and a dark garment, also with a golden halo. The background behind the figures is dark, almost black, with several small, round, orange-red fruits scattered among dark foliage, particularly visible above the central figures. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the figures against the dark setting.

metadata.title: The Holy Family with Saint Mary Magdalen

alt_text: A painting depicts a Madonna holding a child, surrounded by numerous winged cherubs against a dark background
long_description: This arched painting features a Madonna holding a child, centrally positioned against a dense background of winged figures. The Madonna, with light-toned skin, looks down and slightly to her right. She wears a light blue head covering, a white draped garment over her shoulders, and a dark, long-sleeved robe. A golden halo with faint, illegible script encircles her head. The plump, light-skinned child rests in her arms, his eyes closed and head tilted back. He wears a dark, simple garment, and his bare feet are visible at the bottom, resting on a horizontal, striped ledge. The background is filled with numerous winged cherubs. On the left side, these figures are predominantly reddish-orange, blending into the dark background and appearing less distinct. On the right side, the cherubs have brownish skin tones and more clearly defined wings, with some figures also featuring small golden halos. The overall background is dark, creating a contrast with the lighter skin tones of the Madonna and Child. The composition is tightly framed within the arched top of the panel.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Seraphim and Cherubim

alt_text: A head and shoulders portrait of a young man in a red cap and gold tunic against a blue background
long_description: This vertically oriented rectangular portrait depicts a young man from the chest up, set against a plain blue background. The figure is positioned slightly to the left, with his gaze directed subtly upward and to the left. He has a light skin tone, and his dark hair is visible beneath a bright red, close-fitting cap that covers the top and sides of his head. His eyes are light-colored, with a calm, somewhat distant expression. His nose is long and straight, and his lips are thin and closed. He wears a richly decorated garment. The main body of his tunic is a golden-brown color, featuring vertical lines and circular or floral motifs around the chest and shoulders. The sleeves, visible at the shoulders and upper arms, are a contrasting reddish-orange. A narrow collar, red with a thin gold band, is visible at his neck. A dark, textured border frames the entire painted area, showing some signs of age.

alt_text: A woman in a blue satin dress stands in profile, looking down while holding a white ribbon.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young woman standing in profile, facing right, against a plain, light-colored wall. She wears an elaborate, floor-length gown of shimmering blue-grey satin. The dress features a fitted bodice with a white collar, ruffled white cuffs, and dark trim along the sleeves and waist. Her dark hair is styled in an updo, and her head is tilted downwards, her gaze fixed on a long, white ribbon or sash that she holds with both hands at chest level. Her hands are delicately positioned as if she is tying or untying the ribbon. To her right, a small, dark, ornate wooden table stands beside her, holding a folded red cloth, a single red rose in a small clear vase, and a small, rectangular object with a blue frame. The floor beneath her is covered by a patterned rug in shades of red, gold, and dark brown. A vertical, light-colored panel with subtle molding is visible on the left side of the background. In the upper right corner, the name "Charles, Landelle" is inscribed.

alt_text: A brown cow stands in shallow water under a dramatic cloudy sky, with fields and other cows in the distance.
long_description: An oil painting depicts a pastoral landscape under a dramatic sky. In the foreground, a large, light brown cow stands in dark, shallow water, facing left with its head slightly raised. Its body is mostly visible, with its hind legs submerged. To the left of the cow, a dark wooden structure, possibly a sluice gate or part of a fence, rises from the water amidst tall green grasses and white wildflowers. The water reflects the dark tones of the sky above. In the midground, a flat, expansive green field stretches across the canvas, dotted with more white and yellow wildflowers. Two smaller cows, one dark brown and one reddish-brown, graze in the distant field. The upper half of the painting is dominated by a vast, cloudy sky. Dark grey storm clouds gather on the right, while lighter, broken clouds with hints of blue are visible on the left. A small dark bird flies in the upper right sky.

alt_text: A long painting shows a procession of people on horseback outside a city and a banquet inside an arched hall.
long_description: This horizontal panel painting is divided into two main scenes: an outdoor procession on the left and an indoor banquet on the right. The left side depicts a bustling city street with a long line of people, many on horseback, moving from left to right. In the background, various buildings with red-tiled roofs and light-colored stone walls are visible, including a prominent grey church with a large rose window and two spires. The figures in the procession wear elaborate garments, predominantly in shades of gold, red, and dark blue, with intricate patterns. Their horses are depicted in white, black, brown, and grey, adorned with decorative gold and red trappings. Several figures walk alongside the horses, some carrying bundles. The scene transitions to the right into an open hall with dark arched ceilings supported by light-colored columns. The background wall of the hall is covered in a rich, patterned gold fabric. Numerous figures, similarly dressed in opulent gold and red attire, populate this space. In the foreground, a long table covered with a white tablecloth is set with multiple red cups and gold vessels. Several individuals are seated around the table, while others stand nearby, some appearing to serve or interact. The overall impression is one of a grand event, with a continuous flow of activity from the outdoor arrival to the indoor celebration.

metadata.title: The Story of Esther
metadata.artist: Marco del Buono Giamberti|Apollonio di Giovanni di Tomaso

alt_text: A painting depicting a cloudy sky over a riverbank with a large building, figures, and boats.
long_description:
The oil painting presents a wide, low-angle view of a river scene under a cloudy sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by a light blue sky filled with large, textured white and gray clouds, showing visible brushstrokes. The horizon line runs across the middle of the painting, featuring a dark, indistinct line of trees and buildings. A prominent light-colored tower or spire rises above the trees in the central-right background.

In the left foreground, a large, reddish-brown building with visible brickwork occupies the left edge, extending upwards to about two-thirds of the canvas height. A bare, thin tree stands in front of this building, slightly to the right. A dirt path or road stretches from the lower left towards the center, where two figures are visible. One appears to be a person standing next to a light-colored animal, possibly a horse or donkey, facing away from the viewer. Further right, another lone figure in dark clothing stands near the edge of a body of water, looking towards the right.

The water, a dark blue-green, occupies the lower right quadrant of the painting. Several dark boats are moored along the bank, their shapes indistinct. The bank itself is a light brown, sloping gently into the water. The artist's signature, "J. MONA," is visible in dark letters in the lower left corner of the path. The overall color palette is muted, with browns, grays, and blues dominating.

alt_text: A figure with long reddish hair and a green garment kneels, head bowed, in a dark setting.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a figure kneeling or crouching in a dark, somber setting. The figure, positioned slightly to the right of the center, faces towards the left with their head bowed downwards. Long, reddish-brown hair cascades over their shoulders and back, appearing to be adorned with a light-colored, possibly floral, wreath or crown on top of the head. The figure wears a loose, flowing green garment that covers most of their body, with some lighter, possibly gold-colored, embellishments visible on the chest area. Their hands are clasped together or holding an indistinct object in front of them. To the lower left of the figure, a small, lighter shape with dark markings is faintly visible, possibly a small animal or object. The background is dark and largely undifferentiated, with hints of darker tones on the left and a slightly lighter, earthy tone on the ground beneath the figure. In the upper right corner, faint text reads 'R.B.L. / 1754'.

alt_text: A large red poppy with insects and small animals in a dark, overgrown natural setting
long_description: A dark, vertically oriented oil painting depicts a large, ruffled red poppy and various small creatures in a dense, natural environment. The background is predominantly dark brown and black, with faint suggestions of a brick wall on the left and a gnarled tree trunk on the right. The prominent red poppy, with a dark blue-black center, is positioned slightly right of the canvas's vertical center in the upper half. Its stem extends downwards, surrounded by numerous large, dark green, lobed leaves, some with serrated edges. Several smaller, closed poppy buds are visible along the main stem and among the leaves. In the upper left, a brown and orange butterfly with patterned wings is in flight. Below it, a dragonfly with a striped body and transparent wings rests on a leaf. A slender, light-bellied snake with a darker back is coiled among the lower leaves and moss, its head visible near the center. On the ground, a lizard with a striped body and tail is positioned in the lower left. Several snails with spiral shells are scattered on the leaves and the mossy ground. A cluster of small, light-capped mushrooms grows on the moss near the bottom center. In the upper right, a pale butterfly or moth is visible, and another white moth rests on a brown, brick-like object in the lower right corner. The ground is covered in dark green moss, brown earth, and small debris.

metadata.title: Still Life with Poppy, Insects, and Reptiles

alt_text: A tall, narrow panel painting depicts a bearded saint in a robe holding a staff and book, with a smaller figure above
long_description: The image is a black and white photograph of a tall, narrow, vertically oriented panel painting. The artwork is structured into two main sections: a triangular pediment at the top and a larger rectangular panel below. In the triangular pediment, a half-length figure of a man is depicted. He has long, dark hair and a beard, and looks slightly to the right. He wears a dark, possibly textured tunic and a lighter, draped garment over his left shoulder. Below him, a scroll unfurls with the text "ECCE AGNUS DEI" visible. The main rectangular panel features a full-length standing figure of an older man with a long, light-toned beard and dark hair. He wears a dark, hooded robe that falls in heavy folds to his feet. His right hand holds a T-shaped staff, which rests vertically on the ground beside him. His left hand holds a closed, rectangular book, partially concealed by the folds of his robe. The figure stands within an arched niche, which is decorated with intricate Gothic-style tracery above his head. The background behind the figure is a plain, lighter tone. The entire panel is framed by architectural elements, including columns on the sides. At the very bottom of the artwork, a rectangular base displays the text "S. ANTONIUS. AB." in light letters against a dark band. This text is flanked by two diamond shapes, each containing a cross pattern.

metadata.title: Saint Anthony Abbot (with Saint John the Baptist)

alt_text: Tall panel painting: standing male figure with book and staff, smaller female figure above
long_description: This tall, narrow, black and white panel painting features a full-length standing male figure within an architectural niche, topped by a smaller, triangular section containing a bust-length female figure. The main figure, positioned centrally, faces forward with a direct gaze. He has short, dark hair and a beard, and a circular halo with radiating lines surrounds his head. He wears a long, flowing robe that drapes around his body, revealing his bare feet at the bottom. His left hand holds a dark, closed book against his chest, while his right hand grasps a tall, slender staff or rod that extends from the bottom to near his shoulder. The architectural niche around him is ornate, with a pointed arch at the top featuring decorative tracery and a scalloped border. Two slender columns flank the figure. Below the main figure, a horizontal band contains the faint, capitalized inscription "S. IACOBVS". Above the main section, a triangular pediment houses the smaller female figure. She is depicted from the chest up, with her head tilted downwards and her hands clasped at her chest. She wears a dark, hooded garment, and a halo encircles her head. The background behind both figures appears light, possibly gilded or painted with a subtle pattern.

metadata.title: Saint James the Greater (with the Virgin of the Annunciation)

alt_text: A standing male saint with a sword and quill, beneath a triangular panel depicting a bishop.
long_description:
This black and white image depicts a tall, narrow religious panel painting, likely a saint, set within an architectural frame. At the very top, a triangular pediment culminates in a small finial. Within the triangular space below the pediment, a half-length figure of a man is visible, wearing a miter (bishop's hat) and holding a book in his left hand. He faces slightly towards the right.

Below this triangular section, the main rectangular panel features a full-length standing male figure. A halo encircles his head. He has short, dark hair and a beard. He wears a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves, draped in vertical folds. His left hand (viewer's right) holds a quill or feather pen, while his right hand (viewer's left) rests on the hilt of a long sword that hangs vertically beside him. His feet are visible, appearing bare or in light-colored sandals. The figure stands within an arched niche, decorated with Gothic-style pointed tracery and foliage patterns. The entire main panel is flanked by narrow architectural columns.

At the bottom, a rectangular base features the inscription "S. PRISUS. RVOS." in white capital letters on a dark background, framed by a decorative border with diamond shapes.

metadata.title: Saint Julian the Hospitaler (with Saint Nicholas of Bari)

alt_text: A tall, narrow panel painting shows a robed male saint with a halo, holding a book and quill.
long_description: The image is a tall, narrow, black and white photograph of a panel painting. The artwork is structured in two main sections: a rectangular lower part and a triangular upper part, both framed with decorative borders. The central and largest figure is a full-length male, standing frontally, with a halo around his head. He wears a dark, long-sleeved robe with a patterned design, and a lighter-colored undergarment visible at his neck and feet. His left hand holds a closed book, while his right hand holds a quill pen. His gaze is directed slightly to the viewer's left. Behind him, an ornate arched structure with a scalloped inner edge and decorative spandrels frames his upper body. This arch is supported by two slender columns on either side of the figure. Above the main figure, within the triangular section of the panel, a smaller, kneeling figure is depicted. This figure, also with a halo, is shown in profile, looking upwards and to the right, with hands clasped or held close to the chest. The entire panel rests on a base with a visible inscription at the very bottom, which reads "SCS. SIS. P. D. M."

metadata.title: Saint Stephen (with the Angel of the Annunciation)

alt_text: A man in a brown robe with a tonsure holds a green book against a gold arched background.
long_description: The artwork presents a half-length portrait of a man, positioned slightly to the left, against a gold background shaped like a pointed arch. The man has light brown skin, dark eyes, and a short, dark beard. His head is shaved in a tonsure, with a ring of short dark hair around the sides and back. He wears a dark brown hooded robe, which covers his body and arms. A white rope with a knot is visible at his waist on the left side. His left hand, with long, slender fingers, holds a thick, rectangular book with a green cover. The book is oriented vertically, with its spine facing the viewer's right. The green cover is adorned with small gold dots and a central gold medallion-like design. Two black straps with gold clasps are visible on the book's spine. The man's right hand is also on the book, partially obscured by his left hand. Behind his head, a gold halo is visible, decorated with a pattern of small circles and a larger, more intricate circular design. The entire gold background is textured with a repeating pattern of small, stylized leaves or flowers.

alt_text: Mary holds baby Jesus as three kings and other figures gather around in adoration
long_description: The vertical oil painting depicts a crowded religious scene within an architectural setting, featuring several figures in the foreground and a multitude in the background. On the left, a woman with fair skin, wearing a blue cloak and a white head covering, holds a baby wrapped in white cloth. Her gaze is directed downwards towards the baby, who looks slightly to the right. In the lower center, an elderly man with a long white beard and a bald head kneels, his hands clasped in prayer. He wears a rich gold tunic with puffed sleeves and a dark, fur-lined cloak adorned with gold embroidery. His head is bowed towards the baby. On the grey floor in front of him lie a golden scepter and a golden lidded vessel. To the right of the kneeling man, a man with a dark beard and a red garment with an elaborate gold collar raises his right hand. In his left hand, he holds an ornate golden censer. Beside him, a man with dark skin, wearing a golden patterned head covering and a dark, embroidered tunic, holds a golden vessel close to his chest with both hands. Behind these central figures, a dense crowd of people with varied facial expressions and headwear fills the midground. Some raise their hands. The background features architectural elements, including a dark, ornate wall on the left and a stone column on the right. In the upper right, a broken window reveals a distant, blue mountainous landscape with several vertical spears or poles.

alt_text: A half-length portrait of a man in a black hat and fur-lined coat, holding a small golden object
long_description: The artwork is a half-length portrait of a man, presented within an arched, dark brown frame with a thin gold inner border. The man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his head turned to face forward, looking directly out. He has pale skin, a light complexion, and short, light brown hair visible beneath a dark, wide-brimmed hat. A circular, dark medallion with a lighter center is affixed to the front of his hat. His eyes are light, and his mouth is small and closed. He wears a white ruffled collar that extends from his neck. Over a patterned tunic, he wears a heavy, dark brown fur-lined coat. A prominent gold chain with a large pendant hangs around his neck, resting on his chest. His left hand, with pale skin, rests on a spherical golden object positioned at the lower left. His right hand, adorned with rings on two fingers, holds a small, intricate golden object that resembles a cross or a scepter. The background behind the man is a plain, muted green color.

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in a white head covering and dark garment, holding an open book, framed by golden columns
long_description: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a woman is presented within a painted architectural frame. The woman is positioned centrally, facing slightly right with her gaze directed to the right. Her fair skin has subtle pink tones on her cheeks, and her lips are closed with a neutral expression. She wears a large, white, pleated head covering that drapes over her shoulders, obscuring her hair and ears. The fabric shows soft folds and shadows. Beneath the head covering, she wears a dark, possibly black or deep brown, garment with a V-neckline. Her left hand is visible at the bottom center, holding an open book with light-colored pages and a dark binding. She wears a gold ring with a reddish stone on her left ring finger. The background behind her is a dark, unadorned space. The portrait is enclosed by a painted architectural frame featuring two golden, fluted columns with ornate capitals on either side. Above, a decorative architrave with a central, lighter-colored, carved element connects the columns. The bottom edge of the frame is a dark, textured band.

alt_text: A woman holds a baby in a landscape with mountains, a tree, and an offering of fruit.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a child in a vast, detailed landscape. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, is seated, facing forward with her head turned slightly to her right, looking down at the child. She has light brown hair, parted in the middle, and wears a dark blue dress with a gold-trimmed neckline and a red cloak draped over her lap and left arm. A subtle halo of golden rays emanates from behind her head. The child, held in her left arm and resting on her lap, is mostly nude, covered only by a white cloth around its lower body. The child looks upward and to the left, with its right arm extended towards the left. In the lower right foreground, a small pile of fruit rests on a patch of dark earth. This includes a bunch of green grapes, a bunch of dark grapes, a red apple, and a yellow-orange fruit. To the right of the woman, a tall, leafy tree with a dark trunk stands against the sky. The background features an expansive landscape under a cloudy sky. On the left, rugged, rocky mountains rise, with small buildings nestled among them and a winding path visible. On the right, rolling green hills extend into the distance, with a river or body of water visible in the far background. Two small figures and a donkey are visible on a path in the middle ground on the right. The sky above is a mix of blue and white clouds, with a few dark birds flying on the left. The overall palette includes deep reds, blues, greens, and earthy browns.

metadata.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
metadata.artist: Jan Massys|Master of the Liège Disciples at Emmaus

alt_text: Octagonal painting depicting numerous figures and animals engaged in various activities across a mountainous landscape
long_description: The octagonal painting presents a densely populated, multi-scene landscape with numerous figures and animals. The composition is divided into foreground, middle ground, and background, all set within a mountainous terrain. In the foreground, several figures are gathered, some sitting or kneeling amidst dark green foliage. One figure in a pink robe holds a small white animal, possibly a lamb or dog. To their right, a figure in a dark blue robe bends over a square stone well, from which a red, bucket-like structure hangs. Further right, other figures in red and yellow robes are near a small fire or brush. The middle ground features undulating brown and grey mountains dotted with small, dark green trees. Many figures, dressed in robes of red, pink, yellow, and dark blue, are scattered across these slopes. Some are running, others are standing or interacting with animals. Several white and black dogs are depicted chasing white deer or goats up the mountainsides. In the background, more distant mountains rise, with small, light-colored buildings or castles visible on their peaks. The sky at the very top is dark brown, featuring a crescent moon and several small stars. The overall palette includes earthy browns and greys for the landscape, vibrant reds and pinks for clothing, and dark greens for vegetation.

alt_text: Five figures in various poses within a rocky, mountainous landscape under a red sky, framed octagonally.
long_description: The artwork is an octagonal painting depicting five figures in a mountainous landscape under a vibrant red sky. The frame itself is a dark red border. The background features dark brown, jagged mountains with lighter, sandy-colored slopes in the foreground. Sparse, small green plants and a few small, dark green trees are scattered across the sandy ground. In the upper left of the red sky, a white shield-like emblem with a red, rearing creature is visible. To its right, another dark, teardrop-shaped emblem is present. On the far left, a man in a dark green hooded robe stands, playing a light-colored pipe. Next to him, another man in a similar dark green hooded robe leans on a staff, looking upwards. In the center, a woman in a flowing pink gown kneels on one knee, extending her left hand towards the left and her right hand resting on her stomach. To her right, a man in a bright red tunic and green leggings sits on a slope, pointing his right hand towards the kneeling woman. In the lower right, a woman in a yellow gown with a high collar sits on the ground, looking towards the man in red, with her left hand resting on her chest.

metadata.title: A Contest between the Shepherds Alcesto and Acaten

alt_text: Five men torture a nearly naked man on a wooden rack, overseen by a bearded figure with a staff
long_description:
A vertical rectangular painting depicts five men torturing a nearly naked man on a wooden rack, set against a dark background. The central figure, a pale-skinned man with light, wavy hair, lies diagonally across the lower two-thirds of the canvas. He is stretched on a light-colored wooden rack with horizontal rungs, wearing only a blue loincloth and a thin rope around his waist. His head is tilted back, eyes open, and mouth slightly agape.

To the upper left, an older man with a long white beard and mustache wears a dark hat with a red band, a dark green coat with gold trim, and a red undergarment. He holds a long, thin staff diagonally and points towards the central figure with his left hand, looking sternly. Next to him, a man with a prominent nose and mustache, wearing a dark hat and blue garment, observes the scene. To the upper right, a younger man in a red tunic and dark green cap supports the central figure's head and upper body.

At the lower left, a man in a yellow tunic and a white cap with black lettering, which reads "ABBA" and "CHIC", kneels and pulls the central figure's left leg. His face shows a grimace. At the lower right, another man in a dark green tunic, red hose, and a dark cap with gold lettering, reading "HEGES", kneels and pulls the central figure's right leg. The background is dark, with a golden-brown upper section and dark green, foliage-like patterns at the bottom. The painting is enclosed by a dark reddish-brown frame.

metadata.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence; (reverse) Giving Drink to the Thirsty
metadata.artist: Master of the Acts of Mercy

alt_text: An elderly man in a black cap and fur-lined robe holds a small white object, framed by an arch.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts an elderly man within an arched, dark wooden frame with a gold inner rim. The man's pale, wrinkled face is turned slightly to the right, with light-colored eyes looking in the same direction. He has long, wispy white hair visible beneath a dark, soft cap. He wears a black robe with a wide, light brown fur collar. Around his neck is a prominent gold chain composed of interconnected links, from which a small, reddish-brown pendant hangs. His hands are clasped at the bottom center of the painting, resting on a surface covered with a rich, red fabric patterned with gold floral motifs. In his right hand, he holds a small, rectangular white object. The background behind the man is a plain, dark olive green.

metadata.title: Jan (1438/41–1516), First Count of Egmond; Magdalena, Countess of Egmond (1464–1538)
metadata.medium: Oil on canvas, transferred from wood (.122, the Count); oil on wood (.118, the Countess)

alt_text: A person with dark hair looks intently into a handheld mirror, their reflection visible.
long_description: A painting depicts a person, seen from the chest up, looking into a handheld mirror against a dark, plain background. The person, with dark brown hair pulled back into a bun or braid at the back of their head, leans forward. Their right hand is raised, fingers gently touching their forehead, while their left hand holds a rectangular mirror with a dark frame. The person's profile is visible, with a straight nose and full lips, and their gaze is directed downwards into the mirror. They wear a light-colored, possibly cream or off-white, long-sleeved shirt under a darker, brown or olive-toned vest or tunic. The mirror reflects the person's face, which is tilted slightly upwards and to the left, with light illuminating their forehead, nose, and chin. The reflection shows their eyes looking out of the mirror towards the viewer. Strong light comes from an unseen source to the upper left, highlighting the person's face, the mirror's reflection, and parts of their clothing, while the rest of the scene is cast in deep shadow.

metadata.title: The Sense of Sight
metadata.artist: Master of the Annunciation to the Shepherds

alt_text: A long horizontal painting depicts a narrative with many figures, horses, and buildings in a landscape
long_description: The painting is a wide, horizontal panel framed by a gold patterned border. It depicts a continuous narrative scene across a varied landscape, populated by numerous figures, horses, and dogs. On the far left, a grand architectural complex features a multi-story building with a red-tiled roof and an open archway. On a balcony, a central robed figure sits on an ornate throne, flanked by attendants. Below, a large procession emerges from the building's arch. Soldiers carrying long spears march alongside figures on foot and on horseback, accompanied by several white and brown dogs. A tall, grey cylindrical tower stands to the right of the main building. The middle ground transitions to an open landscape with a body of water. Figures on horseback and foot continue their journey, moving towards the right. In the distance, a large, rugged brown mountain or island rises from the water, with smaller figures and animals visible on its slopes. Several small boats are scattered across the water. The right section features a more dramatic, rocky coastline. Figures are depicted disembarking from a boat onto a steep, winding path. Other groups of figures, some mounted on horses and accompanied by hunting dogs, move across the foreground. A large ship with a single mast and furled sails is anchored in the water near the shore. The sky above is a pale blue, and the overall scene is rendered with a detailed, illustrative style.

metadata.title: Scenes from the Story of the Argonauts
metadata.artist: Jacopo di Arcangelo (called Jacopo del Sellaio)

alt_text: A well-dressed man stands before a group of beggars and a kneeling friar under a large stone archway
long_description: The painting depicts a street scene with several figures gathered under a large, light-colored stone archway. In the center, a well-dressed man stands facing left, wearing a dark hat, a black cloak over a dark doublet, white cuffs, and a white ruff. He holds a pair of light-colored gloves in his left hand, which rests on his hip. To his left, a group of five figures approaches him. A woman in a light-colored headscarf and dress carries a baby on her back, wrapped in a teal cloth. She extends her right hand towards the man. Next to her, an older man with a beard and a dark cap holds a hat in his hand. A small child stands between them, looking towards the well-dressed man. In front of the woman, a barefoot boy in brown tattered clothes holds out a small bowl. In the background, to the far left, faint figures are visible in a hazy, open area. To the right of the well-dressed man, a friar in a light brown robe kneels on the ground, facing left, with his hands clasped in prayer and a rosary draped over them. A dark hat lies on the ground near him. The background behind the figures is a dark, shadowed interior of the archway, revealing architectural details and faint figures further back. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by browns, grays, and creams, with accents of dark blue and teal.

metadata.title: Beggars at a Doorway
metadata.artist: Master of the Béguins, French or Flemish, active 1650–60 (possibly Abraham Willemsens, Flemish, active by 1627, died 1672)

alt_text: A painting of Christ on the cross with two women and a man below, against a gold background
long_description: The painting depicts a crucifixion scene with four figures against a gold background. In the center, a pale-skinned man with long brown hair and a crown of thorns is nailed to a wooden cross. His head is tilted to his right, and his eyes are closed. Blood drips from his hands and forehead. He wears a white loincloth. His body is slender, and his arms are outstretched, nailed to the horizontal beam. His feet are crossed and nailed to the vertical beam, resting on a dark, rocky mound at the base of the cross. To the left of the cross, two women stand. The woman closer to the cross wears a light blue veil over a white head covering, a light brown dress, and a dark green cloak. Her head is bowed, and her hands are clasped near her waist. Her face shows a sorrowful expression. Behind her, a second woman, mostly obscured, wears a dark green hooded cloak, with only her face and hands visible. Her hands are clasped at her chest, and she looks towards the crucified figure. To the right of the cross, a man with reddish-brown curly hair and a halo stands, looking up at the crucified figure. He wears a long, flowing green robe over a pink undergarment. His left hand is raised to his chest, and his right hand holds a closed, light-colored book. The background is a flat, textured gold, with faint circular halos around the heads of the three standing figures. The overall palette is muted, with earthy tones and a prominent gold. The figures are rendered with a somewhat elongated and stylized form.

metadata.title: The Crucifixion
metadata.medium: Oil, egg(?), and gold on plywood, transferred from wood

alt_text: A profile portrait painting of a woman with blonde hair, a pearl-studded cap, and a red dress against a dark background
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a woman in profile, facing left, against a solid dark blue background. Her skin is light, with a high forehead, a small, straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Her light brown eye is visible. Her blonde hair is pulled back and covered by an elaborate white cap or net, which is densely studded with small, round, white pearls or beads. On top of her head, a small, ornate jewel with tiny blue and red elements is visible. Around her neck, she wears a necklace composed of small, round, white pearls or beads, each set in a gold-colored bezel, forming a continuous chain. She is dressed in a red garment with a wide, light-colored collar or trim that extends over her shoulders. Beneath the red garment, a dark green or black undergarment is visible. The red fabric shows subtle patterns and some signs of wear. A dark brown border frames the entire painting.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: A panoramic painting depicts a white city with ships, followed by a large army on horseback with tents and banners.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal, rectangular painting with a decorative gold border featuring small, repeating patterns. The central image is divided into three large, overlapping circular sections, each framed by a gold band with smaller circular motifs. The leftmost section depicts a vibrant, multi-storied white city with pink and red roofs, nestled against dark green mountains. Several white buildings with towers line a body of water where two dark ships with sails are docked, one larger with figures on board, and a smaller boat. Figures in colorful attire are visible near the city walls and a tall white tower with a red and white striped banner. The central and right sections portray a vast army. Numerous figures, many on horseback, are depicted in various poses, wearing tunics in shades of orange, blue, yellow, and brown. They carry shields and spears. Behind them, several large white tents with pointed tops are visible, along with numerous colorful banners and flags, some striped red and white, others featuring heraldic designs. Dark green mountains form the background for these military scenes, with some red-roofed structures appearing in the distance on the right. The ground beneath the army is a mix of green and brown.

metadata.title: The Conquest of Naples by Charles of Durazzo
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, embossed and gilt ornament

alt_text: A long, horizontal panel depicting multiple narrative scenes with many figures, including people on horseback and in buildings
long_description: The black and white image presents a long, horizontal artwork divided into multiple narrative scenes, framed by a decorative border of organic shapes at the top and bottom. The overall composition is densely populated with figures and architectural elements. Starting from the far left, a scene unfolds around a draped, tent-like structure. Inside, a bearded man sits on a high-backed chair. Outside, several men on horseback, some holding staffs or spears, are in motion, accompanied by figures on foot. Moving right, a tall, slender, column-like structure stands. To its right, a group of standing figures includes a woman in a long robe holding a small child. Behind them, a building with multiple pointed arches and columns forms a backdrop. Further to the right, another group of figures stands near an arched entrance. A woman in a dark, long robe holds a child. Facing away from this group, a man on horseback is depicted, looking towards the right. The final scene on the far right shows an interior space. A figure reclines on a bed with a decorative base, while another figure stands beside the bed, reaching out towards the reclining person. Other figures are visible in the background near an arched opening. The figures throughout the artwork wear period clothing, and the architecture features prominent arches and columns.

metadata.title: Scenes from a Legend; Coats of Arms
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, embossed gilt and silver ornament

alt_text: Two aged male figures, a bishop and a monk, stand against a textured gold background, holding religious objects
long_description: This vertical rectangular panel features two full-length male figures standing against a textured gold background, framed by a thin black border. The figure on the left, positioned slightly to the left of center, wears a white mitre with gold and red trim, and has a pale, aged face with a short beard. A gold halo encircles his head. He is dressed in a vibrant red cope over a dark green and gold brocade dalmatic. In his left hand, he holds a tall gold crozier with an ornate scroll top, and in his right hand, he holds an open white book. White fabric of an alb is visible at his feet, pooling on the brown ground. The figure on the right, positioned slightly to the right of center, wears a red cap and has a pale, aged face, looking downwards. A gold halo also encircles his head. He is dressed in a long, dark, possibly black, robe with a dark green collar or hood lining. He holds a thin, gold staff with a red ribbon in his right hand and a small, red, bound book with gold clasps in his left hand. White fabric of an undergarment is visible at his feet, pooling on the brown ground. At the feet of the right figure, two small, fantastical creatures are depicted. The creature on the left is green and brown, resembling a dragon or griffin with an open mouth. The creature on the right is white and green, with a bird-like head and a scaly body. The gold background has visible texture, suggesting tooling or brushstrokes.

alt_text: Five men placing a crowned figure into a stone sarcophagus within a vaulted, columned chamber.
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts a scene within a vaulted, columned chamber. In the lower half, five men are shown lowering or adjusting a crowned figure into a large, light-colored stone sarcophagus with a stepped base. The figure in the sarcophagus wears a long, deep red robe with white trim and a gold crown, and has a golden halo around their head. Their skin is pale. To the left, a man in a blue tunic, red hose, and a red hat holds the figure's legs. Another man in a red tunic and blue sleeves supports the figure's midsection. On the right, a man in a green tunic and red hat leans over the sarcophagus, touching the figure's chest. Behind him, a man in a brown robe and a gold hat supports the figure's head, which has a pale face and a short beard. A fifth man, also in a brown robe, stands further back, observing. The men have varied facial expressions and hair colors. The upper half of the painting reveals the architectural interior. A series of gray columns with ornate capitals support a vaulted ceiling with pointed arches. Several arched windows with intricate tracery are visible in the background. On the far left, a raised platform holds a bed draped in red fabric, with a white pillow, a small open book, and a golden candlestick. To the right of the central column, a large, rectangular structure covered in green fabric rests on a stone base. In the upper right corner, three golden-haloed heads with serene expressions peer from behind this green structure. The overall color palette includes rich reds, greens, blues, and browns against the neutral grays of the architecture and pale skin tones.

alt_text: A nude woman reclines with a child, attended by several other women in a draped, classical setting.
long_description: A classical painting depicts a central nude woman reclining on a richly decorated bed, holding a small child. The woman lies on her back, propped up by a large blue and gold pillow, with her left arm bent behind her head and her right arm supporting the child who sits on her stomach, looking towards her face. Her legs are extended to the left. The bed is covered with a light blue fabric adorned with white and red floral patterns, and its ornate wooden base is visible at the bottom right. Around the central figure, six other women are positioned. To the far left, a woman in a golden-orange dress kneels, holding a tall, fluted red vase with a lid. Behind the central figure's head, two women stand close together; one in a green dress holds a smaller red vase, while the other, partially obscured, wears an orange garment. In the upper left, a woman in a flowing light-colored dress pulls back a dark drape. On the right side, a woman in a red dress reaches towards the central figure, holding a lidded red vessel. Above her, another woman in a red dress holds a tambourine aloft. In the upper right corner, a final woman in a flowing orange garment stands, looking towards the center. The background is predominantly dark, suggesting an interior space with heavy drapes.

alt_text: Christ on a cross, surrounded by mourning figures and soldiers, against a gold background
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts the Crucifixion scene against a textured gold background. In the center, Christ hangs on a wooden cross, his body pale with a white loincloth. Blood drips from his hands and a wound on his side. Above the cross, three red, flame-like shapes descend. Around the cross, several angels with wings, some blue and some brown, fly in various positions. Below Christ, a dense crowd of figures fills the lower two-thirds of the composition. On the left, a soldier on a grey horse wears blue armor and a red hat, holding a spear. Other soldiers and figures stand, many looking up at Christ. On the right, another soldier on a white horse wears a blue cloak and red tunic. At the very bottom, directly beneath the cross, a group of figures mourns. A woman in a blue dress and pink cloak lies on the ground, supported by another woman in a pink dress. Another woman in a red dress and blue cloak kneels, looking down. A man in a pink cloak stands nearby, his face covered by his hand. A human skull is visible on the dark ground near the base of the cross.

alt_text: A triptych showing a central panel of a deceased man surrounded by mourners, flanked by a bearded man and a crying woman
long_description: This black and white image displays a triptych, a three-panel painting, with each panel framed. The central panel is wider than the two side panels.
