The central panel depicts a scene with five figures. A pale, deceased man with visible ribs and wounds on his hands and feet is held by three individuals. He wears a loincloth. A woman with a head covering supports his head, looking at his face. To her left, a younger man with long, dark hair looks down. To her right, an older, bald, bearded man supports the deceased's upper body. In the background, a ladder leans against a dark structure, and a distant landscape with hills is visible on the left. At the bottom center of this panel, a small rectangular plaque contains the visible text: "ROGIER VAN DER WEYDEN". The left panel features a bearded man wearing a tall, pointed hat. He holds a hammer in his right hand and a pair of pincers in his left. He is dressed in a dark robe. A landscape with rolling hills and trees forms the background. The right panel shows a woman with an elaborate, patterned headpiece. Her right hand is raised to her face, near her eye. She holds a richly decorated chalice or cup in her left hand. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves and a necklace. A landscape with hills and trees is visible behind her.

alt_text: A panoramic landscape painting depicts a fantastical world with towering mountains, winding rivers, and bustling cities.
long_description: A wide, horizontal painting depicts an expansive, detailed landscape under a sky of light brown, grey, and pale blue, with lighter areas suggesting clouds. In the upper center, a massive, jagged mountain range, light brown with green patches, rises dramatically. Smaller mountains are visible in the far distance to the right. Below the mountains, rolling green hills and valleys are traversed by winding, light brown roads and a wide, blue-green river that snakes through the scene, reflecting the sky. Dark green trees dot the hillsides. Along the river and nestled among the hills, several cities and clusters of buildings appear. On the left, a city with pinkish-brown towers and walls stands by the river. To the right, a larger city with numerous buildings, spires, and a prominent white tower extends along the riverbank. Multiple arched bridges span the river. In the lower left, two figures walk along a dirt path. One figure, dressed in red and white, leads a grey ox pulling a cart. Another figure in light brown walks beside them. Dark green trees frame this section. A prominent reddish-brown arched bridge crosses the foreground, with a figure in a brown robe sitting on its edge, looking towards the right. Further to the right, more buildings and structures are visible, including a large arched entrance. A small boat with a figure is on the river in the mid-right.

metadata.title: The Arrival in Bethlehem
metadata.artist: Master of the Brussels Calling of Saint Matthew

alt_text: A mother in a pink dress holds and kisses a baby, both with gold halos, under a pink archway
long_description: The painting depicts a mother holding a child within an architectural niche. The mother, positioned slightly to the right of center, wears a long-sleeved, high-necked pink dress adorned with a repeating gold circular pattern. Her reddish-blonde hair is pulled back, and a thin gold halo encircles her head. She gazes down at the child, her lips gently touching the child's cheek. A flowing teal-blue cloak is draped over her left shoulder and arm, falling in soft folds to the bottom of the frame, revealing an orange-gold lining on the left side. The child, held in the mother's arms, is positioned to the left. The child's body is partially wrapped in a white cloth, exposing bare arms and legs. A thin gold halo also encircles the child's head, which has light brown hair. The child's left arm is raised, with the hand near the mother's face, and the right arm rests on the mother's chest. The child's face is turned towards the mother, with eyes closed. The figures are framed by a light grey architectural structure. A pink archway with a thin white inner border spans across the top, resting on two light grey pilasters. The upper corners of the background, outside the arch, are dark red with a subtle patterned design. The lower portion of the painting shows a light grey ledge or platform on which the figures appear to be standing or resting. The overall palette is soft, with dominant pink, teal, and gold tones against a muted grey background.

alt_text: A long, rectangular painting depicts two crowded procession scenes with people, horses, and buildings, framed by ornate gold
long_description: A horizontal, rectangular painting is set within an elaborate gold frame featuring intricate raised floral and scrollwork patterns. A shield-like emblem with a dark blue and white diagonal stripe is on the far left, and a reddish-brown shield is on the far right. The painting itself is divided into two main narrative scenes, separated by a vertical gold column matching the frame's style. The left scene depicts a procession moving from left to right, emerging from a light-colored building with multiple arched windows and a tower. A large crowd of figures, dressed in various colored garments including red, blue, yellow, and brown, fills the foreground and middle ground. Several figures ride horses, some pulling a large, ornate carriage with spoked wheels, carrying more people. Behind the procession, a green landscape with rolling hills and scattered trees extends to the horizon under a light blue sky. The right scene continues the procession, also moving from left to right, towards a large, light-colored building with multiple arches and towers, similar to the one on the left. This scene also features a large crowd of figures, horses, and a carriage. Some figures appear to be dismounting or interacting near the building. The background again shows a green landscape with hills and trees. The figures are depicted with stylized features, and the overall color palette is earthy with accents of brighter hues.

metadata.title: King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, embossed and gilt ornament

alt_text: A fair-skinned woman in blue nurses a baby, framed by a golden arch with inscribed text
long_description:
The artwork is a vertical rectangular panel painting depicting a woman breastfeeding a baby, set within an ornate golden frame. The central figure is a fair-skinned woman with long, dark brown hair flowing over her shoulders. She wears a deep blue robe that drapes around her, revealing her right breast from which a fair-skinned baby suckles. The woman's eyes are downcast, and her expression is serene. Around her neck, she wears a delicate necklace with a small, dark, cross-shaped pendant. The baby, with light hair, is cradled in her left arm and partially covered by a blue cloth. Behind the woman's head, a golden, stippled background radiates outwards, suggesting a halo or light source.
The central image is enclosed by a golden, arched frame. Along the inner curve of this arch, dark blue text is inscribed. On the left side, the visible text reads: "domina angelorum latus". On the right side, the visible text reads: "latus et Diva". Below the main scene, a rectangular golden panel contains several lines of dark blue text. The first line is clearly visible: "Ista est illa de qua scriptum est in libro sapientiae: 'Ego mater pulchrae dilectionis et timoris et agnitionis et sanctae spei.'" The subsequent lines of text on this bottom panel are less distinct but appear to continue the inscription. The overall color palette is dominated by deep blues, gold, and the pale skin tones of the figures.

alt_text: Virgin Mary holding Christ Child, flanked by a saint and a kneeling man, against a dark background
long_description: This vertical panel painting depicts four figures: the Virgin Mary, the Christ Child, a saint, and a kneeling man, set against a dark background with architectural and natural elements. On the left, the Virgin Mary is seated, wearing a light pink robe with a blue undergarment and a green sash. She has fair skin, light hair, a gold crown, and a halo. She holds the Christ Child on her lap, who wears a red tunic over a white undergarment, has fair skin, short light hair, a halo, and holds a tall, ornate staff. Behind Mary is a golden, ornate architectural structure resembling a throne, adorned with white flowers and green foliage. To the right, a tall saint stands, dressed in a white robe with a large gold cross on the chest, a white mitre, and a white beard. He also holds an ornate staff with a spherical finial. In front of the saint, a man kneels, facing left towards the Virgin and Child. He wears a black robe and a black turban-like head covering, with his hands clasped in prayer. The background behind the saint and kneeling man is dark, featuring a section of a reddish-brown brick wall on the right, and green foliage with small pink and white flowers. At the bottom center, a white scroll with black Latin text is visible. Below the Virgin Mary on the left, a shield with a black background and a white chevron is depicted. On the bottom right, another shield features red and white vertical stripes with a black diagonal band. The text on the scroll reads: "Hinc tua gens merito coelestia regna figuram Hinc celante preces quam tibi factus agit Hinc tua pura fides hincque est tibi larga potestas Et tibi firma fides cui latet omne bonum Bella ferax domina deus noster requiesque Et gravis hoste tuo sanguine claro".

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Donor, Pietro de' Lardi, Presented by Saint Nicholas
metadata.artist: Master G.Z. (possibly Michele dai Carri, Italian, Ferrara, active by 1405–died 1441 Ferrara)

alt_text: A somber woman in dark robes with a child's hand visible, against a gold halo.
long_description: The artwork presents a bust-length portrait of a woman, angled slightly to her right, with her head gently tilted. Her face is pale with a greenish undertone, featuring rosy cheeks and lips. Her large, dark eyes gaze softly downward. She is enveloped in a dark blue or black mantle that covers her head and shoulders, with a reddish-brown undergarment visible at her right wrist, adorned with a patterned cuff. A gold halo, partially worn away, encircles her head. Her left hand is raised to her chest, with long, slender fingers. To the right of her chest, a small hand, presumably a child's, emerges from beneath her mantle, its fingers curled. A circular, ornate brooch with red and white patterns is visible on her left shoulder. The background is dark, almost black, with some lighter, worn areas around the edges of the panel, indicating the age of the piece.

alt_text: A triptych depicting religious scenes, with Mary and child in the center, Christ in glory on the left, and the Crucifixion on the right
long_description:
This is a three-panel artwork, or triptych, featuring multiple religious scenes against a gold background. The panels are roughly equal in height, with the central panel slightly wider than the two side panels. The overall color palette includes deep reds, blues, browns, and whites, set against the dominant gold.

The central panel depicts a seated figure, likely a woman, in a dark blue or black robe over a red garment, holding a child dressed in a red tunic. Both figures have golden halos. The seated figure is on a throne-like structure with visible legs and a red cushion. Above them, two smaller figures with halos, possibly angels, are positioned on either side. Below the main figures, two standing figures with halos are visible, one on each side.

The left panel is divided into three horizontal sections. The uppermost section features a figure, likely a man, in a red and dark blue robe, seated within a large, oval, striped halo or mandorla. This figure holds a closed book in their left hand and raises their right hand. Below this, two smaller registers show groups of figures. The upper register contains a crowd of people, some with halos, in front of stylized buildings. The lower register shows another group of figures, some in motion, with a few buildings in the background.

The right panel is also divided into three horizontal sections. The top section shows a figure on a cross, flanked by two standing figures below the cross, one in a dark robe and the other in a red and white robe. Buildings are visible behind them. The middle section depicts a scene with several figures, one of whom is carrying a cross, while others interact. The bottom section shows a figure tied to a column, with another figure standing nearby. Stylized buildings are present in the background of this scene as well.

alt_text: A woman with reddish-brown hair holds a baby close to her face, set against a landscape
long_description: A painting depicts a woman holding a baby in the foreground, set against a detailed landscape. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, has fair skin and reddish-brown hair, partially covered by a sheer veil. She wears a dark teal dress with a high neckline and a voluminous red cloak draped over her shoulders and lap, edged with a gold pattern. Her head is tilted down, and her eyes are cast downwards, with a soft expression. She holds a baby, who is mostly unclothed except for a white cloth draped around its lower body, close to her chest. The baby's face is turned towards the woman's, with its left arm around her neck and its right hand resting on her chest. The baby has light hair and fair skin. In the background, a landscape unfolds under a light blue sky. To the left, green mountains rise behind a town with light-colored buildings and a body of water with small boats. To the right, a river flows, spanned by a multi-arched stone bridge, with more green hills and trees beyond.

alt_text: A vertical panel painting depicting three religious scenes: the Annunciation, Nativity, and Adoration of the Magi.
long_description: This vertical panel painting features three distinct religious scenes stacked one above the other, all set against a shimmering gold background. Each scene is separated by thin red horizontal lines.The top scene depicts an Annunciation. On the left, a winged figure with a halo, wearing a pink robe over a blue tunic, stands on a red ground, extending an arm towards the right. On the right, a woman with a halo, dressed in a dark blue robe and white head covering, stands within a simple architectural structure, looking towards the winged figure with clasped hands.The middle scene illustrates a Nativity. A woman in a dark blue robe and white head covering lies on a red blanket in the center, with a halo. To her upper right, a small figure wrapped in white rests in a wooden manger, flanked by an ox and a donkey. Above, several small winged figures with halos hover. To the lower left, an older man with a white beard and halo sits. To the lower right, two women attend to a small figure.The bottom scene shows the Adoration of the Magi. On the right, a woman in a dark blue robe and white head covering sits on a platform, holding a small figure; both have halos. An older man kneels before them, offering a golden object. Behind him, two other men in crowns and elaborate robes stand, holding gifts. To the left, several figures and a horse are visible, facing the central group. A wooden stable structure forms the background for this scene.

metadata.title: Saints and Scenes from the Life of the Virgin

alt_text: A gold-leaf triptych with Madonna and Child enthroned, flanked by multiple scenes of Christ's Passion
long_description: This is a gold-leaf triptych, an altarpiece composed of three panels. The central panel is taller and wider than the two narrower side panels, all featuring pointed arch tops and intricate gold backgrounds with punched patterns. The central panel depicts the Madonna and Child enthroned. The Madonna, wearing a dark blue cloak over a red dress, holds the Child, who is dressed in a reddish garment. Both figures have golden halos. They are surrounded by a symmetrical arrangement of angels and saints, depicted in various colored robes including red, blue, green, and purple, all with golden halos. Below the main scene, a row of four smaller, half-length figures, likely saints or bishops, are shown in individual arched compartments, also with halos. The left panel is divided into three rectangular scenes, stacked vertically. The top scene shows a group of figures in red, blue, and green robes, some with halos, engaged in a narrative. The middle scene features a central figure being scourged by two others, surrounded by more onlookers. The bottom scene depicts a procession, with a central figure carrying a large wooden cross, accompanied by other figures in various colored garments. The right panel is divided into two rectangular scenes. The upper scene portrays the Crucifixion, with Christ on a dark wooden cross, flanked by numerous figures below, dressed in red, blue, and black robes. The lower scene shows a lamentation or entombment, with several figures gathered around a body lying on a sarcophagus, which is decorated with red and green diamond patterns. The overall color palette is rich, dominated by gold, deep reds, blues, and greens.

alt_text: A painted crucifix with Christ on the cross, flanked by figures, and two robed saints above and below
long_description: A large, painted crucifix features a central figure of Christ on a blue cross, set against a gold background with decorative patterns. Christ's body is depicted with light skin, a white loincloth, and visible wounds on his hands, feet, and side, with red lines suggesting blood. His head is tilted to his right, and a gold halo encircles his head. Above Christ's head, on the vertical arm of the cross, are the letters "I.N.R.I." in red. To the left of Christ's outstretched arm, within a quatrefoil-shaped panel, is a woman with light skin, wearing a blue mantle over a lighter garment. Her left hand is raised, palm open, and her right hand is at her chest. She has a gold halo. To the right of Christ's arm, in a similar quatrefoil panel, is a man with light skin, wearing a pink garment under a blue mantle. His right hand is at his chest, and his left hand is lowered. He also has a gold halo. At the very top of the crucifix, in another quatrefoil panel, is a man in a brown monastic robe, holding a closed red book in his left hand and raising his right hand in a gesture. He has a gold halo. At the very bottom of the crucifix, in a final quatrefoil panel, is another man in a brown monastic robe, holding a closed red book in his left hand. He also has a gold halo. The entire cross structure is outlined in gold, with the blue cross arms having a thin red border.

alt_text: A painting of Christ with long hair and a beard, flanked by two angels, against a gold background
long_description: The painting depicts the head and upper chest of a figure, likely Christ, against a richly decorated gold background. The figure faces directly forward, with a pale, slightly green-tinged complexion, dark eyes, and a small, closed mouth with reddish lips. Long, wavy reddish-brown hair, parted in the middle, frames the face and extends over the shoulders. A short, reddish-brown beard and mustache are visible. A large, circular halo, intricately patterned with punched and incised gold designs, surrounds the figure's head. The figure wears a dark blue garment, visible at the bottom of the composition. In the upper corners, two winged figures, likely angels, are depicted in profile, facing towards the center. They wear dark blue robes with gold detailing and have dark wings. Both angels raise their hands, with the left angel appearing to hold a small, light-colored object. The gold background is extensively patterned with small red and blue floral motifs and geometric designs. Along the very bottom edge of the painting, a dark blue band contains white, capitalized text that reads "ECCE HOMO DOLORIS". The entire composition is framed by a raised, gold border with a beaded pattern.

alt_text: A woman in a blue robe holds a child on her lap, seated on a throne with two angels above
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a woman holding a child, seated on an ornate throne, flanked by two angels. The central woman, facing forward with a slight tilt of her head, wears a dark blue cloak that drapes over a pink undergarment. Her light-skinned face has a serene expression, and her dark hair is covered by her cloak. A small, light-colored star-like motif is visible on her left shoulder. Her right hand supports the child's back, while her left hand gently touches the child's cheek. The child, dressed in a pink garment, sits on the woman's lap, facing towards the left. The child has light skin, light curly hair, and bare feet. Its right arm is around the woman's neck, and its left hand touches the woman's chin. The woman and child are seated on a large, elaborate throne with dark brown wooden posts. The throne is draped with patterned pink fabric, featuring intricate designs. Two smaller angels are positioned symmetrically in the upper corners, behind the throne. Each angel wears a pink robe, has grey-blue wings, light skin, and light curly hair, with a small gold halo. The background behind the figures is a solid, warm gold. At the very bottom, a patterned green and white floor or footrest is visible beneath the throne.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Angels

alt_text: A black and white painting of the Madonna holding the Christ Child, surrounded by angels and a dove.
long_description: A black and white painting depicts the Madonna holding the Christ Child, surrounded by multiple cherubic figures and a dove. The Madonna, positioned slightly left of center, is a young woman with long, light-colored hair, wearing a dark dress and a veil. Her gaze is directed downwards. She supports the Christ Child, who is mostly nude with a cloth draped around his lower body, in her arms. The Christ Child holds a small, dark bird in his left hand and looks towards the viewer. Above the Madonna's head, a halo is visible, and further up, a dove with outstretched wings radiates light. Several winged cherubic figures surround the central pair. To the left, two angels look towards the Christ Child. To the right, two more angels are visible, one holding a small cross. Another figure is partially visible at the bottom right. The background is dark and textured with small dots, suggesting a starry sky or patterned fabric. The figures are tightly grouped, filling most of the vertical frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Infant Saint John the Baptist and Angels

alt_text: A seated woman in dark robes with clasped hands against a gold background with trees and rocks
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a single woman seated in the foreground, facing slightly right with her head tilted down. She wears a dark, possibly black or very dark green, hooded cloak that covers her entire body, revealing only her pale face and clasped hands. A reddish-pink garment is visible beneath the cloak around her chest. A white head covering is visible under the dark hood, and a faint halo encircles her head. The background directly behind her head and upper body is a textured gold, featuring a faint circular pattern and gothic architectural elements along the top edge. Behind her lower body, a landscape unfolds with dark green, leafy trees on the left and light brown or pinkish-brown rocky formations on the right. The ground in the immediate foreground is a light, off-white color, adorned with small, stylized plant forms or flowers. The overall color palette is muted, with the dark robes contrasting with the gold and lighter landscape elements.

metadata.title: The Virgin
metadata.medium: Tempera and oil on wood, gold ground

alt_text: Two panels depict a king receiving a kneeling man and a queen receiving gifts, with monks praying below
long_description: The artwork is a two-panel painting, each panel framed by a dark border. The left panel depicts two distinct scenes. In the upper section, a king, seated on a throne and dressed in a red robe with a white fur collar and a gold crown, receives a kneeling man in a brown tunic and black hose, who holds a red hat. Behind the king, a man in a green robe stands. To the right, an arched doorway opens to an outdoor scene with a man on a white horse and a distant red-brick castle. In the lower section, two monks in dark brown habits kneel on a patch of green foliage. They face right, with hands clasped in prayer, each holding a small golden cross. The right panel also features two scenes. In the upper section, a queen, elaborately dressed in a patterned gown and a tall headdress, kneels before a seated figure in a red robe and hat, offering a golden vessel. To her left, a man in a red tunic holds a black hat and a golden object. Several other figures, including women with ornate headwear and a man in a red hat, observe the scene. An arched window in the background reveals a landscape with a red-brick castle. In the lower section, two monks in dark brown habits kneel on green foliage, facing left, with hands clasped in prayer, each holding a small golden cross. A small white and brown dog sits beside the rightmost monk, and a black hat rests on the ground nearby.

metadata.title: Abner's Messenger before David; The Queen of Sheba Bringing Gifts to Solomon; The Annunciation
metadata.artist: Master of the Saint Barbara Legend

alt_text: A multi-panel painting depicting various scenes of people in historical attire within cityscapes and landscapes
long_description: The artwork is a wide, horizontal multi-panel painting, divided into six vertical sections by dark frames. Each panel depicts a scene with numerous figures in historical attire, set in various urban and rural landscapes. The far-left panel shows two distinct scenes. At the top, a man in red robes and a woman in a white head covering and gold-patterned dress sit on a bench under an archway with a gold and black patterned tapestry. Below them, three women in long dresses stand on a tiled floor. The second panel from the left features a street scene at the top with buildings and figures. In the lower half, a woman with long, reddish-brown hair, wearing a dark dress, kneels before a man in a green tunic, offering him a small, rectangular object. Another woman stands behind her. The third panel from the left depicts an interior scene. At the top, two winged figures in white robes appear to be serving food. Below, a group of people are seated at a table laden with food, while others stand around them. A man in a dark hat and red robe is seated at the table, and a woman in a white wimple and dark dress stands nearby. The fourth panel from the left, centrally located, shows a church interior at the top, where a figure preaches from a pulpit under a green canopy. Below, a wedding ceremony is depicted, with a couple in elaborate, patterned clothing standing together, surrounded by other figures. The bride wears a white and gold dress with a long veil. The fifth panel from the left presents a hilly, green landscape with a winding path and distant city buildings at the top. Several figures walk on the path. In the lower section, two women in elaborate dresses and wimples stand facing each other, with a small child in a red dress positioned between them. The far-right panel also has two sections. The upper part shows a street scene with buildings and figures. The lower part depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures; one lies in a bed, while others appear to be carrying or attending to figures, including one being lowered into a dark opening in the ground.

metadata.title: The Life and Miracles of Saint Godelieve
metadata.artist: Master of the Saint Godelieve Legend

alt_text: A man in a dark cap and robe holds an open book, with a Gothic church interior and exterior behind him.
long_description:
The painting, with an arched top, depicts a man in a half-length portrait, positioned slightly to the right of center. He faces left, his gaze directed slightly left and upward. He has light skin, a prominent nose, and short dark hair visible beneath a dark brown, textured cap adorned with a small gold medallion on the right side. He wears a dark, wide-collared robe with a white, possibly fur, trim along the edges, revealing a dark green tunic underneath with dark lacing down the front. His hands, with light skin, hold an open book with a reddish-brown cover. The pages are white with black script, appearing to be musical notation or text.

Behind the man, the background is divided into two main sections. To the left, a detailed Gothic church interior is visible, featuring tall, ornate arches, intricate stone carvings, and what appears to be a stained-glass window. Within this interior, small figures are depicted; one figure in a green and white robe stands near an altar-like structure, while another figure in a brown tunic pulls a rope. To the right, beyond a dark column, a Gothic cityscape or building exterior is shown under a light blue sky. This building features multiple windows and stepped gables. A small, round green tree stands in the middle ground on the right. The overall color palette is dominated by dark browns, greens, and greys, contrasted with the white trim and light skin tones.

metadata.title: Young Man Holding a Book
metadata.artist: Master of the View of Saint Gudula

alt_text: A black and white artwork showing a central Madonna and Child flanked by two standing figures
long_description: The black and white image depicts three figures against a textured, light-colored background, resembling a fresco. In the center, a woman with a dark, draped garment sits on a low, light-colored pedestal. Her head is tilted slightly to her right, and her gaze is directed downwards. She wears a dark head covering that frames her face. On her lap, a small child with a halo sits, leaning their head against the woman's chest. The child wears a lighter-colored tunic and holds a small, rectangular object with visible lines in both hands. The child's head is also tilted downwards, and their eyes are closed or cast down. Both the woman and child have halos around their heads, depicted as faint, circular outlines. To the left of the central group, a standing man faces slightly towards the center. He wears a dark tunic and a draped garment over his shoulders and arm. He has a beard and long hair, and a halo encircles his head. His gaze is directed downwards and towards the central figures. His hands are mostly obscured by his drapery. To the right of the central group, a standing woman faces slightly towards the center. She wears a lighter-colored, draped garment that falls in vertical folds. Her left arm is extended towards the central figures, with her hand open and palm facing upwards. Her right hand is partially visible, holding a fold of her garment. She has long hair and a halo around her head. Her gaze is directed downwards and towards the central figures. The background wall shows signs of wear and texture throughout the composition.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints James Minor and Lucy

alt_text: A diptych with two panels depicting religious figures and two kneeling individuals in an architectural setting
long_description: The artwork is a vertical diptych, composed of two panels of equal size placed side-by-side. The left panel depicts two male figures within an architectural setting. In the foreground, a young man with dark brown, bowl-cut hair kneels, facing right, with his hands clasped in prayer. He wears a long brown robe over a white and red striped garment. Behind him stands an older man with a white beard and a golden halo, wearing a red tunic and a green cloak. His right hand rests on the kneeling man's shoulder, while his left hand holds a sword with a golden hilt. Through an archway in the background, a bustling city scene with numerous small figures and buildings is visible. The right panel also features two figures in an architectural interior. In the foreground, a woman with a white head covering and a golden halo kneels, facing left, with her hands raised in prayer. She wears a dark brown dress and a dark blue cloak. An open book with visible text rests on a small wooden table to her right. Behind her stands a bearded man with a golden halo, wearing a red cloak draped over his left shoulder and waist, leaving his chest bare. A wound is visible on his right side, and his bare feet also show wounds. His right hand is raised with the palm outward, and his left hand points to the wound on his chest. Through an archway in the background, a landscape with trees and small figures is visible. Both panels share a tiled floor with a geometric pattern of light and dark squares.

metadata.title: Saint Paul with a Donor; Christ Appearing to His Mother
metadata.artist: Master of the Saint Ursula Legend

alt_text: A painting of a woman in red and green robes breastfeeding a baby against a golden, arched background.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a woman breastfeeding a baby, framed by a golden arch. The woman, positioned centrally, has fair skin and light reddish-brown, wavy hair. She wears a dark green hooded cloak over a red dress, with a white undergarment visible at her neck and chest. Her left breast is exposed as she gazes down at the baby. Her hands gently support the infant. The baby, with fair skin and a round face, is mostly nude, wrapped in a white cloth around its lower body, and looks up towards the woman while suckling. Behind the figures, a radiant golden background features faint lines emanating from behind the woman's head. This background is enclosed by a gilded, arched frame with decorative elements, showing some signs of age. The dominant colors are the deep red of the dress, the dark green of the cloak, and the bright gold of the background and frame, contrasting with the pale skin tones of the figures.

metadata.title: Virgin and Child
metadata.artist: Follower of Rogier van der Weyden (Master of the Saint Ursula Legend Group, Netherlandish, active late 15th century)

alt_text: Four men and a cat gather around a table, with two dream visions floating above them in a round painting
long_description: A circular painting depicts an indoor scene with four men and a cat. The composition is centered around a small, round white table covered with a white cloth. To the left, a young man with light brown hair, wearing a blue tunic, a red head covering, and a yellow cloth draped over his left arm, pours from a gray pitcher into a cup. He stands on a black and white checkered floor. At the center, a man in a brown robe and a dark hat sits at the table, looking down at a piece of meat on a plate, his hands clasped. Behind him, an older man with a white beard and dark clothing peers from a dark arched doorway. To the right, another young man with light brown hair, dressed in a red tunic and striped yellow and black hose, sits on a red bench or bed, gesturing upwards with his right hand while holding a cup in his left. On the table, alongside the meat, are several small, round bread rolls and two cups. Under the table, a light brown cat with a long tail sits on the checkered floor, looking towards the right. Above the table, two circular, glowing dream bubbles are depicted against the light wall. The left bubble shows a seated figure with a basket of birds on their head, while the right bubble shows a man pruning a vine. A small plaque at the bottom edge of the painting reads: "MASTER OF THE DREAMS OF JOSEPH". The entire artwork is enclosed within a wide, dark brown wooden frame.

metadata.title: Joseph Interpreting the Dreams of His Fellow Prisoners
metadata.artist: Master of the Story of Joseph

alt_text: A painting depicting several figures mourning over the body of a deceased man, set in a landscape
long_description: This vertical panel painting depicts a group of seven figures in a landscape. In the foreground, a pale, emaciated man with dark hair lies horizontally, his head to the left, supported by a woman kneeling in a dark blue robe and white head covering. His right arm is held by another woman kneeling on the far right, dressed in a gold and black patterned gown with a red cloak. The deceased man's body is mostly bare, covered only by a white loincloth. His left arm hangs down, showing a wound on his hand. To the left of the central group, a young man in a long red robe stands, looking down with a somber expression, his hands clasped. Behind the kneeling woman in blue, a woman in an elaborate dark brown and gold patterned gown with a blue and gold headdress stands, looking down. To the right of her, another woman in a dark, almost black, gown with a dark head covering stands, her hand to her temple, also looking down. The background features a light brown rocky outcrop with a small cluster of trees on top, positioned behind the standing man on the left. To the right, a green landscape recedes into the distance, with a light-colored building and several small figures visible in the far right background. The sky is a pale blue-green. The overall color palette is muted, with rich jewel tones in the clothing contrasting with the pale skin of the deceased and the subdued landscape.

metadata.title: The Lamentation
metadata.artist: Master of the Virgin among Virgins

alt_text: A Madonna and Child flanked by an old bearded man and a young woman, all with halos
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts four figures against a plain, dark background. In the center, the Madonna is shown in a three-quarter view, slightly angled to the left. She wears a dark head covering that drapes over her shoulders and a light-colored dress with a subtle patterned design visible on the sleeves and bodice. Her gaze is directed downwards, and her hands gently support the nude infant standing on her lap. She has a faint halo above her head. The infant, positioned slightly to the right of the center, stands facing forward with a small, faint halo. The baby holds a thin, light-colored string or ribbon in its left hand, which extends across its body. To the Madonna's left, an older man with a long, white beard and balding head is depicted. He wears a simple robe and holds an open book with both hands, his right index finger pointing to a page. He has a halo and looks towards the central figures. To the Madonna's right, a younger woman with wavy hair is shown. She wears a simple dress and holds a chalice in her left hand. She also has a halo and directs her gaze towards the Madonna and Child. The background is uniformly dark and unadorned.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Jerome and Mary Magdalen

alt_text: A classical landscape painting features figures and dogs by a pool, framed by an ornate stone archway and lush trees
long_description: The painting depicts a classical landscape scene with architectural elements and figures. The composition is divided vertically, with a natural landscape on the left and a large stone structure on the right. On the left, two figures are seated on a tiled patio next to a rectangular pool of water. One figure, mostly nude with a blue cloth draped over their lap, leans against another figure draped in a red cloth. Next to them, two small dogs, one white with brown spots and one mostly brown, lie on the patio. Behind these figures, a dense cluster of tall green trees rises, with a lighter green, hazy landscape of rolling hills and more trees extending into the distance under a pale blue sky with scattered white clouds. On the right side, a substantial, light brown stone architectural structure dominates, featuring an ornate archway that frames a view of more distant trees and a hazy landscape. The structure has a detailed frieze above the arch and a prominent cornice. Within the archway, to the right, a large stone fountain or basin is visible, with a reclining female statue draped in white fabric on its upper edge. Another smaller, partially obscured statue of a figure with children is also visible on the fountain. The patio extends across the foreground, leading to the pool of water that runs horizontally across the lower center of the image, reflecting the sky. The overall lighting suggests a soft, late afternoon or early morning light.

alt_text: A person walks between two cows on a muddy path in a flat, cloudy landscape under a gray sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a wide, flat, and open landscape under a cloudy sky, rendered in muted greens, browns, and grays. In the center, a figure dressed in dark, heavy clothing walks along a muddy path. The figure is seen from the front, slightly angled, with a hood or scarf covering their head. They hold a stick in their right hand. To the figure's left, a light-colored cow with some brown markings walks forward, its head slightly turned towards the viewer. To the figure's right, a darker cow, predominantly black and white, also walks forward, its head facing the viewer. The muddy path, reflecting the sky in puddles, extends from the foreground into the middle ground, dividing the grassy, marshy terrain. The landscape is low and flat, with hints of distant structures or trees on the horizon line. The sky occupies the upper half of the canvas, filled with heavy, gray and white clouds, suggesting an overcast or impending stormy day. The overall impression is one of a somber, rural scene.

alt_text: A person loads a cart pulled by a white donkey on a muddy path surrounded by bare trees under a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting depicts a rural landscape scene dominated by a central path. The sky, occupying the upper third of the canvas, is a pale, overcast blue with hints of white clouds. On the left side, several tall, slender trees with bare branches rise towards the sky, their dark trunks contrasting with the lighter background. Below these trees and extending into the mid-ground is dense, dark green and brown brushwork, suggesting winter foliage or undergrowth. In the center of the image, a light-colored donkey, possibly white or light gray, stands facing left, harnessed to a dark, two-wheeled cart. The donkey's head is slightly lowered. Behind the donkey, a person wearing a blue jacket and a dark cap is positioned within the cart, bent over, appearing to arrange or load bundles of light brown sticks or brushwood into the cart. The cart itself is dark, with visible wooden wheels. The path beneath the donkey and cart is a mix of dark brown mud and patches of green grass, showing visible texture from brushstrokes. The path extends from the foreground towards the background, disappearing into the distant brush. To the right of the path, the ground is also covered in green grass and scattered pieces of wood or brush. The overall color palette is muted, featuring greens, browns, blues, and grays, characteristic of a cool, possibly winter, day. The signature "A. Mauve" is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: A shepherd with a dog guides a flock of sheep along a dirt road under a cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a pastoral landscape under a cloudy sky, dominated by earthy tones of brown, gray, and muted green. A wide, unpaved dirt path, marked with ruts and tracks, extends from the foreground into the distance, occupying the lower two-thirds of the horizontal composition. On the left side of this path, a figure, likely a shepherd, stands with his back mostly to the viewer. He wears a dark, long coat and a hat, and holds a staff over his right shoulder. To his left and slightly in front, a small, dark-furred dog stands, looking towards the flock. A large group of sheep, predominantly light cream and off-white, occupies the center of the path, moving away from the viewer. Their backs and hindquarters are visible, forming a dense, textured mass. The horizon line is situated in the middle of the painting. The upper third of the canvas shows a light gray, overcast sky with subtle variations in tone. In the background, on the right, a line of dark green bushes and trees stretches across, with a single tall, slender tree standing out in the center-right. Faint, indistinct structures are visible on the distant horizon to the left. The overall palette is subdued, emphasizing the natural, rural setting. A dark signature, "V. Mauve", is visible in the lower right corner.

alt_text: A young person carries a lamb, leading a flock of sheep and a dog on a dirt path under a hazy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a pastoral scene with a young person, a flock of sheep, and a dog on a dirt path under a hazy sky. In the center, a young person, dressed in dark clothing with a light-colored head covering, holds a small white lamb in their arms. They face slightly towards the viewer, looking down at the lamb. A large flock of sheep, mostly white or off-white with some darker markings on their faces and legs, surrounds the central figure and extends across the middle ground. The sheep are moving along a winding, light brown dirt path that stretches from the foreground into the distance. Several puddles of water reflect the light on the path. To the right of the path, behind the main group of sheep, a dark-furred dog walks, looking towards the right. The foreground features sparse green and brown vegetation with small white flowers on the left. The background consists of a flat, open landscape under a pale, hazy sky, with a single, bare, dark-branched tree visible on the right horizon. The overall color palette is dominated by muted browns, greens, and grays, with lighter tones in the sky and on the sheep.

alt_text: A shepherd guides a flock of sheep along a path through a dark, tree-lined landscape
long_description: A grayscale painting depicts a pastoral landscape with a shepherd and a flock of sheep. In the foreground and midground, approximately ten sheep are seen from behind, moving from the lower right towards the upper left. Their light-toned wool contrasts with the darker, wet ground, which shows subtle reflections. Behind the sheep, slightly to the right, a dark, indistinct figure, likely a shepherd, is partially visible, holding a staff. Dense, dark trees with visible foliage dominate the right side and upper background, forming a heavy, shadowed canopy. Through a break in the trees in the upper left and center background, a lighter, hazy sky or distant light source is visible, creating a subtle glow. The ground is uneven, with varying shades of gray suggesting natural, unpaved terrain. The overall composition conveys a somber or contemplative mood through its dark tones and overcast appearance.

alt_text: A woman in a long dress looks up, reaching out, surrounded by two large spotted cats in a stone room
long_description: This black and white painting depicts a woman standing in a stone enclosure, surrounded by two large spotted cats. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, wears a light-colored, flowing dress and a dark shawl draped over her head and shoulders. Her dark hair appears disheveled. She looks upwards with an open-mouthed expression, her left arm extended horizontally towards the right wall, palm open. On the left, a large spotted cat is curled on the ground, facing away from the viewer but with its head turned towards the woman. Its fur is distinctly patterned. On the right, another spotted cat's head and front paws rest on a low stone ledge, also facing the woman. The background consists of rough-hewn stone walls, with a darker, possibly wooden, structure visible on the far right wall. At the woman's feet, a small white flower with a few leaves lies on the ground. The overall composition creates a sense of tension, with the woman's upward gaze and outstretched arm drawing attention to the upper right, while the cats observe her from below.

metadata.title: The Last Token: A Christian Martyr

alt_text: A young girl in an elaborate black dress stands beside a small dog on an ornate red chair
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a young girl standing slightly to the right of center, looking directly forward. She has a pale, round face with light eyes and a serious expression. Her reddish-brown hair is styled in tight curls, and she wears a red, patterned headpiece on the right side of her head. Around her neck is a single strand pearl necklace. She is dressed in a voluminous black gown with a wide, stiff skirt that extends to the bottom of the frame. The dress features intricate silver-gray lace detailing on the wide collar and cuffs, and a large red bow with a pearl center is prominently placed on her chest. Smaller red bows adorn her sleeves. On her right wrist, she wears a light-colored bracelet, and her right hand holds a dark tassel. Her left hand rests gently on the head of a small, light-colored dog with long fur, which sits on an ornate, high-backed red chair to her left. The chair has gold-colored accents on its armrest. The background is dark and indistinct, with a reddish-brown curtain draped behind the girl on the right, and darker, muted tones on the left, suggesting an interior space.

alt_text: Four men in 17th-century attire gather around a wooden bench in a dimly lit room, conversing
long_description: This oil painting depicts four men gathered in a dimly lit interior, likely a room with wooden walls and floor. The overall color scheme is subdued, featuring various shades of brown, gray, and ochre, with accents of dark green and red. The figures are arranged around a dark wooden bench or table, with light illuminating their faces and clothing against a darker background. On the far left, a man sits on the bench, facing right. He wears a wide-brimmed light brown hat, a light-colored doublet with puffed sleeves, dark breeches, and dark shoes with red stockings. His left leg is extended, and his right hand rests on his knee. A dark green piece of fabric is draped over the bench beside him. Behind him and slightly to the right, another man stands, wearing a light-colored doublet and a white collar. He holds a long, thin pipe in his right hand, raised towards his mouth, and looks towards the group. To the right, two men are seated on the bench, facing each other. The man on the far right wears a light-colored doublet, dark breeches, and tall dark boots. A sword with an ornate hilt is visible at his left hip. He holds a small white rectangular object, possibly a card or piece of paper, in his hands and looks down at it. The man seated next to him, closer to the center, wears a darker brown jacket and has dark, curly hair. He leans forward, looking intently at the object held by the man on the far right. The wooden bench features carved details. A small, simple wooden stool is visible on the floor to the far left. A dark green garment hangs on the wall in the upper right corner. The signature "H. J. Jones 1885" is visible in the bottom left corner.

alt_text: A man in 17th-century attire plays a large lute, smiling, with one foot on a stool.
long_description: The painting depicts a full-length portrait of a man playing a large stringed instrument in an interior setting. The man stands slightly to the right of center, facing forward with his head tilted upwards and to the left, a wide smile on his face, and his mouth open as if singing. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat, a white shirt with ruffled cuffs, light grey breeches, and tall, reddish-brown boots with wide, folded tops. His right foot is propped on a small, dark wooden stool, while his left foot is flat on the floor. He holds a light brown lute with a large, rounded body and a long, multi-stringed neck that curves sharply backward at the top. His left hand is on the fretboard, and his right hand is positioned over the soundhole, as if strumming. The background is dimly lit, with a dark, greenish-brown draped fabric visible on the left side. To the right of the man, a dark wooden chair is partially visible, draped with a rich red fabric. The floor is a muted brown-grey. The lighting comes from the upper left, casting highlights on the man's face, shirt, and the lute, creating a warm glow against the darker background. In the bottom right corner, a signature "Meissonier 1865" is visible in dark script.

alt_text: Two men on horseback converse on a dirt road beside a coastal town with a fortress under a cloudy sky.
long_description: An oil painting depicts two men on horseback conversing on a dirt road that runs parallel to a coastline. The man on the left rides a brown horse and wears a dark uniform with a wide-brimmed hat. He faces the man on the right, who rides a white horse and also wears a dark uniform and a similar hat. The man on the white horse has his right arm raised, seemingly mid-gesture in conversation. To the left of the riders, a light-colored stone wall rises alongside the road, behind which are several buildings with light-colored facades and reddish-brown tiled roofs, suggesting a small town or village. Sparse green and brown vegetation grows along the wall and the roadside. To the right of the riders, the dirt road continues, leading towards a body of water, likely the sea, which is a calm blue. Along the far shore, a fortified structure with light-colored walls and buildings is visible, extending into the water. Distant hills or land masses are faintly visible under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. The foreground consists of the textured, light brown dirt road with some darker shadows.

alt_text: A large painting depicts a cavalry charge across a grassy field under a cloudy sky.
long_description: A wide, horizontal oil painting depicts a large-scale military scene with numerous soldiers on horseback across a grassy field under a cloudy sky. The upper third of the canvas features a light blue sky filled with dynamic white and gray clouds. The lower two-thirds are dominated by a field of tall, green and yellow-brown grass, rendered with visible brushstrokes that convey texture and movement. On the left side of the painting, a group of officers on horseback are gathered, appearing to observe or direct. Several wear dark uniforms with tall hats, some plumed. One prominent officer on a white horse, near the center-left, raises his right hand. Behind this group, other mounted soldiers and what appears to be an artillery piece are partially visible. The right side of the painting is filled with a dense, surging mass of cavalry in motion, charging towards the right. Horses are depicted in various dynamic poses, some galloping with legs extended, others rearing. Their riders wear military uniforms, many with tall shakos or helmets. Numerous long, thin swords and lances are raised vertically into the air, reflecting light. A particularly prominent rider on a white horse in the lower right foreground leans forward, his horse in mid-stride. The overall composition emphasizes the contrast between the more static command group on the left and the energetic, forward momentum of the charging cavalry on the right, creating a sense of impending action.

alt_text: A still life painting features various fruits, bread, and baskets arranged on a stone ledge in a landscape.
long_description: A still life painting depicts an abundance of fruits, bread, and containers arranged on a dark stone ledge, set against a natural landscape. On the left, two greenish-yellow quinces sit next to a white plate piled with orange apricots. Behind them, a copper pot with a lid and a handle is stacked on another copper vessel. In the center, a large, light green melon, cut open to reveal its seeds, rests beside a smaller slice. Above the melon, a large cluster of light green grapes spills from a wicker basket, with some darker grapes mixed in. To the right, a dark bottle stands next to a large, light-colored linen cloth draped over a woven basket containing white plates. In front of this basket, several round loaves of light brown bread are piled, with a small knife lying nearby. Further right, a tall wooden bucket with a rope handle sits on the ledge. The background features a lush, dark green hillside with trees, and a bright blue sky with white clouds on the left, revealing distant mountains.

alt_text: The Virgin Mary holds the Christ Child, surrounded by angels playing instruments and two kneeling women in a landscape
long_description: The painting depicts a central group of figures in a lush green landscape under a dark sky. In the center, the Virgin Mary, dressed in a flowing red gown, sits on a dark, ornate throne-like structure with a patterned gold and dark blue fabric canopy behind her. She holds the nude Christ Child, who is wrapped in a white cloth around his lower body, on her lap. The Child reaches his right hand towards a kneeling woman on the left. To the left of Mary, a woman with a gold crown over a white head covering kneels, wearing a white top with red sleeves and a dark gold patterned skirt. Her left hand is extended towards the Christ Child. Behind her, a young man in a dark tunic stands, holding a rosary. Between the kneeling woman and the standing man, an angel with large white wings and a blue tunic plays a harp. To the right of Mary, another woman kneels, dressed in a bright green gown with a dark cloak draped over her shoulders. She holds an open book in her hands. Behind her, an angel with white wings and a red and gold tunic plays a stringed instrument resembling a lyre. In the background, a rolling green landscape features trees, a light-colored building with an arched entrance on the left, and a white and gold domed building on the right. A dark object, possibly a sword or staff, lies on the grass in the foreground, below the kneeling woman on the left.

metadata.title: Virgin and Child with Saints Catherine of Alexandria and Barbara

alt_text: An oil painting depicts an older man with gray hair, a dark shirt, and clasped hands, against a dark background.
long_description: This is a vertical oil painting depicting a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man, positioned slightly to the right of the center, against a dark, uniform background. The man's skin is fair with a reddish undertone, showing visible wrinkles on his forehead, around his eyes, and on his cheeks. His hair is short, wavy, and gray, parted on the left and falling just above his ears. His eyes are dark brown, looking slightly downward and to the right. His nose is prominent, and his lips are thin and closed, forming a neutral expression. He wears a dark brown garment, possibly a shirt or tunic, with a high, rounded collar and a row of small, dark buttons running down the front. His hands are clasped together at the bottom center of the painting, resting just above the lower edge of the frame. The hands are rendered with visible knuckles and veins, matching the skin tone of his face. The overall lighting appears to come from the upper left, casting subtle shadows on the right side of his face and neck. The painting is enclosed within a simple, dark wooden frame.

alt_text: A diptych showing a man and a woman in separate frames, both with hands clasped in prayer
long_description: The image is a diptych, composed of two vertical panels side-by-side, each depicting a bust-length portrait against a dark, plain background. A thin, light brown wooden frame surrounds each panel, with a thicker vertical wooden strip separating them in the center. The left panel features a man with light skin, facing slightly right. He has short, dark brown hair cut in a bowl shape, covering his ears and forehead. He wears a dark, high-collared garment. His hands are clasped together in prayer at the bottom center of the panel, with a simple gold band visible on the ring finger of his left hand. His eyes are light brown, and his expression is neutral. The right panel shows a woman with light skin, facing slightly left. She wears a dark head covering that extends over her forehead, with a sheer, light blue veil draped over it and falling behind her right shoulder. Her dress is dark, featuring a wide, white fur collar that frames her neck and shoulders. A prominent gold necklace with intricate black and red floral-like ornaments adorns her neck. Her hands are clasped together in prayer at the bottom center of the panel, with a simple gold band visible on the ring finger of her left hand. Her eyes are light brown, and her expression is neutral.

metadata.title: Tommaso di Folco Portinari (1428–1501); Maria Portinari (Maria Maddalena Baroncelli, born 1456)

alt_text: A mother breastfeeds a child in a landscape, depicted in a round, gold-framed painting
long_description: The painting is a circular portrait, set within a thick, ornate gold frame. The central figures are a woman and a baby, positioned against a rolling green landscape under a light blue sky. The woman, on the right, has fair skin and light, reddish-blonde hair, partially covered by a white veil. She wears a dark blue or black dress, with a white garment visible underneath, and a flowing red cloak draped over her shoulders and arm. Her left breast is exposed, and she looks down towards the baby. The baby, on the left, has fair skin and is naked, held in the woman's arms. The baby's head is turned towards the woman's exposed breast, appearing to feed. The baby's small hands are visible, one near the woman's breast and the other resting on her arm. The background features a verdant landscape with undulating hills, scattered dark green trees, and faint structures in the distance under a pale blue sky with hints of white. The entire painted surface shows a network of fine cracks. The gold frame is circular, with a textured, slightly worn appearance.

alt_text: A woman in a red dress holds a red flower, framed by an archway, with a landscape visible behind her.
long_description: This vertical painting depicts a pale-skinned woman in a deep red dress, positioned within a dark brown archway. She is shown from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with her gaze directed towards the right. Her long, dark hair is parted in the middle and falls over her shoulders. She has a high forehead, dark eyes, and a small mouth. Around her neck, she wears a thin dark necklace and a longer, gold-colored chain with a dark, possibly metallic, pendant. Her dress features long sleeves and a square neckline, with a dark, horizontally striped bodice. Her left hand, holding a small red flower with a green stem, is positioned near the center of the painting. Her right hand rests on a brown, stone-like ledge that forms the bottom of the archway, and a simple ring is visible on her right ring finger. To the left of the woman, a gray drapery hangs from the archway. Behind her, a landscape is visible through the arch, featuring a light blue sky above a line of rounded, dark green trees. The ground in the landscape appears to be a lighter green. The overall impression is a formal portrait set against a natural backdrop.

alt_text: A woman in a red cloak holds a baby who touches an open book, with a landscape visible through a window
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a baby in a vertical rectangular format. The woman, positioned slightly to the left of center, wears a deep red cloak draped over a dark dress with a gold-trimmed, V-shaped neckline. Her long, light brown hair falls over her shoulders, and she wears a delicate, lace-like headpiece with a dark band adorned with small, dark jewels across her forehead. Her fair-skinned face is turned slightly to the right, with her eyes cast downwards. She cradles a naked baby, who sits upright on a white cloth on her lap, facing forward with a direct gaze. The baby has light, curly hair and fair skin. The woman's left hand supports the baby's back, while her right hand holds an open book with a dark cover. The baby's right hand rests on the pages of the book, which show lines of text. The text on the visible page appears to be "DOMINE LABIA MEA APERIES ET OS MEUM ANNUNTIABIT LAUDEM TUAM". To the right of the figures, a rectangular window opens to a distant landscape under a light blue sky. The landscape features rolling green fields, scattered trees, and a dark forest in the background. Small, indistinct figures appear in the middle ground. The interior wall behind the woman is a dark, reddish-brown wood. The overall palette is rich, with strong contrasts between the red cloak, dark dress, and the lighter skin tones and landscape.

alt_text: A man with long dark hair and a beard in a red robe holds an orb and cross, against a landscape.
long_description: A circular painting depicts a man from the chest up, centered against a landscape background. The man has light skin, long dark brown hair parted in the middle, and a dark brown beard and mustache. He looks directly forward with a neutral expression. He wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved robe in a muted reddish-pink color. His right hand is raised, palm facing forward, with the thumb and first two fingers extended and the ring and pinky fingers bent towards the palm. His left hand holds a dark, spherical orb. A slender golden staff with a small, ornate golden cross at its top emerges from the orb, held upright. The background features a landscape with green trees and rolling hills. On the left, a winding path or road leads into the distance. In the far distance on the right, a light brown building with towers, resembling a castle or fortress, stands on a hill. A body of water is visible in the mid-ground. The sky above is a clear, light blue. The painting is enclosed within a thick, ornate golden frame.

alt_text: Madonna and Child with an apple, set against a landscape background, framed by wooden borders
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a woman holding a child, framed by a rough wooden border. The woman, positioned slightly to the left, looks down with a gentle expression. She has long, wavy reddish-brown hair, parted in the middle, adorned with a thin dark headband. Her pale face features downcast eyes and a small mouth. She wears a dark blue or black dress, largely covered by a voluminous red cloak that drapes over her shoulders and lap. Her left hand delicately holds a small, light yellow-green apple, while her right hand supports the back and leg of the child. The child, nude and chubby, sits on the woman's lap, facing slightly to the right with a direct gaze. He has short, curly, light blonde hair and pale skin. His right hand reaches towards the apple held by the woman, and his left hand rests on her arm. His left leg is bent, and his right leg is extended. Behind the figures, a landscape is visible through an architectural opening, flanked by two dark brown columns or pillars. On the left, rolling green hills, a winding river, and scattered trees extend under a light blue sky. On the right, a denser dark green forest is visible against a similar sky. The distant landscape appears somewhat hazy. The entire painted scene is enclosed within a visible, unpolished wooden frame, revealing its natural grain and texture.

alt_text: A gilded altarpiece depicts the Madonna and Child, flanked by saints, with smaller figures in a predella below.
long_description: A tall, rectangular altarpiece with a pointed, triangular top is centered against a black background. The entire frame is richly gilded and ornately carved. In the central panel, the Madonna, with fair skin and a serene expression, is depicted in a dark blue robe with gold trim, holding the Child. A golden halo with radiating lines surrounds her head. The Child, also with fair skin, is seated on her left arm, wearing a gold patterned garment, and reaches up with his right hand towards her chin. A golden halo surrounds his head. The background behind them is a shimmering gold, with faint patterns and faint depictions of angels in the upper corners. On either side of the main figures, at mid-height, are two standing figures. On the left, a figure in a blue robe holds a staff. On the right, a figure in a dark brown monastic habit stands. Below the main panel, a horizontal strip, known as a predella, features a series of eight smaller, seated figures, each within an arched niche, dressed in various colored robes, with golden backgrounds behind them.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints and Angels

alt_text: A painting of a nun in a brown habit and black veil, holding a red book and a golden object, in an ornate gold frame
long_description: The image depicts a painting of a woman in religious attire, set within an elaborate gold frame. The frame is tall and narrow, featuring a pointed, gabled top adorned with intricate, leafy carvings. Two slender, pointed spires rise from the sides of the gable. The main body of the frame has twisted columns on either side, resting on a rectangular base. The gold surface of the frame shows signs of age, with visible cracks and some areas where the gold leaf appears worn. The painted figure, a woman with light skin, is shown from the waist up, facing slightly to the viewer's left with her head tilted down. She wears a dark brown habit with a black veil covering her head and shoulders, revealing only her face and hands. A white wimple frames her face. Her expression is somber, with downcast eyes and a slightly parted mouth. Behind her head is a circular, golden halo with a textured, radiating pattern. The background of the painting is a flat, textured gold, matching the frame. In her left hand, held at waist level, she clutches a small, rectangular red book with gold clasps and a gold design on its cover. The design appears to be a stylized crown or floral motif. Her right hand, positioned higher, holds a golden, chalice-like object with a wide, fluted rim and a narrow base. The object is held upright. The overall impression is one of solemnity and devotion.

alt_text: A bearded man in a green tunic and purple cloak holds a sword and papers within an ornate gold arched frame.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a bearded man from the waist up, set against a shimmering gold background. The man has a dark brown beard and mustache, and short dark brown hair. His skin is light, and he looks directly forward with a serious expression. He wears a dark teal tunic, visible at his chest, covered by a draped purple cloak that falls over his shoulders and arms. In his right hand, he holds a long, reddish-brown sword vertically, with the hilt positioned near his waist. In his left hand, he holds a stack of several white papers or scrolls. The top paper clearly shows the text "AD ROMANO" and below it, partially visible, "PAVLVS". A circular, ornate halo with concentric patterns of raised dots and lines surrounds his head, glowing against the gold background. The gold background itself is textured and extends upwards into a pointed arch, decorated with intricate geometric patterns and raised relief work along its edges. The figure occupies the central portion of the frame, which is bordered by a simple gold band.

alt_text: A portrait of a man with light skin and dark hair, holding an open book, looking forward.
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a man from the chest up, positioned against a plain, dark olive-green background. The man has light skin, a high forehead, and dark, receding hair. His dark eyes gaze directly forward, and his lips are closed in a neutral expression. His cheeks show a subtle flush. He wears an open-collared white shirt with a visible ruffled or embroidered edge at the neckline. A large, flowing brown drapery is wrapped around his left shoulder and arm, extending across his chest. A small section of a dark green garment is visible beneath the brown drapery on his right side. His right hand holds an open, light yellow-brown book, angled slightly towards the viewer. The visible edge of the book's pages displays vertical text that reads 'ΙΛΙΑΣ'. The man's face and the book are well-lit, suggesting a light source from the upper left.

alt_text: A partially draped woman stands in a dark forest, holding sheer fabric, with a faint child figure nearby.
long_description: A vertical, dark-toned painting depicts a woman standing in a forest setting. The woman, positioned centrally, faces slightly right with her head turned upwards and to the left. She has dark, curly hair and pale skin. Her upper body is partially nude, with her left shoulder and chest exposed. She is draped in a sheer, dark fabric with light-colored vertical stripes, which she holds with both hands clasped at her chest. The fabric extends down, revealing her legs and bare feet on the dark, uneven ground. In the background, dark trees and foliage are visible, with several leaves appearing to float or fall around the woman. To the lower right, a faint, blurry figure of a small child, possibly a putto, is partially visible, appearing to reach upwards amidst the dark foliage. The overall lighting is dim, emphasizing the figures against the dark background.

alt_text: Three figures in a room, two men and a woman, with musical instruments and a painting on the wall
long_description: The painting depicts an indoor scene with three figures and various objects. On the left, a man stands by an open window, looking towards the center. He wears a dark hat, a patterned red and gold jacket, and white cuffs. Through the window, a blue sky and a red curtain are visible. In the center, a woman is seated, facing slightly right with her head turned towards the left. She wears an orange dress with intricate gold patterns, a blue shawl, and a white cap. Her left hand is raised, holding a white object, possibly a letter, while her right hand rests on her lap. Her mouth is slightly open. At her feet is a small wooden box. To the right of the woman, a table is covered with a patterned rug. On the table, a lute rests against a dark object, and some papers are visible. Behind the table, a large, dark stringed instrument, possibly a cello, is partially visible. On the right, a man is seated on a stool, facing left and playing a small stringed instrument with a bow. He wears a dark jacket with white cuffs and a dark sash. His long, light-colored hair falls over his shoulders. On the floor in front of him are a dark hat, a sword, and a bag of fruit. The background features a light-colored wall. Above the table, an arched alcove contains a painting of a woman holding a tray. To the right of the alcove, a large, rolled-up map or scroll hangs on the wall. On the floor in the foreground, an open dark trunk contains white papers, and more loose papers are scattered nearby.

alt_text: A group of people in a dimly lit room, with a woman holding a baby in the center-right
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with several figures in a dimly lit room. The floor on the left features a black and white checkered pattern, transitioning to a patterned rug with red, blue, and gold hues on the right. In the center-right, a woman with a white cap and a red and white shawl sits in a chair, holding a swaddled baby. A man with long, dark hair, wearing a brown vest over a white shirt, stands behind her, looking down towards the baby. To the left of this central group, another figure sits in a dark chair, partially obscured. Further to the left, a woman in a dark dress with a white collar and cuffs stands, facing towards the right with her hands slightly extended. Behind her, in a doorway on the far left, a person in a brown dress and white apron holds a bucket, looking towards the center. On the far right, a small table draped with a red and blue patterned cloth holds several silver vessels, including a pitcher and a tray. Behind the seated woman, a large fireplace with a dark, framed area above it dominates the background. To the right of the fireplace, a bed with ornate, golden posts is partially visible. A small, light-colored dog is visible near the feet of the seated woman. The overall color palette is rich with dark browns, reds, and whites.

alt_text: A man smoking a pipe and a woman looking into a box at a table in a dimly lit interior
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in a dimly lit interior. On the left, a man is seated, facing right, wearing a dark brown coat with gold buttons, a white collar, red breeches, and a black wide-brimmed hat. He holds a long white pipe to his mouth and a small reddish-brown bowl in his left hand, which rests on an open wooden box on a table. His right leg is crossed over his left, revealing bright orange-red stockings and dark shoes. To the right of the man, a woman stands behind the table, leaning forward and looking down into the open wooden box. She wears a white cap that covers her hair, a white collar, and a light-colored blouse. Her right hand holds the lid of a tall, silver pitcher, which sits on the table next to a smaller, closed wooden box. A striped cloth, predominantly red, orange, and brown, hangs over the front of the table. The background is dark, with shelves visible on the back wall, holding several decorative plates. A violin hangs on the wall to the left of the figures. On the wooden floor in the foreground, several playing cards and a broken pipe stem are scattered. The overall lighting is subdued, with a light source illuminating the faces of the figures and the objects on the table.

alt_text: A young woman in a dark dress sits in a stone window archway, holding an apple, with a fruit bowl and vine
long_description: The painting depicts a young woman seated within a stone window archway, looking directly forward. She has light skin, a round face, and her light brown hair is pulled back, partially covered by a dark cap. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with a wide, white collar and cuffs, and a white apron. Dangling earrings are visible. Her right hand, raised, holds a small, round, reddish-orange fruit. Her left hand rests on the stone ledge in front of her, near a small, reddish-brown book with a red ribbon bookmark and a dark, slender object, possibly a knife. To her right, on the ledge, is a white, scalloped bowl containing several light-colored fruits. A leafy vine with a cluster of light blue grapes hangs from the upper left corner, curving over the arch. The background through the archway is dark, revealing a faint outline of a birdcage on the right side. The signature "G. Metsu" is faintly inscribed on the stone ledge below her left hand.

metadata.title: A Woman Seated at a Window

alt_text: A chaotic oil painting depicts a skirmish of men on horseback, some rearing, amidst smoke and trees.
long_description: A dynamic oil painting portrays a chaotic skirmish or battle scene with numerous figures on horseback under a light blue sky with large, fluffy white and grey clouds. On the far left, a dark, rustic wooden building or barn is partially visible. The left and center midground are dominated by a dense group of men on horses. Many horses are in motion, some rearing dramatically, while others appear to be falling. The men wear wide-brimmed hats and cloaks in various shades of brown, black, red, and blue. Several figures hold swords or long poles, some raised in action. White and grey smoke billows from behind this central group, suggesting gunfire. A prominent figure in a dark cloak on a dark horse is seen from behind, holding a long pole. Another man on a white horse raises a sword. A dark hat lies on the ground in the immediate foreground. Towards the center-right, a man on a rearing brown horse, seen from behind, raises a sword towards the right, while a light-colored horse gallops forward. A line of trees with autumn-colored foliage stretches across the mid-distance. Further to the right, a small building with a thatched roof is visible.
