The horse on the left is rearing slightly, its front legs lifted, ridden by a figure in light-colored, flowing robes and a hood, holding a long staff or spear. To its right, another light-colored horse is also in motion, with its front legs bent, ridden by a figure similarly dressed in light robes and a hood, holding a flag or banner that billows behind them. Behind these central figures, several other darker horses and riders are visible, suggesting a larger group following. The ground beneath the horses is dark, uneven, and appears to be a wild, uncultivated terrain with hints of sparse vegetation. The sky above is dark and heavily clouded, creating a dramatic and intense atmosphere. The overall lighting emphasizes the light-colored horses and riders against the darker background, highlighting their movement.

metadata.title: Battle Scene: Arabs Making a Detour

alt_text: A wide river scene with a multi-arched bridge, bustling boats, and a large cathedral dominating a distant city skyline
long_description: The painting presents a panoramic view of a wide river with a bustling city on its far bank under a dynamic sky. The upper half of the canvas is dominated by a light blue sky, transitioning to a slightly darker hue on the right, filled with large, billowy white and grey clouds. The lower half depicts the calm, greenish-brown water of the river, reflecting the sky and distant structures. In the immediate left foreground, a large, dark wooden structure, possibly a crane or part of a dock, extends upwards and to the right, featuring a prominent hook hanging from its arm. Below this structure, a small, dark boat laden with logs is positioned near the bank, with a few figures visible on and around it. Further into the mid-ground, a multi-arched stone bridge spans the river from the left, with several arches visible and small figures and structures on its deck. On the river, numerous boats of various sizes are scattered. A long, narrow boat with a light-colored canopy and several passengers is prominent near the center, moving towards the right. Other smaller boats, some with figures, are visible across the water. The far bank is densely packed with buildings, predominantly in shades of reddish-brown brick with white facades and roofs. The most prominent structure is a large, light-colored Gothic-style cathedral, featuring multiple spires and a tall, square tower on its right side, dominating the central-right portion of the city skyline. Other buildings, including smaller houses and larger public structures, extend along the riverbank to the right, creating a vibrant urban landscape.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a man in a dark hat and cloak, with gold-colored text above him
long_description: This is a vertical portrait painting of a man, depicted from the waist up, against a dark, muted gray-brown background. Gold-colored text is visible across the top of the painting. On the upper left, it reads: "HAC. EST. EFFIGIES. LIGVRIS. MIRANDA." On the upper right, it reads: "COLVMB. I. ANTIPODVM. M. PRIMVS." Below this, to the right, is the word "ORBEM." The man is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his body angled slightly to the right, but his head turned to face the viewer directly. He has a round face with light-toned skin, dark eyes, and short, dark hair visible beneath a dark, soft-brimmed hat that covers his ears. A short, dark beard frames his jawline. He wears a white, ruffled collar over a dark, possibly black, garment. Over this, he is draped in a voluminous, dark cloak or coat that covers his shoulders and arms. His right hand, with light-toned skin and fingers slightly splayed, rests on the front of his body, possibly on his chest or stomach. His left hand is partially visible at the bottom right, resting on a surface. Both wrists show white ruffled cuffs. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting his face and hands against the darker clothing and background. A thin gold border frames the entire painting.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man, Said to be Christopher Columbus (born about 1446, died 1506)

alt_text: A painting of the Madonna and Child surrounded by six other figures, including bearded men and women
long_description: The painting features eight figures arranged in a group, with a woman holding a baby at the center. The central woman, dressed in a light pink gown, a white veil, and a blue draped skirt, gazes downwards at the infant in her arms. The baby, partially covered by a white cloth, is asleep, with its right hand near its mouth. To the left, a large, muscular man with a long, light brown beard and a red cloak draped over his left shoulder looks towards the central figures. Below him, a younger man with dark, shoulder-length hair and a light blue tunic looks up and to his right, holding a scroll with faint, illegible text. To the right of the central woman, a woman with dark hair and a green garment looks towards the Madonna and Child. Behind her, a bearded man in a brown hooded robe points his right hand towards the central group. Below these two, another woman with dark, curly hair and a yellow garment looks towards the center. The background is divided, with a light blue sky on the left side and a dark, almost black, background on the right. The figures are closely grouped, creating a sense of intimacy and focus on the central mother and child. The lighting highlights the faces and bare skin, contrasting with the deep, rich colors of the drapery.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints and Donors

alt_text: A painting of a forest with tall, bare trees, green mossy ground, and scattered yellow flowers
long_description: The painting depicts a forest scene dominated by tall, slender trees with bare branches reaching towards a light blue sky. The sky, visible in the upper half of the image, shows hints of lighter clouds. Many of the tree trunks are dark brown or grey, and several on the left side are heavily covered in dark green ivy that climbs upwards. Some trees in the background appear lighter and more indistinct, creating a sense of depth. The ground in the lower half of the painting is a vibrant green, covered in grass and patches of moss. Several large, moss-covered rocks are scattered across the foreground and midground, forming undulating mounds. A narrow, dark path winds from the lower center towards the upper right, disappearing into the trees. Numerous small, pale yellow flowers with delicate petals are scattered across the green ground, particularly in the foreground and along the path. The overall impression is of an early spring or late autumn forest. In the bottom right corner, a signature "Schultze 74" is visible in dark script.

alt_text: A young man in a blue velvet suit and hat stands with a black dog in a landscape
long_description: This full-length portrait depicts a young man standing in a landscape with a dog. The fair-skinned man, positioned slightly right of center, has dark hair and looks towards the viewer's right. He wears an elaborate blue-green velvet coat and matching breeches, a white waistcoat with extensive gold trim, and white stockings. His black shoes have silver buckles. On his head is a gold-trimmed hat. His left hand rests on his hip, while his right hand holds a light-colored walking stick that extends towards the ground. To the left of his legs, a medium-sized black dog with a white chest patch lies on the ground, looking up towards the man. The background on the left features a large tree trunk. To the right, an expansive landscape unfolds with rolling hills and a distant building under a sky transitioning from blue at the top to warm orange and yellow hues near the horizon. The foreground consists of earthy brown ground, with a small cluster of white flowers and green leaves visible on the far right.

alt_text: A half-length painting of a bearded man in a red cloak and dark tunic, holding a book and gesturing, against a gold background
long_description: The artwork is a vertical, arched panel painting depicting a half-length figure of a man against a gold background. The man is positioned centrally, facing forward with a direct gaze. He has medium-length brown hair, a full brown beard, and a mustache. His skin tone is light, with rosy cheeks. He wears a dark blue or black tunic with a pattern of light-colored, possibly gold, diagonal lines forming a chevron-like design on the sleeves and chest. Over his left shoulder and draped across his body is a vibrant red cloak. His right hand is raised to chest level, with the palm facing outward, two fingers extended upwards, and the thumb and other two fingers bent. His left hand holds a closed book against his lower left side. The book has a light-colored cover, possibly white or cream, with dark bands across it and some faint, dark markings that could be text or decoration. Behind the man's head is a circular halo, rendered in gold with a patterned design. Within the halo, a cross shape is visible, also in gold, with intricate geometric patterns filling the spaces. The entire background is a textured gold, showing some areas of wear and slight discoloration, particularly along the edges and top arch. The overall impression is of a formal, frontal portrait.

alt_text: A gold-backed religious panel painting depicts the Madonna and Child below three haloed male figures.
long_description: A vertical panel painting features two main sections against a gold background. The upper section contains three arched compartments, each with a haloed male figure. The left figure is bearded, wears a dark robe, and holds a red book. The central figure, younger and beardless, wears a red robe over a blue garment, with his right hand raised and left hand holding a dark book. The right figure is bearded, wears a green robe, holds a red book, and has his right hand raised. A dark, decorative band separates the upper and lower sections. The larger lower section features the Madonna and Child within a single arched frame. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the right, looks down with a somber expression. She wears a dark blue mantle over a red garment and a white veil, with a halo around her head. She cradles the Child in her left arm. The Child faces forward, looking to the right, with pink drapery around his lower body and a halo. The background behind them is gold with radiating lines. A dark, decorative band runs along the very bottom of the panel.

alt_text: A painting of a bearded man with a halo, holding a book, within an arched golden frame
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a man from the chest up, set within an ornate golden frame. The man has a long, light brown beard and hair, and looks slightly to his left. A golden halo, composed of concentric circles with intricate patterns, surrounds his head. He wears a dark robe with a patterned neckline and a lighter gray cloak draped over his shoulders and left arm. His right hand is raised to his chest, palm inward, while his left hand holds a closed book. The book is dark with golden accents and some illegible text on its spine. The background behind the man is a light golden color, with an arched top section. The painting itself is contained within a larger, rectangular golden frame featuring architectural elements, including a base, side columns, and a decorative cornice at the top.

alt_text: A black and white painting of the Madonna, Child, and another child in a landscape setting
long_description: This black and white painting, with an arched top, depicts three figures in a landscape. In the center, a tall female figure, likely the Madonna, stands with her hands pressed together in prayer, looking down. She wears a dark, heavy cloak draped over a lighter-toned dress, and a faint halo encircles her head. To the lower left, an infant, presumably the Christ Child, lies on a patterned cloth. The infant is nude, with a halo, and reaches its left arm upwards. Behind the infant, slightly to the left and higher, stands another child, likely Saint John the Baptist. This child also has a halo and holds a slender cross-staff in one hand and a small scroll in the other, looking down towards the infant. The background features a rolling, hilly landscape with scattered trees and faint architectural structures. The foreground is dark, with some decorative elements visible on the ground beneath the figures.

metadata.title: The Virgin Adoring the Child with the Infant Saint John the Baptist
metadata.artist: Jacopo di Arcangelo (called Jacopo del Sellaio)

alt_text: A pointillist painting of a stage performance with a central figure, musicians, and an audience
long_description: The painting depicts a nocturnal or dimly lit stage performance rendered in a pointillist style, characterized by small, distinct dots of color. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by blues, browns, and greens, with accents of warmer tones for lighting. In the upper left, a bare tree trunk with a few branches extends upwards. Behind it, three figures in dark, uniform-like attire and bowler hats are seated behind a railing, appearing to play instruments. Their faces are rendered with minimal features. At the center of the stage, a tall, slender figure stands facing forward, wearing a dark, conical hat and a dark jacket over lighter trousers. This central figure holds a long, light-colored string or chain that drapes downwards. Behind this figure, a large, circular, light-colored object with a radiating pattern is visible. To the right of the central figure, another performer stands, possibly a ringmaster, with a mustache, holding a whip. Further right, a smaller figure in a light-colored ruffled collar looks upwards. The background behind these figures consists of vertical panels in varying shades of brown and green, with rows of small, glowing circular lights. Along the top edge of the stage, several stylized, light-colored crown-like or starburst shapes are arranged. The lower half of the painting shows the audience, depicted as a dark mass of heads and hats, mostly in silhouette, looking towards the stage.

alt_text: Pointillist painting of a dense forest with multiple tree trunks and vibrant green foliage, dappled with light
long_description: A vertical pointillist painting depicts a dense forest scene, dominated by various shades of green. The entire composition is rendered with small, distinct dots of color. Several tree trunks rise vertically through the image. On the far right, a thick, light brown tree trunk with textured bark is brightly illuminated on its right side, creating a contrast with its slightly darker left side. Towards the center, a cluster of thinner, lighter-colored tree trunks, appearing pale yellow or off-white, also show textured surfaces from the pointillist technique. Another darker, partially visible tree trunk is present on the far left edge. The background and midground are filled with a dense array of green and yellow-green dots, suggesting thick foliage, leaves, and undergrowth. The ground in the lower portion of the painting is a lighter, brighter green with hints of yellow, indicating sunlit grass or moss. Dappled light filters through the unseen canopy, creating bright patches on the tree trunks and the forest floor, contributing to an overall impression of a sun-drenched, verdant woodland.

alt_text: A person bends over in a field, surrounded by green and yellow foliage and tree trunks
long_description: An oil painting depicts a person bending forward, positioned slightly to the left of the center. The individual wears a light-colored shirt, possibly white or light blue, and darker trousers, likely blue or grey. Their head is bowed, and their back is curved as they reach down towards a dark, indistinct object or area at the bottom center, possibly a basket or plants. To the left of the person, two prominent tree trunks rise vertically, painted with visible brushstrokes in shades of brown, blue, and orange, suggesting textured bark and shadows. The background and foreground are filled with a vibrant array of green and yellow brushstrokes, creating the impression of dense foliage, leaves, and sunlit grass. The greens range from deep forest green to bright lime, while the yellows suggest sunlight filtering through the leaves or bright flowers. The overall impression is an outdoor scene, possibly a garden or a field, with strong light and shadow contrasts rendered through the varied color palette and thick application of paint. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, contributing to the impressionistic style of the artwork. The composition is horizontal, with the figure occupying a significant portion of the central space.

alt_text: A muted landscape painting depicts rolling hills, a field, and a cloudy sky, with two dark, indistinct structures.
long_description: This horizontal landscape painting is rendered in a muted palette of greens, grays, and browns. The upper third of the canvas is dominated by an overcast sky, primarily light gray with subtle hints of pale blue, especially towards the upper left. Below the sky, a dark green, undulating hill stretches across the middle ground, its crest forming a soft, curved horizon line. The hill appears densely vegetated with dark green and brown brushstrokes, suggesting a forested or heavily overgrown area. The foreground and mid-ground consist of a broad, flat field, depicted in various shades of muted green, olive, and some lighter, almost yellowish-green tones. Patches of darker green and brown are interspersed, indicating uneven terrain or sparse vegetation. Towards the lower left, a low, horizontal pile of dark brown and gray forms, possibly logs or brushwood, is visible with a rough, textured appearance. In the lower right corner, a taller, more vertical mass of dark brown and black brushstrokes rises, resembling a dense thicket of trees or a large hay bale. Its form is somewhat indistinct, blending into the dark tones. A narrow, lighter horizontal band, possibly a path or a stream, runs across the very bottom edge of the painting, separating the foreground from the viewer. The overall impression is one of a somber, natural scene with visible brushwork.

metadata.title: Landscape at Saint-Ouen
metadata.medium: Oil on wood, mounted on wood

alt_text: A pointillist painting of many people relaxing in a park by a river with sailboats.
long_description: The image is a wide, horizontal painting rendered in a pointillist style, depicting a park scene on a sunny day. The composition is divided into a grassy foreground and midground, a body of water in the upper left, and a tree-lined background. In the upper left, a blue river is dotted with several sailboats and rowboats. On the far bank, a distant town or buildings are visible under a light blue sky. The midground and foreground are dominated by a vibrant green lawn, shaded by numerous trees with green foliage. Many figures, depicted as distinct dots of color, populate the park. On the left, a woman in a brown dress stands near the riverbank, holding a fishing pole. Further right, several people sit or recline on the grass, some under red or dark umbrellas. A child in a white dress stands near the center. Towards the right, a tall woman in a dark dress and hat stands prominently in the foreground, holding a parasol. Another woman in a similar dark attire is seated to her right. Animals are also present: a dark dog sniffs the ground in the lower center, and a small, reddish-brown monkey with a long tail walks on the grass in the lower right. Shadows stretch across the grass, indicating the sun's position. The figures are arranged in various poses, creating a sense of leisure and activity across the expansive park setting. The overall palette is dominated by greens and blues, accented by the reds, browns, and whites of clothing and accessories.

metadata.title: Study for "A Sunday on La Grande Jatte"

alt_text: Impressionistic painting of two figures poling a small boat on a river, with a bridge and buildings in the background.
long_description: The painting, rendered with visible, textured brushstrokes in an impressionistic style, depicts a wide river scene under a pale sky. In the midground, two figures occupy a small, light brown boat, positioned slightly right of center. The figure closer to the viewer, facing away, wears dark blue or purple clothing and holds a long, light-colored pole extending into the water on the left. Behind them, a second figure, seated, wears a light blue garment and a dark hat, also holding a pole that extends towards the right. The river water, painted with strokes of light blue, green, white, and brown, reflects the sky and surrounding elements, creating a shimmering, textured surface. Along the left bank in the background, a low, arched bridge spans the river, partially obscured by a mound of green foliage. Further back on the left, a dense mass of dark green trees rises. On the right bank, a dark, flat-topped barge or houseboat is moored near the shore. Behind it, a landscape of green hills and trees leads to a cluster of buildings with reddish-brown roofs and a tall, slender, light-colored chimney or smokestack rising into the pale, muted grey-blue sky. The overall palette consists of earthy greens, browns, and blues, with touches of white and red-orange in the distant structures.

alt_text: A young man in a black coat rides a gray horse, accompanied by a brown dog, in a wide landscape.
long_description: A full-length oil painting depicts a young man on horseback, accompanied by a dog, in a wide landscape. The man, positioned slightly right of center, faces left, looking forward. He has light skin and brown curly hair, wearing a black tricorn hat, a long black coat with buttons, a white cravat, light-colored breeches, and black boots. He holds the reins in his left hand and a riding crop in his right. The horse is a light gray, with a red bridle and a red and gold patterned saddle blanket. It is shown in motion, with its front left and back right legs lifted. Below the horse's head, a small, brown dog runs to the left, its body elongated in stride. The background features a vast green field that extends to the horizon. A dirt path is visible on the left, winding into the distance. In the mid-ground, a large, light-colored, multi-story building with numerous windows stands prominently, slightly to the right of the central axis. Smaller buildings and scattered trees are visible on the left side of the landscape. The sky transitions from a bright blue with fluffy white and brown clouds at the top to a warm orange and pink hue near the horizon, suggesting either dawn or dusk. A single tree with green foliage stands on the far right.

alt_text: A portrait painting of a young boy in a reddish-brown jacket and ruffled collar, looking upwards.
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a young boy from the chest up, set against a dark, indistinct background. The boy, with fair skin, rosy cheeks, and short dark hair, is positioned slightly to the right of center, gazing upwards and to the left. His left hand is raised, with his fingers resting behind his left ear, while his right arm is bent and rests lower in the frame. He wears a reddish-brown jacket with several dark buttons down the front. A prominent white ruffled collar encircles his neck, beneath which a yellowish-orange cravat or scarf is visible. The background on the right side of the boy is a deep, dark brown, almost black, suggesting a shadowed interior or drapery. To the left, behind his shoulder, a lighter area reveals a muted greenish-blue landscape under a lighter sky, hinting at an outdoor setting or a window view.

metadata.title: William Archer Shee (1810–1899), the Artist's Son

alt_text: Madonna enthroned with Archangel Michael, a saint, and angels, while Michael defeats a demon
long_description: The painting features a central Madonna figure seated on a cloud, hands clasped in prayer, looking downwards. She wears a grey cloak adorned with gold stars over a red garment, with a subtle halo around her head. Surrounding her are numerous small angels and cherubs, some with red wings, others playing musical instruments like a lute. A faint rainbow-like arc is visible behind the Madonna. Below her, on the left, stands a winged figure, likely Archangel Michael, with greenish skin, dressed in red and gold armor over red tights. He holds a long spear, which he uses to pin a small, pale-skinned demon to the ground. The demon, with small horns and green leaves around its head, writhes and holds a scroll. On the right, an elderly man with a long white beard and a bald head stands, dressed in a simple white robe. He holds a brown book in one hand and a staff or rolled document in the other. A dark, rectangular structure forms a base behind the lower figures.

metadata.title: The Assumption of the Virgin with Saints Michael and Benedict

alt_text: A woman in a red dress holds a nude baby against a gold background with intricate decorative patterns
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a baby, positioned centrally against a richly decorated gold background. The woman, shown from the waist up, wears a long-sleeved red gown with a white neckline, draped with a dark green mantle over her left shoulder and lap. Her brown hair is parted in the middle and falls over her shoulders. She looks down towards the baby, her right hand gently holding the baby's left hand, while her left hand supports the baby's back and bottom. The baby, nude and light-skinned, sits on the woman's lap, facing slightly left with a direct gaze forward. The baby has sparse, light hair and plump limbs. Its right hand rests on the woman's right hand, and its feet are visible at the bottom of the composition. The gold background is intricately patterned, divided into a grid-like structure. Within this grid, various decorative elements are visible. In the upper left, a profile bust of a classical figure is enclosed in a roundel, with the letters "SC" visible below it. Other roundels contain small, nude, winged figures, often called putti or cherubs, depicted in dynamic poses, some appearing to hold objects. The spaces between the roundels are filled with elaborate scrolling foliage, grotesque masks, and other ornamental motifs rendered in dark lines with occasional red accents. The gold surface shows some areas of wear and darker patina, suggesting age.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.artist: Luca Signorelli (Luca d'Egidio di Luca di Ventura)

alt_text: A bearded man with a halo holds a red book, depicted against a textured gold background within an ornate frame.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a bearded man with a halo, shown from the waist up, against a textured gold background. The man's face is turned slightly to his left, with a serious expression. He has long, wavy brown hair and a full, light brown beard. A circular gold halo, intricately patterned with small floral or geometric designs, surrounds his head. He wears a draped robe, primarily light cream or white, with folds and shadows suggesting volume. A glimpse of a blue garment is visible beneath the white robe, particularly around his chest. Decorative bands with gold patterns adorn the edges of his clothing. His hands are positioned in the lower center, holding a closed, rectangular book with a bright red cover. The book has a dark spine and two small, light-colored circular clasps or decorations on its front cover. The gold background is heavily textured with visible cracks and lines, suggesting age. The entire image is enclosed within a thick, ornate gold frame featuring a repeating pattern of dark blue or green diamond shapes along its inner edge.

alt_text: A bearded man in red and green robes holds a cross and a book against a gold background
long_description: A half-length portrait of a man is depicted on a vertical, arched panel with a gold background. The man, positioned centrally, has light-toned skin, a full gray-brown beard, and wavy gray-brown hair that reaches his shoulders. He looks directly forward with a serious expression. A circular, patterned gold halo is visible behind his head. He wears a red undergarment with ornate, dark red patterned cuffs, and a dark green outer robe with similar patterned trim along the collar and cuffs. His left hand, on the viewer's right, holds a tall, slender red staff topped with a black cross. The letters "SCS" are inscribed in black on the left arm of the cross. His right hand, on the viewer's left, holds a closed book with a light gray cover, featuring dark circular clasps or dots and a small dark mark on its surface. The word "ANDREAS" is inscribed in black capital letters to the right of the man's head, against the gold background. The entire composition is enclosed within a dark, arched frame.

alt_text: A bearded man with a halo holds a knife and a book, set against a gold background in an arched frame
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a male figure from the waist up, set against a gold background within a dark, arched frame. The man has dark, curly hair and a full brown beard and mustache. His skin has a pale, greenish hue, and he looks slightly to the viewer's right with a neutral expression. A golden halo, intricately patterned with circles and dots, encircles his head. He wears a draped, purple-blue outer robe with wide sleeves, revealing a patterned garment underneath with gold and dark orange motifs visible at his chest and sleeves. In his left hand, he holds a dark blue book with white pages and gold clasps. His right hand holds a long, slender knife with a silver blade pointing upwards and a dark handle. Visible text on the gold background to the left of his head reads "S BARTH", and to the right, "OLOMEV". The gold background shows signs of age and texture. The dark frame curves at the top, enclosing the scene, and a flat gold band forms the bottom edge of the panel.

alt_text: A bearded man with a halo holds a green book, depicted against a gold background within an arched frame
long_description: The image is a vertical, arched panel painting depicting a half-length figure of a man. The man is positioned centrally, facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer's right. He has a dark brown beard and short, dark brown hair. A golden halo with an intricate pattern of dots and lines encircles his head. He wears a reddish-pink robe draped over a golden garment with a patterned neckline visible beneath. His left hand, positioned at the lower center, holds a closed green book. The book has a small, white, decorative clasp or bookmark hanging from its spine. The background is entirely gold, showing signs of age and wear with some darker areas and scratches. To the left of the man's head, the letters "SCS" are inscribed in black. To the right, the letters "MATTHYAS" are inscribed in black. The painting is enclosed within a dark, possibly black or dark brown, arched frame that is visible along the top and sides. The bottom edge of the frame is a lighter, golden-brown color.

alt_text: A male saint with a halo holds a red book, depicted on a gold panel with text.
long_description: A vertical, arched panel painting depicts a male figure from the chest up, set against a gold background. The figure has light skin, short brown hair, and a faint halo of gold dots and lines around his head. He looks slightly to his right with a neutral expression. He wears a purple tunic with an ornate brown and gold collar, and a teal-green cloak draped over his left shoulder and arm. His right hand is raised, palm facing forward, with the index finger extended. His left hand holds a rectangular red book with visible stitching or markings on its cover. The book is held against his lower chest, partially covered by the teal cloak. The gold background is textured and shows signs of age, with some areas of paint loss. Black text is visible on the gold background: "SANTUS" to the left of his head and "THOMAS" to the right. The painting is framed by a dark, possibly black or very dark brown, arched border.

alt_text: A painting of a suspension bridge over a river with houses on the far bank under a cloudy blue sky
long_description: The painting depicts a vibrant outdoor scene featuring a river, a suspension bridge, and buildings along the far bank under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The sky occupies the top third of the canvas. A large, dark-colored suspension bridge with a prominent stone pier on the left dominates the left side, extending diagonally from the lower left towards the center-right. Its cables are visible against the sky. Below the bridge, the river fills the lower half of the painting, reflecting the sky and showing ripples on its surface. In the foreground, a small boat with two figures, one standing and one seated, floats on the water. Other smaller boats are moored near the riverbank. The far bank, rising gently from the river, is covered in green grass and features several light-colored houses with dark roofs and some green or brown shutters. A tall, slender tree stands behind one of the houses. A few small figures are visible on the grassy bank near the water's edge. The signature "Sisley. 76" is visible in the lower left corner of the painting in dark green script.

alt_text: An impressionistic painting of a brown house on a hill overlooking a distant town under a bright blue sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a sunlit landscape featuring a two-story house on the left, a wide open foreground, and a distant town under a clear blue sky. The house, positioned on the far left, is a warm brown with a dark roof and white decorative trim around its windows and a second-story balcony. A green-shuttered arched window is visible on the upper floor, above a small balcony with an ornate railing. Below, a rectangular window is flanked by white, scroll-like ornaments. Green foliage climbs the left side of the house. In the foreground, a light-colored dirt or gravel path extends from the bottom center towards the right, curving slightly. Two small figures are visible near the house: one, a child in a light-colored outfit, pushes a small wheelbarrow, while another smaller figure is near the house's base. To the right of the path, the ground rises into a gentle hill covered with trees displaying autumn colors of yellow, orange, and light brown. Further back, a sprawling town with numerous buildings and a prominent church spire emerges from the landscape, bathed in soft light. The sky above is a vibrant, light blue with subtle white clouds. The overall impression is one of a bright, clear day, rendered with visible brushstrokes.

alt_text: An Impressionist painting of a sunlit field bordered by dense trees under a blue sky.
long_description: This Impressionist landscape painting depicts a sunlit field bordered by trees under a clear blue sky. The top third of the canvas is dominated by a light blue sky with scattered small, wispy white clouds. Below the sky, a distant, undulating line of dark green hills or forest stretches across the horizon. In the midground, a line of lighter green bushes and smaller trees runs horizontally, with several taller, slender trees rising above them. One particularly tall, narrow tree with a large, rounded, dark green top stands prominently on the far right. The left quarter of the painting is filled with a dense mass of dark green trees, extending from the top edge down into the midground and casting shadows into the field. The bottom half of the canvas is occupied by a field of light golden-brown and pale green grass or wheat, rendered with visible, textured brushstrokes. Patches of darker green grass and shadows are visible within the field, especially towards the left. The artist's signature, "Sisley. 92", is visible in reddish-brown script in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: An impressionistic painting of a house with a red roof beside a dirt path, surrounded by tall green trees.
long_description: The painting presents a vibrant, impressionistic landscape dominated by a building and numerous trees. In the upper left, patches of light blue sky with white, cloud-like brushstrokes are visible through a canopy of green leaves. A two-story building with a prominent, steeply pitched red-orange tiled roof occupies the left-center. Its walls are rendered in light beige and off-white tones, featuring dark rectangular openings that suggest doors and windows. A small dormer window protrudes from the roof. A light brown and tan path, textured with visible brushstrokes, runs horizontally across the lower-middle of the canvas, extending from the left edge towards the right. Several small, indistinct figures are depicted on or near this path. Two figures appear to be walking away from the house on the path, while another figure is positioned closer to the house's entrance. The right half and upper portion of the artwork are filled with numerous tall, slender trees. Their dark, vertical trunks rise from the foreground, supporting a dense mass of foliage rendered in various shades of green, yellow-green, and blue-green. The leaves are depicted with distinct, dabbing brushstrokes, creating a textured, dappled effect. The ground in the foreground is covered in a mix of green and brown brushstrokes, suggesting grass and undergrowth. The overall scene is brightly lit, conveying a sense of a sunny day.

metadata.title: The Road from Moret to Saint-Mammès

alt_text: A painting of a landscape with a large tree, a dirt path, two figures, and a cloudy sky
long_description: The painting depicts a rural landscape under a cloudy sky. A large, dark-trunked tree with green foliage dominates the left side, its gnarled branches extending across the upper left quadrant. Below the tree, a grassy bank slopes down to a light brown dirt path that stretches from the lower center towards the right and into the distance. On the path, two small figures are visible. The figure closer to the viewer, on the right side of the path, is walking forward. The second figure, slightly behind and to the left, pushes a wheelbarrow. Further along the path, other trees with varying amounts of foliage, including one with light-colored or bare branches, are scattered across the midground. To the right of the path, a muted field extends towards the horizon. The sky above is filled with heavy, textured clouds in shades of blue, grey, and hints of pale yellow and pink, suggesting a specific atmospheric condition. The brushstrokes throughout the painting are visible, creating a textured surface.

metadata.title: The Road from Versailles to Louveciennes

alt_text: A snow-covered street scene with buildings, figures, and bare trees under a muted sky
long_description: The painting depicts a snow-covered street scene under an overcast sky. In the foreground, a wide street is heavily blanketed in white snow, with a slightly darker, less snow-laden path visible down the center, suggesting it has been trodden or cleared. Several small, dark figures are scattered along this path, walking away from the viewer into the distance. On the left, a tall, light-colored building with a dark roofline and visible windows dominates the immediate foreground, its facade partially obscured by bare, reddish-brown branches. Snow rests on its roof and ledges. The street recedes into the midground, flanked by more buildings on both sides, their roofs also dusted with snow. On the right, a long, low, brown wall runs parallel to the street, behind which more snow-covered ground and distant structures are visible. A large, dark, bare tree with gnarled branches stands prominently on the right side, its form silhouetted against the sky. The sky itself is a uniform, muted grey, with a faint, warm, orange-pink glow visible on the horizon line, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The overall color palette is cool, dominated by whites, greys, and browns, with subtle hints of blue and pink.

metadata.title: Rue Eugène Moussoir at Moret: Winter

alt_text: A man in a black coat and white lace collar stands in a room with a classical landscape visible through an archway
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man standing in a dimly lit interior, with a classical landscape visible through an opening on the right. The man, positioned slightly to the left of center, faces forward with a neutral expression. He has an oval face with light skin, dark shoulder-length hair, a thin mustache, and a small beard. He wears a long, dark black coat that reaches his knees, with wide sleeves. A prominent white lace collar with intricate floral patterns covers his shoulders and chest. Matching white lace cuffs are visible at his wrists. His left hand rests on his hip, while his right forearm leans on a dark brown stone pedestal with a carved baluster. He wears dark stockings and dark shoes with reddish-orange straps and heels. To the left, a dark column and a textured stone wall are visible. The floor is dark with faint blue-green and brown tones. On the right, behind the pedestal, an archway opens to a classical landscape scene under a dramatic, cloudy sky. The sky transitions from dark blues and grays at the top to lighter blues and yellows near the horizon. Trees with dark foliage frame the scene, and classical architectural elements, including arches and what appear to be two light-colored statues, are visible in the middle ground. The overall lighting creates a contrast between the dark foreground and the slightly brighter, atmospheric background.

alt_text: Oval portrait of a man with long dark hair, a faint mustache, a light cravat, and a dark coat
long_description: This is an oval-shaped portrait depicting a man from the chest up, set against a dark background. The man's head is slightly turned to his right, and he looks directly forward with a neutral expression. He has long, dark brown, wavy hair that falls over his shoulders and frames his face. His skin appears fair, with a slight flush on his cheeks and nose. He has light-colored eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. A faint mustache is visible above his upper lip. He wears a white or light-colored cravat or scarf wrapped around his neck, with folds visible. Over this, he wears a dark, possibly reddish-brown, coat or jacket. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting his face and the folds of his cravat. The background is a uniform dark brown, providing a stark contrast to the man's face and cravat. The portrait is enclosed by a thin, gold-colored border.

alt_text: A busy landscape painting depicts numerous figures, some on horseback, gathered near a rustic building and a gallows.
long_description: The painting presents a wide, open landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground, a winding dirt path leads from the lower left to the mid-ground right. To the left, a large, gnarled tree with sparse brown and green foliage dominates the scene, its multiple trunks rising towards the top edge. Behind this tree, a rustic, two-story building with a thatched roof and a chimney is visible. Below the tree, a small wooden bridge crosses a narrow stream. Numerous figures are scattered throughout the scene. On the left, a group of men in period attire, some armed with pikes and muskets, are gathered near the bridge and the building, some sitting, others standing. One man in a red jacket stands on the bridge. In the center, a man on a white horse, seen from behind, rides along the path, leading a procession of other figures and horses. Further back, more groups of people and horses are visible on the path. To the right, a raised dirt mound features more figures, some on horseback, and a prominent gallows structure with two tall wooden posts and a crossbeam. A smaller, simpler gallows with a hanging figure is visible further in the distance on the right. The background shows a flat, expansive landscape with distant trees and a faint horizon line. The overall color palette consists of earthy browns, greens, and ochres, with lighter blues and whites in the sky.

alt_text: A full-length portrait of a man with long hair and a beard, wearing red and blue-green robes, standing in an alcove.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man standing centrally within a shallow architectural space. The man has long, dark brown hair that falls over his shoulders and a short, dark beard. His skin is light-toned. He wears a long-sleeved, deep red tunic with a square neckline, visible beneath a flowing, light blue-green cloak draped over his left shoulder and around his body. The cloak covers most of his lower body and extends to his feet, where he wears simple sandals. His right arm is raised with the palm open and fingers slightly spread, while his left arm is bent at the elbow, with his hand extended slightly to the side, palm open. He looks directly forward with a neutral expression. The background consists of a dark green curtain, gathered at the top corners and hanging loosely behind the figure. This curtain is set within a dark brown wooden frame or alcove, which extends along the top and sides of the painting. The floor beneath the man is a light-colored tile with a geometric pattern, featuring a circular design in red and green directly beneath his feet. The overall lighting is even, highlighting the figure against the slightly darker background.

alt_text: A young woman holds a silver platter with a severed bearded head, while a hand grasps its hair
long_description: A painting depicts a young woman holding a silver platter with a severed head, set against a dark background. The woman, positioned on the left, has fair skin, light brown curly hair, and wears an elaborate blue headpiece adorned with a red jewel and pearls. Her dress features a green bodice with gold embroidery and jewels, and red and white striped puffed sleeves. A pearl necklace with a large blue and white jeweled pendant hangs around her neck. She looks down with a somber expression, her left hand supporting the platter from below and her right hand resting on its rim. On the platter rests a male head with closed eyes, light skin, brown curly hair, and a brown beard. A hand from the upper right grasps the head by its hair, holding it upright. Drops of red liquid fall from the head's neck into the center of the platter. The background is uniformly dark, almost black. A dark, textured horizontal band, possibly a ledge, runs across the bottom of the composition. In the bottom right corner, faint white text reads "ANDREAS DE SOLARIO" and below it, "F".

metadata.title: Salome with the Head of Saint John the Baptist

alt_text: A painting depicts a group of figures gathered around a baby, with some on a balcony above.
long_description: The vertical oil painting portrays a multi-figure scene set within an interior space. In the foreground, a woman with dark hair, dressed in a red and gold gown, sits and cradles a light-skinned baby wrapped in white cloth. The baby's head emits a soft glow. To her left, a bearded man wearing a dark cap and a gold and green robe leans forward, gently holding the baby's hand. He looks down at the infant with a slight smile. To the far left, a woman kneels with her back mostly to the viewer, her blonde hair styled in an updo. She wears a white and blue garment with a gold sash and gestures with her right hand towards the central figures. A small child's face is partially visible behind her. To the right of the central woman, another woman with a dark head covering and white top looks down at the baby. On the far right, a dark-haired woman carries a dark cloth on her head, also looking towards the center. A balcony with balusters separates the foreground from the upper level. On this balcony, several women are gathered; one woman in a light blue garment reclines on a bed, attended by others. Further back, additional figures are visible within a dimly lit architectural setting featuring columns. Above, dark, swirling clouds are depicted, with light emanating from behind them. The painting utilizes a rich color palette of reds, golds, blues, and browns, with bright highlights on the figures and the baby.

alt_text: A man in a long red robe and white wig stands, with a smaller figure and draped fabrics in a dark setting
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man standing slightly to the left of center, facing forward. He has a pale complexion, dark eyes, and a long, curly white wig that reaches his shoulders. He wears a high-collared red tunic, a long, flowing red robe, and a lighter, possibly silver or cream-colored, stole draped over his shoulders and down his left side. His left hand rests on his hip, while his right hand is placed on a dark, draped object to his right. He wears light-colored shoes. To the left, a dark, heavy curtain in shades of deep green and gold is partially visible. To the right, a smaller figure with dark skin and a white or light-colored turban or cap leans on a dark surface, wearing a yellow garment with red sleeves. This figure looks towards the main subject. Behind the smaller figure, a dark, indistinct architectural structure is visible under a dark sky with a faint crescent moon. In the lower right foreground, a dark, ornate object, possibly a chest or table, is covered with a large piece of golden-yellow draped fabric. A crest or emblem is faintly visible on the side of the object. The overall color palette is dark and rich, with the vibrant red of the main figure's attire standing out against the muted background.

metadata.title: Diego Pignatelli d'Aragona (1687–1750) and an Enslaved African Servant

alt_text: Two women in a dimly lit kitchen prepare food, one standing by a window, the other kneeling on the floor.
long_description: An oil painting depicts two women engaged in food preparation within a rustic, dimly lit kitchen. On the left, a woman stands beside a tall, multi-paned window, which allows a soft light to illuminate her and the immediate area. She wears a white cap, a white blouse, and a dark skirt, and is focused on peeling or preparing items in a bowl on a wooden counter. Several round, light-colored objects, possibly vegetables or fruit, are on the counter next to a plucked bird. Various earthenware pots and a metal pitcher are stacked on a shelf below the counter. To the right, a second woman kneels on the tiled floor, wearing a white cap, a dark green top, and a reddish-brown skirt. She is actively cleaning or preparing fish in a wooden tub or bucket. Several fish lie on the floor in front of her. The background of the kitchen is dark and features a large fireplace or oven structure. On the far right, a small, dark cat sits near a large metal pot filled with what appears to be more food. Other kitchen implements, including a large brass pot, a smaller dark pot, and a slotted spoon, are scattered on the floor. The overall palette is dominated by dark browns and greens, with lighter tones highlighting the women's faces and the prepared food.

alt_text: A priest kneels before an altar, holding a chalice, with two assistants and a vision of Christ.
long_description: The painting depicts a religious scene set within an ornate architectural space, framed by a red velvet border and a gold inner frame. In the center, a priest with a golden halo kneels on his right knee, facing right. He wears a richly embroidered gold and brown chasuble over a white alb and a red dalmatic, with a red stole visible. His hands are raised, holding a golden chalice and a white host. His gaze is directed upwards and to the right. Behind him, to the left, stand two male assistants, both looking upwards. The assistant closer to the priest wears a dark patterned dalmatic over a white alb, while the leftmost assistant wears a red patterned dalmatic over a white alb and holds a golden staff. All three figures have light skin and short, dark hair. To the right of the kneeling priest is an altar covered with a white cloth, adorned with a red and white embroidered border. On the altar, a golden chalice and a red book are visible. Behind the altar stands a pale, nude figure of Christ, with a white loincloth, displaying wounds on his hands and side. Above the Christ figure, a white banner with a depiction of a face hangs from a dark pole. Further left, another banner with a coat of arms is visible. The background features architectural elements including a gray arched doorway on the left, and a stained-glass window in the upper left, depicting a figure in red and blue. The floor is tiled in a geometric pattern of light and dark squares. The overall color palette is rich, dominated by reds, golds, and browns, with accents of white and blue.

alt_text: A crowned woman holds a baby, flanked by two crowned figures, under an ornate Gothic archway
long_description: This vertical panel painting features a central group of four figures within an ornate architectural setting. In the center, a woman with light skin and long, light brown hair wears a dark blue robe and a golden crown, topped by a halo. She holds a light-skinned baby, mostly unclothed, wrapped in a white cloth, in her lap. The baby's left arm is bent, and a small red mark is visible on its chest. To the left of the central woman, another woman with light skin and light brown hair, also wearing a golden crown and halo, stands in a dark red garment, looking towards the baby. To the right, an older man with a long white beard and a halo stands in a brown robe, holding an open book with visible text in his left hand. He also looks towards the baby. At the man's feet, a small, light brown animal with a mane, possibly a lion, is visible. The figures are positioned under a large, elaborate Gothic archway with intricate golden patterns. Two tall, slender columns with decorative capitals and small figures in niches on top flank the central group. The background behind the figures is a patterned fabric in shades of red and gold. The floor beneath them is a checkered pattern of light and dark squares. The overall color palette is rich with dark blues, reds, browns, and gold accents.

metadata.title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saints Catherine and Jerome
metadata.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood

alt_text: Full-length black and white portrait of a woman in an elaborate, patterned dress with a large ruff
long_description: A full-length, black and white portrait depicts a woman standing, facing slightly to the viewer's right, with her head turned to look directly forward. She has dark hair, parted in the middle, and wears a large, multi-layered lace ruff around her neck. Her elaborate dress features a fitted bodice with a vertical row of large, round buttons or pearls down the front. The bodice and sleeves are intricately patterned with a combination of vertical stripes and diamond-shaped motifs. Her sleeves are puffed at the shoulders and have ruffled cuffs at the wrists. The voluminous skirt is also heavily patterned, with a large section of diamond-shaped lattice work over a striped base, and a wide, horizontally striped band at the hem. In her left hand, she holds a small, light-colored object, possibly a glove or handkerchief, while her right hand holds a long, slender object, possibly a fan or feather. The background on the left features a series of receding rectangular shapes, suggesting an architectural interior, with the text "D. MARIANA STAM PA PARAVICINA CONTE SA DI SANGRATE" visible in the upper left. On the right, dark drapery hangs, partially obscuring the background.

metadata.title: Doña Marianna Stampa Parravicina (born 1612), Condesa di Segrate

alt_text: A portrait of a man with a mustache, dark hair, and a white collar, seated in a dark interior.
long_description: A vertical portrait depicts a man seated, facing forward, against a dark, ornate background. The man has a medium-dark complexion, dark, shoulder-length hair, and a dark mustache. He wears a dark, long-sleeved garment with a wide, flat white collar. His expression is neutral, with his eyes looking directly ahead. His right hand, with fingers slightly curled, rests in the lower right portion of the frame. To the left of the man, a red curtain is partially visible, and a lit candle with a small flame stands in the lower left corner. Behind his head on the left, a dark, ornate candlestick is visible. The background behind the man features a dark red fabric with a lighter, intricate patterned design. To the right, a large, dark, classical-style urn or vase with decorative handles sits on a light-colored pedestal. The overall lighting is dim, with highlights on the man's face and collar, and on the background elements.

alt_text: Archangel Michael in armor stands on a fallen demon, holding a flaming sword and palm frond.
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a winged archangel standing triumphantly over a fallen, horned demon. In the upper two-thirds of the composition, the archangel, with light skin and curly brown hair, faces slightly right, looking forward. The archangel wears a dark teal tunic with gold trim and pearl-like embellishments, a pinkish-white flowing skirt, and gold and teal greaves on the lower legs. A dark gray helmet with white feathery plumes adorns the head. Large, light gray wings with brown undersides extend from the archangel's back, and a red cloak billows behind. The right hand is raised, holding a flaming sword, while the left hand holds a long, thin golden palm frond. The archangel stands on a light-colored cloud, with the right foot pressing down on the left shoulder of the demon below. The background behind the archangel is a golden-yellow sky with soft white and orange clouds. In the lower third, the muscular, nude demon lies on its back, head turned to the right, looking upwards with a pained expression. Its skin is a darker tone, and it has dark, shaggy hair with small horns visible on its head. A large, dark brown, feathered wing is visible on its back. Its right arm is extended towards the bottom right, and its left arm is bent. A dark snake coils around its lower body. The demon is surrounded by dark, rocky ground and wisps of orange smoke or fire, contrasting with the brighter upper half of the painting.

alt_text: Ornate gold altarpiece with painted panels depicting religious figures and a central sculpture of Mary and Child.
long_description: This large, multi-paneled altarpiece features a central sculpture flanked by six painted panels, all encased within an elaborate, gilded Gothic frame. The frame is highly decorative with intricate tracery, arches, and pinnacles, predominantly in gold.The central section is taller than the side wings. At the top center, a painted panel depicts a scene with three figures. A woman in a dark blue cloak and veil cradles the pale, deceased body of a man, who wears a white loincloth. Another woman in a red dress and a man with a halo and red robe support them. A ladder leans against a structure in the background, with a distant landscape and city visible under a light blue sky. Below this panel, in a central niche, stands a carved sculpture of a woman holding a child. The woman wears a gold-patterned gown and a dark cloak, with a crown on her head, and the child is also in gold. The niche is lined with deep red fabric.To the left of the central section, two painted panels are stacked vertically. The upper left panel shows an angel with large, light-colored wings, dressed in a white robe and red cloak, holding a staff and a small, dark object. The background is a textured gold. The lower left panel features a bearded man with a halo, wearing a blue tunic and red cloak, holding an open book and a staff. This panel also has a textured gold background.To the right of the central section, two more painted panels are stacked. The upper right panel depicts a bearded man with a halo, dressed in a blue tunic and red cloak, holding a long staff and an unfurled scroll with illegible text. The background is textured gold. The lower right panel shows a bearded man with long hair and a halo, wearing a red cloak over a simple garment, holding a small lamb on a book or tray. This panel also has a textured gold background. The figures in the painted panels are rendered with detailed drapery and distinct facial features.

metadata.title: Virgin and Child with the Pietà and Saints

alt_text: A close-up portrait painting of a man with pale skin, dark hair, and a white collar against a dark background
long_description: A vertical, waist-up portrait painting depicts a man centered against a dark, plain background. The man's head and shoulders fill most of the frame. He has a pale complexion with a slightly yellowish tint, and his face is turned slightly to the viewer's right, while his eyes look directly forward. His hair is dark brown, parted on his left, and falls to just above his shoulders, framing his face. He has a faint, thin mustache and a small patch of hair on his chin. His eyes are a light green or hazel color, with dark pupils, and are wide open. His nose is long and straight, and his lips are thin and closed, with a slight curve. He wears a dark, possibly black, garment with a wide, flat, white collar that extends over his shoulders. The collar has a subtle greenish-blue tint in some areas, suggesting age or specific lighting. The background is a uniform dark brown or black, providing a stark contrast to the man's pale face and white collar. The brushstrokes are visible, particularly in the skin tones, giving the painting a textured appearance. The overall lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting his face and collar.

alt_text: A young haloed figure speaks from a raised platform to an older woman, while several men study in a room
long_description: This vertical painting depicts an indoor scene with multiple figures arranged within an architectural setting. A light-colored, multi-tiered staircase dominates the center-right, leading up to a raised platform. On this platform, a young figure with a golden halo and light brown hair stands, wearing a long red tunic over a dark green garment. They point their right hand towards an older woman standing at the base of the stairs. This woman, also with a golden halo, wears a dark blue robe, a white head covering, and a wimple, and looks up at the young figure with hands raised. A dark-robed figure is partially visible behind her. To the left of the staircase, several men are seated at wooden desks arranged in two tiers. These men, dressed in various robes and head coverings in shades of blue, green, brown, and white, are engrossed in reading open books or scrolls on their desks. Some have beards. The architectural background includes a red ceiling with radiating lines above the central platform, and a green wall with arched openings on the left. Two dark, bell-shaped lamps hang from the ceiling. The floor is a dark green. The overall composition suggests a formal gathering or a lesson taking place within a structured interior space.

alt_text: A man presents a severed head on a platter to a group of women, while others watch from a castle wall.
long_description:
The painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures set against a fortified background. On the far left, a reddish-brown building with a small, dark window is visible. From this window, a pale hand emerges, stained with red liquid, suggesting a recent beheading. Standing next to the building, a man with a beard, wearing a red tunic, a white apron, and a helmet, holds a large, curved sword pointed downwards. He looks towards the right.

In the center, another man, dressed in dark armor and a helmet, holds a golden platter bearing a severed, bearded head with a halo. He presents this head to a group of women standing to his right. The women are dressed in elaborate gowns; one prominent figure wears a patterned gold dress, while another in a dark blue gown with red trim raises her hands in a gesture of reaction. Several other women, some with head coverings, stand behind them, observing the scene.

Behind the figures, a grey stone wall with battlements stretches horizontally across the mid-ground. Above this wall, in the upper background, three figures wearing various hats peer over the battlements, looking down at the events unfolding below. The sky above the wall is a light, clear blue. The ground in the foreground is a dark, earthy brown.

metadata.title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist

alt_text: A medieval banquet scene with a king, queen, and courtiers at a table, while musicians perform below
long_description: A rectangular painting depicts a medieval indoor scene with a large group of people. In the upper half, a long, white-clothed table stretches across the width of the image, laden with several large, dark, round objects and smaller, lighter rings. Behind the table, a group of approximately twelve figures are positioned. In the center, a man with a golden crown and beard, dressed in a blue and gold robe, stands next to a woman wearing a crown and an elaborate white and red headpiece, dressed in a patterned red and gold gown. To their left, several women with similar elaborate headwear are visible. To their right, several men, some wearing hats and one with a dark, fur-trimmed hood, are gathered. A red tapestry with a floral pattern hangs on the wall behind the figures. In the lower half of the painting, the floor features a geometric tile pattern in red, white, and blue-gray. Below the table, a young woman in a long, flowing red and gold patterned gown with a high slit plays a stringed instrument resembling a viol. She wears a red, heart-shaped headpiece. To her left, a young boy in a dark tunic and red hose walks towards the left, holding a small, ornate golden object. A small black dog sits on the patterned floor to the boy's left. The table is supported by two visible wooden trestle legs.

alt_text: A woman presents a severed head on a platter to a group of people gathered around a banquet table.
long_description: A black and white image depicts a banquet scene with multiple figures. In the foreground, a small, dark-colored dog lies on a geometrically patterned floor with floral motifs. A woman stands centrally, facing right, wearing a long, dark, patterned gown with a high slit revealing an underskirt. She has an elaborate headdress and holds a platter at chest height, on which rests a severed head with a beard and a crown. Behind her, a long table covered with a white cloth displays several small, round food items. Behind the table, a group of approximately ten people are gathered, looking towards the woman and the head. On the left, several women wear elaborate headdresses, one with hands clasped. In the center, a bearded man with a crown and dark robes looks intently. To the right, several men in dark hats and robes gesture. The background features a patterned tapestry with floral or leaf motifs hanging on the wall.

metadata.title: Salome with the Head of Saint John the Baptist
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on canvas, transferred from wood

alt_text: Six male figures with halos and attributes in a multi-panel altarpiece with gold backgrounds and ornate frames.
long_description:
This horizontal altarpiece features six individual panels, each depicting a standing male figure. Each panel is framed by an ornate golden architectural structure, featuring Gothic-style tracery and pointed arches at the top, and a simpler base. The background behind each figure is a shimmering gold leaf, with a circular golden halo around each figure's head. From left to right, the figures are presented in three-quarter length, filling most of their respective panels.

The first figure on the left is a man with a dark beard and long dark hair, wearing a dark robe, holding a tall staff in his right hand. The second figure has light brown hair and a short beard, wearing a green robe over a red garment, holding a small golden chalice in his left hand and gesturing with his right hand towards his chest. The third figure is a balding man with a white beard, wearing a dark red robe over a blue garment, holding a book in his left hand and a short, dark staff or club in his right. The fourth figure is an older man with a long white beard and balding head, wearing a dark red robe over a green garment, holding a sword in his right hand, pointing downwards, and gesturing with his left hand. The fifth figure has a dark beard and long dark hair, wearing a red robe over a dark garment, holding a large, diagonal wooden cross in front of him with both hands. The sixth and final figure has a dark beard and short dark hair, wearing a light-colored robe over a dark garment, holding a large, dark knife or cleaver in his right hand and a book in his left. The overall color palette is rich, with deep reds, greens, and blues contrasting with the bright gold. The wooden frame surrounding the entire piece is dark brown with some visible wear.

alt_text: An armored angel with large wings stands over a wounded dragon, holding a sword and shield on a gold background.
long_description: The artwork depicts a winged figure in elaborate armor standing over a dragon, set against a textured gold background. The central figure, an angel, is positioned slightly to the left of center, facing right. It wears ornate red and gold armor, including a red skirt-like piece, and a small crown with a red jewel on its head. Light brown curly hair frames its face, and a golden halo with radiating lines encircles its head. Large, dark blue and grey wings extend from its back, with the left wing curving upwards. The angel holds a long, silver sword with a gold hilt in its right hand, raised high, and a small, round red and gold shield in its left hand, held defensively. Its right leg is bent, stepping firmly on the dragon's back, while its left leg is extended behind it. The dragon lies horizontally across the lower half of the image. Its body is a light brown or ochre color with darker scales and small, dark wings. Its head is on the right, facing upwards with its mouth wide open, revealing a red interior and sharp teeth. Red blood drips from its neck, where the angel's sword appears to have struck. Its tail curls upwards on the left side of the image. The entire background is a shimmering gold, likely gold leaf, with faint patterns or inscriptions visible throughout. A narrow red border frames the top and left edges of the gold background.

alt_text: A multi-panel altarpiece depicting the Last Judgment with Christ, Mary, saints, angels, and the damned
long_description: The artwork is a large, multi-panel altarpiece, vertically oriented and framed in gold. It is composed of three main vertical sections, each subdivided into multiple horizontal registers. The central panel features a top register depicting a crucifixion scene with Christ on the cross, flanked by figures, with a ladder. Above this, two angels are visible. The second register shows an enthroned Christ in majesty, flanked by Mary and John the Baptist, seated on a golden throne against a dark blue, star-filled background. Below them, a smaller scene depicts Mary and another figure. The third register presents a dynamic scene of numerous angels in red robes, some with golden halos, descending from a dark blue, star-filled sky. The bottom register of the central panel illustrates a fiery pit filled with dark, demonic figures and tormented souls. The left panel's top register shows an angel with green wings, holding a scroll, positioned above a golden arch. Two smaller angels are above this. Below the arch, five horizontal rows of standing figures are depicted, each row containing multiple individuals, likely saints. They wear various colored robes including red, blue, green, brown, and white, and have golden halos, all facing towards the center of the altarpiece. The right panel mirrors the left in structure. Its top register features a scene with multiple figures, possibly the Annunciation, above a golden arch, with two angels above. Below the arch, five horizontal rows of standing figures are arranged, similar to the left panel. These figures also wear diverse colored robes and golden halos, facing towards the center. The entire altarpiece is richly adorned with gold leaf, particularly in the architectural details and halos.

metadata.title: The Trinity Adored by All Saints

alt_text: Madonna holding a crucifix, surrounded by angels playing instruments, with two kneeling figures below
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a central female figure, likely Madonna, seated on an ornate throne against a gold background. She wears a long red cloak over a blue garment, with a white lining visible at the sleeves and neck. A golden halo encircles her head. Her hands hold a small, pale crucifix depicting a figure of Christ. Eight winged angels with golden halos surround her, four on each side, arranged in two vertical rows. The angels play various musical instruments, including a flute, a lute, a trumpet, and a small organ-like instrument. The throne she sits on is a multi-tiered structure with intricate geometric patterns in gold, brown, and blue. At the bottom corners of the painting, two smaller figures in white hooded robes kneel in prayer, facing the central figure. Their hands are clasped together. The entire scene is set against a shimmering gold background, framed by a dark border.

metadata.title: Saint Mary Magdalen Holding a Crucifix; (reverse) The Flagellation

alt_text: A young woman with a sword and an older woman holding a severed head in a dark, rocky setting
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts two women in a dark, rocky landscape. In the foreground, a young woman stands facing forward, her gaze directed upwards and to the right. She wears a bright yellow dress with a blue cloak draped over her left shoulder and arm, and a red underskirt. Her right hand rests on the hilt of a large, dark sword that points downwards. She has dark hair pulled back, adorned with a feathered hat featuring red and white plumes. Her skin is pale. Partially obscured behind her on the right, an older woman looks downwards and to the left. She wears a dark turban and robes. Her hands are clasped around a light-colored cloth, from which a severed head with dark hair and a pale face emerges, resting on a stone block or ledge. The background is dark and rocky, with hints of a lighter, possibly cloudy, sky in the upper left. The ground is dark and uneven.

metadata.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes

alt_text: A lively indoor scene with several people, one woman slumped in a chair, and food and drink on a table
long_description: The painting depicts an indoor scene with several figures engaged in a lively gathering. In the center, a woman in a pink and purple dress with a white apron is slumped back in a wooden chair, eyes closed, with her left arm extended. To her right, another woman in a white head covering and dark dress pours liquid from a blue and white pitcher into a glass held by the slumped woman. To the slumped woman's left, a man with a dark hat and coat smiles, holding her hand with his left hand and a spoon with his right. To the left of the table, two women and a young boy are seated. One woman, wearing a white head covering and a dark top, rests her head on her hand, seemingly asleep or drowsy. The other woman and boy look towards the center. The table is covered with a white cloth and holds a bowl of fruit, a fish, and small dishes. Behind the table, a leaded glass window shows a glimpse of an outdoor scene. In the foreground, a lute leans against an open backgammon board. Nearby, a book lies open on the floor, next to spilled glasses and a knife. To the right, a dark cat crouches near a large platter holding a roasted ham or joint of meat. Drapes hang from the ceiling and a bed canopy is visible in the upper right. A light green cloth is draped across the upper left ceiling.

alt_text: A man checks a seated woman's pulse as another woman observes in a dimly lit interior with a dog
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with three figures and a dog. In the center, a woman sits on a low wooden stool, leaning forward slightly with her right hand resting on her forehead. She wears a white head covering, a blue and white fur-trimmed jacket over a red corset, and a long golden-yellow skirt. Her left arm is extended, and a man, seated on a chair to her left, holds her wrist, appearing to check her pulse. He wears a dark hat, a brown jacket with puffed sleeves, and a white collar. To the right of the seated woman, another woman leans forward from a dark, four-poster bed, observing the scene. She wears a dark dress and a white collar. On the floor in the lower right, a small brown and white dog sleeps curled on a red cushion. To the left of the seated woman, on the floor, are a brass pitcher, a metal pan, a small brazier with glowing embers, and a long-handled object. In the upper left, an open doorway reveals a sunlit outdoor scene with a path, trees, and a distant building with a spire. Above the doorway, a small statue of a nude figure is visible. A dark table with a red cloth and a blue pitcher sits in the mid-ground on the left. The room is generally dark, with light entering from the doorway and illuminating the central figures. The artist's signature "I STEEN" is visible in the lower right corner.

alt_text: A lively outdoor gathering with many people, musicians, children, and animals under a leafy pergola
long_description: The painting depicts a large, festive outdoor gathering of numerous figures, children, and animals under a leafy pergola. In the center foreground, a woman in a light blue bodice and a shimmering brown skirt sits, looking towards the viewer with a gentle smile, her arms slightly outstretched. To her right, a man with dark hair and a brown jacket sits on a stone pedestal, playing a lute-like instrument and looking towards the central woman. To the left of the central woman, a table laden with food and drink is visible, surrounded by laughing and conversing figures. An older man with a white cap and a red face laughs heartily, holding a piece of food. A young girl in a pink dress stands nearby, holding a toy horse on wheels, accompanied by a brown and white dog on a leash. Another dog is partially visible. Further back on the left, a man plays a flute, and other figures are engaged in various interactions. On the far right, a young man stands on a ladder, reaching upwards towards the pergola, smiling. In the background, a classical-style building with a large window and a sunflower is visible under a cloudy sky. The pergola is covered with green foliage, and a birdcage hangs from it, with a bird perched on top. A dark metal pitcher and some nuts are on the checkered ground in the lower right. The scene is crowded and dynamic, filled with activity and interaction.

alt_text: Circular black and white painting depicting a bustling city square with large classical buildings and numerous figures.
long_description: A circular, monochromatic painting depicts an active urban plaza framed by grand architecture. In the immediate foreground on the right, a massive, fluted column rises, its base partially obscuring two figures seated on the ground. To the right of this column, three standing figures are engaged in conversation near a large, dark doorway or entrance. The ground in the foreground is a patterned pavement of light and dark squares.
