alt_text: A bare-chested man with a halo, supported by two angels, one looking down, one looking up
long_description: The painting depicts three figures against a dark, indistinct background. In the center, a bare-chested man with long, dark brown hair and a beard is seated, his head tilted downwards and eyes closed. A faint, reddish-orange glow encircles his head. His muscular torso and arms are prominently lit, with a white cloth draped around his lower body and a larger piece of tan fabric covering his legs. Small red marks are visible on his right hand and just below his right rib cage. To the left, a younger, cherubic figure with curly brown hair and a blue sash over a white garment supports the central man's left arm and chest, looking down at him with a somber expression. The figure's hands are clasped near the central man's chest. To the right, an older-looking angelic figure with dark, curly hair and visible wings supports the central man's right shoulder and arm. This figure wears a dark green or brown draped garment and gazes upwards. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the central figure and the left angel, while the right angel and the background remain in deeper shadow, creating a solemn mood.

alt_text: Dark mountain landscape with a valley, evergreen trees, and a cloudy sky with a faint sunset glow
long_description: The painting depicts a vast, dramatic mountain landscape under a dark, cloudy sky. The upper portion of the sky is dominated by heavy, dark gray and blue clouds, with a band of soft orange and pink light visible along the horizon line, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. Below the sky, layers of mountains recede into the distance, rendered in progressively lighter shades of dark blue, purple, and gray, with some peaks showing faint patches of white, possibly snow. In the middle ground, a wide valley stretches horizontally, appearing misty and illuminated by a soft, greenish light. A winding, reflective body of water, likely a river or stream, can be seen snaking through the valley floor. The right side of the midground is dominated by a dense, dark forest of evergreen trees covering a steep hillside. The foreground features a rocky, uneven terrain with patches of dark green grass and reddish-brown earth. A prominent, tall evergreen tree stands on the left side of the midground, reaching towards the sky. In the center foreground, a small, rounded hillock is topped by a slender, light-barked tree with sparse branches. Further to the right, a few smaller evergreen trees are visible among the rocks and brush. The overall lighting is dim, creating a somber and expansive atmosphere.

alt_text: A man in a blue velvet coat and white wig sits in a chair next to a desk.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man seated in a formal interior setting. He has light, powdered hair, a fair complexion, and a neutral expression, looking directly forward. He wears a high-collared, dark blue velvet coat with a white cravat and ruffled cuffs. A multi-pointed silver star medal with a red center is pinned to his left lapel. A sword hilt is visible at his left hip, tucked under his coat. He wears black breeches and white stockings, with black shoes. He is seated in a green upholstered chair with ornate gold-colored wooden arms and legs. His left arm rests on the chair's armrest, while his right arm rests on a dark green-topped wooden desk to his right. On the desk are a dark inkwell with a quill pen and a white piece of paper. His legs are crossed at the ankles, with his right leg over his left. To his left, on a dark sofa, rests a dark, possibly tricorn, hat. The background is dark, with a dark brown wall and a hint of a dark red curtain in the upper right. The floor is a light brown wooden parquet. The lighting highlights the man's face and the front of his body, creating a contrast with the darker background.

metadata.title: Charles Maurice de Talleyrand Périgord (1754–1838), Prince de Bénévent

alt_text: A bearded man kneels, looking upwards, with keys beside his clasped hands, against a dark background
long_description: The painting shows a full-length portrait of an older man kneeling, positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing towards the upper right corner of the canvas. He has a prominent white beard and mustache, and his gaze is directed upwards with his mouth slightly open. His hands are clasped together in front of him, resting on a dark, indistinct object. To the left of his hands, two metal keys are visible, one larger and golden-brown, the other smaller and darker. He wears a dark, possibly black or deep green, tunic, visible at his left arm and leg. Over this, a voluminous, ochre-brown cloak drapes around his body, covering most of his form. The cloak features deep folds and highlights, especially across his back and legs, suggesting movement or a heavy fabric. His bare feet, with visible toes, are partially seen at the bottom right, emerging from beneath the cloak. The background is predominantly dark, almost black, creating a strong contrast with the illuminated figure. In the upper right quadrant, a faint, dark landscape is discernible, featuring dark trees and a lighter, stormy sky with hints of reddish-brown clouds or land. The light source appears to come from above and to the left, illuminating the man's face, hands, and the prominent folds of his cloak. The overall impression is one of dramatic lighting and a somber atmosphere.

alt_text: A cardinal in red robes walks with his retinue past a classical building under a blue sky
long_description: The painting depicts a procession of figures in an architectural setting under a light blue sky. In the foreground, a group of men occupies the lower left and right portions of the canvas, framed by dark architectural elements. On the left, several men in dark, mostly black, cloaks and hats stand or walk, some with white collars visible. One man in the center-left wears a dark cloak over a yellow-green garment and holds a golden staff or mace over his shoulder. The central figure is a man in elaborate red ecclesiastical robes, including a red biretta on his head and a flowing red cape. He walks towards the right, his left arm slightly bent, holding a small white object. His voluminous white undergarment, possibly a rochet, is visible beneath his cape. To his right, a group of men in dark blue and black attire, some with white collars, attend to him. One man directly behind the cardinal holds the train of his red cape. Another man to the cardinal's right wears a light blue patterned tunic under a dark cloak. The background features a grand classical building with a large dome and a prominent facade, including steps leading up to an entrance. The building is light gray or white, with architectural details like columns, pediments, and niches. A statue is visible in a niche above the entrance. To the left of the building, a ruined archway and distant landscape elements are visible under a light blue sky with faint clouds. The ground is a light brown or tan path.

alt_text: A still life painting featuring ornate silver, gold, and ceramic vessels, shells, and a red velvet cloth.
long_description: The painting is a still life, depicting a collection of luxurious objects arranged on a stone ledge. The background on the left features a dark green landscape with trees under a blue sky, while the right side is a dark brown wall. In the center, a large, oval silver platter with embossed decorative patterns leans against a dark red velvet cloth. The platter is angled, with its top edge pointing towards the upper right. The velvet cloth, draped over the ledge and extending downwards, has gold fringe along its edges. To the left of the platter, a tall, ornate pinkish-brown ceramic urn with a lid stands prominently. It has a fluted body, decorative handles, and small figures on its lid. Further left, a wooden chest with a dark cluster of grapes and a small white shell is partially visible. Below the urn, a large, light brown conch shell with a patterned surface rests on the ledge, alongside a smaller, spiraled shell and a dark leather strap with a gold buckle. Behind the pink urn, a tall, golden amphora with two handles and a small figure on its lid is visible. To the right of the silver platter, another golden ewer with an ornate handle and textured surface is partially obscured by the velvet cloth. The objects are arranged closely, creating a sense of abundance and richness. The lighting highlights the metallic sheen of the silver and gold, and the smooth surfaces of the shells.

metadata.title: Still Life with Silver and Gold Plate, Shells, and a Sword

alt_text: A kneeling figure reaches towards an angel and cherubs in bright clouds, while three figures sleep below
long_description: A dark, dramatic painting depicts a celestial vision above and sleeping figures below. The upper left is filled with bright, swirling clouds illuminated by a golden light. Within these clouds, numerous small, nude, winged figures, or cherubs, are visible, some holding objects. A larger angel with prominent white wings and a blue garment flies downwards from the clouds, extending a hand towards a figure below. In the mid-ground, a figure in a dark blue robe kneels on a reddish mound, looking up with an open mouth and outstretched hands towards the angel. To the right of this kneeling figure, a dark, blocky building with a flat roof stands against a dark blue sky. A dark tree trunk and branches are visible on the far right. In the foreground, three figures lie sprawled on the dark, uneven ground. The figure on the far right is draped in a vivid red robe, lying on their side with their head obscured. In the center, a figure in a yellow-brown robe lies face down, with their head turned to the left, revealing a pale face and white hair. To the left, another figure in a blue-green robe lies on their back, head turned away. The ground is a dark brown, with subtle variations in texture.

alt_text: A multi-panel painting featuring a robed man holding a red book, with two smaller figures above
long_description: The image is a vertical, multi-panel painting with a gold background. The top section has two arched panels. In the left arch, a man with a dark beard, wearing a green cloak over a red tunic, holds a white scroll. He looks forward. A gold halo encircles his head. In the right arch, an angel with light brown wings, wearing a red robe, holds a thin staff. He looks towards the left. A gold halo also encircles his head. The main, larger panel below features a man in a dark brown monastic habit. He has a bald head with short grey hair on the sides and a serious expression, looking slightly to his right. His right hand is raised with the palm facing forward, fingers slightly spread. His left hand holds a closed, rectangular red book with black straps. He stands against a gold background with a circular gold halo behind his head, decorated with a geometric pattern. The overall frame is dark wood with gold accents.

alt_text: A multi-panel painting with a bearded man in a brown robe holding a red book, an angel, and another man
long_description: The image is a vertical, multi-panel painting with a gold background. The top section consists of two smaller, arched panels. The left arched panel shows a figure with light skin, dark hair, and wings, wearing a green tunic and a purple cloak. This figure's right hand is raised to its chest, and its left hand is lowered. The right arched panel shows a figure with light skin, dark hair, and a beard, wearing a red cloak over a dark garment. This figure holds an open book with both hands. The book has a dark cover with a light-colored design. Below these two panels is a larger, rectangular panel with an arched top. This main panel features a half-length portrait of a man with dark skin, a short white beard, and short white hair. He wears a dark brown hooded robe. His gaze is directed forward. His right hand is visible, holding a closed red book with a dark binding. The book has some dark lines or straps across its cover. The man's left hand is mostly obscured by the book and his robe. The background of the main panel is gold, with a lighter gold halo around the man's head. The entire painting is framed by dark wood with gold accents.

alt_text: A partially nude woman in blue drapery is pulled by several men near a large sarcophagus and golden urn.
long_description: A dramatic painting depicts a light-skinned woman, partially nude, with a blue drapery covering her lower body, as the central figure. She wears a light-colored wreath on her head and has her arms outstretched. She is being pulled by several figures. To her immediate right, a man in a brown tunic and a golden helmet holds her arm, while another man in a similar helmet and dark tunic holds a dagger pointed towards her. To her left, a young boy with curly hair reaches towards her. Further to the right, a man in an orange cloak and green head covering pulls her from behind. In the background on the left, a large, light-colored sarcophagus is prominent. It is decorated with a relief of a helmeted profile head and wavy vertical lines, and draped with a green garland. Above the sarcophagus, a sculpted head is visible. To the far left, a dark-robed figure stands next to a tall, golden urn on a decorative pedestal, from which a white cloth hangs. In the upper right, a dark, cloudy sky transitions to lighter hues near the horizon, with distant, dark mountains. Faint figures with spears and horses are visible in the far background on the right. The dominant colors include the woman's blue drapery, the golden hues of armor and the urn, the orange and green of the cloaked figure, and the dark blues and grays of the sky and mountains.

alt_text: Sepia-toned painting depicting several indistinct, draped figures in a soft, dreamlike composition.
long_description: This sepia-toned painting features a soft, blurred composition of multiple figures rendered in shades of brown, beige, and off-white. The overall impression is dreamlike and ethereal, with indistinct forms emerging from a muted background. In the upper left quadrant, a figure's head and upper body are visible, facing towards the right. Below this, a lighter, elongated shape suggests a draped arm or fabric. Towards the center-right, a reclining figure, possibly nude or lightly draped, is depicted with their head oriented to the left and their body extending towards the right. A dark, indistinct mass is present near the head of this reclining figure, possibly indicating hair or shadow. Above and to the right of the reclining figure, several lighter, abstract shapes suggest additional draped forms or figures, blending into the darker background. The brushstrokes are soft and blended, creating a sense of depth and movement without sharp outlines. In the lower right corner, a signature is visible, reading "Eugène Carrière."

alt_text: A person in a patterned robe and hat holds a wine glass, seated against a dark background.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a person seated, facing slightly right, with their gaze directed towards the viewer. The individual has light skin, dark eyes, and dark, shoulder-length hair, and wears a tall, conical hat adorned with intricate dark patterns. They are dressed in a long, open robe featuring diagonal stripes of dark blue, red, and white, worn over a plain white undergarment. Decorative armbands with green accents are visible on the sleeves of the robe. A vibrant red fabric, possibly trousers or a skirt, is visible beneath the robe. The person's left hand, positioned on the viewer's right, holds a clear, stemmed glass containing a red liquid. Their right hand, on the viewer's left, holds a small, rectangular object, possibly a book or case, decorated with red and gold patterns. The background consists of a dark, plain wall, with a rich red drape hanging from the top left corner and extending across the upper portion of the painting. A horizontal patterned border in gold and dark colors runs behind the person at waist level. In the lower left foreground, on a dark green patterned surface, rests a small, lidded bowl or censer with green and gold decorations, placed on a matching saucer. The surface beneath the person is a dark green rug or cushion with floral motifs. On the left side of the painting, near the hand holding the glass, faint script is visible, reading 'رقم مهر علی'.

alt_text: A kneeling figure in red and dark clothing plays a long wind instrument on an aged panel.
long_description: The artwork depicts a single figure kneeling on a rectangular, vertically oriented panel. The figure is positioned slightly to the left of center, facing left in profile, with the head tilted downwards. The person wears a light-colored turban or headwrap, and their face is rendered with simple lines, showing a prominent nose and a small mouth. The figure is dressed in a long-sleeved, reddish-orange tunic or shirt, which extends to the upper thighs. A dark, possibly patterned, belt or sash is cinched around the waist. Dark, loose-fitting trousers or a lower garment in a similar reddish-orange hue are visible below the tunic, covering the knees. A dark, almost black, cloak or outer garment is draped over the figure's shoulders and back, extending downwards. The figure holds a long, slender, dark-colored wind instrument, possibly a flute or pipe, to their mouth with both hands. The instrument extends diagonally downwards from the mouth towards the lower left. The background is a mottled, textured surface in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and dark ochre, showing signs of age and wear, with some areas of lighter, possibly exposed, material. The edges of the panel are irregular, particularly at the top right and bottom left, indicating damage or deterioration.

alt_text: A standing figure in a golden-yellow top and red skirt against a dark background, with head tilted
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting depicting a single standing figure. The figure occupies most of the central space, set against a dark, textured background. The figure stands facing forward, with her head tilted slightly downward and to her left. Her body is slender and elongated. She wears a golden-yellow garment on her upper body, which features a low, rounded neckline and black trim along the edges of the sleeves and the bottom hem. The sleeves are a deep red color, extending to her forearms. Her lower body is covered by a flowing, deep red garment that appears to be a skirt or trousers, reaching to her ankles. Her face is light-skinned with dark, almond-shaped eyes and a small mouth. Her dark hair is long, falling over her left shoulder and down her back. A simple, dark necklace is visible around her neck. Her right arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand resting near her waist. Her left arm is also bent, with her hand positioned near her chest. To the right of her head, a small, circular red object, possibly a flower or jewel, is depicted. The background is a mottled dark brown and gold, with visible texture and some lighter areas, suggesting age or wear. The edges of the painting are rough and uneven.

alt_text: A standing figure in a long red robe and turban, holding a small cup and a stringed instrument
long_description: The image displays a single standing figure painted on a vertical rectangular panel with a mottled, faded brown and orange background. The figure, facing forward with a slight turn to the right, occupies most of the panel's height. The head is topped with a large, dark brown turban with lighter brown folds. The face is light-skinned with dark, arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a small nose, and a small mouth. Dark hair is visible at the sides of the face. The figure wears a long, flowing red robe that extends to the ankles. A dark, possibly black, undergarment is visible at the neck. A dark gray or black cloak is draped over the shoulders, extending down the back. The robe has a row of three dark buttons down the front of the chest. Around the waist, a wide, dark belt with a textured pattern is visible. In the figure's left hand, held at chest level, is a small, light-colored cup or bowl. The right hand holds a long, thin, light-colored stick-like object that extends downwards to a round, light-colored stringed instrument with a dark, star-like design on its body. The instrument hangs at waist level. The figure's feet are mostly covered by the robe, with only a dark shoe visible on the right foot. The overall impression is of an ancient painting with visible wear and fading.

metadata.title: Man Holding a Bottle and a Cup
metadata.medium: Ink, opaque watercolor, and gold on plaster

alt_text: A painting of a woman in an ornate, patterned dress and elaborate headpiece, standing against a dark background
long_description:
The image is a vertical painting with an arched top, depicting a full-length standing woman. The woman is positioned centrally, facing directly forward, with her head slightly tilted. She has dark hair, dark eyes, and a small mouth. On her head is an elaborate, jeweled headpiece with a central peak. She wears a dark, fitted jacket adorned with intricate gold and red patterns, and a prominent round necklace with a central pendant. From her shoulders, fan-like elements with red and gold patterns extend outwards. Her sleeves are also patterned and decorated with small white dots.

Around her waist is a dark belt with a large, circular, jeweled buckle, from which a wide, red sash hangs down the front of her skirt. Her voluminous skirt is a rich brown-gold color, covered in a repeating pattern of dark red and blue floral or geometric motifs, accented with small white dots. The hem of her skirt is also decorated. Her right hand is raised with fingers slightly curled, while her left hand is mostly obscured by her clothing. The background is dark and appears to be a deep green or blue, with a faint rectangular outline on the right side, possibly indicating a window or architectural feature. The overall impression is one of rich detail and ornamentation.

alt_text: A painting depicts a woman and a man surrounded by a camel, deer, lion, rabbit, and other animals in a landscape
long_description: This arched-top painting features two human figures and several animals in a landscape setting. On the left, a woman with dark hair wears a striped headscarf and a long red dress with a gold-colored belt. She sits on the ground, her left hand near her chest, and her right hand raised, holding a small, light-colored object. Behind her, a light-brown camel with a bridle faces right. To the right, a bare-chested man with curly dark hair sits facing left, his legs bent. He holds a small, light-brown deer across his lap, with arrows visible beneath the deer. In the foreground, a variety of animals are arranged around the figures. To the left, a spotted, light-colored animal, possibly a lamb or goat, looks towards the viewer. A light-brown rabbit sits to its right, facing right. Further right, a large, light-brown lion with a mane faces left, its mouth slightly open. Below the lion, a small, dark-colored animal is visible. Another dog-like animal is positioned to the right of the man, facing left. The ground is green and grassy, and in the upper background, a few sparse, dark green palm-like trees are visible against a light blue sky.

alt_text: A detailed scientific illustration of a large brown and black bat with its wings fully extended
long_description: A scientific illustration depicts a large bat with its wings fully extended horizontally against a plain, light-colored background. The bat's body is positioned centrally, with its head facing forward towards the viewer. Its head is covered in dark brown fur, which transitions to a lighter, reddish-brown fur on its chest and belly. The bat has small, pointed ears, dark eyes, and a prominent dark nose. Its large, leathery wings are dark gray to black, stretching across the entire width of the frame. The wings show visible bone structures and membrane folds, particularly along the inner sections. Each wing features a distinct, hook-like claw protruding upwards from the top edge, closer to the body. The left wing extends further to the left, with a slightly scalloped edge, while the right wing is somewhat shorter and appears slightly more folded. Two small, dark, clawed feet hang downwards from the bat's lower body. Visible male genitalia are present between the legs. The overall impression is a detailed anatomical study of the creature.

metadata.title: Great Indian Fruit Bat
metadata.medium: Pencil, ink, and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: A framed botanical illustration depicts a tall, segmented green cactus with two large white flowers and several buds.
long_description: The image shows a framed botanical illustration of a cactus, presented vertically. The artwork is enclosed in a wide, reflective gold frame with a white mat board. The illustration itself features a tall, segmented cactus plant with a vibrant green hue, set against a plain, light background that appears off-white or cream. The cactus stem is thick and ribbed, showing distinct vertical lines and subtle texture. Two prominent white flowers are in bloom: one at the very top of the cactus, and another positioned lower on the right side of the plant. Both flowers have multiple delicate white petals and a dense cluster of stamens in their centers. Several green buds are also visible, some elongated and pointing upwards, suggesting future blooms. A small, dark red, tear-drop shaped object hangs from the left side of the upper cactus segment, and a similar, darker object is near the base on the right. In the top left corner of the overall image, outside the artwork but within the frame, black text reads: "TR.112.2.2012 Photo taken on 4/3/12 at Storeroom One."

alt_text: A haloed figure with reddish-brown hair, wearing a green tunic and red cloak, holds a staff and banner
long_description: The painting depicts a half-length figure, likely a young man, centered within a rectangular gold frame. The background is entirely gold leaf, textured with visible brushstrokes and some areas of wear. The figure has fair skin, a serious expression, and reddish-brown, wavy hair that reaches just above the shoulders. A prominent gold halo encircles the head. The figure wears a teal-green tunic with a patterned gold trim at the neckline and cuffs, and a deep red cloak draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, secured with a red knot on the left side. The cloak also has a patterned gold trim along its edges. The figure's left hand, with a visible red cuff, holds a dark, slender object, possibly a sword hilt or a quill, pointing downwards. The right hand grasps a long, light brown staff that extends vertically upwards, topped with a two-toned banner, light grey on the left and dark grey or black on the right. The figure's gaze is directed straight forward. The ornate gold frame features a repeating dark pattern along its inner edge.

alt_text: A woman in a red cloak holds a dark vessel, set against a gold background within an arched panel
long_description: A vertical, arched panel painting depicts a woman in a red cloak against a gold background. The woman is positioned centrally, facing slightly to the viewer's right, with her head gently tilted. She has a pale complexion, with dark, downcast eyes and a small mouth. A golden halo with radiating lines encircles her head. She wears a deep red cloak that covers her head and drapes over her shoulders and body, revealing a dark green or blue garment underneath. Her hands are clasped at her waist, holding a dark, ornate, lidded vessel. The background is entirely gold, featuring intricate patterns of raised dots and lines, particularly around the halo and in the upper arched section. Within the upper arch, two small, dark circular medallions are visible, one on each side, containing indistinct figures. The painting exhibits visible cracks and signs of age across its surface.

metadata.title: Saint Mary Magdalen
metadata.artist: Follower of Barna da Siena|Follower of Lippo Memmi (Italian, Sienese, active mid-14th century)|Bartolo di Fredi

alt_text: A bearded man with a halo holds keys and a book, set against a gold background in an arched frame
long_description: The image is a vertical panel painting depicting a male figure from the chest up, set within an ornate, arched golden frame. The figure, positioned centrally, has a dark beard and mustache, and a serious expression. He wears a light grey cap and a halo of golden rays with a dotted border around his head. His skin tone is olive. He is dressed in a blue tunic with a gold-trimmed collar, covered by a large, flowing brown cloak draped over his shoulders and arms, also with gold trim. In his left hand, held at chest level, he grasps a large, ornate golden key and a smaller, dark key. His right hand, positioned lower, holds a closed red book with gold clasps and detailing. The background behind the figure is entirely gold, textured with fine lines, and features an elaborate arched design above his head. Within the upper corners of the arch, two small circular medallions depict winged figures, one on the left and one on the right, against a dark background. The overall impression is of a formal, devotional portrait.

metadata.title: Saint Peter
metadata.artist: Follower of Barna da Siena|Follower of Lippo Memmi (Italian, Sienese, active mid-14th century)

alt_text: A Renaissance painting depicts the Adoration of the Magi, with Mary, Child, Joseph, three kings, and attendants.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts the Adoration of the Magi, with numerous figures arranged in a crowded composition. On the right, the Virgin Mary, dressed in a dark blue cloak over a red garment, holds the nude Christ Child, who reaches towards the kneeling figures. Both Mary and the Child have golden halos. Behind Mary stands Joseph, a bearded man with a golden halo, wearing a purple robe. They are positioned under a simple architectural structure with red and gray patterned arches. In the foreground, to the left of Mary, an elderly king with a white beard kneels, wearing a pink and red robe, and appears to kiss the Child's foot. His golden crown rests on the ground beside him. To his left, a younger king with light hair kneels, dressed in a white and gold robe, holding a golden vessel. He wears a crown on his head. Behind these two, a third king, younger with dark hair and a crown, stands looking towards the Child. A group of attendants, some bearded and wearing various head coverings including helmets and turbans, stand behind the kings. A prominent white horse with a red bridle is visible among them, with other horses partially seen behind it. The background on the left features a rocky, barren landscape with small green trees. In the far upper left, tiny figures on camels are visible, suggesting a distant journey. The overall color palette includes rich blues, reds, golds, and earthy tones.

alt_text: A painted head of a person with reddish-brown hair and a black headband on a light, textured background
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting depicting the head of a person against a light, off-white background. The head is positioned centrally, facing forward with a slight tilt to the left. The skin tone is pale, with hints of pink on the cheeks and lips. The eyes are dark brown, looking directly forward, with defined eyelids and faint eyebrows. The nose is straight and relatively narrow. The mouth is small, with the upper lip slightly thinner than the lower, and a dark line indicating the opening. The hair is a reddish-brown color, appearing wavy or curly, and frames the face. A thin black band or ribbon is visible across the top of the head, partially obscured by a green, leaf-like element on the upper left side. The hair extends down the sides of the face, blending into the light background at the bottom. The background itself is a mottled, light beige or off-white, showing some texture and minor cracks in the paint surface. The edges of the painted head are not sharply defined, giving a soft transition to the background. The overall impression is a close-up portrait of a single individual.

metadata.title: Head of an Angel in Full Face
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood (paint around head scraped away and vacant area gessoed)

alt_text: A close-up painting of a woman's face with a neutral expression, framed by a light-colored veil
long_description: The image displays a head-and-shoulders fragment of a painting, featuring the face of a woman looking directly forward. Her skin is light-toned with subtle rosy cheeks. Her eyes are dark brown, almond-shaped, with visible pupils and a slight highlight. Her nose is long and straight, and her mouth is small with reddish-orange lips, closed in a neutral expression. Lightly defined eyebrows arch above her eyes. She wears a light, off-white or beige veil that frames her face, covering her hair and extending down her shoulders. A faint dotted pattern is visible along the edge of the veil across her forehead. On her right side, a darker, possibly blue or grey, garment is visible beneath the veil. The background is a plain, light, neutral color, similar to the veil. The painting exhibits visible cracks and some areas of paint loss, particularly along the edges and on the surface of the face.

metadata.title: Head of the Virgin
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood (paint around head scraped away and vacant area gessoed)

alt_text: Profile portrait of a person with reddish-brown wavy hair, facing left, on a light, textured background
long_description: The image displays a painted profile portrait of a person's head, oriented to the left, on a rectangular panel. The person's skin is light-toned, with a flush of pink on the cheek and chin. The eye is dark and almond-shaped, with a visible eyelid. The nose is straight, and the lips are full and closed, painted in a reddish-pink hue. The neck is visible, extending downwards from the chin. The hair is reddish-brown, depicted with wavy strands that fall from the forehead and extend towards the right side of the panel. A dark, thin band is visible across the top of the head, near the hairline. The background is a light, off-white or beige color, with a textured appearance and visible cracks throughout the surface of the panel. The edges of the panel are visible, showing some wear and slight irregularities.

metadata.title: Head of an Angel in Left Profile
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood (paint around head scraped away and vacant area gessoed)

alt_text: A painting depicts the deposition of Christ, surrounded by grieving figures and a large cross on a gold background.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting with an arched top depicts a religious scene on a gold background. A large brown cross stands centrally on a rocky, light brown mound in the upper half. Above the cross, two dark, winged figures, possibly angels, fly downwards on either side. The top border features an ornate gold arch. In the lower center, the pale, deceased body of a man, likely Christ, lies diagonally, supported by several figures. He wears a patterned gold and white cloth around his waist and legs, with visible red wounds on his side and hands. To the lower left, a woman in a yellow robe kneels, supporting the man's legs. Above her, a man in a dark blue tunic and red cloak stands, looking upwards. To the right of the deceased man, a woman in a dark blue robe and head covering leans over his torso, her arms outstretched. Next to her, a figure in a brown robe kneels with hands clasped. Further right, a woman in a red dress sits, holding the man's feet. Behind these figures, two men stand; one with a white beard wears a red and gold robe and holds a dark pot, while the other, with wings, wears a green robe. All figures have halos. The gold leaf background shows signs of age and wear.

metadata.title: The Lamentation over the Dead Christ

alt_text: Christ crowns the Virgin Mary amidst a host of angels and cherubim in a gilded altarpiece.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts the Coronation of the Virgin Mary by Christ, set within an ornate gilded frame. At the top, a golden archway with a trefoil design frames the scene. Below this, a dense cluster of dark blue winged cherubim with small, light-skinned faces fills the upper background. In the center, Christ, seated on the right, wears a pink tunic and a dark blue cloak, with a golden halo and a light beard. His right arm is raised, placing a crown on the head of the Virgin Mary, who is seated on the left. The Virgin wears a light blue cloak over a golden patterned dress, also with a golden halo, and is slightly bowed. Both figures sit on a golden, cloud-like throne or platform. Surrounding Christ and Mary are numerous angels with golden halos and light skin, their bodies mostly obscured by a reddish-orange, cloud-like background. Many have golden wings visible. Below the main throne, four larger angels are visible. Two are kneeling in the center, facing each other, dressed in elaborate golden and red patterned robes with striped wings. On the far left, an angel stands, holding a long staff-like object. On the far right, another angel stands, playing a stringed instrument resembling a viol. These four angels are positioned on a patterned floor with geometric designs in red, blue, and gold. The entire scene is set against a rich golden background, with details rendered in gold leaf.

alt_text: Two gilded panels depict the Madonna and Child with saints on the left, and the Crucifixion on the right.
long_description: The artwork consists of two vertical, rectangular panels, each set within an elaborate, pointed arch frame of carved and gilded wood. A golden pinecone finial tops each arch. The background of both main scenes is gold. The left panel features the Madonna and Child enthroned with saints. In the center, a woman in a dark blue robe sits on a red patterned rug, holding a child dressed in a pink garment. To her left stands a bearded man in a light brown tunic and red cloak, holding a staff. To her right stands a man in a yellow robe, also holding a staff. Above the central figures, two smaller, haloed figures in light robes are visible. At the very top of the arch, a small circular medallion contains a bust of a figure. A white label at the bottom of this panel reads: "MADONNA AND CHILD WITH SAINTS", "PAOLO DI GIOVANNI FL.", "ITALIAN, SIENESE ACT. ABT. 1390". The right panel depicts the Crucifixion. A figure with a green-tinged body and a white loincloth is nailed to a dark brown cross. Above the figure's head, a white plaque bears the red letters "INRI". To the left of the cross, a woman in a dark blue robe stands, looking downwards. To the right, a man in a light-colored robe stands, looking up at the crucified figure. Below the cross, a figure in a red robe kneels on a rocky, green and brown ground, gazing upwards. At the very top of this arch, a small circular medallion contains a bust of a figure. A white label at the bottom of this panel reads: "ITALIAN, SIENESE ACT. ABT. 1390".

metadata.title: Diptyc
metadata.artist: Workshop of  Paolo di Giovanni Fei

alt_text: A gold-framed religious painting depicting Madonna and Child enthroned, surrounded by angels and saints, with a reclining figure below.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical panel painting set within an ornate gold frame. The central and largest figures are the Madonna and Child, seated on a golden throne against a red patterned background. The Madonna wears a dark blue or black robe and a white veil, holding the infant Jesus, who is draped in gold fabric. Both figures have golden halos. Above and to the sides of the Madonna and Child, numerous angels with golden halos are depicted. Some angels are shown in profile, others frontally, and several appear to be playing musical instruments like lutes or harps. They are arranged in an arc, with some figures partially obscured by the golden architectural elements of the upper frame. Below the angels, on either side of the central throne, stand groups of figures, likely saints, each with a golden halo. On the left, three figures are visible, one with a long white beard holding keys, another with a staff. On the right, three figures are also present, one with a dark beard holding a staff. They wear robes in shades of red, blue, and white. At the very bottom of the painting, a reclining, light-skinned female figure is depicted. She lies on a dark ground, partially covered by a red cloth, with a small tree and a serpent coiled around its trunk to her right. A scroll with the letters "EVA" is visible near her left hand. The entire scene is enclosed by a richly decorated gold frame with intricate carvings.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saint John the Evangelist, Saint Peter, Saint Agnes, Saint Catherine of Alexandria, Saint Lucy, an Unidentified Female Saint, Saint Paul, and Saint John the Baptist, with Eve and the Serpent; the Annunciation

alt_text: Virgin Mary holding Christ Child, flanked by two kneeling figures, against a gold and red patterned background
long_description: The painting depicts the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child, flanked by two kneeling figures, within a pointed arch frame. Mary, positioned centrally, wears a dark blue robe over a red garment, and a dark blue veil covers her head. She holds the Christ Child, who wears a red tunic, in her left arm. Both Mary and the Child have golden halos around their heads. Mary's gaze is directed slightly downward and to the right, while the Child looks forward. To Mary's left, a figure kneels in profile, wearing a long red robe and looking towards Mary and the Child. This figure also has a golden halo. To Mary's right, another figure kneels, facing Mary and the Child, dressed in a long, hooded teal or green robe. This figure's hands are clasped in front, and a golden halo encircles their head. The central figures are seated on a throne-like structure with a patterned base in shades of green, red, and gold. The background behind the figures is predominantly gold, adorned with a repeating pattern of red geometric shapes and small black stars. The entire composition is enclosed within a thick, ornate golden frame with red accents, tapering to a point at the top.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Donors

alt_text: A painted wooden crucifix with Christ on the cross, surrounded by four other figures on a gold background
long_description: The artwork is a painted wooden crucifix, featuring a central figure of Christ on the cross against a gold background. The cross itself has an ornate, shaped outline with quatrefoil extensions at the ends of the arms and the top and bottom of the vertical beam. Christ is depicted with outstretched arms, his body slightly slumped. He wears a green loincloth. Red marks representing blood are visible on his hands, feet, and torso. A red halo with a cross motif is behind his head. His head is tilted to his right, and his eyes are closed. Above Christ's head, within a quatrefoil extension, is a half-length figure of an older man with a beard, wearing a red cloak over a dark garment, holding a book or scroll, with his right hand raised. A gold halo is behind his head. On the left arm of the cross, within a quatrefoil, is a half-length figure of a woman, wearing a dark blue or black garment over a red one, with her hands clasped or crossed over her chest. A gold halo is behind her head. On the right arm of the cross, within a quatrefoil, is a half-length figure of a man, wearing a dark garment, with his hands together. A gold halo is behind his head. Below Christ's feet, within a quatrefoil extension, is a half-length figure of a smaller person with a halo, wearing a red garment over a dark one, with hands clasped. The bottom of the cross tapers into a pointed, unpainted wooden spike. The dominant color is the gold leaf background, which shows signs of age and wear. The figures are painted in muted tones of red, blue, green, and flesh tones. The outlines of the cross and the quatrefoils are decorated with small dots and lines.

alt_text: Two figures, an angel and a woman, flank a vase of flowers against a gold background in a framed panel
long_description: A vertical, rectangular panel with an arched top depicts two figures flanking a central vase of flowers against a gold background. The panel is set within a gilded frame with a decorative arched top featuring small blue and gold squares. The background is predominantly gold, textured with fine lines, and shows some wear. On the left, an angel kneels, facing right, with head bowed. The angel wears a long, flowing red-orange robe with long sleeves. A faint gold halo is visible around the angel's head, and dark brown wings are partially visible behind. In the center, a tall, ornate gold vase with a fluted base holds a plant with thin green stems and small, light blue flowers. On the right, a woman stands, facing left, with her head slightly bowed and her hands clasped near her chest. She wears a long, dark brown robe, with a hint of a reddish garment visible at her neck. Her hair is light brown and pulled back, and a faint gold halo is visible around her head. The figures and vase are positioned on a light, mottled ground that appears to be a floor. Along the bottom edge of the panel, a dark band contains white Latin text: "ECCE ANCILLA DOMINI FIAT MICHI SECUNDUM VERBUM TUUM".

alt_text: A bearded man with a halo stands on a path in a barren landscape with distant buildings and a sunset sky
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts a barren, hilly landscape under a dramatic sky, with a prominent figure in the foreground. In the lower right, a man with a long white beard and hair stands on a dirt path. He wears a dark brown tunic and a lighter purple-brown cloak, and a golden halo encircles his head. He holds a light brown staff in his right hand and raises his left hand with an open palm. The path, light brown with scattered white stones, winds diagonally from the lower left corner towards the upper right. Numerous dark, leafless trees with gnarled branches are positioned along and beside the path, particularly on the left side. A small white rabbit sits at the base of a tree in the lower left. Further up the path, a brown animal lies on the ground, and another brown animal walks on the hill to the right of the path. The landscape features rolling hills in shades of green and brown. On the right, a pink-orange building with a pointed steeple and a red roof is situated on a hill. To its left, a dark, ruined castle tower stands on another distant hill. In the far distance, a small white boat with a mast floats on a body of water. The upper portion of the painting shows a sky filled with horizontal bands of dark gray, orange, and pink clouds, suggesting either dawn or dusk. Two dark, bird-like shapes fly in the upper left corner.

metadata.title: Saint Anthony the Abbot in the Wilderness

alt_text: A triangular panel painting of a haloed figure in a dark cloak, seated and looking down, with a bird.
long_description: The artwork is a triangular panel, with a straight vertical right edge, a straight horizontal bottom edge, and a diagonal top-left edge. It is bordered by a carved, gilded frame that is particularly visible along the bottom and the diagonal left side. The frame shows signs of wear and flaking. A single figure, appearing to be a woman, is depicted seated, facing slightly to the right, with her head bowed and looking downwards. She has a pale complexion and delicate features. A faint golden halo encircles her head. Her hands are crossed over her chest, with her right hand resting on her left. She wears a dark blue or gray cloak draped over a reddish-brown garment, both with visible folds. The background behind the figure is a warm, golden-brown color, appearing somewhat aged and textured. In the upper left area, near the figure's head, a small, dark, bird-like shape is visible, flying towards her. The overall surface of the painting shows areas of wear, cracking, and loss of paint, particularly in the lower left and along the edges.

alt_text: A painting of a solemn man in a jeweled miter and ornate robes, holding a book
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a solemn male figure, likely a bishop or saint, against a gold background. The figure is shown from the chest up, slightly turned to the right, with his gaze directed downwards. He wears a tall, pointed miter adorned with numerous white pearls and larger red and gold jewels. A red band is visible beneath the miter, framing his face. His skin has a pale green-brown hue, and his expression is somber. Behind his head is a circular gold halo with radiating lines, which shows significant crackling and texture. He is dressed in rich, dark brown or purple robes, featuring wide, ornate gold and white bands. These bands are intricately patterned with floral designs and geometric shapes. On the central band of his chest, a small, lighter-toned figure, possibly another saint, is depicted within an arch. His left hand, mostly obscured, holds a tall, slender staff that extends vertically. His right hand, with visible fingers, holds a dark, closed book. The gold background is heavily textured with fine cracks, particularly around the halo, and a dark, curved arch is visible in the upper left corner.

metadata.title: Saint Ambrose
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A bearded figure creates a layered sphere while an angel expels two nude figures from a garden
long_description: The painting is vertically split into two distinct scenes. The left half features a large, bearded figure with a halo, wearing a light blue robe and surrounded by numerous dark blue wings. He descends from the upper left, his right hand pointing towards a large, multi-layered sphere that dominates the lower left quadrant. The sphere consists of concentric rings in shades of blue, white, and light blue, with a prominent red ring near its center. Within the innermost ring, a green and brown landscape with jagged mountains is visible. The figure's left hand rests on the upper edge of this sphere. The background behind the figure is a cracked, light golden-brown. The right half depicts a garden scene under a dark blue sky, populated by several trees bearing yellow-orange fruit. In the foreground, an angel with golden wings and a halo, positioned on the left, pushes two nude human figures towards the right. The angel's right hand is on the shoulder of a nude male figure, who in turn reaches back with his left hand towards a nude female figure. The female figure looks back over her shoulder towards the garden. The ground is green, adorned with small red and white flowers. At the very bottom edge of the canvas, beneath the garden, are three dark, indistinct shapes resembling footprints.

metadata.title: The Creation of the World and the Expulsion from Paradise
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A painting of a woman holding a child, flanked by a man in red and an angel, all with halos
long_description:
This vertical painting depicts four figures against a dark, almost black background. In the center, a woman with dark, wavy hair wears a dark blue mantle draped over a gold and red patterned dress. Her head is gently tilted towards the child she holds in her arms. Both the woman and child are encircled by golden halos with radiating lines. The child, with light skin and a light-colored garment, looks directly forward, with its right arm raised and its left hand resting on the woman's chest. The woman's left hand supports the child from below, while her right hand is positioned near the child's torso.

To the left of the central figures stands an older man with a serious expression and dark hair, wearing a prominent red hooded robe over a dark, pleated garment. He holds a small, open book in his left hand, which displays several lines of illegible script. His right index finger points towards the text in the book.

On the right side of the painting, a younger figure, possibly an angel, with light hair and a red headband adorned with small white dots, looks towards the central group. This figure wears a light, possibly gold-toned garment and holds a small, dark, indistinct object in its hands. A faint, lighter halo is visible around its head.

The overall color palette is rich, featuring deep reds, dark blues, and prominent gold patterns on the central woman's dress, contrasted with the dark background and the earthy tones of the figures' skin and some garments.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Jerome and Agnes
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A nun kneels before a crucifix while an angel appears above a bedchamber scene with multiple figures
long_description: The vertical panel painting depicts two distinct but connected scenes. In the left foreground, a woman in a black and white habit kneels on a patterned floor, facing right. She has an orange halo and her hands are clasped in prayer. Her head is bowed, and her face is visible in profile. To her left, a dark, slender crucifix with a figure of Christ is mounted on a dark wall. The right side of the painting shows an interior bedchamber. A large bed with a red and gold patterned coverlet dominates the space. A figure in a blue garment sits on the bed, facing left, with hands clasped. Behind the bed, three standing figures are visible. One figure in an orange tunic and white head covering holds a pole or staff. Another figure in a dark cap and green garment holds a pink cloth. A third figure with long, light brown hair and a light blue garment stands near the bed. Above the bed, an angel with a halo and wings is depicted in the upper left corner of the bedchamber, surrounded by golden rays of light emanating from a dark cloud. The ceiling of the bedchamber is coffered with decorative elements. The background walls are a muted green. A white curtain hangs on the far right.

metadata.title: Saint Catherine of Siena Beseeching Christ to Resuscitate Her Mother
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A robed figure kneels with raised arms before a crucified figure and an altar in a vaulted room
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts an interior scene with a kneeling figure on the left and a crucified figure and altar on the right. The kneeling figure, positioned in the lower-left quadrant, faces right with arms raised and hands open, palms upward. This figure wears a long, flowing light grey or white robe with numerous vertical folds, and a golden halo encircles their head. Their skin appears a pale green-grey. To the upper right, a figure hangs from a wooden cross, positioned diagonally. This crucified figure also has pale green-grey skin, wears a loincloth, and is adorned with a golden halo. Below the crucified figure, on a light grey rectangular platform, stands an altar. The altar's front is decorated with a rich red and gold patterned design. On top of the altar, a smaller, ornate golden cross stands upright. The background features a room with green-grey walls. Arches with blue-grey interiors are visible in the upper left, supported by slender columns. The ceiling above is patterned with dark brown and gold geometric shapes. The floor is covered in a dark red and brown tiled pattern, consisting of alternating squares and diamonds.

metadata.title: Saint Catherine of Siena Receiving the Stigmata
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A religious painting depicts a robed figure with a halo, surrounded by a wreath, with angels and a banner above
long_description: This vertical, arched-top panel painting features a central male figure against a gold background. The figure, likely a saint, has a light halo around his head and wears a dark brown or black hooded robe that reaches his feet. His left hand is raised with the palm open, while his right hand holds a bundle of thin, dark sticks or reeds. He stands within a large, dark green wreath composed of leaves and several white lilies with yellow centers. Below the central figure, two small, winged, reddish-orange figures, resembling cherubs or putti, are positioned on either side, appearing to support the wreath. Above the central figure, another robed figure emerges from a burst of golden light, also with a halo. This upper figure holds a long, dark banner that unfurls horizontally to the right. The background is primarily gold, showing signs of wear with reddish-brown undertones visible in various areas. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the central figure as the focal point.

metadata.title: The Exultation of Saint Nicholas of Tolentino
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A haloed man gestures towards a woman sitting up in bed, surrounded by several other figures in an interior.
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with seven figures. In the center, a bearded man with a golden halo stands, facing left, with his right hand raised in a gesture. He wears a light blue tunic and a pink cloak. To his left, a woman sits upright in a wooden bed, covered by a red blanket. She wears a light blue dress and a white head covering, with her hands raised in front of her. Behind her, to the far left, a woman in an orange garment stands with hands clasped. Next to her, a dark-haired man with a beard and dark clothing raises both hands. Behind the haloed man, to the right, another man with light brown hair sits on a bench or bed frame, holding a red book. He wears a dark blue tunic and a dark cloak. The room features dark green walls with two arched openings at the top, revealing a lighter, possibly gold-colored ceiling or background. The floor is a light, muted color. The overall palette includes muted blues, reds, greens, and browns, with accents of gold for the halo and architectural details. The figures are arranged in a shallow space, with the bed occupying the lower half of the composition.

metadata.title: Saint John the Evangelist Raises Drusiana
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A religious painting depicts a bearded man and an angel at an altar under an elaborate domed architectural structure, surrounded by onlookers.
long_description:
An arched panel painting, taller than it is wide, depicts a religious scene within an elaborate architectural setting. The upper portion is dominated by a complex structure featuring multiple domes. A large central reddish-brown dome with an orange finial is flanked by two smaller, similar domes, with two more visible below them, creating a tiered effect. The architecture is rendered in shades of light brown, grey, and blue, with intricate details and arched windows against a dark blue background.
Below the domes, a grand, open-sided structure with arches and four white fluted columns frames the central figures. In the center, a bearded man with a halo, wearing a light blue tunic and a pink robe, stands to the left of a white altar. He holds a book or tablet in his left hand and gestures towards the altar with his right. Opposite him, to the right of the altar, an angel with a halo and wings, dressed in a light purple tunic and an orange robe, holds a small object over the altar with both hands. The altar is white with gothic-style arched openings on its front. Behind the altar, a tall, narrow, reddish-brown structure with intricate details rises towards the ceiling. The floor beneath the figures is a patterned tile in dark and light squares.
On either side of the central figures, groups of people are gathered, looking towards the altar. On the left, several men are visible, mostly from the waist up, dressed in various colored robes, including blue and brown. On the right, a similar group of men, also in robes of blue, orange, and brown, observe the scene. Their faces are rendered with individual features, and some have light brown or dark hair.

metadata.title: The Annunciation to Zacharias; (verso) The Angel of the Annunciation
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A man crowns a woman on an ornate throne, surrounded by numerous angels and two musical angels below.
long_description: An arched panel painting depicts a central scene of a man crowning a woman, surrounded by celestial figures. In the center, a woman with a halo and a crown on her head is seated on the left, dressed in a long, flowing white gown with intricate gold patterns. Her hands are raised, palms open, in a gesture of reception. To her right, a man with a halo is also seated, wearing a white tunic and a dark blue-green cloak. He extends his right hand towards the woman's head, appearing to place a crown upon her. Both figures are seated on a large, ornate throne covered in rich red fabric with gold floral and geometric patterns. The throne has architectural elements on its sides. Above and behind the central figures, a multitude of angels with halos are arranged in an arc, their heads and shoulders visible, looking towards the central action. In the foreground, below the throne, two additional angels are depicted. The angel on the left kneels, playing a stringed instrument on a golden stand. The angel on the right is seated on the ground, playing a large, golden harp. The background at the top is predominantly gold, while the ground beneath the musical angels is a lighter, marbled texture.

metadata.title: Coronation of the Virgin
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A painting shows a woman in a dark mantle holding a child, both with golden halos.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a woman and a child, framed in gold. The woman, positioned on the right, has fair skin with rosy cheeks and looks down and slightly to her left. She wears a dark blue mantle that covers her head and shoulders, with a white veil visible beneath. The mantle features a gold patterned trim along its edge and a gold starburst design on her right shoulder. Her left hand gently supports the child. The child, on the left, has fair skin and curly blonde hair, looking up towards the woman's face. The child wears an orange-red tunic with intricate gold patterns and long sleeves. The child's right hand is raised, palm open, near the woman's chin, while the left arm is around the woman's neck. Two bare feet are visible at the bottom of the composition. Both figures have large, circular golden halos behind their heads, intricately patterned with concentric circles and decorative motifs. The woman's halo contains faint, circular text, partially visible, which appears to include "AVE", "MARIA", "GRATIA", and "LUX". The background is entirely gold with subtle patterns. The painting is enclosed in a simple, textured gold frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: A circular painting shows the Madonna in blue holding the Christ Child against a gold background.
long_description: The artwork is a circular painting depicting two figures, a woman and a child, against a gold background. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of the center, wears a deep blue cloak draped over a red garment, with a green lining visible at her neck. Her head is covered by the blue cloak, and she has light skin, dark eyes, and a small mouth. A gold halo with radiating lines encircles her head, and two gold stars adorn her blue cloak, one on her right shoulder and one near her left elbow. She holds a child on her left arm, who is positioned to the left of the center. The child has light skin and reddish-brown hair, looking towards the viewer. He is partially covered by a red garment and a white cloth, with his right arm extended and his left hand holding the white cloth. A gold halo with radiating lines also encircles the child's head. The background is entirely gold, featuring intricate patterns of small circles and swirling lines. An inner border of gold with small dark green rectangular segments frames the central image, followed by a wider, textured gold outer frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: Madonna and Child enthroned, flanked by angels, against a gold background with radiating lines
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts the Madonna and Child seated on a white throne against a gold background. The Madonna, positioned centrally, wears a deep blue robe with a gold-trimmed neckline and cuffs, and a white veil covering her head and shoulders. Her face is pale with a somber expression, and her gaze is directed slightly downward and to the left. She holds the Christ Child on her left lap, supporting him with both hands. The Child is mostly nude, with a light pink drapery covering his lower body. His right hand is raised in a gesture, and his left hand holds a white scroll with the black letters "EGO" visible. He has light brown hair and a serious expression. The white throne has architectural details, including fluted columns and a patterned base. Behind the throne, on either side of the Madonna, are two angels with feathered wings and golden bodies, each with a gold halo. The gold background features radiating lines around the Madonna's head, suggesting a halo, and a decorative border along the arched top and sides of the panel. The bottom edge of the panel has a dark border with small gold decorative elements.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Cherubim

alt_text: Madonna and Child with saints and angels in a gold-framed arched panel painting
long_description: The image is an arched panel painting featuring a central group of the Madonna and Child, flanked by saints, with angels above, all against a gold background. In the center, the Madonna, wearing a dark blue mantle over a red garment, holds the Christ Child. Her head is tilted slightly towards the child, and her gaze is downcast. She has light skin and dark hair. The child, dressed in a light pink garment over a gold tunic, looks out towards the viewer. His right arm is around his mother's neck, and his left hand rests on her arm. Both figures have golden halos with intricate patterns. On the left side, below a small angel's head with feathered wings, a bearded man with long dark hair, wearing a red robe, looks towards the Madonna and Child. Below him, an older bearded man with white hair and a red robe has his hands clasped in prayer, also looking towards the center. Both have golden halos. On the right side, below another small angel's head, a young man in a brown monastic habit with a tonsure looks towards the Madonna and Child, his hands clasped in prayer. Below him, an older man with a bald head and a brown monastic habit also has his hands clasped in prayer, looking towards the center. Both also have golden halos. The entire background is gold, with a golden star visible on the Madonna's right shoulder. The painting is enclosed in a gold, ornate, arched frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Jerome, Bernardino, John the Baptist, and Anthony of Padua and Two Angels
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: Madonna and Child with saints and angels, depicted in a gold-leaf panel painting.
long_description: This vertical rectangular panel painting features a central Madonna and Child against an ornate gold background, surrounded by eight additional figures. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the right of center, wears a dark blue mantle draped over a red garment, with a white veil visible beneath her dark head covering. Her head is gently tilted towards the Child, whom she cradles in her left arm. Her eyes are downcast, and her expression is serene. The Child, dressed in a gold-patterned tunic, looks up at his mother, holding a small, dark bird in his left hand. Both the Madonna and Child have golden halos, with the Madonna's halo featuring inscribed text.The gold background is richly decorated with a repeating pattern of circles and text. Four angelic figures, depicted as heads and shoulders with light hair and golden halos, emerge from the top corners and center, looking down towards the central figures. On the left side, below the angels, are two male saints with halos. The upper saint has short dark hair and wears a dark habit. The lower saint has dark hair and a beard, holding a white scroll with the partial inscription "ELLE-N". On the right side, also below the angels, are two more male saints with halos. The upper saint is bald and wears a brown habit, while the lower saint has a long white beard, wears a red garment, and has his hands clasped in prayer. The Madonna's dark blue mantle is adorned with a gold starburst on her right shoulder. A small white label at the bottom center of the frame reads "SANO DI PIETRO".

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints John the Baptist, Jerome, Peter Martyr, and Bernardino and Four Angels
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: A multi-scene painting depicts a woman in bed, men writing, and women attending to a swaddled baby
long_description: This rectangular painting, set within a gold frame, depicts an interior scene with multiple figures. The composition is divided into two main sections by two white, fluted columns with gold capitals. On the left, a woman with a golden halo lies in a bed with a green blanket and a red headboard. She wears a blue garment with white stripes and a white head covering. Behind the bed, a white curtain with gold trim hangs. Below the bed, two men with halos are present. One, with a long white beard and a blue robe, sits on a wooden bench, actively writing on a scroll with a quill. The other man, also with a long white beard and a red robe, stands beside him, leaning in and gesturing towards the scroll. The right section features three women and a baby. A woman in a reddish-orange dress sits on the light pinkish-red floor, holding a swaddled baby with a golden halo. The baby is wrapped in white cloth. To her right, another woman in a green robe and white head covering kneels, holding a dark bowl. The background wall in this section is a plain reddish-orange on the left and a lighter greyish-blue on the right, with a dark, rectangular opening visible. At the bottom center of the painting, a small dark plaque with white text is affixed. The text reads: "S. GIOVANNI BATTISTA", "ZACCARIA SCRIVE", "IL NOME DEL FIGLIO".

metadata.title: The Birth and Naming of Saint John the Baptist
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: An old, bald man with a gold halo, wearing a brown robe, holds an ornate gold and red book against a blue background.
long_description: The painting depicts a bust-length portrait of an elderly man with a gold halo, set against a solid blue background. The man's head is mostly bald, with short, wispy white hair visible above his ears. His skin is light, and his face shows subtle wrinkles, particularly around his blue eyes and the corners of his downturned mouth. He wears a simple, hooded brown robe that covers his shoulders and chest. A circular gold halo, intricately patterned with small, raised circles, frames his head. The man holds a large, ornate book with both hands at chest level. The book has a prominent red border and a wide gold frame decorated with a repeating geometric pattern of interconnected circles. The central area of the book's cover is a deep blue, from which golden rays emanate outwards. At the center of this blue field is a large, stylized gold monogram "IHS" with a cross symbol positioned above the "H". Around the blue field, within the gold frame, are inscriptions in red capital letters. Visible text includes "IN NOMINE YHV" at the top, "OMNE GENV" on the right, "FLECTATVR CELESTIVM" at the bottom, and "TERRESTRI" on the left. The overall impression is of a solemn figure presenting a sacred text.

metadata.title: Saint Bernardino
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on wood (panel: 20 mm thick with vertical grain; cut along all four sides)

alt_text: A bald man in a brown robe with a halo holds a dark blue panel with a gold sunburst and "IHS" monogram
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a bald, elderly man from the chest up, set against a gold background. The man, positioned slightly to the right of the center, wears a simple, dark brown monastic robe that covers his shoulders and arms. His head is tilted slightly to his left, and his gaze is directed downwards and to his left. He has a somber expression, with visible wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes. A faint, circular gold halo with a patterned border surrounds his head. He holds a rectangular, dark blue panel with both hands, positioned centrally in front of his chest. The panel has a thin red border. On the dark blue surface, a radiant gold sunburst design emanates from a central circular motif. Within this circle, the gold letters "IHS" are prominently displayed, with a small cross above the "H". The sunburst has numerous wavy rays extending outwards. The gold background of the painting is textured with a subtle, repeating pattern along its edges, resembling a decorative border. The overall color palette is dominated by gold, dark brown, and dark blue, with accents of red.

metadata.title: Saint Bernardino
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: A man in a brown robe with a halo holds a red book and displays a wound on his hand against a gold background
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a man from the chest up against a gold background. The man has light brown hair and a beard, and a halo of gold circles surrounds his head. He wears a dark brown, hooded robe that covers most of his body. His head is slightly turned to his right, and his gaze is directed slightly downward and to his right. His right hand, positioned near the center of the painting, holds a piece of white cloth or paper, and a red mark resembling a wound is visible on the palm. His left hand, lower and to the right, holds a closed red book with a white spine. A red mark is also visible on the back of this hand. The gold background is textured and shows signs of age, with cracks and some darker spots. The man's figure fills most of the central space, with the gold background framing him on all sides.

metadata.title: Saint Francis
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: A painting of a woman in a blue mantle holding a child who grasps a bird, against a gold patterned background.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a woman holding a child against a gold background. The woman, positioned on the left, has pale skin with rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and a small mouth. She wears a dark blue mantle draped over her head and shoulders, revealing a white veil underneath. The mantle features a gold patterned border around her face and neck. Her right hand is raised with fingers slightly curled, while her left hand supports the child. The child, on the right, has pale skin, rosy cheeks, and light brown curly hair. He looks upwards and to the right with large dark eyes and a small mouth. He wears a red tunic with gold patterned sleeves and collar. In his left hand, he holds a small, light-colored bird. The background is entirely gold, featuring intricate embossed or painted patterns that form a halo around the woman's head and extend across the upper and right portions of the composition. These patterns include floral motifs and geometric designs.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.artist: Sano di Pietro (Ansano di Pietro di Mencio)

alt_text: Madonna and Child flanked by a bald man and veiled woman, within a gold arched frame.
long_description: This arched panel painting features four figures against a gold background, framed by a thick, ornate gold border. In the center, the Madonna, with pale skin and a serene expression, looks down and slightly to her right. She wears a black cloak over a red dress with gold trim, and a thin white veil under her cloak. A small, gold, six-pointed star adorns her left shoulder. She cradles the Christ Child, who has pale skin, reddish-gold curly hair, and wears a light-colored, loose garment. The Child looks directly forward, slightly to the left, with his right hand resting on the Madonna's left hand and his left hand on her right arm. To the Madonna's left, a bald man with a somber expression, dressed in a brown habit, looks towards the Child. His hands are clasped together. To the Madonna's right, a woman with a pale face and a white wimple covering her head and neck, wears a light brown habit. She holds a thin, dark branch in her hands and also looks towards the Child. The gold background behind the figures features a circular halo around the Madonna's head, inscribed with faint gold text that reads: "AVE MARIA GRACIA PLENA DOMINUS TECUM BENEDICTA TU IN MULIERIBUS ET BENEDICTUS FRUCTUS VENTRIS TUI IHESUS".

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Francis and Catherine of Siena

alt_text: A robed figure with a halo holds a tablet with a circular inscription against a gold, decorative background
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a robed figure centered against a gold background with raised decorative elements. The figure, facing slightly right and looking down, wears a dark brown hooded robe tied with a white rope at the waist. The figure has a bald head with short dark hair on the sides, light skin, dark eyes, and thin lips. A faint gold halo with radiating lines surrounds the figure's head. Both hands hold a rectangular tablet with a red frame. The tablet's central panel is dark blue or black, featuring a gold circular design. Within this design, the letters "IHS" are prominent in the center, with an "S" above, an "I" to the left, and an "S" to the right, all enclosed within a sunburst-like pattern. Below the central "IHS" are the letters "SIMI". The background is predominantly gold, showing visible cracking and texture. Raised, sculpted gold elements resembling stylized wings or foliage frame the figure on both sides, extending from the top corners down to the lower sides, appearing to emerge from a cloud-like base at the bottom.

metadata.title: Saint Bernardino
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, gold ground, pastiglia garland of fruit

alt_text: A painting of the Madonna holding the Christ Child, who reaches for a small red object on a gold background
long_description: The painting depicts the Madonna and Child within an arched, gilded frame. The background is entirely gold, featuring intricate patterns and a circular halo around the Madonna's head with visible text. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the right of the center, is shown from the waist up, looking down and to her left with a serene expression. She wears a dark blue mantle over a light-colored veil and a golden-yellow dress with a white ruffled neckline. The golden dress has a detailed, dark red and black embroidered pattern on the chest.
