Her left hand cradles the Christ Child, while her right hand holds a small, dark red, spherical object, possibly a fruit, which she offers to the child. The Christ Child sits on a small, ornate golden cushion on the Madonna's left hip, facing forward but looking towards his mother. He is mostly nude, with a light reddish-brown sash draped around his waist and left leg. His right arm is raised, reaching towards the red object in his mother's hand, while his left hand rests on her arm. A faint golden halo encircles his head. The gold background behind the Madonna's head features a circular inscription in capital letters: "AVE GRATIAPLENA DOMINUS TECUM." The outer edge of the arched frame is also intricately patterned with gold.

alt_text: A man in dark robes and a black hat stands against a textured gold background within an arched frame.
long_description: The artwork is a tall, narrow, vertical panel painting depicting a single male figure standing centrally against a gold background. The figure wears a long, dark brown or black robe that drapes in heavy folds, covering his body from neck to just above his feet. A small, dark red cross-like emblem is visible on the left side of his chest. On his head, he wears a flat-topped, dark brown or black hat. His face is turned slightly to the viewer's right, with his head tilted downwards. He has light brown hair visible beneath his hat, and his skin tone is light. His eyes are downcast, and his mouth is closed. His right hand is raised to his chest, partially obscured by the robe, while his left hand is visible holding a small, dark object, possibly a rosary or beads, near his waist. His bare feet are visible beneath the hem of his robe, resting on a reddish-brown ground. The background behind the figure is a textured gold, with two raised, pointed arches framing his head and upper body. The entire panel has a slightly worn appearance, with some areas of the gold background showing darker patina or wear.

metadata.title: The Blessed Andrea Gallerani (died 1251)
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: A robed figure with a tonsure holds a red book, standing within a golden arched niche.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a solitary figure, likely a monk, standing centrally within a tall, rectangular frame. The figure faces slightly to the viewer's left, with their head gently tilted downwards. They wear a dark, almost black, hooded robe that drapes over their body, revealing a lighter, off-white tunic underneath. The tunic falls in soft, vertical folds, extending to the bottom edge of the painting. The figure's head features a visible tonsure, with a shaved crown and short brown hair around the sides. Their skin is a medium tone, and their eyes are downcast. In their right hand, held against their chest, is a small, rectangular book with a bright red cover. The left hand is mostly obscured by the dark robe. The background is a textured, shimmering gold, featuring a prominent pointed archway that frames the upper body and head of the figure. The gold surface shows subtle variations in tone and texture. Below the figure's feet, the ground is a reddish-brown, textured area.

metadata.title: The Blessed Ambrogio Sansedoni (1220–1286)
metadata.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)

alt_text: Madonna and Child flanked by two figures on a gold background in an arched panel
long_description: An arched panel painting depicts the Madonna and Child centrally, flanked by two standing figures against a gold background. The Madonna, positioned slightly to the left of center, wears a dark blue cloak over an orange dress and a white veil. She has light skin and looks down towards the Child, who sits on her lap. The Child has light skin, light blonde hair, and wears a gold-colored tunic, reaching out with his left hand. Both the Madonna and Child have circular gold halos behind their heads. To the Madonna's left, a young woman with long, wavy reddish-brown hair and light skin holds a gold vessel in her hands, looking towards the Madonna. She wears a light-colored dress with vertical stripes. To the Madonna's right, a young man with light blonde, curly hair and light skin stands with a bare chest, holding an arrow in his left hand. Red marks are visible on his chest. He looks towards the Madonna. All figures are depicted with light skin tones. The background is entirely gold, with incised patterns forming the halos and a decorative border around the figures. The painting is set within a black outer frame and a gold inner frame.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Mary Magdalen and Sebastian
metadata.date: 15th century style, made in the late 19th to early 20th century

alt_text: A triangular panel painting depicts a crowned woman enthroned, holding a book and scepter, surrounded by six angels
long_description: The image is a triangular panel painting with a gold border. In the center, a crowned woman sits on a throne, holding a blue book and a thin scepter. She wears a pink tunic and a light cream-colored robe, with a golden crown on her head. A golden halo encircles her head, and golden rays emanate from behind her. She is enclosed within a prominent blue, almond-shaped mandorla. Six angels surround the central figure, arranged symmetrically. Two angels with golden halos are positioned at the bottom, one on the left and one on the right. They wear blue robes and have blue wings, lying horizontally and reaching their hands up towards the mandorla. Above these, two more angels with golden halos are positioned, one on each side, slightly higher and further out. They wear pink robes and have pink wings, also lying horizontally and looking towards the central figure. At the top corners of the triangular frame, two additional angels are visible, one on the far left and one on the far right. They wear green robes and have pink wings, looking towards the central figure. The background outside the mandorla is entirely gold, featuring a subtle patterned texture. The overall composition is highly symmetrical, centered on the enthroned woman.

alt_text: A tall, pointed panel painting depicts the Madonna in dark green holding the Christ Child in gold
long_description: This tall, pointed panel painting features the Madonna and Child seated on an ornate throne against a gold background. The panel tapers to a sharp point at the top, where a small, stylized finial is visible. The background is primarily gold, with a repeating pattern of green and red geometric shapes forming an archway around the figures. The Madonna is seated centrally, facing slightly to her right, with her head tilted towards the Christ Child. She wears a dark green mantle draped over a red gown, with a lighter green veil covering her hair. A gold halo encircles her head. Her left arm supports the Child, while her right hand gently touches his left arm. Her expression is serene, with downcast eyes. The Christ Child is held in the Madonna's lap, facing her. He is depicted as an infant, wrapped in a gold garment with dark green stripes. A gold halo also surrounds his head. His right arm is raised towards his mother's face, and his left arm rests on her chest. His gaze is directed towards her. The throne on which they sit is gold, with red accents on the armrests and a patterned green fabric visible behind the Madonna. The base of the panel features a dark brown border with small, repeating decorative motifs, including quatrefoils.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, transferred to canvas and laid down on wood, gold ground

alt_text: A medieval painting depicts the Nativity scene with Mary, Joseph, baby Jesus, angels, shepherds, and animals.
long_description: A vertically oriented painting depicts a Nativity scene within a golden frame. In the upper center, a simple wooden stable structure with a dark roof houses the main figures. On the left, a kneeling woman, dressed in a dark blue cloak over a red garment, gently holds a baby wrapped in white cloth, who rests in a rectangular wooden manger. Both figures have prominent golden halos. Above them, two small angels with red wings and golden halos hover, looking down. To the right of the manger, a bearded man in a pinkish-red robe kneels, his hands clasped, gazing towards the baby. He also has a golden halo. The background features undulating green and brown hills under a golden sky. In the lower left, a brown ox and a donkey lie on the light green ground, with a small brown dog standing nearby. Below the kneeling man, another angel with red wings and a green tunic appears to be descending or flying, also with a golden halo. In the lower right, two figures, likely shepherds, stand in brown and dark red cloaks, looking upwards.

alt_text: A kneeling woman in blue and red gazes at a baby on the ground, with a city and ruins in the background
long_description: The painting depicts a kneeling woman and a baby in a landscape setting. In the foreground, a woman with light skin kneels on a patch of dark green ground, her hands clasped in prayer. She wears a deep blue cloak draped over a red dress, and a light pink veil covers her head, framing her downcast face. A faint halo is visible above her head. To her left, a nude baby with light skin lies on its back on a red cloth, its arms raised and legs bent. The baby's gaze is directed upwards. Behind the figures, a detailed landscape unfolds under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. To the left, a fortified city with light-colored stone walls and towers sits beside a winding river. A multi-arched bridge spans the river, leading to more distant buildings and hills. To the right, partially ruined stone structures, appearing as a stack of large blocks, rise behind the kneeling woman. The ground in the foreground is a dark green with small, light-colored dots, suggesting vegetation.

alt_text: A painting depicts three haloed figures in a room with a gold background, one kneeling, two standing.
long_description: A rectangular painting features three haloed figures within an architectural setting, set against a gold background. On the left, a figure with a golden halo kneels on a dark green floor, facing right. This figure wears a long, flowing pink robe with long sleeves and has hands extended forward. To the far left, a light-colored architectural element with an arched opening is visible. In the center, a light-colored, box-like structure with a red, sloped roof-like top stands. Its interior floor is dark with a subtle patterned design, and a dark, bell-shaped object hangs from its upper center. On the right, two figures stand on a dark green floor, facing left. The taller figure, on the far right, wears a long blue cloak over a red garment and has a golden halo. Their right hand is extended towards the smaller figure. The smaller figure, a child, stands in front of the taller figure, wearing a green tunic and also having a golden halo. The child's hands are open and slightly raised. In the upper right section of the central structure, a smaller, framed image is visible, depicting a blue-robed figure holding a child, both with halos. The background behind the standing figures and above the architectural elements is entirely gold, featuring a patterned border along the top edge.

metadata.title: The Vision of Saint Catherine of Alexandria

alt_text: A standing young man with a halo holds a green book within a golden arched frame.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a standing young man within an ornate golden architectural frame. The figure, positioned centrally, faces slightly to the viewer's right with his head tilted down. He has light brown hair and a circular golden halo with radiating lines behind his head. He wears a long-sleeved red tunic visible at his arms and lower legs, covered by a flowing, light-colored (possibly off-white or pale pink) cloak draped over his left shoulder, across his body, and around his lower half. His bare feet are visible at the very bottom of the panel. In his left hand, he holds a closed, rectangular green book against his chest, with his right hand also resting on it. The background behind the figure is entirely gold, featuring a subtle patterned design. He stands on a green platform. The figure is enclosed within a tall, arched, Gothic-style niche, which is also gold and features intricate decorative carvings along its inner arch. The outer frame of the panel is gold with a twisted rope-like pattern along its inner edge. At the very bottom of the golden frame, below the green platform, the inscription "S. PHILIPPUS S." is visible in raised gold letters.

alt_text: A standing male figure with a halo, holding a staff and a book, within a gilded, ornate arch.
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a full-length standing male figure. The figure has light brown, wavy hair and a short, dark beard, framed by a circular, golden halo with radiating lines. He wears a long, flowing orange tunic, a pink outer garment draped over his left shoulder and arm, and a green sash across his chest. His left hand holds a tall, slender staff that extends from the bottom of the panel to his shoulder. His right hand holds a closed, rectangular red book with gold detailing. The figure stands on a patch of green ground. Behind his head, a pointed, gilded arch with a quatrefoil pattern frames the upper part of the figure. The arch is set within a larger, rectangular wooden panel, which has a raised, gilded border with a repeating leaf motif along the sides of the figure. The overall color palette is rich with gold, pink, orange, and green tones.

metadata.title: A Saint, Possibly James the Greater

alt_text: A gold-framed altarpiece depicts Christ crucified, surrounded by mourning figures, angels, and saints in side panels.
long_description: A multi-panel altarpiece with a central crucifixion scene is set within an ornate gold frame. The central panel depicts a pale-skinned Christ on a wooden cross, wearing a white loincloth. Blood drips from his hands, feet, and side. Above his head, a white banner reads "INRI" in red letters, and a white dove hovers at the very top. Four small, winged angels, two on each side, float near Christ's body, holding small chalices to catch the dripping blood. Below the cross, a crowd of figures gathers. On the left, a group of women, some with halos, are depicted in various states of grief; one woman in a dark blue robe is embraced by others in pink and red garments. On the right, a group of men, some bearded and wearing hats or crowns, observe the scene. One man in a blue robe and red hat raises his right arm towards Christ. A woman in a long red dress kneels at the base of the cross, looking up. The central scene is flanked by two vertical columns, each containing three smaller arched panels. The left column features three figures, all with halos and dressed in red or orange robes, with various hand gestures. The right column also contains three figures with halos; the top and bottom figures wear blue robes with hands clasped in prayer, while the middle figure wears a gold and white robe, also with hands clasped. The entire background of the altarpiece is a shimmering gold.

alt_text: A detail of a gilded altarpiece showing a red-robed angel with a halo and an ornate gold panel
long_description: The image captures a section of an old, multi-layered gilded altarpiece. On the left, a heavily worn, dark gold frame with visible cracks and chips runs vertically. To its right is a rectangular panel with an arched top, featuring a painted figure. This figure, an angel, is depicted from the chest up, facing slightly right with a serene expression. The angel wears a long, flowing red robe with a gold-colored trim around the neck and a gold sash forming an 'X' across the chest. Its hands are crossed over the chest. A circular, golden halo with intricate dotted and patterned designs surrounds the angel's head. The background of this panel is a rich gold, also featuring subtle embossed or painted patterns. To the right of the angel panel, another section of the altarpiece is visible, primarily gold. This section includes a prominent quatrefoil shape with a diamond in its center, rendered in raised gold relief. Below the angel panel, a small portion of another arched panel is visible, showing a hand holding a dark cross.

alt_text: A gold-framed Nativity scene depicts Mary and Joseph adoring baby Jesus, with animals and shepherds nearby.
long_description: This rectangular painting, framed by a decorative gold border with a central arch at the top, depicts a Nativity scene. In the lower center, a naked baby Jesus lies horizontally on a bed of straw, radiating bright golden light, with a golden halo around his head. To the left, Mary kneels, facing right towards Jesus, with her hands clasped in prayer. She wears a blue cloak over a light pink garment and has a golden halo. Behind her are dark, rocky formations. Directly behind Jesus, under a simple wooden shelter, two animals, an ox and a donkey, peer over a wooden manger, looking down at the baby. To the right, Joseph kneels, facing left towards Jesus, with his head tilted downwards. He wears a red cloak over a green garment and has a golden halo. In the upper right, three figures, likely shepherds, are depicted in a rocky landscape, looking upwards. Above them, an angel with wings and a golden halo hovers, radiating golden light. The background features dark brown and grey tones for the rocks and stable interior. The figures are highlighted by golden light, particularly Jesus, Mary, Joseph, and the angel. The gold frame has a textured, dotted pattern along its edges.

alt_text: A painting depicts Christ crucified on a cross, flanked by two grieving figures, within an ornate gold frame.
long_description: A tall, narrow panel painting, set within an elaborate gold frame, depicts a crucifixion scene. The frame features a pointed, triangular top adorned with intricate carved details, transitioning into an arched opening for the main image. In the center, Christ is depicted on a dark brown cross, his body a pale greenish hue, with a lean physique and a white loincloth. Blood drips from his hands, feet, and a wound on his right side. A golden halo encircles his head. Above his head, a red plaque with white capital letters reads "INRI". To the left of the cross, a woman in a dark blue hooded cloak and white undergarment sits on a grey rocky outcrop, her head bowed and hands clasped. A golden halo surrounds her head. To the right, a younger man in a flowing pink robe sits on another grey rocky outcrop. His left hand is raised with fingers slightly splayed, and his right hand rests on his lap. He also has a golden halo. The background behind the figures and the cross is a shimmering gold, while the ground beneath them is rocky and grey, with visible red bloodstains around the base of the cross.

metadata.title: The Crucified Christ between the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist

alt_text: Two male figures, one with a scroll and cross staff, the other writing in a book, on a gold background
long_description: The vertical rectangular painting depicts two full-length male figures standing side-by-side against a gold background. Above each figure's head, the gold background is interrupted by a light blue and dark blue arched decorative element, with a faint circular halo around each head. The gold background below these arches is patterned with small, dark, irregular shapes, resembling scattered leaves or debris. The figure on the left has dark, unkempt hair and a beard. He wears a dark, short-sleeved tunic made of what appears to be animal skin, revealing his chest and arms. A red cloak is draped over his left shoulder and around his waist, extending to his bare feet. He holds a long, thin staff with a small cross at the top in his right hand, resting it on the ground. In his left hand, he holds a partially unrolled white scroll with dark, legible text that reads "ECCE. AGNU. DEI." He points with his right index finger towards the right. The figure on the right has a bald head with a small blue jewel-like object on top, and a long, flowing white beard and mustache. He wears a light orange tunic with a dark blue cloak draped over it, edged with gold trim. His bare feet are visible below the cloak. He is depicted in the act of writing in a dark book with a gold-patterned cover, holding a quill in his right hand and the book in his left. His gaze is directed downwards towards the book. Both figures have light skin tones.

metadata.title: Saints John the Baptist and Matthew

alt_text: A multi-panel religious painting depicting the Madonna and Child surrounded by saints, with scenes of the Crucifixion and Nativity.
long_description: This triptych features three panels with pointed tops, the central panel being taller and wider than the two hinged side panels. Many scenes are set against a gold background. The central panel's upper section depicts the Madonna and Child. Mary, in a blue robe and red dress, holds baby Jesus, who wears an orange robe. Both have halos. They are surrounded by four haloed male figures, two on each side, dressed in various colored robes including yellow, blue, and red. Above them, four small angels with red wings emerge from golden clouds. The lower section of the central panel shows a Nativity scene. Mary, in a blue robe, kneels beside a wooden crib containing baby Jesus. Joseph, in a maroon robe, sits on the right. A donkey and an ox are visible behind the crib, all within a rocky cave setting with green foliage. The left panel is divided into three horizontal sections. The top section shows a figure in a pink robe, possibly an angel, in the sky holding a long, thin object. The middle section portrays the Crucifixion, with Jesus on the cross. Below him, four figures stand: two in blue robes and two in red/maroon robes. The letters "INRI" are visible above the cross. The bottom section features a haloed figure standing in a sarcophagus, surrounded by several other figures, some with halos, against a blue background. The right panel is also divided into three horizontal sections. The top section shows a woman in a blue robe seated on a bed in a room, reading a book. The middle section presents two standing male figures with halos. The figure on the left is nude except for a white loincloth, while the figure on the right wears a dark brown monastic habit. The bottom section depicts a figure in a brown robe kneeling over a small, haloed figure lying on the ground in a rocky landscape with green trees and a small building.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints Peter, Bartholomew, Catherine of Alexandria, and Paul, and (below) the Nativity; left wing (top to bottom): Annunciatory Angel, Crucified Christ with the Virgin, Saints Mary Magdalen and John, and Christ as the Man of Sorrows; right wing (top to bottom): Virgin Annunciate, Saints Onophrius and Paphnutius, and Saint Onophrius Buried by Saint Paphnutius.
metadata.artist: Tommaso del Mazza|Master of Santa Verdiana|Matteo di Pacino

alt_text: A full-length painting of a bearded man in dark robes with a golden halo, pointing downwards.
long_description: The artwork is a tall, narrow, vertical panel painting depicting a full-length male figure. The man stands centrally, facing slightly to his left, with his gaze directed forward. He has a dark, full beard and short, dark hair, and a golden halo with small black dots encircles his head. His skin tone is light brown. He wears a dark, olive-green tunic under a voluminous, dark blue-gray cloak that drapes around his body, creating deep folds. His left hand, with long, slender fingers, points downwards towards the lower left. His right hand is mostly obscured by the cloak, but it appears to hold a dark, rectangular object, possibly a book, tucked under his arm. The background behind his head features a light pink archway set within a gray rectangular frame. Below the archway, the background is a muted, light brown-gray. The lower portion of the panel shows a horizontal band of light pink, beneath which is a wider band of light gray. The entire panel is framed by a thin, dark brown border.

alt_text: A robed figure with a golden halo holds a book and rosary, while a small black devil tugs at their robe.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical panel painting depicting a full-length figure standing within a shallow architectural niche. The central figure is a man, shown in profile facing left, with light skin and short, light brown hair. He wears a simple, light beige or off-white hooded robe that covers his entire body down to his ankles. A golden halo, intricately detailed with small raised dots, encircles his head. His left hand holds a dark green or black book against his chest, while his right hand holds a long, brown rosary with a cross, which drapes over his arm. His bare feet, with visible toes, rest on a light pinkish-brown platform. To the lower left of the figure, a small, black, horned devil with red eyes and sharp claws stands on its hind legs, tugging at the hem of the figure's robe with one clawed hand. The devil has a pointed tail. The background consists of a plain, light purplish-brown wall with a recessed arched opening behind the figure's head. Below the platform, a small rectangular opening reveals a faint, glowing light. The overall palette is muted, with the golden halo and the devil's red eyes providing small points of contrast.

alt_text: An angel with golden wings and a halo guides a young boy with a red cloak through a landscape.
long_description: The painting depicts two figures walking across a landscape under a light blue sky. On the left, a tall, winged figure, presumably an angel, faces right and holds the hand of a smaller boy. The angel has light blonde hair, a golden halo, and large golden wings. They wear a long, light-colored tunic with a patterned hem and red hose. In their left hand, the angel holds a small, dark, fish-like object. The boy, to the right of the angel, also has light blonde hair and a smaller golden halo. He wears a blue tunic, a flowing red cloak, and red hose, and carries a light-colored staff or sword in his right hand. Both figures are walking towards the right, with their gazes directed forward and slightly downward. The ground beneath them is a mottled brown and green. In the lower center, a small, light-colored, four-legged animal, possibly a dog or weasel, walks on the ground. The background features a rolling landscape with green hills, scattered dark green trees, and faint indications of buildings under a pale blue sky. The overall color palette is muted, with earthy tones dominating the landscape and brighter accents on the figures' clothing and halos.

alt_text: An angel with wings and a halo walks beside a young man holding a fish, under a dark, starry sky
long_description: The painting depicts two figures walking from left to right against a dark, starry background. The figure on the left is an angel, characterized by a golden halo around its head and large, reddish-brown wings extending behind its back. The angel has brown, curly hair and looks downwards and slightly to the right. It wears a long, reddish-brown tunic with a dark belt and dark boots, and a yellow cloak is draped over its left shoulder. In its left hand, the angel holds a small, golden, bowl-like object. To the right and slightly behind the angel is a young man with blond hair, looking upwards towards the angel. He wears a dark blue or black tunic with a white collar and red sleeves, over a striped, skirt-like garment in shades of grey and white. His feet are bare. In his left hand, he carries a large, light-colored fish, holding it horizontally. His right hand is positioned near the angel's left hand. The background features a dark sky with numerous small, star-like bursts of light. A faint, dark landscape is visible behind the figures. The ground beneath them is dark and uneven, with a small, light-colored animal, possibly a pig, visible in the lower right corner. The entire scene is contained within a visible, rough wooden frame.

alt_text: Madonna breastfeeding a baby while another child with a staff observes, against a patterned background and landscape
long_description: A Renaissance-style painting depicts three figures in the foreground against a divided background. In the center, a woman with fair skin, light brown hair, and a translucent veil looks down with a somber expression. She wears a deep blue cloak draped over a red dress, which is open at the chest to reveal her breast. A thin gold halo encircles her head. She cradles a plump, fair-skinned baby with light blond curly hair, who is actively breastfeeding from her left breast. The baby's body is partially covered by a sheer white cloth, and its left hand rests on the woman's breast. To the left of the woman, slightly behind her, stands a young child with fair skin and short brown hair. This child looks towards the breastfeeding baby with a serious expression, holding a slender staff topped with a small cross in their left hand. Their hands are clasped together in front of them, and they wear a simple brown garment. The background directly behind the woman is a rich gold fabric with an intricate, dark patterned design. To the far right, a narrow vertical section reveals a distant landscape with green rolling hills, scattered trees, and jagged light-colored mountains under a pale blue sky. The left background behind the standing child is dark and indistinct.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist
metadata.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood

alt_text: An angel kneels before a woman in a detailed architectural interior, holding a lily.
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in an architectural interior, framed by a reddish-brown border. The scene is divided by a prominent grey column in the center. On the left, an angel with large, light-colored wings kneels on a reddish-brown and light-colored tiled floor. The angel wears a flowing cream-colored robe with reddish-brown sleeves and holds a slender white lily stem in its left hand, with its head bowed. Behind the angel, a hallway with receding grey columns and dark ceilings leads to two arched windows revealing a faint, light-colored landscape. Thin, light rays descend towards the angel's head. On the right, a woman kneels on a similar raised platform, facing the angel. She wears a dark teal robe and a white head covering, with her head bowed and hands clasped, holding a small red object. Behind her, a bed with a white canopy and a wooden cabinet filled with books are visible. A white curtain hangs from the ceiling on the right side of the composition. The floor tiles create a sense of depth, and the overall color palette is muted with accents of red and teal.

alt_text: A busy street scene with multiple figures, horses, and buildings, depicting various interactions and a marriage.
long_description:
The rectangular painting depicts a complex street scene with multiple figures and architectural elements. The composition is divided into several narrative sections across a horizontal plane. On the left, a building with a red brick facade features an open doorway on an upper level, where a woman in a light-colored dress interacts with another figure. Below, a man in a dark cloak and hat, labeled "SESTO," stands on a platform with stairs leading down. At the bottom left, several men, some on horseback, are gathered, including a man on a dark horse and another on a white horse with gold trappings. A dark-skinned boy stands near the white horse. Above the red brick wall, a large arched window reveals a scene with two figures in a bed, labeled "SEU" and "LVA."

In the center foreground, two bearded men, one in a gold robe with a halo and the other in a dark robe, stand facing each other and shaking hands. Behind them, a woman in a dark dress stands in an open doorway. To their right, a woman in a white patterned dress stands on a low, light-colored block inscribed "ANARETA." She extends her hand towards a man on a white horse, who wears a red and gold hat and cloak and is labeled "STO." This man is accompanied by several other figures, some holding spears, and another man on a dark horse. The background on the right shows a narrow street with tall, dark buildings. The artwork uses a palette of reds, browns, golds, and light blues.

alt_text: A crowded narrative painting depicting figures gathered around a bed and other people standing before elaborate buildings.
long_description: A rectangular painting depicts a bustling narrative scene with numerous figures and architectural elements. On the left, a multi-story building with arched windows and a light-colored facade rises. In front of it, a group of figures, including one in a flowing orange robe and another in white, stand near a bed. A figure lies on the bed, covered by a white sheet, with the word "DAPHNE" visible in gold lettering on the bed's side. Behind the bed, a cluster of people, some with elaborate headwear and richly patterned garments, observe the scene. A prominent older man with a long white beard and a golden crown wears a robe with "DAVID" inscribed in gold on it. A solitary figure, cloaked in dark brown, sits on the ground in front of the bed, facing away from the viewer. On the right, a grand building features a red, domed roof, a triangular pediment with a small bust, and a portico with tall, light-colored columns. Beneath this structure, a group of men in varied, colorful attire, including red hats, patterned tunics, and leggings, stand facing left. The overall palette includes muted reds, oranges, golds, browns, and whites, set against a backdrop of light-colored buildings and a greenish-blue sky.

alt_text: An angel kneels before a woman in a classical courtyard with arches, columns, and distant buildings.
long_description: The painting depicts two figures in a detailed architectural setting under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the upper background, a building with a red-tiled roof and grey walls features arched windows and small square openings. Three tall, slender dark green cypress trees rise above the roofline. A white dove with outstretched wings flies in the upper left sky. The midground features a cloister with grey arches supported by white columns with ornate gold capitals. A second white dove flies under one of the central arches. The floor is covered with a geometric tile pattern in white, brown, and red. On the left, an angel kneels on its right knee, facing right. It has long, wavy reddish-brown hair and a gold halo. The angel wears a long, flowing green robe with visible red sleeves and large red wings with dark tips extending behind it. Its left hand holds a slender green branch with small white flowers, while its right hand is raised with an open palm and extended fingers. On the right, a woman stands on a small, ornate brown and gold platform, facing left. She has long, wavy reddish-brown hair and wears a long, dark teal cloak draped over a red dress. She holds a small red book in her hands, looking down at it. The figures are positioned in the lower half of the painting, with the architecture providing a sense of depth and enclosure.

alt_text: A gilded altarpiece depicts a crowned Madonna holding the Christ Child with a goldfinch, flanked by two kneeling figures.
long_description: This vertical painting is set within an elaborate, carved gold frame. The frame features twisted columns on the sides, an arched top with intricate acanthus leaf and geometric patterns, and a decorated base. The central panel depicts a woman seated, holding a child on her lap, against a shimmering gold background. The woman, positioned slightly to the right of center, wears a dark blue mantle with gold patterns over a pink garment. Her head is gently tilted, and she looks downwards. A gold halo encircles her head, and a gold crown rests on her veil. The child, seated on the woman's left leg, wears a gold tunic with red trim and also has a gold halo. The child's right arm is raised with an open palm, while the left hand holds a small black and white bird, a goldfinch, which the woman's right hand also touches. In the gold background, faint architectural forms resembling towers or buildings are visible in the upper corners. At the bottom of the main panel, two smaller figures kneel on either side of the woman's feet. The figure on the left wears a red robe, while the figure on the right wears a dark monastic habit and has hands clasped in prayer. Both kneeling figures look upwards towards the central figures.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Two Donors

alt_text: A religious panel painting depicts a woman and two figures near a bound man, against a golden background.
long_description: A vertical rectangular panel painting features a religious scene with multiple figures and architectural elements against a heavily textured, worn golden background. On the left, a tall, slender woman in a dark, long-sleeved robe stands under a red-tiled arched structure. She has a golden halo around her head and holds a small white object in her hands, which are clasped at her waist. To her immediate left, partially visible, are other figures with golden halos. The central and right portions of the painting are dominated by a large, dark architectural structure with two arches and a domed, ribbed roof. Through the arches, the golden background is visible. Below the arches, a bare-chested man is tied to a central red column, his arms bound above his head and his legs bound at the ankles. He faces right, with his head tilted downwards. To his left, a man in a brown tunic looks up at the bound figure. To the bound man's right, another man in a dark tunic stands with his head covered. The ground beneath the figures is a dark green. The golden background shows significant signs of wear and flaking throughout the panel.

alt_text: A painting depicts multiple haloed figures mourning over a deceased body, with angels above a dark mountain
long_description:
The artwork is a vertical rectangular panel depicting a scene with multiple figures against a gold background. In the upper section, two small, winged figures with red garments and golden halos fly in the top left and right corners, facing inward. Between them, a dark, stepped, and jagged mountain formation rises from the center. The gold background shows signs of wear and dark discoloration.

Below the mountain, a central group of seven figures surrounds a recumbent body. The deceased, depicted with pale skin and a white loincloth, lies horizontally on a dark, rectangular sarcophagus or tomb. A figure with dark hair, a red garment, and a golden halo cradles the deceased's head, looking down. To their right, another figure in a dark blue garment and a golden halo supports the deceased's torso. To the left, a bearded figure in a red garment and a golden halo also supports the body.

Further to the left, a figure with a golden halo and a green garment kneels beside the sarcophagus, holding the deceased's feet. To the far right, a figure in a red garment and a golden halo stands or kneels, looking down at the deceased. Another figure with a golden halo is partially visible behind the central group. All figures have golden halos. The overall palette features deep reds, blues, greens, and dark browns, contrasted with the gold background and pale skin tones. The edges of the panel are worn and discolored.

alt_text: A woman in a blue cloak holds a child, framed by a garland, against a detailed landscape
long_description: The painting depicts a woman holding a child, positioned behind a stone ledge, with an expansive landscape in the background. The woman, likely the Madonna, is shown from the waist up, wearing a dark blue cloak over a brown dress, and a white veil covering her head. A golden halo encircles her head. Her face is fair, with a solemn expression, and her eyes are cast downwards towards the child. She cradles the child with both hands. The child, likely Jesus, is depicted as a plump infant, wearing a red cap and a white tunic with a red skirt. The child's right hand is raised with two fingers extended, while the left hand rests on the woman's arm. The child's bare legs and feet are visible below the skirt. Above the figures, a green garland adorned with red ribbons and orange, lantern-shaped fruits stretches across the upper portion of the canvas. The background features a detailed landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. To the left, a city with numerous tall, light-colored buildings and towers is nestled among green hills, with winding paths visible. To the right, a calm body of water reflects the sky, bordered by rolling green hills and a distant settlement or castle. On the stone ledge in the foreground, a green, elongated, gourd-like fruit with two leaves rests on the left, and a small, round, orange fruit is placed on the right.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child
metadata.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood

alt_text: A golden Gothic altarpiece with a central Madonna and Child flanked by smaller narrative panels
long_description: This is a multi-paneled altarpiece, predominantly gold, featuring a large central panel flanked by two vertical columns of smaller panels. The ornate gold frame has pointed arches, spires, and intricate Gothic tracery. The central panel depicts the Madonna and Child seated on a patch of green ground with a dense cluster of dark green trees behind them. The Madonna wears a red dress and a dark, elaborately patterned gold cloak, a gold crown, and a gold halo. She holds the Child, who wears a light purple garment and has a gold halo, on her lap. The Child reaches out with both hands. To the Madonna's left, a kneeling figure in a dark brown habit with a white wimple looks up at her. Above, two pairs of winged angels with halos fly in the golden sky. The left column contains two smaller panels. The top-left panel shows an angel in a pink robe kneeling before a figure in a blue robe, both with gold halos, in a garden setting with a building on the left. The bottom-left panel depicts a woman in a blue robe kneeling before a baby in a manger, with a man in a red robe and an animal nearby, all within a stable-like structure. The right column also contains two smaller panels. The top-right panel shows a woman in a blue robe kneeling at a prayer desk in a room with a red bed in the background. The bottom-right panel features a woman in a blue robe holding a deceased figure, both resting on a blue cloth, against a landscape background with hills and a golden sky.

metadata.title: The Madonna of Humility, the Annunciation, the Nativity, and the Pietà

alt_text: A painting of the Madonna and Child seated on a throne under an ornate arch adorned with golden fruit.
long_description: The vertical painting depicts the Madonna and Child seated on a throne within an ornate architectural setting. The Madonna, positioned centrally, faces forward with her head slightly tilted to her right, looking downwards. She has light skin and her light hair is covered by a white veil. A golden halo with radiating lines encircles her head. She wears a dark green gown with intricate gold patterns, revealing red sleeves at her wrists. A jeweled brooch adorns her chest. Her left arm supports the nude Child, who sits on her lap, facing forward with his head tilted slightly to his left, looking outwards. The Child also has light skin and a small golden halo. His right arm is around the Madonna's neck, and his left arm rests on her lap. The figures are seated on a stone throne with a multi-faceted, star-shaped base. The top surface of the base features a checkered pattern of dark brown and light brown squares. The sides of the base are carved with decorative motifs. Behind the figures, an elaborate golden architectural structure forms an arched canopy. Two columns flank the Madonna and Child. Above the arch and on either side, branches laden with large, round, light orange or yellow fruits, possibly quinces or pomegranates, hang down. Clusters of these fruits are visible at the top left, top right, lower left, and lower right of the archway. The overall background is a warm, golden-brown hue.

alt_text: A man with a halo looks upward, holding an unfurled scroll with illegible writing, pointing a finger up
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a man from the chest up, positioned against a gold background. The man, with light brown skin and short dark brown hair, occupies the central and lower portion of the frame. His head is tilted slightly upward and to the right, with his eyes rolled back, looking towards the upper right corner, and his mouth slightly open. A golden halo, adorned with a pattern of small circles and dots, encircles his head. He wears a light-colored tunic with a dark trim at the neck, and an ochre-colored cloak draped over his left shoulder and arm. His right arm is bent, with the index finger pointing upwards towards the upper left. His left hand holds a partially unfurled scroll that extends downwards. The scroll displays multiple lines of dark, handwritten text in an old, stylized script, which is not clearly legible. The background is a solid gold color, showing some surface cracking. The figure's posture and gaze suggest a moment of contemplation or inspiration.

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in a white head covering and dark dress against a landscape with a lake and hills
long_description: The painting depicts a portrait of a young woman, shown from the chest up, against a landscape background. She is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing left in profile, with her gaze directed forward. Her skin is fair, and her cheeks have a light rosy tone. She has light-colored eyes, a small nose, and her lips are closed. Her hair is completely covered by a white, draped head covering that wraps around her head and neck, forming soft folds. She wears a dark, possibly black, garment that exposes her shoulders. A lighter, possibly white, fabric is visible beneath the dark garment on her right shoulder and arm. The background features a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds in the upper half. Below the sky, a serene landscape unfolds. Rolling green hills with darker green trees are visible in the middle ground, extending across the width of the painting. A body of water, likely a lake or river, occupies the lower left and central portions of the background, reflecting the sky and surrounding landscape. On the left side of the water, a small, light-colored building with a reddish roof is situated on what appears to be a small island or peninsula. The overall impression is one of calm and natural beauty.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman, Possibly a Nun of San Secondo; (verso) Scene in Grisaille
metadata.medium: Oil on wood; (verso: oil and gold on wood)

alt_text: A portrait painting of a man in a black hat and coat, seen in profile against a blue sky and landscape
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a half-length portrait of a man in profile, facing right. The man occupies the left half of the canvas, with his head and shoulders prominent against a landscape background. He has light-toned skin, a prominent nose, and full lips, with a slight double chin. His brown, shoulder-length hair is full and visible beneath a simple, rounded black hat that sits low on his forehead. He wears a plain, high-collared black garment that covers his torso and arms, with no discernible details or embellishments. The background is divided horizontally. The upper two-thirds feature a bright blue sky, which lightens slightly towards the horizon. A few soft white clouds are visible on the right side of the sky. The lower third of the background is a landscape. On the left, a body of dark blue water extends to the horizon, with a small white sailboat visible in the distance. On the right, a stretch of green land with small trees and distant, indistinct buildings is depicted. A light-colored, textured band, possibly representing a stone ledge or parapet, runs across the bottom edge of the painting, separating the viewer from the depicted scene.

metadata.title: Portrait of Alvise Contarini(?); (verso) A Tethered Roebuck
metadata.medium: Oil on wood; verso: oil and gold on wood

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling Venetian canal with numerous boats, grand buildings, and a tall bell tower under a cloudy sky
long_description: This panoramic painting depicts a wide, bustling canal scene in a European city under a light blue sky with scattered white and grey clouds. The foreground and midground are dominated by dark blue-green water filled with numerous boats. On the left, several larger sailing vessels with white sails are docked, their masts reaching towards the sky. The majority of the boats are smaller, dark-hulled gondola-like vessels, many featuring small cabins or striped awnings, and are occupied by small figures rowing or standing. The far bank of the canal is lined with grand, light-tan stone buildings. On the far left, a multi-story building with a domed roof and numerous rectangular windows is visible. Adjacent to it, a large building with arched ground-floor windows and several upper stories stands. Dominating the central composition is a very tall, square bell tower, or campanile, with a pointed spire, rising high above the surrounding structures. To its right, two tall columns topped with statues mark the entrance to a large, open square filled with many small figures. In the background of the square, more buildings with domes and arches are visible. On the far right, a large, ornate palace features two levels of open arched loggias, topped by a more solid upper story with decorative windows and a crenellated roofline. The entire scene is populated by numerous small figures on land and in the boats, suggesting a busy urban environment.

metadata.title: The Molo, Venice, from the Bacino di San Marco

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling harbor with numerous boats, people, and prominent buildings under a cloudy sky.
long_description: This panoramic painting depicts a bustling harbor scene under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground is dominated by a wide expanse of greenish-blue water filled with numerous boats of various sizes. On the left, several large sailing ships with tall masts and rigging are visible, some with sails furled. Smaller, flat-bottomed boats and gondola-like vessels are scattered across the water, many occupied by figures engaged in various activities, such as rowing, loading, and conversing. On the right side of the composition, a substantial stone building with a tall, square tower rises prominently. The tower features a domed top, a golden sphere, and a small, dark figure at its apex. The building's facade below the tower has arched windows and classical architectural elements. Extending to the right from this structure is a long, reddish-brown wall with smaller windows and doorways, along which numerous figures are gathered on the quay. Many smaller boats are moored along this quay, some covered with dark tarpaulins. In the mid-ground, across the water, a large, light-colored classical building with a prominent central dome and a columned portico is visible. To its left, a tall, slender bell tower stands against the sky. Further in the distance, more indistinct buildings and a bridge can be seen. The sky above is a mix of light blue and large, soft white and grey clouds, with hints of pinkish-orange near the horizon on the left.

metadata.title: The Bacino, Venice, with the Dogana and a Distant View of the Isola di San Giorgio

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling city square with a tall tower, a domed cathedral, and arcaded buildings filled with people.
long_description: A panoramic oil painting depicts a wide, open city square bustling with numerous figures under a partly cloudy sky. The square, paved in light brown and tan tones, stretches from the foreground into the distance. On the left, a long, multi-story building with a series of arched arcades on its lower levels recedes into the background. Its facade is light-colored with many windows. In the center-background, a grand cathedral with multiple light blue domes and an ornate facade is visible. To the right of the cathedral, a very tall, slender bell tower, or campanile, rises prominently, its upper section featuring arched openings. On the right side of the square, another long, multi-story building, similar in architectural style to the one on the left, extends towards the foreground. This building also features arcades and numerous windows, with a few figures visible on its balconies. The square is populated by a large crowd of people, dressed in a variety of colorful garments including reds, blues, yellows, whites, blacks, and browns. They are scattered across the square, walking, standing in groups, and interacting. A few small birds are seen flying near the bell tower, and some small animals are on the ground among the people.

alt_text: A panoramic painting of a bustling waterfront city with grand buildings, ships, and many people in a plaza
long_description: A panoramic painting depicts a wide, bustling city scene under a partly cloudy sky. The composition is divided into a waterway on the left and a large open plaza on the right, both teeming with activity. On the far left, several large sailing ships with tall masts and sails are docked in a canal, alongside smaller boats. People are visible on the boats and along the water's edge, appearing to load or unload goods. In the distance, across the water, several buildings with prominent domes and classical architecture are visible. The central and right portions of the painting feature a vast, sunlit plaza filled with hundreds of people dressed in various historical garments, many in groups, some with dogs. In the middle ground of the plaza, two tall columns topped with statues stand prominently. Behind them, a large, multi-story building with arched windows and a balustrade extends horizontally. To the far right, a magnificent, ornate building dominates the frame, characterized by multiple levels of intricate arches, decorative tracery, and a patterned upper facade. The sky above is a mix of clear blue and dramatic, fluffy white and grey clouds, particularly dense on the right side.

alt_text: A detailed painting of a bustling city canal scene with numerous buildings, boats, people, and horse-drawn carriages
long_description: This wide landscape painting depicts a bustling urban scene centered around a winding canal under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. The canal originates in the left foreground and extends into the distant background, flanked by numerous multi-story buildings on both sides. Several small boats, some with figures, navigate the blue-green water. On the left bank, a few figures are visible, including one tending to a small group of sheep. A tall, slender bell tower rises in the far distance on the left. Dominating the central foreground is a large, light yellow building with a brown tiled roof and several distinctive, tall chimneys. It features multiple windows with open brown shutters, and a small balcony on the second floor where two figures are visible. A figure stands in the doorway on the ground floor. In front of this building, a dirt path or street is filled with activity. To the right of the central building, more multi-story buildings line the street, extending into the background. A prominent light-colored dome and another tall bell tower are visible in the mid-ground on the right. The street is populated by numerous figures dressed in period attire, featuring colors such as red, blue, and white. Some figures are on horseback, including one in a red coat, while others walk or stand in groups. A horse-drawn carriage with two horses and a driver is positioned in the lower center. A striped awning, predominantly white and blue, hangs from a building on the far right. Green trees are interspersed among the buildings and along the canal banks.

metadata.title: View of the Brenta, near Dolo

alt_text: A painting of a stone tower with a red flag, a bridge, and boats on water under a cloudy sky
long_description: This painting depicts a serene coastal or riverine landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the center, a tall, round stone tower with battlements stands prominently at the water's edge, topped by a red flag fluttering to the left. To the left of the tower, a stone bridge with two visible arches spans the water, connecting to a verdant bank where a small tree grows. Several small figures are visible on the bridge. The calm water reflects the sky and surrounding structures. In the foreground, a sandy or muddy bank extends from the lower right, featuring a few small figures and what appear to be white ducks or geese near the water's edge. Further right on this bank, a few wooden posts are partially submerged. On the water, a small boat with two figures is positioned near the base of the tower, while a larger sailboat with a white sail is visible in the distance on the right. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by blues, greens, browns, and grays, with the red flag providing a focal point.

metadata.title: Capriccio with a Circular Tower, Two Houses, and a Bridge
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on Masonite

alt_text: A painting depicts a coastal landscape with a prominent church, figures on the shore, and sailboats on the water.
long_description: A painting shows a coastal landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground, dark brown and green land forms a rocky shore. On this shore, two small figures are visible; one stands facing right with an arm raised, seemingly pointing towards the water, while another figure sits nearby. To the left, a small tree with green foliage grows from the dark landmass. An expansive body of greenish-blue water occupies the mid-ground, with several small sailboats featuring white sails visible on its surface. In the right mid-ground, a large stone building with a prominent bell tower stands on a raised area of land. The building has a dark, pointed roof and a smaller, white structure adjacent to it. A low, light-colored wall extends from the main building towards the foreground. In the far background on the right, faint, dark vertical shapes suggest distant structures or trees on the horizon. The overall color palette is dominated by blues, greens, and earthy browns.

metadata.title: Capriccio with a Square Tower and Two Houses
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on Masonite

alt_text: A landscape painting features a tall tower and small buildings on a hill overlooking water with distant mountains.
long_description: The painting presents a broad landscape scene under a light blue and white cloudy sky. In the foreground, a prominent, round, brown stone tower with a dark, pointed roof stands on a grassy, uneven hill. Attached to the base of the tower is a smaller, rectangular building with a dark roof. To the left of the tower, a slender, bare tree with a few sparse leaves rises from the dark brown ground. Below the tower, two small figures are visible on the hill. One figure, dressed in blue, walks towards the left, while another figure, dressed in white, sits on the ground near several light-colored, irregular objects. The hill slopes down to a wide body of water that extends across the midground. On the far side of the water, a low, dark green landmass is visible, dotted with several small white structures, possibly buildings or boats. In the distant background, a range of rugged, blue-grey mountains rises under the pale sky. The overall color palette is muted, featuring various shades of green, brown, and blue.

metadata.title: Capriccio with an Island, a Tower, and Houses
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on Masonite

alt_text: A young man in profile with a red hat stands before a landscape and a stone column
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a young man in profile, facing right, occupying the right half of the composition. He wears a dark tunic with a red draped garment over his right shoulder and a flat, orange-red hat. His skin is fair, and he has dark brown hair visible beneath the hat. His nose is prominent, and his lips are closed. To his right, a light brown stone column with carved details and a capital extends from the bottom to the top edge of the painting. On the column, near the top, an inscription appears to read "SVR" or "VSR" followed by other indistinct letters. Below this, a coat of arms is affixed to the column, featuring a shield divided diagonally into white and red sections, topped by a crown. Near the bottom of the column, a slender plant with small white flowers and a bee is depicted. The left half of the painting shows a detailed landscape under a light blue sky. Rolling green hills with scattered trees and a winding path recede into the distance. In the middle ground, a man on horseback with a dog walks along the path, followed by another figure on foot. Further back, a town with domed buildings and spires is visible on the horizon. The overall lighting is soft and even.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Man, possibly Matteo di Sebastiano di Bernardino Gozzadini

alt_text: Profile portrait of a woman with an elaborate hairstyle, set against a brick wall and a distant landscape
long_description: The painting is a vertical rectangular composition featuring a woman in profile on the left, set against a detailed background. The woman, positioned in the center-left, faces left, showing her fair-skinned profile. Her reddish-brown hair is elaborately styled into a large, wrapped bun at the back of her head. She wears a dark, thin choker around her neck, a white undergarment visible at her chest, and a dark green dress with a richly patterned, possibly brocade, sleeve on her right arm. A small gold pendant hangs from a thin chain around her neck. To her left, a brick wall forms a structural element, featuring a dark, rectangular window opening. Above this window, a light brown stone entablature is carved with the Latin inscription "RAO SVPERSTES". Below the window, a shield-shaped coat of arms is affixed to the wall, displaying a white field with a diagonal red band, topped by a small crown. At the bottom left corner, a pale hand gently holds a golden orb. The right side of the painting opens into a detailed landscape under a light blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the middle ground, a body of water, possibly a lake or sea, is visible with several small boats and a distant city on its far shore. Rolling, light brown hills and scattered trees frame the water. In the foreground of the landscape, a small figure of a woman in a long, light-colored dress stands near a brown horse. Further back, a small figure in a boat navigates a narrow waterway.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman, possibly Ginevra d'Antonio Lupari Gozzadini

alt_text: Madonna and Child with two male saints against a green landscape under a blue sky
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts the Madonna and Child flanked by two male saints, set against a landscape. In the center, the Madonna is shown from the waist up, with fair skin and dark brown hair parted in the middle. She wears a red dress with a blue cloak draped over her shoulders and lap. A thin gold halo encircles her head. She gazes slightly downward and to the right, holding a nude, plump infant with fair skin on her lap. The infant, with light brown hair, looks upward and to the left, holding a small cluster of red berries in its left hand. To the Madonna's left, a younger male saint with fair skin, short brown hair, and a gold halo looks upward and to the right. He wears a brown monastic robe. To the Madonna's right, an older male saint with fair skin, a long dark brown beard, and a gold halo looks directly forward. He wears a red robe. Behind the figures, a green landscape with rolling hills and sparse, tall trees extends to the horizon. Distant light-colored buildings are visible on the hills under a pale blue sky. The bottom edge of the painting features a dark brown band, on which faint white text is visible: 'Preccia donfaber +'.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Francis and Jerome

alt_text: A painting of Madonna and Child with a nun and a kneeling monk against a radiant gold background
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts four figures against a gold background, enclosed within a dark wooden frame with gold decorative elements. In the center-left, a woman with light skin and a serene expression is seated, looking downwards. She wears a dark blue cloak draped over a reddish-brown dress. A gold halo encircles her head, topped by an ornate gold crown. She holds a nude infant with light skin, who stands on her lap, facing slightly right with a raised right hand and a gold halo. To the right of the infant, a woman in a white wimple and dark habit stands, looking towards the infant. She also has a gold halo. Below her, a monk kneels, facing left with clasped hands, looking up at the infant. He wears a light brown habit and has a gold halo. The background is predominantly gold, with radiating lines emanating from behind the seated woman's head, creating a sunburst effect. The lower portion of the background is a solid dark reddish-brown, serving as the ground for the figures. The gold background shows signs of age and texture. The surrounding frame is dark brown with intricate gold patterns along its inner and outer borders.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with Saint Catherine of Siena and a Carthusian Donor

alt_text: A multi-panel altarpiece depicting Christ in glory, the Virgin and Child, crucifixion, and other religious narratives
long_description: This multi-panel altarpiece is set within a gold-colored, pointed arch frame. The artwork is divided into a large triangular top section and a main rectangular body, which is further subdivided into four square panels.In the top triangular section, a central figure of Christ, dressed in a red robe, is depicted with arms outstretched, surrounded by a golden aura and clouds. He is flanked by angels. Below him, on the left, angels assist figures rising from open tombs. On the right, a group of figures, some appearing distressed, are being led by other figures.The main rectangular body is divided into four panels, each with a gold background featuring a dotted pattern. The top-left panel shows the Virgin Mary, dressed in a dark blue robe, seated on a throne and holding the Christ Child, who wears a red garment. Two male saints, one in a red robe and the other in a black habit, stand on either side of the throne.The top-right panel depicts a crucifixion scene. Christ is on a cross in the center, surrounded by a crowd of figures below. These include women in red and blue robes, and soldiers in various attire.The bottom-left panel features a male figure in a white habit, seated at a desk on an elevated platform. He appears to be writing or reading. Below him, a group of figures, mostly men in dark robes, are seated or kneeling, looking up towards him.The bottom-right panel illustrates a nativity scene. The Virgin Mary reclines on a bed or mattress, with the infant Christ in a manger nearby. Angels are visible in the upper right of this panel. Other figures, including a kneeling woman in a black habit and men in simple robes, are present in the foreground, some tending to the infant. This panel has a green, natural landscape background.

metadata.title: The Last Judgment; The Virgin and Child with a Bishop-Saint and Saint Peter Martyr; The Crucifixion; The Glorification of Saint Thomas Aquinas; The Nativity

alt_text: A multi-scene painting with a Madonna and Child, saints, and figures receiving garments, with an angel weaving below
long_description: The painting is vertically oriented and divided into two main registers, with a shimmering golden background dominating the upper half. In the top center, a crowned figure, likely a woman, with a golden halo, emerges from a golden cloud, holding a small child, also with a halo. To the left, a bearded man in a red tunic and blue cloak, with a golden halo, stands on a dark cloud, extending his hand towards a kneeling figure in white robes. This kneeling figure receives a long, striped garment from the child. Behind them, a cluster of red, winged cherubim with halos are visible. On the right, another figure in a red cloak and white head covering, with a golden halo, stands on a dark cloud, holding a white garment. This garment is being distributed to a large group of figures below. Behind this figure, several blue-winged angels with halos are depicted. Below the clouds, a dense group of figures, mostly visible from the waist up, are arranged in rows, all wearing white robes and white head coverings, many with outstretched hands, appearing to receive the white garments. The lower register depicts an interior scene with a brown building on the left. Inside, an angel with large white wings and a golden halo operates a dark wooden loom, weaving a red fabric. On the reddish-brown floor in the foreground, a dark cat walks left, and a small brown dog runs right. A dark, grid-like object rests between the animals and the loom. On the right side of the lower register, a bearded man in a white monastic habit, with a golden halo, stands facing the group of white-robed figures, extending his right hand towards them. The group of white-robed figures continues from the upper register, filling the right side of the lower register.

metadata.title: Santa Francesca Romana Clothed by the Virgin

alt_text: A crowned Madonna and Child surrounded by angels and saints above a dark cosmos and Earth
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a celestial scene above a terrestrial one, set against a gold background. In the upper left, a crowned Madonna, dressed in a light blue robe, is seated and holds a long scroll with Latin script. She is surrounded by several red-winged angels. To the upper right, a group of angels with red and dark wings are depicted, some holding scrolls. In the center of the painting, a kneeling Madonna, wearing a white robe with a blue trim, cradles a nude infant. More angels with red and dark wings are positioned around this central group, some holding scrolls. To the right of the kneeling Madonna, a group of three figures stands: a bearded man holding a sword, a woman in a red robe, and a bald man in a white habit holding a closed book. Scrolls with Latin script extend from these figures. The lower portion of the painting features a dark, curved band speckled with white stars, representing the cosmos. Below this band, a blue-green sphere with visible landmasses and water represents the Earth.

metadata.title: Santa Francesca Romana Holding the Christ Child
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, gold ground, inscriptions on parchment laid down on wood

alt_text: A gold panel painting depicts a man and woman with halos, and two flying angels above
long_description: This vertical rectangular panel painting features two main figures and two smaller angels against a gold background. The gold background is textured and has a decorative border along the top and sides, with a repeating pattern of small, dark shapes. In the upper left, a reddish-brown angel with outstretched wings flies horizontally, facing right. In the upper right, a blue angel with folded wings flies horizontally, facing left. Both angels have small, circular gold halos. Below the angels, two larger figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the panel. On the left, a man with reddish-brown hair and a light complexion is depicted. He wears a blue tunic with intricate gold patterns on the neckline and cuffs, and a purple cloak draped over his left shoulder and arm. His head is tilted downwards, and his eyes are partially closed. His hands are clasped together at his waist. He has a large, circular gold halo with radiating lines. On the right, a woman with a light complexion is shown. She wears a vibrant red hood that covers her head and drapes over her shoulders, and a red garment. Her hands are clasped together in front of her chest in a prayer-like gesture. Her head is also tilted downwards, and her gaze is directed towards the left. She has a large, circular gold halo with radiating lines, similar to the man's. The figures are positioned close together, with the man slightly to the left of the center and the woman to the right.

metadata.title: Saints John the Evangelist and Mary Magdalene

alt_text: A medieval banquet scene with a beheading on the left and a severed head on a platter.
long_description:
The painting depicts an indoor scene with a banquet and a beheading, set within an elaborate architectural structure. The composition is divided into two main sections: a violent act on the left and a feast on the right.

On the far left, a man in a light pink tunic and white head covering stands, holding a long, curved sword. He has just beheaded another man, whose body lies on the ground with the head detached and blood visible. This scene is set against a dark window and an arched doorway within a light-colored building.

To the right, a long, white-clothed banquet table extends across the width of the painting. Seven figures are seated behind the table. From left to right, three women wear crowns and long dresses in dark green, red, and yellow. Next to them, four men are seated, two of whom wear crowns. They are dressed in tunics of green, red, and light brown. The table is set with several round, golden objects and dark knives.

In front of the table, several figures stand. A woman in a white dress with red trim holds a silver platter, presenting a severed head to the seated guests. Other figures in various tunics (orange, white, red) stand nearby, some gesturing. The background features elaborate architecture with arched windows, decorative patterns, and a dark ceiling with gold stars. The overall color palette includes earthy tones, reds, and golds.

metadata.title: The Feast of Herod and the Beheading of the Baptist
metadata.medium: Tempera on wood, gold ground, and silver

alt_text: Two bearded men with halos stand side-by-side against a gold background, one holding a book
long_description: This vertical panel painting depicts two full-length male figures standing side-by-side against a gold background. At the top, a dark arched frame encloses the figures, with a bright gold background filling the space. Each man has a circular gold halo behind his head, intricately patterned with swirling designs and small stars. The figure on the left appears older, with a receding hairline, a short grey beard, and a somber expression. He wears a light-colored tunic with long sleeves, covered by a red cloak draped over his left shoulder and arm, falling in folds to his feet. The figure on the right appears younger, with dark hair and a dark, full beard. He also has a serious expression and holds a closed, dark-colored book in his left hand, resting against his chest. He wears a similar light-colored tunic, covered by a red cloak that drapes over both shoulders and arms, extending down to his feet. Both red cloaks feature a repeating pattern of small, light-colored circles within squares. Both men have pale skin and dark eyes. Their bare feet are visible at the bottom of the panel, positioned on a dark ground line. The gold background behind the figures is plain, contrasting with the detailed halos.

alt_text: A Nativity scene painting shows Mary, Joseph, and baby Jesus in a stable with animals, against a gold and rocky landscape
long_description: This rectangular painting depicts a Nativity scene set within a rocky landscape with a gold sky. In the center, a simple wooden stable with a sloped roof houses the main figures. To the left of the stable, a woman kneels, facing right, her head bowed. She wears a long, flowing white robe with a hint of green at the hem, and a gold halo with radiating lines encircles her head. Inside the stable, a baby wrapped in white and red striped cloth lies in a wooden manger, also adorned with a gold halo. Behind the baby, the heads of a brown cow and a dark-colored donkey are visible, both looking towards the infant. To the right of the stable, a man with a white beard sits on the ground, facing left towards the baby. He wears an orange-yellow robe and has a gold halo with radiating lines around his head. The background features steep, light brown rocky hills on both sides. The upper left and right corners of the painting are filled with shimmering gold leaf, representing the sky. Sparse green foliage and small red flowers are scattered across the hillsides and the light brown ground in the foreground. A few small green trees with dark trunks are visible atop the hill on the right.

alt_text: A gold-leaf panel painting depicts Christ on a cross, flanked by angels and grieving figures below
long_description: This vertical, pointed-top panel painting depicts a crucifixion scene against a gold background. In the center, a nude male figure with a white loincloth is affixed to a dark brown cross. He has dark hair and a gold halo. Two winged figures, or angels, with dark blue bodies and gold halos, float on either side of the cross, near the crucified figure's arms. Their wings are dark. Below the cross, a group of five figures is arranged. On the left, three figures with gold halos are clustered. One figure in a dark brown robe supports another figure in a dark blue robe, whose head is tilted back. A third figure in a dark robe stands behind them. At the very base of the cross, a figure in a bright red robe kneels, looking up at the crucified figure and embracing the cross with their arms. This figure also has a gold halo. On the right, a single standing figure in a pinkish-red outer robe and a dark blue inner garment, with a gold halo, looks towards the center. The gold background is textured and shows areas of red underpainting. The top triangular section of the panel features a dark, cloud-like form with a small, indistinct figure or symbol above it, against the gold. A decorative border of small gold dots frames the entire scene.

alt_text: Madonna and Child with Saint Anne and angels in an ornate golden architectural setting
long_description: A vertical panel painting depicts a religious scene with multiple figures against a golden background. In the lower center, the Virgin Mary, dressed in a dark blue robe and veil, sits holding the nude Christ Child, who stands on her lap. Her head is tilted slightly to the right, and she looks towards the viewer. To her left, an older woman, Saint Anne, sits wearing a maroon robe and white veil, with her hands clasped in front of her chest. Both Mary and Anne have golden halos. On the left side, two angels with golden halos stand, one holding a golden lyre-like instrument. On the right side, three angels with golden halos stand, one holding a golden lute-like instrument. All angels look towards the central figures. Behind the seated figures, a large, white, fluted shell forms a niche within a golden archway. The entire main scene is framed by ornate golden pilasters and a patterned floor with red, gold, and black geometric designs.
