The figures are depicted in traditional attire, with robes in colors such as white, blue, red, brown, and black, adding small bursts of color against the dominant gold and green palette. The overall impression is one of a lively outdoor gathering or festival.

metadata.title: 狩野派   東山遊楽図屏風|Amusements at Higashiyama in Kyoto

alt_text: A seated man in a red robe and white turban holds a brush and palette, looking forward.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a seated man with a dark beard and mustache, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a voluminous white turban, with a hint of dark blue fabric visible beneath it on the left side of his head. His attire consists of a long-sleeved, dark red robe, which is open at the neck to reveal a white shirt or undergarment. The white fabric of his sleeves is also visible at his wrists. His right hand, adorned with a ring on the ring finger, holds a thin brush, while his left hand supports a dark, rectangular object, possibly a palette or a book. He is seated on a surface, with a patterned fabric visible on the left side of the frame, featuring broad diagonal stripes of dark green and dark red. The background is a dark, indistinct warm brown, providing a stark contrast to the illuminated figure. The lighting highlights his face, turban, and hands.

alt_text: A seated man in a black patterned robe, black hat, and white collar, with a colorful bird emblem on his chest
long_description: The image is a full-length portrait of a seated man, presented on a light beige background with a thin blue border at the top and bottom. The man faces slightly to his right, with his body turned slightly to the left. He wears a tall, black, rectangular hat with two rounded, patterned extensions on either side. His face is light-skinned with a short, light-colored mustache and a small goatee. He has dark eyes and a serious expression. He is dressed in a voluminous, dark teal or black robe with a subtle, repeating pattern of swirling shapes. A wide, white collar is visible beneath his chin. On the chest of his robe is a rectangular, colorful embroidered emblem featuring two white cranes with outstretched wings, facing each other over a dark, possibly brown, object. The emblem has red, blue, and green accents. His hands are mostly obscured by the wide sleeves of his robe, resting in his lap. He sits on a chair, the back of which is covered by a light-colored, possibly fur, fabric with dark, irregular spots resembling a leopard print. His feet, clad in white shoes, rest on a dark blue cushion atop a rectangular, dark brown wooden footrest. The footrest has three visible panels on its front, each with a decorative border. The background behind the man is a plain, light beige, creating a simple setting for the figure.

alt_text: A painting depicts a group of figures mourning a deceased man, with a landscape and buildings in the background.
long_description: The painting depicts a somber scene with a group of figures gathered around a deceased man in the foreground, set against a landscape background. The central figure, a pale-skinned man with a bare torso and a white cloth draped around his hips, lies horizontally on a white slab. He wears a crown of thorns, and small red marks are visible on his hands and feet. To his left, a young man with light brown hair and a halo, dressed in a dark tunic and a red cloak, stands with his hands clasped in front of him, looking down. Next to him, an older bearded man in a dark brown robe supports the deceased's back with his arm. To the right of the deceased, a woman with a white turban on her head looks down at him. Below her, another woman in a white veil and dark robe also looks down. Further right, a woman in a green and yellow hooded garment leans over, while another woman in a dark red dress looks towards the deceased. In the lower right corner, a figure in a dark blue and red garment lies on the ground, with their head resting on the lap of another woman. The background features a rolling landscape under a cloudy sky that transitions from light blue to darker gray. On the far left, three crosses stand on a distant hill, with small figures on horseback visible below them. In the middle ground, a dark tree rises, and a path leads towards a fortified town with a prominent castle-like building on a hill. Distant mountains are visible on the far right horizon.

alt_text: A seated person in a dark robe with a topknot hairstyle on a discolored tan background
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting depicts a seated person against a plain, light brown background. The figure is positioned centrally, facing slightly towards the right, with their gaze directed forward. They have a round, light-skinned face with small, dark eyes, a small nose, and a small mouth. Their dark hair is styled into a high topknot, with a long, thin, dark piece extending down their back. The person wears a voluminous dark, likely black, robe that covers most of their body. Hints of red fabric are visible beneath the dark robe, particularly at the sleeves and along the bottom edge. They are seated against a white or cream-colored cushion or fabric, which features a repeating pattern of dark, swirling circular motifs. The background is a uniform light brown or tan, but it shows significant signs of age and damage. Numerous dark spots, areas of discoloration, and patches where the surface material is missing are visible, especially along the bottom and left edges of the artwork. A large, irregular patch of lighter, almost white material is present on the left side, partially obscuring the figure's left arm area. On the right side of the figure, near the bottom, there are vertical lines of dark script, which appear to be Japanese or Chinese characters. Below this script, a small, rectangular red seal impression is visible.

alt_text: God in clouds with angels above a man holding a sword over another man on a block.
long_description: A vertical rectangular oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures. In the upper section, a bearded, elderly man, representing God, emerges from a swirling mass of light brown and white clouds. He wears a pink and light blue robe, with his arms outstretched and hands open. Several small, winged cherubs surround him, some looking down, others looking up. Below the clouds, the scene is darker, set within what appears to be a confined space. On the left, a muscular man stands, facing right, with his body angled towards the center. He has a dark beard, a white cloth draped over his left shoulder, green pants, and a red sash around his waist. A simple wreath adorns his head. He holds a curved, silver sword pointed downwards in his right hand. His bare feet are visible on the dark floor. To the right, a man lies on a raised stone block, partially covered by a flowing red cloth. He has a dark beard and looks upwards with an expression of distress, his hands near his chest. A dark metal chain is visible on the side of the stone block. Several winged angels or cherubs are positioned around the man on the block, some looking at him, one holding a white flower. The background on the far left shows dark vertical and horizontal lines, suggesting bars or a window, while the upper right transitions into the cloud formation.

metadata.title: The Execution of Saint John the Baptist

alt_text: An orange elephant-headed deity with multiple arms sits on a throne, facing a kneeling human figure in a garden
long_description: The image depicts a scene with two main figures set in a garden, framed by a red border with gold floral patterns. In the center, a large, orange, elephant-headed figure with four arms sits on an ornate golden throne. This figure wears a yellow dhoti, multiple white beaded necklaces, armbands, and a golden crown. Its trunk curves to the left, and it holds small, round objects in its upper two hands. The throne has a patterned cushion, possibly leopard print, on its right side. Above the seated figure, a rectangular canopy with a decorated underside is suspended by two slender golden poles. To the left of the throne, a smaller human figure kneels on the light-colored ground, facing the elephant-headed figure. This human figure wears a blue lower garment, a yellow sash across its chest, and a golden crown. Its hands are pressed together in front of its chest. The background features a low white wall separating the foreground from a green landscape. On the far left, dense green foliage represents trees. To the right of the canopy, two slender trees with clusters of purple blossoms rise against the green background. The overall composition is balanced, with the dominant central figure and the smaller kneeling figure creating a clear focal point. The colors are rich and vibrant, primarily orange, yellow, green, blue, and red.

alt_text: Blue-skinned figure in a tree, women in water, and men with cattle on a green hill
long_description: The vertical painting features a vibrant green landscape with a body of water at the bottom, all enclosed by a red border. In the upper left, a herd of cattle, including white, brown, and grey cows, moves across a grassy hill. Two men, one with dark skin wearing a dark garment and holding a stick, and another with lighter skin in a white garment and red hat, lead the cattle. Below them, a third man with lighter skin, dressed in white, sits on the green slope. Further down the hill, more cattle are visible among a line of dark green trees. On the right side of the painting, a large, dark green tree with a thick brown trunk stands prominently. Perched within its branches is a blue-skinned figure wearing a golden crown and draped in yellow and blue garments. This figure looks downwards and to the left. The base of the tree rests on a white and grey square platform. The lower third of the painting is filled with a calm, grey-blue body of water. Seven light-skinned women are partially submerged in the water, facing the tree. They appear to be wearing light-colored lower garments or are bare-chested, with dark hair. Most of the women have their hands raised or clasped in front of them, gazing upwards towards the figure in the tree.

alt_text: Two women stand in a vibrant green landscape with a flowering tree, other trees, and a winding river.
long_description: The painting depicts two women in a lush, verdant landscape under a light green sky. The scene is framed by a thin black border and a wider red border. In the foreground, a woman on the left wears a bright yellow top and a dark blue skirt, with a yellow shawl draped over her head and shoulders. Her right hand is raised, palm facing forward, while her left hand is extended downwards. She has dark hair and visible jewelry on her neck, ears, and wrists. To her right, a second woman stands leaning against a slender tree with pink blossoms. She wears a red shawl over a yellow patterned skirt and top, with her head covered by the red fabric. Her left arm is bent, resting on the tree trunk, and her right hand is near her face. Both women have dark hair and fair skin. The ground is a vibrant green, dotted with small white and yellow flowers. Behind the women, the landscape rises into a gentle green hill. Various trees with dark green foliage are scattered throughout the scene. To the far right, a winding river with dark blue water flows through the landscape, bordered by more trees. Small white birds are perched on the branches of several trees.

alt_text: An elderly man with a long white beard, seated in robes, holding a staff, with calligraphy above.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll depicting a seated elderly man. He is positioned centrally, facing forward with a slight turn to his left. The man has a pale complexion, a long white beard that extends to his chest, and a white mustache. His hair is also white, and he has dark eyes. He wears a layered robe: an inner white garment, a blue undergarment visible at the neck and sleeves, and a prominent outer robe of bright red draped over his left shoulder and arm, extending down his right side. A white sash or stole hangs from his left shoulder, partially obscured by the red robe. He holds a long, slender wooden staff diagonally across his body with both hands, the top end extending above his head and the bottom end resting near his feet. He is seated on a dark, possibly black, chair with a high, curved back and armrests. His feet, clad in red shoes with white soles, rest on a dark, ornate footrest. The background is a plain, light cream color. Above the man's head, on the upper right and left sides of the scroll, are columns of black calligraphic text. Several red seal impressions are visible among the text, particularly on the left side. The scroll is bordered by a light green fabric with a gold patterned band at the top and bottom.

alt_text: A classical painting with a goddess on clouds, cherubs, and several figures in dramatic poses below
long_description: The painting, presented in an oval format, depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures. In the upper center, a fair-skinned woman with long, flowing brown hair reclines on a cloud, looking down and extending her right arm with an open hand. She wears a light-colored, draped garment that exposes her chest and left shoulder. To her left, two winged cherubs are engaged in a struggle with a dark, horned creature, possibly a satyr, near a stone structure. One cherub is on the creature's back, while the other is near its head. Below the central goddess, a fair-skinned woman in a white and pink draped garment is seated, her head tilted back and arms raised. Her left arm is held by a figure standing behind her, who is draped in a white cloth that covers their head and face, revealing only dark eyes. This veiled figure wears a green wreath on their head. To the right of the seated woman, another figure reclines on the ground, wearing a red tunic and a dark helmet or head covering. This figure's right arm is bent, and their hand is near their face. In the lower left, a bronze-colored urn with flames or smoke rises from it, placed on a pedestal. The background is dark and indistinct, with hints of brown and grey, creating a somber atmosphere for the figures in the foreground. The overall color palette includes muted reds, whites, browns, and dark tones.

alt_text: A multi-armed red deity with a flaming halo stands above smaller figures on a blue background.
long_description: The artwork depicts a central, large, red-skinned deity with multiple arms and a fierce expression, set against a light blue background. The deity's hair is depicted as flames, and it wears a crown adorned with skulls, along with numerous necklaces and bracelets of white beads and gold. Its many hands hold various objects, including a bow and arrow made of flowers. Behind the deity is a large, circular halo, primarily golden with intricate patterns, enclosing a lighter blue inner circle. The deity stands on several smaller, prostrate figures. Below the central deity, in the lower section of the image, are three prominent figures. The central one is a dark-skinned, multi-armed figure with a fierce expression, also adorned with jewelry, standing amidst swirling clouds. To its left, a light-skinned figure with a serene expression, wearing elaborate robes and a crown, rides a white horse-like creature. To the right, a red-skinned figure, similar in style to the central deity but smaller, also rides a horse-like creature. The lower background features stylized mountains and clouds in shades of green, blue, and white. The entire composition is bordered by a darker blue fabric.

alt_text: A standing screen features a gnarled tree branch with buds painted on a gold background, framed by dark wood
long_description: A rectangular standing screen is depicted against a plain gray background. The screen consists of a large upper panel and a smaller horizontal lower panel, both enclosed by a dark brown wooden frame. The upper panel features a painting on a gold-colored surface. A thick, gnarled tree branch, painted in dark brown and black tones, extends diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right. Numerous small, dark buds are visible along its thinner branches. In the upper left, a few thin, vertical dark lines are faintly visible. In the lower right corner of the gold panel, a small red rectangular seal is present, accompanied by a few dark, vertical characters. The lower horizontal panel is made of a lighter brown wood and features four decorative cutouts. These cutouts are evenly spaced and resemble diamond shapes with circular centers, connected by a thin dark line. The screen stands on two dark brown wooden feet, one on each side, extending outwards from the bottom of the frame.

alt_text: Five women in traditional attire, some seated and some standing, in an indoor scene with decorative borders
long_description: The artwork features five women in traditional attire against a plain, light tan background. The top edge of the image has a decorative border with vertical green and gold stripes. The left and right edges also have borders, with small blue, purple, and orange squares scattered along them. A faint, light-colored pattern is subtly visible in the tan background on the left and right sides.On the far left, a woman kneels, facing right. She wears a green kimono with a floral pattern and a light blue undergarment. Her black hair is styled upwards, and her face is pale. To her right, another woman kneels, wearing a dark purple kimono with a subtle pattern. She holds a thin brush or tool over a small, dark dish. Several small dishes and cups are arranged on the floor between these two women.Above and slightly to the right of the kneeling women, a woman stands, facing downwards and slightly to the left. She wears a dark green kimono with a red collar and a black skirt patterned with bamboo motifs. Her elaborate black hair is adorned with multiple gold, comb-like ornaments.Below the standing woman, two more women are seated. The one on the left wears a brown kimono with a blue patterned undergarment. She holds a small, dark object in her hands. To her right, the final woman reclines slightly, supported by a green and blue patterned cushion. She wears a bright red kimono and looks towards the left. All women have pale faces and dark, styled hair. A red seal is visible in the bottom right corner.

alt_text: Two women and a small dog on a wooden porch, one holding a leash, the other a ball
long_description:
The artwork depicts two women and a small dog on a raised wooden porch, set against a plain, light brown background. The porch extends from a building on the left side of the image, diagonally towards the lower right. The building features a green mat on its interior floor, a light brown wall, and sliding doors with a grid pattern.

On the left side of the porch, a woman stands facing right, her body slightly angled. She wears a long kimono with a dark blue background patterned with lighter blue, green, and red floral or circular motifs. Her hair is styled in a dark, pulled-back bun. She holds a thin red leash that extends downwards to a small, dark brown dog positioned in the center of the porch. The dog faces right, looking towards the second woman.

The second woman is positioned on the right side of the porch, bending or kneeling. She faces left, towards the dog and the first woman. She wears a vibrant red kimono with a white pattern, possibly depicting waves or abstract shapes, and a dark blue obi. Her hair is also styled in a dark, pulled-back bun. In her hands, she holds a translucent, spherical white object, possibly a ball.

The wooden porch planks are light brown, and the porch is supported by dark brown posts. In the upper right corner of the background, a small green plant with a few red blossoms grows next to a dark, gnarled tree stump. A small, light-colored object rests on top of the stump. The lower right corner contains two red square seals and some black vertical characters.

alt_text: A wide, multi-panel painting shows numerous figures, horses, and buildings on a gold background with green trees.
long_description: This wide, horizontal painting, composed of six panels, depicts a bustling outdoor scene with numerous figures, horses, and structures set against a shimmering gold background. The upper portion features large, irregular golden cloud-like shapes and green hills. On the far left, several brown-roofed buildings are nestled among green trees, and a red torii gate stands nearby. Groups of figures are scattered throughout this area, some seated, some standing. In the upper-middle, a long, dark boat filled with many figures, some holding red and white banners, moves across a blue-green water area. A long, dark wooden bridge or fence-like structure extends horizontally across the entire width of the painting, positioned slightly below the vertical center. Figures are seen walking on and around this structure. Below it, numerous figures on horseback are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting movement or a race. They wear colorful garments in white, blue, red, and green. The lower section also features golden ground and green trees, with more groups of figures visible, some seated in small enclosures, others standing or walking. The overall composition is densely populated with activity.

alt_text: Head-and-shoulders oil portrait of a man with dark hair and beard against a dark background
long_description: This is a head-and-shoulders oil portrait of a man, presented against a dark, almost black background. The man's head and upper torso are positioned slightly to the right of the canvas's vertical center, with his gaze directed downwards and to the right. He has thick, dark brown hair, swept back from his forehead and appearing somewhat disheveled. His fair-skinned face is illuminated from the upper left, casting shadows on the right side of his face and neck. He has dark eyes, a straight nose, and his lips are slightly parted, revealing a hint of red. A reddish-brown beard covers his chin and jawline, connecting to a mustache. He wears a dark jacket or coat, with a crisp white shirt collar visible at his neck and a dark tie or cravat. The brushstrokes are visible, particularly in the hair and clothing. In the upper right corner, the signature "Carolus Duran." is written in red script, with the year "1861." directly below it.

alt_text: Two men in blue robes sit on a raised platform in a room with a garden and cranes below
long_description: The vertical painting depicts an indoor scene above an outdoor garden. In the upper half, two men are seated side-by-side on a raised, dark brown platform covered by a patterned rug. Both men wear long, blue robes with intricate gold and white patterns, and dark hats with red finials. The man on the left holds a small object in his hands, while the man on the right has a long, dark beard. Behind them, a multi-paneled screen displays light brown landscape paintings with green and blue mountains. To the left of the seated men, a dark wooden table holds a blue vase with a plant and other small objects. To the right, another dark wooden table supports a dark green teapot. Architectural elements, including a green and blue tiled roof and pillars, frame the indoor setting. A large, gnarled pine tree with dark green needles extends from the upper right corner, its branches reaching over the roof. The lower half of the painting shows an outdoor garden scene on a light brown ground. Two white cranes with black markings on their wings and red crowns stand near the center-right. One crane stands upright, while the other bends its neck towards the ground. To the left, a large, irregularly shaped blue-green rock formation is surrounded by delicate white flowering branches. Green bamboo shoots grow near the base of the pine tree on the right. A set of light-colored steps leads from the garden ground up to the platform where the men are seated, visually connecting the two scenes.

alt_text: Three vertical hanging scrolls, two with black calligraphy and red seals, one with a monochrome mountain landscape.
long_description: The image displays three vertical hanging scrolls, presented side-by-side against a dark, plain background. Each scroll is mounted identically, featuring a wide upper section of plain light brown fabric, followed by a horizontal band of patterned orange-brown fabric, and a narrower lower section of plain light brown fabric. Small metal hangers are visible at the top of each scroll, and wooden rollers are at the bottom. The patterned orange-brown fabric has a repeating geometric design. The leftmost scroll features a rectangular white panel centered within its patterned orange-brown band. This panel contains multiple columns of black calligraphy, written vertically from right to left, accompanied by several small red square seals. The middle scroll is similarly constructed, with a rectangular white panel also centered within its patterned orange-brown band. This panel also displays multiple columns of black calligraphy, written vertically, along with several small red square seals. The rightmost scroll presents a rectangular white panel within its patterned orange-brown band that features a monochrome ink painting. The painting depicts a rounded mountain or hill, rendered in shades of gray and black, with numerous small, dark trees clustered along its slopes and peak. A small, vertical white rectangular label with black text is positioned in the upper right corner of the painted panel, and a red seal is visible below it.

alt_text: Two vertical hanging scrolls, one with black calligraphy and the other with a landscape of reeds and a bird.
long_description:
Two vertical hanging scrolls are displayed side-by-side against a dark, plain background. Each scroll features a light brown top and bottom section, separated by a wider, reddish-brown section with a subtle, repeating geometric pattern. In the center of each scroll's patterned section is a rectangular panel of light cream-colored paper.

The left scroll's central panel is filled with dense, vertical lines of black calligraphic text, written in a fluid, brushstroke style. Several small, square or rectangular red seal marks are visible among the characters, primarily in the lower left portion of the text block.

The right scroll's central panel depicts a minimalist landscape. The lower half of the panel is dominated by a dense cluster of tall, thin reeds or grasses, rendered in dark grey and black, extending horizontally across the width of the panel. A small, dark bird with a long, pointed beak is visible among the reeds, positioned slightly to the right of center and facing right. The upper half of this panel is largely empty, light cream space, with a few faint, short vertical lines of text or marks in the upper left corner. Both scrolls have a thin, horizontal bar at the very top with a small loop for hanging, and a thicker, cylindrical roller bar at the very bottom.

alt_text: Two vertical scrolls, one with calligraphic text and the other with an ink landscape of a village.
long_description: The artwork consists of two vertical hanging scrolls, presented side-by-side against a dark, plain background. Each scroll features a top and bottom section of plain, light brown fabric. In the middle, a wider band of reddish-brown fabric with a subtle, repeating geometric pattern separates the plain sections. Both scrolls have a rectangular panel mounted within this patterned band. The left scroll's central panel is a light cream-colored sheet of paper filled with multiple columns of black calligraphic text, written vertically from right to left. Several red square seals are visible, some integrated within the text and others positioned below the main body of writing. The right scroll's central panel displays a monochromatic ink wash landscape painting on a light cream-colored sheet. The painting depicts a village composed of numerous small, simple structures with dark roofs, clustered in the middle ground. Behind the village, a dense mass of dark, stylized trees rises, forming a backdrop. The foreground shows a flat expanse, possibly water or land, with a faint, dark line suggesting a path or bridge leading towards the village. The entire scene is rendered in shades of black and gray ink. In the upper right corner of this painting, a small amount of black text and a red square seal are visible.

alt_text: A woman in a pink dress with a snake on her arm looks upward against a dark background
long_description: The painting depicts a woman from the chest up, positioned against a dark, unadorned background. Her head is tilted back and turned slightly to her right, with her gaze directed upwards and to the right. Her eyes appear slightly red-rimmed, and her mouth is slightly open. She has long, reddish-brown hair, which is partially braided or tied and falls over her left shoulder. She wears a draped garment of a reddish-pink color, possibly a toga or robe, with gold trim visible along the edges of the fabric. The garment is open on her right side, revealing her bare chest and right breast. A dark-colored snake is coiled around her left forearm, with its head resting near her chest. Her right hand is positioned near her chest, with fingers slightly splayed, while her left arm is bent at the elbow. She wears a single white pearl earring in each ear. The lighting is dramatic, illuminating her face and upper body, creating a strong contrast with the deep shadows of the background. The overall composition is a vertical rectangle.

alt_text: A traditional landscape painting with mountains, a waterfall, a thatched hut, flowering trees, and small figures
long_description: This horizontal landscape painting on light-colored paper depicts a mountainous scene. The upper half is dominated by large, rounded mountains rendered in light grey and black ink washes, with darker speckles. A prominent waterfall cascades down from the center-left mountain, flowing into a body of water that extends towards the foreground. In the lower left, a small, elevated building with a dark, thatched roof and light-colored walls stands beside the water, its structure visible with posts and a small porch. To the right of the building, the water continues. On the right side of the midground, two large, gnarled trees with bare, dark branches are covered in small white blossoms. A third, smaller flowering tree is visible further to the right. Below the hut on the left, two small, dark figures are depicted, one seated and one standing, near some dark, rounded shapes. On the right, a single small figure walks on a light green, textured ground between the flowering trees. In the upper right corner, vertical black calligraphic text is present, followed by a red square seal. The text reads: 梅花書屋.

metadata.title: Untitled

alt_text: Two vertical scroll paintings depict detailed mountainous landscapes with trees, waterfalls, and small buildings
long_description: The image presents two vertical scroll paintings, displayed side-by-side against a dark, plain background. Each scroll features a light brown fabric mounting with a decorative gold-patterned band framing the top and bottom of the central painted section. The painted areas are rectangular and vertically oriented, depicting mountainous landscapes.The left scroll's painted area shows a landscape dominated by a tall, craggy mountain peak in the upper half, rendered with light gray and green washes. A small, light-colored structure sits atop this peak. Below, a second, smaller mountain or large rock formation is covered with trees, some displaying reddish-brown foliage, and another small building is nestled among them. A winding path or stream, depicted with light gray, meanders through the lower part of the scene, surrounded by more trees and rocky ground. In the upper left portion of the painted area, vertical black calligraphic text reads "洞村漁隱" and "辛丑秋日", followed by two red seals.The right scroll's painted area features a dramatic, towering mountain range in the upper half, characterized by dark gray and black ink washes that define its rugged contours. A prominent waterfall cascades down the right side of this mountain. The lower half of the scroll is filled with dense clusters of trees, rendered in various shades of green and some with reddish-brown leaves, at the base of the mountains. Rocky ground and lighter areas, possibly depicting water or mist, are visible at the bottom. In the upper right portion of this painted area, vertical black calligraphic text reads "仿黃鶴山樵" and "辛丑秋日", followed by two red seals. Both paintings utilize a palette of black, gray, muted greens, and subtle reddish-browns against a light, almost white, ground.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A seated figure in blue patterned robes and a tall hat, with vertical text, framed by a floral border
long_description: The artwork depicts a seated figure against a light, neutral background, framed by a decorative border. The figure is positioned slightly to the left of center, facing towards the right with their head turned slightly to the left. They wear a dark blue robe adorned with a repeating light blue geometric pattern, and an orange undergarment is visible at the chest and sleeves. A tall, black, pointed hat sits atop their head. The figure has dark hair, dark eyes, and a faint mustache. Their hands are not visible, concealed by the wide sleeves of the robe. To the right of the figure, several columns of vertical black script are present on the light background. The central painted area is bordered by a narrow, dark gold band with a subtle pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider, light brown border featuring a repeating pattern of stylized floral motifs, possibly peonies or chrysanthemums, in a slightly darker brown.

metadata.title: 在原業平 「藤房本　三十六歌仙絵巻」 断簡|Ariwara Narihira, from the “Fujifusa Version” of Thirty-six Poetic Immortals (Fujifusa-bon Sanjūrokkasen emaki)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An ink painting featuring abstract, layered rock formations on the left and vertical calligraphy with red seals on the right.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal rectangular painting on a light, off-white paper, set within a light brown wooden frame. The left two-thirds of the paper are dominated by an abstract, organic form resembling a large, jagged rock or mountain. This form is rendered primarily with black ink washes, ranging from dark, solid lines defining its edges and crevices to lighter, translucent grey washes for its body. Interspersed within the black and grey washes are areas of light reddish-brown and subtle hints of light blue or grey, giving the form a textured, layered appearance. Small, dark speckles are scattered around its base and edges. To the lower right of this large form, a smaller, darker, more solid rock-like shape is depicted, also in black ink washes. The right third of the paper contains several vertical columns of black ink calligraphy. The text reads from right to left. Interspersed among the calligraphy and near the painted elements are multiple red square and rectangular seals, some with visible characters. One seal is in the upper right corner, another below the first column of text, and several more are clustered near the bottom of the calligraphy and the painted forms. A small red seal is also visible in the bottom left corner of the paper.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Two vertical scrolls: a dark, moonlit forest with figures, and a light, mountainous scene with a gathering
long_description:
Two vertical scroll paintings are displayed side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a top and bottom section of plain, light brown fabric, and a middle section of grey-green fabric with a repeating gold floral pattern. White vertical strips with small gold accents are attached to the top of each scroll for hanging.

The left scroll depicts a dark, nighttime scene. A bright, pale yellow full moon is positioned at the top center of the artwork. Below it, a dense forest of tall, slender trees with sparse, gold-colored foliage fills the upper and middle ground. In the mid-ground, a raised, ornate platform or structure is visible, surrounded by figures. Numerous small figures, rendered in gold or pale yellow, are scattered across the dark ground, some seated and others appearing to move. The overall impression is of a gathering under a moonlit sky within a forest.

The right scroll presents a lighter, daytime or twilight scene. The upper section features towering, craggy mountains in shades of grey and white, with hints of light brown. The middle and lower sections show an open landscape. A large group of small figures, dressed in light-colored robes (white, beige, and light grey), are gathered on a flat area in the lower half, seated or kneeling in various clusters. Sparse, light-colored trees or bushes are visible among the figures and in the mid-ground. Both artwork sections are framed by a thin, light beige horizontal strip at their top and bottom edges, separating them from the patterned grey-green border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A robed, bearded figure sits beside a bowl, with black calligraphy on a light background, framed by patterned borders.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal composition featuring a seated figure and calligraphy on a light-colored ground, framed by decorative borders. On the right side, a figure is depicted in profile, facing left, seated with legs crossed or tucked beneath. The figure has a short, dark beard and a mustache, and a bald head. A large, flowing robe, outlined in black ink with washes of light pink or red, covers the figure's body and head, forming a hood-like shape. The figure's hands are not clearly visible but appear to be resting in the lap or beneath the robe. To the left of the figure, a simple, wide-mouthed bowl is drawn with black ink lines, showing some internal striations. The main background is a plain, light cream-colored paper. On the left two-thirds of the paper, numerous lines of black calligraphy are arranged in vertical columns, reading from right to left. Two red square seals are visible within the calligraphy: one smaller seal near the top right of the calligraphic text, and a larger, double-square seal at the bottom left. The central paper is bordered by a narrow, textured gold-colored strip, which is then surrounded by a wider, dark blue border featuring a repeating geometric pattern of squares and circles.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts pink peonies, white and yellow chrysanthemums, green plants, and rocks
long_description: This vertical painting on a light beige ground depicts a dense arrangement of various plants and rocks. The artwork is framed by a patterned border. In the upper left, a vertical column of black characters is visible, reading "松柏竹菊蘭", followed by a red square seal. Below this text, a large cluster of pink peonies with numerous petals and dark green leaves occupies the upper-central portion. To the right and slightly below the peonies, a tall cluster of white and yellow chrysanthemums with lighter green foliage extends downwards. Scattered among the chrysanthemums and other plants are small clusters of red berries. In the mid-ground, several grey and brown rocks with textured surfaces are depicted. Various green plants, including some with long, slender leaves and others resembling bamboo, grow around and behind these rocks. White flowers, possibly narcissus, with delicate petals and yellow centers, are visible among the green foliage in the lower-center. The ground beneath the plants and rocks is a light, earthy color, with subtle variations in tone. The lower two-thirds of the scroll are filled with this botanical and rocky scene, while the upper third is mostly open, light beige space.

metadata.title: 秋草花図|Flowers and Grasses of Autumn
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Four figures on a covered boat, one fishing, with vertical black script on the right side.
long_description: A watercolor painting on a light, off-white paper depicts a scene with four figures on a boat. The boat, positioned horizontally across the lower half of the image, has a brown hull and a gray-striped canopy supported by two dark vertical posts. On the right side of the boat, a figure in a light-colored robe is seated, facing right, holding a long, thin fishing rod that extends towards the lower right. This figure has a small beard and mustache and a smiling expression. To the left, under the canopy, three other figures are seated. The leftmost figure wears a gray robe, the middle figure a pale yellow robe, and the third a light robe. They are positioned facing each other, with simple, smiling faces, appearing to be in conversation. The water below the boat is indicated by a few wavy black lines. Vertical black script is present along the entire right edge of the painting. A square red seal impression is visible in the bottom left corner. The overall color palette consists of muted browns, grays, pale blues, and yellows, with black ink used for outlines and details.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Two albums, each with ten leaves; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An open folding fan features painted reddish-pink peaches, yellow flowers, and black calligraphy on a light cream surface.
long_description: A folding fan is displayed open against a plain light gray background. The fan's main surface is a light cream or beige color, composed of pleated paper segments that form a wide, shallow arc. On this surface, a painted scene depicts a branch extending horizontally across the middle. To the left, two reddish-pink peaches with green leaves hang from the branch. To the right, a cluster of yellow flowers with green leaves blooms from the same branch. In the upper left quadrant of the fan, several vertical lines of black calligraphy are visible, followed by a small, square red seal. The fan's ribs, visible at the bottom, are a dark green color. The two outer guard sticks, which frame the fan, are dark brown or black. The guard stick on the right side has a rectangular section near its end with gold-colored characters and a small decorative element. A small, dark green pivot point is located at the bottom center where the ribs converge.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Folding fan; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a dark pot with smoking incense sticks and a white fan on a gradient background.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting, framed by a patterned border. The border is a light gray-gold color with a repeating pattern of stylized leaves. The central painting features a soft, vertical gradient background, transitioning from a very light, almost white gray at the top to a darker, muted gray-brown at the bottom. In the lower half of the central painting, a dark, rounded pot sits slightly to the right of the vertical center. The pot has a wide mouth and a slightly textured appearance, rendered in shades of dark gray and black. Several thin, dark sticks, likely incense, protrude vertically from the pot. Three of these sticks, towards the top, emit small wisps of light gray smoke that curl upwards. To the left of the pot, a white, closed folding fan lies horizontally on the surface. Its handle points towards the lower left, and its fanned-out portion is a soft, off-white color with subtle folds indicated. To the right of the pot, a thin, dark object, possibly a brush or another stick, lies horizontally. In the lower right corner of the central painting, faint, dark calligraphic characters are visible. The overall impression is one of quiet stillness.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on silk

alt_text: A gnarled branch with white blossoms within a light gray circle, with vertical text and a red seal
long_description: The artwork is presented within a dark blue border featuring gold, swirling patterns, and an inner light brown border. The central image is a rectangular piece of light beige paper. Dominating the left and center of this paper is a large, light gray circular shape, resembling a full moon or a circular window. Within the upper left quadrant of this circle, a dark, gnarled branch extends downwards and to the right. The branch is adorned with numerous small, white blossoms, some with dark centers, and tiny dark buds. The branch appears to emerge from a textured, rocky formation in the upper left of the gray circle, rendered in darker gray tones with some black speckles. The right side of the beige paper is mostly empty except for a column of vertical black calligraphic text positioned towards the upper right. Below this text, a square red seal impression is visible. The overall impression is a delicate, monochromatic scene with a touch of color from the seal.

metadata.title: 没倫紹等 (墨斎) 筆  梅図|Plum Blossoms

alt_text: Nine figures gathered around low tables beneath a framed landscape painting of mountains and clouds.
long_description:
The vertical scroll painting depicts nine figures gathered in a room, with a framed landscape painting above them. The background is a light, unadorned beige.

At the top, a rectangular framed painting shows a misty mountain landscape. Jagged, dark gray mountains rise from a sea of light gray and white clouds or mist. A thin blue line outlines the inner edge of the frame. On the right side of the landscape, a small vertical inscription in black characters is visible.

Below this framed painting, nine figures are seated on the floor, arranged in three rows. All figures wear robes, primarily in shades of light brown, beige, and gray, with black ink outlines. Some figures have head coverings.

In the upper row, three figures are present. The leftmost figure sits facing right, holding a small, dark object. To the right, a figure reclines, facing left. Further right, another figure sits facing left, near a small, low table holding a green vase with pink and red flowers.

The middle row contains four figures. The leftmost figure sits facing right, with one hand raised. Two central figures face each other, one looking down at a scroll. The rightmost figure in this row sits facing left, near a small, low table with a dark pot and other small items.

In the bottom row, two figures are depicted. The leftmost figure leans forward over a long, unrolled scroll or piece of paper. The rightmost figure sits facing left, holding a brush or similar implement, with a small, dark object nearby. Various small objects, including cups, a kettle, and writing tools, are scattered among the figures.

The entire painted area is bordered by a decorative fabric, featuring a repeating geometric pattern in shades of brown and gold.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman in a pink kimono stands beside a pine tree and a red gate on a light background
long_description: The image is a vertical painting on a light, tan-colored background, framed by decorative borders. A woman is depicted in the lower-center, standing with her body angled slightly to the left and her head tilted down, looking towards the lower left. She has long, dark hair that falls over her shoulders and a pale complexion. She wears an elaborate, long-sleeved kimono that is primarily pink, with sections of red and white, and intricate patterns of flowers, geometric shapes, and what appears to be a cart or boat motif near the hem. Her right hand is positioned near a small, dark plant or object on the ground. To the right of the woman, a pine tree with dark green needles and a light brown, gnarled trunk extends from the right edge of the painting, with branches reaching towards the center. Behind the tree, a red, arch-like structure, possibly a gate, is partially visible. The painting is bordered by a narrow red band with a subtle floral pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider blue band featuring white cloud-like motifs.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A dark outline drawing on a brown scroll depicts a central standing figure surrounded by five smaller figures
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features dark outline drawings on a reddish-brown background, framed by an ornate border. The central figure, larger than the others, stands on a circular, possibly lotus-shaped, platform. This figure has long, dark, wavy hair, and wears a long, patterned robe or skirt, with bare feet. Its right hand holds a slender, vertical object resembling a staff or sword, while its left arm is bent, with the hand extended forward, palm up. To the left of the central figure, two smaller figures are depicted. The upper left figure has a large head with grotesque features, possibly kneeling or crouching, looking towards the center. Below it, another smaller figure stands on a rock-like base, also facing the central figure. To the right of the central figure, three smaller figures are shown. The upper right figure has a large, round head with exaggerated features, looking towards the center. Below it, a slender figure with dark hair stands on a rock-like base, facing the central figure. Further down and to the right, another small figure with dark hair kneels or sits on a rock-like base, also looking towards the center. Faint, dark outlines suggest rocky terrain or water around the bases of the figures. The painting is bordered by a wide, gold-colored fabric with a repeating floral or cloud pattern, and a narrower red and gold decorative strip at the top and bottom edges.

metadata.title: 不動明王四童子種字像|Fudō Myōō with Four Attendants, Outlined in Seed Syllables
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Two robed figures sit beneath tall trees with small animals in a muted landscape painting.
long_description: The painting is a vertical scroll, rendered in a muted palette of greens, grays, and light browns on a light, almost off-white background. The upper portion of the scroll is largely blank, featuring vertical lines of black text in the upper right corner, followed by two red square seals. Dominating the central vertical space are two tall, slender trees with light gray trunks and dense, dark green-gray foliage. Behind the trees, a light green-gray structure, possibly a wall or building, is visible on a gently rising slope. In the lower middle ground, two robed figures are seated or kneeling on a light-colored ground. The figure on the left wears a light, almost white robe and faces towards the right. The figure on the right wears a light brown-orange robe and is positioned with their back mostly to the viewer, facing left. To the left of these figures and at the base of the trees, several objects are arranged on the ground, including a dark, rounded pot or vessel and a few smaller, lighter-colored items. Below these objects, in the foreground, three small, light-colored, furry animals, possibly monkeys, are gathered on the ground. The ground itself is a light, unadorned surface, suggesting a path or open area.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A standing woman in a white kimono with blue irises, holding a woven basket, beside bamboo and calligraphy.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting depicting a standing woman in a white kimono against a light brown background. The woman is positioned slightly left of center, facing forward with her head turned slightly to her right. She has pale skin, dark hair styled in an elaborate bun on top of her head with some strands falling down her back, and delicate facial features. Her kimono is predominantly white with a pattern of blue iris flowers and green leaves. The sleeves and hem are edged with a red border, and a green sash is visible around her waist. She holds a light brown, woven basket-like object in her left hand, which is partially obscured by her sleeve. Her right hand is also partially hidden within her kimono. To the right of the woman, two tall bamboo stalks extend vertically from the bottom of the frame, with several dark green bamboo leaves visible. More bamboo leaves are depicted in the upper left quadrant of the background. Various lines of dark calligraphy are scattered across the upper half of the background, both to the left and right of the woman's head. The background has a mottled, aged appearance. The scroll is framed by a darker brown border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A procession of people and animals, including an ox, horse, and dog, with a palanquin, on a light background with calligraphy
long_description:
A rectangular painting on a light tan ground, bordered by a decorative pattern. The main scene depicts a procession of figures and animals moving from right to left across the lower half. The upper half contains extensive vertical script.
The painting is framed by a light yellow patterned border, which is then framed by a wider blue and white border featuring stylized waves and flying cranes. In the upper right, a large block of vertical script in black ink fills a significant portion of the space. Below this, a red square seal is visible. In the upper left, another block of vertical script, also in black ink, is present, though less dense than the right side.
The procession consists of approximately fifteen to twenty human figures and three animals: an ox, a horse, and a dog. The figures are depicted in various poses, walking and carrying items. Most wear light-colored robes and straw hats. The ox, dark brown, carries an open-sided palanquin on its back, in which a single figure sits. A person walks beside the ox, holding its lead. Behind the ox, a small white dog with a red collar walks. To the left of the ox, a man carries a long pole with a red banner. Further left, a dark brown horse carries a large basket on its back, which appears to contain items. A man walks beside the horse, holding its lead. Other figures carry branches, fans, or poles. The figures' clothing is primarily in muted tones of white, light brown, and light blue, with accents of red. The background is a uniform light tan.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A painting depicts several small birds among tall green plants with white flowers on a brown background
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a central brown panel framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark green with a lighter green scroll pattern, while the side borders are a faded light green-blue. The central panel has a warm, faded brown background. In the upper left, a single bird with brown and white speckled feathers is shown in flight, wings spread, with its head pointing downwards and to the right. Below it, several tall green plants with slender leaves and elongated, fluffy white flower heads rise from the bottom of the panel. Two smaller, brown-speckled birds are perched among these plants; one on the left is partially obscured by a white flower, facing right, and another on the right is perched on a green leaf, facing left. On the ground at the bottom of the panel, five more small, brown-speckled birds, resembling quails, are depicted. One on the far left is pecking at the ground. To its right, another stands upright. Three more are clustered on the right side, with one facing left and two facing right. Small green plant clusters are scattered on the ground among these birds. The birds vary slightly in size and posture, creating a dynamic scene against the plain background.

metadata.title: 鶉雀粟図|Quail, Sparrows, and Millet
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two gourds with leaves and tendrils on a light background, framed by a decorative gold and green border
long_description: A monochromatic painting depicts two gourds or melons with accompanying foliage on a light, unadorned background. The artwork is enclosed by a decorative border. In the lower-center, a large, light-toned, round gourd with subtle vertical indentations rests. To its right and slightly behind, a smaller, darker gourd with distinct horizontal stripes is visible. Both fruits are rendered in varying shades of gray, creating depth and form. Clusters of broad, lobed leaves, also in shades of gray, emerge from behind and around the gourds, extending upwards and to the left. Thin, dark, curling tendrils weave throughout the composition, originating from the plant material and extending into the empty space above and to the right of the fruits. A small, square red seal with illegible characters is stamped in the lower-left corner of the main image area. The central painting is surrounded by a wide, textured gold border, which is separated from the artwork by a narrower green band featuring a repeating floral or geometric pattern.

alt_text: A scroll painting shows a woman in a light blue kimono and orange obi, standing against a plain background with calligraphy.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll, featuring a central rectangular panel framed by decorative borders. The central panel has a light tan or golden-brown background. Dominating the lower half of this panel is a full-length depiction of a woman, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center. She faces towards the right, with her head gently tilted downwards. Her dark hair is styled upwards and adorned with a small gold ornament. Her face is pale, with delicate features, dark eyebrows, and a small mouth. She wears a light blue kimono, which features a subtle, repeating white floral or geometric pattern. A bright orange obi is tied around her waist. Beneath the kimono, layers of red and gold fabric are visible. Only the very bottom edge of white footwear is visible at her feet. In the upper left portion of the tan background, several vertical lines of black calligraphy are present. In the lower right, a small red square seal with black characters is visible. The central panel is bordered by a narrow strip of light, patterned fabric, which is then surrounded by a wider, dark blue border adorned with a repeating gold floral and vine motif.

metadata.title: 梅翁軒永春筆　立姿遊女図|Standing Courtesan
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A procession of people in traditional attire, including women in kimonos, moving through a garden with flowering trees
long_description: This horizontal artwork depicts a procession of figures moving from left to right, transitioning from an indoor setting to an outdoor garden. On the far left, two women are seated on a light-colored mat in an interior space. One woman, facing right, wears a dark top and an orange skirt, kneeling with her back to the viewer. The other, facing left, wears a grey and white robe, seated with her legs tucked. Between them is a low, dark table with small, dark vessels, suggesting a tea ceremony. To the right, a group of nine figures, mostly women, walk on a raised, light-colored pathway that slopes upwards. The pathway is bordered by thin, dark railings and surrounded by small, bare trees with white and light-pink blossoms. The figures are dressed in elaborate, multi-colored kimonos with intricate patterns. One man, dressed in a green robe, holds a dark umbrella with a white pattern over a woman in a red and green kimono. Many women have elaborate hairstyles adorned with flowers or pins. The background is a light, muted beige, with hints of a light blue sky above the garden scene.

metadata.title: 鳥文斎栄之筆　 三幅神吉原通い図巻 「全盛季春遊戯」|Three Gods of Good Fortune Visit the Yoshiwara; or “Scenes of Pleasure at the Height of Spring”
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A panoramic painting depicts numerous figures in traditional attire moving around buildings, bridges, and a river on a gold background
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal painting with a shimmering gold background that covers the entire upper and lower portions, suggesting a sky and ground. The central scene unfolds across a light brown ground, populated by numerous figures, buildings, and natural elements. On the far left, a large building with a dark brown, multi-tiered roof and light yellow walls is partially visible, surrounded by green, undulating hills. A narrow blue river flows from the left, curving towards the center, where it passes under two arched wooden bridges. Several figures, dressed in various colored robes (red, blue, green, white, black, orange, brown), are seen walking on and around these bridges and buildings. Some figures carry objects or wear wide-brimmed hats. In the middle ground, more buildings with dark brown roofs and light yellow walls are arranged, connected by wooden walkways. Figures are seen interacting, walking, and standing on these platforms and the ground. To the right, the river continues, and more figures are depicted, some in groups, others individually. Several small, green, stylized pine trees are scattered across the landscape, particularly on the right side. The overall composition is dynamic, with figures moving in various directions, creating a sense of activity across the golden landscape. On the far right, a vertical column of faint, dark script is visible.

metadata.title: 月波の遊び・「四月中の申の 日山王日吉祭」;   「八月朔日松尾に相撲あり」|Festivities of the Twelve Months: “Sannō Hiyoshi Festivals Held on the Day of the Monkey in the Mid-Fourth Month”; Festivities of the Twelve Months: “Sumō Wrestling at Matsuno’o Shrine during the Hassaku Festival on the First Day of the Eighth Month”
metadata.medium: Two handscrolls; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows dark bamboo stalks and leaves heavily covered in white snow against a gray background.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a monochrome ink wash depiction of bamboo in snow. The artwork is presented on a scroll with a light beige fabric border, which has a subtle, repeating pattern of leaves or flowers. Wider horizontal bands of a solid, slightly darker beige fabric are present at the very top and bottom of the scroll. The central painted area showcases several stalks of bamboo, rendered in various shades of dark gray and black ink, extending upwards from the lower part of the composition. The bamboo leaves are heavily outlined and filled with white or very light gray, indicating a thick layer of snow. The background behind the bamboo is a soft, graduated wash of light gray, which darkens slightly towards the upper center and lightens towards the bottom. On the left side, near the middle, a vertical column of dark calligraphic text is visible, with a small, square red seal directly below it. Another small, square red seal is located in the lower right corner of the painted section.

alt_text: An ink painting on a scroll depicts a bearded man riding a donkey, with calligraphic text above.
long_description: A vertical scroll features an ink painting and calligraphy on a light brown paper background, framed by decorative borders. The upper portion of the scroll contains several columns of black calligraphic text, written vertically from right to left. Scattered among the text are a few small, rectangular red seals. Below the calligraphy, a minimalist ink painting depicts a man riding a donkey. The man, rendered with broad, expressive brushstrokes, appears to be an older figure with a beard and a head covering, wearing a loose robe. He is seated on the donkey, which is also depicted with ink washes and lines, showing a bridle and reins. The donkey's legs are positioned as if in motion. The overall color palette is dominated by black ink on the light brown paper, with the red seals providing the only other color accent. The central painted and calligraphic area is bordered by a narrow strip with a subtle pattern, which is then framed by a wider, plain, darker brown material.

alt_text: A monochrome drawing depicts multiple figures in a domestic interior with architectural elements and text.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal, monochrome drawing, primarily in black ink on a light, aged paper, depicting an interior scene with multiple figures and architectural elements. The composition is characterized by strong diagonal lines and overlapping planes, creating a sense of depth and a dynamic, almost fragmented perspective. On the far left, a vertical panel with some illegible text runs along the edge. Below it, a figure with a rounded head and draped clothing is seated or reclining, facing right. Above this figure, a structure resembling a palanquin or an ornate bed with a canopy is visible, featuring a dark, solid interior and patterned exterior. Moving right, a large diagonal beam or screen cuts across the middle ground. Behind it, a figure with long hair and draped clothing is shown reclining or sleeping, facing right, with eyes closed. This figure is positioned within a space defined by a patterned screen with a grid-like design. Further to the right, another figure, similarly depicted with draped clothing, is reclining or sleeping, facing left. This figure is partially obscured by another diagonal element. Throughout the scene, various decorative elements are visible on screens and panels, including stylized trees, bamboo, and small landscape motifs. In the lower right, a small, dark, cylindrical object is visible near a reclining figure. On the far right, vertical text is visible, including the characters "てん" (ten) at the bottom. Other smaller, less distinct characters appear near some of the figures. The overall scene suggests a narrative unfolding within a traditional domestic or palace setting.

metadata.title: 「明石」 「澪標」 「蓬生」 「関屋」「絵合」 『源氏物語』 絵巻|"Akashi", "Channel Buoys" ("Miotsukushi"),  "The Wormwood Patch" ("Yomogiu"),  "Gatehouse" ("Sekiya"), and  "Picture Contest" ("E-awase") chapters from the Tale of Genji (Genji monogatari)

alt_text: A painting depicts a seated man with a beard and black cap, wearing patterned robes, on a light brown background.
long_description: The central image is a rectangular painting on light brown paper, depicting a man seated cross-legged, facing slightly to the right. He has light skin, a short black beard, and a small black cap on his head. His eyes are narrow, and his mouth is a thin line. He wears a long-sleeved robe with a light cream background patterned with light green and white circular motifs. The robe has red trim along the edges of the sleeves and the bottom hem. His hands are not visible, tucked within the sleeves. Below the man, his legs are covered by the robe, which continues the light green and white circular pattern. To the right of the man's head, there is a small vertical inscription in black characters, followed by a red square seal. The painting is framed by a thin, light border. To the left of the central painting is a vertical panel of light cream paper with black calligraphic text. The text includes characters such as "危" and "柿". Below some of the text, there is a faint, light yellow floral motif. To the right of the central painting is another vertical panel of light cream paper, which appears blank but shows signs of wear and discoloration, with some darker, irregular patches. The entire composition is set against a dark, plain background.

metadata.title: 住吉具慶筆    三十六歌仙画帖|Portraits and Poems of the Thirty-six Poetic Immortals
metadata.medium: Album of thirty-six paintings and thirty-six poems; ink, color and gold on silk and paper

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono sits on a wooden porch, holding a fan, with a building behind her
long_description: The artwork depicts a painting framed by a decorative border. The central painting features a woman seated on a light brown wooden porch, facing slightly towards the left and looking downwards. She has long, dark hair styled back from her face. She wears a light-colored kimono adorned with intricate floral and geometric patterns in shades of red, orange, green, and blue. Her right hand holds a dark, round fan, which rests against her chest. Her left hand is placed on her lap. To the right of the woman, a building with a thatched roof and sliding screens, some with dark frames, is visible. On the light brown floor to the left of the woman, a faint, wavy pattern, possibly representing water or mist, is depicted. Near her feet on the porch, small, indistinct dark shapes are present. Vertical text is visible on the far left side of the painting, reading '年華如夢' followed by smaller characters below. The painting is enclosed by a wide, multi-patterned border. This border features a light-colored fabric with large, stylized floral motifs in orange, green, and white, alongside sections with dark blue and white geometric patterns. The top and bottom sections of the border have a wavy, cloud-like edge.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A panoramic painting shows horseback riders in a field below a long, elevated spectator stand filled with people.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal painting depicting an outdoor event. In the upper half, a long, elevated wooden stand stretches across the width of the image, filled with numerous spectators. These figures, dressed in various colored garments including blues, greens, reds, and browns, are seated or standing, observing the activity below. The stand is supported by thin vertical posts. Above the stand, a few trees with green foliage are visible on the left and far right, with a light, unadorned sky-like background. Below the stand, a wide, light green field occupies the lower half of the painting. Several figures on horseback are depicted in motion across this field. From left to right, there are at least five horses, each with a rider. The riders wear colorful attire, including blue, red, and white garments, and some carry long poles or spears. The horses are depicted in various shades of brown and white, with some having red or white decorative elements on their saddles or bridles. In the foreground, at the bottom of the image, parts of two buildings with brown tiled roofs are visible on the left and right, suggesting structures bordering the field. The overall composition captures a dynamic scene with a clear separation between the observers and the participants.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a snowy mountain landscape with a river, bridge, and buildings under a pale sky
long_description: A tall, narrow scroll painting features a monochromatic landscape scene, primarily in shades of pale gray, white, and muted brown, framed by a dark teal border with gold floral patterns. The top section is dominated by towering, snow-covered mountains with soft, rounded peaks. Sparse, dark trees are visible along the mountain slopes, suggesting a forest. In the upper left, a block of vertical text in an East Asian script is present, accompanied by several red seals below it. Below the mountains, the landscape transitions to a valley where several traditional-style buildings with sloped roofs are nestled among more snow-dusted trees. A stone arch bridge spans a river that flows from the middle ground towards the foreground. The river occupies the lower portion of the painting, its surface appearing calm and reflecting the muted light. The overall impression is one of a serene, wintery scene.

alt_text: Two vertical scroll paintings depict hazy landscapes with islands, mountains, and water, one with a red sun
long_description: Two vertical scroll paintings are displayed side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a light brown top section with two decorative hanging straps, a dark brown border with a subtle patterned design framing the central painted area, and a plain light brown bottom section with a visible roller.The left scroll depicts a hazy, muted landscape. The central painted area is dominated by a light beige and pale brown wash, suggesting an atmospheric sky and water. In the upper center, a faint reddish-orange circle, possibly a sun or moon, is visible through the haze. Towards the mid-left, a dark, tree-covered island or landmass rises from the water, its contours softly defined. The water below is rendered with subtle horizontal brushstrokes, reflecting the hazy conditions. Small, indistinct forms, possibly boats or structures, appear near the island's base. Faint vertical text and a small red seal are present in the lower left of the painted section.The right scroll presents a similar hazy landscape. The background is a light beige and pale brown wash. In the upper right, distant, soft-edged mountains emerge from the mist, with one peak more prominent. Towards the mid-right, a rugged, dark island or rock formation with some vegetation is visible. In the lower right, a cluster of small, dark green pine trees stands on a low landmass. The foreground consists of water, depicted with subtle horizontal lines, blending into the atmospheric background. Faint vertical text and a small red seal are located in the lower right of this painted section. Both scrolls utilize a limited palette of browns, beiges, and dark greens, creating a serene, misty ambiance.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Diptych of hanging scrolls; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash landscape painting depicting mountains, trees, buildings, a pagoda, and calligraphic text
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal ink wash painting on a light-colored ground, framed by a patterned border. The scene depicts a mountainous landscape with water, buildings, and a pagoda. The color palette is primarily black and grey ink washes, with subtle reddish-brown accents on buildings and the pagoda.In the foreground, on the left side, a cluster of traditional-style buildings with reddish-brown roofs and white walls is nestled on a sloping hillside. These buildings are surrounded by numerous trees, some with dense, dark foliage rendered in varying shades of black and grey ink, and others with bare, delicate branches. A winding path or stream is visible in the lower left, leading towards the buildings. To the left of these structures, a significant portion of the painting is dedicated to calligraphic text, arranged in vertical columns of black ink. The rightmost column of text appears to read "大二三月九日寫" (Written on the 9th day of the 3rd month of the 2nd year of Da...). Below and interspersed within the text are several red seal impressions.Moving towards the right and into the middle ground, a wide body of water, rendered in light grey and white, stretches across the canvas. On the far side of this water, a tall, multi-tiered pagoda with a reddish base stands prominently on a distant hill. This hill is covered with trees, depicted in lighter ink washes, suggesting distance and atmospheric perspective. Further in the background, more undulating hills and mountains are visible, fading into a misty, lighter tone. The overall impression is one of depth and tranquility. The painting is bordered by a light tan fabric with a repeating pattern of small, dark brown cloud-like motifs.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting features a branch with white blossoms and brown leaves, alongside dark ink wash, calligraphy, and a red seal.
long_description: The artwork presents a fan-shaped painting centrally placed on a light yellow rectangular mat. This mat is bordered by a dark green strip adorned with repeating gold floral patterns, which is then framed by an outer light blue border featuring a continuous wave-like design. The fan painting itself is off-white and has a thin gold rim along its curved upper and right edges. On the right side of the fan, a branch extends horizontally, bearing several clusters of white blossoms with subtle green centers and small green stems. Interspersed among the blossoms are several broad, reddish-brown leaves. To the left of the branch, dark gray and black ink wash creates an abstract, textured area. Below this ink wash, a vertical column of black calligraphic characters is visible, ending with a small, square red seal at the bottom left of the fan. The overall composition is balanced, with the delicate floral elements contrasting with the bolder ink work and text.

metadata.title: Untitled
