alt_text: Two figures, one reclining with a fan and one seated, with calligraphic text on a light background.
long_description:
The artwork is a horizontal panel featuring two figures and two blocks of calligraphic text on a light, unadorned background. The style is minimalist, primarily using black ink lines with subtle color accents.

On the left side, a figure is depicted in a reclining or semi-seated position, surrounded by voluminous, draped fabric rendered with simple, flowing lines. This figure has long, dark hair that cascades down, and their face is shown in profile, looking towards the right. They hold a fan with a fanned-out shape in their right hand. Above and slightly to the right of this figure, a block of vertical, handwritten script is present.

On the right side, a second figure is seated cross-legged, facing left. This figure wears a light-colored, flowing robe and a dark, flat-topped hat. They have a small beard and mustache, and their right hand is raised to their chin in a contemplative gesture. Above and slightly to the left of this figure, another block of vertical, handwritten script is visible. The background is a uniform, light tone throughout the composition.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆　三十六歌仙図|The Thirty-Six Poetic Immortals
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A crowded scene of many figures, some appearing as deities, engaged in a lively procession with music and goods
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal scroll painting, featuring a central rectangular panel with a crowded scene, framed by a wide, dark purple border with an intricate, repeating floral or geometric pattern. The central panel has a light, cream-colored background, suggesting an indoor or shallow stage-like setting with faint vertical lines. The scene depicts a large gathering of approximately twenty to thirty figures, mostly human-like, with a few animals. The figures are rendered in a traditional painting style, with outlines and washes of color. Many figures wear elaborate robes in shades of orange, green, blue, brown, and white, with some having long white beards and distinctive headwear, suggesting deities or revered individuals. On the far left, a small, grey ox or cow, heavily laden with large, dark, bulbous objects, is led by a figure. Nearby, another figure carries a large, woven basket. Several smaller figures are positioned on the ground, one kneeling and another holding a small, dark object. In the central area, a prominent group of figures is engaged in various activities. One central figure, with a long white beard and an orange robe, holds a fan. Several individuals play musical instruments, including a stringed instrument and a drum. A large, green, curved object, possibly a musical instrument or a decorative screen, stands vertically behind some figures. A figure holds a black parasol. Towards the right, more figures are present, some carrying items such as a tall, narrow basket filled with red and green plants or flowers. A figure with a wide-brimmed hat stands near the right edge. In the upper right corner, a small figure is depicted hanging upside down from the ceiling, holding a red object. A vertical column of dark characters and a red seal are visible in the upper right corner of the central panel. The overall impression is one of a lively, festive procession or gathering.

metadata.title: 蹄斎北馬筆　雨宿り図|Taking Shelter from the Rain
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A tall figure holding a small figure, with another child reaching out, next to a tree.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on light-colored paper depicts three figures and a tree. A tall figure stands in the lower center, facing right, wearing a light-colored robe with a light blue-green sash. This figure wears a hat and holds a small, bundled figure in their arms, positioned at chest height. To the right of the tall figure, a smaller child stands, facing left towards the tall figure. This child wears a reddish garment and extends one arm forward. Behind the tall figure, on the left side of the composition, a tree trunk rendered in dark ink wash rises vertically, with some dark, textured foliage indicated above. The background is largely empty, light-colored paper, with a faint horizontal line visible in the upper middle section. A small red square seal and some faint black characters are present in the lower left corner of the artwork.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A scroll painting shows three figures on a balcony looking down at a creature, with text above
long_description:
This vertical scroll features a central rectangular panel of light beige paper, framed by decorative fabric borders. The top border is a narrow strip of gold-colored fabric with a geometric pattern. Below this, the side borders are wider, with the left side displaying a light green fabric adorned with yellow wisteria-like vines and leaves, while the right side shows a light beige fabric with similar floral motifs. The lower side borders transition to an orange fabric with white and purple floral patterns and wave-like designs.

The central panel contains both calligraphy and a painted scene. In the upper half of the panel, several lines of black ink calligraphy are arranged vertically. The visible characters read: "諸人の 心の 欲 し き を 下 に 見 る". Below the calligraphy, a building with a dark, textured roof is depicted, possibly with a faint mountain or hill behind it.

On a balcony of this building, three figures are visible behind a dark railing. Two taller figures stand to the left and right, while a shorter figure is positioned between them. All three wear patterned garments with visible colors including red, green, and yellow, and have dark hair styled upwards. They appear to be looking downwards. Below the balcony, on the ground, a reddish, horned creature with a club-like object in its hand is depicted in a dynamic pose, facing left. A bare tree branch extends from the right side of the scene, near the creature. A small, dark object is near the creature's feet. In the lower right corner of the painted section, small black characters read "光琳画" (Kōrin ga), accompanied by a red square seal.

alt_text: Two ink-wash figures, one standing and one kneeling, with a tall staff, below black calligraphy and red seals
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features two figures rendered in black ink wash on a light beige background. In the upper portion, several columns of black calligraphic text are visible, accompanied by two red square seals on the right side. Below the text, a thin, dark vertical pole or staff extends downwards, appearing to be held or positioned between the two figures. The figure on the left stands, facing towards the right, with a round face, a wide smile, and dark, short hair. This figure wears dark, loose-fitting robes. The figure on the right is depicted from behind, kneeling or sitting on the ground, wearing lighter-colored, flowing robes. The entire composition is framed by a patterned border on the left and right sides, featuring a repeating geometric motif in a muted teal and gold color, with more elaborate gold and beige patterns at the very top and bottom edges.

metadata.title: 伊藤若冲筆　伝池大雅賛　寒山拾得 「 一箇大行薩埵、 一箇大佛袒師、 何以為驗 弊帚、殘經落韻詩」|Hanshan and Shide (Japanese: Kanzan and Jittoku)

alt_text: A standing woman in a black kimono with white floral patterns, trimming a small white object.
long_description: The artwork depicts a full-length portrait of a woman standing against a plain, light tan background. The image is framed by a decorative border featuring a blue fabric with a repeating pattern of small gold dots, and a narrower inner border of light tan with tiny gold flecks. The woman stands slightly angled to the viewer's right, her head tilted down as she focuses on her hands. Her face is pale with delicate features, and her dark hair is styled in a large, elaborate updo, adorned with a prominent red floral ornament and a smaller gold accent. She wears a long, black kimono with wide sleeves, which is decorated with scattered white five-petaled flowers and small green leaves. The inner lining of the kimono, visible at the sleeves and hem, features a pattern of dark red and black geometric shapes. A white undergarment is visible at her neck, with a narrow red collar. In her hands, she holds a slender, light-colored object, possibly a wick or a piece of paper, which she appears to be trimming with a small, dark-handled blade held in her left hand. A light tan fan, decorated with a circular blue and white emblem, is tucked into her obi on her left side. Her feet are visible at the bottom, wearing white tabi socks and dark sandals with thick, light-colored soles. The voluminous hem of her kimono pools around her feet, revealing layers of white, red, and light purple fabric underneath. On the left side of the image, near her lower left leg, there is vertical black text followed by a small red seal. The text reads: "清友画".

metadata.title: 鳥居清友筆  羽根突き美人図|Woman with Battledore and Shuttlecock
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A woman on a platform held by a strongman, with a child clinging to his leg, on a scroll
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features three figures arranged vertically on a plain, light brown background. The scroll itself has a dark brown fabric border with a subtle floral pattern, and narrow light blue patterned bands at the top and bottom of the central panel. At the top, a woman stands on a raised yellow platform with red accents. She wears a red and black kimono adorned with orange and white patterns, and her dark hair is styled upwards with decorative pins. She holds a long, thin pipe in her right hand and a small green bowl in her left, looking slightly downward and to her right. Below her, a large, muscular man supports the platform with both hands, his arms flexed. He has a bare, robust torso, a prominent belly, and a short, dark beard. He wears a dark green and blue patterned garment around his lower body, and his face shows a strained expression. A small child, dressed in a white and pink checkered kimono, clings to the man's left leg, with their face turned towards the viewer. To the left of the man and child, vertical Japanese script is visible, accompanied by a red seal at the bottom.

metadata.title: 伝鳥居清重筆　朝比奈義秀図|The Warrior Asahina Yoshihide Lifting a Puppet of a Courtesan on a Go Board
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A person in a red and white robe kneels, holding a fan, beside a pine branch on a scroll.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a single figure kneeling or sitting on a plain, light brown background. The figure, positioned slightly to the left of center and in the lower half of the composition, wears a long, flowing red garment that spreads across the ground, and a loose, white outer robe with wide sleeves. The person's dark hair is styled upwards, and their head is tilted downwards, looking towards a small, open fan held in their hands. The fan is light-colored with a subtle design. To the right of the figure, a sparse pine branch with dark needles extends upwards from the lower right. The main painted area is bordered by a wider, light gold-colored fabric with a subtle, repeating floral pattern. This gold border is further framed at the very top and bottom by a narrower band of dark blue fabric with a lighter, intricate floral motif.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A tall scroll painting depicts a woman and two children in patterned robes standing under a pine tree.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting with a light tan background, framed by a green border with a repeating floral pattern. At the top and bottom of the central image area, there are horizontal bands of a darker tan with green floral motifs. In the center, a tall woman stands facing slightly right, looking down towards the two smaller figures beside her. She wears a long, flowing robe with a light gray-blue base color, adorned with scattered pink cherry blossoms and dark fan shapes. Her wide obi (sash) is a rich red with gold circular patterns. Her hair is styled in a dark, elaborate updo. She holds a small, dark object in her hands, which are positioned near her chest. To her left, a child stands facing her, wearing a similar patterned robe in lighter shades of gray-blue and pink, with a red obi. This child holds a small, light-colored object. To the woman's right, another child stands facing her, also in a patterned robe of gray-blue and pink, with a red obi, and appears to be holding a small, light object. Both children have dark hair styled in updos. To the left of the figures, a tall pine tree with dark green needles and some lighter, almost white tips extends upwards, its branches reaching towards the top of the scroll. The tree trunk is visible at the bottom left, wrapped with a light brown band. A small red rectangular seal is visible in the bottom right corner of the central image area.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a misty mountain landscape with a large peak, water, islands, and small boats
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal ink wash painting, primarily rendered in shades of black, gray, and a pale greenish-blue, set against a light, off-white background. The composition depicts a vast, misty landscape.In the background, a prominent, large mountain peak rises in the upper center-right, appearing to emit a plume of smoke or mist that blends into the hazy sky. To its left, a range of smaller, softer mountains recedes into the distance, also partially obscured by mist.The middle ground is dominated by a wide expanse of pale greenish-blue water. Scattered across this water are several small, dark shapes, possibly representing boats. On the left side of the water, a cluster of dark, rocky islands emerges, densely covered with dark green trees and foliage, extending from the left edge towards the center. On the right side, a more isolated rocky island features a few sparse, gnarled pine trees with dark trunks and green needles. A small, simple, light-colored structure, possibly a house or temple, is visible on this island. A narrow, dark line, suggesting a bridge or path, connects this island to another smaller rock formation further to the right.In the upper left corner of the painting, there is a block of vertical text written in black ink, accompanied by two red square seals positioned below and to the right of the text. The overall atmosphere is serene and somewhat ethereal due to the pervasive mist.

metadata.title: 富士山図 (Fuji-san zu)|Mount Fuji

alt_text: A hazy landscape painting shows mountains, a village by water, and faint text on a light background
long_description: This horizontal painting depicts a muted, hazy landscape. On the left, a large, light gray mountain with a jagged peak rises, its slopes subtly textured with darker lines. Below the mountain, a few tall, dark green pine trees stand on a rocky, light brown outcrop. To the right of the trees, a small cluster of buildings, possibly a village, is situated near the water's edge. These structures have light brown walls and dark brown roofs, with low fences or walls surrounding some of them. Two small, dark figures appear to be walking on a path near the buildings. The landscape opens up to a wide expanse of light gray water, where two circular, light-colored shapes are visible on the surface. Faint, light brown landforms or reeds line the water's edge in the foreground. The sky is a very light, almost white, hazy color, blending seamlessly with the distant mountains and water. Several columns of dark, vertical calligraphic script are present: a short column in the upper left and two longer columns in the upper right.

metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Monochrome scroll painting showing multiple figures in a traditional architectural setting with Japanese script.
long_description: A horizontal, monochrome ink painting on aged, light brown paper depicts an interior scene with multiple figures and two sections of vertical script. The composition is divided into three main visual areas. On the far left, a block of vertical, calligraphic Japanese script occupies about one-fifth of the width. The central and largest section, approximately three-fifths of the width, illustrates a building's interior from an elevated perspective, as if the roof has been removed. Diagonal beams and vertical posts define the rooms and corridors. Figures are rendered with simple, bold ink outlines and minimal shading. In the upper left of this central section, two figures are partially visible, looking downwards. Below them, a figure with a tall, dark hat is seated, facing right. Further right and slightly lower, two more figures are seated, also facing right. In the upper right part of the central section, several figures, mostly women with long, dark hair, are seated or reclining, wearing garments with striped patterns. In the lower right of this section, a single figure with long, dark hair is seated, facing left, next to a stack of cylindrical objects. The far right section, similar in size to the left, contains another block of vertical, calligraphic Japanese script.

alt_text: A long horizontal scroll depicting a lively outdoor scene with many people, buildings, a tree, and a large banner
long_description:
The artwork is a horizontal, panoramic painting depicting a bustling outdoor scene with numerous figures, architectural elements, and a large tree. The background is a light, neutral tone.

On the far left, a large rectangular banner hangs, featuring a red-skinned, muscular figure with a fierce expression, holding a rope. Below this, a structure with a blue and orange striped canopy extends horizontally. Two men, dressed in simple garments, stand on separate raised green platforms, facing each other as if engaged in a performance or contest. Below them, a group of people in colorful kimonos and various hats walk or stand, observing the scene.

Moving towards the center, a prominent green tree with a thick, gnarled trunk and dense, dark green foliage stands. To its right, a series of light-colored buildings with intricate rooflines and blue-patterned curtains are visible. Several tall, white rectangular banners or screens are positioned vertically in front of these buildings.

Throughout the right half of the painting, numerous figures, predominantly women in richly patterned kimonos of various colors like pink, green, blue, and red, are depicted. They are arranged in groups, some standing on raised green platforms, others walking along the ground. Some figures appear to be interacting, gesturing, or performing, contributing to the lively atmosphere. The overall composition suggests a public gathering or theatrical event.

alt_text: Ink wash landscape painting with mountains, water, trees, buildings, and calligraphy.
long_description: A horizontal ink wash landscape painting is centered on a light blue patterned background, framed by a gold border. The painting depicts a panoramic scene of mountains, water, trees, and scattered buildings. In the background, several layers of mountains rise, rendered with lighter ink washes, some exhibiting faint blue hues, suggesting distance and mist. The midground features more detailed mountains with textured slopes and numerous trees, some with dense foliage and others appearing bare or sparse. On the left side, a cluster of traditional-style buildings with dark roofs is nestled among trees at the base of a mountain, near what appears to be a cascading stream or waterfall. Moving towards the center, a body of water, possibly a lake or river, stretches across the middle ground, with a small, simple bridge spanning a narrow section. The right side of the painting shows more clusters of trees, varying in height and density, some with reddish-brown accents on their leaves or branches. A small, single-story building with a dark roof is visible near the water's edge on the right. Several columns of vertical black calligraphy are present in the upper right portion of the painting, accompanied by two red square seals, one near the text and another in the lower left corner of the artwork. The primary colors are black ink on an off-white paper, with subtle blue and reddish-brown accents.

alt_text: Horizontal painting of two dark birds swimming in water, with reeds, pink and white flowers, and calligraphic text.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal painting on a light tan, aged paper. The composition features a minimalist landscape in the lower half and calligraphic text in the upper half. In the lower left, a small patch of green reeds and grass grows on a slightly raised bank. To its right, a body of water is depicted with a light blue-grey wash, curving from the left edge towards the center. Two dark-colored birds, possibly ducks or cormorants, swim in this water. The bird on the left is positioned slightly ahead of the one on the right, both facing generally towards the right. A small, light-colored, indistinct object is partially visible in the water near the left bank, behind the reeds. In the lower right, another patch of green grass and reeds is visible, from which small pink and white flowers emerge. These flowers are clustered together, with some appearing as simple white dots and others showing faint pink hues. The upper portion of the painting contains several columns of black calligraphic text. From right to left, there are three main blocks of text. The rightmost block has two columns, the middle block has three columns, and the leftmost block has four columns. The characters are written in a fluid, cursive style. The background throughout is a uniform light tan, showing some subtle variations in tone and texture.

metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a detailed mountainous landscape with dense trees, flowing water, and calligraphic text at the top.
long_description: A tall, narrow, vertical scroll painting features a detailed landscape with mountains, trees, and water, rendered in muted greens, blues, browns, and grays. The painting is framed by a gold-colored border with a subtle patterned design. The top portion of the painting contains two columns of black calligraphic text on a light background, with several red square seals interspersed. Below the text, the landscape begins with towering, craggy mountains, rendered in light browns and grays, receding into the distance. As the eye moves down, the mountains become more defined, with visible brushstrokes suggesting texture. Dense clusters of trees, primarily in dark green and blue-green hues, cover the slopes and valleys. A winding river or stream, depicted in lighter tones, flows through the landscape, occasionally forming small waterfalls. Small, indistinct structures, possibly houses or temples, are nestled among the trees and mountainsides. The lower half of the painting features larger, more prominent trees with intricate branch patterns, their foliage a deep blue-green. A significant body of water, possibly a lake or wider river, is visible towards the bottom, with a small, arched bridge or structure on its bank. More small, simple buildings are visible near the water's edge and tucked into the dense foliage. The very bottom of the painted area includes a red square seal. The overall composition creates a sense of depth and vastness, with elements layered from foreground to background.

alt_text: A vertical ink and color painting of a mountainous landscape with red-leafed trees and small structures
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a mountainous landscape rendered in ink and light colors on a light, cream-colored ground. A large, light-toned mountain or cliff face dominates the right side, extending from the top to the bottom. Its surface is textured with vertical and diagonal brushstrokes in dark gray and black, suggesting rugged rock formations. On the left, a smaller, similarly textured mountain rises, partially obscured by a dense cluster of trees. Numerous trees with delicate branches and clusters of vibrant red foliage are scattered across the mountainsides, particularly prominent in the middle and lower left. Some trees also display dark green or black foliage, possibly pines, especially on the upper slopes. In the mid-left, nestled among the red-leafed trees, is a small, simple structure with a dark roof, possibly a house or pavilion, connected by a small bridge or pathway that ascends the slope. The lower portion of the painting features a rocky foreground with dark, rounded boulders and lighter, snow-like patches. A narrow path or stream winds through this area, leading towards a very small, simple hut with a dark roof visible at the bottom right. The upper left corner contains vertical lines of black calligraphic text and a red seal impression. The overall palette is dominated by grays, blacks, and light browns, with striking red accents from the autumn foliage.

alt_text: A black ink drawing of a shrine with a demonic face, surrounded by trees, with birds flying above.
long_description: The artwork is a black ink drawing on a light-colored, rectangular sheet of paper, presented within a larger album or book page. The drawing occupies the central portion of the sheet. On the left side of the drawing, a large, gnarled tree with dense foliage stands over a structure resembling a small shrine or monument. Inside this structure, a stylized, horned face with prominent fangs, characteristic of a demonic or oni mask, is depicted. The base of the shrine and the area around it are covered in swirling lines suggesting bushes or clouds. To the right of the shrine, the ground is sparsely detailed with small, spiky plants or rocks. Above this area, in the upper right quadrant of the drawing, two bird-like figures are shown in flight, rendered with simple, swift strokes. The background is mostly blank, light-colored paper. Vertical black text is present on the far left of the drawing, reading "梧庵 鬼面状会 帝山". Below this text, a small red square seal is visible. To the far left of this main drawing, a partial view of another ink drawing is visible, depicting mountains and trees, also with vertical text "梧庵 山水 帝山" and a red seal. The right edge of the entire composition features a vertical strip of light brown paper with dark speckles.

alt_text: Vertical ink wash painting of a mountainous landscape with traditional buildings, dense trees, and a winding path.
long_description: The vertical scroll painting depicts a detailed mountainous landscape rendered primarily in ink washes with subtle color accents. The composition is arranged vertically, with towering mountains dominating the upper half and a village nestled in the lower half. In the upper left, vertical lines of black calligraphy are visible, accompanied by a square red seal below them. The mountains in the upper section are craggy and textured, depicted with varying shades of grey and black ink, and hints of light pinkish-brown on some peaks. A few sparse trees cling to the mountain slopes. The middle ground features a transition to smaller, rounded hills and a denser array of trees, some with dark, full foliage and others appearing bare with intricate branches. A winding path or stream, rendered with dark ink, descends through this area. The lower half of the painting showcases a cluster of traditional buildings with prominent thatched roofs, rendered in light brown and pinkish hues. Some buildings have open fronts, revealing interior spaces. Small figures are visible on the roofs of some structures, possibly engaged in activity. More trees, similar to those in the mid-ground, surround these dwellings. A dark, winding stream or path continues through the foreground, leading towards the bottom edge of the artwork. The overall palette is dominated by black and grey ink, complemented by muted browns, pinks, and subtle greens. The artwork is framed by a brown border with a black section at the top and bottom, featuring gold swirling patterns and small bird-like motifs.

alt_text: A vertical scroll depicts three figures on a suspended platform, with large black text and two small images.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll with a light, off-white background. The top and bottom edges feature a patterned border in muted gold and green tones. A large block of black calligraphic text runs vertically down the upper left side of the scroll, partially overlapping a faint, pale orange vertical stripe that extends from the top to the bottom of the central image area. Near the top, within the pale orange stripe, three figures are depicted standing on a small, rectangular platform that appears to be suspended by two thin lines extending downwards. The leftmost figure, dressed in a blue-green robe, holds a long, thin pole with a small, dark object at its end, pointing towards the large black text. The central figure, in a dark robe, is seated on the platform. The rightmost figure, in a patterned robe, holds a tall, thin staff. Below the suspended platform, two small, rectangular images are stacked vertically on the right side of the pale orange stripe. The upper small image shows a figure with a prominent head. The lower small image depicts a figure with a large head, topped by a small, dark, bird-like creature. Further down the right side, vertical black text is visible, accompanied by a small red seal near the bottom. The overall impression is of a narrative scene with accompanying text and smaller illustrative elements.

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting depicting a mountainous river landscape with trees, boats, and figures, featuring calligraphy at the top
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting, primarily rendered in black and gray ink washes on a light beige paper, framed by a teal-blue fabric border with a subtle gold pattern and thin gold-colored strips at the top and bottom. The painting depicts a vast, serene landscape.In the upper right section, black calligraphy is arranged in five vertical columns. Below the text are two red square seals. The calligraphy reads: "泰光 丙辰深秋寫於江", "上漁樵村北窓下", "名邦一峰居士寫每", "行此幅以花", "庵法正".The upper half of the painting features rolling mountains, depicted with soft, layered ink washes that create a sense of depth and atmospheric perspective. A wide river, represented by the unpainted beige paper, winds through the landscape from the upper left towards the bottom.Throughout the mid-ground and foreground, numerous trees are scattered across hillsides and along the riverbanks. Many of these trees appear deciduous, with fine, dark brushstrokes forming their bare or sparsely leafed branches, and darker trunks. Several trees, particularly in the lower half, resemble weeping willows with their drooping branches.Small details are visible within the landscape: tiny boats float on the river in the middle section, and minuscule figures can be discerned on the riverbanks or within the boats. On a hillside in the mid-ground, a small building is nestled among trees. The varying tones of ink create a sense of light and shadow across the undulating terrain.

alt_text: Vertical ink wash painting of a flowering plum branch with delicate blossoms and black calligraphy on a scroll
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features an ink wash depiction of a flowering plum branch against a light, cream-colored background. The painting is framed by a textured, light brown border with subtle gold patterns, particularly visible at the top and bottom edges. In the upper left quadrant, several lines of black calligraphy are present, accompanied by two small red seals. Below the calligraphy, a thick, gnarled plum branch emerges from the lower left, extending upwards and diagonally across the central and right portions of the composition. The branches are rendered in varying shades of dark grey and black ink, creating a sense of depth and texture. Numerous small, delicate white blossoms with dark centers are scattered along the branches, some appearing as clusters, while other thinner twigs remain bare. The ink wash technique gives the branches a soft, organic appearance, contrasting with the crispness of the blossoms and calligraphy.

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting depicts a plant with green leaves and white flowers, with black text and a red seal.
long_description: The image displays a fan-shaped painting centered on a light beige rectangular background, which is framed by a black border. The fan itself is a pale, off-white or light tan color, with visible vertical lines suggesting its folded structure. On the left side of the fan, a plant with slender branches and numerous leaves is depicted. The leaves are rendered in varying shades of muted green, from a lighter, almost blue-green to a darker, more saturated green. Small clusters of white flowers, appearing as delicate dots or short strokes, are scattered among the leaves and along the branches. The plant extends from the lower left towards the upper center of the fan. On the right side of the fan, there is vertical black text, which appears to be Japanese characters. Below the text, a small, irregular red seal is visible. The rest of the fan's surface is unadorned, providing a simple backdrop for the plant and text.

alt_text: A horizontal scroll painting depicts a procession of various insects carrying objects among plants and flowers.
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal scroll featuring a central painted panel on a light, cream-colored background. Above and below this panel are decorative borders: a narrow brown band with small, light green floral motifs, flanked by wider sections of a light, off-white fabric with a grid pattern of thin blue lines. The main scene unfolds across the central panel, depicting a long procession of insects moving generally from left to right. On the far left, several green grasshopper-like insects walk in a line. As the procession continues towards the center, more diverse insects appear, including mantises, crickets, and smaller beetle-like creatures. Many of these insects are green or brown, with some having lighter undersides. In the middle of the procession, a group of insects carries a small, dark, rectangular object resembling a palanquin or sedan chair, adorned with red ties. Throughout the scene, various plants and flowers emerge from the ground line. On the left, tall, slender green stems with small leaves and a yellow flower are visible, along with a pinkish-red flower. Further right, a blue flower with a yellow center and several stalks of grass or reeds are depicted. The insects interact with these plants, some walking past them, others seemingly climbing on them. Towards the right, the procession continues with more grasshoppers, moths, and other small insects. On the far right, a vertical column of two characters and a red seal are visible. The overall impression is one of a lively, organized movement of the insect world.

alt_text: A traditional painting depicts people by a winding river in a hilly landscape with trees, two children bathing.
long_description: A horizontal painting shows a landscape scene with several figures. The background features rolling hills with slopes in shades of green and light brown. Numerous trees with green foliage and some with bare branches are scattered across the hills and along the riverbanks. A winding river, depicted with light gray water and white ripples, flows from the upper right towards the lower left of the composition. On the left bank of the river, two adult figures are seated. One figure, dressed in white robes and a dark cap, faces right and appears to be writing on a scroll. The other figure, in brown robes, sits facing the first. Further to the right, near the river's edge, another adult figure lies on their side, partially covered by a white cloth. In the river itself, two small figures, possibly children, are partially submerged, appearing to bathe or play. The ground around the river is a light tan color. A small, dark rectangular object with vertical markings is visible on the bank between the seated figures and the river. The painting is framed by decorative borders at the top and bottom, featuring a repeating pattern of gold motifs on a teal background. The overall background of the scroll is a light gold color with a subtle pattern.

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts two women and a child under a pine and flowering plum tree, with butterflies
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring two women and a child in an outdoor setting. The central figure is a tall woman standing slightly to the right of the center, facing left with her head turned towards a smaller woman and child. She wears a light blue kimono with gold floral patterns, a dark obi, and a red lining visible at the sleeves and hem. Her hair is styled up with dark ornaments. Her right hand is extended towards the smaller woman. To her left, a smaller woman kneels or sits on a raised platform, holding the hand of a young child who stands in front of her. The smaller woman wears a light green kimono with a white and green geometric pattern on the lower half, and red lining. The child, standing between the two women, wears a light green kimono with a floral pattern. Both the smaller woman and child have their hair styled up. Behind the figures, a large green pine tree with thick needles extends across the upper left and center of the painting. Intertwined with the pine branches are branches of a flowering plum tree, bearing numerous small red blossoms. The ground beneath the figures is a light tan color, with faint horizontal lines suggesting wooden planks. In the lower left, a small green basket with a red handle and a few small objects sits on a green mat. The painting has a decorative border. The left border is a vertical strip with white cherry blossoms on a light green background. The right border is a gold-flecked tan strip with several white and blue butterflies scattered vertically. The top border is a horizontal strip with white cherry blossoms. In the upper right, there is a vertical column of black text with two red seals. The text reads: "村澤雪園" and "雪園".

alt_text: Two figures in traditional robes within an architectural setting, with vertical script on the right
long_description: A horizontal artwork features a central rectangular area of light-colored paper, framed by two decorative borders. The inner border is a dark blue band with repeating floral patterns in yellow, red, and light blue. The outer border is a wider, brown-gold band with a repeating pattern of stylized cloud or wave motifs. The central paper area contains a drawing and vertical lines of script on the right side. The drawing depicts two figures within an architectural setting. On the left, a figure in dark, flowing robes and a tall, dark hat is seated or kneeling, facing right. They hold a long, thin, dark object diagonally across their body. To their right, a second figure in lighter robes, with hair pulled back, stands or kneels, facing left, holding a tray or dish. Behind the figures are vertical lines suggesting walls or screens, adorned with circular or oval motifs. Below the figures, a series of parallel lines indicates steps or platforms. The left half of the central paper area is mostly blank, with faint, uncolored lines suggesting additional architectural elements or a distant landscape. The drawing is primarily in black ink, with some areas left as outlines.

alt_text: Two figures in traditional attire, one holding cymbals, the other a fan, with a pine branch
long_description: A vertical artwork depicts two figures in traditional attire against a plain, light beige background. The artwork is framed by a decorative border, with a dark brown band at the top and bottom, and a textured gray and gold pattern along the sides. The figure on the left faces right, wearing a black kimono with red and green floral patterns on the sleeves and lower half. A white undergarment is visible at the neck and wrists, and a red sash is tied around the waist. He wears light blue pants and light-colored sandals. A large white bundle is carried on his back, secured by a white head covering. In his hands, he holds two small, round, golden objects, possibly cymbals, and a dark red, textured object. The figure on the right faces left, wearing a kimono with a light blue and black geometric or wave-like pattern, accented with red. He holds a white fan with a red design in his right hand. A dark, elaborate hairstyle is visible, and a sword hilt protrudes from his waist. Both figures have light skin tones. In the upper right portion of the background, a green pine branch extends downwards. In the lower right, there is vertical black text with a red seal beneath it.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono holds a sword, confronting a kneeling man in a room with patterned borders
long_description:
The image depicts a scene with two figures in an interior setting, framed by decorative borders. The central rectangular painting shows a standing figure on the left, appearing to be a woman, holding a long sword with both hands, its blade pointing downwards. She wears a patterned kimono in shades of brown, purple, and gold, with a dark striped skirt. Her hair is styled upwards.

To her right, a man kneels on the light-colored floor, facing her. He is bare-chested, wearing a blue patterned garment over his shoulders and a red loincloth. A dark sword is visible at his waist, with a checkered hilt. His left hand is on the woman's arm, and his right hand is near his own sword. He has a bald head with some hair at the back.

The room features light-colored walls and screens. To the far left, a dark wooden stump or block with a circular indentation on top sits on the floor. In the background, a screen with a textured, possibly carved, design of a tree branch is visible. Further right, a red-leafed tree branch extends from behind a vertical screen. A small vase with red flowers is on a stand in the upper left corner.

The central scene is bordered by a light brown and gold checkered pattern. This is further surrounded by a wider dark blue border with a repeating pattern of gold dragons and clouds. In the lower right corner of the central scene, there is vertical text written in black characters that reads "春川七丈大日如来画".

alt_text: A traditional painting of figures in a building, partially hidden by golden clouds, with a garden below
long_description: The image depicts a scene within and around a building, rendered in a traditional style with a high vantage point. The composition is dominated by large, irregular golden cloud-like shapes that obscure parts of the scene, creating a dynamic, fragmented view. The upper right portion of the image shows the interior of a building with green floors and white walls. A figure in light blue robes is visible, seated or kneeling, facing towards the left. To their right, another figure in light blue and black robes is seen from the back, with long dark hair, seemingly moving or kneeling on the green floor. This area features patterned screens and architectural elements. In the upper left, another section of the building is visible, also with green floors and white walls, and what appears to be a garden with white flowers. A figure in dark robes is partially visible, looking towards the right. The lower left section reveals an outdoor area with green ground, two tall, slender blue and white posts, and green pine-like trees. A dark, rounded shape, possibly a rock or a person's head, is at the base of these posts. The golden cloud-like forms are textured, suggesting gold leaf or paint, and they frame the various vignettes of the scene. The overall color palette includes greens, blues, whites, and the prominent gold. A small, circular red seal with white characters is present in the lower left corner, outside the main artwork area.

alt_text: A multi-story building with many figures in traditional attire, set against a gold background with trees
long_description:
This horizontal painting depicts a multi-story building with numerous figures against a shimmering gold background. The building, rendered in a cutaway perspective, reveals its interior rooms and corridors. Its exterior walls are a light tan, while many interior screens and partitions are a vibrant green. The structure is angled, extending from the lower left towards the upper right.

On the ground level, a veranda extends from the building's left side. Several figures, dressed in colorful robes of red, blue, and white, are seated on this veranda, some facing inward towards the building, others facing left. Inside the ground floor, a large group of figures, similarly attired in various shades of red, blue, green, and black, are seated in rows, appearing to face each other across a central space.

The upper levels of the building also contain multiple rooms, each with figures engaged in different activities. Some figures are seated, while others appear to be moving. In one upper-level room, a small, dark-colored wheeled cart is visible. The background surrounding the building is a textured gold, with stylized green pine trees with dark trunks appearing on both the far left and the right side of the composition. The overall scene is depicted with an elevated viewpoint, offering a comprehensive view of the architectural space and its inhabitants.

alt_text: A seated figure with long dark hair rests on two hairy, beast-like creatures, with a cloud motif below.

The figure is positioned slightly above the center of the composition, facing towards the left with a serene expression. Their hands are clasped in front of them, holding a small, indistinct object. Below the figure are two large, hairy, beast-like creatures rendered in dark ink. The creature on the right has a prominent head with an open mouth, visible teeth, and a shaggy mane, while the creature on the left is a swirling mass of hair and form. The figure appears to be seated on or supported by these creatures. At the bottom of the painting, a stylized, dark ink cloud or swirl motif is depicted. A small red square seal is visible in the lower right quadrant. The central painting is bordered by a patterned brown fabric, which is further framed by a plain green fabric at the very top and bottom of the scroll.

alt_text: Three figures in patterned robes on green and gold stylized landscape with pine trees
long_description: The artwork features three figures in a stylized setting with a gold background. The composition is divided by diagonal bands of green and patterned surfaces, suggesting different levels or rooms. In the upper right, a figure is seated, facing left. This figure wears an orange robe with a white and green floral pattern, and a white undergarment. The surface they sit on is green with a geometric pattern, and behind them are green leaves with small red flowers. In the middle left, a figure is seated, facing right. This figure wears a white robe with a circular floral pattern in white and gray, and a black cap. They sit on a plain green surface. Below and to the right of the white-robed figure, another figure is seated, facing left. This figure wears a green robe with a diamond pattern. They also sit on a plain green surface. Between these figures and in the background are sections of gold, interspersed with stylized green pine trees and dark vertical elements. Some sections feature brown panels with white, wavy lines, resembling fences or screens. The overall impression is of a decorative, multi-level scene.

long_description: The painting shows an indoor scene with a woman seated on the floor, facing towards the right side of the frame, her head bowed. She wears a vibrant red kimono adorned with intricate patterns in black, white, blue, green, and gold. Her black hair is styled upwards, secured with a small, dark ornament. To the left of the woman, a sloped ceiling or roofline is visible above a vertical screen composed of dark vertical and horizontal bars. Below the screen, on the light brown floor, rests a small, rounded white object on a red, circular dish. Vertical script, appearing to be in a script like Japanese characters, is visible on the wall to the left of the screen. To the right of the woman, a low, light-colored wooden table holds a light blue jar topped with a dark, rounded object. Further to the right, delicate plants with thin stems, small green leaves, and several small white flowers grow from the floor. The background is a uniform light brown or tan. The main painted area is framed at the top and bottom by a decorative border featuring a repeating pattern of gold and brown floral or foliate motifs.

Three figures are seated: a central figure in a blue patterned robe, a figure to the left in a red robe, and a figure to the right in a blue robe. Green plants are visible behind them. The lower level of the right scene shows a wooden veranda extending from a building with sliding doors. Two figures are seated on the veranda, one in a red robe and one in a white robe. The central figure, rendered with broad, fluid black ink strokes, occupies the lower half of the main light-colored panel. The figure has a round head with dark hair or a cap, small eyes, and a prominent, long, dark beard that extends down to the chest. The body is suggested by wide, flowing robes with long sleeves, indicated by thick, curved lines. The figure's posture is slightly angled, with the left arm appearing to extend outwards. In the upper right and left sections of the panel, several columns of black ink calligraphy are visible. Below the figure's right arm, near the bottom right corner of the main panel, there is a small, irregular red seal or stamp. long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting on a light tan background, framed by a gold-patterned border. A tall, slender plant with white flowers and green leaves dominates the central-right portion of the composition, extending from near the bottom to almost the top. The main stem is a light brown, with several large, open white flowers featuring yellow centers blooming along its length. Smaller white buds are visible towards the top. The plant has numerous green leaves, some with distinct lobes, attached to the main stem and smaller branches. To the left of the main plant, a smaller, vine-like plant with reddish-pink, spiky inflorescences and darker green leaves intertwines with the lower foliage of the larger plant. An orange butterfly with dark markings on its wings is depicted in flight, positioned to the left of the main plant's upper flowers. Near the bottom right, a red square seal impression is visible, accompanied by a few vertical lines of black text. The background is a uniform, unadorned light tan color.

long_description: A vertical ink painting depicts a small person riding a large ox on a light-colored background. The person, positioned slightly left of center, has dark, curly hair and wears a striped garment. They hold a thin stick or whip in their right hand, guiding the ox. The ox, a prominent light gray figure, is shown with its front legs lifted, suggesting movement or a jump. A thin line, possibly a rope, extends from its nose. Sparse, dark ink marks on the ground beneath the ox and person suggest uneven terrain or vegetation. In the upper right portion of the painting, a dark pine branch with clusters of needles extends downwards and to the left. A small, square red seal is visible in the lower right corner of the artwork. The overall palette consists of various shades of gray and black ink on a light, aged paper surface.

long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a plant with large leaves and a white flower against a plain, light tan background. The plant, possibly a gourd, originates from the lower-right and extends upwards, occupying the central and right portions of the composition. Several large, dark green leaves with visible veins are scattered along the winding vines. One prominent white flower with multiple petals blooms near the center-right. Smaller, elongated green objects, possibly young fruits or buds, are visible along the thinner stems. Two slender, dark brown vertical stalks, resembling bamboo, are positioned behind the plant, providing support. Delicate tendrils curl outwards from the vines. In the lower-left corner, a small area contains dark ink calligraphy and a red square seal. The central painting is bordered by a thin, gold-colored strip with a subtle pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider, light brown fabric with a repeating scroll-like motif.

alt_text: Monochrome drawing depicting numerous figures in and around water, with boats, land, and simple structures.
long_description: This monochrome drawing, presented in a horizontal format, depicts a bustling scene with numerous figures engaged in various activities in and around a body of water. The artwork is rendered in fine black lines on a light background. On the far left, several figures are partially submerged in wavy water, while a small boat with two figures using oars navigates the lower left. Moving towards the center, more figures are seen wading through the water, some standing on what appear to be submerged platforms or shallow ground. A large group of figures occupies the central land area, many walking or standing, some near simple, tent-like structures. Further to the right, the land continues to be populated by figures, some seated on raised platforms, others moving along. A small, low bridge extends from the land into the water on the lower right. In the upper background, faint outlines of buildings or larger structures are visible, suggesting a populated area beyond the immediate scene. The water throughout the image is depicted with undulating lines, indicating movement.

alt_text: A standing figure in traditional attire with a bun hairstyle, looking down, on a plain background with decorative borders
long_description: This vertical artwork depicts a single standing figure, positioned slightly to the right of the central axis, against a plain, light brown background. The figure, seen in three-quarter profile facing left, has dark hair styled into a bun at the back of the head. Their head is bowed, and their gaze is directed downwards. They wear a light blue-grey outer garment with wide sleeves, which is lined with a visible red fabric along the edges of the sleeves and the lower hem. A green sash or obi is tied around the waist. White fabric is visible at the wrists, suggesting an inner layer of clothing. The figure's feet are partially visible, clad in dark footwear. To the right of the figure, vertically aligned text in a dark script is present on the tan background. The artwork is framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders feature a dark blue band with intricate gold floral patterns. The side borders are cream-colored with repeating small, stylized floral or clover-like motifs in red, green, and blue, arranged in vertical rows.

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts a large gathering of people in a mountainous landscape, with some preparing food
long_description: This vertical scroll painting, rendered in ink and light colors on paper, depicts a bustling outdoor scene with numerous figures set within a mountainous landscape. The composition is divided into three main sections, moving from top to bottom. The upper section features a light sky above a range of ink-washed mountains that recede into the distance on the right. A prominent peak on the left is topped with dark, detailed trees. Small groups of figures are visible on a winding path in the upper left and near a body of water that stretches across the middle ground. The central section is dominated by a dense crowd of many figures, predominantly men, with varied expressions and postures. They wear simple robes in light tones such as white, grey, and light blue, outlined with black ink. A large wooden cart wheel is a prominent feature on the left side of this crowd. Some figures hold large, round fans or other implements. On the right, a low wall or bridge structure supports additional figures. The lower section focuses on a group of figures engaged in preparing food or drink. A central robed figure kneels, stirring a pot or bowl. Various pots, bowls, and cups are arranged on the ground around them. To the right, another kneeling figure tends a small fire with a pot placed over it. Other details include a large barrel, a pair of shoes, and a screen with visible calligraphic text and a seated figure drawing. In the lower left corner, a red seal and black calligraphic text are present.

alt_text: Two figures in traditional garments walk with a small white dog on a leash, against a plain background
long_description: The vertical painting depicts two figures and a small dog on a light beige background. The taller figure on the left faces forward, looking slightly right. She wears a dark purple kimono with a patterned obi featuring blue, gold, and red designs. The kimono has a red lining visible at the sleeves and hem. Her dark hair is styled upwards, and her skin is light. To her right, a shorter figure walks slightly behind her, also facing forward. This figure wears a dark striped kimono with a red lower garment and a green obi. Her dark hair is styled similarly, and she holds a white leash in her right hand. Attached to the leash is a small, fluffy white dog walking on all fours, facing right. The background is a uniform, light beige color, with faint horizontal lines visible at the very top edge. In the bottom right corner, there is vertical black text and a red square seal.

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts a woman in layered robes bowing, with black calligraphy in the upper right.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a single female figure on a plain background, framed by decorative borders. The woman is positioned slightly below the center, leaning forward and to the left, with her head bowed and eyes cast downwards. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate updo. She wears multiple layers of flowing robes. The innermost layer visible is a vibrant red, forming a wide, flowing skirt. Over this, she wears a light blue robe with white and darker blue trim, patterned with subtle designs. An outer, lighter-colored robe, possibly cream or pale yellow, is draped over her shoulders and arms, with hints of pink or light purple in its folds. Small red butterfly-like shapes are visible on the cream layer near her waist. In the upper right quadrant, several lines of black Japanese calligraphy are written vertically. The central panel of the scroll is a plain, warm tan or light brown color. It is bordered on the top, bottom, and sides by a narrow band of red and white vertical stripes. Outside this, a wider border of dark blue fabric with an intricate gold floral and cloud-like pattern frames the entire artwork.

alt_text: A standing figure in a kimono adjusts their hair, painted on a vertical scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical painting on a light beige paper, mounted as a scroll with decorative fabric borders. A single figure, appearing to be a woman, stands centrally, facing slightly towards the viewer's left. Her skin is pale, and her dark hair is styled up, with both hands raised to the back of her head, as if adjusting it. She wears a long, flowing kimono that is primarily a light cream or off-white color, adorned with subtle, delicate patterns of leaves or small flowers in light grey and faint blue hues. A vibrant red collar is visible at her neck, and a red lining is also seen along the bottom hem of the kimono and inside the wide sleeves. Around her waist, a light grey obi with a textured, patterned surface is tied. The figure's bare feet are visible at the bottom. On the right side of the painting, near the bottom, there is a vertical inscription in dark characters, accompanied by a small red seal. The painting itself is framed by a narrow, light brown border with a subtle pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider, patterned fabric border featuring geometric shapes and floral motifs in shades of blue, green, gold, and red.

alt_text: A woman with long dark hair sits on the floor, reading a book, dressed in a black and gold kimono
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single figure, a woman, seated in the lower center against a plain, light tan background. The woman has pale skin and long, dark hair that is pulled back from her face, with a few strands visible near her forehead. She is depicted in a kneeling or seated position, looking down at an open book or scroll held in her hands. She wears an elaborate kimono with a dark, possibly black, background adorned with gold floral patterns, resembling chrysanthemums or plum blossoms. Beneath the outer kimono, layers of fabric are visible, featuring stripes in shades of red, white, and light brown. A vibrant blue fabric is also visible around her hands and sleeves. In the lower left corner of the tan background, there is a vertical column of black calligraphic text, accompanied by a small red seal below it. The entire painting is framed by a decorative border. At the top and bottom, there is a narrow green band with subtle gold patterns. Along the left and right sides, a wider brown border features repeating circular gold motifs.

alt_text: A person with a halo rides on the back of a large, light-colored elephant against a plain background
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a person riding a large elephant against a plain, light brown background. The person is positioned in the upper third of the painting, seated on the elephant's back, facing slightly left. A pale, circular halo is visible behind their head. They have dark hair styled in a bun with a dark ornament. Their face is light-skinned with delicate features, and their eyes are downcast. They wear a multi-layered robe: an inner white garment, a red sash, and an outer dark brown cloak. Their lower legs are covered in light blue patterned leggings with white and pink floral designs, and they wear light-colored shoes. The elephant occupies the lower two-thirds of the painting, depicted in a light, almost white, outline with subtle shading. It walks towards the viewer's left, with its head turned slightly forward. Its large ears hang down, and its eyes are open, looking forward. Two short, light-colored tusks protrude from its mouth, which has a reddish-pink detail. Its trunk is curled slightly upwards. The elephant's legs are thick, and its feet show distinct toes. The background is a uniform light brown or tan color. In the upper right quadrant, there are faint dark characters and two small red square seals. The painting is framed by a light beige border with a subtle patterned texture at the top and bottom.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono holds a fan, standing by water and reeds, with calligraphy above
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a woman in a landscape setting with calligraphy. The background is a plain, light tan color. At the top right, black calligraphic text is arranged in two vertical columns, with a small red square seal below the left column. The central figure is a woman, positioned slightly to the left of the vertical center. She faces towards the right side of the painting, with her head bowed and her gaze directed downwards. Her long, dark hair flows down her back. She wears an elaborate kimono, primarily olive green with large floral patterns in shades of pink, light blue, and white, accented with light green leaves. A vibrant red garment is visible beneath the kimono, forming the lower part of her attire. Her left hand holds a white fan, which is partially obscured by her sleeve. The woman stands on a light brown ground that extends across the lower portion of the painting. To her right, a cluster of tall, thin reeds with brown leaves grows from the ground. Below and to the right of the reeds, a small body of water with subtle ripples is depicted. The entire painting is framed by decorative borders: a dark green band with gold floral motifs at the very top and bottom, and narrower green bands with gold floral patterns along the left and right edges.

alt_text: Two figures in white robes walk on a golden path above clouds and water, framed by a patterned border
long_description: A rectangular painting depicts two figures in flowing robes walking on a golden, curved path above a body of water and clouds, all set within a decorative border. The figure on the right, slightly taller, wears a white robe and holds a string of beads. Her dark hair is pulled back. The figure on the left, slightly smaller, also wears a white robe with a visible red undergarment forming a flowing train behind her. Her dark hair is also pulled back. The golden path curves from the lower left towards the upper right, appearing to float above light blue and grey water. White and grey clouds are prominent around the lower figure and extend to the right. In the lower right of the central scene, a dark, irregular shape floats on the water. The background of the central scene is a pale beige. Along the bottom left edge of the central scene, there is a vertical line of black text followed by a red square seal. The central scene is framed by a narrow band of light green with small golden patterns. This inner frame is surrounded by a wider, multi-patterned border featuring vertical strips of white with blue stripes and white dots, interspersed with sections of green leaves and red berries on a light background. Similar floral and leaf patterns in green, gold, and red adorn the top and bottom sections of the outer border.

alt_text: A traditional scroll painting shows a herder guiding several goats through a rocky, sparse landscape with distant mountains.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a pastoral scene rendered in ink and light colors. The upper third of the composition is a blank, off-white space, with black calligraphic text positioned on the left side. The text reads: "丁巳三月寫於停雲館 曾好雨". Below this, the landscape unfolds, depicting a winding path through a rocky terrain. A group of five goats, varying in size and posture, are distributed across the middle and lower sections of the painting. Their bodies are rendered with light brown, white, and grey washes, some exhibiting subtle striped patterns. One goat in the lower left has prominent horns. A small human figure, a herder, wearing a light blue hat and light brown clothing, is positioned among the goats, holding a slender stick. The ground is depicted with dark grey and black brushstrokes, suggesting texture and small rocks. Patches of light blue-green foliage are scattered throughout the landscape, particularly around the goats and in the mid-ground. In the background, a series of dark grey, jagged rock formations or mountains with light blue-green accents rise faintly. A red square seal is visible in the lower right corner of the painted area. The overall palette is muted, dominated by earth tones, greys, and subtle blues.

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a winter landscape with mountains, a river, bare trees, and calligraphy.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting features a winter landscape rendered primarily in shades of grey, black, and white, with subtle hints of reddish-pink. The top left quarter of the scroll contains vertical lines of black calligraphy, followed by a small, square red seal. The upper half of the painting is dominated by a range of mountains, some with textured, horizontal brushstrokes suggesting snow or rock formations, and others with smoother, rounded contours. The sky above the mountains is a light, hazy grey. Below the mountains, a wide body of water, also in light grey tones, stretches across the mid-ground. Several dark, rounded objects, possibly rocks or small islands, are visible in the water on the left. A small, narrow boat with a pointed bow floats near the right bank. The right side of the painting features a steep, rocky bank covered with numerous bare trees. These trees have delicate, branching limbs, many adorned with small, reddish-pink buds or leaves, providing a touch of color against the monochrome landscape. More dark, rounded rocks are scattered along the base of the bank and in the immediate foreground.

alt_text: A person in flowing robes holds a flowering branch, standing in a landscape with mountains and trees.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a standing figure in a monochrome ink wash style on a light, aged paper background. The figure, positioned slightly below the center, has long, dark hair and delicate facial features, looking downwards. They wear long, flowing robes rendered with dark ink outlines and lighter washes, creating a sense of movement and drapery. The figure holds a small branch with delicate blossoms in one hand, while the other hand is slightly extended. Bare feet are visible beneath the robes. In the background, faint, rounded hills are depicted with light ink washes. Sparse trees or bushes with small blossoms are visible on either side of the figure and behind the hills, rendered with delicate lines and dots. The ground beneath the figure is a flat, light area. In the lower right corner, there is vertical calligraphic text and a square red seal impression.

alt_text: A woman in flowing green and red robes with long dark hair stands beside a small white animal on a plain background.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting with a light brown background and decorative golden-brown borders at the top, bottom, and sides. In the lower center, a woman is depicted with long, dark hair flowing down her back and over her shoulders. She wears elaborate, flowing robes, primarily green with subtle blue patterns, and a visible red undergarment. Her left arm is bent, with her hand near her face, while her right arm extends downwards. Her posture suggests a graceful movement or dance. At her feet, to the right, is a small, white, four-legged animal with a long, flowing tail, possibly a cat or fox. The background behind the figure is a plain, light brown. In the lower right corner, there are faint vertical characters of text and a red seal.

alt_text: A vertical painting depicting four seated figures in ornate robes, with two dogs on a lower terrace
long_description: This vertical painting depicts four figures arranged in two rows, with two dogs below. The background is a plain light brown. At the top, two figures are seated on ornate platforms, framed by arch-like structures with green foliage and white flowers. Above these arches are red and gold patterned draperies. The figure on the upper left is a man with a dark beard, wearing a black hat and a black robe, holding a closed fan in his right hand. To his right, an elaborately coiffed woman wears a green and orange patterned robe and holds a round mirror. Below them, in the second row, two more elaborately coiffed women are seated on similar ornate platforms, also framed by arch-like structures with foliage. The woman on the lower left wears a green and orange patterned robe and plays a stringed instrument. To her right, another woman in a green and orange patterned robe sits with her hands resting on her lap. At the bottom of the painting, a red architectural structure with green patterned panels and white sections forms a railing or terrace. Below this structure, on the light brown ground, a white dog lies on the left, and a black dog lies on the right. The figures' robes feature intricate patterns in gold, red, green, and white.

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicting a dark, porous rock and a leafy plant in a pot, with vertical text above.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a light, off-white background with two main subjects in the lower half and calligraphic text in the upper right. On the left, a tall, dark, irregularly shaped rock formation stands upright. It is rendered in shades of black and dark gray, with numerous circular and elongated perforations creating a porous, textured appearance. To the right of the rock, a plant with broad, wavy leaves is depicted in a small, low pot. The plant is rendered in lighter shades of gray and white, with distinct leaf veins. The pot is a simple, rectangular shape with a thin red line along its upper rim. The rock is significantly taller than the potted plant. The upper two-thirds of the scroll are largely empty, providing a sense of open space. In the upper right quadrant, several vertical lines of black calligraphic text are present, followed by a small, square red seal at the bottom of the text block. The entire painted area is framed by a light brown border.

alt_text: Two gold-leaf screen panels depict women and a child in colorful kimonos, with one woman kneeling
long_description: The artwork is a two-panel screen, each panel framed by a dark reddish-brown border. The background of both panels is covered in gold leaf, showing a textured, reflective surface. Within each panel, a large rectangular area of matte gold forms the central ground for the figures. On the left panel, a tall woman stands facing right, looking down at a smaller child. The woman has an elaborate dark hairstyle, a pale face, and wears a long, flowing kimono patterned with red, green, and white motifs over a lighter undergarment. Her left hand is raised slightly, and her right hand is near her waist. The child, standing to the left of the woman and slightly in front, looks up at her. The child wears a dark kimono with colorful floral patterns in pink, blue, and white, and holds a small, red, purse-like object in their left hand. To the left of the figures, a vertical column of dark text is visible. On the right panel, a tall woman stands facing left, looking down at a kneeling woman. The standing woman has an elaborate dark hairstyle adorned with a yellow ornament, a pale face, and wears a long kimono patterned with red, green, and black designs. Her hands are positioned near her waist. The kneeling woman is on her right knee, facing the standing woman and looking up. She wears a light blue kimono with white and red patterns. Her hands are clasped together, holding a red object with white and blue accents. To the right of the figures, a vertical column of dark text is visible.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono sits by a pine tree, holding a hat, with a blue garment hanging
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a woman seated on a gnarled tree trunk, holding a hat, with a pine tree above her. The woman is positioned in the lower-center, facing left with her head slightly turned forward. Her dark hair is styled in a tall, elaborate bun. She wears a red kimono with a white checkered pattern, revealing a white undergarment at her neck. The lower part of her kimono features delicate floral and leaf motifs in white, pink, and light blue. In her right hand, she holds a dark, possibly black, hat with a red cord. Her left hand rests gently on her lap. To her left, a large, textured tree trunk rises, with branches extending across the upper left and center, adorned with clusters of blue-green pine needles. A light blue garment with a subtle pattern hangs from a branch on the left side of the tree. The background is a light, sandy color, with faint horizontal wavy lines suggesting water or a distant landscape. The sky above is a lighter, almost white, tone. The ground around the woman and tree is also light-colored, with sparse green and brown brushstrokes. A red seal and some faint black text are visible near the bottom left of the woman. The entire painting is framed by a dark teal border with a repeating gold floral or cloud pattern.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono stands on a wooden platform, holding a red object, with a small basin nearby.
long_description: The vertical scroll painting depicts a woman standing on a wooden platform against a plain, light brown background. The woman is positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing towards the left with her head gently tilted downwards. Her long, black hair is pulled back, adorned with a small red ornament near the top. Her face is pale with delicate features, including small eyes, a slender nose, and red lips. She wears a light gray kimono patterned with dark gray, stylized floral motifs resembling chrysanthemums. A red collar is visible beneath the kimono, and a wide, light yellow sash is tied around her waist. Her right hand, held near her chest, grasps a small, red, elongated object. Her left hand holds a piece of white fabric that drapes over her arm. Her bare feet are visible beneath the hem of her kimono, with red footwear or socks covering the lower part of her feet. In the lower right portion of the painting, a wooden platform or bridge extends diagonally from the right edge towards the lower left. It features a green, bamboo-like railing. Behind this railing, on the right side, a dark, shallow basin rests on a low, dark wooden stand. Vertical script in black ink is present in the lower right corner, followed by a red square seal. The script reads: "萬洋を以て". The red seal contains the characters "萬洋". The entire artwork is framed by a light green border adorned with small, repeating floral patterns.

alt_text: A multi-panel landscape painting shows misty mountains, a winding river, trees, buildings, and small figures.
long_description: This multi-panel landscape painting, presented across six vertical sections, depicts a vast, serene natural scene with a muted color palette. The overall impression is one of depth and atmospheric perspective, with elements fading into a soft, yellowish-brown background. On the far left, distant, hazy hills emerge from a light mist, leading to a wide body of water that extends across the lower portion of the panels. A small, arched bridge spans a narrow section of this water in the lower-left quadrant. Moving towards the center, prominent, dark mountains rise dramatically, their peaks partially obscured by swirling white and light gray mist. A winding river or lake flows through the foreground, with several small, tree-covered islands. A large, dark-leafed tree stands on one such island in the lower-center. To the right, more mountains continue the rugged terrain. A cluster of traditional-style buildings with white walls and dark roofs is nestled among dense green and brown trees on a gentle slope near the water's edge. A path leads away from these buildings, and two small, indistinct figures, one in white and one in blue, are visible walking along it in the lower-right. The trees throughout the landscape feature varied foliage, rendered in shades of green and brown. In the upper right corner of the far-right panel, a vertical column of dark, calligraphic text is visible.
