alt_text: A gray bird flies over subtle water ripples and reeds on a light beige screen
long_description: This artwork is a six-panel screen, presented horizontally. The background of all panels is a uniform, light, warm beige color, suggesting an expansive sky or a vast, open space. A single bird, rendered in shades of gray and black ink, is positioned slightly left of the center, spanning across the third and fourth panels from the left. The bird appears to be in mid-flight or landing, with its wings spread upwards and slightly back, and its body angled downwards. Subtle, lighter gray washes emanate from beneath the bird, suggesting water ripples or mist. In the lower right portion of the screen, primarily on the fifth and sixth panels, sparse, dark gray and black reeds or tall grasses emerge from the bottom edge, extending upwards. These reeds are depicted with thin, sharp strokes. More subtle gray washes are visible around the base of the reeds, further suggesting a watery environment. A small, red square seal and black text are visible in the bottom right corner of the sixth panel.

alt_text: Ink wash painting on two sliding doors depicting playful puppies in a sparse landscape with hills and bamboo.
long_description: The image displays two vertical sliding doors, each framed in black, featuring an ink wash painting on a light, off-white ground. The overall scene depicts a group of puppies in a sparse landscape. On the left door, in the lower left quadrant, a cluster of five puppies is visible. One puppy, mostly white with some darker markings, sits facing forward, looking towards the viewer. To its left, another puppy, mostly white, is seen from behind, looking towards the sitting puppy. Two more puppies, one mostly white and another with darker patches, are engaged in playful interaction, possibly wrestling, in the lower center. A fifth puppy, mostly white, is partially obscured behind the central group. In the background of the left door, faint, undulating hills are rendered with soft gray washes, and a few small, spiky trees or bushes are visible on a distant rise. A dark, ornate handle is positioned on the left edge of this door, near the top. On the right door, in the lower right quadrant, three more puppies are depicted. One mostly white puppy with a dark patch on its back runs towards the left. Another puppy, with dark patches, is in a playful, possibly rolling, posture below and to the left of the running puppy. A third, mostly white puppy, is partially visible behind the running one. To the left of these puppies, a few stalks of bamboo are rendered with light gray strokes, rising from the ground. The background of the right door also features faint, rolling hills. In the lower right corner, a red, square seal with illegible characters is present. A dark, ornate handle is positioned on the right edge of this door, near the top. The painting uses a limited palette of grays and blacks, with the light ground serving as the primary color for the puppies' fur and the sky.

alt_text: A panoramic painting depicts numerous buildings, people, and activities across a golden landscape with green hills
long_description: This wide, horizontal painting depicts a sprawling landscape filled with numerous traditional-style buildings and a multitude of small figures engaged in various activities. The background is predominantly a shimmering gold, interspersed with areas of green and brown representing hills, ground, and foliage. The buildings feature dark brown, sloped roofs and light-colored walls, often with open interiors revealing scenes within. Starting from the left, the upper portion shows several buildings nestled among green trees, with figures moving between them and visible inside. Below this, more structures are present, and at the bottom left, a white-canopied boat with several figures floats on a body of water. Moving towards the center, a large complex of buildings dominates, with courtyards and pathways bustling with activity. Figures are seen on foot, riding horses, and in ox-drawn carts. A prominent red, ornate cart, possibly pulled by oxen, is visible in the mid-right center, surrounded by many people. The right side of the painting continues this detailed scene, with more buildings and groups of people gathered in various settings. Some figures appear to be conversing or observing, while others are in motion. Green trees and shrubs are scattered throughout the golden landscape, providing visual breaks between the architectural elements and human activity. The overall composition presents a high-angle view, offering a comprehensive look at a lively, populated environment.

metadata.title: 源氏物語図屏風|Fifty-Four Scenes from The Tale of Genji

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicts a vast landscape with towering mountains, numerous buildings, and small boats on water.
long_description: This six-panel screen painting presents an expansive landscape rendered primarily in black ink wash on a light, possibly gold-toned, background. The composition is dominated by a series of towering, craggy mountains that stretch across the entire width of the screen, rising from a body of water that flows through the lower and middle sections. The mountains are depicted with varying shades of ink, creating a sense of depth and texture, and are dotted with numerous small trees and sparse vegetation, particularly on their peaks and slopes. Scattered throughout the mountainous terrain and along the water's edge are numerous traditional-style buildings. These structures vary in size and complexity, ranging from multi-tiered pagodas and large temple-like complexes with sweeping roofs to smaller, simpler dwellings. Many buildings are nestled into the mountain contours or perched on ledges, while others are situated on islands or peninsulas jutting into the water. Small boats, some with figures, are visible on the water in various locations, particularly in the foreground and mid-ground. The overall impression is a vast, inhabited natural environment, with human structures integrated into the dramatic landscape. The light background suggests an atmospheric quality, possibly mist or distant sky.

metadata.title: 狩野山楽筆  金山西湖図屏風|Jinshan Island and West Lake
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A gold screen depicts multiple buildings with figures inside, surrounded by trees and cloud-like forms.
long_description: This multi-panel screen features a shimmering gold leaf background, upon which a complex scene of architectural structures, figures, and natural elements unfolds. The composition is arranged across six vertical panels, with an elevated perspective that reveals the interiors of several buildings, as if their roofs have been removed. The buildings are characterized by light brown wooden frames, dark brown roofs, and sliding panels. Starting from the lower left, a prominent green pine tree with multiple layered branches stands amidst white, cloud-like forms. Above it, a building shows figures seated within its rooms. Moving right, a series of interconnected buildings are depicted. Inside, numerous figures, dressed in robes of red, blue, white, and muted browns, are engaged in various activities. Some are seated on mats, others stand or move between rooms, often in small groups. The interior spaces feature wooden floors, raised platforms, and structural beams. Further to the right, more architectural sections continue, with additional figures visible in different rooms and courtyards. Green foliage and smaller trees are interspersed between the structures. In the lower right, another building with a brown roof is partially visible. The upper right section of the screen contains a small, vertical block of text, written in black characters against the gold background. The overall impression is one of a bustling, yet contained, domestic or courtly environment, rendered with a consistent, high-angle viewpoint.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; innk, color and gold on gilded paper

alt_text: Six-panel screen with twenty-four rectangular sections, each containing text and faint drawings on light paper, framed by gold
long_description: A six-panel screen is presented horizontally, featuring a grid of twenty-four rectangular sections. Each of the six vertical panels contains four stacked rectangular sections. These inner rectangles are made of light-colored paper, each displaying black text written in vertical columns on the right side. To the left of the text, faint, abstract, or landscape-like drawings are visible on the paper. The drawings vary across the sections, some showing geometric shapes, others suggesting natural forms like mountains or water, and some depicting architectural elements. Each light paper rectangle is bordered by a bright gold frame. The entire screen is edged at the top and bottom by a dark border with intricate gold patterns, which also separates the six main vertical panels. The gold frames and decorative borders contrast with the lighter paper sections.

metadata.title: 『伊勢物語』|Forty-nine scenes from the Tales of Ise
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens, with ninety-eight paintings and poem cards (shikishi) applied to gold leaf on paper; paintings: ink and red ink on paper, text: ink on paper

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono sits under a green canopy, reading a long scroll.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a woman seated indoors, reading a scroll. The central panel features a light brown background, bordered on the left and right by dark brown strips adorned with gold and colorful floral patterns, including white, orange, and green blossoms. A narrower green strip with a subtle pattern runs along the top and bottom edges of the central panel. In the upper left, a large green fabric canopy with red trim and a red diamond-shaped accent hangs, with a red tassel suspended from its right side. The woman, positioned slightly left of center, is seated on the floor, facing right, with her head gently bowed as she focuses on a long white scroll. She has pale skin, black hair styled upwards with a small gold ornament, and wears a light blue-gray kimono. The kimono is richly decorated with a vibrant pattern of white, red, orange, green, and yellow flowers and leaves. A brown sash is tied around her waist. She holds the unrolled scroll with both hands, revealing black calligraphic text. To the right of the woman, a vertical column of black text is visible, reading "日本婦人不二之圖" followed by "時丸" and a red square seal below it.

metadata.title: 不非軒時風筆　蚊帳美人図|Woman Reading under a Mosquito Net
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two women in elaborate robes interact in a garden with flowering plants and trees
long_description: The painting depicts two women in traditional attire within a garden setting, rendered in a soft, muted palette. The ground is a light, sandy brown, with a lighter, almost beige sky above. On the left, a woman stands facing right, dressed in a flowing red robe with intricate white and gold patterns. Her long dark hair is styled up, and she holds a small bouquet of colorful flowers and green leaves in her hands. Her robe trails behind her, revealing a white undergarment with red trim. Behind her, a simple wooden gate structure is visible, and green-leafed plants with white flowers grow near the ground. To the right, a second woman stands facing left, dressed in a dark, possibly black or deep green, patterned robe with white and red accents. Her dark hair is also styled up, and her hands are held open, palms up, as if receiving or offering something. Behind her is a low, light brown fence made of vertical slats, and beyond that, two gnarled trees with sparse green foliage. More green plants with white flowers are scattered around the scene. In the bottom right corner, there is a small red seal and some faint black text.

metadata.title: 川又常正筆  「夕顔」『源氏物語』|"Evening Faces" chapter from The Tale of Genji (Genji monogatari)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Monochrome ink landscape painting showing mountains, a river with an arched bridge, and multiple villages.
long_description: This wide, horizontal ink wash landscape painting features a muted, sepia-toned background with varying shades of gray and brown. The composition is divided into distinct sections, moving from left to right. On the far left, tall, rugged mountains with sharp peaks rise prominently, rendered with dark outlines and lighter washes. A small, multi-tiered pavilion or building is visible on a high ridge, surrounded by sparse trees. Below these peaks, a cluster of traditional-style houses forms a village, nestled among smaller, rounded hills and more vegetation. Moving towards the center, the landscape flattens slightly, revealing more clusters of houses and what appears to be cultivated land or fields. Several small, dark figures are depicted near the houses, suggesting human activity. A wide body of water, likely a river or lake, emerges from the mid-ground and flows towards the right. On the right side of the painting, a large, three-arched stone bridge gracefully spans this body of water, connecting two landmasses. Near the bridge, several small boats with figures are visible on the water. Beyond the bridge, the landscape continues with rolling hills, more trees, and distant, softer mountains fading into the upper background. The entire scene is rendered with a consistent ink wash technique, emphasizing natural forms and human settlements.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono reads a scroll by candlelight in a room with a wall hanging
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a woman seated on the floor in an interior setting, framed by a wide, dark blue border patterned with gold fans and shell-like motifs. The room features light-colored walls and a light-colored floor with dark grid lines, suggesting tatami mats. On the right side, a dark grid-patterned screen or door is visible. In the lower center, a woman sits facing left, engrossed in reading a long, light-colored scroll held open in her hands. She wears a kimono with a red lower half and a white upper half, adorned with a subtle pattern. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun. To her left, a tall, slender black candle stand holds a lit white candle. Further left, a small, rectangular, dark-colored box with a red lid sits on the floor. On the wall behind the woman, a large vertical scroll hangs. It features a white animal, possibly a horse or deer, drawn in profile facing left, positioned below several columns of dark Japanese characters. The wall scroll has a light background with a blue and red border.

metadata.title: 石川豊信筆  文を読む遊女図|Courtesan Reading a Letter
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Monochrome ink painting depicting a plant with dark, feathery leaves and a thick stem on a light background
long_description: This is a monochrome ink painting on a light, off-white paper, framed by a light brown border with a subtle geometric pattern. The central subject is a plant, rendered in various shades of dark gray and black ink. The plant features a prominent, thick, cylindrical stem, textured with horizontal brushstrokes, from which several large fronds emerge. These fronds curve outwards and upwards, composed of numerous small, parallel strokes that suggest individual leaflets, creating a feathery appearance. To the right and slightly below the main plant, a smaller, similar plant form is visible, partially obscured. Another smaller, curved element, possibly a root or another stem, extends from the lower left of the main plant. In the lower left corner of the artwork, a small, square red seal is present, containing illegible characters. The background of the painting is plain and unadorned, allowing the dark ink plant to stand out prominently.

alt_text: A vertical ink painting depicts a standing, robed, bearded figure with an earring, beneath calligraphic text.
long_description: A vertical ink painting on a light-colored ground depicts a standing figure, framed by a light brown border and decorative green patterns at the top and bottom. The central panel features a full-length figure, rendered in varying shades of gray and black ink, occupying the lower two-thirds. The figure faces left in profile, with a dark, hooded head covering. A visible ear sports a circular earring, and a dark beard extends from the chin. The body is enveloped in a long, flowing robe, depicted with broad, vertical brushstrokes that create a sense of volume. The robe appears dark gray, with lighter areas suggesting folds. The figure's bare feet are visible at the very bottom of the robe. Above the figure, in the upper right quadrant, is a block of vertical calligraphic text in black ink, which reads from right to left: "落草求人 作麼生 半弱抽身 主過梁觀". To the right of this main text, a smaller column of text reads "達磨化二祖斷臂圖". Below the smaller text, and again in the lower right corner of the central panel, are two red square seal marks.

metadata.title: 雲谷等顔筆　玉甫紹琮賛　達磨図|Bodhidharma

alt_text: Two figures, an adult and a child, stand under a flowering tree in a vertical painting
long_description: A vertical painting depicts two figures, an adult and a child, standing under a flowering tree against a light tan background. The painting is framed by a dark teal border with a gold geometric pattern and an inner brown border with gold swirling motifs. In the upper left, a thick tree trunk rises, from which a large branch extends horizontally across the top half of the image, adorned with numerous clusters of small white blossoms. Below the main branch, smaller green leaves are visible on thinner branches. The taller figure, positioned on the right, faces left with a light complexion and an elaborate dark hairstyle. They wear a long, dark kimono with a red and white patterned hem, and a light brown obi with a circular design. Their hands are partially visible, holding the fabric of their garment. To the left and slightly in front of the adult, a smaller figure, a child, also faces left. This child has a light complexion and wears a dark kimono with red and gold accents and a patterned hem, along with a dark, ornate headpiece. The background behind the figures and tree is a uniform, light tan color.

metadata.title: 歌川豊春筆　桜下遊女と禿|Courtesan and her Attendant under a Cherry Tree
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A large, smiling, reclining figure with a smaller figure looking up at them, and calligraphy above
long_description: A vertical artwork features a central rectangular area of aged, light brown paper, framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark green bands with a repeating pattern of gold four-petal flowers. The side borders are light beige with a subtle, repeating pattern of small, light brown dots. The central area is divided into two main sections. The upper section, occupying about the top third, features several columns of black calligraphic text written vertically from right to left. The calligraphy is in a flowing, cursive style, with varying line thickness and length across the columns. The lower two-thirds of the central area depict two figures drawn with light gray-black outlines. The larger figure is positioned prominently in the center, reclining. This figure has a round, bald head, a smiling face with closed eyes, a mustache, and a small beard. The figure's body is large and round, draped in loose robes that obscure the limbs. The figure appears to be lying on its side, facing towards the left. To the lower left of the large reclining figure, a smaller figure is depicted. This figure is kneeling or crouching, facing upwards towards the larger figure. The small figure has a topknot hairstyle and is wearing simple, loose clothing with a sash around the waist. The background of the central area is a plain, light brown, with some subtle discoloration or aging visible across the surface.

metadata.title: 小野通筆　布袋唐子図|Hotei with a Child

alt_text: Full-length portrait of a man in layered robes and a turban, holding a staff, with calligraphy above
long_description: A full-length, vertically oriented painting depicts a standing male figure against a plain, light brown background. The man faces slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned forward. He has a light complexion, a small dark mustache, and a pointed goatee. His expression is stern, with dark, narrow eyes. He wears a light blue turban-like head covering with a white cloth wrapped around it. His attire consists of multiple layers: an inner, long-sleeved red robe, an outer blue robe adorned with several black bird motifs, and a patterned overcoat in white and gold with geometric and floral designs. His hands are clasped in front of him, holding a long, slender staff or pole that extends from near his chest to the bottom edge of his robes. His feet are visible, wearing white sandals. Above and to the left of the figure's head, black calligraphic text is written vertically, accompanied by two red square seals. Another smaller red seal is positioned near the figure's left shoulder. The central painting is framed by a decorative border. The inner border is a light beige with a subtle floral pattern. The outer border is a darker beige, featuring red fan-like shapes at the top left, blue bow-like motifs on the left side, and red bow-like motifs on the right side, interspersed with small green leaves.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman and child stand beneath a blooming cherry tree on a vertical scroll painting
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a woman and a child beneath a flowering tree on a light tan background. In the upper portion, a gnarled tree trunk extends from the right, with a branch reaching left, covered in clusters of light pink cherry blossoms. Below the tree, a tall woman stands facing slightly right, her head turned upwards and to the right. She has fair skin, dark hair partially covered by a white cap, and wears a long, flowing robe. The robe is primarily dark red with thin vertical stripes, a wide black sash, and a white patterned lining visible at the hem and sleeves. Her left hand is held by a small child standing to her left. The child, with fair skin and a bald head, wears a green robe with red trim and looks upwards in the same direction as the woman. The ground beneath them is a light tan with sparse green and brown markings. In the lower right corner, there is a small red seal and a column of black vertical text. The central painting is framed by decorative borders: a wide blue band with white circular patterns at the very top and bottom, and narrower tan bands with blue geometric patterns along the left and right sides.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Vertical ink painting of a snowy mountain landscape with bare trees and small structures, mounted as a scroll
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting depicts a snow-covered mountain landscape, presented as a hanging scroll. The upper portion features a light gray sky above distant, softly rendered peaks. On the right side, near the top, there is a vertical column of black text and two small red square seals. Below this, a prominent mountain ridge rises, dotted with several small, dark structures that resemble houses or temples. A single, larger bare tree stands on a lower slope of this ridge. The middle section of the painting shows more rugged, snow-dusted mountains and valleys. In the lower half, a cluster of tall, bare trees with intricate branches emerges from a snow-covered rocky outcrop. Smaller bare trees are scattered across the landscape. The foreground consists of snow-covered ground and various dark, rounded rocks. A single red square seal is visible in the lower left corner. The painting uses a limited palette of black, white, and various shades of gray, creating a serene winter atmosphere.

metadata.title: 池大雅筆　倣郭忠恕風雪景山水図|Wintry Landscape, in the Style of Guo Zhongshu
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Three figures, two men and one woman, in traditional attire, with calligraphic text on a light brown background
long_description: The artwork depicts three figures on a light brown, rectangular background, framed by a light blue border with a floral pattern. The border also has a thin gold band separating it from the central image.In the upper left, there is a section of black calligraphic text, arranged vertically. Another, shorter section of vertical calligraphic text is in the upper right. In the lower left, a vertical line of smaller black text is accompanied by a red square seal. A similar red seal is in the lower right, below a short line of vertical text.The three figures are arranged horizontally across the lower half of the central panel.On the left, a bald man with light skin stands with his arms outstretched horizontally and legs spread. He wears a short-sleeved, orange top with three white circular motifs on the front, and white shorts. A dark hilt of a sword is visible at his left hip. He faces towards the right.In the center, a woman with light skin and dark hair styled in an elaborate bun walks towards the right. She wears a long, flowing kimono with wide sleeves and multiple layers. The kimono features a complex pattern with sections of dark blue, green, red, and white, accented with gold.On the right, a man with light skin and dark hair tied back stands in a wide stance, facing towards the left. He wears a patterned kimono, primarily green, brown, and white in a plaid-like design, over a red and white patterned skirt-like garment. Two dark sword hilts are visible at his left hip. He holds an open fan in his right hand, which is bent at the elbow.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink painting of a snow-covered mountainous landscape with trees and a small figure on a path.
long_description: The vertical scroll painting depicts a snow-covered mountainous landscape rendered in ink on light-toned paper. The upper portion features a pale gray sky that transitions into a misty, lighter gray area from which dark, jagged mountain peaks emerge. On the upper left, vertical black calligraphic text is visible, followed by two square red seals. The mountains dominate the composition, characterized by their sharp, craggy forms and extensive white areas suggesting snow. Ink washes create depth and texture, with darker lines defining contours and tree branches. Numerous bare trees, some with snow clinging to their branches, are scattered across the middle and lower slopes of the mountains. A winding path is discernible in the lower right, where a small, dark figure, possibly carrying a staff, walks through the snowy terrain. Another smaller, indistinct form appears near the figure. The overall palette is monochromatic, relying on variations of black and gray ink against the light paper to convey the winter scene.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire, one standing and one seated, on a scroll with patterned borders.
long_description:
The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring two women against a plain, light brown background. The central panel is framed by decorative borders. The side borders are cream-colored with black bamboo stalks, green leaves, and scattered orange and yellow floral designs. The top and bottom borders are dark purple with a repeating geometric pattern.

On the left, a woman stands, leaning slightly forward and facing right. She wears a long, flowing green kimono with red trim along the edges and a wide, light pink sash tied around her waist. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun adorned with a red ornament. She holds a dark, thin object, possibly a comb or a hair ornament, near her head.

To the right and slightly below, another woman is seated on the ground, facing left and looking up towards the standing woman. She wears a dark kimono, possibly black or deep blue, with a prominent peacock feather pattern in shades of blue and green on the lower half. Her inner garment is red with a white geometric pattern. Her dark hair is also styled in an elaborate bun. On the ground next to her are a dark, gourd-shaped object and a small, rectangular box with red edges. A circular red seal mark is visible to the right of the seated woman.

metadata.title: 琴風舎豊麿筆　見立寒山拾得図|Courtesans Parodying Kanzan and Jittoku
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A fan-shaped painting depicts a snowy landscape with bamboo, a woven basket, and gold, red, and blue bands
long_description: The artwork is a fan-shaped painting set against a plain, light brown background. The fan itself is wider than it is tall, with a curved top and bottom edge. The central image within the fan depicts a winter scene. In the middle, a large area of white, textured material represents snow, covering the lower half of the fan's central section. Emerging from the snow are several slender green bamboo shoots, visible in the upper left portion of the snowy area. To the left of the bamboo, a light-colored, rectangular, woven structure, possibly a basket or fence, is partially covered by snow. This structure contains multiple lines of small, dark, vertical text. Above the snow, a wavy, dark blue band stretches across the fan, suggesting water or a distant sky. The top and bottom edges of the fan's central scene are bordered by wide bands of gold, which are divided by thin vertical lines, resembling fan ribs. Above the top gold band, a red, cloud-like or wavy pattern with a distressed, cracked texture appears on either side of the fan's upper curve. The overall impression is a serene, wintry landscape within a decorative fan.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Two folding fans mounted on panels; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: An ink painting of a small bird perched on a thin branch, with calligraphy and red seals.
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular ink painting on a light-colored paper, framed by a narrow gold border and a wider teal-green border. The central image depicts a small bird perched on a thin, dark branch that extends diagonally from the upper right towards the lower left. The bird is positioned slightly left of center, facing left and downwards, with a dark head, lighter chest, and dark wings. Its tail points towards the lower left. Above and to the right of the bird, a thicker, darker branch extends from the right edge, curving downwards and left, with faint suggestions of other branches or foliage above it. The background is a light, off-white, with subtle, lighter ink washes in the upper left suggesting a distant, hazy landscape. On the right side of the central panel, several vertical lines of dark, brush-drawn characters are present. Below these characters, in the lower right, are multiple red seals. One prominent rectangular seal features dark characters on a red background, and another, more irregular red seal is positioned above and to its left. In the upper left quadrant, a single rectangular red seal with dark characters is visible.

metadata.title: 雲溪永怡筆   太虛祥廓賛   枝に小禽図|Bird on a Branch

alt_text: A woman in elaborate robes sits on a veranda, looking towards a winding stream in a muted landscape.
long_description: The artwork presents a scene featuring a figure on a wooden veranda overlooking a landscape with a winding stream. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by light browns, grays, and subtle greens and reds. On the right side of the composition, a woman with long, dark hair is seated on a light brown wooden veranda. She wears layered robes, primarily in shades of muted green, gray, and a prominent red skirt-like garment. Her right arm is raised, and she holds a small, white, trumpet-shaped object to her mouth. A closed white parasol rests on the veranda beside her left hip. The veranda planks are light brown, and it is supported by white posts. Behind the veranda, to the upper right, a section of a building wall is visible, featuring a dark, stylized landscape element and a small, gnarled tree with sparse foliage. Below the veranda, a dark, curved roofline is partially visible. The left two-thirds of the image depict a broad, open landscape. A light-colored, winding stream or path flows from the upper left corner, curving towards the lower center. The ground surrounding the stream is rendered in varying tones of light brown, gray, and darker washes, suggesting earth or shallow water. Delicate, sparse foliage is visible along the left bank of the stream. In the lower center, to the left of the veranda, there is a block of vertical black text with two red square seals below it. The main artwork is framed by a light blue border with a repeating geometric pattern at the top and bottom, and a wider plain brown border on all sides.

metadata.title: 菱川和翁筆　大君 「橋姫」『源氏物語』|Princess Ogimi from the "Bridge Maiden" (Hashihime)  chapter from The Tale of Genji (Genji Monogatari)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on silk

alt_text: Two fish, one diving and one swimming, with calligraphic text above, on a vertical scroll.
long_description: The image displays a vertical scroll painting with a central artwork framed by decorative borders. The main painted area is a rectangular panel of light brown, aged paper, showing some subtle discoloration and texture. This central panel is bordered on the top by a narrow strip of gold-colored paper, and on the left and right by a dark teal fabric adorned with a repeating pattern of gold stylized floral and leaf motifs. In the upper portion of the light brown panel, a block of vertical calligraphic text in black ink is positioned towards the upper right. Below this text, a fish is depicted in a diving motion, with its head pointing downwards and its body curving upwards. This fish is rendered in shades of grey and black ink, with its head and fins appearing darker than its body. In the lower half of the panel, a second, larger fish is shown swimming horizontally, angled slightly upwards towards the right. This fish also uses grey and black ink, with visible scales indicated by fine lines across its body. Its eye is a small, dark circle. Surrounding the lower fish are several dark, rounded shapes, possibly representing pebbles or water plants, and faint, thin lines suggesting aquatic vegetation or water movement. The overall composition places the two fish in a vertical arrangement within a watery setting.

metadata.title: 楊月筆    默默道人賛   藻鯉図|Carp and Waterweeds

alt_text: Two figures in a boat on water surrounded by lily pads, one poling, one reclining
long_description: A monochrome ink painting on a light-colored, rectangular paper panel, framed by decorative borders. The central scene depicts two figures in a small boat on a body of water. The water is rendered in light gray washes, with numerous darker gray, rounded shapes resembling lily pads or lotus leaves scattered across its surface, particularly in the lower half of the composition. A narrow, dark gray boat is positioned slightly right of center, angled diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right. In the front half of the boat, an older man with a prominent dark beard and mustache reclines on his side, facing towards the left. He wears light-colored robes and rests his head on his right hand, which is propped on his knee. His eyes are open, and his mouth is slightly agape. At the back of the boat, a second, younger figure stands, facing away from the viewer, holding a long, thin pole vertically with both hands. This figure also wears light-colored robes. The pole extends upwards and slightly to the right, disappearing beyond the top edge of the central panel. The upper two-thirds of the painting are largely empty, rendered in a pale, uniform wash, suggesting an expansive sky or misty atmosphere. In the upper right corner, there is a vertical line of dark characters, below which is a small, square red seal. The central panel is bordered by a narrow, dark brown band with a subtle pattern, followed by a wider, light blue-green border featuring a repeating golden floral or scroll motif.

metadata.title: 海北友雪筆　周茂叔愛蓮図|Zhou Maoshu Admiring Lotuses

alt_text: A folding fan with a painted dark brown teapot resting on a gnarled branch with small dark blossoms.
long_description: A folding fan is depicted against a plain, light gray background. The fan is open in a semicircular shape, wider at the top, and features a paper surface with alternating vertical stripes of light cream and a slightly darker, textured off-white. The lower portion of the fan reveals light brown wooden ribs, which radiate from a central pivot point at the bottom. Painted on the fan's surface, a dark, gnarled branch extends horizontally across the middle, slightly angled upwards towards the right. Small, dark clusters, resembling blossoms or buds, are scattered along the branch. A round, dark brown and black teapot with a textured appearance sits on the branch, positioned slightly to the left of the fan's center. The teapot has a small spout on its left, a handle on its right, and a lid on top. It rests on a small, flat, golden-brown circular base. To the right of the teapot, below the branch, there are a few lines of dark, vertical script and a small red rectangular seal.

alt_text: A vertical painting shows a dense garden of chrysanthemums in white, yellow, orange, and deep red hues.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a dense, vibrant garden filled with numerous chrysanthemums. The flowers fill most of the canvas, extending from the top edge to the bottom, with green foliage visible between and beneath them. In the upper half, a prominent cluster of white and pale yellow chrysanthemums occupies the central area, surrounded by blooms in shades of orange, deep red, and hints of pinkish-purple. The petals are rendered with a ruffled, full appearance, creating a rich, textured surface across the composition. Towards the lower left, a large, deep red chrysanthemum stands out, while other orange and yellow flowers are scattered throughout the mid-ground. The lower half of the painting features more visible green leaves and stems, depicted in various shades of dark green and olive, suggesting a lush, overgrown environment. The background is largely obscured by the dense floral arrangement, appearing as a soft, blurred mix of greens and browns. The overall impression is one of natural abundance and a rich palette of autumnal flower colors.

metadata.title: Chrysanthemums in the Garden at Petit-Gennevilliers

alt_text: A vertical scroll features flowing black calligraphy in the upper section and six seated figures below.
long_description: A vertical scroll, primarily light beige, is framed by a light blue border on the left and right, and a patterned gold-brown border at the top and bottom. The upper two-thirds of the beige scroll area are filled with vertical lines of black calligraphy, written in a flowing, cursive script. The lines of text vary in length and density, with some characters appearing larger or more emphasized. A small red seal is visible within the calligraphy in the upper right section. Below this main body of text, there are smaller, more scattered lines of calligraphy. The lower third of the scroll depicts six figures seated on the beige surface. They are arranged in two main groups. In the upper right of this group, three figures are seated close together. One figure, with a bald head and a light brown striped robe, faces left and smiles. To their right, another figure in a dark green robe and a black cap also smiles, facing left. Below these two, a figure with long dark hair, wearing a white and red layered robe, sits facing forward. In the lower left of the group, three more figures are seated. One figure, wearing a blue robe and with dark hair styled in a bun, holds a fan and faces right. To their right, a figure in a light green robe and a black cap sits facing right. Further to the right and slightly behind, a figure in a dark gray or black robe sits facing left, with a bald head. Another small red seal is visible in the lower right corner of the beige scroll area, below the figures. The figures are rendered with delicate lines and muted colors.

metadata.title: 窪俊満筆 六歌仙図|The Six Poetic Immortals
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An old man with a long white beard sits with children and a tiger under a peach tree, with text panels.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a scene with a central, light-skinned, elderly man with a long white beard and mustache, wearing a red robe with green and gold accents. He is seated, holding a staff with a pick-like end in his right hand, and has a gentle expression. To his left, two smaller figures, appearing as children, stand. The upper child, in a red robe, looks up at the man, while the lower child, in a green robe, stands slightly in front. To the man's right, a large, striped tiger with a fierce expression, prominent teeth, and wide, round eyes sits. Its fur is brown and black striped with white patches. A smaller figure, appearing as a child, in a green robe, sits on the tiger's back, looking towards the seated man. Above the figures, a tree branch with light pink peaches and green leaves extends across the upper portion of the image. The background is a solid, muted olive-green color. The figures are positioned on a rocky, brown and tan ground. Two red rectangular panels with white Chinese characters are visible: one vertically oriented in the upper left, and another horizontally oriented at the bottom center.

metadata.title: 작자미상 산신과 호랑이   조선|作者未詳 山神圖   朝鮮|Mountain God with Tiger and Attendants
metadata.medium: Framed; Ink and color on silk

alt_text: A brown and black striped tiger lies on muted, rocky ground with dark, cloud-like forms above.
long_description: An oil painting depicts a large tiger lying down in a desolate, muted landscape. The tiger, positioned in the lower half of the canvas, faces towards the right with its head slightly turned towards the viewer. Its fur is a rich reddish-brown with distinct dark brown to black stripes across its body and tail. Its front paws are tucked beneath its head, with one resting on top of the other. The tiger's eyes appear somewhat downcast. The ground beneath the tiger is rendered in earthy tones of brown and gray, suggesting a rocky or uneven terrain. Above the tiger, the background consists of dark, amorphous shapes that resemble either rugged mountains or heavy, swirling clouds, rendered in shades of dark brown, gray, and hints of dull green. A lighter, almost yellowish-green hue is visible in the upper left corner, suggesting a sky. In the bottom left corner, the signature "BARYE" is visible in dark lettering.

alt_text: A grid of small, framed, colorful illustrations depicting various seated and standing figures in a cross-like arrangement
long_description: The artwork features twenty-five small, rectangular illustrations arranged in a symmetrical, cross-like pattern against a plain, light gray background. Each illustration is framed by a dark blue border and a wider reddish-brown outer border. The central vertical column contains seven illustrations. The top three show single, seated, red-skinned figures with multiple arms, some holding objects. The middle two show two seated figures, one with light skin and one with dark skin, embracing. The bottom two show single, seated, red-skinned figures, one with multiple arms. The central horizontal row contains nine illustrations. The central one is part of the vertical column. To its left and right are four illustrations each. These depict various seated figures, some single, some in pairs, with skin colors including yellow, blue, and green. Many have multiple arms and hold objects. Two additional illustrations are placed above the horizontal row, one to the far left and one to the far right. These show single, seated, dark-skinned figures. At the very bottom, a row of six illustrations depicts standing figures. These figures have various skin tones, including light gray, blue, and brown, and are shown in different poses, some holding objects. The background within each small illustration is typically a solid color, often red or blue, with some having a patterned base.

alt_text: Vertical scroll with five large, bold black calligraphy characters on a light background, framed by decorative borders
long_description: The image presents a tall, narrow vertical scroll. The central section features a light, cream-colored surface, likely paper or silk, dominated by five large, bold characters rendered in black ink calligraphy. The characters are arranged vertically, from top to bottom. The brushstrokes are thick and dynamic, exhibiting varying degrees of ink saturation and texture, with some areas appearing solid black and others showing lighter, drier brushwork. At the upper right of the central panel, above the first character, a small, rectangular red seal impression is visible. Further down, to the left of the fourth character, two more small, square red seal impressions are stacked vertically. The central calligraphic panel is bordered by a dark blue fabric adorned with a subtle, repeating pattern of gold or light brown floral motifs. At the very top and bottom of the scroll, wider horizontal bands of a patterned fabric in gold and light brown display a more intricate, woven design. The entire scroll is set against a plain, dark background.

metadata.title: 百年無事人|For a hundred years [I have been] a person with no attachments

alt_text: A bearded fishmonger sells various fish to customers in a bustling market scene.
long_description: This detailed oil painting depicts a busy fish market scene with several figures and an abundance of fish. In the left foreground, a man with a long white beard and a dark red tunic stands behind a wooden table, holding a cleaver over a large fish. The table is laden with various fish, including several bright red salmon steaks, whole grey fish, and smaller pieces of white fish. A signature "B. 1566" is visible on the table's edge. Behind the fishmonger, a woman in a white cap and brown dress holds a wooden basket, while a younger person in a hat next to her also carries a basket containing a fish. Through a stone archway in the background, more figures are seen walking, some carrying baskets, suggesting a lively market street. A distant city skyline with buildings is visible under a cloudy sky. In the right foreground, a woman in a red jacket and white blouse sits or stands behind a round wooden table, her hands clasped. On her table, a large carp rests in a metal bowl, and other fish are arranged on a wooden platter. Below, a smaller barrel holds more fish. Another person's head is partially visible behind the woman, looking down. The painting features earthy browns, reds, and grays, with the vibrant red of the salmon and the woman's jacket providing color contrast.

alt_text: A wrathful red deity with multiple eyes and fangs, crowned with skulls, surrounded by intense flames
long_description: A vibrant, densely composed painting depicts a large, red, wrathful deity at its center, seated or squatting. The central figure has a wide, open mouth revealing fangs, three prominent eyes, and a crown adorned with multiple white skulls. Its robust body is adorned with subtle patterns and what appear to be green or dark blue serpentine forms. Intense orange and red flames emanate from behind and around the central figure, filling much of the background. To the left and right of the main deity, several smaller, lighter-skinned figures are visible, some appearing to be in motion or distress amidst the flames. The upper section of the painting features five smaller, calmer-looking figures, likely deities, seated in various meditative poses within arched frames or surrounded by halos, against a blue and green background. The lower section of the artwork contains more figures, some dark blue or green-skinned and wrathful in appearance, amidst smaller flames and what might be offerings or dismembered forms. A prominent figure in the bottom center is seated within a green, circular halo. The overall palette is dominated by fiery reds, oranges, and yellows, contrasted with the deep red of the central figure and cooler blues and greens in the background and surrounding smaller elements.

alt_text: A colorful, intricate mandala painting featuring a central multi-armed deity surrounded by concentric circles of figures and patterns.
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting features a complex, multi-layered mandala design, predominantly in shades of red, dark blue, and green, with accents of yellow, white, and light blue. The central element is a square, within which a multi-armed, multi-headed deity with red skin is seated on a lotus-like throne. This central figure is flanked by smaller attendant figures and surrounded by a green inner square. This green square is bordered by a red band containing additional smaller figures in various poses. Moving outwards, the central square is encircled by several concentric bands. Immediately surrounding the red border is a dark blue band with intricate red and green patterns. This is followed by a wider, lighter blue band featuring eight circular medallions, each containing a dynamic figure, possibly a deity, in a swirling or dancing pose. Between these medallions are smaller, stylized floral or cloud-like motifs. Another band of colorful, segmented arcs, alternating in shades of red, yellow, and blue, encircles this wider blue band. The entire mandala structure is framed by a dark, narrow border. Along the top edge of the painting, above the main circular design, is a horizontal band containing eight circular medallions, each depicting a seated figure. The bottom edge features a horizontal red band with multiple groups of seated figures, possibly devotees, engaged in various activities such as making offerings or gestures. Two small, white, conical structures, resembling stupas, are also visible on this bottom band. A line of small, light-colored text is visible just above the bottom red band.

alt_text: A woman in a green headscarf and ornate gold jewelry looks out from a dark, intricately carved wooden window.
long_description: A painting depicts a woman framed by a dark, intricately carved wooden window. She is positioned slightly to the left of center, leaning forward with her forearms resting on the lower sill. Her head is tilted slightly to her right, and she looks directly forward with a neutral expression. She has dark, wavy hair partially covered by a sheer, flowing green headscarf. Her skin is light, with rosy cheeks and lips. She wears a light-colored, possibly yellow or gold, sleeveless top over a sheer, dark long-sleeved garment. A large, multi-strand necklace made of numerous gold-colored coins or medallions covers her chest. Her midriff is exposed above a voluminous red skirt or draped fabric. In her right hand, which rests on the sill, she holds a small cluster of pink flowers. To the right of the woman, within the window frame, is a dark, empty birdcage hanging from the top right corner. Below the birdcage, on a small shelf, sits a light gray, slender vase with a narrow neck. The background behind the woman is dark and indistinct. The wooden frame surrounding the window is richly detailed with geometric patterns and carved elements.

alt_text: A dead man held by a grieving woman, flanked by two sorrowful figures against a dark background
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts four figures in a somber, dark setting. In the center, a pale, deceased man with a dark beard and closed eyes lies horizontally, his head resting on the shoulder of a woman. His bare torso shows small red marks, and his right arm is draped over his body. The woman, positioned behind him, wears a dark green head covering and a white garment, her face expressing deep sorrow as she looks down at the man. Her left arm supports his head, while her right hand rests gently on his chest. To the left of the central pair, a young woman with reddish-brown hair and a red and green garment looks down with a mournful expression. To the right, a young man with reddish-brown hair, dressed in a green garment with an orange and dark cloak, also looks down with a sorrowful gaze. The figures are tightly grouped, filling the majority of the frame, with a dark, almost black background. A vertical brown wooden beam is visible behind the figures on the right side of the composition.

alt_text: A detailed panoramic painting of a large temple complex and town on a mountain, with many people and boats
long_description: This multi-panel painting depicts a vast, detailed landscape centered around a large temple complex on a mountain. The overall color palette is earthy, featuring dark greens, browns, reds, and whites. The upper portion of the painting shows dark green mountains with lighter green and brown patches, interspersed with white, stylized clouds. On the far left and right, a body of blue-green water is visible, with a waterfall cascading down the right side of the mountain. The central feature is a sprawling temple complex with multiple red-roofed buildings and white walls, situated on a prominent hill. Numerous small figures are depicted within its courtyards and on its elevated platforms. To the right of the main temple, a tall, multi-tiered pagoda with a red roof rises above the surrounding structures. The mountain slopes are densely covered with dark green trees and hundreds of smaller buildings, characterized by red or brown roofs and white walls. Winding paths connect these structures, populated by a multitude of small figures in various poses, many wearing white, red, or brown garments. Several areas feature white flowering trees. In the foreground, a wide, blue-green body of water flows across the bottom of the scene. Many small boats, each carrying several figures, navigate this water. Along the banks, more buildings are visible, including a prominent red torii-like gate on the right side. The ground and paths are rendered in a sandy brown color, providing a contrast to the green foliage and red roofs. The composition is dense with activity, showing a vibrant community spread across the mountainous terrain and along the waterway.

metadata.title: 長命寺参詣曼荼羅図屏風|Chōmeiji Temple Pilgrimage Mandala
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll remounted as a two-panel folding screen; ink, color, gofun (ground shell pigment), and gold on paper

alt_text: A Buddha figure sits on a lotus base, teaching a group of figures and monks, with rocks, trees, and text
long_description: The image depicts a painted scene on a light, off-white background, framed by a narrow, patterned border. The composition is divided, with a pictorial scene occupying the upper left and a block of vertical text filling the lower right.In the pictorial scene, a large, central figure with a yellow body, red robe, and an orange halo sits on a green lotus-petal base. This figure faces right, with hands in a gesture. To the left of this central figure, three smaller figures are seated on the ground. Two wear brown and orange robes, resembling monks, while the third, smaller figure wears a red robe and kneels. To the right of the central figure, four more figures are seated. Two wear yellow robes and two wear red or brown robes. All the smaller figures appear to be facing the central figure, some with hands clasped in front.The background of the pictorial scene includes two small, sparse green trees with brown trunks, one on the far left and another behind the central figure. On the far right, a large, multi-peaked rock formation rises, rendered in shades of light blue, brown, and grey. The ground beneath the figures is a light brown with scattered green tufts.The right half and bottom portion of the image are filled with vertical columns of black calligraphic text. The text reads:是時此類婆羅又自思惟若以情應識果報者便為常合不應離絕者不為常合是則為斷餘時世尊知情心念識即不常不言此以故不常不斷離斷故不常如緣花地水種子既謝不得名常生芽葉故不得名中三事曰緣亦復如是

metadata.title: 『過去現在因果経』　断簡|“The Historical Buddha Preaching,” a section from The Illustrated Sutra of Past and Present Karma (Kako genzai inga kyō emaki)
metadata.medium: Handscroll section mounted as a hanging scroll;  ink and color on paper

alt_text: A complex, colorful square mandala painting with a central blue multi-limbed dancing figure surrounded by concentric circles and squares.
long_description:
A square painting depicts a highly detailed, multi-layered mandala. At the center, a blue-skinned, multi-limbed, multi-headed figure dances on a small white figure, set against a vibrant red circular ground. This central circle is surrounded by eight smaller figures in various dynamic poses, each within a red, petal-like section. This inner circle is enclosed by a square structure with four T-shaped gates, each containing a small figure, and bordered by intricate patterns in gold and black.

Moving outwards, a broad circular band features numerous small, active figures, some dancing or in expressive poses, against a dark background with red and blue accents. This band is framed by a red circular border adorned with flame-like motifs. The outermost section of the painting forms a square border. The top and bottom edges contain rows of small, seated figures, each within an arched niche, alternating between red and black backgrounds. The side borders also feature rows of figures and decorative elements. The dominant colors are red, black, and blue, with significant use of gold, white, and green for details and figures. The entire composition is densely packed with intricate forms and patterns.

alt_text: A full-length painting of a bearded man in a grey robe with a halo, holding a crucifix and a red book.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a full-length standing male figure against a dark background. The man stands facing forward, with his head slightly turned to his left. He has a dark beard and short dark hair, and a golden halo encircles his head. He wears a long, loose-fitting grey hooded robe that covers his body from neck to ankles. His right hand holds a small brown crucifix on a staff, with a visible red wound on the palm. His left hand holds a small, thick red book with two gold clasps, also showing a red wound on the palm. A tear in the robe on his chest reveals a red wound. His bare feet, with visible red wounds, rest on a light pinkish-brown ground. The background behind the figure is a dark teal or deep green. At the very bottom, a rectangular cartouche contains dark text that reads "CLEMENS BRIGAI SDE COLVMNA" flanking a red shield with a gold border and a gold column design.

metadata.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
metadata.medium: Tempera and gold on wood, transferred to wood

alt_text: A close-up painting of a man with dark hair and beard, looking down, with hands clasped over a white cloth.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a man from the chest up, against a dark, almost black background. The man's head is tilted downwards and slightly to the right. He has short, dark brown hair and a dark beard or stubble. His eyes are closed or heavily shadowed, and his face is rendered in warm, light brown tones with highlights on his forehead, nose, and cheekbones. His right shoulder and upper chest are bare, illuminated by a strong light source from the upper left. His left shoulder and chest are covered by a voluminous white cloth, draped in soft, deep folds. His hands are clasped together over the white cloth, with the fingers of his right hand resting on the back of his left hand. The hands are also highlighted, showing definition in the knuckles and fingers. A hint of a dark red or maroon garment is visible on the lower right, beneath his clasped hands. The dramatic lighting creates a strong contrast between the illuminated figure and the dark background.

alt_text: A self-portrait painting of a man in a dark suit next to a door with a window looking into a dark interior
long_description: A dark, muted painting depicts a man on the left and a door with a window on the right. The man, positioned in the left half of the canvas, is shown from the chest up, facing forward with a direct gaze. He has short, dark hair and a mustache. His face exhibits subtle purple and blue undertones, contrasting with the otherwise somber palette. He wears a dark suit or jacket, and his left hand is visible near the bottom left, appearing to hold a brush or implement. The background behind him is a plain, textured wall in shades of gray. On the right side of the painting, a light gray door stands vertically. It features a dark, elongated handle positioned below a rectangular window in its upper half. The window is divided into multiple panes by dark mullions. Through the window, a dark, indistinct interior scene is visible, suggesting a staircase or a room with vertical elements like railings. The overall color scheme is dominated by grays, dark blues, and blacks, with visible brushstrokes creating a textured surface.

alt_text: An ink landscape painting depicting mountains, a wide body of water, boats, and scattered buildings.
long_description: A horizontal ink wash painting on light-colored paper depicts a vast, serene landscape. On the far left, a large, textured mountain rises, covered with numerous small, dark trees and several multi-tiered buildings with pointed roofs, appearing to be built into the hillside. Below this mountain, closer to the foreground, are more trees and a few smaller structures near the water's edge. Several small figures are visible on paths. The center of the painting is dominated by a wide expanse of water, with a few small boats, some with figures, scattered across its surface. The water is mostly blank, suggesting calm. In the distance, faint outlines of more mountains or hills are visible. On the right side, another prominent mountain, similar in texture and tree coverage to the one on the left, rises. It also features a few small buildings nestled at its base and on its slopes. The trees on this mountain are depicted with fine, dark strokes. The painting uses varying shades of black ink to create depth and texture against the light background. The foreground and midground feature more detailed elements, while the background recedes into lighter, more ethereal forms. In the upper right corner, there is a block of vertical text in black ink, followed by a red square seal. Another red square seal is visible in the lower left corner.

metadata.title: 清   王學浩   焦山媵鼎圖   卷|Presenting the Tripod

alt_text: Ink and wash painting depicting a towering mountainous landscape with dense forests, waterfalls, and small buildings
long_description: A vertical ink and wash landscape painting depicts a towering mountainous terrain with dense forests, water features, and small human structures. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, utilizing various shades of gray and black ink, with subtle hints of muted green, blue, and reddish-brown. The upper portion is dominated by a large, central mountain peak, rendered with textured strokes suggesting rock formations and mist, flanked by fainter, more distant peaks receding into a hazy background. The central mountain descends into a series of undulating hills and valleys, densely covered with trees depicted with dark ink dots and washes, some showing reddish-brown hues. Several small, traditional-style buildings with dark roofs are nestled into the slopes, connected by winding paths or streams. A thin waterfall cascades down a rock face on the far left. The foreground features rugged rock formations and dense clusters of trees, including a prominent tree with a gnarled trunk and sparse, reddish-brown leaves on a rocky outcrop in the lower-center. A body of water or wider stream flows across the bottom, with rocky banks. Vertical text is present on both sides of the painting. On the right, it reads: "王武洪澤亭山色圖真迹 康熙六年丁未歲仲夏原任侍郎徐乾學題" followed by a red seal. On the left, it reads: "丁未秋嶽麓十日泛舟亭山已 王鑑" followed by two red seals.

metadata.title: 清　王鑑　倣范中立溪亭山色圖　軸|Mountain Scenery with Streams and Pavilions in the Style of Fan Kuan
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman and a man converse by a stone well in a classical landscape with distant buildings.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts two figures by a stone well in a classical landscape. On the left, a woman stands, facing right, looking towards the man. She has dark hair pulled back and wears a white blouse, a golden-yellow overdress, and a reddish-brown underskirt. Her left arm rests on the well's edge, holding a large, reddish-brown clay jar. Her bare feet are visible on the light brown ground. On the right, a man sits on the well's edge, facing left, looking at the woman. He has long brown hair and a beard, and is dressed in a red tunic and a blue cloak. His hands are raised and open, as if in conversation. His bare feet are also visible, with his right foot resting on a stone step. The circular stone well is centrally located, with a coiled rope and a small bucket hanging into it. A smaller, empty reddish-brown bucket sits on the ground in front of the well. In the background, a large classical column rises on the right. To the left, a path winds through a landscape featuring trees, distant buildings, and mountains under a blue sky with white clouds. The foreground ground is earthy brown with patches of green foliage.

metadata.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria

alt_text: A vertical scroll features a snow-capped mountain, various figures, animals, plants, and extensive calligraphy.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a series of ink drawings and calligraphy on a light, aged paper background, framed by a green border with a subtle floral pattern. At the top, a large, snow-capped mountain with a broad base and a pointed peak dominates the upper portion, rendered in light gray and white washes. Calligraphy in black ink is arranged in vertical columns to the left and right of the mountain. Below the mountain on the right, a tall, gnarled pine tree with dark green needles stands. On the left, a cluster of plants with broad, lobed leaves and small, light blue flowers appears. A small, brown bird perches on a branch on the right. Further down, the scroll depicts various scenes and individual elements. On the right, a group of three figures in robes are seated around a low table. Below them, two dark birds with pointed wings fly. To the left, a crab with prominent claws is shown. A lone figure in a simple robe sits on the ground on the left. On the right, a group of five standing figures, rendered in light ink, are depicted. Below the seated figure on the left, a person with a large, round hat and a drum is shown in a dynamic pose. To the right, another robed figure sits at a low desk, seemingly writing. The lower section includes a large, dark-scaled fish, possibly a carp, positioned centrally. A small bird with outstretched wings flies to the left of the fish. On the bottom right, a branch with dark, bare limbs and delicate light-colored blossoms extends upwards. On the bottom left, a flowering plant with large, multi-petaled blooms and green leaves is depicted. Several small, round, light brown objects, possibly fruit, are scattered near the bottom center. Calligraphy continues to fill the spaces between the visual elements throughout the scroll.

metadata.title: 蜀山人（大田南畝）・式亭三馬他　諸家書画寄書|Drawings and Poems by Various Artists
metadata.artist: Teisai Hokuba|Shikitei Sanba|Kitao Masanobu (Santō Kyōden)|Shokusanjin (Ōta Nanpo)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A standing figure with an elaborate crown, green halo, and flowing robes holding a leafy branch on a gold background
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a single standing figure against a plain gold background, framed by decorative borders. The figure, positioned centrally, faces slightly to the viewer's right with its head turned towards the viewer. An elaborate, multi-tiered crown, adorned with intricate gold and jewel-like details in red, blue, and green, sits atop the head. Dark hair frames a serene face with a small mouth, a thin mustache, and downcast eyes. A large, solid green circular halo is positioned behind the head. The figure wears richly adorned, flowing robes in shades of blue, gray, and white, featuring subtle patterns. A prominent necklace with colorful beads and a central green jewel adorns the chest. A blue and green sash is visible around the waist, and long, flowing sleeves extend downwards. The figure's right hand, on the viewer's left, gently holds a leafy green branch. The left hand is held lower, partially obscured by the drapery of the robes. The bare feet rest upon a pink lotus flower. The background is a uniform gold with a subtle, repeating geometric pattern. The artwork is bordered at the top and bottom by a blue band featuring a circular floral motif, while the side borders are a lighter gold with a different geometric pattern. Vertical text in black ink, accompanied by two red seals, is present on the right side of the gold background, near the figure's lower body.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆　楊柳観音図|Willow Kannon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold leaf on silk

alt_text: A central painting depicts multiple figures in a landscape, surrounded by four rectangular, gold-flecked borders.
long_description: A vertically oriented rectangular painting features a central scene surrounded by four concentric borders. The innermost border is dark blue with gold flecks, followed by a pinkish-red border with gold flecks, then a teal-green border with gold flecks, and finally an outermost light yellow-tan border also speckled with gold. The central painting shows a group of figures in a natural setting. A prominent figure, dressed in light blue robes, is seated on a light-colored platform in the lower center, looking downwards with hands near the ground. To the left, two figures are partially visible, one peeking from behind a light-colored rock formation, and a smaller figure seated on the ground in front of the main figure. To the right, another figure is seated, wearing a patterned garment and holding a small bowl. The background features brown-leafed trees and light-colored, rounded hills or rock formations. The ground in the foreground is light brown with small, dark shapes. The overall color palette of the central painting is muted, with earthy tones and soft blues.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Brown and blue ink with gold on paper

alt_text: A dark still life painting depicting abundant bunches of grapes, peaches, figs, and small birds among dense foliage
long_description: The painting is a dark, horizontal still life featuring a dense arrangement of fruits and foliage against a very dark background. The composition is filled with intertwining vines and branches, from which various fruits hang. In the upper left and right, several round peaches with light orange and reddish blush tones are visible among dark green leaves. Numerous bunches of grapes are distributed throughout the canvas; some are light green or yellowish-white, while others are dark purple or black. In the upper right quadrant, dark figs, some appearing split open to reveal reddish interiors, are nestled among the leaves. Towards the bottom center, small clusters of bright red berries, possibly currants, are visible. The foliage consists of various shades of dark green leaves, some showing lighter undersides, creating a rich, textured backdrop. Two small, light-colored birds with dark markings are perched near the bottom edge of the painting, one on the far left and another on the far right. The overall lighting is subdued, with highlights catching the surfaces of the fruits and some leaves, creating a sense of depth within the dark setting.

metadata.title: Grape Vines and Fruit, with Three Wagtails

alt_text: A panoramic painting depicts numerous figures in a large building and outdoor landscapes with trees and water
long_description: This wide, horizontal painting depicts a complex narrative scene across multiple panels, set against a shimmering gold background. The composition is divided by large, irregular gold cloud-like forms that separate distinct areas of activity. On the far left, a lush green landscape features tall mountains and a cascading waterfall flowing into dark, calm water. Several figures, dressed in long robes of various colors, walk along paths and gather near the water's edge. Pine trees with dark green needles and brown trunks are scattered throughout this natural setting. Moving towards the center, a large, multi-story building with a brown tiled roof dominates the middle ground. Its light-colored walls are punctuated by open sections revealing interior scenes. Inside, numerous figures are seated on red carpets or standing, engaged in various activities. Some figures are visible on upper balconies, looking down. Around the building, more figures walk on paths, some under flowering trees with white blossoms. To the right, the scene continues with more outdoor areas and sections of the building. Figures are seen ascending and descending stairs, and others gather in groups amidst more green trees and gold cloud formations. The figures throughout the painting are depicted in traditional attire, with detailed garments in shades of red, blue, green, white, and brown. The overall impression is one of a bustling, continuous narrative unfolding across a grand estate and its surrounding landscape.

metadata.title: 邸内遊楽図屏風|Amusements in a Mansion
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, gold, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A bearded man plays a flute while walking on waves, with mountains in the background
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a man playing a flute, rendered in muted earthy tones of brown, cream, and dark green. The upper portion of the painting features dark, indistinct mountains with sparse, dark trees against a lighter brown sky. Below the mountains, a vast expanse of light brown forms the background, with faint horizontal lines suggesting a distant horizon. The central figure is a man, positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing left in profile. He has a bald head with short dark hair on the sides, and a dark beard and mustache. His eyes are dark, looking towards the left. He holds a long, thin, light-colored flute horizontally to his mouth with both hands. He wears a light-colored, possibly cream or pale yellow, robe with wide sleeves. Over his shoulders and upper back, he has a dark, textured garment, possibly made of straw or woven material, which extends down his sides. On his right hip, a light brown pouch or bag with white dot patterns and a green tassel hangs. Below the pouch, several round, gourd-like objects are suspended. A dark, snake-like form is visible near his waist. His legs are covered by the flowing robe, and he wears light-colored, simple sandals or shoes with visible lacing. He appears to be stepping forward, with his left leg slightly bent. The man stands on a surface characterized by dark, wavy lines, suggesting water or mist, which extend across the lower half of the painting. In the upper left corner, a vertical column of dark characters is visible: "白衣大士" and "乙未".

metadata.title: 明   劉俊   韓湘子圖   軸|The Daoist Immortal Han Xiangzi
metadata.medium: Framed hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Portrait of an older man with a white beard, wearing a black four-cornered hat and dark clothing
long_description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man, positioned slightly to the right of the canvas's vertical center, against a dark, unadorned background. The man's face is rendered with a light, pale complexion, and he possesses a long, full white beard that covers his chin and extends down his chest, blending into his dark attire. His hair is not visible, concealed by a black, four-cornered hat with a flat top, which sits high on his head. He wears a dark, possibly black, garment, featuring a crisp white, flat collar that extends over his shoulders and rests against his chest. His eyes are dark and appear to look directly forward, engaging the viewer, and his nose is long and straight. The primary light source illuminates his face and beard from the left, creating subtle shadows that define his features and contrast with the deeper shadows of the background and his clothing. The brushstrokes are smooth, contributing to a realistic depiction of skin texture and the strands of his beard. The overall palette is subdued, dominated by dark tones and the stark white of the beard and collar.

alt_text: A dark painting shows a bearded man gesturing to a group of five figures gathered around a table with coins
long_description: The painting depicts five figures in a dimly lit, dark interior space. A strong light source from the upper right illuminates parts of the scene, creating dramatic contrasts between light and shadow. On the far left, a man with a dark beard and hair is partially visible, dressed in a reddish-brown robe, his face mostly in shadow as he looks towards the center. Next to him, more prominently lit, is a man with long, dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark blue or black tunic. He faces forward, looking slightly to the right, with his right hand extended, palm up, in a clear gesturing motion. His left hand rests on a dark wooden table. To the right of this central figure, a younger man with dark hair and a red cap leans forward over the table, intently observing the coins scattered on its surface. His hands are positioned near the coins. He wears a green garment under a lighter-colored sleeve. Further to the right, a man with a dark, curly beard and hair is seen from the back, turned towards the table. He wears a blue tunic and a large, ochre-colored cloak draped over his shoulders, holding a small pouch or bag in his right hand. Behind this man, partially obscured and mostly in shadow, is another figure, possibly an older woman, with a dark hood covering her head, looking down towards the table. The dark wooden table is positioned in the lower center, with several small, round, metallic objects (coins) scattered on its surface. The background is uniformly dark, with a subtle hint of a vertical architectural element on the right side of the central figure. The overall palette is dominated by dark tones, with strong chiaroscuro effects.

alt_text: Two figures, one with an umbrella, the other pouring liquid, stand on a green ground.
long_description: This vertical painting features two standing figures on a green ground against a lighter green background, framed by a red border. The figures are centrally placed, with the ground occupying the lower fifth of the image and the lighter green background the upper four-fifths. The red outer border has black script along its top edge. The figure on the left is bald with light brown skin, facing right.
