They wear a red and yellow dhoti-like garment, gold armbands, a necklace, and a waist belt. Their hands are cupped, palms up, positioned to receive something. A golden umbrella with a white underside is held by a pole extending from behind their head, arching over them. They stand on small, golden, elevated sandals. The figure on the right has light gray skin and faces left, looking towards the other figure. They wear a tall, ornate golden crown, a yellow top, and a red and purple dhoti-like garment with gold trim. Elaborate gold jewelry adorns their neck, chest, arms, and waist. In their right hand, they hold a golden ewer, from which a stream of white liquid pours into the cupped hands of the left figure. They also stand on small, golden, elevated sandals. The dark green ground beneath the figures is dotted with small red and white flowers and green foliage. A thin gold line and a thin blue line separate the green background from the red border.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque pigments with gold on paper

alt_text: A multi-armed blue and red deity embracing a smaller red figure, surrounded by a red background with many small figures
long_description: A vibrant, multi-figure painting depicts a large, multi-armed, multi-headed blue deity embracing a smaller, red, multi-armed figure at its center. The dominant blue figure stands with its right leg bent and left leg extended, its skin a deep indigo. It has three heads, the central one facing forward, and at least eight arms radiating outwards, holding various implements such as a trident, a sword, a skull cup, a noose, a drum, a vajra, and a bell. This figure wears an elaborate golden crown, multiple necklaces, armbands, and anklets. The smaller red figure, with one head and two arms, embraces the blue deity, mirroring its posture with a bent right leg and extended left leg. This red figure also wears a crown and jewelry. Both figures stand on a multi-layered lotus pedestal with petals in shades of blue, green, red, and gold. The background is a rich, deep red, intricately patterned with swirling, organic motifs that resemble flames or stylized foliage in darker red and gold. Within this red background, several smaller, dark blue or red figures are depicted in ornate, gold-framed niches. The entire central scene is framed by a wide border. The left and right sides of this border contain vertical rows of small, individual figures, each in its own compartment, some seated and some standing, rendered in various colors. The top and bottom borders also feature horizontal rows of similar small, seated figures in compartments. The outermost edge of the artwork is a narrow, dark blue or black frame.

alt_text: A robed figure sits under a tree while another prostrates before him in a misty mountain landscape
long_description: The vertical painting depicts a muted landscape scene with two figures. In the lower-left quadrant, a large, robed figure sits on a rock, facing right. This figure appears to be an older man with a bald head and a prominent earlobe, wearing loose, layered robes that expose his chest. He holds a long staff in his right hand, resting it on the ground. To the right of the seated figure, a smaller figure is prostrated on the ground, facing the seated figure. This figure is also robed, with their head bowed low to the ground. The background features a mountainous landscape rendered with ink washes, creating a sense of depth and mist. On the far left, a steep cliff face rises, from which a gnarled tree with dark foliage extends branches over the seated figure. Smaller trees and sparse vegetation are visible on the lower hills. In the upper-right, a faint, pagoda-like structure is visible on a distant peak, partially obscured by mist. The overall color palette is dominated by warm sepia and brown tones, with darker ink used for outlines and details of the figures and landscape elements. The painting is framed by a light green border with a decorative pattern at the top and bottom.

metadata.title: 明   佚名  問道李鐵拐圖   軸|Daoist immortal Li Tieguai receiving a visitor
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A bearded man in a brown robe supports a levitating younger man above a crowd of onlookers.
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic scene with multiple figures, some levitating, others on the ground, against a muted background. In the upper center, a bearded man in a dark brown monastic robe stands on a cloud-like formation, his right arm raised and his left hand holding the arm of a younger man. The bearded man has a long white beard and is looking upwards. The younger man, dressed in white and light brown flowing garments, appears to be suspended in mid-air, with his arms outstretched and his bare feet visible. His light brown hair is disheveled. Behind the levitating figures, faint, light-colored clouds are visible against a slightly darker sky. To the left, a dark, indistinct architectural element or landscape feature is partially visible. To the right, a dark archway or building entrance is suggested, with a dark shadow extending downwards. In the lower half of the painting, a crowd of people is gathered, looking up at the central figures. On the left, a man in a blue tunic and a reddish-brown cloak kneels on one knee, his hands raised in supplication or awe. Another man stands behind him, also looking upwards. On the right, several figures are grouped. A young man in a light blue tunic with white sleeves reaches up with both hands. Next to him, a woman in a yellow dress embraces a child, both looking up. Behind them, other figures with dark hair and beards are partially visible, also gazing upwards. The overall composition is dynamic, with figures arranged to create a sense of movement and wonder. The lighting emphasizes the central levitating figures.

metadata.title: A Miracle of Saint Joseph of Cupertino (1603–1663)

alt_text: A seated man with powdered hair in purple clerical robes holds papers, looking towards the viewer
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a man seated against a dark, plain background. He is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with his body angled towards the right and his head turned to face the viewer directly. The man has pale skin, dark eyes, a long nose, and a small mouth. His hair is powdered white, styled with curls above his ears and sideburns. He wears a purple clerical robe, consisting of a cassock with a high collar and a mozzetta draped over his shoulders, both trimmed with red piping. A gold cross on a chain hangs around his neck, resting on a white lace ruffle that extends from his collar. His white sleeves feature elaborate white lace cuffs, and a pink patterned fabric is visible beneath the lace on his right sleeve. His right hand, positioned at the center of the canvas, holds several folded sheets of paper with faint, illegible script. His left hand rests gently on his lap. A glimpse of a wooden chair with red upholstery is visible behind and beneath his right arm.

alt_text: Two pages, one with vertical text and red seals, the other with a detailed ink landscape drawing featuring a framed figure.
long_description: The artwork presents two adjacent pages, likely from a book or album, against a dark background. The left page is a light reddish-brown, filled with columns of vertical black calligraphic text. Near the bottom of this page, two square red seals are stamped, one above the other. The right page is a light off-white and features a detailed black ink drawing. The drawing depicts a landscape scene with a prominent rectangular frame in the lower center. Above and around this frame, dense foliage and tree branches are rendered with fine lines, suggesting a natural, possibly mountainous or forested, environment. Inside the rectangular frame, a smaller, more detailed scene is visible, showing a figure, possibly a person, seated or reclining amidst natural elements like rocks and trees. The figure appears to be looking towards the left within the framed scene. The area below the frame suggests ground or a path, also rendered with fine line work. The overall drawing style is intricate, relying on delicate lines and shading to create texture and depth.

metadata.title: 清　改琦，　曹貞秀　列女圖　冊|Famous Women
metadata.medium: Album of sixteen leaves; ink on paper

alt_text: Panoramic ink wash landscape painting depicting mountains, boats on water, and buildings nestled among trees.
long_description: A horizontal landscape painting rendered in muted tones, depicting a vast, misty scene. In the background, craggy, ink-washed mountains rise prominently, particularly on the left and center-right, with softer, more distant peaks fading into the pale sky. A wide expanse of light, yellowish-brown, possibly misty water or sky, fills the middle ground, separating various landmasses. On the left, several boats with tall masts and small structures on their decks float on this expanse. Clusters of dark green and grey trees, along with small, traditional-style buildings, are visible on low-lying land. Moving towards the center, more boats, some appearing as houseboats, are on the water. Small villages with multiple buildings and dense trees are nestled on the landmasses. On the right side, a prominent, multi-tiered building with a curved roof sits atop a bridge-like structure that spans a gap. More buildings and clusters of green trees are on the surrounding land. The foreground also shows sections of land with trees and buildings. The overall color palette is dominated by shades of grey, brown, and pale green against a light, yellowish-brown background. Two red square seals are visible in the bottom right corner of the artwork.

metadata.title: 清   王概   金陵感舊圖   卷|Reminiscence of Jinling
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A wide, colorful painting depicts a large gathering of figures and ornate structures in a green field under a blue sky
long_description: This horizontal, rectangular painting depicts a vibrant outdoor scene with a large gathering of figures and several ornate structures set against a light blue sky. The ground is a bright green, suggesting a grassy field. In the central area, an elevated, multi-tiered golden platform or throne is visible, adorned with intricate details and topped with a tiered roof structure. Several figures are seated on this central platform. To the left and right of this central platform, two smaller, similarly ornate structures with tiered roofs and white canopies stand. Further to the left and right, two more, simpler tiered roof structures are present, making a total of five such structures across the scene. The green field is densely populated with numerous figures, mostly depicted in red and gold attire. Many figures are shown prostrate or kneeling on the ground, facing towards the central platform. They are arranged in rows, creating a sense of a large, ordered crowd. Some figures are seated upright, particularly in the foreground and near the central platform. The figures have light skin tones and dark hair. The background features a white fence or railing that spans the width of the scene, behind which several green palm trees with yellow fronds are visible against the light blue sky. The overall color palette is bright, dominated by greens, reds, golds, and whites. The painting has a solid yellow border at the top and bottom. Small, dark, possibly textual markings are visible on the yellow border at the bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.artist: Court of King Mindon or Thibaw, or associated workshops
metadata.medium: Watercolor and gold on mulberry paper, with gilt lacquered wood covers and cloth lined box

alt_text: A woman with dark curly hair plays a stringed instrument, illuminated against a dark background.
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a woman playing a stringed instrument, positioned slightly to the right of the center against a dark background. Her head is turned to her left, and her gaze is directed slightly upward and to her left. She has fair skin, dark eyes, and dark, curly hair that frames her face. Her lips are full and a light red color. She wears a draped garment of muted olive-green or brown fabric that falls off her right shoulder, revealing her upper chest. A white cuff is visible on her right wrist. Below her, a swath of deep red fabric is draped across her lap. She holds a light-colored wooden stringed instrument, resembling a lute or guitar, with both hands. Her left hand is positioned on the neck of the instrument, while her right hand rests near the circular soundhole. The instrument has multiple strings and tuning pegs visible at the top. Strong light from the upper left illuminates her face, chest, and the instrument, creating dramatic contrasts with the deep shadows on the right side of her face and body, and the entirely dark background.

alt_text: An ink wash landscape painting depicts towering mountains, dense trees, houses, and a wide body of water.
long_description: This two-panel ink wash painting features a detailed landscape rendered primarily in shades of black and gray ink on a light, warm-toned background. The left panel is dominated by a large, craggy mountain range in the upper left, with smaller, rounded hills extending downwards. Numerous trees, including tall pines and deciduous varieties, are densely clustered across the lower and middle sections of the left panel and extend into the right. Several small, simple houses with reddish-brown roofs are nestled among the trees and hills, particularly in the lower left and center. A winding path or stream is visible in the foreground. The right panel opens up to a wide expanse of water or mist in the middle ground, with distant, hazy mountains or islands visible on the horizon. A small, dark boat with a single figure is depicted on the water. More hills and trees line the right edge of the composition. In the upper right corner, there is a vertical inscription of text in black ink, followed by a small, square red seal.

metadata.title: 日根対山筆　「林塘秋暇」|“At leisure in a lakeside grove in autumn”

alt_text: Two vertical ink wash paintings: a disheveled man with children and dog, and a monkey on a rock
long_description: Two vertical ink wash paintings are displayed side-by-side, each with a light off-white background and gold patterned borders at the top and bottom. The left painting features a large, disheveled adult male figure walking towards the right. He has dark, messy hair and a beard, and wears a loose, tattered light grey robe that is open at the chest. His right arm is bent, hand open, gesturing forward. His skin is a light peach tone, and a dark band is around his right ankle. Accompanying him are two small, bald children, both wearing red garments, positioned behind his right leg. A small, white, fluffy dog walks to the right of the children. Dark calligraphic text and a red seal are in the upper left corner. The right painting depicts a grey monkey perched atop a large, dark, craggy rock formation. The monkey faces left, with a reddish face, and its fur is rendered in shades of grey and black ink. The rock formation is depicted with bold, expressive ink washes, extending from the bottom right upwards. Small clusters of red leaves or flowers are visible on and around the rock. Dark calligraphic text and a red seal are in the upper right corner.

metadata.title: 長澤蘆雪筆　岩上猿・猿回し師唐子狗児図|Monkey on a Rock; Monkey Trainer with Chinese Children and Puppy
metadata.medium: Pair of paintings; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A panoramic ink painting depicts a vast, rugged mountain range with numerous peaks and valleys, rendered in shades of gray
long_description: This long, horizontal ink painting depicts an expansive, rugged mountain range. The artwork is rendered in various shades of gray and black ink on a light beige paper, creating a panoramic view that stretches across the entire composition. In the foreground, a series of gently rolling, rounded hills are depicted with lighter ink washes. As the landscape recedes, the mountains become progressively taller, more dramatic, and sharply defined, filling the midground and background. Numerous jagged peaks and steep ridges rise prominently, characterized by intricate lines and varying ink densities that convey depth and texture. Some peaks are slender and pointed, while others are broader and more massive. Throughout the mountainous terrain, subtle indications of vegetation are present, with clusters of small dots and fine lines suggesting trees or foliage on the slopes and along the ridges. Several small, architectural structures, possibly buildings or temples, are nestled within the valleys and on the lower mountain slopes, particularly visible in the left and right sections of the painting. These structures are rendered with delicate lines, integrating them into the natural environment. The overall impression is one of a vast and detailed natural landscape. In the upper right portion of the painting, two distinct blocks of vertical text are visible, written in black ink. Below these texts, several red square seals are present. The text in the right block reads: 金剛全圖 겸재 정선 갑인년 구월 초하루 그리다. The text in the left block reads: 정선 인 정선 인 정선 인 정선 인.

metadata.title: 도암   신학권   금강내산총도   조선|陶菴 申學權   金剛內山總圖    朝鮮|General View of Inner Geumgang
metadata.medium: Six sheets of paper mounted as a single panel; ink and light color on paper

alt_text: A portrait of a woman in an elaborate light gray dress with a large blue lace ruff and multiple pearl necklaces.
long_description: A waist-up portrait depicts a woman with fair skin and reddish-brown hair, looking slightly to the viewer's right. She wears a large, light blue ruff with white lace trim around her neck. Her light gray or silver dress features a subtle, repeating pattern of curved lines and shapes. A small, jeweled ornament adorns the top of her head, nestled in her hair. Around her neck are two necklaces: one a gold chain with red and white jewels, and another shorter, pearl and gold necklace with red accents. A very long strand of pearls is draped over her left arm and held in her right hand. On her right sleeve, a gold brooch with pearls and red jewels is visible. Her left hand holds a small, dark blue object with gold patterning, possibly a purse or book. The background is a plain, dark color. In the upper left corner, light-colored text reads: "Ellen Gethin, dau. of / Sir W. Maurice of Clennenau / Wife of John Owen, Esq. & of / Sir Francis Eure, She Died 1624."

alt_text: A long scroll painting depicts a bearded man and two women riding a deer-drawn cart through a landscape
long_description: A horizontal scroll painting on a light tan background depicts a scene with three figures on an ornate cart pulled by a deer, set within a natural landscape. In the center, a bearded man with a dark cap and a long, light yellow robe sits in the cart, holding a small, light-colored object in his right hand. To his left, a woman in a light blue and white robe sits facing him. To his right, a second woman in a light green robe stands or sits slightly behind him, looking downwards. The cart itself is elaborately decorated with intricate patterns and features a canopy of green foliage above the man. It is pulled by a brown deer with prominent antlers, facing towards the right. The deer wears a colorful harness adorned with blue, red, and green elements. The landscape behind the figures includes rolling hills in muted tones and a tree with white blossoms in the upper right. To the left of the cart, large, gnarled trees with sparse green foliage and exposed roots dominate the upper and middle ground. Further left and lower, rocky outcrops are visible, with delicate pink flowers blooming among them. The ground throughout the painting is a light tan, with subtle washes of green suggesting distant terrain. In the upper right corner, a vertical column of red and black characters is visible.

metadata.title: 清　佚名　金衢先生小照　卷|Portrait of Shaoyu in the guise of Liu Ling
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A multi-armed, multi-eyed central figure stands amidst flames, surrounded by nine smaller seated figures in an ornate painting.
long_description: This vertical rectangular painting depicts a central, large, light-skinned figure with multiple arms and three eyes on its face, standing amidst a red and orange flame-like aura. The central figure wears a dark blue skirt, necklaces, and armbands, with green snake-like forms wrapped around its limbs. Its expression is intense, with wide eyes and an open mouth. Surrounding this central figure are nine smaller, seated figures, each within a circular or oval halo. In the top row, three figures are depicted: the left and right figures wear orange robes and have orange skin, while the central figure wears a white robe and has light skin. On the middle left, a figure with green skin and a green halo sits. On the middle right, a figure with orange skin and an orange halo is shown. The bottom row features three figures. The leftmost figure is red-skinned, multi-armed, and surrounded by red flames. The central bottom figure has yellow skin and wears a simple garment. The rightmost bottom figure has light skin, multiple arms, and is seated in a dynamic pose. The background behind all figures is a dark blue with green foliage and hints of mountains, creating a dense, ornate setting. The overall color palette is rich, featuring reds, oranges, greens, blues, and light skin tones.

alt_text: A bald, bearded man in a green robe kicks at a fiery, smoky altar with a fierce deity, scattering papers.
long_description: A vertical artwork depicts a dramatic scene with a man on the left and a fiery altar on the right, framed by an orange and green patterned border. On the left, a bald man with a short beard and mustache is captured mid-action, his body angled towards the right. He wears a light green patterned robe over white undergarments, with his right arm and left leg exposed. His left leg is raised high, bent at the knee, as if kicking, while his right foot rests on a low, dark brown wooden platform. His face is contorted with an open mouth and wide eyes, and his hands are raised and open. To the right, a large, dark, swirling mass of smoke and red-orange flames erupts from a brown wooden altar. Within the inferno, a dark-skinned, fierce-faced figure, possibly a deity, is visible, holding a sword-like object. Papers are scattered across the lower portion of the image, some in neat stacks, others strewn loosely around the man's feet and near the altar. A black rectangular object lies among the papers near the altar. The background is a plain, light gray.

metadata.title: 小林清親筆　頼豪阿闍梨図|The Fury of Monk Raigō
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold paint on silk

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicting a lively outdoor scene with numerous people, buildings, and a bridge on a gold background
long_description: This six-panel screen painting features a bustling outdoor scene set against a shimmering gold background. The composition is filled with numerous small figures, buildings, and natural elements, creating a sense of lively activity across the entire width. Starting from the left, the first two panels depict large, open-sided structures with people gathered inside and around them. Some figures are seated on raised platforms, while others stand or move through the open spaces. Green trees and foliage are interspersed among the buildings and crowds. In the upper left, more buildings are visible, with figures engaged in what appears to be a performance or procession. Moving towards the center, the scene continues with more multi-level buildings and elevated walkways. A prominent set of stairs leads up to a structure, with groups of people ascending and descending. Pine trees with distinctive, flat-topped branches are scattered throughout the landscape. The gold background serves as the ground and sky, with darker green and brown areas indicating terrain. The rightmost panels feature a cluster of buildings with dark roofs and white walls. A large, white arched bridge spans a dark blue body of water, with many figures crossing it. Below the bridge, several figures are depicted in the water, some appearing to be swimming or in small boats. More people are gathered on the banks of the water and around the buildings, suggesting a market or festival atmosphere. The figures are dressed in various colored garments, including reds, blues, greens, and browns, adding to the vibrancy of the scene. The overall impression is one of continuous movement and interaction among a large community.

metadata.title: 狩野孝信工房作　女歌舞伎図屏風|Women’s Kabuki
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; ink, color, gold, silver, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A seated figure on a lotus throne atop a stylized lion-like creature, within a vertical scroll.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a central composition of a seated figure on a large, stylized lion-like creature. The background within the main rectangular panel is a dark, solid color, possibly dark brown or black. The seated figure is positioned in the upper half of the panel, facing forward. It has a light brown skin tone, dark hair arranged in a high bun, and wears a crown. Its torso is bare, adorned with necklaces and armbands, while a red and gold patterned cloth covers its lower body. The figure holds a green sword vertically in its right hand and a small, dark object in its left hand. A golden halo encircles its head, and a larger, oval-shaped golden mandorla surrounds its entire body. The figure sits cross-legged on a large, multi-layered lotus blossom, depicted with green petals outlined in gold and red accents. Below the lotus, the large, four-legged creature stands facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Its body is primarily a reddish-brown color, with a voluminous green mane and tail, both detailed with gold lines. The creature has a fierce expression with wide, red-rimmed eyes, a red open mouth showing fangs, and a red tongue. It wears a decorative harness around its neck and chest. Its four legs are thick, ending in stylized paws with red and green details. The creature stands on small, cloud-like or wave-like forms. The main painted panel is framed by a dark blue border with a repeating gold wave or cloud pattern. This inner frame is then mounted on a wider, plain light brown scroll material.

metadata.title: 五髻文殊菩薩像|The Bodhisattva Monju (Manjushri) with Five Topknots
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A robed figure with an elaborate headdress rides a white horse, holding a scale and a red orb
long_description: The painting depicts a robed figure riding a white horse against a dark teal background. The figure is positioned centrally, facing slightly to the right, with a serene expression. The figure has pale skin, dark hair styled in an elaborate updo with gold ornaments and green tassels, and wears a long-sleeved garment in shades of dark teal, green, and red, with gold trim. A white sash drapes over the figure's left shoulder. In the figure's raised left hand, a small golden scale with two pans is held. In the raised right hand, a solid red orb is held. The white horse is depicted in profile, facing right, with its front left leg slightly lifted. It has a decorated bridle and saddle. The bridle is red and gold, and the saddle is elaborate, featuring gold and red patterns, with green and gold tassels hanging from its sides. The horse's mane is short and dark, and its tail is long and light-colored, flowing behind it. The background is a solid dark teal color, with a thin horizontal band of dark green at the top and a wider horizontal band of gold and brown patterns at the bottom. The entire painting is framed by a vertical border of blue fabric with a subtle wavy pattern, and a thin gold inner border.

metadata.title: 馬鳴菩薩像|Memyō Bosatsu (Ashvaghosha Bodhisattva) Mounted on a Horse
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: A curled tabby cat painted in ink, seen from above, with Japanese calligraphy to its left
long_description: The artwork depicts a curled-up cat and Japanese calligraphy on a light-colored paper, framed by a darker border. The cat, positioned on the right side of the paper, is seen from a high angle, appearing as a rounded form. Its fur is rendered in shades of grey and black ink, showing distinct tabby stripes across its back and head. The cat's eyes are closed or nearly closed, and its tail is curled around its body, with the tip visible near its front paws. To the left of the cat, a column of black ink calligraphy runs vertically down the paper. Below the calligraphy, near the bottom left corner, is a square red seal impression. The paper itself is a light, neutral tone, possibly aged, with a subtle texture. A narrow, light brown decorative strip with a repeating pattern runs along the top and bottom edges of the paper, separating it from a wider, dark brown, textured outer frame.

metadata.title: 豊蔵坊信海筆　夢中の猫図|Dreaming Cat

alt_text: A woman in a kimono holding two small dogs, with a shamisen and tea set nearby on a light brown ground
long_description: The image depicts a woman seated on a light brown ground, framed by a decorative blue and gold border. The woman is positioned in the lower left quadrant, facing slightly right and looking down. She has pale skin, dark hair styled in an updo, and is wearing a kimono. The kimono features a red underlayer, a grey outer layer with a geometric pattern, and a black obi. Her left arm is covered by a grey sleeve with a white polka dot pattern, while her right arm is mostly covered by a red sleeve with a white dotted pattern. She holds two small, dark, fluffy dogs close to her chest with both hands. To her right, a black lacquered tray holds two small dark cups and a small dark kettle. Further to the right and slightly behind her, a shamisen, a three-stringed musical instrument, lies on the ground. It has a light-colored, rectangular body with a dark brown neck and tuning pegs. A white plectrum rests on its body. The background is a plain, light brown color, providing ample empty space in the upper right. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of black text read "豊川社信筆" with a red seal below. The entire scene is bordered by a blue band with intricate gold floral and vine patterns.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A full-length painting of a standing man in traditional robes holding a flowering branch
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a standing man against a plain, light beige background. The man is positioned centrally, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has a light complexion, a dark mustache, and a short, dark beard. He wears a dark, tall, and somewhat elaborate hat. His long, flowing robes are primarily a light cream or off-white color. A dark grey or black cape-like garment covers his shoulders, and a red sash or band crosses his chest from his left shoulder to his right hip. Light blue-green fabric is visible at the cuffs of his sleeves and along the bottom hem of his robe. His hands are mostly concealed within the wide sleeves of his robe. His left hand, holding a slender branch with small white flowers, emerges slightly from the sleeve. The branch extends upwards and to his left. The man's feet, clad in dark shoes, are visible beneath the hem of his robe. In the lower left corner of the painting, there is a vertical line of dark script and a red square seal. The painting is framed by a light brown border with a repeating pattern of small, light gold floral motifs at the top and bottom.

metadata.title: 長澤蘆雪筆　渡唐天神図|Tenjin Traveling to China
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman in a dark floral kimono leans on a wooden screen, her hand near her chin, looking right.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a woman in a dark kimono leaning on a light wooden structure against a plain tan background. The woman is positioned slightly to the left of the center, facing towards the viewer's right. Her skin is pale, and her dark hair is styled in an elaborate bun adorned with a small yellow floral ornament on the right side. She has delicate features, with small red lips and dark eyes. She wears a dark gray or blue kimono with a red collar and undergarment visible at the neckline. The kimono is patterned with light pink blossoms on green branches, particularly visible on the lower half and sleeves. A yellow obi is tied around her waist. Her right arm is bent, with her hand resting near her chin, and her left arm is also resting on the wooden structure. The light-colored wooden structure, possibly a screen or railing, has a grid pattern with some darker, possibly translucent, squares visible within its framework. The structure extends from the lower left to the mid-right of the painting. In the lower left corner, there is a small red rectangular seal with black characters. The background is a uniform, light tan color.

metadata.title: 大奥女中芝居見物図|Lady-in-Waiting at Edo Castle
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A scroll painting depicting figures in traditional attire, some on a staircase, others walking, with a building and fire
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting with a central panel of light golden-brown paper, framed by patterned fabric borders. The main scene depicts several figures in traditional clothing within a sparse architectural setting. In the upper right, a long, light-colored staircase with dark railings ascends diagonally towards the upper right corner. A single figure in a red robe stands on the ground near the base of the staircase, holding a long, thin object that appears to be a staff or pole with a red tip. This figure faces left, towards a dark, indistinct shape at the top of the stairs. To the left of the red-robed figure, a large, dark brown architectural element, possibly a roof or eaves, extends from the left edge of the panel, curving upwards and to the right. Beneath this structure, a smaller figure in a light-colored garment kneels or crouches near a small, orange and red fire. In the lower half of the panel, five figures in dark, possibly black, robes with light-colored undergarments are depicted. They appear to be walking or floating upwards and to the right, arranged in a diagonal line. Each figure carries a sword or similar weapon at their waist. Their faces are rendered with simple, stylized features. The background is largely unadorned, a uniform golden-brown color, with faint, wispy cloud-like shapes in the upper center. In the lower right corner, there is a small block of vertical text in dark characters, accompanied by a red seal.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一 「月次絵」|Activities of the Twelve Months
metadata.medium: Eleven hanging scrolls from a set of twelve; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical painting depicts pink lotus flowers and large green leaves against a light brown background.
long_description: This vertical painting features a composition of pink lotus flowers and green lotus leaves against a light brown background. In the upper right corner, a vertical column of dark calligraphic text is present, followed by two square red seals. The painting depicts several lotus plants emerging from the bottom. Towards the top, a large, rounded green lotus leaf is partially visible, with a pink lotus bud rising above it. Below and slightly to the left, another large green leaf frames a partially open pink lotus flower. The largest and most fully bloomed pink lotus flower is positioned in the mid-right, with a broad green leaf behind it. A slender pink lotus bud stands upright in the lower-left quadrant. In the lower right, several smaller, round green leaves appear to float on water, and a small, reddish insect with delicate wings is depicted. Various green stems extend upwards from the bottom of the composition, supporting the leaves and flowers. The colors are muted, with soft pinks for the blossoms and varying shades of green for the foliage, all set against the warm, neutral tone of the background. The text in the upper right reads: 信家先生周寫生 庚辰.

metadata.title: 清   唐炗   紅蓮魚藻圖   軸|Red lotus and fish
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A seated figure in white robes against a mountainous landscape with a waterfall and trees, with text above
long_description:
This vertical scroll painting depicts a central figure seated in a natural landscape. At the top, a black rectangular panel contains numerous columns of small, light-colored text. Below this, the main subject is a figure seated cross-legged, facing forward, wearing flowing white robes. The figure has light skin, blue hair, and a serene expression with red markings on the face. An elaborate gold and white headpiece adorns the head, with blue elements and dangling ornaments. A gold necklace with a central pendant rests on the chest. The hands are held in a gesture at the chest level.
The figure is positioned on a dark, rocky outcrop covered with patches of green foliage. Below the rocks, stylized waves of water are depicted in shades of green and white. Behind the figure, a large, pale circular halo extends upwards. The background features a mountainous landscape with a waterfall cascading down from the left side. Dark green trees with sparse foliage are scattered across the mountainsides. The overall color palette includes muted greens, browns, and grays for the landscape, contrasting with the bright white of the figure's robes and the gold and blue accents.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆 白衣観音図|White-Robed Kannon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting featuring a rooster, a fish, a drum, and a red-outlined warrior battling a green creature.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting on a light tan background depicts a series of figures and objects arranged from top to bottom. At the top, a rooster with a red comb, black body, grey wings, and a large black tail stands with its wings slightly spread. Below the rooster, a decorated drum, primarily black and red with gold and green accents, features a dragon motif. To the left of the drum, a large, dark grey fish hangs vertically, head downwards, with a white and red fan-like object below its head. To the right of the drum, a vertical structure resembling bamboo poles or a fence is adorned with white banners featuring blue circular patterns. Two thin poles with pinkish, bell-shaped objects extend upwards from this structure. At the bottom of the scroll, a large, red-outlined figure of a muscular, bearded man, possibly a warrior or deity, is depicted in a dynamic pose. He holds a staff or sword and appears to be engaging with a smaller, green-skinned, horned creature. To the left of this red figure are red and white striped banners. Some faint text is visible on the left side of the red figure, reading "天下一品" and "大黒天". The entire composition is framed by a light brown border with a patterned section at the very top and bottom.

metadata.title: 五月幟図|Boy’s Day Carp Streamer and Shōki Banner
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink and wash landscape painting depicts figures near buildings, trees, a large rock, and layered mountains.
long_description: This ink and wash painting depicts a serene landscape with muted colors, primarily shades of grey, black, light blue, and subtle browns and greens. In the upper left corner, black calligraphic text is arranged in ten vertical lines, reading from right to left: "丁外三月將 邀不歌不酬 浦不枯不竭 亭不朽不滅 觀不留不歇 宿不歸不別 誰不相識兩 兩相識兩兩 攜手共遊此 處有道觀". Below the text, a small red square seal is visible. The foreground features two robed figures standing on a light ground, one taller than the other, facing towards the left. To their right, a low, rectangular platform or table holds two small, dark, cylindrical objects. Sparse, light green and grey vegetation dots the ground. In the midground, a building with a dark, gabled roof and an open front stands on a raised wooden platform with railings. Large, light-colored, broad-leafed plants, possibly banana trees, surround this structure. To the left of the building, a light brown wall with an arched gateway extends towards the left edge of the painting. To the right of the central building, a large, dark, craggy rock formation rises prominently, next to a tall, slender tree with dark, rounded foliage. Several smaller trees with dark leaves are clustered near the rock and the larger tree. Further to the right, another building with a similar roof and structure is partially visible behind trees. The background is dominated by layered mountains, rendered in soft washes of grey and light blue, receding into the distance. The overall impression is one of a tranquil, natural setting with human presence.

metadata.title: 清　吳滔　園林圖　冊頁|Garden scene
metadata.medium: Album leaf; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A large tiger rests on a rocky landscape with a distant waterfall on a six-panel screen
long_description: This six-panel artwork, rendered in ink wash on a warm, light brown ground, depicts a large tiger in a landscape. The tiger occupies the right half of the composition, lying down with its body angled slightly to the left. Its head is raised, facing forward, with its mouth slightly open, revealing teeth. The tiger's fur is depicted with dark brown or black stripes over a lighter tan or cream base, showing muscular definition. Its eyes are dark and focused. Its large paws are visible in the foreground, and its tail curls around its hindquarters. To the left, a waterfall cascades down dark, jagged rock formations. The landscape between the waterfall and the tiger consists of rolling, misty hills or rocky terrain, rendered with soft, light ink washes that blend into the background. The overall impression is one of a vast, natural environment. A small vertical inscription in dark characters is visible on the far right panel.

metadata.title: 岸竹堂筆　虎図屏風|Tiger, Tigress and Cub
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A central, multi-armed figure with a flaming halo, flanked by two smaller figures on clouds, within a decorative border
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a large central figure above two smaller figures, all set against a dark background within a decorative border. The central panel is a deep brown, showing signs of age and wear, framed by a lighter, golden-tan border patterned with large white and light blue chrysanthemum-like flowers and blue cloud motifs. The dominant figure, positioned in the upper center, has light blue skin, a fierce expression, and a golden crown adorned with intricate details. It possesses multiple arms, though not all are clearly visible, and is surrounded by a vibrant red flaming halo. The figure wears elaborate, multi-layered robes in shades of red, green, and gold, with gold patterns and accents, including what appear to be golden armor plates on its torso and limbs. It stands on or emerges from dark, swirling clouds. Below the central figure, two smaller figures stand on separate, reddish-orange cloud formations. The figure on the left is dressed in green robes with a red sash and holds an open book or tablet in both hands. The figure on the right wears red and gold robes, a small golden crown, and has a serene expression. Both smaller figures are depicted with dark hair and stand facing forward. The background behind these figures is a muted brown, with subtle, dark outlines suggesting mountainous terrain and additional wisps of clouds.

metadata.title: 鞍馬山曼荼羅・毘沙門天三尊像図|Mount Kurama Mandala: Bishamonten Triad
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A head-and-shoulders portrait of a bearded man in dark clothing holding a red book, looking forward.
long_description: A head-and-shoulders portrait depicts a man with a reddish-brown beard and hair, set against a dark, unadorned background. The man's face is fair-skinned, with a direct gaze. His left eye (viewer's right) is light brown, while his right eye (viewer's left) is a light blue-gray. His lips are closed, and his expression is neutral. His reddish-brown hair is medium length, slightly tousled, and frames his face. He wears a dark, possibly black, garment that covers his shoulders and chest. A subtle white collar is visible at his neck, just above the dark fabric. His right hand (viewer's left) is positioned at the lower center of the canvas, holding a small, thick red book against his chest. The book has a dark spine and a green ribbon bookmark extending from its bottom edge. His fingers are wrapped around the book, with his thumb resting on the front cover. A narrow white cuff is visible at his wrist. The lighting illuminates his face and the book, creating a contrast with the deep, dark background.

alt_text: A richly adorned person in a green garment and elaborate headwear stands within an arched frame, holding objects.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a single figure, likely a woman, in profile, facing left, set against a dark gray background within an arched architectural frame. The figure has light skin, dark hair, and wears an elaborate green long-sleeved garment with intricate gold and red trim. Her head is adorned with a multi-colored turban-like headpiece featuring jewels, pearls, and black and white feathers. She wears multiple strands of pearl and gold necklaces, large earrings, and numerous bracelets on both wrists. A long, decorative sash or belt with tassels and jewels hangs from her waist. Her right arm is raised, with the hand delicately holding a small, dark, possibly floral or feathery object. Her left hand, positioned lower, holds a white, cross-shaped object. Above the arch, a red panel with gold floral patterns is visible. To the left of the figure, a small, rectangular framed image or mirror is depicted on the wall. The entire painting is bordered by a gold and red patterned frame, which is then surrounded by a plain, light beige mat.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: Blue-skinned man and woman embrace, surrounded by other women in a lush landscape with a river and trees
long_description: The painting depicts a group of figures in a vibrant natural landscape. In the center, a blue-skinned man with a golden crown and yellow dhoti embraces a woman wearing a pink and white sari. They stand under a large, dark green leafy tree, facing each other with their hands gently touching. The man's left arm is around the woman's waist, and her right arm is around his shoulder. Around the central pair, several other women are positioned. To the left, two women in orange and white saris stand close to the embracing couple, looking towards them. Below them, another woman in a dark patterned sari sits on the ground, looking up. To the right of the central tree, four more women are visible. One woman in an orange sari stands near the tree, looking towards the couple. Below her, another woman in a striped yellow and white sari leans against the tree, while a third woman in an orange sari kneels on the ground, looking down. A fourth woman in an orange and white sari stands further right, partially obscured by the tree. The background features rolling green hills on the left, with scattered trees. A winding river with dark green lily pads flows from the left foreground towards the center background, where several white birds stand on its banks. The ground is covered in green grass with small yellow and white flowers. The overall color palette is dominated by greens, blues, yellows, and oranges, with dark outlines defining the figures and landscape elements.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor and gold on paper; dark blue border with red inner rules

alt_text: A large, gnarled tree with white blossoms and green weeping leaves on a gold background with a green ground.
long_description: A six-panel screen painting depicts a large, flowering tree against a shimmering gold background. The tree's gnarled, dark brown trunk, mottled with green, originates from the lower right and extends diagonally upwards and leftwards, dominating the central and right panels. Its branches, laden with clusters of small, white blossoms, spread across the upper half of the screen. Long, slender, light green leaves hang downwards from the branches, resembling a weeping willow. The upper two-thirds of the screen is a uniform, reflective gold. The lower third features a gently undulating green ground, with lighter shades at the top transitioning to darker greens at the bottom. Scattered across the green ground are various small plants and flowers: a cluster of pink flowers on the far left, small blue and yellow flowers near the base of the main tree, and several curled green shoots resembling fiddlehead ferns along with a few yellow flowers on the right. A small, circular red seal is visible on the far right panel, near the ground line.

metadata.title: 酒井抱一筆　桜楓図屏風|Cherry and Maple Trees
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A person in an ornate blue and red costume holds a small bird in an arched portrait.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a person standing centrally within a golden arched frame. The individual has light skin, dark hair, and dark, almond-shaped eyes, with thin, arched eyebrows and small red lips. They wear a tall, black hat adorned with white and green embellishments. Their elaborate attire includes a long, teal-blue outer robe with wide sleeves, heavily decorated with patterns of white pearls and green jewels around the collar, shoulders, cuffs, and hem. A red and white striped garment is visible underneath, along with a wide red sash tied at the waist. A dagger with a white hilt is tucked into the sash on the left. A long, pearl-encrusted strap hangs from the right shoulder. The person wears red pointed shoes. In their gloved left hand, they hold a small, brown and white bird, which faces left. The background is a plain light blue, with a brown, geometrically patterned railing behind the person at waist level. The vertical composition emphasizes the figure and their ornate costume.

alt_text: Two figures in green robes with white patterns, one holding a fan, the other a striped object, with calligraphy
long_description: The artwork is a watercolor painting on a light, off-white paper, framed by a gold border. Two figures are depicted in the center, standing on a plain background. The figure on the left is shorter, facing towards the right. They wear a loose-fitting, light green robe adorned with white, stylized lotus-like patterns. Their lower body is covered by light-colored pants. Their face is mostly obscured by a large, light-colored, fan-like object held up to their chin. A small dark topknot is visible on the back of their head. The figure on the right is taller and stands with their back slightly turned towards the viewer, facing left. They also wear a loose-fitting, light green robe with white, stylized lotus-like patterns, and light-colored pants. Their head is mostly shaved with a dark topknot. They hold a round object with red and white stripes near their chest, with their hands raised. Black calligraphic text is present on the left side of the painting, running vertically, and also in the upper right corner. Below the text in the upper right are two small, square red seals. The overall color palette is muted, primarily light green, white, and black ink on a light background.

metadata.title: 諸画家  加茂季鷹賛  「神妙画帖」|Painting Album of Sublime Talent
metadata.medium: Album of twelve leaves; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A Nativity scene with Mary, Joseph, and shepherds gathered around the infant in a stable, under a starry sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a Nativity scene set at night, with a dark, mountainous landscape in the background. In the center foreground, a nude infant lies on a white cloth in a straw-filled manger. To the left of the infant, a woman with light skin and brown hair, dressed in a red top and blue robe, kneels with her hands clasped in prayer, looking down at the baby. Behind her, an older man with a white beard, wearing an orange robe and holding a staff, stands looking towards the infant. Another figure is partially visible behind him. To the right of the infant, two men kneel. The closer man has light skin and brown hair, wearing a light-colored cloth draped around his waist. The other man, older with a white beard, wears a blue garment and embraces the first man. Behind the infant, a donkey and an ox are visible. The setting includes a simple wooden stable structure on the left and rocky formations on the right. In the upper right background, a bright, glowing light illuminates a small, winged figure in the dark night sky, above distant green trees and mountains. Other small figures are visible in the distant landscape. The foreground features patches of green foliage.

alt_text: A bust-length portrait of an older man with a mustache and goatee, wearing a red velvet cap and robe.
long_description: This bust-length portrait depicts an older man with a direct gaze, positioned against a dark, plain background. His face is characterized by visible wrinkles, a prominent nose, and thin lips. Graying hair is visible at his temples, complementing his gray mustache and a pointed gray goatee that extends from his chin. He wears a deep red velvet cap with a white band around its brim. His shoulders are visible, draped in a voluminous deep red velvet robe or cloak. The robe features a wide white collar and is trimmed with a white, possibly fur, border along its front opening, where several small, round red buttons are visible. The fabric of the robe shows soft folds and highlights, indicating its plush texture. The overall color palette is dominated by rich reds, stark whites, and the dark background, with the man's skin tones providing a warm contrast.

alt_text: Jesus on a cross with grieving figures below and angels catching blood above on a gold background
long_description: The image is a vertical panel painting depicting the crucifixion of Jesus against a textured gold background. In the center, Jesus is nailed to a brown wooden cross. He has a lean body, a crown of thorns on his head, and a white loincloth. Blood drips from his hands, feet, and a wound on his right side. Above his head, the letters "I.N.R.I." are inscribed on a small plaque. Two angels with dark wings and red robes fly horizontally, one on each side of the crossbar, holding small white cloths to catch the blood dripping from Jesus's hands. The angel on the left has dark hair, and the one on the right has light hair. Below the cross, a small, dark brown mound of earth is visible. To the left of the cross, a woman in a dark blue hooded robe stands with her hands raised, looking up at Jesus. She has a pale face and a faint halo. To the right, a man in a long red robe stands with his hands clasped in prayer, also looking up at Jesus. He has short brown hair and a faint halo. At the very base of the cross, a woman with long, light brown hair, wearing a pink robe, kneels and embraces the cross, looking upwards. Small red droplets are visible near her hands. The gold background is uniformly textured with a subtle pattern.

metadata.title: The Crucifixion
metadata.artist: Stefano da Verona (Stefano di Giovanni d'Arbosio di Francia)

alt_text: A woman in a dark kimono sits on a bench by a pond with irises, holding a fan under a tree branch.
long_description: The painting depicts a woman seated on a low, bamboo-style bench beside a body of water, framed by decorative borders. The woman, positioned slightly right of center, wears a dark, patterned kimono with white polka dots and wide sleeves. Her hair is styled in an elaborate dark bun with a red accent. Her skin is pale, and she looks downwards and to her left. She holds a light-colored fan with a blue and white geometric pattern in her right hand, resting her left arm on a dark, possibly fur-like, object in her lap. Her bare feet, with painted toenails, extend towards the left, one shoe placed on the ground beside the bench. Above her, a tree trunk rises on the far right, with a branch extending horizontally across the top third of the image, adorned with sparse green leaves. To the left of the woman, a calm body of water stretches across the middle ground, with several clumps of tall, green iris plants and a few purple iris blossoms. Small rocks are visible along the water's edge. The background is a muted, light beige. The main image is bordered on the top and bottom by a decorative band featuring light-colored circular motifs alternating with green, leaf-like patterns. The left and right edges of the entire artwork are bordered by a dark grid pattern on a light background. A small red seal and some faint Japanese characters are visible on the right side, near the tree trunk.

metadata.title: 歌川豊広筆　「納涼美人図」|Woman Cooling Herself
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A man in a red coat stands in a doorway, looking into a room filled with classical sculptures and busts
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene, looking through a dark doorway into a brightly lit room filled with classical sculptures. In the immediate foreground on the right, a large white classical bust of a bearded man with curly hair is visible, topped by a smaller white female figure wearing a draped garment and a helmet. Both rest on a dark, rectangular pedestal. On the left side of the foreground, a dark wooden stool holds a black top hat, and a white rectangular canvas or board leans against the stool. A dark bottle stands on the floor nearby. Centered in the doorway, a man stands with his back mostly to the viewer, looking into the room beyond. He wears a long, bright red coat with a dark collar, dark blue trousers, and dark shoes. His left hand is tucked into his back pocket. The room he gazes into has light purple-gray walls and a light-colored floor. Along the left wall of this inner room, several white classical sculptures of varying sizes are arranged, some standing on the floor and others on shelves. On the back wall, a large, rectangular white relief sculpture depicts multiple figures in a classical scene. Below this, a darker opening or doorway reveals more white sculptures, including two figures that appear to be holding shields or weapons. A white classical pedestal or column is visible on the right side of the inner room.

metadata.title: The Hall of Antiquities at Charlottenborg Palace, Copenhagen

alt_text: A painting depicts ancient ruins, a temple, and a broken bridge by a river with boats and figures under a cloudy sky.
long_description: The painting depicts a dramatic landscape featuring ancient ruins by a body of water under a cloudy, twilight sky. The sky transitions from dark blue at the top left to a warm orange-pink hue towards the right, with swirling clouds. In the center, a large, ornate ruined temple stands on a raised stone platform. It features a decorative roof supported by columns, with a sarcophagus-like structure visible beneath the canopy, adorned with carved reliefs. Vines and foliage grow over parts of the temple. To the right of the temple, more crumbling stone structures and a dark wall rise, topped by distant, pointed spires of a city or church. On the left side, a dilapidated wooden bridge extends from the bank over a narrow channel of water, leading towards the central ruins. A small, thatched-roof hut sits near the bridge. Further left, a partially submerged white boat with a tall mast leans precariously. Several small figures are scattered on the grassy bank, some seated, others standing. A dark river or canal flows from the mid-ground towards the viewer, with a small rowboat carrying two figures in the lower center. The banks are rocky and uneven, with sparse dark green and brown vegetation. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by dark blues, greens, browns, and grays, with the sky providing the main source of warmer tones.

metadata.title: Imaginary View with a Tomb by the Lagoon

alt_text: A close-up oil portrait of a woman with reddish-brown hair, her pale hand covering her mouth and lower nose
long_description: This is a vertical oil painting depicting a close-up portrait of a woman from the chest up, set against a muted background. The woman's head is slightly tilted, and her gaze is directed downwards or her eyes are closed, with a somber or weary expression. Her skin is rendered in pale tones, with noticeable reddish-pink blush on her cheeks and around her eyes. Her reddish-brown hair is pulled back, with some loose strands framing her face. Her right hand is raised to her face, with the fingers covering her mouth and the lower part of her nose. The hand is painted in lighter, almost white, tones, contrasting with the darker areas of the painting. She wears a dark garment, possibly a dress or top, which is largely obscured by shadow and blends into the dark background on the right side of the canvas. The background behind her head and left shoulder is a lighter, warm beige or light brown, creating a subtle halo effect. The artist's signature, "Degas," is visible in the upper left corner, written in a light brown script. The brushwork is loose and visible throughout the painting, contributing to the textured surface. The overall palette is subdued, dominated by earthy browns, dark grays, and the pale, flushed tones of the woman's skin.

metadata.title: Young Woman with Her Hand over Her Mouth
metadata.medium: Oil colors freely mixed with turpentine on canvas

alt_text: A dimly lit room features red patterned drapes, a central dressing table with a mirror, and various decorative objects.
long_description: The painting depicts a dimly lit interior room, rendered primarily in deep reddish-brown tones. The entire background is covered by heavy, floor-length drapes of a reddish hue, featuring a subtle patterned texture, possibly damask, visible in areas where light catches. The drapes are gathered at the top, creating a canopy-like effect, with a darker red border and thin blue lines running horizontally across them. Centrally positioned is a dark, ornate dressing table with a rectangular mirror. The mirror's frame has decorative carvings at its top. On the table, to the left of the mirror, stands a dark vase containing a cluster of green foliage. To the right, another similar vase with foliage, and a small, dark pitcher are visible. A slender, dark candlestick or similar object is placed between the left vase and the mirror. In the left foreground, a low, upholstered bench or footstool with ruffled trim is partially visible. Adjacent to it, a small, dark green rug lies on the patterned floor. Further right, a tall, slender pedestal table with a decorative, carved base supports a dark, shallow bowl. On the right side of the foreground, another similar pedestal table holds a dark pitcher. The floor is covered by a patterned rug in dark reds and browns, with a faint floral or geometric design. The overall lighting is soft and diffused, contributing to the subdued atmosphere.

metadata.title: A Bedroom in Bernstorff Palace near Copenhagen

alt_text: A tan, slender dog stands in a painted landscape with mountains and hills in the background.
long_description: This horizontal oil painting depicts a slender, short-haired dog, resembling a greyhound, standing in a rugged landscape. The dog, positioned slightly left of center, faces left with its head lowered and gaze directed forward. Its coat is a warm reddish-brown or tan, with lighter cream-colored fur on its chest, belly, and inner legs. A thin white blaze runs down its forehead and snout. The dog wears a simple dark collar around its neck. Its ears are pointed, and its body is lean and muscular, with visible brushstrokes defining its form. The foreground consists of a light, sandy-colored ground with sparse patches of green and brown brushwork suggesting grass or low vegetation. Behind the dog, the midground features darker, more textured brushstrokes indicating rocky terrain and denser foliage in shades of green and dark brown. The background reveals a mountainous or hilly landscape under a muted sky. On the left, distant mountains appear in cool blue-green tones, while on the right, warmer brown and ochre rock formations rise. The sky above is a blend of light blue and grey, suggesting an overcast or hazy atmosphere. The overall impression is a naturalistic portrayal of an animal in its environment.

alt_text: A partially rendered painting of a brown deer with large antlers, mouth open, against a light background.
long_description: A painting depicts a brown deer with large antlers in a dynamic, partially finished state against a light, unpainted background. The deer's body is positioned diagonally across the canvas, with its head turned towards the upper right, mouth agape, revealing its tongue and teeth. Its fur is rendered in shades of rich brown, with lighter tones on its belly and around its face. The neck and chest area show a thicker, shaggier texture. Prominent, multi-tined antlers, rendered in lighter grays and whites, extend upwards and outwards from its head. The deer's front left leg is mostly painted, while its other three legs are primarily outlined in thin, dark lines, suggesting an unfinished sketch. Beneath the deer's body, there are broad brushstrokes of green and yellow, indicating ground or foliage. Faint, unpainted sketch lines are visible around the deer's form and in the background, highlighting the artwork's incomplete nature. The overall background is a light, off-white canvas with visible texture.

alt_text: A woman in an ornate dress holds a glowing severed head on a platter in a dark, architectural setting
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a dramatic scene with a central female figure. The woman stands full-length, facing slightly right, with long, light brown hair adorned by an ornate gold crown or tiara. She wears an elaborate gown featuring a gold skirt, blue sleeves, and a patterned bodice and belt. In her left hand, she holds a small white flower. Her right hand supports a gold platter, on which rests a severed head. The head, belonging to a man with dark hair and a beard, has closed eyes and is surrounded by a bright white halo. Reddish-brown blood drips from the neck onto the platter. The background is dark and somber, with architectural elements on the left, including a dark wall or column and a small, flickering light source, possibly a candle or lamp, on a ledge. To the right, a dark, cloudy sky with hints of blue and lighter clouds is visible. On the ground below the severed head, a long sword with a dark hilt lies diagonally, accompanied by reddish stains. The overall color palette is dominated by dark blues, browns, and golds, contrasted by the white halo and red blood.

metadata.title: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist

alt_text: A large dark fish swims among smaller fish and aquatic plants on a four-panel screen
long_description: This four-panel artwork depicts a scene of fish swimming in water with aquatic plants. The dominant feature is a large, dark-bodied fish, likely a carp, positioned diagonally across the lower right and central panels. Its head points towards the lower left, and its tail extends towards the upper right. The fish has a dark, scaly body with lighter, reddish-brown fins and a similarly colored tail. Its eye is a prominent light circle with a dark pupil. To the left and above the large fish, in the left and central panels, are several smaller, dark-bodied fish, generally swimming towards the left. There are approximately seven smaller fish visible, varying in size, with some appearing slender and others more rounded. The background is a muted, reddish-brown or sepia tone, suggesting water. Scattered throughout this background are numerous dark, brushstroke-like forms resembling submerged aquatic plants or debris. In the lower left panel, vertical lines of dark text are visible. The overall impression is of a tranquil underwater scene rendered with a limited color palette.

metadata.title: 清　龔谷　躍鯉圖　四條屏|Nine carp
metadata.medium: Set of four hanging scrolls, ink and color on paper

alt_text: A white crane with spread wings stands on a rock amidst pine trees, flowering vines, and green plants.
long_description: The artwork depicts a natural scene on two vertical panels, framed by a decorative gold and green border. The background is a muted ochre color. A large white crane with black primary feathers and a red patch on its head stands prominently in the lower-middle section, straddling the seam between the two panels. Its left wing is partially spread upwards, revealing the white underside, while its head is turned to the left, looking downwards. It stands on its right leg, which is bent, with its left leg lifted. Around the crane, a light brown rock formation is visible. Various green leafy plants, some with small reddish-orange flowers, grow around the rock and extend across the lower half of both panels. In the upper left, dark green pine branches extend downwards. In the upper right, a gnarled tree trunk with dark green pine branches rises from the right edge, and delicate white and light orange flowering vines hang downwards from the top. The ground around the base of the tree and rocks is depicted with shades of green and brown.

metadata.title: 清   陳兆鳳   松鶴圖   四條屏|Crane, pine, and rock
metadata.medium: Set of four hanging scrolls mounted on a Japanese bi-fold screen; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A light blue artwork with black calligraphy and golden wavy lines, framed by a light gold border
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular composition set against a light blue background. Black calligraphic script is arranged in several vertical columns, primarily on the right and center-left. The script varies in thickness and fluidity, with some characters appearing more angular and others very flowing. Beneath and around the calligraphy, thin, wavy lines in a metallic gold color are visible. These lines are more concentrated towards the bottom and right side of the composition, resembling reeds or water ripples. Some of the gold lines also appear subtly in the upper left and center. The light blue background has a slightly mottled or textured appearance, with subtle variations in tone. The entire blue and gold composition is bordered by a thin, light gold frame, which is then surrounded by a wider, solid light gold border. This wider border has a vertical seam running down its center on the left side.

metadata.title: 小野お通書　源氏物語画帖|Excerpts from The Tale of Genji
metadata.artist: Ono no Ozū (Ono no Tsū)|Tosa School
metadata.medium: Leaves from an orihon album; calligraphies: ink on decorated paper; paintings: ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Six panels depict various hawks perched on wooden stands, with calligraphic text above each
long_description: This six-panel artwork features a series of six different hawks, each depicted on its own vertical panel. The background of each panel is a light, warm tan color, with white borders separating the panels and framing the top and bottom edges. In the upper section of each panel, black calligraphic text is arranged in vertical columns. Each hawk is shown perched on a horizontal wooden bar or stand, which extends across the lower half of its respective panel. A leash or tether is attached to one leg of each bird, hanging downwards. The hawks vary in appearance: the leftmost panel shows a brown and white hawk with its head turned to the right, looking down, with a red tether. The second panel features a predominantly white hawk with dark markings on its head and wings, facing left, with a red tether. The third panel displays a brown patterned hawk with its head turned left, looking down, with a black looped tether. The fourth panel presents a white and brown hawk facing left, with a long, straight black tether. The fifth panel shows another brown patterned hawk, facing right and looking down, with a green looped tether. The rightmost panel depicts a white hawk facing left, with a red and white patterned tether. The birds are rendered with detailed feathers and sharp talons, and the perches are simple, unadorned wooden bars.

metadata.title: 曽我直庵筆　架鷹図押絵貼屏風|Tethered Hawks
metadata.medium: Twelve paintings mounted as a pair of six-panel folding screens; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A moonlit painting of a large, dark building with a round tower, partially obscured by dense trees.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a dark, nocturnal scene of a large building partially hidden by trees under a moonlit sky. The upper third of the painting shows a dark blue-gray sky with white and light gray clouds. A bright, full moon is visible through a break in the clouds, positioned slightly left of the center. The building, a multi-story structure, occupies the right and center-right of the composition. It features a prominent round tower on its left side, topped with a conical roof, and a gabled section to its right with a steep, dark roof. One window on the right side of the building emits a warm, orange-yellow light. The building's walls are a muted dark brown. Dense, dark trees and bushes fill the left side, foreground, and midground, obscuring much of the building. These trees are dark brown and black, with sparse, dark green or brown leaves. A tall, slender tree stands prominently in the left-center, reaching towards the moon. The foreground is a dark, open area, possibly a path or clearing, with hints of brown and dark green, and sparse ground foliage.

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting showing a figure in a red hood and cloak, with black calligraphic text and a red seal above.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a figure and calligraphic text on a light tan background, framed by decorative borders. In the lower half of the scroll, a pale-skinned figure, likely a woman, is depicted facing slightly to the right. Her dark hair is visible beneath a large, bright red hood or cloak that covers her head and shoulders, extending downwards to the bottom edge of the visible painting. The red fabric shows folds and subtle gold accents. A white garment with faint pink stripes is visible at her neck. The figure has delicate facial features, including thin black eyebrows, small eyes, and small red lips. The upper half of the scroll contains several vertical lines of black calligraphic text, starting from the upper right and moving towards the left. Below the text, on the left side, is a small red square seal. The central tan panel is bordered by narrow vertical stripes of brown, green, blue, and gold on the sides. The top and bottom edges of the central panel are framed by wider decorative bands featuring a patterned design in green, gold, and blue.

metadata.title: 伝歌川豊春筆　蜀山人（太田南畝）賛　女達磨図|Courtesan as Daruma
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Ink painting of a tall waterfall cascading through dense bamboo foliage and rocky cliffs
long_description: A tall, narrow ink painting depicts a waterfall descending through a landscape dominated by bamboo and rocky formations. The artwork is rendered in various shades of black ink on a light, aged background. In the upper section, a waterfall begins its descent from the top right, appearing as vertical streaks of lighter ink against darker rock. Dense bamboo branches with numerous leaves frame the upper left and right sides, extending inward. Below the initial cascade, the waterfall is interrupted by a prominent, textured rocky outcrop that extends from the left. The water then resumes its flow in a second, lower section, again appearing as vertical lines. More bamboo foliage, with individual leaves and slender stalks, is heavily featured in the mid-ground and foreground, particularly on the left and right, partially obscuring the waterfall and cliffs. The bamboo creates a layered effect, with some branches appearing closer to the viewer. In the upper right quadrant, small, vertical lines of text are visible. The lower portion of the painting continues with more bamboo and the suggestion of the waterfall's base, fading into the background.

metadata.title: 清   楊涵   風竹圖   軸|Windblown bamboo

alt_text: A multi-headed, multi-armed red deity stands on a prostrate figure, surrounded by many smaller deities in a vibrant, ornate composition
long_description: The image is a vertical, rectangular painting with a central, large, red-skinned deity. The central deity has five visible heads and at least ten arms, wearing a golden crown and jewelry. It stands on a prostrate, light-skinned figure, who lies on a dark-skinned figure. This central group is framed by an elaborate golden archway with intricate patterns, set against a red background. Above the central deity, within the arch, is a smaller, similar red deity. To the left and right of the central arch, there are vertical columns of eight circular or oval medallions on each side, totaling sixteen. Each medallion contains a seated deity figure, mostly red-skinned, some light-skinned, in various postures, often holding objects. Below the central scene, a multi-tiered platform displays ten more medallions, five on an upper tier and five on a lower tier, each with a seated figure varying in skin color and posture. The entire composition is bordered by a light blue band at the top and sides, and a dark green band at the bottom. Vibrant colors like reds, blues, greens, yellows, and gold are used throughout the detailed and ornate artwork.

alt_text: A long-haired woman in flowing white robes stands among green vines under a pale full moon.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a serene night scene. The background is a soft, muted greenish-gray, suggesting a twilight or moonlit sky. In the upper left quadrant, a pale yellow, circular full moon glows softly. Below and to the right of the moon, a woman is the central figure, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center. She has very long, dark hair that cascades down her back and over her shoulders, reaching past her waist. She wears flowing, light-colored robes, possibly white or a very pale gray, which appear somewhat translucent, blending with the background in places. Her head is turned slightly to her left, and her gaze is directed downwards. Her hands are held together near her waist, though the details are indistinct. Entwined around the woman and framing the right side of the composition are green vines with large, rounded leaves and small, delicate white flowers. The vines extend upwards towards the moon and downwards, creating a natural frame. A small, dark calligraphic signature is visible in the lower right corner of the main painted area. The overall impression is one of quiet contemplation under moonlight.
