metadata.title: 月岡芳年筆　「月百姿 源氏夕顔巻」|The Spirit of the Deceased Yūgao Entwined in Moonflower Vines, based on the print “The Lady of the Evening Faces,” from the series One Hundred Aspects of the Moon (Tsuki hyakushi: Genji Yūgao no maki)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A person sits on a veranda looking at a full moon and hanging lantern amidst mountains, on a scroll
long_description: This vertical scroll features a central painted image framed by decorative fabric sections. The top and bottom sections of the scroll are a light blue fabric patterned with small, repeating gold floral motifs. The central painting depicts a nighttime scene with a figure seated on a veranda, looking out towards a mountainous landscape. The figure, positioned in the lower right, has long dark hair and wears a white garment beneath a purple outer robe adorned with subtle floral patterns, and an orange undergarment. They are seated on a dark floor, facing left, with their back partially to a large, dark vertical pillar on the right side of the composition. A low railing extends from the pillar towards the left, and a small, light-colored table is visible near the figure. Beyond the veranda, a series of jagged, mist-shrouded mountains rise, rendered in shades of grey and green. Above the mountains, a full, pale moon is visible in the light green-grey sky, alongside a dark, multi-tiered lantern suspended by a string. The overall color palette is muted, featuring soft greens, greys, browns, and the deeper tones of the figure's attire.

metadata.title: 月岡芳年筆　「月百姿 石山の月」|Murasaki Shikibu at Ishiyamadera Temple, based on the print “The Moon at Ishiyama,” from the series One Hundred Aspects of the Moon (Tsuki hyakushi: Ishiyama no tsuki)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Three hanging scrolls with faded ink-wash figures, a seated central figure flanked by two standing figures.
long_description: Three vertical hanging scrolls are displayed side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a central rectangular panel containing an ink-wash drawing, framed by decorative fabric borders. The top and bottom borders of each scroll are made of teal-blue fabric patterned with swirling clouds and subtle gold accents. The middle border section, directly above and below the central drawing panel, is a rust-brown fabric with a pattern of smaller, interlocking cloud or wave shapes, also with gold accents. A thin, light green border directly frames each central drawing panel. The scrolls are suspended by two gold-colored loops at the very top of each. The central drawing panels are a faded light brown color. The left scroll depicts a standing figure, facing slightly right, rendered in light, faded ink lines suggesting a robe. A faint, circular shape, possibly a moon or halo, is visible in the upper right corner of this panel. The middle scroll features a seated figure, facing slightly left, with a large, prominent circular halo or aura behind its head and upper body. The figure is seated on a rocky or cloud-like formation, and above it, in the upper part of the panel, are faint, dark ink washes suggesting mountains or clouds. The figure's robes are loosely drawn with ink lines. The right scroll shows a standing figure, facing slightly left, similar in style and fading to the figure on the left scroll.

metadata.title: 白衣観音・寒山・拾得図|Triptych of White-robed Kannon, Kanzan, and Jittoku
metadata.medium: Set of three hanging scrolls; ink on silk;

alt_text: Two vertical panels depict flowering branches, one heavily covered in white snow, against a light brown background
long_description: Two vertical panels, each with a light brown background, are framed by a blue border with a subtle, repeating pattern and thin gold strips at the top and bottom. The left panel features a thick, gnarled branch extending from the lower left, curving upwards and right. This branch and its smaller offshoots are heavily covered in white, suggesting snow, with numerous small white flowers blooming along its length. A thin, dark vertical line runs parallel to the right edge of this panel. A small red seal is visible in the lower right corner of the left panel. The right panel shows several dark, slender branches extending from the lower right, curving upwards and left. These branches also bear small white flowers, but they are not covered in snow. The branches in both panels are rendered with dark ink, and the flowers have delicate white petals with dark centers. A small red seal is also visible in the lower right corner of the right panel. The overall background is a uniform, muted light brown.

metadata.title: 墨梅図|Ink Plum
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll features a robed figure with a wide hat below black calligraphy and a red seal.
long_description: A vertical scroll features a light brown paper surface with a dark blue-green border along the sides and a light brown border at the top and bottom. The upper half of the scroll is dominated by black ink calligraphy arranged in several vertical lines. The text is written in a flowing script. Below the calligraphy, slightly to the left, is a small, square red seal impression. The lower half of the scroll depicts a single figure, seen from the back, walking towards the left. The figure wears a wide-brimmed, conical hat that covers their head and shoulders. They are dressed in long, flowing robes that extend to their ankles, with visible dark shoes or sandals. The figure is rendered in black ink outline with minimal shading, contrasting with the light brown paper background. The overall composition places the text above the figure, creating a balanced vertical arrangement.

metadata.title: 東坡戴笠図|Su Dongpo in a Borrowed Hat

alt_text: A monochrome ink landscape painting shows a misty river scene with hills, trees, and small figures on land and in boats.
long_description: A monochrome ink wash painting depicts a misty landscape with a wide body of water in the foreground and midground. The artwork is framed by a dark blue-green fabric border with a subtle floral pattern, and a narrower gold-brown border. The central image, rendered in shades of gray, black, and beige, shows a hazy atmosphere. On the right, a steep, dark bank slopes down towards the water, covered with sparse, dark trees and brushstrokes suggesting rocky terrain. Two small, indistinct figures are visible on this bank, one appearing to walk uphill carrying a burden. In the midground, the water extends horizontally, with a small boat containing a single figure near the left bank. Further back, on the opposite bank, several trees with drooping branches, possibly willows, are depicted. The background is very hazy, showing faint outlines of distant land or mountains merging with the misty sky. The brushwork varies from soft washes for the mist and distant elements to darker, more defined strokes for the foreground trees and banks. A square red seal impression with illegible characters is visible in the bottom right corner of the painting itself.

alt_text: A hawk with speckled feathers perched on a gnarled pine branch, looking up, in an ink wash painting
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a hawk perched on a gnarled pine branch, rendered primarily in shades of gray, black, and white. The hawk is the central and dominant figure, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center. Its body faces slightly right, but its head is sharply turned upwards and to the left, with a dark, piercing eye and a prominent hooked beak. The hawk's feathers are meticulously detailed, showing a pattern of dark speckles on its back and wings, contrasting with lighter feathers on its chest and belly. Its powerful talons firmly grip the textured surface of the pine branch. The gnarled pine branch extends from the lower left of the composition, curving upwards and then diagonally across the middle ground, providing a stable perch for the bird. Clusters of long, thin pine needles are visible both below the hawk and extending from branches in the upper right portion of the painting. The background is a light, neutral tone, suggesting an open sky or an undefined space, allowing the hawk and branch to stand out. A small, rectangular red seal is visible in the lower right corner of the main painted area. The artwork is framed by a decorative border with a repeating floral or geometric pattern in muted green and gold tones.

metadata.title: 狩野之信筆　松鷹図|Hawk on a Pine

alt_text: An ink landscape painting on a fan shows mountains, trees, water, and a small boat.
long_description: The artwork is an ink wash painting on a fan-shaped piece of paper, mounted on a larger, light-colored sheet with decorative borders. The fan-shaped painting depicts a mountainous landscape rendered in various shades of black and gray ink on a light, aged background. On the right side, steep, rugged mountains rise, densely covered with dark, textured trees, likely pines, indicated by their spiky forms. The ink work here is heavy and detailed, suggesting close proximity. Moving leftward and into the midground, the mountains become less defined, appearing softer and more distant, with lighter ink washes. A body of water, possibly a river or lake, occupies the lower central and left portions of the fan. A small, narrow boat with a single figure is visible on the water in the lower left quadrant. Further left, the landscape recedes into a hazy, almost ethereal distance, with faint outlines of hills or mountains. A small, square red seal is stamped in the lower left corner of the fan, near the boat. The overall composition uses strong diagonal lines and varying ink intensity to create depth and a sense of expansive space within the curved format.

metadata.title: 土岐洞文筆　雪景山水図|Snowy Landscape
metadata.medium: Fan mounted as a hanging scroll; ink, gold wash, and mica on paper

alt_text: A white heron with its head bent down, standing amidst faint reeds on a light brown scroll painting
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a large white heron in the lower half, depicted against a light brown background. The heron is positioned facing right, with its long neck curved downwards and its slender beak pointing towards the lower right. Its body is rendered in light tones with dark outlines, and its long, dark legs extend downwards, ending in visible webbed feet. Faint, dark vertical lines, resembling reeds or tall grasses, are visible in the upper left and right portions of the background, as well as around the bird's lower body. Subtle, wavy lines suggest ground or water beneath the bird. In the lower left, a vertical column of dark characters is present. The central painting is framed by decorative borders. Narrow blue bands with a lighter, intricate pattern run along the top and bottom edges. Wider golden-brown borders with a repeating, subtle floral or geometric motif flank the left and right sides of the artwork.

metadata.title: 俵屋宗達筆　白鷺図|White Heron

alt_text: Two ink wash paintings depict birds of prey, one perched on a leafy branch, the other on rocks
long_description:
This artwork consists of two vertical ink wash paintings, presented side-by-side. Both are rendered in shades of black and gray on a light, cream-colored background, with faint red seals visible on each. The overall style suggests a traditional East Asian aesthetic.

The left painting features a bird of prey, likely a hawk or falcon, positioned slightly above the center. The bird faces left, its head turned slightly upwards. Its feathers are meticulously detailed with fine lines and varying shades of gray, creating texture. It perches on a gnarled branch that extends from the lower left upwards and to the left, adorned with several broad, dark leaves. Faint, lighter brushstrokes suggest a misty background below the branch. In the lower left corner, there is a small block of vertical text in black ink, accompanied by a square red seal.

The right painting also depicts a bird of prey, similar in size and detail to the one on the left. This bird is positioned slightly above the center, facing right, with its head turned slightly upwards. It stands firmly on a prominent, rugged rock formation rendered with strong, dark ink washes that define its craggy surfaces and shadows. Behind and to the right of the rocks, a lighter, more ethereal mountain or hill rises, fading into the light background. A small, square red seal is visible in the lower right corner, near the base of the rocks.

metadata.title: 曽我二直庵筆　鷹図|Hawks
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A multi-panel screen painting depicting a lively procession of figures on a gold background, with buildings and a large tree.
long_description: This horizontal, multi-panel screen painting features a dynamic scene set against a shimmering gold background. The composition is divided into distinct areas by architectural elements and a large group of figures.On the far left, a multi-story building with dark brown walls and a roof is depicted in cross-section, revealing interior spaces. A red floor or rug is visible on the lower level, where several figures are seated or standing. A dark brown staircase ascends towards the upper left.The central panels are dominated by a large, dense group of approximately thirty to forty figures. They are depicted in various active poses, suggesting a procession or dance. Their garments are colorful, featuring shades of red, white, black, blue, green, and brown, often with intricate patterns. Some figures hold objects such as fans, drums, or flutes. Their faces are stylized, and their bodies are rendered with fluid lines, creating a sense of movement across the gold ground.On the far right, another building with dark brown walls and a roof is partially visible. A large, dark green pine tree with gnarled, horizontal branches extends from behind this building, its foliage appearing as dark, cloud-like masses. Several figures are positioned near this building, one appearing to walk away from it, another standing closer to its entrance. A faint wisp of smoke or mist rises from behind the building.The entire scene is framed by a dark brown border with a repeating geometric pattern in green and gold. The gold background has a textured appearance, suggesting the use of gold leaf.

metadata.title: 風流踊図 屏風|Festive Dancing at a Samurai Residence (Fūryū odori zu byōbu)
metadata.medium: Four-panel folding screen; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A figure in elaborate traditional attire, wearing a tall hat and carrying swords, stands against a brown background
long_description: A full-length painting depicts a single figure standing in profile, facing right, against a plain, dark brown background. The figure's head is topped with a tall, cylindrical, dark brown hat with a textured surface. Below the hat, dark hair is pulled back, and a red ribbon is tied under the chin, framing a fair-skinned face with delicate features, dark eyebrows, and small red lips. The figure wears layered garments. The innermost visible layer is white with swirling gold patterns and a prominent circular motif on the left shoulder, featuring red and green elements. Over this, a dark blue or black outer garment is adorned with numerous white, star-like floral patterns. A multi-colored sash, displaying bands of orange, blue, red, and white, cinches the waist. Two swords or daggers are tucked into the back of the sash, with several white, fan-like elements fanning out upwards from behind the left shoulder. The figure's right hand holds another sword or dagger, pointing downwards. The feet are visible, appearing to wear light-colored sandals or be bare, with reddish soles.

metadata.title: 男舞図|Dancer with a Sword
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Japanese calligraphy in black ink on white paper, with yellow flowers and a patterned gold border
long_description: The artwork features black Japanese calligraphy and illustrations of yellow flowers on a rectangular piece of light-colored paper, framed by a patterned border. The paper occupies the central portion of the image. The calligraphy is arranged in vertical columns, primarily on the upper half and extending downwards. The characters vary in size and style; some are bold and distinct, while others are more fluid and delicate. The largest characters are on the right side, with smaller, more cursive script towards the left. Beneath and interspersed with the calligraphy are illustrations of plants. These plants have thin, grey-green stems with small, dark leaves. At the top of each stem are clusters of small, round, yellow flowers, each dotted with tiny black specks. These flowers form a horizontal band across the lower half of the paper, with some stems reaching higher into the areas between the calligraphy columns. The central paper is surrounded by a wider, light brown border. This border is adorned with a repeating pattern of small, stylized gold floral or leaf motifs, which are evenly spaced across its surface.

metadata.title: 「風」：詩歌巻断簡|Poems on “Wind” from Japanese and Chinese and Poems to Sing
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A woman in a green robe sits on a red bench, looking down at objects on a low table beside her.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a woman seated on a red, low-backed bench, looking down and to her right. She has pale skin and dark hair styled in an elaborate bun, adorned with a gold ornament. She wears a long-sleeved green outer robe with light blue and white trim, over a reddish-brown garment with a white polka-dot pattern. A long, flowing green sash or ribbon hangs from her waist. Her left arm is bent, resting on her lap, while her right arm is mostly obscured. Her legs are bent, with her feet tucked beneath her. To her right, on a similar red, low-backed surface, are several objects, including a dark, helmet-like item, a small green mat, and other indistinct forms. The background is a plain, light tan color. In the upper left quadrant, there is vertical black text with a red seal below it. The central painting is framed by patterned borders on the left and right, featuring dark brown branches and leaves on a lighter brown background. A darker, intricately patterned border is at the very top and bottom of the scroll.

metadata.title: 唐美人図  (Tō bijin zu)|Chinese Beauty
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A serene figure in white robes sits on a pink lotus petal floating on water, surrounded by text
long_description: A vertical painting depicts a central figure seated on a large lotus petal, floating on water, flanked by columns of black script and red seals. The figure has light skin, a serene expression, and dark hair styled with an elaborate gold and red headdress. They wear flowing white robes that drape around them, with hints of green and red visible beneath. A large, pale circular halo is positioned behind their head. The figure's hands are gently clasped or resting in their lap. They are seated on a prominent, light pinkish-orange lotus petal, which has visible veins and appears to be floating on stylized light blue waves. To the left of the figure, three columns of vertical black script are present, accompanied by three red square seals. To the right, four columns of vertical black script are visible, with two red square seals. The background is a plain, light grey or pale blue. The central painted area is framed by a dark brown border, which is then surrounded by a wider, light beige border featuring a subtle floral or foliate pattern.

metadata.title: 照山元瑶筆　隠元隆琦 ・ 木庵性瑫賛　一葉観音図 (Ichiyō Kannon zu)|Kannon on a Lotus Petal
metadata.artist: Muan Xingtao (Mokuan Shōtō) 木庵性瑫|Yinyuan Longqui (Ingen Ryūki) 隱元隆琦|Shōzan Gen’yō 照山元瑶
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A blue, horned, running figure with a spear and a smaller pink-clad figure on a light background
long_description: The image is a horizontal scroll or painting section on a light, aged background. On the far left, a large, red and blue cloud-like or flame-like shape is partially visible, extending from the top edge. To its right and slightly below, a smaller, light pink-clad figure lies on its side, facing right. This figure has dark hair and what appears to be light brown fur on its limbs. Its body is mostly covered by a flowing pink garment with red ties. Further to the right, dominating the right half of the image, is a large, blue-skinned, emaciated figure in a running or striding pose, moving towards the right. This figure has prominent horns, a black hat, and a red beard. Its body is skeletal with visible ribs and sinews. It wears a simple loincloth-like garment in reddish-brown and white. Its hands and feet are clawed. The figure holds a long, dark pole or spear diagonally across its body, pointing upwards and to the right. A small red banner or ribbon is attached near the tip of the spear. The background is a plain, light beige or cream color, showing some faint discoloration consistent with age.

metadata.title: 望月玉蟾筆　真珠庵蔵百鬼夜行絵巻図|Copy of Night Parade of One Hundred Demons from the Shinjuan Collection
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An ink wash painting on a scroll depicts bamboo stalks and leaves above textured rocks.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting, rendered in ink wash, features a composition dominated by bamboo and rocks against a subtle background. The upper portion of the painting is a light beige or ochre, gradually transitioning to a pale blue-grey in the lower half, suggesting a distant horizon or atmospheric depth. In the upper right and extending towards the center, numerous bamboo stalks and their slender leaves are depicted with varying shades of dark grey and black ink. Some leaves are rendered with lighter washes, creating a sense of movement and depth. Several bamboo stalks are visible on the right side, characterized by their segmented appearance. At the bottom right, a large, multi-lobed rock formation rises from a light, sandy-colored ground plane. The rocks are textured with darker ink washes, giving them a rugged, organic appearance. To the left of the main rock, smaller clumps of vegetation or rocks are visible. Faint, slender bamboo shoots or grass appear on the lower left. On the right side, near the bamboo stalks, a vertical inscription in black ink is present, accompanied by two small, square red seals stacked vertically. The central painting is bordered by a narrow, light brown patterned strip, which is then framed by a wider, dark brown border adorned with a repeating pattern of gold floral motifs and swirling vines.

metadata.title: 柳沢淇園筆　竹石図|Rock and Bamboo
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A standing figure in a red kimono and a seated bearded figure on a patterned rug, with hanging wisteria.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting depicting two figures within an interior setting, framed by decorative borders. The main painting area is a light tan or beige background. At the top, a small, light green wisteria plant hangs from a thin, curved golden structure, with several long, white flower clusters dangling downwards. In the lower half of the painting, two figures are positioned on a large, rectangular rug with a complex geometric pattern in shades of brown, beige, and white, bordered in red. The rug is angled, with its bottom edge parallel to the bottom of the painting. On the left, a standing figure faces right, slightly turned towards the seated figure. This figure wears an elaborate red kimono with white floral patterns, a wide black and gold striped obi, and a blue and white patterned undergarment visible at the sleeves and hem. Their hair is styled in a dark, upswept fashion. They hold a closed fan with a blue and white pattern in their right hand, extended towards the seated figure. On the right, a bearded figure is seated on the rug, leaning back against a red and black plaid cushion or garment. This figure wears a yellow kimono with a subtle pattern, and a dark plaid outer garment or blanket draped over their lower body and legs. They have a dark mustache and beard, and their dark hair is pulled back with a shaved forehead. Their left hand rests on their lap. On the rug between the two figures, near the standing figure's feet, are a piece of white paper, a small dark object, and a thin dark stick. To the right, near the seated figure, is a red, fan-shaped object and a small, dark, lidded pot. The scroll has a top and bottom border of patterned fabric in gold, blue, and brown stripes, and side borders of dark brown fabric with a subtle checkered pattern and gold floral motifs.

metadata.title: 宮川一笑筆　武士と若衆|Samurai and Wakashu (Male Youth)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono sits on a large, white, stylized elephant, with Japanese text.
long_description: The artwork presents a central image of a woman seated on a large, white elephant, against a plain, light beige background. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center, facing towards the left and looking downwards. She has pale skin and an elaborate dark hairstyle, adorned with several decorative pins. She wears a dark blue kimono patterned with gold, orange, and light blue floral and fan motifs. A prominent red sash or garment is draped across her lap. Her right hand holds a long, thin, dark object, while her left hand rests gently on her lap.The elephant is depicted in a stylized, almost ethereal manner, with a predominantly white body and faint outlines. Its head is turned towards the left, revealing visible tusks and a trunk that curves downwards. The elephant's form features swirling lines, suggesting its body and legs.To the left of the woman and elephant, multiple vertical lines of black Japanese text are present, accompanied by a small red seal below them. Additional vertical lines of black text are visible on the far right side of the image. The central scene is framed by decorative borders: a narrow gold and brown floral pattern along the top and bottom edges, and wider black borders with a repeating gold geometric pattern on the left and right sides.

metadata.title: 勝川春章筆  佛母恵選賛　江口の君図|Courtesan of Eguchi
metadata.artist: Katsukawa Shunshō 勝川春章|Butsumo Keisen
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts an old bearded man and a younger figure seated on the ground.
long_description: The vertically oriented scroll features a central image area of light beige paper, depicting two seated figures at the bottom. On the right, an older man is shown, bald with a long, flowing white beard and mustache. He wears dark, layered robes and holds a curved staff or similar object in his right hand, which rests on the ground beside him. His gaze is directed upwards and to the right, with his mouth slightly open. To his left, a smaller, younger figure is seated, facing towards the older man. This figure wears lighter-colored robes and holds a fan with a dark design in their left hand. A small, light-colored rectangular object lies on the ground in front of the younger figure. The figures are rendered with ink wash, creating shades of grey and black for the robes and outlines. A large, empty space of the light beige paper extends above the figures. In the bottom right corner, below the older man, a red square seal and some faint, dark vertical text are visible. The central image is framed by a narrow, plain gold border, which is then framed by a wider, dark blue-grey fabric border with a repeating pattern of small, light gold circular motifs.

alt_text: A large crowd of people, some holding baskets, look up at a misty mountain with a small figure at the top
long_description: A vertical ink and wash painting on a light-colored ground depicts a large gathering of people at the base of a mountain. The upper third features a misty, craggy mountain range rendered with light grey and black ink washes. A small, indistinct figure appears near the peak on the left. To the left of the mountain, vertical lines of black text are visible, reading "佛說摩訶般若波羅蜜多心經", followed by a smaller line of text and a red square seal. Below the mountain, a dense crowd of approximately thirty to forty individuals fills the central and lower portions of the composition. Most are depicted from the waist up or as busts, with many looking upwards with open mouths and expressive faces. Their skin tones are light, and their clothing is rendered in muted tones of grey, blue, and brown. Several individuals in the upper part of the crowd are raising their arms, some holding flat, dark, woven baskets or trays. The lower part of the crowd includes more figures, some wearing hats or head coverings. Details like woven baskets, a fan, and a staff are visible among the figures. The ground beneath them is textured with short, dark brushstrokes, suggesting foliage or rough terrain. The overall impression is one of a lively, expectant gathering.

metadata.title: 松村呉春筆　賣魚図|Fish Market
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An old man with a long beard and a white deer in a landscape with pine and flowering trees
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts an old man and a white deer within a natural landscape. The upper portion of the painting features dark green pine branches extending from the top right, alongside delicate branches with small white blossoms, possibly plum or cherry, on the left. The background is a light, misty gray, suggesting a cloudy sky or distant mountains. In the center, a smiling old man with a long, flowing white beard and mustache is depicted. He wears a light-colored, possibly cream or beige, robe with wide sleeves and a dark, pointed hat. His right hand holds a staff that extends downwards, with a small, dark, possibly red, object tied near its top. His left hand is positioned near his waist. To the right of the man, a white deer with small, dark antlers stands, its head turned slightly towards the left. The deer's body is mostly white with subtle shading. The lower part of the painting shows a light-colored ground, possibly indicating snow or a misty terrain. On the far lower left, a few dark green, slender leaves, resembling bamboo, emerge from the ground. The overall color palette is subdued, dominated by light grays, muted greens, and soft browns, with the white of the blossoms and the deer providing contrast. A faint vertical inscription in dark characters with a small red seal is visible in the upper right quadrant.

metadata.title: 岸駒筆　寿老人図|Jurōjin
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicting a towering mountainous landscape with temples, trees, and small figures amidst mist
long_description: A vertical scroll painting presents a towering mountainous landscape rendered in a traditional style, with a muted palette of browns, grays, and greens, accented by touches of red. The upper portion is dominated by tall, jagged mountains with textured brushstrokes, partially obscured by light gray mist. In the upper left, vertical black ink text is visible, followed by two red square seals and one red rectangular seal. The text reads: "淺絳山水圖 戊戌秋日寫於 雙清館 吳湖帆". Below the highest peaks, the landscape descends, revealing more hills and mountains emerging from the mist. Clusters of green trees, including pines, are scattered across the hillsides. Several small human figures, some in reddish robes, are visible on winding paths. Buildings with dark roofs and red accents are nestled among the trees and mist, with one prominent complex visible in the mid-right. Further down, the scene includes a waterfall cascading over rocks and a bridge spanning a stream. More small figures are seen crossing the bridge and walking along paths. The lowest part of the painting features a wider, flatter area with scattered rocks, trees, and what appears to be a body of water or a wide river.

metadata.title: 岡田半江筆　 溪山秋社図|Autumn Festival on a Mountain
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on satin

alt_text: Monochrome ink painting of numerous figures in a hilly landscape with pine trees, water, and traditional buildings
long_description: The vertical ink wash painting depicts a sprawling landscape populated by numerous small figures, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light background. The composition is divided into multiple levels, suggesting a continuous narrative or a vast scene. In the upper section, rolling hills with soft outlines recede into the distance, dotted with a few sparse pine trees and isolated figures. Moving downwards, the landscape becomes more densely populated. A winding body of water, possibly a river or lake, flows through the middle ground, bordered by more pronounced hills and clusters of pine trees with gnarled trunks and dense foliage. Many figures are scattered across these hillsides, some seated in groups, others walking or standing. A traditional building with a dark roof and open sides is visible amidst the trees on the right side of the middle ground. The lower section of the painting features the most activity. On the left, a large procession of figures, some carrying what appear to be spears or staffs, moves across a hillside. Other figures are walking or standing nearby. On the right, two large, two-wheeled carts with prominent wheels are positioned on a sloping path, with a few figures around them. More pine trees and undulating terrain fill the foreground, completing the expansive scene.

metadata.title: 冷泉為恭筆　圓融院船岡山子日御遊図|Emperor Enyū’s Outing to Funaokayama on the First Day of the Rat in the New Year
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll features a large, hand-drawn gray circle above black calligraphy on a light beige background.
long_description: A tall, vertical scroll features a central light beige paper panel framed by plain, lighter borders. At the top and bottom of the central panel are horizontal decorative bands. These bands display a repeating pattern of stylized, swirling cloud-like or floral motifs in muted brown and gold tones. Below the top decorative band, in the upper third of the central panel, is a large, hand-drawn circle. This circle, rendered in dark gray or black ink, has an imperfect, slightly smudged outline, with the interior remaining the light beige of the paper. Below the circle, occupying the lower half of the central panel, is a section of black ink calligraphy. The script is arranged in vertical lines, starting from the upper right of this section and extending downwards and slightly to the left. The characters are fluid and varied in size. The bottom decorative band mirrors the top one, completing the composition.

metadata.title: 太田垣蓮月書 「野に山に」の歌|Waka Poem: “Across the fields and hills…”

alt_text: A full-length portrait of a person in a red patterned tunic, turban, and patterned trousers, holding a fan.
long_description: A full-length portrait, framed by a golden arch, depicts a person standing centrally, facing forward. The individual has light skin, dark hair, and dark eyes, with a small mouth. They wear an elaborate, tall turban made of pinkish-red fabric with gold patterns, topped by a gold crown-like element. Their attire includes a short-sleeved, red tunic adorned with white floral patterns, revealing a white patterned undershirt at the neck and wrists. A gold belt cinches the waist. Below the tunic, patterned trousers in shades of pink, yellow, and green are visible, along with a sheer white overskirt that has an intricately embroidered gold and white hem. The person wears simple red sandals on their feet. A gold bracelet is on their left wrist, and they hold a reddish-brown fan with a long handle in their raised right hand. The background features a draped green curtain on the left and a window on the right, looking out onto a landscape with distant mountains and trees under a light sky. The rest of the background is a plain dark wall.

alt_text: Madonna and Child with John the Baptist and a lamb in a wooded landscape with scattered flowers
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts the Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist and a lamb in a wooded landscape. In the center, the Madonna is seated, looking down and to the right. She wears a red tunic with white sleeves and a blue mantle draped over her lap and legs. She holds the nude Christ Child on her left knee, who faces forward with his right arm raised and left hand resting on her arm. To the right and slightly below, a young, nude Saint John the Baptist kneels, looking up towards the Christ Child. He wears a brown animal skin around his waist and holds a tall staff with a white banner inscribed with black text: "ECCE AGNUS DEI". A small white lamb, adorned with a wreath of flowers, stands beside Saint John. The figures are framed by dark trees on either side, with a lighter, more open landscape visible in the upper right background, featuring blue hills under a cloudy sky. A small bird flies in the upper right. Various small flowers, including white, yellow, and blue blossoms, are scattered across the dark ground in the foreground.

metadata.title: Madonna and Child with the Infant Saint John the Baptist

alt_text: Nude winged figure with laurel wreaths, surrounded by musical instruments, a blindfolded putto, and a landscape.
long_description: A classical oil painting depicts a youthful, winged, nude male figure seated centrally, draped in a vibrant blue cloth. He wears a dark green laurel wreath on his head and holds another aloft with his right hand, while his left hand rests on a third wreath. His skin is pale, and his dark hair frames a face looking directly forward. To his left, a small, plump, winged putto with a blindfold over its eyes stands on a red book, its hands tied behind its back with a pink ribbon. Behind the putto, a dark tree trunk rises, and a distant landscape features blue mountains, a body of water, and a cloudy sky. To the right and in the foreground, a collection of objects is arranged on stone steps and the ground. These include several stringed musical instruments like lutes and violins, open books with sheet music, a sword, a painter's palette with brushes, and a globe. A classical white bust is visible behind the instruments, near a large white wing. The overall scene is set against a dark, muted background, with the figures and objects illuminated.

metadata.title: Allegory of Sacred and Profane Love

alt_text: A still life painting features a compote filled with light and dark grapes, peaches, and green leaves
long_description: A still life painting depicts a generous arrangement of fruit in a compote, set against a dark background. The composition is centered, with the fruit overflowing from a dark, stemmed vessel. Large bunches of light green grapes, some with visible stems, cascade downwards on both sides of the compote. Interspersed among them are smaller clusters of dark, purplish-black grapes. Several peaches are prominent, with one large peach centrally placed on the compote, displaying soft pinkish-orange blush over creamy yellow skin. Other peaches are partially visible behind the grapes. Green leaves are scattered throughout the fruit, adding touches of vibrant color. A small, winged insect, possibly a wasp or fly, is visible in the upper left quadrant, hovering above a peach and some grapes. The compote itself has a dark, possibly glass or ceramic, bowl and a fluted stem, resting on a wide, circular base. Gold-colored bands accent the stem and base. The fruit and compote rest on a dark brown, polished surface, likely a table, which occupies the lower third of the painting. The background is uniformly dark, almost black, creating a strong contrast that highlights the illuminated fruit.

metadata.title: Still Life of Grapes and Peaches

alt_text: A dark still life painting features a bounty of fruits, nuts, and vegetables arranged on a table.
long_description: A horizontal still life painting depicts a lavish arrangement of fruits, nuts, and dried vegetables on a dark, shadowed surface. The background is uniformly dark brown, providing a stark contrast to the lighter-toned produce. On the far left, two large, green, melon-like objects are wrapped in twine. Below them, three spiky, green pineapples rest on the table. To their right, a pile of various nuts, including walnuts and hazelnuts, is scattered, with a string of smaller, light-colored nuts extending towards the center. A large, woven basket overflowing with dried corn husks and cobs, along with other dried plant material, occupies the central-left area. To the right of the basket, several red and yellow apples are clustered. Dominating the right side are multiple large bunches of grapes: some are light green, others are deep red, with green and reddish-brown leaves intertwined. A dark, gnarled branch extends diagonally from the upper right. Scattered on the table in the foreground are more individual grapes and nuts, and a small snail is visible on the lower right. The table surface has a carved, lighter-colored edge. The signature "G. Ruoppoli" is visible in white script on the lower left.

metadata.title: Still Life of Fruit and Nuts

alt_text: A still life painting featuring a large bouquet of diverse flowers in an ornate silver vase, with a butterfly and an apple.
long_description: The painting depicts a vibrant still life of various flowers arranged in an ornate silver vase, set against a dark brown background. The vase, positioned centrally, has a sculptural, grotesque design resembling a fish or sea creature, with swirling acanthus leaves and a textured surface. It rests on a dark green-grey tabletop. A profusion of flowers fills the upper two-thirds of the canvas, extending outwards from the vase. Dominating the top center is a large, deep red peony. To its right, a cluster of white lilies, some fully open and others in bud, rises prominently. Nearby are several orange-pink daylilies. Below these, a few red tulips are visible, along with smaller white and yellow blossoms. On the left side, two large, dark purple-black irises are prominent, with a brown butterfly perched on one of their petals. Small yellow buttercup-like flowers are scattered among the foliage. Towards the bottom left, a small, pale red apple with a green leaf rests on the tabletop, near some white bell-shaped flowers. On the right, a single purple tulip bud lies on the table, and a small cluster of purple-red flowers is visible higher up. The dense arrangement includes various green leaves and stems, creating a rich, layered composition.

alt_text: A still life painting featuring various flowers and fruits arranged on a dark surface with green leaves
long_description: The painting depicts a still life arrangement of flowers and fruits against a dark brown background. In the upper half, several flowers with long green stems rise from behind the fruit arrangement. From left to right, a tall stalk of dark pink hollyhocks is visible, followed by a light blue iris with a yellow center, a pale yellow tulip, a white tulip, another light blue iris, a red tulip, a second pale yellow tulip, and a tall stalk of red hollyhocks on the far right. The lower two-thirds of the painting are filled with a dense pile of various fruits, primarily apples, pears, and plums, resting on a lighter brown surface that extends across the bottom. The fruits are arranged in a mound, with some dark green leaves interspersed. Dominant fruits include numerous red and green apples, some with pinkish blushes. Several pears, ranging from yellow-green to reddish-brown, are scattered throughout the pile. A large yellow quince with blue ribbons tied around its stem is prominent near the center. Two large red pomegranates are visible in the upper part of the fruit pile, one on the left and one on the right. Smaller fruits like dark blue and purple plums, and orange-pink apricots or small peaches, are nestled among the larger items and spill onto the foreground surface. A few dark green leaves are visible, particularly around the pomegranates and extending from a branch on the lower right. The overall lighting is soft, highlighting the textures and colors of the produce.

alt_text: A classical painting depicts five figures, mostly nude, with a child and animals in a landscape
long_description: This classical oil painting depicts a scene with five adult figures and one child, mostly nude, set in a pastoral landscape under a cloudy sky. On the far left, a man with a winged helmet stands, holding a staff. Below him, another man sits on a rock, draped in a reddish-pink cloth, holding a staff and extending his right hand towards the center. Behind him, a small group of goats is visible. In the immediate foreground, a small, light-colored dog sleeps curled up on the ground. In the center, three nude women stand. The woman on the left has a small child clinging to her right leg, and a green drape partially covers her. She looks towards the seated man. Next to her, a woman wearing a golden crown and a blue drape stands, gesturing with her right hand towards the left. A peacock is visible at her feet. On the far right, a third woman stands with her back mostly to the viewer, holding a tall staff and a large, round golden shield. A blue drape is wrapped around her. The background features dark green trees on the left, transitioning to a lighter, open sky with soft clouds on the right. The ground is a mix of dark rocks and earthy tones.

alt_text: A shepherd in a red cap tends a flock of sheep in a hilly landscape with distant buildings.
long_description: A pastoral landscape painting depicts a shepherd with a flock of sheep in the foreground, set against rolling hills and distant structures under a cloudy sky. On the right, a young shepherd, wearing a red cap and a blue garment, kneels beside a large brown animal, possibly a cow or a large sheep, partially obscured by a dense, leafy brown tree. A cluster of white and light brown sheep, some with horns, stands in front of him, facing towards the viewer and slightly to the left. In the immediate foreground, a fallen tree trunk lies on the ground, with dark green, leafy plants growing nearby. The middle ground features undulating hills with patches of green and brown, where another smaller group of sheep is visible in the distance. Further back, on the left, a large, round, light-colored building with a smaller structure next to it sits atop a hill. The sky above is a mix of light and dark blues, with soft white clouds scattered across it. The overall color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and blues, with the white of the sheep standing out.

metadata.title: Roman Landscape with a Shepherd and Sheep

alt_text: A still life painting of a woven basket overflowing with various fruits and large green leaves
long_description: The painting depicts a still life composition featuring a variety of fruits and large leaves arranged in and around a woven basket, set against a dark, almost black background. The basket, positioned in the lower center, is made of dark brown, tightly woven material, with a visible handle-like structure on its left side. Overflowing from the basket and spilling onto the surface below are several clusters of fruit. On the left, a large bunch of light green and reddish-brown grapes hangs down, partially resting on a large, dark green, veined leaf. To the right of these grapes, a pale yellow, irregularly shaped quince sits prominently within the basket. Above the quince, a smaller cluster of dark purple grapes is visible. Further to the right, a partially opened pomegranate reveals its bright red arils, while a small, round apple with red and green skin is positioned next to it. Another, mostly intact pomegranate is visible behind the apple. A dark green olive branch with a few leaves extends from behind the pomegranate. Large, dark green fig leaves with prominent veins rise from behind the fruit arrangement, dominating the upper portion of the composition. One fig is visible, cut open to reveal its red interior, positioned near the top center. Another whole fig is partially obscured behind the grapes on the left. The background is a uniform dark brown, providing a stark contrast to the lighter colors and textures of the fruit and foliage. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, casting subtle shadows and highlighting the forms of the produce.

metadata.title: Basket of Fruit
metadata.artist: Bartolomeo Cavarozzi|Master of the Acquavella Still Life

alt_text: A classical painting depicts Mary holding baby Jesus, with Joseph reaching for them, and cherubs above in a landscape
long_description: The painting depicts a religious scene set in a natural landscape under a blue sky. In the upper center, three cherubs float on white clouds. Two larger cherubs hold a basket of flowers and a garland, while a smaller cherub head is visible behind them. To the right, another cherub head emerges from behind a tree. In the lower left, a woman with a halo, dressed in a blue cloak over a pink garment, stands on a rocky bank. She holds a baby with a halo, who reaches out towards a bearded man on the right. The baby is nude except for a white cloth around its waist. To the woman's left, a winged cherub with light brown hair kneels on the ground, looking up. The bearded man, wearing a brown cloak over a purple tunic, stands with his bare feet in a shallow stream of water that flows over rocks. He leans forward, extending both hands towards the baby. His staff and a white bundle lie on the ground behind him to the right. Tall trees with green foliage frame the scene on both sides, with a large palm tree on the left and a dark, gnarled tree on the right. The background features a distant landscape with rolling hills under a lighter blue sky with white clouds. The overall color palette includes blues, browns, greens, and flesh tones.

alt_text: A woman with bare chest embraces two infants, while a third child sleeps beside them in a landscape
long_description: The painting depicts a woman with three children in a natural setting with architectural elements. The woman is positioned centrally, facing slightly right, with her head tilted down towards the children. Her upper body is bare, revealing her chest and stomach, covered by a light brown or beige drape around her lower body and legs. She has dark, curly hair and fair skin. She holds two infants. One infant, with dark hair, is on her left, facing her chest, appearing to nurse. This infant's back is to the viewer. The other infant, with light blonde hair, sits on her lap, facing forward and slightly right, with one arm raised. This infant is also bare-chested. A third, slightly older child, with dark curly hair, lies asleep on a dark purple drape in the lower right foreground. This child wears a blue tunic and rests their head on a light-colored object, possibly a book or block. Their legs are extended towards the right. Behind the figures, to the left, is a dark, stone-like architectural structure, possibly a pedestal or column base. To the right, a dark, shadowy tree or bush frames the scene. In the background, a landscape unfolds under a cloudy sky, featuring distant hills or mountains and a faint outline of buildings. The overall lighting is soft, with a focus on the figures.

alt_text: A painting depicts one man attacking another with a club near a burning fire and a large tree.
long_description: A vertical oil painting depicts a dramatic outdoor scene with two men in the foreground. On the right, a muscular man with light skin and dark hair stands, wearing a light-colored loincloth. He holds a wooden club raised high above his head, poised to strike. His left hand firmly grasps the arm of another man who lies on the ground to his left. This second man, also with light skin and dark hair, is partially nude, wearing a similar loincloth. He is positioned on his back, with his arms raised defensively, and a visible streak of red, possibly blood, is on his head and neck area. To the left of the figures, a large, dark tree with sparse brown foliage dominates the mid-ground. At the base of this tree, a bright fire burns, casting orange and red light. A thick column of grey smoke rises from the fire, partially obscuring the tree trunk and blending into the dark blue sky above. The background features a dramatic landscape with distant, blue-grey mountains under a dark blue sky filled with large, white and grey clouds. Some clouds are illuminated from an unseen light source, creating a stark contrast with the darker areas. The overall palette is dominated by dark blues, browns, and greens, punctuated by the bright fire and pale skin tones of the figures.

alt_text: A young child in a turban kneels, holding a striped ball and pretzels, with a doll and fruit nearby.
long_description:
The painting depicts a young child kneeling on a patterned rug, positioned slightly to the left of the center. The child faces forward, looking directly at the viewer with wide, dark eyes and rosy cheeks. They wear a white turban with a green band and gold trim, a white long-sleeved dress, and a green vest with gold embroidery. Green slippers are visible on their feet. The child's left arm is bent, holding a striped ball with pink, green, and white sections. Their right arm is also bent, holding a string of brown, ring-shaped pretzels over their shoulder. A small doll with a white dress and a pink bow is tucked into the child's right armpit.
To the child's left, a larger doll lies on its back on the rug. This doll wears a light-colored, possibly beige, outfit with pink circular patches and a ruffled collar, resembling a harlequin. To the child's right, a small, rectangular stool with a pink upholstered top and gold-colored decorative elements on its legs is visible. On the stool, a piece of light-colored bread and a small, open paper packet are placed. On the rug in front of the stool, a red apple and a small, irregular brown object, possibly a cookie, are present. The background consists of dark, draped fabric, likely velvet, on the right, and a darker, plain wall on the left. The rug beneath the child has subtle, swirling patterns in muted tones.

alt_text: A detailed painting of a city with temples and people along a river, with boats on the water
long_description: This rectangular painting, framed by a red border, depicts a bustling city situated along a river. The upper portion features a light blue sky, beneath which a red band contains white text in an Indic script. The city itself is a complex arrangement of multi-story buildings and temples, predominantly in shades of red, orange, and white, with some sections featuring blue and white patterned walls. Numerous white domed and spired structures rise from the rooftops. Within the city, various scenes unfold. On the left, buildings with intricate patterns are visible, alongside a golden spire. Towards the center, groups of people are depicted, some appearing to dance or gather, while others are seated on balconies. A prominent dark-skinned figure, possibly blue, with a crown, stands among a group of people. A peacock is perched on a central rooftop. On the right side, the city's edge descends to the water with a zigzag pattern, and an elephant with a rider is shown partially entering the water from the city's lower right. The lower third of the painting shows wavy blue-grey water populated by several boats. Small fish are scattered throughout the water. From left to right, the boats include: one with a person rowing and another fishing; a second boat with a covered structure containing two people and two dark, four-legged animals below, propelled by a rower; a third boat with a large, net-like structure and a single rower; a fourth boat with a covered structure holding two people and a rower; and a fifth boat on the far right carrying three seated people and a rower.

alt_text: A colorful painting depicts a procession with elephants and a cart leaving a palace, moving past water towards a dense forest
long_description: This rectangular painting features a vibrant scene bordered in red. The composition is divided horizontally, with a multi-story building on the left and a dense forest on the right, separated by a body of water. On the left, a large, multi-tiered building rises, predominantly white and light blue with red accents and multiple white spires on its roof. Small figures are visible in the open windows and balconies of the upper levels. At the base of the building, a procession moves from left to right. It includes two decorated elephants, one with a rider, followed by a four-wheeled cart pulled by two white horses. The cart carries several figures, one with dark skin, and is accompanied by other walking figures. A small, white shrine-like structure with a golden top is positioned at the bottom left, adjacent to the building. The central upper portion of the painting depicts a body of water with wavy, light blue lines. Two large trees with dark, rounded canopies and reddish-brown trunks stand within this water, positioned towards the left. The right side of the painting is filled with a dense, colorful forest. Various trees with different shapes and colors of foliage are depicted, including dark green, light green, pink, and patterned grey. The terrain appears undulating, with reddish-brown and grey rock formations. Several animals, including deer and other small creatures, are visible among the trees and rocks. At the very bottom, within the red border, a line of black text in a non-Latin script is present.

alt_text: A multi-armed dark figure with a crown sits centrally, surrounded by numerous smaller figures on a red background
long_description: The image is a vertical rectangular painting dominated by a deep red background. A large, dark-skinned, multi-armed figure with a crown is centrally positioned in the upper half, seated on a golden lotus base. This central figure has a wide, smiling mouth, prominent eyes, and multiple heads, though only one main face is clearly visible. It holds various implements in its many hands, including a sword. The figure is adorned with golden jewelry and a golden crown. It is framed by a large, ornate golden arch against the red background. Surrounding this central figure, and extending across the entire canvas, are hundreds of smaller figures. These figures are arranged in a grid-like pattern, each typically enclosed within a small, arched niche or frame. The smaller figures vary in posture and appearance; some are seated, some are standing, and some appear to be in dynamic poses. Many of these smaller figures are also dark-skinned with golden adornments, similar to the central figure, while others are lighter in color. They hold various objects and some appear to be dancing or in combat. Below the central figure, the grid of smaller figures continues, with several rows of them. Towards the bottom center, another, slightly larger dark-skinned, multi-armed figure is depicted, also within an arched frame, but smaller than the main central figure. This lower central figure is also surrounded by more small figures in niches. The overall impression is one of a complex, densely populated composition with a hierarchical arrangement, all set against a vibrant red and dark background with extensive gold detailing.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Distemper, ink, and gold on cloth

alt_text: A multi-armed deity with a crown and yellow robes rides a large green bird-like creature with wings and a red beak.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a multi-armed deity riding a large, green, bird-like creature, framed by decorative borders. The central deity has light blue-gray skin and four arms. They wear a golden crown, a yellow dhoti, and various gold necklaces, armbands, and earrings. The deity's upper right hand holds a golden mace, the lower right hand holds a golden disc, the upper left hand holds a pink lotus flower, and the lower left hand holds a white conch shell. The deity sits facing slightly right, with their head turned to look left. Below the deity, the large, green, bird-like creature stands facing forward, also looking left. It has a human-like torso and legs, with green, clawed feet. Its head is bird-like with a prominent red beak and a small golden crown. Large green and blue-feathered wings extend from its back. It wears a white and gold patterned dhoti, a white beaded necklace, and gold armbands. The background is a plain wash of light olive green, fading to a lighter, almost white-green at the top. The central image is enclosed by a black border adorned with small gold floral motifs, which is then surrounded by a wider, light pink border speckled with tiny red dots.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque pigments and gold on paper

alt_text: Two men play a board game on the floor, while a third man fans one of them.
long_description: This painting depicts three men in an indoor setting, with a plain yellow wall dominating the upper half of the background. The lower half of the image features a white floor. In the upper left corner, a white decorative arch shape is visible against the yellow wall. On the left, a man with a dark beard is seated on the white floor, facing right. He wears a blue tunic with red and gold trim, red pants, and a red turban. His right hand is extended towards a board game. A black sword with a gold hilt lies on the floor in front of him. In the center, a cross-shaped board game, primarily red with gold and black details, is laid out on the white floor. Small, dark game pieces are visible on the board. To the right of the board game, another man with a dark beard is seated on a red cushion with gold patterns. He faces left, towards the first man. He wears a white tunic with gold and green patterns, a blue turban, and multiple necklaces. He holds a small white object in his right hand. A green-hilted sword lies on the floor in front of his cushion. Behind the seated man on the cushion, a third man stands, facing left. He wears a red patterned tunic with gold trim and a dark patterned turban. He holds a long, white fan with a black handle, fanning the seated man. The figures are arranged horizontally across the lower half of the image, set against the stark yellow background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor with gold on paper, inscribed in devanagari on the reverse

alt_text: A man and woman in a lush forest with a cow, snake, and musical instrument.
long_description: A rectangular painting with a reddish-brown border depicts a scene with two human figures, a cow, and a snake in a vibrant outdoor setting. In the center, a light-skinned man with long, flowing brown hair sits cross-legged on a spotted animal skin, possibly a leopard print. He wears a red cloth around his lower body and chest, adorned with multiple white necklaces and armbands. His hands are raised slightly, palms open, and a small crescent shape is visible on his forehead. To the left of the man, a light-skinned woman sits on the ground, facing him. She is dressed in an orange sari with a brown veil covering her head and shoulders, and she plays a long, light-colored stringed instrument with two gourd-like resonators. To the right of the man, a white cow with small horns and a decorative collar lies on the ground, facing left. In the immediate foreground, a coiled snake with dark markings rests on the animal skin near the man. Nearby, on the green ground, are a small bowl with dark contents and a yellow pot. The bottom edge of the painting shows a grey-green area with numerous small green leaves and pink lotus-like flowers. The background features several large green trees with clusters of white, pink, and orange blossoms. A tall staff with a red, trident-like object at its top leans against a tree behind the man. The sky is a pale blue.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque pigments and gold on paper

alt_text: A vibrant, multi-tiered painting depicts a central white temple surrounded by numerous figures, smaller shrines, and narrative scenes.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting features a complex, multi-tiered composition dominated by a large, white, domed temple structure with a red base in the center. This central temple is flanked by numerous smaller, multi-tiered shrines and buildings, creating an intricate architectural landscape. White staircases and pathways connect different levels of the structure. Above the central temple, and extending upwards, are multiple horizontal tiers of smaller shrines, each containing various figures. These tiers are separated by dark green or blue-grey bands. The uppermost sections of the painting, both within the central composition and along the red border, are densely populated with small figures, including deities, humans, and animals, engaged in diverse activities. The overall color palette is rich, with prominent reds, greens, blues, and whites. Many figures are depicted in various poses, some standing, some seated, and others in dynamic action. The wide red border surrounding the main scene is also filled with a continuous frieze of small figures. The lowest section of the painting shows a horizontal band with more figures and what appears to be a body of water or a landscape with small creatures.

alt_text: A multi-scene painting depicting figures in traditional attire, some indoors and others with horses outdoors.
long_description:
This vertical scroll painting features multiple scenes on a light tan background, framed by a patterned fabric border with dark blue circular motifs. The composition is divided horizontally into distinct areas.

In the upper section, a dark, horizontal band spans the width, suggesting a roofline or distant horizon. Below this, within a building, a slender figure with long dark hair stands on a raised platform, facing towards the right. The building's interior walls are depicted with light, vertical slats.

The middle section shows another figure seated on a lower, raised platform, facing left. This figure wears ornate, light-colored robes and a tall, dark headdress. To the left of this figure, a slender, gnarled tree with sparse light green foliage extends upwards.

The lower section depicts an outdoor scene with several men and horses. On the far left, a man stands holding a bow and a quiver, looking upwards and to the right. In the center-right, two men attend to a light-colored horse that faces left with its head lowered. One man holds the horse's reins, while another stands beside it. Further to the right, a third man is mounted on a light-colored horse, also facing left. Behind this group, a gnarled tree with green foliage has a red, circular object hanging from one of its branches. The ground in this lower scene is a light tan, with subtle horizontal bands of darker brown.

metadata.title: 岩佐又兵衛筆　『平家物語』 平維盛 北の方惜別図|“Taira no Koremori’s Farewell,”  from The Tale of the Heike (Heike monogatari)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: A bald figure reads in an open building while a standing figure observes, set against a sparse landscape
long_description: This horizontal painting features a muted color palette, framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are dark brown with light blue and gold patterns, while the side borders are gold with a subtle texture. The central scene depicts a building on the right, set against a sparse landscape on the left. Inside the building, a bald figure with light skin is seated on a white cushion, wearing a light brown robe. This figure holds an open book or scroll, appearing to read or write. A dark rectangular object rests on the floor in front of them. The building has a simple wooden structure with a raised floor and a roof. Behind the seated figure, a green area with plants is visible, suggesting an outdoor space. To the right of the seated figure, a standing figure with long dark hair faces towards the seated individual. This figure wears a long, light green robe and red footwear. The landscape to the left of the building includes rolling hills in muted green and brown. Sparse, bare branches and clumps of grass are scattered across the light, sandy ground. The background is a very light, almost white, color.

metadata.title: 秋夜長物語絵巻|Scene from A Long Tale for an Autumn Night
metadata.medium: Section of a handscroll, remounted as a hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A multi-armed, monkey-headed deity with a halo, holding various objects, flanked by two smaller human figures
long_description: The central figure is a large, multi-armed, monkey-headed deity with light pink skin, a red face, and a long, pointed snout. It wears a conical hat with colorful stripes and a large, circular halo behind its head. The halo contains multiple smaller heads or faces, some human-like, some animal-like, including a donkey and a horse. The deity has many arms, possibly twelve, extending from its torso. Each hand holds a different object, such as red flowers, a sword-like object, a small bowl, and a club. A large white circle with a smaller inner circle is depicted on its chest. It wears a striped skirt in red, green, and black, and has anklets on its legs. The deity is shown in a dynamic pose, with its left leg bent and its right leg extended. To the lower left of the central figure, a smaller human figure with light skin and dark hair is seated, looking up at the deity. This figure wears a red top and a purple skirt, and appears to be holding the deity's left leg. To the lower right, another smaller human figure, also with light skin, is depicted in a running or dancing pose, holding a small bowl. This figure wears a red top, green pants, and a striped turban. The artwork is rendered on a plain, light brown paper with a thin red border line around the edges.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and opaque watercolor on paper

alt_text: A vertical painting depicting numerous figures, some human-like, some monstrous, in a multi-tiered mountainous landscape with fire and clouds
long_description: The painting is a tall, narrow vertical scroll depicting a complex, multi-scene narrative across a mountainous landscape. The upper section features a swirling, cloud-filled sky in shades of dark blue and gray, populated by several figures. On the far left, a figure hangs upside down, seemingly falling. To its right, another figure with red skin and a weapon stands amidst the clouds. In the upper right, a large, red-faced figure with a beard and elaborate headwear sits behind a blue, draped table, appearing to write on a scroll. Other smaller figures are around this central scene, some kneeling, some standing. Below this, the landscape transitions into a series of rocky, green and brown mountains and valleys. Numerous figures populate this middle ground. On the left, a large, muscular figure with a staff walks forward. To the right, a prominent area of bright red flames engulfs several smaller figures, who appear to be in distress. Other figures are scattered throughout the mountainous terrain, some walking, some sitting, some appearing to be led or driven. A small hut with a thatched roof is visible on the right side. The lowest section of the painting continues the mountainous landscape, with a large area of intense red and orange flames emanating from a dark pit or chasm on the left. Several figures are near this fiery area; some appear to be falling into it, while others are being pushed or are reacting in fear. A large, light-skinned figure with a red garment stands prominently on the right, looking towards the flames. The overall color palette is muted, with greens, browns, and grays, punctuated by vibrant reds for the flames and some lighter tones for figures.

metadata.title: 地獄図|Scenes of the Buddhist Hell
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A frog meditating on a platform, surrounded by various animals, some playing music and others observing
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a gathering of anthropomorphic animals rendered in ink wash on a light-colored ground. The composition is centered around a large frog seated in a meditative posture on a raised, rectangular platform in the upper left quadrant. The frog, depicted with a long, wispy beard, rests on a large green leaf. Behind the platform, a gnarled tree trunk with an owl perched on a branch rises, accompanied by another tall green leaf. To the right of the central frog, two figures resembling human-like animals or monks are seated on the ground. One has a bald head and a beard, while the other wears a hood. Further right and slightly above them, a rabbit-like creature wearing a dark, conical hat plays a flute, with a fox-like animal seated nearby. Below the main platform, a monkey-like figure kneels before a smaller, rectangular table that holds a vase with a single flower. This figure is clad in a patterned robe. In the lower right section of the painting, a group of animals is engaged in musical activities. A fox-like creature plays a stringed instrument, and a rabbit-like figure plays a xylophone. Another larger, robust animal with pointed ears and a tail stands to the right, holding a string of beads. The artwork employs a restricted color palette of black, various shades of grey, and muted greens and browns, with subtle touches of light red. A block of black calligraphic text with a red seal is present in the lower left corner. The text reads: "学而商国士 佛法僧俗士 铁拐李仙人".

metadata.title: 鳥獣戯画の場面|Scene Inspired by the Scrolls of Frolicking Animals and Humans
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on satin

alt_text: A tall, narrow ink painting depicts a mountainous landscape with trees, winding paths, and distant peaks.
long_description: This vertical ink painting, rendered in shades of black and gray on light brown paper, depicts a vast, towering mountainous landscape. The composition is arranged vertically, leading the eye upwards through successive layers of peaks and valleys. In the upper section, faint, distant mountains rise into a hazy sky, with a few slender, jagged peaks emerging more distinctly, topped with sparse trees. Below these, a series of more defined, craggy mountains dominate the upper-middle ground, their slopes textured with intricate brushstrokes suggesting rock formations and clusters of trees. A winding path or river appears to snake through the valleys between these peaks, leading towards the foreground. The middle section features rolling hills and more rounded mountains, some densely covered with trees, others showing bare, textured slopes. As the eye moves towards the lower portion of the painting, the details become slightly less defined, with broader washes of ink suggesting further undulating terrain and scattered vegetation. The overall impression is one of immense scale and depth, created through varying ink tones and brushwork that define the contours and textures of the natural environment.

metadata.title: 七寶山|Chilbosan (Seven Jeweled Mountain)
metadata.medium: Set of 10 paintings previously in folding screen format; ink on cotton

alt_text: A vibrant, overflowing bouquet of diverse colorful flowers in a dark vase sits on a dark table.
long_description: The painting depicts an elaborate floral still life against a dark brown background. A large, overflowing bouquet of various flowers is centrally arranged in a dark, possibly green, glass vase with an ornate, fluted base. The flowers display a wide range of colors, including prominent pink and red roses, white and yellow daffodils, red and orange tulips, blue irises, blue cornflowers, yellow and orange marigolds, and smaller white, pink, and blue blossoms. Some flowers, like a red anemone, are positioned towards the top left, while a red and white striped tulip extends towards the top right. Green leaves and stems are interspersed throughout the bouquet, providing a dark contrast to the bright blooms. The vase rests on a dark brown, flat surface that extends across the bottom of the frame. On this surface, to the left of the vase, a white flower with a green stem lies next to a few small blue forget-me-nots. A butterfly with patterned wings, primarily brown and orange, is perched near the base of the vase on the left. Scattered pink petals and a small red flower with green leaves are visible on the surface to the right of the vase. The lighting appears to come from the upper left, highlighting the flowers and creating subtle shadows.

alt_text: Two figures embrace in a dark setting, one holding a skull, with a third figure slumped in the background
long_description: This dark, dramatic oil painting depicts three figures in a dimly lit interior. In the center, a woman with light skin and reddish-brown, curly hair leans back, her eyes closed and head tilted upwards. She wears a white, draped garment that exposes her chest. Her left arm cradles a dark, round object, possibly a skull, against her body. Her right hand is clasped with the left hand of a man positioned to her right. This man has dark, curly hair and wears a reddish-brown garment with a prominent feathered element on his right shoulder. He leans towards the woman, his face close to hers, with a gentle expression. A red tassel hangs from his garment near the bottom right. In the darker background, to the left of the central figures, a third figure is partially visible. This figure wears a light-colored turban or head covering and an orange-brown garment, appearing to be slumped or sleeping. A dark green leafy branch hangs from the top center of the painting. The central figures are illuminated, contrasting with the deep shadows of the background.

metadata.title: The Temptation of Saint Mary Magdalen

alt_text: A bearded man with dark hair holds a small, light-colored dog against a dark background.
long_description: A vertical portrait painting depicts a man with a beard holding a small dog, both looking forward. The man, positioned slightly to the left of center, has dark, wavy hair with some graying at the temples. He has a full, light brown and gray beard and mustache, fair skin with rosy cheeks, and dark eyes under a slightly furrowed brow. He wears a reddish-brown coat with a wide, dark green velvet collar or lapel. His left arm is bent, holding the dog close to his chest. The dog is small, with light cream or tan fur, dark round eyes, and a dark snout. Its ears appear floppy. The background is a plain, dark, muted blue-green, slightly lighter directly behind the man's head and darker towards the edges and top.

metadata.title: An Old Man with a Dog

alt_text: Ink wash painting of two figures riding water buffalo, with a calf and misty mountains.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical ink wash painting on aged, light brown paper. A decorative border of blue with gold floral patterns frames the top and bottom edges of the scroll. The upper half of the painting is largely empty, featuring only faint, misty gray forms suggesting distant mountains or clouds rendered with light ink washes. The mid-ground and foreground are dominated by three water buffalo and two small figures.
