In the lower left, a large, dark gray water buffalo is depicted in profile, appearing to step onto or over a dark, irregularly shaped mound of earth or rock. A small, hunched figure rides on its back. To the right, another large, dark gray water buffalo walks on a flatter surface, also in profile, with a similar small, hunched figure riding on its back. Behind this second buffalo, a smaller, lighter gray calf follows closely. The ground beneath the animals is rendered with subtle, light gray washes and faint lines, suggesting a sparse landscape. The overall color palette consists of the warm, light brown of the paper and various shades of gray and black ink.

metadata.title: 伝可翁筆　牧童図|Herdboys and Buffalos

alt_text: A standing figure with a halo, holding a staff and bowl, on a lotus, framed by patterned borders
long_description: This vertical artwork depicts a standing figure against a dark, plain background, framed by decorative borders. The central figure, rendered in light gold and brown tones, faces forward with a serene expression. Its head is surrounded by a faint, circular halo. The figure has an oval face with downcast eyes, a small mouth, and elongated earlobes. Dark hair is visible on the head. The figure is draped in flowing robes, primarily dark brown with intricate gold patterns forming geometric shapes and floral motifs. The robes are layered, revealing parts of the chest and arms. The figure's right hand holds a tall, slender staff adorned with an elaborate, multi-tiered finial at its top. The left hand is raised to chest height, palm upward, holding a small, dark, cup-like object. The figure's bare feet rest upon a large, stylized lotus flower, depicted in gold with visible petals. The main image panel is bordered on both vertical sides by wide strips featuring a repeating pattern of gold floral designs on a dark, possibly green or blue-black, background. Narrower, similarly patterned borders are also present at the very top and bottom edges of the artwork.

metadata.title: 地蔵菩薩|Jizō Bosatsu (Sanskrit: Ksitigharba)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A seated man in dark robes and a tall hat on a light background with vertical Japanese text
long_description: The artwork is a horizontal rectangular painting featuring a single figure on a light, aged background, with vertical script on the right. The entire composition is framed by a dark brown border with a subtle, repeating gold pattern. On the left side, a man is seated, facing towards the right, with his head turned upwards and to the right. He has light-toned skin, a small dark mustache, and a short dark beard. His dark hair is styled upwards into a tall, pointed, dark hat that extends slightly backwards. He wears a voluminous, dark, possibly black or very dark blue, robe that covers most of his body. A white garment with a subtle, light-colored pattern is visible underneath the dark robe, particularly around his knees. His left arm is bent, with his hand resting on his lap. A patterned, possibly circular or fan-shaped object with dark and light elements is partially visible behind his right side, near his hip. The background is a muted, light beige or cream color, showing signs of age with slight discoloration and texture variations. On the right side, several columns of dark, vertical script are present. From right to left, the main columns read: "下ノ方ノ大友ノ源伯ノ家子ノ先祖" "寛平六年六月叙従五位下天与二年記" "や候里も力もとてうし" "富家" "醍醐" "朱雀" "や候里も力もとてうし" Smaller, less distinct characters are also scattered among the main columns.

metadata.title: 源宗于　「藤房本　三十六歌仙絵巻」断簡|Minamoto no Muneyuki, from the “Fujifusa Version” of Thirty-six Poetic Immortals (Fujifusa-bon Sanjūrokkasen emaki)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A standing man in traditional attire with a beard and hat holds a flowering branch, with calligraphy in the upper right.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a standing man against a light tan background, framed by decorative borders. The man is positioned centrally, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has an oval-shaped face with light skin, narrow eyes, a long thin mustache, and a pointed beard. He wears a dark, rounded hat with a flat top. His attire consists of a long, flowing robe in a light tan color, outlined in black, with wide sleeves. A darker, cape-like garment covers his shoulders. The robe features decorative bands with intricate patterns along its front opening and bottom hem. His hands are clasped in front, mostly concealed by his sleeves. From his left sleeve, a thin branch with small white and pink blossoms and green leaves extends upwards. A small, rectangular pouch or bag with a tassel hangs from his left side. Dark shoes are visible beneath the hem of his robe. In the upper right section of the tan background, there are several vertical lines of black calligraphy. The text reads: "徑山容付枝", "不是清中柏", "何如社有青", "村尾無". The main painting is bordered on the left and right by wide, light brown panels adorned with repeating dark blue floral patterns, possibly plum blossoms, with lighter centers. A narrow blue patterned strip also separates the bottom of the painting from the lower border.

metadata.title: 等歳筆　渡唐天神|Tenjin Traveling to China
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a misty mountain landscape with tall trees, rocky peaks, and small structures.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting, predominantly rendered in shades of gray, black, and muted green, framed by decorative borders. The main painting is flanked on the left and right by wide, reddish-brown borders adorned with repeating gold floral patterns, primarily large peony blossoms. The top and bottom edges of the scroll feature narrower, dark green borders with intricate gold patterns. In the upper right quadrant of the painting, five vertical lines of black calligraphy are visible, reading from right to left: "白雲深處有仙家", "江上清風明月夜", "獨釣寒江雪", "玉壺冰心在", and "天涯共此時". A smaller, less distinct line of text and a red square seal are positioned below these lines. The background in this area is a light, hazy gray. The central and lower portions of the painting depict a vast, misty mountain landscape. Jagged, dark gray mountain peaks rise from a hazy mid-ground, with lighter, more distant peaks fading into the mist. Several prominent, gnarled pine trees with dense foliage are depicted on rocky ledges and slopes, particularly a large one in the mid-right. Other, more slender trees are scattered throughout the scene. A waterfall or stream appears to cascade down a central rock face. Small, dark-roofed structures, possibly temples or houses, are nestled among the trees and rocks, particularly in the lower-left and lower-right sections, with some appearing connected by small bridges over water. The foreground shows more detailed rocky terrain and water, with a sense of depth created by varying shades of gray and the suggestion of mist.

metadata.title: 天隠龍澤筆　山水図|Landscape
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Three vertical paintings depict birds, dragonflies, and various flowering plants on light brown backgrounds.
long_description: Three vertical paintings are displayed side-by-side, each featuring flora and fauna on a light brown background. Each painting is bordered by a dark blue band with small gold patterns, followed by a wider brown frame with a subtle textured pattern. The left panel shows a dragonfly with translucent wings hovering near the top. Below, large red and white peony-like flowers with green leaves and stems rise from the bottom. Thin green blades of grass extend upwards. At the bottom right, a small body of water contains a green lily pad and a small dark creature. The center panel features a small bird with light brown and white plumage flying downwards from the top. Below, a tall plant with rounded green leaves and small white flowers grows upwards. At the base of this plant, a cluster of orange-red flowers with thin green leaves is visible. The right panel depicts a gnarled, dark brown tree branch with delicate light pink blossoms extending across the upper and middle sections. Two small birds with reddish-brown and white markings perch on the branch. Behind the branch, green bamboo shoots rise from a small dark mound at the bottom.

metadata.title: 伝狩野元信筆　花鳥図|Birds and Flowers
metadata.medium: Set of three hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a bald man holding an insect on a string, with bare tree branches above.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single figure rendered in ink wash on a light brown paper. A bald man, depicted in profile facing right, sits in the lower half of the composition. He wears a loose, long-sleeved robe, with dark ink defining the folds and shadows. His left hand is raised, holding a thin string from which a small, detailed insect, possibly a cicada or cricket, hangs. The man's mouth is slightly open, and his gaze is directed upwards towards the insect. His right hand rests near his lap. Above and to the left of the man, a few bare, dark tree branches extend downwards from the upper left corner. The background is largely unadorned, a light brown expanse. The central painted area is framed by a patterned blue border with a repeating light-colored floral or geometric motif, and narrow gold borders at the very top and bottom.

metadata.title: 雲谷等顔筆　蜆子和尚図|Priest Xianzi

alt_text: Bold black calligraphy over a shimmering gold background with dark, abstract landscape shapes
long_description: The image displays a section of what appears to be a multi-panel artwork, dominated by bold black calligraphy against a shimmering gold background. The composition is divided by a thin vertical gold border, with the right panel being more fully visible. Large, flowing characters in black ink are written vertically and horizontally across the gold surface, varying in size and density. Beneath and around the calligraphy, the gold background is textured with darker, almost black, and lighter gold areas, suggesting abstract landscape forms. These forms include horizontal brushstrokes that resemble water or land, and subtle circular or wavy patterns. Small, irregular flecks of gold are scattered across the darker areas. In the upper right corner of the right panel, a small, light-colored rectangular label with fine black text is affixed vertically. The overall impression is one of rich texture and dynamic script over a luminous, subtly rendered landscape.

metadata.title: 後陽成天皇他筆　和歌色紙帖|Album of waka
metadata.medium: Album of twelve double leaves; ink on gold and silver decorated paper

alt_text: Six figures in traditional attire gathered on a mat, some interacting, with small boxes and a flask nearby
long_description: The image presents six figures in traditional attire, seated on a light brown, textured surface that occupies the central portion of the frame. This central area is bordered by decorative patterns: a gold and brown floral design on the left and right, and a gold and blue pattern along the top and bottom edges.Starting from the upper left, a figure with dark hair styled in a high bun wears a white robe with wide sleeves featuring red and black patterns, and a gold-colored collar. They are seated with their hands slightly raised, looking towards the center. To their right, a bare-chested figure with dark hair pulled back sits in a dark robe, with one leg bent and an arm resting on it. A dark hilt, possibly of a sword, is visible at their waist. This figure smiles, looking towards the right.In the lower left, a figure with dark hair, wearing a light blue-grey robe with gold accents, kneels and holds a dark, pear-shaped flask. They face towards the center. In the middle of the group, on the ground, are three small, rectangular, gold-colored boxes with red floral designs on their lids, arranged in a horizontal line. A small, red, mushroom-shaped object is also visible near the boxes.To the right of the boxes, two figures are positioned closely. One figure, with a dark beard and dark hair, wears a dark robe and leans towards another figure. This second figure, with dark hair in a bun, wears a striped yellow and black garment with red accents, and smiles broadly while looking at the bearded figure. A sixth figure, also in a dark robe, is partially visible behind the bearded figure. The figures are depicted with delicate lines and a palette of muted colors, with subtle gold detailing on their clothing and the boxes.

metadata.title: 遊楽図|People Partying
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Six-panel screen with gold ground, featuring rectangular inserts of landscapes and calligraphic text
long_description: This artwork is a six-panel screen, presented horizontally, with a predominantly gold background. The gold ground is textured with a speckled appearance and features undulating forms in darker gold and brown, suggesting clouds, mist, or distant mountains. Ten rectangular inserts are arranged across the six panels. These inserts vary in size and orientation, some being taller vertical rectangles and others wider horizontal ones. Five of the inserts depict detailed landscape scenes. These scenes feature elements such as green pine trees, small human figures, architectural structures like buildings with tiled roofs, and bridges over water. The colors in these landscape panels are muted, including greens, browns, and some light blues. For example, in the leftmost panel, a vertical insert shows a building with a fence and trees. In the second panel from the left, a vertical insert shows figures among trees and structures. The other five inserts are solid blocks of color, either a muted red or a muted green, and contain visible calligraphic text. The text is written in vertical columns. For instance, in the leftmost panel, a green rectangular insert with text is positioned above a landscape scene, and a red rectangular insert with text is to its right. This pattern of alternating landscape and text panels, often with a red or green background, continues across the screen, creating a dynamic interplay between abstract gold, detailed imagery, and written word.

metadata.title: 土佐派絵師  源氏物語図色紙貼交屏風|Tale of Genji Screen (Genji monogatari zu shikishi harimaze byōbu)
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: Multi-panel screen painting showing a large gathering with horse racing, spectators, and a winding river
long_description: The six-panel screen painting features a warm, light brown background, depicting a lively outdoor scene with numerous figures. The composition is broadly divided into three horizontal registers, with a prominent dark, winding river flowing vertically on the far left.In the upper left panel, a large brown tree with green foliage stands beside the dark river. Below the tree, several figures in colorful robes are gathered near the riverbank, some seated, some standing. A small, simple wooden bridge crosses the river further down. Moving right across the top register, elevated platforms and buildings are filled with many figures, mostly seated, observing the activities below. These spectators wear a variety of robes in colors such as white, green, red, and blue, with some seated under canopies.The middle register, below the elevated platforms, shows more figures on the ground. A long, horizontal wooden fence or barrier extends across the lower half of the middle register. Above this barrier, several figures are depicted on horseback, some holding spears or bows, with their horses in dynamic poses. Other figures are seated or standing on the ground, observing these equestrian activities.In the bottom register, below the horizontal barrier, a procession or race of horses and riders continues. The horses are adorned with colorful blankets and decorations, and their riders wear elaborate, multi-colored costumes. Scattered figures on foot, both seated and standing, are also present in this lower section, observing the horse-related events. Gold accents are visible on some clothing, horse decorations, and architectural details throughout the painting.

metadata.title: 賀茂競馬図屏風|Horse Race at the Kamo Shrine (Kamo kurabeuma zu)
metadata.medium: Six-panel folding screen; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A two-panel painting shows a snowy mountain landscape with a house, a boat on water, and a golden sky
long_description: The artwork is a two-panel painting depicting a serene winter landscape. The upper half of the composition is dominated by towering, snow-covered mountains rendered in shades of white and light gray, with dark outlines defining their contours. In the lower left panel, a traditional-style building with a dark, gabled roof and light-colored walls is nestled on a rocky, snow-covered shoreline. Dense, snow-laden trees and bushes with dark branches are clustered around the building, their forms suggesting a gentle wind. A small red seal mark is visible in the bottom left corner of this panel. The right panel features a wide expanse of calm, light gray water, likely a lake or bay, stretching across the lower and middle sections. A small, flat-bottomed boat with a covered cabin and a single figure at the stern, holding an oar, floats on the water. In the far distance, a range of smaller, snow-capped mountains extends across the horizon. A pale, circular light source, possibly a moon or a low sun, is visible between these distant peaks. The sky above the mountains and water is a warm, muted golden-yellow, providing a soft contrast to the cool tones of the snow and water. The overall impression is one of quiet solitude.

metadata.title: 狩野山雪筆　王子猷訪戴安道図|Wang Ziyou Visiting Dai Andao on a Snowy Evening (Ō Shiyū hō Tai Andō zu)
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink and gold on paper

alt_text: A person in a red robe reclines, reading a book, with calligraphic text above on a scroll.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll with a central light tan panel framed by decorative borders. The top and bottom borders are a muted blue with gold, swirling patterns. The side borders are a rich gold with a repeating geometric pattern of squares and circles. The central tan panel features black calligraphic script in the upper half, arranged in several vertical lines of varying lengths. Below the script, in the lower half of the panel, a person reclines on their left side, facing towards the right. The person wears a long, flowing red robe adorned with white and light blue geometric patterns, including squares and triangles. Their left arm is bent, with their elbow on the ground and their head resting on their left hand. Their hair is black, styled in a high bun on top of their head, and their face is pale with delicate features. In front of the reclining person, a small, open book with white pages lies flat on the tan surface. To the right of the person, a slender, black stand with a circular base holds a small, light-colored object at its top.

metadata.title: 遊女藻塩読書図|The Courtesan Moshio Reading a Book
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two figures in kimonos holding fans, framed by checkered and patterned borders on a gold background.
long_description:
This artwork features two panels, each depicting a standing figure on a gold background, framed by decorative borders. The overall background of both panels is a shimmering gold, with subtle horizontal lines and variations in tone. Each figure is positioned centrally within its respective panel.

The left panel shows a figure with long, dark hair, wearing a kimono with wide sleeves. The kimono is patterned with horizontal stripes in shades of light blue, green, pink, and brown. The figure holds a white fan with a gold design in their right hand, extended slightly to the side. Their body is angled slightly to the right.

The right panel shows a second figure, also with long, dark hair, wearing a white kimono adorned with a vibrant pattern of colorful flowers and geometric shapes in green, red, blue, and gold. This figure holds a white fan with a gold design in their left hand, raised above their head. Their body is angled slightly to the left.

Both figures are enclosed by an inner border featuring a checkerboard pattern of alternating dark gray and gold squares. This checkerboard border is then surrounded by a wider, outer border that is gold with an intricate, subtle pattern of leaves and flowers in a slightly darker gold or brown hue.

metadata.title: 舞伎図屏風|Screen of Two Dancers (Bugi zu byōbu)
metadata.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink, color, and gold on paper

alt_text: A white egret with outstretched wings descends towards its reflection in water, surrounded by reeds.
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a white egret in flight over water, set against a light golden-tan background. The egret, positioned in the upper half of the central panel, is depicted with its wings spread wide, as if in the process of landing or taking off. Its body is angled downwards, and its long neck is curved, with its beak pointing towards the water below. Its long, slender legs are bent, with its feet tucked beneath its body. The bird's plumage is rendered in shades of white and light gray, with delicate brushstrokes suggesting individual feathers. Below the egret, in the lower half of the central panel, a faint, ghostly reflection of the bird is visible in the pale, slightly darker tan area representing water. The reflection shows the bird's body, wings, and legs, mirroring its pose above. To the right of the reflection, a cluster of tall, thin, dark green reeds rises from the water, with a few smaller, lighter green plants at their base. The central golden-tan panel is framed by two decorative fabric borders. The inner border, at the top and bottom, is a narrow strip of gold-colored fabric with a subtle, repeating floral or geometric pattern. The outer borders, running vertically along the left and right sides, are wider strips of teal-blue fabric. This teal fabric features a pattern of stylized white waves and small, gold-colored fish or scales. In the bottom right corner of the central panel, there is a vertical column of dark calligraphic text, followed by a red square seal.

metadata.title: 土佐光起筆　鷺図|Heron
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A dark-skinned figure in ornate robes and a crown stands amidst swirling waves and clouds
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a central standing figure against a dynamic background of waves and clouds. The artwork is framed by decorative borders: a light green fabric with a subtle floral pattern on the left and right sides, and narrower brown strips with a geometric or floral motif at the top and bottom. The central figure has dark skin and stands facing forward, slightly angled to the viewer's right. The figure wears an elaborate, multi-layered robe in shades of red, gold, blue, and white, with flowing sleeves and sashes. A golden crown with red and blue accents adorns the figure's head. In the figure's right hand, held near the chest, is a small, dark, three-lobed object resting on a golden dish. Behind and around the figure, the background is filled with swirling patterns. Above the figure's waist, the background consists of light brown and white waves with golden highlights, creating a sense of movement. Below the figure's waist, dark brown, rounded cloud-like forms provide a base. The overall color palette is rich, with dominant earthy tones of brown and gold, complemented by the vibrant reds, blues, and whites of the figure's attire and the green of the side borders.

metadata.title: 龍王図|Dragon King
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A man, a monkey, and a performer in a patterned suit interact on a gold background with scattered white dots
long_description: The artwork depicts a lively scene with three figures on a large, light gold, kidney-bean-shaped panel, which is set against a darker gold background adorned with scattered white and gold flecks. On the left side of the central panel, a bald man with a light green robe sits on the ground, facing right. He has a light brown jug next to him and holds a thin, dark rope that extends towards the monkey. His mouth is open in a smile, revealing teeth. A dark-handled sword with a light scabbard lies on the ground near his left knee. Below and slightly in front of the man, another figure in a light blue and white striped garment lies on the ground, partially obscured, with a dark-handled sword nearby. In the center of the panel, a brown monkey stands on its hind legs, facing right, with its arms raised. It holds a small, reddish, spherical object in its hands. The thin rope from the man is around its neck. To the right of the monkey, a figure in a blue and white patterned suit with a ruffled white collar and a dark hat is depicted mid-jump, facing left. This figure holds a large, striped, red and black paddle-like object above its head, poised as if to strike. The suit features a repeating pattern of small white shapes on a blue background. The background outside the central panel is a darker gold, with a dense pattern of small white and gold dots resembling scattered blossoms or flecks, creating a shimmering effect.

metadata.title: 狩野常信筆　人物花鳥団扇画帖|Album of Fan-Shaped Paintings of Figures, Birds and Flowers
metadata.medium: Album of twelve double leaves; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Gold-leaf screen with calligraphic text on cream panels, one featuring a flowering pink plum branch.
long_description: The artwork presents a multi-panel composition against a textured gold-leaf background. The gold surface exhibits a slightly mottled or aged appearance, with variations in its reflective quality. Three distinct rectangular sections, or panels, are visible, each featuring a light cream or beige ground.On the far left, a partial vertical panel is visible, containing several columns of black calligraphic text. A subtle decorative border, composed of a repeating wave-like or cloud-like pattern in a lighter tone, runs along the top edge of this panel.Immediately to its right, a full vertical panel is depicted. This panel showcases a flowering branch, rendered in shades of brown and black, which extends diagonally from the lower right towards the upper left. The branch is adorned with numerous pink blossoms, ranging from small buds to fully open flowers, each with a darker pink center. Black calligraphic text is written vertically on this panel, primarily positioned to the right of the flowering branch, with some characters appearing to intertwine with the branch itself.Further to the right, a horizontal rectangular panel is situated in the lower-middle portion of the gold background. This panel also contains multiple columns of black calligraphic text. A decorative border, similar in style to the one on the far left panel, runs along its top edge. The gold background continues to the right of this horizontal panel, filling the remainder of the frame. The overall composition combines delicate script and natural imagery against a rich, shimmering backdrop.

metadata.title: 定家十体画帖|Teika’s Ten Styles of Japanese Poetry
metadata.medium: Album of ten leaves; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A folding fan with white chrysanthemums and green leaves on a gold background, with black text.
long_description: The image displays an open folding fan, presented against a plain gray background. The fan's surface is predominantly gold, with a detailed design of white chrysanthemums and green leaves. Approximately eight large, round white chrysanthemum blossoms are depicted, each with a small yellow or light green center. Their petals are rendered with fine black outlines, creating a sense of texture and depth. Interspersed among the flowers are several dark green, deeply lobed leaves with visible veins, providing a contrast to the white and gold. The floral arrangement covers the left and central portions of the fan's upper surface. The right side of the fan's gold surface is largely clear, featuring a vertical column of black calligraphic text, followed by a small, rectangular red seal impression below it. The lower part of the fan reveals its structural elements: a series of light brown wooden ribs fanning out from a central pivot point. A small, carved wooden piece, possibly a guard, is visible at the very bottom center where the ribs converge.

metadata.title: 菊図|Chrysanthemum
metadata.medium: Fan; ink and color on gold-leafed paper

alt_text: Two vertical ink paintings depict cranes: one standing with an open beak, the other bending near bamboo.
long_description:
Two vertical scroll paintings, rendered in ink wash on light brown paper, are displayed side-by-side. The artwork features two cranes in a natural setting.

The left scroll shows a tall crane standing prominently on a grassy bank in the foreground, facing slightly left. Its long neck is extended upwards, and its beak is open, suggesting a call. The crane's body is primarily white with dark, possibly black, feathers on its wingtips and legs. Its long, slender legs end in splayed feet. Behind the crane, a body of water stretches horizontally, with a faint, lighter horizon line. Sparse, dark, pointed vegetation, resembling distant pine trees, appears on the far bank. The lower left corner contains red seals and faint, dark script.

The right scroll depicts another crane, partially obscured by a large, dark bamboo stalk that dominates the right side of the scroll. This crane is positioned to the left of the bamboo, with its head bent downwards, appearing to preen or forage. Its body is also white with dark markings. The bamboo stalk is thick and segmented, with several slender branches bearing dark, pointed leaves extending to the left. A faint red circular mark is visible near the top right, adjacent to the bamboo. Grassy banks and faint vegetation are also present in the background, similar to the left scroll. Red seals are visible in the upper right corner.

metadata.title: 鶴図|Cranes
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: A landscape painting depicts misty mountains, a waterfall, trees, and a small house, framed by decorative borders
long_description: This horizontal landscape painting is framed by a dark blue border featuring gold patterns, and an inner gold border with lighter, intricate designs. The artwork itself is rendered on a light tan ground. The composition is dominated by a large, dark gray mountain range on the right, characterized by steep, textured slopes. A narrow, light-colored waterfall descends vertically through the center of this range, disappearing into a misty valley below. Smaller, darker peaks are visible behind the primary mountain. In the middle ground, a wide expanse of mist separates the foreground from the distant elements. Several trees with dark green foliage and light brown trunks are scattered across gently rolling hills in the foreground. On the far left, a small, light-colored building with a dark roof is nestled among these trees on a low slope. In the distance, on the left, faint, blue-gray mountain peaks emerge from the mist, creating a sense of depth. The color palette is muted, featuring shades of gray, green, and light brown against the pale background. In the upper right quadrant, there is visible black text arranged in a vertical column, accompanied by a red seal.

metadata.title: 与謝蕪村筆　浅絳山水図|Landscape in Light Colors
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on silk

alt_text: A brown rabbit sits near a large rock and flowering plants on a vertical scroll painting
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a light brown background with gold patterned borders on the left and right sides. In the upper left quadrant, several lines of black calligraphic text are visible. Below the main text, a smaller block of text and a red square seal are present. The transcribed text reads: "高情逸格迥時輩 清氣孤標出世塵 百合花開 國畫庚辰春日作". A large, dark rock formation dominates the right side of the painting, extending from the middle to the lower right. Its surface is textured with shades of brown, gray, and black. From behind and above the rock, branches with green leaves and numerous flowers extend towards the upper left. The flowers are a mix of pink and white, some fully open with multiple petals, others appearing as buds. In the lower center, a light brown rabbit with distinct white spots on its back sits on sparse green grass and small green plants. The rabbit faces slightly towards the right and looks upwards, its ears erect. The ground around the rabbit and rock is a lighter shade of brown, suggesting a gentle slope.

metadata.title: 森蘭斎筆  慈雲飲光賛  薔薇に兎図|Rabbit and Roses
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll with a bird flying before a full moon, surrounded by extensive calligraphy
long_description: A vertical scroll features a pale blue-cream background bordered by a dark blue fabric with a repeating pattern of gold and light blue geometric shapes. The upper section of the scroll is dominated by black ink calligraphy, arranged in vertical lines of varying lengths and densities, extending down both the left and right sides of the central image area. In the lower-middle right, a large, pale, circular full moon is depicted. Below and slightly to the left of the moon, a dark-feathered bird with outstretched wings is shown in flight, its head angled downwards and to the left. The bird's body is detailed with lighter markings. In the lower right corner, a small, square red seal is visible. The top and bottom edges of the scroll have narrow bands of light blue fabric with gold cloud-like patterns.

metadata.title: 窪俊満筆　大田南畝賛　石川雅望賛　浅草庵市人賛　四方真顔賛　時鳥図|Hototogisu
metadata.artist: Yomo Magao|Rokujuen 六樹園|Kubo Shunman|Asakusaan Ichindo|Ōta Nanpo
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two long-tailed birds perch on a flowering branch with white blossoms and red flowers on a golden background
long_description: A vertical painting depicts two birds perched on a flowering branch against a plain, light golden-brown background. A thick, gnarled dark brown branch extends diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right, with smaller twigs branching off. Numerous small, white, five-petaled blossoms with yellow centers are scattered along the upper and lower sections of the branch. In the middle-left, clusters of large, red, multi-petaled flowers with dark green leaves are visible. The upper bird, positioned in the middle-left, faces right with its head turned upwards. It has a long, slender, blue-grey tail, a reddish-brown back, a white belly, and a distinct white stripe above its eye, extending to a red beak. Its legs are reddish. Below and slightly to the left of the upper bird, a second, smaller bird perches on a lower part of the branch, facing upwards. This bird is predominantly brown with a lighter underside and a small, pointed crest on its head. Vertical black text and two red square seals are present on the left side of the background, above and to the left of the upper bird. The central painted area is framed by a narrow, dark brown patterned border, which is then surrounded by a wider, light tan border with a subtle floral pattern.

metadata.title: 岸駒筆　梅花小禽図|Birds on a PlumTree
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows a mountainous landscape with a waterfall and several figures gathered in a clearing.
long_description:
A vertical scroll painting depicts a lush, mountainous landscape with human figures. The upper portion features tall, rounded mountains covered in shades of green foliage, with lighter, misty areas suggesting clouds or distance. A prominent white waterfall cascades down from the upper right, flowing into the middle ground. Numerous dark green trees, including tall pines, are scattered across the mountainsides and valleys.

The middle section of the painting reveals a clearing where several figures are gathered. In the center, a bearded figure in light robes is seated on the ground, playing a stringed instrument. Opposite them, another figure in light robes sits, facing the musician. To their right, a third figure is seated near a low, dark table, appearing to serve from a bowl. Further up and to the right, a fourth figure is seated near another small table. The clearing is surrounded by various trees and dense green foliage, including a large, gnarled tree trunk on the left.

The lower part of the painting continues the landscape with more trees and a winding path. A small, solitary figure in light robes walks on this path towards the right side of the composition. The overall color palette is dominated by greens, light browns, and tans, with white accents for the waterfall and figures' clothing. In the upper right corner, there is a column of black text, and in the lower left, a small red square seal is visible.

metadata.title: 大倉笠山筆　高山流水・愈伯牙鐘子期図|High Mountains, Flowing Water: Yu Boya and Zhong Ziqi
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A traditional painting depicts numerous figures engaged in various activities within a lush landscape featuring flowering trees, large rocks, and bridges under a full moon
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts a vibrant outdoor scene with numerous figures set within a detailed landscape. The sky, a pale yellow-beige, occupies the upper portion, featuring a single white full moon in the upper right quadrant. Below the moon, a large, dark, craggy mountain with blue-green accents dominates the right side of the composition. On the far upper left, a large, gnarled tree with dark branches and white blossoms frames the scene. Throughout the mid-ground and foreground, many smaller trees with white and light pink blossoms are scattered, creating a sense of spring or early summer. Numerous figures, predominantly men and boys, are depicted in various activities. They wear traditional robes in colors such as white, light blue, red, and brown. Some figures are seated in groups, conversing or reading, while others stand, walk, or engage in playful interactions. Several individuals hold objects like fans or scrolls. The landscape features prominent, dark, textured rocks with blue-green and brown tones. Multiple wooden bridges with railings span across lower ground or water, connecting different sections of the tiered landscape. Stone walls are visible in the lower left and mid-ground. The ground itself is a light brown or tan color, with hints of green. The overall composition is bustling, with groups of people clustered under trees and near rocks, creating a lively and dynamic scene. Red text is visible in the upper right corner of the painting.

metadata.title: 中林竹洞筆 「芳園酔月」図|Fragrant Garden under a Hazy Moon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a vast mountainous landscape with a waterfall, a body of water, and a small boat with figures
long_description: A vertical scroll painting, primarily in muted tones of grey, brown, and light blue, with some green and red accents, depicts a dramatic mountainous landscape. The upper portion features a pale, light brown sky with a faint, circular, lighter area, possibly a moon or sun, slightly to the left of center. Below this, towering, jagged mountains rise, their peaks disappearing into the upper mist. The mountains are rendered in shades of grey and light brown, with soft, undulating lines suggesting their forms. In the middle ground, a large, sheer cliff face dominates the left side, with a thin waterfall cascading down its face into a body of water below. To the right of this, a series of smaller, tree-covered mountains slope down towards the water. These mountains are dotted with dark green pine trees and bare, lighter-colored trees. A winding path is visible on the rightmost mountain, leading to a small cluster of buildings or structures near the top, where a few small figures in red and brown garments can be seen. Wisps of mist or clouds are visible between the mountain peaks. The lower third of the painting depicts a turbulent body of water, rendered in shades of light blue and grey, with white foam indicating waves and currents. Several large, dark rocks emerge from the water near the foreground. A small, light-colored boat with a pointed bow and stern is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, navigating the choppy waters. Two figures are in the boat: one standing at the stern, holding a long pole, and another seated in the middle, wearing a light-colored, possibly white, hat or head covering. On the far right, a rocky shoreline with more pine trees extends into the water. A vertical inscription in dark characters is visible on the lower right side of the painting.

metadata.title: 長澤蘆州筆　月下遊舟図|Boat under the Moon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows a lush mountainous landscape with traditional buildings, a waterfall, and figures on a bridge
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a vibrant, detailed mountainous landscape. The upper section features towering, verdant green mountains, some shrouded in mist, with distant peaks fading into the background. In the upper left, vertical lines of black calligraphy read: "戊子春日寫於西湖之南山草堂 王山人國賓先生屬 八十八叟下一下愚". Below this text are two red seals. A small red circle, possibly a sun, is visible between two mountain peaks. Nestled within the upper mountains are small, traditional buildings with red roofs, surrounded by pine trees and flowering trees with pink blossoms. A waterfall cascades down from the middle of the mountains, flowing into the lower sections. The central part of the painting showcases a larger complex of traditional buildings, characterized by green roofs and teal-colored accents. Figures are visible inside one of these structures. Large, dark green pine trees are prominent, framing the buildings and contributing to the dense foliage. Wisps of mist or clouds drift through this area, partially obscuring the landscape. Small white birds are depicted flying in the sky above the central buildings. The lower section reveals a body of water, possibly a river or lake. A red arched bridge spans the water, with two figures crossing it. A large weeping willow tree with bare branches stands prominently near the water's edge, alongside other deciduous trees, some showing pink blossoms. On the right bank, a winding path leads into the distance, and several small, deer-like animals are seen grazing. Additional smaller buildings are scattered near the water. The bottom right corner contains two more red seals. The entire scene is framed by a blue border with a repeating pattern.

metadata.title: 田能村直入  蓬莱春旭図|Spring Sunrise at Hōrai
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on satin

alt_text: A vertical painting depicting figures in a room with elaborate furniture and many decorative objects
long_description: The vertical painting features a light, off-white background, with the upper half largely empty except for a column of dark vertical text on the left side. The lower half of the composition depicts an elaborate interior scene with multiple figures, furniture, and decorative objects.On the far right, a tall, dark-wood shelving unit rises, featuring multiple open tiers filled with numerous small items. These include various vases, stacked books, small sculptures, and other decorative pieces, many in shades of green, blue, and red.Towards the center-right, several figures are arranged around a low, dark-wood table. One prominent figure, possibly a man, stands with a long beard and wears a brown robe, looking towards a group of figures. Three other figures, likely women, wear long, flowing robes in white, blue, and red patterns, with elaborate hairstyles. One woman holds a small, red-lidded container, while another gestures.On the lower left, a dark-wood table displays several potted bonsai trees and various small vases and dishes. To the right of this table, another figure, dressed in a patterned robe, holds a large, round, blue and white patterned object, possibly a lantern or a decorative orb, with tassels hanging below.In the bottom right corner, another column of dark vertical text is visible, accompanied by a small, square red seal impression. The text on the left reads: "山陽高士舊藏丁亥冬日寫於京華大風堂門人張大千爰". The text on the bottom right reads: "丁亥冬日寫於京華大風堂門人張大千爰". The overall scene is richly detailed with a focus on intricate objects and traditional attire.

metadata.title: 鈴木松年筆　蘇東坡先生捧腹図|Su Dongpo Laughing
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ancient painting depicts a large pair of human feet adorned with numerous seated and standing figures.
long_description: A painting on a light brown, aged surface, framed by a slightly darker border, depicts a large pair of human feet. The feet are shown from the soles, with the toes pointing upwards, rendered in light brown with darker outlines. Intricate circular patterns, resembling mandalas or stylized flowers, are visible on the heels and balls of the feet. Numerous smaller figures are arranged around and within the feet, mostly seated in meditative poses within arched, red-outlined frames. Above the toes, six seated figures are arranged in two rows of three. These figures have light skin, dark hair, and wear orange or white robes. Between the big toes, a taller, standing figure with multiple heads and arms is depicted, wearing white and green robes, standing on a lotus base. Along the outer edges of the feet, more seated figures are arranged vertically. On the left side, below the top row, are two seated figures, one in white robes and one in orange, followed by a larger, robust figure in orange, kneeling with clasped hands. On the right side, three seated figures are visible, one in orange, one in green, and one in white. Below the feet, three main figures are depicted: a central seated figure in orange and white, a seated figure in white robes with long hair to its left, and another seated figure in white robes to its right. Between the central and rightmost bottom figures, a smaller, green-skinned, muscular figure with a weapon is shown in a dynamic pose. The overall color palette includes muted reds, oranges, greens, whites, and browns, with black outlines defining the forms.

alt_text: A woman kneels to breastfeed a chained, elderly man in a dark, dramatic painting
long_description: A dark, dramatic painting depicts two figures in a dimly lit space. On the left, a woman kneels, facing right. She has pale skin, a bare chest, and her head is wrapped in a reddish-brown turban. Her left breast is exposed, and she leans forward, looking down towards the man. A draped olive-green and patterned fabric covers her lower body and left arm. To her right, an elderly man sits on the ground, facing left. He is bare-chested, with a long white beard and thinning grey hair. His wrists are bound by dark chains, and a red cloth is draped over his lap and legs. He leans back slightly, looking up towards the woman's breast. The background is almost entirely dark, with faint, indistinct shapes visible in the upper right corner, suggesting a cavern or cell. Strong chiaroscuro lighting highlights the figures' skin and the folds of their drapery against the deep shadows.

alt_text: A long horizontal painting depicts a procession of people, some riding horses, others walking and carrying items
long_description: The painting depicts a long, horizontal procession of numerous figures moving from left to right across a plain, light tan background. The figures are concentrated in the lower half of the frame, with the upper half largely empty. The procession includes both people on foot and individuals riding horses. On the far left, several men in blue and brown garments walk, some carrying long poles topped with white or green finials. One man rides a light-colored horse. Moving right, a man on a dark horse is followed by a group of men carrying a covered, rectangular palanquin. More men walk alongside, some with swords at their waists, others carrying bundles or boxes. In the central section, a man with a wide-brimmed hat carries a long pole with a large, green, curved blade-like weapon. Another group of men carries a second palanquin. Several individuals ride horses, including a woman in a vibrant red robe and an elaborate hairstyle, and another woman in a blue robe. Attendants in various colored garments, including black, blue, and orange, walk beside the horses. Some carry long poles with red finials. Towards the right, the procession continues with more men on foot, some with swords, and others carrying items. Another man rides a light-colored horse. The clothing throughout the procession features a variety of colors such as blue, green, orange, red, black, and brown, contrasting with the light background. The horses are depicted in shades of light brown, dark brown, and grey.

metadata.title: 菱川派 「参勤交代図」|Daimyo Procession to Edo
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: Full-length portrait of a person in elaborate dark blue attire, holding a dagger, with a vase of flowers and a hookah
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a person standing centrally, facing forward with a direct gaze. The individual has dark hair, prominent dark eyebrows, and light skin. They wear a tall, black, conical hat and a dark blue long-sleeved coat with a wide white collar. The coat is richly trimmed with a floral pattern in white, gold, and red along the edges and down the front. A wide red sash is tied around the waist, from which a dagger with an ornate hilt hangs. The hands are clasped at the waist, holding the dagger's hilt. The long coat extends to the floor, revealing white patterned slippers. To the left of the figure, a white vase with delicate floral patterns holds a vibrant bouquet of pink, white, blue, and orange flowers. To the right, an ornate silver hookah with intricate designs stands on a small yellow table, featuring a long red hose that extends to the floor. The background consists of a light blue wall, topped by a red draped fabric with a gold patterned border. The floor is covered by a patterned rug in shades of red and brown.

metadata.title: Portrait of a Prince (Possibly Mohammad Mirza)

alt_text: A seated figure with reddish skin, wearing a crown and patterned robes, against a golden halo and rainbow arch.
long_description: A painting depicts a seated figure with reddish-orange skin, positioned centrally. The figure wears a golden crown, multiple necklaces, and bracelets on both wrists and upper arms. A patterned garment, featuring red, blue, and white circular motifs on a dark background, covers the torso and legs. The figure's right hand is raised with fingers together, palm facing left, while the left hand rests on the lap. Behind the figure's head and upper body is a large, cracked golden oval, surrounded by a rainbow-colored arch with bands of red, orange, yellow, green, and blue. The background to the left and above the rainbow is dark blue. The top right corner of the painting is torn, revealing a plain, light-colored surface beneath. The figure sits on a rectangular green cushion or mat with dark vertical stripes. A thick red border frames the entire painting, which shows signs of age with cracks and some paint loss.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fragment; colors and black ink on paper

alt_text: A fragment of an illuminated manuscript page featuring a seated figure surrounded by black text.
long_description: The artwork is a fragment of an illuminated manuscript page, roughly rectangular with irregular, torn edges, set against a plain background. The page is light brown with visible creases and wear. Centered on the page is a small, rectangular illustration framed by a red border. Inside this frame, a figure with light orange skin sits in a meditative pose on a multi-layered lotus throne. The figure wears a golden crown, earrings, and necklaces, and is adorned with patterned garments in red, green, and gold. A golden halo encircles the figure's head, and a larger, multi-colored rainbow aura surrounds the entire body, set against a dark blue background. The figure's right hand is raised in a gesture, while the left hand rests in the lap. Surrounding the central illustration, black script in multiple lines covers the page, arranged in columns to the left, right, and above the image. A small line of red script is visible below the right side of the illustration. The text is dense and fills most of the available space on the page.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fragment; colors and black ink on paper

alt_text: An aged manuscript page with black text and a colorful seated figure in an oval illustration.
long_description: A rectangular manuscript page, light brown in color with an irregular, torn edge on the right side, is presented horizontally. The majority of the page is covered with lines of black script, likely in a South Asian or Tibetan language, arranged in horizontal lines. Some red marks are visible in the left margin. Approximately two-thirds of the way down the page, a faint, empty circular outline is present within the text block. At the bottom of the page, a solid black rectangular block of text is visible. On the right side of the page, a vibrant, colorful illustration is set within an oval frame with a deep blue background. The illustration depicts a light-skinned, multi-armed figure seated in a meditative pose on a red lotus base. The figure wears a golden crown, elaborate gold and red garments, and various pieces of jewelry. A golden halo or aura surrounds the figure's head and upper body. The figure holds a golden bowl in one of its right hands and a white, flower-like object in one of its left hands. Other hands are also visible, holding additional objects or making gestures. The details of the figure's face, including eyes, nose, and mouth, are clearly depicted.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fragment; colors and black ink on paper

alt_text: Green-skinned figure in red robe seated in meditation, surrounded by a rainbow aura, on a page with text
long_description: The image features a rectangular illustration centered on a light beige, aged paper with black script. The illustration depicts a green-skinned figure seated in a meditative posture, with legs crossed and hands in a gesture. The figure wears a red robe with gold outlines, draped over the left shoulder and around the lower body. The right hand is raised to chest level, palm facing outward with fingers extended, while the left hand rests in the lap. A small gold halo encircles the figure's head, and a larger, light blue aura surrounds the body. This blue aura is framed by a vibrant, multi-colored arch resembling a rainbow, with concentric bands of red, orange, yellow, and green, each outlined in gold. The figure sits on a stylized lotus pedestal, rendered in red, gold, and white. The background within the illustration's red border is a solid deep blue. Black script in a non-Latin alphabet, possibly Tibetan, surrounds the illustration on the paper. Visible text includes "༄༅། །བདེ་བར་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་" above the top left corner, "། །དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་" above the top right, "གཤེགས་པའི་" to the bottom left, and "། །དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་" to the bottom right.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Fragment; colors and black ink on paper

alt_text: Crowned woman holding a child on a throne within an ornate architectural setting
long_description: The image depicts a crowned woman holding a child, seated on a throne, within an elaborate architectural structure. The woman, positioned centrally, wears a dark olive-green robe over a blue garment with gold trim, and a white veil. A gold crown with red and blue jewels sits on her head, and a light blue halo encircles her head. Her skin is a muted olive tone. She holds a child, also with olive-toned skin, dressed in a pink tunic, on her left lap. The child has a gold halo and looks slightly to the left. The woman's gaze is directed downwards and to her right. They are seated on a white and pink throne with small red and blue columns. Behind them, a rich red fabric with gold floral patterns hangs, draped over the top of the throne. This fabric is bordered by a multi-colored fringe. The throne is set within a complex, golden architectural structure that fills the background. On the left, the structure features arched openings, small columns, and geometric patterns. On the right, a tall, narrow window with a grid-like pattern is visible. The overall color palette is dominated by gold, red, olive-green, and blue, with accents of pink and white. The painting has a slightly aged appearance with visible cracks in the paint.

alt_text: A painting of a calm, reflective body of water surrounded by dense, dark green and brown vegetation
long_description: A horizontal oil painting depicts a tranquil, shaded natural scene. A body of water, possibly a pond or slow-moving stream, occupies the left two-thirds of the canvas. Its surface is mostly calm, reflecting muted light and the surrounding foliage, appearing in shades of light blue, grey, and dark brown. The reflections are elongated and slightly blurred. Along the lower left edge and extending into the water, a cluster of green leafy plants with small, light-colored berries or flowers grows. A tall, slender stalk with a spike of small, pale blossoms or seed heads rises vertically from the lower left, partially obscuring the water. The right side of the painting is densely packed with various types of vegetation. Dark green and brown leaves, tall grasses, and plants with reddish-brown seed heads or flowers create a thick border along the water's edge and extend into the background. A large, broad-leafed plant with prominent veins is visible in the lower right foreground. The colors are predominantly deep greens, earthy browns, and some muted reddish tones, suggesting a rich, overgrown environment. The overall lighting is soft and diffused.

metadata.title: Study of Water and Plants
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on wood

alt_text: An oil painting shows a deep mountain valley with steep, rocky slopes and multiple white waterfalls under a cloudy sky
long_description: A horizontal oil painting depicts a rugged mountain valley under a cloudy sky. The composition is dominated by steep, rocky slopes rendered in earthy tones of brown, grey, and dark green, framing a central, receding valley. On the left, a large, imposing mountain face features a prominent, wide waterfall cascading down its center, appearing as a bright white streak against the dark rock. Below this main waterfall, a smaller, narrower stream of water flows further down the slope. The right side of the painting presents similarly rugged mountains, from which multiple thin, ribbon-like waterfalls descend, appearing as faint white lines against the darker, vegetated rock. The central part of the valley, between the main mountain faces, is a mix of shadowed rock and patches of green, suggesting a deep, winding terrain. Another significant waterfall is visible in the lower-center, flowing down a dark, steep incline. The immediate foreground is dark and indistinct, primarily composed of dark brown and green brushstrokes, indicating the base of the mountains or a shadowed valley floor. The sky at the top is light blue with soft, white and grey clouds. Visible in faint white script in the lower right corner are the characters '22 July 1835 F'.

metadata.title: Gudvangen
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on wood

alt_text: A man with a pipe works with string while a woman watches in a rustic room.
long_description: The painting depicts an interior scene with two figures. In the foreground, a man sits on a simple wooden chair, facing slightly left and looking down at his hands. He wears a dark brown, shaggy fur hat, a light blue and white striped long-sleeved shirt, a dark brown vest, and dark trousers. A light-colored pipe is held in his mouth. His hands are actively engaged with a light-colored string or rope, possibly knotting or winding it. He wears dark socks and dark wooden clogs. To his left, a reddish-brown wooden table or workbench holds a winding device with more string. Behind the man and slightly to his left, a woman stands, looking directly forward with a neutral expression. She wears a light blue jacket, a reddish-orange patterned skirt, and a white head covering. Her hands are clasped in front of her. The wall behind them is light-colored and textured. On the upper left wall, a dark wooden clock with a white face hangs. Below it, several small, rectangular images, possibly prints of animals, are tacked to the wall. To the right of these, a framed painting of a sailboat on water is visible. The right side of the room features a reddish-brown wall section or doorframe, with a dark blue curtain hanging. The floor is made of light brown wooden planks.

alt_text: Four figures in traditional attire in a snowy garden and building, with a pond and ducks.
long_description: This horizontal artwork depicts a winter scene with figures in traditional attire, divided into an outdoor garden on the left and a building interior on the right. The ground and tree branches in the garden are covered in white snow. In the left half, three women are positioned outdoors. The leftmost woman wears a red outer robe with gold patterns over white layers, standing and facing right. The central woman, kneeling or sitting, wears a light blue outer robe over white layers with red trim, facing right and appearing to interact with the leftmost woman. The third woman, on the right of this group, wears a yellow-gold patterned outer robe over white layers, standing and facing left towards the other two. Behind them are snow-covered pine trees and a pond with two ducks, one brown and one white with brown markings, swimming near snow-covered islands. A low, patterned wall, also dusted with snow, runs across the foreground. The right half of the artwork shows a building interior with wooden railings and latticework screens. A man sits on the floor, wearing a red robe with white inner layers and a black hat. He holds a black stringed instrument, possibly a biwa. Behind him is a decorative screen with a yellow background and red floral patterns. The overall color palette includes muted browns and greens for the landscape, contrasted with vibrant reds, blues, and yellows for the clothing. Black calligraphic text is present on the far left and far right edges of the artwork.

metadata.title: 龍女書　源氏物語絵巻|Illustrated Handscrolls of The Tale of Genji
metadata.medium: Five handscrolls; ink and color on paper (illustrations); ink on paper (texts)

alt_text: A central bearded man in a green robe and turban, surrounded by ten other men and two children, seated in an arched room.
long_description: A painting depicts a group of eleven men and two children seated on a golden patterned rug within an architectural setting. A large man with a dark beard, green turban, and green robe sits centrally, facing forward, with a light halo around his head. He holds a small child in a green robe on his left and another small child in a light pink robe on his right, both with small halos. To the central figure's left, three men are seated: one in a blue robe, one with a white beard in a light gray robe, and one in a brown robe, all wearing white turbans. To his right, three men are seated: one in a brown robe with a halo, one in a dark teal robe, and one in a light gray robe, all wearing white turbans. In the foreground, three men are seated with their backs to the viewer: one in a brown robe, one in a white robe, and one in a light gray robe, all with white turbans. The background features a light-colored architectural structure with multiple arched niches and columns. Faint script is visible within the arches and on the rug. Visible text includes: "نور چشم حضرت آدم", "نور چشم حضرت نوح", "نور چشم حضرت ابراهیم", "نور چشم حضرت موسی", "نور چشم حضرت عیسی", "علی بن ابی طالب", "حسن", "حسین", "زین العابدین", "محمد باقر", "جعفر صادق", and "موسی کاظم".

metadata.title: People of the Prophet's House with Companions

alt_text: Three vertical scrolls with calligraphic text and central paintings of figures, flowers, and a stylized object.
long_description:
Three vertical scroll paintings are displayed side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a light beige background with black calligraphic text at the top and bottom, framing a central painted section. The central sections depict various elements, often connected by a white, upward-tapering cloud or vaporous shape.

The leftmost scroll shows a small figure in red and white robes floating in the upper part of the white cloud. Below, at the base of the cloud, is a boat-like object filled with white flowers and green pods.

The middle scroll features faint horizontal lines in its upper central section, suggesting a distant landscape or clouds. Below, a white, serpentine object, resembling a swan's neck, rises from a red, circular stand with four legs. A small white object rests on the stand.

The rightmost scroll depicts a small figure in green and red robes sitting on a cloud-like shape in the upper part of its white cloud. Below, at the base of the cloud, is a cluster of white flowers and green leaves, resting on a green, patterned mat or cushion. The overall composition suggests a series of related scenes.

metadata.title: 鳥文斎栄之筆　蜀山人（大田 南畝）賛　吉原の蜃気楼図|Shellfish and Apparitions of the Yoshiwara Pleasure Quarter
metadata.medium: Triptych of hanging scrolls with inscribed mountings; painting: ink and color on silk; calligraphy: ink on silk mounting fabric

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicting a large group of robed figures, some with animals, in a crowded composition
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting, primarily in ink wash with some light color accents, on a light-colored paper or silk background. The composition is densely packed with approximately eighteen robed figures, mostly men, arranged in a vertical cluster. At the top, a figure with a bald head and a beard holds a small, flaming object aloft. To his right, another bald figure with a staff stands next to a large, striped animal, possibly a tiger, which is partially obscured. Below them, several figures are depicted with various expressions and postures. Some figures have bald heads, while others have hair and beards. Their robes are mostly rendered in shades of gray and black ink, with occasional touches of light red or orange on their skin or garments. In the middle section, a central figure with a dark beard and mustache holds a scroll or book. Around him, other figures are shown in various states of interaction or contemplation. One figure to the left has a prominent, elongated earlobe. Many figures have expressive faces, some smiling, some serious, some with exaggerated features. Towards the bottom, a figure with a staff stands next to a small, dark animal, possibly a dog or lion-like creature, which is lying on the ground. Another figure is seated, looking towards the animal. Throughout the painting, there are small red seals and some vertical lines of black text, likely inscriptions, scattered among the figures. The overall impression is one of a gathering of distinct individuals, rendered with dynamic brushwork.

metadata.title: 十六羅漢図合作 (Jūroku rakan zu gassaku)|Collaborative Painting of Sixteen Arhats
metadata.artist: Suzuki Shōnen 鈴木松年|Tomioka Tessai 富岡鉄斎|Murase Gyokuden 村瀬玉田|Amano Hōko 天野方壺|Kōno Bairei 幸野楳嶺|Ikeda Unshō 池田雲樵|Asai Hakuzan 浅井柳塘|Yamanaka Shūhan 山中秋帆|Imao Keinen 今尾景年|Murata Kōkoku 村田香谷|Morikawa Sōbun 森川曾文|Mori Kansai 森寛斎|Shiokawa Ichidō 塩川一堂|Suzuki Hyakunen 鈴木百年|Tanomura Chokunyū 田能村直入|Shige Shuntō 重春塘
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on satin

alt_text: Ink painting of multiple figures in a mountainous landscape with trees and water, across two panels
long_description: This is a two-panel ink wash painting on light-colored paper, depicting multiple figures within a serene landscape. The artwork is rendered in shades of black and gray, with varying brushstrokes creating depth and texture. The left panel features two main figures. On the far left, a figure with flowing robes stands on a rocky outcrop, looking upwards, with a tall, slender rock formation rising behind them. To their right, a smaller figure, possibly a child, leads an ox or water buffalo across the foreground, positioned near the base of a large, gnarled tree with sparse foliage. In the background of the left panel, faint, distant mountains and trees are visible, suggesting a vast, open landscape with a body of water in the middle ground. The right panel presents a group of three figures in a more intimate setting. Two figures are seated or kneeling on the ground in the foreground, facing towards the left. One is seated on a low rock, while the other is on the ground in front of them. A third figure stands slightly behind and to the right of the seated pair, observing them. The background of the right panel shows gently rolling hills and sparse vegetation, with a tree branch extending downwards from the top edge of the panel. The overall composition suggests a continuous landscape across both panels, with figures engaged in different activities.

metadata.title: 伝狩野山楽筆　仙人高士図屏風|Chinese Sages
metadata.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink on paper

alt_text: Three men conversing in a mountainous landscape with a large gnarled tree and distant peaks
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts three men in a muted landscape. The upper half is dominated by a large, gnarled tree with dark, twisting branches and sparse foliage, extending across the top. Behind the tree, a steep, dark mountain rises on the left, with lighter, more distant mountains visible to the right. The sky is a uniform, light beige-brown, suggesting an overcast day. In the lower-middle section, three men are positioned on a flat, light brown ground. The leftmost man has a small beard, wears a light-colored robe, and stands facing right, looking towards the other two. The middle man, also bearded, wears a darker robe and gestures with his right hand towards the man on the far right. The rightmost man has a large, bald head and a wide, smiling expression. He wears a layered, light-colored robe with dark and reddish accents, and faces left, looking at the other two. Behind the men, a dark, horizontal wooden fence or railing is visible. The foreground in the lower right corner features some small, dark green plants and rocks.

metadata.title: 虎渓三笑図|Three Laughers of Tiger Ravine
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts a bald, bearded man with large earlobes and rings, looking forward.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a man depicted from the chest up, set against a plain, muted background. The central painted area is framed by decorative golden-brown borders with a repeating floral pattern. The man occupies the lower half of the central panel, facing slightly left but looking directly forward. He is bald on top, with short, dark hair on the sides of his head, and a full, dark beard and mustache. His eyes are wide open with heavy eyelids and dark pupils, and his mouth is a thin, downturned line. His earlobes are elongated, each adorned with a large, dark, circular ring. He has a thick neck and shoulders, wearing a simple, light brown garment with dark, broad straps or folds of fabric crossing his chest. The painting cuts off just below his chest. A small, faint red seal is visible on the left side of his chest, near the patterned border. The background is a light brown or beige, showing subtle horizontal lines.

metadata.title: 朱衣達磨像|Bodhidharma in Red Robes
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Golden relief panel depicting three seated figures amidst elaborate scrollwork and decorative borders
long_description: A rectangular, horizontal golden relief panel is presented against a plain gray background. The panel features a multi-layered frame surrounding a central, deeply carved scene. The outermost frame layer displays a continuous, undulating leaf or wave pattern, while an inner border consists of a row of small, raised beads. The central area of the panel is densely filled with intricate, high-relief scrollwork and three prominent seated figures. The figures are positioned centrally, to the left, and to the right, each seated on a low, ornate platform or throne. They appear to be in a meditative pose, with hands resting in their laps, and each is backed by a circular halo or aureole. The entire surface, including the figures and the elaborate background, is rendered in a uniform golden hue, giving the artwork a rich, luminous appearance. The detailed scrollwork creates a sense of depth and texture, with smaller, less distinct forms emerging from the swirling patterns between the main figures.

alt_text: A grid of numerous identical seated figures, possibly deities, in dark ink on a light background.
long_description: The artwork features a dense grid of small, dark ink illustrations on a light, aged paper-like background. The grid is composed of approximately 10 rows and 10 columns, though some figures are obscured or damaged, particularly towards the bottom and right. Each individual illustration depicts a seated figure, likely a deity or Buddha, in a meditative pose. The figures are rendered with fine lines, showing details such as a halo or aura behind the head, a distinct hairstyle, and flowing robes. Their hands appear to be in a specific mudra or gesture. Each figure is contained within a rectangular frame, and the repetition creates a strong sense of pattern and multitude. Some areas of the paper show discoloration and minor damage, with darker smudges and lighter worn patches, especially in the central and lower right sections of the grid. The entire printed sheet is mounted on a light tan mat, which is then surrounded by a darker brown, textured frame.

metadata.title: 不動明王坐像印仏 (Fudō myōō zazō inbutsu)|Stamped Images of the Wisdom King Fudō (Acala)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; woodblock printed images; ink on paper

alt_text: A seated elderly man with a long beard and a younger attendant in a framed scene with a moon and sun
long_description: A vertical painting features two figures against a golden-brown background, framed by dark borders with gold accents. In the center, a large, elderly man with a long white beard and mustache is seated on an ornate, dark-colored throne with red and gold decorative elements. He wears a dark green robe over a red garment, with white fabric visible at his neck and sleeves. He holds a red staff with a curved, possibly dragon-headed, top in his right hand, resting it on his shoulder. His left hand rests on his lap. To the right and slightly below the seated man, a smaller, younger figure stands. This figure has dark hair pulled back and wears a light-colored robe with green and red trim. They hold a small, ornate object, possibly an incense burner, in their hands, extended towards the seated man. In front of the throne, on a dark, layered platform, are a pair of ornate, red and white shoes with curled toes. Behind the seated man, a rectangular frame with decorative borders encloses a scene depicting a dark sky with white clouds. A golden full moon is visible on the right, and a silver crescent moon is on the left, with a small dark circle between them.

metadata.title: 伝教大師(最澄)像|Portrait of Dengyō Daishi (Saichō)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting featuring black calligraphic text above a large, pale circle partially obscured by dark, swirling ink washes
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll, presented on a light beige or cream-colored paper ground. It is framed by light blue-grey borders on the left and right, and decorative patterned borders at the very top and bottom, featuring a repeating, light beige scroll-like or cloud-like motif. The upper section of the scroll contains black calligraphic text arranged in vertical columns, with a small red square seal visible below the text on the left side. The main visual content below the text features a large, pale, circular shape, centrally positioned but slightly to the left. This light circle is partially enveloped and obscured by dynamic, dark ink forms. These forms are rendered with varying shades of grey and black, using visible brushstrokes that create a swirling, cloud-like or misty effect around the lighter circle. The dark ink appears to rise from the bottom and descend from the top, creating a sense of movement and depth, with some areas showing distinct, textured brushwork and others appearing more diffused.

metadata.title: 月に雲図 (Tsuki ni kumo zu)|Moon amid Clouds
metadata.artist: Gekijō 撃壤|Seisetsu Shūcho 誠拙周樗

alt_text: Two white ducks swim in water beneath a gnarled tree branch with white blossoms on a scroll painting
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting with a light brown or tan background, suggesting aged paper or silk. A gnarled tree trunk with branches extends from the left side, starting near the middle and curving upwards and to the right. The trunk is dark brown with lighter brown and green mossy textures. White blossoms with small yellow centers are scattered along the branches, some in clusters, others as single buds. In the lower left, dark brown, spiky reeds or grasses emerge from the water, partially obscured by the frame. Two white ducks are depicted in the lower half of the painting, swimming in a body of water. The water is a slightly darker tan than the background, with subtle, wavy lines indicating ripples. The duck on the left is slightly larger and positioned closer to the viewer, facing right. Its head is turned towards the second duck. The second duck is to its right and slightly behind, also facing right. Both ducks have white feathers, reddish-orange beaks, and small dark eyes. Their bodies are textured with fine lines suggesting feathers. The painting is framed by a dark border with intricate gold floral patterns. A thin gold band separates the painting from this outer border. In the upper right corner of the painting, there is a small red square seal with illegible characters.

metadata.title: 梅に水鳥図 (Ume ni mizutori zu)|Plum Tree and Waterfowl
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A bird with a dark head and reddish-brown body perches on a branch with white and green foliage against a gold fan-shaped background.
long_description: The image features a fan-shaped painting centered on a light beige background, framed by a dark green border with a repeating gold floral pattern. The fan-shaped artwork has a textured gold background, suggesting the use of gold leaf. In the lower right quadrant of the fan, a bird with a dark head, white chest, and reddish-brown wings and tail is perched on a thick, gnarled branch.
