The branch, appearing to be made of a light, silvery-gray material with visible wood grain, extends from the lower left towards the right. To the left of the bird, large, undulating white forms with green undersides or outlines rise from the branch, resembling snow-covered leaves or plants. Small clusters of red berries or fruits are visible among the green and white elements on the branch. Faint, delicate branch-like patterns are etched into the gold background around the bird. The overall composition is balanced, with the bird and foliage occupying the lower and left portions of the fan.

metadata.title: 雪中芭蕉小禽図 (Setchū bashō shōkin zu)|Plantain and Bird in Snow
metadata.medium: Fan-shaped painting mounted on a hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold leaf on paper

alt_text: A rectangular artwork with black calligraphy, stylized flowers, and a feathery plant on an aged tan background, framed by a gold and blue floral border.
long_description:
The artwork features a rectangular central panel with a light brown, aged appearance, framed by a dark blue border with gold patterns. The central panel is horizontally oriented. Along its top and bottom edges, a wavy blue line runs, resembling water or clouds. Above and below these wavy lines, thin gold strips separate the central panel from the outer border.

The central panel contains black ink calligraphy arranged in vertical columns, primarily on the right and center. On the far right, a column of large, bold characters descends. To its left, another column of slightly smaller characters follows. Further left, a third column of characters is visible. In the upper center-right, a delicate, feathery plant motif, possibly a reed or grass, is drawn in a lighter ink, with faint curved lines extending from it. Scattered across the left and central areas of the panel are several stylized, open-blossom flowers, resembling chrysanthemums, also rendered in a lighter, faded ink. Some faint circular smudges are visible near the center. On the far left, a column of smaller, more cursive script runs vertically.

The outer border is a dark, deep blue, adorned with a repeating pattern of intricate gold stylized flowers and leaves, creating a rich, textile-like appearance.

metadata.title: 近衛前久筆　『和漢朗詠集』より白居易詩及び 藤原敏行和歌 (部分)|Chinese Couplet by Bai Juyi and Waka by Fujiwara no Toshiyuki (partial) from “Japanese and Chinese Poems to Sing” (Wakan rōeishū)
metadata.medium: Handscroll section mounted as hanging scroll; ink on dyed and decorated paper

alt_text: A scroll painting depicts a reclining bearded man with a kneeling child, and black calligraphy above.
long_description: The vertical scroll features a light brown background with a decorative border. The top and bottom edges have a narrow gold band, while the left and right sides have a wider dark green border adorned with gold swirling patterns. The upper half of the scroll contains multiple columns of black calligraphic text. From left to right, the columns read: "す", "の"; "み", "ち", "の", "お"; "み", "ち", "の", "お"; "す", "し"; "り", "は". On the upper right, a vertical inscription in black ink reads: "元禄二年二月日", followed by "小野道風書". The lower half of the scroll depicts two figures rendered in black ink with varying washes. A large, robust man with a beard and a bald head is shown reclining, resting his head on his right arm. He wears loose-fitting robes. To his left, a smaller figure, possibly a child, kneels on the ground, facing the larger man. This smaller figure has a topknot and wears simple garments, with one hand raised as if in conversation or offering. The figures are positioned towards the bottom center of the scroll, with ample empty space above them.

metadata.title: 布袋図 (Hotei zu)|Hotei and a Child
metadata.artist: Ono no Ozū (Ono no Tsū) 小野通

alt_text: Japanese calligraphy and stylized yellow trees on white paper, framed by gold and patterned fabric borders.
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular panel featuring a central light cream-colored paper with black calligraphy and painted elements, framed by decorative borders. On the paper, several columns of black ink calligraphy are visible, primarily on the right and center-left. The characters vary in size and stroke thickness. Below and across the lower portion of the paper are stylized trees or bushes, rendered in a light yellow or golden wash. These trees are clustered, with some darker yellow accents suggesting trunks and branches, forming a gentle, undulating landscape. A subtle horizontal wash of the same light yellow/gold color runs along the very bottom edge of the paper. The central paper is bordered by a narrow, textured gold band. This gold band is then surrounded by a wider, dark fabric border. This outer border features sections of dark gray or black fabric with small white geometric patterns, alongside sections displaying colorful floral and leaf motifs in shades of blue, green, orange, and brown on a dark background.

metadata.title: 松下絵和歌巻断簡 (Matsu shita-e wakakan dankan)|Section of a Handscroll with Waka and Underpainting of Pines

metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink on gold decorated paper

alt_text: Calligraphic text interspersed within a dense cluster of fern-like foliage on a decorative scroll.
long_description: A rectangular artwork features a central off-white panel framed by decorative fabric borders. The central panel is dominated by a large, dense mass of foliage, resembling ferns or moss, rendered in varying shades of grey, brown, and light beige. The foliage is clustered, with an irregular, organic shape that spreads across much of the panel. Several lines of black calligraphic text are visible, some appearing within the foliage and others around its edges. In the upper right, the characters "天の" are visible. Below and to the right of the foliage's center, the characters "けり" appear. Further down on the right, the character "山" is present. In the upper left, the character "雪" is visible, and in the lower left, the character "と" is followed by other less distinct characters. The central panel is bordered at the top and bottom by a golden-brown fabric with a repeating pattern of dark green and light gold swirling motifs. The wider side borders are an olive-green fabric adorned with a repeating pattern of light blue, cloud-like or floral designs.

metadata.title: 金銀刷檜絵下絵和歌巻断簡 (Kingin-zuri hinoki shita-e wakakan dankan)|Waka Poem with Printed Gold-and-Silver Underpainting of Cypress Fronds
metadata.medium: Section of a handscroll mounted as hanging scroll; ink on paper with decoration printed in gold and silver

alt_text: A woman on a veranda looks out at a garden while a man reads inside a traditional building
long_description: The horizontal painting depicts a scene with two figures in a traditional setting. On the left, an outdoor garden area features a small tree with light pink blossoms and green leaves, surrounded by tall green grasses. Above the garden, light blue, cloud-like shapes are visible against a pale background. In the center, a woman with long, dark hair sits on a light brown wooden veranda, facing left and looking towards the garden. She wears a white upper garment and a flowing red lower garment. To her right, a building with light brown wooden walls and a dark roof is partially visible. Inside the building, a man with a shaved head sits on a green mat, facing right, engrossed in reading a scroll or book. He wears dark robes. Behind the woman, a wall with a white pattern on a blue background is visible, suggesting an interior space. The overall color palette is muted with accents of red, green, and blue.

metadata.title: 『狐草紙』|Tale of the Fox (Kitsune no sōshi)
metadata.medium: Handscroll: ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a seated man in a dark robe and hat, with black calligraphy above him
long_description:
A tall, vertical scroll painting features a seated man against a plain, light tan background. The top and bottom edges of the scroll are framed by narrow, gold-colored borders with subtle, repeating patterns. Below the top border, a large section of the tan background is filled with black calligraphic text arranged in several vertical lines. The rightmost line reads "と山時もと一", followed by "推我か心の一を施", then "仏殿", "人世五通な剣", and finally, on the leftmost side, "人生七十" with additional smaller characters below it.

Below the text, a man is depicted seated, facing slightly towards the viewer's left, with his gaze directed forward. He has a light skin tone, a small dark mustache, and a small dark beard. He wears a dark, flat-topped hat and a dark, long-sleeved robe that is folded over at the chest. His hands are clasped together, holding a closed fan. Blue and white tassels hang from his waist. The man is seated on a rectangular green mat, which has a border composed of white dots on a dark background. Below this mat, a wider patterned band with white dots on a dark background stretches across the scroll, followed by the final gold-colored patterned border at the very bottom.

metadata.title: 千利休像に遺偈 (Sen no Rikyū zō ni yuige)   |Portrait of Sen no Rikyū with his Death Poem
metadata.artist: Unidentified artist|Joshinsai Sōsa 如心斎宗左

alt_text: A robed figure writes on a scroll, with calligraphy, a colorful bird, and a flowering branch above
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular composition featuring a central light beige panel set against a wider, light tan background with blue borders at the top and bottom. Above the central panel, a branch with green leaves and small white flowers extends from the upper left. To the right of the branch, a large, colorful bird with a long, flowing tail is depicted, facing right. Its feathers are rendered in shades of gold, green, and blue. The light tan background in this upper section also contains subtle gold patterns. The central light beige panel occupies the majority of the artwork's width. On the left side of this panel, several vertical lines of black calligraphy are present. On the right side, a bald figure, dressed in a simple robe, is seated on the ground, facing left. The figure holds a brush and appears to be writing on a long, unrolled scroll or piece of paper laid out in front of them. To the left of the seated figure is a small, black, pedestal-like stand with a dark object on top. To the right of the figure, two rectangular objects are stacked vertically, and next to them is a red square seal with black characters. The bottom section of the artwork, below the central panel, mirrors the upper section's light tan background with subtle gold patterns, and is framed by a blue border at the very bottom.

metadata.title: 兼好法師画像 (Kenkō Hōshi zō)|兼好法師画賛 (Kenkō hōshi gasan)|Monk Kenkō Reading by Lamplight
metadata.artist: Unidentified|Imperial Prince-Monk Ryōshō 良尚入道親王
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A standing figure in a white kimono with red, green, and black patterns, holding a fan.
long_description: A full-length painting on a vertical scroll depicts a standing figure against a plain, light beige background. The figure, positioned slightly right of center, faces forward with their head tilted down and to the right. They have light skin and black hair styled in an elaborate bun with a white, rectangular ornament. The figure wears a long, flowing white kimono with wide sleeves. The kimono is adorned with a vibrant pattern of large, stylized circular motifs in red, green, and light blue, interspersed with swirling red lines and tassels. Some circles contain smaller concentric circles or floral patterns. A black and white checkerboard patterned sash (obi) cinches the waist, and a red collar is visible beneath the white kimono. The figure's left arm is bent, holding a fan or similar object partially obscured by the sleeve. Their right arm is mostly hidden by the voluminous kimono. The figure's feet, visible at the bottom, wear white footwear with red trim. The overall impression is of a graceful, posed figure.

metadata.title: 若衆立姿図 (Wakashū tachisugata zu)|Elegantly Garbed Male Youth

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono holds a fan, standing beside a stringed instrument on a light background
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting depicting a standing woman on a plain, light tan background. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing left with her head tilted downwards. Her black hair is styled elaborately, adorned with multiple thin, golden, spiky ornaments radiating from the back of her head, and a red floral ornament near her left ear. Her face is pale with delicate features, and her eyes are downcast. She wears a long, flowing kimono. The main body of the kimono is a muted purple-grey, with a cream-colored collar and red lining visible at the sleeves and hem. The lower portion of the kimono is decorated with a pattern of green leafy vines and small blue flowers. Her left arm is bent, holding a light-colored, closed fan with dark ribs. Her right hand holds a length of light cream-colored fabric that drapes down her front. To the lower left of the woman, a long, stringed instrument, resembling a koto, rests on a low, red stand. A small blue object, possibly a book, and a piece of white paper are placed on the ground near the instrument. To the left of the woman's waist, there is a vertical column of black calligraphic text that reads "春の夜の夢" (Haru no yo no yume), followed by a red seal. The entire painting is framed by a decorative border with vertical stripes of gold, blue, and cream patterns.

metadata.title: 団扇立美人図 (Uchiwa tachi bijin zu)|Courtesan with Fan and Koto

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire, one balancing an object on her head, on a decorative scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring two women against a plain background, framed by decorative borders. The background behind the figures is a solid, light tan color. The woman on the left stands slightly taller and is positioned slightly behind the woman on the right. She wears a light blue-grey kimono with a red lining visible at the sleeves and hem, and a dark green obi. Her right hand is raised, holding a dark, rounded, basket-like object on top of her head. Her left arm is bent, with her hand near her waist. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The woman on the right wears a dark, possibly black or deep blue, kimono with a vibrant red and gold patterned lining visible at the sleeves and collar. She has a dark obi. Her left hand holds a small, dark, flat, rectangular object at her side. Her right hand is partially obscured by her sleeve. Her hair is also styled in an elaborate updo. Both women have pale complexions and dark hair. The scroll is bordered by a wide, light brown fabric with a repeating pattern of small, circular motifs in red, blue, and white. At the top, there is a wider band of gold fabric with a repeating pattern of two large, symmetrical, stylized motifs that resemble mythical creatures or elaborate floral designs. A similar wide band of gold fabric with a pattern of green and brown stylized pine branches or clouds is present at the bottom of the scroll.

metadata.title: 筑摩祭・鍋被り美人図 (Tsukuma matsuri, Nabe kaburi bijin zu)|Women Carrying Pots for the Tsukuma Festival
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; partly woodblock printed, partly painted in ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical ink wash painting shows a tall, misty mountain, dense forests, terraced hills, and a small bridge.
long_description: The vertical ink wash painting, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light-colored ground, is framed by a dark green border with a patterned gold-colored inner edge. At the top, a prominent, pointed mountain rises, its peak softly blurred by what appears to be mist or clouds. To its left, a smaller, rounded hill is visible. Below these peaks, a dense band of dark, textured trees stretches across the mid-ground. Further down, a body of water with several small, irregular landforms or islands is depicted. Below the water, the landscape transitions into a series of terraced or stepped hillsides, rendered with distinct horizontal lines and varying shades of ink. Scattered among these are individual trees and small clusters of foliage. In the lower left foreground, a cluster of tall, slender trees with full, dark canopies stands prominently. To the right, a small, arched bridge spans a narrow waterway. In the upper left corner of the painting, vertical characters "三峰" are visible, accompanied by a small, square red seal below them.

metadata.title: 富嶽図 (Fugaku zu)|Mount Fuji
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A black bird, pink chrysanthemums, and a dark rock formation on a vertical scroll.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a black bird, pink flowers, and a dark rock formation on a light cream background. At the top, a black bird with a white belly and tail feathers is depicted in mid-flight, descending towards the right. Below the bird, a large, round pink chrysanthemum with many petals is prominent. To its right, vertical black text and two small red square seals are visible. Below the chrysanthemum, a cluster of smaller pink flowers with elongated leaves extends vertically. A prominent, jagged dark gray and black rock formation runs diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, partially obscured by the pink flowers. More pink flowers and light green stems are visible around and behind the rock. Near the bottom center, a small red square seal is present. The painting is framed by a dark green border with gold scrollwork patterns at the top and bottom, and a lighter green textured border along the sides.

metadata.title: 雁来紅に叭々鳥図 (Ganraikō ni hahachō zu)|Amaranthus and Mynah Bird
metadata.artist: Kakutei 鶴亭 (Kaigan Jōkō 海眼浄光)

alt_text: A figure in traditional attire extends an arm towards a cylindrical object on the ground, within a vertical scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a single figure on a light, unadorned background. The central figure, positioned slightly below the vertical center, is a person in traditional attire, depicted in light washes of color and black ink outlines. The figure stands with their body angled slightly to the right, leaning forward, with their head tilted downwards. Their right arm is extended forward and slightly down, while their left hand is held near their chest. They wear a light-colored, flowing garment, possibly a kimono, with subtle green and blue tints, cinched at the waist by a patterned obi in shades of red and white. A small, light-colored cap or head covering sits atop their dark hair, which is styled in a bun at the back of their head. On the ground to the lower right of the figure, a light brown cylindrical object, resembling a bucket or basket, lies on its side, with other faint, indistinct shapes nearby. In the lower left corner, vertical lines of black text are visible, accompanied by two square red seals below them. The central painting is framed by a wide, textured gold-colored border, with a narrower, patterned gold band at the top and bottom edges of the painted area.

metadata.title: 千代能姫図 (Chiyono-hime zu)|Lady Chiyono
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Three mice on and around a red table with books, peacock feathers, and coral in a scroll painting
long_description: This is a vertical scroll painting with a light beige background, framed by patterned borders at the top and bottom. The top border features a repeating floral motif in muted blues, browns, and greens. In the upper left quadrant of the main beige area, there is a column of black calligraphic text with two red square seals beneath it. Below this, on the left side, a slender, light-colored vase holds several long peacock feathers and a branch of red coral. The peacock feathers are dark green and brown with prominent iridescent "eye" spots. The coral is a vibrant red, branching upwards. In the lower half of the painting, a red, four-legged table with a slightly raised edge is depicted. On the tabletop, a stack of blue-covered books is visible, with a lighter-colored, open book resting beside them. Two small, grey-brown mice are positioned on the table. One mouse stands on the stack of blue books, facing right, while the other is to its left, appearing to interact with the open book. Below the table, a third mouse is partially visible, peeking out from behind a stack of loose papers or unbound books. Another blue-covered book lies on the floor beneath the table. The bottom border mirrors the floral pattern of the top border.

metadata.title: 楓鼠図 (Fūso zu)|Rats on a Scholar’s Desk
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical ink painting depicts large, dark leaves with circular water drops, framed by a gold border.
long_description: A vertical hanging scroll features an ink painting of several large leaves on a light, aged paper background, framed by a patterned gold border. The leaves are rendered in varying shades of gray and black ink, showing prominent veins and a slightly textured surface. Numerous circular and oval shapes, representing water drops, are visible on the leaf surfaces, depicted as lighter areas that contrast with the darker ink of the leaves. A central, twisted stem or stalk runs vertically through the middle of the composition. The leaves overlap, creating a sense of depth. In the upper right portion of the painting, there are red seals and black calligraphic characters. The overall impression is one of natural detail rendered with a limited color palette.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of towering mountains, dense trees, and a cascading waterfall in a rugged landscape
long_description: A vertical ink wash landscape painting depicts a rugged mountain scene with a cascading waterfall and dense trees. Towering, jagged peaks dominate the upper half of the composition, rendered in varying shades of black and grey ink, with subtle hints of light reddish-brown on some rock faces. Areas of lighter grey and white suggest mist or clouds swirling around the mid-sections of the mountains, and a faint blue wash is visible in the upper right background. In the upper right corner, black calligraphic characters read "未米" above a square red seal. Below the highest peaks, a dense forest of trees, primarily dark green and black, covers the steep slopes. A prominent waterfall descends through the center of the painting, appearing as a light, almost white, streak against the darker rock and foliage, flowing over multiple rocky ledges. In the lower half, more trees with visible light brown trunks and branches are scattered across the lower slopes and at the base of the mountains. The brushwork varies from fine lines for delicate branches to broad, textured washes for rock formations and dense foliage, creating a sense of depth and movement within the mountainous terrain.

metadata.title: 緑陰煎茗図 (Ryokuin senmei zu)|Brewing Tea in the Shade of Trees
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting shows numerous figures along a winding river in a misty, mountainous landscape with a pavilion
long_description: This vertical scroll painting depicts a vibrant, verdant landscape with a winding river flowing through it, populated by numerous small figures. At the top, a series of green and brown mountains rise, partially obscured by white mist, suggesting a deep, layered background. Below these mountains, a waterfall cascades down a steep, green hillside into the river. On the right bank of the river, a traditional pavilion with a dark, multi-tiered roof and red pillars stands, surrounded by trees, some bearing pink blossoms. The river, light blue-green in color, meanders from the upper middle section down to the bottom of the painting. Along its banks, dozens of small figures, predominantly dressed in blue robes, are seated or standing on the grassy slopes. They are arranged in small groups, some appearing to converse, others looking towards the river. Small, dark objects, possibly cups, are visible floating in the river, particularly in the middle section. A white, bird-like form floats in the river near the pavilion. The landscape is rich with various trees and foliage, including tall bamboo groves on the left bank. Towards the bottom, the river flows under a light-colored arched bridge on the right side. More figures are scattered on the lower banks. In the lower left corner, vertical lines of black text are visible, accompanied by a square red seal. Another square red seal is present in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: 蘭亭曲水図 (Rantei kyokusui zu)|Lanting Pavilion by a Winding Stream
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical ink painting of a vast mountainous landscape with trees, houses, and calligraphic text at the top
long_description: This vertical ink painting on light paper depicts a detailed mountainous landscape. At the top, a large, craggy mountain range dominates the left side, rendered with dark ink washes and textured strokes, suggesting rocky formations and sparse vegetation. Several small, simple buildings with tiled roofs are nestled into the mountainside on the upper left. To the right of these prominent peaks, the landscape recedes into a valley with softer, more distant mountains and hills, depicted with lighter ink. In the upper right quadrant, multiple columns of black calligraphic text, written in a script that is not legible at this resolution, cover a significant portion of the sky and distant landscape. Below the main mountain range, a dense forest fills the middle ground, featuring various types of trees. Some trees have thick, rounded canopies, while others show slender trunks and delicate branches. More buildings are visible on the left, integrated into the forested slopes. The lower half of the painting is filled with a dense, textured pattern of foliage, suggesting a thick undergrowth or a vast expanse of trees extending into the foreground. The overall palette is monochromatic, primarily black ink on a light, possibly aged, paper, creating a sense of depth and atmosphere.

metadata.title: 大雅山村馬市図臨写 (Taiga “Sanson umaichi zu” rinsha)|After Ike Taiga’s “Horse Market in a Mountain Village”
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An ink painting depicts towering mountains, a waterfall, trees, and a small village with a bridge
long_description: The vertical ink painting on light-colored paper depicts a mountainous landscape rendered primarily in black and gray ink washes with subtle reddish-brown accents. A massive, craggy mountain dominates the upper right and central portion of the composition, appearing to have a waterfall cascading down its face, indicated by lighter vertical streaks. Below the main peak, a dense cluster of tall, slender trees with sparse branches rises from a sloping hillside. To the left of these trees, a small, two-story building with a dark roof is nestled on a lower slope. Further down and to the right, a small, arched bridge spans a narrow stream or river, with more trees scattered on the surrounding banks. In the upper left quadrant, a column of black calligraphic text is present, reading: "不從泉源路半枯 山骨灣冷、樹湯影 層峰一年有經 戊己真年十月寫春琴". Below and to the left of the text are several red seal impressions. The background features lighter, more ethereal mountain forms, suggesting depth. The overall impression is a serene, traditional landscape.

metadata.title: 寒林山水図 (Kanrin sansui zu)|Wintry Landscape with Trees
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink painting of a tall, narrow mountain landscape with waterfalls, dense bare trees, and small figures
long_description: The artwork is a tall, narrow vertical scroll painting rendered in ink on aged, light brown paper, creating a monochromatic landscape with subtle tonal variations. The composition is dominated by towering mountains and dense forests, depicted from a high vantage point. In the upper section, a series of softly contoured mountains rise, their peaks fading into the distance. A narrow, multi-tiered waterfall cascades down from a cleft between two peaks on the left, flowing into a valley. Sparse, bare trees with delicate branches dot the upper slopes and ridges. As the eye moves downward, the landscape becomes more densely forested. Jagged mountain forms and steep cliffs emerge on the right, textured with vertical brushstrokes. The middle ground is filled with a thick canopy of leafless trees, their intricate, gnarled branches forming a complex network. A winding path or stream is suggested through the dense foliage. In the lower section, the trees are even more prominent and detailed, with a variety of trunk shapes and branch patterns. On the lower right, nestled among rocks and trees, two small figures are visible. One figure appears to be seated, while the other stands nearby, both facing towards the left. A faint red seal is visible near the figures, and a column of vertical text is present in the upper right quadrant of the painting.

metadata.title: 冬山水図 (Fuyu sansui zu)|Winter Landscape
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash painting depicting towering mountains, dense pine trees, a waterfall, and buildings with a figure by a stream.
long_description: This vertical ink wash painting, rendered primarily in shades of black, gray, and muted greens and browns on a light beige background, depicts a vast mountainous landscape. The upper half is dominated by towering, craggy mountains with textured brushstrokes suggesting rocky surfaces and sparse foliage, receding into a lighter, misty background. In the mid-ground, a waterfall cascades down the right side of a central mountain. Below it, a cluster of buildings with reddish-brown roofs is nestled among dense pine trees. Further up and to the left, another group of buildings, possibly a temple complex, is visible on a higher mountain slope. The foreground features a winding stream or river, with a small figure in a reddish-brown robe seated on the bank to the left of the stream, facing right. More large pine trees with dark green needles and brown trunks frame the lower part of the scene, particularly on the left. Several small, simple buildings with reddish-brown roofs are visible on stilts along the stream's edge on the right. In the upper left, vertical text in black ink reads: "匡山沈學" followed by "高山仰止" and "丁丑年冬月寫於" and then "清溪草堂". Below this text, there is a red square seal.

metadata.title: 「夏山深翠」(Kazan shinsui) |“The Deep Green of Summer Mountains”
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical ink painting depicts a gnarled flowering tree, bamboo stalks, and a textured rock, with calligraphy.
long_description: A vertical ink painting on a light, off-white paper depicts a gnarled tree, bamboo, and a large rock, rendered primarily in black ink washes. On the right, a twisted, dark-trunked tree extends upwards and slightly to the left, its branches covered with numerous small, light-colored blossoms. To the left of the tree, a cluster of tall bamboo stalks rises from the bottom, with many thin, dark leaves extending outwards. The bamboo is depicted with varying shades of ink, creating depth. At the base of both the tree and the bamboo, a large, irregularly shaped rock is rendered with textured ink washes, showing contours and shadows. In the upper left quadrant, several vertical lines of black calligraphy are present. Below the calligraphy and near the base of the rock, two square red seals are visible.

metadata.title: 墨梅竹図 (Boku baichiku zu)|Ink Plum and Bamboo

alt_text: Ink wash painting depicting a large, pale moon between two stylized trees on a light background
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting on a light, yellowish-beige paper depicts a large, pale circular moon positioned centrally, slightly to the right. The moon is diffuse, with faint, wispy ink wash visible within its form and around its edges, suggesting clouds or mist. Above the moon, on the left side, a tall, slender tree with stylized, dark ink foliage extends upwards and curves slightly towards the moon. Below the moon, a larger, gnarled tree with multiple branches and stylized dark ink foliage extends from the lower left towards the right. Behind this lower tree, a triangular shape rendered in lighter ink wash suggests a mountain. In the upper left corner, vertical lines of dark calligraphy are present, with two red square seals below them. The painting is mounted on a dark blue fabric with a repeating gold pattern, visible along the left and right edges, and a gold patterned strip at the very top.

alt_text: A man in elaborate attire sits in a room with two attendants, a harbor view, and decorative borders
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a man seated in a room, framed by multiple decorative borders. The central figure, a man with light skin, a mustache, and a small beard, sits on a light green chair, looking towards the viewer's left. He wears a red and gold hat, a gold jacket with red trim, and red trousers. A sword with a blue scabbard is tucked into his sash. To his left, two smaller figures are seated on the floor, facing the main figure. One wears a red and gold outfit, the other a green and gold outfit. Behind the main figure, a large window or opening reveals a harbor scene with a body of water, a distant island, and several boats under a light blue sky with white clouds. To the main figure's right, a light blue curtain is draped, and a small, ornate wooden table with drawers holds a vase of flowers and other small objects. The central scene is enclosed by a black frame with gold floral patterns. This is surrounded by a wide border with a light blue-grey background covered in intricate red, green, and gold floral and geometric patterns. The outermost border features alternating red and gold sections with small decorative elements, finished with a thin red line.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolors with gold on paper, laid down in an album page with ornamental margins and border

alt_text: A portrait of a woman with dark skin, wearing a white shawl, gold jewelry, and a headpiece, against a cloudy sky
long_description: This is a half-length portrait painting of a woman with dark skin, positioned slightly to the right of the center, looking towards the upper right. Her dark hair is pulled back, adorned with a light-colored headpiece featuring three circular, decorative elements across the top of her head. She has dark eyes, a small nose, and full lips. Her ears are decorated with gold-colored earrings, each composed of multiple small, flat discs. Around her neck are three strands of gold-colored beads, and a longer necklace hangs lower, featuring a light pink, triangular pendant. She wears a white garment with a ruffled collar, covered by a voluminous white shawl draped over her shoulders and arms. A hint of a reddish-pink garment is visible beneath the shawl on her right side. On her right hand, which rests near the bottom right corner, she wears a ring with a light pink oval-shaped stone. The background is a blue sky with soft white and gray clouds. In the upper right corner, light-colored text reads: "Joanna de Silva, a native of Bengal, the faithful and affectionate Nurse of the Children of Lieutenant Colonel Charles Desare. Painted by Will Wood 1792."

alt_text: Two figures, one rising in orange, the other reaching in white and blue, against a dark landscape.
long_description: This vertical oil painting depicts two figures in a dynamic pose within a natural setting. On the upper left, a figure, possibly a woman, is shown in a flowing reddish-brown garment. Her arms are outstretched, and her head is tilted back, with reddish hair visible. She appears to be rising or floating from a darker area into a lighter background of hazy pink and light blue. Below her, some light pink and white brushstrokes suggest flowers or light. On the lower right, another figure, also possibly a woman, is depicted in a light-colored flowing garment with blue drapery. Her arms are outstretched towards the figure on the left. A red element, possibly a ribbon or flower, is in her hair, and she holds yellow elements, resembling flowers or leaves, in her left hand. This figure is partially obscured by a dark, vertical brown mass on the right, which could be a tree trunk or rock face. The lower half of the painting is composed of dark brown and green brushstrokes, suggesting ground or foliage. The overall brushwork is loose and expressive.

alt_text: Three gold-toned panels depict classical figures, including draped women, men, winged beings, and symbolic objects.
long_description:
This artwork is a triptych-like composition set within a dark wooden frame, featuring three distinct panels. The central panel is wider than the two side panels. Each panel has a gold background and is bordered by a decorative band with a laurel wreath pattern at the top and a wave pattern at the bottom. The dark wooden frame itself is adorned with small, gold, star-like embellishments at the corners and along the top and bottom edges.

The left panel shows a standing female figure draped in light, flowing, peach-colored fabric. Her arms are raised, with her hands near her head, possibly holding a garland. At her feet, a smaller, nude figure, possibly a child, bends over a dark vessel. 

The central panel features three main standing figures and two smaller winged figures. On the left, a figure draped in dark teal stands, looking towards the right, holding what appears to be a scroll or tablet. In the center, a figure draped in dark brown is seated, looking downwards, holding a lyre or similar stringed instrument. This central figure wears a wreath on their head. On the right, a figure draped in red stands, looking towards the left. Above the seated central figure, two winged beings with light blue and gold wings float. Flanking the seated figure are two decorative pedestals; the left one has a snake coiled around a staff, and the right one supports a small plant.

The right panel displays a standing female figure in light brown and gold drapery. Her arms are raised, holding a shallow bowl or plate above her head. A smaller, nude figure, possibly a child, stands at her feet, looking up at her, and appears to hold a bow or staff.

metadata.title: Study for the Ceiling of the Marquand Music Room

alt_text: A nude, muscular man with dark hair and a beard crouches, leaning on a stool and a box.
long_description: The painting features a nude, muscular man positioned in a dynamic, crouching pose against a dark, warm brown background. The man occupies the central and lower-left portions of the canvas. His body is turned away from the viewer, with his back and right side prominently lit, emphasizing his musculature. His left knee rests on a small, wooden stool with a reddish cushion, while his right leg is extended backward and to the right, with his foot on the ground. His left arm is bent, and his hand rests on a dark, rectangular block or box positioned to his left. His head is turned sharply to his left, looking downwards, revealing a profile of his face with dark, curly hair and a beard. The lighting creates strong contrasts, with highlights on his shoulders, back, buttocks, and the extended right leg, while areas like his chest and the underside of his left arm are in shadow. The background is a uniform, dark reddish-brown, providing a stark contrast that makes the figure stand out. The stool is light brown wood with a dark red top, and the block is a dark, muted gray-brown.

alt_text: Two elaborately dressed men stand in a dimly lit room with blue drapery and ornate furniture.
long_description: A vertical painting depicts two men in ornate attire standing on a dark blue carpet in a dimly lit interior. The background is dark, almost black, with a lighter gray area behind the figures.On the left, a taller man with light skin and a dark mustache wears a red and gold turban, a long-sleeved, knee-length, light orange coat with intricate gold patterns, and a white pleated skirt. He has multiple gold necklaces and earrings. He holds a sword with a gold hilt in his right hand, its tip resting on the floor. To his left, a small, ornate green table with gold legs holds a gold object.On the right, a shorter man with light skin and a dark mustache wears a white turban, a long-sleeved white tunic, and green patterned pants. A gold and red sash is tied around his waist, with a blue-handled dagger tucked into it. His hands are raised in front of him, palms together, fingers slightly apart. He is barefoot. To his right, an ornate brown table with gold legs holds a small, round clock with a white face and black Roman numerals.A large blue drapery with gold trim hangs from the top left, sweeping down to the middle left of the scene.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Opaque watercolor with raised gold on paper

alt_text: A large standing figure with a halo surrounded by multiple smaller robed figures on a reddish-brown panel.
long_description: A vertical painting on a reddish-brown background depicts a central, light-skinned figure standing upright, wearing a reddish robe. This central figure has a halo behind its head and its right arm is visible, bent at the elbow, with a small, light-colored object in its hand. Surrounding this main figure are numerous smaller figures, arranged in rows and clusters. At the top, a row of heads and shoulders shows figures with varying hairstyles, some dark, some light, and some bald. Below them, several figures are depicted from the waist up, wearing reddish robes, some with halos behind their heads. In the lower section, more robed figures are visible, some with halos, and some with distinct features such as beards. One figure on the lower left has a white beard and appears to hold a snake, while another on the lower right has a white beard and holds a long, light-colored staff. All figures are outlined in black, and their skin tones range from light to a muted yellow-brown. The background is a uniform reddish-brown with visible texture and slight discoloration.

metadata.title: 영산희상도|靈山會上圖)|Vulture Peak Assembly
metadata.medium: Unmounted; ink, gold, silver and white pigment on silk

alt_text: A landscape painting on a light brown surface depicts misty mountains, a waterfall, water, and trees, with dark script on the right.
long_description: A rectangular landscape painting on a light brown, textured surface is framed by a lighter, patterned border. The painting's background features dark, misty mountains, with a visible waterfall cascading down one of the peaks on the left side. The middle ground is dominated by a wide expanse of water, rendered in a muted, brownish tone, suggesting a lake or river. In the foreground, on the left, a cluster of dark, slender trees grows atop a rocky outcrop. Another group of similar trees is visible on a smaller rock formation further to the right in the foreground. The overall color palette is subdued, primarily in shades of brown, gray, and dark green. In the upper right quadrant of the painting, several vertical columns of dark, calligraphic script are present. The script reads: "高雅誰能敵 寂寞寄幽獨 龍池記嘉會 蘭亭想逸風 郁郁名園樹 蕭蕭古澗松 聊復開襟抱 茲焉托始終 丙子嘉平月 嘉興沈周" followed by a small red seal.

alt_text: A man in dark and red traditional clothing sits below black calligraphy on a tan scroll.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring a seated man and extensive calligraphy on a light tan background. The central panel is framed by a narrow dark gray border with a subtle pattern, which is then surrounded by a wider, light brown border adorned with a repeating floral or leaf motif. The upper two-thirds of the central panel are filled with black calligraphy, arranged in multiple vertical lines of varying lengths. Several small red seals are visible within and below the calligraphic text. Below the calligraphy, a man is depicted seated, facing slightly to the right, with his head turned to look directly forward. He has a light complexion, dark hair styled with a shaved forehead and a small bun at the back. He wears a dark, long-sleeved inner garment beneath a wide-shouldered, dark red outer robe. This outer robe features two white square patches with black outlines on the chest, one on each side. His hands are clasped in front of him, holding a closed fan with a dark handle and light-colored blades. His lower body is covered by a voluminous, pleated, dark red skirt-like garment.

metadata.title: 初代市川男女蔵像|Memorial Portrait of the Actor Ichikawa Ōmezō I
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A multi-panel painting depicts a vibrant outdoor scene with numerous people, elaborate buildings, and lush landscapes.
long_description: This wide, horizontal painting, divided into eight vertical panels, illustrates a sprawling outdoor scene bustling with many small figures and elaborate structures. The overall color palette is muted, featuring greens, browns, reds, and blues against a light tan background. On the far left, green mountains with a visible waterfall rise in the upper section. Below, a walled compound with several buildings, including one with a prominent green-tiled roof, contains a few figures. A small bridge crosses a body of water. Moving right, a large central courtyard area is densely populated with numerous figures, many dressed in colorful robes of red, blue, green, and white. They are engaged in various activities such as dancing, conversing, and playing. Several large trees with dark green foliage and brown trunks are scattered throughout this area. A large, open-sided pavilion with a white roof stands centrally, also filled with figures. Further to the right, more buildings with green-tiled roofs and red accents are visible. A tall, multi-tiered pagoda-like structure with a green roof stands out. Courtyards and pathways connect these structures, which are also populated by many figures, some seated inside buildings and others outdoors. The scene continues to the far right with a cluster of buildings featuring green and blue roofs nestled among trees. Distant, lighter-colored hills form the background. The composition is dense and detailed, showcasing intricate architecture and varied activities within a natural setting. The ground is primarily a light brown or tan, and the sky is a pale, light tan or cream color.

metadata.title: 곽분양행락도|郭汾陽行樂圖|The Banquet of Guo Ziyi
metadata.medium: Eight-panel folding screen; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A painting depicts a village with a church tower beside a flowing river, bordered by trees.
long_description: An oil painting depicts a tranquil village scene alongside a flowing river under an overcast sky. The wide river dominates the lower half and center of the canvas, its surface a mix of greens, blues, and grays, showing ripples and reflections of the sky and surrounding landscape. The river flows from the foreground towards the upper left. On the left bank, a narrow strip of green grass separates the water from a dirt path. Two small figures, possibly women, are visible walking along this path, moving away from the viewer. Behind them, a large, light-colored building with a reddish-brown roof stands prominently. Further along the path, a stone wall runs parallel to the river, leading to more buildings in the village. One building has the word "HOTEL" visible on its facade. In the mid-ground, the village extends across the left and center, featuring various buildings with muted yellow, brown, and gray facades and reddish-brown roofs. In the distance, a light-colored church tower with a domed top rises above the village rooftops. The right bank of the river is densely covered with green and brown foliage, and several tall, slender trees with light-colored trunks stand vertically, their branches extending into the upper right portion of the painting. The background features a gentle hill or mountain range behind the village, partially obscured by trees. The overall lighting is soft and diffused, suggesting an overcast day.

alt_text: A drawing of a man in profile, wearing a pink turban and white garment, with a mustache and curly hair.
long_description: The artwork is a head and shoulders portrait of a man, depicted in profile, facing towards the left side of the frame. His skin is a medium-dark tone, rendered with brown and reddish-brown watercolor washes. He has dark, curly hair that is visible beneath a large, light pink turban wrapped around his head. A prominent dark mustache extends horizontally across his upper lip, connecting to a short, dark beard that frames his chin and jawline. His eye is open, looking straight ahead. He wears a simple white garment, possibly a shawl or robe, draped over his right shoulder and partially visible on his left. The background is a plain, light off-white, with faint, diagonal pencil lines suggesting a subtle texture or shadow behind him. The drawing combines delicate pencil outlines and cross-hatching for definition with soft watercolor washes for color and shading.

alt_text: A dark, multi-armed figure with red flames stands between two smaller figures in a vertical scroll painting
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features a dominant, dark-skinned central figure surrounded by vibrant red and orange flames, flanked by two smaller figures, all set against a dark background. The central figure, positioned in the upper half of the composition, has multiple arms, with at least four clearly visible. It holds a sword in its upper right hand and a looped chain or rope in its upper left hand. The figure is adorned with intricate gold jewelry, including necklaces, armbands, and earrings. Its face is dark with three visible eyes. The red and orange flames emanate from behind and around the figure, forming a large, upward-reaching halo that extends towards the top and sides of the dark background. Below the central figure, the ground is dark and indistinct. To the lower left, a smaller, red-skinned figure stands, facing towards the central figure. This figure wears red and dark patterned garments and holds a long, thin, golden staff vertically. To the lower right, another smaller, light-skinned figure stands, also facing towards the central figure. This figure wears patterned garments in shades of brown, red, and white, and appears to be holding an indistinct object or making a gesture with its hands. The main painted area is framed by a narrow, dark green border with subtle gold patterns, which is then surrounded by a wider, golden-yellow border featuring repeating gold floral or cloud motifs.

metadata.title: 不動明王像|Fudō Myōō (Achala Vidyaraja), The Immovable Wisdom King
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A man in dark robes and a cap leads a light-colored horse by a red bridle.
long_description: A painting depicts a man leading a horse on a plain, light-colored background. The man, positioned on the left, faces right and looks towards the horse. He wears a dark, long-sleeved robe over light blue pants and a dark cap. He has a mustache and a small beard. His bare feet are visible. He holds a white rope that connects to the horse's red bridle. The horse, occupying the right side of the composition, is large with a light grey or tan body, a dark mane, and a dark tail. It stands facing right, with its head turned slightly left towards the man. Its red bridle features white and red decorative elements. The central image is framed by a narrow, solid gold-colored border, which is then surrounded by a wider, patterned green fabric border adorned with light green floral motifs.

metadata.title: 駿馬図 (断簡)|Horse and Groom
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A seated figure with calligraphy above and plant stalks to the left on a vertical scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a seated figure, calligraphy, and plant stalks on a light brown ground, framed by dark, ornate borders. The upper third of the scroll is dominated by extensive calligraphy in dark ink, arranged in multiple vertical columns of varying lengths. A small, square red seal is visible near the top right of the calligraphic section. Below and to the left of the calligraphy, a cluster of slender plant stalks, rendered in dark, fluid brushstrokes, emerges from the left edge and curves upwards and towards the center. These stalks have long, narrow leaves. In the lower third of the scroll, a single figure is depicted in light gray ink, seated on the ground and facing towards the right. The figure appears to be a man, possibly elderly, with a bald head and a visible beard. He is dressed in loose, flowing robes and holds an indistinct object in his hands, which are clasped together. The figure is positioned slightly above the bottom border. The scroll's dark outer borders are adorned with intricate gold patterns, possibly floral or geometric, along their inner edges.

metadata.title: 陳蒲鞋偈頌画賛  (Chin Poai geju gasan)|Inscription on the anonymous painting of Chen Puxie

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts dark grapes and broad leaves on a vine, with black calligraphy above.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical rectangular composition on a light, untextured paper, framed by decorative borders. The paper occupies the central portion of the image. In the upper right quadrant, a column of black calligraphic text is present. The text reads: "紫自雷霜珠 碎泉間烏孩 拾口老詩葉 研中臣左海". Immediately to the left of the final character of the calligraphy, a small, square red seal is visible. The lower half of the paper features an ink wash painting of a vine with grapes and leaves. A cluster of dark, round grapes hangs towards the lower left, rendered in the darkest ink. Above and to the right of this cluster, several broad, lobed leaves are depicted using varying shades of gray and black ink washes, creating a sense of depth and texture. Thin, dark vine tendrils extend from the main cluster, curving upwards and to the left, and also horizontally to the right. Another, smaller cluster of grapes is partially visible among the leaves to the right of the main cluster. In the lower right corner of the painted area, a larger, rectangular red seal is stamped. The paper is bordered at the top and bottom by a narrow band of dark brown fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern. This dark band is then bordered by a wider, light gold fabric with a woven, intricate floral or scroll pattern.

metadata.title: 墨齊(没倫紹等)筆　葡萄図|Grapes
metadata.artist: Bokusai 墨齊 (Motsurin Jōtō没倫紹等)

alt_text: An ink painting of a robed figure with a bowl, conjuring a dragon amidst swirling mist.
long_description: This vertical ink painting on a light-colored ground depicts a robed figure in the upper half, seemingly interacting with a dragon-like creature emerging from swirling mist below. The figure, positioned in the upper left, is shown in profile, facing towards the right. They wear loose, flowing robes rendered with broad, dark ink lines, and a simple cap or head covering. Their left hand holds a shallow, round bowl or dish, while their right arm is extended forward, with the hand open. The figure's posture suggests a leaning or kneeling position, with their gaze directed downwards. Below the figure, the composition transitions into a dynamic interplay of dark and light ink washes, forming dense, cloud-like or rock-like masses. From these swirling forms, a serpentine dragon-like creature emerges in the lower right quadrant. Its head, with visible eyes and a snout, is rendered with fine lines, and its body curves upwards and to the left, disappearing into the mist. The overall impression is one of movement and ethereal energy. In the lower left corner, two vertical characters are visible, rendered in dark ink. The central artwork is framed by a narrow dark blue border with gold patterns at the top and bottom, which is then surrounded by a wider, plain golden-brown border.

metadata.title: 雪村周継筆　費長房図|Daoist Master Fei Zhangfang with a Dragon

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a light-furred monkey hanging upside down from a bamboo stalk
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a monkey hanging from a bamboo stalk, set within a decorative scroll mounting. The central image features a light-furred monkey with a dark face, hands, and feet, suspended head-down from a thick bamboo stalk on the left side of the composition. Its long, slender tail is wrapped around the stalk above its head, providing support. The monkey's body is rendered with soft, feathery brushstrokes, giving it a fluffy appearance, while its face and extremities are defined with darker ink. To the right and behind the monkey, several other bamboo stalks rise vertically, some with dark, pointed leaves extending from their nodes. Lighter ink is used for some background bamboo, creating a sense of depth. A small, square red seal is visible near the bottom right corner of the central painting. The artwork is predominantly black ink on a light, aged paper background. The central painting is bordered by a dark blue fabric with gold floral patterns at the top and bottom, and green fabric with gold floral patterns along the sides.

metadata.title: 竹猿猴図 (Chikuenkō zu)|Gibbon and Bamboo

alt_text: Ink painting of a gnarled tree with grapes, bamboo, and a small animal at its base
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a gnarled tree trunk dominating the central composition. The tree, rendered in varying shades of black ink, extends from near the bottom edge to the top. Its textured bark shows deep crevices. In the upper half, branches with clusters of pine needles extend outwards. Intertwined with the tree are vines bearing numerous bunches of grapes, depicted as dark, round forms. A small, dark bird with a pointed beak is visible on the upper part of the tree trunk, facing right. Below, on the left side of the trunk and in the foreground, tall, slender bamboo stalks with pointed leaves rise vertically. At the very bottom, a small, furry animal, possibly a badger or similar rodent, is crouched near the base of the tree, partially obscured by the bamboo and sparse grass. Its head is lowered, appearing to sniff or dig at the ground. The background is a light, neutral tone, providing contrast to the dark ink work. The painting is framed by a green fabric border adorned with repeating gold patterns.

metadata.title: 松竹葡萄栗鼠図|소나무, 대나무, 포도, 그리고 다람쥐|Sonamu, daenamu, podo, geuligo dalamjwi|Pine, Bamboo, Grape, and Squirrel

alt_text: A large crowd of elaborately dressed figures gathers around a building with spectators, framed by decorative borders.
long_description: This artwork depicts a vibrant scene with a large gathering of people in an outdoor setting, framed by decorative borders at the top and bottom. The background is a plain, light brown or gold color, suggesting an open space. On the right side, a two-story wooden building with a dark, tiled roof stands. Numerous figures are visible within the building, looking out from both the upper and lower floors. On the lower floor, a man in a blue top and red pants sits on the edge, while others observe from behind a railing. The left and central portions of the image are dominated by a dense crowd of figures, all dressed in colorful, patterned robes of red, orange, green, blue, white, and black. Many wear elaborate headwear and have distinct hairstyles. Some figures appear to be performers or part of a procession, holding staffs, banners, and musical instruments, including a large drum and a stringed instrument. A prominent group of women in similar patterned robes is arranged in rows in the lower-center. The figures are depicted in various poses, standing, kneeling, and sitting, conveying a sense of activity and movement. In the bottom center, a low, dark, rectangular structure is visible, possibly a stage or platform. The top and bottom edges of the artwork feature a dark border adorned with intricate gold floral patterns.

metadata.title: 群舞図 (Gunbu zu)|People Dancing
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A dark, stout animal with a curled tail on a light scroll, framed by decorative borders
long_description: A vertical scroll painting features a dark, stout, four-legged animal, likely a dog or puppy, positioned in the lower center against a plain, light beige background. The animal is depicted in shades of dark gray and black, with lighter outlines that give it a soft, rounded appearance. It faces left, with its head lowered as if sniffing the ground. Its small, pointed ears are visible, and a single white dot with a dark pupil indicates an eye. The animal has short, thick legs and a tail that curls upwards and forwards over its back, featuring a small star-like pattern near its tip. The main panel of the painting is bordered on the top and bottom by a dark reddish-brown band with repeating gold floral or geometric motifs. The entire composition is framed by wider, gold-colored side borders, which also show faint patterns. A small, faint red seal or signature is visible in the lower right quadrant of the main panel, below the animal's hind legs.

metadata.title: 俵屋宗達工房　狗図|Puppy
metadata.artist: Studio of Tawaraya Sōtatsu 俵屋宗達工房

alt_text: Three vertical ink paintings depict a dark bird on a branch, a seated bearded man with a small dog, and two birds.
long_description:
Three vertical ink wash paintings are presented side-by-side on a light brown, speckled background with a gold-flecked border. The overall tone is muted, with shades of black, gray, and white against the light brown paper.

The left panel features a dark bird, possibly a crow, perched on a gnarled, leafless tree branch. The bird faces left, its body mostly dark with some lighter markings on its wings. The branch extends from the lower left, curving upwards and then horizontally, with a smaller branch extending to the right. The upper two-thirds of the panel are empty.

The central panel shows a seated, bearded man in profile, facing right. He wears dark robes with a lighter undergarment visible on his back and arm. He is hunched over, looking down at something in front of him. To his right, on a low, dark rectangular object, sits a small, fluffy white dog, also facing right. Below the man, on the ground, are two long, thin objects, one resembling a brush and the other a knife. The upper portion of this panel contains faint, wispy ink washes suggesting distant mountains or clouds. Two red seals are visible at the bottom left.

The right panel depicts two birds on a flat ground plane. The larger bird, a duck or goose, is in the foreground, facing right with its beak open. Its feathers are rendered with varying shades of gray, creating a patterned effect. Behind and slightly to the left of the larger bird is a smaller, lighter-colored bird, possibly a chick, facing left. In the upper right, several vertical, angular strokes suggest reeds or bamboo. Two red seals are visible at the bottom right.

metadata.title: 六祖・芦雁・叭々鳥図|Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of Zen, with Geese and Myna
metadata.medium: Set of three hanging scrolls; ink on paper

alt_text: Two vertical scroll paintings depict misty mountain landscapes with waterfalls, trees, a river, and a moon
long_description:
The image displays two vertical scroll paintings, presented side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll is mounted with a light blue-green brocade fabric at the top and bottom, featuring a repeating pattern of stylized floral or cloud motifs. A narrower band of gold-colored fabric with a subtle pattern separates the brocade from the central painted area. Two vertical gold-colored strips run down the upper brocade section of each scroll, with small horizontal bars.

The painted sections depict a continuous, misty mountain landscape. The left scroll features a tall, rugged mountain range on the left, partially obscured by mist. A waterfall cascades down the mountain's side into a body of water at the bottom. Scattered trees, some appearing snow-dusted, grow on the mountain slopes and along the water's edge. The water extends across the lower portion of the painting, with small landmasses or islands visible.

The right scroll continues the landscape, showing more mountains and trees. A prominent, pale circular form, resembling a moon, is visible in the upper-middle section, partially veiled by mist. Trees, some with reddish-brown foliage, are clustered on the mountain slopes and along the water. The water in the foreground reflects the pale sky. The overall color palette of the painted sections is muted, primarily shades of brown, gray, and pale green, with areas of white mist. The mounting fabrics provide a contrast with their more vibrant blue-green and gold tones.

metadata.title: 岩佐又兵衛筆　瀟湘八景図|Eight Views of Xiao and Xiang
metadata.artist: Iwasa Matabei (Iwasa Matabē) 岩佐又兵衛
metadata.medium: Diptych of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A seated figure in robes holding prayer beads, with calligraphy above, on a scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll featuring a central painted image and calligraphy on a light tan paper, framed by decorative borders. The outermost borders, at the top and bottom, are a light sage green fabric with a repeating gold floral or geometric pattern. Inside these, a narrower, dark brown border with a subtle gold scrollwork pattern frames the central tan paper. The main subject is a seated, bald figure positioned in the lower half of the tan paper. The figure is depicted in profile, facing towards the upper right, with a calm expression. He wears a loose, long-sleeved robe in a muted reddish-brown color. The sleeves and collar of the robe feature a decorative band of green with a gold patterned design. His hands are clasped together in front of his chest, holding a long string of small, white, spherical beads. Where his hands meet, the robe has a section with a more intricate pattern of green and gold, possibly depicting stylized flowers or leaves. The figure's legs are folded beneath him, obscured by the voluminous robe. Above the seated figure, occupying the upper half of the tan paper, are several columns of black ink calligraphy. The writing is in a flowing, vertical script, arranged from right to left. The first column on the far right is shorter, followed by three longer columns of text, and a final shorter column on the far left. The paper itself shows some subtle discoloration consistent with age, but the image and text remain clear.

metadata.title: 僧正遍照「道蘊本」三十六歌仙絵巻断簡|Archbishop Henjō (Sōjō Henjō zu), from the Dōon Version of the Thirty-Six Poetic Immortals
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll: ink, color, gold and silver on paper

alt_text: A person in a patterned kimono and white head covering holds a fan on a scroll with decorative borders.
long_description: A tall, vertical artwork, likely a scroll, features a central rectangular panel framed by decorative borders. The central panel is a plain, light tan color. In the lower half of this central panel, a standing person is depicted, facing slightly to the right with their head turned towards the left. They wear a light blue-grey kimono adorned with large, colorful floral patterns in shades of red, pink, green, blue, and yellow. A dark obi (sash) with gold patterns is tied around their waist. Their head is covered by a white hood or scarf that frames their face. The person holds a yellow fan with a prominent red circle and black lines in their right hand, held at chest level. Their left hand holds a small, dark, indistinct object. The central panel is surrounded by wide, patterned borders. These borders feature a textured, golden-brown background with scattered green trees, bushes, and subtle landscape elements, suggesting hills or mountains. The patterns are more dense and detailed at the top and bottom edges of the scroll.

metadata.title: 舞妓図|Dancer with a Fan
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Three vertical scroll paintings depict a woman, a man, and another woman in traditional attire
long_description: Three vertical scroll paintings are presented side-by-side against a dark background. Each scroll features a light brown fabric mounting at the top and bottom, with a lighter, off-white border framing the central painted area. The central painted area of each scroll is a muted greenish-gray, with subtle variations in tone. The figures are depicted in the lower half of each scroll, leaving ample empty space above them. The left scroll shows a woman seated on a red cushion, facing right. She wears a green outer robe with intricate patterns, a white undergarment, and a red skirt. Her long black hair is pulled back, and her face is pale. To her right, on the ground, are a small brown pot and a woven basket containing a white object. Faint, dark gray cloud-like shapes are visible in the upper left background. The middle scroll features a man reclining on a patterned blue and white cushion, facing left. He wears a white robe, a black cap, and a red sash. His right arm is bent, resting on a white pillow, and he holds an open book or scroll in his left hand. A red rectangular object with some writing is on the ground in front of him. Faint, dark gray cloud-like shapes are visible in the upper background. The right scroll depicts a woman seated on a red cushion, facing left. She wears a multi-layered robe with a red skirt, a gray patterned outer layer, and a green sash. Her long black hair is pulled back, and her face is pale. To her left, a faint, light gray waterfall or cascade is depicted vertically in the background.

metadata.title: 人麻呂 (中)  ・ 伊勢 (右) ・ 小町 (左) 図|Portraits of Three Famous Poets: Hitomaro (M) ・Ise (R) ・Komachi (L)
metadata.artist: Tosa Mitsunari 土佐光成|Tosa Mitsutaka 土佐光高|Tosa Mitsuoki 土佐光起
metadata.medium: Triptych of hanging scrolls: ink, color, gold and silver on silk

alt_text: A vertical painting depicts white, pink, and reddish-orange peonies with green leaves on a light background
long_description: This vertical painting, presented as a hanging scroll, features a vibrant cluster of peonies and foliage against a plain, light beige background. The main floral arrangement occupies the lower right and central portions of the composition, extending upwards and slightly to the left. At the top right, a red circular seal with black characters is visible. The largest flowers are at the top center, depicted in white with subtle gray shading, their petals appearing full and layered. Below these, to the left, are several light pink peonies, also with multiple petals and delicate shading. Further to the right and slightly below the pink flowers, a group of reddish-orange peonies adds a strong color contrast. Throughout the composition, dark green leaves with varying shades of gray and brown are interspersed among the blossoms, creating a dense, organic feel. Some slender, dark green stems and leaves extend downwards from the main cluster towards the bottom edge. The painting is framed by a wide, patterned border of teal fabric with gold-colored motifs, and narrow gold-colored strips at the top and bottom edges of the painted area.

metadata.title: 牡丹図 (Botan zu)|Peonies
metadata.medium: Panel of a folding screen remounted as a hanging scroll; ink, color and gold on paper

alt_text: Two ink wash paintings depicting a seated figure with a broom and a standing figure with a scroll
long_description:
This artwork consists of two vertical ink wash paintings, presented side-by-side. Each painting features a single figure rendered in shades of black, grey, and light reddish-brown on a light, off-white paper background. The top and bottom of each scroll have decorative borders with a black background and repeating gold floral patterns.

The left scroll depicts a figure seated on a large, dark, irregular rock-like form, seen from the back and slightly turned to the right. The figure has short, dark hair and wears a loose, dark robe. A large, round object, possibly a straw hat or gourd, with a dark center and lighter, reddish-brown outer sections, is carried on their back. A dark-bristled broom rests on the ground near the bottom right of the figure. Faint, dark calligraphic text and two red square seals are visible in the upper left area of the scroll.

The right scroll shows a standing figure, facing towards the left, with their body slightly angled towards the viewer. This figure has a round face, a prominent nose, and dark, disheveled hair. They wear a loose, dark robe, with lighter undergarments visible at the chest. A light-colored scroll or staff is tucked behind their back, extending upwards. A small, light-colored pouch hangs from their waist. Their feet, wearing simple sandals, are visible as they stand on or near a dark, irregular rock-like form. Faint, dark calligraphic text and two red square seals are visible in the upper right area of this scroll.

metadata.title: 与謝蕪村筆　寒山拾得図|Hanshan and Shide
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical ink wash landscape scroll painting shows towering mountains, misty valleys, dense trees, waterfalls, and small buildings.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting, rendered primarily in ink wash with subtle green and brown accents, depicts a grand mountainous landscape. The upper third of the composition features towering, craggy mountains, their peaks fading into a soft, misty background, suggesting great depth. In the upper right quadrant, a block of vertical text in black ink is visible, accompanied by several red seals. The text reads: "右有書 一常懷抱此景 溪水門道遙 追遠松枝手 看元處中 中而生 小可此不 庚午年". Below the highest peaks, the landscape becomes more densely vegetated. Numerous trees with dark green and brown foliage cling to the steep slopes and cluster along the banks of a winding river or lake. Several waterfalls cascade down the mountainsides, their white streaks contrasting with the darker rock. Small, traditional-style buildings with tiled roofs are nestled within the landscape; one is perched on a cliff edge in the middle ground, and another is situated closer to the water on the right. The lower portion of the painting features the calm body of water and more rocky, tree-covered terrain. The overall palette is dominated by shades of grey and black ink, with muted greens for foliage and light browns for the structures. The painting is bordered by a patterned gold fabric.

metadata.title: 浅絳山水図 (Senkō sansui zu)|Landscape in Light Colors
metadata.artist: Murase Kōtei 村瀨栲亭|Aoki Shukuya 青木夙夜
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A person on a brown horse traverses a rocky, mountainous path with a large, gnarled tree above.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting depicting a mountainous landscape with a figure on horseback. In the upper section, a large, gnarled tree with dense, reddish-brown foliage dominates the left side, its branches extending towards the center. Below and to its right, faint, misty areas suggest distant valleys or water. Rocky outcrops with dark grey and white accents are visible on both sides of the upper and middle sections, defining the terrain. The middle and lower sections feature a person riding a brown horse. The person, positioned in the lower-middle, is hunched forward, wearing a muted green or grey garment and a cap. They are seated on a white saddle or blanket on the horse's back. The horse, light brown with a lighter mane and tail, walks on a winding path that descends from the upper right towards the lower left. The ground is textured with short, brush-like strokes in shades of brown and light yellow, indicating dry vegetation or scrub. In the upper left corner, vertical calligraphic text in black ink is present, accompanied by a small red seal below it. The overall color palette is muted, featuring various shades of brown, grey, and light yellow, with the reddish accents of the tree providing a subtle contrast.

metadata.title: 松村呉春筆　渓山探薬図|Herb Gatherer in the Mountains
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a mountainous landscape with a waterfall, pine trees, and calligraphy on a vertical scroll.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape. Tall, pointed peaks rise towards the top, rendered in light gray washes and darker ink outlines. In the upper right quadrant, black calligraphic text is arranged in vertical lines, followed by a red square seal. The text reads: "天涯海角共此時，萬里風煙入畫圖。辛丑秋日寫於滬上，王震。" On the left side, a white waterfall descends from a high point, flowing over a dark, steep cliff face. The water appears as a smooth, light stream against the textured rock. Numerous trees, including several large pine trees with dark, dense needles and lighter, gnarled trunks, are positioned on the mountain slopes, primarily on the right side and in the middle ground. Smaller clusters of trees and dotted foliage are scattered throughout the rocky terrain, which is rendered with varied ink strokes to suggest texture and form. The lower portion of the painting shows the base of the mountains meeting a lighter, flatter area, with a few small rocks and sparse vegetation. The artwork is executed in a monochromatic palette of black ink in various shades and washes on a light, off-white paper, with subtle hints of light brown or ochre visible in some of the foliage and rock details.

metadata.title: 釧雲泉筆　觀瀑山水図|Viewing a Waterfall
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A tall ink wash scroll painting depicts a towering central mountain peak surrounded by smaller, tree-covered mountains and scattered structures.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical ink wash painting, presented as a scroll. The central image is a tall, narrow landscape dominated by mountains rendered in various shades of black ink on a light, off-white background. In the upper half, a prominent, towering mountain peak rises centrally, its contours defined by curved, layered brushstrokes. To its left, a smaller, rounded peak is visible, and to its right, another peak with a more textured surface. Calligraphy, consisting of several vertical lines of characters, is positioned on the left side of the central peak. The middle section features a dense arrangement of mountains and hills. Many of these slopes are covered with numerous small, dark dots, suggesting dense foliage or trees. Scattered among these hills are small, simple structures, possibly houses or temples, indicated by a few lines and dots. The lower third of the painting depicts a valley or lower mountain slopes. Here, clusters of taller, slender trees, possibly bamboo, are visible, rendered with vertical brushstrokes. The ground is textured with many small dots and lines, indicating terrain and vegetation. More small structures are nestled within these lower areas. The overall impression is one of a vast, rugged, and densely vegetated mountain range. The painting is framed by a light beige border, which is then mounted on a dark blue fabric with a subtle pattern of dark blue, stylized leaf or cloud shapes and small, reddish-pink floral accents at the very top and bottom edges of the scroll.

metadata.title: 「青山雨歇」|Green Mountains as the Rain Ceases

alt_text: Two vertical panels show a serene landscape with mountains, water, boats, buildings, and small figures.
