long_description: This artwork consists of two vertical panels, presented side-by-side, depicting a continuous, expansive landscape scene. The background of both panels features a light gold sky with swirling, cloud-like patterns. The overall color palette includes muted greens, blues, and grays for the landscape elements, contrasted with the vibrant gold of the sky and the specific colors of the buildings and figures.The left panel, from top to bottom, shows a series of green and gray mountains receding into the distance, with a body of water in the foreground. Several small boats with figures are scattered across the water. In the middle ground, islands covered with green trees and rocky outcrops emerge from the water. Towards the bottom, a thatched-roof building is nestled among lush green trees on the shore. Several small figures are gathered around the building and on the adjacent land, some appearing to converse. A larger boat with a dark sail and multiple figures is positioned close to the shore.The right panel continues the landscape. In the upper portion, distant, hazy mountains line the horizon above a vast expanse of water, where a single small boat sails. The lower half is dominated by a large, multi-story building with a prominent blue tiled roof and red accents. This elaborate structure extends over the water, supported by a white stone base. Figures are visible on the building's balconies and on the rocky shore below. Several small boats are moored near the building, and more figures are seen on the land, some standing and others seated.

metadata.title: 狩野伊川院栄信筆 岳陽楼図|Yueyang Pavilion
metadata.artist: Kanō Isen’in Naganobu 狩野伊川院栄信
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll features black calligraphic text above a monochrome landscape painting of mountains, water, and trees
long_description: The image displays a vertical scroll, primarily composed of light beige paper mounted on a dark green fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern. The top half of the paper is filled with vertical lines of black calligraphic text, written in varying sizes and styles. Some characters are larger and bolder, while others are finer. Several red seal impressions, typically square or rectangular, are interspersed among the lines of text and below them. Below the text, the bottom half of the scroll depicts a monochrome landscape painting. On the left side, a tall, jagged mountain peak rises, rendered with washes of light gray and darker ink lines suggesting rocky textures. To its right, a series of smaller, rounded hills or mountains recede into the background, also in shades of gray and black. In the foreground, a body of water stretches horizontally across the lower part of the painting. On the right bank of this water, a prominent, gnarled tree with long, drooping branches extends over the water. Its foliage is depicted with loose, dark ink strokes. Below the tree, the bank is rendered with dark, textured ink washes, suggesting rocks or dense vegetation. The overall impression is a serene, misty landscape.

metadata.title: 澱川邂逅之図 (Yodogawa kaikō no zu)|Unexpected Meeting on the Yodo River
metadata.artist: Tanomura Chikuden 田能村竹田|Rai San’yō 頼山陽

alt_text: Two cranes with red crowns call amidst bamboo and snow on a vertical scroll painting
long_description: A vertical scroll painting depicts two cranes calling amidst bamboo and snow, set against a light yellowish-brown background. The painting is framed by a green fabric border with a repeating floral pattern and thin gold-brown strips. In the lower half, two large cranes stand prominently. Both have white bodies, long black necks, and black tail feathers. Each crane has a distinct red patch on its head. Their beaks are open and pointed upwards, suggesting they are calling. The crane on the left is slightly in front of the one on the right. Numerous bamboo stalks and leaves are scattered throughout the composition. In the foreground, bamboo appears in various sizes, some with delicate leaves. In the upper half, bamboo stalks and leaves are depicted with a lighter, almost white wash, suggesting they are covered in snow or frost. A faint, large circular shape, possibly a moon, is visible in the upper background, partially obscured by bamboo. Wavy lines in the middle ground might represent water or mist. The ground beneath the cranes is rendered with subtle ink washes, creating gentle slopes and shadows.

metadata.title: 田能村竹田筆  竹林双鶴図|Pair of Cranes in Bamboo Grove
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two vertical scrolls, one with pink and white peonies, the other with black calligraphy
long_description: Two vertical scrolls are displayed side-by-side. Both scrolls feature a light yellow-beige background and are framed by a blue border with a subtle patterned design, topped and bottomed with a narrow brown patterned band.The left scroll depicts a flowering plant, likely peonies, with multiple blossoms and green foliage. The plant has slender brown stems that branch upwards from the bottom. Several large, full blossoms are visible, with two prominent white flowers near the bottom center and three pink flowers positioned above them and to the right. The leaves are a vibrant green, clustered around the stems and flowers. A small red square seal is present in the lower left corner of the painted area.The right scroll is filled with vertical lines of black calligraphy. The characters are written in a fluid, cursive style, varying in size and stroke thickness, extending from the top to the bottom of the scroll. Two red square seals are visible within the calligraphy: one positioned approximately halfway down the scroll on the left side of the text, and another smaller one near the bottom right of the text.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.artist: Matsumura Keibun 松村景文|Rai San’yō 頼山陽
metadata.medium: Pair of hanging scrolls;  ink and color on silk

alt_text: Two vertical scrolls depict blue irises, birds, and water, with a kingfisher on the left and swallows on the right
long_description: The artwork consists of two vertical scroll paintings, presented side-by-side, each framed by a dark teal border with a subtle, repeating pattern. Both scrolls feature a light cream background and depict natural scenes with blue irises, birds, and water. The left scroll shows a kingfisher perched on a wooden post in light blue water. The bird has a blue back, orange chest, and white belly, with a long, dark beak pointed downwards. Ripples emanate from the post in the water. Behind the bird, a cluster of vibrant blue irises with long green leaves grows from a light green and brown mound. Another smaller wooden post is partially submerged in the water to the right of the kingfisher. At the bottom, there are two red square seals and some black calligraphic text. The right scroll features two swallows and a similar cluster of blue irises. One swallow, with dark plumage and a reddish throat, is depicted in flight, soaring towards the left in the upper portion of the scroll. Below it, another swallow, identical in appearance, perches on a light green and brown mound, its beak open as if vocalizing. This mound also supports a dense cluster of blue irises with green leaves. Light blue water with gentle ripples is visible at the bottom of the scroll. Similar to the left scroll, two red square seals and black calligraphic text are present at the bottom.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Diptych of hanging scrolls; ink and color on silk

alt_text: An ink wash painting shows a crowded scene of human and monstrous figures in a mountainous landscape.
long_description:
A vertical ink wash painting, rendered in black ink on light-colored paper, depicts a dense and dynamic gathering of diverse figures within a mountainous landscape. In the upper right, a small village with thatched-roof huts is nestled into a hillside, with mountains rising in the background. Sparse trees are visible near the village. To the right of the village, vertical black ink text is present, followed by two red square seals.

The upper-mid section features several large figures. On the left, a spiky-haired, round-faced figure with a wide grin sits, looking towards a bearded, human-like figure with a prominent nose and open mouth, who is seated at a low table with an open book. To their right, another figure with a covered head reads from a small book, while an adjacent figure holds a large fan.

Below this central group, the scene becomes more crowded and chaotic. A large, round-eyed, whiskered creature with a beak-like mouth is on the far left. Further right, a figure rides a small, shaggy animal. Numerous other figures, some with animalistic features like beaks or horns, are scattered throughout, engaged in various activities, including looking at books or scrolls. The lowest part of the image shows smaller figures, some appearing as children or imps, amidst swirling lines that suggest water or clouds. A bird-like creature is also visible at the very bottom right. The figures are rendered with expressive brushstrokes, varying in thickness and intensity.

metadata.title: 高井鴻山筆　妖怪図|Demons and Monsters

alt_text: A serene figure with a halo is seated on a rocky outcrop, surrounded by dense bamboo foliage, in an ink wash painting.
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting depicts a serene figure seated on a craggy rock formation, surrounded by bamboo. The figure, positioned slightly below the center, wears flowing robes and a tall headdress, with hands clasped in front. A large, luminous circular halo glows behind the figure's head. The rock formation, rendered with dark, textured brushstrokes, extends into a calm body of water at the bottom. A small, dark object rests on the water's surface near the base of the rock. Behind the figure and the rock, a dense grove of bamboo shoots with delicate leaves fills the upper two-thirds of the painting, extending towards the top edge. The background is a light, misty wash, creating a sense of depth. In the upper right corner, a column of vertical text in black ink is visible, with two small red square seals below it. The overall palette consists of various shades of black, gray, and sepia tones, characteristic of traditional ink wash art.

metadata.title: 天野方壷筆　竹林観世音図 |Kannon in a Bamboo Grove
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and gold on silk

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicts a lush, cloud-shrouded mountainous landscape with trees, waterfalls, and small buildings.
long_description: A vertical scroll painting presents a detailed mountainous landscape, rendered in a traditional style with ink and color. The composition is divided into several tiers by swirling white clouds that obscure parts of the mountains. At the top, a large, prominent green mountain peak dominates the upper right, with smaller peaks receding into the distance on the left. A block of black text, arranged in vertical columns, is visible in the upper left corner, accompanied by several red seal marks. Below the text, more green mountains emerge from the clouds, dotted with dark green trees, some with reddish-pink foliage. Waterfalls cascade down the mountain slopes, appearing as thin white lines. In the middle ground, a multi-tiered pagoda-like structure with a pointed roof is nestled among the trees on a mountain slope. Further down, a series of pavilions with dark roofs and light-colored walls are connected by bridges over a stream or river. Small figures can be seen near these structures and on paths. The lower section features more rugged green and brown mountains, dense trees, and a body of water with visible rocks. The overall color palette is dominated by various shades of green and brown for the mountains and trees, accented by white clouds, red and pink foliage, and the dark ink of the text and outlines. The painting is framed by a light beige border and a wider teal-colored silk mounting with a subtle patterned texture.

metadata.title: 白雲紅樹 (Hakuun kōju)|White Clouds and Crimson Trees
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A horizontal scroll depicting a procession of various green, pink, and orange mythical creatures.
long_description: A horizontal scroll features a procession of fantastical creatures on a light, aged paper background. From the left, a partially visible green, spotted, frog-like creature is depicted. To its right, a pale pink, skeletal-looking figure with red outlines and small horns or bumps on its head appears to be running, holding a thin red string. Below this figure, a green, frog-like creature wearing a black hat rides on the back of a larger, light green, turtle-like creature with a patterned shell and a long, reddish-brown, hairy tail. The frog-like rider holds reins. Above these, a large, green, human-like figure with a black hat, a long nose, and a red tongue runs to the right. This figure wears a blue garment and has red ribbons or flame-like elements emanating from its head. Further to the right, a prominent winged creature with an orange-brown feathered body, green legs, and a human-like face runs forward. Fiery red elements surround its head and hands, and a long, dark green ribbon flows dynamically behind it. The scroll ends on the far right with a vertical strip of light yellow, speckled paper.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A vertical scroll painting depicting sixteen seated figures, mostly deities, arranged hierarchically on a gold background.
long_description: This vertical scroll painting features sixteen figures arranged hierarchically on a gold background, framed by a narrow, ornate gold border. At the very top, a red-skinned figure with outstretched arms floats on a white cloud-like base. Below this, a light-skinned figure with a dark halo is seated in a meditative pose on a pink and blue lotus pedestal. The main composition consists of five rows of seated figures. The first four rows each contain three figures, while the bottom row has two figures on the left and one on the right, making a total of fourteen figures in this section. All figures in these rows are seated on lotus pedestals, which vary in color from pink and red to blue and green. Each figure has a dark halo behind their head. The figures display a range of skin tones, including dark brown, light brown, and white. Their garments are rendered in various colors such as red, white, blue, and green. Some figures wear elaborate crowns or headpieces, while others have simpler hair arrangements. Hand gestures and objects held by the figures also vary. For example, some figures hold small vessels or have hands in specific mudras. The figure at the bottom right is distinct, depicted with dark skin, seated on a multi-tiered red and gold pedestal, and surrounded by a red, flame-like aura. The overall impression is one of a structured assembly of divine or revered beings.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, and gold on silk

alt_text: A figure holding a sword and lotus sits atop a fierce, stylized lion-like creature in a vertical scroll
long_description:
This vertical scroll painting depicts a central figure seated on a large, stylized lion-like creature against a plain, muted background. The figure, positioned in the upper half of the composition, has light skin and dark hair styled in a series of dark, rounded forms. They wear white robes with green and gold accents, adorned with multiple necklaces and armbands. In their right hand, they hold a slender blue sword pointing upwards, while their left hand holds a blue lotus flower with its stem extending downwards. A circular halo of light blue and yellow light surrounds the figure's upper body and head.

Below the figure, the large, brown lion-like creature stands on all fours. It has a dark green mane that frames its head and extends down its back, and a matching dark green tail. The creature's face is depicted with a fierce expression, featuring a wide-open mouth revealing a red tongue and white fangs, and yellow eyes with red pupils. It wears a red collar adorned with gold medallions and a patterned saddle cloth in shades of blue, white, and gold. Each of its four feet rests on a blue and gold lotus-like pad. The main background is a plain olive-green, and the entire painting is framed by ornate brown borders with intricate gold patterns.

metadata.title: 五髪文殊菩薩像|The Bodhisattva Five-Topknot Monju (Manjushri) (Gokei Monju Bosatsu zō)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gofun, gold pigment, and kirikane (cut gold leaf) on silk

alt_text: A central seated figure with a halo, flanked by two standing figures, all on a gold background.
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring three figures against a gold background, framed by a light brown border. A large central figure is seated in a meditative pose, facing forward. This figure has dark hair, a light-colored face, and wears flowing, light-colored robes with subtle gold patterns. A circular gold halo surrounds the head, and a larger, fainter gold aura surrounds the body. The figure's right hand is raised slightly, palm outward, while the left hand rests in the lap, holding a small, dark, cylindrical object. The central figure sits on an elaborate, multi-tiered pedestal or throne, primarily red and gold with intricate patterns and decorative elements. To the left and right of the central figure, two smaller standing figures are positioned, facing slightly inward. Both wear elaborate, patterned robes in shades of gold, red, and green, with long sleeves and flowing sashes. Each standing figure has a circular gold halo behind their head and holds a long, slender staff-like object. The figure on the left has a small white disc above their left shoulder, while the figure on the right has a small red disc above their right shoulder. Above the central figure, a decorative red and gold canopy-like structure hangs, adorned with multiple strands of small, bead-like elements. The top and bottom edges of the main gold background feature a horizontal band of green fabric with a repeating floral or geometric pattern.

metadata.title: 薬師三尊|Triad of the Medicine Master Buddha Yakushi (Bhaisajya Buddha)
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, metallic paint, and kirikane (cut gold) on silk

alt_text: Two figures in a boat on a river beneath a moonlit sky with mountains and trees
long_description: The artwork is a vertical ink wash painting, predominantly in muted tones of sepia, grey, and black, depicting a moonlit river landscape. The composition is arranged vertically, with a large body of water dominating the lower two-thirds. In the upper left quadrant, a faint, pale circular moon is visible against a slightly lighter, hazy sky. To the right of the moon, a dark, imposing cliff face descends from the top edge, its surface textured with rugged lines. Gnarled, dark trees with intricate branches and hanging, moss-like foliage cling to the cliff face, extending towards the center. Below the cliff and across the upper mid-ground, a wide expanse of water stretches into the distance. Hazy, dark outlines of distant mountains or hills are visible on the far bank, interspersed with sparse, dark, pointed trees. Several small, dark, indistinct shapes, possibly rocks or small islands, dot the water's surface in the mid-ground. In the lower right foreground, a small, dark-lined boat floats close to a rocky bank. Two figures are seated in the boat. The figure in the front is smaller, facing away from the viewer, with their back towards the larger figure. The larger figure, seated towards the stern, has a prominent beard and is looking towards the left. Both figures wear simple, light-colored robes. The rocky bank beneath the boat is rendered with dark, textured strokes and features some spiky, dark foliage. Additional clusters of similar spiky foliage are scattered along the bottom edge of the painting and sparsely across the water in the mid-ground. In the upper left corner, there is a vertical inscription in black characters, followed by two square red seals. The visible characters of the inscription include "辛卯".

metadata.title: 明　葉廣　月下漁夫圖　軸|Fisherman viewing the moon
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A painting of a gnarled pine tree with several small birds perched on its branches, beside rocky cliffs and a waterfall
long_description: The painting depicts a natural landscape dominated by a large, gnarled pine tree on the left and center. Its thick, textured trunk, rendered in shades of brown and tan, twists upwards and branches out, supporting dense clusters of dark green pine needles. Several small birds are perched among the branches. One bird is near the top, partially obscured by foliage. Another, with light brown and white plumage, is in the upper-left, facing right. In the mid-left, two birds with reddish throats and blue-gray and white bodies face left. A fifth bird, similar in appearance, rests on a lower branch towards the bottom-center. To the right of the pine tree, a steep, rocky cliff face, depicted in gray and light brown washes, descends from the top. A small, white waterfall cascades down the rocks on the right side. In the lower-right, delicate, bare branches of a leafless bush extend from the base of the cliff. The background is a light, muted beige. In the upper-right corner, vertical black text with two red seals is visible.

metadata.title: 清 吳龍 仿古山水圖 冊|Paintings after old masters
metadata.medium: Album of fourteen leaves; ink and color on paper

alt_text: An ink wash landscape painting depicts thatched-roof buildings, a large pine tree, a stone wall, and figures
long_description: A horizontal ink wash painting in shades of black and grey on a light, aged paper background depicts a mountainous landscape with human structures and figures. On the far left, two thatched-roof buildings are nestled among trees. The foreground building has an open porch where a single figure sits, facing right, with a table in front. Behind it, another building is partially visible. The middle ground is dominated by a large, gnarled pine tree with dense needle-like foliage, its trunk curving upwards. Rocky terrain and sparse vegetation are visible around the tree. To the right of the pine tree, a stone wall or bridge-like structure with an archway extends horizontally. Beyond this wall, the landscape recedes into misty mountains and dense forests, rendered with lighter ink washes. In the lower right, two small figures walk on a path near the stone wall; one appears taller and holds a staff, while the other is smaller. A small, red, square seal is visible in the lower right corner of the painting.

metadata.title: 清 尤蔭 長嘯軒圖 卷|The Studio of Prolonged Soughing

alt_text: A traditional painting depicts people in a mountainous landscape with a river, trees, and a man on horseback
long_description: The painting depicts a vibrant landscape scene with multiple groups of figures. The background features rolling mountains with a prominent large green tree on the left side of the upper mountain and a smaller tree with reddish-orange leaves on the right. The mountains are rendered with shades of brown, green, and blue, suggesting rocky terrain and foliage.In the upper left corner, there is vertical text in black characters that reads "同我子德从 南亩田呈喜", with a red seal below it containing two characters.The mid-ground is divided by a winding river or path that flows from the upper left towards the lower right, passing under a small, arched bridge. On the left side of the river, a group of four figures is engaged in activity in a light green field. One figure kneels, two stand, and one is partially obscured by a small, leafy bush. They wear simple garments in blue, white, and brown.On the right side of the river, a woman in a long blue robe and a child in a red garment walk along a path. Behind them, another figure carries two baskets suspended from a pole across their shoulders. Further down and to the right, a man with a beard, dressed in a long red robe, rides a brown horse. He is accompanied by two other figures on foot: one holding a dark umbrella over the rider, and another walking beside the horse. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy tones of tan and brown for the ground and sky, with rich greens and blues for the foliage and water, and pops of red and white for the figures' clothing.

metadata.title: 清　費肇陽　豳風七月詩意圖　冊|Odes of the State of Bin: The Seventh Month
metadata.medium: Album of twenty leaves; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A man in a dark robe and red hat sits on a tiger-skin covered chair against a floral background
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a man seated centrally, facing forward. He has light skin, a thin mustache, and a small goatee. He wears a dark brown, long-sleeved robe with wide cuffs and a high collar. A long necklace of alternating red and green beads hangs around his neck, ending in a blue tassel with gold embroidery. His red hat has a small red finial at the top. The robe's cuffs and lower hem are adorned with intricate gold and blue embroidery. He is seated on a dark wooden chair covered with a tiger skin, visible by its orange and black stripes and clawed armrests. The background behind him is a light beige, featuring flowering branches with pink and white blossoms and green leaves, forming an arch. Flanking the central figure are two vertical panels with blue and white geometric patterns and small floral motifs. The chair rests on a dark, ornate wooden stand, which sits on a patterned floor or rug with repeating circular and square designs in shades of green, brown, and blue.

metadata.title: 清   佚名   官員朝袍端罩像   軸|Portrait of a man in court robes with fur surcoat
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: Two women in traditional attire, one standing with a long white object, the other seated at a writing desk
long_description: The artwork depicts a scene with two women in traditional attire, set against a light, speckled background. The main panel is on the right, with a partial panel visible on the far left. In the central panel, a woman stands on the left, facing right, dressed in a dark blue kimono with a white floral pattern and a green outer garment. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with dark ornaments. She holds a long, flowing white object, possibly a wig or a piece of fabric, which extends downwards. Several tiny, colorful figures, appearing to be children or small dolls, are depicted interacting with this white object, some climbing on it, others near its base. One small figure in red is visible near the standing woman's waist. To the right, another woman is seated on the floor, facing left, dressed in a teal-green kimono with a patterned hem and a purple inner garment. Her hair is also styled in an elaborate updo with golden, spiky ornaments. She holds a small white piece of paper in her hands, looking down at it. In front of her is a low, rectangular black table with a yellow surface patterned with red flowers. On the table are various items, including a red container, a brush, and other small objects. A fan lies on the floor near her. The background of this central panel is a light beige or cream color, with a fine, speckled texture. A red seal with black characters, appearing to read "春信" (Harunobu), is visible near the bottom left of this panel. To the far left, a portion of another panel is visible, showing the trunk of a light-colored tree with delicate pink blossoms. Below the tree, a red and blue object, possibly part of a palanquin or carriage, is partially visible. The right edge of the central panel is bordered by a vertical strip of gold-colored paper with a repeating geometric pattern in dark blue.

metadata.title: 豊原国周筆　当世庶民風俗画帖|Artisans, Beauties, and Annual Events
metadata.medium: Thirty paintings mounted as an accordion album; ink, color, gold and gold flecks on silk

alt_text: A blue-skinned figure sits centrally, adorned with gold, surrounded by many smaller figures and ornate patterns.
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a large, dark blue-skinned figure seated centrally, facing forward. The figure wears an elaborate gold crown, multiple gold necklaces, armbands, and bracelets. Its hands rest in a meditative gesture in its lap. Behind the figure's head is a gold halo, and a larger, flame-like red and gold aura frames its body. The figure is seated on a multi-tiered throne or lotus base, decorated with intricate red, gold, and black patterns. To the left and right of the central figure, at shoulder height, stand two smaller, light-skinned figures on lotus pedestals, also adorned. Below these, near the central figure's knees, are two small, dynamic figures, one appearing as a white lion-like creature on the left. The background immediately surrounding the central figure is dark blue or black, subtly patterned with gold. The entire composition is bordered by multiple rows of small, circular medallions, each containing a miniature, mostly gold-colored, seated figure against a red background. The dominant colors are dark blue, rich red, and gold, with black accents.

alt_text: A traditional landscape painting depicting a village nestled among misty mountains and cultivated fields
long_description: This horizontal landscape painting depicts a serene scene with mountains, mist, a village, and cultivated fields. The color palette is predominantly muted greens, grays, and browns, with touches of light blue and ochre, set against a light, unpainted background. In the upper half, a range of rolling mountains extends across the width of the painting. These mountains are rendered with textured brushstrokes, suggesting dense foliage or rocky surfaces, in shades of gray and muted green. Patches of light mist or clouds partially obscure the lower slopes and valleys, creating a sense of depth and atmosphere. Below the main mountain range, a wide expanse of light-colored mist or water stretches across the midground. Several smaller, tree-covered hills emerge from this misty layer, appearing as islands. In the foreground, on the left side, a village is depicted with numerous buildings. These structures feature dark, gabled roofs and light-colored walls, often enclosed within walled courtyards. Various trees with green and reddish-brown foliage are scattered throughout the village. A small, multi-tiered pagoda-like structure stands on the far left. To the right of the village, the landscape transitions into terraced fields, showing distinct rows of crops in muted green and brown. A cluster of tall, slender pine trees stands between the village and the fields, and a few smaller buildings are visible near the fields. In the upper right corner, black calligraphic text is present, accompanied by two red square seals. On the far right edge, a vertical strip of light brown paper with additional black calligraphic text is attached.

metadata.title: 清　余奏言、顏炳　望雲山莊後圖八景　卷|Rear View of the Mountain Villa for Watching Clouds
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper

alt_text: A central figure in a red robe sits on a platform in a temple, surrounded by many kneeling figures and trees.
long_description: A colorful painting depicts a religious scene with a central figure and numerous attendants, set within a landscape featuring a building. In the center, a large, multi-tiered wooden building with a red roof and blue and green panels houses a figure with light skin and a red robe, seated cross-legged on a raised platform, facing forward. This central figure has a halo around its head. Several figures in yellow robes are seated on the platform around the central figure, some kneeling, some cross-legged, all facing inward. To the right of the building, a large group of figures in yellow robes stands or kneels on a lower platform, also facing left towards the central figure. The ground is yellow-brown, with several green trees with dark trunks. One tree on the left has small pink flowers. A white, ornate staircase leads up to the building from the foreground. A dark blue sky is visible above the building and trees. The bottom section of the image contains multiple lines of text in an unknown script, appearing on a light yellow background.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Accordion-fold album (Burmese: parabaik), watercolors, ink and gold on mulberry bark paper, with tooled leather boards

alt_text: Oil painting of a dark-skinned man with short hair, looking forward, against a muted background.
long_description: The painting is a portrait of a dark-skinned man, depicted from the chest up, against a muted, dark background. The man's head is slightly turned to his left, and his gaze is directed forward, meeting the viewer's eye. He has short, dark, curly hair and a short, dark beard and mustache. His facial features include a broad nose and full lips. Strong light illuminates the left side of his face and shoulder, creating deep shadows on the right side of his face and body. His bare shoulders and upper chest are rendered in rich brown tones, but the painting appears unfinished below the shoulders, revealing lighter, unpainted canvas or underpainting with visible brushstrokes. The background is a blend of dark brown and grey, darker on the left and gradually lightening towards the right, providing a somber contrast to the figure.

metadata.title: Bust-Length Study of a Man
metadata.medium: Oil on paper, laid down on canvas

alt_text: Intricately detailed line drawing of an architectural column with a capital, featuring figures and decorative motifs.
long_description: The image is a monochrome line drawing depicting a highly ornate architectural column and its capital, rendered in fine black lines on a light-colored, plain background. The column is positioned on the left side of the vertical page, leaving the right half mostly blank. The capital, at the top, consists of multiple horizontal bands of intricate decoration. The uppermost band features a series of small, standing figures, some appearing to hold objects or make gestures, separated by architectural elements. Below this, a band of repeating geometric or floral motifs is visible. The central feature of the capital is a large, stylized face, possibly a lion or mythical creature, with wide, staring eyes, a prominent nose, and a wide mouth, flanked on either side by a volute resembling an elephant's head. Further decorative bands with repeating patterns are beneath this central face. The column shaft extends downwards from the capital. A large, standing figure is carved into the shaft, depicted with multiple arms, wearing an elaborate, tall crown, necklaces, and a draped garment. This figure holds various objects in its hands, including what appears to be a staff and a conch-like item. To the left of this main figure, a smaller, standing figure is also visible, similarly attired. The lower section of the column shaft continues with more decorative bands and smaller architectural niches, one of which contains a tiny, standing figure.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and wash on J. Whatman paper watermarked 1798

alt_text: Intricate line drawing of a highly decorated architectural column featuring figures, animals, and ornate motifs.
long_description: The image is a detailed black-and-white line drawing of a tall, ornate architectural column, rendered in black ink on light-colored paper. The column is depicted vertically, filling most of the frame, with blank paper visible to the right. The upper section of the column, the capital, features two large, stylized lion-like creatures (yalis) with open mouths, prominent fangs, and elaborate manes, facing outwards from the column. Above them are horizontal bands of intricate floral and geometric patterns, with some sections appearing unfinished. One upper panel shows a bird-like creature. Below the capital, the column shaft is divided into multiple vertical panels and horizontal registers. The upper part of the shaft includes smaller figures within niches; one central niche shows a dancing figure with multiple arms. Further down, the column widens slightly. On the left, a tall, standing figure with an elaborate headdress and multiple arms holds various objects. On the right, a seated figure with a similar headdress and multiple arms is depicted riding on the back of a large, decorated elephant. The elephant is adorned with patterns. Below the elephant, another seated figure is visible. The lower part of the column features more horizontal bands of intricate carvings, including smaller figures in various poses, some appearing to be musicians or dancers. The very bottom shows a base with multiple layers of geometric and floral designs. The entire drawing is characterized by fine lines and dense ornamentation, depicting a complex architectural element.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and wash on J. Whatman paper watermarked 1798

alt_text: Detailed line drawing of an ornate architectural column featuring deities, figures, and decorative motifs
long_description: A black and white line drawing depicts a highly ornate architectural column, rendered with intricate detail on a light-colored paper. The column is presented vertically, filling most of the frame. The uppermost section features multiple horizontal bands of carvings, including small figures, geometric patterns, and a prominent central stylized lion-like face (kirtimukha) with wide eyes and a detailed mane, flanked by smaller decorative elements. Below this, further bands of repeating patterns, such as small arches and floral motifs, are visible. The middle section of the column narrows slightly and is densely decorated with both vertical and horizontal bands of carvings. A large, scrolling bracket extends outwards from the left side of the column. The lower middle section is dominated by three standing figures, likely deities, positioned centrally. They are adorned with elaborate headdresses, jewelry, and draped garments, with the central figure appearing slightly smaller and positioned between two larger figures. To the left of these, a single standing figure in profile, holding a round object, faces right. The base of the column is also richly decorated with smaller figures seated or standing within architectural niches, surrounded by various decorative patterns. The entire drawing showcases a dense and intricate style of ornamentation.

metadata.title: Untitled
metadata.medium: Ink and wash on J. Whatman paper watermarked 1798

alt_text: Detailed line drawing of an ornate architectural column featuring multiple tiers of figures, animals, and decorative motifs.
long_description: The image is a detailed, vertical line drawing of an ornate architectural column, rendered in black ink on a light, off-white background. The column is depicted from its elaborate capital down to its base, showcasing multiple tiers of figures, animals, and decorative architectural motifs. At the top, a large, stylized creature head, resembling a lion or mythical beast with an open mouth and fangs, projects from the capital, facing towards the left. This creature is part of an intricately carved bracket, adorned with swirling scrollwork and floral patterns. Below the capital, the main shaft of the column is divided into several horizontal registers and vertical panels. On the right side, a prominent depiction features a figure riding a rearing horse. He has a full, dark beard and mustache. His right hand is raised, with fingers near his chin or mouth, and his elbow rests on an unseen surface. He wears a dark brown jacket or coat over a muted blue or grey shirt or vest, with a hint of red visible at his collar. Strong, directional light comes from the upper left, illuminating the left side of his face and the brim of his hat, creating a sharp shadow of his head and hat on the light-colored wall behind him. The wall features vertical stripes or panels in alternating shades of pale blue and cream. A narrow, dark reddish-brown vertical element is visible along the far left edge of the background. The lower part of the man's body and the right side of the painting are largely in shadow, rendered in deep browns and muted tones. A stylized signature, resembling an "A" with a flourish, is visible in the bottom left corner of the artwork.

alt_text: Six children playing on a fan-shaped painting, set against a gold background with ornate borders
long_description: A fan-shaped painting is centrally positioned on a rectangular gold-colored background, which is framed by an elaborate gold border. The painting within the fan depicts six children engaged in various activities on a light gold ground. One child lies on their back in the center, while another child kneels over them, appearing to interact. To the left, a child sits, looking at a small, dark object and a brown rabbit-like toy. Another child kneels on the right, looking at a round, dark object. Two other children stand or crouch around the central figures. All children have similar hairstyles with shaved sides and a top knot. Their garments are in shades of white, red, green, and brown. A small red seal mark is visible on the right side of the fan. The rectangular background behind the fan is a solid, slightly darker gold. The surrounding border features intricate, repeating patterns of geometric shapes and stylized floral motifs in gold.

metadata.title: 唐子遊び図扇面|Chinese Boys at Play
metadata.medium: Folding fan mounted as a hanging scroll; ink, color, gold, and mica on paper

alt_text: A woman in a blue dress paints flowers, surrounded by art supplies and a floral arrangement
long_description: The image is a vertical oil painting depicting a woman in a dark, arched interior, engaged in painting. The woman is positioned slightly right of center, seated at a table. She wears a dark blue dress with light brown sleeves and a white lace collar. Her hair is dark and pulled back, and she looks directly forward with a neutral expression. Her right hand holds a small, light pink flower, while her left hand holds a wooden artist's palette with various paint colors and several paintbrushes. On the table in front of her, to the left, is an open book with a drawing of a flower on its visible page, resting on top of another closed, tan-colored book. Below these books, a piece of white lace or fabric with a floral pattern is spread out. To the left of the woman, a large bouquet of various flowers in shades of red, white, purple, and yellow is arranged in a dark vase. Some red flowers hang down from the top of the bouquet. To the right of the woman, a dark red curtain is draped, partially obscuring the upper right corner of the scene. On the table to her right, a single pink rose with a green stem and leaves lies next to a small white cup. A small butterfly with patterned wings is visible near the rose. In the dark background, behind the woman, a faint outline of an easel with a blank canvas is visible. The overall lighting is dim, with the foreground elements illuminated. The background is mostly dark brown and black.

alt_text: A man and woman in traditional robes interact on a gold background, with a partial figure on the left
long_description: The image depicts a scene with two main figures on a plain gold background, with a partial figure visible on the far left. In the center-right, a man is seated on a low, ornate, gold-colored stool. He has a shaved head with dark hair on the sides and is wearing a dark brown robe with a subtle pattern. He leans forward, looking towards the woman beside him. The woman is reclining on the ground, dressed in a green robe adorned with white floral patterns and red accents, particularly on the inner lining of her sleeves and hem. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate updo. She looks towards the man, with her left arm bent and resting on his upper arm or shoulder. A small, dark-handled sword or dagger with a red cord is visible near her right side, resting on the ground. To the left of the man, on the gold ground, are a few small, colorful objects, including red and green shapes that resemble dishes or cups. On the far left edge of the image, the lower torso and legs of another figure are partially visible, wearing a green robe with pink and white patterns. The gold background is largely unadorned, showing a vertical seam line roughly in the middle of the image. The far right edge features a vertical strip of gold with a textured, possibly speckled, appearance.

metadata.title: 男色秘戯図巻|Handscroll of Ten Homoerotic (Nanshoku) Scenes
metadata.medium: Handscroll; ink and colors on silk

alt_text: Still life painting of white and blue flowers in a vase, with grapes, peaches, and a cut melon on a stone ledge
long_description: A still life painting depicts a vibrant arrangement of flowers and fruits on a stone ledge against a dark brown background. In the upper left, a bouquet of white and light blue flowers, interspersed with green leaves and buds, is arranged in a clear, faceted glass vase with gold decorative elements. Delicate white flowers and green tendrils extend to the left, partially over a cluster of light green grapes. To the right of the grapes, three ripe peaches with blush-pink and yellow skins rest on a dark green leaf. Dominating the right side is a large, round, green-skinned melon, which has been cut open. Its vibrant orange flesh and numerous seeds are exposed, with several slices arranged around the main body. A small dark fly is visible on the cut surface of one melon piece. The fruits and vase are placed on a light brown stone ledge or table, which has a visible crack on its right side. A large, veined green leaf lies beneath the peaches, extending towards the viewer. The background is a plain, dark brown, providing a stark contrast to the colorful still life elements.

metadata.title: Still Life with a Vase of Flowers, Melon, Peaches, and Grapes
metadata.artist: Charlotte Eustache Sophie de Fuligny Damas, marquise de Grollier

alt_text: A woman in an elaborate kimono with a complex hairstyle, looking over her shoulder.
long_description: A full-length portrait depicts a woman standing, turned slightly to her right, looking back over her left shoulder. Her face is pale with dark eyebrows and red lips. Her black hair is styled high and wide, adorned with numerous gold, comb-like ornaments. She wears a dark-colored kimono with wide, flowing sleeves. The kimono is intricately patterned; the upper sections feature muted landscapes and figures, while the lower half is dominated by vivid, detailed scenes of hell. These scenes include numerous small figures in various states of torment, alongside red and orange flames, and demonic figures. The hem of the kimono is decorated with patterns in shades of green and blue. The background is a plain, light golden-brown color. A small vertical inscription in dark characters is visible on the right side of the background.

metadata.title: 地獄太夫|The Hell Courtesan
metadata.artist: Utagawa Kunisada II  二代歌川国貞
metadata.medium: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

alt_text: A detailed Japanese woodblock print depicts numerous figures harvesting tea leaves and processing them under thatched roofs
long_description: This horizontal artwork depicts a bustling scene of tea harvesting and processing, featuring numerous figures engaged in various tasks. The composition is divided by several thatched roof structures that extend diagonally from the top edges towards the center, creating a sense of depth and enclosure.On the left side, several women are shown amidst lush green tea bushes, meticulously picking leaves. They wear kimonos in shades of brown, orange, and blue, often with white or patterned head coverings. Below them, two men are seated on the ground, processing the harvested leaves. One man in a dark brown kimono holds a small bowl, while another in a blue patterned kimono works over a large, cylindrical container wrapped in bamboo, filled with green leaves. A second similar container sits nearby.In the central area, more women are actively picking leaves from the dense green bushes. A tall, slender pole supports one of the thatched roofs, and a young woman in a dark patterned kimono with a red sash peeks out from behind it, under the roof's edge.Towards the right, an open pathway leads away from the tea bushes. Two figures, both in blue kimonos, walk towards the right edge; one carries a small child on their back. In the lower right corner, two men appear to be involved in administrative duties. One man, standing in a blue striped kimono and a brown outer garment, holds a sheet of paper. Next to him, an older man kneels, opening a black lacquered box that contains several books or scrolls. The overall color palette includes various greens for the foliage, with earth tones, blues, browns, oranges, and purples for the clothing and structures. Some vertical script is visible in the lower right corner.

metadata.title: 宇治製茶之図|Illustrations of Uji Tea Production 宇治製茶之図 (Uji sei-cha no zu)
metadata.artist: Saitō Motonari 斎藤玄就|Monk Nindō Sōen 忍道宗延
metadata.medium: Handscroll of thirty-two sheets reformatted as a folding album (orihon)

alt_text: An ink wash painting depicts a mountainous landscape with dense forests, a waterfall, and traditional buildings
long_description: The artwork is an ink wash painting, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white on a light beige paper. The composition depicts a dense, rugged mountainous landscape. On the left, a prominent, rounded mountain face rises, characterized by textured brushstrokes that define its contours and crevices. To the right of this mountain, a deep valley is filled with a dense forest, where numerous trees are depicted with dark, fine lines for trunks and branches, and softer, lighter washes for their foliage. A waterfall cascades down the center of the image, appearing as a vertical streak of white against the darker trees and rocks, disappearing into the lower part of the valley. In the upper right quadrant, nestled within the mountains and trees, are several traditional buildings with multi-tiered, curved roofs, rendered in lighter tones. Further back, in the upper center and right, additional mountains recede into the distance, their forms softened by lighter ink washes, creating a sense of depth and atmospheric perspective. The overall scene conveys a secluded natural environment. On the right side of the paper, outside the main painted area, there is vertical calligraphy in black ink and several red square seals.

alt_text: Several figures gathered around a table under trees, with a bridge spanning a body of water below
long_description: This painting depicts an outdoor scene with multiple figures gathered under trees and a bridge in the foreground. The upper portion of the image features a light brown background, possibly sky or distant land, beneath a canopy of dark green trees with visible brown trunks. The texture of the painting shows extensive wear, with numerous small cracks and areas where paint has flaked off. In the mid-ground, a central group of five figures is arranged. Three figures are seated around a rectangular table. On the left side of the table, one figure wears a light-colored robe with green details, facing right, while another figure in a green robe sits beside them. On the right side of the table, a figure in a light brown robe and a dark hat faces left, with red accents on their lower body. The table holds various small objects, including green and light-colored items, and a small yellow object. Behind the central table, a yellow vase or pot is visible. To the right of the main group, two additional figures are seated on the ground or low platforms; one wears a pink garment, and the other a green and purple garment. The lower portion of the painting is dominated by a dark brown wooden bridge, characterized by a lattice-like structure of horizontal and diagonal beams. Beneath the bridge, a dark area, possibly water or land, is visible, with patches of blue and brown, indicating further deterioration of the artwork.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of an old man with a long white beard holding a small object
long_description: A tall, narrow scroll features an ink wash painting of an old man, framed by decorative borders. The outermost borders are a light gold fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern of stylized flowers and foliage. Inside this, a narrower band of light gold fabric displays a geometric lattice pattern. The central painting, rendered in shades of black and grey ink on a light, uncolored ground, depicts a man from the chest up, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center. He has a bald head with a dark topknot of hair at the back, prominent white eyebrows, and a long, flowing white beard that reaches his chest. His face shows visible wrinkles, suggesting age. He wears a loose-fitting robe with wide sleeves, outlined in dark ink and filled with lighter washes. His hands are clasped together in front of him, holding a small, light-colored, somewhat spherical object. A vertical column of black characters is visible on the right side of the painting, near the man's shoulder. The overall impression is one of a monochromatic portrait with delicate brushwork.

alt_text: A long procession of numerous small figures carrying elaborate palanquins, banners, and ceremonial objects.
long_description: A horizontal painting on a light brown background depicts a long, elaborate procession of numerous small figures and ornate objects, moving from left to right. The procession is arranged in two main, parallel lines across the canvas.In the upper line, starting from the left, a group of figures in varied robes of red, blue, green, and brown wear distinct hats. Some carry tall, multi-tiered, umbrella-like structures adorned with patterned fabrics in blue, white, and red. Following them is a large, green, domed palanquin or carriage, supported by multiple bearers. This is succeeded by more figures, some in white robes, and a rectangular, covered structure. The upper line culminates on the right with a very large, ornate red palanquin or carriage. This grand structure is richly decorated with gold and blue patterns and topped with a prominent, flaming, pearl-like ornament. It is carried by many figures and flanked by others holding tall poles with small flags or spear-like finials.The lower line, positioned below the upper, also begins on the left with figures carrying similar tiered, umbrella-like structures. Next are several figures holding tall, white, cylindrical lanterns or poles. Further to the right, a group of figures carries large, rectangular red banners, each displaying black characters. The figures throughout the procession are depicted with simple, stylized forms and minimal facial details. The overall color palette is composed of muted reds, blues, greens, browns, and whites against the plain, light brown ground.

alt_text: A large, golden-skinned figure with a green headdress sits amidst numerous smaller figures and mythical creatures
long_description: This highly detailed, colorful painting features a large central figure surrounded by numerous smaller figures and mythical creatures against a dark blue background. The central figure has a prominent, round, golden-skinned face with wide eyes and a small mouth. This figure wears an elaborate green, pointed headdress with gold accents and intricate gold and patterned clothing. It holds a slender, staff-like object in its right hand and sits upon a large, blue, dragon-like creature with red and gold details. Around the central figure, a multitude of smaller figures are depicted. Many are human-like, some with multiple arms or animalistic features, and several are shown riding various animals, including horses, deer, and other fantastical beasts. These smaller figures are arranged in dense clusters, some appearing to float on clouds, while others are positioned on stylized ground elements. The overall color palette is rich, dominated by shades of gold, red, blue, green, and brown, with intricate patterns and swirling cloud motifs filling the space. The composition is densely packed, creating a sense of depth and activity across the entire surface.
